entries.prompt:
冬の初めの晴れた朝、山あいの温泉町。石段の下の塩の湯だまりで、殻の欠けたヤドカリ・シオが湯治をしている。湯守が柄杓で湯を足す。「治るまで、動かさんことだ」。石段のいちばん上で、白いコートの男が木の堰に手を向けると、板が裂けて乳白色の熱湯が段々を落ちてくる。さくらは湯守を旅館の玄関へ押しこみ、シオを湯だまりに残して、一人で石段を駆け上がる。

男のささやき。「……そいつ抜きか。なら、忘れるのは、自分だな」。さくらは腰のポケットからペンを抜き、左の手のひらに「しお」と書く。両手を突き出すと、熱湯は見えない面で止まり、背丈の倍の渦巻く壁に積み上がる。押されて一段ずつ下がり、背中のすぐ後ろに湯だまり。さくらは左腕を横へ突き出す。湯樋にこびりついた白い湯の花が石から剥がれ飛び、前腕に叩きついて、いびつでひびだらけの籠手になる。

その拳を突き出すと、湯の壁が真ん中から白い結晶に固まり、縦にひびが走って左右へ崩れ落ちる。濡れた石段が、上の男までまっすぐ開く。籠手は白い粉になって崩れ、さくらは座りこむ。手のひらの粉を払うと、字が出てくる。「……これ、だれの、なまえ？」

一緒に旅をしている友達が手持ちで撮った記録。湯だまりの縁越しの低い広角、背中越しの煽り、湯樋すれすれを走る低空のカメラ、左肩越しに籠手と湯の壁を同じ画に入れる縦の構図、手のひらのマクロ。BGMなし。
entries.translated_prompt:
A clear morning at the beginning of winter in a mountain hot spring town. At the salt water pool below the stone steps, Shio, a hermit crab with a chipped shell, is bathing for healing. The bathkeeper adds water with a ladle. "Do not move until you are healed." At the top of the stone steps, a man in a white coat points his hand toward a wooden weir; the board splits, and milky-white hot water cascades down the steps. Sakura pushes the bathkeeper into the inn's entrance, leaves Shio in the pool, and runs up the stone steps alone.

The man whispers. "...Leaving that one behind? Then forgetting is my own task." Sakura pulls a pen from his waist pocket and writes "Shio" on his left palm. When he thrusts both hands out, the hot water stops against an invisible plane and piles up into a swirling wall twice his height. Pushed down step by step, the pool forms right behind his back. Sakura thrusts his left arm sideways. White steam flowers clinging to the water trough peel off the stone, slam onto his forearm, and become a distorted, cracked gauntlet.

When he punches forward, the wall of water crystallizes into white solid form in the middle, cracks run vertically, and it collapses left and right. The wet stone steps open straight up to the man above. The gauntlet crumbles into white powder, and Sakura sits down. As he brushes the powder off his palm, characters appear. "...Whose name is this?"

Recorded handheld by a friend traveling together. Low-angle wide shot over the edge of the pool, upward angle from behind, low-altitude camera running close to the water trough, vertical composition capturing the gauntlet and water wall in the same frame over the left shoulder, macro shot of the palm. No BGM.

entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt for Seedance 2.5 Flash depicting an action scene in a winter Japanese highland pasture, featuring characters Sakura and Shio battling hay rolls with magical crab shell armor.
entries.prompt:
冬の初めの霜の朝、日本の高原の放牧地。尾根に立つ白いコートの男が手を払うと、わら色の巨大な干し草ロールが霜を巻き上げて斜面を転がり落ちてくる。さくらは白く曇った殻のヤドカリ・シオを胸に抱き、力を使わずに横へ飛ぶ。柵で杭を打つ牧場の女性へ次のロール。「にげて!」。手を上げかけると、肩のシオの殻がぴしっときしむ。さくらは拳を握って下ろし、女性の腕を引いて小屋へ駆けこむ。

岩の陰で、男のささやき。「……使えよ。そいつの殻が、割れるまで」「……なら、あの小屋だ」。小屋の真上の尾根で、いちばん大きいロールが縁からはみ出して揺れる。迷うさくらの手から、シオが割れた柵の板へ下り、塩の粒で字を書く。「いいよ」。「……いいの? シオ」。シオが手首に乗ると、左の前腕が六角の格子の結晶の籠手に変わり、足もとの霜が輪になって吹き飛ぶ。

落ちてくるロールを掌底で止め、尾根へ弾き返す。男が片手で受け止め、斜面の途中で押し合い。さくらが一歩踏みこむと、男の靴が半歩下がり、ロールは干し草の雨になって弾ける。拳の上でシオの殻の縁が、初めて小さく欠けた。「……やすめば、なおる?」

一緒に旅をしている友達が手持ちで撮った記録。地面すれすれの煽り、横から並走する手持ち、望遠で縦一列に圧縮した押し合い、左肩越しに籠手とロールを同じ画に入れる縦の構図、殻と欠片のマクロ。BGMなし。
entries.translated_prompt:
A frosty morning at the start of winter, in a Japanese highland pasture. A man in a white coat standing on the ridge waves his hand, sending giant straw-colored hay rolls rolling down the slope, kicking up frost. Sakura holds Shio, a hermit crab with a cloudy white shell, to her chest and leaps sideways without using force. Another roll heads toward a ranch woman hammering stakes by the fence. "Run!" As she raises her hands, Shio's shell on her shoulder creaks sharply. Sakura clenches her fist, lowers it, grabs the woman's arm, and rushes into the cabin.

In the shadow of the rocks, the man whispers: "...Use it. Until that shell cracks." "...Then, that cabin." On the ridge directly above the cabin, the largest roll teeters over the edge. From Sakura's hesitant hand, Shio descends onto a broken fence plank and writes letters with grains of salt. "It's okay." "...Is it, Shio?" When Shio rests on her wrist, her left forearm transforms into a gauntlet of hexagonal lattice crystals, and the frost at her feet blows away in rings.

She stops the falling roll with her palm and bounces it back toward the ridge. The man catches it with one hand, pushing against it mid-slope. As Sakura steps forward, the man's shoes slip back half a step, and the roll bursts into a rain of hay. For the first time, the edge of Shio's shell on her fist chips slightly. "...If we rest, will it heal?"

Recorded handheld by a friend traveling together. Low-angle shots skimming the ground, handheld tracking from the side, telephoto compression of the push-up in a vertical line, vertical composition capturing both the gauntlet and the roll over the left shoulder, macro shots of the shell and fragments. No BGM.

entries.prompt:
15-second animated short, one continuous shot, soft misty pastel fairy-tale style matching <Picture 1>, NEOVO looks exactly as in <Picture 1> NEOVO: a small glowing creature with a round head, left half warm orange and right half cool blue, big round eyes, two thin antennae with fluffy feather tips (orange and blue), long flowing tail of shimmering orange, pink and blue threads. No arms, no legs. Face round, soft and natural. Setting: the Misty Land of Pebbles: glittering orange pebbles on the left, sparkly blue pebbles on the right, bare silvery trees in soft fog, warm peach light on one side and cool blue light on the other, floating sparkles. 
0–3s: NEOVO floats happily over the pebbles, tail swaying, then spots a big shiny bubble drifting nearby, eyes widen. 
3–6s: the orange half rushes toward the bubble while the blue half pulls back, NEOVO wobbles side to side in a tug of war with itself, then spins round like a spinning top, tail wrapping around into a fluffy cocoon with only eyes and antennae sticking out.

9–12s: the bubble pops into a shower of orange and blue sparkles, NEOVO's hair and tail puff up into a giant fluffy ball, then gently settle down, the orange and blue colors now swapped sides.

entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 30 seconds, vertical 9:16, night. A real-time in-engine story cutscene from a next-gen open-world crime video game. Seven shots, hard cuts only where marked. Original score. One short slow-motion beat on the final gunshot, everything else at normal speed.

CINEMATIC QUALITY (mandatory, applies to every shot of this video):
This must clearly look like a video game, not live action and not a movie. Real-time rendered in-engine cutscene from a AAA open-world crime game on current-gen consoles: game character models with slightly idealized, very clean skin, crisp rendered hair cards, glossy wet materials, ray-traced reflections on car paint and puddles, screen-space ambient occlusion in corners, bright saturated neon and practical lights, volumetric fog and steam rendered in clean layers, subtle bloom and lens flare from headlights. Slightly stylized game lighting where every light source is readable and every character pops from the background with a soft rim light. Game cutscene camera: smooth, deliberate, motivated moves, clean focus pulls, no film grain, no camcorder noise, no real-world skin blemishes. Medium and wide shots establish where we are. Inside, one open room: in the front half, long metal lab tables with glass flasks and condensers bubbling over burners and drifting steam; in the center, a metal chair with the woman taped to it and a small steel tray with one used syringe beside it; in the back right corner only, one single small 2x2 meter grow tent with a few cannabis plants under purple LED lights; a back door in the back left corner. The rest of the walls are bare wood. Clear open floor between the lab tables and the back door.

He drives straight ahead fast, both hands on the wheel at ten and two, the neon gas station sliding past the side window and washing pink light over his face. 0.5s: the phone lights up and buzzes, screen reads "UNKNOWN". 1.0s: he taps it once with his right thumb and puts the hand back on the wheel. 1.5s: the guard speaks through the speaker. 3.0s: the woman's slurred voice; his knuckles whiten on the wheel, his eyes narrow, his jaw tightens. 4.5s: the guard snaps and the call ends, screen goes dark. 5.0s: he answers quietly to the dead line, eyes on the road. 5.5s: he floors the gas, the engine roars, his body presses back into the seat as the car surges forward. entries.title: Roblox Style Weather Forecast
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a Roblox-style 3D weather forecast video using Seedance 2.5, including character geometry and animation guidelines.
entries.prompt:
EVERYONE HAS A WEATHER FORECAST. 

Style : Roblox Style 3D 

Generated with Seedance 2.5 on @frameo_ai 

#Madewithframeo

Try it with prompt : Art style: polished Roblox-style 3D game-avatar animation, combining classic chunky block-avatar proportions with detailed avatar customization. Use image1 for the broad, sturdy block silhouettes, and image2 for hairstyle variety, layered clothing, accessories, and expressive character styling. Apply a consistent cylinder-head and block-body design to all main characters.

CHARACTER GEOMETRY:
Heads are short, upright CYLINDERS with curved sides, flat circular tops and bottoms, and gently softened edges. Keep the head moderately sized above a much larger, substantial block body. Torso shapes are broad, thick rectangular boxes; arms and legs are chunky rectangular volumes with lightly beveled edges. Preserve the large, unmistakably blocky silhouette beneath clothing. Joints are discreet and integrated into the avatar.
Hands are simple rounded game-avatar hands with a subtle thumb shape and minimal finger definition, allowing basic gestures and object holding. Head tops are seamless, with no exposed studs, connector pegs, or assembly sockets.

FACES:
Use simple, flat cartoon facial graphics mapped onto the cylinder head: black dot or oval eyes, a few eyebrow strokes, and a clearly readable mouth shape. Select expressions according to each character's personality and the situation: neutral, happy, worried, annoyed, sad, confused, or surprised. Open mouths and visible teeth remain simple flat graphic shapes. Keep expressions bold and game-like, with no detailed facial anatomy. Expression changes use simple face-texture swaps at clear reaction beats.

HAIR, CLOTHING, AND MATERIALS:
Hair uses stylized sculpted sections with clear volume, broad grooves, and recognizable silhouettes. Clothing adds restrained three-dimensional detail over the block body: hoodie hoods, jacket collars, cuffs, pockets, layered hems, shoes, and accessories. Use simple seams and readable fabric textures while keeping the underlying rectangular forms prominent.
Give materials appropriate variation: softly matte skin surfaces, fabric-like clothing, sculpted hair, and subtle highlights on metal accessories. Maintain a clean digital game-avatar finish with moderate detail.

WORLD AND LIGHTING:
A colorful suburban game map with geometric houses and shops, square windows, lawns, roads, sidewalks, street lamps, playgrounds, and stylized trees. Use coherent environmental detail, cheerful colors, soft daylight, gentle ambient shading, and clear contact shadows. A polished in-game cutscene aesthetic.

MOVEMENT AND CAMERA:
Playful, slightly rigid game-avatar animation: chunky walk cycles, simple arm swings, quick turns, small jumps, and readable reaction poses. Allow basic shoulder, elbow, and knee movement while preserving the rigid block volumes.
Fast cuts every 1–2 seconds. Mix wide establishing shots, medium shots, over-the-shoulder views, and close-ups of faces or important objects. Vertical 9:16.

CAPTIONS AND AUDIO:
Show one word at a time in the center of the screen, using bold white sans-serif text with a thick black outline; highlight key words in red. First-person voiceover narration, background music, and playful sound effects. No lip-sync dialogue.

AVOID:
LEGO minifigure proportions, C-shaped claw hands, head studs, exposed connectors, trapezoid toy torsos, uniformly shiny plastic, cube-shaped or spherical heads, slim realistic bodies, detailed fingers, realistic facial modeling, skin pores, individual hair strands, constant smiling, excessive bloom, copied reference logos, and changing character geometry between shots.

Mood: bright daylight at school, slightly overcast afternoon, emotional rainy atmosphere at home, golden sunset at the end; light upbeat music turning warm and emotional.

30 seconds, 15 shots, 2 seconds each.

Shot 1 (0–2s): Close-up of a cheerful block kid walking through a colorful suburban town. A small bright yellow sun floats above his head, glowing gently. Other townspeople have different miniature weather systems above their heads. Narration: "In this town, everyone has their own weather."

Shot 2 (2–4s): At school, the kid notices another student sitting alone on a bench. A small grey rain cloud floats above the lonely student's head, releasing tiny raindrops. The lonely student has a sad face. Narration: "Some days, it rains inside."

Shot 3 (4–6s): The kid approaches the lonely student, smiles, and offers his hand. They start playing together. The grey cloud slowly disappears and a bright little sun appears above the lonely student's head. Caption "SUNSHINE" in red. Narration: "And sometimes, people bring the sunshine back."

Shot 4 (6–8s): The kid experiences a terrible day: he fails a school test, gets splashed by a passing car, and drops his ice cream. Quick comedic cuts showing each unfortunate moment. His cheerful expression slowly disappears. Narration: "But today, everything went wrong."

Shot 5 (8–10s): Close-up of the kid standing sadly on the sidewalk. His little sun disappears and transforms into a dark grey storm cloud with tiny lightning flashes. His face becomes sad, with a single tear. Caption "STORM" in red. Narration: "My sunshine disappeared."

Shot 6 (10–12s): He walks home slowly through the suburban street, shoulders lowered, with his personal rain cloud following above his head. Gentle rain falls only from his miniature cloud. Narration: "I thought nobody noticed."

Shot 7 (12–14s): The kid opens the front door of his house and sees Mom sitting quietly on the living room sofa. Warm interior lighting, but Mom looks emotionally exhausted. Narration: "But when I got home…"

Shot 8 (14–16s): Close-up of Mom. A large grey rain cloud floats above her head, releasing slow raindrops. Her eyes look tired, her eyebrows droop, and her expression is sad. Narration: "Mom had a storm of her own."

Shot 9 (16–18s): The kid pauses and looks at Mom's rain cloud, then looks at his own storm cloud. His expression changes from sadness to concern. He slowly walks toward her. Narration: "Then I had an idea."

Shot 10 (18–20s): The kid runs forward and jumps into a big, heartfelt hug with Mom. Mom is initially surprised, then wraps both arms around him. Their weather clouds begin glowing softly. Narration: "So I gave her my sunshine."

Shot 11 (20–22s): Close-up above their heads. Both grey rain clouds slowly dissolve into tiny glowing particles. A beautiful miniature rainbow appears above them, accompanied by warm sunlight and sparkling effects. Sound effect: "Ding!" Narration: "And something beautiful happened."

Shot 12 (22–24s): Dad walks through the front door, looking tired after a long day. A dark grey rain cloud floats above his head with subtle lightning. He notices Mom and the kid hugging and slowly approaches them. Narration: "Then Dad came home."

Shot 13 (24–26s): Dad joins the hug, wrapping his arms around both of them. All three weather systems transform together. The rain clouds disappear, three bright suns appear, and a large colorful rainbow forms above the family. Caption "SUNSHINE" in red.

Shot 14 (26–28s): Emotional close-up of the three family members hugging. All three have closed-eye smiles and subtle blushes. Their miniature suns glow warmly while a beautiful rainbow floats above them. Narration: "Sometimes, you can be someone else's sunshine."

Shot 15 (28–30s): Wide cinematic shot of the family standing together outside their suburban home during a beautiful golden sunset. A giant glowing rainbow stretches across the sky above their house. The three family members stand close together, smiling. Their weather systems show bright sunshine. Narration: "And that's how the storm ends."

00:00–00:03- 地震
低角度跟拍脚后跟,他跑过马来西亚城市街道。地面剧烈摇晃,他差点摔倒,建筑晃动,玻璃爆裂。混凝土在他身后砸落。他回头看了一眼,加速。

00:03–00:06- 坍塌
正面跟拍镜头快速后退。建筑外墙在他身后崩塌。他急转方向,跳过金属护栏,混凝土块摧毁了他原本的路线。街道上尘土弥漫。

00:06–00:09- 汽车撞击
他跑到一个路口。车辆失控朝他滑来。他在最后一刻飞扑出去。镜头跟着他一起俯冲。一辆车从他头顶掠过。他翻滚起身,继续跑。

00:09–00:12- 路面裂缝
一道巨大裂缝撕裂路面。他跑上一辆受损汽车,借力弹跳,跃过正在塌陷的路面。重重落地后继续奔跑。

00:12–00:15- 玻璃雨
侧面跟拍。高层窗户在他头顶炸裂。玻璃如雨落下。他护住脸,低头躲过一块坠落的金属招牌,继续前进。

00:15–00:18- 坍塌
前方建筑正面倒塌。他发现废墟下方有一条狭窄缝隙,压低身体滑铲钻入。混凝土在他上方砸落。他满身尘土钻出,立刻继续跑。

00:18–00:21- 车辆混乱
一辆公交车撞上多辆汽车。一辆打转的车朝他冲来。他跳上引擎盖,借车顶弹开,落在对面人行道上,身后火花四溅。

00:21–00:24- 高架路断裂
前方高架道路断裂解体。他全速冲到边缘,纵身一跃,整个人飞过塌陷段。短暂戏剧性慢动作,然后回到实时。重重落地,翻滚,起身,继续跑。

00:24–00:27- 碎片追击
厚重尘土降低能见度。肩高位置的追逐镜头。坠落的街灯和混凝土迫使他不断急变方向。他撞到墙上踉跄,撑住身体继续跑。远处车辆爆炸,冲击波卷着尘土朝他扑来。

00:27–00:30- 最终坍塌
镜头移到前方,正面对着他。他朝镜头跑来,身后巨大建筑接连倒塌。他跳过一道混凝土护栏。一块巨型楼板在他身后砸落,掀起巨大尘云。他从尘土中冲出,仍在奔跑。切黑。最后一步脚步声。

音效:深层地震轰鸣、结构断裂声、玻璃爆炸、人群恐慌、轮胎声、金属撞击、混凝土砸落、粗重喘息、火花声、远处爆炸、最终低频坍塌声。

表演:他表现得像真实的人在拼命求生,而不是摆造型的动作英雄。恐惧、本能和肾上腺素支配每一个反应。真实的平衡感、冲击和恢复动作。

镜头:低角度跟拍、正面追击、侧面跟拍、肩扛追逐、甩镜、贴地滑行、短暂空中跟随镜头。镜头始终跟随他的运动惯性。没有随意无人机航拍、漂浮镜头或不可能的旋转。

最终感受:不间断的 30 秒求生肾上腺素——跑 → 坍塌 → 闪避 → 跳跃 → 冲击 → 恢复 → 跑 → 更大坍塌 → 跑。

时长:30 秒 | 画幅比:16:9

Both shoulder straps secure the backpack. The monitor is physically supported by the same rigid frame throughout. The support joints remain locked, with a fixed distance between the man's face and screen.

The backpack, support, and monitor move together with his torso. Footsteps create only slight vibration. Show believable weight through his posture and taut straps, without exaggerated bouncing or flexing.

His hands hold the controller below the monitor. His eyes can briefly check the ground beneath its lower edge, allowing him to follow a clear walking route.

ENVIRONMENT AND REALISM
Times Square pedestrian plaza after rain, matching the reference: bright advertising displays, reflective damp pavement, metal barriers, moving pedestrians, and traffic beyond the pedestrian area.

Real skin texture, natural hair, fabric weave, worn hardware, plausible reflections, and realistic light from the monitor. The real city must look like live-action footage. Only the image on the monitor looks like a video game.

He stays within the pedestrian plaza. Leave a clear corridor wide enough for the projecting monitor. Pedestrians notice the equipment and make room naturally.

GAMEPLAY
A sports car drives along a palm-lined city boulevard, viewed from a third-person chase camera. Retain the recognizable GTA VI branding from the reference and a simple, stable game HUD.

The same car continues through the same driving sequence across shots. It makes one clear turn during 00:04-00:08, then continues forward.

The car's steering corresponds to a small thumb movement on the controller. Gameplay remains animated whenever the screen is visible, including during the conversation.

Keep all game imagery inside the monitor. Perspective, reflections, and screen brightness must match the physical display. No game graphics appear over the real city.

00:00-00:04 | ABSURD FROM FRAME ONE
Begin with an eye-level medium-wide tracking shot from the man's side, slightly behind his shoulder.

The opening composition clearly shows the backpack, the entire overhead support, the large monitor projecting in front of him, and both hands holding the controller. Include his walking legs and enough Times Square background to establish that he is outdoors.

Do not begin with a close-up of gameplay. The absurd portable setup must be understandable immediately.

The man walks at an ordinary relaxed pace, looking at the monitor and actively playing.

Beside his route, a stationary adult pedestrian holding a hot dog is about to take a bite. He notices the enormous gaming rig and freezes with the hot dog just short of his open mouth. His eyes follow the gamer.

The gamer continues past without noticing. Keep the reaction brief, believable, and visible within the main shot.

00:04-00:08 | GAMING WHILE WALKING
Cut on a matching footstep to a closer rear three-quarter tracking shot. Clearly show the screen, the man's hands, and the frame's attachment to his backpack.

On the screen, the car enters one sharp turn. His thumb moves the stick, and he makes a small involuntary lean of his shoulders in the same direction, only a few degrees.

His feet keep a normal walking rhythm and remain on the same route. He does not stagger, stop, or swing the monitor sideways. The rigid setup follows his slight torso movement as one assembly.

He straightens as the on-screen car completes the turn.

Two pedestrians ahead notice the equipment and step to the sides with sufficient clearance. Their reactions remain subtle and spontaneous.

An engine rev and one short tire squeal synchronize with the turn on the screen.

00:08-00:12 | THE QUESTION
Cut to an eye-level side two-shot from the gamer's unobstructed side. Frame his face in profile behind the monitor's near edge, with the approaching passerby beside his route.

The monitor remains physically in front of the gamer, facing him. Do not move or shrink it to reveal his face. Choose the camera angle to see his profile naturally.

A young adult male passerby, already approaching from ahead, slows and stops beside the route, outside the monitor's footprint.

From approximately 00:08.2 to 00:10.8, the passerby looks at the rig and asks:
"Bro, why not just play at home?"

While hearing the question, the gamer takes one final short step and stops beside him by approximately 00:09.5. Show a natural transfer of weight as the equipment settles.

The gamer keeps both hands on the controller, continues playing, and does not turn his head toward the passerby.

Allow a brief deadpan reaction beat after the question. The screen remains active.

00:12-00:15 | THE PUNCHLINE
Continue the same side two-shot without a cut.

From approximately 00:12.0 to 00:14.2, the gamer answers casually while watching the game:
"My doctor said I need more walks."

The delivery is sincere, clear, and conversational, without a smile or exaggerated emphasis.

As he finishes the sentence, he begins walking again, taking one or two natural steps before the video ends. The entire rig travels with him.

The passerby stays where he stopped and silently follows the gamer with a bewildered look. Keep both men visible during this final reaction.

End while the gamer is still walking and playing. No additional event or dialogue.

CAMERA AND EDITING
Use three camera setups:
1. Medium-wide side tracking shot establishing the complete rig.
2. Rear three-quarter tracking shot revealing gameplay.
3. Side two-shot for the full conversation and final reaction.

Use two clean cuts, at approximately 00:04 and 00:08. Match walking direction, body position, controller grip, and equipment orientation across cuts.

Keep support connections readable. Use moderate depth of field so the equipment and relevant reactions remain understandable.

Natural handheld or stabilized camera movement with realistic motion blur. No slow motion, speed ramps, crash zooms, or repeated actions.

AUDIO
Exactly two intelligible spoken lines, both in English.

Passerby, curious and puzzled:
"Bro, why not just play at home?"

Gamer, completely matter-of-fact:
"My doctor said I need more walks."

Accurate lip synchronization. No voice-over and no extra dialogue.

entries.prompt:

REFERENCES
Image1 — character sheet (Yoon Mirae, 38: messy low bun held by a matte black claw clip, with loose strands at the temples; a faded navy work polo with a small white embroidered HANGER logo on the LEFT chest, no readable text; a thin beige knit zip cardigan; washed black slacks; grey cotton socks, no shoes; a cheap black digital watch on the LEFT wrist; no rings; a plain white folded envelope held in her RIGHT hand).
Image2 — character sheet (Yoon Haeun, 11: straight black shoulder-length hair with even blunt bangs; a small matte yellow oval snap hair clip on the RIGHT side of her head; an oversized cream knit cardigan with brown buttons over a white Peter Pan collar blouse; a navy pleated knee-length skirt; white ankle socks, no shoes). She is a real 11-year-old child in every shot.
Image3 — location (small old Seoul villa living room, overcast winter late afternoon about 5pm: a window on the LEFT wall with thin white curtains and a grey overcast city outside; a wall calendar at back-left with one date circled in red; ONE upright black lacquered piano against the BACK WALL CENTER with gold 「SAMICK」 lettering on the fallboard, a short stack of books and a small framed photo on top; a black tufted piano bench; a lighter clean rectangle on the wall to the left of the piano; a beige front door wide open at the RIGHT, the corridor beyond with folded navy moving blankets and an empty hand dolly; cardboard boxes and a low folding table with a grey mug in the FOREGROUND LEFT; worn speckled grey linoleum; one paper globe ceiling lamp, already on).

PROP LOCKS
- PROP-PIANO: the upright black lacquered SAMICK from Image3. The fallboard (the key cover) starts CLOSED at 0s. Image2 opens it at 7s, plays, and closes it HERSELF at 17s. After 17s it stays shut. Nobody else ever touches the piano, the bench, the books, or the photo. Gold 「SAMICK」 lettering stays on the fallboard; no other readable text.
- PROP-ENVELOPE: ONE plain white folded payment envelope, no writing, no window, no stamp. It is in Image1's RIGHT hand from 0s until 23s, when she drops it and it lands on the linoleum near her feet and stays there. Never a second envelope, never opened, never handed over.
- PROP-CLIP: ONE small matte yellow oval snap hair clip, worn on the RIGHT side of Image2's head from 0s until 26s. It is never duplicated and never changes color. At 26–28s she unclips it with her RIGHT hand and sets it gently on the closed black fallboard, near the gold 「SAMICK」 lettering. It stays there, alone, until the end.
- PROP-DOLLY: the empty hand dolly and the folded navy moving blankets remain still in the corridor beyond the open door. They never move closer. No movers, no hands, no bodies in the hallway.
- Wardrobe and accessories exactly as in the refs: her beige cardigan stays on; the hanger logo stays on the LEFT chest; the black claw clip stays in the mother's bun; the daughter's cream cardigan and yellow clip (until removed) stay as locked; both remain in socks, no shoes. No rings on either hand.

STAGING LOCK
- Image2 is already seated on the black tufted bench at the start, facing the piano (her back to the first camera), both small palms resting flat on the CLOSED fallboard. She stays on the bench for the entire clip; she turns around on the bench at 18s to face her mother, but she does not stand up or leave the bench.
- Image1 stands just inside the wide-open beige door at frame-RIGHT from 0s, the envelope in her RIGHT hand, eyes down. She stays there through the playing. At 23s she crosses the linoleum, kneels in front of the bench, and hugs her daughter tightly from the front — a wholesome, protective mother-and-child hug only. She does not sit on the bench and does not touch the piano.
- Camera axis: an establishing wide from the FOREGROUND-LEFT boxes, looking toward the piano on the back wall, with the window on frame-LEFT and the open door on frame-RIGHT; an over-the-daughter's-shoulder toward the mother at the door; profiles and close-ups at the keyboard; a later over-the-mother's-shoulder onto the daughter's face during the hug; a final static insert of the fallboard. Never cross the line: the window stays LEFT, the door stays RIGHT, the piano stays on the back wall.
- The movers are never seen and never enter. The corridor shows only the empty dolly and the folded blankets.
- Child-safety framing: this is a wholesome mother-daughter farewell to a piano. Nothing suggestive, no lingering on the child's body, no adult styling. Image2 remains clearly an 11-year-old child in every shot.

LOOK / LIGHTING LOCK (identical in every shot)
Overcast winter late afternoon, about 5pm, exactly as in Image3: soft cool-grey daylight from the LEFT window as the key, a grey city faintly visible through thin white curtains and faintly fogged glass; one warm paper globe ceiling lamp as a gentle fill. Long soft shadows fall toward camera-right. The light stays at this single 5pm overcast tone in every shot; it does NOT brighten, does not warm into sunset, does not move, and no evening or night falls. Low saturation, slightly cool and modest, filmic grain, high-end K-drama melodrama grade. Skin stays natural and luminous; no harsh orange, no beauty-key glamour lighting.

SOUND
Natural ambience throughout: a small wall clock ticking, a faint cold draft from the open corridor, a very distant overcast city hum, sock-soft shifts on the linoleum, the fallboard opening and later closing, the envelope landing on the floor, breaths. No knocking, no doorbell, no voices from the hall.
Music: NO score, NO BGM, NO underscoring, NO cello, NO pad, NO choir, at any time. The only music is the diegetic upright piano, played live in the room from 7s until she stops mid-phrase at 16s: a slow, simple, gentle original lullaby in C major — right hand a single-note melody in a narrow gentle range, left hand soft slow sustained chords. It is an original melody, not a known song, not a carol, not a folk song, not a film theme. When her fingers lift at 16s, only the last struck note rings and naturally decays into silence; no new notes after the hands leave the keys. After that decay, silence is the weapon: ticking clock only, no music under the lie, the hug, or the final shot.
Voices: ONLY these three lines, spoken by the character clearly on screen at that moment. Image1: a low, cracked, tired adult female voice, barely holding. Image2: a soft, clear 11-year-old girl's voice. The two voices never merge and never swap. No other voices: no narrator, no mover, no neighbor, no hallway talk, no second child.

PACING
Slow and sparse. Long silent pauses. Let the last note die, let the lid close, let the lie sit, let the final insert hold. No fast cuts, no fast-forward feel.

BEATS
0–4s — Establishing wide from the FOREGROUND-LEFT boxes: the small worn living room, the overcast window at frame-left, the open beige door at frame-right with the empty dolly and folded navy blankets still in the corridor, no people outside. Image2 sits on the black tufted bench with her back to camera, both small hands resting flat on the CLOSED fallboard, the yellow oval clip on the RIGHT side of her hair. Image1 stands near the open door, the plain white envelope in her RIGHT hand, eyes down. A clock ticks. A faint corridor draft. Distant city. No music.
4–7s — Over-the-daughter's-shoulder, Image1 clearly on screen at the door. She lifts her eyes to her daughter's back. Her mouth is in sync, a low cracked voice, barely holding:
   Image1: 「…마지막으로 한 번만 쳐 봐.」
   A short silence. The

entries.title: Girl and Firefly Forest Animation
entries.description: A prompt for a 15-second cinematic 3D animated fantasy video featuring a girl finding a firefly in an enchanted forest.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second cinematic 3D animated fantasy video in 16:9 widescreen format, with ultra-detailed Pixar-style animation and realistic lighting.

Scene 1 (0–4 seconds):
A cute little girl wearing a dark green hooded cloak stands alone in a magical enchanted forest. Giant mushrooms, lush green moss, and ancient trees surround her. Soft blue moonlight and beautiful sunbeams filter through the trees. A tiny golden glowing firefly appears on the moss in front of her.

Scene 2 (4–7 seconds):
The little girl slowly walks toward the glowing firefly, bends down, and gently reaches out with both hands. The camera smoothly moves closer, capturing her curiosity and innocent expression.

Scene 3 (7–11 seconds):
Close-up shot of the little girl carefully holding the tiny golden firefly in her cupped hands. Its warm golden light illuminates her face, fingers, and beautiful eyes. She gently closes her eyes and smiles peacefully.

Scene 4 (11–15 seconds):
The firefly begins glowing brighter and gently floats upward toward her face. The girl opens her eyes, looks up in wonder, and gives a beautiful innocent smile. End with a cinematic close-up of her joyful face.

Visual Style: High-end 3D animated fantasy, adorable character design, detailed facial expressions, magical golden particles, volumetric lighting, soft depth of field, realistic hand movements, cinematic camera transitions, enchanting atmosphere, 4K quality.

Audio: Gentle magical piano music, soft forest ambience, and subtle sparkling sounds.

Important: Maintain consistent character appearance, green hooded cloak, facial features, and proportions throughout the entire video. No text, no subtitles, no watermark.

entries.title: Seattle Overlook Walk Tourist Scene
entries.description: A prompt for a hyper-realistic cinematic scene in Seattle where a woman takes a tourist photo, replacing an existing video segment.
entries.prompt:
Seattle — Overlook Walk Tourist Photo Scene
Dreamina Seedance 2.5 | 12 Seconds | 3:4 Vertical
Create a 12-second hyper-realistic cinematic replacement scene for the existing Seattle video. Three distinct shots with hard cuts, natural American English dialogue, realistic physical interactions, and precise object continuity.
CHARACTER AND LOCATION REFERENCES

Use the original female streetwear reference image and existing Seattle video to preserve Woman 1's exact facial identity, black knit beanie, long dark wavy hair, beige puffer vest, fitted top, oversized blue jeans, belt, and accessories.

Use "OVERLOOK WALK.png" as the architectural and environmental reference.

The setting is Seattle's Overlook Walk, featuring landscaped terraces, wooden seating, pedestrian walkways, metal railings, and Elliott Bay in the background. Natural late-afternoon autumn lighting.

Woman 1 carries a small bouquet of yellow flowers in her LEFT hand throughout the entire scene. Her RIGHT hand is free to receive, operate, and return the tourist's smartphone.

Man 1, her male friend from the original Seattle video, remains nearby with consistent appearance.

The tourist couple consists of two American adults with consistent facial identities and clothing across all shots.

SHOT 1 — THE OFFER | 0:00–0:04

Medium-wide three-quarter camera angle showing Woman 1 approaching the tourist couple, who are struggling to frame a selfie with the waterfront behind them.

Woman 1 notices and gestures toward their phone with her empty right hand.
Woman 1: "You want the skyline in it too?"

Tourist: "Please."

The tourist extends the smartphone toward Woman 1.

Woman 1 takes the phone with her RIGHT hand. The handoff is clearly visible and physically completed before the cut.

Her yellow flowers remain securely in her LEFT hand.

Hard cut.

SHOT 2 — THE PHOTOGRAPH | 0:04–0:08

Over-the-shoulder camera angle from slightly behind Woman 1, looking past her toward the tourist couple and Seattle waterfront.

Woman 1 holds the smartphone upright in her RIGHT hand, camera facing the couple.

The couple stands together with Elliott Bay behind them, smiling naturally.
Woman 1 adjusts the framing slightly.

Woman 1: "Okay, got it."

She visibly taps the phone's camera shutter button with her right thumb.

The photograph is actually taken. The couple relaxes their pose.

The yellow flowers remain in her LEFT hand, clearly separate from the phone.

Hard cut.

SHOT 3 — THE PAYOFF | 0:08–0:12

Medium conversational shot showing Woman 1 handing the smartphone back to its original owner using her RIGHT hand.

The tourist receives the phone and looks at the photograph on its screen.

Tourist: "That's actually perfect."

Woman 1: "I charge by the compliment."
The couple laughs. Woman 1 smiles, turns, and begins walking away with Man 1.

The bouquet remains in her LEFT hand.

End with a natural walking movement suitable for cutting into the next Seattle waterfront scene.

CINEMATOGRAPHY

Hyper-realistic live-action photography with authentic skin pores, natural facial expressions, believable fabric movement, and accurate human anatomy.

Natural handheld cinematography with three distinct camera perspectives:

Shot 1: Three-quarter medium-wide interaction

Shot 2: Over-the-shoulder photograph

Shot 3: Medium conversational payoff

Use hard cuts only. No morphing, dissolves, or continuous camera orbit between shots.

Natural waterfront ambience, wind, footsteps, distant pedestrians, and casual conversation. No background soundtrack.

SUBTITLE DESIGN
All spoken dialogue uses Poppins SemiBold, weight 600, pure white #FFFFFF over a dark charcoal #17212B rounded rectangle at 60% opacity.
Dialogue font size 36–42 px at 1080 × 1440 resolution. Bottom-center, approximately 8–10% above the lower edge. Background padding 12 px vertical and 22 px horizontal, 10–12 px corner radius.

Synchronize subtitles precisely with the spoken words. Maximum two lines. No opening location title.

CRITICAL CONTINUITY AND ACTION RULES

The yellow flowers remain in Woman 1's LEFT hand from beginning to end. They never teleport, switch hands, disappear, or change appearance.

The smartphone begins in the tourist's possession, transfers visibly into Woman 1's RIGHT hand, remains in her right hand while she takes the photograph, and transfers visibly back to the original tourist.

The phone must never appear simultaneously in two people's hands except during the physical handoff.

Woman 1 must actually take the photograph. Show the phone aimed at the couple and a deliberate shutter-button press.

The tourist couple must remain stationary and visibly pose during the photograph.

Only the designated speaker delivers each line. Accurate lip synchronization, no overlapping or duplicated dialogue.

Maintain consistent character identities, clothing, props, background architecture, lighting, and spatial orientation across all three shots.

No extra characters entering the interaction, no duplicated people, no extra hands, no distorted phones, no unnatural gestures, and no unexplained object transfers.

Prioritize the physical sequence: offer → receive phone → photograph → return phone → joke → walk away.

The finished scene should feel like a spontaneous, slightly humorous interaction captured during a real afternoon in Seattle.

entries.title: Seaside Romance Short Film Prompt
entries.description: A prompt for generating an emotional 20-second romantic short film involving a letter and childhood connection.
entries.prompt:
A deeply emotional and realistic 20-second romantic short film.
A young man sits alone at a small seaside café, holding an old handwritten letter. He notices a young woman walking along the beach. She looks familiar. Their eyes meet, and both smile shyly.

He approaches her and gives her the letter. She opens it and discovers a beautiful handwritten message. Her eyes fill with happy tears.

Suddenly, she takes a small folded photograph from her purse. It shows the two of them together as children, revealing that they have known each other since childhood.

They look at each other in disbelief, then laugh and embrace.

The final shot shows them walking hand in hand beside the ocean as the sun sets.

Natural human expressions, realistic faces, beautiful romantic atmosphere, authentic emotions, elegant clothing, warm sunset lighting, gentle ocean waves, soft piano music, smooth camera movement, consistent characters and exceptionally realistic visuals.

Original story, original characters, no recognizable references, no text overlays, no logos.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second cinematic 2D animated inspirational short film titled "{argument name="film_title" default="The Boy Who Made the World Brighter"}"

VISUAL STYLE: Beautiful hand-drawn 2D animation with polished modern animated-film quality, expressive characters, fluid movements, detailed city backgrounds, cinematic camera angles, rich colors and warm atmospheric lighting. Avoid slideshow-like scenes or static illustrations.

MAIN CHARACTER: A kind 24-year-old young man with short messy dark brown hair, warm brown eyes, a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers. Maintain identical facial features, hairstyle, clothing and proportions throughout.

SIGNATURE EFFECT: Whenever he helps someone, a subtle golden aura appears around his hands and gently spreads around the person, symbolizing kindness and hope.

STORY — 30 SECONDS:

Scene 1 (0–4s): A busy modern city street. Everyone rushes around, distracted by phones. The young man notices an elderly woman struggling to cross the road.

NARRATION: Warm, emotional natural storytelling voice, perfectly timed:

"In a world where everyone is busy, one person chose to care. He helped without expecting anything in return. And soon, his kindness inspired others. Because one small act can make the whole world brighter."

AUDIO: Emotional orchestral music beginning with soft piano and gradually building with uplifting strings. Add natural city ambience, footsteps, traffic and subtle magical sounds when the golden aura appears.

FINAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Exactly 30 seconds, 16:9 landscape.
- Consistent character design and animation style.

entries.prompt:
23-second vertical 9:16 animated comedy.

Premium theatrical 3D animation with appealing sculpted faces, expressive eyebrows and eyes, slightly exaggerated adult proportions, detailed groomed hair, tactile fabrics, soft skin shading, cinematic global illumination and convincing physical weight.

Match the character reference's visual style across the character, room, props and lighting. This is a fully animated scene, not live-action footage or a live-action background with an animated person.

REFERENCES
VIDEO REFERENCE:
Use the supplied video as the primary guide for the opening composition, physical performance, movement sequence, emotional progression, camera behavior and original audio timing.

Preserve its recognizable choreography and comedy. Replace the original man with the character from Image 1 and translate the setting into the same animated visual style.

IMAGE 1:
The identity, costume and rendering reference for the ONLY physical on-screen character.

Preserve his adult face, stocky build, tousled auburn hair, beard, expressive eyebrows, charcoal T-shirt, opaque white adult diaper with side fastening tabs, bare legs, bare feet, dark gaming headset and white-and-black controller.

The diaper is an essential nonsexual comedy prop. Do not replace it with shorts or ordinary underwear.

Image 1 does not define the opening pose or background. Begin with the gamer kneeling as in the video, not standing against the reference's neutral backdrop.

IMAGE 2:
The television screen artwork only.

Preserve its illustrated protagonists, existing logo, tropical sunset palette, composition and countdown-panel design. Keep this artwork confined to the television display.

The two illustrated people are part of a static screen image. They never become physical characters in the room.

PRIORITIES
The video controls performance, camera movement and audio timing.
Image 1 controls the gamer's appearance, clothing and animated visual style.
Image 2 controls the television artwork.

Follow the exact English dialogue provided below. Internal action timings are approximate guides; align gestures and facial reactions to the original audio without stretching, accelerating or cutting speech.

SETTING AND OPENING
A modest living room rendered in polished cinematic 3D animation. A large widescreen television stands on a low dark media console. Gray carpet, dim warm room illumination and pink-purple television light.

Begin immediately in the video's rear three-quarter handheld composition. The gamer is already kneeling close to the television, facing its screen.

His knees and shins rest on the carpet. His diaper is visible below the T-shirt. He holds the controller naturally.

An open pizza box is on his left. A blue snack bag and a beverage can are nearer the camera. A plain white game console stands beside the media unit.

Keep the prop arrangement consistent with the video and leave clear carpet beside the gamer for his final collapse.

The friend speaks from behind the camera and remains unseen throughout. Do not show the friend, their hands, their reflection or a recording device.

PERFORMANCE
The gamer is clearly an adult man in his mid-thirties.

His emotional progression:
confident anticipation,
rising excitement,
premature celebration,
disbelief,
desperate outrage,
exhausted resignation.

Use precise eye direction, expressive brows, readable mouth shapes and coordinated head, shoulder and hand movements. Exaggerate emotion without losing physical coherence.

TIMELINE
The following intervals cover the entire video. Within them, prioritize the reference audio's exact cadence and the event order described below.

00:00-00:04 | THE SETUP
The friend asks from behind the camera:
"Bro, are you wearing a diaper?"

The gamer remains focused on the television and confidently replies:
"I'm not missing a second."

He makes small eager shifts on his knees, holding the controller and leaning toward the screen. Preserve the source video's gestures and rhythm.

The television displays Image 2. Its countdown panel shows "00:06" until the spoken countdown begins.

00:04-00:10.50 | ANTICIPATION
The gamer counts:
"Six, five, four, three, two, one, zero!"

Match the original vocal cadence. Change the existing television digits in synchronization with the spoken numbers:

Six: 00:06
Five: 00:05
Four: 00:04
Three: 00:03
Two: 00:02
One: 00:01
Zero: 00:00

Keep the surrounding artwork unchanged.

As excitement builds, he releases one hand from the controller and raises both arms, retaining the controller securely in the other hand. His free hand forms a celebratory fist.

Match the video's raised-arm performance. He stays kneeling, with grounded knees and natural torso movement.

00:10.50-00:11.10 | THE REVEAL
Immediately after the spoken "zero," the countdown reaches 00:00 and its timer panel disappears.

A centered dark translucent download dialog appears over the unchanged television artwork.

Exact dialog text:
"Downloading"
"0%"
"14 hours remaining"

Below the text, show an empty progress-bar outline consistent with 0%.

The dialog is a flat interface element attached to the television screen, correctly following its perspective. It is not a floating object in the room.

The camera moves closer to the television as in the video. Keep "14 hours remaining" readable and unobstructed.

The gamer notices the message before reacting. His celebration stops and his arms begin to lower.

00:11.10-00:14.30 | DISBELIEF
The gamer reacts:
"Fourteen hours? Fourteen hours, bro! Don't laugh."

The camera returns to a wider framing as he twists toward the unseen friend.

His eyes widen and his mouth opens in shock. He points toward the camera with his free hand while holding the controller in the other.

"Don't laugh" is directed at the friend behind the camera. Do not add a new reply or an invented laugh.

Keep the download dialog visible on the television behind him.

00:14.30-00:18.00 | THE BREAKDOWN
He cries:
"I waited twelve years, Sony! Twelve years!"

Match the reference's emphatic gestures and distressed facial performance. Direct his complaint toward the television, with the same brief looks toward the friend as in the source.

His frustration becomes a physical collapse. He leans forward, braces his free palm on the carpet and lowers his hip and shoulder into the clear space beside him.

Keep the controller in his other hand throughout. He holds it close to his upper chest during the descent so that it cannot pass through his body or become trapped beneath him.

Show a coherent transition from kneeling to lying on his side. No instant pose change or teleportation.

He draws his knees toward his chest. His free hand moves toward his face. The headset remains securely on his head.

The camera tilts down to follow the collapse while retaining the pizza box and part of the television.

By the friend's next question, he is curled on the carpet. He does not land on any food, packaging or the beverage can.

00:18.00-00:22.14 | THE CALLBACK
The unseen friend asks:
"Bro, you good?"

Still curled on his side, the gamer answers:
"Fourteen hours, that's why I wore it."

Deliver the final line with tired resignation, following the source audio. His face remains sufficiently visible for readable lip synchronization. His eyes briefly turn toward the friend.

The controller remains in one hand near his chest. His free hand rests near his face. His diaper stays visible enough to connect the final line with the opening question.

He remains lying down through the end.

The television still shows the same download dialog:
"Downloading"
"0%"
"14 hours remaining"

Finish naturally after the complete final line, including the word "it." Do not add another joke, a standing action, a fade-out or an end card.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30 second ultra realistic, cinematic romantic café date video featuring the same beautiful young woman and handsome young man throughout the entire video.

GIRL'S APPEARANCE: A beautiful young woman with long, glossy dark hair styled half up with soft face framing strands, expressive brown eyes and elegant natural makeup. She wears a cream ribbed square neck long sleeve top, a champagne beige satin maxi skirt with ruched detailing and a thigh slit, pearl drop earrings, delicate layered gold necklaces, a gold wristwatch and an elegant ring. She carries a structured ivory handbag.

BOY'S APPEARANCE: A handsome young man with neatly styled dark hair, wearing a sophisticated fitted black shirt, tailored black trousers, a classy wristwatch and polished black shoes.

LOCATION: A luxurious romantic café with large glass windows, marble tables, cream upholstered chairs, fresh flowers, candles, warm golden lighting and a beautiful evening atmosphere.

SCENE 1 – ARRIVAL (0–5 SECONDS)

Show the girl gracefully entering the luxury café, holding her ivory handbag. Her champagne satin skirt flows naturally as she walks. Cut to the boy sitting at a marble table near the window. He notices her, smiles and stands up to welcome her.

Boy: "There you are. I've been waiting for you."

Girl: "Sorry, did I keep you waiting?"

SCENE 2 – THE FIRST LOOK (5–10 SECONDS)

The boy smiles and gently pulls out a chair for her. She sits gracefully, arranging her satin skirt. He looks into her eyes.

Boy: "You look beautiful tonight."

Girl (smiling shyly): "You always know what to say."

SCENE 3 – COFFEE TIME (10–17 SECONDS)

Show a waiter placing two cappuccino cups on the marble table with a chocolate dessert, flowers and a candle. The girl gently picks up her coffee and takes a sip. The boy looks at her lovingly.

Boy: "So, how was your day?"

Girl: "Better now that I'm here with you."

They smile and laugh softly. Include close-ups of their hands, coffee cups, her gold jewellery and watch.

SCENE 4 – THE CUTE MOMENT (17–24 SECONDS)

The couple shares chocolate dessert. The girl accidentally gets a little cream near the corner of her lips. The boy notices and gently wipes it away with a napkin.

Boy (playfully): "You've got a little cream here."

Girl (laughing shyly): "Stop teasing me!"

entries.title: Viking Reunion Winter Night Cinematic
entries.description: A detailed 30-second cinematic video prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting a Viking returning home to his son on a snowy mountain night, with precise timing, camera movements, and emotional beats.
entries.prompt:
30 seconds, vertical 9:16 format, 24 frames per second. Cinematic photorealism, one continuous shot with smooth camera movement.

A winter night in the mountains. A snow-covered hillside, dark fir trees, and towering rocky peaks. Above the mountains stretches a deep blue, star-filled sky with a clearly visible Milky Way. A small wooden house with a snow-covered roof stands on the slope. Warm amber light spills from its window, while a cool blue lamp beside the house illuminates the path. Snow, stones, dry grass, and old wooden fence posts fill the foreground.

0–8 SECONDS — RETURNING HOME

Our Viking walks along the snowy path toward the house, carrying his axe in his right hand with the blade pointing downward. The camera smoothly follows him from behind and slightly to one side. His boots compress the snow, leaving deep footprints. The axe sways naturally with his steps, and his fur cloak moves gently in the wind. His breath is visible in the freezing air.

Keep the house, snowy mountains, and starry sky in the frame. Nearby stones and grass move across the frame faster than the distant cliffs, creating natural parallax.

8–12 SECONDS — THE DOOR OPENS

The Viking reaches the porch, stops, and carefully leans his axe against the exterior wall beside the door: the metal head rests on the ground, and the handle leans against the wall. The axe remains in this position.

He opens the wooden door inward. Warm light from the house spills onto the snow, his face, and his fur cloak. The camera gently moves to one side, revealing a three-quarter view of the Viking and the open doorway.

12–18 SECONDS — REUNITING WITH HIS SON

His little three-year-old son appears inside the house. The boy wears a simple, loose-fitting beige shirt that reaches his knees. Seeing his father, he smiles joyfully and runs toward him from inside the room, reaching both arms upward. The child stays indoors, just inside the doorway.

The Viking's stern expression softens into a warm smile. He bends down, gently lifts his son with both hands, and brings him close to his chest. The boy wraps his arms around his father's neck.

18–23 SECONDS — HOME

The Viking tenderly kisses his son on the cheek. The boy smiles and snuggles against him.

The father settles the child securely on his right arm, supporting him beneath his thighs, and steps inside. With his free left hand, he gently closes the door. The strip of warm light on the snow gradually narrows and disappears. The window continues to glow warmly.

The camera remains outside. Every action unfolds naturally and sequentially, without cuts.

23–30 SECONDS — BENEATH THE STARS

After the door closes, the camera slowly rises and smoothly tilts upward: from the glowing window and snow-covered roof to the majestic cliffs, then toward the star-filled sky.

The bright Milky Way dominates the upper frame, emphasizing the scale of nature versus the warmth of the home below.

entries.title: Korean Melodrama Rooftop Scene
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot cinematic prompt for a Korean melodrama scene on a hospital rooftop at golden hour.
entries.prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5 — 16:9 — 30s — "옥상에서 (On the Rooftop)" — Korean melodrama short, multi-shot cinematic, Korean dialogue, soft emotional piano only from 18s, natural ambience.

REFERENCES
@Doctor — character sheet (Dr. Han Seoyun, 29: dark low ponytail with face-framing strands, knee-length white coat with a navy cross logo on the left chest, a clip-on photo ID badge, light-blue scrubs, white clogs, a black stethoscope around her neck, a silver watch on her LEFT wrist, a dark-grey clipboard).
@Patient — character sheet (Kang Jiwoo, 29: soft black fringe; pale-blue/white striped patient pajamas with a mandarin collar and white buttons; a long oatmeal-beige knit cardigan; a white ID wristband on his LEFT wrist; a taped IV cannula on the back of his RIGHT hand; grey slippers; a silver IV stand on 5 wheels with one clear bag).
@Rooftop — location (hospital rooftop at golden-hour dusk: grey steel door in a white stairwell block FOREGROUND LEFT with a lit wall lamp; ONE long backless light-oak bench in the CENTER parallel to the glass railing; pampas-grass planters; Seoul skyline beyond with N Seoul Tower on the RIGHT hill; the low sun on the LEFT; white sheets on a line far RIGHT).

PROP LOCKS
- PROP-IV: the silver IV stand from @Patient (5 wheels, one clear bag, a clear tube to the taped cannula on his RIGHT hand). It stands on the deck at the LEFT end of the bench, beside him, and never moves. The tube stays connected the whole time.
- PROP-CLIPBOARD: the dark-grey clipboard from @Doctor with a few white sheets on it. NO readable text on it ever. She holds it to her chest, then sets it face-down on the bench at her right.
- Wardrobe and accessories exactly as in the refs; the stethoscope stays around her neck.

STAGING LOCK
- @Patient is already seated on the bench at the start, at its LEFT half, facing the skyline. The IV stand is at his left.
- @Doctor enters from the steel door (frame left), walks to the bench and sits on HIS RIGHT side, about 30 cm away, also facing the skyline.
- They stay seated side by side for the rest of the clip and never stand up or swap sides.
- Camera axis: shoot from behind and from the sides (profiles against the sunset), plus front two-shots from the railing side. Never cross the line: he is always on frame-LEFT of her in the from-behind shots.
- No other people anywhere on the rooftop.

LOOK / LIGHTING LOCK (identical in every shot)
Golden-hour dusk exactly as in @Rooftop: a warm peach-gold sun low on the LEFT horizon, rim-lighting their hair and shoulders; soft lavender ambient fill on their faces; a pink-to-lavender sky; long soft shadows. The sun stays at the same height throughout; it does NOT set, the sky does not darken, and no night falls. A soft lens glow, low saturation, filmic grain, high-end K-drama melodrama grade. Skin stays luminous; no harsh orange.

SOUND
Natural ambience: a soft wind, pampas grass rustling, the sheets flapping gently, distant city traffic hum, one far-off ambulance siren very faint at 0–4s, the steel door creaking open and shut, clog footsteps on the wooden deck, clipboard paper rustling, breaths.
Music: complete silence of music until 18s; then a very soft, slow solo piano enters under the hand-hold and swells gently to the end.
Voices: ONLY these four lines, two each. @Patient: soft, warm, slightly weak male voice. @Doctor: calm female voice that cracks. No other voices.

PACING
Slow and sparse. Long silent pauses between lines. Let looks and breaths land. No fast cuts, no fast-forward feel.

BEATS
0–4s — Wide from behind: @Patient sits alone on the bench against the golden skyline, the IV stand at his left, the cardigan moving in the breeze. The steel door at frame left creaks open. @Doctor steps out holding the clipboard to her chest and stops. She looks at his back. A slow breath in.
4–8s — She walks across the deck (clogs on wood) and sits on his right. A long silence. He keeps looking at the city. Profile two-shot, his mouth in sync, soft:
   @Patient: 「결과 나왔지?」
8–13s — Close-up of @Doctor: her fingers tighten on the clipboard and her jaw sets. She can't answer. He slowly turns to her with a soft, knowing smile. Close-up of @Patient, mouth in sync:
   @Patient: 「의사로서 말해 줘. 옛날 여자친구 말고.」
13–18s — Close-up of @Doctor. She lifts her chin and forces her professional voice, mouth in sync:
   @Doctor: 「강지우 환자분은…」
   Her voice cracks and she stops. Her lips press together, her eyes fill and her blinking quickens. She can't finish and looks down. Silence. The wind lifts the strands at her temples.
18–22s — Piano enters. Reaction close-up of @Patient: he lets out a small breathy laugh, his eyes glistening, and speaks softly, mouth in sync:
   @Patient: 「…역시. 넌 그 말 못 할 줄 알았어.」
22–26s — She sets the clipboard face-down on the bench at her right. Then, without a word, she reaches over and takes his RIGHT hand in both of hers, gently above the taped cannula. Insert of the hands: her fingers lace through his, the silver watch on her wrist, the ID wristband on his. A tear falls onto the back of her hand. He closes his eyes for a moment.
26–28s — Close-up of @Doctor, finally looking at him with tears running down, a trembling small smile, mouth in sync, barely a whisper:
   @Doctor: 「…옆에 있을게.」
28–30s — Wide from behind, slowly pulling back: the two of them on the bench, holding hands, his head slowly tilting to rest on her shoulder, the IV stand beside them, silhouettes against the golden Seoul skyline and the low sun. Hold. Piano fades.

NEGATIVE
No extra voices: no narrator, voiceover, nurse, PA announcement or third person. No dialogue other than the four lines; each line is spoken by the character on screen at that moment, and the male and female voices never merge. No other people on the rooftop. No text, subtitles, readable clipboard text, readable badge text, watermark or UI. No sunset progression, night, darkening sky or lighting change between shots. No standing up, swapping sides or moving the bench. No IV tube disconnecting, no blood, no needles shown being removed, no oxygen mask. No kiss. No crying loudly, sobbing or screaming, no exaggerated faces. No wardrobe drift: the coat stays on, the stethoscope stays around her neck, the cardigan stays on him. No second bench, no extra IV stand. No music before 18s, no dramatic orchestral swell or vocals. No fast cuts, shaky handheld or fast-forward look.

Natural ambience: a soft wind, pampas grass rustling, the sheets flapping gently, distant city traffic hum, one far-off ambulance siren very faint at 0–4s, the steel door creaking open and shut, clog footsteps on the wooden deck, clipboard paper rustling, breaths.
Music: complete silence of music until 18s; then a very soft, slow solo piano enters under the hand-hold and swells gently to the end.
Voices: ONLY these four lines, two each. @Patient: soft, warm, slightly weak male voice. @Doctor: calm female voice that cracks. No other voices.

PACING
Slow and sparse. Long silent pauses between lines. Let looks and breaths land. No fast cuts, no fast-forward feel.

BEATS
0–4s — Wide from behind: @Patient sits alone on the bench against the golden skyline, the IV stand at his left, the cardigan moving in the breeze. The steel door at frame left creaks open. @Doctor steps out holding the clipboard to her chest and stops. She looks at his back. A slow breath in.
4–8s — She walks across the deck (clogs on wood) and sits on his right. A long silence. He keeps looking at the city. Profile two-shot, his mouth in sync, soft:
   @Patient: "The results are out, right?"
8–13s — Close-up of @Doctor: her fingers tighten on the clipboard and her jaw sets. She can't answer. He slowly turns to her with a soft, knowing smile. Close-up of @Patient, mouth in sync:
   @Patient: "Tell me as a doctor. Not as an ex-girlfriend."
13–18s — Close-up of @Doctor. She lifts her chin and forces her professional voice, mouth in sync:
   @Doctor: "Patient Kang Jiwoo is..."
   Her voice cracks and she stops. Her lips press together, her eyes fill and her blinking quickens. She can't finish and looks down. Silence. The wind lifts the strands at her temples.
18–22s — Piano enters. Reaction close-up of @Patient: he lets out a small breathy laugh, his eyes glistening, and speaks softly, mouth in sync:
   @Patient: "...As expected. I knew you couldn't say that."
22–26s — She sets the clipboard face-down on the bench at her right. Then, without a word, she reaches over and takes his RIGHT hand in both of hers, gently above the taped cannula. Insert of the hands: her fingers lace through his, the silver watch on her wrist, the ID wristband on his. A tear falls onto the back of her hand. He closes his eyes for a moment.
26–28s — Close-up of @Doctor, finally looking at him with tears running down, a trembling small smile, mouth in sync, barely a whisper:
   @Doctor: "...I'll stay by your side."
28–30s — Wide from behind, slowly pulling back: the two of them on the bench, holding hands, his head slowly tilting to rest on her shoulder, the IV stand beside them, silhouettes against the golden Seoul skyline and the low sun. Hold. Piano fades.

NEGATIVE
No extra voices: no narrator, voiceover, nurse, PA announcement or third person. No dialogue other than the four lines; each line is spoken by the character on screen at that moment, and the male and female voices never merge. No other people on the rooftop. No text, subtitles, readable clipboard text, readable badge text, watermark or UI. No sunset progression, night, darkening sky or lighting change between shots. No standing up, swapping sides or moving the bench. No IV tube disconnecting, no blood, no needles shown being removed, no oxygen mask. No kiss. No crying loudly, sobbing or screaming, no exaggerated faces. No wardrobe drift: the coat stays on, the stethoscope stays around her neck, the cardigan stays on him. No second bench, no extra IV stand. No music before 18s, no dramatic orchestral swell or vocals. No fast cuts, shaky handheld or fast-forward look.

entries.title: Supernatural High School Action Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a photorealistic live-action supernatural high-school action video featuring a girl fighting bullies, with strict character locking and specific power effects.
entries.prompt: Create a 28-second, 16:9, 4K, 24fps photorealistic live-action supernatural high-school action video. Story: surrounded by bullies → frightened apology → slap triggers power → instinctive self-defense → shock as power fades → crowd splits → super-speed combat → bewildered ending. Use the uploaded three-view sheet only to lock the same lead's identity, hairstyle, proportions, and outfit; the three views are one girl, not three characters. Lead: 18-year-old white American female senior (@ image1), gray-green eyes, jaw-length deep chestnut-brown hair. Keep the same face, hair, proportions and outfit throughout: open blue-gray/charcoal/off-white plaid overshirt, fitted white ribbed tank, light-blue high-waisted straight-leg jeans, black-and-white low-top sneakers, no backpack. Scene: modern American high-school hallway, gray-beige metal lockers on both sides, fluorescent ceiling lights mixed with side-window daylight, polished reflective floor. High-budget live-action teen-superhero look; 35mm lens, moderately shallow depth of field. Camera: restrained handheld at first; during conflict use OTS, side tracking, push-ins/pullbacks, pans and brief whip-pans; stable again after fighting. Keep the lead focused on whoever she interacts with or fights; use side/front-3/4/rear-3/4/OTS angles, preserve action axis and momentum, and never interrupt combat by making her face the lens. Powers: bright ice-white core with electric cyan-blue outer glow, fine cyan arcs and a few pale-cyan/white particles; speed leaves short white-core/cyan-edge afterimages. Energy realistically lights skin, clothes, students, floor and lockers. Electrical/super-speed only: no pink/purple/red energy, ice blocks, icicles, snowflakes, frost or freezing mist. 0.0–1.2s: Start with the lead already irregularly surrounded by students, clearly bullied. Front-3/4 medium close-up. She lowers her head, shoulders tense, hurt/frightened/humiliated. A female bully in a dark varsity jacket shoves her shoulder; she stumbles back as camera moves with her. 1.2–3.2s: Over bully's shoulder, lead anxious and slightly off-center. Bully leans in: "Oh, what? You wanna do something now?" Natural lip sync. Brief reverse OTS shows bully's contempt. 3.2–5.1s: Front-3/4 close-up. Lead looks down, then up, trembling: "I... I'm sorry." Sincere, frightened, restrained; no smirk or planned retaliation. 5.1–8.2s: Side medium close-up keeps both girls visible. Bully slaps her hard: arm swings → palm hits cheek → head snaps sideways → power awakens progressively. Tiny ice-white point appears in normal pupils; ~0.2s iris lights and faint cyan currents form around eyes; ~0.4s cyan patterns spread from neck to right shoulder/arm; ~0.6s ice-white core gathers in right hand with cyan arcs. Only then she instinctively throws a right-handed punch, clearly hitting bully's upper chest/shoulder; white flash + cyan arcs knock bully backward. Lead remains frightened and restrained, not vengeful. 8.2–11.0s: Her right fist stops naturally forward/side. Front-3/4 approach. She looks toward the bully, then at her hands as power fades: iris light contracts to pupils, eye currents fragment, neck/arm patterns dim, palm cores shrink, tiny fingertip sparks remain, eyes nearly return gray-green. She looks shocked, confused, frightened, overwhelmed; no superhero pose. 11.0–14.0s: Side view with hallway depth. Most students flee in different directions; a few mistakenly think she attacked unprovoked and approach separately from different positions, never together or in a queue. Nearest attacker charges from front-side. She hears footsteps, turns toward him; fading power reactivates—white pupil cores and cyan arcs return—then she becomes a white-center/cyan-edge speed streak and reaches close combat by 14s. 14.0–16.6s: Continuous side/rear-3/4 tracking. She sidesteps the first male attacker, pivots with his momentum and redirects him off balance; gaze immediately follows the next threat. A second male in a dark hoodie rushes from another direction; she high side-kicks him, white-core/cyan-edge trail along leg, shoe clearly hits torso and drives him into lockers. 16.6–18.9s: Another attacker comes from behind/side after an irregular beat. Quick pan; she hears him, ducks under the strike, rotates to his side and counters with palm or elbow. Hair and overshirt swing naturally. 18.9–21.1s: Another male charges from the opposite side. Fluid whip-pan; she slips sideways from his fist, blocks with forearm, counters close-range; white core + cyan arcs flare at contact and knock him back. Other students keep fleeing; she only counters active attackers. 21.1–23.1s: Final attacker charges from farther down hall. She keeps eyes on him, dashes sideways at super speed and flows into a powerful spinning kick driven by hips/waist with stable support foot; white-core/cyan-edge arc trail. Shoe clearly hits torso; white flash, cyan arcs and air-pressure shockwave send him backward, lockers shake. Brief slow motion at contact, then normal speed. 23.1–28.0s: She retracts leg, stays oriented toward where he was thrown, confirms no one else attacks, then looks at her hands. Power fades again: leg trail vanishes → arm arcs break apart → palm cores shrink → eyes return gray-green → a few pale-cyan particles remain. She raises her head, realizes the hallway is quiet, then naturally turns toward camera position and walks closer with shock, confusion, caution and lingering fear. Camera tracks backward steadily, ending on a medium close-up. Rules: preserve the full awakening sequence and both fade/reactivation beats; keep crowd, shove, frightened apology, slap, instinctive right punch, shocked reaction and split crowd behavior. Attackers enter individually from different directions at irregular intervals. Same face/hair/outfit throughout. No missing overshirt, skirt swap, backpack, body clipping, distorted faces, extra limbs, attacks without contact, blood/gore, text, subtitles, logos or watermark.

entries.prompt:
晴れた昼、古い酒蔵の町の石畳の坂。坂の上で天日干しされている、空の巨大な仕込み桶。門の前の杜氏が自慢げに言う。「今年の酒は『小春日』。いい名前だろう」。その時、桶を止めていた楔がぱきっと割れ、桶が坂を転がり落ちてくる。「逃げて!」。さくらは杜氏の袖を引いて門へ走るが、その拍子に肩のヤドカリ・シオが石畳に落ちる。

さくらがシオへ手を伸ばしても、シオは動かない。「……シオには、効かない!」。さくらは手を桶へ振り上げて握り込み、桶はシオの手前でぴたりと止まる。押し戻すと、桶は坂を上っていく。拾った楔には、刃物で切った跡。「……また、切られてる」。杜氏は首をかしげる。「……はて。今年の酒は、なんて名前だったかな」。坂を下りるさくらの肩で、シオだけが蔵のすき間を向く。暗がりから声。「……やっぱり、そいつには効かないのか」

一緒に旅をしている友達が手持ちで撮った記録。肩越しに坂の上の桶を見上げる縦の構図、楔へのクラッシュズーム、石畳すれすれの低い目線で迫る桶、手持ちで走って追うカメラ、蔵のすき間へのドリーイン。BGMなし。
entries.translated_prompt:
Sunny day, stone-paved slope in an old sake town. Large empty brewing barrels drying on top of the slope. The Toji (master brewer) at the gate boasts proudly, "This year's sake is called 'Koharu-hi'. Isn't that a good name?" Suddenly, the wedge holding the barrel cracks, and the barrel rolls down the slope. "Run!" Sakura pulls the Toji's sleeve towards the gate, but in the process, the hermit crab Shio on her shoulder falls onto the stones.

Even when Sakura reaches for Shio, he doesn't move. "...It doesn't work on Shio!" Sakura raises her hand towards the barrel and clenches it; the barrel stops precisely before Shio. When pushed back, the barrel goes up the slope. The picked-up wedge has marks from being cut with a blade. "...It's been cut again." The Toji tilts his head. "...Hmm. What was this year's sake called again?" As Sakura walks down the slope, only Shio looks towards the gap in the storehouse. A voice comes from the darkness. "...So, it really doesn't work on him?"

Recorded handheld by a friend traveling together. Vertical composition looking up at the barrel over the shoulder, crash zoom to the wedge, low angle close to the stones as the barrel approaches, handheld camera chasing while running, dolly-in into the storehouse gap. No BGM.
