entries.prompt:
生成一段30秒、16:9横屏的写实电影级动作短片,直接根据文字生成。

【核心要求】
高密度、快节奏、连续的近身格斗,像顶级动作电影里最燃的一段打戏,共6轮交手、18个镜头。
第一帧就在交手中,没有片头、走路、对峙或摆造型。
全片不使用慢动作,所有动作都是实时速度。
每个镜头约1.5到2秒,只完成一个清楚的攻防,并能看到击中后的结果。
镜头之间动作紧密衔接,上一个动作的结果就是下一个动作的开始,全片没有停顿。
剧情分三幕:前10秒女主被压制;中间10秒双方拉锯,女主被打倒在地;最后10秒女主爬起来,越打越猛,最后一击结束战斗。

【人物】
女主:约27岁的成年东亚女性,五官漂亮,眼神凌厉,黑色长发扎成高马尾,身材匀称有力量。穿黑色短款皮夹克、灰色背心、黑色工装短裤、黑色高帮靴。她没有武器。
对手:一名比女主高大很多的成年男性,络腮胡,穿脏旧的军绿色工装外套和深色长裤,右手握一根锈迹斑斑的钢管。
全片只有这两个人,长相、服装和武器始终保持一致。

【场景】
傍晚的废弃仓库。高处破碎的窗户射进几道斜斜的光束,光束里飘着灰尘。仓库里堆着几个木箱,墙边有一排铁皮货架,地面是满是灰尘的水泥地,一侧有一扇半开的卷帘门。
全片都在同一个位置,木箱、货架和两人的位置前后连贯。

【分镜】

第一幕:被压制

镜头1(0–1.5秒):侧面中景。对手抡钢管横扫,女主下蹲躲过,钢管砸中木箱,木屑飞溅。

镜头2(1.5–3秒):手持跟拍。对手反手用钢管末端捅中女主腹部,女主弯腰后退两步。

镜头3(3–5秒):中景。对手冲上来一脚正蹬,女主双臂交叉格挡,仍被踢得后背撞上铁皮货架,货架剧烈晃动,上面的杂物掉落。

镜头4(5–7秒):中景。对手举钢管当头砸下,女主向侧面翻身闪开,钢管砸中货架,铁皮凹陷,发出巨响。

镜头5(7–8.5秒):近景。女主趁对手收棍,一记肘击打中他的肋部,对手闷哼一声。

镜头6(8.5–10秒):近景。对手马上用空着的左手一拳打中女主脸侧,女主马尾甩动,踉跄后退。

第二幕:拉锯,被打倒

镜头7(10–11.5秒):侧面中景。对手再次横扫钢管,女主双手抓住钢管中段,两人僵持角力。

镜头8(11.5–13秒):近景。女主用膝盖猛顶对方持棍的手腕,钢管脱手,滚落到木箱旁边的地上。

镜头9(13–14.5秒):中景。失去武器的对手挥出重拳,女主格开,连续两记短拳打中他的腹部,对手弯腰。

镜头10(14.5–16秒):中景。对手猛地抱住女主的腰,把她整个人抱起来向后推。

镜头11(16–17.5秒):稍宽中景。对手把女主重重摔在水泥地上,地面扬起一大片灰尘,女主痛苦地咬紧牙关。

镜头12(17.5–20秒):近景。对手扑上来想压住她,女主在地上一脚蹬中他的胸口,对手被蹬得后退,女主趁机翻身爬起,单膝跪地后站起。

第三幕:反杀

镜头13(20–21.5秒):近景跟拍。对手挥拳扑来,女主低头躲过,一记重拳打中他的下颌,对手头部后仰。

镜头14(21.5–23秒):中景。女主不给喘息机会,连续一记左拳、一记右拳打中对方脸部和腹部,对手连连后退。

镜头15(23–24.5秒):中景。对手反扑,伸手抓向女主,女主抓住他的手腕向下一拧,对手被拧得弯腰。

镜头16(24.5–26秒):近景。女主双手抱住对手后颈,一记膝撞顶中他的胸口,对手身体弓起。

镜头17(26–28.5秒):稍宽中景。女主抓住对手的衣领,借他弯腰的力道把他甩向木箱堆,对手撞散木箱,连人带木箱倒在地上,灰尘四起,起不来。

镜头18(28.5–30秒):女主面部近景,窗外的光束斜照在她脸上。她满脸灰尘,嘴角有轻微擦伤,胸口剧烈起伏,眼神冰冷地盯着倒地的对手。画面直接结束。

【动作与摄影】
写实电影质感,斜射的光束和飘浮的灰尘,暗部保留细节,人物脸部清楚。
每一拳、每一脚都要先接触目标,再出现身体受力、后退或失衡,不能打空气,也不能没碰到就提前倒下。
女主的动作利落凶狠,借力打力,被打会疼、会失衡,不是无敌。
撞击瞬间可以有轻微镜头震动,但必须看清谁打中了谁。
人物左右位置在相邻镜头之间保持一致,不瞬移,不穿模,不增加多余的手或武器。
钢管脱手后一直留在木箱旁的地上,没有人再捡起它。
不使用空翻、飞踢或超能力,不出现血腥特写。镜头集中在动作上,不刻意特写身体部位。

【声音】
仓库空旷的回响。钢管砸木箱、撞货架、钢管落地、每一记击打、摔地、撞散木箱的声音都和画面准确同步。
从第一秒开始就是紧张、快速、鼓点密集的动作配乐;女主被摔倒时音乐短暂压低,她爬起来后节奏重新爆发,在最后撞散木箱时达到最强,结尾留下喘息和木箱碎片落地声。
无对白,无旁白,无字幕,无文字,无水印。
entries.translated_prompt:
Generate a 30-second, 16:9 landscape realistic cinematic action short film, generated directly from text.

[Core Requirements]
High density, fast pace, continuous close-quarters combat, like the most intense fight scene in a top-tier action movie, consisting of 6 rounds of engagement and 18 shots.
The first frame is already mid-combat, no intro, walking, standoff, or posing.
No slow motion throughout the film, all actions are at real-time speed.
Each shot lasts about 1.5 to 2 seconds, completing only one clear attack/defense move, showing the result of the hit.
Actions are tightly connected between shots, the result of the previous action is the start of the next, with no pauses throughout the film.
The plot is divided into three acts: the first 10 seconds the female lead is suppressed; the middle 10 seconds both sides struggle, the female lead is knocked down; the last 10 seconds the female lead gets up, fights harder, and ends the battle with a final blow.

[Characters]
Female Lead: An adult East Asian woman around 27 years old, beautiful features, sharp eyes, black long hair tied in a high ponytail, well-proportioned and strong build. Wearing a black short leather jacket, gray tank top, black cargo shorts, and black high-top boots. She has no weapons.
Opponent: An adult male much taller than the female lead, with a stubble beard, wearing dirty old military green workwear coat and dark trousers, holding a rusty steel pipe in his right hand.
Only these two people appear in the entire film, their appearance, clothing, and weapons remain consistent.

[Scene]
An abandoned warehouse in the evening. Slanted beams of light shine through broken windows high up, dust floating in the beams. Several wooden crates are piled in the warehouse, a row of iron shelves along the wall, the ground is dusty concrete, and a half-open roller shutter door is on one side.
The entire film takes place in the same location, with the positions of the crates, shelves, and the two characters remaining coherent.

[Shot List]

Act 1: Suppressed

Shot 1 (0–1.5s): Side medium shot. The opponent swings the steel pipe horizontally, the female lead ducks to dodge, the pipe hits a wooden crate, wood chips fly.

Shot 2 (1.5–3s): Handheld tracking shot. The opponent thrusts the end of the steel pipe into the female lead's abdomen, she bends over and steps back two paces.

Shot 3 (3–5s): Medium shot. The opponent rushes forward with a front kick, the female lead blocks with crossed arms but is still kicked back against the iron shelf, which shakes violently, dropping items from it.

Shot 4 (5–7s): Medium shot. The opponent raises the steel pipe to strike overhead, the female lead rolls sideways to dodge, the pipe hits the shelf, denting the metal with a loud noise.

Shot 5 (7–8.5s): Close-up. While the opponent retracts the pipe, the female lead delivers an elbow strike to his ribs, he grunts.

Shot 6 (8.5–10s): Close-up. The opponent immediately punches the side of the female lead's face with his free left hand, her ponytail swings, she stumbles backward.

Act 2: Struggle, Knocked Down

Shot 7 (10–11.5s): Side medium shot. The opponent sweeps the steel pipe again, the female lead grabs the middle section with both hands, they engage in a stalemate.

Shot 8 (11.5–13s): Close-up. The female lead knee-strikes the opponent's wrist holding the pipe, the pipe slips out and rolls onto the ground next to the wooden crate.

Shot 9 (13–14.5s): Medium shot. The unarmed opponent throws a heavy punch, the female lead deflects it and lands two quick jabs to his abdomen, he doubles over.

Shot 10 (14.5–16s): Medium shot. The opponent suddenly hugs the female lead's waist, lifting her up and pushing her backward.

Shot 11 (16–17.5s): Wider medium shot. The opponent slams the female lead hard onto the concrete floor, raising a large cloud of dust, she grits her teeth in pain.

Shot 12 (17.5–20s): Close-up. The opponent lunges to pin her, the female lead kicks him in the chest from the ground, knocking him back, she rolls over, gets up on one knee, then stands.

Act 3: Counter-Kill

Shot 13 (20–21.5s): Close-up tracking shot. The opponent punches forward, the female lead ducks, landing a heavy punch on his jaw, his head snaps back.

Shot 14 (21.5–23s): Medium shot. The female lead gives no breathing room, landing a left jab and a right cross to his face and abdomen, he retreats repeatedly.

Shot 15 (23–24.5s): Medium shot. The opponent counter-attacks, reaching for the female lead, she grabs his wrist and twists it downward, forcing him to bend over.

Shot 16 (24.5–26s): Close-up. The female lead wraps both arms around the opponent's neck, delivering a knee strike to his chest, his body arches.

Shot 17 (26–28.5s): Wider medium shot. The female lead grabs the opponent's collar, using his bent posture to throw him towards the pile of wooden crates, he crashes into them, scattering them and falling to the ground with dust rising, unable to get up.

Shot 18 (28.5–30s): Close-up of the female lead's face, light beams from the window slant across her face. Her face is covered in dust, a slight abrasion on the corner of her mouth, chest heaving heavily, cold eyes staring at the fallen opponent. The screen ends abruptly.

[Action & Cinematography]
Realistic cinematic texture, slanted light beams and floating dust, details preserved in shadows, faces clearly visible.
Every punch and kick must make contact with the target before showing physical impact, recoil, or imbalance; no hitting air, no falling early without contact.
The female lead's movements are crisp and fierce, borrowing force, feeling pain and losing balance when hit, not invincible.
Slight camera shake is allowed at impact moments, but it must be clear who hit whom.
Left-right positioning of characters remains consistent between adjacent shots, no teleporting, no clipping, no extra hands or weapons.
The steel pipe remains on the ground next to the crate after being dropped, nobody picks it up.
No flips, flying kicks, or superpowers, no gore close-ups. Focus on the action, do not deliberately close-up on body parts.

[Audio]
Echoes of the empty warehouse. Sounds of the steel pipe hitting crates, shelves, landing on the ground, every strike, slam, and crashing crate sync accurately with the visuals.
Tense, fast-paced action soundtrack with dense drum beats starting from second one; music dips slightly when the female lead is thrown, rhythm explodes again as she gets up, reaching peak intensity when the crates crash, ending with panting and sounds of falling crate fragments.
No dialogue, no narration, no subtitles, no text, no watermarks.

entries.title: Wuxia Bamboo Forest FPV Fight Prompt
entries.description: A prompt for generating a continuous FPV shot of a wuxia martial arts fight in a bamboo forest, emphasizing kinetic speed, ghost camera movement, and cinematic realism.
entries.prompt:
One CONTINUOUS FPV shot, no cuts, one unbroken take, EXTREME kinetic speed — a relentless barrage of strikes, never a pause. The footage NEVER reverses. NO slow motion except one half-second beat at the reveal, then an instant snap back to full speed. Photoreal point-blank framing. GHOST CAMERA: only the CAMERA moves — INVISIBLE, no drone, shadow or reflection ever appears in frame. The camera ORBITS the two fighters and DIVES in on every strike, then whips back out — always moving, never static; it only ever DESCENDS or stays level, never climbs. GEOMETRY LOCK: the two fighters always face each other, one axis between them; every blow travels across that axis, OFF-axis past the lens. NO fade to black — the take ends mid-fight.

CINEMATIC CAPTURE: real FPV footage — ultra-wide 14mm lens, barrel distortion, 180-degree shutter, heavy motion blur on whip pans, fine grain. A towering bamboo forest at dawn, mist between the stalks, gold light shafts, leaves carpeting a small clearing. Grade: jade green and pale gold, soft mist, rich contrast — a classic wuxia epic shot from a racing FPV, NOT a game engine, NOT animation.

The HERO is a young woman in flowing white silk robes with long black hair tied high, fast and weightless. Her OPPONENT is a tall grey-bearded master in heavy black robes, powerful and unhurried. Both are original characters. The shot opens ALREADY mid-fight, high in the swaying bamboo tops: she runs along a bending stalk and SNAPS a kick at his head, he sweeps it aside, and both fighters drop through the canopy trading blows, the camera DIVING down with them through tearing leaves. They land in the clearing and the barrage begins: the camera orbits tight as she fires a rapid chain of palm strikes, he blocks every one, forearms CRACKING; it dives on his heavy punch as she slips it, the fist tearing past the lens and splintering a bamboo stalk behind her. She plants a foot on a trunk, RUNS two steps along it and spins down into a whirling kick; he catches her ankle, she twists free in midair and lands crouched. The camera whips low around their circling feet, then dives in again — elbow, knee, double palm, sweep — each blow answered instantly, robes snapping, sleeves whipping the air. He drives her back with a storm of punches, bamboo shattering on both sides as she ducks and weaves, until she rebounds off a trunk. THE REVEAL: half-second slow motion — both fighters flying at each other, her spinning kick and his open palm meeting in midair, sweat and leaves hanging motionless in the gold light — then an INSTANT SNAP back to full speed as the blows COLLIDE, the impact blasting a ring of leaves and mist outward and bending the bamboo all around; they both land and instantly explode into an even faster exchange, a blur of hands, the camera orbiting.

entries.title: Subway Wing Chun Fight Silence Effect
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for a live-action subway fight scene featuring Wing Chun combat and a unique 'sound cancellation' visual/audio effect.
entries.prompt:
**IDENTITY:** Use image as the exact face, identity and outfit reference. Exactly ONE So-Yeon throughout. Real human actor, authentic skin, eyes, hair and biomechanics. Never CGI or digital double.

**SETTING:** Empty late-night Korean subway platform. Metal benches, yellow safety strip, flickering fluorescent lights, tiled walls, arrival board reading "도착 정보 없음", dark tunnel and approaching train. Five unarmed delinquent boys in untidy school uniforms.

**STYLE:** Ultra-photorealistic live action, restrained VFX, intimate cinematic framing. Korean dialogue. No music or subtitles. Only diegetic sound.

**POWER — HOLLOW NOTE:** So-Yeon awakens into emotionless, close-range Wing Chun combat: CHAIN PUNCH → TRAP → PALM → ELBOW → PARRY → HOOK → KNEE. Minimal footwork, tight centerline strikes, no kicks, spins or dashes.

Every physical impact cancels sound at its contact point: IMPACT → ABSOLUTE SILENCE (0.2s) → AMBIENCE AND DELAYED REACTION RETURN. Larger strikes create larger silence zones. Final strike silences the entire platform for 0.35s. Subtle air shimmer only; no glow, particles, shockwaves, wind, heat or supernatural visual spectacle. Horror is entirely audio-driven.

**ACTION TIMELINE:**

**00:00–00:06:** So-Yeon sits hunched on a bench as five boys surround, slap her head, pull her ponytail, kick the bench and knock her bag toward the tracks. Leader: "야, 반응 좀 해봐. 재미없게." She whispers: "아… 하지 마…" Train rumble swells, then ALL sound abruptly disappears.

**00:06–00:12:** Sound returns. So-Yeon stands perfectly still, eyes cold and unfocused. Leader swings; she traps his wrist and palm-strikes his chest. Contact creates localized silence; his soundless gasp arrives late with the returning ambience. She stares at her hand, confused. A bully shouts: "저 새끼가?!" Four rush her.

**00:12–00:22:** Rapid, brutally efficient Wing Chun against simultaneous attackers. Chain punches, traps, elbow, parry, palm, hook and knee. Feet barely move. Every readable impact creates a separate silent pocket; overlapping silences swallow the platform as the boys collapse one after another. No rage, no wasted motion.

**00:22–00:27:** Leader escapes toward the stairs, then turns and swings wildly. So-Yeon calmly walks inside his attack and lands one powerful centerline palm strike. Entire platform goes silent for 0.35s. He slides backward across the tiles.

**00:27–00:30:** Train roar, fluorescent hum and delayed body impact slam back simultaneously. Headlights illuminate So-Yeon's blank face. She studies her open hands, briefly frightened, then walks toward the arriving train. Never looks back. CUT.

**CAMERA:** Tight, steady close-ups, slow push-ins during silence, brief handheld jolts on contact. No whip-pans, speed ramps or chaotic editing. Hold each silence uncomfortably long.

**NON-NEGOTIABLE:** One consistent real human. Clearly readable simultaneous combat. Every sound cancellation follows physical

entries.prompt:

TITLE: THE SECRET STRAWBERRY GARDEN

The pink-haired girl in the reference image is the main heroine. The girl stands in the same kitchen, opens the refrigerator and discovers an unusually large glowing red strawberry. She picks it up with both hands and looks surprised.

3–6 SECONDS:

She brings a transparent round glass dessert mold to the counter. She pours beautiful translucent pink jelly into it, creating smooth swirling patterns.

She adds another layer of pink transparent jelly. The dessert gradually becomes a beautiful clear strawberry-shaped dome, with the miniature garden visible inside.

19–23 SECONDS:
She decorates the top with fresh strawberries, tiny white flowers and delicate green leaves. The finished dessert sparkles under the warm kitchen lights.

23–27 SECONDS:
She carefully cuts a slice from the transparent dessert. The inside reveals an astonishing miniature garden, with tiny trees, flowers and red strawberries surrounded by glowing pink jelly.

entries.title: Hermit Crab Gondola Rescue
entries.description: A detailed Japanese prompt for Seedance 2.5 Flash describing a dramatic scene involving a hermit crab, a girl named Sakura, and a malfunctioning gondola cabin in an autumn valley.
entries.prompt:
晴れた昼、紅葉の深い谷。ゴンドラ乗り場に立つさくらの肩で、白いヤドカリが谷を見ている。突然、ヤドカリがさっと殻にこもる。次の瞬間、谷の上の朱色のキャビンの前の留め具が外れ、キャビンは残った1本のワイヤーで、前がほぼ真下を向くほど傾いてぶら下がる。「助けてくれ……！」。さくらが手を伸ばすと、残った1本に刃物の跡。「……切られてる」

キャビンがまたがくんと下がる。さくらが手を握り込むと、キャビンは空中でぴたりと止まる。手首を返して水平に戻し、乗り場へ引き寄せる。降りた老人はベンチで首をかしげる。「……はて。わしは、何しにここへ来たんだったかな」。ヤドカリは床にこぼした塩の粒で字を書く。「……シオ？」。最後、肩のシオだけが振り向く。谷の向こうの尾根を、白いコートの男が歩き去っていく。

一緒に旅をしている友達が手持ちで撮った記録。肩越しに谷の上のキャビンを見る縦の構図、留め具とワイヤーへのクラッシュズーム、1本で吊られたキャビンの横を流れるフライバイ、外れた金具が揺れるホイップパン、窓越しの手持ち、望遠で尾根へ寄るズーム。BGMなし。
entries.translated_prompt:
A sunny day, deep valley with red leaves. On Sakura's shoulder standing at the gondola station, a white hermit crab looks at the valley. Suddenly, the hermit crab quickly retreats into its shell. The next moment, the front clasp of the vermilion cabin above the valley comes loose, and the cabin hangs tilted almost straight down on the remaining single wire. "Help me...!" When Sakura reaches out, there are blade marks on the remaining wire. "...It's cut."

The cabin drops again with a jolt. As Sakura clenches her hand, the cabin stops dead in mid-air. She twists her wrist to return it to horizontal and pulls it toward the station. The old man who gets off tilts his head on the bench. "...Hmm. What did I come here for?" The hermit crab writes letters with grains of salt spilled on the floor. "...Shio?" Finally, only Shio on the shoulder turns around. A man in a white coat walks away along the ridge beyond the valley.

Record shot handheld by a friend traveling together. Vertical composition looking over the shoulder at the cabin above the valley, crash zoom to the clasp and wire, flyby past the cabin hanging on one wire, whip pan as the detached metal shakes, handheld through the window, zoom to the ridge with telephoto. No BGM.

entries.prompt:
【優先参照画像及び記述名称】
下記の優先参照画像を正確に分析し、忠実に再現する。
@Image1=記述名称:主人公
主人公の顔・髪・メイク・服・アクセサリー・ネイル・靴の基準とする。映像に使うのは主人公本人の姿だけ。
@Image2=記述名称:おやじ
おやじの顔・頭・体つき・服の基準とする。映像に使うのはおやじ本人の姿だけ。
@Image3=記述名称:若者
若者の顔・髪・体つき・服の基準とする。映像に使うのは若者本人の姿だけ。
@Image4=記述名称:焼き鳥屋の店内、大将、店員、隣の席の客、奥の席の客、ジョッキ
焼き鳥屋の店内と、大将・店員・隣の席の客・奥の席の客・ジョッキの基準とする。
上記の参照画像の対象は以後、記述名称のみプロンプトに記載する。

【優先順位】
外見は優先参照画像を優先し、大きさ・動作・配置・カメラ・時間・順番・音は以下の記述を優先する。参照画像の質感にかかわらず、映像全体を実写の映画の質感で統一する。

【映像仕様】

30秒。3:4の縦長。24fps。
実写映画品質。居酒屋の客がスマートフォンでこっそり撮ったような、その場のままの自然な実写の映像。手持ちの小さな揺れが最後まで続く。フィルムのような細かい粒子、自然なモーションブラー。
色調は、赤ちょうちんと裸電球のオレンジ色の暖かい色。
舞台:夜の焼き鳥屋の店内。看板・品書き・ポスター・黒板の文字は日本語。
光:天井の赤ちょうちんと裸電球の、上からのオレンジ色の暖かい光。おやじと主人公と若者の顔と表情は読めて、テーブルの下といすの下には影が落ちる。奥の焼き台のあたりは煙で少しかすむ。最後まで同じ夜の店の光。
カメラ:手前の席に座った撮っている人が、自分のテーブルの上で胸の高さに構えたスマートフォン。向かいのテーブルと3つのいすをまっすぐ見る、35mm相当のレンズ。画面には、いちばん手前に撮っている人のテーブルのジョッキと焼き鳥の皿、その先の床の通路をはさんで向かいのテーブル、そのテーブルの奥に3つのいすが入り、奥に焼き台と赤ちょうちんが見える。最初から最後まで同じ席から、30秒をひと続きの1カットで撮る。ピントは3つのいすに座る人に合い、奥の焼き台と奥の席の客は少しぼける。
主人公は1人、おやじは1人、若者は1人で、最後までこの3人のまま。全カットで同じ主人公の顔・髪・服と、同じおやじの顔・服と、同じ若者の顔・服を保つ。
並び:3人は、向かいのテーブルの奥に並ぶ3つのいすに座り、向かいのテーブルをはさんで撮っている人の方を向く。主人公が来る前は、左のいすにおやじ、右のいすに若者が座り、真ん中のいすは空いている。主人公が座ってからは、画面の左からおやじ・主人公・若者で、この並びが最後まで同じ。
主人公は真ん中のいすに座ると、右腕の肘をおやじの左肩に、左腕の肘を若者の右肩にかけて、おやじと若者の間で身を乗り出す。つっこみで体勢を変えても、言い終わるとまた両肘を肩に戻す。
おやじは最初から右手にジョッキを1つ持っている。

【音響共通】
音は、店のざわめき、焼き台で串が焼けるジューという音、遠くでジョッキが当たる音が、最後まで小さく続く。
音声:声はすべて日本語の標準語で話す。台詞は話している人物の口の動きに合わせる(Lip sync)。台詞を言っている人だけが口を動かし、ほかの人は口を閉じて聞いている。1人ずつ順番に話し、書いた台詞をそのまま最後まで言い切る。台詞の声は、店のざわめきよりはっきり大きく、スマートフォンで撮った近い声で聞こえる。主人公は成人の若い女性で、明るくはじけた高めの声のギャル語を、台本を読む演技ではなく、友達としゃべる時のような素の早口で、笑いまじりに話す。主人公の掛け声は、ひとかたまりの一息で弾けるように叫ぶ。おやじは50代の男性で、低めのだみ声の、酔った大きな声。若者は20代の男性で、小さめの落ち着いた声で、ぼそっと話す。大将、店員、隣の席の客、奥の席の客の声は、ざわめきと笑い声と店の声だけ。
画面の文字は、焼き鳥屋の店内の看板・品書き・ポスター・黒板の日本語だけ。

【SCENE1/0:00〜0:30】
酔ったおやじが草食系の若者に説教しているところへ、主人公が割って入り、おやじの武勇伝につっこむ。

【CUT01/0:00〜0:30】
最初のフレームは、焼き鳥屋の店内の、撮っている人の席からの画。35mm相当。画面の下の端に撮っている人のテーブルのジョッキと焼き鳥の皿が少し入り、その先の床の通路をはさんで向かいのテーブル、そのテーブルの奥の左のいすにおやじ、右のいすに若者が座り、真ん中のいすは空いている。奥で大将がうちわで炭をあおぎ、煙と赤ちょうちんが見える。店のざわめきと焼き台のジューという音。
0:00から、おやじが真ん中のいすの上へ体を乗り出し、右手にジョッキを持ったまま、左手で若者の右肩をバンバンと2回たたいて、上機嫌に笑う。肩をたたくたびに、パンパンという手の音が鳴る。若者は肩をすくめ、困った顔で目を伏せる。奥で店員がジョッキを運んで通路を横切る。
0:02から、おやじが乗り出したまま若者の顔をのぞきこみ、低いだみ声で大きく、酔って得意げに言う。「おまえなぁ、そうしょくけいだかなんだかしらんが、おとこはがつがついかんとだめだ!」 若者は目をそらして、口をきゅっと結ぶ。奥の席の客がジョッキを高く上げて乾杯する。
0:07.5から、若者がうつむいて、向かいのテーブルの串の皿から、焼き鳥の串を1本つまみ、先を小さくかじって飲みこんでから、小さく低い声で、ため息まじりにぼそっと言う。「はぁ…」 おやじは若者を見ている。店員が皿を運んで、3つのいすのうしろの通路を通る。
0:09から、画面の右の通路から主人公が歩いてきて、真ん中のいすのうしろに回り、満面の笑顔でいすを引いてどさっと座る。いすの脚が床をこするギギッという音。おやじはびっくりして体を左のいすへ引き、若者は目を丸くして顔を上げる。主人公が右腕の肘をおやじの左肩に、左腕の肘を若者の右肩にかけて身を乗り出し、間を空けずに、高い声で弾むように早口に言う。「え、なになに?おじ、こいばな?」 すぐに弾けるように叫ぶ。「あげてこー!」 隣の席の客がちらっとこちらを見て、すぐ自分たちの話に戻る。
0:13.5から、おやじが気を取り直してジョッキを持った右手を胸の前に置き、胸を張って、左手の指を3本立てながら、だみ声で大きく、自慢げに言う。「おれのわかいころはなぁ、ひとばんでさんにんくどいたもんだ!」 若者は横目でおやじを見る。奥で大将が串を返し、奥の席の客は笑いながら飲んでいる。
0:17.5
entries.translated_prompt:
【Priority Reference Images and Description Names】
Accurately analyze and faithfully reproduce the following priority reference images.
@Image1 = Description Name: Protagonist
Use as the standard for the protagonist's face, hair, makeup, clothes, accessories, nails, and shoes. Only the protagonist's appearance is used in the video.
@Image2 = Description Name: Old Man
Use as the standard for the old man's face, head, body type, and clothes. Only the old man's appearance is used in the video.
@Image3 = Description Name: Young Man
Use as the standard for the young man's face, hair, body type, and clothes. Only the young man's appearance is used in the video.
@Image4 = Description Name: Yakiniku Shop Interior, Owner, Staff, Neighboring Customer, Back Customer, Beer Mug
Use as the standard for the yakiniku shop interior, owner, staff, neighboring customer, back customer, and beer mug.
For the above reference image subjects, only use the description names in the subsequent prompts.

【Priority Order】
Prioritize the priority reference images for appearance, and prioritize the following descriptions for size, action, placement, camera, time, order, and sound. Regardless of the texture of the reference images, unify the entire video with the quality of live-action film.

【Video Specifications】

30 seconds. 3:4 vertical aspect ratio. 24fps.
Live-action movie quality. A natural live-action video that looks like it was secretly filmed on a smartphone by a customer in an izakaya. Small handheld shakes continue until the end. Fine film-like grain, natural motion blur.
Color tone: Warm orange colors from red lanterns and bare light bulbs.
Setting: Nighttime yakiniku (skewer) shop interior. Signs, menus, posters, and blackboard text are in Japanese.
Lighting: Warm orange light from above coming from ceiling red lanterns and bare light bulbs. The faces and expressions of the old man, protagonist, and young man are readable, with shadows falling under the tables and chairs. The area around the grill in the back is slightly hazy with smoke. The same nighttime shop light continues to the end.
Camera: A smartphone held at chest height on the table by the person filming, who is sitting in the front seat. A lens equivalent to 35mm looking straight at the opposite table and three chairs. In the frame, the beer mug and skewer plate on the filmer's table are in the immediate foreground, followed by the aisle floor, then the opposite table, behind which are three chairs, and further back are the grill and red lanterns. From start to finish, shoot the 30 seconds as one continuous cut from the same seat. Focus is on the people sitting in the three chairs, while the grill in the back and customers in the back seats are slightly blurred.
The protagonist is one person, the old man is one person, and the young man is one person; these three remain throughout. Maintain the same face, hair, and clothes for the protagonist, old man, and young man across all cuts.
Arrangement: The three sit on the three chairs arranged in the back of the opposite table, facing the person filming across the table. Before the protagonist arrives, the old man sits in the left chair, the young man in the right chair, and the middle chair is empty. After the protagonist sits down, the arrangement from left to right on screen is Old Man - Protagonist - Young Man, and this remains the same until the end.
When the protagonist sits in the middle chair, she rests her right elbow on the old man's left shoulder and her left elbow on the young man's right shoulder, leaning forward between them. Even if she changes posture during interjections, she returns both elbows to their shoulders after finishing speaking.
The old man holds one beer mug in his right hand from the beginning.

【Common Audio】
Sound: The murmur of the shop, the sizzling sound of skewers grilling on the stand, and the clinking of mugs in the distance continue softly until the end.
Voice: All voices speak in standard Japanese. Dialogue matches the lip movements of the speaker (Lip sync). Only the person speaking moves their mouth; others listen with mouths closed. Speak one by one in turn, saying the written dialogue completely to the end. Dialogue voices are clearly louder than the shop murmur, sounding close as if recorded on a smartphone. The protagonist is a young adult female who speaks bright, high-pitched 'Gal' slang not as scripted acting but as casual rapid-fire chatter among friends, laughing along. Her shouts burst out in one breath. The old man is a male in his 50s with a low, drunk, loud voice. The young man is a male in his 20s with a small, calm voice, speaking briefly. The voices of the owner, staff, neighboring customer, and back customer consist only of murmurs, laughter, and shop sounds.
On-screen text is limited to Japanese signs, menus, posters, and blackboards in the yakiniku shop.

【SCENE1 / 0:00-0:30】
The drunk old man is lecturing the herbivore-type young man when the protagonist interrupts and retorts against the old man's tales of bravery.

【CUT01 / 0:00-0:30】
The first frame is the view from the filmer's seat inside the yakiniku shop. Equivalent to 35mm. At the bottom edge of the screen, the filmer's table with a beer mug and skewer plate is partially visible, separated by the floor aisle from the opposite table. Behind that table, the old man sits in the left chair, the young man in the right chair, and the middle chair is empty. In the back, the owner fans the charcoal with a fan, showing smoke and red lanterns. Sounds of shop murmur and sizzling skewers.
From 0:00, the old man leans his body over the middle chair, still holding the beer mug in his right hand, and pats the young man's right shoulder twice with his left hand, smiling cheerfully. With each pat, a slapping sound occurs. The young man shrugs his shoulders, looking troubled and averting his eyes. In the back, a staff member carries a beer mug across the aisle.
From 0:02, the old man, still leaning, peers into the young man's face and says loudly in a low, drunk, proud voice: "Hey you, I don't know if you're a herbivore or whatever, but a man has to be aggressive!" The young man looks away, pursing his lips tightly. Customers in the back raise their mugs high for a toast.
From 0:07.5, the young man looks down, picks up one skewer from the plate on the opposite table, takes a small bite of the tip, swallows, and then says quietly in a small, low voice, sighing: "Haa..." The old man watches him. A staff member carries plates through the aisle behind the three chairs.
From 0:09, the protagonist walks in from the aisle on the right side of the screen, goes around behind the middle chair, pulls the chair with a big smile, and sits down heavily. The sound of chair legs scraping the floor. The old man is surprised and pulls his body toward the left chair, while the young man opens his eyes wide and raises his face. The protagonist rests her right elbow on the old man's left shoulder and her left elbow on the young man's right shoulder, leaning forward, and without pause, speaks rapidly in a high, bouncing voice: "Eh, what's what? Uncle, love story?" Immediately shouting explosively: "Tell me!" The neighboring customer glances over briefly before returning to their own conversation.
From 0:13.5, the old man recovers his composure, places his right hand holding the beer mug in front of his chest, puffs out his chest, and while raising three fingers on his left hand, says loudly and boastfully in a deep voice: "When I was young, I hit on three women with just one move!" The young man looks at the old man sideways. In the back, the owner turns the skewers, and customers in the back drink while laughing.
From 0:17.5

entries.prompt:
【片名】目标上错车

【时长】30秒完整短片,不分段

【画幅】21:9宽银幕

【整体风格与摄影】

1974年意大利特工动作喜剧,35毫米Techniscope胶片,粗粝颗粒、柔和老式变形宽银幕镜头、零星尘点与轻微划痕。真实雨夜街景、老式汽车和手工怪物服,打斗采用短促、略微加速的肢体喜剧。

低饱和灰蓝、灰褐与暗绿色,湿路面反射路灯和少量店铺暖光,不使用强烈霓虹滤镜。人物面孔在阴影中仍清楚可辨。

明确硬切,跟拍、近景和全景交替。关键抢夺与上车动作必须看清起点、接触和结束状态,不用甩镜遮盖瞬移。

【参考图与角色锁定】

参考图是设计依据,不是首帧。

@img1@1d2dabbf-315a-45e9-9bc5-3a9b2f3bfc7a锁定四位怪客:

怪嘴怪:苍白巨大畸形头部、多嘴躯干、黑色分节护甲。

法老:双角金色头冠、古埃及金色服饰。

机械绅士:黑色圆顶礼帽、旧式西装、半边机械脸与机械手。

龙虾怪:红色弯角头甲、宽厚甲壳、巨大双钳。

保持四位各自体格与服装,不添加激光或超能力。

@img2@452944ad-728c-4f07-8905-faffae4ab8c4仅锁定男女主体格关系,男主略高且明显更宽厚,忽略背景文字与刻度。

@img3@341cf5e8-4ba4-4c87-81e0-16a31533315e锁定成年女主的面容、她穿着@eca39a0d-c8c6-4b09-9090-6f38598ec86f和高跟鞋。

@img4@196fe266-a351-44fa-9c7a-223532b8bbbe锁定男主的面容、身材和穿着。

另加一只普通旧式指针腕表,表面明确显示两点五十八分。

本片发生在70年代的香港雨夜城市街头。

【女主——海妖风身体语言】

女主静止时身体微侧,肩部松沉,颈部拉长,下巴略抬,重心落在一侧,双脚前后错位,形成自然流畅的S曲线。

半垂眼皮,冷静观察身后倒影与街道动静,表情克制,有疏离而危险的从容感。接头时略侧头靠近男主说话,不夸张媚笑。

行走、避让和关门时,双脚自然分开支撑,高跟鞋落点准确,采用短步与半转身,不在湿地上急旋或长距离奔跑。

只在出租车驶离后轻拢一次耳侧发丝。海妖风仅用于姿态、眼神与动作收尾,不改变服装,不增加魔法特效。

【固定空间与车辆】

一条雨夜老街,前景是有雨棚的平整人行道,车道在画面右侧。

一辆1970年代宽体六座出租车停靠路边,车头朝画面右方。

乘客后舱有两排座椅、四个乘客位置,顶部和腿部空间足够四怪收拢身体坐下。

靠人行道一侧是一扇宽大的后舱侧门,向车头方向开启,门打开后不占据四怪接近路线。

司机始终坐在前排,后舱与驾驶位之间有固定隔板。

前排乘客侧车窗降下,方便女主递钱。

出租车初始静止,司机等候。车辆只有在四怪坐稳、侧门关好后才驶离。

男主站在后舱侧门旁,女主从画面左侧走来。

四怪沿人行道从女主来路接近,不从车道或墙里突然出现。

【道具与动作逻辑】

只有一只深棕色硬壳公文箱,两枚金属锁扣。

女主右手提箱,放到男主脚边后,箱柄仍朝自己,便于重新提起。

箱内只有四张单独的黑白通缉照,分别对应四怪,不放机密文件或武器。

四怪依次上车:

机械绅士先进入后舱,坐到内侧后排;

法老跟入,坐到它旁边;

龙虾怪侧身进入前排乘客座,双钳收在胸前;

怪嘴怪最后坐进剩余位置。

不能把四个宽体角色同时塞在普通三人后座。

男主只使用挡路、转移来势、扶住肩背的短促动作。

车门不击打身体,不夹手脚。

女主不把公文箱伸进车内,四怪始终没有抢到箱子。

【30秒严格分镜】

镜头1|0—3秒

人行道高度的侧向短跟拍。

女主从撑伞路人之间穿过,走到出租车旁。

她从路边橱窗倒影看见四怪跟随,随即停到男主身侧,将公文箱放在他脚边。

身体微侧,目光仍望着橱窗,用重庆话低声说:

"三点钟方向,四个尾巴。"

背景两位路人正常走过,尚未察觉危险。

镜头2|3—5秒

硬切,男主腕表与脸部中近景。

男主先看表,表针清楚显示两点五十八,再抬头认真纠正:

"才两点五十八。"

女主目光停在他脸上半拍,没有回答。

背景机械绅士已加快脚步,法老紧随,另外两怪稍后。

镜头3|5—8秒

硬切,出租车侧面全身中广景。

机械绅士从女主左后方伸手抓向地上的箱柄。

女主看到来手,先提起公文箱,向出租车车头方向退半步,让箱子离开抓握范围。

机械绅士前扑落空,上身继续向前。

男主用靠近车门的一只手将宽侧门拉开,另一只手贴住机械绅士上背,顺着它原有来势稍向门口引导。

机械绅士为了站稳,先踏上低踏板,再迈进后舱。

头帽避开门框,不撞头,双手未被门夹住。

镜头4|8—11秒

硬切,车门外朝车内的中景。

机械绅士转身想出来,男主宽厚身体留在门外,挡住直线路径。

法老赶到,弯腰伸手抓机械绅士的西装肩部,想把它拉出来。

机械绅士正向内退步腾出空间,反而将法老牵得向门内跨了一步。

龙虾怪在后方急着靠近,一侧厚肩甲碰到法老后背。

法老顺着这股短促推力,第二只脚也踏进车内。

两人跌坐在内侧后排,法老头冠微歪,机械绅士礼帽压低。

碰撞是服装与坐垫间的闷响,不打破车窗。

镜头5|11—14秒

硬切,侧门外全身侧景。

龙虾怪站在门口,双钳伸进去,试图拉出法老。

钳臂太宽,左右同时探入时碰到门框,发出两声空心"当"。

男主不硬推它,先用手掌轻拍门框内侧,示意收拢。

龙虾怪本能地收钳、侧身,肩甲终于通过门口。

它向车内迈一步,想继续够法老。

男主只在其上背扶一下,帮助它完成转身,龙虾怪顺势坐到靠门的前排乘客座。

双钳收在胸前,门口仍留有最后一个人的通行空间。

镜头6|14—17秒

硬切,沿人行道望向车门的低机位中广景。

怪嘴怪最后冲来,伸手抓向女主手中的公文箱。

女主先看清它的来向,再将箱子收到身体远侧,沿车身向前侧移一步。

怪嘴怪抓空,继续朝车门方向踉跄。

男主侧身让出入口,左手扶住它上臂,右手轻带肩背,使来势转入后舱。

怪嘴怪两步跨上踏板,坐进最后一个空位,挤得龙虾怪肩膀轻晃。

它立刻回头想起身,法老恰好调整头冠,双角挡住其前倾路线;它只好缩回座位。

四怪全部在车内,手脚和双钳均越过门槛。

镜头7|17—20秒

硬切,前排车窗与后舱侧门同框的中景。

男主扫一眼门槛,确认没有手脚,扶住侧门外缘。

女主走回门旁,用空着的左手接过门把,利落将门关好,锁舌"咔哒"。

她右手仍提公文箱,随后将箱子放在自己脚边,取出提前夹在外袋中的纸币,递进司机车窗:

"机场,莫停。"

司机接钱,简短点头,不说话。

镜头8|20—23秒

硬切,街道方向的宽全景。

出租车平稳起步,向画面右侧驶离,不急甩、不漂移。

后舱车窗中,法老终于坐直,发现车在走,伸手指向窗外。

机械绅士试着隔着玻璃解释,龙虾怪举钳又怕碰到同伴,怪嘴怪被挤在座位上,四张脸形成狼狈的一排。

人行道上一位路人停下半步,看看出租车,再看看若无其事的男女主,随后继续走。

没有人拦车或进入车道。

镜头9|23—26秒

硬

[Title] Wrong Target Car

[Duration] 30-second complete short film, no segmentation

[Aspect Ratio] 21:9 Widescreen

[Overall Style & Cinematography]

1974 Italian agent action comedy, 35mm Techniscope film, coarse grain, soft old-style anamorphic widescreen lens, scattered dust spots and minor scratches. Real rainy night street scenes, vintage cars and handmade monster costumes, fights use short, slightly accelerated physical comedy.

Low-saturation gray-blue, gray-brown and dark green, wet road surface reflects streetlights and some shop warm lights, no strong neon filters. Faces clearly distinguishable even in shadows.

Explicit hard cuts, alternating tracking shots, close-ups and wide shots. Key snatch and boarding actions must clearly show start, contact, and end states, no whip pans to cover teleportation.

[Reference Images & Character Locking]

Reference images are design basis, not first frames.

@img1@1d2dabbf-315a-45e9-9bc5-3a9b2f3bfc7a locks four oddballs:

Mouth Monster: Pale giant deformed head, multi-mouth torso, black segmented armor.

Pharaoh: Double-horned golden crown, ancient Egyptian golden attire.

Mechanical Gentleman: Black bowler hat, old-fashioned suit, half mechanical face and mechanical hand.

Lobster Monster: Red curved horn headshell, thick shell, giant pincers.

Maintain individual physiques and costumes, no lasers or superpowers added.

@img2@452944ad-728c-4f07-8905-faffae4ab8c4 only locks physique relationship between male and female leads, male lead slightly taller and clearly broader, ignore background text and scales.

@img3@341cf5e8-4ba4-4c87-81e0-16a31533315e locks adult female lead's face, she wears @eca39a0d-c8c6-4b09-9090-6f38598ec86f and high heels.

@img4@196fe266-a351-44fa-9c7a-223532b8bbbe locks male lead's face, physique and attire.

Additionally add a common old-style analog wristwatch, dial clearly shows 2:58.

This film takes place on Hong Kong rainy night city streets in the 70s.

[Female Lead - Siren-like Body Language]

When stationary, female lead's body slightly sideways, shoulders relaxed, neck elongated, chin slightly raised, weight on one side, feet staggered front and back, forming natural smooth S-curve.

Half-lowered eyelids, calmly observing reflections behind and street activity, restrained expression, with detached dangerous composure. When meeting contact, slightly tilts head towards male lead, no exaggerated flirtation.

When walking, avoiding, and closing doors, feet naturally spread for support, heel strikes accurate, using short steps and half-turns, no spinning or long-distance running on wet ground.

Only lightly tucks hair behind ear once after taxi drives away. Siren style used only for posture, gaze, and action endings, no costume changes, no magic effects added.

[Fixed Space & Vehicle]

A rainy night old street, foreground is flat sidewalk with awning, traffic lane on right side of frame.

A 1970s wide-body six-seat taxi parked by curb, front facing right of frame.

Passenger rear cabin has two rows of seats, four passenger positions, ceiling and legroom sufficient for four monsters to huddle and sit.

Wide rear cabin side door on sidewalk side, opens towards front of car, open door does not block four monsters' approach route.

Driver always in front seat, fixed partition between rear cabin and driver seat.

Front passenger window lowered, convenient for female lead to pass money.

Taxi initially stationary, driver waiting. Vehicle only departs after four monsters seated securely and side door closed.

Male lead stands by rear cabin side door, female lead walks from left of frame.

Four monsters approach along sidewalk from female lead's path, no sudden appearances from lanes or walls.

[Props & Action Logic]

Only one dark brown hard-shell briefcase, two metal clasps.

Female lead carries case in right hand, after placing at male lead's feet, handle still towards herself for easy re-grasping.

Case contains only four separate black-and-white wanted posters, corresponding to four monsters, no confidential documents or weapons.

Four monsters board sequentially:

Mechanical Gentleman enters rear cabin first, sits inner back row;

Pharaoh follows, sits beside it;

Lobster Monster sidles into front passenger seat, pincers held to chest;

Mouth Monster finally sits in remaining spot.

Cannot cram four wide-bodied characters into standard three-person back seat simultaneously.

Male lead only uses blocking, momentum redirection, shoulder/back supporting short actions.

Doors do not strike bodies, do not pinch limbs.

Female lead does not put briefcase inside car, four monsters never succeed in grabbing case.

[Strict 30-Second Storyboard]

Shot 1 | 0-3s

Short lateral tracking shot at sidewalk height.

Female lead passes between umbrella-carrying pedestrians, walks to taxi.

She sees four monsters following in roadside shop window reflection, immediately stops beside male lead, places briefcase at his feet.

Body slightly sideways, gaze still on window, says quietly in Chongqing dialect:

"Three o'clock direction, four tails."

Background two pedestrians walk normally, unaware of danger.

Shot 2 | 3-5s

Hard cut, male lead's wristwatch and face medium-close shot.

Male lead checks watch first, needle clearly shows 2:58, then looks up seriously correcting:

"It's only 2:58."

Female lead's gaze pauses on his face for half a beat, no reply.

Background Mechanical Gentleman accelerates, Pharaoh follows closely, other two slightly behind.

Shot 3 | 5-8s

Hard cut, taxi side full-body medium-wide shot.

Mechanical Gentleman reaches from female lead's left rear towards case handle on ground.

Female lead sees incoming hand, lifts briefcase first, steps half back towards taxi front, moving case out of grasp range.

Mechanical Gentleman's lunge misses, upper body continues forward.

Male lead uses hand near door to pull wide side door open, other hand presses Mechanical Gentleman's upper back, guiding slightly towards door along its original momentum.

To stabilize, Mechanical Gentleman steps on low pedal first, then enters rear cabin.

Hat avoids door frame, no head bump, hands not pinched by door.

Shot 4 | 8-11s

Hard cut, medium shot from outside door into car.

Mechanical Gentleman turns trying to exit, male lead's broad body stays outside door, blocking straight path.

Pharaoh arrives, bends reaching for Mechanical Gentleman's suit shoulder, trying to pull it out.

Mechanical Gentleman stepping back to make space instead pulls Pharaoh one step further into door.

Lobster Monster hurries closer from behind, one thick shoulder pad hits Pharaoh's back.

Pharaoh follows this short push, second foot also steps into car.

Both collapse onto inner back row seats, Pharaoh's crown slightly tilted, Mechanical Gentleman's bowler hat pressed down.

Collision is muffled thud between costume and cushion, no broken windows.

Shot 5 | 11-14s

Hard cut, side full-body shot outside door.

Lobster Monster stands at door, pincers extended in, trying to pull Pharaoh out.

Pincer arms too wide, hitting door frame when entering left and right simultaneously, making two hollow "clang" sounds.

Male lead doesn't push hard, first taps door frame inside with palm, signaling to retract.

Lobster Monster instinctively retracts pincers, sidles, shoulder pads finally pass through doorway.

It steps one foot into car, continuing to reach for Pharaoh.

Male lead only supports its upper back briefly, helping it complete turn, Lobster Monster slides into front passenger seat near door.

Pincers held to chest, doorway still leaves passage space for last person.

Shot 6 | 14-17s

Hard cut, low-angle medium-wide shot along sidewalk towards door.

Mouth Monster charges last, reaching for briefcase in female lead's hand.

Female lead first sees its direction, then moves case to far side of body, steps sideways forward along car body.

Mouth Monster grabs air, continues staggering towards door.

Male lead sidesteps to clear entrance, left hand supports its upper arm, right hand lightly guides shoulder/back, redirecting momentum into rear cabin.

Mouth Monster steps two feet onto pedal, sits in last empty spot, causing Lobster Monster's shoulder to shake slightly.

It immediately turns trying to stand up, Pharaoh adjusting crown exactly blocks its forward path with horns; it has to shrink back into seat.

All four monsters inside car, hands/feet and pincers all over threshold.

Shot 7 | 17-20s

Hard cut, medium shot framing front window and rear cabin side door.

Male lead scans threshold, confirms no limbs, holds outer edge of side door.

Female lead walks back to door, takes door handle with free left hand, efficiently closes door, latch clicks "click".

Right hand still holding briefcase, then places it at her feet, takes out banknote pre-clipped in outer pocket, passes into driver window:

"Airport, don't stop."

Driver takes money, nods briefly, silent.

Shot 8 | 20-23s

Hard cut, wide shot towards street direction.

Taxi starts smoothly, drives right out of frame, no sharp swerves, no drifting.

In rear cabin window, Pharaoh finally sits upright, realizes car is moving, points out window.

Mechanical Gentleman tries explaining through glass, Lobster Monster raises pincers fearing hitting companion, Mouth Monster squeezed in seat, four faces form disheveled row.

Pedestrian on sidewalk pauses half-step, looks at taxi, then at nonchalant male/female leads, continues walking.

No one stops car or enters traffic lane.

Shot 9 | 23-26s

entries.description: A detailed prompt for Seedance 2.5 to generate a 30-second ultra-photorealistic zombie horror scene in a Korean hospital operating room.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-photorealistic Korean zombie horror action sequence inside a busy modern Korean hospital operating room during a complicated surgery.

### MAIN CHARACTER

A beautiful young Korean female nurse in her mid-20s with long black hair tied loosely behind her head, wearing authentic light-blue medical scrubs, a surgical gown, white medical mask, and disposable gloves.

A male surgeon in his 40s and two female nurses are performing surgery on a male patient lying unconscious on the operating table.

### SCENE

The operating room is brightly illuminated by powerful surgical lights. Medical monitors beep continuously while the surgeon carefully operates on the patient. Two female nurses assist him by passing surgical instruments.

Suddenly, one female nurse stops moving. Her hands begin trembling uncontrollably. She drops a surgical instrument onto the floor.

The surgeon turns toward her and asks what's wrong.

She slowly raises her head. Her eyes have turned completely milky white. Thick dark veins begin spreading across her forehead, cheeks, neck, and arms. Blood appears around her mouth.

She suddenly screams hysterically and violently throws a metal medical instrument tray across the operating room.

### THE ATTACK BEGINS

* The infected nurse suddenly grabs another female nurse by the hair and throws her against a medical equipment trolley.

* The surgeon rushes toward her, but she grabs his surgical gown and violently slams him against the operating table.

* Another nurse desperately tries to escape, but the zombie grabs her arm and throws her onto the floor.

* The infected nurse climbs onto the operating table, knocking over surgical instruments and medical equipment.

* The patient remains unconscious as the operating room descends into chaos.

* Two hospital security guards rush inside, but the infected nurse attacks them with terrifying speed, lunging and knocking them backward.

* Medical monitors fall, surgical instruments scatter across the floor, and emergency alarms begin blaring.

### FINAL SCENE

Red emergency lights flash throughout the operating room.

The infected female nurse stands on the operating table, surrounded by fallen medical equipment and terrified hospital staff.

Her black hair is dishevelled, her eyes are completely milky white, dark veins cover her face and neck, and blood surrounds her mouth.

She slowly turns toward the camera, smiles disturbingly, and begins laughing hysterically.

Suddenly, she jumps off the operating table and charges directly toward the camera lens.

Format: 30-second cinematic zombie survival action sequence, 16:9 widescreen, 24fps, ultra-photorealistic, gritty Hollywood movie style.

Scene and Character:
A young man with messy dark hair wearing a worn, dark grey hoodie is desperately escaping from a group of infected zombies inside an underground parking garage. The zombies have pale, damaged skin, bloodied clothing, and aggressive, unnatural movements. A futuristic angular electric pickup truck is parked inside the garage.

Action and Camera Direction:

[0–3s] Opening Escape:
Start with a cinematic shot of a dark metal emergency exit door inside a concrete stairwell. The young man rushes through the door and runs down the narrow concrete passage. Handheld tracking camera follows closely behind him, creating urgency and tension.

[3–6s] Entering the Parking Garage:
He bursts out of the stairwell into a dimly lit underground parking garage. Cold fluorescent lights flicker overhead. Rows of parked vehicles, concrete pillars, and deep shadows create a terrifying atmosphere. Camera follows behind his shoulder as he runs.

[6–10s] Zombies Appear:
He spots several infected zombies standing between parked cars. They notice him and suddenly begin running toward him. The camera tracks his movement as he rushes toward a futuristic electric pickup truck.

[10–13s] Getting Inside the Vehicle:
He reaches the vehicle, quickly opens the driver's door, jumps inside, and immediately activates the illuminated digital dashboard. Close-up shots show his trembling hand operating the futuristic controls.

Cut to a dramatic front view of the truck. Its distinctive full-width LED headlights suddenly illuminate. Through the windshield, several zombies approach aggressively, reaching toward the vehicle.

[20–24s] Breaking Through:

Along the edge of white foam, a fisherman's small white boat tilts as it circles, slowly being pulled toward the center. "Chidori-maru, hold on!" Sakura, running along the breakwater, stops when she sees the fisherman in the boat. Because using her power makes those nearby lose their memories. "I'll carry him. Pull!" The "Minase" on the salt-covered planks of the old boat has not faded at all. "Then why only the letters..."

Recorded handheld by a friend traveling together. entries.title: Pixar Style Fantasy Dog Transformation Prompt
entries.description: A prompt for a photorealistic cinematic fantasy film featuring a rat-like giant attacking a horned man and his dog, who transforms into a gigantic Dalmatian to fight back.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT
25-second HORIZONTAL 16:9 photorealistic cinematic fantasy film.

A rat-like giant forces a horned young man and his small three-eyed Dalmatian into a forest barn and locks the entrance. The dog transforms in BLUE FIRE into a gigantic Dalmatian. While BOTH creatures are still INSIDE, the dog LEAPS onto the attacker, driving him through the closed wooden doors. They burst OUTWARD into the clearing together. The dog pins the attacker and growls, then returns to his small form. The man embraces him and says, "Thank you, buddy."

Real-time action, convincing weight, physical contact, momentum, and landings. No slow motion or speed ramps.

REFERENCES
image1 shows TWO FORMS OF THE SAME DOG, not two separate animals.

LEFT: the small normal Dalmatian.
RIGHT: his gigantic muscular transformed form.

Match the white fur, black spots, floppy spotted ears, canine face, two brown eyes, and pale-blue third eye centered on the forehead. Preserve recognizable markings between forms. The giant dog retains the reference's massive torso, thick limbs, enormous paws, and natural canine anatomy. No armor or additional limbs.

image2 defines the young adult man. Preserve his exact face, dark brown skin, short curly platinum-blond hair, pale eyes, pointed ears, and asymmetric horns. In the frontal reference, the black horn is on image-left and the ivory horn on image-right. Keep their anatomical placement consistent through camera changes.

Copy his layered ivory hooded robe, textured fabric, brown belt and pouch, leather forearm bindings, and brown boots. Hood down throughout.

These images define character appearance, not scenery. Do not reproduce the studio backgrounds.

REALISM
Live-action feature-film appearance. Natural skin pores, individual fur strands, worn leather, frayed cloth, splintered timber, and dusty stone.

Fantasy creatures have convincing muscle movement, grounded contact shadows, and substantial physical weight. Blue transformation fire illuminates nearby surfaces and airborne dust without burning the building or clothing.

Warm forest daylight outside; dim barn interior with sunlight entering gaps between boards and roof beams. Realistic motion blur and coherent exposure.

CHARACTERS
MAN: frightened but responsive. He retreats when threatened, moves clear of the fight, and approaches only after the attacker is subdued.

DOG: starts as the small Dalmatian from image1. His forehead eye glows blue before transformation. His giant form remains white with black spots and floppy ears. Its mass is comparable to the attacker's. He moves like a powerful quadrupedal animal.

ATTACKER: towering rat-like humanoid with a hunched muscular body, coarse gray-brown fur, long pinkish muzzle, rounded ears, uneven yellow teeth, heavy clawed hands, and a fleshy tail. His confidence becomes panic after the dog's transformation.

LOCATION AND GEOGRAPHY
An old timber-and-stone barn beside a forest clearing.

Tall double wooden doors form the ONLY entrance used in this sequence. They are closed and secured from inside with a heavy wooden crossbar seated in fixed frame brackets. The entire old doorway can break under the creatures' combined impact.

A stone grinding wheel stands to the left. Barrels line the right wall. Dust and grain cover the floor. A broad central lane connects the interior to the doors.

The man remains beside the right wall during the confrontation. The dog enters the central lane before transforming. The attacker retreats to the closed entrance.

Allow enough interior space for the giant dog to take two powerful strides and leap. The doorway is broad enough for both creatures to crash through as its doors and damaged frame break outward.

Outside, leave clear dirt ground for the landing and pin.

TIMELINE

00:00-00:02 | FORCED INSIDE
Exterior three-quarter wide shot, already in motion.

The man and small dog are stepping backward over the open threshold into the barn. The attacker stands directly in front of them, outside, facing into the building.

He advances with a threatening clawed-hand gesture, driving them farther inside. The man recoils; the dog retreats beside his boots. The attacker follows them across the threshold.

Clearly establish that he is forcing them into the barn.

00:02-00:05.5 | THE CLOSED EXIT
Cut to an interior wide view.

The man and dog move clear of the entrance toward the right wall. The attacker closes both door leaves and lowers the nearby crossbar into its frame brackets.

Show the fully closed, secured doors. Daylight is reduced to thin cracks. All three characters are now INSIDE.

00:05.5-00:09.5 | INTIMIDATION
The attacker turns from the entrance and approaches the man.

In a medium two-shot, he bends forward, exposes his teeth, and brings his muzzle close to the man's face. The man takes a short backward step and raises a forearm defensively.

While the attacker focuses on the man, the small Dalmatian moves away from the man's boots into the clear central lane. Briefly widen the framing to show this repositioning.

The dog plants all four paws and faces the attacker. Avoid prolonged staring or idle poses.

00:09.5-00:11.5 | BLUE-FIRE TRANSFORMATION
Low three-quarter view of the dog in the central lane, with the other characters still visible behind him.

His forehead eye flashes BLUE. Blue fire spreads rapidly across his spotted fur.

In one continuous transformation, his torso enlarges, shoulders broaden, legs thicken, and paws expand. He becomes the giant Dalmatian from image1.

His paws press into the dusty floor as his weight increases. Grain and dust shift beneath them. The flames contract into blue wisps and disappear.

The man presses toward the right wall, outside the dog's path. The attacker turns toward the transformation.

00:11.5-00:13.5 | PANIC
The giant dog lowers his head, exposes his teeth, and takes one heavy step toward the attacker.

Brief close-up of the attacker's widening eyes and collapsing confidence.

Return to a wider view. The attacker retreats toward the CLOSED doors, then turns to face them and grabs the crossbar.

The dog pivots into alignment with the central lane. The man's position remains safely to the right.

00:13.5-00:15.5 | FAILED ESCAPE
Interior side view.

The attacker frantically tries to lift the crossbar. One end catches in its bracket. The beam remains in place and the doors stay CLOSED.

He glances back, but keeps his body facing the doors.

Behind him, the dog lowers his body and bends his hind legs, preparing to spring. Establish a short clear run-up between the dog and the attacker's back.

IMPORTANT: the attacker has not opened the doors or escaped. Both creatures remain completely INSIDE the barn.

00:15.5-00:17.5 | LEAP THROUGH THE DOORS
Interior three-quarter wide shot showing the giant dog, the attacker, and the closed doorway together.

The dog takes two forceful strides, compresses his hind legs, and LAUNCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

His front paws reach forward and catch the attacker's shoulders as his heavy chest strikes the attacker's upper back. This is ONE airborne pounce, not a standing shove or a separate paw strike.

SHOW THE DOG LEAVING THE FLOOR AND MAKING CONTACT.

The dog's forward momentum drives the attacker chest-first into the closed wooden doors. The dog remains pressed against his back as they hit.

The doors splinter violently OUTWARD. The crossbar and old frame fittings fail, hinges tear from weathered wood, and broken boards fly into the clearing.

Both creatures burst through the doorway TOGETHER, traveling from the dark interior into the sunlit exterior. The attacker leads; the dog follows directly against him.

Keep the camera inside until the impact breaks the doors and their bodies begin crossing the threshold.

Then cut to an exterior side angle CONTINU

The fluorescent lights begin flickering violently. The camera follows the nurse as she reaches the security door and desperately tries to unlock it.

Suddenly, everything goes silent.

entries.title: Giant Cat Model Railway Scale Reveal
entries.description: A comparison prompt between Seedance 2.5 and Kling 4.0 for a photorealistic video of a ginger cat watching a model railway, with a camera pull-back reveal.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second photorealistic live-action video, horizontal 16:9, in one continuous shot. A real ginger house cat is watching a model railway on a wooden table. For the first half, the camera is so low inside the miniature street that the scene looks like a full-sized city with a gigantic cat behind it. The change in camera position reveals the true scale.

CAMERA AND LOOK

DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. Begin at rail height, looking along a gently curving track. Blue-hour light, warm apartment windows, a bright red two-car Japanese commuter train with lit headlights. A little handheld drift, subtle tape grain, believable motion blur. Keep the train, the cat's eye and the paw large enough to read on a phone.

0–4 seconds. Open with the red train already rounding the bend toward us. In the gap between two buildings, a huge green cat's eye is watching it. The eye tracks the train as it passes the lens from left to right. A ginger ear twitches above the roofline.

4–8 seconds. The camera pans right with the train. As the last carriage clears the bend, one broad ginger paw comes down into the newly empty space just behind it. A soft tap. The paw misses. The train carries straight on along the same track.

8–12 seconds. In one physical movement, lift the camera above the rooftops and pull back past the front edge of the wooden table. Now we see the entire model railway in a lived-in apartment and the ordinary-sized ginger cat sitting on a chair behind it. The same red train is still moving around the loop.

12–15 seconds. Hold the wider view. The cat draws back the paw it just used and gives it two slow, casual licks. The red train rolls past again in the foreground. Cut on the second lick.

AUDIO

A steady wheel-on-rail rhythm, the soft tap of the paw and quiet room tone. As the camera pulls back, the little electric motor becomes audible. No dialogue, music, captions or logos.

entries.translated_prompt:
A sunny day in a small southern salt village. A hut where salt is boiled is burning, and the roof beams collapse scattering sparks. In the back corner is an old man boiling salt. At the entrance, a woman from the salt fields supports a falling beam on her shoulder and shouts, "Father-in-law!" Before Sakura and Nagi who rushed over, the stove cracks, and a giant iron pan filled with boiling salt water tilts toward the old man. Sakura raises her hand but stops when she sees the woman next to her. If she uses it, people nearby will lose their memories. "I'll go. Stop them!"

Sakura grips her collar and extends her right hand. The collapsing pan stops in mid-air, and Nagi ducks under it to bring out the old man. When she pushes her hand up, the pan breaks through the burning roof into the sky. She flips her wrist, and the pan turns over beyond the roof; the boiling brine falls onto the sand of the salt field, sending white steam rising to the sky. Then, the woman staggers holding her temple. "Tell me more about Minase." "Minase? ... I don't know that name." From the soot-covered base of the burnt stove, a slab of salt. Wiping it with cloth reveals the engraving "Minase." Temple boards fade as they age, but this one hasn't faded at all. "And yet... why only this?"

Recorded handheld by a friend traveling together. entries.prompt:
THE LAST SIGNAL | ORIGINAL CINEMATIC THRILLER

STORY — 30 SECONDS:

0–5 seconds: Establish a crowded underground station. A female railway engineer in a navy-blue uniform checks an electrical cabinet while passengers wait for their train.

5–10 seconds: Suddenly, the power fails. Red emergency lights activate, alarms sound, and an automated safety barrier locks. A father realizes his young daughter in a yellow raincoat is stranded on the opposite side.

10–15 seconds: The engineer notices an approaching train and realizes the safety system has malfunctioned. She immediately rushes toward an emergency control cabinet while a station attendant directs passengers away.

15–20 seconds: She opens the cabinet and struggles to pull an old emergency lever. The approaching train grows louder, creating intense suspense.

20–25 seconds: The emergency mechanism finally activates, and the barrier begins opening. The father reaches his daughter and pulls her safely away from the platform edge.

25–30 seconds: The train passes safely. The father embraces his daughter, the station lights return, and the little girl gives the exhausted engineer a grateful smile. End with a cinematic close-up of the engineer's relieved expression.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
Photorealistic characters, consistent faces and clothing, realistic human movement, believable physical interactions, dramatic lighting, wet-floor reflections and detailed railway environments.

CAMERA & AUDIO:
One continuous cinematic tracking shot with no cuts. Natural camera movement, realistic train sounds, rainfall, emergency alarms, mechanical sounds, footsteps and synchronized dialogue.

IMPORTANT:
Maintain character consistency and logical action continuity throughout. Avoid morphing, duplicated characters, unnatural movements and abrupt transitions. The final result should feel like an original professionally directed short film with suspense, emotional depth and a satisfying conclusion.

entries.title: Sunflower Cafe Cinematic Sequence with Reference Images
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for Seedance 2.5 that uses reference images (image_1, image_2) to maintain character and location consistency in a 14.7-second continuous action sequence in a sunflower cafe.
entries.prompt:
<<<image_1>>>  → OPENING FRAME. Clip starts exactly on this frame: woman with long black wavy hair, cream cap-sleeve blouse, olive wide-leg trousers, back to camera, walking into a grey concrete-block flower café drowned in sunflowers, single brass pendant lamp hanging centre, framed Van Gogh-style sunflower paintings on the wall, blurred books and camera in bottom foreground.

<<<image_2>>> also → CHARACTER REF — hair length and wave, build, posture, wardrobe. Lock likeness. Wardrobe never changes across the clip.

<<<image_1>>> also → LOCATION REF — concrete block walls, exposed timber beam, track spots, pendant lamp, trunk table with cake, matcha and phone, terracotta and dark glass vases, rusty filing cabinet, metal trunks, corner concrete pillar, mirror on the back wall. Every object keeps its real shape, scale and position in every shot.

SECTION 1 — SHOT TIMELINE

ONE CONTINUOUS ACTION, 14.7 seconds, 10 locked camera placements joined by hard match cuts.

CAMERA RULE — every placement is a fully locked, tripod-dead frame. Zero shake, zero drift, zero zoom, zero push. The camera never moves inside a shot; it only changes position at the cut. Every cut lands mid-motion — her body, hands and hair pick up at the exact pose, speed and direction the previous frame left them. No resets, no repeated action, no pose jumps. Motion blur and depth of field consistent with a real cinema camera, 25fps, 1/50 shutter.

PERFORMANCE: unhurried, no dialogue, no looking at the lens except the final frame. Natural weight shifts, hair swings with real inertia, fingers interact with petals, pages, ceramics with real contact and pressure.

SHOT 1 (0.00–1.73) — ESTABLISHING, EYE LEVEL, LOCKED
• Image 1 frame. She walks away from camera into the space, three slow steps, hair swinging, left hand brushing a sunflower head as she passes the trunk table. Pendant lamp top-centre, blurred books and camera body bottom foreground. Dust motes in the lamp pool.
• CUT on her right foot lifting mid-stride, left hand still touching the petals.

SHOT 2 (1.73–3.50) — FRONTAL WIDE, LOCKED, SYMMETRICAL
• Camera now on the far side of the room facing back toward the entrance, centred on the tree trunk and the row of pendant lamps. Her right foot lands exactly where it was lifting; she is now walking toward camera, face half-lit, eyes down on the flowers, still brushing petals with her left hand as she passes.
• CUT as her hand leaves the petals and her shoulders start to turn toward the back wall.

SHOT 3 (3.50–4.77) — HIGH ANGLE MEDIUM, LOCKED, FROM TOP OF THE BACK SHELF
• Camera mounted high, looking down past the mirror and sunflower painting. Her shoulders finish the same turn; she reaches with both arms, lifts the large burlap-wrapped bouquet off the floor against the wall. Only her back and side visible, face hidden by hair. Mirror catches a sliver of the pendant lamp.
• CUT as the bouquet clears the floor and she begins lowering it toward the trunk table.

SHOT 4 (4.77–6.00) — TRUE OVERHEAD FLAT LAY, LOCKED
• Camera straight down on the trunk table: cake slice on an aged book, phone showing a music player, matcha latte with leaf art, sunflowers ringing the frame. The bouquet she was lowering enters top of frame and settles. Her right hand continues the same motion down, fingers wrap the warm cup and lift it out of frame. Brightest, most saturated shot.
• CUT as the cup rises past frame edge, her fingertips the last thing visible.

SHOT 5 (6.00–7.13) — HIGH ANGLE MEDIUM CLOSE, LOCKED, BOUQUET ABOVE STILL LIFE
• Camera looking down at 45 degrees over the bouquet and table. The cup keeps rising in the same arc to her lips; she sips, steam thread rising, then sets the cup down on the trunk edge. Petals in sharp focus, concrete wall falling soft behind.
• CUT as the cup touches wood and her other hand reaches for the open book.

SHOT 6 (7.13–8.47) — HIGH ANGLE CLOSE, LOCKED, LOOKING DOWN AT HER LAP
• She has sat on the low stool beside the trunk; camera is directly above her shoulder, looking down at olive trousers, open aged book, burlap bouquet across her lap. Her hand completes the reach, lifts the book from the table, and turns one page with a real paper flex. Nothing moves but page, hand and hair tips.
• CUT as the page lands flat and she pushes up to stand.

SHOT 7 (8.47–9.87) — STILL LIFE B-ROLL, EYE LEVEL, LOCKED, NO PEOPLE
• Camera at shelf height on the sunflower field painting, dark glass vases, rusty filing cabinet, metal trunks. Pure hold. Her off-screen movement is implied only by a faint shadow crossing the cabinet door left to right and one vase petal trembling from her passing.
• CUT exactly as the shadow leaves the cabinet.

SHOT 8 (9.87–11.20) — LOW ANGLE, GRASS LEVEL, LOCKED, SHALLOW FOCUS
• Camera on the floor among the sunflowers, lens almost touching petals, looking up. Blurred sunflowers fill the foreground, sharp sunflowers in the terracotta vase midground, ceiling beam and track spots far behind. Her olive trousers cross inches from the lens, heavy foreground blur sweeping through, then her arm reaches down into frame and pulls one stem from the vase, matching the standing-and-walking motion left by shot 7.
• CUT as the stem comes free and her arm lifts.

SHOT 9 (11.20–12.83) — PORTRAIT MEDIUM, EYE LEVEL, LOCKED
• Camera across the room framing the corner, concrete pillar hard right. She arrives in the corner carrying the bouquet plus the single pulled stem, raising it in the same lift, and tilts her head slowly to the left, hair falling across her cheek. A bystander's head partly in frame bottom right, left in. Pendant light rims her hair.
• CUT at the deepest point of the head tilt.

SHOT 10 (12.83–14.53) — CLOSING WIDE, EYE LEVEL, LOCKED, SYMMETRICAL
• Camera centred under the row of pendant lights, the same woman now completing the tilt back upright, standing in the flowers. A phone on a small tripod stands sharp in the foreground pointed at her — the photo spot revealed. She settles into the pose, exhales, and lets a small honest smile reach the phone, not us. Darkest frame of the clip.
• 14.53–14.72: hard cut to black.

SECTION 2 — MASTER EFFECTS INVENTORY

1. Locked tripod frame — every shot — absolute stillness, no micro-movement.
2. Hard match cuts on continuous body motion — 9x — no action repeats, no pose reset.
3. Camera height alternation — high (3, 5, 6) / overhead (4) / grass level (8) / eye level (1, 2, 7, 9, 10).
4. Foreground blur layering — 3x (1, 8, 10).
5. Shallow focus inserts — 3x (4, 6, 8).
6. Practical-only light — pendant lamp pools, track spots, soft daylight from the opening, heavy natural falloff.
7. Off-screen presence — 1x (7) — shadow and trembling petal.
8. Steam, dust motes, page flex, petal contact — physical micro-details every shot.

entries.prompt:

15 SECONDS | 16:9 | 60FPS | 8K LOOK

Ultra-photorealistic Hollywood live-action martial arts fight inside an underground subway station.

CHARACTER LOCK:
@image1 is the only protagonist. Preserve exact reference face, hairstyle, beard, body proportions and black tactical outfit. Always completely EMPTY-HANDED. No weapons in his hands. All enemies carry Japanese katanas. Maintain identity throughout.

ENVIRONMENT:
One underground subway station with long platforms, railway tracks, tiled walls, concrete pillars, metal benches, ticket machines, fluorescent lights, signs and one stationary train. Cool lighting, reflective floors and subtle dust. No other locations.

ACTION — NONSTOP COMBAT:

0–3s: Several katana attackers surround @image1. One attacks with a horizontal slash. @image1 ducks underneath, delivers rapid Wing Chun punches to his face and torso, then a spinning back kick to another enemy's chest.

3–6s: Three enemies attack simultaneously. @image1 evades their blades, blocks one sword arm, delivers an elbow to the face and a Muay Thai knee to the torso, then performs a fast suplex takedown on another attacker.

6–9s: Two enemies attack from opposite directions. @image1 ducks one slash, pivots and delivers a jumping knee to the second enemy's face. Follows with rapid punches and a powerful grappling throw.

STRICT TARGET LOCK:

CAMERA:
Dynamic handheld-Steadicam tracking, wide shots, low angles, close-up impacts, lateral tracking, whip pans and fast push-ins. Keep @image1 and his target visible. Realistic impact shake and continuous fight coverage.

Photorealistic Hollywood action film, realistic skin, natural expressions, authentic clothing physics, cool fluorescent lighting, HDR, subtle Kodak 35mm grain. No artificial CGI appearance.

MOTION:
2.3x action pacing. Wing Chun punches, Muay Thai knees, side kicks, jumping knees, spinning elbows, evasive footwork and grappling takedowns. Immediate transitions. No pauses, idle poses, slow motion or repeated animation

entries.prompt:
严格30秒，16:9横屏，Seedance 2.5，真人电影级古风仙侠反转喜剧，原生普通话音画同步。
作品：《说好的合影呢？》
整体采用真实自然的中国古风影视美学，细腻肤质、真实丝绸衣料、自然体积光、丰富环境纵深和克制的人物表演。
借鉴经典视觉喜剧中的信息差、物体运用、行为重复与角色互换，以及现实生活中为了拍出一张满意的照片而不断折腾身边人的熟悉情境。
主线非常明确：
小师妹原本想和师姐一起留下一张好看的合影。
白衣师姐却过分在意自己在画面中是否完美。
她不断让小师妹举起铜镜、调整方向、寻找合适光线，逐渐把小师妹变成了自己的专属补光助手。
观众比小师妹更早意识到，这张所谓的“合影”实际上只有师姐一个人。
拍完以后，小师妹发现画面里只有自己举镜子的那只手。
师姐竟然还一本正经地解释“手拍得挺好”。
小师妹没有争吵，而是把铜镜交到师姐手里，让师姐亲自体验刚才的过程。
最后一个镜头完全呼应开头，只交换两个人的位置与身份。
核心喜剧来自：
认真得过分的师姐；
逐渐察觉问题的小师妹；
一个人追求出片，另一个人被迫承担全部辅助工作的生活反差；
以及最后精确对称的角色互换。
不加入反派寻仇、师父拆台、突然战斗、随机魔法或无关反转。
【人物与人物关系】
角色ID A：同一个@图片1剑仙师姐。
25–30岁成年东亚女性，保持参考图中完全相同的人脸身份、五官骨相、肤质、比例、气质和发型。
高挑纤细，黑色长发半挽，白玉簪固定，始终穿白色刺绣真丝汉服、分层半透明宽袖、银色腰封、玉佩及白色布靴，持唯一一柄银色长剑。
性格冷静、端庄、自信，平时看起来不在乎外表，实际上对自己的形象相当讲究。
面对留影这件事，她甚至像研究剑法一样认真安排角度、姿势与光线。
角色ID B：同一个@图片2小师妹。
20–25岁成年东亚女性，保持参考图中完全相同的人脸身份、五官、面部比例、编发、体型和气质。
身形娇小，五官自然圆润灵动，穿同一套青绿色亚麻汉服、深色腰带、木簪和黑色布鞋，持唯一一柄深色钢剑。
性格直率、善于观察，开始时愿意帮师姐完成拍摄。
当她明白自己被当成举镜子的助手以后，不发火、不撒泼，只以同样的方式让师姐体验一次。
本集只有这两名核心人物，不额外增加师父、敌人或其他主要角色。
关键道具为一面直径约30厘米的古代抛光铜镜，以及一枚稳定放在石台上的仙侠留影石。
铜镜依靠真实自然光反射补光，有实际重量，始终由人物双手或单手合理握持。
留影石只用短促、柔和的灵光完成一次静态留影，不出现现代相机、电子屏幕或复杂法术界面。
【当前地点与空间连续性】
本轮新上传的所有背景与地点参考图共同决定视频的实际物理世界。
先无声提炼并整合参考图中能够兼容的真实地形、主要建筑关系、空间尺度、材质、植被、水体、天气、云层、山雾、主光方向、色彩、倒影和空气纵深。
重新组合为本轮独有、合理、连续的实际场景。
在这些真实空间中选择一处适合留影、可以安全站立的观景平台或庭院石台；如果参考图没有相应平台，就使用参考世界里真实存在、可供人物活动的位置。
绝不能凭空替换成陌生的泛化仙侠场景。
整段故事发生在同一个位置。
留影石固定在一个稳定石座上，面向师姐原本所站的位置。
师姐最初站在画面中央。
小师妹站在画面边缘，举起铜镜，将自然光柔和地反射到师姐脸上。
小师妹身体大部分处于留影石取景范围之外，只有举着铜镜的手和铜镜边缘刚好进入画面。
这种真实的几何位置必须从开头一直保留到反转揭示，不能为了笑点突然改变。
背景始终自然鲜活：
风吹动头发和衣袖；
树叶随风轻摆；
已有水体持续流动；
山雾按照真实地势缓慢变化；
光影和倒影随着摄影机视角合理变化。
但这些环境运动保持叙事中立，不主动推动或改变剧情。
【0–4秒：开场钩子】
开场首先给出一个非常漂亮的电影级中远景构图。
同一个白衣师姐站在参考图形成的壮阔自然空间中。
她姿态优雅，腰侧银色长剑自然垂落，浅色真丝宽袖被微风轻轻吹动。
初看仿佛一张真正绝美、庄严的剑仙电影剧照。
然而摄影机立刻进行一次小幅度、精准的横向移动。
画面旁边突然露出同一个青衣小师妹。
小师妹正吃力地高举一面铜镜，手臂已经开始发酸。
她看向师姐：
小师妹：“师姐，说好的合影呢？”
师姐甚至没有转头，只看着留影石的位置：
师姐：“镜子再抬高点。”
原本庄严的剑仙画面，瞬间变成一场让人十分熟悉的拍照折腾现场。
【4–10秒：人物目标与铺垫】
保持同一位置、同一面铜镜以及两人的真实空间关系。
中景双人镜头。
小师妹把铜镜举得更高一点。
师姐认真观察反射到自己脸上的柔和光线，轻轻移动下巴，又整理一缕头发。
师姐：“往左一点。”
小师妹按照要求移动手臂。
师姐：“再高一点。”
小师妹再次照做。
镜子有实际重量，她抬着的手臂已经明显开始疲劳。
小师妹终于有些疑惑：
小师妹：“师姐，我也入画了吗？”
师姐看了一眼留影石的取景方向。
她已经注意到小师妹大部分身体并没有进入画面。
短暂停顿。
师姐仍然非常平静：
师姐：“入了，放心。”
小师妹暂时选择相信。
师姐脸上那一点极其细微的不自然，让观众开始意识到她心里其实很清楚。
【10–18秒：喜剧冲突升级】
仍然保持完全相同的地点、人物和道具关系。
师姐先稍微转动身体寻找更适合面部的光线，再调整银色长剑的角度，使自己的整体轮廓更加优雅。
她只改变两次姿态。
但每次调整，都需要小师妹重新改变铜镜角度，才能让反射光保持稳定。
镜头不使用快速蒙太奇，而是完整记录两次连续、合理的动作。
小师妹一边举着铜镜，一边尝试把脑袋伸入留影石的取景范围，希望自己也能出现在合影里。
师姐立即轻轻提醒：
师姐：“别晃，马上好了。”
小师妹只好停住。
她保持着一个越来越不舒服的举镜姿势。
此刻给出一个留影石实际取景方向的客观镜头。
观众可以清楚看见：
画面中央是姿态完美的白衣师姐。
画面边缘只露出小师妹举铜镜的手和一点铜镜边框。
小师妹的脸和身体完全不在画面里。
这一镜头必须让观众先于角色理解最终的笑点。
留影石只发出一次极其柔和的短促灵光，完成静态留影。
不产生夸张魔法。
【18–25秒：关键变化与反转】
留影结束。
师姐终于放松姿态：
师姐：“成了。”
小师妹立即放下已经发酸的手臂，走到留影石旁边查看刚才的画面。
摄影机先保持自然的双人中景，再短暂展示刚刚记录的构图。
留影结果与之前取景镜头完全一致：
师姐漂亮地站在中央。
小师妹只有一只举镜子的手出现在画面边缘。
不出现任何文字。
小师妹认真看了一眼。
停顿半拍。
小师妹：“我呢？”
师姐非常认真地伸手指向画面边缘那只手。
师姐：“这儿，手拍得挺好。”
小师妹缓慢转头看向师姐。
小师妹：“你管这叫合影？”
师姐原本自信的表情第一次出现明显迟疑。
她看看留影画面，再看看小师妹。
终于意识到自己的解释听起来实在有些不像话。
不要让她继续狡辩，也不要增加第三人说话。
这一段的笑点依靠清楚的视觉证据、师姐一本正经的回答和小师妹的表情成立。
【25–30秒：笑点回收与结尾】
小师妹没有继续争论。
她只是非常自然地把铜镜交到师姐手里。
小师妹：“行，换你举。”
师姐下意识接过铜镜。
小师妹已经走到刚才师姐所站的画面

The final shot completely echoes the beginning, only swapping the positions and identities of the two people.
Core comedy comes from:
The overly serious senior sister;
The observant junior sister who gradually notices the issue;

[Current Location and Spatial Continuity]
All newly uploaded background and location reference images in this round determine the actual physical world of the video.
First, silently extract and integrate compatible real terrain, main building relationships, spatial scale, materials, vegetation, water bodies, weather, clouds, mountain mist, main light direction, colors, reflections, and air depth from the reference images.
