entries.title: Robot Saves Man from Falling Debris
entries.description: Detailed prompt for a vertical smartphone-style video where a humanoid robot saves a man from falling construction debris, with specific physics and character details.
entries.prompt:
STYLE: authentic vertical smartphone video filmed handheld by an ordinary passerby on a city sidewalk in the evening. Real phone footage, not cinematic: auto exposure adjusting between bright shop windows and the dark sky, slight digital noise in shadows, mild motion blur on fast movement, autofocus occasionally hunting, slightly crushed blacks, warm sodium streetlight mixed with cool shop-window LED light. Underneath this texture everything is fully real: real people, real skin, real asphalt, real bricks, real dust, real physics.

FORMAT
15 seconds, vertical 9:16, real-time speed, one continuous uncut take, no slow motion, no speed ramps. Photorealistic live-action rescue drama with a dry comic ending. No text, captions, UI overlays, timestamp or music.

REFERENCE
Image #1 defines only the adult female humanoid robot. Preserve exactly: soft youthful adult face, brown eyes, natural brows, subtle makeup; long straight light brown hair with a center part falling past the shoulders; small stud earrings; slim adult build with long legs; fitted beige short-sleeved T-shirt with a small dark chest logo, hem ending just above the waist; high-waisted dark purple cycling shorts with a small front drawstring; white chunky running sneakers. Exposed mechanical waist between shirt hem and waistband: brushed silver mechanical blocks and actuators, small bright white LED lights, bundles of blue, yellow and black wires, metal brackets and fasteners, one blue cable running down her left hip. Her torso is always connected to her pelvis through this mechanism, same scale and construction from every angle. Do not copy the photo's background, crowd, lanyards, stanchions or floor.

PHYSICS RULE
The robot is far stronger and heavier than she looks. This is the only supernatural element and it is consistent: she absorbs the falling load by bending her knees deeply, her sneakers press into the asphalt and crack it, her waist mechanism visibly compresses and trembles under the weight. Everything else obeys real physics: the load swings and falls with real gravity, bricks are heavy and shatter on impact, dust spreads and settles, the man falls with real weight, liquid spills naturally.

CAMERA OPERATOR
The operator is never visible, not even in reflections in shop windows. He stands at the entrance of a small coffee shop about four meters from the action, filming at chest height. The camera looks along the sidewalk: the construction scaffolding runs along the right side of the frame, the street with passing cars is on the left, the robot is in the center.
Real handheld phone behavior: micro-shake, breathing sway, a slight tilt, subjects drifting off-center, late autofocus. He reacts physically: tilts up fast toward the crack above, tilts back down, flinches and steps back at the impact, then slowly steps forward.
These imperfections never hide the key moments: the strap snapping, the pallet tilting, the robot's dash, the push, the pallet falling, the catch, the lowering, the cup being crushed, the lift to his feet and all lines.

CHARACTERS
The Man: around thirty, slim build, short dark brown hair, clean-shaven, navy bomber jacket over a white T-shirt, black trousers, white sneakers, white over-ear headphones on his head, phone in his left hand, paper takeaway coffee cup with a plastic lid in his right hand. Absorbed in his phone, oblivious.
The Worker: construction worker on the scaffolding at third-floor level, about nine meters up, orange hi-vis vest, white hard hat, work gloves.
Passersby: four or five adults: a woman with a shopping bag, an older man, a young couple. Ordinary clothing, real faces, all several meters away from the load.
Robot: calm, focused, silent. Her face stays composed during the whole rescue; effort shows only in her body and mechanism. No bulging muscles, no grimace.
The Man's arc: oblivious, shock, breathless gratitude, deadpan loss.
Passersby's arc: idle, frozen fear, stunned silence.

LOCATION AND BLOCKING
Evening city street just after rain. Wet dark asphalt sidewalk reflecting streetlights and shop windows, shallow puddles. Along the right side: a building under construction with steel scaffolding, green safety netting and plywood hoarding at street level. A tower crane boom crosses the dark sky above with small red warning lights. A pallet of red bricks hangs from the crane hook about twelve meters above the sidewalk on two lifting straps. The bricks are shrink-wrapped in clear plastic and held with steel bands on a wooden pallet, roughly one ton. One top corner of the wrap is already torn, with a few loose bricks on top.
Fixed positions: the robot stands by a lit shop window in the center of the frame, about two meters from the Man's path. The Man walks along the sidewalk from the background toward the camera and stops directly under the hanging load to read something on his phone. Passersby are scattered behind and around them.

TIMELINE

00:00-00:02.2 | CALM
Quiet evening sidewalk. The robot stands by the shop window, waist LEDs glowing softly, reflected in the wet asphalt. The operator films her curiously, focus pulling onto her mechanism. The Man walks into frame, headphones on, scrolling his phone, sipping coffee, and stops under the load. Faint crane motor hum above, traffic noise.

00:02.2-00:04.2 | THE SNAP
At 00:02.2 a sharp metallic crack sounds above: one lifting strap snaps. The pallet jerks and tilts steeply, hanging from the remaining strap, swinging. Three loose bricks slide off the torn corner and fall, smashing on the sidewalk two meters to the side of the Man; he does not notice, his headphones block the sound. The operator tilts up fast, catching the tilted swinging pallet against the dark sky, then tilts back down to the street.
At 00:02.8 the Worker leans over the scaffold rail and shouts: "Look out! Move!"
At 00:03 the robot's head turns up toward the load. She moves: two fast powerful steps toward the Man, sneakers slapping wet asphalt.

00:04.2-00:05.8 | THE PUSH AND THE FALL
At 00:04.2 the second strap slips off the hook with a metallic screech. The pallet drops in free fall.
At 00:04.5 the robot reaches the Man and takes his place. With her left arm she shoves him firmly sideways by the shoulder toward the street side, away from the scaffolding. He stumbles two meters and lands on his back on the wet asphalt, splashing a puddle, fully visible to the camera. His phone stays clutched in his left hand. The coffee cup flies out of his right hand, bounces once and stops upright on the asphalt about half a meter in front of the robot's feet, lid on.
From 00:04.8 to 00:05.4 she plants her feet shoulder-width apart and raises both arms straight above her head, palms open, looking up.

00:05.8-00:08 | THE CATCH
At 00:05.8 the pallet slams into her palms. Massive impact: a deep thud, crack of wood, the steel bands groan. She absorbs the energy by bending her knees deeply into a half squat over about half a second, arms staying straight. Her waist actuators compress hard with a loud mechanical whine, the white LEDs flicker once and stabilize. Her sneakers press two to three centimeters into the asphalt and cracks spread outward around her feet. Four more bricks spill off the torn corner and shatter on the asphalt on the scaffolding side, away from the Man. A cloud of red brick dust bursts out and drifts in the streetlight. Her hair whips down from the air push.
The operator flinches back one step, frame shaking hard, then steadies.
At 00:06.5 she pushes back up to standing, the pallet stable above her head.

00:08-00:11 | THE HOLD AND LOWERING
Near silence: the hum of her mechanism, dust settling, distant traffic. The robot holds about one ton of bricks overhead, completely still, face calm, waist mechanism trembling slightly under the load. Passersby stand frozen, the woman with the shopping bag covering her mouth.
At 00:09 s

FORMAT: Exactly 30 seconds | 16:9 | 24fps | Photorealistic live-action | Vintage 1997 Sony MiniDV home-video aesthetic.

CHARACTERS: A cheerful young Japanese woman with warm brown eyes and long black hair in a loose side braid tied with a cream ribbon. Her grandmother is an elderly Japanese woman with short silver-grey hair, wearing a dusty-rose floral dress and beige apron. SETTING: A peaceful Japanese mountain village in summer 1997, featuring a traditional wooden cottage, flowing river, lush green hills, hydrangea gardens, plum orchard, bamboo fencing and a small pottery workshop.

30-SECOND SCENE SEQUENCE:

- 00–04s: The young woman opens her wooden window, welcomes the morning sunlight and steps onto the veranda, admiring the mountains.
- 04–08s: She picks hydrangeas with her grandmother. A butterfly flies past, making them laugh.
- 08–12s: In an old pottery workshop, grandmother teaches her to shape clay on a pottery wheel. They laugh at her imperfect creation.

- 20–23s: She plays in the shallow river, splashing water playfully towards the camera.
- 23–27s: At sunset, they hang glowing paper lanterns beneath the veranda and enjoy green tea together.
- 27–30s: She rests her head on her grandmother's shoulder. The camera captures the glowing cottage, river and distant mountains before cutting to black.

CAMERA STYLE: Authentic 1997 Sony MiniDV family footage with imperfect handheld movements, natural camera shake, slightly crooked framing, autofocus fluctuations, digital noise, motion blur, compression artifacts and faded warm colours. Avoid modern cinematic grading or professional stabilization.

AUDIO: Only natural ambience: birds, breeze, flowing water, footsteps, pottery sounds, laughter, sizzling food and evening insects. No music or narration.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: No modern objects, vehicles, smartphones, contemporary clothing, anime, fantasy, artificial posing, slow motion, identity changes, outfit changes, duplicated characters, distorted anatomy, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

entries.title: Lighthouse Collapse Scene Prompt for Seedance 2.5
entries.description: A detailed video prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting a dramatic scene where a lighthouse tilts towards the sea, involving characters Sakura and Nagi rescuing an old keeper amidst falling debris and camera movements.
entries.prompt:
前の日に止めた岬の灯台は、海のほうへ斜めに傾いたまま。海の岩の上で、白いコートの男がとどめの腕を上げる。「おい、あんた。中だ！」。さくらのことを忘れたナギが先に立ち、2人は傾いた扉から飛び込んで、転がり落ちてくる工具をかわしながら螺旋階段を駆け上がる。てっぺんのガラスの灯室で、番人の老人がレンズの台座にしがみついている。手を伸ばしたさくらを、番人が止める。「握ったものは守れる。だが、その分は、そばにいる者が払う」。さくらは隣のナギを見る。「……だから、ナギが」

「わしが忘れなかったのは、そばの者が払ったからだ。だから、ひとりでここにいた」。塔がまた傾き、ガラスが割れる。さくらは上げかけた手を握りしめて下ろし、番人を背負って階段を降りる。外れたレンズがすぐ横をかすめて吹き抜けへ落ちる。番人が古い日誌をさくらの胸に押し込む。「これを持っていけ。別のやり方を見つけた者がいる」。足もとの段が割れ、つかんだ袖が指からすり抜ける。さくらは襟巻きを握り、落ちていく番人を力で止めて、段の上へ戻す。番人がこめかみを押さえる。「……どうやって、守るんだったか」。3人が外へ飛び出した背後で、灯台は海へ崩れ落ちる。「……大丈夫か、あんた」

一緒に旅をしている友達が手持ちで撮った記録。走って追う手持ち、灯室への望遠のクラッシュズーム、螺旋階段を真上から見下ろすカメラ、吹き抜けへのドリーイン、肩越しの見下ろし、崩れる灯台から後ろ向きに走って逃げる追従。BGMなし。
entries.translated_prompt:
The lighthouse at the cape, stopped the day before, remains tilted diagonally toward the sea. On the rocks by the sea, a man in a white coat raises his arm for the finishing blow. "Hey, you! Get inside!" Nagi, who has forgotten about Sakura, steps forward first, and the two jump through the tilted door, dodging falling tools as they rush up the spiral staircase. In the glass lantern room at the top, the old keeper clings to the lens pedestal. He stops Sakura as she reaches out. "What you hold can be protected. But the cost is paid by those beside you." Sakura looks at Nagi next to her. "...That's why, Nagi..."

"I didn't forget because those beside me paid the cost. That's why I was alone here." The tower tilts again, and the glass shatters. Sakura clenches her raised hand and lowers it, then carries the keeper down the stairs. A detached lens grazes past her side and falls into the void. The keeper pushes an old journal into Sakura's chest. "Take this. Someone found another way." The step beneath their feet cracks, and the sleeve she grabbed slips from her fingers. Sakura grips her scarf and uses force to stop the falling keeper, pulling him back onto the step above. The keeper presses his temple. "...How did we protect?" As the three burst outside, the lighthouse collapses into the sea behind them. "...Are you okay, you?"

Recorded handheld by friends traveling together. Handheld chase running, crash zoom on the lantern room, top-down view of the spiral staircase, dolly-in to the void, over-the-shoulder downward gaze, and tracking shot running away backward from the collapsing lighthouse. No BGM.

entries.title: Subway Robot Rescue Drama
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for a vertical smartphone-style video featuring a humanoid robot saving someone on a subway platform, using Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
STYLE: authentic vertical smartphone video filmed handheld by an ordinary commuter on a subway platform. Real phone footage, not cinematic: auto exposure reacting to the train headlights, slight digital noise in shadows, mild motion blur on fast movement, autofocus occasionally hunting, slightly crushed blacks, cold fluorescent color cast. Underneath this texture everything is fully real: real people, real skin, real steel, real gravel, real physics.

FORMAT
15 seconds, vertical 9:16, real-time speed, one continuous uncut take, no slow motion, no speed ramps. Photorealistic live-action rescue drama with a dry comic ending. No text, captions, UI overlays, timestamp or music.

REFERENCE
Image #1 defines only the adult female humanoid robot. Preserve exactly: soft youthful adult face, brown eyes, natural brows, subtle makeup; long straight light brown hair with a center part falling past the shoulders; small stud earrings; slim adult build with long legs; fitted beige short-sleeved T-shirt with a small dark chest logo, hem ending just above the waist; high-waisted dark purple cycling shorts with a small front drawstring; white chunky running sneakers. Exposed mechanical waist between shirt hem and waistband: brushed silver mechanical blocks and actuators, small bright white LED lights, bundles of blue, yellow and black wires, metal brackets and fasteners, one blue cable running down her left hip. Her torso is always connected to her pelvis through this mechanism, same scale and construction from every angle. Do not copy the photo's background, crowd, lanyards, stanchions or floor.

PHYSICS RULE
The robot is far stronger and heavier than she looks. This is the only supernatural element and it is consistent: her landing sprays gravel and her sneakers sink into the ballast, she lifts an adult man easily, her waist mechanism visibly compresses under every load. Everything else obeys real physics: the man's weight, the train's mass and braking, falling bodies, gravel, dust and air pressure.

CAMERA OPERATOR
The operator is never visible, not even in reflections on train windows. He stands on the platform about three meters back from the edge, filming at chest height. The camera looks diagonally along the platform toward the tunnel: the track runs along the left side of the frame, the tunnel mouth is in the far left background, the train approaches from the background and passes along the left side of the frame, never toward the camera.
Real handheld phone behavior: micro-shake, breathing sway, a slight tilt, subjects drifting off-center, late autofocus, exposure dimming as the headlights grow. He reacts physically: steps toward the edge to look down at the tracks, flinches back as the train enters, then steps forward again.
These imperfections never hide the key moments: the fall, the jump, the lift, the man reaching the platform, her vault out, the train passing, the phone handover and both lines.

CHARACTERS
The Man: early thirties, average build, short dark hair, light stubble, grey hoodie, dark jeans, black sneakers, white wireless earbuds, holding a phone. Tired commuter face.
Passengers: about ten adult commuters with backpacks and work bags, ordinary clothing, real faces. A woman in a beige coat and a heavy-set man in a dark jacket stand closest to the edge, near the Man.
Robot: calm, focused, silent. Her face stays composed; effort shows only in her body and mechanism. No bulging muscles, no grimace.
The Man's arc: distracted, shock and pain, terror, breathless gratitude, confused deadpan.
Passengers' arc: idle, panic, shouting, stunned silence.

LOCATION AND BLOCKING
Evening underground metro station on an overhead-wire line: a catenary wire runs above the track, there is no electrified third rail on the ground. Tiled walls, round concrete columns, yellow tactile safety strip along the platform edge, cold fluorescent ceiling lights, dark tunnel mouth in the background. The platform edge is about 1.1 meters above the track bed. Track bed: two steel rails on concrete sleepers, grey gravel ballast, dust, a little litter.
Fixed positions: the robot stands by a column about two meters from the edge, in the left-center of the frame. The Man stands on the yellow strip about two meters further along the platform toward the tunnel, clearly visible. The woman in the beige coat and the heavy-set man stand just behind him.

TIMELINE

00:00-00:02 | WAITING
Quiet platform. The robot stands by the column, waist LEDs glowing softly. The operator films her curiously, focus pulling onto her mechanism. The Man stands on the yellow strip, earbuds in, scrolling his phone. Faint tunnel rumble.

00:02-00:04 | THE FALL
A passenger with a large backpack hurries past behind the Man; the backpack clips his shoulder. He stumbles, one foot steps off the edge and he falls onto the track bed, landing hard on his side on the gravel between the two rails. One earbud pops out onto the gravel. His phone skids and stops face down on the gravel just beside the far rail. He grabs his ankle, grimacing, tries to stand and collapses back.
The woman in the beige coat screams "Oh my God!". Passengers rush to the yellow strip and stop at the edge. The operator steps forward and tilts down at the Man.
At 00:03.5 the tunnel walls light up: two train headlights appear deep inside the tunnel. A loud horn sounds.

00:04-00:05.5 | THE JUMP
The heavy-set man shouts "Get up! Get up!". The Man looks toward the headlights, frozen.
The robot moves: two fast steps to the edge and she jumps down, landing on both feet beside the Man. Gravel sprays, her sneakers sink into the ballast, her waist mechanism compresses on impact and extends. The train is now visible leaving the tunnel, about seventy meters away, already braking hard: wheels screeching, sparks under the bogies.

00:05.5-00:08 | THE LIFT
Preparation: she crouches and grips the Man under both arms, his hoodie bunching in her fists.
Lift: in one smooth powerful motion she straightens up and raises him to the platform edge, her waist actuators compressing with a mechanical whine. His chest and arms land on the yellow strip. The woman in the beige coat and the heavy-set man grab his arms and hoodie and drag him fully onto the platform. All three fall backward onto the tiles. He is safe at 00:07.5.
The robot turns and scoops his phone off the gravel with her left hand.

00:08-00:11 | THE ESCAPE
The headlights flood the frame, exposure dims. The train is about twenty meters away, braking, still dangerous.
Phone in her left hand, she plants her right palm on the platform edge and vaults up in one movement, knees tucked, landing in a crouch on the yellow strip at 00:08.8.
At 00:09.2 the front of the train slides past behind her at moderate braking speed, half a meter from her heels. The air push lifts her hair forward and flaps her T-shirt; passengers' hair and coats move. The operator flinches back, frame shaking. The carriages roll past, slowing, and the train stops along the platform at 00:11 with one door stopping directly beside the robot and the Man.

00:11-00:13 | GRATITUDE
Brakes release with a hiss. Silence on the platform. The Man sits on the tiles between the two passengers, breathing hard, holding his ankle.
The robot stands, brushes gravel dust off her shorts once, steps to him and holds out his phone. The screen is completely shattered.
The Man, breathless, in natural English:
"...Thank you."
Spoken 00:11.6-00:12.3.
He takes the phone and stares at the cracked screen.

00:13-00:15 | THE ENDING
The door beside them opens with a hiss and a chime at 00:13. The robot calmly steps into the carriage, unhurried, waist LEDs glowing, and takes a handrail, expression unreadable. The doors close behind her at 00:14.
The Man looks from his shattered phone to the closed doors and says flatly, in natural English:
"...That was my train."

entries.title: Zhuge Liang Modern Empty City Strategy Drone Footage
entries.description: A humorous prompt for Seedance 2.5 generating black-and-white security camera footage of Zhuge Liang using drones and a laptop to scare off Sima Yi's army during the Empty Fort Strategy. Features three synchronized camera angles with continuous timestamps and strict visual constraints.
entries.prompt:
【诸葛亮的现代空城计｜监控录像版】
16:9横版，30秒，黑白老式安防监控录像。真实三国古装历史电影质感与荒诞现代科技融合。诸葛亮在西城使用笔记本电脑操纵无人机，吓退司马懿大军。人物始终严肃自然，不刻意搞笑。

【监控与时间】

三台固定广角监控，四段录像，仅在第7、15、24秒切换机位。全程无运镜、变焦、慢动作。

黑白VHS低分辨率、颗粒噪点、水平扫描线、轻微拖影、四角暗角、暗部死黑、亮部轻微过曝。

左上角白色点阵时间戳「建兴六年 14:20:00」，每秒递增，至14:20:29结束。所有摄像头使用同步时钟，切换不重置、不跳秒。左下角显示CAM01、CAM02或CAM03，右上角显示REC。

【场景与空间】

蜀汉建兴六年，西城县北城门。青灰砖石城墙、夯土路、木质城楼、瓦檐、宽阔门洞。北门完全敞开，城内空旷，两名蜀军老兵穿粗布衣服在门洞内侧扫地。

魏军沿北方道路向南逼近，撤退时原路向北。全片城门、道路、城楼和人物位置保持不变。白天自然光，轻微扬尘。

【人物】

诸葛亮：47岁左右，清瘦儒雅，黑色纶巾、浅色宽袖鹤氅、深灰交领长袍，留短须，白羽扇放在手边。镇定自若，端坐城楼。

司马懿：49岁左右，深色魏军将领铠甲、古代头盔、厚重披风，留黑须，骑深色战马，谨慎多疑。

两人五官、发型、服饰全程一致。

【0—7秒｜CAM01 城门监控】

摄像头安装于北城门西侧角楼，高约18米，朝东北方向35度俯拍。画面右下方是敞开的北城门，中央是道路，左上方为魏军来路。

0—3秒：两名老兵慢悠悠扫地。远处尘土飞扬，司马懿率领魏军前锋骑兵和步兵逼近。

3—7秒：司马懿在距城门数十米处勒马停下，抬头观察空荡荡的城楼。魏军前锋跟着停步。两名老兵继续扫地，毫无反应。

7秒监控切换。

【7—15秒｜CAM02 城楼监控】

摄像头固定在城楼内侧屋檐下，高3.5米，距离诸葛亮约3米，向下俯拍30度。画面中央为诸葛亮及完整木桌，旁边站着一名童子。确保双手、桌面、电脑清晰可辨。

7—10秒：诸葛亮端坐桌前，桌上盖着古琴布。童子紧张望向城外，诸葛亮轻轻摆手示意安静。

10—13秒：诸葛亮慢慢掀开琴布，露出一台银灰色现代笔记本电脑。他神情平静地打开屏幕，熟练敲击键盘。

13—15秒：诸葛亮看着电脑，按下回车键，屏幕亮起简洁的黑白控制界面。他轻轻拿起白羽扇，露出胸有成竹的微笑。

15秒监控切换。

【15—24秒｜CAM03 魏军前锋监控】

摄像头固定在北城门西侧向外延伸的箭楼，高约12米，朝东北偏东方向35度俯拍。画面左侧为魏军前锋，右侧远景为城门和城墙。

15—19秒：六架黑色现代四旋翼无人机从城墙后方的露天校场依次升空，旋翼高速旋转，越过城墙，朝魏军方向飞来。飞行速度、爬升高度和远近比例真实连续。

19—22秒：六架无人机在魏军阵前上空排列悬停，发出明显嗡鸣。士兵纷纷仰头，队列出现骚动。司马懿抬头看见从未见过的飞行器，又看向敞开的城门，怀疑城内藏有未知伏兵。

22—24秒：司马懿猛然勒紧缰绳，调转马头，挥手下令撤退。身边几名骑兵开始掉头，后方军队尚未完全反应。

24秒切换监控。

【24—30秒｜CAM01 返回城门】

恢复第一台监控的完全相同位置、朝向、焦距和构图。

24—27秒：魏军前锋沿来时道路向画面左上方撤退，后方步兵陆续转身，扬起尘土。六架无人机仍在城门前方上空盘旋，未发动攻击。

27—30秒：前锋骑兵逐渐远去，后方士兵仍在撤离，魏军没有瞬间消失。北城门始终敞开。画面右下角，两名老兵从头到尾没有停止扫地，甚至没有抬头。

最后一秒画面轻微滋滋闪烁，水平扫描线划过，时间戳显示14:20:29，录像结束。

【声音】

无BGM、无旁白、无喜剧配乐。

只有战马蹄声、甲胄摩擦、扫帚擦地声、布料掀动声、笔记本开合与键盘声、无人机旋翼嗡鸣、远处魏军惊呼及撤退脚步声。声音带有老式监控麦克风的压缩底噪。

【严格约束】

3台固定监控，4段画面，仅在7、15、24秒切换。各机位视角始终不变，禁止电影特写、推拉摇移。

CAM01和CAM03从城门西侧朝东北方向观察；CAM02仅拍摄诸葛亮及桌面，不强行展示城外。

诸葛亮始终坐在城楼，不瞬移、不下楼；最后CAM01画面不出现诸葛亮。

电脑只有一台，银灰色，始终放在同一桌面。六架无人机必须从城内升空，越过城墙后到达魏军上空，不能凭空出现。

魏军从北面来、向北面退，前锋先撤、后队跟随，不得瞬间消失。无人机无武器、不攻击、不爆炸。

全片统一黑白VHS质感。人物、建筑、道具数量、地理位置、光线方向、时间戳保持连续一致。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Zhuge Liang's Modern Empty City Strategy | Surveillance Footage Version]
16:9 landscape, 30 seconds, black-and-white vintage security camera footage. Fusion of realistic Three Kingdoms historical film texture and absurd modern technology. Zhuge Liang uses a laptop to control drones in Xicheng, scaring away Sima Yi's army. Characters remain serious and natural, not intentionally funny.

[Surveillance and Time]

Three fixed wide-angle surveillance cameras, four recording segments, switching camera positions only at seconds 7, 15, and 24. No camera movement, zoom, or slow motion throughout.

Black-and-white VHS low resolution, grain noise, horizontal scan lines, slight ghosting, corner vignetting, crushed blacks, slight highlight blowout.

Top-left white dot-matrix timestamp "Jianxing Year 6 14:20:00", incrementing by one second, ending at 14:20:29. All cameras use a synchronized clock; switching does not reset or skip seconds. Bottom-left shows CAM01, CAM02, or CAM03; top-right shows REC.

[Scene and Space]

Shu Han Jianxing Year 6, North Gate of Xicheng County. Gray-blue brick and stone city walls, rammed earth roads, wooden gate towers, tile eaves, wide gate openings. The north gate is completely open, the city interior is empty, two veteran Shu soldiers in coarse cloth clothes are sweeping inside the gate opening.

Wei army approaches southward along the northern road, retreating back north along the original path. City gates, roads, gate towers, and character positions remain unchanged throughout. Daytime natural light, slight dust.

[Characters]

Zhuge Liang: Around 47 years old, thin and scholarly, wearing a black silk cap, light-colored wide-sleeved crane cloak, dark gray cross-collar robe, short beard, white feather fan placed beside him. Calm and composed, sitting upright on the gate tower.

Sima Yi: Around 49 years old, dark Wei general armor, ancient helmet, heavy cloak, black beard, riding a dark warhorse, cautious and suspicious.

Facial features, hairstyles, and costumes of both remain consistent throughout.

[0–7s | CAM01 Gate Surveillance]

Camera installed on the northwest corner tower of the north gate, approx. 18 meters high, looking down northeast at 35 degrees. Bottom-right is the open north gate, center is the road, top-left is the approach of the Wei army.

0–3s: Two veterans sweep leisurely. Dust flies in the distance; Sima Yi leads the Wei vanguard cavalry and infantry approaching.

3–7s: Sima Yi stops his horse tens of meters from the gate, looks up at the empty gate tower. Wei vanguard stops following suit. The two veterans continue sweeping, showing no reaction.

Switch at 7s.

[7–15s | CAM02 Tower Surveillance]

Camera fixed under the inner eaves of the gate tower, 3.5 meters high, approx. 3 meters from Zhuge Liang, looking down at 30 degrees. Center of frame is Zhuge Liang and the complete wooden table, a young attendant stands nearby. Ensure hands, tabletop, and computer are clearly distinguishable.

7–10s: Zhuge Liang sits upright before the table, covered by guqin cloth. Attendant nervously looks outside; Zhuge Liang gently waves to signal quiet.

10–13s: Zhuge Liang slowly lifts the cloth, revealing a silver-gray modern laptop. He calmly opens the screen and types skillfully.

13–15s: Zhuge Liang looks at the computer, presses Enter, screen lights up with a simple black-and-white control interface. He gently picks up the white feather fan, smiling confidently.

Switch at 15s.

[15–24s | CAM03 Wei Vanguard Surveillance]

Camera fixed on the arrow tower extending outward from the west side of the north gate, approx. 12 meters high, looking down east-northeast at 35 degrees. Left side is the Wei vanguard, right background is the gate and walls.

entries.title: Gothic Comedy Makeup Transformation Animation
entries.description: A detailed prompt for Seedance 2.5 generating a 26-second vertical gothic comedy animation. It specifies character identities based on a reference image (@image1), defines strict blocking and environment details, and includes a second-by-second timeline with dialogue and actions for a witch making over a ghost.
entries.prompt:
A 26-second VERTICAL 9:16 gothic comedy in premium stylized 3D feature-animation style. Expressive character acting, detailed velvet, lace, hair and cosmetics, soft cinematic lighting, crisp close-ups and lively editing. Match the animation style of @image1. This is a stylized animated film, not live action. Natural-speed actions, no slow motion.

REFERENCES
@image1 is the character identity and starting costume reference:
LEFT character = the witch makeup artist.
RIGHT character = the ghost woman BEFORE her makeover.
Preserve their faces, body proportions, skin colors and starting clothes. The reference is not the first-frame composition. Both characters are adults.
No video reference is required. Follow the choreography and timeline below.

CHARACTERS
WITCH: shorter, curvy, confident adult woman with warm peach skin, amber eyes, sculpted dark purple waves with a silver forelock, burgundy lipstick, a tilted black witch hat with a plum band and gold crescent, gold crescent earrings, plum velvet midi dress, black belt and black heeled ankle boots. Dry humor, precise gestures, unimpressed expressions. Her appearance never changes.

GHOST: much taller, slender adult woman with pale gray-blue skin, large gray-green eyes, purple under-eye shadows, long tangled dark hair, an antique ivory dress with lace collar and cuffs, frayed hem and gray lace-up shoes. Initially awkward and anxious. Keep her facial identity and pale skin throughout the makeover. Only her makeup, hairstyle and later accessories change.

ENVIRONMENT AND BLOCKING
An intimate gothic dressing room with dark plum walls, ornate antique gold furniture, cobwebs in the upper corners, candles and warm bulbs around a large vanity mirror. Cool blue light enters through a rear doorway on screen right.
The vanity and mirror occupy the left and central background. Two separate plum upholstered seats stand in front of the vanity: the witch's seat on screen left and the client's seat on screen right.
Once the makeover starts, the witch stands on the client's screen-left side. Maintain these positions across cuts.
Cosmetics are arranged on the vanity: lipstick, concealer, orange sponge, eyeshadow brush, liner, false lashes, tweezers, lip pencil, lip brush, hairspray, hairpins, a crescent choker and a powder compact.
Keep backgrounds spatially consistent. Reflections show the same characters and current actions, never extra people.

TIMELINE

0.00-1.00 | THE FAILED SCARE
Medium two-shot, slightly angled toward the vanity. The witch is seated on screen left, already applying burgundy lipstick with her right hand.
The ghost steps into view behind her, raises both hands beside her face with fingers spread, leans forward and exclaims, "Boo!"
The witch does not flinch. Her lipstick hand stays steady.

1.00-2.70 | COMPLETELY UNIMPRESSED
Cut to a close-up of the witch. She slowly shifts only her eyes toward the ghost, maintaining a bored expression.
At approximately 1.10 she gives a short disapproving "Mm-mm."
She finishes one small lipstick stroke, lowers the lipstick and gives a second "Mm-mm." at approximately 2.10.
Make these two separate brief vocal responses. No frightened reaction.

2.70-4.00 | TAKE A SEAT
Return to the two-shot. The witch places the lipstick on the vanity and gestures toward the empty client seat with an open hand.
The ghost lowers her raised hands, steps around the chair and sits. Show her hips settling onto the cushion.
The witch rises beside her and reaches for the concealer. Cut only after the ghost is seated.

4.00-5.20 | CONCEALER
Frontal close-up of the ghost, looking uncertain.
The witch's right hand enters from screen left and places one small beige concealer dab beneath each eye. Both marks remain visible until blended.
The ghost follows the applicator with her eyes without moving her head excessively.

5.20-7.00 | SPONGE REACTION
A slightly tighter close-up. An orange sponge gently presses and releases against the ghost's cheek and under-eye area, visibly blending the concealer.
The ghost briefly scrunches her nose and bares her teeth in an awkward comic grimace, then relaxes.
The sponge deforms slightly on contact. It never passes through her face.

7.00-9.30 | EYESHADOW
Macro of a closed eyelid. A soft brush deposits shimmering smoky plum eyeshadow with one controlled sweep.
Cut to a matching close-up of the other eyelid receiving the same treatment.
By the end, both eyelids have matching finished eyeshadow. Preserve her natural eye shape.

9.30-11.50 | EYELINER
Close-up of one closed eye. The witch draws a clean dark line along the upper lash line with a small outward flick.
Use a brief matching insert to establish the other eye completed.
The tool touches the eyelid, never the eyeball.

11.50-13.50 | LASHES
Tight close-up. Tweezers place a false lash strip onto the upper lash line while that eye is closed.
The witch gives a quiet evaluative "Mm-mm." around 12.00.
A short cut reveals both lash strips properly attached. The ghost opens both eyes and blinks once. No loose floating eyelashes.

13.50-15.30 | LIP CONTOUR
Close-up of the mouth. A burgundy pencil traces the cupid's bow and continues along the lip edge.
A brief editing ellipse reveals the completed outline. Keep her lips the same anatomical size.

15.30-17.50 | LIP COLOR
A fine lip brush fills the outlined lips with deep berry-red color.
The witch lightly supports the underside of the ghost's chin with one fingertip, then withdraws her hand.
The ghost gives a small pleased smile. Her face remains recognizably the same.

17.50-20.70 | HAIR TRANSFORMATION
Medium shot. The witch gathers the ghost's long hair upward with both hands.
Use two quick action-matched cuts showing successive stages: gathered hair, then a secured tall sculpted updo. The witch visibly inserts hairpins.
Leave two fine face-framing strands. Add one small gold crescent and one gold star hair ornament.
The witch picks up hairspray from the vanity and releases one short visible mist above the hairstyle, directed away from the ghost's eyes. The ghost briefly widens her eyes.
Hair is physically styled, not magically replaced.

20.70-23.00 | FIRST LOOK
Cut to an over-the-shoulder mirror composition with both women's reflections clearly visible.
The ghost turns her head slightly to inspect the makeup and updo, then smiles in surprise.
The witch watches with a satisfied knowing smile.
The mirror accurately reflects the completed hair and makeup.

23.00-25.00 | THE CHOKER
Close-up of the neck below the existing lace collar. The witch places a narrow black choker around the exposed neck above the collar and fastens it at the back.
A small gold crescent pendant settles at the front.
The choker remains on for the rest of the film. Do not fasten it again in Part 2.

25.00-26.00 | PREPARE THE CONTINUATION CUT
Medium-close frontal view of the seated ghost, with the witch on screen left.
The witch holds an open round powder compact in her LEFT hand. With her RIGHT hand she lifts a fluffy powder brush toward the ghost's RIGHT cheek, the cheek visible on screen left.
The ghost closes her eyes and turns her face very slightly toward screen right.
At 25.80 the bristles make soft contact with the cheek. Begin a gentle upward sweep.
End at 26.00 with the bristles still touching the cheek, the sweep incomplete. Do not withdraw the brush, finish the stroke, fade out or freeze-frame.

AUDIO AND DIALOGUE
Exactly these spoken sounds and words:
Ghost at 0.00: "Boo!"
Witch near 1.10: "Mm-mm."
Witch near 2.10: "Mm-mm."
Witch near 12.00: "Mm-mm."
No other speech.
The ghost's scare is theatrical and brief. The witch's delivery is dry, low and unimpressed.
Detailed synchronized foley: lipstick cap, light chair movement, cosmetic taps, soft brush strokes, tweezers clicking, clothing rustle and one short hairspray hiss.

Its head resembles a monstrous Venus flytrap, featuring multiple layers of sharp, irregular teeth surrounding a deep, fleshy mouth. The creature has an organic, textured, slightly wet surface. Its mouth opens wide, revealing a dark glowing interior. It moves its flexible stem aggressively, attacks with powerful vine movements, and releases strange glowing green biological energy.

The giant stem crashes into the ground, throwing dirt, grass, and debris into the air.

entries.title: Cinematic Supernatural Exorcism Sequence

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic, cinematic supernatural exorcism sequence set inside a dark 17th-century bedroom during cold, overcast daylight.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: Keep the main character's original identity, facial features, body proportions, hairstyle, and clothing unchanged. Show a gradual, believable supernatural transformation without changing the person's identity or inventing new physical features.

CHARACTERS: Exactly five people throughout: one possessed character, one lead priest, and three assistants. No one else enters.

0–8 SECONDS: THE STRUGGLE

The character lies face-up on the bed, violently struggling in irregular bursts. Assistants hold the shoulders, upper arms, and lower legs. The lead priest stands nearby, holding a prayer book and silver aspergillum. Show intense facial expressions, realistic resistance against the mattress, and tense close-ups. The character's expression slowly shifts from fear to an unnaturally cold stare.

8–16 SECONDS: SUPERNATURAL DISTURBANCE

The closed window suddenly swings open by itself. A powerful cold gust rushes into the room. Curtains billow inward, hair moves naturally, bedding shifts, and prayer-book pages flutter rapidly. The priest struggles to continue praying as the assistants become visibly frightened. The door remains closed.

16–24 SECONDS: THE TRANSFORMATION

Use dramatic hard cuts between the character's partially obscured face, the priest's frightened reaction, and the violently moving curtains. The supernatural appearance develops progressively. The character's movements become slower and more controlled before the struggle suddenly stops.

24–30 SECONDS: THE SINISTER SMILE

The character becomes completely still for a brief moment, then slowly turns the gaze toward the lead priest. A cold, unsettling expression replaces the earlier fear. One corner of the mouth gradually rises into a sinister smile. A faint, contemptuous chuckle emerges. End with an intense facial close-up and subtle continuous movement in the hair, clothing, curtains, and prayer-book pages.

VISUAL STYLE: Photorealistic cinematic horror, tense handheld camera, dramatic close-ups, decisive hard cuts, natural human movement, realistic wind physics, cold muted lighting, atmospheric shadows, and consistent character appearance.

AUDIO: Strained prayers, breathing, bed creaks, window opening, rushing wind, fluttering paper, moving fabric, and a low sinister chuckle only.

晴れた朝、旅の目的地だった岬の白い灯台。たどり着いた瞬間、塔が軋みながら海のほうへ傾いてくる。灯室のガラスの向こうで、番人の老人が窓を叩いている。海の岩の上には、白いコートの男。右手で灯台を引き倒しにかかる。「……灯台ごと、かよ」。さくらとナギが右手を上げて止めにかかるが、ガラスが割れて目の前に降り、2人は地面を削りながら引きずられる。崖の縁が崩れ、番人は傾いた回廊の手すりにしがみつく。「止まら、ない……！」

On a clear morning, the white lighthouse at the cape, which was the destination of the journey. The moment they arrive, the tower groans and tilts toward the sea. Beyond the glass of the lantern room, the old keeper bangs on the window. On the rocks by the sea stands a man in a white coat. He pulls the lighthouse down with his right hand. "...Even the lighthouse?" Sakura and Nagi raise their right hands to try to stop it, but the glass shatters and falls in front of them, dragging the two along as they scrape the ground. The edge of the cliff crumbles, and the keeper clings to the railing of the tilted corridor. "It won't stop...!"

The keeper shouts. "Before you use it, grip what you want to protect!" Sakura clenches her scarf around her neck with her left hand, plants her feet, and resets her stance. Wind blows outward from Sakura, pushing the lighthouse back. The lighthouse stops heavily, still diagonal. The man is no longer on the rocks by the sea. A voice comes from afar. "I took your share from him." Nagi holds his head and collapses. "...Nagi?" Nagi lifts his face and says. "...Who are you?" Sakura gasps and introduces herself again. "...Sakura. We're traveling together."

Recorded handheld by friends traveling together. Handheld chase running, crash zoom on the lantern room, whip pan to the rocks by the sea, low-angle tracking shot near the ground, and frontal close-up looking up at the sky. No BGM.

entries.prompt:
生成一条完整的30秒真人电影级魔幻动作短片，16:9横屏。

【故事】
一头巨型甲壳兽袭击古城入口前的小孩。一名成年女守卫冲入救人，将孩子送进安全门洞，自己留在门外与巨兽搏斗。她被巨兽压制、撞倒，但发现巨兽的冲撞正在破坏旁边的独立石拱，最终利用已经受损的石拱击毙怪兽。结尾回到女主的呼吸、站姿与眼神，确认她活下来，威胁已经结束。

重点：场面宏大，打斗激烈，攻防清楚，有真实体重、接触、惯性和破坏反馈。不是游戏过场，不是招式展示，不是一边倒的轻松碾压。

【女主固定形象】
约二十六岁的成年东亚女性，真实自然的面容与皮肤，深棕色高马尾，额前少量碎发。
穿深灰色不透明战斗内搭、哑光旧钢色轻型胸甲与肩甲、深棕色高腰工装短裤、不透明防护内衬、护膝、胫甲和深棕色平底战靴。短裤到大腿中部，便于活动，正常覆盖。
装备有磨损与划痕，不是光亮游戏皮肤。
从第一镜起，手中就持有一柄深色木质长柄战刃，顶端为单片旧钢色弧形刀刃。全片只有这一柄武器，不消失、不复制、不变形。
人物漂亮但不摆拍，战斗中会喘息、失衡、沾灰，头发和衣服逐渐凌乱。

【怪兽固定形象】
一头肩高约四米的四足甲壳巨兽，低伏厚重的头部、两根短钝角、四条粗壮肢体、灰黑色分层甲壳、一条短而沉重的尾巴。
深琥珀色眼睛，不发光。
像有真实体重的大型动物，冲撞后需要调整脚步和转向，不能瞬间掉头。
全片保持同一体型、外形和肢体数量，不长出翅膀、触手或额外能力。

【孩子】
约十岁的孩子，穿灰米色普通衣服，主要以背影出现，害怕但没有受伤。
被救入门洞后，不再回到战斗区域，不拍孩子被击打或受伤。

【固定场景与空间】
明亮午后，山谷古城外的宽阔石台，远处有高大城墙、山谷和云层，空间宏大，战斗区域清楚。

右后方：坚固古城入口，门洞敞开，通向安全内院。
左后方：独立的废旧石拱，两根石柱支撑一块沉重横梁。其中靠近战斗区域的石柱，从第一镜就有明显风化裂纹。
左侧石拱外侧：一段厚实矮墙，可供女主侧身躲到后方。
前景与中央：开阔干燥石台，少量碎石和低矮石栏。

独立石拱不是安全入口的一部分，两者有足够距离。石拱坍塌不能波及孩子。
所有后续利用的结构都在开场建立镜头中出现。场景不换地方，不交换门与石拱的位置。

【摄影与光线】
真人史诗动作电影摄影，真实服装、实物道具与写实生物特效质感。
主光始终是左后方的午后阳光，天空光柔和补亮人物面部。石粉和尘埃在侧逆光中清楚可见，但不能遮住关键动作。
自然肤色，浅灰石材，克制色彩，保留明暗层次。
打斗以实时速度为主，关键接触要看清。中景和全身景承担攻防，近景补情绪，不用连续碎切隐藏动作。
镜头可短距离跟拍，有克制手持感，不剧烈乱抖，不做整圈环绕。

【时间与镜头】

0–3秒：
广角侧向跟拍，第一帧就进入危险。
巨兽撞碎一段低石栏，碎石落在石台上。孩子被困在右后方安全门洞外，女主从侧面冲入。
同一画面清楚交代安全入口、左侧独立石拱、已有裂纹的石柱和石拱外侧矮墙。女主的长柄战刃从开场就可见。

3–6秒：
切侧面中景。
女主赶到孩子身旁，空出一只手引导孩子转向敞开的门洞，孩子自己跑入内院，不安排抱起或抛接。
女主回身面对巨兽，简短说：“进去，别回头！”
孩子随后不再出镜。

6–10秒：
切稳定的侧面中全景，完整拍清一次攻防。
巨兽前爪横扫，女主向攻击外侧移步，用战刃偏转爪缘，而不是正面挡住巨兽全部重量。
接触后她被迫退开两步，靴底摩擦石面，重新站稳。怪兽前爪落地，压裂局部石板。
先发生接触，再出现位移和碎石反馈。

10–14秒：
切短距离跟拍中景。
巨兽继续向前冲压，女主避让不及，被肩部擦撞失衡，倒地后沿石面滑出一小段距离。
她没有飞上高空，没有翻滚数圈，头部不撞击石面。
武器留在她手边，清楚可见。她试图撑起身体，巨兽在后方调整重心，准备追击。

14–18秒：
切较低的侧面中景。
女主握住原有长柄战刃，借柄支撑起身，呼吸明显变急，护甲和短裤沾上灰尘。
她退向左侧石拱外缘，目光短暂落在已经风化开裂的石柱上。
不安排长时间思考特写，不说解释性台词。巨兽沿她刚才的移动路线逼近。

18–22秒：
切广角侧面，女主、巨兽、石柱和矮墙保持同框。
巨兽扑近，女主沿石柱外侧避开，巨兽肩部撞上已有裂纹的石柱。
裂缝扩大，小石块掉落，横梁轻微下沉，但暂时没有坍塌。
女主到达石拱外侧、靠近矮墙的位置，巨兽停在受损柱旁。所有人物位置有连续移动轨迹。

22–25秒：
保持相同侧向空间关系，切稍近的中全景。
巨兽重新朝女主冲撞。她在冲撞路径外做一次短距离侧跃，落到既有矮墙后方，正常落地。
巨兽因自身前冲惯性再次撞上受损支撑，石柱断裂。
不凭空增加陷阱、炸药、武器或超能力。

25–27秒：
切三分之四广角。
沉重横梁失去支撑，向下坠落，压倒巨兽。
横梁刚分离时短暂减速强调重量，落下撞击恢复实时速度。
巨兽倒下后停止运动，以非血腥方式明确交代死亡。石块按重力下落，尘土在撞击后扩散，不像爆炸火球。
右侧安全入口保持完整，孩子不受波及。

27–30秒：
切女主中近景，缓慢推近。
她从矮墙旁站起来，用原有长柄战刃支撑，肩膀随呼吸起伏，脸和装备上有灰尘，眼神仍然警觉。
背景中能辨认倒下的巨兽和坍塌石拱，但不喧宾夺主。
她先稳住双脚，再确认怪兽不再动。
最后停在女主的面容与生存姿态上，她的目光锁定倒下的巨兽，不以怪兽尸体或建筑倒塌作为最后一帧。

【声音】
真实而有重量的巨兽脚步、甲壳摩擦、战刃与爪缘接触声、靴底摩擦、石材断裂和沉重坍塌。
声音与接触时刻准确同步，不使用连续夸张爆炸声。
紧张的低音节奏与克制史诗配乐逐渐推进，坍塌后迅速收轻，最后突出女主喘息和落石余音。
唯一对白：“进去，别回头！”
无旁白，无胜利口号，无罐头音效。

【连续性与限制】
女主面容、服装、发型和武器始终一致。
怪兽体型、甲壳、四足结构与短尾始终一致。
石栏与石柱的损坏逐步累积，不自动恢复。
右侧安全入口与左侧独立石拱不交换位置。
人物移动必须有过程，不瞬移，不穿墙，不穿透对方。
女主不能徒手举起巨兽，不能正面静止接住巨兽全力冲撞。
无连续空翻，无整圈旋转，无漂浮落地，无能量光束，无魔法秒杀。
无血腥伤口特写，无肢解，无孩子受伤画面。
镜头以完整攻防和人物表情为中心，不刻意拍摄身体部位。
无字幕，无文字，无Logo，无水印
entries.translated_prompt:
Generate a complete 30-second live-action cinematic fantasy action short, 16:9 landscape.

[Story]
A giant armored beast attacks a child in front of an ancient city entrance. An adult female guard rushes in to save the child, sending them into a safe doorway while she stays outside to fight the beast. She is pinned down and knocked over by the beast but realizes its charges are damaging a nearby independent stone arch. Finally, she uses the damaged arch to kill the monster. The ending returns to the heroine's breathing, posture, and gaze, confirming she survived and the threat is gone.

Focus: Grand scenes, intense fighting, clear offense and defense, realistic weight, contact, inertia, and destruction feedback. Not a game cutscene, not a move showcase, not one-sided easy crushing.

[Fixed Heroine Appearance]
An adult East Asian woman around 26 years old, with realistic natural facial features and skin, dark brown high ponytail, some loose hair on forehead.
Wearing dark gray opaque combat inner layer, matte old steel light chest armor and shoulder guards, dark brown high-waisted cargo shorts, opaque protective lining, knee pads, shin guards, and dark brown flat-soled combat boots. Shorts reach mid-thigh, convenient for movement, normal coverage.
Equipment has wear and scratches, not shiny game skins.
From the first shot, holding a dark wood long-handled war blade with a single piece of old steel curved blade at the top. Only this weapon throughout the video, does not disappear, duplicate, or deform.
Beautiful but not posing, gasps, loses balance, gets dusty during battle, hair and clothes gradually become messy.

[Fixed Monster Appearance]
A four-legged armored beast about 4 meters tall at shoulder, low heavy head, two short blunt horns, four thick limbs, gray-black layered shell, short heavy tail.
Deep amber eyes, no glow.
Like a large animal with real weight, needs to adjust steps and turning after charging, cannot turn instantly.
Maintain same body type, shape, and limb count throughout, no wings, tentacles, or extra abilities.

[Child]
About 10-year-old child, wearing gray-beige ordinary clothes, mainly appears from back, scared but uninjured.
After being saved into doorway, does not return to battle area, no shots of child being hit or injured.

[Fixed Scene and Space]
Bright afternoon, wide stone platform outside valley ancient city, distant high city walls, valleys and clouds, grand space, clear battle area.

Right rear: Sturdy ancient city entrance, open doorway leading to safe inner courtyard.
Left rear: Independent ruined stone arch, two stone pillars supporting a heavy beam. The pillar near battle area has obvious weathering cracks from first shot.
Outside left stone arch: A thick low wall, allowing heroine to hide behind it sideways.
Foreground and center: Open dry stone platform, some rubble and low stone railings.

Independent stone arch is not part of safe entrance, sufficient distance between them. Arch collapse cannot affect child.
All structures used later appear in opening establishing shots. Scene does not change location, doors and arch positions do not swap.

[Cinematography and Lighting]
Live-action epic action film cinematography, realistic costumes, physical props, and realistic creature effect textures.
Main light always afternoon sun from left rear, sky light softly fills faces. Stone dust and debris clearly visible in side backlight but must not obscure key actions.
Natural skin tones, light gray stone, restrained colors, maintain tonal layers.
Fighting primarily at real-time speed, key contacts clearly visible. Medium and full shots handle offense/defense, close-ups add emotion, no rapid cuts hiding action.
Camera can track short distances, restrained handheld feel, no violent shaking, no full circle orbits.

[Time and Shots]

0-3s:
Wide angle lateral tracking, danger enters frame immediately.
Beast smashes low stone railing, rubble falls on platform. Child trapped outside right rear safe doorway, heroine rushes in from side.
Same frame clearly shows safe entrance, left independent stone arch, cracked pillar, and outer low wall. Heroine's long-handled war blade visible from start.

3-6s:
Cut to lateral medium shot.
Heroine reaches child, frees hand to guide child toward open doorway, child runs into inner courtyard independently, no carrying or throwing.
Heroine turns to face beast, briefly says: "Go in, don't look back!"
Child then disappears from view.

6-10s:
Cut to stable lateral medium-full shot, fully capture one offense/defense exchange.
Beast sweeps front claw, heroine moves outward from attack path, deflects claw edge with war blade rather than blocking full weight directly.
After contact, forced to retreat two steps, boot soles scrape stone surface, regains stance. Beast front claw lands, cracking local stone slabs.
Contact happens first, then displacement and rubble feedback.

10-14s:
Cut to short-distance tracking medium shot.
Beast continues forward charge, heroine fails to dodge, grazed by shoulder causing imbalance, falls and slides short distance along stone surface.
Does not fly high, does not roll multiple times, head does not hit stone surface.
Weapon remains beside her, clearly visible. Tries to push up, beast adjusts center of gravity in background preparing pursuit.

14-18s:
Cut to lower lateral medium shot.
Heroine grips original long-handled war blade, uses shaft to support rising, breathing noticeably faster, armor and shorts covered in dust.
Retreats toward left stone arch edge, gaze briefly falls on already weathered cracked pillar.
No long thinking close-up, no explanatory dialogue. Beast approaches along her previous movement path.

18-22s:
Cut to wide angle lateral, heroine, beast, stone pillar, and low wall remain in same frame.
Beast lunges, heroine dodges outside pillar, beast shoulder hits already cracked pillar.
Cracks expand, small stones fall, beam slightly sinks but temporarily does not collapse.
Heroine reaches position outside stone arch near low wall, beast stops beside damaged pillar. All character positions have continuous movement trajectories.

22-25s:
Maintain same lateral spatial relationship, cut to slightly closer medium-full shot.
Beast charges again at heroine. She performs short lateral leap outside charge path, landing normally behind existing low wall.
Beast due to forward momentum hits damaged support again, stone pillar breaks.
Do not arbitrarily add traps, explosives, weapons, or superpowers.

25-27s:
Cut to three-quarter wide angle.
Heavy beam loses support, falls downward, crushing beast.
Brief deceleration when beam separates to emphasize weight, impact returns to real-time speed.
Beast stops moving after falling, death clearly conveyed non-gory way. Stones fall by gravity, dust spreads after impact, not like explosion fireball.
Right safe entrance remains intact, child unaffected.

27-30s:
Cut to heroine medium-close shot, slow push-in.
She stands up beside low wall, supported by original long-handled war blade, shoulders rise and fall with breathing, face and equipment dusty, gaze still alert.
Background recognizable fallen beast and collapsed stone arch but not dominant.
First stabilizes feet, then confirms beast no longer moves.
Ends on heroine's face and survival posture, gaze locked on fallen beast, not beast corpse or building collapse as final frame.

[Sound]
Realistic weighted beast footsteps, shell friction, war blade and claw edge contact sounds, boot scraping, stone breaking, and heavy collapse.
Sounds accurately synchronized with contact moments, no continuous exaggerated explosion sounds.
Tense bass rhythm and restrained epic score gradually build, quickly soften after collapse, finally highlight heroine's panting and falling stone echoes.
Only dialogue: "Go in, don't look back!"
No narration, no victory slogans, no stock sound effects.

[Continuity and Restrictions]
Heroine's face, costume, hairstyle, and weapon always consistent.
Monster's body type, shell, four-leg structure, and short tail always consistent.
Railing and pillar damage accumulates progressively, does not auto-recover.
Right safe entrance and left independent stone arch do not swap positions.
Character movement must have process, no teleporting, no wall clipping, no passing through each other.
Heroine cannot lift beast with bare hands, cannot statically catch full-force charge head-on.
No continuous somersaults, no full rotations, no floating landings, no energy beams, no magic instant kills.
No gory wound close-ups, no dismemberment, no child injury scenes.
Shots focus on complete offense/defense and character expressions, do not deliberately photograph body parts.
No subtitles, no text, no logos, no watermarks

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Cinematic Action Sequence Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a cinematic action scene with Seedance 2.5, featuring characters Sakura and Nagi fighting on a breakwater using telekinetic powers over tetrapods, with specific camera movements and no BGM.
entries.prompt:
晴れた朝、北の岬へ続く防波堤の一本道。行く手に、港で遠くから見ていた白いコートの男が立ちはだかる。「……港の、あいつだ」。男は積み上げられたテトラポッドを引きはがし、投げつけてくる。さくらは右手を突き出し、別のテトラポッドを浮かせて盾にする。空中でぶつかり、盾が押し負ける。男（ナギ）がさくらを抱えて飛び込み、2つのテトラポッドがさくらの立っていた場所に叩きつけられる。フードが落ち、さくらは初めて、すぐ近くでナギの顔を見る。

遠くから声。「……もっと、使え」。ナギ「使わせるのが、あいつの狙いだ」。落ちた襟巻きを拾って「……大事なものだろ」。さくら「おばあちゃんからの、形見」。白いコートの男が、もっと大きなテトラポッドを浮かせる。「1人で受けるな。……一緒に押し返す」。2人で同時に止める。「当てるな。……海へ」。弧を描いて押し返し、男の足元の海へ落とす。水柱が晴れると、男はもういない。さくらは襟巻きに触れる。「……これ、誰の、だっけ」。「……灯台の番人なら、わかるかもしれない」。2人は灯台へ歩き出す。

一緒に旅をしている友達が手持ちで撮った記録。走って追う手持ち、望遠へのクラッシュズーム、地面すれすれの追従、空をあおる正面の寄り、海を見下ろす俯瞰。BGMなし。
entries.translated_prompt:
On a clear morning, along a single path leading to the northern cape's breakwater. Ahead stands the man in the white coat seen from afar at the port. "...It's him, from the port." The man tears off stacked tetrapods and throws them. Sakura extends her right hand, lifting another tetrapod as a shield. They collide in mid-air, and the shield is overwhelmed. The man (Nagi) grabs Sakura and dives, and two tetrapods slam into where she was standing. Her hood falls off, and for the first time, Sakura sees Nagi's face up close.

A voice from afar: "...Use more." Nagi: "Making you use it is his goal." He picks up the fallen scarf: "...This is precious, isn't it?" Sakura: "It's an heirloom from my grandmother." The man in the white coat lifts a larger tetrapod. "Don't take it alone. ...Push back together." They stop it simultaneously. "Don't hit him. ...Into the sea." They push it back in an arc, dropping it into the sea at the man's feet. When the water column clears, the man is gone. Sakura touches the scarf. "...Whose was this again?" "...The lighthouse keeper might know." The two start walking towards the lighthouse.

Recorded handheld by a friend traveling with them. Handheld chase running, crash zoom to telephoto, low-angle tracking near the ground, frontal close-up looking up at the sky, overhead view looking down at the sea. No BGM.

entries.title: Korean Zombie Prison Horror
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a photorealistic Korean zombie horror sequence set in a prison, featuring a prisoner transforming into a zombie.
entries.prompt:
Create a ultra-photorealistic Korean zombie horror sequence set inside a high-security Korean prison at midnight. A young Korean woman prisoner wearing an authentic orange prison uniform, consisting of an orange short-sleeved prison shirt and matching orange prison trousers, with a prisoner identification number printed on her chest, walks cheerfully through a dimly lit prison corridor. Her dark hair is slightly messy, and she playfully waves at a male prison guard standing near her cell.

Suddenly, her cheerful expression disappears. Her eyes slowly turn milky white, dark veins spread across her neck and face, and subtle blood appears around her lips. She begins laughing hysterically, tilting her head at an unnatural angle. The guard approaches her, confused, but she suddenly charges toward the metal bars, violently shaking them with inhuman strength.

The guard unlocks the cell door to investigate, and she suddenly lunges at him, knocking him to the floor. She crawls rapidly along the corridor on all fours, her orange prison uniform remaining consistent throughout. Other prisoners scream and bang on their cell doors as emergency alarms activate.

A female prison officer rushes out of the control room, only to see the infected prisoner crawling unnaturally across the ceiling. She drops her keys and runs toward the security exit.

The lights flicker violently before the entire corridor goes dark. In the final scene, two glowing milky-white eyes appear behind the glass of the security booth. A bloody hand slowly presses against the window as the woman's hysterical laughter echoes through the prison.

STYLE: Photorealistic Korean zombie horror, cinematic 4K, authentic Korean prison interiors, orange prisoner uniform, creepy laughter, milky-white eyes, dark veins, subtle blood, terrifying facial expressions, unnatural movements, flickering fluorescent lights, handheld camera shake, suspenseful atmosphere, Hollywood horror cinematography.

NEGATIVE: Crop tops, shorts, casual clothing, civilian outfits, cartoon, anime, obvious CGI, excessive gore, inconsistent characters, changing prison uniforms, distorted anatomy, subtitles, text overlays, watermark.

entries.title: Sakura and Nagi Port Scene

entries.prompt:
晴れた朝、港のコンテナ置き場。旅の途中のさくらが通路を歩いている。誰も触れていないのに、積み山の上の段の留め金具が、奥から手前へ1つずつ外れていく。突風で一番上の青いコンテナがずれ、さくらのすぐ後ろに叩きつけられる。さくらは手を上げかけて、握りしめる（頭の中で「……もう使うな」）。走って逃げる。前の地面に影が広がり、赤茶のコンテナが前方をふさぐ。振り向いて手を突き上げると、頭のすぐ上でコンテナが止まる。

駆けつけた男が積み山を押さえる。「下は持つ。上をやれ」。さくらは宙の6個と地面の2個を壁ぎわへ下ろす。「……あなたは？」「ナギだ。……前にも言った。それに、もう使うなとも言った」「……いつ？」。「さっきの金具、風じゃない。誰かが外した。あんたは狙われてる。放っておけない」「北の岬に、灯台の番人がいる。力を使っても、忘れなかった人だ」「……その人に会えば」「行くぞ」。遠くの積み山の上に、白いコートの人影。

一緒に旅をしている友達が手持ちで撮った記録。BGMなし。光やオーラは足さず、コンテナが動くだけにした。崩れるのは最初から最後まで左の積み山から右の通路へ。男と白いコートの人物の顔は一度も映していない。撃つ前に、絵コンテの顔をくり抜いた紙芝居で位置関係を決めてから撃った。締めの地図と「わすれたもの」帳と「つづく」だけコードで描いた。
entries.translated_prompt:
On a sunny morning, at a port container yard. Sakura, who is on a journey, walks down the aisle. Although no one touches it, the fasteners of the top tier of the stacked mountains come off one by one from back to front. In a gust of wind, the blue container on top shifts and slams right behind Sakura. She raises her hand halfway and clenches it (in her head: "...don't use it anymore"). She runs away. A shadow spreads on the ground ahead, blocking the way with a reddish-brown container. When she turns around and thrusts her hand up, the container stops just above her head.

A man rushes over and holds down the stack. "I'll hold the bottom. You do the top." Sakura lowers the six floating ones and two on the ground towards the wall. "...Who are you?" "Nagi. ...I told you before. And I also said don't use it anymore." "...When?" "That fastener earlier wasn't the wind. Someone removed it. You are being targeted. I can't leave you alone." "At the northern cape, there is a lighthouse keeper. A person who didn't forget even after using power." "...If I meet that person..." "Let's go." On top of the distant stacks, there is a figure in a white coat.

Recorded handheld by a friend traveling together. No BGM. No added light or aura, only moving containers. The collapse goes from left stack to right aisle throughout. Never show the faces of the man and the person in the white coat. Before shooting, determine positions with paper theater cutouts of storyboard faces. Only draw the closing map, 'Forgotten Things' ledger, and 'To be continued' with code.

entries.title: Android Stunt in Mall Atrium
entries.description: A prompt for generating a photorealistic video of a female android performing an impossible stunt (jumping floors) in a shopping mall, styled as accidental handheld camcorder footage.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT
18 seconds, vertical 9:16. One continuous handheld take, real time, no cuts. Photorealistic accidental eyewitness footage of an impossible stunt by a female android in a giant shopping mall atrium, filmed by a spectator on the upper gallery.

LOOK
Ultra-detailed, true-to-life imagery with Hollywood-level realism: real skin pores, fine hair strands, fabric weave, brushed metal micro-scratches, accurate daylight, reflections and shadows. Over this, a DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel: subtle fine 16mm-like grain, light MiniDV tape texture, mild chroma bleed, auto-exposure breathing, restrained highlight bloom from the dome, natural motion blur. The texture is a light layer that never hides detail, anatomy or architecture. No heavy degradation or fake vintage filter.
Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. The operator reacts to events instead of anticipating them. Errors are brief and physically plausible. No gimbal smoothness, no drone moves.
The camcorder and camera operator never appear on screen: not in glass reflections, shadows, screens or foreground. No camera body, no hands, no REC symbol, timestamp, subtitles or borders.

REFERENCES
Photo of the android woman: exact face, hair, body, outfit and exposed mechanical waist core. Identity stays locked in every frame.
"seedance_2_video 1 17.58.51.mp4": mall atrium design, extreme multilevel depth, trampoline placement, rebound and somersault trajectory. Current instructions override conflicting details.

CHARACTER
A photorealistic female android nearly indistinguishable from a human: long straight dark brown hair with a center part, light olive skin, dark brown eyes, defined brows, calm confident face. Fitted teal short-sleeve cropped t-shirt, high-waisted black biker shorts ending mid-thigh, plain black athletic sneakers.
Her midriff between shirt hem and waistband is an exposed mechanical core: brushed steel plates, vertical chrome pistons, a central steel panel with two small glowing blue displays, cables and joints lit by internal cobalt light. The glow spills onto the shirt hem and waistband and brightens with exertion.
She moves like an elite gymnast with tiny machine precision: crisp stops, no tremor. She is much heavier than a human, and every contact shows that weight. Hair and clothing behave naturally and stay secure. The core never changes shape, size or position.

ENVIRONMENT AND GEOGRAPHY
A colossal circular mall atrium: white curved structural bands, about ten stacked gallery levels, continuous glass balustrades with steel top rails, storefronts, escalators, a huge glass dome in soft daylight. Hundreds of spectators on every level, filming on phones.
Starting level order, always: CROWD / CONTINUOUS GLASS BARRIER / WOMAN ON NARROW EXTERIOR STONE LEDGE / OPEN DROP.
The ledge is a narrow strip of pale travertine about 40 cm wide outside the glass. The glass is always directly behind her heels. The ledge keeps this width and surface for the whole video. The glass has no gaps, doors or missing panels.
On the ground floor stands exactly ONE large round trampoline: blue padded rim, black bed, steel springs and legs. A cleared 6-meter circle of bare floor surrounds it, ringed by black stanchions with belts. Ground spectators stay behind that ring. The trampoline is not visible in the opening frame.
The drop is real architecture: true floor heights, people and storefronts at believable scale on every level. No lens trickery, no raised floor, no platform under the trampoline.

PHYSICS RULE
Her return to the top is possible only because her leg actuators fire at the instant of trampoline contact, adding thrust through the bed. All launch energy is delivered at that single contact. No mid-air boost, no hovering, no jets, no stretched flight time. Gravity stays real throughout.

CAMERA
The operator stands on the starting gallery behind the glass, about three meters to her side, filming diagonally over the top rail. Opening: tilted, slightly too-tight framing that cuts off the top of her head, then a clumsy correction to full body.
At the jump, react a fraction late, then tilt steeply down after her. One clumsy zoom-in during the fall that overshoots, then eases back wide before trampoline contact so the full depth stays readable. A brief focus hunt on the rail glass resolves back to her.
During the ascent and somersaults, follow upward unevenly but keep her full body framed against the galleries. The camera never points above her head into the dome.
At landing, settle on her full body including both feet. Final beat: a slight face crop, then an imperfect correction.

TIMELINE
0.00-2.40 BOOT-UP.
She stands upright on the ledge, turned three-quarters toward the crowd. Her core powers up: the two blue displays flicker, then lock bright. Ankle and knee servos make a short calibration whir as she shifts weight from foot to foot with mechanical precision. She glances down into the void, then back at the crowd. Spectators murmur, phones go up, someone shouts "Is she real?!"

2.40-4.40 THE SALUTE.
She faces the crowd fully, brings her right hand up in a crisp, exact military salute, holds it for one still beat with a faint confident smile, then snaps the hand down with a tiny servo click. The galleries roar.

4.40-5.60 THE JUMP.
She turns to the void, sets both sneakers at the ledge edge, bends her knees, swings both arms back and launches outward in a deliberate, powerful swan dive, arms spread, body arched. Stone grit puffs from the ledge edge under her push. The operator gasps and tilts after her a beat late.

5.60-8.30 THE FALL.
Real-time free fall, accelerating under true gravity. Gallery levels rush past behind her, spectators on lower levels lean out and point, and she shrinks dramatically in frame. Hair streams upward. Halfway down she tucks, rotates forward half a turn and opens feet-first, arms out for stability, eyes locked on the target. The trampoline and the cleared circle are revealed below during the tilt.

8.30-8.90 THE IMPACT.
Both sneakers hit the exact center of the bed. Under her heavy machine body, the bed plunges almost to the floor, springs stretch to their limit, the steel legs flex. At maximum compression her core flares bright blue and her leg actuators fire with a deep hydraulic thump. One spring snaps off the frame and skitters across the floor. Ground spectators flinch back behind the stanchions. One contact, normal speed, no freeze.

8.90-11.60 ASCENT AND TWO BACKFLIPS.
She rockets upward, galleries rushing downward past her. Near the top of her climb she tucks tightly and completes TWO clean, compact backward somersaults, shoulders, hips and knees coherent, full body visible, the blue core tracing a faint motion-blur arc. The rising speed bleeds off naturally at the apex just above the original ledge. Every gallery erupts in screams and cheers.

11.60-12.40 POWER LANDING.
She opens out, drops onto the narrow ledge and lands in a controlled three-point superhero landing: both sneakers flat and fully supported, one knee deeply bent, the other knee low, right fist pressed onto the stone. A heavy metallic impact. A hairline crack spreads a short distance through the travertine under her fist, and a small puff of stone dust lifts. The glass behind her shudders and rings but stays intact. Her hair swings forward, then settles. Perfectly stable, no wobble, no slip.

She holds the pose for one breath. The core glow pulses down to calm. She rises slowly and smoothly to full height with a soft hydraulic hiss, brushing grit off her knuckles with her thumb. entries.title: Ultra-Realistic Winter Morning Home Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 15-second ultra-realistic video featuring a Korean woman in a cozy apartment, styled like an early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic 16:9 landscape video featuring the same naturally attractive 24-year-old Korean woman with long loose dark hair, minimal makeup, an oversized maroon hoodie, and loose casual pants. Preserve her exact facial identity, hairstyle, and body proportions throughout.

Setting: A cozy apartment on a chilly winter morning. Soft natural daylight enters through the window. Authentic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home-video aesthetic, filmed by another person, with slight handheld shake, imperfect framing, subtle autofocus adjustments, faded colors, and natural lighting.

0–3 seconds: She stands near the apartment window, rubbing her hands together. She suddenly shivers, pulls her shoulders inward, and wraps her arms around herself. Her expression suggests that the room is much colder than expected.

3–6 seconds: She looks toward a jacket hanging on a nearby coat rack. She walks over, still slightly shivering, reaches for it, and pulls it off the hanger.

6–10 seconds: She puts the jacket on over her maroon hoodie, slips one arm into a sleeve, then struggles briefly to get the other arm through. She wiggles her shoulder to settle it properly and gives a small amused smile.

10–13 seconds: She pulls the jacket closed, adjusts the collar, and rubs her hands together inside its warm sleeves. Her body relaxes as she finally feels comfortable.

13–15 seconds: She looks toward the camera with a satisfied smile, gives a tiny playful nod, and walks away feeling warmer.

Motion must be smooth, natural, and physically accurate. Realistic shivering, fabric movement, sleeve interactions, and natural walking. Maintain consistent character identity and clothing. No stuttering, judder, duplicated frames, distorted hands, or sudden transitions.

Audio: Quiet indoor ambience, faint wind outside, subtle footsteps, jacket fabric rustling, and natural clothing sounds. No music or narration.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 vs Omni Flash: Kun Spirit Tea
entries.description: A highly detailed, second-by-second prompt for a comedic scene of a character trying to heat tea with magic, comparing Seedance 2.5's performance against Google Omni flash 1.2.
entries.prompt:
《鲲灵煮茶·火诀》｜10 秒，720p，16:9 横屏，24 fps。真人实景质感的中式仙侠日常喜剧，皮肤、衣料和液体细节自然，全片只有一位角色。

使用随附图1（@图片1）作为唯一身份参考。锁定成年鲲灵茶师的脸、深蓝至冰蓝的长发、弯曲呆毛、蓝白鲸鳍耳、单条分叉鲸尾、藏蓝交领茶师袍、白领白袖口、白腰带和褶边头饰。身份、发型、服装和鲸尾前后连贯。背景、姿势和取景可按以下分镜变化。

云山竹林间的古木茶庐，竹格窗有冷白侧逆光，炉火给木纹添一点暖色。榆木案上只有一只青瓷茶盏，盛半盏澄亮琥珀茶汤。她想图省事，用一个小火诀把冷茶温一温。两手空着，施法全靠手诀。

0–1.3 秒｜贴案微距拍完全静止的冷茶，茶面清晰，无热汽。她疲倦平淡的脸在后方柔焦。轻轻移焦，切同侧近景。她举右手至胸前，食指中指并拢，拇指扣住屈起的无名指和小指，掐出干净的双指火诀。左手仍搭在桌沿。

1.3–3.6 秒｜越肩特写同时看清两根指尖、空气间隙、青瓷盏和茶面。她双指向杯心斜下方轻点一次，指尖亮起一点朱红橙金的小灵火；一缕短而细的火息从指尖出发，掠过空气，明确触到茶汤正中央，触点才亮起细小暖光。接触前茶汤不动；接触后茶汤先起涟漪、再缓慢旋转。半秒后，茶面先冒一丝淡白水汽，随温度升高变成两三缕清晰上升的半透明白汽，窗光照亮卷曲边缘。俯拍见旋转加快到一个受控的小漩涡，少量气泡和茶珠只在杯口内，杯外干净。

3.6–4.7 秒｜她眼睛略睁大，立即一屈双指、收掌灭诀。火光瞬间熄灭，水旋即停。画面明确留出半拍，拍同一盏已经平静的茶仍往上冒着白色热汽。蒸汽从液面自然升起，被室内微风带向窗边；没有火苗和烟灰。

4.7–6.1 秒｜同轴近三分之四侧面。她神情平淡，用双手把还在冒白汽的同一只青瓷盏举到唇边，盏口始终托在嘴唇正下方。镜头同时清楚拍到嘴、杯沿和杯口。

6.1–7.0 秒｜正常速度，维持同一个近侧特写，嘴与杯口都看得见。她只轻啜一小口。热茶刚碰舌尖，她就缩眉，杯沿反射性向下撤约四厘米，杯口仍正对嘴下方。杯沿离唇的下一瞬，她立刻“噗”地吐出刚入口的茶，几颗明显的琥珀茶滴从嘴唇飞过这段空隙，准确打在原盏的茶面上，激起一圈小涟漪。短促、干脆、清晰，嘴到杯口的路径完整可见，白汽飘向窗侧。反应与吐出紧接，停顿只在茶滴落杯之后。

7.0–10 秒｜吐完才停。她缓缓呼气，神情由烫到的紧绷松开，安静而难以置信地盯着杯子，把杯子往案上放。热茶仍向窗侧飘出清楚的半透明白汽，最后在杯子下放途中结束。人物不笑、不看镜头。

近场音效：茶庐风声、低炉火声、指尖灵火短燃、细微茶汤旋转与冒泡、清脆收诀声、轻啜、短促克制的“呸”、茶滴落盏和呼气。轻柔诙谐的月琴、古琴拨弦、弱音箫与轻刷手鼓，施法时稍推进，烫到时收弱，茶落回杯时轻拨一下。音效清楚，无对白、歌唱、梗音和罐头笑声。

严格顺序：冷茶无汽 → 徒手掐火诀 → 指尖火息接触茶面 → 茶汤旋转、升温冒白汽 → 收诀灭火，液面平静但仍冒热汽 → 刚啜入口就被烫到，当即短促吐回同一盏 → 吐完才发愣 → 杯子冒着余热白汽往案上放。

禁止出现诀杖、魔杖、法器、其他角色、重复杯子、魔法击中人手或木桌、接触前冒汽或搅动、整杯起火、黑烟、蒸汽遮住脸与杯、猛烈沸腾溅出、喝前做苦相、喝后停顿再吐、拉长吐水过程、吐出整杯、呕吐、唾液丝、手指或口部结构异常、夸张表演、转成动漫、冻结、渐隐、字幕、文字、标志、水印。
entries.translated_prompt:
"Kun Spirit Brewing Tea · Fire Spell" | 10 seconds, 720p, 16:9 landscape, 24 fps. A daily-life comedy set in a Chinese Xianxia world with realistic live-action texture; skin, fabric, and liquid details are natural. Only one character appears throughout.

Use attached Image 1 (@Image1) as the sole identity reference. Lock the face of an adult Kun Spirit tea master, deep blue to ice-blue long hair, a curved ahoge, blue-white whale-fin ears, a single forked whale tail, navy cross-collar tea master robe, white collar/cuffs, white belt, and frilled headpiece. Identity, hairstyle, clothing, and whale tail must remain consistent. Background, pose, and framing can vary per storyboard below.

An ancient wooden tea hut among cloud mountains and bamboo groves, cold white side-backlight through bamboo lattice windows, firelight adding warmth to wood grain. On the elm wood table sits only a celadon tea cup containing half a cup of clear amber tea. She wants to save effort by using a small fire spell to warm the cold tea. Her hands are empty; casting relies entirely on hand seals.

0–1.3s | Macro shot close to the table showing completely static cold tea, clear surface, no steam. Her tired, flat face is soft-focused in the background. Gently rack focus, cut to same-side close-up. She raises her right hand to chest level, index and middle fingers together, thumb holding bent ring and pinky fingers, forming a clean two-finger fire seal. Left hand remains on table edge.

1.3–3.6s | Over-the-shoulder close-up clearly showing both fingertips, air gap, celadon cup, and tea surface. She lightly taps diagonally downward toward the center of the cup with two fingers; a tiny spirit flame (vermillion-orange-gold) lights up at her fingertips; a short, thin breath of fire travels from fingertips, across the air, clearly touching the exact center of the tea, lighting up a tiny warm glow at the contact point. Before contact, tea is still; after contact, tea first ripples, then slowly rotates. Half a second later, faint white steam rises from the surface, becoming two or three clear, semi-transparent white wisps rising as temperature increases, window light illuminating curled edges. Top-down view shows rotation accelerating into a controlled small vortex, few bubbles/tea beads inside rim, outside clean.

3.6–4.7s | Eyes widen slightly, immediately bends two fingers, closes palm to extinguish seal. Fire light instantly dies out, water stops swirling. Frame explicitly leaves a beat, showing the same now-calm tea still emitting white hot steam. Steam rises naturally from surface, carried by indoor breeze toward window; no flames or ash.

4.7–6.1s | Coaxial near 3/4 side view. Expression is flat, she lifts the same celadon cup still emitting white steam to her lips with both hands, cup rim always directly under lower lip. Camera clearly captures mouth, cup rim, and opening simultaneously.

6.1–7.0s | Normal speed, maintain same near-side close-up, mouth and cup opening visible. She takes only a small sip. As soon as hot tea touches tongue tip, she furrows brow, cup rim reflexively moves down ~4cm, opening still directly under mouth. The instant rim leaves lips, she immediately "puh" spits out the just-ingested tea, several distinct amber tea drops fly from lips across this gap, accurately hitting the original cup's tea surface, causing a small ripple. Short, crisp, clear, path from mouth to cup opening fully visible, white steam drifts toward window. Reaction and spit-out are immediate, pause only occurs after tea drops land in cup.

7.0–10s | Stops only after spitting. She slowly exhales, expression relaxes from scalded tension, quietly and disbelievingly stares at cup, places it on table. Hot tea continues emitting clear semi-transparent white steam toward window, ending during cup placement. Character does not smile, does not look at camera.

Near-field audio: wind in tea hut, low furnace fire, short ignition of fingertip spirit fire, subtle tea swirl/bubbling, crisp sound of closing seal, light sip, short restrained "pah", tea drops landing in cup, exhale. Soft humorous Yueqin, Guqin plucking, muted Xiao, light brush drum; music swells slightly during casting, weakens when scalded, light pluck when tea returns to cup. Audio clear, no dialogue, singing, meme sounds, canned laughter.

Strict order: Cold tea no steam → Handless fire seal cast → Fingertip fire breath contacts tea surface → Tea swirls, heats up, emits white steam → Seal closed, fire out, surface calm but still steaming → Just sipped gets scalded, immediately short spit back into same cup → Stunned only after spitting → Cup placed on table while emitting residual heat steam.

Prohibited: Staff/wand/magic tools, other characters, duplicate cups, magic hitting hands/table, steam/stirring before contact, whole cup catching fire, black smoke, steam covering face/cup, violent boiling/splashing, grimace before drinking, pause after drinking before spitting, prolonged spitting, spitting whole cup, vomiting, saliva strands, finger/mouth structural anomalies, exaggerated acting, anime style conversion, freeze frame, fade out, subtitles, text, logos, watermarks.

entries.title: Samurai Fantasy Action Scene
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a cinematic Japanese samurai fantasy scene featuring a blonde woman and a samurai, including action choreography and transformation effects.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic Japanese samurai fantasy scene set in an ancient traditional Japanese village. A beautiful young blonde woman wearing a navy-blue school uniform and a young Japanese samurai dressed in a dark traditional outfit stand in a quiet village street.

The samurai suddenly draws his katana as the woman moves past him. She quickly dodges and falls dramatically to the ground. Suddenly, a mysterious fiery creature appears, launching a powerful fire attack toward the samurai.
