entries.prompt:
15 seconds, horizontal 16:9. Photorealistic live-action dark fantasy film. Realistic character movement, convincing creature weight, detailed skin, fur, leather and cloth. Cinematic blue-fire transformation integrated with natural forest lighting. Real-time action, no slow motion.

REFERENCE IMAGES

IMAGE 1 — HORNED MAN
Exact identity and wardrobe reference for the protagonist: a young adult Black man with short platinum-blond curls, natural blue eyes, pointed ears and two curved black horns. Match his face, skin tone, horn shape, hairstyle, layered charcoal robe, belt, wrist wraps and boots throughout.
His eyes never glow.

IMAGE 2 — DALMATIAN BEFORE AND AFTER
This reference shows TWO FORMS OF ONE DOG, not two separate dogs.
Use the small Dalmatian as the starting and ending form. Use the enormous muscular Dalmatian as the completed transformed form.
Preserve the recognizable black-and-white coat pattern, floppy ears and identity throughout growth and shrinking.
Exactly THREE eyes in both forms: two natural brown lateral eyes and one blue eye centered on the forehead.
ONLY the central forehead eye glows during activation and transformation. The two lateral eyes remain brown and never emit light.
The transformed dog must match the reference's massive shoulders, thick neck, powerful body, enormous paws, dark claws and fangs.

IMAGE 3 — ORC HUNTER
Exact identity, costume and equipment reference for the antagonist. Match the supplied orc's face, skin tone, pointed ears, lower tusks, hair, heavy build, worn leather clothing, bracers, belt and boots.
Use his coarse rope net, attached hauling rope and wooden club.
He is the ONLY antagonist. No human hunter and no additional attackers.

LOCATION AND SPATIAL CONTINUITY
An ancient damp forest with massive trees, exposed roots, wet leaves, muddy soil and shallow puddles. Soft daylight through branches, thin atmospheric mist, muted natural colors.
A clear patch of ground provides enough room for the creature to grow without intersecting trees.

Maintain clear geography:
The horned man is behind the dog.
The dog stands between its owner and the approaching orc.
The orc faces them from several steps away.
When knocked down, the orc falls backward into the open muddy path.

NET MECHANICS
The net is a loose weighted capture net with a hauling line that gathers its edges under tension. It is not tied around the man and is not anchored to a tree.
Pulling the hauling line traps his arms against his upper body.
Releasing that line removes tension, allowing him to lift the loose mesh off his shoulders.

TIMELINE

0.0–2.5 SECONDS — AMBUSH
Start immediately with action in a medium-wide shot.
The horned man and his normal-sized three-eyed Dalmatian are walking through the forest.
The orc throws his rope net from beside a tree. It opens visibly in flight and lands over the man's shoulders and arms, leaving his face and horns visible.
The orc grips and pulls the attached hauling line with his left hand, forcing the man onto one knee. His wooden club remains lowered in his right hand.
The dog is outside the net and turns sharply toward the orc.

2.5–4.0 SECONDS — EYE ACTIVATION BEFORE TRANSFORMATION
The dog steps between its owner and the orc, braces its paws and growls.
The orc advances one step and raises the club threateningly, without striking.

Cut to a close-up of the dog's face.
The central blue forehead eye gradually brightens into an intense icy-blue glow, illuminating the white fur around it.
Hold the glowing eye on the unchanged, normal-sized dog for approximately half a second.

CRITICAL ORDER:
First the forehead eye lights up.
Then a brief visible pause.
Only afterward do the blue flames appear and the physical transformation begin.
No body growth during the initial eye close-up.
Both lateral eyes remain natural brown.

4.0–8.0 SECONDS — CONTINUOUS BLUE-FIRE TRANSFORMATION
Cut to a low three-quarter full-body shot.
Show the entire transformation in one uninterrupted camera move, pulling backward and slightly upward as the creature grows.

4.0–5.0:
Blue fire blooms around the glowing forehead eye and flows over the head, along the spine and around the shoulders.
Flames spread around the chest and legs.
The dog plants its forepaws firmly in the mud. Its toes spread, paws enlarge and thick black claws extend, cutting grooves into the wet soil.
Its shoulders begin to rise and broaden.

5.0–6.0:
The blue flames surge upward into a turbulent envelope around the dog.
Through gaps and translucent edges in the fire, clearly show its chest expanding, neck thickening, back rising and hindquarters growing.
Muscles gain mass beneath skin and short spotted fur.
The hind paws shift wider to support the changing center of gravity.
Increasing weight presses all four paws deeper into the mud and pushes water outward.

The frightened orc releases the hauling line and stumbles backward, still holding the club.
Show the rope falling slack onto the ground.

6.0–7.0:
The enormous head rises through the flames.
The muzzle broadens, the jaw becomes heavier and the lips lift into a snarl as the fangs lengthen.
Preserve the floppy ears and recognizable Dalmatian markings.
The growl deepens into a powerful roar.
The forehead eye remains bright blue; the lateral eyes remain brown.

7.0–8.0:
The creature reaches its complete reference appearance.
Its head is higher than the standing orc's head, its body several times larger than the original dog.
It steps forward out of the fire with one heavy forepaw, displacing mud and splashing a puddle.
The flames fall away behind it. Last blue tongues trail off its shoulders and vanish as sparks.
Its coat remains intact and unburned.

BLUE FIRE
Realistic volumetric flame movement: white-blue cores, saturated blue outer tongues, irregular flickering, upward convection, blue embers and heat distortion.
Moving blue light illuminates the orc's face, the man's clothing, nearby bark and wet ground.
Blue reflections appear in puddles.
The flame envelope rises and expands with the growing body.
Keep enough gaps in the flames to see the actual anatomical transformation.
No orange fire, no opaque smoke curtain and no whiteout flash.
Do not replace the dog with a monster through a hidden cut.

8.0–10.5 SECONDS — PROTECTIVE ATTACK
The transformed dog makes a short, powerful forward lunge.
Its shoulder and chest knock the orc backward onto the muddy path.
The club leaves the orc's hand during the fall and lands visibly to the side.

The creature plants three paws on the ground and places its remaining forepaw across the orc's upper chest, restraining him without puncturing or crushing him.
It lowers its snarling head close to the orc's face and roars.
The orc freezes, frightened, with his head and tusks clearly visible.
Mud and water splash from the impact.
No biting, blood or graphic injury.

In the background, the horned man lifts the now-loose net off his shoulders, lets it fall and stands up. The mesh clears his horns without snagging.

10.5–11.5 SECONDS — THE COMMAND
The horned man looks directly at the creature and calmly says in English:
“Enough.”

The dog immediately stops roaring, lifts its paw from the orc and steps backward toward its owner.
Create clear separation between dog and orc before the reverse transformation begins.

11.5–13.8 SECONDS — RETURN TO NORMAL

The body lowers naturally as its legs shorten. Its paws reposition to maintain balance.
It returns to the exact normal-sized Dalmatian from Image 2.

entries.title: Cinematic Baby Crying Comedy Scene
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt for a 30-second continuous take featuring a married couple in bed. The husband is tasked with getting the baby, leading to a humorous exchange about who gave birth. It specifies photorealistic style, camera movements, and dialogue.
entries.prompt:
30 seconds, 16:9 widescreen, ultra-photorealistic live-action, 4K cinematic quality, 24 FPS, single continuous take, no cuts, no transitions, no hallucinations.

**SCENE AND CHARACTERS**

A beautiful, modern bedroom at 2:30 AM. A married couple in their early 30s lies side by side in a comfortable king-size bed. The husband is a handsome, naturally attractive man with realistic facial features, wearing a simple cotton T-shirt. His wife is a beautiful young woman with natural skin texture, slightly messy sleeping hair, and comfortable nightwear. Both look like real adults, not models posing for a commercial. The room is dimly illuminated by a warm bedside lamp, with cool moonlight entering through the curtains. A baby sleeps in a separate nursery next door.

**CONTINUOUS ACTION — EXACTLY 30 SECONDS**

**0–5 SECONDS:** Begin with a medium-wide shot of the couple lying in bed. The room is quiet except for the subtle hum of the night. Suddenly, their baby cries audibly from the adjacent room. The husband opens his eyes, turns toward his wife, and says naturally in a sleepy voice:

**HUSBAND:** "Baby's crying. Go get him."

**WIFE:** Without opening her eyes, she replies sleepily, "I'm asleep."

**5–10 SECONDS:** The husband looks at her with a mildly annoyed but humorous expression.

**HUSBAND:** "You're talking! Don't lie."

**WIFE:** Still refusing to move, she mumbles, "I'm not going."

Their facial expressions, pauses, eye movements, and sleepy voices must feel spontaneous and completely natural.

**10–16 SECONDS:** The husband exhales, looks toward the nursery, then turns back to his wife.

**HUSBAND:** "I changed his diaper once today, fed him, and gave you a massage!"

**WIFE:** She opens one eye slightly and replies matter-of-factly, "I gave birth to him."

The husband freezes for a moment, processing her response. His expression changes from frustration to silent defeat. The humor comes entirely from realistic acting and timing, not exaggerated facial expressions.

**16–23 SECONDS:** The husband slowly gets out of bed and walks toward the nursery. The camera smoothly follows him in the SAME continuous take, maintaining natural perspective and realistic motion. He enters the softly illuminated nursery, where the baby lies safely in a crib, crying naturally. He leans toward the crib and gently says:

**HUSBAND:** "Shhh, buddy. Your mom gave birth to you."

He carefully checks on the baby, gently soothes him, and makes sure he is comfortable. The baby gradually becomes quieter. No unsafe handling, no sudden movements, and no artificial-looking baby animation.

**23–27 SECONDS:** Without any cut, the camera smoothly follows the husband as he returns to the bedroom. He quietly slips back into bed beside his wife.

**27–30 SECONDS:** He looks at his wife with an affectionate, defeated smile, gently kisses her cheek, and settles beside her. She gives a tiny sleepy smile without opening her eyes. He closes his eyes, and both settle down to sleep. The baby's crying has subsided in the background. End on a peaceful, intimate two-shot of the couple lying together.

**CINEMATOGRAPHY AND REALISM**

* One uninterrupted, physically plausible camera take from beginning to end.
* Smooth, controlled camera tracking through the bedroom doorway into the nursery and back, with no teleportation or impossible camera movements.
* Natural skin pores, authentic facial micro-expressions, realistic hair strands, subtle fabric wrinkles, and anatomically correct hands.
* Warm practical bedside lighting combined with soft, cool moonlight.
* Physically accurate shadows, realistic depth of field, natural exposure, and consistent white balance.
* Realistic low-light cinematography with detailed shadow retention; no artificial HDR appearance.
* Accurate lip synchronization for every spoken line, with each character speaking only their own dialogue.
* Natural conversational pacing with short pauses and believable sleepy voices.
* The baby remains in the adjacent nursery until the husband enters; the wife stays in bed throughout.
* Preserve the exact same faces, clothing, body proportions, bedroom layout, and nursery geography throughout the sequence.
* Keep the comedy subtle, affectionate, relatable, and grounded in everyday married life.

**AUDIO DESIGN**

Crystal-clear dialogue, natural room tone, soft nighttime ambience, and realistic baby cries originating from the adjacent nursery. Dialogue must remain intelligible and correctly synchronized with mouth movements. No background music, laugh track, voice-over, subtitles, or additional dialogue.

**STRICT NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS**

NO cuts, NO jump cuts, NO montage, NO transitions, NO time skips, NO scene resets, NO duplicate characters, NO extra people, NO changing faces, NO morphing, NO distorted anatomy, NO extra fingers, NO floating objects, NO disappearing props, NO wardrobe changes, NO incorrect spatial continuity, NO unnatural camera movement, NO exaggerated acting, NO cartoon effects, NO artificial skin, NO hallucinated dialogue, NO random sounds, NO subtitles, and NO watermarks.

**FINAL RESULT:** A believable, beautifully photographed 30-second domestic comedy that looks like a real moment captured by a professional cinematographer in a real home, with perfect continuity, natural performances, and emotionally authentic humor.

entries.title: Shadow Assassin Frozen Lake
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 30-second cinematic Korean historical fantasy drama featuring an assassin named Natalia fighting royal mages on a frozen lake.
entries.prompt:
Title: NATALIA — THE SHADOW ASSASSIN

FORMAT: 16:9 landscape, 1920×1080, 30 seconds, ultra-realistic cinematic Korean historical fantasy drama.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: Use the provided Natalia character reference as the exact visual identity. Preserve her facial features, face shape, natural hair color, skin tone, and overall appearance. Keep her approved hairstyle, makeup, dark Joseon-inspired assassin outfit, sword, and accessories exactly consistent throughout every shot. Do not redesign her.

SETTING: A vast frozen lake surrounded by snow-covered mountains and dark pine forests. Thick winter mist drifts across the ice. A group of powerful royal mages in traditional dark Korean robes surrounds Natalia. Their robes move in the freezing wind. The atmosphere is tense, mysterious, and dangerous, with subtle blue magical energy glowing around their hands.

SHOT 1 — THE SURROUNDED ASSASSIN (0–5 seconds)

Wide cinematic establishing shot. Natalia stands alone in the center of the frozen lake, her back partially turned toward the camera. Six royal mages slowly form a circle around her, their robes flowing in the wind. One mage steps forward, raising his hand as blue magical energy gathers around his fingers.

Male Mage, in Korean:
"네가 바로 나탈리아인가? 그림자 암살자?"

Meaning: “So, you're Natalia? The Shadow Assassin?”

SHOT 2 — THE NAME (5–10 seconds)

Slow cinematic push-in toward Natalia's face. She slowly turns her head toward the mage. Her expression remains completely calm, almost amused. A few strands of hair move across her face in the icy wind. She looks directly at him with a cold, confident gaze.

Natalia, in Korean, with a quiet, mocking smile:
"내가 가는 곳마다 목이 땅에 떨어지지. 아름다운 이름이지 않나? 나탈리아."

Meaning: “Wherever I go, heads fall to the ground. A beautiful name, isn't it? Natalia.”

She subtly places one hand on the handle of her sword.

SHOT 3 — THE FIRST ATTACK (10–15 seconds)

Without warning, one mage launches a powerful blue magical strike toward her. Natalia instantly draws her sword. In a rapid, elegant movement, she cuts through the incoming energy and slides across the frozen surface. The magical blast explodes behind her, sending ice fragments and snow into the air.

Use a dynamic tracking camera that follows her movement. Keep the action clear and physically believable.

SHOT 4 — THE FIGHT (15–23 seconds)

A fast, beautifully choreographed sword fight begins. Two mages attack from opposite directions. Natalia ducks beneath the first strike, spins gracefully, blocks the second with her sword, and disarms one opponent with a precise movement. She pivots and strikes the ice, sending a sharp wave of blue energy across the frozen surface.

Use a combination of fast tracking shots, dramatic close-ups, and brief slow-motion moments at the most impactful movements. Her fighting style should feel graceful, precise, effortless, and deadly — never clumsy or exaggerated.

SHOT 5 — THE FINAL MOMENT (23–30 seconds)

The remaining mages gather their energy for one powerful combined attack. Natalia stands still for a brief moment, sword lowered beside her. Blue magical energy begins glowing faintly along the blade.

As the mages launch their attack, she suddenly rushes forward with extraordinary speed. A sweeping sword movement cuts through the magical energy, creating a powerful burst of blue light, flying ice, and swirling snow.

Final shot: Natalia stands in the middle of the frozen lake, her sword held calmly at her side. The defeated mages lie scattered in the distance. She slowly looks toward the camera's direction without directly staring into the lens. Cut to black.

VISUAL AND CINEMATIC DIRECTION

High-budget Korean historical fantasy K-drama aesthetic.

Photorealistic faces, natural skin texture, realistic fabric and hair movement.

Beautifully choreographed sword combat with clear movements and believable physical contact.

Deep winter atmosphere, frozen lake reflections, drifting mist, snow particles, and subtle blue magic.

Dramatic cinematic lighting with cool blue-grey tones and controlled contrast.

Fluid camera movement, elegant slow motion, dynamic tracking shots, and impactful close-ups.

Natural Korean dialogue with accurate lip synchronization.

Preserve Natalia's exact character identity and costume in every shot.

No modern objects, guns, modern clothing, random costume changes, extra characters, or unnecessary transitions.

No exaggerated anime-style effects or cartoon visuals.

IMPORTANT: The scene should feel like an expensive Korean fantasy drama opening sequence. Natalia must appear calm and terrifyingly skilled, as though fighting several powerful mages is barely an inconvenience to her.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Joseon Witch Action Sequence
entries.description: A detailed prompt for creating a cinematic Korean historical fantasy action sequence featuring a witch fighting armed men in a traditional night bazaar, emphasizing realistic movement and supernatural effects.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic Korean historical fantasy action sequence set in the Joseon Dynasty. The location is an atmospheric traditional Korean night bazaar, filled with wooden hanok storefronts, fabric-covered market stalls, hanging paper lanterns, wooden signboards, and wet stone pathways.

The main character is a mysterious young Korean witch wearing an elegant flowing black Joseon-era hanbok with subtle silver embroidery, long black hair, and delicate traditional accessories. Her appearance, facial features, hairstyle, and clothing must remain perfectly consistent throughout the entire video.

Her personality is calm, mysterious, confident, and intimidating. Her fighting style combines graceful Korean martial arts with supernatural witchcraft.

Use cinematic live-action realism, detailed fabric physics, realistic human movement, natural facial expressions, dramatic lantern lighting, atmospheric smoke, and sophisticated action cinematography. The fight must feel physically grounded, with clear choreography and believable impacts.

SHOT 1 — THE STRANGER (0–6 SECONDS)

A wide cinematic establishing shot of a busy Joseon-era night bazaar. Merchants are closing their wooden shops while customers walk between traditional market stalls. Warm paper lanterns illuminate the narrow streets.

The camera smoothly tracks backward as the mysterious witch walks toward it through the crowded market. Her long black hair and flowing sleeves move naturally with her steps. People instinctively move aside as she passes.

Suddenly, five armed men wearing dark traditional Joseon clothing step into her path. Their leader approaches her aggressively.

SHOT 2 — THE CONFRONTATION (6–11 SECONDS)

Medium cinematic shot. The leader grabs the witch's wrist and orders her to kneel. She slowly turns her head toward him, completely unafraid.

She calmly says in natural Korean-accented English:

"You should have let me pass."

The man angrily draws his traditional Korean sword and swings toward her. Without changing her facial expression, she catches his attacking wrist with one hand, stopping the sword inches from her body.

Use a dramatic close-up followed by a quick camera movement revealing the other four men drawing their weapons.

SHOT 3 — THE WITCH AWAKENS (11–20 SECONDS)

Her eyes briefly illuminate with a deep crimson glow. A subtle wave of dark supernatural energy moves through the air.

She releases the man's wrist, pivots gracefully, and sends him crashing into a wooden market stall.

Two other attackers rush toward her from opposite directions. She ducks beneath the first sword, spins, and delivers a powerful kick to the second attacker.

She extends her hand toward another attacker. A burst of invisible telekinetic force lifts him off his feet and throws him backward into stacked wooden crates.

Use dynamic tracking shots, controlled handheld camera movement, and brief slow motion only at the most impactful moments. Every attack must be clearly visible and physically believable.

SHOT 4 — THE FINISHING MOVE (20–26 SECONDS)

The two remaining men charge toward her simultaneously with their swords raised.

The witch stops walking and slowly raises one hand.

Both swords are violently pulled from their hands and suspended in the air through supernatural telekinesis.

She closes her fingers into a fist. The weapons fly away and embed themselves into nearby wooden pillars.

With one final controlled gesture, a powerful invisible shockwave throws both men backward onto the wet stone street.

Lanterns swing violently, market fabrics flutter, and dust rises through the warm light.

SHOT 5 — THE MYSTERY (26–30 SECONDS)

The market becomes silent.

The witch stands completely composed among the fallen attackers. She gently adjusts her sleeve, turns around, and continues walking down the lantern-lit street.

A terrified elderly merchant watches her disappear into the darkness and quietly whispers:

"What... are you?"

End with a cinematic rear tracking shot of the witch disappearing into the misty night bazaar.

STRICT GENERATION REQUIREMENTS

Maintain consistent witch identity, face, hairstyle, and black hanbok throughout.

Authentic Joseon Dynasty Korean architecture, clothing, weapons, and marketplace.

Realistic Korean historical drama aesthetic, not anime or video game graphics.

Fast, fluid, visually readable martial arts choreography.

Natural body mechanics, realistic collisions, and convincing physical impacts.

Magic should look sophisticated, dark, and cinematic rather than exaggerated.

No modern objects, buildings, accessories, or weapons.

No random extra characters joining the fight.

No unnecessary cuts, teleportation, or sudden character transformations.

No characters looking directly into the camera.

No subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, or text overlays.

Maintain cinematic lighting and a consistent color grade throughout.

FINAL RESULT: A visually stunning 30-second Korean historical dark-fantasy action sequence that feels like a high-budget scene from a Joseon-era supernatural K-drama.

entries.title: Baby Dragon Pip Mirror Rivalry
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a photorealistic fantasy comedy short featuring a baby dragon named Pip encountering his reflection in a mirror, with strict continuity rules.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic live-action fantasy comedy short, vertical 9:16, 30 seconds, 30fps, no dialogue. Looks like a real high-budget fantasy film: real actress, real practical set, photorealistic CGI creature fully integrated into the plate. Natural skin texture, real fabric, real scale texture catching the light. Warm soft morning sunlight through a cottage window, cozy filmic color grade, subtle grain, shallow depth of field, natural motion blur. No cartoon, no Pixar, no 3D-render look.

WATERMARK: A small, subtle "@aivoxy" text watermark in the TOP-RIGHT corner of the frame, 50% opacity, clean white sans-serif font, small (about 4% of frame width), visible for the full 30 seconds, never moving, never covering the characters.

MIRROR LOCK (MANDATORY):
- One tall, free-standing oval mirror in a carved wooden frame, standing on the floor in the CENTER of the room, always in the same place.
- The reflection is ALWAYS a perfect, exact mirror image of what stands in front of it: the same dragon, same size, same colors, same markings, moving at exactly the same moment, flipped left-to-right like a real mirror. The reflection never moves on its own, never lags, and never shows anything different.
- When Pip walks behind the mirror, the back of the mirror is plain dark wood, and nothing is behind it.

MOTION QUALITY: Smooth, fluid, realistic motion with real weight and follow-through. No jitter, no morphing, no flickering, no paws or fingers passing through the mirror or faces. Fast, snappy comedic timing: every beat lands quickly, no long pauses, something moves in every single second. Mostly low floor-level close-ups, with one wide shot per stage.

CONTINUITY: Fixed cottage bedroom layout: the mirror in the CENTER, a wooden bed on the LEFT, a window with sunlight on the RIGHT, a woven rug on the floor in front of the mirror. Pip always has exactly four legs, two wings and one tail, and stays the same small size. No teleporting: every movement is shown on screen. Continuous action, no time jumps. Never add another character. No text, no captions, no dialogue (except the watermark).

CHARACTERS, exactly two:
ONE pet dragon "Pip", a SMALL baby dragon the size of a medium dog (shoulder height about 45 cm). A big round head, huge wet amber eyes with vertical pupils, a short chubby body, stubby legs with oversized paws, a short rounded snout. White-cream textured scales with pink-magenta markings, a crest of soft pink flexible spikes, small wings slightly too big for his body. Curious, brave, dramatic, easily jealous.
ONE real young woman in her mid-20s with messy wavy blonde hair, thin round wire glasses, freckles, a cream linen blouse with rolled sleeves and a dark brown pinafore apron dress. Amused, warm, laughing.

Stage 1 (0–4s), HOOK: Low close-up. Pip trots across the rug, then freezes mid-step, nose to nose with his own reflection in the mirror. His eyes go huge. The reflection's eyes go huge at the same moment. Neither moves. One spike on his head slowly rises, and the reflection's spike rises too.

Stage 2 (4–10s): Pip lowers his head and lets out a tiny growl. The reflection growls back. He puffs up his chest. It puffs up too. He snaps his wings wide open to look big, and the reflection spreads its wings at the same moment. He lets out a squeaky little roar with a tiny puff of smoke, and the reflection does exactly the same. Pip jumps back, shocked.

Stage 3 (10–16s): Wide shot. Pip narrows his eyes, suspicious. He slowly tiptoes sideways around the edge of the mirror frame to sneak up on the "other dragon" from behind, then pounces around the back. He finds only the plain wooden back of the mirror. Confused, he looks left, looks right, sniffs the wood, then runs back around to the front, and the "other dragon" is right there again, staring at him. Pip's jaw drops.

Stage 4 (16–23s): The woman walks in from the left, sees what's happening, and laughs. She kneels, scoops Pip up in her arms and hugs him in front of the mirror, kissing the top of his head. Close-up on Pip: he sees the reflection of HER hugging and kissing the "other dragon". His face drops. His eyes narrow with jealousy and a tiny jealous wisp of smoke curls from his nostrils. He pushes his snout toward the mirror and glares at the reflection.

Stage 5 (23–30s): Pip wriggles in her arms, then turns his head and quickly gives her cheek a big lick to claim her, while glaring sideways at the mirror. The reflection does exactly the same. Pip gives up, sighs, and slowly leans forward and gives the mirror a gentle little kiss. He leaves a small smoky snout-print smudge on the glass. The woman bursts out laughing. Final close-up: Pip looks at the smudge, then gives the camera a slow, confused side-eye. Hold. Music button.

STYLE: Photorealistic live-action fantasy comedy, warm morning sunlight and soft reflections on the mirror glass, crisp comedic timing, a believable creature with real weight. No morphing, no extra limbs, no warped hands or paws, stable glasses and face, the reflection always perfectly matching.

AUDIO: Playful pizzicato strings and light comedic woodwinds. Soft padding paws, a curious sniff, a tiny growl, a wing "whoosh", a squeaky roar with a little puff of smoke, a surprised yelp, sneaky tiptoe music, a wood "tap" when he sniffs the back of the mirror, her warm laughter, a big wet lick, a sad little sigh, a soft "smooch" on the glass, and her big laugh at the end.

entries.title: Birthday Surprise Betrayal Drama
entries.description: A cinematic K-drama style video prompt depicting a birthday surprise gone wrong, focusing on emotional reactions, lip-sync accuracy, and realistic apartment setting.
entries.prompt:
STORY: Han Ji-eun (26), wearing a beige wool coat, cream sweater and black skirt, arrives at her boyfriend's Seoul apartment at night, carrying a white birthday cake with lit candles. She expects a romantic surprise. Instead, an unfamiliar woman, Choi Yuna (24), wearing an oversized charcoal-grey men's hoodie and lounge shorts, opens the door.

12-SHOT SEQUENCE:

1. (0–2s) Tracking shot: Ji-eun approaches the apartment, smiling with her birthday cake.
2. (2–4s) She rings the doorbell, fixes her hair and whispers, “생일 축하해 줄게.”
3. (4–6s) Door opens; an unfamiliar woman appears. Ji-eun's smile fades. “누구세요?”
4. (6–8s) Ji-eun asks, “저… 민재 씨 집 맞죠?” The woman casually replies, “네. 그런데요?”
5. (8–11s) The woman claims, “저 민재 오빠 동생인데요.” Ji-eun looks confused.
6. (11–14s) Low-angle reveal: men's shoes beside unfamiliar women's heels. Ji-eun notices.
7. (14–17s) Camera reveals two wine glasses, an open wine bottle and a woman's handbag inside.
8. (17–20s) Ji-eun quietly says, “저… 여자친구인데요.” The woman's smile disappears.
9. (20–22s) Close-up: Ji-eun's trembling hands struggle to steady the tilting cake.
10. (22–25s) A male voice from inside: “누구 왔어?” The woman replies, “오빠, 손님 왔어.” Ji-eun freezes.
11. (25–28s) Min-jae (28), black T-shirt and dark lounge trousers, walks into view, sees Ji-eun and freezes. “지은아…?”
12. (28–30s) Ji-eun looks down at the cake, forces a tiny painful smile and whispers, “생일 축하해…” Cut immediately to black.

CHARACTER LOCK: Ji-eun: Korean, 26, soft oval face, natural skin, expressive dark eyes, long wavy dark-brown hair, beige coat, cream sweater, black skirt, handbag. Yuna: Korean, 24, slightly messy dark hair, bare face, oversized charcoal hoodie, lounge shorts. Min-jae: Korean, 28, neatly styled short black hair, black T-shirt, dark lounge trousers. Maintain identical faces, clothing and proportions throughout.

VISUAL DIRECTION: Premium cinematic K-drama realism, natural Korean performances and accurate Korean lip-sync, expressive micro-reactions, realistic skin and fabric, shallow depth of field, slow tracking and suspenseful push-ins. Warm apartment lighting contrasts with cool corridor lighting. Consistent apartment layout and prop positions. Cake stays in Ji-eun's hands throughout. Min-jae appears only in Shot 11.

AUDIO: Natural Korean dialogue, accurate lip-sync, footsteps, elevator ambience, doorbell, handle movement, faint TV and subtle suspense score that builds toward the reveal, then nearly disappears.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Excitement → confusion → suspicion → humiliation → heartbreak. No confrontation, explanation or resolution. End immediately after “생일 축하해…” with a hard cut to black.

entries.title: Korean Sunday Routine Vlog
entries.description: A prompt for a 30-second ultra-realistic DV-style home video of a young Korean woman's peaceful Sunday afternoon routine, including greeting neighbors and buying street corn.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic early-2000s DV home video of a stylish young Korean woman enjoying a peaceful Sunday afternoon in an older Seoul neighborhood.

Main Character: A young Korean woman in her early 20s, naturally beautiful, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, long black wavy hair tied in a messy side ponytail, fitted pastel-blue cropped top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers and a simple silver necklace. Maintain perfect identity, facial features, hairstyle, outfit and body proportions throughout the entire video.

SCENE 1 – Greeting the Neighbours (0–6 seconds)

The video opens with the woman walking casually down a narrow residential street, carrying a small reusable shopping bag. She spots three young women neighbours standing outside a local convenience store, chatting together. She approaches them with a cheerful smile, waves and says, "Hey girls! Happy Sunday!"

One neighbour smiles and replies, "Hey! Where are you going?"

She laughs and responds, "Just taking a little walk!"

They exchange friendly smiles and casual waves before she continues walking.

SCENE 2 – The Kite Moment (6–13 seconds)

As she walks past a small neighborhood playground, she notices a little Korean girl struggling to retrieve a colourful kite caught in a low tree branch. The woman stops, looks up, smiles and gently reaches for the kite.

She carefully frees it from the branch, brings it down and hands it directly to the little girl. The girl happily takes the kite with both hands and says, "Thank you, unnie!"

The woman smiles and replies, "You're welcome! Be careful!"

The girl runs back toward her friends, holding the kite.

SCENE 3 – Street Corn Stop (13–21 seconds)

She continues walking and notices a small traditional Korean street-food cart selling freshly steamed corn. She approaches the elderly vendor, who smiles and greets her.

She points toward the corn and says, "One, please!"

The vendor picks up a freshly steamed yellow corn cob using metal tongs and hands it to her in a small paper sleeve. She pays the vendor, says, "Thank you!" and takes a bite.

Show a natural close-up of her enjoying the warm corn, smiling slightly as she chews. A little steam rises from the freshly cooked corn.

SCENE 4 – Walking Home (21–30 seconds)

She continues strolling through the quiet residential street, casually eating her corn while holding her shopping bag in the other hand.

The afternoon sunlight falls across old apartment buildings, parked bicycles and small neighborhood shops. A gentle breeze moves her hair.

She turns toward the camera while taking another bite and says playfully:

"Honestly, Sundays like this are the best!"

She smiles, turns around and walks toward her home. Just before entering the gate, she glances back at the camera and gives a little wave.

The footage ends with her disappearing inside as the camera operator slightly zooms in accidentally. Cut to black.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic superhero battle sequence in vertical 9:16 format, 4K quality, 24fps, featuring two young students with extraordinary supernatural powers in a modern Korean city.

Scene 1 – The Mysterious Escape (0–5 seconds)
A young man wearing a black suit and a beautiful blonde schoolgirl wearing a navy school uniform with a white shirt and red bow run together along a wet elevated highway beneath massive concrete overpasses. The sky is dark and stormy. Suddenly, red glowing energy particles appear around them, and the ground begins to vibrate.

Scene 2 – Gravity Manipulation (5–10 seconds)
As they continue running, several abandoned cars suddenly rise into the air. Massive pieces of concrete, glass, and debris float around them. The young man turns around in shock while the girl calmly raises her hand. The entire environment appears to be controlled by supernatural forces.

Scene 3 – The Girl Awakens (10–15 seconds)
The blonde girl suddenly leaps into the air, surrounded by powerful glowing purple energy rings. She spins gracefully in midair as supernatural energy swirls around her body. Concrete pillars crack, and debris floats around her.

Scene 4 – The Energy Clash (15–21 seconds)
The two students face each other and extend their hands. Two powerful red-orange energy spheres form between their palms. Lightning-like energy streams collide, creating a spectacular explosion of glowing particles, shockwaves, and floating debris.

Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic fashion video using the uploaded image as the exact reference for the woman's face, hairstyle, outfit, and overall appearance.

A confident young woman with a short dark bob haircut walks slowly through a crowded city street. She wears a stylish black leather jacket, fitted black top, black trousers, and black boots. Her expression is serious, fearless, and mysterious.

As she walks forward, the wind suddenly starts blowing harder. Her hair and jacket move naturally with the wind. The surrounding crowd begins noticing her, but she keeps walking without looking at anyone.

She stops in the middle of the street and looks directly into the camera with an intense, powerful gaze.

Suddenly, a massive cinematic gust of wind sweeps through the entire street. Papers fly into the air, people's clothes and hair move dramatically, and dust swirls around her.

The woman remains completely calm and still as the storm intensifies around her.

The camera slowly pushes toward her face. She slightly raises her chin, giving a fearless, powerful expression.

Dark storm clouds gather overhead, dramatic lightning flashes in the distance, and the atmosphere becomes intense and cinematic.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic live-action fashion film, dramatic storm atmosphere, powerful female energy, natural wind physics, realistic facial details, cinematic camera movement, high contrast, moody lighting, 4K quality.

Avoid: Cartoon effects, CGI appearance, face distortion, changing identity, duplicated people, unnatural body movements, excessive lightning, text, subtitles, and watermarks.

Mood: She doesn't run from the storm. She IS the storm.

entries.title: Skeleton Halloween Party Phone Video
entries.description: A chaotic, photorealistic vertical phone video prompt featuring skeletons partying in a lounge, utilizing harsh flash lighting and erratic camera movements typical of amateur footage.
entries.prompt:
Variation 1 💥 

20-second vertical 9:16 photoreal phone video, handheld smartphone with harsh direct on-camera flash at 3am in the same dark crimson red-velvet lounge. Black curtains, orange Halloween string lights, glowing carved pumpkins on wooden crates, a black speaker thumping, a green EXIT sign in the back, sagging fake cobwebs. Raw party footage, punchy flash, deep black shadows, slight motion blur, phone grain. Hard cuts roughly every 1.5 seconds, wild party camera: beat-bounce, whip pans, crash zooms, Dutch tilts, 360 spins, one overhead, one floor-level shot.

Cast: the same small skeleton crew, never more than five in frame. They're real-looking, slightly yellowed bone skeletons: Sunglasses (crooked shades, backwards cap), Hawaiian (open floral shirt), Bow-tie (bow tie only), Witch-hat (slipping witch hat, one sneaker) and Chain (gold chain sliding through its ribs). Clothes are worn badly, and every face is a deadpan hanging jaw with empty eye sockets. Tiny cigarettes sit in their teeth, with smoke leaking from their eye sockets and nose holes. They hold red plastic cups and shot glasses, and every cup stays a separate object.

0–1.5s: Crash zoom on Hawaiian, who plays its own ribcage like a xylophone with two drumsticks to the beat, cigarette bouncing in its teeth.
1.5–3s: Whip pan to Sunglasses, who blows smoke and the whole puff comes out of its ear holes instead. It pauses, confused, then keeps dancing.
3–4.5s: Low angle as Chain does the limbo under a broomstick, its spine bending way too far and folding flat like a toy. It pops back up and sips.
4.5–6s: Dutch tilt as Witch-hat fills a cup and pours it into its skull through the eye socket; the drink pours straight out of its jaw into Bow-tie's cup below. Bow-tie drinks it.
6–7.5s: Beat-bounce wide on a bone tug-of-war: two skeletons pull one skeleton's arm until it detaches, and both fall back onto the sofa.
7.5–9s: Close-up as the detached arm gives a lazy thumbs-up from the floor.
9–10.5s: Overhead shot of three skeletons doing a conga line. The middle one's pelvis falls off and keeps walking in the line by itself.
10.5–12s: Floor-level shot of a skull rolling across the floor like a bowling ball, still wearing the sunglasses, knocking over five empty cups like pins. A headless body raises both arms in celebration.
12–13.5s: Whip pan as the headless Sunglasses body gropes around and screws a carved pumpkin on as its head. It keeps dancing proudly while the pumpkin glows.
13.5–15s: 360 spin around Bow-tie, who does a breakdance head-spin that unscrews its skull. The body keeps spinning without it.
15–16.5s: Crash zoom on two skeletons, who toast with shot glasses so hard their hand bones swap and stick. They keep drinking with each other's hands.
16.5–18s: Beat-bounce as the whole crew of five does the Macarena perfectly in sync, except Witch-hat, whose hip bone pops off on the hip-shake.
18–20s: Final punch-in on pumpkin-head Sunglasses leaning into the lens. Smoke pours out of the carved pumpkin's eyes and mouth, and the real skull is tucked under its arm, chewing a cigarette. Deadpan stare, then a hard cut to black.

Style: real phone party footage, direct flash, red velvet, orange Halloween lights. No cinematic grade, no teal, no lasers, no plywood, no cartoon or claymation look, no gore, no flesh, no blood, no morphing, no extra limbs, no text, no subtitles, no watermark.

Variation 2 💥

20-second vertical 9:16 photoreal phone video, shot handheld on a smartphone with harsh direct on-camera flash at 3am inside a dark crimson red-velvet lounge. Black curtains, cheap orange Halloween string lights, a few glowing carved pumpkins on wooden crates, a black speaker thumping, a green EXIT sign glowing in the back, fake cobwebs sagging off the ceiling. Raw party footage, punchy flash, deep black shadows, slight motion blur, real phone grain. Hard cuts roughly every 1.5 seconds, energetic party camera: beat-bounce, whip pans, punch-ins, Dutch tilts, quick spins, one overhead shot.

Cast: small group of real-looking, slightly yellowed bone skeletons (never more than five in frame), each one distinct: one in crooked sunglasses and a backwards cap, one in a loose Hawaiian shirt hanging open over its ribcage, one with a bow tie and nothing else, one in a slipping witch hat and one mismatched sneaker, one wearing a gold chain that keeps sliding through its ribs. Clothes worn badly, too big, falling off. Skeletons dance upright like clumsy drunk humans, jaws hanging deadpan, empty eye sockets, zero expression. Tiny cigarettes clamped in their teeth with smoke curling out of their eye sockets and nose holes; red plastic cups and shot glasses in bony hands (cups always separate objects, never fused to hands).

0–1.5s: Flash-lit punch-in on Sunglasses skeleton bobbing its skull to the beat, cigarette in teeth, smoke drifting out of its eye sockets. Camera bounces on the beat.
1.5–3s: Whip pan to three skeletons doing a sloppy shoulder shimmy, bones rattling, Hawaiian shirt flapping open.
3–4.5s: Low angle: Bow-tie skeleton chugs a red cup, the drink pours straight through its jaw and ribcage and splashes on the floor. It keeps chugging, deadpan.
4.5–6s: Dutch tilt: Witch-hat skeleton spins, its hat flies off and lands on another skeleton's skull; nobody reacts.
6–7.5s: Close-up: gold chain slides down through the ribcage and clinks onto the pelvis; the skeleton keeps dancing.
7.5–9s: Overhead shot: four skeletons in a tiny circle doing the worm-arm wave, cigarette smoke rising into the flash.
9–10.5s: Whip pan: a skeleton dances too hard, its jaw pops off, it catches it mid-air and snaps it back on without stopping.
10.5–12s: Camera spins 360 around two skeletons slow-dancing, skull to skull, a cigarette passed from teeth to teeth.
12–13.5s: Punch-in: Sunglasses skeleton takes a shot, the liquid drips out through its neck vertebrae; it slaps the glass down on a crate.
13.5–15s: Beat-bounce wide: all five skeletons doing a clumsy line-dance step, one a half-beat late, one sneaker falling off.
15–16.5s: Close-up: a skeleton's hand pops off at the wrist while waving; the hand keeps waving on the floor alone.
16.5–18s: Low Dutch angle: Bow-tie skeleton collapses into a pile of bones on the sofa, cup still upright in its hand, cigarette still smoking.
18–20s: Final punch-in: Sunglasses skeleton leans into the phone lens, sunglasses slide down its nasal hole, slow puff of smoke out of both eye sockets, deadpan stare. Hard cut to black.

Style: real phone party footage, direct flash, red velvet, orange Halloween lights. No cinematic grade, no teal, no lasers, no plywood, no cartoon or claymation look, no gore, no flesh, no blood, no morphing, no extra limbs, no text, no subtitles, no watermark.

entries.title: Autumn Persimmon Floating Scene
entries.description: A detailed Japanese prompt for Seedance 2.5 describing an autumn scene where persimmons float in the air near an old house, involving characters Sakura and a teacher.
entries.prompt:
秋の晴れた昼、山あいの古い家の庭。柿の実が何百個も空に浮いている。さくらがぽかんと見上げる。先生がさくらの手を見るが、さくらは首を横に振る。縁側でお茶を飲むおばあさんが指を動かすと、柿はかごへ落ちていく。「呼ばれたけん、来たぞ」「遠慮せんと、取っていき」。柿が1個、さくらの前で止まる。「あの岩、重かったろう」。さくらが固まり、先生が咳払いをする。「ごまかすの、下手やねえ」。

おばあさんがお茶を置く。「半分は、わたしよ」。カートを握る指が動き、岩が道から離れる。さくらは力んで柿を飛ばし、先生の頭に落とす。「こら」。肩の力を抜き直すと、柿が1個、静かにかごへ入る。軒下一面に柿のすだれを掛けて、三人で笑う。先生が仏間で手を合わせる。おばあさんが写真を見て首をかしげる。「この人、だれやったかねえ」。先生が目をそらす。「使うたび、ひとつ消えるんよ」「今日は、この人やったねえ」。さくらが自分の手のひらを見る。

一緒に来た友達が手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、BGMなし。画面に出るのは三人だけ。かごは3個、動く柿は1個。光やオーラは足さず、物が動くだけにした。庭・柿の空・すだれ・仏間・写真は参照画像、続きは前のパートの実際のコマを参照にした。
entries.translated_prompt:
A clear autumn day, the garden of an old house in the mountains. Hundreds of persimmons are floating in the sky. Sakura looks up in surprise. The teacher looks at Sakura's hand, but she shakes her head. As the grandmother drinking tea on the veranda moves her fingers, the persimmons fall into the basket. "They came because they were called," "Don't hesitate, take them." One persimmon stops in front of Sakura. "That rock was heavy, wasn't it?" Sakura stiffens, and the teacher coughs. "You're bad at making excuses."

The grandmother places the tea down. "Half is mine." The fingers gripping the cart move, and the rock leaves the path. Sakura strains to blow a persimmon, dropping it on the teacher's head. "Hey." After relaxing her shoulders again, one persimmon quietly enters the basket. They hang a curtain of persimmons under the eaves, and the three laugh together. The teacher puts his hands together in the Buddhist altar room. The grandmother tilts her head looking at a photo. "Who was this person?" The teacher looks away. "Every time you use it, one disappears." "Today, it was this person." Sakura looks at her own palm.

Recorded handheld by a friend who came along. About 2 seconds per cut, no BGM. Only three people appear on screen. Three baskets, one moving persimmon. No light or aura added, just objects moving. The garden, sky full of persimmons, curtain, Buddhist altar room, and photos are reference images; the continuation refers to actual frames from the previous part.

entries.title: Family Comedy Cafe Earring Reveal
entries.description: A prompt for a stylized 3D animated family comedy video where a baby catches her dad staring at another woman, leading to an earring reveal.
entries.prompt:
16s / 5 shots / vertical 9:16 / stylized 3D animated family comedy, soft doll-like character style

STYLE: This is a stylized 3D animated short in a soft, glossy, doll-like family animation look, like a premium animated feature. Soft rounded shapes, rich warm golden-hour light, gentle bloom on highlights, shallow depth of field with creamy round bokeh, clean silky fabric shading, polished marble and glass. Every character moves with clear, readable animated acting: strong anticipation, clean poses, natural follow-through in hair and fabric, timing at real speed with small comedic holds. No live-action, no photoreal humans, no text anywhere.

STORY: A young family sits at a sunny cafe terrace. The dad keeps staring at an elegant woman at the next table, and his baby daughter on mom's lap catches him red-handed, tugs mom's chin and points straight at him like a tiny detective. Mom turns, furious, the dad panics, then slowly pulls out a small velvet box: he was only staring at the woman's earrings, because he bought mom the exact same pair. Mom melts, and the baby grabs one earring and holds an earring to her own ear, smug, as if the case is closed and she won.

SHOT LIST:
Shot 1 (0-3s): Medium shot of the family table. The dad's eyes slide sideways off his coffee and lock on something off screen right. The baby on mom's lap stops chewing her biscuit and narrows her eyes at him.
Shot 2 (3-6s): Over the dad's shoulder. At the next table, an elegant woman tucks her hair behind her ear and her long sparkling earring catches the sun. The dad leans a little closer, mouth slightly open.
Shot 3 (6-9s): Close two shot of mom and baby. The baby grabs mom's chin with her tiny hand, turns mom's face toward the dad and points at him with her whole arm. Mom's smile drops and her eyes narrow.
Shot 4 (9-13s): Close on the dad. He feels the stare, freezes, slowly turns, sweats, swallows, then reaches into his jacket and slowly sets a small dark red velvet box on the table and opens it. Inside: the same long sparkling earrings.
Shot 5 (13-16s): Mom gasps, hands to her cheeks, eyes shining. Before she can take the box, the baby snatches one earring and holds it up to her own ear, chin raised, totally pleased with herself. Dad drops his forehead to the table in defeat.

SUBJECT:
The dad is a man in his early 30s in the stylized doll-like 3D look: tall and slim, broad shoulders, a strong square jaw, thick straight dark brows, big warm brown eyes with long lashes, a short neat dark stubble along the jaw, smooth fair olive skin with a soft blush. Thick dark brown hair, short on the sides, longer on top, swept back with one loose strand falling over his forehead that bounces when he moves. He wears a fitted cream knit polo with three buttons, the top one open, under an unstructured light camel blazer with soft shoulders and one inside pocket on the LEFT side of his chest, slim dark navy trousers and brown suede loafers. A thin silver watch on his LEFT wrist, a plain gold wedding ring on his LEFT ring finger.
The mom is a woman in her late 20s in the same doll-like look: slim, elegant, a heart-shaped face, big green almond eyes with thick lashes and soft brown liner, arched brows, porcelain skin with a soft peach blush. Long glossy dark chocolate brown hair pulled up in a big soft messy bun on top of her head with a few loose wavy strands framing her face. She wears a soft blush pink silk blouse with long loose sleeves and a rounded high neckline, tucked into high-waisted cream wide trousers. Small gold stud earrings, a thin gold wedding ring on her LEFT ring finger.
The baby is a chubby baby girl around one year old, round face, huge sparkling hazel eyes, tiny button nose. Soft light brown hair gathered into one small sprout ponytail on top of her head. She wears a pastel pink cotton romper. She sits on mom's lap, facing forward, held by mom's LEFT arm around her belly. In her RIGHT hand at the start she holds a round plain butter biscuit with one bite missing.
The elegant woman is a woman in her late 20s seen mostly from the side and back: sleek straight jet black hair to her shoulders, a pale grey sleeveless high-neck knit top, and a pair of long sparkling drop earrings: a small gold stud with a thin chain and a teardrop of pale pink crystal at the end.
The same dad, the same mom, the same baby and the same woman in every shot, nothing about them changes.

WORLD: A sunny cafe terrace on a quiet European style street at golden hour. Foreground: a small round white marble table, on it a white porcelain coffee cup and saucer in front of the dad on the RIGHT side of the table, a tall glass of iced pink lemonade in front of the mom on the LEFT, a small white plate with two more butter biscuits in the middle. The woman's table is about two meters to the RIGHT of the dad, with a single cup. The sun is low behind the RIGHT side of the frame, giving warm golden rim light on hair and shoulders. Palette: warm cream, honey gold and soft blush pink, with one accent of deep red velvet for the gift box. Anchors: the marble table, coffee on the RIGHT, lemonade on the LEFT.

LOOK: Stylized 3D animated feature look in vertical 9:16. A virtual 35mm-style lens, camera at seated eye level, very shallow depth of field so backgrounds dissolve into warm round bokeh. Skin is smooth and porcelain with a soft blush and subsurface glow on ears and cheeks, eyes very glossy with big clear catchlights.

MOTION: Everything moves at a natural real-time pace with clear animated acting, no slow motion and no sped-up jumps. The dad's eye moves lead and his head follows a beat later, then his shoulders. When he freezes, he holds the pose with tiny breathing in the shoulders and one blink. The baby moves in short chubby bursts: a quick grab, a stretch of the whole arm, a little bounce on mom's lap, her sprout ponytail bouncing after every move. Mom's turn is slow and heavy with intent: eyes first, then her chin, then her shoulders square up. The velvet box is small and light, the dad sets it down gently with his RIGHT hand and it makes a soft tap.

SHOTS IN DETAIL:

Shot 1 (0-3s). Camera: medium shot from across the table at seated eye level, centered on the family, slight slow push-in from medium to medium close. First frame: the dad on the RIGHT and the mom with the baby on the LEFT, the marble table in the lower third. Last frame: the same, a bit tighter. Start pose: the dad holds the coffee cup by the handle with his RIGHT hand at chin height, his LEFT hand flat on the table, eyes on mom. The mom faces the baby, smiling, her RIGHT hand resting on the table near the lemonade, her LEFT arm around the baby's belly. The baby nibbles the biscuit held in her RIGHT hand. 0-1s: the dad's eyes slide to his LEFT, frame right, toward something off screen, and lock there; the cup stops halfway to his mouth. 1-2s: his eyebrows lift slightly, a tiny dreamy smile starts. The baby stops chewing, crumbs on her lip, and her eyes slowly slide up to her dad. 2-3s: the baby's eyebrows pull down, she narrows her eyes into a suspicious squint and her cheeks puff. Mom keeps smiling at nothing, unaware. Sounds: <soft cafe ambience> <a spoon clinking on a saucer> <the baby's tiny chewing stops>.

Shot 2 (3-6s). Camera: over the dad's LEFT shoulder, his shoulder and the back of his head soft and blurred on the LEFT side of the frame, the woman's table sharp on the RIGHT, a slow gentle push-in toward the woman's ear. First frame: the woman in profile, facing frame right, her cup in front of her. Last frame: tighter on her ear and the earring. 3-4s: the woman lifts her RIGHT hand and tucks her straight black hair behind her RIGHT ear in one slow smooth motion, revealing the long pink crystal drop earring. 4-5s: the earring swings gently from the movemen

entries.title: Halloween Horror Black Cat Transformation
entries.description: A prompt for creating an ultra-realistic Halloween horror video featuring a mysterious black cat transforming into a demonic entity in a foggy village setting.
entries.prompt:
Create a  ultra-realistic, photorealistic live-action Halloween horror video featuring a mysterious black cat with sleek glossy fur and piercing golden eyes.
SETTING
A deserted village street at midnight, surrounded by enormous glowing jack-o'-lanterns, twisted trees, abandoned houses, scattered autumn leaves, and thick rolling fog. A blood-red moon hangs above the village, casting an eerie orange-red glow across the road.
— THE MYSTERIOUS CAT
A black cat slowly walks down the empty village street, passing several glowing pumpkins. Its golden eyes reflect the flickering candlelight. The camera follows it from a low ground-level angle as its paws move naturally across the leaf-covered road.

The camera slowly pushes toward the cat's face. Its eyes transform into glowing supernatural orange eyes with narrow vertical pupils. Its fur rises, its mouth stretches into an unnatural monstrous grin, and its sharp fangs become visible.
The pumpkins behind it begin shaking violently as black smoke erupts from the ground. The cat suddenly opens its mouth and releases a terrifying demonic growl.
— FINAL HORROR REVEAL
The cat slowly walks toward the camera, staring directly into the lens. Its glowing eyes become brighter with every step.
It suddenly stops inches from the camera, opens its mouth impossibly wide, revealing rows of terrifying sharp teeth, and unleashes a horrifying demonic scream.
FINAL SHOT: Extreme close-up of the cat's fiery orange eyes and monstrous grin. The pumpkins behind it simultaneously explode into darkness as the screen cuts to black.

entries.description: A complex prompt for a photorealistic monster chase video in vintage VHS style, where a woman uses a transformation gun to turn monsters into jelly versions, requiring multiple reference images.

entries.title: Midnight Bloodline Action Thriller
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a 30-second photorealistic Hollywood action thriller titled 'The Last House Standing' using Seedance 2.5, including reference image instructions, timeline beats, and strict continuity rules.
entries.prompt:
THE LAST HOUSE STANDING — SEEDANCE 2.5

Generate one continuous EXACTLY 30-second, 16:9 photorealistic Hollywood action thriller, 60 FPS target.

REFERENCES & CONTINUITY:
@image1 = Protagonist. Preserve exact face, beard, hairstyle, skin and body proportions. Outfit: black T-shirt, open charcoal jacket, dark cargo pants, black belt, fingerless gloves and black boots. One consistent matte-black pistol.

@image2 = Five distinct attackers: (1) tall bearded leader in black; (2) muscular bald heavy with cheek scar and olive vest; (3) lean man in black hoodie; (4) tall masked intruder in black; (5) curly-haired young man in navy jacket. Maintain identical appearances and clothing.

@image3 = Modern two-storey luxury house at midnight. Charcoal stone exterior, wooden panels, driveway, gate and garden. Interior: open living room, dark wooden floor, grey sectional sofa, black marble table, large windows, entrance hallway, staircase on right and dining area behind. Warm amber lights contrast with cool moonlight. Preserve exact layout.

TIMELINE — 10 BEATS:

00–03: Moonlit house reveal. Protagonist waits inside as five silhouettes approach.

03–06: Main door bursts open. Five intruders enter and spot the protagonist.

06–09: Attackers open fire. Protagonist takes cover behind the sofa. Bullets strike walls and furniture.

09–12: Attacker 3 rushes. Intense hand-to-hand fight; attacker falls.

12–15: Heavy attacker charges. Brutal close-quarter struggle beside sofa.

15–18: Leader fires from hallway while masked attacker approaches.

18–21: Protagonist fights masked attacker and knocks him down.

21–24: Youngest attacker intervenes and is defeated. Leader remains.

24–27: Final intense confrontation. Leader falls; all five attackers are incapacitated.

27–30: Wide shot of the damaged living room. Protagonist stands alone, lowers his pistol and looks directly into camera.

CAMERA & AUDIO:
Dynamic tracking, low-angle shots, handheld action, dramatic close-ups and brief slow motion. Original Hollywood orchestral action music, deep bass, gunfire, footsteps, punches, furniture impacts, debris and heavy breathing synchronized with action.

FINAL RULES:
Preserve all reference identities, outfits, weapons and location continuity. Realistic physics, cinematic choreography, consistent lighting, no duplication, identity drift, teleportation, random location changes, text, subtitles or watermark. Exactly 30 seconds.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Magical Girl Transformation Prompt

entries.prompt:
A 15-second magical girl transformation sequence with a premium mobile game gacha climax. Vertical 9:16.

[Image 1] defines the character before transformation.
[Image 2] defines the exact completed costume, hairstyle, accessories, wand or staff, final pose and background.

STRICTLY 2D
Preserve the original 2D illustration style of both references: the same face, proportions, linework, painted shading and textures.
All character animation, backgrounds, light ribbons and particles must remain hand-drawn-looking 2D animation.
No 3D modeling, CGI rendering, photorealism or plastic materials.

TRANSFORMATION DIRECTION
Light wraps around her body, and her outfit visibly forms one part at a time.
Show each transformation in its own close-up, progressing upward from footwear to costume and accessories.
Each featured part must actually transform during its shot, rather than simply showing an already completed outfit.
Connect the close-ups with flowing light-ribbon wipes and matching movement. Maintain clear continuity of the same character.

0–2s — LIGHT ENVELOPES HER
Begin with the ordinary appearance in [Image 1].
A small spark awakens near her chest. Luminous ribbons spiral around her body, lifting her hair and clothing.
She closes her eyes and relaxes into the transformation.
The surroundings dissolve into an illustrated magical space using the colors and motifs of [Image 2].
An opaque luminous costume silhouette keeps her covered during the clothing change.

2–4s — FOOTWEAR CLOSE-UP
Cut to a close-up of her feet.
A ribbon of light circles one ankle and sweeps across both feet, revealing the finished footwear from [Image 2].
The new fabric and ornaments become clearly visible as the light moves away.

4–6s — MAIN COSTUME CLOSE-UP
Move upward to a close-up of her waist and torso.
Light winds around her, weaving the main costume into place in distinct layers.
Fabric, trim and skirt details form sequentially, matching [Image 2].
The completed fabric unfurls with elegant hand-drawn motion.

6–8s — SLEEVES AND FINISHING DETAILS
Close-up of her arm and upper body.
Light travels along her arm, forming the sleeves or arm accessories shown in [Image 2].
The remaining jewelry and head ornament appear in sequence as the light rises.
Her final hairstyle settles into place.

8–11s — WAND GRASP
A concentrated stream of light forms the exact wand or staff from [Image 2] in front of her.
Clearly show her open hand reaching toward it, her fingers closing around the handle, and the grip becoming secure.
Use the same holding hand as [Image 2].
Only after she firmly grasps it, a pulse of magic travels from the handle to its tip.
Keep the wand intact and stable in her hand.

11–12.5s — FINAL POSE
Pull back smoothly to reveal the completed transformation.
She moves into the final pose of [Image 2] while holding the wand.
Her hair, ribbons and skirt follow the movement and settle.
She opens her eyes

entries.title: Dog and Cat Superbike Race Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 17-second vertical video featuring a golden retriever and a tuxedo cat riding a superbike. Includes specific scene breakdowns, visual style instructions, and audio cues.
entries.prompt:
Create a 17-second ultra-realistic cinematic action video in vertical 9:16 format.

A cute golden retriever dog and a black-and-white tuxedo cat are riding together on an aggressive black superbike with striking orange racing accents. The cat sits confidently in the front near the handlebars while the happy golden dog sits behind it. Both animals look adorable yet fearless.

Scene 1 (0–3 seconds): A wide cinematic tracking shot of a powerful black superbike speeding down a smooth racing track under a beautiful blue sky.

Scene 2 (3–6 seconds): Close-up side view revealing the golden retriever and tuxedo cat riding together on the motorcycle, enjoying the thrilling adventure.

Scene 3 (6–10 seconds): Dynamic low-angle tracking shots as the motorcycle leans aggressively into a racing turn. The dog's ears move naturally in the wind while the cat maintains a confident expression.

Scene 4 (10–14 seconds): The motorcycle accelerates and performs an incredible high-speed wheelie, lifting its front wheel into the air while both animals remain perfectly positioned.

Scene 5 (14–17 seconds): The motorcycle lands smoothly, accelerates away, and disappears into the distance along the racing track.

Visual Style: Photorealistic animals, premium superbike details, realistic fur physics, cinematic camera movements, natural sunlight, realistic shadows, smooth motion, dynamic racing angles, professional Hollywood action cinematography.

Audio: Powerful superbike engine revving, tire sounds, rushing wind, and energetic cinematic background music.

Important: Maintain consistent dog and cat appearances throughout the video. Ensure realistic motorcycle physics, natural animal movements, and visually seamless scene transitions. No humans, no extra animals, no cartoon effects, no distorted anatomy.

entries.title: Mother Brushing Daughter Hair Pixar
entries.description: A prompt for a 15-second Pixar-style 3D animated short film depicting a humorous interaction between a mother trying to brush her daughter's hair and the daughter's annoyed reactions.
entries.prompt:
Create a high-quality 3D animated Pixar-style short film featuring a loving mother and her adorable little daughter.

Scene 1 (0–3 seconds): In a cozy modern bedroom with soft purple walls, a beautiful mother wearing a cream knitted sweater stands behind her little daughter, who is wearing pink pajamas. The mother gently brushes the girl's long, thick reddish-brown hair using a pink hairbrush. The little girl looks slightly uncomfortable and unhappy.

Scene 2 (3–5 seconds): The mother starts gathering the girl's long hair into a high ponytail. The little girl suddenly gets annoyed and tries to run away, while the mother follows her, holding her hair gently.

Scene 3 (5–8 seconds): Show a close-up of the little girl's face with big expressive green eyes, raised eyebrows, and a shocked, frustrated expression. Her mother looks surprised and worried.

Scene 4 (8–11 seconds): The scene transitions to a bright, beautiful modern kitchen. The mother kneels behind the little girl and tries to fix her messy hair into a ponytail. The girl looks extremely annoyed, rolling her eyes with a funny expression.

Scene 5 (11–15 seconds): Show an emotional close-up of the little girl giving an adorable angry side-eye while her mother finally manages to tie her hair. The mother smiles proudly, while the girl remains unimpressed.

Visual Style: Premium Pixar-inspired 3D animation, cinematic lighting, realistic hair physics, detailed facial expressions, smooth character animation, warm family atmosphere, expressive eyes, natural movements, beautiful indoor environments, professional animated movie quality.

Camera: Mix of medium shots, close-ups, facial reaction shots, and smooth cinematic camera movements.

Format: Vertical 9:16, 4K resolution, 24 FPS, approximately 15 seconds.

Important: Maintain consistent character faces, hairstyles, clothing, body proportions, and colors throughout every scene. No character distortion, no extra fingers, no flickering, no subtitles, and no text on screen.

entries.title: Korean Horror Dumpling Stall Part 1
entries.description: A detailed multi-part prompt for a Korean horror-fantasy short film involving a granma's dumpling stall, specifying character sheets, prop locks, staging, and lighting for the first part.
entries.prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5 — 16:9 — 30s — PART 1 of 2 — "할매 만두 (Granma's Dumplings)" — Korean horror-fantasy short, multi-shot cinematic, Korean dialogue, no BGM, natural ASMR ambience only.

REFERENCES
Granma — character sheet (≈90-year-old tiny woman, silver bun with red cat-head binyeo hairpin, plum quilted vest, cream blouse, white apron with red dumpling pocket, charcoal skirt, black slippers, green jade bangle on LEFT wrist).
YoungMan — character sheet (24, messy black fringe, black bomber with orange lining + reflective sleeve strips, grey hoodie, navy cargo joggers, white-grey sneakers, matte black helmet with clear visor).
Cat — character sheet (large solid-black tomcat, amber-gold slit eyes, notch on LEFT ear, red braided cord collar with small brass bell).
Stall — exterior location (tiny red hanok-roof stall, 「할매 만두」 sign, six red lanterns, steamer stack with steam on the left, indigo split curtain with white dumpling symbol as the only entrance, stool with cat figurine right of the curtain, white parking box on the right).
Hotel — interior location (vast dark-gold palace-hotel hall, three crystal chandeliers in a line, red dragon columns, red carpet to a double staircase, full-moon round window at the back, ONE round white-cloth table with one red velvet chair, gold-rim plate, silver chopsticks).

PROP LOCKS
- PROP-BIKE: small matte-black 125cc city scooter-motorbike. Parks inside the white parking box at frame right of Stall and stays there.
- PROP-HELMET: matte black helmet, clear visor. He takes it off outside and carries it in his RIGHT hand. When he sits, he sets it on the table at his LEFT elbow, and it stays there.
- TABLE SET: the one table holds only the gold-rim white porcelain plate (empty), silver chopsticks and spoon on a rest, and the helmet. NO food appears in Part 1.
- The curtain symbol, the 「할매 만두」 sign text and the chandeliers stay identical to the refs. No new signs, no extra text.

STAGING LOCK
- Outside: stall on the LEFT, parking box on the RIGHT, street recedes to the right with one cool street lamp. YoungMan arrives from frame right.
- Cat outside: sits upright on the small wooden stool to the RIGHT of the curtain, beside the cat figurine.
- Inside: the entrance curtain is at the front; the table is about 6 m ahead on the red carpet. YoungMan sits in the ONE red velvet chair. Granma comes down the staircase side (back of the hall) and stands on his RIGHT side of the table. Cat walks in and sits on the red carpet on his LEFT, beside the chair leg.
- No other people, guests, staff or animals anywhere. Only one cat, only one table.

LOOK / LIGHTING LOCK (keep identical tone in every shot)
- Exterior: cool deep-blue night, wet asphalt, light drizzle, warm red-gold lantern glow on the stall, light mist.
- Interior: warm rich gold chandelier key light with cool-blue moonlight fill from the round window, deep shadows in the far corners, light haze. Same exposure and grade in every interior shot.
- Ultra-photorealistic live action, low saturation, filmic grain. Horror-fantasy mood: beautiful but too still and too perfect.

SOUND
No music at all. Natural ASMR only: scooter engine idling then clicking off, drizzle and drips, steamer hiss outside, one long sad cat meow, the curtain fabric rustling, then near-silence inside. Footsteps echo on marble in the huge hall, crystals faintly tinkle, the chair creaks softly.
Voices: ONLY Granma speaks in Part 1, in a soft, slow, sweet old woman's voice. YoungMan never speaks; he only breathes and gives one stunned exhale. Cat only meows.

PACING
Slow and atmospheric. Each beat holds; silences breathe. No rushed cuts, no fast-forward feel.

BEATS
0–4s — Wide Stall at night in the drizzle, steam drifting from the steamers, lanterns swaying slightly. PROP-BIKE rolls in from the right and stops in the parking box; the engine clicks off. Quiet drizzle.
4–7s — Medium: YoungMan pulls off PROP-HELMET, shakes his damp fringe, looks at the glowing tiny stall. He breathes in the steam and gives a small, tired, hungry smile.
7–11s — He walks up to the curtain, helmet in his right hand. On the stool to the right of the curtain, Cat slowly turns his head toward him. Close-up of Cat: ears lower, amber eyes soften with pity, and he gives one long, low, sad meow.
11–13s — YoungMan glances down at the cat, chuckles softly under his breath, and parts the indigo curtain with his LEFT hand. Warm gold light spills across his face, and he steps through. Behind him, Cat hops off the stool and pads in after him.
13–19s — THE REVEAL. Reverse shot from inside: YoungMan stops just past the curtain. The camera cranes slowly up and back to reveal the vast Hotel hall: chandeliers, dragon columns, staircases and the moon window, impossibly bigger than the tiny stall. He turns slowly in place, looking up, lips parted, stunned. One shaky exhale. Cat walks calmly past his sneakers down the red carpet without looking back.
19–24s — Echoing footsteps. Wide: Granma appears on the staircase side and walks slowly down the red carpet toward him, small steps, hands folded on her apron, sweet warm smile. Medium close-up of her, clearly on screen, mouth in sync, she bows slightly and speaks:
   Granma: 「어서 와요, 손님. 오래 기다렸어요.」
   Reverse: YoungMan bows back awkwardly, unsure.
24–27s — She gestures with an open palm to the single table. He walks to it and sits in the red velvet chair, setting the helmet on the table at his left elbow. Cat sits down on the carpet at the left side of his chair, upright and still. Granma, standing at his right, smiles a beat too long, then turns and walks slowly away toward the staircase, out of frame.
27–30s — END SHOT (no characters visible): a slow, gentle push-in on the table top in close-up, showing only the empty gold-rimmed white plate and the silver chopsticks on their rest under the chandelier glow, with haze drifting in the light. No hands, no people, no cat in frame. Hold in silence.

NEGATIVE
No background music, no score, no stingers. No extra speaking voices: no narrator, no voiceover; YoungMan does not speak; Cat does not talk in Part 1, only one meow. No dialogue other than Granma's one line. No other people, guests, waiters or crowds; no second cat. No text, subtitles, captions, watermark or UI; no changes to the 「할매 만두」 sign. No food or dumplings on the table yet. No demonic or black eyes, no glowing eyes, no monster features in Part 1. No change to the lighting tone, no daylight, no interior flicker. No wardrobe drift; the helmet is never on his head inside. No floating objects, magic sparkles or particles. No jump cut through the reveal, no shaky handheld, no fast-forward look. Final 3 seconds: no characters in frame.

entries.prompt:
The Wrong Delivery – Seoul Street Revenge Comedy

Create an ultra-realistic live-action action-comedy scene set in a crowded outdoor shopping district in Seoul, South Korea. Cinematic handheld camera work, natural daylight, authentic Korean street atmosphere, realistic human movement, expressive reactions, and perfectly timed physical comedy. No animation or video-game aesthetics.

MAIN CHARACTER:
A stylish Korean man in his late 20s, athletic build, short textured black hair, wearing a dark oversized hoodie, beige cargo trousers, and white sneakers. Maintain his exact facial features, hairstyle, clothing, and body proportions throughout the entire sequence.

SECONDARY CHARACTER:
A confident Korean woman in her 20s, wearing a fashionable long coat, black trousers, and boots. She carries a large takeaway shopping bag.

SCENE AND ACTION:

The man stands outside a busy Seoul convenience store, happily eating a large takeaway burger while checking his phone. He places his food on a nearby public bench for a moment to answer a message.

A woman walks past, accidentally bumps into the bench, and his drink spills onto his trousers. He looks up in disbelief.

She barely acknowledges him and continues walking.

The man picks up his half-eaten burger, notices the woman has mistakenly taken his identical takeaway shopping bag, and immediately rushes after her.

He catches up and politely taps her shoulder. She turns around, assumes he is bothering her, and dismissively pushes his hand away.

He points toward the bag, trying to explain. She rolls her eyes, opens it, and discovers that it contains a ridiculously large birthday cake instead of her shopping.

The man starts laughing uncontrollably.

Embarrassed and annoyed, she suddenly grabs the cake box and accidentally drops it. The cake slides out and lands directly on the man’s hoodie.

He freezes, looking down at the mess.

A brief silence follows.

He slowly looks up at her with an exaggerated serious expression. Without saying a word, he takes a small handful of frosting from his hoodie and gently places it on the tip of her nose.

She stares at him in disbelief.

A nearby street performer notices the situation and starts laughing. The woman tries to maintain her dignity but accidentally slips on a fallen piece of cake, landing safely on a pile of empty cardboard delivery boxes.

The man bursts into laughter, picks up his burger, takes another bite, and walks away triumphantly.

FINAL SHOT:
The camera follows him walking confidently through the crowded shopping street, eating his burger with a satisfied expression. Behind him, the woman gets up, notices frosting on her nose, and shouts at him while pedestrians laugh.

SOUND DESIGN:
Authentic Seoul street ambience, passing traffic, footsteps, convenience-store door chime, food-wrapper sounds, drink splashing, surprised reactions, laughter, cake hitting ground, fabric rustling, and distant city noise. Natural diegetic audio only — no music score unless faintly heard from a nearby shop speaker.

entries.prompt:
秋の晴れた昼、山あいの細い山道。崩れ落ちた灰色の巨大な岩が道をふさいでいる。さくらが両手のひらを向けて踏ん張る。足元の小石だけが宙に浮き、岩は少しも動かない。力が抜けて、片ひざをつく。そこへ手押しの買い物カートのおばあさんが歩いてくる。先生がさくらの手を下ろさせる。「人が来た」。おばあさんは岩を見上げて、「これじゃ、帰れねえ」。さくらが先生を見る。先生は息を吐いて、小さくうなずく。

先生がカートを押して、おばあさんを道端へ連れていく。さくらは1人で岩の前に立ち、目を閉じて肩の力を抜く。「動いて」。根元から土がこぼれ、巨大な岩が路面から離れる。振り向きかけたおばあさんの前に、先生が回り込んで山を指さす。岩は空中を横へ動き、谷へ下りていく。ドーン。土ぼこりが晴れると、紅葉の道が奥まで開いている。おばあさんがさくらの手を両手で包み、手のひらを見て笑う。「ありがとうね」。

一緒に来た友達が手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、BGMなし。画面に出るのは三人だけ。岩は1個、カートは1台。光やオーラは足さず、重い物が動くだけにした。山道・岩・開いた道・おばあさんは参照画像、続きは前のパートの実際のコマを参照にした。

The teacher makes Sakura lower her hands. 'Someone's coming.' The old lady looks up at the rock, 'I can't go back like this.' Sakura looks at the teacher. The teacher exhales and nods slightly.

The teacher pushes the cart, taking the old lady to the side of the road. Sakura stands alone before the rock, closes her eyes, and relaxes her shoulders. 'Move.' The old lady holds Sakura's hands with both of hers, looking at her palm and smiling. 'Thank you.'

entries.title: Giant World Macro Photography Video
entries.description: A prompt for a 30-second dreamlike fantasy video where a man experiences the world as if everything is 50-100x larger than normal.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic dreamlike fantasy, photoreal, macro-photography look, one continuous unbroken shot with no cuts, 30 seconds. The man from @Image1 is normal human size, but everything in the world around him is 50–100x larger than normal. Soft golden-hour light, volumetric haze, floating pollen particles, warm pastel palette, shallow depth of field. The camera flows smoothly with him the entire time.

0–4s: Extreme close-up of a giant dewdrop on a blade of grass, the man's sleeping face reflected inside it. Slow rack focus reveals him lying on soft moss, surrounded by grass blades towering like a green forest of skyscrapers.
