8–12s: A ladybug the size of a car walks past, glossy red shell catching the light. He steps back, frozen. The ladybug pauses, turns its head toward him, then calmly walks on. He laughs in disbelief.

16–20s: He floats over the meadow. Below, a rain puddle stretches like a lake with a white paper boat as big as a ship. A huge brass pocket watch lies open in the grass, its second hand sweeping past like a crane arm.

entries.title: Robot goat haystack prank prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for Seedance 2.5 creating a funny vertical smartphone-style video of a robot working while a goat repeatedly tries to headbutt it, culminating in a haystack dive. Includes strict rules for camera, characters, and actions.
entries.prompt:
Create a native 18-second, vertical 9:16 real smartphone video: one continuous handheld take with no cuts, filmed by a farm owner standing in a goat pasture at golden hour. No reference image. No text, no captions, no logos, no subtitles.

CORE RULES
One continuous shot, real-time speed, no cuts, no slow motion. Only two characters are visible: one humanoid robot and one goat. The person filming is never visible, only heard. The robot does not move its feet except for exactly one calm sidestep at 12.0 seconds. The goat headbutts the robot from behind twice without any effect, then makes a huge run-up, the robot calmly steps aside at the last moment, and the goat flies past and dives head first into a big haystack, leaving only its back legs sticking out and kicking. The climax must be clear even with the sound off. Nobody is hurt: at the end the goat pops its head out of the hay, fine. Funny and absurd, not scary.

CHARACTER
ROBOT: an adult-size humanoid service robot, about 175 cm tall, glossy white arm and leg segments, a beige padded chest and torso panel, black joints, black five-fingered mechanical hands, no brand name and no text anywhere. Its head is a rounded glossy black helmet with a flat black glass face screen. On the screen, soft white LED lines form its expression: two round dot eyes and one thin mouth line. Exactly two arms and two legs. It stands in the centre of the frame, its body turned three quarters toward the LEFT and slightly toward the camera, bent forward from the hips over a low wooden board, calmly working, its back and rear facing the RIGHT side of the pasture.
GOAT: an adult white goat with large beige patches on its neck and back, long floppy ears, golden-yellow eyes with horizontal pupils, a long white beard, curved horns, a stubborn, dramatic personality. Exactly four legs.
OWNER (off-screen, voice only): a woman in her mid-twenties holding the phone.

FACE
Robot face screen: clean black glass, soft glowing white LED lines, simple and readable. Only these expressions, only when written: NEUTRAL (two round dots, flat line), BLINK (the dots close into short lines for a moment and open again), BORED (half-closed dots, flat line), CALM (dots, a tiny smile), SMUG (eyes as happy arcs, wide upward curved smile). Never text, numbers or symbols.
Goat face: realistic goat anatomy, horizontal pupils, ears moving independently, beard swinging with movement. Its mouth stays closed the whole video.

VOICE
Owner: warm young adult female voice close to the phone mic, natural and unscripted: whispers at first, then real breathy laughter that becomes uncontrollable. The robot never speaks, only quiet servo whirs. The goat makes only hoof sounds, snorts and one short bleat at the end.

CAMERA
Vertical phone held at chest height about 4 metres from the robot, from the side, so the whole robot from head to feet, the low board, the haystack on the left and the pasture stretching far into the background on the right are all in frame. Main action stays in the centre and upper two thirds of the frame.

CAMERA HAND
The phone is in the owner's right hand. Her hands and arms never appear in frame.

HANDHELD
Natural small hand shake and breathing movement; a small flinch at each headbutt; a slight pan to the right following the goat's far walk between 8.5 and 10.0 seconds, then a pan back to the robot during the run; a strong shake when she laughs. No zoom jumps, no whip pans.

LOOK
Real modern smartphone video, golden hour exposure, mild grain in shadows, slight compression softness, true-to-life warm colours, a little lens flare from the low sun, no filters, no beauty smoothing.

LIGHTING
Low golden sun behind on the RIGHT, giving a warm glowing rim light on the goat's white fur and beard, on the robot's glossy white arms and on the top of the haystack. Soft warm fill from the bright orange sky. Low ground mist over the far pasture. The light stays the same for the whole video.

VISUAL MATCH
The image must look exactly like this: a casual phone video shot by a farm owner in her own goat pasture at golden hour, handheld at chest height, a warm orange sky, low mist over a wide green pasture, a weathered wooden fence along the far background, a big round golden haystack on the left, a white and beige robot with a black helmet in the centre, a glowing white and beige goat, light grain, no text on screen, one continuous take that feels unplanned and real.

SETTING
A family farm goat pasture in the evening: short green grass with patches of straw, a wide open field behind, a weathered wooden fence running along the far background.

BACKGROUND
Foreground: short grass and straw. Midground: the big round golden haystack on the LEFT, about 2 metres tall; directly in front of it a low wooden board, about 40 cm high, resting on two short tree stumps; the robot in the centre bent over the board. Background: the open pasture stretching far to the RIGHT, the weathered fence, a small red wooden shed far away, a line of trees in warm haze. The haystack is visible from the first frame. Distant movement only: the low mist drifting. The background never warps or shifts.

MOTION
The robot moves slowly and calmly with small mechanical pauses and quiet servo whirs, never glitching, never reacting to the hits with its body. The goat moves with real weight: hoof scraping, a short trot, a real galloping run-up with its legs moving in a natural goat gait, a jump and a dive. The order of movement is always eyes or screen first, then head, then shoulders.

DEFECT PREVENTION
Hands: the robot's RIGHT hand holds one small screwdriver in a fist grip the whole video and never lets go; from 0.0 to 12.0 seconds it slowly turns a screw in the board. The robot's LEFT hand presses flat on the board from 0.0 to 12.0 seconds, then hangs relaxed along its body. Five fingers per hand; fingers never merge with each other, the screwdriver or the board. The camera hand is never visible.
Face: the goat's head shape, horns, beard, eyes and patches stay identical the whole time. The goat's mouth stays closed. The robot screen shows only the listed expressions. The robot's head turns toward the camera stay under 45 degrees.
Body and legs: the robot's feet stay planted from 0.0 to 12.0 seconds; when the goat hits it, its body does not move at all, only the goat bounces back. At 12.0 to 12.6 seconds the robot takes exactly one calm step with its RIGHT foot toward the camera, its LEFT foot follows, then it stands still again until the end. The goat always has exactly four legs; its knees bend only naturally; hooves never slide. The goat hits only the robot's rear and lower back with the top of its head and horns.
Objects: exactly one low wooden board on two short stumps, exactly one small screwdriver, exactly one big round haystack. The board and the stumps never move. The haystack keeps its size and shape, except a soft burst of loose hay where the goat dives in. No readable text anywhere.
Continuity: one take, the haystack always LEFT, the robot in the CENTRE, the open pasture to the RIGHT, the sun always behind on the right.
Physics and environment: small puffs of dust and grass fly from the goat's hooves during the run; when the goat dives into the haystack, a cloud of loose golden hay bursts out and slowly floats down. The goat's back half sticks out of the haystack, back legs kicking in the air, tail wagging. No liquid. No reflections of the owner or the phone on the robot's glass. Nobody else appears.

STORYBOARD
00:00.0-00:02.0 HOOK. Wide side view. START POSE: the robot bent forward over the board in the centre, screen NEUTRAL, right hand slowly turning the screwdriver, left hand flat on the board, feet planted; the haystack on the left; about 4 metres behind the robot on the right the goat stands with its head lowered, horns pointed at the robot's back, scraping the ground

entries.title: Korean Camcorder Style Video
entries.description: A detailed prompt for creating a 30-second ultra-realistic live-action video in Korea, mimicking early 2000s consumer camcorder footage. Used with Seedance 2.5 and GPT Image 2.5.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic live-action video featuring a naturally beautiful young Korean woman in her early 20s spending time with a friend in an older residential neighborhood in Korea on a warm late-summer afternoon.

The video should feel like genuine footage casually recorded on an early 2000s consumer digital camcorder. It should not look like a commercial, K-drama, music video, staged production, or cinematic film. Keep everything simple, candid, engaging, and natural.

**Character Consistency**

The main character has shoulder-length dark brown-black hair with soft, natural waves, subtle makeup, realistic skin texture, and a relaxed, expressive face.

She wears:
- A fitted white short-sleeve top.
- Light blue straight-leg jeans.
- White sneakers.
- A small dark brown shoulder bag.
- A delicate silver necklace.

Maintain perfect character consistency throughout the entire video. Her facial features, hairstyle, clothing, accessories, body proportions, and the same bottled drink must remain identical in every shot.

**Location and Environment**

A quiet, older Korean residential neighborhood featuring:
- Narrow concrete alleys and small side streets.
- Low-rise brick villa-style apartment buildings (빌라) and small apartment complexes.
- Brick and concrete walls, with potted plants and small rooftop or doorstep gardens.
- Parked bicycles.
- Utility poles with tangled overhead electrical and cable wires.
- A small neighborhood mini-mart or convenience store with an open front and a drink refrigerator.
- Shaded walkways, narrow stairways, and apartment entrances with metal gates.

The environment should feel lived-in, ordinary, and authentic. Avoid recognizable landmarks, identifiable brands, readable signage, advertisements, or commercial activity. Any signs or labels should be blurred, generic, or out of focus.

**Visual Style and Camera Direction**

Authentic handheld early 2000s consumer DV camcorder footage.

Use:
- Natural handheld camera shake.
- Imperfect framing and spontaneous camera movements.
- Occasional autofocus breathing and focus hunting.
- Slight automatic exposure fluctuations.
- Soft digital image detail.
- Faded, slightly washed-out colors.
- Subtle digital video noise.
- Natural motion blur.
- Occasional accidental zooming.

The person filming should behave like a friend casually recording everyday moments. The characters should react naturally to the camera.

Absolutely no gimbal shots, drone footage, stabilized camera movements, slow motion, beauty filters, or polished cinematic aesthetics.

**Storyboard and Timeline**

**00:00–00:05, Leaving the Apartment**
She walks out of her apartment building through a metal gate, adjusts her shoulder bag, notices the camera, and smiles naturally. Her friend casually follows behind while filming.

**00:05–00:10, Buying a Cold Drink**
She buys a bottled cold drink from a small neighborhood mini-mart. She gently presses the cold bottle against her cheek, laughs as the camera zooms in on her face, and casually says in Korean: "오늘 진짜 덥다." (It's so hot today.)

**00:10–00:15, Walking Through the Neighborhood**
The two friends walk along a quieter residential alley. A gentle breeze moves her hair. She turns back toward the camera, looks directly into the lens, and smiles naturally.

**00:15–00:20, A Playful Moment**
She sits on a low wall beside an apartment garden. Her friend notices a tiny leaf caught in her hair and points it out. She removes the leaf herself and bursts into natural laughter.

**00:20–00:25, Sharing a Drink**
They continue walking together. She briefly takes the bottled drink from her friend, takes a casual sip, hands it back, and smiles toward the camera.

**00:25–00:30, Saying Goodbye**
At the apartment entrance, she turns toward the camera, waves casually, and says in Korean: "내일 봐." (See you tomorrow.)

She walks inside the apartment building. Her friend continues recording for one additional second as the door closes. The footage then abruptly cuts to black.

**Audio and Sound Design**

Use only authentic environmental sounds recorded naturally within the scene:
- Footsteps on concrete.
- Distant passing traffic.
- Bicycle sounds.
- Summer cicadas (매미) and other insects.
- Ambient residential neighborhood sounds.
- Mini-mart refrigerator humming.
- Bottle handling and movement.
- Rustling leaves.
- Faint conversations in Korean and distant neighborhood chatter.

Include only natural character dialogue. No background music, voiceover, artificial sound effects, subtitles, captions, explanatory text, logos, watermarks, or random text.

**Realism and Physical Accuracy**

Every movement must feel spontaneous and physically believable.

Ensure realistic:
- Walking and sitting movements.
- Drinking and handling the bottle.
- Hair movement in the breeze.
- Facial expressions and hand gestures.
- Natural interactions between friends.

Avoid exaggerated acting, identity drift, wardrobe changes, distorted hands, extra fingers, duplicate characters, teleportation, CGI-like appearances, or physically impossible movements.

**Final Direction:** The finished video should look like a genuine personal memory captured by a friend on an inexpensive early 2000s digital camcorder in Korea. It should feel imperfect, nostalgic, intimate, spontaneous, and completely believable, as if someone found an old home video from the summer of 2003.

Include only natural character dialogue. No background music, voiceover, artificial sound effects, subtitles, captions, explanatory text, logos, watermarks, or random text.

**Realism and Physical Accuracy**

Every movement must feel spontaneous and physically believable.

Ensure realistic:
- Walking and sitting movements.
- Drinking and handling the bottle.
- Hair movement in the breeze.
- Facial expressions and hand gestures.
- Natural interactions between friends.

Avoid exaggerated acting, identity drift, wardrobe changes, distorted hands, extra fingers, duplicate characters, teleportation, CGI-like appearances, or physically impossible movements.

It should feel imperfect, nostalgic, intimate, spontaneous, and completely believable, as if someone found an old home video from the summer of 2003.

Create a cinematic 2D anime-style martial arts training sequence featuring a young athletic woman and a tall athletic man sparring inside a traditional martial arts dojo.

They begin an intense hand-to-hand sparring sequence. The woman throws quick punches, the man blocks and counters with controlled movements. She dodges his attacks, steps sideways and maintains her fighting stance.

The man suddenly launches a powerful jumping kick. The woman reacts quickly, ducks and evades the attack. Continue with dynamic martial arts movements, fast punches, defensive blocks, spinning kicks and agile footwork.

Visual style: Premium Japanese anime animation, cinematic 2D hand-drawn aesthetic, detailed character designs, smooth fluid movement, expressive facial animation, dramatic action choreography, realistic martial arts physics, beautifully animated clothing and hair.

entries.title: Baby Raccoon and Bulldog Comedy Animation
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 3D animated comedy featuring a baby raccoon and a bulldog in a backyard, with specific scene beats and negative prompts for Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second vertical 9:16 cinematic 3D animated comedy set in a sunny backyard garden with a small pond, flowers, muddy grass, a wooden fence, and a large tree. Use warm daylight, soft shadows, detailed environments, and polished family-animation quality.

Main Character: Maintain the exact same cute baby raccoon throughout the video: fluffy gray fur, black eye mask, round ears, tiny paws, chubby body, and highly expressive cartoon facial expressions.

Scene 1 (0–3s): A baby raccoon sits beside an open picnic lunchbox containing a shiny frosted donut. He excitedly reaches for it, but the lid suddenly snaps shut, startling him.

Scene 2 (3–7s): He grabs the lunchbox and struggles comically with it, tumbling and rolling across muddy grass. He finally sits upright, proudly holding the donut.

Scene 3 (7–10s): Medium close-up. The raccoon smiles proudly, then slowly looks upward as he realizes someone is standing over him.

Scene 4 (10–13s): Low-angle POV reveals a large, angry tan-and-white bulldog with a wrinkled face and heavy body. The lunchbox lid is stuck on its head like a helmet. Hold on the intimidating expression.

Scene 5 (13–19s): The frightened raccoon runs away. The bulldog immediately chases him across the backyard. Use fast side-tracking camera movement, bouncing bodies, flying dirt, exaggerated leg movement, and motion blur. The raccoon eventually flies out of frame toward a large tree.

Scene 6 (19–22s): Wide shot of the quiet garden. Reveal the raccoon sitting near the tree, dazed but unharmed.

Scene 7 (22–27s): The raccoon notices a small yellow-and-black striped bee hovering near a flower. He curiously watches it, then tries to catch it with his mouth. The bee buzzes around his face while he fumbles comically.

Scene 8 (27–30s): The bee escapes safely. Cut immediately to an extreme close-up of the raccoon with enormously swollen, bright-red, glossy cartoon lips from the sting. His eyes are wide with shock and embarrassment. Hold on this ridiculous expression as the final punchline.

Animation & Camera Direction:
Expressive eye animation, squash-and-stretch body movement, believable weight, cinematic framing, smooth camera tracking, quick reaction cuts, realistic motion blur, playful slapstick timing, detailed environmental lighting, and clear visual storytelling.

Consistency Rules:
Maintain identical character design, fur, proportions, and facial features in every shot. Keep the environment consistent. No dialogue, text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

Negative Prompt:
Inconsistent character design, changing appearance, extra limbs, malformed paws, duplicate characters, warped faces, broken anatomy, incorrect animal proportions, random objects, floating objects, camera jitter, flickering textures, changing environment, poor lip shape, stiff movement, low-detail backgrounds, text, subtitles, logos, and watermarks.

entries.title: Zombie City Last Stand Action
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 30-second Hollywood-style zombie action scene titled 'Zombie City: Last Stand', utilizing reference images for characters and environment, generated with Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
One survivor. A city full of zombies. No way out. 

ZOMBIE CITY: LAST STAND — SEEDANCE 2.5 PROMPT

ENGINE DIRECTIVE: Create exactly 30 seconds of photorealistic Hollywood-style zombie action, 16:9 widescreen, 60fps where supported. Use @image1 for protagonist identity, @image2 for zombie design, and @image3 for the ruined city environment.

CHARACTER CONTINUITY: Preserve @image1's exact face, hairstyle, beard, skin tone, and body structure. Outfit: distressed olive-green field jacket, black shirt, charcoal cargo pants, black gloves, rugged combat boots, crossbody survival bag, and a steel machete. Keep the same appearance throughout.

ZOMBIES — @image2: Two distinct infected humans with pale grey-green decaying skin, cloudy eyes, damaged faces, torn dirty clothing, and aggressive movements. Zombie A wears a ripped grey shirt and dark trousers; Zombie B wears a torn burgundy hoodie and black jeans.

LOCATION — @image3: A devastated downtown street with cracked asphalt, abandoned cars, shattered storefronts, damaged buildings, scattered debris, drifting smoke, and overcast daylight. Maintain consistent geography and lighting.

TIMELINE:

00–03s: Wide cinematic reveal of the ruined city. The protagonist notices two zombies approaching from opposite sides and draws his machete.

03–06s: Zombie A charges. The protagonist dodges its grab and counters with a fast, controlled machete strike. Zombie A collapses.

06–09s: Zombie B rushes from beside an abandoned sedan, attempting to grab and bite the protagonist.

09–12s: Close handheld camera captures the protagonist blocking the attack, breaking free, and pushing Zombie B away.

12–15s: Low-angle tracking shot as Zombie B lunges again. The protagonist dodges and prepares a counterattack.

15–18s: Dynamic side tracking as the protagonist outmaneuvers the zombie on the cracked roadway.

18–21s: Zombie B attacks again. The protagonist pivots, breaks its balance, and forces it to its knees.

21–24s: He delivers a decisive final strike. Zombie B falls motionless. Keep violence non-graphic.

24–27s: The protagonist stands between both defeated zombies, breathing heavily while holding the machete.

27–30s: Close-up of his determined face, followed by a wide reveal of distant zombie silhouettes approaching through the smoky intersection. End on a suspenseful cinematic hook.

AUDIO: Original dark survival-action score, realistic footsteps, zombie snarls, weapon swishes, impacts, wind, distant alarms, and heavy breathing.

QUALITY: Stable identity, consistent wardrobe and weapons, realistic physics, cinematic camera transitions, detailed textures, natural motion blur, synchronized audio, no teleportation, no morphing, no extra limbs, no location changes, and no graphic gore.

entries.title: Night Drive Near Collision Action Sequence
entries.description: A complex prompt for generating a 30-second Hollywood-style action sequence involving a night drive and a near-collision with a truck, requiring an uploaded reference image for the driver's identity.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Hollywood-style action sequence in native 4K, 16:9, 24 FPS, featuring the person from the uploaded reference image as the driver of a sleek black luxury sedan at night.

Scene 1 – Night Drive: A beautiful illuminated highway with glowing streetlights, city lights, and cinematic reflections on the car. Begin with low-angle tracking shots of the black sedan speeding along the road.

Scene 2 – Interior Close-ups: Show the driver clearly, preserving his exact facial identity, hairstyle, beard, and appearance from the reference image. One male friend sits in the front passenger seat, with three friends in the back. Capture close-ups of the driver steering, streetlights reflecting across his face, and friends enjoying the ride.

Scene 3 – Approaching Truck: Show exterior shots of the black car moving fast. Suddenly, a massive 12-wheel truck appears in the opposite lane, approaching at high speed. Build tension with dramatic front-facing and road-level camera angles.

Scene 4 – Blinding Headlights: Switch to the driver’s POV. The truck’s powerful headlights create intense realistic glare across the windshield. Show the driver’s eyes widening, hands tightening around the steering wheel, and passengers reacting with shock.

Scene 5 – Near Collision: The two vehicles approach dangerously close. At the very last second, the driver makes a sudden steering correction, narrowly avoiding a head-on collision. The truck slightly clips the driver’s-side wing mirror, breaking it off. Show the impact in brief cinematic slow motion, with realistic glass and plastic fragments scattering.

Scene 6 – Aftermath: The car regains control and continues down the highway. The passengers look shocked. Show a close-up of the shaken driver and an exterior shot revealing the missing side mirror.

Final Shot: A beautiful rear tracking shot of the black sedan disappearing into the illuminated night highway, followed by a close-up of the driver’s serious expression.

Visual direction: Premium Hollywood action cinematography, professional cinema-camera angles, realistic vehicle physics, natural motion blur, detailed reflections, dramatic lighting, deep midnight-blue and warm amber color grading, realistic sound effects, seamless transitions, and consistent characters.

Important: Maintain the exact driver’s identity, five occupants, same car and truck throughout. Preserve realistic road positioning and vehicle movement. The only damage should be the broken driver-side mirror. No head-on crash, explosions, vehicle deformation, distorted faces, or changing characters. Make every shot feel like a real high-budget action movie.

entries.title: Cat Witch Pumpkin Prank Halloween Video
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 20-second Halloween fantasy comedy short featuring a small orange tabby cat wearing a witch hat interacting with jack-o'-lanterns.
entries.prompt:
Create a ~20-second, 16：9 vertical, 24fps live-action Halloween fantasy comedy short.
Concept: “The Cat Witch’s Prank”
Overall tone:
Cute Halloween, cat POV, light fantasy, playful chase comedy, and polished social-media short-film energy.
The mood should feel warm, mischievous, slightly magical, and funny — never scary, violent, disturbing, or horror-driven.
Keep the visuals photorealistic and cinematic, like a high-quality Halloween pet commercial.
Main Character
The main character is one small orange tabby cat.
Appearance:
Small body
Round face
Short orange tabby fur
Amber eyes
Slightly oversized black witch hat
Deep purple hat band
Small orange-and-black bow tie around the neck
The same exact cat must remain consistent throughout the entire video.
Do not change the breed, fur color, body size, face, hat, or accessories.
There is only one cat in the entire film.
No humans appear.
Camera Style
The video is primarily shown from the cat’s first-person point of view.
Keep the camera low, close to the cat’s eye level, with subtle natural movement as if the cat is sneaking through the environment.
Occasionally show:
The cat’s orange front paws
The tip or edge of the witch hat entering the top of frame
The cat’s shadow on the ground
Brief reflections of the cat in glass, windows, or metal decorations
These details should make it clear that the viewer is experiencing the scene through the witch cat.
Avoid excessive cuts.
Keep movement continuous and spatial relationships easy to follow.
0–4 sec — Sneaking Toward the Pumpkins
Halloween midnight.
A quiet suburban front porch lit by warm amber porch lights.
Three jack-o’-lanterns of different sizes sit near the front door.
The porch includes subtle Halloween decorations, a few fallen leaves, candles, and wooden steps.
From the cat’s low first-person POV, the camera slowly moves forward.
Two small orange paws carefully step across the wooden porch.
The pointed tip of the witch hat occasionally swings into the top edge of frame.
The cat quietly approaches the largest jack-o’-lantern.
Sound:
Soft paw steps on wood, distant crickets, and subtle playful sneaking music.
The cat stops directly in front of the pumpkin.
4–8 sec — The Spell
The cat lifts one front paw.
A tiny ring of soft purple magic appears just in front of the paw.
The magic should feel delicate, cute, and mischievous — not powerful or explosive.
The paw gently swipes through the air.
All three jack-o’-lanterns suddenly glow purple through their eyes.
The cat pauses for about 0.3 seconds.
The camera slowly leans closer toward one pumpkin.
The pumpkin suddenly gives a tiny shake.
The cat freezes in surprise.
Sound:
A soft “ting,” a tiny “poof,” followed by a small squeak.
8–12 sec — The Prank Goes Wrong
The largest jack-o’-lantern begins a cute magical transformation.
Do not make it explode or become grotesque.
Four tiny mouse-like feet appear underneath it.
Two small rounded mouse ears pop out from the sides.
A thin mouse tail appears behind it.
The pumpkin itself stays round, recognizable, and pumpkin-shaped.
The second and third jack-o’-lanterns transform the same way.
Now all three pumpkin mice begin scampering quickly across the porch.
From the cat POV, the camera takes one small step backward.
One pumpkin mouse turns and faces the cat.
Pause for about 0.3 seconds.
All three pumpkin mice squeak together:
“Squeak!”
Then they suddenly charge toward the cat.
12–17 sec — Reverse Chase
The cat immediately turns and runs.
The first-person camera moves quickly but remains readable and controlled as the cat runs back across the porch.
Visible in frame:
Fast-moving orange paws
The witch hat tip bouncing wildly near the top of frame
The cat’s shadow racing across the wooden floor
The camera briefly looks backward.
All three glowing pumpkin mice are chasing the cat.
Their tiny legs move rapidly while they squeak:
“Squeak, squeak, squeak!”
One pumpkin mouse runs too fast and bumps into another.
Both roll once across the porch, quickly pop back upright, and immediately continue chasing.
Keep the moment cute and slapstick, never dangerous.
The playful Halloween music speeds up into a fast comedic rhythm.
17–20 sec — Final Twist
The cat hides behind a large porch planter.
The camera slowly peeks around the edge of the planter.
Everything suddenly becomes quiet.
The three pumpkin mice are gone.
The cat relaxes.
Pause for about 0.5 seconds.
Then one tiny pumpkin mouse slowly rises into frame from directly below the camera, extremely close to the cat.
It looks up.
“Squeak?”
The cat suddenly jerks backward in surprise.
The witch hat falls off and lands directly in front of the camera.
CUT TO BLACK.
Final sound:
One surprised “Meow!”
Then a tiny comedic magical “poof.”
Visual Direction
Photorealistic live-action pet cinematography.
Color palette:
Warm orange pumpkin light, deep blue nighttime shadows, and subtle purple magic accents.
The pumpkin mice should feel:
Cute, round, tactile, believable, and lightly magical.
They must not have:
Sharp teeth, disturbing faces, grotesque features, blood, or horror elements.
The cat’s movements must follow realistic feline behavior:
Light footsteps, natural pauses, believable body reactions, realistic running, and natural ear and tail responses.
Magic effects should stay small, elegant, clean, and playful.
Avoid oversized fantasy VFX.
Sound Design
No human dialogue.
Use:
Soft cat paw sounds
Small meows
Mouse squeaks
Light magical ting and poof effects
Pumpkin rolling sounds
Witch hat falling sound
Playful Halloween background music
Music pacing:
Sneaky and quiet at first, faster during the transformation, energetic and comedic during the chase, then suddenly quiet before the final punchline.
Avoid
No humans.
No second cat.
No breed changes.
No cat transforming into a human.
No talking cat.
No realistic horror monsters.
No blood.
No injuries.
No sharp teeth.
No disturbing faces.
No horror sound design.
No extreme camera shake.
No pumpkin explosions.
No extra limbs.
No subtitles.
No logos.
No watermarks.

entries.title: Pixar Style Ultrasound Comedy Video
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 15-second 3D animated comedy video featuring a couple reacting to multiple babies on an ultrasound screen.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second high-quality 3D animated comedy video in a polished Pixar-inspired family animation style. Set the scene inside a warm, modern hospital maternity room. Maintain consistent character designs, facial features, clothing, and proportions throughout the video.

Scene 1 (0–2 seconds):
Close-up of a pregnant woman's belly during an ultrasound examination. A doctor holds an ultrasound scanner against her belly while the monitor in the background displays a cute animated baby moving and waving.

Scene 2 (2–4 seconds):
Reveal an excited young couple beside the examination bed. The husband is a handsome young man with messy brown hair, round glasses, and a blue shirt. His pregnant wife has blonde shoulder-length hair and wears a soft pink maternity outfit. Both look excited as they watch the ultrasound screen.

Scene 3 (4–6 seconds):
Cut to a close-up of the husband's face. His expression suddenly changes from excitement to complete shock. His eyes widen, his mouth drops open, and he raises one hand in disbelief as he realizes something unexpected.

Scene 4 (6–9 seconds):
Show the ultrasound monitor displaying multiple adorable babies instead of just one. Three or four cute animated babies appear together, smiling, waving their tiny hands, and moving playfully. The couple is completely surprised.

Scene 5 (9–12 seconds):
Cut to the pregnant wife looking shocked and confused. Her eyes widen, her mouth opens, and she gestures toward her husband as if asking him what is happening. The husband appears overwhelmed and dramatically falls backward onto the hospital floor.

Scene 6 (12–15 seconds):
Wide shot of the maternity room. The pregnant woman sits on the examination bed in disbelief while a female medical professional stands beside her. The husband lies dramatically on the floor after fainting from shock. Finish with a close-up of the ultrasound monitor showing the adorable babies waving happily.

Visual Style: Premium 3D animated family comedy, expressive cartoon facial animations, realistic fabric textures, soft cinematic lighting, warm hospital environment, smooth character movements, exaggerated comedic reactions, detailed ultrasound monitor, vibrant colors, professional animation quality.

Camera: Smooth cinematic camera movements, close-ups, reaction shots, and wide shots with seamless transitions.

Format: Vertical 9:16, 4K resolution, 24 FPS, approximately 15 seconds.

Important: Make the humor come from the unexpected multiple-babies ultrasound reveal and the father's exaggerated fainting reaction. No subtitles, no logos, no watermarks.

entries.title: Sakura Telekinetic Hay Bales
entries.description: A specific prompt for Seedance 2.5 describing a scene where a character named Sakura uses telekinesis to lift and stack hay bales in an autumn pasture, interacting with a teacher. Includes technical parameters like resolution and frame rate.
entries.prompt:
Seedance 2.5 /16:9/480p/24fps
【プロンプト短縮版】
秋の晴れた昼、山あいの牧草地。干し草を丸く巻いた巨大な牧草ロールが6個。さくらが手のひらを向けた先で、ロールが草から少しだけ浮いて揺れている。先を歩いていた先生が振り向いた瞬間、ドスンと落ちる。さくらは手を背中に隠してとぼける。先生が両手と肩で押してみせ、2人で押しても、のろのろとしか転がらない。先生が縄を取りに小屋へ行ったすきに、手をかざすと1個がふわりと浮いて宙をすべる。調子に乗って両手を振ると、6個ぜんぶが浮き上がる。

6個が頭上で輪になって回りだす。下ろそうと手を振るほど跳ねて、小屋の屋根すれすれをかすめる。戻ってきた先生が縄を落とし、さくらの腕を下ろさせて、肩を落として息を吐いてみせる。力が抜けると、ロールが空中で止まる。先生が小屋の横を指さして、両手で三角を作る。さくらがそっと手を動かすと、1個ずつ下りてきて、下に3個、上に2個、てっぺんに1個。小屋の屋根より高いピラミッドができる。

一緒に来た友達が、すぐそばから手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、BGMなし。画面に出るのは二人だけ。ロールは全編で6個、横倒しの向きのまま。光やオーラは足さず、重い物が浮くだけにした。牧草地・先生・浮いたロール・積み上がりは参照画像、続きは前のパートの実際のコマを参照にした。

Just as the teacher walking ahead turns around, they drop with a thud. Sakura hides her hands behind her back, playing innocent. The teacher demonstrates pushing with both hands and shoulders; even when the two push together, they only roll slowly. While the teacher goes to the shed to get rope, Sakura raises her hand, and one roll floats gently and slides through the air. Getting carried away, she waves both hands, and all 6 rolls lift up.

The 6 rolls begin to circle above their heads. They bounce higher the more she tries to lower them, grazing just above the shed roof. The returning teacher drops the rope, lowers Sakura's arms, slumps his shoulders, and exhales. As tension leaves, the rolls stop in mid-air. The teacher points beside the shed and makes a triangle with both hands. Sakura moves her hand gently, and the rolls descend one by one: 3 at the bottom, 2 in the middle, 1 on top. A pyramid taller than the shed roof is formed.

Recorded handheld by a friend who came along, from nearby. Each cut is around 2 seconds, no BGM. Only the two people appear on screen. Throughout, there are 6 rolls, remaining on their sides. No light or aura added; just heavy objects floating. Pasture, teacher, floating rolls, and stacking are reference images; continuation refers to actual frames from the previous part.

entries.title: Cinematic Horror Short: The Quiet Ones
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 15-second vertical cinematic horror short featuring a woman and a ghost on a Halloween porch, focusing on atmosphere and specific character details.
entries.prompt:
Create a native 15-second, vertical 9:16 cinematic horror short. No reference image. No text, no captions, no logos. Clear simple story, every shot readable without sound.

CORE RULES
One adult woman, one ghost figure in a white sheet, one house: the front porch and the front hallway. Nobody else appears. The ghost never shows a face, hands or feet. Calm, slow, building dread, then a final scare.

CHARACTER
Lena, 27 years old, clearly adult, long dark wavy hair, pale skin, dark red lipstick, natural beautiful face, fitted black long-sleeve top, black high-waist jeans, black ankle boots. She holds a round black ceramic candy bowl full of orange and black wrapped candy.

FACE
Natural skin texture, real expressions: warm smile, then polite confusion, then slow fear, then pure terror. Mouth opens only moderately, only upper teeth show. Eyes stay sharp and alive. Head turns under 45 degrees.

GHOST
An adult-height figure fully covered by a plain old white bedsheet with two small black eye holes. It holds a small black trick-or-treat bowl through the sheet, the hands are never visible. It stands completely still and silent. The bottom hem of the sheet floats about 3 cm above the porch boards, with only darkness under it.

VOICE
Lena: soft, friendly, natural American English, then a shaky whisper.

CAMERA
Real cinema camera, slow controlled moves, shallow depth of field, gentle slow push-ins. Shots are clean and steady.

LOOK
Dark moody cinematic Halloween night: deep teal and blue night tones outside, warm orange light from the porch lamp and a carved pumpkin, warm yellow wall sconce inside. Soft film grain, rich contrast, deep but readable shadows. Faces always clearly lit.

SETTING
A classic American suburban house on Halloween night. Front porch: white wooden railing, old wooden boards with fallen leaves, a glowing carved jack-o-lantern by the door, a warm porch lamp. Behind: a quiet foggy street, bare trees, a full moon, distant houses with lit windows. Inside: a narrow front hallway with dark wood floor, a staircase on the left, a brass wall sconce, a small side table.

MOTION
Natural human weight and timing. The ghost is completely motionless except where stated. The sheet only moves when the wind moves it.

DEFECT PREVENTION
Hands: Lena holds the candy bowl with both hands, LEFT hand under it, RIGHT hand free only to drop the candy and to slam the door. Five fingers per hand.
Face: her face, hair and lipstick stay identical in every shot.
Ghost: never shows hands, feet, face or legs. Same sheet, same eye holes in every shot.
Objects: one candy bowl (hers), one small black bowl (ghost), one candy, one pumpkin, one door. Nothing duplicates or vanishes except the ghost disappearing as stated.
Continuity: same outfit, same night, same porch, same hallway in every shot.
Physics: candy falls with real gravity. The empty sheet collapses softly like real fabric.

STORYBOARD
00:00.0-00:02.0 Shot 1, wide from inside the hallway toward the front door. The doorbell rings. Lena walks to the door with the candy bowl and opens it, smiling. Through the open door, the ghost stands on the porch under the orange porch lamp, motionless, bowl held out.
00:02.0-00:05.0 Shot 2, over Lena's shoulder onto the ghost. She smiles: "Aww, cute costume!" She drops one orange candy into the ghost's bowl. The ghost does not move or say anything.
00:05.0-00:07.5 Shot 3, close-up on Lena. Her smile slowly fades. She tilts her head: "Where are your parents?" Silence. Only wind.
00:07.5-00:09.5 Shot 4, slow tilt down the sheet to the porch boards: the hem floats above the floor, nothing underneath, no feet, no shadow. Leaves blow under it.
00:09.5-00:11.0 Shot 5, wide on the porch. A gust of wind. The sheet collapses flat onto the porch boards, completely empty. The black bowl drops and the candy rolls out.
00:11.0-00:13.0 Shot 6, inside. Lena steps back and slams the door shut with her RIGHT hand, then leans her back against it, breathing fast, eyes closed, clutching the candy bowl.
00:13.0-00:15.0 Shot 7, wide down the hallway from behind Lena. She opens her eyes, still facing the camera. Far behind her, at the end of the dark hallway under the brass sconce, the same white sheet ghost stands perfectly still, facing her. She does not see it. The sconce flickers once.

SOUND
Doorbell, creaking door, wind and dry leaves, candy clinking into the bowl, a long silence, soft fabric falling, the door slamming, her fast breathing, one low deep hum and a light flicker buzz at the end.

FINAL FEEL
A clean, clear, beautifully shot Halloween horror short with a chilling final reveal. Not polished influencer content.

entries.title: Romantic Drama at Red Light Intersection
entries.description: A detailed cinematic video prompt for a romantic drama scene where two former lovers meet at a busy intersection, triggering a montage of happy memories before parting ways.
entries.prompt:
THE RED LIGHT: WE USED TO BE US

DURATION: 30 SECONDS
ASPECT RATIO: 16:9 LANDSCAPE
STYLE: Ultra-realistic live-action romantic drama, premium cinematic photography, Japanese romance film atmosphere, natural performances, subtle 35mm film grain, realistic skin texture, cinematic color grading.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
@image1 = Male protagonist, the woman's former boyfriend.
@image2 = Female protagonist, the man's former girlfriend.

STRICT IDENTITY LOCK:
Preserve both characters' exact facial identities, facial structures, hairstyles, and recognizable features throughout every scene. Their clothing may change naturally between present and past, but their faces must remain consistent. No face swapping, identity mixing, or character duplication.

STORY:
Two former lovers unexpectedly encounter each other at a busy city intersection. A brief exchange of glances triggers a rapid montage of their happiest memories. When the traffic light turns green, reality returns. They pass each other silently and continue in opposite directions.

SCENE 1 — AN UNEXPECTED ENCOUNTER
00:00–00:05

Late afternoon at a busy Japanese urban intersection. Red traffic lights, waiting pedestrians, passing cars, storefront reflections, and soft sunlight create a realistic cinematic atmosphere.

Begin with a wide establishing shot, then slowly push through the waiting crowd toward @image1. He looks across the street and suddenly freezes.

POV shot: @image2 stands on the opposite side. She recognizes him at the same moment.

Alternate close-ups of their faces. Their expressions shift subtly from surprise to quiet recognition. They maintain eye contact without speaking.

The surrounding traffic sounds become slightly muffled.

TRANSITION:
Push toward @image2's eyes. As she blinks, use a precise match cut to the same eye movement in a memory of her laughing at @image1 in a sunlit coffee shop.

SCENE 2 — THE FIRST MEMORY
00:05–00:09

FLASHBACK: A cozy coffee shop with warm afternoon sunlight, amber highlights, soft shadows, and subtle analog film texture.

@image1 slides a drink across a wooden table. @image2 takes a sip, mischievously steals his drink, and laughs. He pretends to be annoyed before smiling.

Use intimate handheld medium shots and close-ups of their natural expressions.

TRANSITION:
The coffee cup fills the frame and match cuts into the circular surface of an umbrella during a rainy-day memory.

SCENE 3 — MEMORIES IN MOTION
00:09–00:19

A rapid, sweet nostalgia montage. Each memory lasts approximately 0.5–1 second. Use seamless match cuts, natural movement, foreground objects, and coherent visual transitions.

MEMORY 1 — SHARING AN UMBRELLA:
@image1 holds an umbrella over @image2 while walking through light rain. His shoulder gets wet. She notices, moves closer, and laughs.
Transition: A raindrop on the umbrella match cuts into sunlight reflected on a train window.

MEMORY 2 — THE TRAIN RIDE:
They sit beside each other on a moving train, sharing earphones. @image2 rests her head on his shoulder. He glances at her with a gentle smile.
Transition: The train enters a dark tunnel, creating a natural full-frame transition.

MEMORY 3 — COOKING TOGETHER:
In a small home kitchen, @image1 struggles with a simple meal. @image2 laughs and playfully teases him. He jokingly defends his cooking.
Transition: A kitchen towel briefly covers the lens before revealing the next memory.

MEMORY 4 — THE BEACH:
They run along a beautiful beach during golden hour. @image2 runs ahead, turns around, and invites him to catch up. He follows, laughing.
Use a low-angle tracking shot of their feet in the sand, followed by a wide coastal shot.
Transition: A wave rushes toward the camera until water and foam fill the entire frame.

MEMORY 5 — THE NIGHT FESTIVAL:
Warm lanterns illuminate their faces. @image2 grabs @image1's hand and pulls him toward colorful festival stalls. They turn toward each other and laugh.
Use handheld tracking, warm bokeh, and candid close-ups.
Transition: A glowing lantern passes directly in front of the lens, briefly obscuring the entire frame.

MEMORY 6 — THE LITTLE MOMENT:
They sit together on a park bench at sunset. @image2 rests her head on his shoulder. @image1 gently moves a loose strand of hair away from her face. They exchange warm smiles.

This is the montage's most intimate memory.

TRANSITION BACK TO PRESENT:
Sunlight reflecting on their faces match cuts into the red traffic signal reflected on a passing car window. Warm colors instantly return to the cooler palette of the present.

SCENE 4 — THE YELLOW LIGHT
00:19–00:24

Back at the intersection. @image1 and @image2 are still looking at each other.

City ambience gradually returns. The traffic light changes from red to yellow.

Alternate close-ups show quiet affection, recognition, and restrained sadness.

@image2 gives a barely noticeable smile. @image1 gently returns it.

Insert one final flashback lasting approximately 0.5 seconds: the couple walking hand in hand beneath golden sunlight, laughing together.

Immediately match cut back to the present, where their hands hang separately at their sides.

No dialogue. No tears. Let the contrast tell the story.

SCENE 5 — THE GREEN LIGHT
00:24–00:30

The traffic light turns green. Pedestrians begin crossing from both sides.

@image1 and @image2 walk toward each other among the moving crowd.

Use a controlled lateral tracking shot, keeping both characters visible as they approach.

They pass each other. Their shoulders nearly touch, but they do not make contact.

For a brief moment, their expressions soften with recognition. Neither stops. Neither speaks. They continue in opposite directions.

ENDING SHOT:
The camera remains stationary as the crowd gradually separates them.

@image1 disappears into the crowd on one side. @image2 disappears into the crowd on the other.

Hold the wide composition as ordinary pedestrians continue crossing and the city resumes its rhythm.

End naturally without a fade to black, title card, or text.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
Present day: cooler, restrained colors, realistic city lighting, slightly desaturated tones.
Flashbacks: warm golden sunlight, soft highlights, subtle 35mm film grain, natural colors, intimate handheld cinematography.

CAMERA:
Wide establishing shots, controlled dolly-ins, intimate close-ups, lateral tracking, natural handheld movement, shallow depth of field, realistic motion blur, and seamless match cuts.

All flashbacks must feature the same recognizable characters. Their past clothing may differ from their present clothing, but their identities must remain unchanged.

AUDIO:
NO BACKGROUND MUSIC.
Use natural city traffic, footsteps, cafe ambience, rain, train sounds, kitchen ambience, waves, and distant festival sounds. Connect memories with brief natural sound bridges. Restore the city ambience when the traffic light changes to green.

No narration, no dialogue, no lyrics.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS:
No identity drift, face swapping, duplicate characters, artificial expressions, robotic movement, excessive slow motion, fantasy portals, random transitions, plastic skin, exaggerated crying, text overlays, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

FINAL EMOTIONAL GOAL:
The audience should feel the sweetness of a relationship returning through a few seconds of memory, followed by the quiet realization that the two people can no longer return to the life they once shared.

The memories should make the audience smile. The ending should leave a gentle ache without explaining everything.

[LOCATION & ATMOSPHERE]
A hanok-style courtyard market in an old Korean town at dusk, just after rain. Wet grey flagstones with shallow puddles, dark timber pillars, curved tiled roofs, plaster walls, canvas-covered produce stalls, stacked bamboo crates, a stone well in the center, and a stone staircase on the left leading up to a lantern-lit lane. Paper lanterns and hanging bulbs give warm amber light against cool slate-blue ambient dusk. Light mist rises off the stones. Palette is muted indigo, slate, amber and earth tones. Absolutely no neon, no glowing signs, no colored light.

[CINEMATIC STYLE]
Premium photorealistic action cinema, 35 mm anamorphic look, 40° field of view on wide shots and 28° on close shots, organic grain, natural motion blur, soft highlight roll-off, realistic skin, wet cloth, fabric, metal and stone textures. Natural, restrained color grade. No glossy CGI finish.

[ACTION & CAMERA]
0–5s: Wide, low, front-facing tracking shot. Seo-yeon walks slowly down the stone staircase with the closed umbrella in her right hand, its steel tip tapping each step. Seven opponents wait in the courtyard below. Opponent 7 (charcoal coat) says in a low, amused tone: "You walked into the wrong market tonight." She tilts her head slightly and answers calmly: "Then I'll leave it a little tidier." Opponents 1 and 2 charge. She steps off the last stair, flicks the umbrella around so the brass hook catches Opponent 1's ankle, and pulls sharply. He drops flat on the wet stone with a splash. Camera drops with the pull.

5–10s: Opponent 2 swings a wild haymaker. She ducks and snaps the umbrella open right in his face. The canopy bursts open with a spray of rainwater and blinds him. From behind the canopy she lands a spinning heel kick on his shoulder, sending him sliding across a puddle. She snaps the umbrella shut in one motion. Camera orbits 180° around the canopy burst in one smooth arc, catching water droplets in the air.

10–15s: Opponents 3 and 4 flank from the market stalls. She burst-steps forward in one explosive sprint, a streak of water spraying from her sneakers, and reappears between them. A short jab with the steel tip into Opponent 3's raised forearm, then the brass hook catches Opponent 4's collar and she swings him sideways into a stack of bamboo crates, which tumbles lightly. Camera whip-pans left, then right, and settles behind her shoulder.

15–20s: Opponent 5 (rust coverall) charges like a bull. She runs at the plaster wall, takes two steps up it, flips backward over his head, and opens the umbrella mid-flip so she drifts down behind him in a soft, controlled landing. She closes it as her feet touch and drives the shaft into the back of his knees. He falls forward into a canvas stall, which sags and splashes rainwater from its tarp. Camera follows the wall-run in a tight vertical tilt, then drops to the landing.

20–25s: Opponent 6 (olive bomber) hurls a wooden stool at her. She snaps the umbrella open as a shield and the stool bounces off the canopy and clatters away. She spins the open umbrella once, flinging a wide arc of trapped rainwater into Opponents 6 and 3's faces, then snaps it shut and blocks Opponent 6's punch with the shaft held crosswise in both hands. She twists and flicks her away with a sharp one-handed rotation. Opponent 6 slides back across the wet stone. Camera pushes in tight on the shield-open, then pulls wide.

She springs up at the stone well in the center of the courtyard, steps onto its rim, and plants the closed umbrella's tip beside her foot. Water streams off the canopy. Opponents 7 and 1 stand ahead of her, breathing hard, while the others recover behind. She is breathing steadily, eyes locked forward. HOLD this exact final frame for the last half second.

Medium-wide frame, 40° field of view, camera at chest height in front of her at about 5 m. Her weight is slightly forward, ponytail swaying to the left. Opponent 7 (charcoal coat) is on the left at about 4 m, Opponent 1 on the right at about 3 m, the rest staggered behind them. Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic underwater fantasy adventure in vertical 9:16 format, approximately 30 seconds long, filmed from a first-person POV.

The enormous creature emerges slowly from the shadows, revealing intricate scales, glowing blue eyes, and powerful horns. The dragon remains calm and affectionate, creating a heartwarming final moment. End with an extreme close-up of its shimmering scales and mesmerizing blue eyes.

entries.prompt:
Cinematic Cat & Dog Motorcycle Stunt

Use all 3 reference images:

Image 1: Exact motorcycle design.
Image 2: Cat as the motorcycle driver.
Image 3: Dog as the passenger behind the cat.

Create a photorealistic, high-energy, 17-second motorcycle stunt sequence with premium Hollywood action cinematography.

0–3s: Explosive Launch
Start with an ultra-low camera skimming the asphalt as the motorcycle accelerates toward the lens. Track backward at speed, then execute a precise whip-pan to reveal the cat driving and the dog riding behind.

3–6s: High-Speed Cornering
Track alongside the motorcycle as it leans into a sweeping turn. Capture spinning wheels, tire grip, road motion blur, and aggressive but controlled camera movement.

6–9s: Heroic Wheelie
The cat lifts the front wheel in a controlled wheelie while the rear tire stays on the road. Drop the camera low and tilt upward for a powerful action-movie perspective.

9–13s: Epic Ramp Jump
The motorcycle launches off a stunt ramp. Track the entire jump continuously, rising from a low side angle into a dramatic aerial three-quarter view. Both animals stay securely on the bike.

13–15s: Impact Landing
Follow the motorcycle down as both tires reconnect with the road. Show realistic suspension compression, tire grip, a small burst of dust, and one synchronized camera jolt.

15–17s: Full-Throttle Escape
Switch to a low rear chase shot as the motorcycle accelerates toward the open road. Finish with both animals and the bike clearly visible.

Visual direction: Photorealistic live-action, wide-angle action cinematography, dynamic tracking, realistic physics, dramatic perspective, natural motion blur, and seamless spatial continuity.

Continuity rules: Preserve the exact cat, dog, and motorcycle from the references. The cat always drives; the dog remains the passenger. No morphing, extra animals, duplicated limbs, distorted wheels, teleportation, hidden cuts, or impossible midair movements.

Audio: Powerful cinematic action music, realistic engine revs, tire-on-road sounds, wind rush, and a punchy landing impact synchronized with the action. No unrelated mechanical sounds.

entries.description: A detailed cinematic video prompt for generating a 30-second ultra-realistic clip of a Korean woman's Halloween night in Seoul using Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic video starring a stylish young adult Korean woman living alone in a modern Seoul apartment on Halloween, October 31.

She wakes up in her cozy bedroom as warm morning sunlight fills the room. She reaches for her smartphone, checks the calendar showing October 31 — Halloween, and smiles excitedly.

She walks into a modern bathroom, ties her hair back, and washes her face. At an illuminated vanity mirror, she applies foundation, smoky eye makeup, black eyeliner, dark-red lipstick, and delicate spiderweb makeup near one eye.

一緒に来た友達が、すぐそばから手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、セリフ・字幕・BGMなし。画面に出るのは二人だけ。斧は1本、止まる丸太は3本。光やオーラは足さず、物が止まるだけにした。斧が当たる瞬間は寄りで撮った。裏庭・衣装・先生・浮いた丸太は参照画像、後半は前半の実際のコマを参照にした。

entries.title: Korean Travel Vlog Script Prompt
entries.description: A detailed script-based prompt for Seedance 2.5 (via Flova.ai) featuring a Korean travel vlogger on a volcanic hilltop. Includes character locks, location references, and timed scene descriptions.
entries.prompt:
PART 1 (30 seconds)

CHARACTER
Use @image 1 and @image 2 as the Master Identity Lock. Keep her face, hair, skin tone, outfit (cream knit cardigan, sage-olive cargo pants, white sneakers, beige bucket hat, tan backpack) and body proportions exactly the same throughout. No identity drift.

LOCATION
Use @image 3 as the environment reference: a windy volcanic hilltop on a Korean island with golden silver-grass, low black stone walls, and a wooden lookout over the sea. Soft late-morning sunlight, light sea breeze, gentle clouds. Keep the same light and weather for the whole video.

STYLE
A spontaneous travel vlog filmed by a friend following just behind and beside her, with slight natural shake, smooth reframing, and candid expressions. Realistic live action, not stylized.

VOICE AND PERFORMANCE
Native Korean speech, natural conversational tone, accurate lip-sync. Every line is performed with visible emotion: the eyebrows, eyes, mouth, and breathing all react to what she feels. Her expression should change before, during, and after each line, with no flat or robotic delivery.

TIMECODE AND SCENES

00:00–00:04 | The Trailhead
She walks along a stone-wall path through tall silver-grass. She glances at the lens, eyes lighting up, eyebrows lifting, and says with bright, bubbly excitement and a rising pitch: "정상이 나를 부르고 있어!" (The summit is calling me!) She ends with a proud, wide grin and a small fist pump. Camera follows from the front at a medium shot.

00:04–00:08 | The Wobble
She tries a slow, cool model walk. Her sneaker catches a small pebble and she wobbles slightly. Her eyes go wide for a split second, then she freezes in a proud “ta-da” pose, holding a stiff, tight smile with flushed cheeks. She says in a deadpan whisper through the smile, eyes darting sideways: “…의도한 거야.” (…I meant to do that.) Camera drifts closer to catch her face.

00:08–00:12 | The Pony
A brown Jeju pony grazes beside the path. She crouches to take a selfie with it, but the pony calmly turns its back to her. Her jaw drops in mock offense, her lower lip pushes into a pout, and she says in a wounded, dramatic tone: "진짜? 얼굴도 안 보여 주는 거야?" (Seriously? You won’t even show me your face?) Then she bursts into helpless laughter, shoulders shaking. Camera: low angle, then a quick pan to her reaction.

00:12–00:17 | Grass Tunnel
The path narrows into tall silver-grass. She pushes through, disappears behind it, then pops out making hand-binoculars and scanning the horizon with a squinted, ultra-serious explorer face. She gasps softly, thrilled, as if she has spotted something. Camera follows from behind, then swings around to the front.

00:17–00:22 | The Wind Hits
She climbs a few stone steps to the crater rim and spreads her arms, eyes closed, face lifted in blissful relief. A gust throws her hair across her face. She pulls a strand from her mouth, scrunches her nose, and laughs. Wide shot, then a medium close-up.

00:22–00:27 | The Seagull
She flaps her elbows like a seagull with a goofy, beaming face. She stops, points at the lens with a playful, challenging look, chin lifted and eyebrows raised, and says in a teasing sing-song voice: "너도 해 봐!" (You try!) Camera circles in a gentle quarter turn, with the sea visible behind her.

00:27–00:30 | Final Frame (hold exactly)
She steps onto the small wooden lookout. A sudden gust blows her hat off and she catches it in mid-air with a surprised gasp and wide eyes. She crouches beside the rope railing, holding the hat against her knee, looking into the lens, laugh fading to a breathless, happy smile. Medium shot, slightly low angle, ocean and soft clouds behind her, camera steady for the last second.

AUDIO
Wind across the grass, soft footsteps on gravel, fabric rustle, pony snort, distant waves, spontaneous laughter. No background music.

NEGATIVE
No face or outfit changes, no real falls, no dangerous actions, no teleporting, no location jumps, no body distortion, no glitches, no CGI look, no stiff movement, no flat or emotionless dialogue, no lip-sync mismatch, no neon or glowing colors.

FORMAT: 16:9 | 30s | 4K | 24 FPS | Ultra-realistic live action | Natural handheld

PART 2 (15 seconds)

Use the very last frame of Part 1 as the first frame / @image 4.

CONTINUITY LOCK
Start from exactly the frame in @image 4: she is crouched beside the rope railing on the wooden lookout, holding her hat, looking into the lens with a fading smile. Same pose, same camera angle, same light, same wind, same background. No cut, no reset. Keep the identity from @image 1 and @image 2 and the outfit identical.

VOICE AND PERFORMANCE
Native Korean speech, natural tone, accurate lip-sync, with emotion visible on her face and in her breath for every line.

TIMECODE AND SCENES

00:00–00:03 | Picking Up
Without a cut, she stands up, puts the hat back on, and tilts her head toward the steps with a cheerful, bouncy energy. She says in a light, breathless voice: "내려가면 간식이다, 가자!" (Snacks are waiting downhill, let’s go!) Camera stays at her medium shot and follows.

00:03–00:07 | The Balance Beam
Back on the trail, she steps onto a low black stone wall and walks along it with arms out like a gymnast, tongue slightly between her teeth in concentration. She keeps it low and safe, then hops off with a small, proud landing and a triumphant “yes!” face. Camera follows from the side, then moves behind her.

00:07–00:11 | Snack Review
She sits on the wall, takes a triangle kimbap from her backpack, and bites in. She closes her eyes, chews slowly, savoring it, and nods with solemn drama like a food critic. Her eyes open wide and she turns to the lens, saying in a hushed, awestruck voice: "별 다섯 개." (Five stars.) Wind ruffles her hair. Close-up, then medium shot.

00:11–00:15 | The Quiet Ending
She stands, walks toward the camera with a mischievous half-smile, leans in, puts a finger to her lips, and whispers with sparkling, conspiratorial eyes: "비밀이야." (It’s a secret.) She gently tilts the lens up toward the open sky and soft clouds, and the shot slowly settles as the wind fades into silence.

AUDIO
Wind, footsteps on gravel, kimbap wrapper crinkle, distant waves, soft laughter, ending in quiet ambience. No background music.

NEGATIVE
No cut or reset at the start, no face or outfit changes, no location or lighting change, no dangerous balancing, no glitches, no CGI look, no flat or emotionless dialogue, no lip-sync mismatch, no neon or glowing colors.

entries.description: A detailed prompt for creating a realistic 15-second casual UGC vlog-style skincare video using Seedance 2.5. It specifies camera movements, dialogue timing, and strict adherence to reference images for character and product consistency.
entries.prompt: Create a realistic 15-second casual UGC vlog-style skincare video based on the first frame and 16-panel storyboard reference image. The video should feel like a normal morning routine filmed on an iPhone, where the creator casually uses the serum and briefly mentions it, not like a scripted advertisement.Keep the same woman from the reference photo, same casual home setting, and same small frosted glass serum bottle consistent throughout the video. The product should appear naturally on the desk, in her hand, or near the mirror, but it should not be treated like a perfect commercial hero object in every shot. The 16-panel storyboard image is only a visual reference for camera angles, casual movement, product placement, facial expressions, and authentic UGC mood. Do not generate a split-screen video, do not show grid lines, and do not recreate the 16-panel layout in the final video.Use varied iPhone-style camera movement: handheld selfie opening, table-height wide shot, over-the-shoulder mirror angle, casual push-in, close-up of opening the bottle, quick texture shot, mirror application shot, tabletop sliding B-roll, low table-level foreground shot, and final casual pull-back. Keep the framing slightly imperfect and natural.Dialogue:0:00- 0:03: "I'm just getting ready, but I wanted to show you this."0:03-0:06: "I've been using it for a few mornings now."0:06-0:09: "It feels really light, not sticky."0:09-0:12: "I just use a tiny bit before makeup."0:12-0:15: "Honestly, it's been easy to keep in my routine."Avoid polished advertising style, scripted sales tone, perfect model posing, over- centered product shots, luxury commercial lighting, plastic skin, over-smoothed face, extra people, extra bottles, text, logo, watermark, and fake readable brand text.

entries.title: Ghost Noodle Horror Comedy
entries.description: A prompt for a horror-comedy video of a girl eating noodles and encountering a ghost on a cabinet, generated with Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second photorealistic live-action horror-comedy video 

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic cinematic live-action, natural human acting, realistic skin and hair, believable body movements, natural bedroom lighting, subtle horror atmosphere, realistic shadows, realistic cockroach movement, realistic noodle physics, cinematic depth of field. The horror should feel believable at first, then naturally turn into unexpected comedy.

CHARACTER:
A young woman with long dark hair, natural makeup, and simple comfortable home clothes. Keep her face, hairstyle, clothing and appearance exactly consistent in every shot.

GHOST:
A creepy female ghost with very long messy black hair, pale skin, dark tired-looking eyes and old grey clothing. She is sitting quietly on top of a tall wooden cabinet. Her movements are slow and natural, not exaggerated or supernatural.

LOCATION:
A realistic cozy bedroom at night. Bed beside a tall wooden cabinet, warm bedside lamp, slightly dark corners, realistic household objects and furniture.

SCENE 1 — 0–6 SEC

The girl enters her bedroom naturally while holding a cup of instant noodles and chopsticks.

She sits down near the bed and comfortably starts eating the noodles directly from the cup.

She looks relaxed and enjoys the food. Her movements should feel completely natural, like an ordinary night at home.

CAMERA:
Natural medium shot, slight handheld cinematic movement.

SOUND:
Soft footsteps, chopsticks, realistic noodle-eating sounds and quiet room ambience.

MUSIC:
Very subtle calm nighttime ambience. No horror music.

DIALOGUE:
No dialogue.

SCENE 2 — 6–9 SEC

The girl casually looks forward.

The camera reveals a tall wooden cabinet directly ahead.

A creepy female ghost is sitting silently on TOP OF THE CABINET.

She has been there the entire time.

The ghost looks down toward the girl without moving much.

CAMERA:
Slow reveal from the cabinet toward the ghost.

MUSIC:
A very low, subtle horror drone begins.

entries.title: Orbit to Street Seamless Transition
entries.description: A prompt for a seamless one-take camera movement from Earth's orbit to a street scene with four women posing. Created with Seedance 2.5 on WizstarAI.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic video using a continuous, seamless one-take camera movement.

0–2s: Start in Earth's orbit and perform an extreme crash zoom through the clouds, sweeping past retro city skylines and tall brick buildings. Absolutely no cuts, stutters, or interruptions.

2–4s: Descend into a cobblestone street intersection. Reveal four young women walking confidently toward the camera, clearly visible in the frame.

4–10s: The camera smoothly swoops closer and settles in front of them. They naturally slow down, come to a complete stop, and transition into distinct poses matching Image 1.

Character actions (left to right):
• Denim jacket + cargo pants: Stops, removes hands from pockets, and crosses arms over the chest.
• Olive utility vest + ripped jeans: Steps forward, stops, and slides hands into front pockets.
• Plaid shirt + neck scarf + trousers: Completes the final half-step, adjusts the scarf, and puts hands into pockets.
• Black leather jacket + black pants: Stops confidently, removes hands from pockets, and crosses arms tightly.

Environment: Vintage city corner, brownstone buildings, classic street clock, cinematic lighting, realistic fabric movement, natural body mechanics, detailed textures, and 8K visual quality.

Key requirement: Preserve character consistency, natural walking-to-stopping transitions, and uninterrupted camera motion throughout the entire 10-second sequence.

entries.description: A prompt for a photorealistic 30-second vlog of a stylish Korean woman eating cotton candy in Seoul, styled like early-2000s MiniDV footage, generated with Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 30-second personal vlog featuring the same stylish young Korean woman in her early 20s enjoying a playful afternoon on the streets of Seoul.

CHARACTER: Long black hair in a loose ponytail, realistic skin texture, glossy lips, subtle makeup, fitted baby-pink top, low-rise jeans, silver jewelry, and black sneakers. Maintain consistent facial identity and outfit.

STORY: She walks confidently down a colorful shopping street, holding a giant pink cotton candy. She takes a bite, notices the sugar sticking to her lips, and gives the camera a cheeky smirk. She spins the cotton candy playfully, accidentally gets a little on her fingers, and laughs while trying to clean them. Passing a street vendor, she buys a blue cotton candy, holds both colors beside her face, and poses like a playful baddie. She ends by walking away while looking back at the camera with a confident smile.

VISUAL STYLE: Early-2000s MiniDV footage, 4:3 aspect ratio, handheld camera shake, imperfect framing, faded colors, natural sunlight, subtle grain, authentic candid moments.

AUDIO: Street ambience, footsteps, vendor chatter, wrapper sounds, and natural laughter. No music or narration.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: No face drift, distorted hands, unnatural expressions, CGI, anime, beauty filters, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

entries.title: Post-Apocalyptic Car Chase Short
entries.description: A complex narrative video prompt for a 30-second post-apocalyptic short film involving a character named Alin stealing a key from Ston, with detailed scene breakdowns, reference locks, and cinematography instructions.
entries.prompt:
30s, 16:9, ultra-realistic post-apocalyptic ruin-punk cinematic short. Dense visuals, grounded physics, natural performances, and clear action continuity. The story: Alin enters Ston’s territory to recover a stolen ignition key, provokes him into revealing its location, and escapes with it after a tense confrontation.

Reference lock: Ref 1 = Alin, Ref 2 = Ston, Ref 3 = ruined city layout, Ref 4 = rusty red-brown modified muscle car. Preserve their identities, proportions, and designs. Do not inherit reference backgrounds or poses.

0–5s — Arrival: Start inside the moving car. Tight shots of Alin’s hands, eyes, and calm side profile as she drives through a ruined city toward a collapsed industrial courtyard. Dust and wreckage pass naturally outside. She spots Ston standing beside a wrecked watchtower and slows. No dialogue.

5–10s — The provocation: Alin drives into the courtyard and performs two controlled drift circles around Ston, throwing up dust and gravel. Ston tracks the car, becoming increasingly aggressive but remaining grounded and physically believable. The car stops directly in front of him. Alin exits calmly, holding his gaze.

10–16s — The reveal: Ston gives one deep roar and steps toward her. Alin does not retreat. She points toward the watchtower. Ston glances back for a moment, revealing a small metal key hanging from a chain around his neck. Alin’s eyes briefly confirm it. Ston notices her attention and grips the chain.

16–23s — The confrontation: Ston lunges. Alin sidesteps the attack and uses the car door as a barrier. Ston slams into the metal, denting it with realistic weight. Alin pulls the chain free during the impact, stumbles back, regains balance, and runs toward the driver’s side. Ston recovers and charges after her. Keep the action continuous, with no teleporting or impossible movements.

23–30s — The escape: Alin reaches the car, starts the engine, and reverses sharply as Ston grabs the rear of the vehicle. The tires regain traction, the car pulls free, and she accelerates through the courtyard exit. Ston remains standing in the dust, roaring as the car disappears into the ruined streets. End on a brief rear view of the car leaving, then cut to Alin’s calm eyes in the mirror as she closes her hand around the stolen key.

Cinematography: Motivated cuts only, clear screen direction, realistic vehicle weight, natural dust lag, believable impacts, subtle handheld movement, no excessive shaky cam. Medium-low saturation, burnt rust red, weathered sand gray, charcoal, dusty gold sunlight, textured blacks, subtle film grain.

Sound: Continuous engine load, tire friction, gravel, metal impacts, wind, car-door mechanics, and one final roar. No dialogue, subtitles, watermarks, extra characters, glowing eyes, exaggerated facial expressions, or AI-looking motion. End with the story completed, not mid-action.

entries.title: Water Balloon Art Experience Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a short video showing students throwing paint-filled water balloons at a canvas in an autumn park, focusing on playful interactions and color splashes.
entries.prompt:
秋の晴れた昼、芝生の広場。木枠に張った真っ白な巨大キャンバス。絵の具入りの水風船を投げて色を咲かせるアート体験。さくらが黄色の風船を思い切り投げる。ぽよん。割れずに跳ね返って、足元まで転がってくる。力いっぱい振りかぶったら、今度は手の中でパシャッ。白いシャツの胸に青が広がる。銀髪の先生が吹き出して、手首のスナップだけで軽く一投。真ん中に黄色の花が咲く。まねして投げると、緑が小さく咲く。ガッツポーズ。勢いで投げたオレンジは端をかすめて飛んでいく。先生がにやりとして、両腕で抱えるほど巨大な風船を持ち上げる。

先生が次々に風船を手渡す。受け取っては投げ、受け取っては投げる。青、黄、緑、オレンジ。パシャッ、パシャッと花が咲いて、白がどんどん減っていく。最後は二人で巨大な風船を抱えて、助走して、放る。真ん中で大きく割れて、しぶきが二人に降る。色まみれで大笑いして、ハイタッチ。一面の色になったキャンバスの前に、並んで立つ。

一緒に来た友達が、すぐそばから手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、セリフ・字幕・BGMなし。画面に出るのは二人だけ。絵の具は黄・青・緑・オレンジの4色だけで、キャンバスの色は増えるだけ。人物は寄りで撮った。広場・衣装・先生は参照画像、後半は前半の実際のコマと、完成したキャンバスの画像を参照にした。
entries.translated_prompt:
On a sunny autumn day, in a grassy plaza. A huge white canvas stretched on a wooden frame. An art experience where you throw paint-filled water balloons to bloom colors. Sakura throws a yellow balloon with all her might. Boing. It bounces back without popping and rolls to her feet. When she winds up forcefully again, this time it pops SPLASH in her hand. Blue spreads across her white shirt's chest. The silver-haired teacher chuckles and lightly tosses one with just a wrist snap. A yellow flower blooms in the center. Mimicking him, she throws one and green blooms small. Thumbs up. The orange one thrown with momentum grazes the edge and flies off. The teacher smirks and lifts a balloon so huge he has to hold it with both arms.

The teacher hands over balloons one after another. Receive and throw, receive and throw. Blue, yellow, green, orange. Splash, splash, flowers bloom, and the white decreases rapidly. Finally, the two hug a giant balloon together, run up, and release it. It bursts largely in the middle, spraying them with droplets. Covered in colors, they laugh loudly and high-five. Standing side by side in front of the now fully colored canvas.

Recorded handheld by a friend who came along. About 2 seconds per cut, no dialogue, subtitles, or BGM. Only the two people appear on screen. Paints are only four colors: yellow, blue, green, orange; canvas colors only increase. Characters filmed close-up. Plaza, costumes, and teacher are reference images; the second half references actual frames from the first half and the completed canvas image.

entries.title: Eastern Fantasy Swordswoman vs Fox Spirit
entries.description: A detailed prompt for an Eastern fantasy duel between a swordswoman and a nine-tailed fox girl in a cherry blossom grove, featuring photoreal-CG visuals and specific energy effects.
entries.prompt:
Eastern fantasy photoreal-CG film look; dusk-pink grove light through cherry blossoms; real skin, cloth, fur and petal physics; film-grade pink-and-teal palette; lethal, exhilarating, then comic; no plastic CG look, no game-render feel
The swordswoman (teal-and-white ink-patterned outfit, high ponytail, twin short blades; her energy is a straight teal light): the duelist, reused verbatim in every shot
The nine-tailed fox girl (white hair, fox ears, red outfit, nine white tails tipped in red; fights with an oil-paper umbrella and curling red ribbon energy): the opponent, reused verbatim in every shot
