entries.title: Oriental Style Cinematic Video Prompt for Seedance 2.5
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-shot video prompt for generating an oriental-style cinematic sequence featuring a woman in white Hanfu, misty lakes, and horse riding, optimized for Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
东方国风半写实CG绘本质感；雾气弥漫与斜射天光；真实水面倒影、衣料垂坠、马匹毛发与奔跑动态质感；胶片级青蓝与琥珀对置色调；空灵、悠远、如梦；禁塑料感、禁游戏CG感
白衣女子（白衣汉服，长发松挽，宽大衣袂层层垂落）：全片主角，各镜沿用同一描述，不得变脸变装
蓝衣骑者（深蓝衣袍，身形挺拔）：仅结尾草原镜出现，骑白马
白马（通体雪白，鬃毛长而飘）：雾湖镜与草原镜共用同一匹
场景组：雾湖与秋林、月洞门庭院、莲塘、竹影小舟、青山花坡、纱帘竹丛、金色草原
全片一条旅程线：泛舟、立门、采莲、偃卧、奔跑、帘影、策马；镜与镜硬切，每镜是一幅独立的画
空间逻辑：人在景中始终保持小比例，山水是主角；唯一例外是竹影小舟与纱帘两镜的近景
斜射的晨昏天光穿过雾气，暗部被雾抬亮不死黑；青蓝的水与琥珀的陆对置
音频：国风器乐配乐流淌全片，水声、风声、马蹄声随镜而至；无对白、无旁白
情绪弧线：惊奇、静观、亲近、安眠、释放、含情、辽远、纵情告别

0–2.8秒大远景缓慢漂移
雾湖开场：镜面般的湖上雾气分层，两只小舟各载一个白衣人影远远漂着，左右金黄与深红的秋树垂入画面作框，倒影在水里微微晃；白衣女子骑白马自雾深处踏水而行，衣袂与马鬃拂过水面，马行水上不沉不溅，雾里另有白色鹿形身影若隐若现
开场确立：梦境逻辑、人物小比例、雾与倒影的质感基调

2.8–4.9秒全景固定
白墙月洞门：圆门正中立着白衣女子，成一幅剪影，门内是木格与远山，门侧一个小小的坐影作伴；一枝花树自左上斜入，人只有呼吸与衣袂的微动，影子落在墙面上
延续：构图对称、庭院静止、人物不走出圆门

4.9–8.2秒俯瞰全景缓慢跟移
莲塘自正上方俯瞰：翡翠色莲叶铺满水面，粉白莲花点缀其间；一条窄长木舟横穿画面，白衣女子立在船头，白衣拖尾铺在船板上，她俯身探向莲花，摘下一朵捧在手里，船尾有人摇橹，水面星光细碎闪烁
延续：俯瞰角度全程不变，船行方向不变，莲叶海不稀疏

8.2–11.1秒近景固定
竹影小舟内：木栏小舟里层层铺着白色毛皮与织物，白衣女子偃卧其中闭目小憩，一只手垂在舟边；前景竹叶虚化轻晃，斑驳光斑落在毛皮与衣料上，呼吸可见
延续：睡意与安宁，人物全程不起身、不睁眼

11.1–14秒远景航拍跟移
青山花坡：起伏的绿丘带着梯田般的坡纹，粉白花树疏疏点缀；白衣女子披深色披风在坡间奔跑，双袖张开，披风在身后猎猎，人自画面一侧横贯而过，始终只占一小点
延续：小比例尺度，奔跑不腾空不飞翔，花树不增不减

14–16.7秒近景固定
纱帘竹丛间：白衣女子半隐在白色纱帘之后，右侧竹叶探入画面；阳光透过竹叶把斑驳碎光落在她的侧脸与衣上，她含笑微侧首，发间光影缓缓浮动，帘子只轻轻飘
延续：斑驳光影是本镜主角，笑意含蓄不放大

16.7–18.3秒远景固定
金色草原小径：干草金黄，一条小径自画面中线向远方收去，两个小小人影沿径缓行；天空里群鸟横贯成河，偶有一两只大鸟自镜头前掠过，翅膀遮住一瞬画面
过渡：由静转动，辽远感拉满，为策马蓄势

18.3–22.8秒全景侧跟随后持续拉远
草原策马：蓝衣骑者伏身骑白马全速疾驰，四蹄腾空，侧面跟拍下枯金草浪向后倒退；约两秒后镜头开始耐心拉远，马与人一点点变小，草原与天空一点点变大，至地平线居中处只剩一个仍在移动的小点，画面就停在这里，不淡出
收束：全片唯一动力镜；速度先给足，拉远必须走完，结尾留白

严禁任何形式的对白与旁白；无文字、无水印、无现代元素；无人物放大占满画面（近景两镜除外）；无雾气消散、无倒影消失；无马匹沉水、游泳或马腿穿模；无策马降为慢跑或小跑；无拉远中途停住、无结尾提前淡出黑场；无俯瞰角度漂移、无莲叶变陆地；无纱帘变实墙、无竹影光斑频闪；无鸟群变黑点噪点；无草原变沙漠；无镜头内叠化；无身份漂移、无人物复制
entries.translated_prompt:
Oriental style semi-realistic CG painting texture; mist-filled with slanted skylight; realistic water reflections, fabric draping, horse mane and running dynamic textures; film-grade cyan-blue and amber contrasting tones; ethereal, distant, dreamlike; no plastic feel, no game CG feel.
Woman in White (white Hanfu, long hair loosely tied, wide sleeves layering down): Main character throughout, same description in every shot, no face or costume changes.
Rider in Blue (dark blue robe, upright figure): Appears only in the final grassland shot, riding a white horse.
White Horse (pure white body, long flowing mane): Shared between the misty lake and grassland shots.
Scene Group: Misty lake and autumn forest, moon gate courtyard, lotus pond, bamboo shadow boat, green hills flower slopes, gauze curtain bamboo grove, golden grassland.
The entire film is one journey line: boating, standing at gate, picking lotus, reclining, running, curtain shadows, horse riding; hard cuts between shots, each shot is an independent painting.
Spatial Logic: People remain small in proportion within the scenery, landscapes are the protagonists; the only exceptions are close-ups in the bamboo shadow boat and gauze curtain shots.
Slanted morning/evening light passes through mist, dark areas lifted by mist without crushing blacks; cyan-blue water contrasts with amber land.
Audio: Oriental instrumental music flows throughout, water sounds, wind, and hoofbeats arrive with each shot; no dialogue, no narration.
Emotional Arc: Surprise, contemplation, intimacy, sleep, release, affection, vastness, joyful farewell.

0–2.8s Extreme Long Shot Slow Drift
Misty Lake Opening: Layered mist on mirror-like lake, two small boats with white-clad figures drifting far away, golden and deep red autumn trees framing left and right, reflections swaying slightly in water; Woman in White rides a white horse emerging from deep mist walking on water, sleeves and mane brushing the surface, horse walks on water without sinking or splashing, faint white deer shapes visible in mist.
Establishes: Dream logic, small character scale, mist and reflection texture tone.

2.8–4.9s Wide Shot Static
White Wall Moon Gate: Woman in White stands centered in circular door as silhouette, wooden lattice and distant mountains inside, small seated figure beside door; Flower branch enters from top left, person only has breathing and slight sleeve movement, shadow falls on wall.
Continues: Symmetrical composition, static courtyard, character does not exit moon gate.

4.9–8.2s Overhead Wide Shot Slow Follow
Lotus Pond Top-Down View: Emerald lotus leaves cover water, pink-white flowers scattered; Narrow long wooden boat crosses frame, Woman in White stands at bow, white trailing robes spread on deck, she leans to pick a lotus holding it in hand, rower at stern, starlight flickering on water surface.
Continues: Overhead angle constant, boat direction constant, lotus sea does not thin out.

8.2–11.1s Close-Up Static
Inside Bamboo Shadow Boat: Wooden railing boat layered with white fur and fabrics, Woman in White reclining sleeping with eyes closed, one hand hanging over side; Foreground bamboo leaves blurred swaying, dappled light on fur and fabric, breathing visible.
Continues: Drowsiness and peace, character never sits up or opens eyes.

11.1–14s Extreme Long Shot Aerial Follow
Green Hills Flower Slopes: Undulating green hills with terraced slope patterns, sparse pink-white flower trees; Woman in White wearing dark cloak runs across slopes, arms spread wide, cloak fluttering behind, person traverses frame side-to-side always remaining tiny dot.
Continues: Small scale ratio, running without levitating/flying, flower trees do not increase/decrease.

14–16.7s Close-Up Static
Between Gauze Curtains and Bamboo: Woman in White half-hidden behind white gauze curtains, bamboo leaves enter from right; Sunlight through bamboo casts dappled broken light on her profile and clothes, she smiles slightly tilting head, light/shadow floats slowly in hair, curtains only gently drift.
Continues: Dappled light/shadow is main subject, smile subtle not exaggerated.

16.7–18.3s Extreme Long Shot Static
Golden Grassland Path: Dry grass golden, narrow path converges from center to distance, two tiny figures walk slowly along path; Flock of birds spans sky like river, occasional large bird flies past lens blocking frame briefly.
Transition: From still to motion, vastness maximized, building momentum for horse riding.

18.3–22.8s Wide Shot Side Follow then Continuous Pull Back
Grassland Horse Riding: Rider in Blue crouches on white horse galloping full speed, four hooves off ground, side follow shot shows dry golden grass waves receding backward; After about 2 seconds camera begins patient pull back, horse and person shrink gradually, grassland and sky grow larger, until horizon centered leaving only moving tiny dot, frame stops here without fade out.
Conclusion: Only dynamic shot in whole film; Speed given fully first, pull back must complete, ending leaves blank space.
Strictly prohibit any form of dialogue and narration; No text, watermarks, modern elements; No character filling screen (except two close-up shots); No mist dissipation, no reflection disappearance; No horse sinking/swimming/leg clipping; No horse slowing to trot/jog; No pull back stopping midway, no early fade to black; No overhead angle drift, no lotus leaves turning to land; No gauze curtain turning to solid wall, no bamboo shadow light flickering; No bird flock turning to black noise dots; No grassland turning to desert; No dissolve transitions within shot; No identity drift, no character duplication.

entries.title: Sakura Breaking Wall in Old House Prompt
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt describing Sakura breaking through a wall in an old Japanese house with a sledgehammer, emphasizing physical interaction and lighting changes.
entries.prompt:
秋の昼、畳を上げた古民家の一室。障子窓の光が板の床に落ちる。頭に手ぬぐいを巻いたさくらが、柱2本のあいだの白い土壁に大ハンマーを振る。ボスッ。跳ね返されて、漆喰が少し欠けるだけ。しびれた手を振って苦笑い。白髪の棟梁がハンマーを受け取り、手を柄の端へ滑らせる振りを見せて、欠けの真ん中を指さす。握り直して、もう一度。ドスッ。ひびが走って、土の塊が床に落ちる。三発目でズボッと抜けて、小さな穴から光が一本、向こうの暗い部屋へ差し込む。

ハンマーを拾って、穴の縁を叩いて広げる。中から竹の格子がのぞく。棟梁が素手で格子を折り取る。腰を落として、大きく振りかぶって、最後の一撃。壁がごっそり崩れ落ちて、暗かった奥の間に昼の光がどっと流れ込む。床に四角い光が広がる。大穴から奥をのぞきこんで、目をまるくする。棟梁が手をたたく。二人で、大穴の前に並ぶ。

一緒に来た友達が、すぐそばから手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、セリフ・字幕・BGMなし。画面に出るのは二人だけ。大ハンマーは1本、壊す壁は1面だけで、欠け→ひび→小さな穴→大穴の順に戻らない。人物は全部寄りで撮り、ハンマーが当たる瞬間は壁と腕だけの寄りで見せる。部屋・衣装・棟梁は参照画像、後半は前半の実際のコマを参照にして、棟梁も壁の状態もそのまま続けた。
entries.translated_prompt:
Autumn afternoon, a room in an old farmhouse with tatami mats removed. Light from shoji windows falls on the wooden floor. Sakura, wearing a headband, swings a large sledgehammer at a white earthen wall between two pillars. Thud. It bounces back, chipping only a little plaster. She shakes her numb hand and smiles wryly. A white-haired master carpenter takes the hammer, demonstrates sliding his hand to the end of the handle, and points to the center of the chip. He grips it again and strikes once more. Thud. Cracks run through, and chunks of earth fall to the floor. On the third strike, it punches through, and a single beam of light shines from the small hole into the dark room beyond.

He picks up the hammer and taps the edge of the hole to widen it. Bamboo lattice is visible inside. The master tears out the lattice with bare hands. He lowers his hips, winds up big, and delivers the final blow. The wall collapses completely, and daylight floods into the previously dark inner room. A square patch of light spreads on the floor. Looking through the large hole, eyes widen in surprise. The master claps his hands. The two stand side by side before the large hole.

Recorded handheld by a friend who came along, just nearby. About 2 seconds per cut, no dialogue, subtitles, or BGM. Only the two people appear on screen. One large hammer, one wall to break, progression: chip -> crack -> small hole -> large hole (irreversible). All shots are close-ups; when the hammer hits, show only the wall and arm in extreme close-up. Room, costume, and master are reference images; second half references actual frames from first half, maintaining continuity of master and wall state.

entries.title: Ghibli Style Carbonara Cooking Video
entries.description: A detailed prompt for creating a Studio Ghibli-inspired anime cooking video of Roman spaghetti carbonara, specifying style, timeline, audio, and negative constraints.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second cinematic hand-drawn anime cooking video in a Studio Ghibli-inspired style showing the preparation of authentic Roman spaghetti carbonara, entirely from the text description below.
IMPORTANT: Do not display, recreate, trace, reference, or imitate any storyboard, sketch, reference image, panel, annotation, or source material. Generate only original animation.
STYLE
Studio Ghibli-inspired hand-painted anime style, lush watercolor-and-gouache backgrounds, soft cel-shaded animation with gentle hand-drawn motion, painterly and mouthwatering food with warm glossy highlights, steam drawn as soft flowing wisps, shallow painterly depth of field, warm golden evening light, subtle film grain, smooth camera movement. Setting: a rustic Roman kitchen with ochre walls, copper pans, and a worn wooden table. Only hands visible, no faces. Fast rhythmic editing with natural match cuts based on movement, shape, and composition.
TIMELINE
0–2s — Guanciale
A knife cuts guanciale into thick strips. They land in a cold pan and begin to render golden fat.
2–4s — Pasta
Spaghetti is lowered into a pot of rolling boiling water and swirls into a spiral as steam billows.
4–6s — Egg Cream
Egg yolks, grated pecorino, and black pepper are whisked into a thick golden paste in a bowl.
6–8s — Combine
Hot spaghetti is lifted with tongs and tossed into the pan with the crisp guanciale and a splash of starchy water.
8–10s — Emulsify
Off the heat, the egg mixture is poured in. The pasta is tossed fast until the sauce turns creamy and glossy.
10–12s — Plate
Tongs twirl the pasta into a tall nest on a white plate. Guanciale pieces are scattered on top.
12–15s — Hero Reveal
Fresh black pepper and pecorino snow down over the pasta. A fork lifts a glossy twirl as steam rises and the camera slowly arcs around the plate.
AUDIO
Warm, light acoustic instrumental with mandolin, soft accordion, and gentle chimes, 100–110 BPM. Synchronized cooking sounds: knife on board, fat sizzle, boiling water, whisking, tongs, fork twirl. End with one soft mandolin note.
NEGATIVE
No photorealism, no 3D CGI, no live-action look. No storyboard, reference image, sketch, panels, borders, numbers, arrows, annotations, subtitles, captions, UI, logos, or text overlays. No cream, no unrelated ingredients or dishes. Carbonara only. Keep the food, hands, utensils, lighting, and environment visually consistent throughout.

All visible signage, storefront lettering, posters, menus, and background text must be correctly spelled, legible, and meaningful; no gibberish text.

Character continuity: Male protagonist matches Reference Image 1 exactly: same face, tousled brown hair, dark brown sweater, white undershirt, and gray trousers. Female receptionist matches Reference Image 2 exactly: same beautiful facial features, blue eyes, long center-parted blonde hair, black asymmetrical one-shoulder top, and tailored black trousers. Maintain both identities and outfits without changes. Natural body language, relaxed gestures, authentic facial expressions.

Scene 1 — Vesterbro Streets (0–4s)

Begin with the exact supplied male reference image, transitioning naturally into movement. He walks along a Copenhagen sidewalk, briefly checking a pickup address on his phone. Picturesque Scandinavian buildings, bicycles, autumn trees, and pedestrians.

Camera: Beautiful medium-wide composition, protagonist in the left third, layered architecture extending deep into the frame. Subtle handheld movement.

Title: "Copenhagen, Denmark" — Poppins Semi-Bold 600, 42px at 1080p, white #FFFFFF on softly rounded charcoal-slate #17212B at 60% opacity, bottom-center, visible for 2 seconds. No other titles.

Scene 2 — Parcel Pickup (4–8s)

He enters a small, tastefully designed neighborhood parcel shop. A friendly female employee retrieves a neatly wrapped rectangular package from behind the counter.

Camera: Static architectural composition through foreground shelving, warm natural window light, protagonist slightly off-center. Sign behind counter reads "PARCEL COLLECTION."

Performance: Casual greeting, comfortable posture, natural eye contact.

Scene 3 — The Exchange (8–13s)

The employee hands him the package, raising her eyebrows slightly with playful curiosity.

Employee: "Do you actually know what's in it?"

He glances down at the package, then back at her, a small amused smile forming.

Him: "Apparently I'm not cleared for that."

They share a brief, genuine laugh and warm smiles. Her amusement is spontaneous; his delivery is dry and lightly playful. Natural conversational volume, subtle facial expressions, no exaggerated laughter or theatrical gestures.

Camera: Intimate medium two-shot, both faces visible, beautifully balanced against the shop interior. Hold the composition throughout the dialogue.

Scene 4 — Through Copenhagen (13–17s)

He walks along a picturesque Vesterbro sidewalk carrying the parcel. Cyclists pass naturally in the bicycle lane; elegant Danish architecture and neighborhood storefronts fill the background. Storefront lettering reads "ATELIER" and "BAGERI."

Camera: Cinematic environmental wide shot, protagonist positioned in the right third, beautiful architectural depth and foreground bicycles. Gentle lateral camera movement.

Performance: Relaxed, purposeful walk, natural awareness of surroundings.

Scene 5 — Graphic Design Studio Delivery (17–22s)

He enters an extraordinary contemporary graphic design studio lobby. Gallery-quality minimalist architecture: warm off-white plaster, polished concrete, pale oak, sculptural furniture, dramatic abstract typographic artwork, curated design books, and a stunning monolithic reception desk. Sparse, artistic, exceptionally sophisticated. Reception wall lettering reads "FORM / STUDIO."

Behind the desk stands the beautiful blonde receptionist from Reference Image 2, matching her exact appearance, hairstyle, and black outfit.

He approaches and hands her the parcel.

Receptionist: "Perfect. Thank you."

Him: "No problem."

She accepts it with a warm, understated smile. He returns a small friendly smile. Natural conversational delivery, relaxed shoulders, genuine eye contact.

Camera: Stunning medium-wide architectural composition. He occupies the left third, she occupies the right third, with sculptural interior details and beautiful negative space between them. Soft directional window light, sophisticated depth and shadow.

Ending: She places the parcel on the desk as he turns to leave. Hold their natural smiles for a brief moment. Clean hard cut.

Global direction: Preserve exact facial identity, clothing, package appearance, and spatial continuity. Every shot must be thoughtfully composed, never generic centered framing. Realistic human movement and emotionally appropriate dialogue. No morphing, no unnatural gestures, no exaggerated speech, no gibberish text, no subtitles beyond the opening location title.

entries.title: Zombie Chase Animation Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed 30-second animation prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting a zombie chase scene in an ancient port city, specifying character references, camera movements, lighting, sound design, and strict continuity rules across 16 shots.
entries.prompt:
《布市逃生》｜30s｜2:1｜16 Shots
参考图：
图1：女主唯一人物参考，保持面容、发型、服装、配饰及身材比例一致。
图2：唯一场景参考。古老港口布市，潮湿石板主街、高悬布棚、固定大布车、右侧石阶、货箱平台与尽头铁门。所有镜头处于同一连续空间。
图3：丧尸外观参考。成百只身材、服装、步态各异的丧尸组成密集尸潮，持续从主街与巷道追来。其中一只宽肩、灰黄破衬衣、深色围裙的壮尸为固定追兵。

整体风格：
高质量日式电影动画，电影级构图与光影，真实人体运动惯性、重心转移与环境物理反馈。
全片高强度连续追逐，真实速度，快速运动剪辑。摄影机始终贴近奔跑路线，前景障碍高速掠过，强烈纵深视差，动态跟拍与适度运动模糊。人物动作、落脚位置及追兵距离清晰可辨。
女主从第一帧已经全力冲刺，尸群始终紧追不舍。

时间轴
镜头01｜0–1.4s
正面高速退行跟拍。女主已经在湿石街道全力奔跑，身体前倾，头发与裙摆向后飞扬，急促喘息。肩后两只丧尸疯狂逼近，远处整条街被密集尸潮占满。棚柱从画面两侧飞速掠过。
镜头02｜1.4–4.2s
切侧面全身高速跟拍。女主沿布市主街冲刺，连续踩过积水，脚下水花向后飞溅。固定大布车与摊位掠过镜头。
奔跑中她发现右侧通往铁门的石阶，前方一座带轮子的轻型布架挡住通路。她立即左手收住裙摆，右手准备推架。围裙壮尸在后方紧追。
镜头03｜4.2–5.4s
切丧尸后方追逐视角。摄影机紧贴追兵向前猛冲，一只腐烂手臂突然伸向女主后背，几乎抓住她。
女主瞬间斜切绕过大布车车角，丧尸一把抓空。前方布架迅速逼近。
镜头04｜5.4–5.8s
高速脸部特写。女主边跑边快速扫视布架与大车之间的狭窄空隙，瞬间判断路线，身体持续前冲。
镜头05｜5.8–6.2s
手臂特写。女主右手猛地扣住布架竖杆，借奔跑冲力将布架一端向街心推开，动作迅速果断。
镜头06｜6.2–6.6s
超低机位特写。布架转向轮猛然偏转，碾过湿石板，架体迅速斜移，大车旁出现可供一人穿过的空隙。
镜头07｜6.6–10s
切侧前方全身高速跟拍。女主松开右手，左手提裙，侧身从刚打开的空隙中高速穿过，落脚后立即加速。
身后一只瘦尸猛撞布架，紧接着围裙壮尸以肩胸狠狠撞上另一侧！
布架剧烈歪斜，布卷滚落，后方尸群被迫分流。女主奔跑中短暂回头，看见壮尸惊人的冲撞力量，随即转回头冲向右侧石阶。
镜头08｜10–13.8s
侧后方全身追拍。女主急转右侧石阶，连续高速登阶。
前方木箱角挡住路线，她右脚猛蹬高阶，身体顺势斜跨箱角，左脚准确落在上方台阶，屈膝缓冲后立即继续向上冲刺。
围裙壮尸紧跟着冲上石阶，其余丧尸被狭窄阶梯与木箱挤得相互碰撞。
镜头09｜13.8–15s
低机位鞋部高速跟拍。女主连续踏过最后几级湿石阶，鞋底猛蹬，水滴飞溅，裙摆随步伐剧烈摆动。
前脚踏上平台，后脚紧随，身体直接转入平地加速冲刺。镜头随她抬升。
镜头10｜15–18.6s
平台侧前方高速全身跟拍。女主沿货箱通道冲向铁门，密集货箱从镜头边缘飞掠。
一只及膝木箱突然挡住最短路线。
女主左手提裙，右掌迅速撑住固定箱角，利用前冲惯性斜跨障碍，前脚落地后立即继续冲刺。
围裙壮尸以肩膀狠狠擦撞箱堆，仍然紧追。女主冲到铁门前，右手已经伸向横闩。
镜头11｜18.6–20.6s
门区中全景。女主冲至铁门，右手猛地抽开横闩，左手与肩膀紧接着向外推门。
锈涩铁门发出刺耳摩擦声，仅打开一条无法通过的窄缝！
女主身体被迫急停。她立刻撤肩回头，看见围裙壮尸正沿平台高速冲来。
门左侧墙边存在一处可完全避开正面冲撞的空间。
镜头12｜20.6–21s
门闩特写。横闩已经退出，女主左掌迅速离开门面。沉重铁门仍卡在狭窄开口，无法直接逃脱。
镜头13｜21–21.4s
过肩快速切镜。围裙壮尸低头前倾，肩胸对准铁门疯狂冲来，后方尸群密密麻麻涌过货箱通道。
女主瞬间发现可以利用它的冲击力！
镜头14｜21.4–21.8s
腰腿特写。女主左手猛收裙摆，双脚迅速调整，身体压低重心，准备向门内左侧墙边闪避。
镜头15｜21.8–26.2s
切连续全身宽镜头，完整呈现女主、铁门、围裙壮尸与门外空间。
围裙壮尸冲至约两米，突然蹬地猛扑！
女主瞬间向左横跨，后脚迅速收回，整个身体完全闪入左侧墙边！
下一瞬间——
砰！
壮尸肩胸狠狠撞中铁门远离左铰链的位置！
沉重铁门被冲击力猛然撞开，向外急速旋转，门轴发出刺耳巨响！
壮尸失去支撑，身体踉跄越过门槛，向门外右侧狼狈摔倒。
铁门向外打开接近90度。
就在左侧通路完全露出的瞬间，女主猛地从墙边蹬出，沿门洞左侧高速跨槛逃出！
她穿过铁门与壮尸向右侧跌倒同步发生，彼此身体路线完全错开。
后方其他丧尸已经涌到门口。
镜头16｜26.2–30s
切门外斜前方全身退行高速跟拍。女主冲出门槛，迅速绕过展开的铁门与右侧倒地壮尸，沿外墙湿石路急转，再次全力冲刺！
摄影机随着她的急转加速追拍，墙面与石路边缘从画面两侧飞掠。
后景中，围裙壮尸挣扎撑起身体，其他丧尸绕过它，疯狂涌出铁门继续追赶！
女主只抢出几步距离，急促喘息，头发飞扬，身体持续向前猛冲。
视觉与声音
冷青灰自然天光，棚下暖黄色灯笼局部照明。潮湿石板产生真实反光，远处薄雾形成城市纵深。人物穿过棚影和灯光时，面部明暗自然变化。
全片无背景音乐、无对白、无旁白、无字幕。
只保留真实环境声音：急促脚步、踩水、喘息、丧尸嘶吼、布架轮子滚动、木架撞击、布卷坠落、鞋底蹬地、铁闩抽动、壮尸猛烈撞门与门轴摩擦声。
entries.translated_prompt:
"Escape from Cloth Market" | 30s | 2:1 | 16 Shots
Reference Images:
Image 1: Sole character reference for female lead, maintain consistency in face, hairstyle, clothing, accessories, and body proportions.
Image 2: Sole scene reference. Ancient port cloth market, wet cobblestone main street, high-hanging cloth stalls, fixed large cloth carts, stone steps on right, cargo box platform and iron gate at end. All shots in same continuous space.
Image 3: Zombie appearance reference. Hundreds of zombies with varied bodies, clothes, gaits forming dense horde, continuously chasing from main street and alleys. One broad-shouldered, grey-yellow torn shirt, dark apron strong zombie as fixed pursuer.

Overall Style:
High-quality Japanese cinematic animation, cinematic composition and lighting, realistic human motion inertia, center of gravity transfer, and environmental physics feedback.
Full-length high-intensity continuous chase, real speed, fast motion editing. Camera always close to running route, foreground obstacles rushing past, strong depth parallax, dynamic tracking and moderate motion blur. Character actions, foot placement, and pursuer distances clearly distinguishable.
Female lead sprinting at full force from first frame, zombie horde constantly chasing closely.

Timeline
Shot 01 | 0-1.4s
Frontal high-speed reverse tracking. Female lead already sprinting full force on wet stone street, body leaning forward, hair and skirt flying backward, panting heavily. Two zombies wildly approaching behind shoulders, entire street filled with dense horde in distance. Stall poles rushing past both sides of frame.
Shot 02 | 1.4-4.2s
Cut to side full-body high-speed tracking. Female lead sprinting along cloth market main street, stepping continuously through puddles, water splashing backward under feet. Fixed large cloth carts and stalls passing by lens.
While running she discovers stone steps on right leading to iron gate, a wheeled light cloth rack blocking path ahead. She immediately gathers skirt with left hand, prepares to push rack with right hand. Aproned strong zombie pursuing closely behind.
Shot 03 | 4.2-5.4s
Cut to zombie rear pursuit perspective. Camera rushing forward hugging pursuers, a rotten arm suddenly reaching toward female lead's back, almost grabbing her.
Female lead instantly diagonally cuts around corner of large cloth cart, zombie grabs air. Front cloth rack rapidly approaching.
Shot 04 | 5.4-5.8s
High-speed facial close-up. Female lead scanning narrow gap between cloth rack and cart while running, instantly judging route, body continuing forward rush.
Shot 05 | 5.8-6.2s
Arm close-up. Female lead's right hand fiercely gripping vertical pole of cloth rack, using running momentum to push one end of rack toward street center, action swift and decisive.
Shot 06 | 6.2-6.6s
Ultra-low angle close-up. Cloth rack steering wheels suddenly deflecting, crushing wet cobblestones, rack body quickly shifting diagonally, gap appearing beside cart sufficient for one person to pass through.
Shot 07 | 6.6-10s
Cut to side-front full-body high-speed tracking. Female lead releases right hand, lifts skirt with left, sidesteps through newly opened gap at high speed, accelerating immediately after landing.
Behind her a thin zombie violently hits cloth rack, followed immediately by aproned strong zombie slamming shoulder/chest into other side!
Cloth rack violently tilting, rolls falling, rear horde forced to split. Female lead briefly looks back while running, seeing astonishing impact force of strong zombie, then turns back rushing toward right stone steps.
Shot 08 | 10-13.8s
Rear-side full-body pursuit. Female lead sharply turning right stone steps, continuously climbing high-speed.
Wooden crate corner ahead blocking route, she kicks hard on higher step with right foot, body diagonally straddling crate corner, left foot accurately landing on upper step, knee bending for buffer then immediately continuing upward sprint.
Aproned strong zombie closely following up stone steps, other zombies colliding mutually squeezed by narrow stairs and crates.
Shot 09 | 13.8-15s
Low-angle shoe high-speed tracking. Female lead continuously stepping over last few wet stone steps, soles kicking hard, water droplets splashing, skirt swinging violently with steps.
Front foot lands on platform, back foot follows, body directly transitioning to flat ground acceleration sprint. Lens rising with her.
Shot 10 | 15-18.6s
Platform side-front high-speed full-body tracking. Female lead rushing toward iron gate along cargo channel, dense cargo boxes flying past lens edges.
A knee-high wooden crate suddenly blocking shortest route.
Female lead lifts skirt with left hand, right palm quickly bracing against fixed crate corner, using forward momentum to diagonally straddle obstacle, continuing sprint immediately after front foot lands.
Aproned strong zombie violently scraping crate pile with shoulder, still pursuing closely. Female lead reaches iron gate, right hand already reaching for bolt.
Shot 11 | 18.6-20.6s
Gate area medium full shot. Female lead rushes to iron gate, right hand fiercely pulling open bolt, left hand and shoulder immediately pushing door outward.
Rusty iron gate emitting harsh friction sound, opening only a narrow impassable crack!
Female lead's body forced to stop abruptly. She immediately withdraws shoulder looking back, seeing aproned strong zombie rushing along platform at high speed.
Space exists on left wall side of gate completely avoiding frontal impact.
Shot 12 | 20.6-21s
Bolt close-up. Bolt already withdrawn, female lead's left palm quickly leaving door surface. Heavy iron gate still stuck in narrow opening, unable to escape directly.
Shot 13 | 21-21.4s
Over-the-shoulder quick cut. Aproned strong zombie lowering head leaning forward, shoulder/chest aimed wildly charging at iron gate, rear horde densely flooding through cargo channel.
Female lead instantly realizing she can utilize its impact force!
Shot 14 | 21.4-21.8s
Waist/leg close-up. Female lead fiercely gathering skirt with left hand, feet quickly adjusting, body lowering center of gravity, preparing to dodge toward inner left wall side.
Shot 15 | 21.8-26.2s
Cut to continuous full-body wide shot, fully presenting female lead, iron gate, aproned strong zombie, and outside space.
Aproned strong zombie rushing to about two meters, suddenly kicking ground pouncing!
Female lead instantly straddling left, back foot quickly withdrawing, entire body completely dodging into left wall side!
Next instant—
Bang!
Strong zombie's shoulder/chest violently hitting iron gate position far from left hinge!
Heavy iron gate slammed open by impact force, rotating outward rapidly, hinges emitting harsh loud noise!
Strong zombie losing support, body stumbling over threshold, falling awkwardly to right outside gate.
Iron gate opening outward nearly 90 degrees.
Just as left passage completely exposed, female lead fiercely kicking out from wall side, escaping at high speed straddling threshold along left side of doorway!
Her passing through gate and strong zombie falling right occur synchronously, their body paths completely offset.
Other zombies behind already flooding to entrance.
Shot 16 | 26.2-30s
Cut to outside diagonal front full-body reverse high-speed tracking. Female lead rushing out threshold, quickly bypassing opened iron gate and fallen strong zombie on right, sharply turning along outer wall wet stone road, sprinting full force again!
Camera accelerating tracking with her sharp turn, wall surfaces and stone road edges flying past both sides of frame.
Background, aproned strong zombie struggling to rise, other zombies bypassing it, wildly flooding out iron gate continuing chase!
Female lead only gaining few steps distance, panting heavily, hair flying, body continuing forward rush.
Visual and Sound
Cold cyan-grey natural daylight, warm yellow lantern local illumination under stalls. Wet cobblestones producing real reflections, distant thin fog creating urban depth. Facial light/shadow naturally changing when characters pass through stall shadows and lights.
No background music, no dialogue, no narration, no subtitles throughout.
Only retain real environmental sounds: hurried footsteps, stepping water, panting, zombie roars, cloth rack wheel rolling, wooden rack collision, roll falling, sole kicking, iron bolt pulling, strong zombie violent gate hit and hinge friction sounds.

entries.title: Pixar-Style Family Comedy Animation
entries.description: A prompt for a 3D animated family comedy featuring a tired father and crying toddlers, styled like Pixar with expressive emotions and comedic interactions in a cozy home setting.
entries.prompt:
Create a 20-second high-quality cinematic 3D animated family comedy featuring an emotionally expressive young couple and their two crying toddlers inside a cozy modern home.

Scene 1 (0–3 seconds): Extreme close-up of a little girl with brown hair, pink bows, large expressive eyes, and rosy cheeks. She looks intensely angry, furrowing her eyebrows, scrunching her nose, and pressing her lips together. Use detailed skin shading, soft cinematic lighting, and subtle facial movements.

Scene 2 (3–5 seconds): Cut to the little girl crying dramatically, tears rolling down her cheeks, her mouth wide open in an adorable tantrum. Her face shows exaggerated sadness and frustration.

Scene 3 (5–8 seconds): A tired young father with messy dark curly hair, thick eyebrows, light stubble, a dark green T-shirt, and gray sweatpants sits on a sofa while two toddlers cry beside him. He looks exhausted, frustrated, and emotionally overwhelmed.

Scene 4 (8–11 seconds): Close-up of the father as his expression changes from irritation to a serious, determined frown. Cut to a low-angle full-body shot of him walking down the hallway with the two toddlers following him.

Scene 5 (11–15 seconds): In a warmly lit living room, the father faces the mother, a young woman with long brown hair tied in a loose bun, wearing a pink knit sweater and light-colored pants. Both stand with their arms crossed, exchanging intense, annoyed looks. Use alternating over-the-shoulder shots and close-ups to emphasize their comedic confrontation.

Scene 6 (15–20 seconds): The father stands awkwardly against a wall with wide, worried eyes and a stiff posture. The two toddlers stand on either side of him, looking up at him with innocent expressions. He appears completely defeated by family life. End with a funny, slightly uncomfortable pause and expressive eye movements.

Visual Style: Premium Pixar-inspired 3D animation, stylized yet highly detailed characters, realistic fabric textures, soft subsurface skin scattering, expressive facial animation, cinematic depth of field, warm indoor lighting, smooth camera movements, natural character interactions, exaggerated comedic expressions, polished animated-movie quality, 4K UHD, 24 FPS, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.

Character Consistency: Maintain consistent facial features, hairstyles, clothing, body proportions, and colors throughout all scenes. Ensure smooth transitions, believable body language, realistic tears, synchronized facial expressions, and no character morphing.

Audio: Natural toddler crying, subtle indoor ambience, soft footsteps, and light comedic background music. No dialogue or subtitles.

entries.title: European Travel Vlog Cinematic Sequence
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt for a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic travel vlog featuring a European female vlogger exploring city streets and food stalls.
entries.prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | 4K Ultra HD | 30 FPS | Ultra-photorealistic cinematic travel vlog.

A beautiful, friendly 25-year-old European female vlogger with fair skin, expressive blue eyes, and long, slightly wavy light brown hair explores a charming European city on a sunny afternoon. Wearing a white oversized T-shirt, light blue jeans, white sneakers, and a beige crossbody bag, she films herself with a handheld vlogging camera.

0–5 seconds: She walks through a beautiful European city filled with historic architecture, colorful buildings, cobblestone streets, outdoor cafés, and passing bicycles, enthusiastically saying, “Hey guys! Welcome back! Today we're exploring this beautiful city and hunting for amazing food!”

5–10 seconds: She explores charming narrow streets, flower-filled balconies, boutiques, and lively street performers, smiling at the camera and saying, “Wow, these streets are gorgeous! There's something exciting around every corner!”

10–16 seconds: She discovers a bustling street food stall featuring sizzling sandwiches, crispy potatoes, and freshly baked pastries. Close-ups reveal rising steam and melted cheese as she receives a fresh sandwich, saying, “Okay, this smells incredible! I just found the perfect place to grab a bite!”

16–22 seconds: Sitting at an outdoor café, she shows the sandwich to the camera, takes a realistic bite, and smiles with genuine excitement. “Mmm! That's so good! Crispy, cheesy, and absolutely delicious!”

22–27 seconds: A dynamic travel montage shows her exploring historic landmarks, laughing beside a fountain, browsing colorful market stalls, and enjoying coffee in warm afternoon sunlight. She says, “Beautiful streets, amazing food, and such great vibes! I'm loving this place!”

27–30 seconds: Standing in a beautiful European square, she waves warmly at the camera and says, “Thanks for watching! See you on my next adventure! Bye!” The camera transitions into a cinematic wide shot of the city.

Production: Ultra-realistic 4K visuals, natural skin texture, consistent facial identity, authentic English dialogue with a subtle European accent, accurate lip-sync, realistic food textures, natural handheld selfie shots, cinematic B-roll, warm sunlight, smooth transitions, authentic city ambience, and subtle upbeat travel music.

Negative prompt: No cartoon visuals, artificial skin, face changes, inconsistent outfits, distorted hands, robotic speech, inaccurate lip-sync, excessive camera shake, unrealistic food, watermarks, random subtitles, vertical framing, black bars, or abrupt transitions.

entries.title: Disney World Family Vacation Home Video
entries.description: A prompt for generating a photorealistic early-2000s family vacation home video at Disney World using Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
DISNEY WORLD, 2001 — “THE DAY WE NEVER FORGOT”

30 SECONDS | 9:16 | PHOTOREALISTIC EARLY-2000s FAMILY VACATION HOME VIDEO | MULTISHOT

CAMERA

The entire video is recorded by a parent using a consumer MiniDV camcorder during a family vacation to Walt Disney World’s Magic Kingdom. The footage has the characteristic soft focus, slight grain, and color bleeding of analog tape. The camera zooms in and out erratically, pans quickly between family members, and occasionally loses framing. The audio includes ambient park noise, distant music from attractions, and the parents calling out to the children.

SCENE BREAKDOWN

0:00 - 0:05: A shaky shot of the Cinderella Castle in the background, slightly overexposed due to bright sunlight. A young child (approx. 5 years old) runs into the frame from the right, laughing, holding a large cotton candy that is melting in the heat.

entries.title: Times Square Mechanical Combat

entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second cinematic action sequence for Seedance 2.5.
Aspect ratio: 16:9, landscape.
Photorealistic mechanical characters in realistic live-action surroundings.
Extremely fast aerial combat, precise weapon contacts, powerful impacts, and spectacular destruction.

PRIMARY VISUAL RULE — SPARK-FREE MECHANICAL COMBAT
Do not generate flying sparks or glowing particle trails anywhere in the sequence.
Show weapon contact through physical recoil, brief camera vibration, metallic sound, and a small cool-white daylight reflection confined to the contacting metal surfaces.
This reflection does not scatter, spray, or leave a trail.

All flying debris must look like solid manufactured material:
silver metal fragments, dark steel pieces, white ceramic chips, recognizable gears, brackets, and electronic components.
Fragments have hard edges, visible thickness, rigid rotation, and gravity-driven trajectories.
Avoid clouds of tiny luminous specks.

Keep destruction effects neutral in color.
No red, orange, yellow, pink, or brown particle effects.
No liquid-like jets, splashes, droplets, dripping, or wet textures.
Dust is pale gray, dry, thin, and slowly settling.

SETTING
Times Square, New York City, in bright midday daylight.
Giant LED billboards, tall commercial buildings, glass storefronts, projecting signs, maintenance platforms, streetlights, and broad intersecting streets.
Blue sky, strong natural sunlight, crisp shadows, and neutral daylight color grading.
The combat area is deserted.

The fighters repeatedly move between street level and several stories above the intersection.
Use walls, columns, billboard frameworks, and elevated platforms as physical rebound surfaces.
Keep the streets visible below during aerial exchanges.

Maintain consistent geography and accumulating damage.
Broken buildings, fallen signs, glass, craters, and rubble remain damaged throughout the sequence.

REFERENCE ASSIGNMENT

REFERENCE IMAGE 1 = A, THE CYBERNETIC ONI SAMURAI.
Preserve the reference silhouette and appearance: tall black horns, ivory-colored armored helmet, red electronic eye details, mechanical respirator, purple and acid-yellow armor, decorative chest plates, exposed machinery, hoses, heavy boots, and mechanical backpack.
The helmet and chest ornamentation are manufactured armor.
A carries two katana matching the reference.

A moves through explosive jumps, wall rebounds, rapid pivots, ballistic momentum, and physical combat.
A never teleports or transforms into mist.

REFERENCE IMAGE 2 = B, THE MECHANICAL REAPER.
Preserve the exact reference silhouette, proportions, color arrangement, markings, hanging fabric, chains, and enormous curved scythe with its suspended vessel.

B is an entirely mechanical construct.
The deer-skull-shaped face is an ivory-colored ceramic mask mounted over a metal head assembly.
The branching antlers are manufactured metal structures with ceramic-coated surfaces.
The rib-shaped chest decoration is artificial armor.
The interior contains gears, motors, circuit boards, brackets, cables, and a central metal chassis.
The hanging costume fabric is synthetic.
Red reference details are rigid painted surfaces or small electronic indicator lights.

Keep the reference appearance while making the construction unmistakably artificial.
B remains visibly taller than A.
Only B can transform into dense black mist and teleport.

Reference colors remain attached to intact armor and equipment.
During the final destruction, emphasize neutral metal interiors and white ceramic fracture surfaces.
Do not turn painted colors or electronic lights into colored particle effects.

Use the references only for character design.
Do not display reference-sheet backgrounds, annotations, detail panels, borders, or duplicate character views.
Do not exchange character identities, weapons, colors, or abilities.

BLACK-MIST TELEPORTATION
B's mechanical body and equipment disappear and reassemble together.
Only one physical B exists at a time.
The antlers, scythe, chains, and accessories always return with B.

Each transition is extremely fast but readable:
solid machine → localized black mist → relocation → mechanical reassembly.

The mist remains monochrome black and charcoal gray, without colored droplets or glowing particles.
B must become physically solid to attack.
A eventually anticipates this reassembly moment.
After the final successful cut, B remains solid and breaks apart mechanically.

ACTION AND CAMERA RHYTHM
Begin at exactly 0 seconds with A already being thrown violently backward and upward.
Start directly inside the action.

Make most of the battle airborne.
Include actual midair sword-and-scythe exchanges, defensive rotations, rapid counters, knees, and kicks.
Maintain strong momentum, powerful arcs, and fast descents.
A redirects movement through contact with structures, weapons, and the opponent.
B attacks through teleportation from above, below, behind, and across A's flight path.

Use motivated cuts around 2, 4, 7, 10, and 13 seconds.
The one-second intervals describe choreography beats, not mandatory cuts.
Continue each shot between those transitions.
Keep silhouettes, weapon contacts, and travel directions readable.

SECOND-BY-SECOND CHOREOGRAPHY

[00:00–00:01]
ACTION:
A is already hurtling diagonally backward and upward after B's scythe strike.
A's boots tear a trench through the asphalt before leaving the street.
A crashes through a building corner above the storefront.
Glass panels fracture into clear angular pieces, concrete blocks break apart, and the entrance canopy collapses.
A retains both katana.
CAMERA:
Begin low beside the torn pavement and track A's diagonal flight upward.
Follow into the building impact with a short, heavy camera jolt.

[00:01–00:02]
ACTION:
A plants both boots against an exposed concrete column and rebounds immediately.
The column fractures and the surrounding floor edge drops away.
A accelerates across the intersection several stories above the road.

CAMERA:

The enormous sign tilts away from its mounting.
CAMERA:

Keep both fighters, the billboard structure, and the drop to the street visible.

[00:03–00:04]

entries.title: Sakura Breaking Tiles in Karate Dojo Prompt
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt depicting Sakura attempting to break tiles in a karate dojo, guided by a master, focusing on action precision and environmental details.
entries.prompt:
昼の空手道場。障子窓の光が板の間に落ちる。初めて道着を着たさくらが、ブロックに渡した瓦5枚に拳を振り下ろす。ゴツッ。1枚も割れない。拳を抱えて跳ねて、吹き出す。白髪の師範が隣で腰を落とし、拳を真下へ、瓦の手前でぴたりと止める。2本指で自分の目を指して、その指を瓦の下の床へ。真似をして、狙って、もう一度。バキッ。5枚が全部真っ二つ。振り向くと、師範が倍の10枚を抱えて歩いてくる。

10枚がブロックに置かれる。ごくりと息をのむ。師範は腕を組んで下がる。目を閉じて、大きく吸って、吐く。拳を引き上げて、振り下ろす。上から下まで順番に割れて、最後の1枚まで抜ける。顔を上げると、師範がいちばん下の破片を2つ拾って笑っている。跳ねてハイタッチ。割れ口を合わせると、ぴったり合う。床には割れた瓦の山。ぺこりと頭を下げて、照れ笑い。

一緒に来た友達が、すぐそばから手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、セリフ・字幕・BGMなし。画面に出るのは二人だけ。瓦の山は1つ、前半5枚・後半10枚、割れた破片は床に残す。人物は全部寄りで撮り、瓦の厚みは床すれすれの低い位置から見せる。道場と瓦の見た目は人のいない参照画像、後半の師範は前半の実際のコマを参照にして同じ人のまま。
entries.translated_prompt:
Daytime karate dojo. Light from shoji windows falls on the wooden floor. Sakura, wearing a gi for the first time, swings her fist down at five roof tiles placed on a block. Thud. Not a single tile breaks. She hops holding her fist, laughing nervously. A white-haired master next to him lowers his stance, bringing his fist straight down, stopping precisely just before the tiles. He points to his own eyes with two fingers, then points those fingers to the floor under the tiles. Mimicking this, aiming, striking again. Crack. All five tiles split cleanly in half. Turning around, the master walks over carrying double the amount—ten tiles.

Ten tiles are placed on the block. She gulps. The master crosses his arms and steps back. Eyes closed, deep inhale, exhale. Raises fist, swings down. They break sequentially from top to bottom, passing through the last tile. Lifting her face, she sees the master smiling, picking up two fragments from the bottom layer. She jumps for a high-five. Aligning the broken edges, they fit perfectly. A pile of broken tiles remains on the floor. She bows deeply, smiling shyly.

Recorded handheld by a friend who came along, just nearby. About 2 seconds per cut, no dialogue, subtitles, or BGM. Only the two people appear on screen. One pile of tiles, first half 5 tiles / second half 10 tiles, broken fragments remain on the floor. All shots are close-ups; tile thickness shown from low angle near floor level. Dojo and tile appearance use reference images without people; second half master references actual frames from first half to maintain same person identity.

entries.prompt:

Create a 30-second cinematic adventure featuring one athletic miniature woman at approximately 1/5 scale inside a busy stationary shop. Maintain her exact face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, backpack, and miniature scale consistently throughout the entire video.

She begins by running across a towering stack of notebooks, leaping from one notebook to another as if crossing rooftops. entries.title: Japanese Shinobi Supernatural Action Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating an ultra-photorealistic Japanese supernatural action sequence featuring a shinobi summoning a Shinigami (death god) on a battlefield.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic live-action Japanese supernatural action sequence with high-budget Hollywood cinematography, realistic physics, dark fantasy atmosphere, and practical-feeling VFX. A Japanese female shinobi with long black hair, wearing a fitted black ninja outfit, layered dark robe, forearm wraps, and traditional black boots, stands on a devastated battlefield surrounded by ruined shrines, broken stone structures, cracked ground, and swirling dust.

HAND SEALS: She faces a powerful enemy and rapidly performs precise ninja hand seals. Strong winds intensify as the camera pushes toward her focused face. She completes the final seal and forcefully shouts in Japanese, 「死鬼封尽！」 (“SHIKI FŪJIN!”). A powerful shockwave blasts dust and debris outward.

SOUL EXTRACTION: The Reaper's spectral arm passes harmlessly through the female shinobi and reaches the enemy. Its enormous hand grabs the enemy's spiritual essence, forcibly extracting a translucent humanoid soul from the intact physical body. The soul stretches and struggles against the supernatural force while the chains hold the enemy in place.

FINAL SEAL: The Shinigami pulls the soul into its open mouth and absorbs it. A massive shockwave erupts across the battlefield. The enemy collapses to their knees, completely immobilized. entries.title: Last Ember Midnight Canyon

entries.title: Daruma Otoshi Game Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting a Daruma otoshi (wooden doll stacking game) at a shrine, focusing on physics, impact, and character reactions.
entries.prompt:
秋晴れの神社の境内。二階建ての屋根に届く、巨大なだるま落とし。木槌を横に振り抜く。ごーん。いちばん下の青い段は、数センチずれるだけ。塔がぐらりと揺れ、はるか上でだるまが空を背に揺れる。銀杏の葉が降ってくる。しびれた手を振って見上げ、吹き出す。係のおばあさんが、腰を落として水平に素振りしてみせる。真似をして、狙いを合わせて、もう一度。スパーン。青い段だけが飛び出し、上の塔がストンと一段落ちる。

黄色を抜く。緑は少し高く当たって、だるまが縁ぎりぎりまで傾く。息をのむ。だるまが座り直す。肩を落として笑う。最後の橙。腰を深く落として振り抜くと、だるまがそのまま地面にストンと下りて、起き上がりこぼしみたいに揺れて止まる。おばあさんと両手でハイタッチ。地面に立つだるまの頭を、ぽんぽんとなでる。うしろには、抜いた四色の段が転がっている。

一緒に来た友達が、すぐそばから手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、セリフ・字幕・BGMなし。画面に出るのは二人だけ。塔1基、段4つ、だるま1つ、木槌1本。人物は全部寄りで撮り、塔の大きさはあおりと画面からのはみ出しで見せる。境内と塔の見た目は、人のいない参照画像で固定。
entries.translated_prompt:
Autumn clear day at a shrine precinct. A giant Daruma otoshi reaching the roof of a two-story building. Swinging the mallet horizontally. Boom. The bottom blue block only shifts a few centimeters. The tower wobbles, and far above, the Daruma sways against the sky. Ginkgo leaves fall. Shaking numb hands, looking up, bursting into laughter. Without pause she uses a leaning bamboo pole to spring into the air and drives a knee into attacker 4, who collapses onto the stones.

SHOT 3 (5-7.5s) Camera glides close to the ground and sweeps upward, FOV 30 degrees. She sprints downhill in a low crouch under hanging bamboo and ropes, spins into a sweeping kick that sends attacker 5 crashing into a rusted tea rack. Hand-plant roll, then a flying kick into attacker 6, who skids backward into the edge of the terrace wall.

SHOT 4 (7.5-10s) Camera orbits her, FOV 32 degrees. She slides on her knees through the shallow irrigation channel, throwing up a wide sheet of water, and pops up at the collapsed footbridge. She vaults the gap and twists mid-air to ram her shoulder into attacker 7, sending him to the terrace below. She lands, catches a bamboo pole thrown by attacker 8, plants it and pole-vaults, driving both feet into attackers 8 and 9, who fly in opposite directions.

SHOT 5 (10-12.5s) Camera pushes forward as if chasing, then pulls back fast, FOV 38 degrees. She runs along the leaning bamboo scaffolding, then back-flips over attacker 10's sneak attack from behind. Mid-air she twists and lands a back kick between his shoulder blades, sending him rolling forward down the slope.

SHOT 6 (12.5-15s) Camera drops to a low wide angle, FOV 30 degrees, then locks front-on at eye level. She lands and slides through a puddle in a low crouch, water spraying around her, then rises into a sharp ready stance. Her braid and the hem of her shirt are still swinging from the speed. The sequence ends sharply on this strong, still pose, final frame in crisp focus.

CAMERA: Momentum-driven tracking that follows her center of gravity (jumps, wall-runs, pole vault, kicks) rather than sitting static. Reactive impact cinematography: a sharp small shake on every hit, the camera briefly following a thrown opponent, then snapping back to her. Natural motion blur on fast moves.

PACING: Speed builds through the explosive moments. Her actions are clear and decisive; enemy reactions are fast and heavy. No slow motion, no pauses, no posed moments, no wasted movement.

VISUAL QUALITY: Ultra-high definition, cinema grade, realistic skin, fabric and water physics, live-action photographic look.

POSITIVE LOCKS: Pink streaks stay a soft rose tone, braid stays on her right shoulder, plum shirt and cream cargo trousers unchanged, boots and gloves unchanged, exactly ten attackers in charcoal coats and slate face wraps.

CONSTRAINTS: At least ten enemies, all hit. No empty kicks; every strike connects. No repeated moves. No fantasy light effects, no neon colors, no neon glow, no cartoon or CGI-style look, no distorted limbs, no clipping or objects passing through each other, no stuttering motion, no extra people, no text or watermarks.

entries.title: Stealth Game Cinematic Sequence
entries.description: A complex prompt for generating a photorealistic stealth game video sequence involving a female protagonist searching an office, utilizing reference images for character consistency and storyboarding.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second photorealistic stealth-game video in 16:9.

REFERENCE PRIORITY
 is the authoritative reference for the adult female protagonist: preserve her face, hairstyle, physique, outfit, footwear and backpack throughout.

-Image2 is the storyboard for the first half.
-Image3 is the storyboard for the second half.

Read each storyboard from left to right, top to bottom. Follow all six panels of Image2, then all six panels of Image3.

The storyboard images define actions, locations, camera compositions and game interface. If the protagonist’s appearance differs between references, Image1 takes priority.

IMPORTANT
Produce full-screen moving scenes. The storyboard grids are planning references only: never display panels, borders, collages or split screens. Animate the actions between the illustrated moments naturally rather than presenting a slideshow.

VISUAL STYLE
Realistic third-person stealth gameplay with cinematic camera work, believable human motion and natural daylight. Modern university athletics administration wing: sage-green walls, pale terrazzo floors, oak doors with glass panels, black-framed windows and indoor plants.

Maintain consistent room geography: the office entrance connects to the corridor, the sage-green drawer cabinet stands against the side wall, and the solid-front oak desk stands near the windows. Preserve these positions across camera changes.

The protagonist wears her backpack on BOTH shoulders throughout. Both straps remain attached and the backpack moves naturally with her body.

SHOT SEQUENCE

0–3 seconds:
Start immediately with the protagonist concealed beside a corridor corner. The camera looks past her shoulder toward a male staff member walking away. She cautiously peeks around the corner and waits until he disappears from view.
HUD status: “STAY HIDDEN”, then “WAIT FOR PATROL”.

3–6 seconds:
She approaches the office door and looks through its glass panel. Show her checking the empty office before touching the handle. She listens briefly, then reaches for the handle.
HUD status: “CHECK THE OFFICE”.

6–9 seconds:
Close view of her hand pressing the handle, followed by a medium shot as she opens the door and slips inside. The camera follows smoothly through the doorway. She leaves the door slightly ajar.
HUD status: “OPEN DOOR”, then “ENTER QUIETLY”.

9–12 seconds:
She moves to the sage-green cabinet, crouches beside it and pulls out a drawer. Show the drawer sliding along its rails and her hands searching inside.
HUD status: “SEARCH DRAWER”.

12–15 seconds:
She spots her pink-cased smartphone, grasps it and lifts it from the drawer. The phone is clearly visible. Her expression briefly shows relief. She quietly pushes the drawer closed.
HUD status: “PHONE RECOVERED”.
Change the main objective to “ESCAPE UNSEEN”.

15–18 seconds:
Footsteps approach. She freezes, turns toward the doorway and lowers herself behind the cabinet before a female lecturer enters. The lecturer has a short dark bob, a teal blazer and cream trousers, matching Image3. She carries folders and walks toward the bookcase without noticing the protagonist.
HUD warning: “TEACHER RETURNING”.
The ALERT meter rises to amber because of the nearby threat, without reaching full detection.

18–21 seconds:
While the lecturer faces away, the protagonist moves into concealment behind the solid-front oak desk. Use a clear wide shot to establish that the desk blocks the lecturer’s line of sight. She holds the recovered phone close and watches the lecturer carefully.
HUD status: “STAY OUT OF SIGHT”.

21–25 seconds:
The lecturer remains turned toward the bookcase. The protagonist quietly moves from behind the desk toward the office exit, staying outside the lecturer’s field of view. The camera tracks her movement smoothly. She crosses the doorway into the corridor.
HUD status: “MOVE TO THE EXIT”.

25–28 seconds:
From the corridor, she gently pulls the office door closed. The latch clicks softly. She glances back, then relaxes as the ALERT meter falls to zero.
HUD status: “CLOSE THE DOOR”.

28–30 seconds:
Medium frontal tracking shot as she walks down the corridor. She raises the recovered phone at chest height and gives a small relieved smile. Keep both backpack straps visible.
Main objective changes to “MISSION COMPLETE”.
Final status: “PHONE RECOVERED”.

GAME INTERFACE
Match the HUD design shown in Image2 and Image3: small translucent charcoal panels, thin pale outlines, cyan accents and pink or amber alert indicators.

Keep the interface anchored to the screen, with identical placement and typography across every shot:
- Top left: “HEALTH”, “STAMINA”, “ALERT”.
- Top center: the current mission objective.
- Bottom left: a circular mini-map showing the protagonist’s position and orientation.
- Bottom right: “C CROUCH”, “E INTERACT”, “SHIFT SPRINT”.
- Lower center: the current action or warning.

Initial objective: “RECOVER YOUR PHONE”.
After collecting the phone: “ESCAPE UNSEEN”.
Final objective: “MISSION COMPLETE”.

HEALTH stays constant. STAMINA changes subtly with movement. ALERT responds to the lecturer’s proximity and returns to zero after escape.
Keep all English text sharp, correctly spelled and stable. Never cover the protagonist’s face or hands with interface elements.

AUDIO
Quiet corridor ambience, distant footsteps, soft sneaker steps, backpack movement, door-handle click, drawer sliding and a restrained suspense soundtrack.
A subtle notification sound when the phone is recovered, a brief warning tone when the lecturer approaches, and a short success chime at the end.
No dialogue or voice-over.

CONTINUITY
Natural movement, realistic weight and hand contact with objects. No teleportation, duplicate characters, extra limbs or changing outfits. The phone remains in her hand after collection. Doors and drawers move physically and consistently.
The lecturer never directly sees the protagonist.
Maintain a playful, tense stealth-game atmosphere and a complete beginning, middle and ending.

entries.title: Dark Fantasy Superhero Cinema Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 30-second dark fantasy superhero battle in a flooded cathedral, featuring transformation sequences and monster combat.
entries.prompt:
THE LAST LIGHT OF SAINT VARCHEN

[ENGINE DIRECTIVE]
Genre: Supernatural dark-fantasy superhero cinema. Duration: exactly 30 seconds. Format: 16:9, 60fps where supported. Photorealistic Hollywood realism, realistic skin, wet materials, volumetric rain, cinematic lighting and natural motion blur.

HERO LOCK: Use @image1 as the sole hero. Preserve the exact face, skin tone, hairstyle, beard, age, body proportions and identity. Begin in the reference outfit, then transform into a matte midnight-graphite tactical suit with segmented armor and glowing gold energy seams. Face remains uncovered. No cape, helmet, logos or clones. Combat uses fists, bracers and gold kinetic energy.

CREATURES:

1. THE HOLLOWHORN: A towering 4-meter revenant with a skeletal stag skull, broken antlers, rusted chains, black smoke and pale-blue glowing eyes. Heavy, powerful attacks.
2. THE SPLINTER: A fast, long-limbed ash wraith with a cracked porcelain mask, elongated fingers and a translucent body.

LOCATION: Flooded, ruined Cathedral of Saint Varchen at night. Violent storm, shattered rose window, broken pillars, ankle-deep black water, blue-white candles and a collapsed roof. Creatures attack from frame-right.

[30-SECOND TIMELINE]

00:00–00:05 | THE DROWNED NAVE
Descend through the broken roof into the flooded cathedral. Show rippling water, candle reflections and the hero standing still in the original outfit. Two blue eyes open in the darkness. Thunder strikes at 00:04.

00:05–00:10 | THE WARDENS AWAKEN
The Hollowhorn crashes into the water, chains swinging, while the Splinter clings upside down to a pillar. The hero raises one hand as gold energy gathers. At 00:09, lightning strikes through the roof.

00:10–00:15 | TRANSFORMATION
In slow motion, gold particles replace the outfit as graphite armor assembles across the body. Gold seams ignite and a shockwave blasts both creatures backward. The Splinter lunges; the hero catches its wrist and throws it into a pillar.

00:15–00:20 | THE REVERSAL
The hero dodges a chain, lands a gold-powered uppercut, then gets smashed into a pillar. The Splinter pins the hero while the Hollowhorn lifts the hero by the throat. Gold energy flickers.

00:20–00:25 | THE BREAK
Near-silence at 00:21. The hero reignites, breaks the Hollowhorn's grip, strikes through the Splinter's torso and slams it into the marble, cracking the floor. The Hollowhorn charges.

00:25–00:30 | FINAL STRIKE
The hero leaps and punches through the Hollowhorn's skull with a gold-powered fist at 00:26.5. Both creatures disintegrate into embers and ash. The hero lands, rises, and faces dawn illuminating the shattered rose window. Cut to black exactly at 00:30.

[AUDIO] Original orchestral dark-fantasy score, deep drones, choir, taiko, heavy brass and percussion. Sync thunder at 00:04, lig

entries.title: DV Style Summer Night Video Prompt

entries.prompt:

创建一个30秒、超写实的2000年代初家用DV录像，记录一位年轻东亚女性在老式居民楼阳台上度过一个普通的夏夜。纯观察视角，无对话，无叙事起伏，只有日常生活的节奏。
人物
长相与图2一致，服装、发型与图1一致：素颜，头发随意扎起，碎发凌乱，白色宽松T恤、蓝白格子睡裤、米色拖鞋。嘴唇自然闭合，嘴角放松，神情平静。全程保持面容、服装、发型和身形一致。
动作时序
00:00–00:05 — 她收回视线，低头看向手里的盆，端着一盆湿衣服往前走两步，弯腰把盆放在地上。
00:05–00:12 — 她从盆里抖开一件T恤，踮脚挂到晾衣杆上，衣服滴下几滴水。再挂一件。
00:12–00:16 — 右侧的落地扇摇头转过来，吹动她的碎发和衣角，她停下来对着风扇吹了两秒。

连贯性
盆、衣服、西瓜、勺子数量始终一致，不凭空出现或消失。桌上的蚊香持续冒细烟。风扇匀速摇头。动作按真实时间进行，从容不迫。
摄影与画质
固定机位，与图1完全相同的角度，全程不移动、不推拉、不变焦。顶上暖黄色白炽灯是唯一光源，平光略过曝。DV噪点、轻微色偏、边缘暗角、偶尔的自动对焦呼吸。右下角橙色日期码 2003 07 19 全程固定不变。
声音
只有环境声：风扇嗡嗡声和摇头的咔哒声、远处蝉鸣和邻居家电视声、衣架碰撞声、勺子刮西瓜声、拖鞋踩地声。无背景音乐。
禁止
无字幕、无配乐、无慢动作、无电影感调色、无运镜、无浅景深、无灰色棚拍背景。4:3，30s，720p

entries.title: Dubai night hypercar cinematic sequence
entries.description: A detailed shot-by-shot prompt for a photorealistic cinematic night sequence featuring a Bugatti Chiron driving through Dubai.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic night Dubai luxury hypercar sequence. Anamorphic 2.39:1, high-contrast cool-blue / warm-amber grade, strong practical lighting only (streetlights, building lights, car LEDs, blue interior glow), heavy motion blur on background lights and traffic, sharp subject focus, glossy black paint reflections, wet-asphalt look. No text, no logos, no watermarks. 20-second continuous flow matching the reference cut.

**0:00–0:02**

High-angle aerial looking almost straight down the illuminated Burj Khalifa. Tower centered vertically, white-lit stepped crown and cylindrical body dominant. Dense city grid and multi-level highways stretch to the horizon. Slow clockwise orbital drift while gently descending. Wide lens, deep blacks, sparkling lights.

**0:02–0:04**

Continuous orbital move that slides the Burj Khalifa toward the left edge of frame. Camera continues descending and tilting down, revealing more of the glowing highway interchange below. Smooth drone-style motion, no shake.

**0:04–0:06**

Aerial push-in and steeper tilt down over the complex multi-level highway interchange. Circular ramps, elevated roads, and glowing roundabouts fill the frame. Camera accelerates slightly while dropping altitude. Strong leading lines from the road network, warm sodium and cool white lights.

**0:06–0:07**

Low aerial tracking shot just above the multi-lane highway. Camera is positioned slightly behind and above the traffic flow, looking forward down the road. Multiple cars with headlights and taillights are visible, strong light trails, an overpass crosses above in the upper frame. The black Bugatti begins to emerge clearly in the right lane. Smooth forward tracking, matching traffic speed, slight downward tilt.

**0:07–0:08.5**

Camera drops lower and locks onto the rear of the glossy black Bugatti Chiron. Distinctive continuous horizontal red LED light bar, large rear wing, and quad exhausts are clearly visible. Tracking stays tightly matched to the car’s speed from a rear three-quarter position. Dubai high-rise skyline fills the background, streetlights streak past, heavy motion blur on surrounding traffic.

**0:08.5–0:10**

Smooth lateral camera move from rear three-quarter into a full side profile tracking shot. The black Bugatti is now seen completely from the side, moving left-to-right across frame. Through the driver’s window the man with dark messy hair, well-groomed beard, and glasses is visible in profile, looking straight ahead. Camera stays locked to the car’s speed with no shake. City towers and highway barriers streak past in the background with strong motion blur and warm/cool light mix.

**0:10–0:12**

Side tracking shot matching speed exactly. Full side profile of the black Bugatti moving left-to-right. Through the driver’s window a man with dark messy hair, well-groomed beard, and glasses is visible in profile, calm focused expression, looking straight ahead. Heavy motion blur on background lights and barriers. Cool blue fill on the car’s paint mixed with warm streetlight highlights.

**0:12–0:14**

Tighter side tracking, camera moves closer to the driver’s window. Man’s face and upper body clearly framed in the window, still in profile, eyes forward behind glasses. City lights streak past. Smooth, locked speed match, no camera shake.

**0:14–0:15.5**

Interior close-up from the passenger side looking toward the driver. Hands on the steering wheel (large ring on right hand, dark sleeve visible). Soft blue glow from the digital instrument cluster and ambient lighting. Man’s face remains in profile, dark messy hair, well-groomed beard, glasses, low-key lighting, composed intensity. Subtle vehicle motion.

**0:15.5–0:17**

Tight profile close-up of the man’s face. Cool blue key light on his eye, cheekbone, and glasses, warm bokeh orbs from city lights in the background. Dark messy hair and well-groomed beard clearly visible. Shallow depth of field, gentle camera drift matching the car’s motion. Eyes looking forward, calm expression.

**0:17–0:19**

Driver’s point-of-view looking forward through the windshield. Rearview mirror centered in frame reflecting the man’s face, dark messy hair, well-groomed beard, and glasses. Blue illuminated dashboard and steering wheel in the foreground. Highway stretching ahead with light trails, distant skyscrapers and Burj Khalifa silhouette visible. Smooth forward motion with slight vibration.

**0:19–0:21**

Quick low-angle frontal shot of the Bugatti’s distinctive four circular LED headlights blazing cool-white/blue light, immediately followed by a wide aerial pull-back of the full Dubai skyline at night with the Burj Khalifa perfectly centered, city grid and highways glowing.

**Key matching rules**

- Car stays pure glossy black Bugatti Chiron with accurate rear light signature and proportions at all times.

- Driver: man @image1 dark messy hair, well-groomed beard, glasses, light-to-medium skin, calm/intense focused expression, never looks at camera.

- Camera language: smooth high aerial orbits and descents → locked high-speed tracking (rear then side) → interior close-ups → final wide aerial. No handheld shake, no unnecessary cuts except the last two shots.

- Lighting and color must stay practical night sources only.

entries.prompt:
Create one ultra-realistic cinematic live-action video set in Japan in 2003–2004. The entire story must be shown in a clear chronological sequence with smooth transitions. Do not skip any important action. The same adult Japanese woman and the same adult Japanese man must remain consistent from beginning to end.

SCENE 1 — WALKING ON THE STREET

A Japanese woman walks along a quiet early-2000s Japanese neighborhood street during the daytime. She passes small shops, bicycles, older Japanese cars, utility poles, and period-correct storefronts. The camera follows her naturally from the front and side.

SCENE 2 — THE PHOTOS DROP

A few meters ahead, a Japanese man walks while carrying a small photo folder containing several printed photographs. The folder accidentally opens. The photographs fall onto the pavement.

SCENE 3 — WIND SCATTERS THEM

Before he can collect them, a natural gust of wind catches the loose photographs. Several photos slide across the sidewalk while a few move toward the curb. The man immediately stops and turns around, looking worried.

SCENE 4 — WOMAN NOTICES

The woman sees the scattered photographs and the man's reaction. She immediately stops walking, looks at him, then looks down at the photographs and realizes he needs help.

SCENE 5 — BOTH START COLLECTING

The woman crouches down and begins collecting the photographs one by one. The man also kneels down and collects photographs from another part of the sidewalk. Show their hands picking up individual photos clearly.

One photograph remains on the ground. A stronger gust pushes it farther along the sidewalk. The woman notices it immediately and follows it while the man continues collecting the others.

SCENE 7 — SHE SAVES THE LAST PHOTO

The photograph slides close to the curb. Before it can reach the road, the woman quickly but safely catches it with one hand. She looks relieved, then walks back toward the man holding the recovered photograph carefully.

SCENE 8 — COUNTING AND ARRANGING

Both return to the same spot. The woman places her collected photographs beside the man's. They carefully arrange all the recovered photos into one neat stack. The man counts them and realizes that the complete set has been recovered.

SCENE 9 — RECOGNIZING THE MEMORIES

The man slowly looks through the photographs. Close-up shots show printed family and personal memories from the early-2000s era. His worried expression changes into visible relief and emotion.

SCENE 10 — RETURNING THE PHOTOS

The woman gathers the photographs into one neat stack and gently hands them to the man. He accepts them with both hands and immediately places them safely back inside his photo folder.

SCENE 11 — THANK YOU

The man looks genuinely grateful. He gives the woman a respectful Japanese bow and a warm smile. She smiles back and gives a small polite nod, showing that she is happy

entries.title: Korean Supernatural Action Sequence
entries.description: A complex prompt for generating a photorealistic Korean supernatural action scene involving telekinetic powers, baseball, and cinematic camera angles.
entries.prompt:
Create an intense, ultra-photorealistic Korean supernatural action sequence

The heroine korean uniform appears to be an ordinary, beautiful, quiet schoolgirl. However, she secretly possesses extraordinarily powerful telekinetic abilities, allowing her to manipulate gravity, control moving objects, redirect projectiles, and overpower opponents without physical contact.

When activating her powers, her eyes develop a subtle electric-pink glow. The glow must remain elegant, mysterious, and realistic, never exaggerated or cartoonish.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY — STRICT IDENTITY LOCK

HEROINE — THE SECRET TELEKINETIC GIRL

A beautiful 22-year-old woman @korean uniform with delicate but realistic facial features, naturally textured skin, and an expression of cold, effortless confidence.

Her personality is calm, fearless, sarcastic, and emotionally controlled. She never panics, even when facing extraordinary danger.

MALE ANTAGONIST — THE BASEBALL PLAYER

A handsome, athletic 22-year-old Korean man @Image with slightly messy black hair, sharp facial features, and an arrogant, competitive personality.

He wears a black school blazer, partially untucked white shirt, loosened black tie, black trousers, and dark sneakers.

He holds a wooden baseball bat and initially believes he can intimidate the heroine.

LOCATION

An outdoor Korean high-school baseball field during a bright afternoon. Reddish-brown dirt, white baseball markings, green boundary fencing, tall protective netting, metal bleachers, school buildings, and wooded hills in the distance.

Several students in Korean school uniforms watch from behind the fence.

Natural daylight, realistic shadows, subtle dust particles, and believable environmental details.

SHOT-BY-SHOT CINEMATIC SEQUENCE

0:00–0:03 — The Dangerous Pitch

Open with a dramatic medium shot of the male antagonist @Image standing at home plate, gripping his wooden baseball bat.

A baseball flies toward him at tremendous speed. The camera tracks the approaching ball in a rapid telephoto shot.

The antagonist turns sharply, preparing to swing. Students watch nervously from the sidelines.

0:03–0:06 — The Heroine Activates Her Powers

Cut to the heroine @korean uniform standing casually near the edge of the baseball diamond.

She raises two fingers almost imperceptibly.

Her eyes develop a subtle electric-pink glow.

The approaching baseball suddenly freezes in midair, spinning violently while suspended by an invisible force. Its seams begin glowing with faint orange friction sparks.

The surrounding dust lifts off the ground in a circular pattern.

0:06–0:10 — The Impossible Impact

The heroine flicks her wrist.

The baseball accelerates forward with explosive supernatural force.

The antagonist swings his bat with all his strength, but the instant the bat connects with the ball, an enormous invisible telekinetic shockwave erupts.

Bright orange sparks explode around the impact point.

His bat violently recoils, his shoulders twist backward, and his feet leave the ground.

Use a brief 120 FPS slow-motion impact followed immediately by real-time acceleration.

0:10–0:14 — The Telekinetic Launch

The male antagonist is hurled several meters backward through the air, spinning sideways in a spectacular controlled stunt.

His blazer flutters violently, his tie whips across his shoulder, and the baseball bat flies out of his hands.

The camera follows his trajectory with a fast handheld whip-pan.

He lands heavily on the soft dirt near the fence, sliding and rolling as a cloud of dust rises around him.

Nearby students recoil in complete disbelief.

0:14–0:17 — The Girl Who Never Moved

Cut to the heroine standing exactly where she started.

Her long blonde hair moves gently in the breeze.

She casually lowers her hand as the electric-pink glow disappears from her eyes.

Behind her, shocked students stare at the fallen baseball player.

She looks toward him with an amused, unimpressed expression.

0:17–0:20 — The Final Warning

Close-up of the heroine's face.

The antagonist struggles to sit up, staring at her in disbelief.

She tilts her head slightly and gives him a tiny sarcastic smile.

HEROINE (calmly): "You should've stayed on the bench."

For a split second, her eyes flash electric pink again.

Smash cut to black.

CINEMATOGRAPHY AND VISUAL EFFECTS

Camera: ARRI Alexa Mini LF cinematic realism, 35mm and 50mm lenses, realistic shallow depth of field, dynamic tracking shots, low-angle action framing, and fast whip-pans.

Telekinesis: Invisible force distortion, subtle atmospheric ripples, realistic floating dust, gravitational pressure waves, restrained electric-pink eye illumination, and physically convincing object trajectories.

Lighting: Bright natural afternoon sunlight, soft facial shadows, natural highlights, authentic Korean drama color grading, and realistic environmental reflections.

Sound design: Sharp baseball impact, sudden supernatural low-frequency rumble, explosive air displacement, wooden bat vibration, shoes scraping dirt, shocked students gasping, and a deep cinematic bass hit during the telekinetic launch.

Strict requirements: Maintain identical character faces, hairstyles, outfits, and body proportions across all shots. No face morphing, no unnatural limbs, no random costume changes, no excessive glowing energy beams, no cartoon physics, no artificial CGI-looking humans, no subtitles, no text overlays, no logos, and no watermark.

Overall direction: Make the heroine appear overwhelmingly powerful without effort. The central visual contrast must be between the antagonist's explosive physical aggression and the heroine's almost motionless supernatural dominance. The final result should feel like a high-budget Korean supernatural action drama, with convincing stunt choreography, breathtaking impact, and a memorable heroine reveal.
