entries.title: Private jet suspense cinematic short
entries.description: A complex multi-reference prompt for Seedance 2.5 creating a 20-second cinematic suspense short film inside a private jet, utilizing specific reference images for character and setting consistency.
entries.prompt:
20 seconds, 16:9, high-end cinematic suspense short film, realistic cinematography, 35mm film look, realistic lighting and physical movement.

Use @Image 1 as the only female protagonist throughout the entire film, keeping her face, blonde hair, body shape, and brick-red silk dressing gown completely consistent. Use @Image 2 as the only private jet cabin and @Image 3 as the only cockpit. The character, aircraft, and spaces must remain consistent throughout. No additional characters, duplicate characters, deformation, or disappearance.

【0–2.5 seconds】

The shot begins with movement already in progress: a luxurious private jet cabin with symmetrical composition along the central axis. The female protagonist walks quickly forward alone along the central aisle, looking natural but slightly alert. The camera smoothly tracks backward, maintaining distance from her. The cabin is illuminated by stable, warm golden artificial lighting, appearing bright, warm, and luxurious. Outside the windows are gloomy blue-gray clouds, with no direct sunlight.

As she walks forward, the cabin ceiling lights and wall lights suddenly begin flickering continuously. The entire cabin alternates between bright and dim due to the electrical malfunction, causing the woman's face and the seats to repeatedly shift between light and shadow. She immediately stops walking and looks up at the lights, her expression instantly becoming alert.

The next moment, the aircraft suddenly jolts violently. Inertia throws her body forward, causing her to stumble one step. She immediately reaches out and grabs the seat beside her. A transparent glass tumbler on the table responds to the aircraft's movement with realistic inertia, sliding across the tabletop toward the edge before naturally falling off and shattering. The glass must maintain continuous, physically realistic movement, without floating, teleporting, or suddenly disappearing.

Hearing the abnormal loud noise, the woman immediately looks toward the cockpit, realizing something is wrong. As the aircraft experiences its first violent shake, the camera suddenly accelerates backward, instantly establishing a strong sense of impact.

【2.5–4.5 seconds】

The aircraft violently loses control again, and the cabin suddenly tilts to one side. The woman immediately turns and rushes toward the cockpit, but after running only a few steps, a violent lateral jolt strikes without warning. She loses her footing, her body is thrown sideways, and she crashes heavily onto the aisle floor.

She does not stop. She immediately reaches out and grabs the base of the nearest seat, trying to get back up, but the aircraft tilts again, throwing her back down through inertia. The camera rapidly tracks backward with slight shaking, continuously following her struggle.

【4.5–7.5 seconds】

Realizing she can no longer stand normally, the woman immediately switches to crawling along the floor toward the cockpit. She alternately grips the bases and armrests of the seats on both sides with her hands, struggling to move forward while being pulled and thrown around by the aircraft's continuous shaking.

A violent jolt makes her slide backward a short distance. She grips the seat tightly to stabilize herself, then continues forward. The aircraft briefly returns to a level position. She immediately pushes herself up, staggers forward, rushes to the cockpit door, and forcefully pushes it open.

The camera follows rapidly from behind her at a low angle, producing realistic handheld shake as she crawls, gets up, and sprints. The cockpit doorframe quickly sweeps across the frame and completely obscures the camera, creating a seamless spatial transition through occlusion rather than using a conventional hard cut.

【7.5–10 seconds】

The camera seamlessly enters the cockpit from behind the door, following the woman from behind. She collapses into the left pilot's seat and grips the control yoke tightly with both hands.

The cockpit combines warm artificial lighting with the cold blue environment outside. Churning black thunderstorm clouds fill the windshield. Instrument warning lights begin flashing. She pulls the control yoke sharply, trying to control the aircraft, but the plane continues tilting violently.

The camera rapidly pushes in from over her shoulder, briefly entering her point of view: thunderstorm clouds rush closer at high speed as the aircraft shakes violently.

【10–14 seconds】

Cut to a close external aerial shot of the aircraft.

The same private jet suddenly loses altitude, and its nose begins pointing noticeably downward. The camera tracks parallel to the aircraft, clearly capturing the complete progression from an uncontrolled tilt into a steep dive.

The aircraft continues descending at high speed, with the dive angle becoming increasingly steep. The wings shake violently in the powerful airflow, and the fuselage visibly jolts up and down. Do not make the aircraft suddenly disappear or crash instantaneously.

Keep the entire aircraft visible in the frame while slightly tracking downward, allowing the audience to clearly feel that the plane is rapidly falling. The thunderstorm clouds remain in the distance as a dark background, with occasional lightning flashes across the sky, but the aircraft must remain clearly visible and must not enter the clouds.

The main focus of this section is to convey realistic high-speed loss of control and a strong sense of vertical descent.

【14–20 seconds】

Instantly return to the cockpit.

Red emergency warning lights continue flashing, with red light repeatedly sweeping across the woman's face. The light fixtures remain intact, with no explosions, shattering, or exaggerated visual effects.

Extreme close-up of her face: her hair is disheveled, her breathing is rapid, and her expression gradually changes from panic to genuine despair. She desperately pulls the control yoke, but the aircraft still does not regain control.

She finally realizes that the aircraft is continuing to descend and that she can no longer save it. She stares forward, briefly losing focus, as all hope disappears from her eyes.

Amid the violent shaking, she screams one desperate “NO!” The scream continues and gradually becomes uncontrollable. The red warning lights repeatedly sweep across her face, and her hair moves slightly with the shaking. She keeps looking forward, unable to do anything, forced to watch helplessly as the aircraft continues descending.

For the final approximately 2 seconds, hold on an extreme close-up of her desperate, terrified face. Let the scream end naturally, then cut off abruptly.

Sound: Roaring engines, continuous electrical malfunction sounds, aircraft turbulence, the glass tumbler sliding and shattering, hurried footsteps, rushing airflow, instrument warning alarms, and the woman's rapid breathing and sustained desperate screaming. No subtitles, text, or logos.

Core requirements: The female protagonist must be moving naturally from the very first frame. Do not leave her standing still and staring for a long time. When the malfunction begins, she must react immediately and appropriately to the situation. The aircraft malfunction must first be conveyed through continuous abnormal cabin lighting, then gradually escalate into violent turbulence. The environment outside the windows must remain gloomy, while the cabin is illuminated by its own artificial lighting. The glass tumbler must slide across the table toward the edge before naturally falling off. All character movements, inertia, hair, clothing, and aircraft movements must follow realistic physics.

entries.prompt:
A fast-paced, ultra-realistic cinematic FPV drone shot racing through the heart of Tokyo, Japan, at golden hour, capturing the electrifying energy of one of the world's most vibrant cities. The camera flies between towering skyscrapers, sweeps past sleek glass buildings, dives over crowded intersections, and glides alongside futuristic architecture. The movement is fluid, immersive, and breathtaking, with razor-sharp turns and seamless altitude changes that make the viewer feel as if they are flying at incredible speed through the city.

The drone plunges toward the bustling streets of Shibuya, weaving between moving cars, colorful taxis, buses, and pedestrians crossing the famous scramble intersection. It skims above the crosswalk, passes beneath glowing street signs, sweeps past convenience stores and Japanese storefronts, then banks sharply around a building covered in enormous digital advertisements. Crowds move naturally across the sidewalks while bicycles pass through narrow streets and traffic flows through illuminated intersections.

Warm sunlight reflects off glass skyscrapers as vibrant Japanese billboards begin glowing against the evening sky. entries.title: 1950s Korea Historical Sequence
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a realistic 30-second cinematic historical sequence set in 1950s Korea, depicting a young woman's ordinary daily routine from morning chores to neighborhood errands.
entries.prompt:
Create a highly realistic 30-second cinematic historical sequence set in Korea during the 1950s. The entire video should feel like a naturally observed fragment of ordinary life from that era — not a vlog, not a modern recording, and not a person performing for a camera.

MAIN SUBJECT:
A young Korean woman in her early 20s with a consistent, natural appearance and believable facial features. She has black hair tied loosely back, minimal makeup, natural skin texture and subtle everyday expressions.

Her outfit is period-inspired but youthful and attractive: a fitted cropped short-sleeve cotton top paired with high-waisted shorts ending around the upper thigh, simple flat leather shoes, and a small understated necklace. The clothing should look like authentic, practical 1950s cotton clothing rather than modern fashion. Natural fabric wrinkles, slightly faded colors and realistic stitching.

CONCEPT:
Show several small moments from her ordinary daily routine, progressing naturally from inside her home to the neighborhood outside. She never looks into or acknowledges the camera. There is no visible camera, filming equipment, phone or modern recording device.

SCENE 1 — MORNING AT HOME | 0–6 SEC
Inside a modest 1950s Korean home with wooden floors, simple bedding, handmade household objects and sunlight entering through a paper-covered window.

The woman folds a small stack of freshly washed clothes, then carries them outside in a woven basket. Her movements are casual and unhurried. Sunlight falls naturally across the room, revealing dust particles in the air.

SCENE 2 — HANGING LAUNDRY | 6–11 SEC
She steps into a small courtyard behind the house and hangs clothes on a simple rope line.

Show her stretching upward to place a shirt over the line, securing it with simple wooden clothespins, then smoothing another garment with her hands. A light breeze gently moves the hanging clothes and her loose hair.

Include small environmental details: clay pots, wooden walls, stone ground, a water basin and neighboring rooftops in the background.

SCENE 3 — PREPARING TO GO OUT | 11–16 SEC
She returns inside and quickly prepares to leave. She picks up a small woven shoulder bag, checks herself naturally in a small old-fashioned mirror, adjusts her hair and puts on her simple shoes.

Her expression is relaxed and spontaneous — never posed.

SCENE 4 — WALKING THROUGH THE NEIGHBORHOOD | 16–22 SEC
She walks out through a wooden gate into a quiet 1950s Korean residential lane.

Show traditional houses, stone walls, bicycles, wooden carts, laundry lines, children playing farther away and neighbors performing ordinary chores. She walks naturally through the scene carrying her small bag.

SCENE 5 — EVERYDAY ERRAND | 22–27 SEC
She approaches a small public water pump or communal washing area. She briefly fills a small metal container, adjusts her grip and continues walking.

Keep the interaction simple and believable. No vendor, no market performance and no staged interaction.

SCENE 6 — FINAL MOMENT | 27–30 SEC
She walks along a sunlit lane bordered by old Korean houses and trees. A breeze moves her clothes naturally as she passes through patches of sunlight and shadow.

She briefly pauses to look toward something happening farther down the street, smiles subtly, then continues walking out of frame.

VISUAL STYLE:
Authentic 1950s Korean period-film aesthetic. Photorealistic historical reconstruction with soft natural daylight, slightly faded monochrome or extremely subtle muted color, fine analog film grain, gentle halation, slight lens softness, natural exposure fluctuations and occasional tiny imperfections characteristic of period film.

The image must NOT look like a modern video with a generic "vintage filter." Architecture, clothing, props, materials and human behavior should all convincingly belong to 1950s Korea.

CAMERA:
Observational period cinematography. The camera exists as an unseen observer rather than a participant. Use carefully composed static shots mixed with very slow natural camera movement. No handheld vlog movement, no selfie perspective, no modern stabilization, no dramatic zooms and no shots where the subject appears aware of being filmed.

AUDIO:
Pure environmental sound: birds, distant voices, footsteps, fabric moving in the breeze, wooden doors, water flowing from the pump, distant bicycles and neighborhood activity. No music, no narration, no modern sound effects.

REALISM:
Every movement must obey real-world physics. Natural hands and fingers, realistic walking, believable fabric deformation, consistent shadows, physically accurate sunlight, authentic facial expressions and continuous character identity. No extra fingers, warped hands, floating objects, distorted faces, modern objects or AI-looking motion.

The final result should feel like a genuine 30-second fragment of everyday Korean life from the 1950s — intimate, quiet, observational and historically believable, with the woman's ordinary routine providing the visual story.

FORMAT:
30 seconds, Seedance 2.5, 16:9, ultra-high-quality photorealism, cinematic historical realism, consistent character identity, coherent transitions, natural motion and authentic 1950s Korean atmosphere.

entries.title: Zombie Alien Donut Shop Comedy
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for a 30-second cinematic comedy scene featuring a zombie and an alien fighting over the last donut in a 2am shop, with strict identity locks and choreographed action beats.
entries.prompt:
A zombie and an alien walk into a donut shop at 2am only one donut left

FORMAT: 30 seconds | 24fps cinematic | ultra photorealistic live action | studio comedy action | practical prosthetic creature makeup | VFX time freeze | 2am fluorescent night interior. Real-time, no random slow motion.

NO ON-SCREEN TEXT - CRITICAL: no captions, subtitles, titles, logos, watermarks, timecode or UI at any point. Menu board and case labels are blank coloured panels, never legible.

IDENTITY LOCK: the same two leads in every shot, never changing face, skin, height, wardrobe or props. No morphing, no extra fighters. The cashier and four customers become frozen statues after 0:03 and never move, blink or react until 0:27.

CHARACTERS
THE ZOMBIE: 6 foot 2, gaunt, grey-green mottled skin with dry cracked patches, cloudy pale eyes, sunken sockets, lank dark hair, no wounds, no blood. Torn navy night-shift security uniform, crooked clip-on tie, one shoe untied. Moves stiff and heavy, then surprisingly quick. Voice: deep gravelly rasp, slow, every word an effort.
THE ALIEN: 4 foot 10, slender, smooth pale lilac skin, large glossy black almond eyes, small nostril slits, narrow bald cranium, long four-fingered hands. Oversized yellow tourist rain poncho, small cross-body camera. Voice: light, clipped, overly correct English with a faint electronic flutter.

ENVIRONMENT: a narrow 24-hour donut shop at 2am. Cream tile floor, chrome stools, a lit glass display case along the right wall, all trays empty except exactly ONE glazed donut on a paper doily, glowing under the case light. Rain streaking the front window, a red traffic light outside.

0:00-0:03 THE FREEZE
Handheld medium down the counter. A customer drops a coffee cup, coffee arcing. The zombie and the alien lunge at the case from opposite ends. Sound drops out. Everything stops: coffee hangs as a glossy brown ribbon, raindrops pinned on the glass, the cashier's yawn locked open. Only the two leads keep moving.

0:03-0:08 REALIZATION
Both straighten, look at the hanging coffee, then each other. Slow 30 degree orbit.
ALIEN: "I have crossed four galaxies for this donut."
ZOMBIE: "I... died... for this donut."
ALIEN: "That is not the same thing."

0:08-0:13 FIRST EXCHANGE
The zombie swings a long stiff arm, the alien ducks, slides on wet tile and kicks a stool into his shins. He topples, catches the counter, groans. Whip pan as she vaults onto the counter.

0:13-0:18 THE FLASH
She snaps her camera in his face, a hard white flash. He staggers, then pulls a folded umbrella from a frozen customer with real effort, the customer staying rigid.
ZOMBIE: "Rude."

0:18-0:23 COUNTER FIGHT
Fast tracking shot. She leaps stool to stool over frozen shoulders, he swings the umbrella, she parries with a frozen customer's rolled newspaper. Three crisp readable exchanges. His clip-on tie pops off. Her hood flops over her eyes.

0:23-0:27 TRUCE
Both stop, breathing hard, hands on knees, coffee ribbon between them.
ALIEN: "Share?"
ZOMBIE: "Share."
They shake hands, four lilac fingers in a grey palm. Micro pause. Both eyes flick to the donut.

0:27-0:30 TIME RESUMES
Both dive at the case. The world unfreezes: coffee splashes down, the cashier finishes the yawn, customers jolt, rain runs, fridge hum slams back.

LAST FRAME: locked medium wide down the counter. The zombie and the alien pressed cheek to cheek at the open case, both gripping the one donut, glaze stretching between their hands, both grinning, coffee spraying through the light. Cashier and customers turn to stare. No text, captions, subtitles, signage lettering, logos or watermarks anywhere in frame.

CAMERA: controlled handheld in exchanges, smooth dolly and orbit on freeze reveals, low angle for the zombie, eye level for the alien, fast whip pans. Shallow depth on dialogue, consistent screen direction.

LIGHT AND COLOUR: cold overhead fluorescent key, warm amber case glow on faces and the donut, red street light through the rainy window. 70% cool tile and skin, 20% case amber, 10% red.

VFX AND PHYSICS: frozen liquid holds surface tension and highlights. The resume restores gravity in one continuous frame, no morphing, no dissolve. Stools scrape and tip, his heavy fall shakes the counter, she lands light, poncho crackling and lagging, true contact shadows. Nothing floats except the deliberately frozen.

ACTING: natural blinking, active brows on the zombie, the alien's eyes narrowing and widening, dry deadpan timing. Only the speaker's mouth forms words.

AUDIO, DIEGETIC ONLY: fridge hum and rain before the freeze. During it near-silence: breathing, a dry groan, sneaker squeak on wet tile, poncho crackle, stool scrape, umbrella whoosh, shutter clack. At resume: splash, gasps, rain and hum return. These are the only words spoken. No music, no score, no humming, no swell, no drone.

LOCKS: No blood, no gore, no wounds. No duplicated people, no extra limbs, the alien always has four fingers. No wardrobe or face changes, no cartoon physics, no excessive shake. Dry comedy, readable fight, coherent physics.

entries.prompt:
THE HARVEST KING — SEEDANCE 2.5

DIRECTIVE: Exactly 30 seconds, 16:9, photorealistic Hollywood folk-horror, 60fps where supported. Preserve @image1’s exact face, hair, skin tone, build, outfit and props in every shot. No identity drift, clones or costume changes.

LOCATION: Haunted pumpkin farm on Halloween night, foggy field, corn maze on the left, weathered red barn far right, rusted tractor, blue moonlight and glowing orange pumpkins. Maintain geography.

MONSTER: A 15-meter Harvest King made of vines, rotten pumpkins, tractor wheels and farm tools. Giant carved pumpkin head, burning candle inside its mouth (weak point), enormous rusted scythe. Supporting enemies: burlap scarecrows with ember eyes, stitched mouths and rusted sickles.

WEAPON: @image1’s existing equipment plus one rusted iron lantern-hook pole pulled from a fence. Grounded, weighty combat and realistic physics.

TIMELINE:

00:00–00:05 | THE AWAKENING: Macro jack-o’-lantern candle sputters. Crane shot reveals the foggy field as orange light ignites pumpkins toward the barn. @image1 turns toward the glow, alert.

00:05–00:10 | SCARECROWS: Scarecrows break free and attack. The hero tears a rusted iron pole from the fence, dodges a sickle and strikes an attacker into the others. Track laterally through corn.

00:10–00:15 | CROW STORM: Five scarecrows rush him. He blocks sickles, hooks a leg and counters. One powerful boot strike shatters a scarecrow into straw and exploding crows during a 180° slow-motion orbit. Music abruptly fades.

00:15–00:20 | THE GIANT RISES: Earth splits; pumpkins roll inward. The colossal Harvest King erupts from the soil, towering over the barn. It swings its scythe; the hero slides underneath as the blade splinters the fence and barn wall permanently.

00:20–00:25 | THE CLIMB: The hero sprints, leaps onto the embedded scythe handle and climbs onto the giant’s arm. He hooks whipping vines with his pole, swings past them and reaches the shoulder, facing the burning candle inside its mouth.

00:25–00:30 | FINAL TWIST: Flame-lit close-up. He drives the pole through the carved mouth, smashing the candle. A fiery blast erupts; he leaps clear. The giant collapses into rotten pumpkins and straw in slow motion. At dawn, the hero rises among motionless scarecrows. At 00:29.5, the untouched jack-o’-lantern relights and its smile widens. Cut to black at exactly 00:30.

AUDIO: Original score: eerie cello and music box, crows, wind, creaking wood, taiko and choir escalating into 140-BPM orchestral action. Synchronize impacts, metallic scythe whistle, flame blast and giant collapse. Absolute silence at 00:28.5; one final music-box note. No dialogue, text or logos. Maintain continuity of damage, fire, debris and character identity.

6-7s: Close on the centre screen: a finger of NORA presses a glowing round button. <a soft chime>
7-10s: Low at road level behind CAR beside the bus: the four nozzles flare white, gas blasts onto the asphalt, a cyclist swerves, and CAR rises straight up past the side of the bus, level, the Chrysler Building ahead. <thrusters spooling up into a roar>

15-19s: NORA's view through the windscreen at the 20th floor: dozens of flying cars between the towers, first gliding in neat stacked lanes, then several break out and dart everywhere, cutting across lanes, diving and swerving, thrusters glowing. <thrusters humming> <horns in the air>

MAIN SUBJECT
Woman: about 20 years old, light brown (chestnut) hair in a messy loose high bun with wispy loose strands around the face, light grey-blue eyes, freckles across the nose and cheeks, warm natural smile. Cream textured linen blouse with a gathered round neckline and full sleeves rolled up to the forearms, dark charcoal-grey wool pinafore dress with wide straps, long dark wool skirt, simple brown leather boots, a folded linen cloth tucked into the pinafore. She speaks English in a natural, warm voice.
Baby dragon: a SMALL, slim, lizard-like baby dragon with a big head, the size of a large cat, about 45 cm long and 25 cm tall at the shoulders. Cream-white pebbled scales with soft pink and lilac mottled patches on the back, legs and tail, a smooth cream scaled chest and neck. A tall fan of pink-tipped spikes (pink to crimson tips, lilac bases) sweeps up and back from the top of the head like a crest, with smaller cream spikes around the cheeks and neck. TWO cream ridged horns curving up from the head, the right one taller than the left. VERY LARGE round glossy amber eyes with black vertical pupils, pink skin around the eyes, a small pale pink nose, a gentle closed-mouth smile. One large translucent pale wing visible with pink ribs and fine pink veins, wingspan about 70 cm, and a wing arm covered in scales. A tail that curls upward, ending in a fan of pink-tipped spikes. Four sturdy legs with cream claws. Quick, curious and playful like a puppy. It does not speak, only makes tiny squeaks and chirps.

LOCATION AND HEIGHT
Stone courtyard of a rustic cottage at ground level. Rough wooden table 2 m long and 0.9 m high. In the middle of the table lies a flat grey stone slab, 60 cm wide and 5 cm thick. On the slab stands a small black iron tripod, 25 cm high, and under it lies a neat stack of split dry firewood logs with a handful of dry kindling and twigs between them. The firewood is UNLIT from the start: no flame, no embers, no smoke. There is NO other fire source anywhere in the scene. Foreground: on the table, a black cast-iron pot 35 cm wide with a domed lid with a knob, filled with dry corn kernels (at the start it stands on the bare slab beside the tripod), a wooden bowl of kernels, loose kernels on the planks. Midground: a mossy dry-stone wall 1.3 m high, a grey stone cottage on the left with a dark wooden door, a stack of firewood against the cottage wall. Background: green hills and sea cliffs about 3 km away under a golden sunset sky. Nobody else is present.

CAMERA AND LOOK
Handheld cinematic live-action, horizontal. Shot sizes: medium-wide, three-quarter, close-up. One low warm sun from the left behind the wall, golden hour, soft long shadows, natural skin tones, muted contrast. Mild bloom, faint film noise, slight hand shake, delayed autofocus right after the fire burst. The only extra light is the small orange glow of the dragon's flame. No glossy beauty lighting, no artificial rim light, no heavy grading. The camera and the operator never appear.

TIMELINE (CONTINUOUS STORY)
Cut only after a movement is finished. The dragon is always on the woman's RIGHT side, on the table. The stone slab with the tripod and firewood stays in the middle of the table.

00:00-00:03.5 THE LEAP AND THE FIRE (one continuous medium-wide shot, slow push-in)
The first frame is already in motion. The woman leans over the open pot on the table, both hands on the table edge, looking down at the corn. The unlit firewood and tripod are visible on the slab beside the pot. 00:00-00:00.5 TAKEOFF: at the right edge of the frame the baby dragon pushes off the dirt ground with its hind legs, wing snapping half open. 00:00.5-00:01.3 FLIGHT: it arcs about 1 m up and across the table edge in a short rising curve, wings fluttering. 00:01.3-00:01.8 LANDING: its front claws hit the wooden planks first, then the hind legs, it slides about 10 cm and scatters a few kernels, the tail whips for balance and the wings fold. The woman freezes, eyes wide, still leaning over the pot. 00:01.8-00:02.4: the dragon sits right beside the pot, inhales, its throat glows orange and its chest swells. 00:02.4-00:03.0: ONE short bright jet of fire, about 40 cm long, goes straight down into the open pot only. 00:03.0-00:03.5: the kernels burst at once into white popcorn that shoots out of the pot toward the lens and the woman's face. The firewood stays unlit, the wooden table does not catch fire. No dialogue in this block, only her sharp gasp.

00:03.5-00:06.5 SHOCK (one close-up, slightly handheld)
Close-up of the woman's face at pot level: her whole face is covered in black soot except the area around her wide grey-blue eyes, popcorn pieces stuck in her hair and on top of her bun, a few popcorn pieces still falling past the lens. The baby dragon slides its head into the frame at her right shoulder, huge amber eyes, a guilty little smile, a thin puff of smoke from one nostril. She turns her head slowly toward the dragon and says in a stunned, breathless voice: "What did you do?"

00:06.5-00:09.5 THE SCOLDING (one medium-wide shot, three-quarter angle)
The cottage door, the table, the wooden bowl and firewood are visible. 00:06.5-00:07.5: the woman straightens up and wipes her cheek with the back of her hand, smearing the soot. 00:07.5-00:08.5: she points one finger at the dragon and says firmly but with a hint of a smile: "Less fire." 00:08.5-00:09.5: she puts both hands on her hips. The dragon sits on the table among scattered popcorn and kernels, lowers its head, closes its eyes, folds its wings tight, the tail tip flicks nervously. At the end it opens ONE eye and peeks at her.

00:09.5-00:15 THE GENTLE FLAME (one medium shot, three-quarter angle)
00:09.5-00:11.0: the woman drops a quick handful of kernels from the wooden bowl into the pot, lifts it with both hands onto the iron tripod above the UNLIT firewood and closes the lid. The baby dragon sits on the table about 30 cm from the slab, on her right. 00:11.0-00:12.5: she raises ONE finger and says calmly, in a low, soothing voice: "Slow down... easy." while the dragon shuffles closer without leaving the table. 00:12.5-00:14.5: only now the dragon leans its head toward the firewood and breathes a thin, soft flame, careful and controlled. The kindling catches first, then the logs, and an orange ring of flame lights the base of the pot. This is the FIRST and ONLY fire under the pot, started by the dragon. The flame stays on the stone slab, the wooden planks do not burn. 00:14.5-00:15.0: the lid begins to rattle faintly as the first kernels pop inside.

00:15-00:18 PERFECT (one close-up, table level, held to the final frame)
00:15.0-00:16.2: low close-up behind the pot. Holding the folded linen cloth, the woman lifts the lid, steam rolls out and the pot is full of fluffy WHITE popcorn, none of it burnt. The dragon did NOT burn it. 00:16.2-00:16.6: her eyes go wide, her mouth opens in surprise. 00:16.6-00:17.7: she breaks into a bright happy smile, looks at the drag

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Cinematic Family Bedtime Story
entries.description: A complete, detailed prompt for generating a photorealistic 30-second vertical video featuring a family bedtime scene with dialogue and specific character descriptions.
entries.prompt:
Create a photorealistic, cinematic 30-second vertical featuring a loving family. Daddy is a 30-year-old man wearing a soft navy-blue T-shirt. Mommy is a 28-year-old woman wearing a cream-colored nightdress. Their adorable 4-year-old daughter wears pink pajamas with tiny stars. Keep faces, hairstyles, clothing, voices, and proportions consistent throughout. Setting: a cozy child’s bedroom at night with a warm bedside lamp and soft blankets.
SCENE 1 — ONE LAST THING (0–7 seconds)
Camera: Medium shot of daddy tucking his daughter into bed and pulling up her blanket.
Daddy: “Goodnight, princess. Time to sleep!”
The daughter gently grabs his hand.
Daughter: “Wait, daddy! I have one more wish!”
Daddy smiles and sits beside her.
SCENE 2 — THE UNEXPECTED WISH (7–14 seconds)
Camera: Close-up of the daughter looking into daddy’s eyes.
Daddy: “What do you wish for, sweetheart? A new toy?”
She shakes her head.
Daughter: “No. I wish you could stay little with me forever!”
Daddy’s smile softens as he listens.
SCENE 3 — MOMMY HEARS HER (14–22 seconds)
Mommy appears in the doorway and hears the conversation.
Mommy: “Why do you want daddy to stay little?”
The daughter looks at mommy.
Daughter: “Because then nobody would tell me to go to bed!”
Mommy laughs. Daddy raises his eyebrows in playful surprise.
SCENE 4 — THE SWEET ENDING (22–30 seconds)
Daddy gently kisses his daughter’s forehead.
Daddy: “I may grow older, but I’ll always be your daddy.”
The daughter hugs him around the neck.
Daughter: “Good. Then you can carry me even when I’m big!”
Mommy sits beside them and joins the hug. End with the daughter smiling sleepily between her parents.
STYLE: Photorealistic faces and natural skin textures, realistic child expressions, accurate lip-sync, soft warm lighting, gentle bedtime piano music, close-ups during emotional dialogue, and smooth cinematic camera movements. Natural conversational pacing. Keep the bedroom and characters consistent.

秋の田んぼ。稲をかき分けて迫るコンバインの刈り取り部。運転席で目を丸くするさくら。畦のおじさんが腕を前へまっすぐ伸ばす。レバーを倒すと機体が奥へよれ、今度は手前へよれすぎる。土手の上から見下ろすと、刈り跡はへびのようにくねっていた。おじさんがしゃがんで、稲の株の列を手のひらでなぞる。

あごひもを結び直して、レバーを握る。分草板の先を株の列に合わせると、機体はぶれずにまっすぐ進む。最後の稲が吸い込まれる。見下ろすと、くねった跡の隣に一本だけまっすぐな刈り跡。軽トラの荷台に、金色のもみが滝のように流れ落ちる。運転席で両手を上げる。

entries.title: Realistic Fire Rescue Sequence
entries.description: A prompt for a live-action style rescue sequence where a woman saves a trapped man from a fire, emphasizing physical realism and strength.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic live-action rescue sequence, daytime, modern apartment building. Real Hollywood footage look, NOT animation or CGI.
Rules: Exactly ONE young woman (hero) and ONE trapped adult man. No attackers, no supernatural effects, no extra characters. Same people, same clothes, same building throughout. No teleporting, no location changes.
Sequence (continuous, no missing transitions):
Outside: Wide establishing shot of a multi-story apartment building in a busy urban street. The woman stands alone on the sidewalk. A small, realistic fire starts in an upper-floor window with orange flames and dark smoke. People outside panic and look up.
Entering: She realizes someone is trapped and runs inside. Realistic handheld camera follows her through a smoke-filled hallway with flickering emergency lights. She covers her mouth and calls, "Is anyone there?" A weak voice answers, "Help!"
Finding him: She finds a man near a blocked doorway, conscious but struggling to breathe. She says calmly, "I'm going to get you out." She helps him stand, his arm over her shoulder.
Blocked exit: Heavy ceiling debris falls across the corridor and blocks the way out. It does NOT disappear.
Her strength: She says, "Stay here." She grips the object with both hands and physically drags and pushes it aside. Her muscles tense, her breathing gets heavy, her feet push against the floor, and dust falls. Her strength is the ONLY unusual element: no flying, no glow, no magic, no cartoon physics.
Rescue: She returns to the man, supports him through the smoke, and gets him out of the building.
Firefighters: Real firefighters and emergency vehicles have arrived and take over helping the man. He looks back to thank her, and she gives a quiet nod and steps away from the crowd.
Quiet exit: Slow cinematic tracking shot from behind as she walks away down the sidewalk. The burning building, firefighters and flashing lights stay visible in the background. Final shot: wide view of the building and firefighters, with her already walking away in the distance.
Look: Photorealistic live-action, natural skin texture, realistic fire, smoke, dust and debris, natural handheld camera, natural depth of field, realistic lighting, no unnecessary slow motion, no excessive cuts, no superhero look.

entries.prompt:
NEON BREACH

[ENGINE DIRECTIVE]
Genre: Cyberpunk action thriller. Duration: exactly 30 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9. Target: 60fps where supported. Style: photorealistic Hollywood cinema, heavy rain, neon reflections, volumetric lighting, realistic motion blur and skin texture.

HERO LOCK: @image1 is the only hero. Preserve his exact face, hairstyle, facial hair, skin tone, age, body proportions, outfit and accessories in every shot. No clones, costume changes, new weapons or invented powers.

LOCATION: Halcyon Stack, a rain-soaked futuristic megacity with two 40-story towers connected by a glass skybridge, rooftop machinery, steel gantries and abstract neon signs. Maintain spatial continuity.

ENEMIES: Three red-scanner hunter drones using ramming and taser darts, plus a 3-meter armored enforcer with matte-black plating, hydraulic limbs and a dim blue visor.

CAMERA: Motivated low tracking, lateral pursuit, tactical high angles, over-the-shoulder shots, controlled slow-motion orbit and vertical descending tracking. Natural motion blur. Hero generally travels left to right.

[AUDIO]
Original pulsing synth bass, industrial percussion, rising tense strings, heavy rain, distant sirens, drone rotors, hydraulic servos, glass shattering, steel groans and cable snaps. Music cuts at 00:27, leaving rain and a soft sustained synth pad.

[TIMELINE]

00:00–00:05 | THE HUNT
Wide aerial view of neon towers in heavy rain. Camera drops behind @image1 sprinting across a rooftop. Three drones rise and lock on at 00:03. He vaults a ventilation unit.

00:05–00:10 | DRONE ALLEY

00:10–00:15 | THE ENFORCER

00:20–00:25 | CABLE DROP

The enforcer falls through neon-lit rain and impacts the street at 00:27. Silence follows. The hero rises at the rooftop edge and looks back at the shattered skybridge. Camera slowly pulls away, revealing the immense glowing city.

END: Quiet, powerful cinematic composition. No text or logos.

entries.prompt:
Duration: 25–30 seconds

Visual style: Ultra-photorealistic, dark fantasy, futuristic luxury car commercial, gothic Halloween cinema.

CHARACTER & WORLD CONSISTENCY
A glamorous adult vampire queen with long red wavy hair, pale porcelain makeup, smoky eyes, deep burgundy lipstick, a black velvet corset dress.

She drives the same sleek metallic-silver futuristic flying sports car throughout the film. The car has sculpted aerodynamic bodywork, violet neon underglow, glowing propulsion systems, a panoramic glass canopy, and elegant gullwing doors.
Paris at midnight on Halloween. Gothic architecture, fog-covered rooftops, wet streets, floating mist, glowing pumpkins, and a gigantic luminous blood-red moon dominate the atmosphere.

Maintain consistent character appearance, car design, lighting, and wardrobe across all shots.

SHOT 1 — THE HALLOWEEN NIGHTMARE (0–4 seconds)

Camera: Cinematic street-level tracking shot transitioning into an intimate interior close-up.

A massive traffic jam fills a rain-soaked Paris boulevard. Red brake lights stretch into the distance. The Eiffel Tower glows through atmospheric fog.
Inside the silver car, the vampire queen taps her fingers impatiently against the steering wheel. Violet dashboard light reflects in her eyes.

Her phone rings.

Friend, on the phone: “Babe! Where are you?! The Halloween party is starting!”

Vampire queen: “Relax, darling. I'll find another way.”

She smirks, revealing her tiny vampire fangs.

SHOT 2 — THE SUPERNATURAL TAKEOFF (4–8 seconds)

Camera: Extreme macro close-up, followed by a dramatic low-angle exterior shot.

Her black-gloved finger presses the glowing violet flight-mode control.
The dashboard pulses with futuristic holographic light. Mechanical propulsion fins unfold beneath the car. Violet energy illuminates the wet asphalt.

The suspension rises. The wheels rotate inward as concealed thrusters activate.

The car lifts smoothly, then suddenly accelerates vertically between the surrounding buildings, leaving a swirling vortex of mist and crimson-violet light.

Vampire queen: “Traffic is so… mortal.”

The camera races upward beneath the vehicle, revealing its glowing undercarriage as the car climbs into the night sky.

SHOT 3 — THE EIFFEL TOWER SPIRAL (8–13 seconds)

Camera: Fast aerial chase shot with a sweeping 360-degree orbit around the vehicle.

The silver flying car bursts through a layer of clouds and approaches the illuminated Eiffel Tower.
It banks sharply, then performs a spectacular corkscrew spiral around the tower, weaving through the open night sky without touching the structure.

The camera circles the car while the Eiffel Tower rotates dramatically in the background. Its golden lights streak across the car's reflective silver body.

The vehicle dives past the tower's upper section, rolls gracefully onto its side, and pulls upward into a steep climb.

A trail of violet light curls around the tower like magical ribbons.

The camera pulls far back to reveal the Eiffel Tower, the Seine, illuminated bridges, and the sprawling city below.

SHOT 4 — THE BLOOD MOON REVEAL (13–19 seconds)

Camera: Extreme wide shot transitioning into a dramatic side profile and a 360-degree aerial orbit.

A gigantic blood-red Halloween moon emerges from behind dark, rolling clouds, appearing enormous above the Paris skyline.
The car accelerates toward the moon, climbing through swirling silver mist. The camera follows from behind as the city shrinks beneath the vehicle.

At the peak of the ascent, the car performs a graceful aerial barrel roll directly in front of the enormous crimson moon.

For a breathtaking moment, the car becomes a sharp black-and-silver silhouette against the glowing red lunar surface.

The camera rotates a full 360 degrees around the flying car, revealing the moon, drifting clouds, the Eiffel Tower far below, and the entire illuminated Paris skyline.

The moonlight catches the vampire queen's face through the panoramic glass canopy. Her cape flows behind her like crimson smoke.

She smiles confidently.

Vampire queen: “Now this is my kind of nightlife.”

SHOT 5 — THE EPIC 360° PARIS PANORAMA (19–24 seconds)

Camera: Seamless cinematic aerial orbit, then a rapid descending chase shot.

The car levels out and glides above Paris in a wide, sweeping arc.
The camera completes a breathtaking 360-degree panoramic orbit around the vehicle, showcasing gothic rooftops, the winding Seine, glittering bridges, the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre courtyard, and the blood-red moon dominating the horizon.

Clouds drift beneath the car. Violet propulsion trails illuminate the mist.

The car suddenly tilts forward and dives toward the city in a controlled cinematic descent.

The camera chases closely behind as it races between elegant Parisian rooftops, then banks sharply into the illuminated street leading to the Halloween club.

SHOT 6 — THE VAMPIRE QUEEN ARRIVES (24–30 seconds)

Camera: Low-angle tracking shot, dramatic slow motion, final hero shot.

The car descends through swirling fog and lands perfectly outside an extravagant gothic Halloween nightclub.
Its violet lights pulse once. The gullwing doors open slowly.

The vampire queen steps out in slow motion. Her crimson-lined cape sweeps dramatically across the pavement as purple spotlights cut through the fog.

Her friends, dressed as glamorous witches and vampires, stare at her in disbelief.

Friend: “BABE! HOW DID YOU GET HERE SO FAST?!”

Vampire queen, smirking: “I don't wait in traffic. I fly.”

She flashes her fangs and walks confidently toward the club entrance.

The camera cranes upward to reveal the silver flying car, the gothic nightclub, the illuminated Eiffel Tower, and the enormous blood-red moon above Paris.

END FRAME: The vampire queen's silhouette against the glowing club entrance as violet light and crimson moonlight fill the screen.

CINEMATIC CAMERA & VFX REQUIREMENTS

Spectacular aerial tracking shots and dramatic low-angle vehicle reveals.

A complete 360-degree camera orbit around the flying car against the blood-red moon.
A dramatic corkscrew flight maneuver around the Eiffel Tower.
Volumetric fog, swirling clouds, moonlit mist, realistic reflections, and violet energy trails.
Strong contrast between silver metallic surfaces, violet neon, crimson moonlight, and golden Parisian architecture.
Physically coherent vehicle movement, realistic acceleration, smooth banking, and elegant aerial rolls.
Sophisticated gothic fashion-film aesthetics with blockbuster-scale visual effects.
Seamless transitions, cinematic motion blur, carefully controlled slow motion, and epic orchestral-electronic music.
Natural English dialogue with accurate lip-sync and consistent character identity.
NEGATIVE PROMPT: Cartoon rendering, cheap CGI, flat lighting, low-resolution textures, inconsistent vehicle geometry, changing faces, changing outfits, duplicated cars, distorted Eiffel Tower, broken architecture, random text, unwanted logos, excessive motion blur, jerky camera movement, gore, or horror imagery that overwhelms the luxury-fashion aesthetic.

entries.prompt:
GETTING READY FOR HER FIRST JOB INTERVIEW

Create an ultra-realistic personal vlog filmed by a friend using a consumer MiniDV camcorder in South Korea in 2003. A young Korean woman nervously prepares for her first job interview in her modest bedroom, from choosing her outfit to rushing out the door.

CHARACTER & CONTINUITY

A Korean woman in her early 20s with a soft oval face, natural skin texture, shoulder-length dark brown hair, and side-swept bangs. She starts in a T-shirt and home trousers, then changes into a white blouse, dark knee-length skirt, dark cardigan, and black shoes. Maintain consistent identity, hairstyle, outfit, and props.

SCENE 1 — OUTFIT (0–5s)

She compares two cardigans against her interview clothes, hesitates, chooses the darker one, and gives the camera a nervous smile. A wooden desk, paper calendar, and handwritten interview note establish the year.

SCENE 2 — IRONING (5–10s)

She carefully irons her blouse, struggles briefly with a sleeve, smooths it out, and checks the collar. A corded telephone and household calendar appear in the background. The iron stays safely on the board when not in use.

SCENE 3 — PRACTICE (10–15s)

Dressed for the interview, she practices her introduction in a mirror, forgets her words, checks handwritten notes, and tries again. She notices the camera and laughs shyly.

SCENE 4 — DOCUMENTS (15–20s)

She organizes her résumé and application papers into a folder. One page falls; she retrieves it and puts it back. Seeing the clock, she places the folder in her shoulder bag and checks for her purse and keys.

SCENE 5 — FINAL CHECK (20–26s)

She smooths her blouse, adjusts her cardigan, fixes her collar, and tucks back loose hair. After attempting a confident smile, she notices the time and grabs her bag in a hurry.

SCENE 6 — DEPARTURE (26–30s)

She hurries to the door, checks her keys, slips into her black shoes, and gives the camera one last nervous smile. The camera follows her into the hallway before an abrupt recording cut.

VISUAL STYLE & SOUND

Authentic early-2000s MiniDV footage: soft SD detail, mild video noise, imperfect handheld framing, autofocus hunting, accidental zooms, and brief exposure shifts. Use natural lighting, realistic colors, and period-appropriate Korean apartment interiors. Include fabric rustling, ironing, paper shuffling, faint clock ticking, footsteps, jingling keys, and the door opening. Dialogue is quiet, natural Korean speech.

CONTINUITY RULES

Keep facial identity, anatomy, lighting, and room layout consistent. Use a natural transition for the outfit change. Once dressed, her outfit stays unchanged. Documents remain in the folder and bag after packing; account for the keys before departure.

Hazy sun, dust in the air, ten lanes of traffic bunched up before the barriers: colorful painted trucks with hanging decorations, overloaded buses, auto-rickshaws, hatchbacks, a tractor, a cow wandering calmly between lanes. Horns blaring, a chai vendor on the shoulder, a "FASTag" sign overhead.

The hero car is the vehicle from @Image1 and @Image2: a low, angular wedge-shaped coupe in matte silver-white, dark bronze-tinted glass roof, thin white light strip across the nose, five-spoke black wheels, full-width red tail light bar, four round gold-ringed thruster ports in the rear diffuser, rear plate reading "RDSTR". Keep this exact design, proportions, and color in every frame.

0-7s: Camera starts at ground level, low and handheld, drifting along the jammed lane and past the rickshaws and trucks, then finds the silver car sitting in the queue, glowing quietly among the chaos. A driver in a crisp shirt and sunglasses, [@Image3: optional driver], drums the steering wheel, unbothered. The car glides over the closed barrier, with the driver giving the operator a small two-finger salute.

20-26s: It sets down gently on the open highway beyond the plaza, wheels touching with a soft bounce. The road ahead is completely empty. The car cruises off with its red light bar glowing, leaving the whole plaza staring.

entries.title: Retro Shopping Date MiniDV Video
entries.description: A prompt for generating a nostalgic 2003-style shopping date video of a Korean couple, emphasizing authentic camcorder aesthetics and natural interactions.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Korean home video from around 2003, casually recorded by a friend using an early-2000s consumer MiniDV camcorder. Capture a sweet, spontaneous shopping date between a young Korean couple at a busy Seoul shopping mall, with imperfect framing, natural interactions, and authentic everyday behavior.

CHARACTERS: A young adult Korean woman in her early 20s with long black hair, natural makeup, a fitted pastel-pink top, low-rise blue jeans, sneakers, and a small shoulder bag. Her boyfriend is a young Korean man in his early 20s with slightly messy black hair, a casual striped T-shirt, loose jeans, and sneakers. Maintain consistent faces, outfits, and body proportions throughout.

STORY:

The couple walks through a crowded Seoul shopping mall, playfully teasing each other while the camera follows them from behind. They enter a toy store filled with colorful plushies. The woman excitedly picks up an oversized teddy bear, hugs it tightly, and makes her boyfriend take a picture of her with it. He jokingly holds a tiny stuffed rabbit beside his face, making her burst into laughter. They choose two soft toys, carry them around the mall, and stop in front of a large store mirror. She pulls him close and takes a mirror selfie with a small early-2000s digital camera while he makes a funny expression behind her.

Later, they buy one large ice cream and share it while walking through the mall. She takes a bite, offers it to him, and laughs when he accidentally gets a little ice cream on his lip. She gently wipes it away with her finger as he smiles shyly. They enter an old-fashioned mall elevator, still holding their plush toys. Just before the doors close, he leans toward her and gives her a brief, sweet kiss. She smiles bashfully at the camera as the elevator doors slide shut, ending the recording abruptly.

CAMERA & FOOTAGE: Authentic 4-3 early-2000s MiniDV footage, handheld shake, imperfect framing, accidental zooms, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild compression noise, and natural motion blur. The camera behaves like a friend casually filming them, sometimes reacting late or briefly losing the action. No polished cinematography or smooth tracking shots.

SETTING: A busy Seoul shopping mall circa 2003, crowded walkways, toy stores, colorful plushies, clothing shops, large mirrors, old-fashioned elevators, fluorescent lighting, and shoppers passing naturally in the background.

AUDIO: Natural mall chatter, footsteps, shop announcements, toy-store ambience, camera shutter clicks, plastic shopping bags, laughter, ice cream wrapper sounds, elevator chimes, and quiet spontaneous conversation. Casual natural English dialogue. No background music or narration.

REALISM & CONTINUITY: Natural couple chemistry, shy smiles, playful teasing, believable hand movements, realistic ice cream interaction, consistent character id

entries.title: Seoul Summer Errand Home Video Prompt
entries.description: A prompt for generating a realistic, shaky handheld home video of a young Korean woman running errands in an old Seoul neighborhood, mimicking early-2000s DV camcorder footage.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home video of a young Korean woman running a small summer errand in an old Seoul residential neighborhood. It should feel like an unplanned recording by a friend using an early-2000s DV camcorder.

SUBJECT: A naturally pretty Korean woman in her early 20s, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, long black hair in a loose low ponytail with wispy strands. She wears a white sleeveless knit top, faded-blue denim shorts, white ankle socks, black canvas sneakers, and a thin silver bracelet. Maintain identical face, hairstyle, outfit, and proportions throughout.

SETTING & STYLE: Quiet, lived-in Seoul streets with narrow concrete lanes, modest houses, weathered walls, potted flowers, parked bicycles, overhead wires, hanging laundry, and a tiny local shop. Warm summer afternoon, ordinary neighborhood life, no recognizable brands or tourist attractions.

Use shaky handheld footage, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild noise, motion blur, and subtle camcorder handling sounds. No stabilization, cinematic camera moves, dramatic lighting, or commercial polish.

30-SECOND SEQUENCE:

- 0–5s: She exits her house with a cloth tote, checks the door, notices the camera, smiles, and says, “I'm just going to the shop.”
- 5–11s: She greets an elderly neighbor with a polite bow, then steps aside as a little girl rides past on a bicycle, its bell ringing. The camera briefly follows the bicycle.
- 11–18s: Wind shakes a flowering pot, scattering small flowers. She picks one up, gently returns it to the planter's edge, smiles at the camera, and continues.
- 18–25s: At a tiny neighborhood shop, she takes a reusable container from her tote, receives a small paper-wrapped item from the shopkeeper, thanks them, and puts it away.
- 25–30s: She walks back past the same houses and bicycles. Her ponytail moves in the breeze as she waves playfully at the camera, reaches her doorway, turns back with a smile, and the footage abruptly cuts to black.

AUDIO: Natural location sound only—footsteps, bicycle bell, distant scooters, birds, summer insects, rustling leaves, faint neighborhood chatter, shop door, and subtle camcorder noise. No music, narration, added sound effects, or other dialogue.

IMPORTANT: Prioritize authentic everyday behavior, natural expressions, realistic timing, consistent identity, and the imperfect charm of an old personal home video. Avoid staged acting, exaggerated gestures, artificial skin, visual glitches, or an AI-generated appearance.

entries.title: Eastern Fantasy Dragon and Woman Confrontation Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed text-to-video prompt for Seedance 2.5 generating a cinematic scene of an Eastern dragon descending into a well while confronting a woman in a moon-white robe.
entries.prompt:
青砖天井，珍珠白应龙缓缓下探，月白长袍女子与龙对峙；15 秒竖屏。

时长：15秒
比例：9:16竖屏
形式：纯文生视频，无任何参考图。
风格：东方奇幻写实电影感，慢节奏、压迫感与静谧并存。
无对白、无旁白、无字幕、无界面文字、无音频歌词。

【主体】
一口深邃的青砖圆形天井水井，井壁多层楼阁式砖纹向上延伸。井底浅水映出微光。
一条成年东方应龙（独角、长须、四爪），鳞片为珍珠白带靛青边缘，从井壁上方极慢下探。
井台浅水广台边站着一位成年东方女性，身着月白交领长袍与雾青披帛，长发披散，面朝巨龙，神情镇定。

【镜头与动作】
00:00–00:04：镜头沿浅水广台边缘做极轻微顺时针弧移，同时微微后撤，人物、水面反射、井壁与盘井而下的龙形成缓慢透视变化；严格不做剧烈Orbit。
00:04–00:10：应龙龙头先向下送出，颈部形成柔和弧线，力量沿胸段缓慢传递；近前龙爪略张再收。盘绕井壁的后半龙身做极慢S形延迟波动。翼根膜翼仅轻颤，不展开扑翼。龙口微张吐少量寒雾。井中薄雾盘旋下坠，水面细纹外扩。
00:10–00:15：月白衣女子几乎不动，衣摆与长发被压风后拂。建筑绝对稳定。镜头缓推至女子与龙面对面的特写后定格。

【光影】
天井顶洒下冷青天光，井壁湿润反光；龙鳞与寒雾带细微高光。

【Negative】
参考图依赖，字幕，识别框，HUD，西方飞龙造型，多头，肢体增生，剧烈抖动，瞬移，卡通塑料质感，水印，平台Logo，对白，音乐盖过环境音。

秋晴れの重機体験場。巨大なバケットが地面に突き刺さり、土が飛ぶ。運転席で目を丸くするさくら。指導係のおじさんが手のひらで「ゆっくり」。かくかく伸びるアーム。爪がタイヤの穴を通り過ぎ、そのまま土の山に突き刺さる。山が崩れ、土砂がタイヤを押し流す。固まるさくら、吹き出すおじさん。土煙が晴れると、タイヤは杭のすぐ横まで来ていた。

あごひもを締め直して、レバーを握る。今度はなめらかに下りるアーム。爪がタイヤの穴に引っかかる。持ち上がって、空にぶら下がる黒いタイヤ。じわじわ左へ、杭の真上。ゆっくり下ろすと、杭が穴を通って、どすん。運転席で両手を突き上げる。

一緒に来た友達が手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、セリフ・字幕・BGMなし。画面に出るのは二人だけ。ショベルカー1台、杭1本、タイヤ1本、土の山1つ。機体・ヘルメット・服は文字なしの無地。体験場の配置は、人のいない引きの参照画像で固定。

entries.title: Seoul Cinematic City Tour Video
entries.description: A prompt for generating a 20-second cinematic tour of Seoul, South Korea, featuring a couple in various locations with specific pacing and title overlays.
entries.prompt:
Seoul, South Korea
20-Second Cinematic City Tour | Seedance 2.5 | 16:9

Use the supplied image as the exact opening frame. Preserve both characters' faces, hairstyles, outfits, and natural proportions throughout. 

Ultra-realistic cinematic photography, natural skin texture, authentic Seoul locations, lively crowds, and realistic lighting. Dynamic tracking cameras, smooth lateral pans, instantaneous hard cuts, natural movement. No slow motion, no morphing. No subtitles except the specified opening location title.

Opening Title — Scene 1 Only

Display "Seoul, South Korea" during Scene 1 only.

Poppins Semi-Bold (600), 42px at 1080p, white #FFFFFF text on a deep charcoal-slate #17212B background at 60% opacity. Softly rounded rectangle, consistent padding, bottom-center in the lower-third video-safe area. Keep visible approximately 2 seconds. Never render floating white text or position it at the top.

Scene 1 — Seoul Street (0–2.5s)
Begin with the exact supplied image. The couple briefly holds eye contact with the camera, then turns and walks into the busy evening street. Neon signs and pedestrians surround them. Display the specified opening title.

Scene 2 — Seongsu Design District (2.5–4s)
Diagonal tracking shot as the couple walks past a fashionable industrial-style concept store. Contemporary displays, stylish shoppers, and active street life.

Scene 3 — Hannam-dong Portrait (4–7.5s)
Beautiful close-up of both faces, looking directly into the camera with confident, natural model-like expressions. Smooth right-to-left camera pan across their faces. Soft city lights and passing pedestrians behind them.

Scene 4 — Euljiro After Dark (7.5–9s)
Quick lateral tracking shot of the couple moving through a narrow, lively alley filled with Korean neon signs, intimate bars, and nighttime crowds.

Scene 5 — Modern Korean Restaurant (9–12.5s)
The couple sits together at a stylish restaurant counter. A server places Korean dishes before them. They share a bite, exchange a playful look, and laugh naturally. Warm lighting, lively restaurant atmosphere.

Scene 6 — Vinyl Listening Bar (12.5–14s)
Inside a dimly lit listening bar, the man flips through vinyl records while the woman leans beside him. Warm lamps, record shelves, and turntables.

Scene 7 — Haebangchon Night Street (14–16.5s)
Handheld tracking alongside the couple walking downhill past independent cafés, creative bars, and lively outdoor gatherings. Colorful nighttime street activity.

Scene 8 — Seoul Rooftop (16.5–20s)
At a stylish rooftop bar overlooking Seoul, Namsan Seoul Tower glows in the distance. The couple shares a quiet conversation, then turns toward the camera as it drifts smoothly past them. End on a beautiful, intimate portrait of both characters.

Production Direction
Maintain exact character identity and wardrobe throughout. Both characters remain prominent in every shot. Authentic Korean architecture, signage, food, and street culture. Natural interactions, expressive faces, varied camera angles, and continuous background activity.

Follow the specified shot durations, alternating quick editorial cuts with longer character-focused moments. Clean instantaneous hard cuts only. No artificial transitions, no slow motion, no plastic skin, no visual distortions. No generated music; preserve natural environmental sounds and brief conversational ambience.

entries.title: Subway Zombie CQC Action Sequence
entries.description: A comprehensive video prompt for Seedance 2.5 detailing a 30-second hyper-realistic horror-action sequence involving a survivalist fighting zombies in a flooded subway station.
entries.prompt:
[ENGINE DIRECTIVE]
Generate a continuous 30-second hyper-realistic live-action horror-action sequence at 60fps ultra-realism in 16:9 widescreen format. Maintain 100% strict visual consistency with provided asset sheets: "Maya" (Survivalist in leather jacket, chest harness, titanium crowbar) and "The Infected Swarm" (Pale, veined hyper-fast infected). Setting strictly follows "Flooded Subterranean Subway Terminal". Style: Gritty neo-noir horror-action, rapid 2-to-3 second beats, visceral CQC leverage, red emergency strobe lighting, water splash physics.

[AUDIO DIRECTIVE]
• MUSIC: Driving industrial pulse synth blended with heavy taiko-style impact thuds and rising distorted electronic tension.
• SOUND DESIGN: Rain dripping, glass shattering, shrieking infected roars, crowbar metal impacts, water splash blasts, and flare ignition hiss.

[TIMELINE BREAKDOWN]

00:00 - 00:03 | PLATFORM AMBUSH & GLASS BREAK BURST
• VISUAL: Low-angle tracking shot along flooded concrete as flashlight beam cuts through mist.
• ACTION: Maya stands alone on the dark subway platform. Suddenly, glass on a crashed subway car shatters as five hyper-fast infected burst through, sprinting through water toward her.
• SOUND: Dripping water mist, explosive glass SHATTER, shrieking infected roars, heavy water splash running.

00:03 - 00:06 | SIDESTEP HOOK & PILLAR FACE-SMASH
• VISUAL: Dynamic close-quarters camera tracking Maya's leverage counter.
• ACTION: Lead infected lunges; Maya sidesteps sharply, hooks its ankle with her titanium crowbar, and drives its momentum face-first into a steel support pillar, sending water and glass spraying.
• SOUND: Crowbar ankle HOOK, steel pillar face-impact CRUNCH, water splash explosion.

00:06 - 00:09 | WATER DROP ELBOW & KNEE JOINT DISRUPT
• VISUAL: Low-angle impact camera tracking the ground CQC.
• ACTION: Two infected tackle her simultaneously. Maya drops low into standing water, delivers a tactical elbow strike to break the first infected's jaw, and jams her crowbar into the second infected's knee joint to collapse its balance.
• SOUND: Heavy water plunge CRASH, jaw-breaking elbow THUD, knee joint crunch.

00:09 - 00:12 | HYPER-SLOW FLARE SPARK & BLINDING THRUST
• VISUAL: 0.8-second time-dilation orbital camera close on the flare ignition.
• ACTION: In hyper-slow motion, Maya unclips a red road flare from her vest, sparks it to life, and thrusts the intense red chemical flame directly into a lunging infected's face, blinding it instantly.
• SOUND: Time-dilation sub-bass DROP, flare striker IGNITION HISS, intense burning sizzle, screeching roar.

00:12 - 00:15 | TURNSTILE VAULT & ESCALATOR SWARM REVEAL
• VISUAL: Upward tilting hero tracking shot as Maya vaults onto elevated ground.
• ACTION: Using the flare's red glare, Maya vaults onto an overturned metal turnstile, looking down as dozens of infected pour out from dark escalators behind her, setting up Phase 2.
• SOUND: Boot turnstile CLANG, red flare crackle, roaring swarm echo, swelling action riser.

00:15 - 00:18 | HANDRAIL SWING & FLOODED TRACK KNOCKDOWN
VISUAL: Dynamic high-angle tracking camera following the aerial swing.
ACTION: Maya leaps from the turnstile onto an overhead hanging handrail, swinging her legs forward in mid-air to kick three infected into the flooded track bed below.
SOUND: Handrail metal friction, double boot impact THUD, heavy track bed water plunge CRASH.

00:18 - 00:21 | ALPHA TACKLE & VENDING MACHINE GLASS CRASH
VISUAL: Fast pursuit camera crash-zooming into the impact.
ACTION: Landing near the emergency exit, an alpha-style infected tackles her sideways into a flickering neon vending machine, shattering the glass panel in a shower of electrical sparks.
SOUND: Body metal slam IMPACT, glass shattering CRUNCH, electric spark crackle.

00:21 - 00:24 | FRAME TRAP & HORDE LEVERAGE THROW
VISUAL: Tight profile camera tracking the fast CQC combination.
ACTION: Maya traps the alpha's arm against the steel frame, strikes its torso with three rapid palm-and-knee thrusts, and executes a leverage throw that hurls it back into the advancing swarm.
SOUND: Frame binding CLACK, rapid torso strikes THUD-THUD-THUD, heavy horde crash collision.

00:24 - 00:27 | STEEL DOOR BOOT & CROWBAR DOOR-JAM
VISUAL: Medium wide tracking shot capturing the barricade action.
ACTION: Maya kicks open the heavy steel emergency door, ducks through, slams it shut, and jams her titanium crowbar tightly through the handles—sealing the swarm inside as bloodied hands beat against reinforced glass.
SOUND: Heavy boot door KICK, steel door SLAM, crowbar handle JAM CLICK, violent glass banging.

00:27 - 00:30 | BLOOD WIPE & DARK TUNNEL ESCAPE
VISUAL: Hero close-up tracking shot settling in dim red emergency light.
ACTION: Maya leans against the door frame panting, wipes a streak of dark blood from her cheek, clicks her chest flashlight back on, and turns toward the dark escape tunnel ahead. CUT TO BLACK.
SOUND: Heavy breathing exhale, leather glove face wipe, flashlight click SNAP, tunnel wind howl, total silence.

entries.title: Neon War Zone: Ghost Assault Military Animation
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 30-second cinematic military action video with a dark comic book aesthetic, featuring a special ops squad in neon green and magenta tones.
entries.prompt:
一、基础视频规格

视频时长：30秒，一次性连续生成。

画面比例：16:9横屏，1920×1080，60fps。

视频类型：原创军事题材风格化战斗动画，电影级高强度动作短片。

视觉风格：暗黑军事漫画、表现主义战争动画、粗粝丝网印刷、动态泼墨、半色调颗粒、2.5D分层运动、真实军事动作与抽象视觉特效融合。

画面质量：高细节、高反差、强烈轮廓、电影级光影、清晰可辨的战斗动作。

全片无字幕、无解说、无水印、无品牌LOGO。

二、参考图像与视觉一致性

严格以两张上传图片为人物与美术风格参考。

人物设计：

一支由5名成年海军陆战特种作战人员组成的战斗小队，主角采用第一张参考图中的士兵形象。

全员穿着暗橄榄绿色战斗服、厚重战术防弹背心、模块化弹匣包、作战手套、战术护膝、重型作战靴，佩戴带有夜视仪安装座的战术头盔、护目镜及战术通信设备。

携带与参考图外形一致的现代模块化卡宾枪，保留枪身导轨、瞄准装置、弹匣、枪托和附件轮廓。

所有装备统一为深黑色与暗橄榄绿色，细节采用荧光绿色边缘反射及洋红色轮廓高光。

士兵脸部大部分隐藏于头盔阴影之中，面部表情冷峻，充满压迫感。

人物整体比例真实，人体结构准确，装备具有厚重的材质感和重量感。

绝对统一的色彩体系：

主背景：高饱和薄荷绿、灰绿色、荧光青绿。

人物主体：极深墨绿色、橄榄黑、纯黑色。

视觉强调：高饱和荧光洋红、玫红、少量亮粉色。

亮部：低饱和青绿色反射。

暗部：接近纯黑，但保留装备的结构层次。

禁止出现大面积橙黄色爆炸火光、蓝紫色霓虹灯、暖色夕阳或传统灰棕色战场调色。

动画材质：

人物具有厚重的手绘军事概念插画质感。

战斗服、头盔、武器及防弹背心使用粗糙笔触、黑色墨块、错位丝网印刷纹理和高反差阴影表现。

人物轮廓具有荧光洋红色油墨溢出效果。

每一次快速移动都伴随细小洋红色粒子、粉尘、墨迹拉丝和破碎的涂料颗粒。

背景由大面积绿色色块、黑色负空间、抽象烟尘和废墟剪影构成。

整体视觉保持参考图那种强烈、粗粝、危险、充满实验性的平面艺术特征。

三、30秒电影级逐秒分镜

镜头01｜00:00至00:04｜幽灵现身

纯黑画面中出现少量荧光绿色颗粒。

一条猛烈的洋红色墨迹从屏幕右侧划过，瞬间揭示一名全副武装的海军陆战特种士兵。

士兵正面面对镜头，缓慢向前迈步，低位持枪。

摄影机使用28mm广角镜头，从腰部高度轻微仰拍，快速推进至中近景。

头盔覆盖眉眼，面部隐藏在黑色阴影中。

人物右侧出现极其强烈的洋红色轮廓光。

背景为参考图同款纯净薄荷绿色，散布少量复古印刷颗粒。

随着脚步落地，黑色油墨从脚下向四周迅速扩散。

开场必须拥有强烈的视觉冲击力。

镜头02｜00:04至00:08｜黑色小队

快速切换至极低机位侧面跟拍。

五名海军陆战特种士兵沿着荒废工业区的残破通道快速推进。

主角位于队伍前方，其余队员以前后错落的队形穿过画面。

动作参考第二张图片中的士兵奔跑姿势。

士兵背包、通信天线、战术背心和武器随跑动自然震动。

摄影机与士兵保持平行高速跟踪，制造强烈的运动视差。

地面为粗糙破碎的黑色混凝土。

人物每一次脚步落地，地面都溅起洋红色粉尘及黑色液态墨迹。

背景从明亮薄荷绿逐渐过渡到大面积纯黑色负空间。

画面具有明显的漫画式速度感。

镜头03｜00:08至00:13｜火力遭遇

小队突然遭遇来自前方废墟的攻击。

黑色建筑剪影边缘出现急促的洋红色枪口闪光。

大量抽象粉色弹道光迹迅速划过画面。

主角快速侧身躲避，队员分散至废弃混凝土掩体后方。

一连串打击落在墙壁和地面，激起黑色碎片、绿色粉尘与荧光洋红色油墨飞溅。

摄影机快速摇移、甩镜、跟随主角下蹲。

插入一个0.5秒的极近特写，展示主角头盔边缘、护目镜、战术背心纹理和枪身细节。

枪口闪光以洋红色和白绿色抽象色块表现。

冲击瞬间采用短暂的漫画式抽帧与局部画面定格。

不出现血腥伤口。

镜头04｜00:13至00:19｜交叉掩护

进入全片最激烈的动作高潮。

主角从掩体后快速跃出，其他四名队员在不同纵深位置进行交叉掩护。

侧面广角镜头展现五名士兵在废弃工业走廊内高速穿插。

摄影机进行一次连续的低位横向移动，随后快速绕至主角肩后。

主角抬枪指向前方黑色敌方剪影，短促的洋红色枪口闪光照亮头盔和手套。

地面不断出现巨大的黑色泼墨爆裂。

大量洋红色粒子从背景向前景冲出。

废弃钢架和残破墙面以黑色几何图块的形式快速掠过。

所有士兵保持真实的人体重心和装备惯性。

运动节奏紧张、干净、猛烈。

使用少量0.2秒到0.4秒的速度渐变，强调冲刺、急停、转身和掩护动作。

镜头05｜00:19至00:25｜极限突破

摄影机紧贴主角右后方，以35mm镜头进行高速肩后追踪。

主角带领小队冲出狭窄通道，进入开阔的废弃集装箱区域。

背景突然转变为明亮的薄荷绿色大面积色块。

前景出现倾斜的黑色钢架剪影和巨大的残破集装箱。

士兵们快速穿过黑暗区域。

一道巨大的洋红色冲击波以抽象泼墨形态从画面深处猛烈扩散。

黑色碎片与粉红色油墨颗粒在慢动作中短暂悬浮。

主角跃过低矮障碍物，落地后继续向前推进。

镜头以高速推轨追逐主角，周围景物被拉伸成黑绿交错的抽象速度线条。

最后通过一次猛烈的黑色墨迹擦镜转场进入结尾。

镜头06｜00:25至00:30｜幽灵定格

运动突然减速。

主角从黑色烟尘中缓缓走出，正面面对摄影机。

其他四名海军陆战特种士兵逐渐显现在身后不同深度的空间中。

主角保持低位持枪姿态，缓慢迈出最后一步。

摄影机从膝盖高度缓缓仰拍，使用35mm电影镜头。

画面恢复第一张参考图的经典视觉构图。

中央人物为深黑与暗橄榄绿色。

背景为纯净、高饱和的薄荷绿。

人物肩膀、头盔及枪身右侧出现鲜明的洋红色轮廓光。

衣物和装备上呈现粗糙的油墨纹理。

少量黑色墨迹和荧光粉色碎片在人物周围缓慢漂浮。

最后1秒所有人物进入具有力量感的静态英雄构图。

画面突然切至纯黑，留下极短的低频声音尾响。

四、电影摄影与动画运动

全片以28mm和35mm电影广角镜头为主。

大量低机位仰拍、侧面高速跟拍、肩后追踪、极近距离装备特写、快速甩镜与猛烈推进。

镜头运动必须连贯、有重量感，保持主体明确可辨。

使用2.5D分层动画构建人物与背景纵深。

人物采用真实动作捕捉感的运动规律，同时呈现24fps手绘动画式动作节奏。

输出60fps，允许在关键冲击画面使用风格化抽帧和瞬间定格。

墨迹飞溅、粉尘扩散和粒子拖尾具有独立的动画层。

视觉特效与士兵身体动作精准同步。

保留强烈的印刷纹理、半色调网点、细小划痕、油墨偏移和动态胶片颗粒。

五、声音设计

音乐风格：黑暗工业电子、军事节奏、电影级低频冲击。

节奏：140 BPM左右。

00:00至00:04：沉重低频脉冲、军靴脚步、金属装备碰撞。

00:04至00:08：工业鼓点逐渐加速，加入
entries.translated_prompt:
I. Basic Video Specifications

Video Duration: 30 seconds, generated continuously in one go.

Aspect Ratio: 16:9 landscape, 1920x1080, 60fps.

Video Type: Original military-themed stylized combat animation, cinematic high-intensity action short film.

Visual Style: Dark military comics, expressionist war animation, rough silkscreen printing, dynamic ink splashes, halftone grain, 2.5D layered motion, fusion of realistic military action and abstract visual effects.

Image Quality: High detail, high contrast, strong outlines, cinematic lighting, clearly discernible combat actions.

No subtitles, no narration, no watermarks, no brand logos throughout the video.

II. Reference Images and Visual Consistency

Strictly use the two uploaded images as references for characters and art style.

Character Design:

A combat squad consisting of 5 adult Marine Special Operations personnel; the protagonist adopts the soldier image from the first reference photo.

All members wear dark olive green combat uniforms, heavy tactical ballistic vests, modular magazine pouches, combat gloves, tactical knee pads, heavy combat boots, and tactical helmets with night vision mounts, goggles, and tactical communication devices.

Carry modern modular carbines consistent with the shape in the reference images, retaining rail systems, aiming devices, magazines, stocks, and accessory outlines.

All equipment is unified in deep black and dark olive green, with details featuring fluorescent green edge reflections and magenta outline highlights.

Soldiers' faces are mostly hidden in helmet shadows, with cold expressions full of oppressive force.

Overall character proportions are realistic, human anatomy is accurate, and equipment has a thick material feel and weight.

Absolutely Unified Color System:

Main Background: High-saturation mint green, grey-green, fluorescent cyan-green.

Character Subject: Extremely deep ink green, olive black, pure black.

Visual Emphasis: High-saturation fluorescent magenta, rose red, small amounts of bright pink.

Highlights: Low-saturation cyan-green reflections.

Shadows: Near pure black, but retaining structural layers of equipment.

Prohibit large areas of orange-yellow explosion fire, blue-purple neon lights, warm sunset colors, or traditional grey-brown battlefield palettes.

Animation Material:

Characters have a heavy hand-drawn military concept illustration texture.

Combat uniforms, helmets, weapons, and bulletproof vests use rough brushstrokes, black ink blocks, misaligned silkscreen textures, and high-contrast shadow representation.

Character outlines have fluorescent magenta ink overflow effects.

Every rapid movement is accompanied by tiny magenta particles, dust, ink streaks, and broken paint granules.

Background consists of large areas of green color blocks, black negative space, abstract smoke/dust, and ruin silhouettes.

The overall visual maintains the intense, rough, dangerous, and experimental flat art characteristics of the reference images.

III. 30-Second Cinematic Second-by-Second Storyboard

Shot 01 | 00:00 to 00:04 | Ghost Appears

A few fluorescent green particles appear on a pure black screen.

A violent magenta ink stroke sweeps across from the right side of the screen, instantly revealing a fully armed Marine Special Ops soldier.

The soldier faces the camera directly, slowly stepping forward, holding the gun low.

Camera uses a 28mm wide-angle lens, slightly looking up from waist height, quickly pushing into a medium close-up.

Helmet covers eyebrows and eyes, face hidden in black shadows.

An extremely strong magenta rim light appears on the right side of the character.

Background is the same pure mint green as the reference image, scattered with a few vintage print grains.

As footsteps land, black ink rapidly spreads outward from underfoot.

The opening must have strong visual impact.

Shot 02 | 00:04 to 00:08 | Black Squad

Quick cut to an extremely low angle side tracking shot.

Five Marine Special Ops soldiers advance rapidly along a dilapidated passage in an abandoned industrial zone.

The protagonist is at the front of the squad, other members pass through the frame in staggered formation front-to-back.

Action references the running posture of the soldier in the second image.

Soldiers' backpacks, communication antennas, tactical vests, and weapons vibrate naturally with running.

Camera maintains parallel high-speed tracking with soldiers, creating strong motion parallax.

Ground is rough, broken black concrete.

Each time a foot lands, magenta dust and black liquid ink splash up from the ground.

Background transitions gradually from bright mint green to large areas of pure black negative space.

Frame has obvious comic-style speed lines.

Shot 03 | 00:08 to 00:13 | Firepower Encounter

Squad suddenly encounters attack from ruins ahead.

Urgent magenta muzzle flashes appear at edges of black building silhouettes.

Large amount of abstract pink tracer rounds quickly sweep across the frame.

Protagonist quickly dodges sideways, teammates scatter behind abandoned concrete cover.

Series of impacts hit walls and ground, kicking up black debris, green dust, and fluorescent magenta ink splatters.

Camera pans quickly, whip-pans, follows protagonist crouching.

Insert a 0.5-second extreme close-up showing protagonist's helmet edge, goggles, tactical vest texture, and gun details.

Muzzle flashes represented by magenta and white-green abstract color blocks.

Impact moments use brief comic-style frame skipping and local freeze frames.

No bloody wounds appear.

Shot 04 | 00:13 to 00:19 | Cross Cover

Enter the most intense action climax of the entire film.

Protagonist leaps quickly from cover, other four teammates provide cross-cover at different depth positions.

Side wide-angle shot shows five soldiers moving at high speed through abandoned industrial corridor.

Camera performs one continuous low-position lateral move, then quickly wraps around behind protagonist's shoulder.

Protagonist raises gun pointing at black enemy silhouette ahead, short magenta muzzle flash illuminates helmet and gloves.

Giant black ink explosions constantly appear on the ground.

Large amount of magenta particles rush from background to foreground.

Abandoned steel frames and broken walls fly past quickly as black geometric blocks.

All soldiers maintain realistic body center of gravity and equipment inertia.

Movement rhythm is tense, clean, and fierce.

Use small amounts of 0.2s to 0.4s speed ramps to emphasize sprinting, sudden stops, turns, and covering actions.

Shot 05 | 00:19 to 00:25 | Extreme Breakthrough

Camera tightens behind protagonist's right shoulder, using 35mm lens for high-speed over-the-shoulder tracking.

Protagonist leads squad out of narrow passage into open abandoned container area.

Background suddenly changes to bright mint green large color blocks.

Foreground shows tilted black steel frame silhouettes and huge broken containers.

Soldiers move quickly through dark areas.

A giant magenta shockwave spreads violently from deep within the frame in abstract ink splash form.

Black fragments and pink ink particles float briefly in slow motion.

Protagonist leaps over low obstacles, continues advancing after landing.

Camera chases protagonist with high-speed dolly track, surrounding scenery stretched into black-green interlaced abstract speed lines.

Finally enter ending via a violent black ink wipe transition.

Shot 06 | 00:25 to 00:30 | Ghost Freeze Frame

Motion suddenly decelerates.

Protagonist walks slowly out of black smoke/dust, facing camera directly.

Other four Marine Special Ops soldiers gradually appear in spaces at different depths behind him.

Protagonist maintains low gun-holding posture, takes final step slowly.

Camera looks up slowly from knee height, using 35mm cinema lens.

Frame restores classic visual composition of first reference image.

Central figure is deep black and dark olive green.

Background is pure, high-saturation mint green.

Vivid magenta rim light appears on right side of shoulders, helmet, and gun.

Clothing and equipment show rough ink textures.

Small amount of black ink and fluorescent pink fragments float slowly around figures.

Last 1 second all figures enter static hero composition with sense of power.

Frame cuts suddenly to pure black, leaving very short low-frequency sound tail.

IV. Cinematography and Animation Motion

Entire film primarily uses 28mm and 35mm cinematic wide-angle lenses.

Heavy use of low-angle shots, side high-speed tracking, over-the-shoulder tracking, extreme close-ups of equipment, quick whip-pans, and violent push-ins.

Camera movements must be coherent, weighted, keeping subject clearly identifiable.

Use 2.5D layered animation to construct depth between characters and background.

Characters adopt motion laws with realistic motion capture feel, while presenting 24fps hand-drawn animation style action rhythm.

Output 60fps, allow stylized frame skipping and instant freezes during key impact scenes.

Ink splashes, dust diffusion, and particle trails have independent animation layers.

Visual effects precisely synchronized with soldier body actions.

Retain strong print textures, halftone dots, fine scratches, ink offset, and dynamic film grain.

V. Sound Design

Music Style: Dark industrial electronic, military rhythm, cinematic low-frequency impact.

Tempo: Around 140 BPM.
