entries.title: Late Night Talk Show Tesla Pendant
entries.description: A prompt for a 1990s-style talk show scene where a host inspects a guest's Elon Musk-shaped pendant, requiring reference images for consistency.
entries.prompt:
Create a 17-second photorealistic late-night talk-show scene in horizontal 16:9 format using the four attached references. All spoken dialogue must be in English.

REFERENCE PRIORITY
Image 1: opening composition, studio, furniture placement and character positions. Adapt the framing to 16:9 by extending the studio naturally on both sides, without stretching the image or cropping either character.
Image 2: male host’s face, hairstyle and clothing.
Image 3: adult female guest’s face, copper-red hairstyle, glasses, red dress and necklace.
Image 4: exact design of the small gold pendant shaped like Elon Musk’s head.

Preserve both characters’ identities throughout. Elon Musk appears ONLY as the miniature pendant, never as a person in the studio.

FORMAT AND VISUAL STYLE
Horizontal 16:9 throughout. No vertical framing, black bars or aspect-ratio changes.
An old television broadcast from the late 1990s: slightly soft standard-definition detail, subtle analog video noise, restrained colors, warm studio lighting and a blue nighttime city backdrop. Preserve this archival television texture within the 16:9 frame. Avoid modern cinematic grading, glossy commercial lighting and excessive VHS distortion. Faces and pendant must remain readable.

TIMELINE — EXACTLY 17 SECONDS

0.0–3.0 seconds:
Begin with the scene from Image 1, reframed naturally into 16:9. A steady two-shot shows the host and guest seated, looking at each other. The host notices her necklace, shifts his eyes toward the pendant and asks with natural curiosity:
HOST: “What’s that you’re wearing?”
The guest follows his gaze and gives a small welcoming smile.

3.0–6.0 seconds:
Keep the action visible in the two-shot. The host rises from his chair and moves toward the guest around the nearest open end of the desk. He bends at the waist to inspect the pendant closely. The guest remains seated and slightly raises her chin.
He carefully slides his left hand, palm facing upward, beneath the pendant and lifts it only a few centimeters. The pendant settles onto his open palm, still attached to the necklace around her neck. The chain remains loose. His attention stays on the jewelry.

6.0–8.5 seconds:
Cut to a tight jewelry detail shot, maintaining 16:9. The tiny sculpted gold head rests face-up on the host’s open left palm. Its shape and facial details match Image 4 exactly. The attached chain remains visible, leading back toward the guest’s neck. The host’s curious face is visible close behind and to the side of his palm.
GUEST: “It’s a pendant shaped like Elon Musk’s head.”

8.5–10.5 seconds:
Cut to a medium two-shot from the same side of the scene. The host remains standing and leaning beside the seated guest, still supporting the pendant in the SAME left palm. He looks up from the pendant toward her face.
HOST: “Why do you wear it?”

10.5–15.0 seconds:
Hold the medium two-shot. The guest looks at him with a sincere, dreamy smile and says:
GUEST: “Because he’s my idol, and I want to fly in a Tesla!”
She means “fly” literally; do not replace it with “drive” or “ride.”
The host listens without interrupting. He keeps his hand still, supporting the pendant without pulling the chain.

15.0–17.0 seconds:
A brief comic pause. The host slowly turns his head toward the camera with raised eyebrows and a puzzled, deadpan expression. The guest smiles proudly. A short burst of studio audience laughter begins after her final word. End on their reactions, with the pendant still resting on his palm.

AUDIO
English dialogue only. Speak exactly the four specified lines, in the exact order, with natural conversational delivery and accurate English lip synchronization.
One speaker at a time. Conversational male host voice; warm, sincere female guest voice.
Subtle studio room tone, quiet chair and clothing movement.
Audience laughter only during the final two seconds.
No music, narration, translations or additional dialogue.

CONTINUITY AND PHYSICS
Exactly two people. Keep faces, hairstyles, glasses, clothes and studio layout unchanged.
The host begins seated, stands once, and remains standing afterward.
The guest remains seated throughout.
Show the host’s movement before cutting to the pendant; no teleportation or movement through the desk.
Keep both heads within the frame during the standing and leaning movement.
The pendant stays attached to the same chain around her neck throughout.
One pendant only, constant miniature size, rigid gold material, no morphing or animation.
The host supports it with his LEFT palm in every shot. Five natural fingers; no fused hands or fingers.
Keep the chain slack and the pendant close to its original hanging position.
Preserve screen direction and matching hand positions across cuts.
The focus is the jewelry, dialogue and facial reactions.
No subtitles, captions, logos or watermarks.

entries.title: Korean Mystery Drama Rainy Bookstore
entries.description: A prompt for creating a Netflix-quality Korean mystery drama scene involving a woman finding a time-traveling photograph in a rainy bookstore.
entries.prompt:
Visual Style
Ultra-photorealistic live-action Korean mystery drama, indistinguishable from footage captured on an ARRI Alexa 35 with anamorphic lenses. Premium Netflix-quality production. Natural performances, realistic human movement, consistent protagonist throughout every frame, physically accurate lighting, ray-traced reflections, realistic skin texture, authentic Seoul architecture, subtle cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field, realistic handheld stabilization, smooth Steadicam movement, premium production design, HDR, 4K. Absolutely no AI artifacts, morphing, flickering, identity drift, warped hands, unrealistic expressions, impossible transitions, or abrupt scene changes.
0:00–0:05 | Rainy Evening
A peaceful rainy evening in Seoul.
A slow cinematic drone shot reveals narrow streets glowing beneath warm storefront lights. Rain falls gently onto wet pavement, creating beautiful reflections of cafés, bookstores, and street lamps.
The camera slowly descends to street level.
A beautiful young Korean woman, around 24 years old, walks naturally along the sidewalk carrying a transparent umbrella. She wears a beige trench coat, cream knit sweater, black trousers, and white sneakers. Her long black hair moves gently with the breeze. Other pedestrians pass naturally without acknowledging her. Traffic flows realistically in the background.
Everything feels like a real Korean film.
0:05–0:10 | The Bookstore
She notices a quiet independent bookstore tucked between two cafés.
Warm light spills onto the wet pavement through large glass windows.
She pauses.
Closes her umbrella.
Naturally shakes off the rain.
Opens the wooden glass door.
A small bell rings softly.
The camera follows her inside in one continuous Steadicam shot without cutting.
Inside, shelves are filled with books, warm wooden furniture, soft ambient lighting, and a few customers quietly reading.
The environment feels authentic and lived in.
0:10–0:15 | The Discovery
She slowly walks through the aisles.
Running her fingers gently across book spines.
She notices one beautiful hardcover book displayed alone.
She picks it up.
As she opens it...
A single elegant orange envelope slowly slides out and lands gently on the wooden floor.
The envelope carries a subtle warm glow.
Nothing supernatural.
Just enough to draw attention.
She kneels.
Picks it up carefully.
Opens it.
Inside is a perfectly preserved photograph.
0:15–0:21 | The Photograph
Close-up.
The photograph shows...
Her.
Standing inside this exact bookstore.
Wearing the exact same outfit.
Holding the exact same book.
But...
The photograph is dated 10 years in the future.
The camera slowly pushes toward her face.
She studies every tiny detail.
Her breathing becomes slightly heavier.
No exaggerated acting.
Only subtle confusion and disbelief.
The ambient bookstore sounds become quieter, allowing the emotional moment to breathe.
0:21–0:26 | The Stranger
She slowly raises her head.
Across the bookstore...
A woman is quietly reading beside the window.
The camera slowly reveals her.
She looks almost identical.
Same facial features.
Same gentle smile.
Slightly older.
Elegant cream overcoat.
Hair styled a little differently.
The older woman looks up.
Their eyes meet.
She smiles warmly.
Says nothing.
Everything around them continues normally.
Customers browse books.
A barista prepares coffee.
Rain continues outside.
The world never stops.
0:26–0:30 | The Letter
The older woman calmly closes her book.
Walks toward the exit.
As she passes a nearby wooden table...
She quietly places another identical orange envelope on it.
Without looking back...
She exits through the front door.
The bell rings softly.
The younger woman immediately follows.
She steps outside.
The rainy street is completely normal.
Pedestrians continue walking.
Cars continue passing.
The older woman is nowhere to be seen.
The camera slowly pulls upward as the younger woman looks down at the second envelope in her hands.
Rain continues falling.
Fade to black.
Global Cinematic Direction
Every location must look like a real place in Seoul, filmed on location with practical lighting and premium cinema cameras. Maintain perfect facial consistency for both versions of the protagonist. The older woman should look like the same person approximately ten years later through subtle aging, hairstyle, posture, and wardrobe—not heavy makeup.
Camera movement should remain elegant and restrained: slow dolly shots, gentle Steadicam tracking, natural push-ins, and smooth crane movements. Every transition must have a logical cause-and-effect relationship. No sudden location jumps, no impossible continuity, and no unexplained character movement. Background extras should behave naturally and independently, creating the feeling of a genuine bookstore rather than an AI-generated environment.
The orange motif should appear only in the envelope, its subtle reflections, and the warm bookstore lighting, keeping it tasteful.

Overall tone: quiet, emotional, mysterious, and deeply cinematic, like the opening sequence of a premium Korean mystery film. The mystery comes from the story and performances, not from excessive visual effects, making the entire sequence feel believable and polished.

日本家屋のお化け屋敷、ハロウィン期間。カボチャのランタンが並ぶ廊下で、押し入れからおばけが飛び出して両袖を上げる。カップルはくすっと笑って、横をすり抜けていく。肩を落として押し入れへ。めくり布を持ち上げると、さくらの素顔。口を結ぶ。今度は待ちすぎて、通り過ぎた主婦二人の背中に両袖を上げる。二人はおしゃべりしたまま去っていく。インカムの先輩が肩をたたき、懐中電灯を二回点滅させて「これが合図」。

entries.prompt:

A modern Japanese city neighborhood in the early morning, partially covered by thick natural fog. A clean Korean-Japanese minimalist home opens onto a quiet residential street. Compact modern houses, narrow asphalt roads, small gardens, utility poles, overhead wires, parked bicycles, roadside signs and distant apartment buildings gradually emerge through the mist. The city is already beginning to wake up, with faint traffic and pedestrians barely visible through the fog.
MAIN SUBJECT
@image1 exactly like the attached reference. Outfit exactly like the attached reference. Wearing simple PINK FLIP-FLOPS outdoors. Playful, cute, gemas, naturally expressive and energetic. Never posed.
@image2 exactly like the attached reference. Preserve the exact appearance, fur pattern, face, colors, body proportions, amber eyes, large paws, fluffy white fur with orange-and-black patches and short bobbed tail throughout the entire scene. Gigantic scale with realistic feline anatomy, weight, balance, acceleration and momentum. No clothing, saddle, armor or accessories.
@image1 naturally interacts with @image2. She searches for a small bench, uses it to climb onto the cat, then grips @image2’s thick fur with BOTH HANDS throughout the ride. Fingers visibly sink into the fluffy coat. Her body follows every movement naturally.
CAMERA
Aggressive reactive handheld. Candid, imperfect and physically operated. Natural camera sway, micro-jolts, slight focus corrections, imperfect framing, brief motion blur and delayed reactions. Camera movement reacts directly to the subjects and environment.
NO gimbal. NO stabilized look. NO smooth tracking. NO locked shots. NO static camera. NO robotic movement. NO predictable camera movement. NO symmetrical composition. NO forced centering. NO polished commercial cinematography.
AUDIO
ABSOLUTELY NO MUSIC.
NO BACKGROUND MUSIC.
NO AMBIENT MUSIC.
NO MUSICAL SCORE.
NO SONG.
NO MELODY.
NATURAL LOCATION SOUND ONLY.
Soft birds, distant traffic, faint motorcycles, light wind, leaves, footsteps, flip-flops against the ground, fabric movement, cat breathing, giant paws striking asphalt and natural feline sounds.
@image1 says ONLY:
“산책 가자!”
@image2 responds naturally:
“냐옹!”
No other dialogue.
SCENE
00:00–00:02.2
REAR FOLLOW — INSIDE HOUSE → FRONT DOOR → OUTSIDE.
The camera begins INSIDE the modern minimalist house, directly behind @image1.
@image1 walks naturally toward the closed front door.
The camera follows closely behind, framing her back, shoulders and the back of her head.
She opens the door FROM INSIDE.
Soft early-morning sunlight and thick natural fog appear beyond the doorway.
@image1 steps outside wearing simple PINK FLIP-FLOPS.
The camera follows directly behind her through the doorway.
She walks along the small front pathway.
NO DIALOGUE.
The foggy city neighborhood gradually appears ahead.
@image2 is relaxing quietly in the front yard.
@image1 notices the gigantic cat.
CUT.
00:02.2–00:04.2
REAR HANDHELD FOLLOW — FINDING THE BENCH.
@image1 walks toward @image2.
She realizes the gigantic cat is too tall to climb onto directly.
She notices a SMALL WOODEN BENCH.
She moves the bench beside @image2.
The camera follows naturally from behind.
@image2 watches calmly.
The cat understands what she wants and slowly lowers its entire body into a deep crouch, bringing its back to approximately bench height.
@image1 reacts with a small delighted smile.
CUT.
00:04.2–00:06.3
CLOSE REAR / SIDE-REAR HANDHELD — MOUNTING.
@image1 steps onto the small bench and carefully climbs onto @image2’s enormous back.
She immediately grips the thick fur with BOTH HANDS, fingers visibly sinking into the fluffy coat.
She settles naturally and gently strokes @image2’s head.
@image2 slightly lifts its head into her touch.
@image1 leans forward playfully.
She says:
“산책 가자!”
@image2 responds:
“냐옹!”
The cat’s ears point forward.
Its body subtly tenses.
CUT.
00:06.3–00:08.0
AGGRESSIVE HANDHELD — SUDDEN TAKEOFF.
Without warning, @image2 EXPLODES FORWARD.
The camera reacts slightly late.
@image1 grips the thick fur with BOTH HANDS.
Her PINK FLIP-FLOPS bounce naturally against the cat’s sides.
@image2 races toward the front fence.
@image1 leans forward with the acceleration.
@image2 plants its enormous paws—
HUGE JUMP OVER THE FENCE.
The camera violently tilts upward.
Beyond the fence, a modern Japanese city street is almost completely swallowed by thick morning fog.
HARD CUT ON JUMP.
00:08.0–00:10.0
AGGRESSIVE REAR 3/4 CHASE — FOGGY CITY MORNING.
@image2 lands heavily on the asphalt.
THUD!
It immediately accelerates deeper into the city.
@image1 remains firmly gripping the thick fur with BOTH HANDS.
The giant cat races through the fog-covered morning street, passing utility poles, parked bicycles, compact houses, roadside signs and faint early traffic.
The camera struggles to keep up, bouncing and swinging naturally.
Distant apartment buildings emerge through the mist.
@image2 runs deeper into the fog.
The cat and rider gradually disappear into the dense morning mist.
Only the foggy city street remains.
HARD CUT.
NO BLACK.
CUT DIRECTLY INTO SCENE 1.

Korean-Japanese minimalist home. Rear-follow opening from inside the house. @image1 opens the front door from inside and walks outside. She finds a small wooden bench, uses it to mount the gigantic Japanese Bobtail, gently strokes its head and says “산책 가자!” before the cat suddenly takes off. Playful. Cute. GEMAS. GOOFY. Energetic. Natural rider-cat interaction. Gigantic cat deliberately lowers its body so @image1 can mount. @image1 grips fur with BOTH HANDS throughout the ride. Pink flip-flops outdoors. Aggressive reactive handheld. Candid. Imperfect. Natural motion blur. Sudden acceleration. Huge fence jump. Foggy waking city. Cat and rider naturally disappear into the morning fog. NO BLASSSHH. NO LIGHT BURST. NO SPECIAL EFFECT TRANSITION. NO SUPERNATURAL TRANSITION. NO MUSIC. NO BACKGROUND MUSIC. NO AMBIENT MUSIC. NO MUSICAL SCORE. NATURAL LOCATION SOUND ONLY. HARD CUT directly into SCENE 1. SLICE OF SLICE. NO POLISHED COMMERCIAL LOOK. 4K.

entries.title: Ferrari Entrance Action Sequence
entries.description: A highly detailed video prompt for Seedance 2.5 recreating a specific action sequence involving a character with unique appearance getting into a yellow Ferrari, referencing input images.
entries.prompt:
Create a 20-second photorealistic video, vertical 9:16, following the action sequence of the original reference video.

REFERENCE PRIORITY
IMAGE 1 establishes the exact opening frame: hotel entrance, architecture, lighting, yellow Ferrari, open driver’s door, five security staff, and the main character’s starting position BEHIND the car, closer to the hotel entrance.
IMAGE 2 defines the main character’s exact face, age, physique, hairstyle, clothing, accessories, and shoe length. If his details differ between the images, use IMAGE 2 for his appearance while preserving his position and perspective from IMAGE 1.

MAIN CHARACTER
The same short, athletic man, approximately 30 years old, in every frame. Preserve his curled mustache, enormous pale platinum hair puffs extending horizontally, teal patterned long coat and trousers, orange waistcoat, neck scarf, white socks, brown clutch, single wristwatch, and extremely elongated burgundy pointed shoes.
His face, body proportions, hairstyle, outfit, and shoe length remain consistent.

CAR AND LOCATION
Preserve the corrected yellow Ferrari from IMAGE 1 exactly: body proportions, wheelbase, black roof, circular rear lights, wheels, rear diffuser, twin exhausts, interior, and conventional outward-opening driver’s door.
Do not redesign, stretch, shorten, or deform the car.
The hotel, red sculpture, background vehicles, pavement, and evening lighting remain consistent.

ACTION TIMELINE

0–5 SECONDS — WALKING TOWARD THE CAR
Start with the composition of IMAGE 1. The man is already walking away from the hotel entrance, several meters behind the stationary Ferrari.
He approaches its rear with confident, slightly theatrical steps, then walks around the rear bumper toward the visible left-hand driver’s side.
His elongated shoes move rigidly with his feet, clearing the pavement naturally without bending or sliding.
The camera smoothly tracks his movement, gradually revealing his full body and the open driver’s doorway.
Security staff watch discreetly from their established positions.

5–8 SECONDS — GREETING
One of the staff members on the left of the entrance steps naturally toward the open driver’s door to assist him. The remaining four staff stay in the background.
The man transfers his clutch to his left hand before greeting the attendant.
They exchange one brief right-handed handshake, release their hands, and the attendant steps aside.
The man turns toward the driver’s seat.

8–16 SECONDS — GETTING INTO THE CAR
Keep the boarding action clearly visible from a medium-wide driver-side angle.
The man turns his hips toward the seat, bends his knees, ducks his head, and lowers himself onto the driver’s seat.
His oversized hairstyle brushes gently against the doorway, compressing slightly through physical contact without changing its design.
He places the clutch on the passenger seat.
He carefully brings his legs inside one at a time, turning each long shoe sideways and guiding its rigid pointed tip through the open doorway into the footwell.
Make this the main gently comic moment, as in the original video: an eccentric, impeccably dressed man carefully fitting his unusual footwear into a low sports car.
Both shoes visibly pass through the doorway. Neither shoes nor feet disappear, shrink, bend, or pass through solid bodywork.
He draws his coat tails fully inside.

16–18 SECONDS — CLOSING THE DOOR
Only after the man, both shoes, and his coat are completely inside, the attendant gently closes the driver’s door until it latches.
The man faces forward and takes the steering wheel.
The attendant steps clear of the vehicle.

18–20 SECONDS — DRIVING AWAY
The Ferrari moves FORWARD slowly along the clear driveway, in the direction its nose is pointing.
Its wheels rotate consistently with its movement.
The camera pans naturally to follow the departure, ending on a rear three-quarter view with the red taillights visible.

CAMERA
One continuous natural handheld-style take, with smooth walking-speed tracking and restrained camera movement.
Begin exactly from IMAGE 1, then move around the rear toward the driver’s side as the man approaches.
Keep the character’s hairstyle and long shoes visible during the approach and boarding. Do not teleport the camera or change the layout of the location.

AUDIO
Realistic footsteps, quiet hotel ambience, subtle clothing sounds, a soft door latch, engine idle, and gentle acceleration.
No intelligible dialogue, music, captions, or text.

CONTINUITY
Exactly one main character and five staff members; one of these five acts as the attendant.
No additional people appear.
The car remains stationary until the driver is fully inside, the door is closed, and the attendant is clear.
Maintain realistic scale, anatomy, contact shadows, reflections, and physical interaction.
No morphing faces, duplicated limbs, changing accessories, warped car panels, sliding feet, or objects passing through solid surfaces.

entries.title: High-Budget Roadster Car Commercial
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 28-second high-budget live-action car commercial featuring a roadster, with specific scenes, assets, and physical realism instructions.
entries.prompt:
TITLE: "TRY THIS ROADSTER". A 28-second high-budget live-action car commercial, filmed for real on location by a professional crew with camera cars, a drone, a runway crane and an air-to-air camera jet. Shot on 35mm film: warm natural light, soft halation, fine grain, real motion blur, smooth stabilised moves with subtle handheld life. Every shot is at real-time speed with no slow motion, cut fast and punchy. The effects are flawless and invisible. Nothing looks digital or animated.

ASSETS:
- Roadster: the car, with the same shape, silver-white colour, scale and RDSTR plate in every shot.
- Character: the woman, with the same face, hair and outfit throughout.
- Racer: the man, an original racing driver in a plain white-and-silver race suit with no logos.
- Interior: the cabin, left-hand drive, with her always seated on the left behind the yoke.
- FlightFX: whenever the car hovers or flies, exactly four thin, semi-transparent white cold-gas vapour jets blow straight down from beneath it. They are soft and misty, with no glow and no flame.
- Courtyard, Desert and Runway: the locations. Each scene stays strictly in its own location.
Use every image for appearance only, never its background.

PHYSICAL REALISM: the car is always lit by the scene's own sun, casts a real moving shadow, reflects its surroundings, and is a normal 4.5 m sports car in scale. The camera always physically moves with the action.

SCENE 1, COURTYARD [0s-7s], location Courtyard (old stone college building, soft overcast daylight):
[0-1.5s] LOW DETAIL: the camera glides past the car's front wheel and sculpted silver flank, with the two people walking toward it in the background.
[1.5-3.5s] MEDIUM, OVER THE SHOULDER: Racer rests a hand on the car's roof, smiles and says, "Try this Roadster." Character, facing him, lights up and replies, "It looks amazing!"
[3.5-5.5s] MEDIUM: she opens the driver's door, slides into the left seat and runs her hand over the yoke, admiring the cabin.
[5.5-7s] LOW WIDE: the door closes with a solid thunk and the car starts with a soft electric hum.

SCENE 2, DRIVE-AWAY [7s-8s]: LOW TRACKING on a leafy street. The car accelerates past the lens with a rush of air, a light smoky haze curling off the tyres toward camera.

SCENE 3, DESERT CAMELS [8s-12s], location Desert (golden-hour highway, dunes, acacias):
[8-9s] CHASE behind the car: about 12 real camels scattered naturally on and beside the road turn their heads toward it, and one groans.
[9-10s] LOW REAR: the four vapour jets fire downward, smoke and sand billow out from beneath the car, and it lifts off the asphalt.
[10-11s] LOW ANGLE among the herd: a camel's head fills the foreground. Behind it, the car flies overhead and completes one smooth barrel roll around its nose-to-tail axis, with thin vapour trails behind it.
[11-12s] LOW REAR CHASE: the car lands softly on the road in a burst of smoke and dust and drives on.

SCENE 4, STREET SWEEPER [12s-15s], suburban autumn street:
[12-13s] MEDIUM WIDE: a tired street sweeper in an orange high-visibility vest stands beside a huge pile of leaves. The car hovers low beside the kerb, and she smiles at him from her open window.
[13-15s] LOW GROUND: the jets blast the pile into a swirling cloud of orange leaves and vapour. It clears to reveal a spotless sidewalk and the sweeper laughing in amazement.

SCENE 5, APPLE TREE [15s-17s], sunny green orchard:
[15-16s] WIDE TRACKING: the car flies in low and hovers beside a big apple tree heavy with red apples, its jets rustling the grass.
[16-17s] MEDIUM CLOSE-UP at her window: she reaches out, twists and plucks a shiny red apple, the branch springs back, and she smiles at it.

Preserve the human face, long pointed nose, curled thin moustache, black shoulder-length hair, black-and-orange pointed witch hat with curved horns, orange-and-black Halloween-patterned clothing, orange tie, footwear, and twisted wooden staff with its glowing orange core.

High-end cinematic 3D animation with anime-inspired combat speed, powerful impacts, expressive character animation, detailed cloth simulation, convincing elastic physics, volumetric smoke, atmospheric depth, dramatic lighting, and sophisticated VFX.

The action is aggressive, fast, fluid, and dangerous, never slow or comedic. Every movement has a purpose: attack, dodge, counterattack, acceleration, recoil, or repositioning.

ENVIRONMENT

An enormous, apparently endless Halloween wasteland. Dark charcoal-gray terrain, fractured stones, scattered boulders, twisted dead trees, distant haunted-castle ruins, giant carved pumpkins, low drifting fog, floating ash, glowing embers, and a colossal orange-red moon behind moving storm clouds.

entries.description: A detailed prompt describing a calligraphy practice scene between a teacher and student, focusing on realistic motion, ink dynamics, and emotional beats for Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
板張りの大広間。先生が巨大な筆を全身で振り下ろし、墨が扇形に飛ぶ。目を見開くさくら。受け取った筆の重さで、腕ががくんと下がる。墨を吸った穂先から、しずくがぼたぼた落ちる。筆を頭上に掲げて、紙の上を一歩ずつ。上の真ん中に下ろそうとした瞬間、重さに体を持っていかれて、筆がどすんと落ちる。大きな墨だまり。頬に、墨の点がひとつ。先生はしみをじっと見て、うなずき、「続けて」と手を流す。

頬に墨をつけたまま、口を結んでうなずく。墨だまりのすぐ下に穂先を下ろし、後ろへ下がりながら線を引く。全身で振り下ろして、まっすぐ下へ。手首を返して、はねる。腕を組んだ先生が、小さくうなずく。体をひねって左へ払い、右へ抜く。肩で息をする。二人で紙の端を持って、立ち上げる。あの墨だまりは、『永』の一画目の点になっていた。見上げて、笑う。

友達が手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、セリフ・字幕・BGMなし。画面に出るのは二人だけ。筆は1本、紙は1枚、字は『永』一文字だけ。書いている途中は字の全体を映さず、全体が見えるのは紙を立てたときだけ。完成した字は、前半の墨だまりのコマから作った参照画像どおり。
entries.translated_prompt:
A large hall with wooden floors. The teacher swings a giant brush down with their whole body, splashing ink in a fan shape. Sakura's eyes widen. As she takes the brush, her arms sag from its weight. Drops of ink fall from the saturated tip. She lifts the brush overhead and steps onto the paper one step at a time. Just as she tries to lower it to the top center, her body is pulled by the weight, and the brush drops heavily. A large pool of ink forms. One dot of ink lands on her cheek. The teacher stares at the stain, nods, and gestures 'continue'.

With the ink still on her cheek, she nods with pursed lips. She lowers the tip just below the ink pool and draws a line while stepping back. She swings down with her whole body, straight down. She flicks her wrist up. The teacher, arms crossed, nods slightly. She twists her body to sweep left, then right. She breathes heavily. The two hold the edges of the paper and lift it up. That ink pool had become the first dot of the character 'Ei' (永). She looks up and smiles.

A record shot handheld by a friend. About 2 seconds per cut, no dialogue, subtitles, or BGM. Only two people appear on screen. One brush, one sheet of paper, only the character 'Ei'. During writing, the entire character is not shown; the full character is visible only when the paper is lifted. The completed character matches the reference image created from the previous ink pool frame.

entries.title: Downhill Longboard Raw Run
entries.description: Detailed prompt for a continuous 30-second shot of a downhill longboarder in a Swiss alpine valley.
entries.prompt:
A single continuous 30-second take with no cuts. Rider, an adult male downhill longboarder, bombs a two-lane mountain road down a green Swiss alpine valley at extreme speed. The road is smooth grey asphalt with a white dashed centre line, a metal guardrail on the valley side, and white-and-black roadside marker posts. On one side, a steep bright-green meadow rises with old wooden Swiss chalets with red-brown shutters and dark timber barns. On the other side, dense dark conifer forest falls away into the valley. Forested mountains with green pasture clearings fill the distance, with low white clouds drifting across the peaks under a bright overcast sky. There are wooden utility poles along the road.

[Rider]
Rider wears a white full-face downhill helmet with a dark visor, so his face is never visible. He wears a plain white T-shirt, slim grey pants and black-and-white low-top skate shoes. He wears black slide gloves with round white hard pucks on the palms. He rides a long downhill board with black grip tape and bright red urethane wheels.

[Image Quality]
Ultra-high-definition 8K, with crisp, razor-sharp detail on Rider, his clothing folds, the glove pucks, the board and the red wheels. The asphalt grain, the meadow grass, the chalet wood and the distant tree lines are finely resolved. It has a clean, high-end action-camera look with no compression artifacts, no noise and no smearing. Rider stays sharp while the roadside streaks with strong directional motion blur.

[Camera and Look]
A low chase camera follows him like real raw-run footage: a wide-angle action lens about 1.5 meters off the ground, 3 to 4 meters behind, with natural high-frequency vibration from the road. The camera never stays dead-centre. It drifts left and right with each corner and keeps Rider on the left or right third, so the next corner and the open road ahead are always readable. The look is ultra-realistic documentary sports footage in natural soft overcast daylight, with no slow motion.

[Speed Rule]
Speed is everything in this video. From the first frame Rider is already travelling at over 100 km/h, and he never visibly slows down. Every corner is taken at full speed. His hand touches the asphalt only as a light, fast dab for balance and grip, never as a braking slide, and the board stays nearly straight. Immediately after each corner he snaps back into a deep tuck and keeps accelerating, so each straight is faster than the last. The motion blur, the white dashes flicking past rapidly and the wind tearing at his T-shirt never ease off.

[Stage 1 / approx. 0–3s] Instant corner
The video opens mid-run at full speed with a fast right-hand curve already arriving. Rider leans hard into it in a low crouch, dabs his gloved right hand on the asphalt with a quick scrape and sweeps through the apex without losing speed. The camera swings around the outside of the curve, and the guardrail whips past in the foreground.
End state: Rider exiting the curve, still at full speed.

[Stage 2 / approx. 3–10s] Acceleration straight
Continue from the previous stage. Rider snaps into a deep aero tuck: front knee bent, back knee tucked behind the front calf, chest low, hands clasped behind his back. The road drops steeply down the valley. The chalets on the meadow side and the utility poles flash past one after another, and the white centre dashes strobe under the camera. His T-shirt ripples violently in the wind.
End state: Rider at an even higher speed, with a left-hand curve rushing toward him.

[Stage 3 / approx. 10–17s] Corner with oncoming car
Continue from the previous stage. Rider dives into the left-hand curve at full speed, dabs his left hand on the asphalt and holds a tight inside line. Right at the exit, a white compact car appears coming uphill in the opposite lane and passes within a few meters in a heavy rush of wind. Rider stays low and committed in his own lane, without flinching or braking. The camera lets the car pass through the edge of the frame and then settles back behind him.
End state: The car is gone and Rider is back in his tuck, still accelerating.

[Stage 4 / approx. 17–23s] Right-left switchback
Continue from the previous stage. A quick right curve flows straight into a left curve. Rider carves through both at full speed, with one fast hand dab on each side and his shoulders rolling with the road. The camera follows close, its horizon tilting slightly with each lean.
End state: Rider exits onto the longest, steepest straight of the run.

[Stage 5 / approx. 23–30s] Top speed
Continue from the previous stage. Rider is in his deepest, tightest tuck, and this is the fastest moment of the whole video. The roadside smears into pure streaks of green and grey while the valley and mountains ahead stay steady. The wheels hum at a high pitch, and the board is perfectly stable.
End state: Rider at absolute top speed, small against the huge green valley, still pulling away down the road.

[Maintain Consistency]
One rider only, always the same Rider with the same white helmet with the visor down, white T-shirt, grey pants, black gloves and red-wheeled board. His face is never shown. He always rides downhill in the same direction of travel. The car stays in the opposite lane and passes once. The take is one continuous shot with no cuts, no slow motion, no slowing down and no on-screen text.

Audio is raw on-board sound only, with no music: <roaring wind buffeting the camera>, <constant hard rumble of urethane wheels on asphalt>, <quick gritty scrapes of the glove pucks on the road>, <a car engine growing louder then a sharp whoosh as it passes>, <the wheel hum rising in pitch as the speed climbs>.

The footage must resemble a scene filmed on a physical movie set with practical effects, real human performances, realistic environmental details, and restrained cinematic color grading. It must NOT look like animation, a video game, a CGI showcase, or glossy AI-generated footage.

SCENE:
Inside a modern luxury overnight train traveling through a real metropolitan city on a cloudy afternoon. A young adult East Asian woman with natural skin texture, slightly messy black hair, and a simple cream-colored sleeveless top is sitting on a large bed beneath a thick ivory duvet. A subtle handheld camera movement, realistic autofocus behavior, minor exposure adjustments, and natural motion blur. The camera never passes through objects or moves impossibly. The window frame remains fixed, and the outside environment moves consistently with the train's direction. Avoid dramatic artificial camera sweeps.

ACTION AND TIMING:

0–7 SECONDS:
The woman casually strokes her cat while looking out of the window. The train gently vibrates as buildings, railway infrastructure, and occasional commuters pass outside. Her breathing, blinking, hand movements, and posture are natural and imperfect. Nothing feels staged.

7–13 SECONDS:
She notices people running along a nearby station platform. One commuter briefly looks toward the train with a frightened expression before disappearing behind a passing structural column. The woman stops stroking the cat and leans forward slightly, trying to understand what is happening. Her reaction is subtle and believable, not theatrical.

13–20 SECONDS:

In the distance, a huge, indistinct humanoid figure moves between buildings through rain and grey urban haze. Show it partially obscured by concrete pillars, passing structures, and smoke. Its size becomes apparent gradually through comparison with real buildings and people. Do not reveal a detailed fantasy monster or use exaggerated supernatural movement.

20–25 SECONDS:
The woman notices the figure approaching the tracks. A heavy impact or distant explosion makes the train windows vibrate slightly. She instinctively pulls the cat closer and shifts backward on the bed. Her eyes widen, her breathing quickens, and she glances between the window and the cabin door. Keep her physical reaction spontaneous

Ultra-photorealistic live-action Korean supernatural horror-action with premium semi-CGI VFX. {{Girl}} defines SO-YEON’s exact identity throughout. One character only: petite Korean schoolgirl, loose dark ponytail, navy blazer, white blouse, plaid skirt. Real human anatomy, skin, and facial expressions; never CGI or a digital double.

Opponents: Five unarmed delinquent male classmates in untidy dark uniforms.
Location: Bright Korean classroom, late-afternoon golden sunlight, desks, chalkboard, windows, scattered papers.
Audio: Korean dialogue, physical impacts, scraping furniture, transformation scream, environmental sounds only. No music or subtitles.

00:00–00:06 — BULLYING: So-Yeon sits with her head down as boys flick her head, pull her ponytail, and kick her chair. She flinches and grips her desk. Leader sneers, {야, 반응 좀 해봐. 재미없게.} She whispers, {아… 하지 마…}

00:06–00:09 — ZOMBIE AWAKENING: Her body convulses violently. Dark veins spread across her face, neck, and hands; her eyes turn bloodshot white, and her jaw unhinges with a wet crack. She releases an inhuman scream. The boys recoil in terror. One shouts, {뭐, 뭐야 씨발?!}

00:09–00:15 — FIRST STRIKE: After one eerie moment of stillness, So-Yeon lunges with terrifying speed, chaining Taekwondo, Karate, and Pencak Silat seamlessly: dash → punch → evade → parry → redirect. Her body punch launches a boy over desks. A transparent compressed-air burst, subtle pale-cyan distortion, and glowing blue petals erupt at impact.

00:15–00:21 — MULTIPLE ATTACKERS: Two boys rush simultaneously. She slips between them, redirects a wrist, lands an elbow and low sweep, then a devastating side kick. Another attacks; she ducks, redirects his momentum, and delivers a high roundhouse. Each physical impact creates a visible pressure cavity, expanding transparent shockwave, and pale-cyan petals. Desks, papers, and the chalkboard react physically.

00:21–00:28 — FINAL FINISHER: The leader runs for the door. She accelerates past overturned desks; the camera overshoots and whip-pans to reacquire her. She parries his attack, chains a jab, body punch, low kick, and spinning Taekwondo back kick. In 0.25-second micro-slow-motion, her heel connects, compressing the air. TIME SNAP — KRA-BOOM! A massive transparent shockwave blasts desks and papers aside, cracks the chalkboard, knocks down the wall clock, and throws the leader into the front wall. The shockwave hits the camera, causing lens vibration and brief focus loss.

00:28–00:30 — AFTERMATH: So-Yeon stands amid the wreckage. Her veins fade, jaw resets with a soft crack, and her eyes return to normal. She stares at her trembling hands in disbelief, then walks forward through settling dust without looking back. CUT.

CAMERA: Reactive handheld pursuit, close-ups, low-angle tracking, whip-pans, rapid focus shifts, readable choreography, realistic impact shake. Camera struggles to keep up wit

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Werewolf Transformation Horror Comedy
entries.description: Detailed prompt for generating a 30-second photorealistic cinematic horror-comedy featuring a werewolf transformation using reference images.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second photorealistic cinematic horror-comedy using the four attached reference images.

REFERENCE MAPPING:

IMAGE 1 - MAN BEFORE TRANSFORMATION:
Use this exact male character: dark, neck-length wavy hair brushed back, a moustache, prominent nose and recognizable facial proportions. He wears a white shirt with rolled sleeves and an open collar, brown trousers, a brown belt, and burgundy-red leather boots with unusually long upward-curving pointed toes. Exactly one gold wristwatch on his LEFT wrist.

IMAGE 2 - MAN AFTER TRANSFORMATION:
This is the exact final werewolf design. Preserve his recognizable identity, dark wavy hair, pointed ears, amber-yellow eyes, short wolf-like muzzle, black nose, long fangs, hairy forearms, clawed hands and visible tail. Maintain the reference’s muscular humanoid proportions and approximate height.
His white shirt becomes torn as shown, while his brown trousers, belt and curved red boots remain recognizable. Keep exactly one gold watch on his LEFT wrist in every shot, regardless of camera angle.
The different panels show the SAME character from different angles. Use the detailed snarling face panels for his transformed facial anatomy.

IMAGE 3 - BLONDE WOMAN:
Use the exact woman from the latest full-length black-dress reference. Preserve her face, blue-grey eyes, freckles, long loose wavy blonde hair and natural body proportions.
Her outfit is the exact floor-length black evening gown with an off-the-shoulder design, a deep sweetheart neckline, fitted bodice and flowing opaque skirt. Preserve her delicate silver pendant and black pointed-toe heels.
Keep this dress unchanged throughout her supernatural transformation and return to human form.

IMAGE 4 - LOCATION:
Use the exact evening street and parked graphite-grey sports coupe from the cooler, less-yellow location reference. Preserve the architecture, street corner, car design and parking position.
Cool blue-grey dusk, subdued warm-white streetlights, lightly reflective pavement and balanced natural colours. No heavy yellow or orange cast.

Reference collages are identity guides only. Render normal full-screen cinematic shots, never a collage, split screen or reference sheet. Do not reproduce studio backgrounds.

OPENING AND SPATIAL CONTINUITY:
Start immediately beside the parked car. Both characters are present from the first frame, standing beside its camera-facing passenger door. The woman stands closest to the door, holding her phone; the man faces her approximately two metres away.
The first frame shows his human identity from Image 1, with the transformation already beginning.
No establishing shot, no approach to the car and no introductory montage.
The car remains stationary. Maintain consistent positions, screen direction and lighting across cuts.

0-5 SECONDS - IMMEDIATE TRANSFORMATION:
Medium shot beside the car. The man’s shoulders jerk and his fingers tense from the very first frame.
His ears sharpen, eyes turn amber-yellow, nose darkens, and face develops the short wolf-like muzzle shown in Image 2. Fangs emerge, fur spreads over his forearms and exposed chest, and his fingers develop long dark claws. His shoulders expand modestly, tearing the white shirt at its seams. A tail pushes through the rear of his trousers.
End in the exact humanoid werewolf form from Image 2, wearing the same red boots and single left-wrist watch. Show continuous anatomical change rather than an instant character replacement. No blood or gore.

5-9 SECONDS - THE THREAT:
The werewolf leans toward the woman and growls close to her face. His breath shifts loose strands of her blonde hair.
She remains completely calm, lowers her phone and looks directly at him.
His growl fades into an awkward silence.

9-13 SECONDS - ONE SECOND:
She raises her free index finger and calmly says in English:
“One second.”
She opens the passenger door, places her phone on the seat and closes the door.
The werewolf watches in confusion, tilting his head slightly.
Show believable hand contact, door movement and phone placement. The phone stays inside the car afterward.

13-19 SECONDS - HER SECRET:
Close-up of the same woman. She slowly smiles.
During the smile, her upper canine teeth lengthen into fangs, her cheekbones sharpen subtly, faint dark veins appear at her temples, and her irises turn amber with vertical pupils. Two dark horns emerge through her blonde hair and curve backward.
Keep her facial identity recognizable, her hair blonde and her dress unchanged.
Cut to the werewolf as an unnaturally enormous horned shadow climbs across him and the car. Suggest her greater supernatural power through the shadow without revealing a new full-body creature.
His ears flatten and his eyes follow the shadow upward. His aggressive expression turns to fear.

19-25 SECONDS - ESCAPE:
The werewolf gives a small frightened whimper, turns away and runs toward the visible street corner.
The long curved toes of his boots catch against each other. He stumbles onto his hands and knees. His RIGHT boot slips off and remains on the pavement near the car.
He scrambles up and runs around the corner, still wearing the LEFT boot, with his right foot bare.
Use a clear wider shot so the stumble, lost boot and escape are easy to understand. No duplicated shoes or disappearing accessories.

25-30 SECONDS - PUNCHLINE:
Cut back to the woman, fully human again and matching Image 3: blue-grey eyes, normal teeth, no horns and no dark veins.
Standing beside the car, she lifts the abandoned right boot and calls toward the corner with amused confidence:
“Forgot your shoe, Cinderella?”
Finish with a brief reaction shot: the werewolf cautiously peeks around the corner, pointed ears appearing first.

CAMERA AND PERFORMANCE:
Live-action cinematic realism, natural skin and fabric textures, convincing creature effects, controlled camera movement and clear editing.
Prioritize expressive faces, readable physical comedy and consistent character anatomy.
Fit all action and both spoken lines within 30 seconds.

AUDIO:
Quiet evening street ambience, fabric tearing, restrained transformation sounds, a deep growl, a car-door click, a frightened whimper, hurried footsteps and leather scraping the pavement.
Let the sound briefly fall quiet before the final joke.
All dialogue is spoken in English with natural delivery and accurate lip synchronization. Only the woman speaks. The werewolf makes nonverbal creature sounds.

No narration, subtitles, text overlays, extra people, moving cars or additional dialogue.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Dark Fantasy Battle Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for 'The Bell of Ashfall', directing a 30-second dark-fantasy film sequence involving a hero and a colossus.
entries.prompt:
THE BELL OF ASHFALL

ENGINE DIRECTIVE: Create an exactly 30-second, 16:9 photorealistic live-action dark-fantasy film, targeting 60fps where supported. Hollywood-level VFX, realistic textures, storm lighting, volumetric rain, natural motion blur, and cinematic camera movement.

HERO LOCK: @image1 is the only hero. Preserve his exact face, hairstyle, facial hair, skin tone, age, body, outfit, accessories, and weapon in every shot. No identity drift, clones, or costume changes. Keep his face recognizable.

ANTAGONIST: A 15-meter horned Cinder Colossus with black basalt skin, glowing ember-orange cracks, amber eyes, and a damaged left shoulder.

LOCATION: Ruined gothic Ashfall Monastery above a bottomless gorge, with a collapsing rope bridge, flooded courtyard, broken statues, and a timber bell tower containing a massive bronze bell.

TIMELINE:

00:00–00:05 | STORM BRIDGE
Aerial 24mm shot reveals the storm-lashed monastery. Ground-level tracking follows the hero sprinting across a swaying rope bridge. Planks snap behind him as lightning illuminates the gorge.

00:05–00:10 | THE COLOSSUS
The bridge collapses. The hero leaps, catches a hanging rope, and climbs to the cliff. The Colossus rises from the abyss, roars, and slams its enormous hand beside him.

00:10–00:15 | COURTYARD CHASE
The hero races through shin-deep water as the giant destroys statues and arches. He slides beneath a crushing fist, and a stone column shatters. He reaches the bell tower.

00:15–00:20 | THE BELL TOWER
The hero climbs unstable timber scaffolding. The Colossus punches through the tower wall, cracking beams. The hero cuts the bell's restraining rope, sending the massive bronze bell swinging outward.

00:20–00:25 | THE STRIKE
The hero jumps onto a beam as the bell swings through the breach and slams into the Colossus's chest at 00:22. Slow-motion impact, expanding shockwave, airborne rain, and glowing cracks spreading across its body.

00:25–00:30 | DAWN OF ASH
At 00:26, the Colossus explodes into stone fragments and ash, falling into the gorge. Storm clouds part as golden dawn illuminates the victorious hero. End with a cinematic close-up, drifting ash, and the humming bell.

AUDIO: Dark orchestral strings, distant choir, pounding war drums, thunder, rain, creaking wood, crushing stone, and monstrous roars. At 00:22, a powerful bronze gong triggers near-silence and a lingering resonance. Finish with hopeful choir, warm strings, and fading wind.

CONTINUITY: Grounded, readable action; progressive destruction; consistent screen direction; no extra characters, text, or logos.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Wind Tunnel Floating Video
entries.description: A detailed prompt for Seedance 2.5 to generate a realistic first-person style video of a person experiencing weightlessness in a wind tunnel, focusing on physical reactions and camera movements.
entries.prompt:
手招きされてヘルメットをかぶる。扉が開いた瞬間の風に押し戻され、背中を受け止められる。飛び込むと体が浮くが、横へ流されて肩がガラスに触れる。腰をつかまれて真ん中へ戻され、金網すれすれまで沈む。腕を大きく広げた瞬間、ふわっと持ち上がる。

肩を支えられて水平に浮く。脚を伸ばす合図、あごを上げる合図。手が離れても、腕を広げ直して一人で浮いている。親指を立てられて、口元がゆるむ。腰をつかまれ、二人でらせんを描いて筒の上まで上がる。上で口を開けて笑う。降りてきて出入口をくぐると、膝が笑ってよろける。ヘルメットを脱ぐと髪がぼさぼさのまま、笑ってハイタッチ。

友達がガラスの外から手持ちで撮った記録。1カット2秒前後、セリフ・字幕・BGMなし。浮いている間は常に腹ばいで、足は金網に着かない。出入りは黒い枠の扉だけ。つなぎもヘルメットも無地。
entries.translated_prompt:
Invited by hand gesture, puts on helmet. Pushed back by the wind when the door opens, caught on the back. Jumps in and body floats up, but is swept sideways and shoulder touches glass. Waist grabbed and returned to center, sinks almost to the wire mesh. Arms spread wide, gently lifted.

Supported by shoulders, floating horizontally. Signal to extend legs, signal to lift chin. Even after hands are released, spreads arms again to float alone. Thumbs up given, mouth relaxes into a smile. Waist grabbed, two people spiral up to the top of the tube. Laughs with mouth open at the top. Comes down and passes through the entrance/exit, knees buckle and stumbles. Takes off helmet, hair is messy, laughs and high-fives.

Recorded handheld by friend from outside the glass. Approx 2 seconds per cut, no dialogue/subtitles/BGM. Always prone while floating, feet do not touch the wire mesh. Only black-framed doors for entry/exit. Uniforms and helmets are plain.

entries.title: Realistic Kitten Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a realistic video of an Abyssinian kitten waking up and interacting with its owner in a bedroom setting.
entries.prompt:
严格参考上传的小猫的角色三视图 【小猫角色图】 ，视频中始终是同一只约2个月大的阿比西尼亚幼猫。保持三视图中的头身比例、幼猫体型、脸型、超大直立耳朵、灰绿色杏仁眼、深色眼线、砖粉棕色鼻头、暖棕色细密ticked毛发、较深的头顶和背部、浅暖杏色下巴和胸口、细小四肢、幼猫小爪以及深色尾尖完全一致。不要改变年龄，不要长大，不要改变毛色和五官。

真实家庭卧室，清晨，自然柔和的窗光，床上是略微凌乱的米白色纯棉被子。画面是一段主人刚醒来后随手用手机拍到的真实生活记录。

0–2秒：小猫刚刚睡醒，趴在柔软的被子上，慢慢抬起头看向镜头，眼睛还有一点困，耳朵轻轻转动。它先伸直两只前爪，屁股微微翘起，做一个非常自然的猫咪伸懒腰动作。

2–4秒：小猫伸完懒腰后走近镜头，仰头看着主人，嘴巴轻轻张开，发出一声很短、奶声奶气的幼猫叫声。表情好奇又有一点撒娇，不能像人一样说话。

4–7秒：主人的一只手自然伸入画面。小猫主动走过去，用额头和脸颊蹭主人的手指和掌心，眼睛舒服地微微眯起来，耳朵放松。主人轻轻挠它的下巴和脸颊，小猫明显很享受。

7–10秒：小猫突然变得有一点调皮，用两只很小的前爪轻轻抱住主人的一根手指，侧身倒在被子上，轻轻蹬一下后腿，但不是攻击，也不咬人。最后它松开手指，趴在被子上抬头看向镜头，耳朵竖起，形成一个非常自然可爱的结束画面。

整体必须是“真正的小猫在做这些动作”，而不是人类动作套在猫身上。轻度拟人化仅体现在情绪和互动感，所有身体运动必须遵循真实2个月幼猫的骨骼结构、关节活动范围、重心和平衡方式。

写实摄影，真实猫毛细节，真实幼猫运动惯性，轻微手持摄影感，镜头位置接近床面高度，近距离跟拍，偶尔有非常轻微的自然对焦变化。不要商业广告感，不要棚拍感，不要过度电影化。温暖但不过度橙黄的清晨室内光线，浅景深，真实生活抓拍质感。

不要成年猫，不要把身体拉长，不要长腿，不要肥胖，不要圆脸英短体型，不要改变头身比例，不要缩小耳朵，不要把眼睛变成纯圆卡通眼，不要白色胸毛，不要明显虎斑条纹，不要蓬松长毛，不要改变毛色，不要额外斑纹，不要改变眼睛颜色，不要粗尾巴。

不要站立行走，不要双脚直立，不要像人一样挥手，不要人类表情，不要说人话，不要穿衣服，不要卡通化，不要动画风，不要3D玩具感，不要夸张表演。

不要多一只猫，不要身体复制，不要额外四肢，不要多爪、多尾巴、畸形脚掌，不要人手变形，不要猫爪与人手融合。

不要频繁切镜头，不要突然改变焦段，不要瞬移，不要动作跳帧，不要猫的体型在不同镜头中发生变化。
entries.translated_prompt:
Strictly refer to the uploaded three-view diagram of the kitten character [Kitten Character Image]. The video must always feature the same approximately 2-month-old Abyssinian kitten. Maintain the head-to-body ratio, kitten physique, face shape, oversized upright ears, grey-green almond eyes, dark eyeliner, brick-pink-brown nose tip, warm brown fine ticked fur, darker top of head and back, light warm apricot chin and chest, slender limbs, small kitten paws, and dark tail tip exactly as shown in the three views. Do not change age, do not let it grow up, do not change fur color or facial features.

Realistic home bedroom, early morning, natural soft window light, slightly messy off-white cotton duvet on the bed. The scene is a realistic life record casually filmed by the owner just after waking up.

0-2s: The kitten has just woken up, lying on the soft duvet, slowly lifting its head to look at the camera, eyes still a bit sleepy, ears twitching gently. It first stretches its two front paws, lifts its bottom slightly, performing a very natural cat stretching motion.

2-4s: After stretching, the kitten walks closer to the camera, looks up at the owner, opens its mouth slightly, making a short, milky kitten meow. Expression is curious and a bit clingy, but it cannot speak like a human.

4-7s: The owner's hand naturally enters the frame. The kitten actively walks over, rubbing its forehead and cheeks against the owner's fingers and palm, eyes comfortably narrowing slightly, ears relaxed. The owner gently scratches its chin and cheeks, and the kitten clearly enjoys it.

7-10s: The kitten suddenly becomes a bit playful, lightly hugging one of the owner's fingers with its two small front paws, rolling onto its side on the duvet, gently kicking its hind legs once, but not attacking or biting. Finally, it releases the finger, lies on the duvet looking up at the camera, ears perked up, forming a very natural and cute ending scene.

Overall, it must be "a real kitten doing these actions," not human actions imposed on a cat. Mild anthropomorphism is only reflected in emotions and interaction; all body movements must follow the skeletal structure, joint range of motion, center of gravity, and balance method of a real 2-month-old kitten.

Realistic photography, real cat fur details, real kitten movement inertia, slight handheld camera feel, camera position close to bed height, close-range tracking shot, occasional very slight natural focus changes. No commercial advertising feel, no studio shooting feel, no overly cinematic style. Warm but not overly orange-yellow early morning indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic life snapshot texture.

No adult cats, do not elongate the body, no long legs, no obesity, no round-faced British Shorthair physique, do not change head-to-body ratio, do not shrink ears, do not turn eyes into pure round cartoon eyes, no white chest fur, no obvious tabby stripes, no fluffy long hair, do not change fur color, no extra patterns, do not change eye color, no thick tail.

No standing walking, no bipedal stance, no waving like a human, no human expressions, no speaking human language, no wearing clothes, no cartoonization, no animation style, no 3D toy feel, no exaggerated performance.

No multiple cats, no body duplication, no extra limbs, no multi-paw/multi-tail/deformed feet, no deformed human hands, no fusion of cat paws and human hands.

No frequent cuts, no sudden focal length changes, no teleportation, no action skipping, no changes in the cat's physique between different shots.

entries.title: Anna to Kuntilanak Horror Transformation
entries.description: A complex horror video prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting a woman transforming into a ghost (Kuntilanak) via a mirror reflection, with strict reference image locks and scene-by-scene instructions.
entries.prompt:
HER LAST LOOK — THE MIRROR
Duration: 15s | Vertical 9:16 | Photorealistic supernatural horror.
REFERENCE LOCK
Image 1 = Human Ana. Preserve exact face, facial proportions, dark-brown shoulder-length hair, body proportions, brown-beige plaid romper and white sneakers.
Image 2 = Ghost Ana. Match the pale face, long tangled black hair, distressed ivory long-sleeved dress, muddy stains and pale hands. No identity drift.
SCENE 1 — HER REFLECTION (0–3s)
Night, Ana's bedroom. Ana stands directly before a large mirror, gently fixing her hair with both hands. She tilts her head and smiles at her reflection. The reflection perfectly mirrors every movement. Medium shot, slow cinematic push-in, realistic bedroom lighting.
SCENE 2 — SOMETHING IS WRONG (3–5s)
Ana leans closer and adjusts her hair. Suddenly, her reflection lags slightly behind her real movements. Ana freezes as her smile fades. Disturbed, she raises both hands and completely covers her face. An unnatural breeze moves her hair despite the closed room. The reflection remains visible in the mirror.
SCENE 3 — THE TRANSFORMATION (5–8s)
While Ana's face is hidden behind her hands and sweeping hair, her reflection transforms first: shoulder-length hair becomes long, tangled black hair; the plaid romper becomes a dirty ivory gown; her face turns deathly pale and her hands become ghostly. Ana slowly lowers her hands. The supernatural change spreads from the reflection to her real body, completing as her hands reach her sides. Reveal both Ana and her reflection as the same terrifying ghost, accurately matching Image 2. Preserve their alignment and physical continuity.
SCENE 4 — THE LAST LOOK (8–11s)
Ghost Ana stands motionless before the mirror, head lowered. She slowly raises her pale face as tangled hair parts naturally. Her reflection maintains perfect synchronization. She locks eyes with herself, then slowly shifts her gaze directly toward the camera, as if sensing someone behind her. Slow push-in, cold muted lighting, oppressive silence.
SCENE 5 — FINAL SCARE (11–15s)
Ghost Ana turns away from the mirror and slowly approaches the camera. Her long gown drags across the floor and her tangled hair sways naturally. She tilts her head, then suddenly lunges close. Her black hair swings forward, physically covering the entire lens until the frame becomes completely black. End immediately; no additional shot.
CONTINUITY & NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
Maintain consistent bedroom layout, mirror geometry, camera direction and reflection alignment. The reflection changes first; real Ana transforms only after her face is concealed. No duplicated characters, random reflection behavior, premature wardrobe changes, face morphing, anatomy errors, teleportation, unexplained cuts, cartoon effects, gore, text, logos or watermarks. Ultra-realistic skin, hair and fabr

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Paragliding Instruction Prompt
entries.description: A detailed short-form prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting a paragliding lesson on an autumn hilltop. It includes specific camera directions, character actions, and technical parameters like duration and aspect ratio.
entries.prompt:
秋の山の上の草地。頭上で翼が立ち上がり、ハーネスごと後ろへ引かれて半歩ずれる。踏み直したとたん、ヘルメットが目元までずり落ちて、片手で押し上げる。歩き出しが遅れて、後ろから背中を押されてつんのめる。小さかった歩幅がだんだん広がり、草を蹴る足が軽くなって、靴底が地面を離れる。もう浮いているのに、脚だけがまだ二、三歩走っている。

ライザーを握りしめたまま、座面に座りそこねて、二度目ですとんと収まる。毛先が頬にかかって首を振る。両手をそっと離し、オレンジのハンドルを渡される。右を強く引いて地平線が傾き、手を止める。手を添えてもらってもう一度ゆっくり引くと、眼下の川が横切っていく。着地では、今度は走る足がちゃんと地面をとらえる。しぼんだ翼が背中にかぶさって、笑いながら握手。

友達目線の手持ち。1カット2秒前後、セリフ・字幕・BGMなし。翼1枚・ハーネス2つ・ヘルメット2つは最後まで同じ数。さくらは常に前、インストラクターは常に後ろ。
entries.translated_prompt:
Autumn grassland on top of a mountain. Wings rise overhead, pulled backward along with the harness, shifting half a step. Just after regaining footing, the helmet slips down over the eyes, pushed up with one hand. Start walking late, shoved from behind by the back, stumbling forward. Small steps gradually widen, feet kicking grass become light, soles leave the ground. Already floating, yet legs are still running two or three steps.

Gripping the riser tightly, failing to sit properly on the seat, settling firmly on the second attempt. Hair tips touch cheeks, shaking head. Both hands gently release, handed an orange handle. Pulling strongly to the right tilts the horizon, stopping hands. With help holding hands, pulling slowly again, river below crosses horizontally. On landing, this time running feet properly catch the ground. Deflated wings cover back, laughing while shaking hands.

Handheld shot from friend's perspective. Approx 2 seconds per cut, no dialogue/subtitles/BGM. One wing, two harnesses, two helmets remain constant throughout. Sakura is always in front, instructor always behind.

entries.title: Man Running Up Rocket Stunt
entries.description: Vertical smartphone-style video of a muscular man running up a giant rocket and doing a backflip, made with Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 smartphone-style video, realistic documentary footage, bright sunny day, clear blue sky with wispy clouds.

Scene: A colossal polished stainless-steel rocket (Starship-style, shiny brushed metal hull with weld seams and rivets) stands on a concrete launch pad. A dense crowd of spectators stands behind metal barricades on both sides, holding up smartphones, cheering and filming.

Action sequence:
1. (0-3s) Low-angle tracking shot from behind: a huge muscular bald man, shirtless, wearing bright orange athletic shorts and black sneakers, sprints down the corridor between the cheering crowds straight toward the base of the giant rocket, camera slightly shaky, handheld feel.
2. (3-7s) Without stopping, he runs straight up the curved vertical hull of the rocket, defying gravity, his body horizontal then vertical against the steel surface. The camera tilts upward dramatically, following him as he sprints higher and higher toward the pointed nose cone, his figure shrinking against the towering silver body of the rocket.
3. (7-9s) He launches off the very tip of the nose cone and performs a full backflip high in the air against the deep blue sky, the rocket top visible far below him.
4. (9-12s) He lands feet-first back onto the curved steel hull and immediately sprints back down the vertical surface with perfect balance, camera panning down following his descent, crowd below holding phones up.
5. (12-14s) He hits the concrete, rolls momentum into a sprint toward the camera and stops in a powerful double-biceps flex, roaring triumphantly, while the crowd erupts in cheers behind the barricades.

Style: hyper-realistic, natural daylight, crisp reflections on the metal hull, dynamic camera movement, subtle handheld shake, no cuts — one continuous take.

entries.title: Metalworking Contestant Walk-on Video Prompt
entries.description: A complex video prompt for Seedance 2.5 generating a 30-second contestant introduction package for a metalworking competition using a reference image.
entries.prompt:
Generate a 30-second epic contestant introduction package for a high-stakes metalworking competition. Core subject is the large man from <<image1>>. Main event is his slow dramatic entrance into the workshop, multiple intermediate shots of presence and environment, on-camera self-presentation with text overlays, and separate interview segment.

<<image1>> provides the man's face, mullet hairstyle, thick mustache, aviator sunglasses, overall powerful build and proportions. Do not use the original clothing or background from this image.

The man wears a heavy black leather blacksmith apron over a soot-stained open red plaid flannel shirt with cut-off sleeves, thick leather gloves tucked into his belt, dark work jeans, and steel-toe boots. His arms and apron show fresh soot and heat marks.

Language: American English. All voiceover and dialogue use the contestant's own deep, gravelly Southern American accent.

0-3s
Start state: Extreme wide of a dim industrial workshop, orange forge glowing at the far end, sparks drifting, anvil and tools silhouetted. The man stands small in the distance, backlit.
Main event: He begins walking slowly toward camera. Low, rising cinematic score starts under heavy forge ambience.
End state: He is still far but clearly advancing.

3-6s
Continuing: Same man, same clothing and lighting direction.
Main event: Cut to low-angle tracking shot following his boots and powerful stride on the concrete floor, sparks falling around him. 
Voiceover (his own voice): {They told me a man from the hills had no place at a forge this big.}
End state: Boots fill the lower frame as he continues forward.

6-9s
Continuing: Identity, clothing, and spatial direction locked.
Main event: Cut to medium side angle as he walks past hanging hammers and chains. Camera drifts with him. Close detail of soot on his forearm and leather apron.
End state: He passes the midground tools, still advancing.

9-12s
Continuing: Same continuous walk energy.
Main event: Cut to medium-wide frontal as he approaches. Camera slowly pushes in. Forge light rims his mullet and shoulders. He looks straight ahead.
End state: He fills more of the frame, roughly halfway to camera.

12-15s
Continuing: Same man and environment.
Main event: Quick cut to extreme close-up of his face and sunglasses reflecting the forge glow, then back to medium as he stops and plants his feet. Simple white text fades in lower third: 【Buck Harlan】.
End state: He stands still, text visible, looking into camera.

15-18s
Continuing: Clothing, identity, and workshop locked.
Main event: Cut to medium close-up. He speaks directly. Text updates to 【Buck Harlan · West Virginia】.
Dialogue (his own voice): {Name's Buck Harlan. Been swinging hammers since I could stand.}
End state: He holds the line, slight nod.

18-21s
Continuing: Same setup.
Main event: Cutaway to close-up of his gloved hand resting on the anvil, then back to his face as he continues.
Dialogue: {Today I came to prove the steel remembers who shaped it.}
Camera holds with a very slow push. Distant hammer strikes under the score.
End state: Text remains, he finishes the sentence.

21-24s
Clean hard cut to separate interview setup. Same man, same clothing, now against a darker workshop wall with soft key light and practical forge glow deep in background.
Main event: Medium shot of him standing or seated, looking slightly off-camera as if speaking to an interviewer. 
Dialogue (same voice): {I don't care about the cameras.}
End state: He begins the next thought.

24-27s
Continuing: Same interview lighting and identity.
Main event: Cut to tighter close-up on his face and sunglasses. Natural hand gesture enters frame.
Dialogue: {I care about the heat, the iron, and whether the piece holds when it cools.}
Camera drifts slowly in.
End state: He delivers the line with weight.

27-30s
Continuing: Same.
Main event: Final cut to medium close-up. Slight confident smirk as he finishes. Text overlay locks lower third: 【Buck Harlan · West Virginia】.
Dialogue: {That's all that matters.}
End state: Frame holds on his face, text, and forge glow in background. Score and ambience settle.

Consistency lock
Keep the man's identity, mullet, mustache, sunglasses, build, clothing, soot marks, and voice identical across every shot. Maintain consistent workshop lighting direction and spatial orientation. No additional people. No subtitles except the specified on-screen text. No background music that overpowers dialogue.

Same formula for the 2nd one:

Generate a 30-second epic contestant introduction package for a high-stakes culinary competition. Core subject is the large man from <<image1>>. Main event is his slow dramatic entrance into the kitchen, multiple intermediate shots of presence and environment, on-camera self-presentation with text overlays, and separate interview segment.

<<image1>> provides the man's face, mullet hairstyle, thick mustache, aviator sunglasses, overall powerful build and proportions. Do not use the original clothing or background from this image.

The man wears a slightly worn white double-breasted chef's jacket with sleeves rolled to the elbows, a white waist apron, dark jeans, and the same steel-toe boots. Light flour and sauce marks on the jacket and apron.

Language: American English. All voiceover and dialogue use the contestant's own deep, gravelly Southern American accent.

0-3s
Start state: Extreme wide of a large professional kitchen, warm glow from multiple gas ranges and heat lamps at the far end, steam rising, stainless steel and hanging pots silhouetted. The man stands small in the distance, backlit.
Main event: He begins walking slowly toward camera. Low, rising cinematic score starts under heavy kitchen ambience.
End state: He is still far but clearly advancing.

3-6s
Continuing: Same man, same clothing and lighting direction.
Main event: Cut to low-angle tracking shot following his boots and powerful stride on the kitchen floor, steam drifting around him. 
Voiceover (his own voice): {They told me a man from a roadside kitchen had no place on a line this big.}
End state: Boots fill the lower frame as he continues forward.

6-9s
Continuing: Identity, clothing, and spatial direction locked.
Main event: Cut to medium side angle as he walks past stainless counters and hanging pans. Camera drifts with him. Close detail of flour marks on his jacket sleeve and apron.
End state: He passes the midground equipment, still advancing.

9-12s
Continuing: Same continuous walk energy.
Main event: Cut to medium-wide frontal as he approaches. Camera slowly pushes in. Range light rims his mullet and shoulders. He looks straight ahead.
End state: He fills more of the frame, roughly halfway to camera.

12-15s
Continuing: Same man and environment.
Main event: Quick cut to extreme close-up of his face and sunglasses reflecting the range glow, then back to medium as he stops and plants his feet. Simple white text fades in lower third: 【Buck Harlan】.
End state: He stands still, text visible, looking into camera.

15-18s
Continuing: Clothing, identity, and kitchen locked.
Main event: Cut to medium close-up. He speaks directly. Text updates to 【Buck Harlan · Rural Texas】.
Dialogue (his own voice): {Name's Buck Harlan. Been cooking over open flame since I could stand.}
End state: He holds the line, slight nod.

18-21s

The image language is natural, cinematic, and expensive, but the music must feel dynamic: uplifting electronic rhythm, around 124–132 BPM, with deep bass drums, fast electronic hi-hats, short metallic hits, synth pulses, wind, bridge creaks, rain texture, zipper sounds, and foot-splash impacts forming the rhythm. Every hard cut, foot landing, bridge movement, zipper pull, water drop impact, and head turn must land precisely on a drum hit or musical accent. The music is not background atmosphere; it is the main engine of the edit.

0–2s: lush Amazon rainforest valley in natural morning light, with green canopy, atmospheric mist, and an old suspension bridge crossing above a flowing river. Double composition: a small full-body model stands on the left wearing the orange Quechua jacket, dark hiking trousers, and hiking boots; a large frontal half-body portrait dominates the right side, hood down, central zipper and chest pockets clearly visible. The model looks toward the opposite side of the bridge, with only a subtle forward movement around 1s, while the music enters with low-frequency pulses and fast electronic rhythm.

2–4.5s: a heavy drum hit cuts hard into a suspension-bridge crossing shot. Frontal half-body close-up as the model walks across the bridge, rainforest and river visible behind her. Wind moves surrounding leaves and her hair. Storm clouds gather over the canopy as the first raindrops strike her shoulders. Natural light illuminates her face, orange hood, and water beads on the jacket. Each rain impact follows the fast electronic hi-hat texture.

4.5–6.5s: top-down tracking shot of the model crossing wet wooden bridge planks. The river is visible between the boards. The camera stays close above her body, showing the orange jacket, swinging arms, dark hiking trousers, boots, and splashing water. She accelerates toward the opposite bank as rainfall intensifies. Each foot landing bursts water outward and triggers a short metallic accent.

6.5–9s: stay in the real rainforest environment. Water beads sit on the orange waterproof fabric and slide along seams; the central zipper, black chest pockets, hood, and cuffs flash through natural light. The model raises the hood, tightens its adjustment, and closes the zipper while continuing across the bridge, each action landing on a clear metallic beat and synth pulse.

9–12s: rainforest side-running wide shot. Use diffused natural light filtering through the canopy, wrapping around the body and rain haze. The model runs left to right toward the opposite bank; hiking boots, wet ground reflections, tropical leaves, and drifting mist flash briefly. The suspension bridge recedes behind her as she enters the jungle trail. The music moves into denser drums, and the image cuts follow her running cadence.

12–16s: rain portrait close-up. Three-quarter side face, hood up, long chestnut-brown hair moving naturally in the wind. Rain covers the orange hood and shoulders. Her facial features remain consistent with the reference portrait. A small Quechua mark on the jacket is visible but understated. Dense water beads cover the fabric while rain lines cross the background. The model slowly turns her head toward the trail, and the end of the turn lands on a deep bass hit.

16–20s: waterproof detail climax. Extreme close-ups of orange shoulder water beads, cuffs, vertical chest pockets, central zipper, hood seams, and jacket adjustment details. Water forms round droplets and rolls off the surface; natural light travels across the fabric texture while the jacket remains matte and water-repellent. Editing becomes faster, alternating water beads, zipper, hood adjustment, and boot-splash impacts on the beat.

20–24s: keep the entire section inside the rain-soaked Amazon rainforest. Intercut foot splashes, running side silhouettes, orange fabric water beads, rain falling from tropical leaves, shoulder seams, and zipper details. The cuts move quickly between the model’s sharp side face, defocused shoulder, boot splash, and macro fabric droplets as bass drums, electronic hi-hats, and percussion become denser. She pushes through the final stretch of vegetation and emerges into a small clearing.

24–27s: main half-body hero stance. The model stands slightly right of center in the rainforest clearing, hood up, surrounded by lush green foliage, with an old suspension bridge visible in the distance. Hood up, she looks directly at the camera with a confident, calm expression. The lighting is soft but dramatic, highlighting the water droplets on the orange jacket. entries.translated_prompt:
从[image1]、[image2]创建视频广告。使用输入的女性肖像来锁定模特身份：长直栗棕色头发，自然侧分，棕色眼睛，轮廓分明的眉毛，精致的面部特征，柔和的下颌线，温暖的自然肤色，冷静克制的表演广告气质。使用输入的产品图像来锁定服装：Quechua亮橙色防水技术夹克，雕塑感橙色兜帽带黑色衬里，中央黑色防水拉链，两个垂直黑色拉链胸袋，长袖，可调节袖口，技术面板结构，逼真的防水织物纹理，正宗的Quechua品牌标识。模特穿着深色徒步裤、实用的登山靴和一个紧凑的户外背包。所有可见文字必须仅为英文，且唯一可见的品牌为Quechua。

这部影片是一则30秒的户外冒险商业广告。影像语言自然、具有电影感和高级感，但音乐必须充满动感：令人振奋的电子节奏，大约124–132 BPM，包含深沉的低音鼓、快速的电子踩镲、短促的金属敲击声、合成器脉冲、风声、桥板吱嘎声、雨声质感、拉链声和脚步溅水声共同构成节奏。每一个硬切、脚步落地、桥梁移动、拉链拉动、水滴撞击和头部转动都必须精确地落在鼓点或音乐重音上。音乐不是背景氛围；它是剪辑的主要引擎。

0–2秒：郁郁葱葱的亚马逊雨林山谷，沐浴在自然的晨光中，有绿色的树冠、大气薄雾，以及一座横跨流动河流上方的旧吊桥。双重构图：左侧站着一个较小的全身模特，身穿橙色Quechua夹克、深色徒步裤和登山靴；右侧占据主导的是一个大的正面半身肖像，兜帽放下，中央拉链和胸袋清晰可见。模特望向桥的另一侧，在1秒左右只有微妙的前进动作，同时音乐以低频脉冲和快速电子节奏进入。

2–4.5秒：一记沉重的鼓点硬切入吊桥穿越镜头。当模特走过桥梁时，正面半身特写，身后可见雨林和河流。风吹动周围的树叶和她的头发。风暴云在树冠上方聚集，第一滴雨水击中她的肩膀。自然光照亮她的脸、橙色兜帽和夹克上的水珠。每一滴雨的冲击都跟随快速的电子踩镲质感。

4.5–6.5秒：俯视跟踪镜头，拍摄模特穿过湿滑的木板桥面。木板之间可以看到河流。相机保持在她身体正上方近距离，展示橙色夹克、摆动的双臂、深色徒步裤、靴子和飞溅的水花。随着降雨加剧，她加速冲向对岸。每一次脚步落地都会向外溅起水花并触发一个短促的金属重音。

6.5–9秒：留在真实的雨林环境中。水珠停留在橙色防水织物上并沿着接缝滑动；中央拉链、黑色胸袋、兜帽和袖口在自然光下闪烁。模特拉起兜帽，调整紧度，并在继续穿过桥梁时拉上拉链，每个动作都落在清晰的金属节拍和合成器脉冲上。

9–12秒：雨林侧面奔跑广角镜头。使用透过树冠过滤的漫射自然光，包裹着身体和雨雾。模特从左向右跑向对岸；登山靴、潮湿的地面反射、热带树叶和飘散的薄雾短暂闪现。当她进入丛林小径时，吊桥在她身后远去。音乐转入更密集的鼓点，画面剪切跟随她的跑步节奏。

12–16秒：雨中肖像特写。四分之三侧面脸，兜帽戴上，长栗棕色头发在风中自然摆动。雨水覆盖橙色兜帽和肩膀。她的面部特征与参考肖像保持一致。夹克上的一个小Quechua标志可见但不显眼。密集的水珠覆盖织物，雨线划过背景。模特缓慢地将头转向小径，转头的结束落在一记深沉的低音鼓点上。

16–20秒：防水细节高潮。橙色肩部水珠、袖口、垂直胸袋、中央拉链、兜帽接缝和夹克调节细节的极端特写。水形成圆形液滴并从表面滚落；自然光在织物纹理上游走，同时夹克保持哑光和拒水性。编辑变得更快，交替展示水珠、拉链、兜帽调整和靴子溅水冲击，均在节拍上。

20–24秒：将整个部分保持在被雨浸透的亚马逊雨林内。交错剪辑脚步溅水、侧面奔跑剪影、橙色织物水珠、从热带树叶落下的雨水、肩缝和拉链细节。随着低音鼓、电子踩镲和打击乐变得更加密集，剪切在模特的锐利侧脸、虚焦的肩膀、靴子溅水和宏观织物液滴之间快速移动。她穿过最后一段植被，出现在一个小空地上。

24–27秒：主要半身英雄姿态。模特站在雨林空地的中心稍偏右位置，兜帽戴上，周围环绕着茂密的绿色植物，远处可见一座旧吊桥。兜帽戴好，她带着自信、平静的表情直视镜头。光线柔和但富有戏剧性，突出了橙色夹克上的水滴。音乐达到峰值强度，带有层叠的合成器和强劲的节拍。
