entries.title: Spawn Transformation Scene
entries.description: A complex prompt for a Spawn-inspired transformation scene involving character consistency, volcanic setting, and physics-based molten effects, using GPT-6.1 and Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
REFERENCE + TRANSFORMATION LOCK

@image1 = Character A's starting appearance.
@image2 = the exact final transformed appearance of the SAME Character A.

Exactly one physical character throughout. These references show two stages of one transformation.

Preserve @image1's face, hair, anatomy, proportions, outfit, and accessories until the connected transformation visibly reaches them. Ignore only the original backgrounds, poses, framing, and text.

Build the transformed appearance toward @image2's exact silhouette, proportions, colors, materials, markings, garment construction, head treatment, and accessories.

The transformation is the only authorized appearance change. Do not introduce a second person or replace A with an unrelated face.

@image2 overrides generic costume descriptions. Include only accessories visible in it, with their exact counts, dimensions, and attachment points.

The original face and hair remain uncovered until the final Japanese line ends at approximately 22s. Only afterward does the referenced head treatment complete.

No new character, creature, weapon, or unreferenced accessory.

SETTING + LIGHTING

An immense vertical chasm opens into an underground volcanic chamber. Fractured basalt walls, drifting ash, molten fissures, distant fire, and heavy smoke establish enormous depth.

A broad solid stone shelf lies beneath the fall path, above the molten channels. One existing passage leads away from the shelf.

Amber light rises from molten rock. Restrained emerald light originates from one fissure in the shelf.

Two molten channels lie several meters beyond the shelf: rear-left and rear-right relative to A's first standing position. Lock their world positions throughout the sequence, including the rear camera view.

Each eruption follows:
MOLTEN SWELLING → PRESSURE RELEASE → RISING FOUNTAIN → HEAVY DROPLETS FALL BACK INTO THE CHANNEL.

Molten strands stretch and break under gravity. Ash and fabric react after the pressure gust reaches them. Changing eruption light moves naturally across A and the costume.

The central shelf stays solid. Lava and falling debris do not strike A.

FALL + MATERIAL PHYSICS

A initially falls SUPINE AND FACE-UP:
FACE AND CHEST TOWARD THE CEILING AND OPENING ABOVE.
BACK TOWARD THE CHAMBER BELOW.
TORSO APPROXIMATELY HORIZONTAL.

An emerald pressure column visibly slows the descent before reorientation and landing. Its upward support allows one controlled quarter-turn into a feet-down position.

Outside the column, ash and loose stones continue falling normally.

The black coating has one connected origin at the same fissure:
STONE → BOOTS → ANKLES → LEGS → TORSO → SHOULDERS → ARMS AND HANDS → REFERENCED HEAD TREATMENT.

Material adheres, advances, and resolves into the exact target design. No instant outfit replacement, disconnected armour, or unrelated intermediate creature.

The body costume is complete by 20s. Any cape present in @image2 is fully formed and unfolded by 20s, then retains its final size and attachments. It may ripple and billow but never unfolds again.

Remaining referenced head details and other incomplete accessories finish by 26s.

SHOT 1 — 0–2s | FALLING FACE-UP

Begin already in motion with a tight oblique tracking view from above A's chest.

The terrified face points upward toward the receding ceiling and shaft opening.

A falls on the back: chest upward, back downward, head and feet at approximately the same height. Arms spread slightly; legs remain loosely bent.

Air pulls reference hair and loose clothing upward, opposite the downward fall.

A keeps looking above, past the camera toward the opening.

The camera descends with A, easing sideways into an oblique full-body view that clearly establishes the supine position.

Passing walls and particles communicate downward travel.

A reaches one hand sideways toward a passing rock edge but cannot touch it. Maintain the face-up position throughout this shot.

One sharp breath. No dialogue.

SHOT 2 — 2–6s | THE CHAMBER BELOW

Wide descending pursuit continues the same face-up, back-down fall as the shaft opens into the chamber.

Show the solid shelf directly beneath A's back. Preserve the downward vector.

At approximately 5s, the fissure emits the emerald pressure column.

Only when A enters it does the falling speed decrease visibly. Fabric follows the body's deceleration with a slight delay. Ash curls around the column's edge.

Once braking is established, upward pressure supports A's upper back.

A draws the knees inward, lowers both feet, and pitches through one smooth approximately 90-degree turn into an upright, feet-down orientation.

A lateral camera view shows the complete reorientation.

Finish by approximately 5.9s, with the right foot leading and knees bent for landing.

No instant stop, pose replacement, full somersault, or uncontrolled spin.

SHOT 3 — 6–8s | ARRIVAL

Low lateral view shows the right foot contacting the solid shelf first, followed by the left knee and right palm.

A absorbs the remaining momentum through a grounded three-point landing.

Dust and small fragments move only after contact.

A remains intact and breathes hard. Flames stay beyond the shelf; clothing and body do not burn.

The braking column disperses into the existing haze.

A lifts the head and looks across the cavern in disbelief.

SHOT 4 — 8–10s | SOMETHING FINDS YOU

Push into a medium three-quarter view, keeping the face, planted right hand, and boots readable.

A says in natural casual Japanese, breathless and shaken:
「くそ……ここ、どこだ？」

Begin near 8s and finish before 9.75s. Clear original voice and natural lip synchronization.

Meanwhile, one thin black film flows from the fissure across the stone, touches the boots, and adheres around the ankles.

A notices the contact and glances down.

At 10s, A is still on the left knee, right foot planted, right palm on the stone, and coating at ankle height only.

No armour, cape, chains, or mask yet.

SHOT 5 — 10–12s | SOMETHING CLIMBS

Continue immediately from the kneeling state. Push down into an extreme close-up of the coated ankle and planted boot.

The continuous black leading edge crosses the lower leg and climbs toward the thigh.

Behind it, material resolves into @image2's exact lower-body surfaces.

Ash grains adhere briefly, then slide away. Preserve real seams, reflections, and depth.

A lifts the planted right palm, presses through the right foot, and begins rising.

The camera follows the upward motion.

SHOT 6 — 12–14s | THE FIRST ERUPTION

Continue into a tight facial close-up as A stands with both feet grounded.

At approximately 12.3s, the rear-left channel swells and erupts into a towering lava fountain beyond A's shoulder.

Its orange light passes across the face before the pressure gust reaches the hair and clothing.

A flinches slightly, then looks down toward the spreading material: widened eyes, tense jaw, quick breath, and visible loss of control.

entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 10-second viral prank comedy video in Venice featuring a living statue lion and a dog. It specifies character appearances, realistic interactions, and a precise timeline of events for a handheld smartphone footage style.
entries.prompt:
Create an EXACTLY 10-second ultra-realistic viral prank comedy video set in Piazza San Marco, Venice, Italy. Vertical 9:16, handheld smartphone social-media footage, photorealistic live action, natural micro-shake, sharp focus on the group, realistic exposure and motion blur, smooth autofocus shifts, no dramatic camera moves. The camera operator stands 2-3 meters from the group and steps slightly closer when the prank hits.

CHARACTERS: Exactly five clearly adult women in their early-to-mid 20s, natural makeup, realistic skin, distinct faces, consistent appearance throughout.
Woman 1 (prank target): medium dark brown wavy hair, cream fitted sleeveless top, light blue high-waisted jeans, white sneakers, small tan crossbody bag.
Woman 2: long blonde loose ponytail, pale blue summer dress, white sneakers, sunglasses on head.
Woman 3: shoulder-length black hair, loose white linen shirt over black top, beige tailored shorts, clean sneakers.
Woman 4: long auburn hair, muted green fitted top, cream wide-leg trousers, small black shoulder bag.
Woman 5: dark curly hair tied back, soft pink blouse, denim skirt, white sneakers.

STATUE: One real adult human living-statue performer styled as the golden winged Lion of Venice. Full-body aged-gold metallic paint and costume, a huge sculpted golden mane framing his gold-painted human face with painted lion-nose markings so his face and lips stay visible, small feathered golden wings on his back, a golden tail, golden paw gloves, weathered bronze patina in the folds. He must look like a real professional living-statue performer, NOT CGI. A tip jar sits at his feet. One pigeon perches calmly on his mane from 3.0s until the end.

DOG: One small, very cute fluffy golden-cream Pomeranian-style dog wearing a tiny gold cape, sitting beside the lion's feet, perfectly still like a little statue sidekick. Realistic fur, believable dog behavior, identical throughout.

PROP: A small antique gold tourist camera with a short gold strap, held loosely at the lion's waist, identical throughout.

ENVIRONMENT: Late afternoon Piazza San Marco, warm sunlight, pale stone pavement, recognizable arches and architecture, a few distant adult pedestrians, no dense crowd. No logos, captions, subtitles or watermarks.

EXACT 10-SECOND TIMELINE:

0.0-1.5s: Lion and dog are both perfectly motionless. The five women stroll in giggling. Woman 1 spots them, gasps at the dog and points, whispering. Friends push her forward.

1.5-3.0s: Woman 1 strikes an overly dramatic model pose beside the lion. Women 2-5 line up behind her, cooing at the dog. She pokes the lion's golden shoulder. Nothing. Only the dog's eyes slowly follow her. She whispers that they are clearly not real.

3.0-4.2s: Woman 1 gets bolder. She boops the lion's golden nose, then fluffs his mane like a hairdresser. The pigeon lands on his mane. He does not react. The dog tilts its head sideways in judgment. The friends cry with silent laughter.

4.2-5.5s: The lion's eyes slide toward Woman 1, then his head turns slowly and deadpan. She freezes mid-fluff, hands in the air. Beat of total silence. She shrieks and leaps backward, grabbing Woman 2. The dog lets out one tiny squeaky bark. Her bag swings wildly.

5.5-7.0s: The lion calmly raises the gold camera and photographs the group. Loud mechanical shutter click, tiny warm flash. Woman 2 screams, Woman 3 hides behind Woman 4, Woman 5 doubles over. The dog sneezes. The pigeon does not move. The camera operator stumbles back laughing.

7.0-8.5s: Straight-faced, the lion lowers the camera, bows with a flourish, gently takes Woman 1's hand like a Venetian gentleman and leans in. Woman 1 is too stunned to move, friends gasping. He plants one big, loud, theatrical kiss on her cheek. His golden tail swishes once. At the same moment the dog hops up and paws her leg, wagging its tail wildly.

8.5-10.0s: The lion instantly snaps back into a frozen pose, deadpan, pigeon still on his mane. The dog snaps back into its statue sit with its tongue sticking out. Woman 1 touches her cheek and finds a shiny gold lip print, then sees a gold paw print on her jeans. The four friends scream with laughter and collapse together. Dazed and laughing, Woman 1 drops a coin in the tip jar with a clink.

AUDIO (diegetic only): Piazza ambience, distant footsteps and murmuring, pigeon wing flutter, giggles, whispers, shrieks, one tiny dog bark, a dog sneeze, the mechanical camera shutter click, a loud comedic kiss smack, the coin clink, laughter. No music, no voiceover, no narration.

LAST FRAME: The lion frozen in a perfect pose with the pigeon on his mane, the cute dog sitting frozen beside him with its tongue out, Woman 1 in the foreground with a gold lip print on her cheek laughing in disbelief, her four friends doubled over beside her, golden afternoon light. No on-screen text, no captions, no subtitles, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks, no logos anywhere in the frame.

CONSISTENCY: Same five women, same outfits, same gold camera, same lion costume, same single dog and same single pigeon throughout. The kiss is a quick playful cheek kiss only. No extra people or animals, no morphing, no extra fingers, no distorted faces, not CGI.

entries.title: Immersive Game Reality Transition
entries.description: A complex multi-stage prompt for creating a 30-second video transitioning from a gritty real-life bedroom scene into a hand-inked cartoon game world and back, requiring multiple reference images for characters and environments.
entries.prompt:
Gritty lived-in bedroom verité that hard-cuts into a hand-inked chase cartoon, then snaps back to reality. 35mm handheld in the room, warm lamp against cold TV glow. Inside the game: paper-grain comic, bold ink, motion streaks. One continuous 30s story.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]

[char_sheet_1] : cartoon runner turnaround, lock the design.

[char_sheet_2] : real man identity — face, beard, skull cap, Pulp Fiction tee, jeans, Vans, forearm tattoo.

Images [still_1] and [still_2] : bedroom, couch, TV, rage pose. Images [still_3] [still_4] [still_5] : in-game rooftop and mine-cart look, cartoon man plus runner.

[still_6] : wake-up, bloodhound, paused screen. Identities stay locked. Only the man restyles when the game pulls him in.

[TIMELINE]

0-4s: [Medium handheld] Man sunk in the gray couch, locked in, thumbs working a white controller. TV shows the cartoon runner sprinting rooftops. Lamp warm, room messy, pizza box and Monster cans on the table. Focused, a little smug.

4-8s: [Push-in] TV slams to red GAME OVER. He jolts up, face twisting, shouting "No, no, no—come on!" He hurls the controller. It cracks the screen. Glass spiders, a blue spark jumps. Pure rage.

8-12s: [Whip to the TV] A white-blue energy vortex tears out of the crack and yanks his cap, shirt, arms. He grabs the stand, feet slide on the carpet, then gets sucked in. Body stretches, colors flatten. Hard smash-cut into ink.

12-18s: [Dynamic low tracking on the tiles] He lands cartoonified — same beard, tee, jeans, now inked, eyes huge — mid-stride beside the black-headed runner, pencil behind the ear. A giant pink eraser crashes through chimneys behind them. Both sprint. Cap flies off. He yells "What the hell is this?!"

18-24s: [Action tracking] They dive into a rust mine cart on a wooden trestle. Sparks kick off the rails. Eraser debris explodes behind. He clutches the rim, runner steers. Panic, wind, lanterns whipping past.

24-28s: [Smash cut, static wide] Back in the bedroom. He is asleep on the couch, controller still on his chest, mouth open. TV shows the runner on a PAUSED menu. A bloodhound stands on the cushion and licks his face, long slow laps.

28-30s: [Close] Eyes crack open, confused, still half-asleep. The dog keeps licking. He mutters "...the hell?" The controller never left his stomach. Dream logic lands.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]

Photoreal room, illustrated game world, coherent physics, perfect motion blur, stable identities, readable TV text, cinematic lighting, no extra limbs, no morphing faces, movie-level cut stability.

entries.title: Ultra-Realistic Cinematic FPV City Destruction
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic FPV video of a catastrophic city collapse. It specifies camera movement through debris, fire, and falling structures with precise timestamps and style/audio instructions.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic FPV destruction sequence through a dense modern city during a catastrophic collapse. The camera moves at extreme speed from ground level, weaving through traffic, falling concrete, shattered glass, dust, fire, and collapsing structures. Relentless momentum, realistic destruction physics, cinematic scale, dynamic motion blur, dramatic lighting, 4K HDR. No text, logos, subtitles, or watermarks.

[0–5s] — THE COLLAPSE
The FPV camera races inches above a crowded city street. Cars brake and swerve as buildings suddenly begin collapsing on both sides. Concrete fragments and glass rain down while the camera aggressively weaves between vehicles and debris.

[5–10s] — NARROW ESCAPE
A huge section of concrete crashes directly ahead. The camera sharply banks around it, then ducks beneath collapsing scaffolding as metal beams fall behind. Dust rapidly fills the street while the camera maintains extreme speed.

[10–15s] — THE ALLEY
The camera shoots into a narrow alley between towering buildings. A massive shockwave erupts behind, sending fire, dust, papers, and debris racing toward the lens. The camera accelerates harder as the alley begins collapsing around it.

[15–20s] — GROUND BREAKS
The asphalt suddenly splits open beneath the camera. The FPV view rolls violently as cracks race across the ground and vehicles fall sideways. The camera briefly flips almost upside down, narrowly clears the collapsing pavement, then stabilizes.

[20–25s] — THROUGH THE CHAOS
The camera bursts through the end of the alley into a wider boulevard engulfed in destruction. Buildings crumble in the distance, fires burn between abandoned vehicles, and enormous clouds of dust sweep across the street.

[25–30s] — FINAL BURST
The camera continues forward at maximum speed, weaving between overturned cars and falling debris. A final building collapses behind it, creating a gigantic wall of dust and smoke. The camera breaks through into an open intersection, revealing the full devastated skyline before rapidly pulling upward into a wide cinematic shot.

STYLE: ultra-realistic FPV drone cinematography, extreme ground-level speed, physically accurate destruction, realistic concrete and glass debris, detailed smoke and fire, dynamic camera rolls, aggressive banking, natural motion blur during high-speed movement, cinematic depth of field, volumetric dust, dramatic contrast, epic blockbuster scale, 4K HDR.

AUDIO: intense wind rush, engines, tires screeching, concrete impacts, collapsing metal, glass shattering, deep structural rumbles, shockwave explosions, fire, and debris rushing past the camera. No dialogue.

entries.title: Retro Gym Vlog POV
entries.description: Early-2000s style handheld gym vlog featuring a Korean woman.
entries.prompt:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld POV. She holds the camera herself, occasionally placing it on a gym bench or near a mirror. Natural hand shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, clumsy zooms, slight face cut-offs and shaky walking shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.
LOOK:
Soft blurry tape texture, faint tape noise, muted contrast, realistic skin tones, bloomed gym lights, subtle auto-exposure shifts and authentic early-2000s home-video imperfections.
STYLE:
Casual personal gym vlog — playful, natural, slightly tired but happy. Genuine smiles, small laughs, imperfect movements and spontaneous reactions.
CHARACTER:
Young Korean woman in her 20s with long black hair tied in a high ponytail, natural makeup, realistic skin and a slim athletic build. She wears a fitted pastel pink top, loose white pajama-style pants and clean white sneakers. Natural post-workout sweat and slightly flushed skin. Keep her face, hairstyle and outfit consistent.
SETTING:
Cozy gym in the evening with workout machines, mirrors, benches, water fountain and soft overhead lighting.
STORYBOARD:
(~3s — propped medium shot)
She finishes her workout, breathing heavily with her hands on her hips. She wipes sweat from her forehead and adjusts her ponytail.
GIRL: “Okay… I survived.”
(~3s — handheld close-up)
She grabs her water bottle and takes a long drink, looking relieved.
GIRL: “That was harder than I expected.”
(~3s — handheld medium shot)
She sits on a bench, opens a protein bar and takes a bite. She smiles at the camera while chewing.
GIRL: “Best part of the workout.”
(~3s — mirror shot)
She places the camera near the full-length mirror, steps back and adjusts her ponytail. She checks her outfit and gives a small confident smile.
(~3s — front mirror pose)
She takes a casual front selfie, then turns slightly sideways, laughing at herself.
(~3s — back mirror pose)
She turns around for a quick back pose, adjusts her ponytail and looks over her shoulder toward the mirror.
(~3s — handheld close-up)
She picks up her water bottle, drinks again and wipes the sweat from her cheek.
GIRL: “I’m definitely going to feel this tomorrow.”
(~6s — arm's-length selfie)
She walks toward the gym exit carrying her water bottle and protein bar. She turns the camera toward herself, smiles and says:
GIRL: “Okay, I’m done. See you tomorrow!”
She gives a playful wave and ends the recording.
AUDIO:
Natural gym ambience only — machines, footsteps, breathing, water bottle sounds, protein-bar wrapper, fabric movement, distant conversations and natural laughter. No music, narration or subtitles.
NEGATIVE:
No cinematic commercial look, beauty filters, plastic skin, CGI, anime, cartoon, exaggerated body proportions, unrealistic sweat, outfit changes, hairstyle changes, face changes, polished camera movement, gimbal shots or slow motion.

Follow her down an old stairwell into narrow residential alleys with brick buildings, bicycles, plants, and small shops. She browses a stationery store, politely greets the owner, then visits a small bakery, buys a red-bean pastry with cash, and eats it while walking.

She discovers a rooftop viewpoint, watches Seoul rooftops and distant buildings, enjoys the breeze, then gently pets a stray cat. Later, she sits outside a neighborhood laundromat, finishes her pastry, passes a fruit stand, and walks home. At the apartment entrance, she turns toward the camera, smiles warmly and says, “See you tomorrow,” then disappears inside. The camera stays outside briefly before abruptly ending.

VISUAL STYLE: Authentic early-2000s consumer MiniDV/DV footage: handheld, imperfect framing, slight shake, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, blown highlights, soft digital sharpness, CCD noise, DV/interlacing characteristics, natural motion blur, occasional digital zooms, washed-out colors and imperfect white balance. Realistic eye-level camera with occasional accidental framing.

CHARACTER: Natural Korean beauty, realistic skin texture and imperfections, believable proportions, natural expressions and hair movement. No plastic skin, exaggerated beauty, posing, or AI-perfect features.

AUDIO: Only authentic location sounds—footsteps, traffic, bicycles, birds, shops, bakery sounds, cash, wind, washing machines and distant conversations. No music or narration.

NO: Cinematic aesthetics, modern smartphone look, color grading, subtitles, captions, beauty filters, CGI appearance, dramatic lighting, slow motion, stabilization, or polished commercial visuals.

Make it feel like a genuine spontaneous personal memory recorded on an old MiniDV tape in Seoul around the early 2000s.

entries.prompt:

SCENE: Six Japanese students in dark uniforms sit in impossible twisted positions while calmly drawing disturbing hollow-eyed faces with wide toothy grins. entries.title: Turkey Cyberpunk Travel Film Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for creating a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic travel film showcasing Turkey, blending cyberpunk technology with historic architecture using FPV drone movements.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic FPV travel film showcasing the futuristic energy, natural beauty, and cultural character of TURKEY. Blend cyberpunk technology with Istanbul’s historic architecture, vibrant streets, Mediterranean and Aegean coastlines, and spectacular night imagery. Use extreme-speed FPV drone movement, hyperlapse, seamless spatial transitions, and dense but controlled flash-cut editing. 8K cinematic realism, photorealistic environments, realistic crowds and vehicles, dramatic lighting, smooth motion blur only during rapid transitions, premium commercial cinematography. No text, logos, subtitles, or watermarks.

[0–6s] — CITY FROM THE SKY
Begin above Istanbul at sunrise, surrounded by mist and clouds. An FPV drone dives rapidly between modern skyscrapers before sweeping toward the Bosphorus. The scene transitions from warm daylight into blue-hour neon as the city below comes alive. Cars create flowing light trails while the camera races through vibrant streets, revealing Istanbul’s futuristic energy beside historic architecture.

[6–12s] — TECHNOLOGY & HISTORY
Use rapid cinematic match cuts: a modern tram glides through the city, instantly transitioning into a close-up of a traditional Turkish coffee being prepared; a speeding ferry cuts across the Bosphorus, followed by a dramatic aerial reveal of the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. Turkish street life, glowing shopfronts, crowded avenues, and modern architecture flash together in rhythmic visual transitions.

[12–18s] — SPATIAL FOLD TO THE COAST
A moving object passes directly across the lens and becomes a seamless transition into the Turkish coastline. The camera bursts over crystal-clear turquoise water near Antalya and races along dramatic Mediterranean cliffs. Speedboats cut through the sea, white spray exploding behind them. Transition toward Cappadocia as hot-air balloons suddenly fill the sky above the surreal rock formations.

[18–24s] — TURKEY IN MOTION
The camera dives between Cappadocia’s towering rock formations and rapidly transitions to a bustling Istanbul street at golden hour. Match-cut between a Turkish flag waving in the wind, a crowded bazaar, traditional architecture, modern city traffic, and people enjoying the coastline. Use fast but visually coherent transitions that emphasize Turkey’s contrast between ancient heritage and modern life.

[24–30s] — THE GRAND FINALE
Night falls instantly. The camera rises above Istanbul and reveals the Bosphorus illuminated by thousands of city lights. A massive coordinated drone light show forms elegant abstract shapes above the skyline while boats move across the glowing water below. The camera pulls rapidly backward and upward into an enormous aerial panorama, revealing Istanbul stretching across both sides of the Bosphorus.

End with a powerful wide cinematic shot of the illuminated city, water, bridges, historic landmarks, and night sky.

STYLE: ultra-realistic 8K cinematic travel film,

entries.title: Baby Monkey House Party Scene
entries.description: A surreal and detailed prompt for generating a party scene with baby rhesus macaques wearing clothes.
entries.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 photoreal smartphone footage filmed by someone dancing inside a baby rhesus macaque house party at 3am, in a dark velvet lounge, phone flash on. Direct on-camera flash is the only light: bright, crisp, punchy light on the babies, fur glowing, vivid saturated colours, strong contrast, deep black shadows, the room falling off into darkness a few feet behind them. Deep crimson velvet curtains and a red velvet sofa just visible in the dark, wooden crates, a lounge mirror, a glowing red EXIT sign, a black PA speaker cabinet. Cigarette smoke lit up white by the flash. Phone grain, motion blur on fast moves, flash flickers on the beat, candid party-phone-video look. Tall vertical framing: subjects stacked up the frame, tight close-ups filling the height, low angles looking up.

Cast: real infant rhesus macaques only, a few weeks old, tiny enough to sit in one adult hand, oversized heads, huge dark eyes, pink faces, soft short baby fur, delicate hands. Never adult size. Every baby wears baggy brightly coloured cartoon trousers that fully cover them from the waist to the ankles: polka dots, stripes, and clown checks, comically too big, sagging and twisted. A small party: a pale golden baby, a dark charcoal baby, a warm tan baby, a grey-brown baby, one slightly bigger reddish-brown baby who is the life of the party, one round silver-grey baby, and a smaller olive-brown baby. They party like clumsy tiny humans: standing upright, swaying, raising little hands, bobbing heads, arms around shoulders, cheersing tiny cups. Faces stay cool, half-lidded and deadpan while the bodies go wild. Every shot is a small group of at most five. Nobody is bare from the waist down.

Extra mismatched clothes, worn badly:
- The reddish-brown baby wears oversized black sunglasses crooked on its face, slipping down its nose, plus baggy red polka-dot trousers.
- The dark charcoal baby has a tiny baseball cap on backwards and sideways, brim flopping, plus baggy blue striped trousers.
- The warm tan baby is tangled in a doll-sized button-down shirt worn inside out, one sleeve hanging empty, plus baggy yellow check trousers.
- The pale golden baby has one tiny mismatched sock and a thin chain tangled in its fur, plus baggy green spotted trousers.
- The rest wear only the baggy cartoon trousers. Clothes slip and hang wrong.

Camera: the phone is held upright by someone dancing at baby-monkey height. It never stays still. It bounces on the beat, sways, whip-pans, punch-in zooms, Dutch angles, and pushes into faces. Motion blur on fast moves. Hard cuts on the beat.

Shots, 30 seconds:
0–1.2s: phone bouncing, tall close-up on the warm tan baby standing upright, inside-out shirt with one empty sleeve swinging, baggy yellow trousers sagging, head bobbing, a tiny cigarette in its mouth, smoke trailing up; whip pan out.
1.2–2.8s: swing in on four babies standing on their hind legs, arms around each other, all in baggy cartoon trousers: pale golden one smoking, dark charcoal one with the backwards cap sliding off and a tiny shot glass balanced on its head, warm tan one in the crooked shirt, grey-brown one lower in frame staring blankly into the lens while its body keeps swaying; punch-in on the stare.
2.8–4.2s: Dutch-angle: the reddish-brown baby, sunglasses slipping, red polka-dot trousers, raises a tiny clear cup to cheers the camera, then sips; behind it the pale golden one on a wooden crate, red velvet curtains, EXIT sign near the top of frame.
4.2–5.4s: slow push across five babies standing close, swaying in place in their baggy trousers, little hands raised, flash on their faces; no jumping, no crowd.
5.4–6.6s: whip pan to the olive-brown baby swaying upright in striped trousers, tiny cigarette in its mouth, shoulder shimmy, camera bouncing with it.
6.6–8.4s: slow orbit around the warm tan one and the dark charcoal one swaying close, arms on shoulders, both smoking, empty sleeve and slipping cap swinging, baggy trousers sagging.
8.4–10.4s: low angle looking up: the reddish-brown baby tips its head back and chugs from the tiny clear cup, sunglasses sliding to the tip of its nose, two or three others beside it raising their hands; pale golden one on a crate beside a plate of snacks, red velvet sofa.
10.4–11.8s: punch-in on the round silver-grey baby in clown-check trousers, swaying in place, hands waving, deadpan face.
11.8–13.2s: whip pan along the red velvet sofa: three babies standing on the cushions swaying, the grey-brown one with eyes half-closed, the charcoal one's cap nearly falling off.
13.2–14.6s: low angle from behind the reddish-brown baby standing on the black speaker, both little hands pumping, sunglasses crooked, polka-dot trousers sagging; camera tilts up.
14.6–16s: the camera drifts through five babies standing close and swaying, bumping lightly, baggy trousers and cigarette smoke in the flash; no jumping.
16–17.6s: charcoal and warm tan sway side by side under the EXIT sign, smoking, head-bopping, cap and empty sleeve moving with them; camera sways with them.
17.6–20s: push-in on the reddish-brown baby chugging, head tipped all the way back, cup upside down, sunglasses falling off, two others beside it raising their hands; camera shakes.
20–21.6s: a baby in red polka-dot trousers and crooked sunglasses leans into a lounge mirror and tries to look cool, then startles at its own reflection and waves at it, cigarette bobbing in its mouth.
21.6–23.2s: two babies attempt a handshake, miss, bonk foreheads, then laugh with their mouths wide open and throw their little arms around each other, caps and trousers slipping.
23.2–24.8s: one baby in striped trousers slides down the red velvet sofa cushion on its bottom like a tiny slide, cigarette in its mouth, arms up, and lands in another baby's lap.
24.8–26.4s: a baby on a crate conducts the others with a lit cigarette like a tiny baton, baggy yellow trousers sagging, while three babies in front sway completely off the beat.
26.4–28s: two babies try to trade hats, the baseball cap ends up on the wrong head sideways, sunglasses end up on the cap, both freeze and stare at the camera, deadpan.
28–30s: the reddish-brown baby in polka-dot trousers spins once holding a tiny plastic cup, loses its balance, plops onto the speaker, sunglasses fall into the cup, and it takes a victorious sip anyway while the others clap.

Upbeat house track with a pitched-down vocal, muffled party ambience and cheering.

Cigarettes held only in mouths, tiny, scaled to the babies. The cup stays a separate rigid object held in the hand, rim touching only the mouth, never merging with the hand, mouth, face, sunglasses or fur. The shot glass sits on the fur of the head and wobbles. Every baby is fully dressed from the waist down in baggy cartoon trousers in every frame. Real infant rhesus anatomy: tiny bodies, oversized heads, pink faces, proper hands and feet, no extra limbs, no adult macaques. No static shots, no locked-off camera, no smooth gimbal moves, no jumping crowds. No muted colour grade, no soft cinematic film look, no teal wash, no plywood walls, no laser or stage lights, no morphing, no text, no watermark, no subtitles.

Mixed-reality hybrid animation combining playful 2D hand-drawn character art with a photorealistic greenhouse. Whimsical stop-motion physics, expressive line animation, exaggerated scale, warm sunlight, realistic plants and playful environmental sound effects.

entries.title: Golden Retriever Puppy Birthday Party
entries.description: A prompt for a heartwarming animal story where a mother golden retriever steals a birthday cake for her puppies, featuring continuous shot dynamics and realistic interactions.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second photorealistic, heartwarming animal story in one continuous shot. Use a close-focusing 18mm wide-angle perspective with a fast, low, animal-height camera that smoothly rises into intimate human reactions without cutting. Maintain realistic animal movement, natural fur, believable object contact, and continuous spatial geography.

Set the sequence in one cozy backyard patio beside a small garden shed on a bright late-afternoon day. A wooden picnic table, two garden chairs, and a small covered dog bed occupy the same connected space.

The main animal is one golden retriever mother. The human character is a young boy wearing a mustard-yellow sweater. The important prop is one small round birthday cake with white frosting and a single blue candle.

0 to 2 seconds: Start extremely close to the cake on the picnic table. The mother dog reaches up, gently grips the cake box edge with her mouth, and pulls it down. The box lands softly on the patio. She immediately picks it up and trots away.

2 to 4 seconds: Race backward ahead of the dog as the boy notices. He follows with a surprised expression and says, “Hey, that’s for my birthday!”

4 to 6 seconds: Move alongside the dog as she passes between the two garden chairs. The camera stays low. The cake box bumps lightly against the ground with each step while the boy follows naturally behind.

6 to 8 seconds: Curve around the final chair and reveal the covered dog bed. The mother dog reaches it and carefully lowers the cake beside the bed. She releases the box and looks toward the puppies.

8 to 10 seconds: The first puppy slowly crawls forward from inside the bed and rests its chin beside the cake box. The boy kneels down, confused but smiling.

10 to 12 seconds: Rise slightly to include the boy, mother dog, and bed. The boy opens the box and discovers several tiny puppies gathered inside. He softly says, “Oh… you wanted a party too.”

12 to 14 seconds: Continue a close flowing orbit. The mother dog gently nudges the cake toward the puppies while the boy places it safely outside their reach. The puppies wiggle excitedly.

14 to 15 seconds: A second puppy suddenly pops its head beside the first and gives the blue candle one tiny curious sniff. The boy laughs quietly. End with the mother dog, two puppies, and boy sharing the warm moment.

Audio: Speak only the two quoted lines. Include soft paw steps, cardboard movement, quiet garden birds, puppy sounds, and the boy’s gentle laugh. No narration and no talking animals.

Continuity restrictions: One mother dog, exactly two puppies, one boy, one cake, one patio. No cuts, duplicated puppies, disappearing objects, magical movement, humanlike animal gestures, candle touching the puppies, or sudden location changes.

entries.title: Late Night Tattoo Studio Visit
entries.description: A prompt for a 30-second ultra-realistic video of a young woman visiting a tattoo studio to test temporary flower designs, featuring handheld camera aesthetics and intimate moments.
entries.prompt:
VIDEO CONCEPT:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic personal video of a young woman visiting a tiny late-night tattoo studio with her friend.

She is not getting a tattoo. Instead, she is helping the artist choose between two tiny temporary flower designs, then testing one on her wrist. The video captures the nervous laughter, close-up details, and her genuine reaction when she sees it.

The entire scene should feel intimate and spontaneous.

FORMAT:
30 seconds • 16:9 • 1080p • photorealistic live-action • raw handheld consumer-camera footage

MAIN CHARACTER

A young Korean woman in her early 20s with long straight dark-brown hair.

She wears a loose black zip-up jacket, faded blue jeans, simple white sneakers, and a small silver ring on her right hand.

Keep her face, hairstyle, outfit, ring, body proportions, and identity completely consistent.

LOCATION

A tiny independent tattoo studio in Seoul, South Korea, around 11:30 PM.

The studio is located above a quiet street and has:

- Warm desk lamps
- A small tattoo chair
- Wooden work table
- Framed original artwork
- Ink bottles
- Paper sketches
- Small plants
- Metal shelves
- Concrete walls
- One large window overlooking the quiet street

No recognizable tattoo artists, brands, logos, or copyrighted artwork.

CAMERA / VISUAL STYLE

The video is recorded by her friend on a small consumer digital camera.

- Handheld
- Slight natural shake
- Close imperfect framing
- Autofocus occasionally shifts between her face and the temporary tattoo
- Warm indoor exposure
- Slight digital noise
- Natural skin texture
- Mild motion blur
- No stabilization
- No artificial bokeh
- No commercial beauty lighting

TIMELINE

0–5 SECONDS — THE DESIGNS

The camera enters the studio.

The woman sits at a small table looking at two tiny flower sketches.

She looks between them.

She points at one.

“This one?”

The artist nods.

She looks toward the camera.

“Or this one?”

---

5–10 SECONDS — TESTING IT

The artist prepares a small temporary tattoo transfer.

The woman holds out her wrist.

The camera moves closer.

She watches carefully.

She looks slightly nervous but amused.

---

10–16 SECONDS — APPLICATION

The temporary flower design is pressed onto her wrist.

She keeps her arm completely still.

The camera focuses on the artist's hands.

The paper is carefully peeled away.

The small flower design is revealed.

---

16–21 SECONDS — FIRST LOOK

She rotates her wrist toward herself.

Her expression changes into a genuine smile.

She looks at the camera.

“Wait… I actually like it.”

She turns her wrist under the light.

---

21–26 SECONDS — CLOSE-UP

The camera moves very close to the details should look physically printed on the skin rather than digitally composited.

She touches the edge of the design.

She laughs quietly.

---

26–30 SECONDS — WALKING OUT

She puts her jacket back on.

The camera follows her toward the studio door.

Before leaving, she looks back at the camera.

Handheld, imperfect framing, slight shake, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, soft DV detail, digital noise and natural motion blur. EXACT STORY — KEEP THIS ORDER

0–4s: In her Japanese bedroom, she picks up gym bag, packs towel + water bottle, puts on sneakers and leaves apartment.

Bad Gym Day, Made With Seedance 2.5 on @TapNow_AI

prompt:

**Scene 4:** She arrives at a rooftop viewpoint overlooking a beautiful city skyline during sunset. The golden sun slowly sets behind the buildings. She sits on a bench, gazes at the sunset, and enjoys the peaceful atmosphere.

**Scene 5:** At blue hour, she walks along a modern urban street with glowing streetlights and passing cars. The camera captures her beautiful side profile and flowing hair in a cinematic tracking shot.

**Scene 6:** Nighttime outdoor café with warm fairy lights hanging overhead. She sits at a cozy wooden table with her iced coffee and handbag. She smiles at the camera, raises her drink, takes a sip, and waves goodbye with a cheerful expression.

**Visual style:** Ultra-realistic 4K, photorealistic skin texture, natural facial expressions, cinematic depth of field, soft lighting, warm golden-hour tones, beautiful bokeh, smooth camera movements, professional color grading, realistic hair physics, natural body movements, aesthetic Korean lifestyle vlog, dreamy peaceful atmosphere.

**Camera:** Mix of wide shots, medium shots, close-ups, slow-motion details, smooth tracking shots, and gentle cinematic transitions.

**Mood:** Peaceful, romantic, cozy, elegant, dreamy everyday life.

Maintain perfect character consistency, identical facial features, hairstyle, clothing, and accessories across all scenes. No distorted hands, no flickering, no face changes, no unnatural movements, no text, no watermark.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Rice Harvesting Scene
entries.description: A detailed prompt for Seedance 2.5 to generate a realistic video of a woman named Sakura harvesting rice in Japan, focusing on natural movements and camera work.
entries.prompt:
10月、日本の田んぼ。黒髪・前髪ありの女性「さくら」が、チェックシャツ、作業用サロペット、長靴、麦わら帽子で手刈りを体験する。

冒頭は、抱えた黄金色の稲穂の向こうから顔が見える近景。鎌で刈る→手間取る→隣の手元を見る→握る量を変える→少しずつ動作がつながる。周囲が休憩へ向かっても、最後の一株を刈ってから合流。

手袋を外し、畦でおじいちゃんとお菓子を食べる。目が合い、口元が緩む。お茶を飲んで肩の力が抜ける。周囲が立つと残りを食べ、手袋を着け直して田んぼへ。今度は少し迷いの減った手つきで刈る。

友人のスマホ手持ち撮影。顔の近景を中心に、手元・全身・田んぼの中景を切り替える。軽い手ブレと追従の遅れ。動作は自然な速さで、場面はテンポよく進める。

顔・衣装・道具を維持。字幕、セリフ、誇張した咀嚼音、過剰演技、固定カメラなし。

「集中する→力が抜ける→また動く」を、表情の指示より身体の動作で描く。
entries.translated_prompt:
October, a rice field in Japan. A black-haired woman with bangs, "Sakura," experiences hand-harvesting wearing a checkered shirt, work overalls, long boots, and a straw hat.

The beginning is a close-up where her face appears from behind the golden sheaves of rice she is holding. Cutting with a sickle → struggling → looking at the neighbor's hands → adjusting the grip amount → movements gradually connect. Even when others head towards break time, she joins them only after cutting the last stalk.

She takes off her gloves and eats snacks with an old man on the ridge. Their eyes meet, and her mouth relaxes. She drinks tea and her shoulders loosen. When everyone stands up, she finishes eating, puts her gloves back on, and returns to the field. This time, she cuts with fewer hesitations.

Handheld smartphone footage by a friend. Focuses on close-ups of the face, switching between hands, full body, and medium shots of the rice field. Slight camera shake and lagging follow. Movements are at a natural speed, and scenes progress rhythmically.

Maintain face, clothing, and tools. No subtitles, dialogue, exaggerated chewing sounds, overacting, or fixed cameras.

Depict "Focus → Relaxation → Action" through physical movements rather than facial expressions.

entries.title: Four Seasons East-Asian Inlay Art Video
entries.description: A complex prompt for generating a video depicting a traditional East-Asian mother-of-pearl inlay artwork quadtriptych showing four seasons on glossy black lacquer, created with Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
Traditional East-Asian mother-of-pearl inlay artwork quadtriptych on glossy black lacquer ground. 4 vertical panels showing 4 seasons, each with distinct color palette while maintaining unified artistic style. Shallow 3D relief where every shell element sits slightly raised and casts real shadows.

PANEL 1 (LEFT - SPRING): Cherry blossom trees with pink and white iridescent shell petals falling through air. Young koi fish swimming in clear pond with emerging lotus shoots. Blue butterflies emerging from cocoons. Delicate pink clouds above. Traditional Chinese pavilion with fresh green moss on roof tiles. Soft pastel iridescence - pink, light green, pearl white, soft coral. Morning light atmosphere.

PANEL 2 (CENTER-LEFT - SUMMER): Full blooming lotus flowers in pink and white on black mirror pond. Large mature koi fish with vibrant orange and white scales. Dragonflies with iridescent blue-green wings hovering above water. Lush green pine trees with dense shell needles. Waterfall flowing vigorously between rocks. Bright midday lighting. Palette: vibrant teal, turquoise, coral pink, emerald green, bright silver.

PANEL 3 (CENTER-RIGHT - AUTUMN): Maple trees with red, orange and gold iridescent shell leaves falling on pond water. Mature koi fish with deep crimson and gold scales swimming slowly. Golden-orange clouds drifting above. Silver and copper cranes standing among rocks. Chrysanthemum flowers in amber and burgundy tones. Warm golden hour lighting. Palette: crimson, gold, amber, copper, deep orange, burgundy, bronze.

PANEL 4 (RIGHT - WINTER): Snow-covered pine branches with white and silver shell needles. White and pale pink plum blossoms emerging through snow. Koi fish swimming under partially frozen pond with ice crystals. White cranes with silver-tipped feathers in flight. Delicate pearl snowflakes falling gently. Moon and stars visible through thin clouds. Cool evening lighting. Palette: pearl white, silver, pale blue, icy turquoise, soft pink, deep black.

UNIFIED ELEMENTS ACROSS ALL PANELS: Continuous black mirror pond connecting all 4 panels. Koi fish present in each panel (different sizes/colors per season). Consistent mother-of-pearl inlay technique throughout. Visible vertical dividers between panels. Iridescent shell surfaces catching light differently in each season.

TECHNICAL: 8K resolution, horizontal 16:9 aspect ratio, 4-panel quadtriptych layout with visible divisions, photorealistic CGI rendering, shallow 3D relief with real shadows, soft directional studio light creating rainbow iridescence on all shell surfaces.

MOOD: Peaceful, meditative, cyclical, zen, luxurious handcrafted aesthetic, East Asian traditional art, serene beauty of nature's seasons.

entries.title: Emotional Cat Loss Short Film
entries.description: A prompt for a deeply emotional cinematic short film about a woman grieving her cat, contrasting rainy present reality with warm golden flashbacks.
entries.prompt: Create a deeply emotional, photorealistic cinematic short film about a woman grieving the loss of her beloved fluffy ginger tabby cat. On a gloomy rainy evening, inside a dimly lit apartment, the woman wearing a dark beige trench coat kneels beside an empty grey pet bed, gently picks up a red feather toy, holds it tightly against her chest, and begins crying as rain streaks down the window. Transition into warm, golden flashbacks showing her happiest memories with the cat: the cat approaching her on the couch for affection, playfully weaving between her legs in the hallway, happily playing with a feather teaser wand while she laughs, gently nuzzling the cat, and lovingly cradling it beside a sunlit window. Use warm sunlight, soft lens flare, shallow depth of field, and nostalgic golden tones for the memories, contrasting with the cold blue-gray lighting of the present. Suddenly return to reality as she breaks down in uncontrollable tears, then curls up on the wooden floor beside the empty pet bed, tightly hugging a white pillow or blanket while sobbing. Slowly pull the camera back to emphasize her loneliness, then shift focus to a framed photograph of the ginger cat in the foreground, leaving the grieving woman blurred in the background. End with the photograph in sharp focus as rain continues outside, creating a powerful feeling of love, memory, loneliness, and loss, with realistic facial expressions, natural tears, detailed cat fur, cinematic camera movement, subtle film grain, realistic lighting, 4K quality, and no text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Cinematic Grandmother Fight Scene Prompt
entries.description: A detailed text-to-video prompt for Seedance 2.5 that generates a 15-second cinematic fight scene featuring an elderly Japanese woman with superhuman speed battling various men in everyday locations, incorporating rapid kiss attacks and dynamic camera movements.
entries.prompt:
15秒、4:3、実写フォトリアル。日本を舞台にしたシネマティックで真剣な高速格闘シーン。コミカルな演技やバラエティ的な演出にはしない。本気の映画アクションとして描く。ただし、戦闘技として突然「高速キッス」が何度も挟まる。この高速キッスだけが異様な要素だが、登場人物自身は一切ふざけず、必殺技の一種のように扱う。

映像は35mm映画フィルムのような質感。自然なフィルムグレイン、わずかなハレーション、柔らかなハイライト、深い黒、落ち着いた自然な色調、微細なレンズフレア、映画用レンズらしい自然なボケ。デジタル的にシャープすぎず、過剰なHDRやCM調にはしない。日本映画の本編から切り出したようなシネマティックなレンズトーン。文字、字幕、ロゴ、HUDなし。

主人公は日本人の腰の曲がった高齢女性。毎回、外見、顔、髪型、体格、服装を自然にランダム化する。花柄ブラウスとベストの近所のババア、割烹着、農作業着、スーパー帰りの服装、上品なカーディガン、派手な柄物、和服、ジャージ、小柄で非常に腰の曲がったタイプ、痩せ型で鋭い目つきのタイプなどから毎回違う人物にする。白髪、灰色髪、短髪、パーマ、お団子などもランダム。ただし共通して、腰が強く曲がった高齢女性であり、普段はゆっくり動きそうに見えるが、戦闘開始後だけ常識外れの超高速格闘能力を発揮する。

対戦相手は成人男性。高齢男性に限定しない。普通のサラリーマン、若い不良風の男、中年の店主、筋肉質なスポーツマン、作業着姿の職人、宅配スタッフ、スーツ姿の会社員、ストリートファッションの若者、観光客風の男性、頑固そうな中年男性などから毎回ランダムに設定する。年齢、体格、服装、髪型も毎回変更する。ババアより大柄でもよい。

ロケーションも毎回ランダムに変更する。昔ながらの商店街、住宅街の細い路地、大型ショッピングモール、スーパーマーケット、コンビニ前、駅前広場、地下街、飲食店や店舗の店内、ホームセンター、観光地の参道など、日本国内の日常的な場所を選ぶ。必要に応じて通行人、買い物客、店員、学生、会社員、観光客などが自然に存在する。背景人物は主役にせず、戦闘が始まると驚いて振り返る、立ち止まる、距離を取る、道を開ける程度の自然な反応にする。

格闘技の内容も毎回ランダムに組み合わせる。高速前蹴り、高速回し蹴り、ローキック、足払い、膝蹴り、掌底、肘打ち、中国拳法風の連続掌打、八極拳風の短距離突進、太極拳風の受け流し、柔道の崩し、体落とし、小外刈り風の足技、腕を取って体勢を崩す動き、高速ステップ、高速フェイントなどを複数組み合わせる。同じ技だけを連打しない。ババアは腰が曲がった姿勢を基本的に維持しながら、人間離れした速度で戦う。

映像全体の最重要構造は固定する。

「高速移動 → 一瞬だけ実体化 → 格闘技 → 即離脱 → 別方向から再接近 → 突然急停止 → 高速キッス → 即離脱 → 再び高速格闘」

この反復を15秒間、高密度で繰り返す。

高速キッスは絶対に省略しない。キッスは最低5回程度入れる。各キッスのたびに顔の超接近アップを0.2〜0.4秒程度だけ短く差し込む。キッスの直前まで激しく高速移動しているのに、唇が接触する瞬間だけ突然時間が止まったように人物が鮮明になり、接触を明確に見せる。直後には即座に高速で離脱し、そのまま格闘へ復帰する。

キッスの前に長く見つめ合わない。恋愛的な間を作らない。キッス後に照れない。笑い合わない。色気を強調しない。キッスそのものも本気の格闘の中に組み込まれた異様な接触技として扱う。男は毎回驚くが、コミカルな顔芸にはしない。驚愕と困惑を短く見せた直後に本気で反撃しようとする。

この戦いは同じ場所に固定しない。対峙した開始地点から、戦いながら少しずつ位置を移動していく。攻防のたびに2人の立ち位置がずれ、前進、後退、横移動、回り込み、押し込み、回避によって、画面内の背景が少しずつ変化していく。商店街なら店先から通路中央へ、通路中央から別の店の前へ、ショッピングモールなら柱やベンチやエスカレーター付近へ、スーパーなら通路沿いに移動しながら、路地なら奥へ流れながら戦う。戦闘全体を通して、2人は周囲の環境の中を移動し続け、ひとつの定位置で格闘し続けない。高速移動するババアだけでなく、男も押し返し、踏み込み、かわし、よろけ、追いながら位置を変える。結果として15秒の間に戦場の重心が少しずつ移動していく。

カメラワークも固定しない。カメラは1か所に置いた固定撮影ではなく、戦いに合わせて常に位置と向きを変える。前進、後退、横移動、斜め移動、回り込み、追従、遅れて追うリフレームを自然に組み合わせる。ワイドで全体を捉えた直後に少し寄り、別の角度へずれ、また追いかける。2人の移動に合わせてカメラも数歩分動いてついていく。時には男の肩越し、時にはババア寄り、時には2人の進行方向に合わせて並走する。カメラ自体を無意味に高速回転させたり、同じ構図を固定し続けたりしない。戦いながらロケーションの別の部分が見えてくる、空間の中を一緒に移動している感覚を出す。

0.0〜1.5秒。ババアと男が至近距離で対峙している。両者とも本気の構え。ババアは腰の曲がった姿勢のまま低く重心を落とし、鋭く男を見据える。男も警戒しながら構える。場所に通行人や客がいる場合、まだ周囲は日常の状態。緊張感のある静かな導入。カメラはミディアム〜ややワイドで2人を捉えつつ、完全固定ではなく、じわりと寄るか、わずかに横へ動いて緊張感を高める。

1.5〜2.1秒。男が先に踏み込む。腕を伸ばす、掴みにいく、蹴りを出す、打撃を仕掛けるなど、毎回違う攻撃を開始する。その瞬間、ババアが突然異常な速度で加速。身体に強いモーションブラーと残像が生じ、男の攻撃線を紙一重で外しながら一瞬で顔面付近へ入り込む。ここで2人の位置は開始地点から少しずれる。カメラも遅れて追い、横へ流れる。

2.1〜2.4秒。第1高速キッス。突然、顔の超接近アップ。高速移動が完全に止まり、ババアが男へ一瞬だけキッスする。唇の接触が明確に見える。男は目を見開く。0.2〜0.4秒だけ鮮明に見せる。

2.4〜3.0秒。キッスを離した瞬間、ババアはすでに高速離脱。男だけが一瞬その場に残され、驚愕したまま次の方向を探す。ババアの残像が別方向へ走る。男はそれに引っ張られるように数歩動き、戦場の位置がさらにずれる。カメラもその移動に合わせてリフレームする。

3.0〜3.3秒。第2高速キッス。別方向からババアが突然真正面へ実体化。顔の超接近アップへ瞬時に切り替わり、再び短いキッス。すぐ離れる。

3.3〜4.5秒。ワイドまたはミディアムへ戻り、高速格闘。ババアが男の周囲を猛烈な速度で移動しながら、高速蹴り、足払い、掌打、中国拳法風の連撃、柔道の崩しなどからランダムな技を連続で差し込む。1つの動作を長く見せず、0.2〜0.4秒程度の短いアクションを連続させる。男も本気で防御し反撃する。2人は攻防しながら少しずつ移動し、開始地点とは違う背景が見えてくる。カメラも並走、斜め追従、回り込みを混ぜて追う。

4.5〜4.8秒。第3高速キッス。激しい高速移動の途中で突然ババアが男の顔の目前へ停止。顔の超接近アップ。短く明確なキッス。直後すぐ高速離脱。

4.8〜5.4秒。高速格闘再開。男が反撃しようとするが、ババアは側面、背後、正面へ高速で位置を変え、攻撃をかわしながら技を差し込む。強い残像、風圧、衣服の揺れ。男もそれに合わせて踏み替え、向きを変え、押し戻され、2人はさらに別の場所へ移る。カメラも止まらず一緒に動く。

5.4〜5.7秒。第4高速キッス。再び超接近アップ。キッスだけ一瞬完全に止まり、すぐ高速離脱。

5.7〜8.4秒。ここは高速格闘の密度を最大化する。ババアが男の周囲を高速で回り込み、0.2〜0.4秒単位で攻撃方向を変える。高速前蹴り、回し蹴り、足払い、掌底、肘、受け流し、崩し、投げへの入り、短距離突進などをランダムに組み合わせる。男も本気で攻撃を返すが、ババアは直前で回避し、別方向へ抜ける。ババアが複数人に増殖したようには見せず、1人の人物が超高速で位置を変えているように描く。この区間では攻防の流れで2人が通路、路地、フロアなどをさらに移動し、背景が段階的に変化する。通行人や客がいる場合は、戦いを避けるように自然に脇へ下がり、進路が開く。カメラも後退しながら受けたり、横へ動いたり、回り込んだりして空間の変化を見せる。

8.4〜8.7秒。第5高速キッス。激しいラッシュの途中で突然真正面へ実体化。顔の超接近アップ。キッス。その瞬間だけ背景と人物の速度感が止まり、唇の接触が鮮明に見える。即離脱。

8.7〜10.5秒。高速格闘へ即復帰。男が大きく反撃し、ババアが紙一重でかわす。さらに中国拳法、柔道、キック系などから別の技を高速で組み合わせる。この区間にテンポを壊さない範囲で第6高速キッスを短く1回追加してもよい。その場合も必ず「顔の超接近アップ → 短い接触 → 即離脱」で処理する。この区間でも2人はその場にとどまらず、押し引きしながら戦いの位置が少しずつ移動し続ける。カメラも追い続ける。

10.5〜12.5秒。一度だけ両者の距離が開く。男は体勢を整え、本気で最後の攻撃に備える。ババアも腰の曲がった姿勢のまま静かに構える。2人とも相手から視線を外さない。ここだけ短い緊張の間を作る。ただし長く止まりすぎない。この時点ですでに開始地点とは違う位置まで戦いが移動していることが背景から分かる。カメラは少し回り込みながら2人の距離感を見せる。

12.5〜13.4秒。ババアが突然真正面から猛烈な速度で突進。強い残像を引きながら一気に距離を詰める。男も迎撃しようとするが、その攻撃をかわしながら顔の目前まで到達。直前で完全急停止。ここでも2人はさらに数歩分位置を移し、カメラも一緒に踏み込む。

13.4〜13.9秒。フィニッシュ高速キッス。顔の超接近アップ。最後のキッスはそれまでよりわずかに長く、最も明確に見せる。直前まで超高速だった映像が、この瞬間だけ完全に静止したように見える。恋愛的な演出は一切入れない。真剣な必殺技として扱う。

13.9〜15.0秒。キッス直後、男が強い衝撃を受けて後方へ大きく吹き飛ぶ、転倒する、床を滑る、壁や什器の方向へ弾かれるなど、ロケーションに合わせた真剣な決着。過剰なギャグ落ちは不要。ババアはその場付近に残り、腰の曲がった姿勢のまま静かに男を見る。笑顔、勝利ポーズ、指差し、コミカルな仕草はしない。カメラは決着の勢いに合わせてわずかに流れ、最後に止まる。

高速移動の表現は「急加速 → モーションブラーと残像 → 一瞬だけ実体化 → 鮮明な技またはキッス → 即再加速」を繰り返す。高速中ずっと人物をぼかし続けず、停止した瞬間だけ身体と顔を鮮明にする。

カメラは実写映画の格闘シーンとして撮影する。基本はミディアム〜ワイドで、2人の位置関係と技の動線を明確にする。高速移動中は短いパン、急なリフレーム、わずかに遅れる追従、自然な手持ち感、前進、後退、横移動、回り込みを使う。カメラそのものを無意味に高速回転させない。

キッスの瞬間だけ必ず顔の超接近アップへ切り替える。「ワイドで高速格闘 → 突然顔の超アップ → 0.2〜0.4秒のキッス → 即ワイドへ戻って高速格闘」という映像テンポを何度も繰り返す。このアップとワイドの高速な切り替えが映像の重要なリズム。さらに各ワイド、ミディアム、アップの撮影位置や背景は少しずつ変化し、同じ場所、同じ画角、同じ背景で繰り返さない。

登場人物は最後まで真剣。ふざけない。笑わない。キッスだけをギャグとして強調しない。全体としては緊迫した本格高速格闘映画であり、その中に説明不能な高速キッス技が何度も自然に組み込まれている状態を維持する。

毎回ランダムに変更するのは、ババアのタイプ、男の人物設定、ロケーション、背景人物、格闘技、技の順番、男の反撃、戦いながら移動する方向と経路、カメラが追従する方向と角度、最後の決着方法。

毎回必ず維持するのは、腰の曲がった日本のババア、35mm映画フィルム調のシネマティックな映像、本気の高速格闘、0.2〜0.4秒単位の高速アクション、最低5回程度の高速キッス、キッスごとの顔の超接近アップ、キッスだけ一瞬完全停止、キッス直後の即高速離脱、即格闘復帰、最後の高速キッスによるフィニッシュ、戦いながら少しずつ空間を移動していくこと
entries.translated_prompt:
15 seconds, 4:3 aspect ratio, photorealistic live-action. A cinematic and serious high-speed combat scene set in Japan. Do not use comedic acting or variety-show style direction. Depict it as intense movie action. However, sudden "high-speed kisses" are repeatedly inserted as combat techniques. This high-speed kiss is the only bizarre element, but the characters themselves do not joke around at all; treat it as a type of special move.

The video should have the texture of 35mm film. Natural film grain, slight halation, soft highlights, deep blacks, calm natural tones, subtle lens flares, and natural bokeh typical of cinema lenses. Avoid digital sharpness, excessive HDR, or commercial-style looks. Cinematic lens tone as if cut from the main feature of a Japanese film. No text, subtitles, logos, or HUD.

The protagonist is an elderly Japanese woman with a bent waist. Randomize her appearance, face, hairstyle, physique, and clothing naturally every time. From neighborhood grandmas in floral blouses and vests, cooking aprons, farm work clothes, shopping return outfits, elegant cardigans, flashy patterns, kimonos, jerseys, small-framed extremely hunched types, thin types with sharp eyes, etc., choose a different person each time. White hair, gray hair, short hair, perms, buns, etc. are also random. However, commonly, she is an elderly woman with a strongly bent waist who appears to move slowly normally but displays absurdly super-fast combat abilities only after the battle starts.

The opponent is an adult male. Not limited to elderly men. Regular salarymen, young delinquents, middle-aged shop owners, muscular sportsmen, workers in overalls, delivery staff, suited office workers, street-fashion youths, tourist-like men, stubborn-looking middle-aged men, etc., are randomly selected each time. Age, physique, clothing, and hairstyle also change each time. He can be larger than the grandma.

Locations are also randomized each time. Choose everyday places within Japan such as old shopping streets, narrow residential alleys, large shopping malls, supermarkets, in front of convenience stores, station squares, underground malls, inside restaurants or shops, home centers, pilgrimage paths at tourist sites, etc. Pedestrians, shoppers, clerks, students, office workers, tourists, etc., exist naturally as needed. Background figures should not be the focus; when the fight begins, they react naturally by turning around in surprise, stopping, keeping their distance, or making way.

Combat techniques are also randomly combined each time. Combine multiple moves such as high-speed front kicks, high-speed roundhouse kicks, low kicks, sweeps, knee strikes, palm strikes, elbow strikes, continuous palm strikes like Chinese martial arts, short-distance charges like Bajiquan, deflecting like Tai Chi, Judo off-balancing, body drops, foot techniques like outer reap, grabbing arms to break posture, high-speed steps, high-speed feints, etc. Do not spam the same technique. The grandma fights at human-impossible speeds while basically maintaining her hunched posture.

Fix the most important structure of the entire video:

"High-speed movement → Instant manifestation → Combat technique → Immediate disengagement → Re-approach from another direction → Sudden stop → High-speed kiss → Immediate disengagement → Resume high-speed combat"

Repeat this iteration densely for 15 seconds.

Never omit the high-speed kisses. Include at least about 5 kisses. Insert a super close-up of faces for only 0.2–0.4 seconds for each kiss. Even though there is intense high-speed movement right before the kiss, the moment the lips touch, time seems to stop suddenly, making the characters clear and showing the contact explicitly. Immediately after, disengage at high speed and return to combat.

Do not stare into each other's eyes for long before the kiss. Do not create romantic pauses. Do not blush after the kiss. Do not laugh together. Do not emphasize sensuality. Treat the kiss itself as a bizarre contact technique embedded within serious combat. The man is surprised every time, but do not make it a comical facial expression. Show brief shock and confusion, then immediately try to counterattack seriously.

This battle does not stay fixed in one location. Starting from the confrontation point, they gradually shift positions while fighting. With each exchange, the two fighters' standing positions shift, and through advancing, retreating, lateral movement, circling, pushing, and dodging, the background on screen changes slightly. In a shopping street, move from the storefront to the center of the aisle, then to the front of another store. In a shopping mall, move towards pillars, benches, or escalators. Along supermarket aisles, flow deeper into alleys. Throughout the entire fight, the two continue moving through the surrounding environment and do not keep fighting in one fixed spot. Not only the high-speed moving grandma, but the man also pushes back, steps in, dodges, stumbles, and chases, changing position. As a result, the center of gravity of the battlefield shifts slightly during the 15 seconds.

Camera work is also not fixed. The camera is not a static shot placed in one location but constantly changes position and orientation according to the fight. Naturally combine advancing, retreating, lateral movement, diagonal movement, circling, tracking, and reframing that lags behind. After capturing the whole scene in wide, zoom in slightly, shift to another angle, and chase again. The camera moves several steps along with the fighters' movements. Sometimes over the man's shoulder, sometimes closer to the grandma, sometimes running alongside matching their direction of progress. Do not spin the camera meaninglessly fast or keep the same composition fixed. Create a sense of moving together through space where different parts of the location become visible during the fight.

0.0–1.5s. The grandma and man confront each other at close range. Both are in serious stances. The grandma lowers her center of gravity in her hunched posture, glaring sharply at the man. The man also guards warily. If there are pedestrians or customers, the surroundings are still normal. Tense, quiet introduction. The camera captures both in medium-to-slightly-wide, not completely fixed, but creeping in or moving slightly sideways to heighten tension.

1.5–2.1s. The man steps in first. Start a different attack each time: extending arms, trying to grab, kicking, striking, etc. At that moment, the grandma suddenly accelerates at abnormal speed. Strong motion blur and afterimages occur on her body, narrowly avoiding the man's attack lines while instantly entering near his face. Here, the two's positions shift slightly from the starting point. The camera also trails late, flowing sideways.

2.1–2.4s. First high-speed kiss. Suddenly, super close-up of faces. High-speed movement stops completely, and the grandma gives the man a fleeting kiss. Lip contact is clearly visible. The man's eyes widen. Show clearly for only 0.2–0.4 seconds.

2.4–3.0s. The instant the kiss breaks, the grandma has already disengaged at high speed. Only the man remains momentarily, shocked, looking for the next direction. The grandma's afterimage runs in another direction. Pulled by this, the man moves several steps, shifting the battlefield position further. The camera reframes according to this movement.

3.0–3.3s. Second high-speed kiss. The grandma materializes suddenly directly in front from another direction. Instantly switch to super close-up of faces, giving another short kiss. Leave immediately.

3.3–4.5s. Return to wide or medium, high-speed combat. While moving fiercely around the man at high speed, the grandma inserts random techniques continuously from high-speed kicks, sweeps, palm strikes, Chinese martial arts combos, Judo off-balancing, etc. Do not show one action for long; chain short actions of about 0.2–0.4 seconds. The man defends and counters seriously. The two move slightly while attacking and defending, revealing backgrounds different from the start. The camera mixes running alongside, diagonal tracking, and circling to follow.

4.5–4.8s. Third high-speed kiss. During intense high-speed movement, the grandma suddenly stops right in front of the man's face. Super close-up of faces. Short, clear kiss. Immediately disengage at high speed.

4.8–5.4s. Resume high-speed combat. The man tries to counter, but the grandma changes position rapidly to sides, back, and front, dodging attacks while inserting techniques. Strong afterimages, wind pressure, swaying clothes. The man also adjusts footing, turns, gets pushed back, and the two move to yet another place. The camera keeps moving together without stopping.

5.4–5.7s. Fourth high-speed kiss. Again, super close-up. Only the kiss stops completely for a moment, then immediate high-speed disengagement.

5.7–8.4s. Maximize density of high-speed combat here. The grandma circles the man at high speed, changing attack direction every 0.2–0.4 seconds. Randomly combine high-speed front kicks, roundhouse kicks, sweeps, palm strikes, elbows, deflections, off-balancing, entries into throws, short charges, etc. The man returns attacks seriously, but the grandma dodges at the last second and exits in another direction. Do not depict the grandma multiplying into many people; draw it as one person changing position at super-high speed. In this section, the flow of offense and defense moves the two further along aisles, alleys, floors, etc., with backgrounds changing progressively. If there are pedestrians/customers, they naturally step aside to avoid the fight, opening the path. The camera retreats to receive, moves sideways, or circles to show spatial changes.

8.4–8.7s. Fifth high-speed kiss. During intense rush, suddenly materialize directly in front. Super close-up of faces. Kiss. For that moment, the speed sensation of background and characters stops, lip contact is vividly seen. Immediate disengagement.

8.7–10.5s. Immediately return to high-speed combat. The man counters heavily, the grandma dodges narrowly. Further combine different techniques from Chinese martial arts, Judo, kick systems, etc., at high speed. You may add a sixth high-speed kiss briefly once in this section without breaking tempo. If so, always process it as "Super close-up of faces → Brief contact → Immediate disengagement." Even in this section, the two do not stay put; positions shift slightly while pushing and pulling. Camera continues following.

10.5–12.5s. Distance between the two opens once. The man regains stance, preparing seriously for the final attack. The grandma also stands quietly in her hunched posture. Neither takes eyes off the opponent. Create a short tense pause here. But don't stop too long. By now, backgrounds indicate the fight has moved to a position different from the start. Camera shows their distance while circling slightly.

12.5–13.4s. The grandma suddenly charges straight ahead at fierce speed. Closing distance instantly with strong afterimages. The man tries to intercept, but she dodges his attack reaching right in front of his face. Complete hard stop just before. Here too, the two shift positions by several more steps, and the camera steps in together.

13.4–13.9s. Finish high-speed kiss. Super close-up of faces. The final kiss is slightly longer than before, shown most clearly. The image, which was ultra-fast until just before, appears completely frozen in this moment. No romantic staging whatsoever. Treat it as a serious special move.

13.9–15.0s. Right after the kiss, the man receives strong impact, flying backward largely, falling, sliding on floor, bouncing off walls/fixtures, etc., a serious conclusion fitting the location. Excessive gag falls unnecessary. The grandma remains nearby, quietly looking at the man in her hunched posture. No smiles, victory poses, pointing, or comical gestures. Camera flows slightly with the momentum of the conclusion, finally stopping.

Expression of high-speed movement repeats "Rapid acceleration → Motion blur and afterimages → Instant manifestation → Clear technique or kiss → Immediate re-acceleration." Don't keep characters blurred throughout high-speed; clarify body and face only at the moment of stopping.

Shoot the camera as a live-action movie fight scene. Basically medium-to-wide, clarifying the positional relationship and trajectory of techniques. During high-speed movement, use short pans, sudden reframes, slightly delayed tracking, natural handheld feel, advancing, retreating, lateral movement, circling. Don't spin the camera itself meaninglessly fast.

Always switch to super close-up of faces only at the moment of the kiss. Repeat the video tempo "Wide high-speed combat → Sudden face super-close-up → 0.2–0.4s kiss → Immediately return to wide high-speed combat" many times. This fast switching between close-up and wide is the important rhythm of the video. Furthermore, shooting positions and backgrounds for each wide, medium, and close-up change slightly; don't repeat same location, same angle, same background.

Characters remain serious until the end. No joking. No laughing. Don't emphasize the kiss alone as a gag. Maintain the state of a tense, full-scale high-speed combat movie overall, with inexplicable high-speed kiss techniques naturally embedded many times within it.

What changes randomly each time: Grandma's type, Man's character setting, Location, Background figures, Combat techniques, Order of techniques, Man's counterattacks, Direction and route of movement during fight, Direction and angle of camera tracking, Final conclusion method.

What must always be maintained: Hunched Japanese grandma, 35mm film texture cinematic video, Serious high-speed combat, High-speed actions in 0.2–0.4s units, At least about 5 high-speed kisses, Super close-up of faces for each kiss, Complete stop only for the kiss, Immediate high-speed disengagement after kiss, Immediate return to combat, Finish via final high-speed kiss, Moving through space slightly while fighting

entries.title: Pixar Style Father Daughter Hug
entries.description: A prompt for a heartwarming 3D animated scene of a father working from home with his baby daughter, ending in an emotional hug.
entries.prompt:
Create a heartwarming cinematic 20-second 3D animated family scene in a cozy home office during a warm evening.

A young father with curly brown hair, expressive eyebrows, and a red-and-blue Spider-Man inspired sweater sits at a wooden desk working on a laptop. Beside him is his adorable little baby girl wearing a beige knitted outfit and a cute bear-ear winter hat.

The baby watches her father closely while he works. The father occasionally looks at her with a tired but loving expression, drinks from a white coffee mug, and continues typing on his laptop. The baby sits beside him in a small high chair, curiously observing everything.

Show the father becoming distracted when the baby interacts with a small red toy car and a plate of food on the desk. Include natural facial expressions, subtle eye movements, gentle hand gestures, and realistic parent-child interaction.

Later, the baby proudly shows her father a handmade drawing of the two of them together with a heart. The father's expression changes from tired and stressed to emotional, surprised, and deeply touched.

End with the father smiling warmly, turning toward his daughter, embracing her lovingly, and giving her a gentle hug.

Style: high-quality cinematic 3D animation, Pixar-inspired family-film aesthetic, soft warm indoor lighting, detailed expressive faces, realistic fabric and hair textures, cozy atmosphere, shallow depth of field, smooth character animation, natural camera movement, emotional storytelling.

Vertical 9:16 composition, cinematic framing, consistent character appearance throughout, smooth transitions, detailed environment, wholesome emotional ending.

entries.title: Cinematic Martial Arts Fight Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 30-second photorealistic martial arts fight scene in a Japanese temple courtyard using Seedance 2.5, including shot-by-shot breakdown and audio instructions.
entries.prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5 | 30s | 16:9

Photorealistic live-action martial arts action in a ruined Japanese temple courtyard at dusk. Large-format cinema look, drifting mist, wet flagstones, crumbling stone torii, mossy lanterns, broken pillars and collapsed halls. Desaturated moss green, stone grey and cedar brown, warm lantern accents, natural skin texture, subtle film grain. Soft grey light from camera-right, warm lantern light from camera-left.

HERO: Use Image1 with EXACT same face, hairstyle, body build and outfit in every shot. Calm, controlled and extremely fast. Natural dust and fabric wear increase during the fight.

VILLAIN: Tall broad-shouldered warrior, charcoal-black layered kimono, dark indigo sash, half-face iron mask, long tied-back black hair, worn hardwood bo staff. Outfit remains unchanged.

SHOT FLOW:
00:00–02: Hero stands beneath torii, mist drifting; 24mm extreme-wide slow dolly-in.
02–04: Villain emerges dragging staff; 35mm low-angle tracking shot.
04–06: Hero drops into low fighting stance; 85mm quick push-in.
06–08: Villain swings staff; hero ducks and palm-strikes ribs; 28mm handheld action.
08–10: Rapid staff attacks; hero blocks twice and punches mask; 40mm handheld.
10–12: Overhead staff strike; hero sidesteps and lands elbow; 35mm arc.
12–14: Villain lands heavy blow, throwing hero across wet stone; 24mm ground tracking.
14–16: Hero rises, parries staff thrust and lands knee; 50mm push-in.
16–18: Hero jumps low sweep, pushes off pillar and kicks staff away; 35mm crane rise.
18–20: Unarmed villain throws rapid punches; hero slips, blocks and ducks; 40mm handheld.
20–22: Hero traps arm, elbows villain and flips him onto stone; 28mm orbit.
22–24: FINAL COMBO 1 — rising palm strike + low kick.
24–26: FINAL COMBO 2 — powerful rotating back kick to chest.
26–28: FINAL COMBO 3 — two-handed palm strike sends villain crashing onto wet stone.
28–30: Hero calmly walks toward torii as mist closes in; slow 24mm pull-back, fade to black.

AUDIO: No dialogue. Wind, footsteps, cloth movement, staff whooshes, impacts, stone cracks and water splashes. Music builds from low drone → cello → fast taiko → orchestral climax at 00:24 → near silence → sustained cello note.

Maintain exact identity, costumes, environment, lighting direction and realistic physics throughout. No face changes, outfit changes, extra characters, random weapons or inconsistent backgrounds.

entries.title: Ember Fracture Awakening Combat
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a supernatural martial arts combat scene featuring So-Yeon, focusing on realistic physics, glass-like fracture VFX, and specific Korean dialogue.
entries.prompt:
EMBER FRACTURE — AWAKENING Image SO-YEON | 30s | 16:9 | one continuous generation.

LIVE-ACTION ONLY: Ultra-photorealistic AAA supernatural martial arts. <<<image_1>>> locks SO-YEON's exact identity; same single woman throughout. Small 160cm build, messy black hair, black hoodie/pants/Converse. Real skin, pores, hair, eyes and biomechanics. Never CGI/digital double.

ALLEY: Wet narrow convenience-store alley at night, red/pink/teal neon, puddles, crates, dumpster, vending machine, steam. 5 unarmed male delinquents attack aggressively, never taking turns.

AUDIO: Korean dialogue, diegetic impacts/traffic/ambience only. No BGM/subtitles.

AWAKENED COMBAT: Her body takes over automatically; unarmed Taekwondo × Karate × Pencak Silat, extremely fast, fluid chained movement with no reset poses.

VFX LOCK: Acceleration = physical movement + subtle heat-shimmer/refractive distortion only. No fire, flames, embers, orange particles, beams, plasma or teleportation. Every strong physical impact creates a brief glass-like spiderweb fracture in the air, splitting neon light, then silently disappearing; realistic steam/dust/debris from impact.
IMPACT → FRACTURE WEB → NEON REFRACTION → DISSIPATION.

00–03: So-Yeon cowers against wall. Leader smacks her head. She slowly glares through bangs. {어쭈? 이 년 봐라? 많이 컸다?}

03–06: Fear returns; she flinches: {아…! 미안…}. Leader swings again.

06–09: 0.3s slow-mo: automatic head-slip → Silat parry → pivot → body punch. Fracture flash. Leader crashes into crates.

09–12: She stares at trembling hand in disbelief. {저 년이?!} Four rush simultaneously.

12–17: Heat-shimmer dash through two: parry → redirect → elbow → sweep → side kick. Impact fracture + steam. Continue instantly.

17–22: Two attack together: diagonal dash → duck → shoulder redirect → roundhouse. Wide fracture-web splits pink/teal neon.

22–27: Final attacker from behind. Maximum physical dash; camera lags/whip-pans. Evade → parry → jab → body punch → low kick → spinning back kick. 0.25s slow-mo; dense fracture-web across wall.

27–30: Largest fracture lattice spreads across alley, neon reflections split, debris/crates fly, enemy slides away. Fracture hits lens → brief refracted distortion. So-Yeon studies her hands, then calmly walks through steam, half frightened/half amazed, hair falling over eyes. Never looks back. CUT.

CAMERA: Close, kinetic handheld pursuit; tracking, whip-pans, low angles, OTS, facial inserts, rapid focus. Camera reacts slightly late to acceleration. Impact shake only on physical contact. Readable action > chaos.

HARD LOCK: Real human + real environment + VFX in same frame. No duplicate So-Yeon. No teleportation. Every VFX effect must originate from visible physical contact.

entries.title: Tiny Clockwork Explorer Animation Prompt
entries.description: A prompt for creating a mixed-reality animation where a tiny hand-drawn explorer navigates a giant mechanical workshop, including detailed scene breakdowns and style instructions.
entries.prompt:
A tiny hand-drawn 2D animated explorer discovers a giant abandoned clockwork workshop, turning gears, springs, buttons, and mechanical objects into a thrilling miniature obstacle course.

Style: Mixed-reality hybrid animation combining expressive hand-drawn 2D character art with a realistic mechanical workshop environment. Playful stop-motion physics, smooth hand-drawn motion, cinematic lighting, realistic textures, and detailed mechanical sound effects with energetic background music.

Camera & Framing: Extreme macro close-ups, low-angle tracking shots, dynamic overhead views, shallow depth of field, tilt-shift miniature effects, and fast cinematic camera movements following the tiny explorer.

Audio & Scene Breakdown

[00:00] - [00:03]
Visual: A tiny explorer wearing a blue jacket, brown boots, and a small red backpack stands beside a massive brass gear as it slowly begins rotating.

[00:04] - [00:07]
Visual: She jumps onto the moving gear teeth, runs across them, and leaps onto a giant metal spring that launches her onto a wooden workbench.

[00:08] - [00:12]
Visual: A huge mechanical lever suddenly moves beneath her, sending her sliding across a polished metal surface before she grabs a dangling copper wire.

[00:13] - [00:17]
Visual: She swings across the workshop and lands inside an enormous open pocket watch, running between its moving gears as sparks glow in the background.

[00:18] - [00:22]
Visual: A giant wind-up key begins turning, creating a powerful gust that pushes her across the table while loose screws and metal pieces roll around her.

[00:23] - [00:27]
Visual: She discovers a tiny glowing blue crystal hidden inside a mechanical box and carefully reaches toward it as the entire workshop begins coming alive.

[00:28] - [00:30]
Visual: She touches the crystal, causing hundreds of gears to move simultaneously as the camera rapidly pulls backward to reveal the entire workshop operating like one enormous machine.
