Subtitle: "Mine knocked a glass off the table, looked me dead in the eye, and blamed ME."
Orange nods slowly in the background: "Classic."

10-15s: Two-shot, both staring at the skyline.
Orange (whisper): "She says I never listen. I'm a CAT. I don't listen to anybody."
Subtitle: "She says I never listen. I'm a CAT. I don't listen to anybody."
Tuxedo: "Respect the honesty, though."

15-20s: Tuxedo leans in, furious whisper, eyes wide.
Tuxedo (whisper): "She told me to 'use my words.' I HAVE four words. All of them are 'feed me' and 'move.'"
Subtitle: "She told me to 'use my words.' I HAVE four words. All of them are 'feed me' and 'move.'"
Orange wheezes silently, shoulders shaking.

20-25s: Both go quiet. Orange stares into the distance.
Orange (whisper): "That's it. I'm done. Tonight I'm leaving her."
Tuxedo (whisper): "Finally. Say it again, louder."
Orange (louder, voice cracking): "I'M LEAVING HER!"
Subtitles match.

25-30s: A distant female voice calls out: "Dinnerrr!" Both cats' ears shoot up instantly. They stare at each other, then bolt off the ledge in opposite directions. Cut to the empty ledge, one tiny "meow" echoes.
Orange (off-screen): "Coming, babe!"
Tuxedo (off-screen): "Coming, honey!"
Subtitles match. Fade to black.

Style: photorealistic, 4K, cinematic color grade, subtle city ambience, light comedic sound effects (record scratch on the "four words" line, tiny whoosh on the bolt-off). No cartoon look, no text other than subtitles.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Tokyo Cat Rescue Vlog
entries.description: Detailed prompt for a photorealistic early-2000s Tokyo street vlog involving a cat rescue chase, with strict identity and era locks.
entries.prompt:
Create a highly photorealistic 30-second early-2000s Tokyo street vlog filmed on an authentic consumer MiniDV/DV camcorder.
IDENTITY LOCK: Use the exact same young Japanese woman from the reference image. Keep her face, hair, body proportions, outfit and dark-brown shoulder bag identical throughout.

CAT LOCK: Use the SAME small fluffy domestic cat throughout. Realistic fur and movement, wearing a simple harness. The cat is always safe and unharmed.

ERA LOCK: Everything must authentically belong to Tokyo around 2003–2004: streets, cars, clothing, shops, signs, vending machines and technology. No smartphones, AirPods, modern cars, LED screens or contemporary fashion.

CAMERA: Genuine consumer MiniDV footage—handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, soft digital detail, subtle DV noise, motion blur and occasional imperfect zooms. No 4K, DSLR, VHS effect, cinematic stabilization or modern retro filter.

EXACT STORY:

0–5s — WALK: She casually walks down a Tokyo side street carrying her cat.

5–9s — SNATCH: A young Japanese man approaches from behind, suddenly takes the cat from her arms and runs away. She reacts in shock. The cat remains secure and unharmed.

9–15s — CHASE: She runs after him down the same street while the camcorder operator follows shakily. The man continues holding the cat safely.

15–21s — CATCH: She catches him, grabs his sleeve and firmly demands her cat back. Non-graphic confrontation, no weapons or serious violence.

21–25s — RECOVER: She takes the cat back, checks it carefully and hugs it with relief.

25–30s — WALK AWAY: She gives the man an angry look and walks away carrying her cat safely. The camera follows from behind.

CONTINUITY: Same woman, cat, thief, outfit, bag and street throughout. No teleportation, duplicated people/cats, identity drift, scene skipping or reordered actions. Natural reactions and realistic movement. No blood, weapons, injury, subtitles, watermarks or text overlays.

FINAL FEEL: A spontaneous early-2000s Tokyo home-video moment that unexpectedly turns into a short cat-recovery chase, captured like genuine consumer DV footage.

entries.title: Kindness in Seoul Neighborhood
entries.description: A prompt for generating a realistic early-2000s home video style clip of a young woman helping an elderly person carry groceries in a quiet Seoul neighborhood.
entries.prompt:
Main Subject: Young Korean woman, 24, naturally attractive, realistic skin, minimal makeup, long dark hair loosely down. Wearing an oversized maroon hoodie and loose casual pants, carrying a simple canvas shoulder bag. Preserve her exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, body proportions and appearance throughout.

Location: Quiet older Seoul neighborhood during a pleasant morning. Narrow residential street with low-rise apartment buildings, small local shops, parked bicycles, potted plants, utility poles and modest homes. An elderly Korean woman is preparing to carry a moderately large cloth sack filled with groceries or household items. The street feels peaceful, lived-in and authentic.

Lighting & Atmosphere: Warm, gentle and uplifting morning atmosphere. Soft sunlight filters between the buildings, creating warm highlights while the street remains naturally shaded. Muted colors, soft shadows, slightly faded tones and a nostalgic early-2000s feeling. Cozy and wholesome without looking staged or sentimental.

Style: Ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video filmed by another person. Multi-shot, but still completely candid and unstaged. Each shot should feel like the camcorder operator naturally repositioned themselves while following the moment. Natural handheld movement, subtle camera shake, imperfect framing, gentle reframing, occasional autofocus hunting, mild exposure shifts, faded colors, soft contrast, authentic DV compression, subtle digital noise and natural microphone noise.

Shot 1 — 00:00–00:04:
Medium-wide handheld shot from behind and slightly to the side as the young woman walks casually down the residential street. Her canvas shoulder bag rests naturally on one shoulder. She notices an elderly woman ahead struggling to lift a moderately heavy cloth sack onto her back.
Shot 2 — 00:04–00:07:
The camcorder moves closer from the side. The elderly woman tries to lift the sack herself, but it slips down before she can get it onto her back. She pauses and tries again. The young woman notices and naturally slows down.

Shot 3 — 00:07–00:11:
Closer side-angle shot. The young woman walks over and quietly gestures that she can help. She takes hold of the sack while the elderly woman steadies herself. Together, they lift it smoothly onto the woman's back. The young woman adjusts the sack slightly so it sits securely.
Shot 4 — 00:11–00:14:
The elderly woman gives her a grateful smile and small nod. The young woman responds with a warm little smile and a brief nod, then steps back.

Shot 5 — 00:14–00:17:
The young woman turns and continues walking down the street. The camcorder follows her from behind for a moment before drifting slightly to her side.
Shot 6 — 00:17–00:20:
She glances toward the camcorder while still walking. She gives a quiet, contented smile—natural and understated, as if she's simply pleased that she could help. She turns her gaze forward and continues walking.

entries.title: Handbag Throw Physics Test
entries.description: A prompt for generating a photorealistic live-action video where a woman throws a handbag towards the viewer with realistic weight and momentum, caught by a foreground hand.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic live-action video, real-time speed throughout. NO slow motion.

Refer to Image 1. Inside a 3D anamorphic billboard on a modern building, an elegant woman with wavy hair wears a red high-slit velvet gown and reclines sideways on a marble ledge. A red crocodile-skin handbag is beside her.

She quickly grabs the handbag, lifts it, then forcefully SLINGS it forward toward the viewer. Her arm makes one fast forward swing and releases the bag with strong force.

The moment the bag leaves her hand, it must immediately shoot rapidly toward the foreground hand. The flight is FAST and SHORT, with no lingering airborne time. Do not show the bag slowly traveling through the air. It moves quickly from the woman's hand directly toward the catcher.

The bag has real weight and momentum. Gravity naturally pulls it slightly downward during the fast flight, but it must continue moving rapidly forward. No floating, hovering, slow drifting, or suspended motion.

A manicured foreground hand catches the SAME handbag almost immediately after the throw. The hand and wrist recoil naturally from the bag's momentum and weight.

ONE continuous shot. No cuts, hidden transitions, camera resets, or duplicated objects.

Exactly ONE handbag from beginning to end. The bag leaves the woman's hand once and is caught once. Never duplicate, replace, regenerate, or recreate the bag.

Preserve the woman's face, hair, gown, handbag, marble ledge, billboard and building. Realistic physics, anatomy and motion. No morphing, flickering or teleportation.

NO SLOW MOTION AT ANY POINT. No artificial SFX. Natural ambient sound with relaxed, sensual background music.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Miniature Arcade Stunt
entries.description: Prompt for a high-energy viral short video featuring a miniature woman performing stunts in a giant arcade, with specific style and physics requirements.
entries.prompt:
STYLE: Miniature Tiny-Person FX, photorealistic live-action, cinematic macro photography, ultra-shallow depth of field, realistic amusement-park lighting, ultra-detailed 8K, vertical 9:16, high-energy viral short-video style.

DURATION: 30 seconds.

SETTING: A gigantic indoor arcade filled with oversized claw machines, racing simulators, basketball games, air-hockey tables, giant plush toys, neon signs, glowing buttons, prize shelves, and colorful arcade machines. Everything feels enormous from the perspective of a palm-sized woman.

She sprints across enormous glowing arcade buttons, jumping between them before launching herself from a giant joystick. She grabs a hanging cable, swings between massive arcade machines, and lands on a racing-game cabinet.

She jumps onto the steering wheel of a giant racing simulator as it suddenly accelerates, holding on through the shaking motion before jumping away at the last moment.

She lands on a huge air-hockey table as a massive puck races toward her. She jumps onto it, rides across the table, leaps over the goal, and lands on a pile of oversized plush toys.

Inside a giant claw machine, she climbs across stuffed animals as the mechanical claw descends toward her. She jumps onto a plush bear, uses it as a trampoline, grabs the claw, and swings out of the machine.

She lands on a towering prize shelf, races across giant stuffed toys, and leaps onto a glowing neon sign above the arcade entrance. The camera pulls far back to reveal her tiny scale against the enormous arcade.

Large glowing text appears:

“BUILT FOR THE BIG MOMENTS”

She raises both arms as colorful arcade lights flash around her.

SFX: Arcade beeps, button clicks, footsteps, mechanical sounds, engine roar, tire screech, air-hockey hiss, plush impacts, rushing air, electronic chimes, crowd ambience, energetic victory sound.

VISUAL REQUIREMENTS: Consistent 1:15 scale, realistic physics, seamless action, photorealistic materials, authentic reflections and shadows, cinematic macro DOF, consistent character identity. No cartoon look, animation style, scale changes, duplicate character, outfit changes, distorted anatomy, floating objects, subtitles, narration, or watermark.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Bamboo Pole Comedy
entries.description: Prompt for a hyper-realistic slapstick comedy scene involving a bamboo pole mishap at a Korean villa, with specific shot directions and dialogue.
entries.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic cinematic slapstick comedy in four seamless shots outside a modest two-story Korean villa on a bright afternoon, using natural handheld smartphone cinematography.
Use Image Reference 1 as the woman and Image Reference 2 as the man; preserve their identities, faces, hairstyles, clothing, and proportions consistently.
Shot 1: The woman stands at an open second-floor window, struggling to straighten a large white bedsheet with an unusually long bamboo laundry pole.
The pole suddenly slips from her hands and falls vertically toward the narrow walkway as the camera instinctively tilts down and follows it.
Shot 2: The scruffy man casually walks beneath the building, completely unaware, when the bamboo pole crashes onto his head with a loud THUNK, sending him dramatically onto the pavement.
He sits up rubbing his head as the woman leans out apologetically; she says, “I’m sorry! I really didn’t mean to!” and he replies flirtatiously, “It’s okay... but you’re really beautiful.”
Shot 3: The man grabs the bamboo pole, sprints toward the building, plants it like a pole vaulter, and launches himself upward toward the second-floor window.
The bamboo bends dramatically under his weight as the camera cranes upward and tracks his ascent, with the man leaning forward as if attempting to kiss the woman.
Shot 4: The woman recoils and shouts, “Eww... you’re so ugly! Go away!” before delivering a perfectly timed front kick into his torso.
The bamboo snaps back like a giant slingshot, launching him violently into the sky as the camera whip-pans and continuously tracks his spinning body until he becomes a tiny silhouette disappearing into the clouds.
Cut back to the window as the woman calmly dusts off her hands, picks up another bamboo pole, and resumes fixing the bedsheet as if nothing happened.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Teacher Morning Vlog Prompt
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a 30-second ultra-realistic vlog of a teacher's morning routine in early 2000s South Korea, including scene breakdowns and era-specific details.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic morning vlog set in a small town neighborhood in South Korea in the early 2000s, filmed casually by a friend on an authentic consumer DV camcorder. It must feel like genuine home-video footage, not a modern video with a retro filter.

Use the provided reference image for the woman's face, hairstyle and outfit. Keep her identical in every scene.

EXACT ORDER — 6 SCENES:

0–5s — WASHING FACE: Early morning, soft sunrise light. The same young Korean woman (late 20s, hot pink sleeveless collared top, white high-waist jeans, white sneakers, small hoop earrings, butterfly pendant necklace, hair in a messy bun) steps out of her modest house into the small yard. An old leaking outdoor steel tap is running. She cups water in her hands, washes her face, and dries it with a small towel hanging nearby.

5–8s — GETTING READY: Fresh and smiling, she picks up a brown canvas shoulder bag and a few textbooks from a small outdoor table, glances at the camera, and heads out through the metal gate.

18–23s — HER SHORT SPEECH: Standing in front of the class, she smiles and speaks a few warm words to the children. The children listen, smile, and clap softly.

23–30s — LECTURE BEGINS: She picks up a piece of chalk, writes the lesson title on the chalkboard, turns to the children and begins explaining. Children raise hands and take notes with pencils. She nods encouragingly.

CONTINUITY: Same woman, same hot pink top, white jeans, white sneakers, hairstyle, brown canvas bag and books throughout. The same school kids appear on the road. Same children in the classroom. No teleporting, identity drift, outfit changes, disappearing props or reordered actions.

CAMERA: Raw consumer DV camcorder footage, 4:3 frame, with subtle handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, soft digital detail, soft slightly washed-out skin tones, mild CCD/DV noise, motion blur, compressio

entries.title: Modern Warfare Cinematic Short Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 30-second cinematic modern warfare special ops video with realistic night lighting, character consistency, and specific camera movements.
entries.prompt:
16:9 横屏，30秒，电影级现代夜间特种作战短片，超写实真人摄影，高预算军事惊悚片质感。整体色调为冷蓝黑色，低饱和、低照度、高反差，空气中有轻微雾气、灰尘和冷凝水汽。场景为深夜城市高层建筑内部及相连的工业走廊，包含狭窄通道、金属门、混凝土墙面、低亮度应急灯和窗外模糊城市灯光。全片保持同一夜间环境、同一人物、同一服装、同一枪械、同一冷蓝光线，不改变时间、地点和视觉风格。
主角高度参考上传图片中的同一名特种兵。深色夜战作战服，宽松深色战术外套，深色贴头帽或头套，黑色战术手套，胸前有软管式呼吸或通信装置，肩背黑色战术装备包。主角手持同一把现代突击步枪，枪械安装消音器、瞄准镜、战术灯和前握把。人物始终保持冷静、克制、专业、专注。面部、服装、装备和枪械在整段视频中保持一致，不换脸、不换装、不换武器。
0至5秒：
以接近上传图片气质的中近景开始。摄影机位于主角正前方略低位置，35mm镜头，轻微仰拍。主角单膝或低姿停在黑暗走廊边缘，低头快速确认武器状态，然后缓慢抬头观察前方。冷蓝色侧光打在脸部、帽子和武器边缘，背景大部分沉入黑暗。窗外只有模糊蓝白城市灯点。摄影机缓慢向前推进，不做快速切换。声音只保留沉重呼吸、衣料摩擦、远处风声和轻微无线电杂音。
5至10秒：
主角起身，以低姿贴着右侧墙面向前推进。枪口始终朝向前方，动作安静、缓慢、明确。摄影机保持在主角左后方肩后位置，以35mm镜头稳定跟随。主角经过一个转角时短暂停顿，身体贴墙，先观察，再继续移动。前方远处出现一名守卫的模糊身影。守卫缓慢转身巡视，不要突然出现。空间关系保持清晰，主角在近景，守卫在走廊远端。
10至15秒：
主角接近守卫所在区域，停在门框阴影内。守卫开始察觉异常，头部轻微转向主角方向。主角立即抬枪，用消音武器完成一次极短促点射。守卫产生自然受击反应并倒入墙边或地面，不出现夸张血腥。主角不原地停留，立刻跨过守卫位置继续前进。摄影机仍保持肩后跟拍，不切成太多角度。重点表现“发现、反应、压制、继续推进”的清晰动作链。
15至20秒：
主角来到目标房间门外。房门关闭或半掩，门缝中透出微弱蓝白光。主角靠墙站位，短暂停顿，调整握枪姿势，侧头确认室内动静。摄影机从肩后缓慢移动到主角侧前方，保持同一空间连续性。主角迅速推门进入，不使用复杂爆破，不增加多人协同。房间内只有一名高价值目标和一名贴身护卫。护卫位于目标侧后方，目标靠近桌面、设备或窗边。
20至25秒：
主角进入房间后立即控制射界。护卫首先发现主角，试图抬起武器。主角迅速进行一次短点射压制护卫，然后立即将枪口转向高价值目标。高价值目标后退一步，试图躲向桌边或墙角。主角保持稳定站姿和精准持枪动作，迅速完成目标清除。整个过程只安排两次明确动作：先压制护卫，再锁定目标。避免同时多人乱动，避免复杂枪战。不要血浆特写，不要慢动作，不要大规模爆炸。
25至30秒：
主角快速扫视房间确认安全，低头看一眼胸前通讯装置，短暂停顿，随后转身撤离。摄影机跟随主角从房门退出，再次回到冷蓝色走廊。最后3秒使用与开头相似的低机位中近景。主角持枪向前进入更深的黑暗，冷蓝色雾气和远处城市灯光出现在背景。主角轮廓逐渐被黑暗吞没，画面在沉重呼吸声和微弱无线电杂音中切黑。
Seedance 2.5 稳定执行规则：
人物一致性为最高优先级。主角全程保持同一张脸、同一深色头套、同一作战服、同一战术外套、同一胸前软管装置、同一背包和同一把步枪。不要生成额外队员，不要生成大量敌人。全片最多出现主角、一名走廊守卫、一名贴身护卫和一名高价值目标。
镜头数量控制在少量长镜头和清晰过渡。避免连续快速剪辑，避免360度绕拍，避免突然切到完全不同空间。摄影机以35mm为主，必要时使用50mm近景。主要采用肩后跟拍、侧前方中近景和轻微低机位。摄影机运动平稳，保留轻微手持呼吸感。
动作必须简洁明确。每个时间段只执行一个主要动作目标。不要同时安排大量奔跑、多人交火、爆炸、直升机、烟雾和快速切镜。优先保证人物、武器、动作和空间连续性。
所有枪械保持相同结构、长度和附件位置。枪托始终贴合肩部，双手持枪姿态符合真实人体结构。禁止枪管弯曲、弹匣变形、瞄具漂移、武器忽然变长或变短。
夜间光线全程保持冷蓝黑色调。禁止突然出现暖色日光、明亮白天、红色霓虹或赛博朋克环境。暗部保留细节，皮肤、衣料、金属和墙体要有真实纹理。
负面约束：
人物换脸，人物变装，突然换枪，武器变形，枪管弯曲，瞄具漂移，弹匣消失，手指穿模，多余手指，多余肢体，人物瞬移，场景跳变，大量群演，复杂多人混战，敌人突然生成，科幻感，赛博朋克感，游戏CG感，卡通感，塑料质感，夸张血腥，血浆特写，爆炸过多，镜头剧烈乱晃，快速无逻辑切镜，过曝，过饱和，白天场景，暖色阳光。

Face, clothing, equipment, and weapon remain consistent throughout the video; no face-swapping, no outfit changes, no weapon changes.
0-5 seconds:
Start with a medium close-up similar in vibe to the uploaded image. Camera positioned slightly low directly in front of the protagonist, 35mm lens, slight upward angle. Protagonist kneeling or in low posture at the edge of a dark corridor, quickly checking weapon status while looking down, then slowly raising head to observe ahead. Cold blue side light hits face, cap, and weapon edges, background mostly sinking into darkness. Only blurred blue-white city light dots visible outside windows. Camera slowly pushes forward, no fast cuts. Sound retains only heavy breathing, fabric friction, distant wind, and slight radio static.
5-10 seconds:
Protagonist stands up, advancing forward along the right wall in low posture. Muzzle always facing forward, movements quiet, slow, and deliberate. Camera stays behind protagonist's left shoulder, following steadily with 35mm lens. Protagonist pauses briefly when passing a corner, body against wall, observing first, then continuing to move. A blurry figure of a guard appears in the distance ahead. Guard turns slowly to patrol, do not appear suddenly. Spatial relationships remain clear, protagonist in foreground, guard at far end of corridor.
10-15 seconds:
Protagonist approaches the area where the guard is located, stopping in the shadow of the door frame. Guard begins to sense anomaly, head slightly turning towards protagonist. Protagonist immediately raises gun, completing one extremely short burst with suppressed weapon. Guard has natural reaction to being hit and collapses against wall or floor, no exaggerated gore. Protagonist does not stay in place, immediately steps over guard position and continues advancing. Camera still follows from behind shoulder, not cutting to too many angles. Focus on expressing the clear action chain of "discovery, reaction, suppression, continued advancement".
15-20 seconds:
Protagonist arrives outside the target room door. Door is closed or half-open, faint blue-white light leaking through the crack. Protagonist takes position against wall, brief pause, adjusting grip, tilting head to confirm movement inside. Camera slowly moves from behind shoulder to side-front of protagonist, maintaining spatial continuity. Protagonist quickly pushes door open, no complex explosives, no multi-person coordination added. Only one high-value target and one personal guard inside the room. Guard is behind the target, target near desk, equipment, or window.
20-25 seconds:
Protagonist controls firing line immediately upon entering the room. Guard notices protagonist first, trying to raise weapon. Protagonist quickly suppresses guard with one short burst, then immediately turns muzzle towards high-value target. High-value target steps back, trying to hide behind desk or wall corner. Protagonist maintains stable stance and precise gun-holding posture, quickly eliminating the target. Entire process arranges only two clear actions: first suppress guard, then lock onto target. Avoid multiple people moving simultaneously, avoid complex gunfights. No blood splatter close-ups, no slow motion, no large-scale explosions.
25-30 seconds:
Protagonist quickly scans room to confirm safety, looks down at chest communication device, brief pause, then turns to withdraw. Camera follows protagonist exiting through the door, returning to the cold blue corridor again. Last 3 seconds use low-angle medium close-up similar to the beginning. Protagonist holding gun advances deeper into darkness, cold blue fog and distant city lights appearing in background. Protagonist's silhouette gradually swallowed by darkness, screen fades to black amidst heavy breathing and faint radio static.
Seedance 2.5 Stability Execution Rules:
Character consistency is highest priority. Protagonist maintains same face, same dark balaclava, same combat uniform, same tactical jacket, same chest tube device, same backpack, and same rifle throughout. Do not generate extra team members, do not generate large numbers of enemies. Maximum characters in whole video: protagonist, one corridor guard, one personal guard, one high-value target.
Number of shots controlled to few long takes and clear transitions. Avoid continuous fast cuts, avoid 360-degree orbiting, avoid sudden cuts to completely different spaces. Camera primarily uses 35mm, occasionally 50mm close-ups. Mainly adopts over-the-shoulder follow, side-front medium close-ups, and slight low angles. Camera movement smooth, retaining slight handheld breathing feel.
Actions must be concise and clear. Each time segment executes only one main action objective. Do not arrange large amounts of running, multi-person firefights, explosions, helicopters, smoke, and fast cuts simultaneously. Prioritize guaranteeing character, weapon, action, and spatial continuity.
All guns maintain same structure, length, and attachment positions. Stock always fitted to shoulder, two-handed gun-holding posture conforms to real human anatomy. Prohibit barrel bending, magazine deformation, sight drift, weapons suddenly becoming longer or shorter.
Nighttime lighting maintains cold blue-black tone throughout. Prohibit sudden appearance of warm sunlight, bright daytime, red neon, or cyberpunk environments. Shadows retain detail, skin, fabric, metal, and walls need real textures.
Negative Constraints:
Face swap, outfit change, sudden weapon change, weapon deformation, barrel bending, sight drift, magazine disappearance, finger clipping, extra fingers, extra limbs, character teleportation, scene jumping, large crowds, complex multi-person melee, enemies suddenly spawning, sci-fi feel, cyberpunk feel, game CG feel, cartoon feel, plastic texture, exaggerated gore, blood splatter close-ups, excessive explosions, violent camera shaking, fast illogical cuts, overexposure, oversaturation, daytime scenes, warm sunlight.

entries.title: GTA Style Bank Heist Game Sequence

entries.prompt: Create a 30-second ultra-realistic AAA open-world third-person action game sequence, fully rendered as fictional GTA-style gameplay from beginning to end. Generate the female player character yourself: a stylish young woman with long dark hair, natural facial features, dark fitted jacket, dark pants and practical boots. Keep her appearance perfectly consistent throughout the entire video. Set the mission in a highly detailed modern city bank with realistic interiors, security guards, vault, cash, police vehicles, traffic and NPCs. Use a true third-person gameplay camera behind the character, realistic game physics, animations, lighting, reflections and a complete GTA-style HUD with minimap, health, mission objectives and notifications. At 0–4 seconds, she enters the bank and the HUD shows MISSION START — BANK HEIST — STEAL THE CASH. At 4–8 seconds, she quickly bypasses security and reaches the restricted vault corridor; HUD: SECURITY BYPASSED. At 8–14 seconds, she reaches the vault, opens it and rapidly fills a duffel bag with cash; HUD: CASH SECURED. At 14–18 seconds, the alarm activates, red warning lights flash and NPCs panic as she runs toward the exit; HUD: ALARM TRIGGERED — ESCAPE. At 18–24 seconds, she exits, gets into a waiting getaway car and drives away while police vehicles begin chasing her through busy city streets. At 24–27 seconds, she makes a sharp turn through a narrow street and loses the police, with the minimap showing ESCAPE ROUTE. At 27 seconds, make exactly one hard cut to a natural third-person gameplay continuation at a hidden safehouse, where she steps out carrying the cash-filled duffel bag. HUD displays MISSION PASSED — CASH SECURED — ESCAPE SUCCESSFUL — RANK S. Make the entire video look like authentic high-budget GTA gameplay, including game-engine visuals, HUD, minimap, NPC behavior, vehicle physics and camera movement. No live-action look, no cinematic movie style, no anime, no cartoon, no random cuts, no teleportation and no graphic gore.

entries.title: Dog Walk in Residential Area
entries.description: A detailed prompt for Seedance 2.5 generating a realistic video of a woman walking her dog in a Japanese residential area, focusing on natural movement and ambient sound.
entries.prompt:
日本の住宅街。友人の犬を散歩させるさくら。
順調に歩き始めた犬が、道端のにおいに足を止める。さくらも止まり、様子を見てしゃがむと、今度は急に歩き出す。慌てて立ち上がり、早歩きから小走りへ。

後半は、その勢いのまま犬が減速して座り込む。さくらが戻って目線を下げると、犬が体を寄せる。少し触れ合ったところで犬は立ち、来た道へ。さくらも一拍遅れて立ち上がり、またついていく。

友人が歩きながら撮るスマートフォン映像。軽い手ブレ、追従の遅れ、構図の修正。人物・犬・赤茶色のリードの同一性と物理的なつながりを維持。感情は視線と身体動作で表現する。

セリフ・字幕・BGMなし。足音と衣擦れ、住宅街の環境音だけで描く、犬任せの午後。
entries.translated_prompt:
Japanese residential area. Sakura walks her friend's dog.
The dog starts walking smoothly but stops to sniff something on the roadside. Sakura also stops, crouches down to look at it, and then suddenly starts walking again. She hurriedly stands up and goes from fast walking to jogging.

In the second half, the dog slows down and sits while still having momentum. Sakura returns, lowers her gaze, and the dog leans its body against her. After a brief moment of contact, the dog stands up and heads back the way they came. Sakura stands up a beat later and follows again.

Smartphone footage filmed by a friend while walking. Slight hand shake, delay in tracking, composition adjustments. Maintain identity and physical connection between person, dog, and reddish-brown leash. Express emotions through eye contact and body movements.

No dialogue, subtitles, or BGM. A dog-led afternoon depicted solely with footsteps, rustling clothes, and ambient sounds of the residential area.

entries.title: Whip Pan Camera Motion AI Video
entries.description: A complex prompt demonstrating whip pan camera transitions between different cultural scenes (Maasai, Mongolian, Viking, etc.) generated with Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
0:00–0:05 — Maasai village, firelit clearing: The camera moves low among a Maasai fireside gathering, weaving past men in red shúkà cloth seated in conversation, some sharing a gourd of fermented milk. It settles on a circle of clapping men as a warrior mid-leap rises impossibly high in the adumu jumping dance, beads and ochre-dyed hair swinging, firelight flaring across his face. Crash zoom to the calabash drummer's hands, striking at lightning speed. 

0:05–0:10 — Whip pan to Mongolian steppe camp: A sudden fast 360-degree whip pan cuts across darkness and lands on a Mongolian steppe camp, a roaring bonfire outside a felt ger tent. A throat-singer crouches low, chest and throat resonating with a deep guttural drone, while beside him a horsehead fiddle player draws long, sorrowful notes, firelight catching the carved horse head at the instrument's neck. Rapid focus pull to the fiddle player's bow arm sawing with practiced intensity. 

0:10–0:15 — Whip pan to Viking hall: A violent whip pan hurls the camera into a smoke-filled Viking longhouse, torchlight catching axe blades and shields mounted on timber walls. Bearded warriors pound wooden tankards on long tables in unison, chanting low and building, a horn-blower raising a great curved war horn and sounding a deep bellow that cuts through the hall. 

0:15–0:20 — Whip pan to Plains fire circle: Another hard whip pan lands on a Native American Plains fire circle at night, a hide drum group seated tight around a large ceremonial drum, mallets striking in unified, driving rhythm. Quick whip pan to a dancer in feathered regalia spinning through rising sparks, fringe and feathers blurring with motion. 

0:20–0:25 — Whip pan to Māori haka: A final sharp whip pan crashes into a Māori gathering at night, warriors performing the haka in fierce unison — stamping feet shaking loose earth, tongues bared, eyes wide, hands slapping chests and thighs in thunderous rhythm. 

0:25–0:30 — Rhythmic collapse, hold on fire: The camera pulls back slightly but stays within the Māori circle, holding steady as the stamping rhythm reaches its peak, dust rising and catching firelight — the frame holds on their pounding feet and fierce expressions as the sequence closes.

entries.prompt: 全片生物、面部近景、建筑和远景统一为明显电脑生成的高品质AAA奇幻游戏过场动画，使用数字雕刻脸模、经过美术设计的材质光影与成束头发，不混入实拍演员，不采用2D动画、赛璐璐描边或普通gameplay。整体是由连续硬切连接的末日奇幻战争蒙太奇：巨型军团推进、远超军团尺度的骨架生物显露、城内两只巨人短暂肉搏，最后切到另一只猿形巨人的咆哮蓄能；不同生物保持各自身份，不把这些切镜做成同一角色连续变形。环境与色彩：密集的中世纪半木构城市，红褐瓦顶、深棕木梁、浅米色墙面、窄石街、烟囱、尖顶塔楼与高耸外围石墙；所有普通房屋、街道和塔楼都远小于巨人，战斗者的腰胸高过附近屋顶，巨型军团更高，远处骨架生物又远超整个军团。厚重灰褐烟云和橙金逆光覆盖城市，浮尘、碎瓦和蒸汽形成多层纵深；开头为浓重焦褐尘雾，中段为暖金天空照亮的城内废墟，结尾为巨大圆形金色逆光与翻卷云雾，保持同一末日暖金色系。A巨型军团：多排无发的超巨大成年男性化人形生物，宽肩厚胸、深红肌束与浅象牙腱膜、深陷眼窝和清楚齿列，肋部及肩胸表面具有连续雕刻组织；这是生物本来的完整外观，不是新鲜伤口，没有流血。它们空手、无衣甲，前后排列有真实纵深，头肩与步幅略有差异，沿同一个方向持续缓慢行进，身体周围蒸汽升腾，脚下带起尘浪，不是静止观众或重复粘贴的同一人。B骨架巨构：军团后方仅有一个远比它们庞大的非人骨架生命体，浅褐象牙色中央脊柱高耸，两侧大量狭长弧形肋骨向外展开再向下弯曲，像覆盖军团上空的巨大骨架穹顶，肋弓之间有真实空隙，不是翅膀或建筑。前部低悬着一张狭长的红褐骨质面孔，深眼窝、尖长耳、露齿下颌，黑色长发成束垂落在面部两侧，头部通过颈部连接同一骨架，不是独立漂浮的头。最初眼睛暗，随后两眼亮起翠绿色光。C黑发硬拳巨人：中段肉搏主角之一，强健修长的人形非人生物，棕褐皮肤与清楚胸腹肌束，肩背宽而腰收，长深棕黑发、尖耳、强下颌与齿列，双眼翠绿发光。两只拳头及下段前臂覆盖浅灰白色粗糙硬化结晶，晶层依附真实拳指与腕部，仍是同一双手，不是手持石块或拳套武器；肘关节以上保留原本肌肉形态。D浅金骨甲巨人：另一名肉搏者，体量与C接近但更宽厚，短浅色头发、浅金色眼光，脸、胸、背、肩和四肢有层叠浅金褐色生物骨甲，深褐肌束连接甲片之间，甲片是身体的一部分，不是穿戴金属盔甲。空手，两臂与头部全程完整，肩颈逸出薄蒸汽。E黑鬃猿形巨人：末段独立角色，厚重黑褐毛发覆盖巨大肩背与极长双臂，躯干前倾，腿较短且强健，沉重猿人面孔、后梳深色头发、突出眉弓、尖耳与猩红眼睛，嘴中有成排尖齿。它与C、D和B是不同生物；长臂、黑毛与红眼始终保留。0.00–2.20秒：立即从浓重橙褐烟尘中的略倾斜近中景开始，前景破碎屋脊、墙板与石块遮住画面下部，数名A的巨大无发头颅与肩胸从废墟后方逼近，后面还能看见更大的模糊肋骨轮廓。摄影机沿废墟缓慢侧移，近处残墙与碎片快速横过，远处头颅较慢移动形成尺度与parallax；蒸汽和尘流不断穿过它们面前。2.20–4.20秒：切到接近地面的斜侧宽景，整排A从画面近侧延伸到远处，宽肩、长臂与肌束胸腹从烟中显出，身体随沉重步伐交替起伏，手臂自然摆动。摄影机沿军团方向缓慢退移，前景滚动尘浪，后排继续推进，不能让军团站定摆姿势。4.20–7.20秒：硬切正面低角极宽景，A的前排头肩横贯画面下方，B的巨大中央骨架与两侧肋弓在它们后方高高耸起。镜头缓慢上仰并略微前推，烟云先遮住上部结构再被气流拨开，低悬长发面孔位于中央骨架下方。两次短促金色闪电在远后方云层中亮起，瞬间照亮肋骨边缘、云团与军团轮廓后迅速衰退，闪电不是射向士兵的攻击，也不把已有生物变成其他形态。7.20–9.60秒：切B低悬面孔的正面紧近景，巨大的弧形肋骨仍在头后形成连续背景。黑发束垂在两颊旁，尖耳向外，头部微微抬正；先保留深暗眼窝，随后两眼由暗变为清晰翠绿光，视线凝向前方。烟和小尘粒持续通过镜头，不让脸冻结，不添加对白或眼部光束。9.60–11.60秒：以烟雾中的硬切转入另一片城内街区，低角正面中全景，C从灰褐尘幕中向前迈步显露，双拳低垂，胸腹与肩背随步伐运动，两侧较小塔楼和红瓦屋顶明确显示巨人尺度。镜头略向前接近，翠绿眼光透过黑发可见，两只浅灰硬化拳和前臂同时保持清晰；这不是B缩小成人形，也不复制出第二个C。11.60–12.40秒：突切向上仰拍的云天，一具蜷曲的巨大人形轮廓处于金色分叉闪电和近圆形发光蒸汽团中央，身体向下坠近，一臂抬过头侧，一膝收起。电弧沿周围空气和身体轮廓分叉，强光短暂压暗背景。只展示这个有实体身体的空中电光片段，不插入小人长大或从C体内分裂出的过程。12.40–13.20秒：切城内贴石街的倾斜低机位，远处房屋之间D已处于落地后的低蹲，石块和瓦片被震起，贴地尘浪沿街涌向镜头；落地位置与尘浪源点一致。高墙和红瓦屋顶上方可见一艘遥远的浅色长椭圆飞 entries.translated_prompt: All biological entities, facial close-ups, architecture, and backgrounds are unified as obviously computer-generated high-quality AAA fantasy game cutscenes, using digitally sculpted face models, artist-designed material lighting/shadows, and bundled hair. No live-action actors, no 2D animation, cel-shading, or standard gameplay visuals. The overall structure is an apocalyptic fantasy war montage connected by continuous hard cuts: a giant legion advancing, a skeletal creature far exceeding the legion's scale revealed, two giants briefly engaging in melee combat within the city, and finally cutting to another ape-like giant charging up a roar; different creatures maintain their distinct identities, do not make these cuts a continuous transformation of the same character. Environment and Colors: A dense medieval half-timbered city, reddish-brown tile roofs, dark brown wooden beams, light beige walls, narrow stone streets, chimneys, pointed towers, and high outer stone walls; all ordinary houses, streets, and towers are much smaller than the giants, fighters' waists/chests are higher than nearby roofs, the giant legion is taller, and the distant skeletal creature exceeds the entire legion. Heavy gray-brown smoke clouds and orange-gold backlighting cover the city, floating dust, broken tiles, and steam form multi-layered depth; the beginning has heavy scorched-brown dust fog, the middle has city ruins illuminated by warm gold skies, and the end has huge circular golden backlighting and swirling clouds, maintaining the same apocalyptic warm gold color scheme. A Giant Legion: Multiple rows of hairless super-giant adult male humanoid creatures, broad shoulders and thick chests, deep red muscle bundles and pale ivory tendons, deeply sunken eye sockets and clear teeth, rib cage and shoulder/chest surfaces have continuous sculpted tissue; this is the creature's complete original appearance, not fresh wounds, no bleeding. They are bare-handed, without clothing/armor, arranged with real depth front-to-back, slight differences in head/shoulders and stride, continuously moving slowly in the same direction, steam rising around their bodies, dust waves kicked up by their feet, not static audiences or repeated paste of the same person. B Skeletal Megastructure: Behind the legion there is only one non-human skeletal lifeform vastly larger than them, a tall light brown ivory central spine, numerous long slender arc-shaped ribs expanding outward and curving downward on both sides, like a huge skeletal dome covering the sky above the legion, with real gaps between rib arches, not wings or buildings. entries.title: Ultra-Realistic Chinese Cooking Video Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a 30-second cinematic cooking video of spicy-and-sour fish, including specific timestamps for preparation, cooking, and plating.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic cooking video of a skilled Chinese chef preparing spicy-and-sour fish in a professional kitchen. The chef wears a clean white chef uniform. Fast, precise cooking movements, realistic food textures, authentic fire, steam and oil physics, natural human motion, cinematic food photography. No text, logos, subtitles, or watermarks.

[0–4s] — FISH PREPARATION
The chef firmly holds a fresh whole fish on a wooden cutting board. With fast, controlled knife movements, the chef removes the head and smoothly follows the spine, separating the fish into clean fillets. Realistic knife sounds and subtle moisture details.

[4–8s] — THIN SLICING
The fillet is placed flat on the board. The chef rapidly slices it into extremely thin, delicate pieces with precise wrist movements. The translucent slices fall naturally one after another, revealing detailed fish texture and moisture.

[8–11s] — SEASONING
The fish slices are transferred into a bowl and coated with spices and a light marinade. The chef quickly tosses and mixes them until every piece is evenly coated with a smooth, glossy layer.

A heavy iron wok heats over a strong blue-orange flame. Oil begins to shimmer. Pickled mustard greens, pickled chilies, garlic, and spices are thrown into the wok. They immediately sizzle as the chef rapidly tosses the ingredients, filling the scene with realistic steam and aromatic heat.

[15–20s] — COOKING THE FISH
Rich stock is poured into the wok and reaches a vigorous boil. The chef carefully adds the delicate fish slices and controls the wok with quick, precise movements, keeping the fish intact. A light starch slurry is added while the wok is rotated in smooth arcs, creating a silky, glossy sauce that coats every slice.

[20–24s] — PLATING
The cooked fish is carefully transferred into a deep serving dish. White fish slices settle among golden pickled vegetables and red chilies. The glossy sauce flows naturally around the fish while steam rises from the hot dish.

[24–27s] — HOT OIL FINISH
Fresh minced garlic and dried red chilies are arranged on top. The chef pours scorching hot oil over them. A powerful, realistic sizzling reaction erupts, sending fragrant steam upward as the toppings bloom in the hot oil.

[27–30s] — FINAL HERO SHOT
The camera slowly pushes toward the finished dish. Tender white fish, golden pickled vegetables, bright red chilies, glossy sauce, fresh garlic, and swirling steam fill the frame. End on an irresistible macro close-up of the bubbling, freshly cooked spicy-and-sour fish.

Ultra-realistic food cinematography, photorealistic chef, authentic Chinese cooking technique, realistic knife handling, detailed fish texture, natural steam and fire, physically accurate oil movement, cinematic depth of field, subtle handheld camera movement, warm professional kitchen lighting, macro food details, high dynamic range, 4K, premium food commercial quality.

She smiles, pats his head, puts the stick down and picks up the same shopping bag again.

She continues walking home, smiling as a light breeze moves her hair and leaves around the street.

She reaches her wooden front door, turns toward the camera and says softly:

"Small help brightens the day."

She walks inside and the camera cuts to black.

Camera: Raw handheld early-2000s DV camcorder, shaky footage, autofocus hunting, faded warm colors, exposure shifts, motion blur, soft digital detail, accidental zooms. No polished cinematography.

Audio: Natural Seoul neighborhood ambience, birds, children in the distance, bicycles, footsteps, plastic bag rustling, wind and distant traffic. Clear Korean voices. No music.

Continuity: No disappearing or duplicated objects. Exactly one clear shopping bag, always in her left hand, it stays with the woman except when she sets it down to free the kite, then she picks up the same bag again. The kite stays with the boy after being handed over. The stick stays in her hand until she puts it down. Exactly one grandmother and three children. Smooth realistic movements and transitions.

entries.title: Autumn Fashion Film Transition Prompt for Seedance 2.5

entries.prompt:
Using the supplied first frame as the exact opening image, create a 20-second horizontal 4:3 ultra-photorealistic autumn fashion film.

CORE CONCEPT

Yuna Bell remains lying on the same rug beneath a continuously rotating walnut ceiling fan.

The fixed overhead camera never moves.

Every time one fan blade physically sweeps across Yuna’s body, her outfit changes seamlessly into the next established autumn look. The blade is the only transition device.

The effect must resemble an expertly planned practical in-camera fashion transition, not a magical body transformation.

IDENTITY LOCK

Preserve Yuna’s exact:
- Face
- Eye shape
- Beauty mark
- Skin tone
- Hair color
- Hair length
- Body proportions
- Hand structure
- Age impression

Her body remains in the same location and orientation throughout the video.

Only these elements may change during fan-blade transitions:
- Clothing
- Shoes
- Handbag
- Jewelry
- Minor editorial pose details

Do not morph her face or body.

CAMERA LOCK

- Fixed 90-degree overhead camera
- Horizontal 4:3
- No cuts
- No camera movement
- No zoom
- No rotation
- No reframing
- No focus breathing
- No angle changes
- No slow motion
- Real-time fan rotation

FAN CONTINUITY

Use one three-blade walnut ceiling fan rotating clockwise at a constant moderate speed.

The fan must:
- Preserve the same blade shape and wood texture
- Maintain a fixed central axis
- Rotate at constant speed
- Cast a consistent moving shadow
- Pass between the camera and Yuna
- Create exactly three complete wardrobe transitions

Each transition occurs only behind the passing blade. The new clothing is revealed progressively at the blade’s trailing edge.

No dissolve, flash, smoke, particles, digital glitch or body morphing.

0.0–3.5 SECONDS — LOOK 1

Continue directly from the first frame.

Yuna lies in LOOK 1.

She presses the small wooden remote once with her right thumb.

She makes subtle editorial movements:
- Turns her chin slightly toward camera-right
- Extends her left wrist
- Straightens her right leg
- Gives a restrained half-smile
- Returns her eyes directly to the camera

Her cinnamon leather jacket creases naturally beneath her shoulders.
Her breathing creates a subtle rise and fall in her torso.

The fan continues rotating overhead.

3.5–5.0 SECONDS — TRANSITION TO LOOK 2

The first broad walnut blade enters from the lower-left and sweeps clockwise across Yuna’s body.

As the blade crosses:
- LOOK 1 disappears only within the area hidden by the blade
- LOOK 2 is revealed immediately behind the trailing edge
- Her face, body, hair and physical position remain unchanged

Reveal LOOK 2:
- Oatmeal cable-knit sweater
- Green-and-cream checked pleated skirt
- Chocolate tights
- Burgundy loafers
- Cream socks
- Dark green top-handle bag
- Gold necklace

The burgundy bag from LOOK 1 becomes the dark green bag only while fully covered by the same blade sweep.

No accessory may remain duplicated.

5.0–8.0 SECONDS — LOOK 2

Yuna now wears LOOK 2 completely.

She changes pose naturally:
- Brings both hands lightly together over her waist
- Bends both knees slightly
- Tilts her head toward camera-left
- Smooths the edge of the pleated skirt with two fingers
- Maintains direct upward eye contact

The cable-knit sweater compresses realistically against the rug.
The skirt pleats spread naturally around her hips.

The fan shadow moves consistently over her face and clothing.

8.0–9.5 SECONDS — TRANSITION TO LOOK 3

A second fan blade sweeps across the frame from upper-left toward lower-right as part of the same clockwise rotation.

Behind the blade, reveal LOOK 3:
- Muted plum asymmetric knit top
- Oversized charcoal wool blazer
- Taupe wide-leg trousers
- Pointed black ankle boots
- Oxblood rectangular handbag
- Sculptural gold earrings

The pleated skirt and tights disappear only under blade occlusion.
The wide-leg trousers emerge with correct continuity around both legs.

Yuna’s legs, knees and feet remain in the same anatomical positions.

9.5–13.0 SECONDS — LOOK 3

Yuna performs a more structured editorial pose:

- Extends her left leg
- Bends her right knee outward slightly
- Places her left hand on the blazer lapel
- Moves her right hand beside the oxblood bag
- Turns her face back toward the camera
- Gives a composed, serious expression

The blazer spreads naturally over the rug.
The wide trousers retain realistic folds and fabric weight.
The handbag stays beside her right hip.

No item floats or slides without contact.

13.0–14.5 SECONDS — TRANSITION TO LOOK 4

The third walnut fan blade passes over Yuna from lower-right toward upper-left.

Reveal LOOK 4 behind its trailing edge:
- Moss-green fitted cardigan
- Chocolate satin camisole
- Espresso leather midi skirt
- Charcoal socks
- Burgundy heeled loafers
- Cherry-red handbag
- Narrow charcoal headband
- Gold index-finger ring

The charcoal blazer, trousers, boots and oxblood bag disappear completely beneath the blade before the new items appear.

Hair remains the same length and arrangement except for the charcoal headband being added during full blade occlusion.

14.5–18.0 SECONDS — LOOK 4

Yuna now wears LOOK 4 completely.

She performs the final pose adjustment:
- Extends both legs diagonally toward camera-right
- Crosses her ankles
- Places the cherry-red handbag beside her left waist
- Raises her right hand near her collarbone
- Places her left arm above her head
- Turns her chin slightly toward camera-left
- Returns her eyes directly to the camera

She gives a very subtle confident smile.

The leather skirt shows restrained natural highlights.
The satin camisole responds softly to her breathing.
The cardigan fibers remain visible.

18.0–20.0 SECONDS — FINAL HOLD

Yuna becomes completely still in LOOK 4.

Only the following continue moving:
- Natural breathing
- One or two loose hair strands
- Rotating ceiling fan
- Soft moving fan shadow
- Subtle sunlight variation

The fan completes another partial rotation but does not trigger an additional outfit change.

End with Yuna looking directly upward, framed symmetrically on the autumn rug.

Hold the final image for the last half-second.

MOTION QUALITY

- Real-time movement only
- Subtle editorial posing
- Natural joint movement
- Accurate finger anatomy
- Realistic breathing
- Physically correct fabric compression
- Consistent fan speed
- Stable room geometry
- No sliding body
- No changing body scale
- No sudden pose teleportation

FASHION MATERIAL QUALITY

Render materials distinctly:

- Cable knit: visible yarn and soft thickness
- Leather jacket: matte grain and natural creases
- Wool blazer: dense soft texture
- Satin camisole: controlled highlights
- Leather skirt: structured weight and subtle reflection
- Tights: opaque woven appearance
- Handbags: firm construction and believable straps
- Shoes: stable shape, soles and closures

LIGHTING AND COLOR

Maintain consistent late-afternoon sunlight throughout.

Color palette:
- Walnut brown
- Burnt sienna
- Burgundy
- Moss green
- Charcoal
- Oatmeal
- Muted plum

Use premium but natural autumn color grading.
Preserve real skin tone.
No extreme orange cast or crushed shadows.

AUDIO

Use subtle realistic apartment sound:
- Quiet ceiling-fan motor
- Soft blade movement through air
- Remote-button click
- Gentle clothing rustle
- Low room ambience

Optional minimal original ambient fashion soundtrack at very low volume.

No dialogue.
No narration.
No transition sound effects.
No camera shutter sounds.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS

No cuts, camera movement, zoom, camera rotation, angle change, morphing face, changing body, identity drift, changing hair length, duplicated clothing, overlapping outfits, extra shoes, duplicated handbags, disappearing limbs, extra fingers, warped hands, broken legs, floating accessories, sliding props, unstable rug pattern, changing floorboards, fan changing shape, fan changing direction, inconsistent fan speed, blade passing t

entries.title: Japanese Park Size Change Action

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second photorealistic cinematic action short on a bright summer day in a Japanese park. A young adult Japanese woman wearing a school-style uniform moves through a surreal size-changing adventure. Realistic physics, high-speed movement, seamless scale transitions, dynamic camera work, natural sunlight, detailed environments, cinematic 4K. No text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

[0–5s] — THE JUMP
She crouches confidently on a thick tree branch in a sunny park, focused and fearless. Without hesitation, she jumps forward. The camera dives rapidly alongside her as she falls toward a picnic table below.

[5–9s] — THE SIZE SHIFT
Just before landing on the picnic table, her body suddenly shrinks to the size of a soda can. The tabletop transforms into a gigantic landscape filled with oversized sandwiches, fruit, chips, and drinks. She immediately starts running between the giant food items.

[9–13s] — THE BEE
A bee suddenly races past her like a speeding vehicle. She jumps onto its back and grabs onto its body. During the movement, another seamless scale transition makes her roughly the same size as the bee. The bee rapidly takes flight.

[13–18s] — HIGH-SPEED FLIGHT
The bee weaves through the park at incredible speed. She holds tightly onto its back as they race between pedestrians' legs. Giant shoes hit the ground around them like moving obstacles. Strong wind blows her hair and clothing backward while the camera tracks them at ground level.

[18–22s] — WATER BALLOON CHAOS
They fly through a group of children having a water-balloon fight. Time suddenly shifts into dramatic slow motion. Water balloons burst around her, with thousands of sparkling droplets suspended in the sunlight. She looks both nervous and thrilled as the bee narrowly avoids the explosions.

[22–25s] — HUMAN TUNNEL

She jumps from the bee. While falling, her body rapidly expands back to normal human size in one seamless visual transition. A young adult male student nearby opens his arms and catches her safely.

[27–30s] — FINAL MOMENT
Both are now normal-sized. She briefly hugs him, then turns toward the camera with a playful smile and a quick wink. He looks surprised and delighted. Freeze briefly on the charming final frame.

entries.title: Hakka no Togame Ice Effect Video

Duration: 20s (2×10s)
Format: 16:9 | 24fps
Style: Ultra-photorealistic live-action Japanese supernatural action, premium Hollywood cinematography, grounded realism, physically believable ice effects, cinematic blue-hour atmosphere.

CONTINUITY LOCK

- Fusia = exact same identity throughout.
- Fully manifested Bankai from Scene 1 onward.
- Same abandoned hydroelectric maintenance station.
- Same Fusia–Boncoz spatial axis.
- Direct continuity between both scenes.
- Boncoz remains colossal (3–4× human height).

BANKAI LOCK

- Hakka no Togame = environmental temperature collapse.
- No beams, projectiles, energy waves, teleportation, or magical auras.
- Ice spreads physically through water, concrete, metal, moss, and machinery.
- Real crystalline material behavior only.

SCENE 1 — ENVIRONMENTAL FREEZE

Fusia faces Boncoz across the abandoned maintenance yard and calmly declares, "Bankai... Hakka no Togame." Temperature rapidly collapses. Water crystallizes, puddles freeze, pipes and machinery gather frost, and ice spreads naturally through connected surfaces. A ground-level freezing front races across the yard toward Boncoz. The colossal creature struggles as thick crystalline ice climbs over his feet, legs, torso, shoulders, and arms. Final frame: Boncoz remains standing, fully encased in ice except for his exposed head, while Fusia stands composed in fully manifested Bankai.

SCENE 2 — GOD SPEED FINISHING SLASH

Continue directly from Scene 1. Fusia locks eyes on Boncoz, tightens her grip on the crystalline katana, and drops into a launch stance. God Speed activates through one explosive acceleration burst, carrying her instantly across the battlefield. Upon reaching Boncoz, time shifts into cinematic slow motion as she delivers a full-body finishing slash through the frozen giant. Massive fractures erupt through the existing ice shell and spread across his colossal body. Fusia finishes in a low stance as cracks multiply. The fracture network reaches Boncoz's exposed head, freezing it completely. A final catastrophic fracture tears through the entire frozen structure and Boncoz explodes into countless crystalline ice shards while Fusia remains motionless amid the falling debris.

AUDIO

No music. Cold wind, dripping water, ice crystallization, cracking frost, Boncoz's struggle, God Speed acceleration, impact shockwave, ice fracture, and shattering debris.

NEGATIVE

anime, cartoon, game graphics, glossy CGI, plastic skin, AI faces, energy beams, magical projectiles, teleportation, shrinking scale, repeated freezing, frozen poses, daylight, dead frames, unnecessary pauses.

entries.title: Early 2000s Home Video Seoul
entries.description: A hyper-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring a Korean woman visiting a neighborhood restaurant in Seoul.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home-video of a young Korean woman stopping at a small neighborhood Korean restaurant during a quiet morning in Seoul.

MAIN SUBJECT

Young Korean woman, 24 years old, naturally attractive with realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, expressive dark-brown eyes and long dark hair worn loosely down.

Preserve her exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, body proportions and appearance throughout the entire video.

OUTFIT

Replace the maroon hoodie with a cozy casual early-2000s outfit:

soft cream cable-knit cardigan
muted dusty-blue fitted T-shirt underneath
loose dark-brown straight-leg trousers
worn white canvas sneakers
small dark-brown canvas shoulder bag
simple silver wristwatch

Her clothing should look ordinary, comfortable and naturally lived-in rather than styled for a fashion shoot.

LOCATION — SMALL KOREAN RESTAURANT

A tiny family-run Korean restaurant tucked into an older residential neighborhood in Seoul.

The restaurant feels authentic and modest rather than trendy.

Outside are an aged Korean signboard, slightly faded menu posters, a small standing menu board, plastic beverage crates, potted plants, an old bicycle leaning against the wall and a glass entrance door covered with a few small Korean stickers.

Inside, show glimpses of:

compact wooden tables
metal chopstick containers
stainless-steel cups
tissue boxes
condiment bottles
handwritten Korean menu sheets
an old wall clock
small refrigerator filled with drinks
steaming pots behind the counter
an older Korean woman preparing food

Warm steam occasionally drifts from the kitchen.

The restaurant should feel like a genuine neighborhood place that local residents have visited for years.

LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE

Quiet early morning in Seoul.

Soft overcast daylight outside has a cool blue-gray tone, while the restaurant interior glows with warm yellow fluorescent and tungsten light.

This creates a cozy contrast between the cool street and warm restaurant.

Muted colors, slightly underexposed shadows, soft highlights and imperfect white balance.

A gentle breeze moves her loose hair and cardigan when she is outside.

The atmosphere is peaceful, nostalgic, comfortable and slightly sleepy.

CAMERA STYLE

Ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video, filmed casually by another person accompanying her.

Completely candid and unstaged.

Natural handheld operation with:

subtle hand shake
imperfect framing
occasional crooked composition
gentle accidental reframing
slight autofocus hunting
small exposure adjustments
imperfect automatic white balance
faded MiniDV colors
soft contrast
mild highlight blooming
authentic DV compression
subtle digital noise
slight microphone hiss
occasional autofocus breathing

No stabilization. No cinematic gimbal movement. No modern commercial color grading.

Motion remains fluid and natural at normal real-time speed.

00:00–00:03 — ARRIVING

The camcorder follows slightly behind her as she approaches the tiny neighborhood restaurant.

She notices the faded menu displayed beside the entrance and slows down.

She leans slightly toward it, reading the Korean dishes.

A little steam escapes when another customer opens the restaurant door.

She smiles and quietly says:

WOMAN:
“아… 배고프다.”

She lightly touches her stomach and looks through the restaurant window.
00:03–00:06 — LOOKING AT THE MENU

She steps closer to the handwritten menu board.

Her canvas bag slips slightly down her shoulder while she reads.

She casually pushes it back up without looking.

The person filming asks from behind the camcorder:

CAMERA PERSON:
“뭐 먹을래?”

Without turning around, she continues studying the menu.

WOMAN:
“잠깐만…”

She points at one item with her finger.
00:06–00:09 — INSIDE

Natural handheld cut as she pushes open the glass restaurant door.

A small bell above the door jingles.
The warm restaurant interior contrasts with the cool morning outside.

An older woman behind the counter looks up.

RESTAURANT OWNER:
“어서 오세요.”

The young woman gives a small polite bow.

WOMAN:
“안녕하세요.”

She walks toward an empty table.

00:09–00:12 — THE LITTLE ACCIDENT

She sits at the small wooden table and begins removing her shoulder bag.

Without noticing, her elbow lightly bumps the stainless-steel chopstick container.
It tilts.

She reacts quickly and catches it with both hands just before it falls over.

Her eyes widen for a second.
She freezes.

Then she slowly looks directly toward the camcorder.

The person filming quietly laughs.

CAMERA PERSON:
“야…”

She immediately starts laughing too.

WOMAN:
“안 떨어졌잖아.”

Her expression is playfully defensive and slightly embarrassed.

00:12–00:15 — FOOD ARRIVES

A steaming bowl of kimchi-jjigae is placed in front of her with rice and several small banchan dishes.

Steam rises naturally toward her face.

Her embarrassed expression immediately changes into a delighted smile.

She leans slightly toward the bowl and inhales the aroma.

WOMAN:
“와… 맛있겠다.”
She picks up her metal spoon, then briefly looks toward the camcorder with an excited little smile.

The camera accidentally drifts downward toward the steaming stew before casually reframing her face.

End naturally as she begins eating.
AUDIO

Natural location audio only.

Include:

soft neighborhood traffic, distant bicycle bell, footsteps, restaurant door bell, quiet Korean conversation in the background, kitchen utensils, bubbling stew, plates touching tables, metal chopsticks, refrigerator hum, ventilation fan, chair movement, fabric rustling and subtle MiniDV microphone hiss.

No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects.

MOTION & REALISM

All movement must remain continuous, physically believable and real-time.

The cardigan, hair and shoulder bag should have realistic secondary motion.

Steam from the food should rise irregularly and naturally.
When she accidentally knocks the chopstick container, it should only tilt slightly and she should realistically catch it—no exaggerated slapstick reaction.

Her expressions should transition naturally:

sleepy curiosity → hunger → concentration → surprise → embarrassment → laughter → excitement when the food arrives.

The humor should come from an extremely ordinary human moment rather than staged comedy.

IMPORTANT

The video should feel like someone found an old MiniDV tape from a casual morning in Seoul around 2003–2005.

Do not make the restaurant luxurious, modern, minimalist or Instagram-style.

Avoid perfect compositions, dramatic cinematic lighting, beauty filters, overly clean skin, exaggerated acting, artificial slow motion, speed ramps, frame skipping, duplicated frames, stop-motion movement or excessive motion blur.

The final glance at the camcorder should feel spontaneous and familiar, as though she is comfortable with the person filming her.

The vintage appearance must come from realistic MiniDV camera behavior, autofocus, automatic exposure, white-balance imperfections, compression and casual handheld operation, not from choppy or artificially degraded motion.

She steps closer to the handwritten menu board.

Her canvas bag slips slightly down her shoulder while she reads.

She casually pushes it back up without looking.

The person filming asks from behind the camcorder:

Without turning around, she continues studying the menu.

WOMAN:

00:06–00:09 — INSIDE

Natural handheld cut as she pushes open the glass restaurant door.

An older woman behind the counter looks up.

00:09–00:12 — THE LITTLE ACCIDENT

She sits at the small wooden table and begins removing her shoulder bag.

Without noticing, her elbow lightly bumps the stainless-steel chopstick container.
It tilts.

She reacts quickly and catches it with both hands just before it falls over.

Her eyes widen for a second.
She freezes.

Then she slowly looks directly toward the camcorder.

The person filming quietly laughs.

"Hey..."

She immediately starts laughing too.

"See, it didn't fall."

Her expression is playfully defensive and slightly embarrassed.

A steaming bowl of kimchi-jjigae is placed in front of her with rice and several small banchan dishes.

Steam rises naturally toward her face.

Her embarrassed expression immediately changes into a delighted smile.

She leans slightly toward the bowl and inhales the aroma.

"Wow... it looks delicious."
She picks up her metal spoon, then briefly looks toward the camcorder with an excited little smile.

The camera accidentally drifts downward toward the steaming stew before casually reframing her face.

End naturally as she begins eating.
AUDIO

Natural location audio only.

soft neighborhood traffic, distant bicycle bell, footsteps, restaurant door bell, quiet Korean conversation in the background, kitchen utensils, bubbling stew, plates touching tables, metal chopsticks, refrigerator hum, ventilation fan, chair movement, fabric rustling and subtle MiniDV microphone hiss.

MOTION & REALISM

All movement must remain continuous, physically believable and real-time.

The cardigan, hair and shoulder bag should have realistic secondary motion.

Steam from the food should rise irregularly and naturally.
When she accidentally knocks the chopstick container, it should only tilt slightly and she should realistically catch it—no exaggerated slapstick reaction.

Her expressions should transition naturally:

sleepy curiosity → hunger → concentration → surprise → embarrassment → laughter → excitement when the food arrives.

The humor should come from an extremely ordinary human moment rather than staged comedy.

The video should feel like someone found an old MiniDV tape from a casual morning in Seoul around 2003–2005.

entries.title: Volcanic popcorn eruption scene
entries.description: A highly detailed video prompt involving a woman dropping a bag of popcorn kernels into a volcano, resulting in a massive popcorn explosion. Requires character reference and storyboard.
entries.prompt:
Create a 17-second ultra-realistic cinematic vertical video featuring the woman from the provided character reference.

Use the newly provided female character reference as the ONLY identity reference for the main character. Do NOT use the face or identity of the woman visible in the storyboard.

Use the provided 13-panel Master Storyboard as the exact visual, chronological and action guide for the entire video.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:
Preserve the exact facial identity of the provided woman throughout the entire video, including her facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, long dark hair, body proportions and recognizable appearance.

Her identity must remain unchanged in every shot.

Keep the character visually consistent from beginning to end. No face drift, no identity change, no hairstyle transformation and no replacement character.

The wardrobe should be adapted naturally for the volcanic adventure while maintaining a believable, consistent outfit throughout the sequence.

IMPORTANT:
The Master Storyboard controls the scenes, actions, camera progression, timing and visual composition.
The provided character reference controls ONLY the identity and appearance of the main woman.

Do not copy the storyboard woman's face.

STORY AND ACTION:

SHOT 1 — 0:00–0:02
Begin with the woman holding an enormous transparent bag completely filled with unpopped popcorn kernels near the edge of a massive volcanic crater.

Use a close-to-medium cinematic perspective showing her, the giant popcorn bag and the glowing crater in the background.

She looks toward the crater with curious anticipation.

SHOT 2 — 0:02–0:03
Move closer as she looks down toward the crater.

Her expression changes slightly as she watches the glowing lava below.

The giant popcorn bag remains firmly in her hands.

SHOT 3 — 0:03–0:04
She releases the giant popcorn bag.

The transparent bag begins falling downward into the crater.

Use a dynamic camera movement following the falling bag.

Keep the bag physically consistent and clearly visible.

SHOT 4 — 0:04–0:05
The bag hangs above the glowing lava crater.

Use a dramatic overhead perspective looking down into the circular volcanic formation.

The bag continues descending naturally under gravity.

The glowing lava illuminates the transparent plastic and popcorn kernels.

SHOT 5 — 0:05–0:06
The bag falls closer toward the lava.

Increase the sense of speed while maintaining realistic gravity and physical motion.

The camera follows the bag toward the center of the crater.

SHOT 6 — 0:06–0:08
The crater suddenly erupts.

A powerful vertical volcanic burst rises from the center.

The popcorn bag is caught in the eruption.

Use a dramatic wide overhead shot showing the full scale of the crater.

SHOT 7 — 0:08–0:09
The eruption transforms into an enormous explosion of freshly popped popcorn.

Thousands of realistic popcorn pieces burst upward and outward.

Use a fast cinematic camera push into the popcorn cloud.

Each popcorn piece should have believable individual motion.

SHOT 8 — 0:09–0:10
The popcorn explosion fills the frame and transitions into the interior of a small vehicle or cabin.

Popcorn rushes through the space and begins accumulating everywhere.

Use strong forward motion as the popcorn wave moves toward the camera.

SHOT 9 — 0:10–0:12
The cabin rapidly fills with popcorn.

Popcorn rises from the floor and piles naturally around the seats and interior surfaces.

The volume increases continuously until the woman is surrounded.

Do not make the popcorn appear instantaneously.

SHOT 10 — 0:12–0:14
The camera pushes through the popcorn toward the woman.

She is partially buried in the enormous pile, with her upper body and face clearly visible.

She looks toward the camera and begins laughing.

Popcorn moves naturally around her shoulders and arms.

SHOT 11 — 0:14–0:15
Close-up of the woman emerging from the popcorn.

She smiles directly toward the camera.

A few popcorn pieces rest naturally in her hair and on her shoulders.

Warm orange volcanic light illuminates her face.

SHOT 12 — 0:15–0:16
She gathers a large handful of popcorn with both hands.

She brings it toward her mouth with a playful, delighted expression.

Keep the popcorn pieces physically consistent and naturally positioned.

SHOT 13 — 0:16–0:17
Extreme close-up final moment.

She happily eats the popcorn while looking toward the camera.

She smiles playfully with popcorn around her.

End on her satisfied expression.

CAMERA:
Use motivated cinematic camera movement throughout:
handheld close-ups, overhead crater shots, dynamic tracking, dramatic push-ins, macro popcorn details and an intimate final close-up.

Use subtle speed changes only where they enhance the eruption and popcorn explosion.

PHYSICS:
Realistic gravity.
Realistic falling motion.
Realistic volcanic eruption dynamics.
Realistic popcorn expansion and flight.
Realistic popcorn accumulation and weight.
Realistic interaction between the woman and the popcorn.

No teleportation.
No duplicated objects.
No floating elements without support.

AUDIO:
Natural environmental sounds:
volcanic rumbling,
lava glow ambience,
popcorn kernels shaking inside the bag,
eruption roar,
popcorn explosion crackling,
popcorn filling the cabin,
woman laughing softly,
popcorn crunching when eaten.

No music unless requested.
No dialogue except laughter and natural vocal reactions.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic cinematic quality.
High detail textures.
Physically accurate lighting.
Volcanic glow reflections on skin and popcorn.
Shallow depth of field during close-ups.
Strong contrast between dark volcanic rock and bright lava glow.
Warm color grading with orange highlights and deep shadows.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic documentary sequence depicting the construction of the Great Pyramid of Giza, as if the footage was secretly captured on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder. The entire video should feel like authentic recovered historical footage—not a polished modern film.

0–5s — Establishing Shot
Handheld DV-camera footage opens on the enormous Giza construction site at sunrise. Hundreds of workers move across a vast sandy landscape while the unfinished pyramid dominates the background. Wooden scaffolding, ramps, ropes, sledges, stone blocks, dust and activity fill the frame. The camera operator walks closer through the construction site. Workers strain together to pull a massive limestone block along a wooden sled while others shout instructions and coordinate the ropes. Sand kicks up around their feet. The camera briefly struggles to focus as people pass directly in front of the lens, making the footage feel spontaneous and unscripted.

10–16s — The Construction Process
A closer handheld shot reveals workers hauling enormous stone blocks up a massive earthen ramp toward the rising pyramid. Wooden rollers, ropes, crude tools and temporary structures surround them. 16–22s — Human Moment
The footage moves into a crowded work area. A group of workers pauses briefly beside a freshly positioned limestone block, breathing heavily and covered in dust. One worker looks directly into the camera for a moment before returning to work. Behind him, dozens of others continue the construction, creating a powerful sense of scale and human effort.

The camera slowly backs away and rises slightly, revealing the immense pyramid under construction, surrounded by thousands of workers, ramps and organized building activity. Golden sunlight cuts through airborne dust, creating natural volumetric rays. The unfinished structure feels monumental and almost overwhelming.

27–30s — Documentary Ending
The camera turns toward the pyramid’s upper levels as workers continue moving stones against the glowing sky. The operator lowers the camera slightly; the image becomes shaky and briefly overexposed by the sun. End abruptly like an authentic recovered DV recording.

entries.title: Shibuya Dragon Fantasy Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a fantasy video set in Shibuya crossing featuring a woman summoning a dragon, with specific instructions on lighting, camera, and sound.
entries.prompt:
Shibuya arrival→orb in her palm→red rain on the city→the black dragon rises.

Character: a young East Asian woman with delicate, soft features, fair skin, natural makeup with red lips and a calm, aloof expression; long straight silver white hair to her waist; spiked black armor with layered black and crimson spikes on the pauldrons, and clawed black and crimson gauntlets on both hands; a long deep crimson cape; thigh high black armored boots; a long, slender dark crimson sword in her right hand. No horns and no wings. Keep the same face, armor and sword throughout.

Camera language (global rule): anamorphic widescreen lenses, horizontal flares, oval bokeh, shallow depth of field, fine film grain. It is a real physical camera with many low and upward angles, and it shakes with every explosion, shockwave or roar.

Light system (global rule): every shot of the piece, including the close ups and the shots of the sky, is the same golden hour: a low sun between the buildings, an orange pink sunset sky, thin dust in the air with visible light beams, warm gold highlights and cool blue grey shadows, with contrast clearly stronger than ordinary daylight. There is no blue sky and no grey overcast sky anywhere in the piece. The only red in frame comes from her and what she summons: the core of the vortex, her eyes, the orb, the falling red streaks, and the dragon's eyes and mane. The explosions are real orange yellow fire and rolling black smoke.

Brightness (global rule): the opening crossing is a bright golden hour. Both vortex shots, close and overhead, are clearly darker than the opening, but the city around them stays readable. The burst in the sky and the 2 fireballs that fill the frame are the brightest moments, clearly brighter than any other frame. It ends in bright golden hour.

Sound (global rule): the first 2 seconds of shot 4 are the quietest moment of the piece, only a little wind. The burst in the sky is a boom that makes the image tremble, each explosion is louder than the last, and the dragon's roar is loudest of all.

Shot 1 (00:00 to 00:03): a high overhead wide shot of the Shibuya scramble crossing in Tokyo, the sun in frame between 2 distant buildings throwing a horizontal flare, a dense crowd crossing. From the first frame, a plume of smoke as black as ink rises from the exact center of the crossing, darker than anything around it, spinning and growing taller. The crowd keeps walking, then stops, looks up and backs away, while the smoke becomes a vortex column taller than the buildings on either side, with a dark red glow at its core. Sound: crowd and traffic, a low rumble growing louder.

Shot 2 (00:03 to 00:05): cut to a close shot of the vortex, the camera near the ground pushing toward it. Rolling black smoke fills most of the frame, swirling like a tunnel, with orange red fire only in a small core at its very center, the crossing's buildings still visible at both edges. She walks out of that fire core as a black silhouette, only the edges of her armor rimmed in red, walking toward the camera as it pushes toward her, until it frames only her legs, boots and the dark crimson sword dragging along the ground, her cape rolling behind her. Sound: the roar of the vortex, heavy footsteps, the blade scraping the ground.

Shot 3 (00:05 to 00:07): cut to an eye level side medium shot at the crossing. Behind her, out of focus, stand the Shibuya buildings covered in colorful signs and giant screens under the sunset. She stands on the zebra stripes, wind blowing her hair and cape sideways, the black and red vortex behind her several times taller than she is, the distant crowd stopped and staring. The camera slides slowly sideways. Sound: wind, the crowd's murmur dying away.

Shot 4 (00:07 to 00:12): cut to a low angle close shot from her chest up, behind her the orange pink sunset sky and a tall Shibuya building with a big sign, the camera pushing in very slowly. Calm, she slowly raises her clawed left gauntlet, palm up. Her eyes light up red, and above her palm an orb forms and grows: a ball of spinning black smoke, pitch black at its center like a black hole, wrapped in crackling red lightning. It is not glass or crystal and has no shiny surface. Its red light turns half her face red while the other half stays in shadow. Sound: near silence, then a rising energy hum and crackle.

Shot 5 (00:12 to 00:14): cut to an over the shoulder view from behind her hand, her glowing red claws and the orb in the foreground, the crossing behind. The orb shoots into the sky and the camera whips up after it with heavy motion blur, chasing a dark crimson spike shaped trail up between the high rises into the orange pink sunset, until it shrinks to a red dot. Sound: a sharp whoosh.

Shot 6 (00:14 to 00:17): cut to a view straight up between 2 skyscrapers into the orange pink sunset sky. The red dot bursts, and red light spreads across half the sky, wider than the whole crossing; it rolls into a black cloud full of red embers, which bursts outward into thousands of red streaks, like a giant upside down firework, falling on the whole city. Sound: the deep boom, then the hiss of countless falling streaks.

Shot 7 (00:17 to 00:18): cut to a wide angle camera low on the road, on an avenue lined with parked black taxis under the sunset. The first red streak hits the road only a few car lengths from the camera and its fireball instantly climbs to half the frame; more streaks slam down behind it, merging into a wall of fire several times taller than the taxis, and a fireball rolls in and swallows the frame. Sound: a chain of explosions, each closer than the last.

Shot 8 (00:18 to 00:20): cut to another street, a black sedan in the foreground and rubble all over the road. More red streaks crash down along the street, explosions push closer, lift the car and send it tumbling toward the camera, and a last fireball fills the whole frame. Sound: explosions, tumbling metal, debris landing.

Shot 9 (00:20 to 00:22): cut to a shot looking straight down from directly above the crossing, the cars below no bigger than matchboxes. Fires and wreckage everywhere; a giant black and red vortex covers the whole intersection and slowly turns, debris and smoke spiraling inward toward a point of red light at its center. Sound: a deep spinning rumble.

Shot 10 (00:22 to 00:25): cut to a camera low on the ground. In the background the crossing's buildings, signs and screens stand clearly readable against the sunset, and this shot is at least as bright as the overhead shot. Dark red smoke rolls along the ground, the road splits, and a huge creature's back rises out of it, black scales with glowing red cracks like cooling lava, silhouetted against the sunset, first taller than a car, then taller than the buildings, until it fills the frame. Sound: the ground cracking, a low growl.

Shot 11 (00:25 to 00:30): cut to a low angle wide shot of the crossing, fires burning in the foreground, buildings and giant screens on both sides, the orange pink sunset behind. A black Eastern dragon rises out of the vortex, head held high: a long serpentine body, black scales, a pair of swept back horns, a dark crimson mane and dorsal fins, glowing red eyes. Its head is bigger than a bus, and reared up it stands taller than the buildings. It roars at the camera, shaking it, coils once above the crossing and surges into the sky, trailing a red streak of motion blur; by 00:28 it is already high above the buildings, and by 00:29 it is only a small shape in the clouds. Sound: a deafening roar, strong wind, fading away.

Frame requirements: realistic cinematic look, 21:9 widescreen, clean hard cuts between shots. Crowd, cars and buildings are at real scale; explosions and smoke follow real physics. She and the dragon stay the same throughout, the dragon's body contin
