光照系统（全局规则）：整个视频中的每一个镜头，包括特写和天空的镜头，都是相同的黄金时刻：建筑物之间的低太阳，橙粉色的日落天空，空气中漂浮着薄薄的灰尘，可见光束，温暖的高光与冷调的蓝灰色阴影形成对比，对比度明显强于普通日光。视频中任何地方都没有蓝天或灰色的阴天。画面中唯一的红色来自她和她召唤的东西：漩涡的核心、她的眼睛、能量球、落下的红色条纹，以及龙的眼睛和鬃毛。爆炸是真实的橙黄色火焰和滚滚黑烟。

亮度（全局规则）：开场的十字路口是明亮的黄金时刻。两个漩涡镜头（近景和俯视）明显比开场更暗，但周围的城市仍然清晰可读。天空中的爆发和充满画面的两个火球是最亮的时刻，明显比其他任何帧都亮。结尾回到明亮的黄金时刻。

声音（全局规则）：第4个镜头的前2秒是整个视频中最安静的时刻，只有微风声。天空中的爆发是一声让图像颤抖的巨响，每次爆炸都比上一次更响亮，龙的咆哮声最大。

镜头1（00:00 - 00:03）：东京涩谷全向十字路口的俯拍广角镜头，太阳在远处两栋建筑之间入画，投射出水平眩光，密集的人群正在穿过路口。从第一帧开始，一股像墨水一样漆黑的烟柱从十字路口的正中心升起，比周围任何东西都黑，旋转并变得更高。人群继续行走，然后停下，抬头看并后退，与此同时，烟雾变成一根比两侧建筑物还要高的漩涡柱，核心处有暗红色的光芒。声音：人群和交通噪音，低沉的轰鸣声逐渐变大。

镜头2（00:03 - 00:05）：切到漩涡的近景，摄像机贴近地面推向它。滚滚黑烟占据了大部分画面，像隧道一样旋转，只有在最中心的小核心处有橙红色的火焰，十字路口的建筑物在边缘依然可见。她作为一个黑色剪影从火核中走出来，只有盔甲的边缘镶着红光，向着推近的摄像机走来，直到画面只框住她的腿、靴子和拖在地上的深红色剑，斗篷在她身后翻滚。声音：漩涡的咆哮，沉重的脚步声，刀刃刮擦地面的声音。

镜头3（00:05 - 00:07）：切到十字路口齐眼高度的侧面中景。在她身后，失焦的是覆盖着彩色招牌和巨型屏幕的涩谷建筑，处于夕阳之下。她站在斑马线上，风吹动她的头发和斗篷向一侧飘动，身后的黑红漩涡比她高出数倍，远处的人群停下来注视。摄像机缓慢横向滑动。声音：风声，人群的嘈杂声逐渐消失。

镜头4（00:07 - 00:12）：切到从胸部以上拍摄的低角度特写，身后是橙粉色的日落天空和一栋带有大招牌的涩谷高楼，摄像机非常缓慢地推进。她平静地慢慢抬起戴爪状护手的左手，掌心向上。她的眼睛亮起红光，手掌上方形成一个能量球并长大：一个旋转的黑烟球，中心像黑洞一样漆黑，包裹着噼啪作响的红色闪电。它不是玻璃或水晶，也没有闪亮的表面。它的红光将她的半张脸染红，另一半保持在阴影中。声音：近乎寂静，然后是上升的能量嗡嗡声和噼啪声。

镜头5（00:12 - 00:14）：切到从她手后方的过肩视角，前景是她发光的红色爪子和能量球，背景是十字路口。能量球射向天空，摄像机带着强烈的运动模糊向上甩动，追踪一道深红色的尖刺状轨迹，穿过高楼之间进入橙粉色的日落，直到缩小成一个红点。声音：尖锐的呼啸声。

镜头6（00:14 - 00:17）：切到透过两栋摩天大楼之间直视橙粉色日落天空的视角。红点爆发，红光蔓延到半个天空，比整个十字路口还宽；它卷曲成充满红色余烬的黑云，向外爆发出成千上万的红色条纹，像一个巨大的倒置烟花，落在整个城市上。声音：深沉的巨响，然后是无数落下条纹的嘶嘶声。

镜头7（00:17 - 00:18）：切到位于道路低处的广角摄像机，在夕阳下排列着黑色出租车的街道上。第一道红色条纹击中距离摄像机仅几辆车远的道路，其火球瞬间攀升至画面的一半；更多条纹在其后方砸下，合并成一堵比出租车高数倍的火墙，一个火球滚入并吞噬了整个画面。声音：一连串爆炸，每一次都比前一次更近。

镜头8（00:18 - 00:20）：切到另一条街道，前景是一辆黑色轿车，道路上满是瓦砾。更多红色条纹沿着街道坠落，爆炸逼近，掀起汽车并将其翻滚着推向摄像机，最后一个火球填满了整个画面。声音：爆炸声，金属翻滚声，碎片落地声。

镜头9（00:20 - 00:22）：切到从十字路口正上方垂直向下看的镜头，下面的汽车小如火柴盒。到处是火灾和残骸；一个巨大的黑红漩涡覆盖了整个交叉口并缓慢旋转，碎片和烟雾螺旋向内，朝向中心的一个红点。声音：深沉的旋转轰鸣声。

镜头10（00:22 - 00:25）：切到低地面的摄像机。背景中，十字路口的建筑、招牌和屏幕在夕阳下清晰可读，这个镜头至少和俯拍镜头一样亮。深红色的烟雾沿地面滚动，路面裂开，一只巨大生物的背部从中升起，黑色的鳞片上有像冷却熔岩一样的发光红色裂缝，在夕阳下呈现剪影，起初比汽车高，然后比建筑物高，直到填满画面。声音：地面开裂声，低沉的吼叫。

镜头11（00:25 - 00:30）：切到十字路口的低角度广角镜头，前景燃烧着火焰，两侧是建筑和巨型屏幕，背后是橙粉色的日落。一条黑色的东方龙从漩涡中升起，头高昂：长长的蛇形身体，黑色鳞片，一对向后掠的角，深红色的鬃毛和背鳍，发光的红眼睛。它的头比公共汽车还大，直立起来时比建筑物还高。它对着摄像机咆哮，震动了摄像机，在十字路口上空盘旋一圈后冲入天空，留下一道红色运动模糊的轨迹；到00:28时它已经在建筑物上方很高处，到00:29时它在云中只是一个小小的形状。声音：震耳欲聋的咆哮，强风，逐渐消失。

画面要求：逼真的电影外观，21:9宽屏，镜头间干净硬切。人群、汽车和建筑物处于真实比例；爆炸和烟雾遵循真实物理规律。她和龙在整个过程中保持一致，龙的身体连

entries.title: Dragon Rider Dark Fantasy Epic
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 30-second epic dark fantasy cinematic sequence featuring a warrior riding a dragon through a storm towards a burning kingdom.
entries.prompt:
Style: Epic dark fantasy, ultra-realistic cinematic live-action, massive scale, dramatic storm atmosphere, realistic dragon anatomy, detailed armor, glowing embers, volumetric lightning, powerful orchestral tension.

0–5 SEC — STORM AWAKENING
A violent nighttime storm fills the sky. Lightning tears through enormous black clouds as a gigantic ancient charcoal-scaled dragon suddenly emerges from the darkness. An armored warrior rides on its back, their cloak violently whipping in the wind. Lightning flashes behind them, creating a powerful heroic silhouette.

5–10 SEC — THROUGH THE STORM
The dragon dives at incredible speed between towering storm clouds. Heavy rain strikes the camera as lightning illuminates its enormous wings. Close-up of the warrior gripping glowing ancient reins, their eyes reflecting blue lightning. Each powerful wingbeat creates shockwaves that tear through the clouds.

10–15 SEC — THE BURNING KINGDOM
The dragon breaks through the clouds, revealing a devastated medieval kingdom below. Towers collapse into burning streets, fire spreads across rooftops, and thick smoke covers the horizon. The dragon circles above the ruined city and releases a terrifying roar.

15–20 SEC — FINAL DESCENT
The dragon folds its wings and dives toward the burning city. Arrows and flaming projectiles rise from below. The warrior draws a legendary sword glowing with intense blue energy, illuminating their armor and the dragon's scales. Lightning strikes behind them as they descend through rain and fire.

20–25 SEC — THE CHARGE
The dragon spreads its wings and races toward the massive burning city gate. Smoke, sparks and debris explode around them. The warrior leans forward with the glowing sword raised, while the dragon accelerates directly toward the gate.

25–30 SEC — LEGENDARY ARRIVAL
The dragon smashes through the burning gate in a massive explosion of fire, stone and debris. Suddenly everything becomes quiet. The warrior stands beside the dragon among the ruins, overlooking the burning kingdom. Lightning illuminates their silhouettes as embers slowly drift through the darkness. The dragon gives one final powerful roar as the camera pulls back into a vast cinematic aerial shot.

Visual quality: Ultra-photorealistic, cinematic lighting, realistic fire, rain, smoke and debris, detailed creature textures, natural movement, dramatic camera work, seamless continuity, powerful Hollywood dark-fantasy atmosphere.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Gym Vlog Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 30-second handheld camcorder-style gym vlog featuring a Korean idol attempting a personal record, with specific camera instructions, character descriptions, and shot-by-shot breakdown.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA/LOOK: DV 16mm tape camcorder, handheld POV by CHASE; sometimes propped on mirror/rack. Shaky framing, imperfect focus/zoom, occasional face cut-offs. Soft blurry tape texture, faint noise, bloomed gym lights, flickering exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin, gradually increasing sweat. Camcorder never visible.

STYLE: Playful gym vlog → steadily building tension → focused PR attempt → triumphant release. Quick handheld cuts, music audible throughout.

CHASE: Korean idol in her 20s, long black high ponytail, glowing skin, expressive eyes, slim athletic build. Modest new matching long-sleeve workout set, sneakers, towel around neck, no jewelry.

SETTING: Early-evening gym, mirror wall, bench press, barbell, phone/speaker, water bottle, soft overhead lighting.

30s / 12 CUTS:

1. 3s: Mirror, propped camera. Pose/excited: “Okay guys, new gym fit. Check it out!”
2. 2.5s: Close outfit check, tugging sleeve/hem: “So comfy, and the color is perfect.”
3. 2.5s: Warmup with phone: “Playlist is locked in. This one always gets me going.”
4. 2s: Playful dance/stretch, laughing; music only.
5. 2.5s: Sets camera near bench, eyes heavier plate: “Okay... today’s the day I try a new PR.”
6. 2s: Macro of hands loading heavy plate; metal clink.
7. 2.5s: Close face, nervous/focused: “Okay. Okay. Deep breath.”
8. 2.5s: Side angle, lies down and grips bar; music fades, breathing louder.
9. 3s: Unracks, slow controlled descent, hard press upward: “Come on—come on—”
10. 2s: Racks bar, sits up stunned; heavy breathing.
11. 2.5s: Huge grin, covers mouth: “Wait—I actually did it!”
12. 3s: Sweaty arm’s-length selfie, triumphant fist: “New PR! Okay, best gym fit ever. See you guys!”

entries.title: TV Drama Argument Scene Prompt
entries.description: A complex prompt for generating a 15-second continuous TV drama scene involving an argument between two characters, focusing on spatial continuity and emotional progression.
entries.prompt:
15s, 9:16 vertical, photorealistic premium American TV drama. Use Image 1 and Image 2 as sequential references for continuous action. Keep the same two adults, faces, hair, proportions, clothing and apartment.

An American couple argues intensely at night. He thinks his joke was harmless; she feels humiliated. Keep the argument fast, emotional and natural. Use only the dialogue below.

[0–3s] Start from Image 1. Medium two-shot. She sits on the sofa:
“Seriously? That was your idea of funny?”
He replies: “Oh, come on. It was a joke.”

[3–5s] She stands naturally and moves into the open living room:
“You embarrassed me!”
He immediately replies: “I didn’t mean—”

[5–7s] Continue seamlessly into the positions shown in Image 2. No cut or jump. Medium-wide two-shot. They face each other.
She: “You never do!”
He: “So now I can’t joke around?”

[7–10s] Naturally transition into medium shot-reverse-shot. Hold on him:
“Making this a huge deal?”
Cut to her matching medium shot:
“You think this is about the joke?”
She continues: “It’s about you not caring how I feel.”
Keep eyelines consistent.

[10–12.5s] Return to a medium two-shot. She says:
“You still don’t get it!”
As she speaks, she walks directly past the man toward the entrance behind him. She does not turn around first. Let her finish the line while walking.

[12.5–15s] She reaches the door behind him, opens it, storms out and slams it hard. He stays in place, turns his head and follows her with his eyes. After the door closes, hold briefly on his medium shot, his anger shifting to shock and disbelief.

Cinematic handheld camera with natural transitions. No extreme close-ups. Preserve the apartment layout, 180-degree rule and spatial continuity. The entrance door is directly behind the man.

Natural acting and realistic movement. No added dialogue, repeated turning, touching, pushing, chasing, sudden repositioning, teleportation, duplication, face or clothing changes, exaggerated acting, subtitles, text, music or extra people.

entries.title: Monday Work Performance Art
entries.description: A surreal fashion editorial video prompt featuring a seesaw dunking performance, generated with Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
A cinematic indoor performance-art / fashion editorial video, shot in a single continuous take inside a slightly worn historic room with cracked plaster walls, dark wood floors, a vintage wooden bed with rumpled beige linens, beige curtains over a tall window, and a soft abstract pink painting on the wall.

A large custom-built pale mint-green wooden seesaw / dunk-lever structure (thick beams, metal bolts, industrial-craft aesthetic) spans the room. On the high end, a woman hangs completely upside-down, knees hooked over the beam, wearing a short beige-and-black horizontal-striped dress. An off-camera operator slowly pumps the opposite end of the lever, tilting the beam so her head and hair repeatedly dunk into the water then lift out, water streaming from her hair and the cloth. entries.title: Heartwarming Family Scene Prompt
entries.description: A prompt for a heartwarming cinematic 3D animated scene of a father and daughter playing hide-and-seek in a living room.
entries.prompt:
Create a heartwarming cinematic 3D animated scene in a warm, cozy family living room during golden hour. A cute toddler girl with curly light-brown hair, wearing a simple white sleeveless dress and white socks, stands shyly behind a sheer white curtain near a large sunlit window. She looks playful and curious, gently peeking through the curtain.

Cut to her young father, a handsome brown-haired man wearing a light beige button-up shirt with rolled sleeves and blue jeans, sitting in the living room. He suddenly notices his little daughter and looks surprised and concerned. He quickly gets up from the sofa, moves around it, and searches for her with expressive facial reactions.

The father walks toward the bright window and suddenly spots the little girl. His expression changes from worry to pure happiness. He smiles warmly, reaches toward her, gently picks her up in his arms, and lifts her slightly into the air.

The little girl laughs joyfully with her eyes closed while her father looks at her lovingly. He hugs her close and spins gently in place. End with a beautiful wide shot of the father holding his laughing daughter in front of the glowing window, warm sunlight streaming through the curtains, soft lens flare, peaceful family atmosphere.

Style: high-quality cinematic 3D animation, expressive Pixar-inspired character animation, adorable child expressions, realistic fabric and hair movement, detailed cozy living-room environment, warm golden-hour lighting, soft volumetric sunlight, shallow depth of field, smooth natural character motion, emotional storytelling, polished animated-film quality, cinematic composition, 4K detail.

Camera: start with a close-up of the toddler behind the curtain, slowly push in, cut to a medium shot of the father noticing her, follow his movement with smooth tracking shots, use expressive close-ups for his facial reactions, then transition to a gentle handheld-style push-in as he picks her up, finishing with a wide cinematic shot.

No text, no subtitles, no watermark, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no duplicate characters, consistent character identity throughout.

entries.title: Cyberpunk Tactical Infiltration Prompt

entries.prompt:
Create ultra-cinematic cyberpunk tactical infiltration sequence, shot like a high-budget futuristic action film. Photorealistic humans, realistic anatomy and movement, detailed tactical gear, neon cyan/crimson lighting, volumetric rain, wet reflections, atmospheric fog, realistic physics, anamorphic cinematography, shallow depth of field, dynamic camera movement, seamless transitions. 00:00–00:03 — A vast futuristic metropolis at night, heavy rain and neon skyscrapers disappearing into mist. A female operative in a sleek wet black tactical suit and hood surveys the city. Extreme close-up of her eyes reflecting neon lights. Her male teammate checks a rugged holographic tactical tablet.

00:03–00:07 — The team attaches to a futuristic drone-deployed rappelling cable and descends a massive glass skyscraper. Dynamic aerial and low-angle tracking shots, rain streaking across reflective glass. They land silently on a balcony.

00:16–00:20 — A futuristic elevator descends into the secure facility. Red emergency lighting pulses. Doors open to reveal the three-person squad in black tactical gear. Low-angle hero shot as they step out in synchronized formation.

00:20–00:24 — The female operative extracts the brilliant blue energy core from its holographic containment field. Blue light illuminates her face and armor. She locks it inside a sophisticated metallic energy case with a mechanical click.

00:24–00:28 — Alarms erupt. Red lights flash as the squad sprints through a glass corridor and leaps from the skyscraper. Mechanical bat-like glider wings deploy from their tactical suits with realistic articulated movement. They transition from freefall into controlled flight above the neon metropolis. Camera pulls far back as the squad disappears into the storm carrying the glowing energy core.

entries.title: Korean University Vlog Early 2000s
entries.description: A prompt for generating a realistic early-2000s style vlog of a day at a Korean university, emphasizing period accuracy and camera realism.
entries.prompt:
A 30-second ultra-realistic personal Korean university morning vlog set in South Korea around 2003, filmed entirely on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder. The SAME young Korean female student must remain perfectly consistent in face, hair, body proportions, outfit, accessories and backpack throughout.

0–5s — GET READY: In a modest early-2000s Korean bedroom, she fixes her hair, gets dressed, grabs her backpack and gives the camera a small sleepy smile. Include period-accurate books, magazines, stationery and furniture.

5–10s — WALK TO UNIVERSITY: She walks through an authentic early-2000s Korean neighborhood with older cars, buses, shops, utility poles and pedestrians, occasionally glancing at the camera.

10–16s — CAMPUS + CLASSROOM: She enters an early-2000s Korean university, walks into class, sits down, takes out her notebook and pens while a professor teaches and students take notes.

16–22s — CAFETERIA: After class, she gets a simple Korean lunch in a busy university cafeteria, sits down, takes a bite and smiles naturally.

22–30s — FRIENDS: She meets 2–3 Korean university friends and walks with them across campus toward the street, laughing and chatting. End with them continuing down the sidewalk.

STYLE: Genuine raw early-2000s DV footage—handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, soft digital detail, mild CCD/DV noise, motion blur, compression and occasional awkward zooms. Natural skin texture and candid behavior.

Everything must be authentically early 2000s: clothing, hairstyles, cars, buildings, signs, stationery, technology and interiors. No smartphones, modern laptops, AirPods, modern cars, LED lighting, 4K sharpness, cinematic camera movement, beauty filters, VHS effects or modern influencer styling.

CONTINUITY: GET READY → KOREAN STREET → UNIVERSITY GATE → CLASSROOM → CAFETERIA → WALK WITH FRIENDS. No teleporting, outfit changes, identity drift, duplicated people, warped hands or disappearing props.

entries.prompt:
Using the supplied first frame as the exact opening image, generate a 30-second horizontal 4:3 photorealistic lifestyle influencer vlog.

VIDEO CONCEPT

A realistic “Day in My Life” vlog following Mara through a relaxed sunny day in New York City:

1. Morning introduction at home
2. Quick green smoothie in the kitchen
3. Getting dressed to leave
4. Walking through the city
5. Browsing a clothing store
6. Meeting Elise at a café
7. Walking and relaxing together in a sunny park
8. Casual selfie sign-off

The video must feel spontaneous and personal, combining front-facing smartphone selfies, handheld point-of-view details and a few believable third-person shots recorded by a friend.

IDENTITY CONTINUITY

Mara must preserve:
- Same face
- Same hazel-green eyes
- Same freckles
- Same long chestnut hair
- Same body proportions
- Same grey T-shirt
- Same jeans
- Same jewelry

She adds the black leather jacket, sneakers and tan shoulder bag before leaving the apartment. They must not appear before she physically puts them on.

Elise appears only during the café and park scenes.

No identity changes, face replacement or spontaneous outfit transformation.

CAMERA RULES

Use three clearly motivated camera perspectives:

1. Mara’s front-facing handheld smartphone camera
2. Mara’s rear-camera point-of-view detail shots
3. Short third-person shots filmed by Elise or made with a phone placed on a stable surface

Every camera change must have a logical reason.

Transitions should use:
- Mara’s palm briefly covering the lens
- Refrigerator door passing across the camera
- Jacket fabric crossing the frame
- A yellow taxi or pedestrian passing close to the lens
- Shopping bag passing across the camera
- A controlled whip pan following Mara’s movement

Do not teleport between locations without a visible transition.

0.0–3.5 SECONDS — MORNING SELFIE INTRODUCTION

Continue directly from the first frame.

Mara holds the phone at arm’s length and says naturally:

“Good morning. I thought I’d bring you along today.”

She smiles, shifts her weight and brushes one strand of hair away from her face.

The camera moves slightly with her breathing and wrist position.
Her eyes look primarily into the lens, occasionally checking the phone screen.

She begins walking toward the kitchen while keeping the selfie camera on herself.

3.5–6.5 SECONDS — KITCHEN SMOOTHIE

Mara turns the camera toward a bright compact kitchen.

Use three quick but coherent shots:
- Hand placing spinach, banana and frozen mango into a blender
- Close-up of pale green smoothie pouring into one transparent glass
- Selfie shot of Mara raising the finished drink beside her face

The kitchen has:
- White cabinets
- Pale stone counter
- Stainless-steel faucet
- Bowl of fruit
- Bright window light
- Ordinary small appliances

Mara takes one real sip, swallows and gives a small approving nod.

She says:

“Quick breakfast, then I’m heading downtown.”

No food or glass duplication.

6.5–9.0 SECONDS — GETTING READY

Mara places the phone on the entrance bench, creating a stable waist-height third-person shot.

She enters the frame and:
- Puts on her black leather jacket
- Slides the tan shoulder bag over her right shoulder
- Checks that her keys are inside
- Picks up the phone

She reaches toward the lens. Her jacket sleeve fills the frame and creates a natural transition.

9.0–12.5 SECONDS — CITY STREET SELFIE

Reveal Mara walking along a real Manhattan neighborhood sidewalk in bright afternoon sunlight.

Environment:
- Red-brick apartment buildings
- Ground-floor cafés and small shops
- Parked cars
- One yellow taxi passing in the street
- Trees with fresh green leaves
- Ordinary pedestrians
- Realistic crosswalk and traffic lights

Mara holds the phone slightly below eye level and walks at a comfortable pace.

She says:

“The weather is way too nice to stay inside.”

Her hair moves naturally in the breeze. Sunlight changes subtly as she passes beneath tree shade.

Keep her gait stable and avoid excessive selfie-camera bouncing.

12.5–16.0 SECONDS — CLOTHING STORE

A yellow taxi passes close behind Mara and creates a color-wipe transition into a bright contemporary clothing store.

Mara films herself browsing a rack of neutral-colored shirts and lightweight summer jackets.

Use:
- Over-the-shoulder shot of her hand sliding hangers
- Mirror shot showing her full outdoor outfit
- Close-up as she holds a pale blue shirt against herself
- Brief amused expression when she notices the camera in the mirror

She carries only one tan shoulder bag.

At the end, show her leaving with one small kraft-paper shopping bag.

Do not generate readable brand names or price labels.

16.0–19.5 SECONDS — WALKING TO THE CAFÉ

Use a third-person sidewalk shot filmed from approximately four meters ahead.

Mara walks toward the camera carrying the small shopping bag. She takes out her phone, checks a message and smiles.

A foreground pedestrian crosses naturally from right to left, creating a brief visual wipe.

Cut to Mara opening the door of a warm neighborhood café.

Movement direction remains continuous.

19.5–23.0 SECONDS — CAFÉ WITH ELISE

Inside the café, Elise sits at a small wooden table near a window.

Mara approaches and gives her a brief natural hug.

Use a combination of:
- Stable two-shot from a phone placed on the table
- Close-up of two coffee cups arriving
- Overhead shot of Mara’s shopping bag beside the chair
- Short close-up of both women laughing

Elise asks:

“So, was the shopping successful?”

Mara glances toward the paper bag and replies:

“More successful than planned.”

Their laughter should feel spontaneous and slightly imperfect.

23.0–26.5 SECONDS — SUNNY PARK WALK

Mara lifts the kraft-paper bag briefly past the lens, creating a soft brown wipe transition.

Reveal Mara and Elise walking through a large sunny city park.

Environment:
- Green lawn
- Mature trees
- Paved walking path
- People sitting on blankets in the distance
- Joggers and cyclists remaining far behind
- Partial city skyline visible through the trees
- Warm late-afternoon sunlight

Elise films Mara for a short third-person shot as Mara walks backward, laughs and gestures toward the park.

Cut to Mara’s selfie camera as Elise enters beside her.

26.5–30.0 SECONDS — FRIENDSHIP MOMENT AND SIGN-OFF

Mara turns toward Elise and they share a quick warm hug.

Keep the phone in Mara’s extended right hand. The camera naturally shifts closer during the hug but does not become fully blocked.

They separate and sit side by side on a park bench.

Mara looks into the camera and says:

“Honestly, this was exactly the kind of day I needed.”

Elise smiles and waves once.

Mara reaches her hand toward the lens. Her palm fills the frame naturally and ends the video.

Hold no artificial freeze frame.

PERFORMANCE DIRECTION

Mara’s delivery should feel conversational rather than scripted.

Include:
- Natural pauses
- Small breaths
- Occasional glances at the screen
- Slightly imperfect hand gestures
- Real blinking
- Brief laughter
- Subtle changes in walking speed
- Hair adjustments caused by wind

Avoid exaggerated influencer expressions, constant wide smiles or overly polished advertising behavior.

CAMERA AND EDITING QUALITY

- Realistic smartphone dynamic range
- Slight handheld movement
- Smooth stabilization without floating-camera behavior
- Consistent left-right screen direction
- Natural autofocus adjustments
- Brief realistic exposure adaptation when moving indoors or outdoors
- Cuts motivated by gestures and foreground wipes
- No random viewpoint changes
- No impossible camera positions
- No excessive lens flare
- No slow motion
- No speed ramping

LIGHTING AND COLOR

Use bright, natural late-spring daylight.

Apartment:
Soft neutral morning window light.

Street:
Clear sunlight with moving tree shadows.

Store and café:
Balanced practica

entries.title: Office Stealth Game Video Prompt
entries.description: A complex prompt simulating a stealth game mechanic in an office setting, including HUD elements, detection meters, and scripted events for Jessica reaching her desk.
entries.prompt:
SETTING & CAMERA
One continuous modern American office: entrance → security desk → badge gate → glass corridor → open office → whiteboard aisle → Jessica’s desk. Morning light, hard floors, realistic office furniture. A white PTZ security camera is already mounted above/right of her desk and must remain there throughout.

0–25.5s: continuous third-person tracking, usually 1.5m behind Jessica’s right shoulder. Realistic follow-lag, whip-pans to threats, no hidden cuts or teleportation.
25.5s: hard cut to fixed frontal medium close-up showing Jessica, her desk, and the PTZ camera.

HUD: Minimap bottom-left; STAMINA/COMPOSURE top-left; DETECTION top-center; SPRINT/CROUCH/INTERACT/SLIDE bottom-right. Opening: “LATE — 12 MIN” / “OBJECTIVE: REACH YOUR DESK UNDETECTED.”

0–7s — SECURITY GUARD

Jessica sprints through the entrance with her bag. The guard notices her. She hides behind a large planter instead of confronting him, dropping low as he approaches with his radio. Detection rises 58% → 91%. When he looks away, she quietly slips out, badges through the gate, and continues. The guard notices the closing gate but does not chase. Detection falls to 34%.

7–13s — HR CART

HR pushes a tall cart loaded with folders toward Jessica. She accidentally brushes the glass, then quickly crouches behind the cart and moves with it, staying hidden as HR checks both sides. She circles behind the cart when HR looks away, then breaks cover and runs once the corridor is clear. HR never clearly sees her. Detection peaks at 96%, then drops to 40%.

13–18s — DEPARTMENT HEAD DISCOVERY

The department head appears at a T-junction and notices Jessica's reflection through the glass. He turns toward her. A large solid-red “!” flashes exactly twice above him. Only afterward, DETECTION turns red: “ALERT.” He calls, “Hey! Hold on!” Jessica turns and says, “Oh, crap!” He follows her route.

18–23.5s — WHITEBOARD ESCAPE

Jessica races through the open-office aisle, grabs a wheeled whiteboard, and pulls it diagonally across his path. He brakes before hitting it and immediately circles around. Jessica squeezes through the remaining gap between the whiteboard and desk using a low side-slide, keeping her bag tight to her body, then immediately gets up and runs. He remains behind her.

23.5–25.5s — FALSE SUCCESS

Jessica reaches her desk, drops into the chair, puts the bag underneath, and starts typing while catching her breath. The department head searches the rear aisle but cannot see her. DETECTION falls to 0%. Green “MISSION COMPLETE” appears. Jessica smiles with relief.

25.5–30s — CCTV TWIST

At 26.2s, the pre-installed PTZ camera physically whirs, pans and tilts toward Jessica, then its red indicator illuminates. She slowly looks up toward it and freezes. Remove “MISSION COMPLETE.” Show “CCTV DETECTED”, followed by red “MISSION FAILED.” She mutters, “You've got to be kidding me.”

entries.title: University Friends Selfie Video
entries.description: Detailed prompt for a playful selfie video of two university friends making funny faces, referencing specific images and video styles.
entries.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A playful vertical selfie video of two second-year Japanese female university students, best friends, both bubbly and full of energy, in the empty tiered lecture hall of the university they both attend, shown in <<<image_3>>>, after the last class of the day. Recreate the rhythm of the hand-sweep gag from <<<video_1>>>: the video is built on deliberate contrast in three parts. (1) It opens with both girls dead serious, like an ID photo. (2) Then the hands sweep across the front girl's face about five times per second, and at every single pass she appears with a completely different exaggerated expression, flickering by rapid-fire — it starts with silly funny faces and builds into a fierce angry face. (3) In the final second, the act collapses and both friends burst into laughter together.

ACTIVE REFERENCES / REFERENCE USAGE
<<<image_1>>> defines the front character's identity, hair and complete outfit: bleached honey-blonde choppy short hair with dark roots at the parting and wispy bangs, two small kelly-green snap hair clips, white cropped ribbed T-shirt, open cobalt-blue zip-up track jacket with two white stripes down each sleeve, small silver hoop earrings. No hat.
<<<image_2>>> defines the rear character's identity, hair and complete outfit: glossy straight black chin-length bob with blunt bangs, white T-shirt, bright kelly-green chunky ribbed knit cardigan with dark buttons and long sleeves, black wide-leg trousers. No hair clip. The blonde girl's green hair clips match her best friend's green cardigan, and both wear plain white T-shirts, the way close best friends do.
Use the large facial portrait on each sheet for facial identity. Take only their faces, hair and clothing from the sheets; do not inherit the grey background, the flat lighting or the three-view layout.
<<<image_3>>> defines the lecture hall: rows of long light-oak desks with grey fabric seats rising in steps behind them, a stairway aisle on the left, pale cream walls, a wooden double door at the top back, tall windows with pale vertical blinds on screen-right with green campus trees in warm sunlight outside, flat white ceiling lights. Adapt its viewing angle to the selfie camera.
<<<video_1>>> controls only the hand choreography, the sweep timing, the small head dips and the relative placement of the two people. Its performers' faces, hair, clothing, cap, room and facial expressions do not transfer. Any watermark or logo in <<<video_1>>> does not appear.

FIRST FRAME
The video begins directly through the phone's front-facing camera. <<<image_1>>> holds the phone at arm's length at about eye level, with her holding hand and the phone outside the frame. Her face and upper chest fill the lower-centre foreground. <<<image_2>>> is close behind her, slightly offset toward screen-right, her chin almost resting on <<<image_1>>>'s shoulder, relaxed and comfortable like best friends, with her face clearly visible beside <<<image_1>>>'s head. Both look into the lens with dead-serious straight faces, lips pressed together, eyes steady, like an ID photo.

WORLD AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
They sit at one of the long desks in a middle row, facing the front of the hall, <<<image_2>>> just behind and beside <<<image_1>>>; the phone camera looks back at them from the front. Behind their heads, the empty rows of desks and seats rise in steps toward the back of the hall, softly out of focus, with the bright windows and green trees toward screen-right. Keep the hall consistent with <<<image_3>>>; the tight selfie framing crops most of it. No other students anywhere in the hall.
<<<image_1>>> holds the phone throughout. <<<image_2>>> has both hands free to perform the sweeps around <<<image_1>>>'s face. Keep their front-to-back arrangement the whole time.

SHOT FORMAT
One continuous 10-second vertical 9:16 selfie take. The selfie image fills the whole vertical frame, with extra headroom above <<<image_1>>>'s head for the hand movements. No cuts, no external view of them filming.

OPTICS AND CAMERA
Natural front-camera perspective at arm's length, both faces readable. The camera stays almost stationary during the gag, with only slight natural hand drift. During the final laughter, allow a small believable wobble from <<<image_1>>>'s shaking shoulders while keeping both faces in frame. No zoom, no orbit, no reframing.

ACTION / PERFORMANCE TIMING
<<<image_2>>> reproduces the reference's rapid alternating hand sweeps from 0.75s to 9.0s, exchanging the upper and lower hand positions, with the same sweep directions and pace as <<<video_1>>>. She is an energetic girl deliberately holding a poker face: her face stays completely straight until 9.0s, with only her bright eyes showing she is holding back a laugh.
From 0.75s to 9.0s, <<<image_2>>>'s hands pass across <<<image_1>>>'s face about five times per second, every 4 to 5 frames, exactly at the pace of <<<video_1>>>. EVERY single hand pass reveals a different face: her expression changes behind each passing hand, about every 0.2 seconds, so the faces flicker by rapid-fire like a flipbook. Each face is big, clear and fully formed the instant the hand clears. Consecutive faces are opposites in mouth shape and eye opening (closed mouth then open mouth, wide eyes then shut eyes), so every reveal is a jolt.

PART 1 — SERIOUS
0.00–0.75s (frames 0–17): both girls dead serious, looking straight into the lens, not a hint of a smile. <<<image_2>>> raises one open hand above <<<image_1>>>'s head and places the other below her chin.

PART 2 — RAPID-FIRE FACES (starts with funny faces, builds into anger)
Two faces in each half second, one per hand pass, in this order:
0.75–1.25s (frames 18–29): cross-eyed with both cheeks puffed like a balloon → a huge wide-open toothy grin.
1.25–1.75s (frames 30–41): tongue stuck out to one side with one eye shut → eyes and mouth stretched wide in a shocked "O".
1.75–2.25s (frames 42–53): lips pushed far forward and twisted sideways → a wailing cry face, mouth pulled down, eyes squeezed.
2.25–2.75s (frames 54–65): lower jaw jutting out, eyes half-lidded → a sparkly idol smile with a wink.
2.75–3.25s (frames 66–77): nostrils flared, eyebrows shot up to the hairline → a sulky pout with puffed lower lip.
3.25–3.75s (frames 78–89): eyes rolled up to the ceiling, mouth hanging open → a smug, one-sided grin.
3.75–4.25s (frames 90–101): cheeks sucked in like a fish → an excited silent scream, mouth wide.
4.25–4.75s (frames 102–113): eyes closed, head drooping as if dozing → eyes popping wide, startled.
4.75–5.25s (frames 114–125): lips rolled in over the teeth → a big beaming grin.
5.25–5.75s (frames 126–137): an ugly sobbing face → a dreamy, melting bliss with eyes closed.
5.75–6.25s (frames 138–149): cross-eyed with the tongue tip touching her upper lip → nose wrinkled in disgust, "ew".
6.25–6.75s (frames 150–161): cheeks puffed tight → a sharp gasp, eyebrows high.
Now the faces turn from funny to cross, getting angrier with every pass:
6.75–7.25s (frames 162–173): a suspicious side-eye squint → a flat, unimpressed blank stare.
7.25–7.75s (frames 174–185): an exasperated eye-roll → an irritated frown, lips pressed hard.
7.75–8.25s (frames 186–197): narrowed glaring eyes → teeth clenched, a low growl face.
8.25–9.00s (frames 198–215): FULL FURY, the final and strongest face — eyes blazing wide in a fierce glare straight into the lens, eyebrows slammed down and together, nose wrinkled, teeth bared and clenched. She holds this fury through the last few hand passes, and it looks even fiercer after each one.
Negative for 0–9s: no talking, no smiling on <<<image_2>>>, no two consecutive reveals with the same face, no face changing while it is visible, no laughing before 9.0s, n

【画风】

彩色铅笔与蜡笔手绘的绘本动画，严格参考两张资产图的画风：清晰的彩铅笔触、纸张的颗粒纹理、温柔的线条。天空、海水与光线使用淡淡的水彩晕染。这是手绘动画，不是 3D、不是真人。

【Vlog 拍摄方式】

整部片子像一对情侣自己用手机拍的旅行 Vlog：自然的手持晃动、走路时轻微的上下颠簸、偶尔的镜头光晕与阳光过曝、镜头偶尔轻轻歪一下。

拿手机的那只手永远在画面之外。自拍镜头中，两人挤在画面里，举着手机的手臂伸出画面边缘；画面中绝对看不到手机、自拍杆或拿手机的手。

16:9，24fps。

【her】

5 英尺 3 英寸。棕色头发盘成蓬松的丸子头，头上斜插一支黄色铅笔，一侧别着粉色纸飞机发夹；红色圆框大眼镜，雀斑，粉红腮红。浅绿色麻花开衫，芥末黄上衣，珊瑚粉百褶裙，紫白条纹袜，红色雨靴，斜挎青绿色小布包。

【him】

5 英尺 10 英寸，比 her 高出一截，自拍时要微微弯腰才能和她挤进同一个画面。黑色蓬松小卷发，头顶翘起一根卷成圈的呆毛，耳后夹着一支黄色铅笔，鼻梁上贴着创可贴，粉红腮红。蓝白横条纹毛衣，橙色针织围巾，橄榄绿卷边长裤，一只黄袜一只蓝袜，白色帆布鞋配橙色鞋带。

【两人的手】

两人的手都是小小的圆球，没有手指。全片他们只做简单的大动作：牵手、挥手、拿着甜筒、握住车把、把围巾绕在对方脖子上、把头靠在对方肩上、额头相贴。

【场景】

一座初秋的海边小镇：彩色的老房子、石板小巷、木栈桥、灯塔、海边公路。海风一直在吹，他的围巾与卷发、她的碎发与开衫全程被风吹动。

【声音】

全片没有任何台词、对白或旁白。唯一的人声是两人的笑声。

背景音乐：温暖又带着一点感动的原声吉他与钢琴，轻轻的拍手节奏，没有人声演唱。环境声：海浪、海鸥、风声、自行车铃、脚步声。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【分镜】

0.0–2.5 | 自拍，火车车厢里 | 两人挤在车窗前的画面里，兴奋地睁大眼睛，身后的车窗外，蓝色的大海正从山坡后面出现；清晨的阳光照在两人脸上

2.5–5.0 | 跟拍，从 him 的视角 | her 在前面牵着他的手奔跑，回头冲镜头笑，拉着他沿着一条下坡的石板小巷跑向尽头闪闪发光的大海；手持画面随奔跑上下颠簸

5.0–7.5 | her 拍 him，中景 | him 站在木栈桥的尽头，海风把他的卷发和橙色围巾吹得乱飞，他害羞地朝镜头挥挥手，围巾差点被吹走，他慌忙用手按住

7.5–10.0 | him 拍 her，中景 | her 穿着红色雨靴踩进浅浅的海浪里，溅起一片水花，她张开双臂大笑；镜头因为拍摄者在笑而轻轻晃动

10.0–12.5 | 自拍，冰淇淋店门口 | 两人各拿着一个甜筒凑到镜头前，him 的那一球冰淇淋突然从甜筒上掉了下去，他一脸震惊；her 笑着把自己的甜筒递到他嘴边

12.5–15.0 | 跟拍，从后面的自行车上 | him 骑着自行车在前面，沿着海边公路前进，围巾在身后飞扬，他回过头朝镜头咧嘴一笑；右边是一望无际的蓝色大海

15.0–17.5 | 自拍，灯塔顶上 | 两人靠着灯塔顶的栏杆，身后是辽阔的海面，风大得两人都眯起了眼睛，头发被吹得乱七八糟，两人一起大笑

17.5–20.0 | 中景，海边的长椅 | 风变凉了，her 缩了缩肩膀；him 把自己的橙色围巾解下来，一圈一圈绕在她的脖子上，她低头把脸埋进围巾里，脸红了

20.0–22.5 | 固定机位，手机放在石头上 | 夕阳下，两人并肩坐在海边的悬崖草坡上，背对镜头，看着金红色的太阳沉进海里；her 慢慢把头靠在 him 的肩上

22.5–25.0 | 自拍，金色的夕阳光 | her 对着镜头微笑，然后转头去看 him——却发现他根本没有看镜头，而是一直在看着她；她愣了一下，脸一下子红了，两人都笑了

25.0–27.5 | 跟拍，从后面 | 夜晚，港口边挂满了一串串暖黄色的小灯，两人牵着手慢慢向前走，她的头上还围着他的橙色围巾，海面上倒映着灯光

27.5–30.0 | 固定机位，手机放在矮墙上 | 暖黄的小灯下，her 踮起红雨靴，him 弯下腰，两人的额头轻轻相贴，闭着眼睛笑；海风吹动橙色的围巾，远处的灯塔亮着光；画面自然收束

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【连续性】

17.5 秒之后，橙色围巾一直围在 her 的脖子上，不再回到 him 身上。

【负面提示词】

画面中出现手机，出现自拍杆，出现拿手机的手，出现第三个拍摄者；

手长出手指，手变成人手，身体比例改变；

出现台词，出现对白，旁白，唱歌，歌词，对口型，字幕，屏幕文字，Logo，水印，图片原有标签文字；

her 失去眼镜，失去丸子头，失去红雨靴；him 失去创可贴，失去呆毛，条纹颜色改变；两人身高相同；

橙色围巾在 17.5 秒后回到 him 脖子上，出现第二条围巾；

写实照片风格，真人电影质感，3D 渲染，光滑的数字绘画，失去彩铅笔触，失去纸张纹理；

稳定器般平滑的镜头，完全静止的画面（固定机位镜头除外），溶解，叠化，黑场转场，定格。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Reference Image Usage Rules]

Her appearance, hairstyle, red round glasses, clothing, and painting texture must strictly refer to Character Asset Image 1; his appearance, curly hair, bandage on nose, clothing, and painting texture must strictly refer to Character Asset Image 2.

Only extract the visual design from the asset images. Strictly prohibit generating character three-view diagrams, gray backgrounds, detail grids, color bars, dimension lines, all label text, and watermarks.

[Art Style]

Hand-drawn picture book animation with colored pencils and crayons, strictly referring to the art style of the two asset images: clear pencil strokes, paper grain texture, gentle lines. Sky, sea, and light use faint watercolor bleeding. This is hand-drawn animation, not 3D, not live-action.

[Vlog Filming Method]

The entire film looks like a travel Vlog filmed by a couple themselves with a smartphone: natural handheld shake, slight up-and-down bouncing when walking, occasional lens flare and sun overexposure, and the camera occasionally tilts slightly.

The hand holding the phone is always out of frame. In selfie shots, the two are squeezed into the frame, arms holding the phone extend out of the edge; absolutely no phones, selfie sticks, or hands holding phones visible in the frame.

16:9, 24fps.

[Her]

5 feet 3 inches. Brown hair in a fluffy bun, a yellow pencil slanted in her hair, a pink paper airplane hairpin on one side; large red round glasses, freckles, pink blush. Light green linen cardigan, mustard yellow top, coral pink pleated skirt, purple-white striped socks, red rain boots, crossbody teal small cloth bag.

[Him]

5 feet 10 inches, taller than her, must bend slightly to fit in the same frame during selfies. Black fluffy small curls, a ahoge curling into a circle on top, a yellow pencil tucked behind the ear, a bandage on the bridge of the nose, pink blush. Blue-white horizontal striped sweater, orange knitted scarf, olive green rolled-edge pants, one yellow sock one blue sock, white canvas shoes with orange laces.

[Their Hands]

Both have small round ball hands, no fingers. Throughout the film, they only do simple large movements: holding hands, waving, holding ice cream cones, gripping handlebars, wrapping scarves around each other's necks, leaning heads on shoulders, touching foreheads.

[Scene]

An early autumn seaside town: colorful old houses, cobblestone alleys, wooden boardwalks, lighthouses, coastal roads. The sea breeze is always blowing, his scarf and curls, her stray hairs and cardigan are blown by the wind throughout.

[Sound]

No dialogue, conversation, or narration in the entire film. The only human voices are their laughter.

Background music: Warm and slightly moving acoustic guitar and piano, light clapping rhythm, no vocals. Ambient sound: waves, seagulls, wind, bicycle bells, footsteps.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[Storyboard]

0.0–2.5 | Selfie, inside train car | Two people squeezed in front of the window, eyes wide with excitement, outside the window behind them, the blue sea appears from behind the hillside; morning sunlight shines on their faces

2.5–5.0 | Follow shot, from his perspective | She runs ahead holding his hand, turning back to smile at the camera, pulling him along a downhill cobblestone alley towards the sparkling sea at the end; handheld screen bounces up and down with running

5.0–7.5 | She films him, medium shot | He stands at the end of the wooden boardwalk, sea breeze blows his curls and orange scarf wildly, he shyly waves at the camera, scarf almost blown away, he hurriedly presses it down with his hand

7.5–10.0 | He films her, medium shot | She steps into shallow waves wearing red rain boots, splashing water, arms open laughing; camera shakes lightly because the shooter is laughing

10.0–12.5 | Selfie, outside ice cream shop | Each holding a cone close to the camera, his scoop suddenly falls off the cone, he looks shocked; she smiles and offers her cone to his mouth

12.5–15.0 | Follow shot, from the bicycle behind | He rides the bicycle in front, along the coastal road, scarf flying behind, he turns back and grins at the camera; endless blue sea on the right

15.0–17.5 | Selfie, top of lighthouse | Leaning against the railing at the top of the lighthouse, vast sea behind, wind so strong both squint, hair messy, both laughing together

17.5–20.0 | Medium shot, bench by the sea | Wind gets colder, she shrugs; he takes off his orange scarf, wraps it around her neck layer by layer, she buries her face in the scarf, blushes

20.0–22.5 | Fixed position, phone on stone | Under sunset, sitting side by side on cliff grass slope by the sea, backs to camera, watching golden-red sun sink into sea; she slowly rests head on his shoulder

22.5–25.0 | Selfie, golden sunset light | She smiles at camera, then turns to look at him—realizing he wasn't looking at the camera, but constantly looking at her; she freezes, blushes instantly, both laugh

25.0–27.5 | Follow shot, from behind | Night, harbor lined with strings of warm yellow lights, holding hands walking slowly forward, still wearing his orange scarf on her head, lights reflected on sea surface

27.5–30.0 | Fixed position, phone on low wall | Under warm yellow lights, she tiptoes in red rain boots, he bends down, foreheads gently touch, eyes closed smiling; sea breeze blows orange scarf, distant lighthouse lit; screen closes naturally

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[Continuity]

After 17.5 seconds, the orange scarf stays wrapped around her neck, never returning to him.

[Negative Prompt]

Phone in frame, selfie stick, hand holding phone, third person filming;

Hands growing fingers, hands becoming human hands, body proportions changing;

Dialogue, conversation, narration, singing, lyrics, lip-syncing, subtitles, screen text, Logo, watermark, original label text on image;

She loses glasses, loses bun, loses red rain boots; he loses bandage, loses ahoge, stripe color changes; same height;

Orange scarf returns to his neck after 17.5s, second scarf appears;

Realistic photo style, live-action movie quality, 3D rendering, smooth digital painting, loss of pencil strokes, loss of paper texture;

Stabilizer-smooth camera, completely static frames (except fixed position shots), dissolve, fade, black screen transition, freeze frame.

entries.title: Sports Sunglasses Commercial
entries.description: A prompt for a high-end cinematic commercial for fictional sports sunglasses. Features dynamic camera movements, weather changes, and product close-ups.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic cinematic commercial for a fictional premium sports sunglasses brand called VOLT. The film should feel like a high-end global sports campaign, combining athletic performance, stylish cinematography and dynamic camera movement.

A confident young female athlete with long dark hair wears black performance leggings, a fitted white sports top, lightweight running shoes and sleek VOLT sports sunglasses. Maintain the same woman, outfit and exact sunglasses design throughout.

She begins running along a modern city road at sunrise. Use wide shots showing her full body, front tracking shots, side tracking shots and dynamic low-angle camera movement. The sunglasses remain naturally visible without making every shot a product close-up.

She moves from the city into a mountain trail, running through changing terrain. Show wind moving through her hair and realistic sunlight reflecting from the lenses. Include brief macro shots of the sunglasses showing the lens coating, frame texture, curved design and secure fit.

The environment changes into a bright coastal road. She cycles and then runs along the waterfront under intense sunlight. The camera moves alongside her while the sunglasses protect her eyes from glare.

Suddenly, light rain begins. She continues running confidently through the wet trail. Use slow-motion shots of rain droplets hitting the sunglasses and water rolling across the lenses while maintaining clear visibility.

Finish with her stopping on a mountain overlook at golden hour. She looks toward the horizon as the camera slowly moves from her face into an extreme cinematic close-up of the sunglasses, capturing the sunset reflected across the lenses.

Voiceover throughout:
“Move faster. See clearer. Stay focused. Built for bright days, changing conditions and every challenge ahead. VOLT sports sunglasses. See the motion.”

Audio: Energetic cinematic soundtrack, realistic footsteps, wind, breathing, cycling sounds, rain and subtle lens/gear sounds. Build the music as her journey becomes more intense.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic sports cinematography, photorealistic skin and fabrics, realistic sunlight and reflections, natural athletic movement, dynamic tracking shots, shallow depth of field, slow motion, realistic rain physics, premium color grading and high-end commercial quality.

Negative: No sunglasses design changes, lens distortion, identity drift, outfit changes, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, duplicated people, unrealistic motion, excessive CGI, subtitles, captions, random text or watermark.

entries.title: Hollywood Thriller Rainy House Standoff Scene
entries.description: A 30-second video prompt for Seedance 2.5 detailing a suspenseful thriller scene in a secluded house during heavy rain, featuring a woman discovering intruders and grabbing a shotgun.
entries.prompt:
TOTAL DURATION: 30 SECONDS
STYLE: Ultra-realistic Hollywood thriller, photorealistic cinematography, natural performances, realistic physics, cinematic lighting, restrained suspense, premium production design, 35mm anamorphic look, subtle film grain, realistic depth of field.

0–4 SEC — THE WARNING

Night. Heavy rain hits the windows of a secluded modern house. A dim hallway stretches into darkness. The young woman slowly enters the frame, immediately sensing that something is wrong.

Camera: Slow handheld tracking shot behind her, subtle natural camera movement.
Audio: Rain, distant thunder, quiet breathing, faint house creaks.
Mood: Uneasy silence and anticipation.

4–8 SEC — SOMETHING MOVES

She stops. A faint movement appears at the far end of the living room. She slowly turns her head.

Lightning briefly illuminates the room, revealing several intruders partially concealed in the shadows.

Camera: Slow push-in toward her face, then rack focus from her eyes toward the silhouettes.
Performance: Controlled fear, widened eyes, shallow breathing.
Audio: Thunder suddenly rolls closer, followed by complete silence.

8–13 SEC — THE REALIZATION

The woman remains completely still. One intruder subtly shifts position.

Her eyes move toward a shotgun lying on a nearby table.

Camera: Extreme close-up of her eyes → cut to the shotgun → cut back to her face.
Lighting: A cold lightning flash briefly outlines the weapon and the surrounding darkness.
Audio: Her breathing becomes slightly louder; faint heartbeat-like bass begins.

13–19 SEC — THE WALK

She slowly begins walking toward the table.

Every footstep echoes through the quiet room. The intruders remain motionless, watching her.

Camera: Low-angle tracking shot beside her legs → slow side profile → close-up of her hand approaching the table.
Performance: Fear controlled by determination; no exaggerated movements.

19–23 SEC — THE GRAB

Her hand suddenly closes around the shotgun.

She pauses for one tense second.

The room becomes completely silent.

Camera: Extreme close-up of her hand gripping the weapon → rapid rack focus to the intruders.
Lighting: Lightning flashes across the room, revealing everyone's faces for a split second.

23–27 SEC — THE TURN

She slowly turns around and faces the intruders.

The camera moves around her shoulder, revealing the silhouettes ahead.

Nobody speaks.

Camera: Slow 180-degree cinematic arc, ending in a dramatic frontal shot.
Performance: Her expression changes from fear to controlled determination.

27–30 SEC — THE STANDOFF

Wide shot.

She stands alone in the center of the room, shotgun held defensively, while the intruders remain spread across the darkness.

A final lightning flash freezes the composition.

Camera: Extremely slow push-in toward her face.

Audio: Thunder crack → silence → single deep cinematic impact.

END ON: Her unwavering expression as the screen cuts to black.

VISUAL QUALITY: Photorealistic skin, realistic hair movem

entries.title: Mermaid Exhibit Pose Video
entries.description: A prompt for a photorealistic video of a woman posing as part of a museum mural, performing mermaid swimming motions. Details the mural content and specific choreography.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic handheld medium-wide shot inside a quiet contemporary art gallery. A large mint-green wall mural fills the frame: a painted arched aquarium window opening onto teal water. On the mural: a smiling grey beluga with an orange clownfish near its head (upper left), a large realistic grey dolphin swimming in from the right, small yellow/blue/silver fish, two penguins on the painted ledge (one standing, one diving), a small seal, and a few tropical fish on the surrounding green wall. A small white informational plaque sits on the far left of the mural.
A young woman is posed as if she is part of the mural — floating horizontally across the “water.” She wears a long straight bubblegum-pink wig with bangs, a fitted white long-sleeve top, and a sparkly pink mermaid tail with a grey ruffled waist. Her body is aligned so her tail sits inside the painted arch and her torso extends left into the gallery space. Soft gallery lighting from above; her real shadow falls on the wall, mixing with the painted shadows.
Over 13 seconds she performs a playful mermaid swim:
0–2s: Starts with left arm reaching toward the plaque, right hand near the painted dolphin’s snout. She looks left in profile, then turns her face toward camera, lifts both hands to fluff her pink hair.
2–5s: Arms sweep in a swimming stroke. She smiles, glances at camera, then looks toward the dolphin. Body gently rocks as if floating.
5–8s: Broader swim motion — left arm extends fully left, right hand brushes her tail. She grins at the camera, then looks up and right toward the painted beluga.
8–13s: Settles into a classic mermaid pose: left arm outstretched, right hand resting on her pink tail, chin lifted, eyes looking up and slightly off-camera as if gazing at the surface. Soft smile. Hold the pose as the shot ends.
Camera stays mostly locked on the mural with slight handheld drift. Natural indoor color, no heavy grade. Photoreal live-action, not cartoon. Smooth continuous motion, no cuts.
Style / technical tags
photorealistic, live-action, museum interior, forced-perspective mural, mermaid cosplay, pink wig, white top, sequined pink tail, swimming arm motions, playful, whimsical, soft overhead gallery light, mint wall, teal painted water, dolphins penguins fish mural, 13 seconds, medium-wide, slight handheld, 24fps, natural color

entries.prompt:
【全局·画质设定】

30秒，16:9，60fps。
暗色幻想厚涂绘画动画，粗粝笔触、硬边明暗、概括色块与清晰剪影。人物、武器和建筑统一为具有立体空间的绘画动画，笔触稳定附着于表面。

高速运动中人物面部、持刀手、实体刀锋和攻防关系始终清楚可辨。

图1绑定场景：冷蓝灰乌云下的宏大古城，厚重白色城墙、层叠深灰瓦顶、中央宽街和微弱暖灯。雨后屋面与石板湿润。

战斗路线固定为：

屋顶追斩 → 白墙折返 → 建筑前庭接战 → 高处屋脊决胜。

远处城墙、屋顶和建筑方位始终连续，禁止空间跳变。

图2绑定角色A外形，

图3绑定角色B外形，

电影级细节、真实金属材质、全局光照、体积云雾、接触阴影、高动态范围。

金属刀刃反光锐利，刀锋碰撞产生真实金属摩擦、火星和细小刃口震动。

整体以墨黑、灰青、冷白、深褐为主要色调。

速度感主要来自快速身体动作、连续变线、背景高速掠过、前景视差、衣物惯性以及碎片飞散。

碎瓦、木屑、石屑沿受力方向抛出，随后受到重力影响坠落、碰撞、弹跳。

头发、衣摆与链条随身体转向产生真实滞后。

所有建筑破损持续保留，禁止自动复原。

【角色设定】

A｜红衣长发刀客。

采用图2的脸型、长发高束、深红外衣、浅色腰带、黑色宽裤、绑腿与鞋履。

使用图3弧形金属刀。

保留深色刃面、暖金边缘护手与深色缠柄。

右手主握。

重斩、压刀和强力格挡时允许双手握住同一刀柄。

刀鞘始终固定腰侧。

B｜白发刀客。

采用图4的白色短发、青绿色眼睛、黑色内袍、白色无袖外衣、腰带与体型。

使用图5银亮弧形刀。

保持冷白刃口、对应护手、浅色缠柄、刀柄末端链条及挂饰。

链条始终固定连接刀柄，并根据加速度自然甩动。

【核心动作规则】

纯双人武艺对决。

首帧已经进入攻击状态，不做站立展示，不做对峙铺垫。

前三秒必须完成：

B空中挥刀攻击 → A侧向踏瓦反斩 → B紧随落地近身连续抢攻。

全片围绕真实挥刀、格挡、拨刀、闪避、卸力、反切、追斩和脚步换位推进。

核心节拍：

斩 → 挡 → 反切 → 拨开 → 追斩 → 侧闪 → 回斩。

常规段保持每秒4—6个双方合计攻防动作。

短爆发段允许每秒6—8拍。

所有动作短促、利落、连续。

短引刀、快速转髋、接触立即变线。

上一刀的收刀方向直接成为下一刀的起点。

禁止每次攻击后重新摆姿势。

换位过程中继续攻击。

落脚瞬间继续挥刀。

格挡后立即卸力反击。

普通接刀只产生短促肩臂偏转与小幅脚步移动。

禁止人物长时间漂浮。

【摄影规则】

以双人中景、全景高速侧跟为主。

特写内部人物继续运动。

12—16秒｜第一次重攻

14—15秒进入动态特写：

16—20秒｜前庭接战

双方跨越屋顶间隙。

空中仍持续交刀。

落入前庭后立即滑步继续攻击。

双方重新回到高处屋脊。

A拨刀后横切。

B卸力反击。

entries.title: Kitten Selfie Hair Play
entries.description: A prompt for a vertical selfie video where a kitten plays with a woman's hair. Uses a reference image for the subject and details specific actions and camera behavior.
entries.prompt:
REFERENCE & SUBJECT

Use "@*image1" as the exact visual reference for the woman. Preserve her facial identity, hairstyle, clothing, skin texture, body proportions, and natural appearance throughout the entire video.

Exactly ONE small tabby kitten is present from beginning to end. Preserve the same kitten, fur pattern, size, eyes, whiskers, ears, and body proportions. No other animal and no duplicate subject.

FORMAT

30-second continuous vertical 9:16 handheld smartphone front-camera selfie footage.

The woman is indoors beside a bright window in soft natural daylight.

She holds the phone with one arm while holding the kitten against her chest with the other.

Natural smartphone exposure, subtle sensor noise, realistic skin texture, slight handheld jitter and natural arm drift.

No cuts, no transitions, no zoom, no cinematic camera movement.

---

0–5 SEC — QUIET BEGINNING

The woman is already holding the kitten against her chest.

Her tied-back hair has a few loose strands around her face.

She looks toward the kitten with a relaxed smile.

The kitten calmly watches her face.

She gently rubs the kitten behind one ear.

She quietly says:

"You're getting sleepy, aren't you?"

The kitten blinks slowly.

---

5–10 SEC — KITTEN NOTICES HAIR

One loose strand of her hair moves near the kitten's face.

The kitten follows it with its eyes.

It raises one paw and lightly touches the strand.

The woman notices and gives a small nose-laugh.

She moves her head slightly away.

The strand swings back toward the kitten.

The kitten becomes more interested.

---

10–15 SEC — FIRST GRAB

The kitten reaches up and catches the loose strand between its paws.

The woman immediately reacts with a surprised laugh.

She gently tries to free her hair.

The kitten holds on.

Her eyes squeeze shut for a moment as she laughs.

The phone shakes slightly from her reaction.

She says:

"Ow, hey, that's my hair."

---

15–20 SEC — KITTEN PULLS

The kitten gives another small playful tug.

The woman leans her head away while laughing.

Her loose hair moves across her cheek.

She carefully supports the kitten's body and uses her fingers to free the strand.

The kitten keeps reaching upward.

Her shoulders bounce naturally with laughter.

---

20–24 SEC — KITTEN CLIMBS

The kitten suddenly places both front paws higher against her chest.

It starts climbing toward her shoulder.

She reacts with a little surprised yelp followed by laughter.

The camera drifts slightly upward as her arm adjusts.

She catches the kitten securely before it can climb further.

---

24–27 SEC — AFFECTIONATE RESET

She gently settles the kitten back against her chest.

She presses her cheek lightly against the kitten's head.

The kitten's ears flick.

She takes a small breath and smiles.

The kitten suddenly notices the phone.

---

27–30 SEC — FINAL REACH

T

entries.title: 2.5D Anime Samurai Battle in Rain
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 30-second premium cinematic 2.5D anime samurai battle featuring two warriors fighting in a dojo and outside in the rain, with specific choreography and camera angles.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second premium cinematic 2.5D anime samurai battle in 16:9 widescreen. High-budget Japanese anime movie style, fluid animation, realistic physics, dramatic lighting, strong 2.5D depth/parallax, cinematic camera movement.

CHARACTERS:
Warrior A: adult male, long black ponytail, black-red samurai outfit, black katana with red handle, calm and precise.

Warrior B: adult male, silver-white hair, dark navy samurai outfit, dark katana with blue handle, aggressive and extremely fast.
Keep faces, hairstyles, outfits and weapons consistent throughout.

0–3s: HOOK:
Extreme close-up of rain sliding down Warrior A's katana. Lightning flashes. Warrior B suddenly attacks from behind. A blocks at the last second. Their swords lock inches from their faces.

3–7s:FAST DUEL:
Explosive katana battle across the dojo: slashes, parries, spinning attacks, dodges and counters. Sparks fly and the wooden floor cracks. Fast tracking camera.

7–10s:SLOW MOTION:
Warrior B delivers a powerful slash. A bends backward and narrowly dodges. Rain freezes in the air as the camera performs a cinematic 360° orbit. Suddenly return to full speed.

10–15s: HAND-TO-HAND:
A disarms B. The fight instantly becomes close-range martial arts: punch, block, elbow, knee, spinning kick and shoulder throw. B recovers, grabs his katana and attacks again.

15–19s: DOJO BREAK:
Their swords lock with massive force. The floor cracks and they crash through the dojo wall into the heavy rain outside. They immediately continue fighting.

19–23s: AERIAL CLASH:
Both sprint toward each other and leap. Their katanas collide mid-air in dramatic slow motion. Sparks, rain and debris freeze around them before a powerful impact throws them apart.

23–27s: FINAL SPEED:
They rush toward each other at extreme speed: slash → parry → punch → dodge → elbow → sword clash → spinning kick → final counter. Use low angle, tracking, close-up and overhead shots.

27–30s: EPIC ENDING:
Silence. One rain droplet falls between them. Both raise their katanas and attack simultaneously. Massive final clash, shockwave, flying rain, leaves and debris. Camera pulls back to reveal the entire ancient Japanese temple beneath storm clouds and lightning. Cut to black on a lightning flash.

STYLE: Professional martial-arts choreography, realistic weight and momentum, authentic katana movements, cinematic slow/fast speed ramps, volumetric lighting, rain reflections, atmospheric fog, dynamic hair and clothing, detailed Japanese architecture, movie-quality anime visuals.

Show a cute little girl with red hair tied in small pigtails, wearing a yellow polka-dot dress, standing beside a cheerful vintage ice cream vendor and his small traditional ice cream cart → the vendor playfully teases her by moving the ice cream scoop just out of her reach while she looks surprised and excited → camera cuts to a wider shot as the vendor performs a funny, energetic ice cream-selling routine around his cart, making the nearby villagers laugh and watch → show the little girl following him excitedly as the playful performance continues → close-up of the smiling vendor proudly holding up an ice cream scoop → end with a warm close-up of the little girl happily receiving a vanilla soft-serve cone from him.
Whimsical family-friendly 3D animation, expressive cartoon style

entries.title: Peaceful Summer Bike Ride
entries.description: A prompt for a serene, cinematic video of a woman riding a bicycle through fields and enjoying nature. Focuses on slow-living aesthetics and golden hour lighting.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic 30-second video, photorealistic, 4K, shallow depth of field. A beautiful young East Asian woman with long flowing black hair, wearing a cream off-shoulder knitted sweater, denim shorts, and white sneakers. She rides a silver city bicycle with a wicker basket full of yellow, purple and white wildflowers along a dirt path through a vast field of white daisies and rolling green hills under a bright blue sky with fluffy clouds. Hair blowing in the wind, gentle smile.
Cut to her lying on her back in the grass under a tree with dappled sunlight, holding an open book, peaceful expression, eyes half-closed.
Then close-up of her hands gently dipping into a clear pebble-bottomed stream.
She walks away from camera pushing the bicycle along the path beside the stream.
Golden hour: she sits on the grass by the river with the bicycle parked behind her, looking toward the sunset reflecting on the water.
Drone shot pulls back revealing her small figure sitting beside a winding river through lush green fields and rice paddies, village houses in the distance, warm sunset light.
Final shot: silhouette of the woman sitting by a calm lake watching a vivid orange sunset, sky glowing with warm colors.
Mood: peaceful, nostalgic, slow-living Japanese countryside summer, dreamy and serene. Soft natural lighting, gentle camera movements, filmic color grading.

entries.title: Vinyl Record Vlog Scene
entries.description: A prompt for a 9:16 vertical vlog scene featuring an Asian female vlogger selecting a vinyl record, with specific audio-visual sync instructions and retro aesthetics.
entries.prompt:
9:16, 24fps, 15 seconds.

0-3s: Selfie perspective. An Asian female vlogger with retro glasses, freckles, and pearl necklaces stands by a mid-century wooden cabinet in direct sunlight. A few carefully selected vinyl records are neatly displayed (not a crowded rack). Her fingertips glide over the covers, and she smoothly pulls out an R&B album, whispering to the camera: "My soul food for today."
4-7s: [Audio-Visual Sync] Detail close-ups. A slow-motion shot of her placing the record on the dark walnut base. The moment the needle drops and touches the vinyl, a crisp static sound syncs with the start of a rhythmic retro R&B track, which continues playing. Voiceover: "Listen to that warmth."
8-11s: [The Immersion] Third-person montage. First, a facial close-up of the vlogger with eyes closed, swaying her head to the beat; then, the camera pulls back to show her dancing gracefully in the room. Audio: The R&B track swells, becoming clearer and richer.
11-15s: [Outro] Final shot. She looks directly at the camera, smiling genuinely, holding the vinyl cover near her face. Text overlay fades in subtly: "Music is life." Fade to black.

entries.title: Fashion Model BTS Vlog Prompt
entries.description: Detailed prompt for a playful behind-the-scenes fashion shoot vlog featuring a Korean idol, utilizing handheld camcorder aesthetics and specific storyboard cuts.

DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights under studio lighting, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones, authentic early-2000s consumer DV/16mm camcorder character.

**STYLE:**
Playful, self-deprecating fashion-shoot BTS vlog tone — genuine behind-the-scenes chaos mixed with humor, small mistakes, nervous excitement, and candid moments between takes. Quick handheld cuts, spontaneous interactions, wardrobe adjustments, makeup touch-ups, and playful reactions. Feels like an authentic personal camcorder recording rather than a polished fashion film.

**Character**

CHASE — Korean idol, 20s. Long black hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin with a light natural makeup finish, big expressive eyes. Slim athletic build. During the shoot she wears a modest high-fashion editorial outfit with long sleeves and full torso coverage, paired with stylish trousers or a long skirt, fashion sneakers or boots. No jewelry unless part of the styling.

**Setting**

A professional fashion photography studio in the evening — large seamless backdrop, softboxes, C-stands, reflector boards, clothing racks, makeup station, styling table, scattered fashion accessories, photographer and crew moving around in the background. Warm studio practicals mixed with cool photographic lights. Authentic busy BTS atmosphere.

2. *(~2.5s, handheld, mirror shot)*
