entries.title: Japanese Temple Horror Found Footage
entries.description: A prompt for a 1990s-style found-footage horror short filmed in a Japanese temple, detailing character appearances, mask designs, and specific shooting styles.
entries.prompt:
1990s Japan, a terrifying and grotesque masked ritual — 30 second found-footage horror short

LOOK: real footage, not AI-generated. Shot like a 1990s Japanese theatrical horror film on 35mm — visible film grain, shallow depth of field, low-key lighting with deep falloff, true skin texture with pores and fine lines. The amber of the oil lamps stands against a cold blue-gray falling from gaps above, warm against cold in one frame. Corners sink into vignette, halation blooms around the lamps, thin vertical scratches pass now and then. Most of every frame sinks into darkness — only a hand's width around each candle is lit, walls, floor and far background falling to black, and the hall as a whole is never brightly lit. No grading gloss, no HDR, no lens flare, no waxy AI skin, no beauty smoothing, no all-over brown filter.

SHOOTING STYLE: the tone of a haunted-spot exploration tape. 16:9 horizontal from start to finish, no black bars on any side. Until 0:13.5 the picture peers out from where the two students hide behind a pillar. The Hi8 camcorder is visible only at 0:00–0:02.5, held in the male student's hands; after that no device ever appears on screen. Only the first image at 0:15 opens on the fallen camcorder's low viewpoint, and the cuts after it move freely to whatever angle fits the scene. No battery, recording or time indicators, subtitles or logos.

CHARACTER — MALE STUDENT: one fictional adult man in his early twenties. Short tousled black hair, dark eyebrows and eyes, a straight nose, a clean-shaven face and natural skin texture. A black jacket over a blue-gray hoodie, olive cargo trousers and black lace-up boots. The Hi8 camcorder belongs to him.

CHARACTER — FEMALE STUDENT: one fictional adult woman in her early twenties. An oval face, dark eyes and black hair tied low, with loose strands framing her face. A burgundy jacket, black high-neck top, dark gray cargo trousers and black boots.

CHARACTER CONTINUITY: these are the only two students. Keep the faces, hair and clothes established in the first shot consistent throughout. Both students' faces and skin stay clean and unmarked to the end, except for the dark red flecks that hit her face at 0:24.

MASKED GROUP: one group, maintaining the following distinct mask designs throughout. A white Noh mask with only a pierced mouth, a mask clustered from dozens of small white faces, a carved brown oval mask, a silver beaked mask of joined metal plates, a red mask with square eye holes, a riveted white helmet mask, a corroded bronze disc mask, a large bird-skull white mask — no two alike. Layered black, ink-burgundy and aged off-white garments, bare feet. Bare faces never revealed, no new members.

LOCATION: only one old Japanese timber ritual hall — dark wooden floorboards, an octagonal sunken pit at the center, a rope hung with bronze bells dropping from the ceiling into the pit, weathered planks laid radially in a ring around it, candles and oil lamps along the floor and windows, thick timber pillars and a shrine altar at the back. The only lights are the candles' and lamps' amber and a blue-gray night seep from wall gaps. All the lamps snap out and back irregularly through the entire film — each dark beat lasts half a breath, the lit stretches longer.

TWO PHENOMENA: a pale gray-white membrane joining numerous human faces of different sizes and expressions hangs tangled between the beams across the full ceiling width from 0:00. The lamps' amber tints its underside and its shadow falls on the beams, so it reads as part of this place. The membrane sways slowly as if breathing, the faces each open and close their mouths at their own pace, and some look down — never frozen like statues. It sits one span lower each time the lamps snap back, and at 0:18 it is yanked up and vanishes. The dozens of arms appear only after 0:21.5 — long, gaunt, ash-pale arms with jutting knuckles and fingers bent like hooks. The two phenomena never share a frame and never merge.

DARK RED LIQUID: pours down with the arms at 0:21.5, splashing only where the arms pass, on the floor around the male student, and at 0:24 on the female student's face. The pool and the flecks on her face stay unerased to the end.

DIALOGUE: whispers and cries come from behind the camcorder; only the woman's scream is lip-synced. The whispers are frightened — breath mixed in, voice ends trembling.

(0:00–0:02.5) — The two students from behind, crouched hiding in the dark behind a thick pillar — the male aims the camcorder through the gap. Beyond them the masked group bows on the planks ringing the pit, to a low chant. Across the ceiling the face membrane sways breathing, mouths opening and closing. Their tense breaths tremble. Transition: cut mid-bow

(0:02.5–0:05) — Same framing. Every lamp snaps out for half a beat — when light returns the membrane hangs one span lower and several faces open their mouths. Between the students' trembling breaths, the woman's frightened whisper, Dialogue: 「ちょっと…な、何あれ…」 Transition: cut with the lamps lit

(0:05–0:07) — Close on the nearest masks. The clustered-faces mask and the silver beaked mask dip, scratches caught in the lamplight. The man's breath-mixed whisper, Dialogue: 「しっ…静かに…」 Transition: cut mid-bow

(0:07–0:09) — Close on other masks. The red square-eyed mask, the bronze disc mask and the bird-skull mask bow deep and rise at mismatched beats. The lamps snap out and back once more. Transition: cut mid-bow

(0:09–0:10.5) — The chant stops dead and every sound is gone at once. The whole group freezes mid-bow and every head snaps around at once to face the lens — dozens of masks all turned straight at us. That instant one low short roar bursts and cuts off with no tail. Transition: cut on the locked stares

(0:10.5–0:12.5) — The whole group drops to all fours at once and charges the lens at full speed — limbs hammering the floor like animals, the distant figures growing larger and larger within the cut until they fill the frame. A few come flipped over, bellies to the sky. Like objects, not people. Dialogue: 「うわっ！」 Transition: cut as masks flood the frame

(0:12.5–0:13.5) — Struck, the picture whips hard side to side and plunges downward, smearing into blur — then tears into an analog glitch, horizontal scanlines ripping, boiling color-dot noise — and cuts dead to full black. Transition: cut on the severed signal

(0:13.5–0:15) — The black holds in silence. The frame holds only black; from far off, a rapid whispered incantation begins to seep in, layer on layer. Transition: cut over the whispering

(0:15–0:17) — The fallen camcorder's low view opens from a distance, wide — students and group in one frame. At the pit's edges the male in his black jacket frame-right, the female in her burgundy jacket frame-left, 1.5 metres apart, upright, wrists tied behind, struggling. The group lies flat on the planks around them, chanting clearly. Transition: cut mid-incantation

(0:17–0:19) — Same floor-level view. The membrane sinks span by span over the students' heads, every face gaping as if screaming without sound, each writhing at its own pace — then at 0:18 all are yanked upward and vanish. The group stays flat on the ground, the incantation running on. Transition: cut on the empty ceiling

(0:19–0:21.5) — Close-up insert on the male student, still in his black jacket and blue-gray hoodie. He wrenches his bound shoulders hard, struggling, then cranes his neck to stare up — shoulders heaving with ragged breath, head rocking side to side. From all sides the whispered incantation rushes in. Transition: cut over the upturned face

(0:21.5–0:24) — Thud — the gaunt ash-pale arms crash down waterfall-fast across the whole ceiling as the loudest roar bursts. Arms with jutting knuckles and fingers bent like hooks. Dark red liquid splashes around the male student, and the arms engulf him
entries.translated_prompt:
1990年代日本，一场恐怖且怪诞的面具仪式——30秒伪纪录片风格恐怖短片

视觉风格：真实影像，非AI生成感。模仿1990年代日本院线恐怖电影在35毫米胶片上的拍摄效果——可见胶片颗粒，浅景深，低调照明伴有强烈的明暗衰减，真实的皮肤纹理包括毛孔和细纹。油灯的琥珀色光芒与从上方缝隙透入的冷蓝灰色形成对比，冷暖色调共存于同一画面。角落沉入暗角光晕，灯光周围出现光晕扩散，偶尔有细微的垂直划痕掠过。每个画面的大部分陷入黑暗——只有每支蜡烛周围一只手宽的范围被照亮，墙壁、地板和远处背景落入黑色，整个大厅从未明亮过。无调色光泽，无HDR，无镜头光晕，无蜡质AI皮肤，无美颜平滑处理，无全画幅棕色滤镜。

拍摄风格：闹鬼地点探索录像带的基调。全程16:9横向比例，四周无边框黑条。直到0:13.5，画面是从两名学生躲在柱子后窥视的角度拍摄。Hi8摄像机仅在0:00–0:02.5期间可见，由男学生手持；此后屏幕上不再出现任何设备。只有0:15的第一个镜头以掉落的摄像机的低视角开始，之后的剪辑自由切换到适合场景的任何角度。无电池、录制或时间指示器，无字幕或标志。

角色——男学生：一名虚构的成年男性，二十岁出头。短而凌乱的黑色头发，浓眉黑眼，直鼻，剃须干净的脸庞和自然皮肤纹理。蓝色灰色连帽衫外穿黑色夹克，橄榄绿工装裤和黑色系带靴。Hi8摄像机属于他。

角色——女学生：一名虚构的成年女性，二十岁出头。椭圆形脸，深色眼睛和低扎的黑发，几缕散发垂在脸侧。酒红色夹克，黑色高领上衣，深灰色工装裤和黑色靴子。

角色连续性：这两名学生是仅有的两个学生。保持第一镜头中建立的面孔、头发和服装在整个过程中一致。两名学生的面孔和皮肤始终保持干净无标记，除了0:24击中她脸上的暗红色斑点。

面具团体：一个团体，全程保持以下独特的面具设计。一个只有穿孔嘴的白色能剧面具，一个由数十个小白色面孔聚集而成的面具，一个雕刻的棕色椭圆面具，一个由金属板拼接而成的银色喙状面具，一个方形眼孔的红色面具，一个铆接的白色头盔面具，一个腐蚀的青铜圆盘面具，一个大型鸟头骨白色面具——没有两个相同。层叠的黑色、墨酒红色和陈旧米白色衣物，赤脚。绝不露出真容，无新成员加入。

地点：仅有一座古老的日本木制仪式大厅——深色木地板，中心有一个八角形下沉坑，一根挂着铜铃的绳子从天花板垂入坑中，围绕坑呈放射状铺设的风化木板，地板和窗户沿线的蜡烛和油灯，粗大的木柱和后方的神坛。唯一的光源是蜡烛和油灯的琥珀色光芒以及从墙壁缝隙渗入的蓝灰色夜色。在整个影片中，所有灯具不规则地熄灭和重新亮起——每次黑暗持续半口气的时间，亮起的时段更长。

两种现象：一张苍白的灰白色薄膜连接着无数不同大小和表情的人类面孔，从0:00开始纠缠悬挂在横跨整个天花板宽度的梁之间。灯光的琥珀色染了其底面，其阴影落在梁上，因此它看起来是这个场所的一部分。薄膜缓慢摇曳，仿佛在呼吸，面孔各自以自己的节奏张开和闭合嘴巴，有些向下看——绝非像雕像般静止。每当灯具熄灭再亮起时，它就下降一臂的距离，并在0:18时被向上拉起并消失。数十只手臂仅在0:21.5之后出现——长而瘦削、灰烬般苍白的手臂，指节突出，手指弯曲如钩。这两种现象从不共享同一画面，也从不融合。

暗红色液体：随手臂在0:21.5倾泻而下，仅溅在手臂经过的地方、男学生周围的地板上，以及在0:24溅到女学生的脸上。池水和她脸上的斑点直到最后都未被擦除。

对白：耳语和哭声来自摄像机后方；只有女人的尖叫声是对口型的。耳语充满恐惧——混合着呼吸声，声音以颤抖结束。

(0:00–0:02.5) — 两名学生的背影，蹲伏躲在一根粗柱子后的黑暗中——男生透过缝隙瞄准摄像机。在他们身后，面具团体在环绕坑洞的木板上鞠躬，伴随着低沉的吟唱。天花板上的人脸薄膜摇曳呼吸，嘴巴开合。他们紧张的呼吸颤抖着。转场：在鞠躬中途切镜

(0:02.5–0:05) — 同样的构图。每盏灯熄灭半拍——当光线恢复时，薄膜下降了一臂距离，几张脸张开了嘴。在学生颤抖的呼吸间，女人惊恐的低语，对白：「ちょっと…な、何あれ…」(等等……那、那是什么……) 转场：在灯光亮起时切镜

(0:05–0:07) — 特写最近的面具。聚集面孔的面具和银色喙状面具低下头，灯光下捕捉到的划痕。男人混合着呼吸的低语，对白：「しっ…静かに…」(嘘……安静点……) 转场：在鞠躬中途切镜

(0:07–0:09) — 特写其他面具。红色方眼面具、青铜圆盘面具和鸟头骨面具深深鞠躬并以不匹配的节拍抬起头。灯具再次熄灭和亮起一次。转场：在鞠躬中途切镜

(0:09–0:10.5) — 吟唱戛然而止，所有声音瞬间消失。整个团体在半鞠躬时僵住，每一个头同时猛然转向镜头——几十个面具全部正对着我们。那一刻一声低沉短促的咆哮爆发并无尾音切断。转场：在锁定凝视时切镜

(0:10.5–0:12.5) — 整个团体同时四肢着地，全速冲向镜头——肢体像动物一样捶打地板，远处的形象在剪辑内越来越大直到填满画面。有几个翻转过来，肚皮朝天。像物体，不像人。对白：「うわっ！」(哇！) 转场：在面具涌入画面时切镜

(0:12.5–0:13.5) — 受到撞击，画面剧烈左右摇晃并向下坠落，模糊成一片——然后撕裂成模拟故障，水平扫描线撕裂，沸腾的色彩噪点——并彻底切断至全黑。转场：在信号中断时切镜

(0:13.5–0:15) — 黑暗在寂静中持续。画面仅保持黑色；从远处开始，快速的低语咒文开始渗入，层层叠加。转场：在低语声中切镜

(0:15–0:17) — 掉落摄像机的低视角从远处打开，广角——学生和团体在同一画面中。在坑的边缘，穿黑色夹克的男生位于画面右侧，穿酒红色夹克的女生位于画面左侧，相距1.5米，直立，手腕在身后被绑住，正在挣扎。团体平躺在他们周围的木板上，清晰地吟唱着。转场：在吟唱中途切镜

(0:17–0:19) — 同样的地面视角。薄膜一臂臂地沉降到学生头顶上方，每一张脸都大张着，仿佛在无声尖叫，各自以自己的节奏扭动——然后在0:18全部被向上拉起并消失。团体保持平躺在地面上，咒文继续运行。转场：在空荡的天花板处切镜

(0:19–0:21.5) — 男学生的特写插入镜头，仍穿着他的黑色夹克和蓝灰色连帽衫。他用力扭动被绑住的肩膀，挣扎着，然后伸长脖子抬头凝视——肩膀随着急促的呼吸起伏，头部左右摇摆。从四面八方涌来低声的咒文。转场：在仰起的面孔处切镜

(0:21.5–0:24) — 砰——瘦削的灰烬般苍白的手臂如瀑布般快速砸下，覆盖整个天花板，最响亮的咆哮爆发。手臂指节突出，手指弯曲如钩。暗红色液体在男学生周围飞溅，手臂将他吞没

entries.title: Penguin Girl Garden Animation
entries.description: A prompt for a cute 3D animated video of a baby penguin girl in a floral dress exploring a magical cottage garden at golden hour.
entries.prompt:
A cute cinematic 3D animated baby penguin girl wearing a delicate vintage cream-white floral dress with lace details and a small ribbon, standing in a magical cottage garden at golden hour. The scene begins with an empty flower-filled garden, a rustic stone wall covered with green vines and tiny white daisies, warm sunset light glowing in the background.

The adorable penguin slowly peeks out from behind the stone wall, looking curiously toward the camera while holding a small white daisy in her wing. She carefully steps out from behind the wall and walks along the stone pathway through the flower garden. Her fluffy dark-gray and white feathers, huge expressive eyes, tiny orange beak, rosy cheeks, and soft rounded body create an irresistibly cute appearance.

She stops in the warm sunset light, gently turns toward the camera, smiles with her eyes closed, and happily holds a fresh white daisy toward the viewer. A small daisy is tucked beside her head. Her dress softly sways with her movement.

Cinematic camera movement, slow gentle push-in, subtle tracking shot following the penguin, then a beautiful close-up of her face and flower. Warm golden-hour sunlight, soft rim lighting, dreamy bokeh, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric and feather textures, detailed stone wall, lush grass and flowers, volumetric sunlight, magical cozy atmosphere, emotional and heartwarming mood, high-end 3D animated film quality, ultra-detailed, smooth natural character animation, cinematic composition, 9:16 vertical video, 4K.

entries.title: Storyboard Recreation Prompt
entries.description: A prompt for recreating a storyboard sequence with strict character consistency and realistic live-action feel.
entries.prompt:
Create a 12-second ultra-realistic vertical cinematic video.

Use the provided character reference for the exact same female character and use the provided master storyboard as the strict visual guide for the entire sequence.

Recreate the storyboard's actions, camera positions, framing, timing and visual progression in the same chronological order. Do not invent additional scenes or change the main actions.

Maintain strict character consistency throughout the entire video: identical face, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, accessories and overall appearance.

The video should feel like premium realistic live-action footage with natural human movement, believable physics, realistic facial expressions and physically accurate interaction with the environment.

Follow the storyboard panel by panel:
- preserve the opening composition and first action
- reproduce each major movement and reaction in the correct order
- match the camera perspective and framing of each storyboard moment
- use natural transitions between consecutive actions
- preserve the exact spatial relationship between the character and surrounding objects
- keep all props consistent and physically present
- reproduce the final composition and ending shown in the storyboard

Use dynamic but realistic camera movement, including handheld tracking, close-ups, wider framing and motivated camera shifts wherever shown by the storyboard.

Keep motion fluid and continuous. Avoid sudden teleportation, duplicated objects, changing clothing, facial identity drift, unnatural body deformation or inconsistent backgrounds.

Prioritize realistic lighting, natural shadows, authentic textures, detailed skin, realistic hair movement and believable environmental physics.

The final result must look like a professionally captured real-life video rather than an AI-generated sequence.

No subtitles.
No captions.
No logos.
No watermark.
No unnecessary text.
No additional characters or actions that are not shown in the storyboard.

entries.title: Mediterranean Longboard Rider Prompt
entries.description: A cinematic tracking shot prompt featuring a rider descending a cobblestone alley in a Mediterranean village at golden hour.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic third-person tracking shot, camera following closely behind
a young rider on a wooden longboard, descending a steep cobblestone
alley in a sunlit Mediterranean cliffside village at golden hour.

Camera stays locked ~1.5m behind and slightly below the rider
(low eye-level, mild wide-angle), moving at the same speed — the
rider's silhouette stays centered-low in frame while whitewashed
houses and terracotta rooftops streak past on both sides.

The alley opens into a sweeping hairpin curve above the coastline;
the rider leans into a smooth carving turn, camera drifting slightly
outward with the momentum as if riding along. The turn releases onto
an open cliffside road running beside the sea — the view widens, the
ocean fills the horizon, and the rider glides at full speed as the
camera eases back to reveal the full golden-hour coastline.

Loose cream linen shirt and hair stream backward in the wind, selling
speed without fast cuts or heavy motion blur. Warm amber sunlight
on stone walls and rooftops against a deep cobalt sea and indigo sky
— soft painterly color grading, gentle bloom, continuous unbroken
take, smooth handheld-gimbal micro-bounce on the cobblestones.

Style: painterly illustrated realism, soft diffused light, warm/cool
color contrast, dreamy and tranquil mood despite the downhill speed.
Motion: buttery smooth, high frame rate feel, no jitter, no stutter.
Duration: 8-10 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9.

Negative: no bicycle, no pedaling motion, no other people, no text,
no logos, no harsh motion blur, no shaky handheld chaos, no jump cuts.

entries.title: Emotional Stress Test Video Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for testing emotional rendering capabilities in Seedance 2.5, depicting a woman's transition from rage to grief at a dining table with precise timing and camera instructions.
entries.prompt:
A woman in her 40s sits alone at a small dining table at night, reading a letter. Over 20s, her rage slowly curdles into grief before breaking into physical destruction. A woman mid-40s, natural skin with visible pores, fine lines and under-eye texture, shoulder-length hair loosely tied back, worn cardigan over a plain top. 100% reference match. Small wooden table, warm lamp camera-left, letter in foreground, shelf with framed photos and glass vase behind her, shadowed corner of the room.

Timed multishot: continuous 0–12s, then HARD CUTS only at 12s, 14.5s and 17s. 0–12s MCU→CU, FOV 29°, slow creeping handheld push-in with fine 1cm tremor. 12s WS FOV 63°, 14.5s MS FOV 47°, 17s CU FOV 18°. Final shot is low and static from floor level.

0–3s: eyes scan letter, jaw tightens, grip whitens knuckles. 3–6s: eyes glass over, one tear rolls down her right cheek, breathing shortens. 6–9s: hands tremble, paper shakes, shoulders draw inward. 9–10s: she reads the final line, sharply exhales and drops the letter. 10–12s: hands drag through her hair, head tilts back, first sob breaks. 12s: she violently shoves the table forward and rises. 14.5s: she sweeps framed photos and vase from the shelf; glass and frames scatter realistically. 17s: she sits collapsed in the corner, knees drawn up, crying, one hand over her mouth, the other loosely holding a kitchen knife resting against her knee, never raised.

Keep the performance restrained and realistic: micro-tremors, wet reflective eyes, visible catch-light, natural flushing, no exaggerated crying. Realistic paper movement, table weight/friction, glass impact and body weight. Single 3200K practical lamp throughout; no new light sources. Diegetic audio only: paper, breathing, sobs, table scrape, lamp rattle, glass breaking, floor settling. No score. Photoreal, natural skin texture, fine film grain, handheld documentary intimacy, no stylized color grade, real-time, 24fps. Hair, cardigan, lighting and character remain consistent across every cut.

entries.title: Pneumatic Spheres Physics Simulation Prompt
entries.description: A complex prompt comparing Seedance 2.5 and Minimax 3 performance on a chaotic physics simulation involving bouncing pneumatic spheres in a brutalist room. Includes detailed timestamped camera movements and material specifications.
entries.prompt:
10-second ultra-photorealistic first-person smartphone recording. One continuous shot inside a large brutalist room filled with dozens of enormous, lightweight pneumatic spheres bouncing chaotically in every direction. The spheres have different diameters, ranging from 30 centimeters to 2 meters. Their perfectly smooth, ultrathin, translucent elastic membranes feature sophisticated colors: electric cobalt blue, transparent amber, smoky violet, turquoise, coral red and pearlescent silver. Restrained saturation, subtle iridescence, realistic reflections and physically convincing materials. They behave like highly elastic, air-filled spheres, never like gelatin. Their surfaces compress during collisions and immediately recover their spherical shape. They bounce against each other, the walls, floor and ceiling, creating continuous kinetic chain reactions.

[00:00–00:02] Immediate chaos. The handheld camera rushes forward through the room. Enormous colored spheres collide violently. A large cobalt sphere strikes the floor and rebounds toward the ceiling. Smaller amber and turquoise spheres scatter in different directions.

[00:02–00:04] The camera abruptly turns right. Two enormous spheres collide directly ahead, compressing dramatically before rebounding. A coral sphere suddenly strikes the camera, temporarily obscuring the entire image and causing a violent handheld jolt.

[00:04–00:07] Aggressive upward camera movement reveals multiple spheres striking the ceiling. The operator moves backward, rapidly changing direction. Extreme close-ups capture translucent membranes, realistic reflections and spectacular elastic collisions. Several smaller spheres rebound between larger ones.

[00:07–00:10] The camera spins around, revealing the entire room filled with constantly moving colored spheres. A massive transparent amber sphere approaches directly toward the viewer and strikes the camera. The image shakes violently as the operator recoils. End abruptly while the spheres continue bouncing everywhere.

CAMERA: Strict first-person POV. The entire video is recorded directly through the smartphone camera. The smartphone itself is completely invisible. Never show the device, its screen, its edges, the operator's hands or the operator's body. No external camera angles or third-person shots.

Aggressive handheld movements, rapid physical approaches, sudden rotations, unpredictable framing, natural motion blur, realistic autofocus and authentic smartphone wide-angle optics.

PHYSICS: Convincing pneumatic elasticity, realistic momentum transfer, gravity, collisions and immediate shape recovery. Every sphere maintains its individual color, size and approximate volume. No gelatinous deformation, liquid behavior, bursting.

entries.title: POV Cliff Jump into Volcanic Spring
entries.description: A highly detailed first-person POV video prompt simulating a cliff jump into a volcanic spring canyon, emphasizing realistic GoPro physics, camera behavior, and environmental details.
entries.prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5 | TEXT TO VIDEO | SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE | 22s | 1080x1920 | 9:16 | 30fps | 1080p

SCENE AND LOCATION
A hidden volcanic spring canyon deep in a Pacific Northwest pine forest on a bright summer day. A narrow, deep gorge with steep, very high walls of dark gray basalt made of vertical hexagonal columns, streaked with tan and rust tones and covered in patches of bright green moss, ferns and small shrubs.
At the bottom is a crystal-clear natural spring pool. The shallow edges glow bright turquoise and aqua, fading to deep sapphire blue in the center. The water is so transparent that the bottom is fully visible: honeycomb-patterned volcanic rock, mossy boulders, and two long pale submerged logs lying diagonally across the bottom.
Two white waterfalls pour into the pool: a thin one at the far back of the canyon and a larger one spilling from the right-hand cliff wall, making white foam where it hits the water. Tall dark-green conifer and pine trees line the canyon rim. Above is a vivid clear blue sky with a few small white clouds. Hard, bright midday sunlight with strong contrast, and sun sparkles on the water.

THE JUMPER
A young man seen only from his own first-person view. Tanned bare feet and lightly hairy shins, and loose navy-blue swim shorts with a large mustard-yellow hibiscus flower pattern and white drawstrings. No shirt, no shoes, no gloves. His hands and forearms appear naturally in frame when he moves them.

CAMERA AND REALISM
First-person POV from a GoPro strapped to his forehead. It looks like real action-cam footage, not a cinematic camera. 16mm-equivalent ultra-wide lens with slight barrel distortion, and saturated but natural color.
Use real action-cam behavior throughout: small head bob and micro-jitter from breathing and body weight, rolling-shutter wobble on fast moves, quick auto-exposure shifts between bright sky and the shaded canyon, a small sun flare on upward tilts, light sensor noise in the shadows, and wind buffeting that shakes the frame during the fall.
The cliff is about 35 meters high. Gravity, body motion and water physics are fully realistic.

0-2s | THE EDGE (real time)
POV looking straight down from the top of the basalt cliff. His bare feet stand on the rough, dark rock ledge at the bottom of frame, with the shorts visible at the lower edge. Both hands hover forward at the sides of frame. The turquoise pool, the submerged logs and the waterfalls are far, far below. His toes curl over the edge and small grit crumbles off. His right hand tosses a pink-and-white striped inflatable tube out over the drop; it tumbles down and lands as a tiny speck on the water far below. Wind, distant waterfall roar, upbeat chill electronic music starts.

2-4s | THE COUNTDOWN (real time)
A quick nervous tilt down at the drop, a sharp exhale, then two fast steps back from the edge, with the ledge bouncing in frame. Young male voice, hyped: "Three, two, one!"

4-7s | THE TAKEOFF (natural slow motion, about 50% speed)
Two running steps forward, then his last foot pushes off the ledge in slow motion. Rock grit kicks up and floats in the sunlight, the cliff edge slides away beneath his feet, his arms swing forward and out wide, and the whole turquoise canyon opens up below. The slow motion looks like a real high-frame-rate action-cam clip, not a frozen hang. Deep bass swell, stretched wind.

7-13s | THE FALL (real time, fast and continuous)
The speed ramps smoothly back to normal and the stomach drops.
7-9s: The frame dips and wobbles, his arms flail slightly for balance at the edges of frame, and his feet kick at the bottom of frame. A loud yell: "Woooooo!"
9-11s: The basalt column wall, moss and ferns streak upward past the lens, and the right-side waterfall rushes by with spray catching the sun. Wind roars louder and the frame shakes from air buffeting.
11-13s: The glowing turquoise water rushes up and fills the frame, and the pink tube and submerged logs grow fast. His arms snap tight to his body and his legs lock straight for a feet-first pencil dive. The music builds to the drop.

13-14s | IMPACT
A hard feet-first hit into the water and a white explosion of bubbles swallows the lens. Loud plunge splash, deep impact whoosh, and the music goes heavily muffled underwater.

14-17s | UNDERWATER (short, energetic, real time)
A violent swirl of silver bubbles clears to reveal crystal-clear blue water, bright sun shafts cutting down from the surface, the pale submerged logs and honeycomb volcanic rock bottom below, and small fish darting away. His hands push into frame for one strong breaststroke pull, then fast kicks straight up toward the bright glowing surface, with bubbles streaming past the lens. No slow sinking.

17-19s | SURFACE BREAK
The camera bursts through the surface, water droplets sliding across the lens, and bright sunlight floods in. The music snaps back to full clarity on the beat drop. His hand grabs the pink-and-white tube floating right beside him.

19-22s | THE REWARD
POV bobbing on the turquoise water holding the tube, then a sharp tilt up revealing the towering basalt cliff, the tiny ledge he jumped from far above, the pine trees on the rim and the vivid blue sky, with the waterfall splashing on the right. Same voice, out of breath and triumphant: "Yeah, dude! That was insane!" Faint distant cheering. Music plays clean to the final frame.

AUDIO
Continuous upbeat chill electronic track: a bass swell on takeoff, a fast build through the fall, muffled underwater, then a clean drop on surfacing. Real ambient layers: wind that grows with speed, fabric flapping, heavy breathing, waterfall roar, splash, bubbles. Dialogue clear over the music.

KEEP
One continuous take, first-person only. The same shorts, feet and hands throughout, and the same canyon layout with two waterfalls, turquoise pool and submerged logs. The slow motion lasts only 3 seconds at takeoff. The fall is fast, real time and builds speed without pausing. Every beat is quick and punchy.

AVOID
Extra slow motion beyond the takeoff, hovering or floating mid-air, smooth cinematic gimbal movement, cuts to third person, showing the jumper's face, extra people, distorted hands or extra fingers, morphing cliffs, changing water color, text, subtitles, watermarks.

entries.title: Hypercar Commercial Video Prompt

entries.prompt:
15-second, 16:9 premium hypercar commercial. Photorealistic cinematic luxury, ultra-realistic automotive cinematography.

Use Image 1 ONLY as reference for the car’s shape, W-logo, materials, proportions and design. Keep the EXACT SAME CAR throughout. Stable geometry, identical wheels, body panels, paint and proportions.

ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT. No cuts, no teleporting, no direction reversal. The car ALWAYS moves forward.

0–3s — LOW HERO ENTRY:
Nighttime city overpass with wet asphalt and elegant reflections. Camera starts extremely low beside the front wheel, smoothly tracking the car as it moves forward. Reveal the headlights, sculpted fender, aerodynamic splitter and naturally spinning wheel.

3–6s — DRIVER + COCKPIT:
Camera smoothly arcs around the front quarter and tracks alongside the car. Through the window, clearly show a REAL DRIVER with hands naturally controlling the steering wheel. Briefly reveal the premium cockpit. City lights glide realistically across the glossy gunmetal body.

6–9s — WHEEL DETAIL:
Move into an extreme cinematic close-up of the spinning wheel, tire, rim and brake caliper. Tire and rim rotate naturally, while the center W-logo cap remains perfectly upright and does NOT rotate. Camera smoothly rises along the fender toward the windshield, revealing the driver again.

9–12s — FRONT HERO:
Camera glides across the windshield and sweeps around the front corner into a dramatic low frontal hero angle. Clearly show headlights, aerodynamic nose and W emblem. Maintain stable reflections, geometry and lighting.

12–15s — ACCELERATION + REAR CHASE:
Driver accelerates. The car continues moving FORWARD. Camera smoothly travels from the side around to the REAR, transitioning into a low rear three-quarter chase shot. The hypercar accelerates away down the illuminated highway. Rear lights gradually become smaller in the distance. The car NEVER reverses.

STYLE:
Ultra-premium automotive commercial, restrained luxury, dramatic nighttime lighting, glossy metallic gunmetal paint, realistic wet-road reflections, natural driver movement, precise cinematic camera choreography, realistic physics, shallow depth of field, premium commercial-grade finish.

entries.title: Korean Idol Gym Vlog with Resistance Bands
entries.description: A video generation prompt for a realistic POV gym vlog featuring a Korean idol doing resistance band exercises, styled like handheld DV camcorder footage.
entries.prompt:
**CAMERA:**
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself, occasionally propping it on a mat or bench for hands-free band shots. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.

**LOOK:**
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights under gym lighting, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones.

**STYLE:**
Lighter, more relaxed gym-vlog tone than a heavy weights day — slower controlled movements, calmer pacing, playful commentary about the resistance building up despite how "simple" it looks.

**Character**

CHASE — Korean idol, 20s. Long black hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin with a light sweat sheen, big expressive eyes. Slim athletic build. Modest long-sleeve athletic top, loose joggers or fitted leggings (arms and torso fully covered), sneakers, no jewelry.

**Setting**

A gym mat area in the evening — resistance bands laid out nearby, mirror wall, water bottle on the floor, soft overhead lighting.

**Storyboard (15s, 6 cuts)**

1. *(~2.5s, propped camera, medium shot)* She sits on the mat, picking up a resistance band, looping it around her legs. CHASE: "Okay, lighter day today — just bands."

2. *(~2.5s, medium propped shot, leg exercise)* She performs a slow, controlled lateral band walk, focused on form. CHASE: "Looks easy, but it's definitely not."

3. *(~2s, macro insert, shallow DOF)* Close-up on the band stretching taut around her legs, muscle definition visible. No dialogue — ambient gym sound only.

4. *(~2.5s, handheld, arm exercise)* She switches to a band pull-apart for her shoulders, slow and deliberate, breathing steadily. CHASE: "This one sneaks up on you though."

5. *(~2.5s, medium propped shot)* She finishes a set, shaking her arms out, smiling at the light burn. CHASE: "Okay yeah, definitely feeling that now."

6. *(~3s, arm's-length selfie finish)* She sets the band aside, wiping her hands, relaxed and satisfied. CHASE: "Nice change of pace — see you guys next time!"

entries.prompt:
Main Subjects: A young adult couple on their first proper date, dressed in authentic mid-2000s casual fashion. He wears a casual button-up shirt, loose jeans, and sneakers; she wears a fitted cardigan, camisole, bootcut jeans, small shoulder bag, and simple hair accessories.

Location: Ordinary suburban cinema in the United Kingdom, around 2005. Old movie posters, carpeted lobby, CRT ticket screens, concession counter, paper tickets, plastic seats, and a dark theater. No smartphones or modern digital displays.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic 2005 consumer MiniDV home-video footage. Authentic 4:3 DV image, faded colors, soft contrast, mild digital noise, visible compression, autofocus hunting, blown highlights around lobby lights, motion blur, and imperfect white balance.

Camera Style: A friend secretly documents small moments from a respectful distance with a bulky MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, awkward framing, sudden zooms, autofocus breathing, occasional camera obstruction, and no stabilization. The couple occasionally notices the camera and reacts naturally.

Timeline — 15 Seconds

00:00–00:03
The footage begins outside the cinema entrance. The couple stands beside the poster wall, both slightly nervous. He checks the paper tickets twice and says, “I definitely bought the right ones.” She looks at the tickets and laughs.

00:03–00:06
Inside the lobby, they buy popcorn and drinks. He tries carrying everything at once, nearly drops the popcorn, catches it at the last second, and proudly looks toward the camera as if nothing happened.

00:06–00:09
Inside the theater, they sit beside each other. He quietly reaches for the popcorn at the exact moment she does. Their hands bump, sending a few pieces flying. They both freeze, then silently laugh.

00:09–00:12
During a quiet scene, he whispers something to her. She tries not to laugh and covers her mouth. The camera captures both struggling to stay serious while people around them remain focused on the movie.

00:12–00:15
After the movie, they walk out into the lobby. She asks, “So… did you actually watch the movie?” He pauses and says, “Honestly? Not really.” She laughs and lightly pushes his shoulder as the camcorder zooms in too quickly and loses focus.

Audio: Cinema lobby chatter, ticket-machine sounds, popcorn bags, drink cups, footsteps, muffled movie audio, quiet laughter, whispered conversation, and natural theater ambience. No added music, no narration.

Comedic Direction: Keep the romance subtle and believable. Build the humor through nervous first-date behavior: double-checking tickets → almost dropping popcorn → accidental hand collision → trying not to laugh → admitting he barely watched the movie.

Goal: Create a nostalgic 2005 MiniDV memory of a genuine first cinema date—awkward, sweet, funny, and imperfect, like footage accidentally recorded by a friend before smartphones became the norm.

entries.prompt:
Moonlit ruin→slipped blade→seal shatter→particle cathedral.

Character reference, SERAINE from @[image 1]: chin length silver white short hair, a long fringe covering an eye, grey blue eyes, a cold and severe expression; silver plate armor covered in gilded scrollwork relief, a white cape, and a pale white kite shield slung on her back with a gold edged cross on its face. Light system (global rule, runs by the second): from 00:00 to 00:05, the only cold light in frame is blue moonlight falling through the collapsed dome, and the only warm light is a thin layer of white gold light on her blade; there is no other light source. At 00:05, the moment the seal shatters, the white gold light on her blade goes out and the sword turns back to cold steel. At 00:23 the rose window finishes assembling and light floods through its tracery into the nave. From 00:26 the particles solidify and the light settles into a soft, steady warm gold. The camera starts low behind her, with a corner of the kite shield on her back always pinned along the left edge of the frame. In midair the particles weave vault rib after vault rib, the ribs cross and close, patching the hole in the dome bay by bay. The camera glides along the closing ribs toward the high wall at the west end of the nave, where in the round opening the particles assemble a huge rose window petal by petal, finishing at 00:23.

The camera slowly backs away from the rose window and descends, pulling back along the central axis of the nave until the whole rebuilt cathedral opens up in frame: rows of stone pillars, the closed dome, the rose window. As the particles settle they solidify into real grey white stone and gilded ornament. The seal reassembles whole in its original place, and the sword is still standing straight up in its exact center. SERAINE rises to her feet beside the seal. 角色参考，来自 @[image 1] 的 SERAINE：齐下巴长的银白色短发，长长的刘海遮住一只眼睛，灰蓝色的眼睛，冷酷而严厉的表情；覆盖着镀金卷草纹浮雕的银色板甲，白色披风，背上挂着一面浅白色的鸢形盾，盾面上有一个金边的十字。头上没有角。在整个镜头中保持她的脸、头发、盔甲图案、盾牌和剑的设计一致。

灯光系统（全局规则，按秒运行）：从 00:00 到 00:05，画面中唯一的冷光是透过坍塌穹顶落下的蓝色月光，唯一的暖光是她剑刃上薄薄的一层白金光芒；没有其他光源。在 00:05，即封印破碎的瞬间，剑刃上的白金光芒熄灭，剑变回冷钢。从同一时刻起，从封印中涌出的粒子自身发出白金光芒，并成为画面中的主要光源；粒子来自破碎的封印，而不是来自剑。在 00:23，玫瑰窗组装完成，光线通过其花饰涌入中殿。从 00:26 开始，粒子固化，光线稳定为柔和、恒定的温暖金色。除了月光、剑刃、粒子和玫瑰窗外，画面中没有出现其他光源。

亮度（全局规则，按秒运行）：从 00:00 到 00:05，整体非常黑暗，只能辨认出人物轮廓、断裂柱子的剪影以及积水上的反射。00:05 破碎的瞬间必须明显比之前的任何帧更亮。从 00:05 到 00:23，随着建筑逐层重建，画面逐渐变亮，每一阶段都比上一阶段更亮。从 00:23 到 00:26 是作品中最明亮的部分，必须明显比 00:05 到 00:23 更亮。从 00:26 到 00:30，光线稳定为温暖的恒定光，明显比最明亮的部分暗，但明显比开头亮。

摄像机从她身后低处开始，她背上的鸢形盾的一个角始终固定在画面的左边缘。深夜，一座被留作废墟的哥特式大教堂的中殿：穹顶塌陷成一个大洞，石柱只剩下断桩，拱肋散落在地板上，地板湿滑，覆盖着瓦砾和积水。在中殿正中央的石板中嵌着一个直径约 2 米的圆形镀金神圣封印。从第一帧开始，SERAINE 右手持剑，剑尖指向身体一侧下方，整把剑清晰可见。她沿着中殿走向封印。

在 00:03，她踩在一块湿滑的瓦砾上，脚滑出，身体向前倾，本能地将剑向下刺以支撑自己；剑尖直接插入封印中心，剑身直立在那里。随后她的手从剑柄上滑落，跪倒在封印边缘。从此以后，剑一直直立在封印中心，从不倒下，从不移动，也没有人再触碰它。摄像机随着那次向下的刺击降至地面水平。封印从剑尖进入的点向外呈放射状裂纹，在 00:05，整个封印破碎，碎片分裂成无数微小粒子，从封印向各个方向涌出，如潮水般席卷整个中殿地板。从此以后，她一直跪在封印旁，直到最后站起来。

摄像机紧贴地面，并沿粒子流动的方向向前推进。粒子到达每根断裂柱子的底部，并从断裂处向上堆叠，逐节延伸每根柱子。摄像机沿着一根正在生长的柱子爬升，一直升到穹顶的高度。在半空中，粒子编织出一根又一根拱肋，拱肋交叉闭合，逐间修补穹顶的洞口。摄像机沿着闭合的拱肋滑向中殿西端的高墙，那里的圆形开口中，粒子一片片组装成一扇巨大的玫瑰窗，于 00:23 完成。

摄像机缓慢地从玫瑰窗后退并下降，沿着中殿的中轴线拉远，直到整座重建的大教堂出现在画面中：成排的石柱、封闭的穹顶、玫瑰窗。随着粒子沉降，它们固化为真正的灰白色石头和镀金装饰物。封印在其原始位置重新组装完整，剑仍然直立在封印的正中心。SERAINE 在封印旁站起身来。摄像机缓慢地从玫瑰窗后退并下降，沿着中殿的中轴线拉远，直到整座重建的大教堂出现在画面中：成排的石柱、封闭的穹顶、玫瑰窗。随着粒子沉降，它们固化为真正的灰白色石头和镀金装饰物。封印在其原始位置重新组装完整，剑仍然直立在封印的正中心。SERAINE 在封印旁站起身来。

entries.title: Korean Japchae Anime Cooking Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for creating a hand-painted 2D anime-style cooking film featuring Korean Japchae in a countryside setting, designed for Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-sec hand-painted 2D anime cooking film in the peaceful Korean countryside. Warm storybook lighting, soft watercolor textures, delicate backgrounds, gentle cel shading, natural hand-drawn motion, cozy cinematic atmosphere, appetizing food close-ups and steam.

STYLE/SETTING: Authentic Korean world: hanok homes, gray giwa roofs, stone walls, onggi jars, wooden fences, changhoji lattice windows, rice fields and green hills. No Japanese architecture, torii, tatami-focused interiors, Japanese text, CGI, logos, watermarks, UI, titles, captions, subtitles, or any on-screen text.

FOOD: Authentic Japchae (잡채): sweet-potato glass noodles, beef, carrot, onion, red pepper, spinach, shiitake, egg strips, soy-garlic sauce, sesame oil/seeds. Serve with white rice and kimchi. Keep the same home, hands, food design, lighting and visual style throughout.

0–3s: Hands carry a bamboo basket of fresh spinach, carrot, red pepper and shiitake through a Korean garden; hanok and onggi jars behind, warm sunlight, breeze, birds.

3–6s: Hands soak dangmyeon in a wooden bowl inside a traditional Korean kitchen.

6–9s: Close-up slicing carrot, onion and red pepper into thin strips.

9–12s: Slice shiitake, spinach, beef and thin egg omelette ribbons.

12–15s: Boil dangmyeon, rinse in cold water and drain; steam and translucent chewy noodles.

15–18s: Stir-fry beef with soy sauce, then carrot, pepper, mushrooms and spinach; sizzling steam.

18–22s: Mix soy-garlic sauce. Toss noodles, vegetables, beef and egg until glossy; add sesame oil and sesame seeds.

22–26s: Plate steaming Japchae on Korean ceramicware; colorful noodles, vegetables, beef and egg.

26–30s: Wide hanok interior: Japchae, white rice and kimchi on a low wooden table. Changhoji window reveals Korean hills, rice fields and distant hanok rooftops. Warm afternoon light, slow pull-back, hold final frame.

CAMERA: Mostly static illustrated close-ups, clean short cuts, gentle push-ins/pull-backs, minimal shake, no rapid cuts.

AUDIO: Birds, breeze, leaves, water, chopping, boiling and sizzling. No voiceover or dialogue. Optional very soft distant gayageum.

MOOD: Peaceful, nostalgic, intimate Korean countryside cooking memory. Consistent hand-painted 2D anime style from start to finish.

entries.title: Squid Game Style Thriller Trailer Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed, timestamped prompt for a 30-second cinematic survival-game trailer featuring Korean thriller aesthetics, rapid cuts, and specific action sequences.
entries.prompt:
30s cinematic survival-game trailer, dark Korean thriller aesthetic, rapid cuts, escalating tension, dramatic sound design, realistic live-action.

0–0.8s: Black screen, heartbeat, "PLAY." flashes.
0.8–1.6s: Drone descends into a huge pastel toy-like arena under grey skies.
1.6–2.2s: Trembling hands pin a numbered tag onto a player.
2.2–2.8s: Rows of motionless masked guards, geometric masks.
2.8–3.4s: Young Korean idol-like woman, sleek hair, striking features, simple tracksuit uniform, scared but determined, sweating.
3.4–4s: Giant animatronic doll slowly turns toward players.
4–4.4s: "RED LIGHT."
4.4–5s: Players freeze mid-stride.
5–6s: Player stumbles → gunshot → drops; crowd recoils.
6–7.2s: Panic and screaming, shaky camera, dust/debris in slow motion.
7.2–8.4s: White-knuckled hands on rope → two teams in brutal tug-of-war above a chasm.
8.4–9s: Rope snaps, players fall.
9–9.6s: Woman desperately pulls teammate from edge.
9.6–10.8s: Masked guards watch from glass walkway; mysterious ornate-mask figure watches monitors.
10.8–12s: Rapid flashes: marble, knife, glass bridge; player steps on glass and it shatters.
12–13.2s: Shattered glass suspended; woman's terrified face as she judges the gap.
13.2–14.4s: She leaps → lands hard and rolls, alive.
14.4–15s: Dozens of fallen players across colorful arena.
15–16.2s: Two survivors fight desperately; coin flips in slow motion.
16.2–17.4s: Her trembling hand reaches a final switch; guards raise weapons together.
17.4–18.6s: Childhood/pre-fame photos flash against her bloodied present; money rains over arena.
18.6–19.2s: She screams for a falling teammate.
19.2–20.4s: Rapid montage: knife fight, collapsing rope bridge, hands clawing at ledge; masked figure partially removes mask, face hidden.
20.4–21s: Woman stands alone under spotlight amid empty arena, breathing hard.
21–22.2s: Blood-red glitching title forms; rapid flashes of all game locations.
22.2–23s: Black screen: "Only one leaves the floor."
23–24s: Extreme close-up of her eyes snapping open, resolve hardened.
24–28s: Wide slow-motion hero shot: she stands amid wreckage, numbered tag torn away.
28–30s: Title/logo holds as score swells; final beat—doll's eyes snap open → hard cut to black.

Maintain exact character identity, Korean appearance, hairstyle, facial features, outfit and continuity throughout. Photorealistic cinematic lighting, high production value, realistic motion, visceral but non-graphic violence, fast trailer editing.

entries.title: Washroom Zombie Attack Sequence
entries.description: A tense horror prompt for a washroom attack scene involving a zombie woman, requiring strict character consistency with a reference image.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic Korean zombie-horror sequence inside a dim public washroom. Use << < image >>> as the exact reference for the zombie woman and keep her face, hair, body proportions and outfit consistent.

A young woman enters the washroom and washes her hands, unaware that the zombie woman is watching her through the mirror. The zombie slowly reveals pale skin, dark veins, twitching fingers and completely black eyes before suddenly attacking her. She grabs the victim, pins her against the tiled wall, and chases her when she escapes toward the exit.

The victim struggles to escape, but the zombie catches her again. Dark veins spread across the victim's neck and face as she convulses and collapses. Her eyes turn milky white and then black as she rises, now infected. The two infected women turn toward another person entering the washroom and suddenly charge at them.

End with the washroom lights flickering as the infected women stand motionless beneath the fluorescent lights, staring directly into the camera.

Style: photorealistic Korean zombie horror, claustrophobic tiled washroom, wet surfaces, cold fluorescent lighting, realistic skin, dark veins, terrifying eyes, unnatural but believable movements, handheld camera, practical-effects feel, natural reactions, no gore, no graphic injuries, no CGI look, no morphing, no duplicate characters, no distorted anatomy, no subtitles, no text, no watermark.

entries.title: Japanese Supernatural Train Thriller Prompt
entries.description: A detailed, timestamped prompt for a 30-second Japanese supernatural thriller set on a late-night train, focusing on atmospheric horror and surreal events.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic live-action Japanese supernatural thriller set inside a nearly empty Tokyo underground train station late at night

0–5 seconds:
A young Japanese woman runs down the empty platform while repeatedly looking behind her. The last train is about to leave. She reaches the train just before the doors close

5–10 seconds:
Inside the almost empty train, only three passengers are sitting silently. The woman catches her breath and looks through the window

The train starts moving

Suddenly, every passenger turns their head toward her at exactly the same time

She freezes

10–16 seconds:
The lights inside the train begin flickering. The digital station display changes rapidly between different station names before showing a station that does not exist

The train slows down

The woman looks outside

The train is passing through a completely dark underground tunnel filled with hundreds of motionless people standing beside the tracks

16–22 seconds:
The train suddenly stops

All three passengers slowly stand up and walk toward her without saying anything

She backs away and desperately presses the emergency button

Nothing happens

Then one passenger quietly points behind her

22–27 seconds:
She turns around

The train doors are now open

But instead of the platform, there is an identical train directly outside

Inside that train, she sees herself sitting alone

Her reflection slowly looks up and smiles

27–30 seconds:
The woman steps backward in terror

The doors suddenly close

The other passengers disappear

The train begins moving again

She looks at the window

Her reflection is no longer there

Cut to black

entries.title: Olympic Table Tennis Match
entries.description: A prompt for a photorealistic cinematic film of the final point in an Olympic table tennis match.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30 second photorealistic cinematic film of the final point in an Olympic style table tennis match. 16:9 widescreen. Two adult elite athletes: Player A wears deep cobalt blue and begins on camera left; Player B wears vivid coral red and begins on camera right. Keep their faces, uniforms, paddles, and sides of the table consistent throughout. One white ball is in play at all times.

0–5 seconds — The serve
Open at table height, looking along the white center line toward the net. The arena is dark, with a warm pool of light on the blue table and soft cyan and magenta light behind the players. Slowly dolly toward Player A, framed on the left third. Player A holds the ball on an open, still palm, tosses it nearly vertically, and strikes it on the way down. Hear a breath, a shoe squeak, and the sharp paddle contact.

5–10 seconds — Follow the ball
Track the serve low and clearly: the ball bounces once on Player A’s side, crosses above the net, and bounces once on Player B’s side. Player B returns it after that bounce. At the moment of paddle contact, use a brief extreme slow motion close up to reveal the brushing action and spin. A faint cyan reflection traces the ball’s actual path for an instant, then fades. The ball stays solid white.

10–21 seconds — The rally
Return to real speed. Show three clear back-and-forth returns between the players. For every return, the player strikes the ball once; it crosses the net, bounces once on the opponent’s side, and the opponent then strikes it. Preserve the ball’s direction and position across every cut. Alternate a readable wide side view with close shots of footwork, eyes, and paddle contact. One low shot follows a return just above net height. Then rise to an overhead view where the blue table becomes a clean geometric shape and each player occupies an opposite third of the frame.

21–27 seconds — The deciding shot
Player B sends a fast angled return that bounces once on Player A’s side. Player A lunges and reaches it before a second bounce. Player A’s counter crosses the net and lands once near the far corner of Player B’s side. Stretch only this decisive movement into slow motion. The camera moves laterally with the ball while both players remain spatially clear. Player B reaches but cannot touch it; the ball kicks away after its first bounce.

27–30 seconds — The result
Return to real speed as the ball lands on the floor beyond Player B. Hold briefly on Player A’s stunned expression before the crowd erupts. End on a wide arena shot: the table glows at center, Player A stands in the left third, and Player B remains in the right third. Let the final image breathe.

entries.title: Subway Platform Fashion Video
entries.description: A prompt for a 9-second photorealistic fashion video featuring a woman on a subway platform with motion-blurred trains, specifying character details, camera angles, and mood.
entries.prompt: Photoreal cinematic ~9 seconds, high-end fashion-film look. A young woman with long wavy blonde hair, olive-tan skin, sharp brows, and glossy lips. A pale pink flower is pinned behind her right ear. She wears a light blue spaghetti-strap mini dress with small black polka dots and carries a woven straw shoulder bag. Soft glam makeup, gold jewelry, warm skin highlights. Location: underground subway platform at night. Yellow safety strip on the platform edge, tiled walls, overhead fluorescent lights. A silver metro train streaks behind her in heavy motion blur — windows, doors, and at one moment an Japanese flag graphic on the passing car. Shot sequence, continuous energy: Medium close-up, she looks over her shoulder into camera while the train screams past behind her. Profile: she brings a lip wand or finger to her mouth, applying gloss as hair lifts in the train wind. She turns, hair swinging, eyes on camera, slight smirk. Wider on the platform: she touches her collarbone / strap, dress and bag readable, train still moving in the background. Head tipped back, hair flying, chin up, train with the flag ripping through frame. She looks back and smiles. Fast hair flip — hand rakes through hair, back partly to camera. Tight close-up: she blows a kiss to lens, fingers near lips, flower still in hair. Camera: mixed handheld fashion-cam and locked beauty close-ups. Shallow depth of field on her face, background train smeared into silver-and-light streaks. Practical station lighting plus a warm key on her skin. Color: creamy highlights, rich dark hair, the pink flower and red lips pop against cool subway metal. Motion: hair and dress always moving from train rush / her own turns. No extra people in focus. Mood: confident, flirty, summer-night city girl, music-video energy. Audio direction: upbeat dance-pop / Latin-pop, lyrics in the vein of “she got that vibe… dance all night… eyes on me.” Train rumble low under the track. entries.prompt:
**CAMERA:**
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself, occasionally propping it on a rack or bench. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.

**LOOK:**
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights under gym lighting, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones.

**STYLE:**
Playful, self-deprecating gym-vlog tone — exaggerated complaining, genuine laughs, exhausted-but-amused energy. Quick handheld cuts, slightly wobbly camera movement matching her shaky legs.

**Character**

CHASE — Korean idol in her 20s. Long black hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin with a heavy post-workout sheen, big expressive eyes. Slim athletic build. Modest long-sleeve athletic top, loose joggers/leggings (arms and torso fully covered), sneakers, towel around neck, no jewelry.

**Setting**

A gym in the evening — squat rack, leg press machine, a water fountain across the room, mirror wall, soft overhead lighting.

**Storyboard**

1. *(~2s, propped camera at squat rack, medium shot)* She stands, hands on hips, catching her breath, dramatic exhale. CHASE: "Okay... leg day is not it today."

2. *(~2s, handheld, close on her face)* She winces, shaking out one leg, laughing at herself. CHASE: "Why did I do that many reps—"

3. *(~2s, medium propped shot, leg press machine)* She sits down, pushes through a rep, face straining, then flops back with a groan. CHASE: "Okay that's it, I'm done, I'm so done."

4. *(~1.5s, macro insert, shallow DOF)* Close-up on her hand gripping the machine handle, knuckles slightly tense. No dialogue — ambient gym sound only.

5. *(~2s, handheld, walking, camera wobbling)* She stands up and immediately wobbles, grabbing the rack for balance, bursting into laughter. CHASE: "Wait— okay my legs are literally shaking—"

6. *(~2s, handheld, unsteady walk)* She takes exaggerated, wobbly steps toward the water fountain, camera bouncing with her uneven gait. CHASE (laughing): "This is so embarrassing, someone help me—"

7. *(~1.5s, close handheld, at the fountain)* She leans down for a sip of water, sighs in relief, wipes her mouth with the back of her hand. CHASE: "Okay... water is life right now."

8. *(~2s, arm's-length selfie finish)* She leans against the wall, still catching her breath, grinning tiredly at the lens. CHASE: "Never doing legs again — see you guys, I'm going to go lie down somewhere."

[Stage 1] 0.0–1.5s — LANDING
Initial state: <Hyo> is already descending, bike level, straw dust trailing behind.
Primary event: she presses the bike down and both wheels slam the landing ramp almost together; suspension compresses deep, a burst of dust fires out sideways.
End state: both wheels planted, suspension at full compression, her body squashed low over the bars.

[Stage 2] 1.5–4.5s — REBOUND AND ACCELERATE
Continue from the previous stage: same rider, same bike, camera still behind her.
Primary event: the suspension springs back and she stands on the pedals, hammering a fast cadence straight down the dirt track, dust tail streaming behind her.
End state: fully upright on the pedals at full speed, track running dead straight ahead of her.

[Stage 3] 4.5–8.5s — FLAT-OUT RUN
Primary event: she rips past the line of straw bales on her left; the bales, the stubble edge and the track texture streak past and out of frame; her buns and the hem of her windbreaker snap in the wind, settling a beat after her body.
End state: the second dirt lip is now filling the lower frame ahead of her.

[Stage 4] 8.5–11.5s — QUICK HOP
Primary event: she pops the second lip, gets a short sharp half-second of air with the bike tucked, and lands both wheels immediately, a hard crunch and rebound without losing any speed.
End state: back on the track at full speed, still accelerating.

[Stage 5] 11.5–15.0s — RUN-IN AND LAUNCH
Primary event: she drives at the main take-off mound, gloves tight on the bars, body loading as the lip rushes up under her front wheel, then the front wheel leaves the lip and she rises into the air.
End state (loop-ready): the exact composition of [Image 1] — seen from behind, low angle, airborne off the lip, bike level, gold field below her wheels.

CAMERA — one continuous chase shot. The camera rides roughly 3m behind her rear wheel at about 80cm height, matching her speed so she stays the same size in frame while the ground rushes underneath. Her BACK stays to the lens for all 15 seconds. No cuts, no zoom. The camera never orbits ahead of her, never swings to her side or front, never shows her face, never reverses.

PHYSICS — true parabolas, honest suspension compression and rebound, dust and straw lifting and settling at their own weight.

AUDIO — ASMR ambient/diegetic only: wind roaring past her ears, tyres crunching and drumming on packed dirt, suspension hissing through its stroke, fast freehub buzz and chain whir, stubble rattling the frame. No narration, no voiceover, no dialogue, no music.

NEGATIVE / FAILED TAKE CONDITIONS — No slow motion, no hovering, no floating, no hang time longer than 1.5 seconds; any drifting or slow-motion feel = failed take. No front view, no side view, no face visible, no camera orbit = failed take. A second person or a second bike = failed take. A crash or a foot down = failed take. No summer clothing. No dark, dusk, foggy, sunset or night grading = failed take. No on-screen text, captions, logos or watermarks. No photoreal or 3D CG rendering.

entries.title: Vesra Sword Fight Awakening Prompt
entries.description: A complex cinematic prompt for generating a sword fight scene involving a character named Vesra, focusing on red light dynamics and weather effects.
entries.prompt:
Storm last stand→crack awakening→feather blade volley→red blade cleave.

Character reference, VESRA from @[image 1]: waist length silver hair, red eyes with red eyeshadow, black cracks bursting sideways from the corners of her eyes toward both sides (not tear tracks running down); a black armored corset with cutouts at the sides of the waist and on the legs, a thigh band on her right leg, a pair of black wings on her back with dark red inner feathers, and a red energy longsword. No horns on her head. Keep her face, the direction of the cracks, the armor patterning and the sword design consistent for the whole shot.

Red light system (global rule, runs by the second): from 00:00 to 00:09 there is no red light anywhere in frame, and her blade and armor plates are cold grey steel. At 00:09 the cracks at the corners of her eyes and her pupils light up red first. At 00:11, when the feathers fire, the entire edge of every feather lights up a clear dark red, and the feather blades drag clearly visible red trails through the curtain of rain; the red in this beat must take up a real area of the frame, not a thin edge you can barely see. At 00:15, once the sword is back in her hand, red light spreads along the already formed blade from the guard toward the tip, fully covering it by 00:17. After 00:27 the red on the sword draws in to a single thin line along the edge without going out completely, and that thin red line is still visible at the end. Apart from her sword, her eyes, the cracks and the feather edges, no other red light source appears in frame.

Brightness (global rule, runs by the second): from 00:00 to 00:03, apart from the few frames where lightning flashes, the frame is almost fully black, showing only the edge outlines of the figures and the broken pillars with no detail at all. From 00:03 to 00:08 it is a little brighter than the first 3 seconds but still very dark overall, and shapes are read by the reflections off the standing water on the ground. From 00:09 to 00:14 her cracks and feathers are the only light in frame. From 00:17 to 00:24 the red light lights up the entire middle ground. From 00:25 to 00:26 the red light of the explosion fills the whole frame, its brightest point close to pure white overexposure; this is the brightest beat of the piece and must be clearly brighter than the stretch from 00:17 to 00:24. From 00:27 to 00:30 it falls back to dark, with only the faint glow of embers left on the ground.

The camera starts low, pressed against the wet stone surface, with a stretch of her black wing always pinned along the bottom edge of the frame. The top of a ruined gothic cathedral in a rainstorm, a broken bell tower platform hanging high in the air, the ground covered in fallen pillars and rubble, standing water reflecting the lightning. From the first frame VESRA holds the longsword in her right hand, the blade clearly visible and, for now, cold grey steel with no red light at all. A giant stone winged demon reaches a huge claw down from the top of the frame and clamps onto her pauldron, the claw staying in frame the whole time, and flings her against the broken pillars again and again, the sword staying in her right hand throughout. The instant she crashes into the water the longsword is knocked out of her palm: you can see it leave her fingers and spin across the surface of the water, coming to rest in the water an arm's length to her left, and it lies in that exact spot from then on until she takes hold of it again. The camera never leaves the ground, tracking sideways with the direction she is thrown, and rain hitting the front of the lens leaves water streaks.

The camera pushes in along the surface of the water to her face: silver hair plastered to the side of her face, blood mixed with rain running down. She looks up, and the black cracks at the corners of her eyes spread and widen toward both sides, red light showing through from deep inside them. She digs her fingers into the cracks in the stone under the water and pushes her upper body up.

The black wings on her back snap open to their full span, and right after that the feathers peel off the wing surfaces row by row and become dozens of black feather blades fired all at once, each one dragging a vivid dark red trail through the curtain of rain, driving into the stone demon's chest and both wings, forcing it back half a step and punching several holes through its stone wings. The camera pans with the feather blades through the rain and passes a close up of a single feather blade in flight.

Once the feather blades are in the stone demon, the camera travels back along the ground from the stone demon to her side and settles on her right hand and the sword an arm's length away, with no cut in between. She reaches out, takes hold of the hilt and lifts the sword out of the water. The sword's length, width and outline follow the character sheet strictly and stay exactly the same from the moment it is in her hand to the end of the piece, never growing longer, never deforming and never producing an extended light blade. Once her grip is steady, red light spreads along the already formed blade from the guard toward the tip, fully covering it by 00:17, and after that only its brightness changes.

The stone demon rips the feather blades out of its chest and lunges, and she drops her center of gravity and passes under its belly. Through this pass the blade stays a metal sword wrapped in red light, the guard, the edge and the tip always distinguishable, and the sword does not grow longer for even a single frame. When the tip scrapes the stone, what lights up is the stone itself: sparks and a red scorch mark stay on the ground behind her, and that scorch mark belongs to the ground, not to the sword, and is not connected to the blade. The camera follows this pass at ground level.

After passing through she turns and leaps, and the camera circles halfway around her, sweeping in turn across her back, her open black wings and the head of the stone demon as it turns. At the peak of the jump she brings the sword down with both hands, the red sword light tearing open the whole curtain of rain, and cleaves the stone demon apart on a diagonal from shoulder to waist, top to bottom. A ring of dark red energy bursts out from the cut and pushes outward in a circle, blasting all the surrounding raindrops apart into mist.

The stone demon's body breaks apart along the cut, the grey white inner stone grain showing at the break, big chunks of stone and broken pieces of its wings crash into the water and throw up huge splashes, and the rubble rolls across the ground until it comes to rest. VESRA lands in the foreground at the edge of the platform, her back to the camera, black wings half folded, the tip of her sword angled down at the ground, a thin red line still left along its edge. The camera slowly pulls back, the visual weight stretching out toward the rain flooded abyss behind her, and the frame returns to dark, with only the embers in the cracks of the rubble still glowing.

The rain streaks, splashes and mist of the storm should feel physically real, light falloff should follow real optics, and movement paths should obey gravity and inertia. entries.description: A prompt for a high-end game cinematic featuring a robot manipulating crystals in an alien landscape.
entries.prompt:
**STYLE / GLOBAL LOOK:**Hyper-realistic next-gen game cinematic, Unreal Engine 5 quality, ray-traced lighting, physically based materials, volumetric atmosphere, subtle film grain, anamorphic lens flares, shallow depth of field, motion blur. Color palette: burnt amber, molten gold, and copper crystal spires under a turbulent emerald-teal sky with thick rolling clouds lit from within. Accents of acid-green bioluminescent crystal energy. Mood: mysterious, powerful, ancient alien world. Smooth continuous camera moves, seamless flowing cuts, no jitter, no morphing, consistent character design throughout.

**CHARACTER — THE ROBOT:**
A slender bipedal robot roughly human height. Large smooth spherical head, dark oxidized bronze-black metal with fine engraved geometric etchings and faint scratches. Two large glowing emerald-green almond-shaped eyes that pulse with inner light and cast green light onto the face plating. Two articulated ear-like antenna fins on each side of the head that twitch and swivel expressively. Segmented ribbed torso and limbs made of layered dark bronze plating with visible pistons, exposed cables, and thin green glowing energy seams at the joints. Rounded shoulder and hip joints. Movement is fluid, weighted, and agile — like a martial artist, with anticipation, follow-through, and secondary motion in the fins and cables. Green eye glow intensifies when channeling power.

**ENVIRONMENT:**
An endless field of colossal jagged crystal spires, 10–40 meters tall, sharp translucent amber-gold shards with internal refraction, caustics, and glowing veins. Ground is cracked dusty golden sediment with scattered crystal fragments and drifting glowing dust motes. Sky is a swirling stormy emerald-teal with god rays breaking through clouds. Faint heat haze and floating particles everywhere.

---

**SHOT 1 (0.0s – 1.5s) — OPENING:**
Fade in from pure black. A single green glow emerges in darkness, resolving into the robot's eyes igniting. Low ambient hum.

**SHOT 2 (1.5s – 7s) — MEDIUM LOW ANGLE, THE BEND:**
Cut to a low-angle medium shot from behind and slightly below the robot, looking up past its shoulder toward the sky. The robot stands in a wide grounded stance among the towering amber spires. It raises its right arm in a slow, deliberate, martial-arts style motion, palm open. In front of it a large faceted emerald-green crystal octahedron levitates, rotating slowly, trailing glowing green particles and refracting light. The robot's fingers flex and the crystal responds — pulsing, spinning faster, energy arcs crackling between its palm and the crystal. Camera slowly orbits a few degrees to the right and pushes in gently, revealing the robot's profile. Wind blows dust across the ground. Amber spires refract the green glow.

**SHOT 3 (7s – 11.5s) — EXTREME CLOSE-UP, THE FACE:**
Seamless cut to a tight close-up on the robot's head, slightly off-center, amber crystal walls softly out of focus behind. The huge green eyes burn brighter, light rippling across the polished dark bronze plating and engraved patterns. Its ear fins swivel forward with a mechanical click. The head tilts slowly upward with focused intent, tiny servo movements, a reflection of the floating green crystal visible in its eye. Subtle rack focus from the etched metal surface to the eyes. Green rim light on one side, warm amber bounce on the other.

**SHOT 4 (11.5s – 17s) — EPIC WIDE, THE FIELD:**
Cut to a sweeping wide shot: the camera glides high and slow across the vast forest of amber crystal spires stretching to the horizon under the churning teal storm sky. The robot is a tiny silhouette in the center clearing, arms spread wide. As the camera drifts forward and slightly downward, the ground begins to tremble — dust lifts, small crystal shards vibrate and float upward, green light pulses beneath the surface cracks radiating out from the robot. Lightning flickers inside the clouds. Volumetric god rays sweep across the spires.

**SHOT 5 (17s – 24s) — THE ERUPTION:**
Dynamic cut to a low, fast tracking shot skimming just above the ground toward the robot. The robot drops into a powerful crouch, then thrusts both arms upward with explosive force. Clusters of jagged emerald-green crystals burst violently out of the golden ground in a shockwave ring, growing and fracturing outward in slow motion, shards spinning through the air catching light, dust and debris flying toward the camera. The camera whips around the robot in a fast 180-degree arc as spires of green crystal spear upward around it, refracting and casting brilliant green caustics over everything. Energy trails, sparks, and floating glass-like fragments fill the frame with heavy depth of field and motion blur.

**SHOT 6 (24s – 28s) — HERO POSE:**
Cut to a slow-motion medium-low angle. The robot lands in a stable stance, arms lowering with follow-through, ear fins settling, surrounded by newly formed towering green crystals glowing against the amber spires. Its eyes flare one final time, the crystal above it rotating serenely. Debris drifts down gently. Camera slowly pulls back and tilts up toward the stormy sky.

**SHOT 7 (28s – 30s) — OUTRO:**
The green glow overwhelms the frame, then a hard cut to black. Two thin horizontal glitching white streaks of distorted static flicker on the black screen for a beat, then vanish.

---

**NEGATIVE / AVOID:**
Low-poly, flat shading, cartoon look, plastic textures, stiff or robotic jerky animation, character morphing, extra limbs, text, watermarks, camera shake, flicker, blurry faces, inconsistent design between shots.

Arman and Tavara charge from opposite directions, forging TWO GOLDEN BLADES and TWO SERRATED BLOOD BLADES mid-motion.

「オラァッ！」 「ハッ！」

Arman super-dashes through the storm, his golden blades merging into ONE MASSIVE GOLDEN KATANA.

Tavara forms a MASSIVE BLOOD TRIDENT. Both accelerate toward each other.

TRIDENT × GOLDEN KATANA.

KRAAA-BOOOOM!

━━━━━━━━━━━━
SCENE 2 — FINAL DEATH CLASH
━━━━━━━━━━━━

START EXACTLY FROM THE WEAPON LOCK. SAME CRATER. SAME DAMAGE. NO RESET.

Tavara transforms the trident into a MASSIVE BLOOD SCYTHE. Arman evades as it tears through the battlefield.

Hundreds of blood spears erupt from the ground. Arman super-dashes through them toward Tavara.

Golden energy compresses into ONE MASSIVE KATANA.

「ここで終わらせるッ！」

Tavara forms a massive crimson wave. Arman launches forward and cuts directly through it.

FINAL DISTANCE CLOSED.

ONE STEP. ONE ROTATION. ONE FINAL SLASH.

「終わりだッ！」

POINT-BLANK GOLDEN DETONATION.

Crater expands. Rocks, ash and smoke explode outward. Burned trees collapse.

Smoke clears.

Tavara lies defeated.

Arman lowers the Golden Katana.

CUT TO BLACK.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Japanese horror-action sequence set inside a crowded traditional Japanese night market during a busy evening

0–5 seconds:
A vibrant night market is packed with people, glowing lanterns, food stalls and narrow crowded streets. A young female vendor suddenly notices every customer around her becoming completely still at the exact same moment. A steaming bowl falls from her hand and crashes onto the ground. She looks around in confusion as the entire market goes silent

5–10 seconds:
Without warning, every lantern in the market goes out simultaneously. A terrifying scream erupts from somewhere deep inside the market. People suddenly start running in panic as a mysterious blood-covered man crashes through a food stall. The vendor grabs a frightened little girl and pulls her away from the crowd

10–17 seconds:
The vendor drags the girl through a narrow alley between market stalls while terrified people rush past them. Behind them, several infected figures begin chasing through the market. She spots a small metal service door and forces it open, pushing the girl inside

17–23 seconds:
They enter a dark storage corridor beneath the market. The vendor locks the door behind them. Heavy impacts suddenly begin hitting the other side. She grabs a metal pole and slowly backs away with the girl

23–27 seconds:
The impacts suddenly stop

Complete silence

The vendor looks at the locked door

Then a quiet voice whispers from behind them

“Don’t open that door”

The vendor freezes

27–30 seconds:
She slowly turns around

The little girl is standing completely still

Her eyes are now unnaturally dark

The girl smiles

Cut to black

entries.prompt:
SCENE — KATEN KYŌKOTSU: KARAMATSU SHINJŪ
DURATION: exactly 10 seconds
FORMAT: 16:9
STYLE: ultra-photorealistic live-action cinematic fantasy action, grounded CGI, desaturated palette, high-contrast lighting, realistic anatomy and physics, dark supernatural atmosphere, cinematic Japanese tragedy, practical environmental interaction, no digital-art appearance.
PACE: extremely fast continuous escalation, zero pause, zero dead frame.

REFERENCES
IMAGE 1 — PAKSHUN
Preserve facial identity, hairstyle, costume, proportions, and appearance exactly.

IMAGE 2 — OPPONENT
Preserve facial identity, hairstyle, costume, proportions, and appearance exactly.

ACTION

0.0–2.0 SECONDS — BANKAI
Tight rear three-quarter shot. Opponent charges. Pakshun lowers his sword and says: 「卍解……花天狂骨枯松心中。」
A violent pressure wave tears across the ground. Dust, leaves, debris, and hundreds of dark petals rise. The environment rapidly desaturates into black, grey, and pale tones. Camera performs a fast 360° orbit as Opponent closes in.

2.0–4.0 SECONDS — SHARED WOUND
Opponent attacks. Pakshun pivots and cuts across his torso. An identical wound instantly appears on Pakshun. A thin crimson thread connects both wounds as Opponent retreats. The ground cracks beneath it and black water erupts upward.

A massive wave floods the battlefield. Camera dives underwater seamlessly. Both characters struggle violently against the current, with realistic movement of soaked clothing, hair, debris, and petals. Pakshun plants his feet and pulls one hand back. The entire current suddenly freezes in turbulent suspension.

Pakshun rises through the suspended water. Countless thin white threads spread behind him into a huge web. Opponent tries to escape, but threads catch his wrist, arms, torso, and legs, tightening and dragging him toward the center. Pakshun advances. Camera rapidly pulls back to reveal the full structure.

8.5–10.0 SECONDS — HAKKA NO TOGAME
Pakshun grips one primary thread and pulls once. Every thread becomes violently taut. Water erupts outward and dark petals explode across the frame. Pakshun makes a minimal sword-draw motion. One sharp white cutting line tears across the composition.

SMASH CUT TO BLACK. One sharp sword-slash sound. END.

VISUAL RULES

- Both characters remain active throughout.
- No teleportation, transformations, NPC behavior, or static posing.
- No glowing anime aura or excessive energy beams.
- All water, debris, fabric, hair, petals, and threads obey believable physics.
- Grounded CGI integrated into live-action photography.
- Every action directly causes the next event.
- Continuous movement, zero pauses, zero dead frames.
- No unnecessary movement or ending hero pose.

entries.description: A prompt for creating a fast-paced anime-style cooking video demonstrating how to make katsudon.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second fast-paced cinematic Japanese anime cooking video showing the preparation of authentic katsudon, entirely from the text description below.

IMPORTANT: Do not display, recreate, trace, reference, or imitate any storyboard, sketch, reference image, panel, annotation, or source material. Generate only original anime-style animation.
