High-quality Japanese anime film style, cinematic summer lighting, ultra-detailed food textures, realistic cooking physics, visible steam and moisture, shallow depth of field, macro close-ups, smooth camera movement, warm Japanese kitchen atmosphere. Fast rhythmic editing with natural match cuts based on movement, shape, texture, and composition.

TIMELINE

0–2.5s — Prepare Pork Close-up of hands pounding a thick pork loin with a wooden mallet on a cutting board. The meat gradually flattens and its fibers loosen. Sprinkle salt and pepper evenly. Crisp rhythmic impacts.

2.5–5s — Bread the Pork Quick match cuts: press the pork into flour, dip into beaten egg, then firmly coat with coarse panko breadcrumbs. Show realistic egg dripping and breadcrumbs adhering to the surface.

5–7.5s — Fry Lower the breaded pork into hot golden oil. Intense bubbling surrounds the cutlet as the crust turns golden brown and crispy. Warm cinematic lighting and detailed oil movement.

7.5–9.5s — Slice Place the fried tonkatsu on a wooden board. A sharp knife cuts it into even strips. The crispy crust cracks naturally, revealing juicy white pork with gentle steam escaping.

9.5–12s — Simmer Dashi & Onion Thinly sliced onions gently simmer in amber dashi inside a shallow pan. Small bubbles rise while the onions become translucent. Chopsticks gently move them through the broth.

12–14s — Add Tonkatsu Place the sliced tonkatsu carefully over the simmering onions using chopsticks. The broth begins soaking into the crispy edges while steam rises.

14–16.5s — Pour Egg Slowly pour beaten golden egg over the tonkatsu and onions. The egg spreads naturally through the gaps and begins setting around the hot edges.

16.5–19s — Set the Egg Close-up of the egg gently coagulating over low heat. Edges become soft and golden while the center remains glossy, slightly runny, and trembling. No stirring.

19–21s — Prepare Rice A white ceramic donburi bowl receives a generous mound of steaming Japanese short-grain rice. The rice looks fluffy and slightly glossy.

21–24s — Assemble Carefully slide the egg-and-tonkatsu mixture from the pan onto the rice. The egg settles naturally in a soft wave while dashi lightly absorbs into the rice.

24–26s — Final Close-Up The finished katsudon rests on the counter. Glossy egg slowly settles over the tonkatsu and rice, gently trembling. Slow cinematic push-in.

26–30s — Hero Reveal Present the finished katsudon in a traditional blue-and-white ceramic bowl on a wooden surface. Golden egg cover

entries.title: UFO Cow Abduction Smartphone Video Prompt

entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second, vertical ultra-realistic smartphone video filmed THROUGH THE FRONT WINDSHIELD of a stationary car beside a rural highway. ONE continuous handheld recording.

VIEWPOINT AND WEATHER

An unseen man films from the front passenger seat. An unseen woman sits beside him in the driver’s seat. Only their voices are heard.

A narrow strip of dashboard remains along the bottom of the image. Rain beads on the windshield, and working wipers periodically clear the view. Focus stays on the scene outside.

Wind, rain, low fog, and dull overcast daylight. Wet asphalt, roadside grass bending in gusts, and a muddy cattle pasture immediately beside the road.

Natural phone exposure, slight hand shake, mild compression, and occasional autofocus hesitation. Everything has the texture of an unexpected event recorded through wet glass.

SCENE

A large, solid, weathered grey flying saucer hovers low above the nearby pasture. Its underside has a broad, open circular hatch.

A faint shaft of pale light connects the opening to a black-and-white cow below. Rain and mist make the shaft visible without washing out the cow or the surrounding landscape.

A farmer in a rain-soaked work jacket, muddy jeans, and rubber boots is already running toward his cow.

The cow, farmer, and spacecraft are all close enough to remain recognizable from the car. Keep their positions consistent throughout.

CONTINUOUS ACTION

Start with the cow’s hooves already lifting off the grass. Her body rises slowly beneath the spacecraft and begins turning around its vertical axis. Her legs move independently as she struggles to find the ground.

The farmer reaches her while her hind legs are still within reach. He jumps and grabs ONE rear leg with BOTH hands.

Show the actual grab: his hands close around the lower leg, his grip holds, and his boots lift clear of the ground as the cow continues rising.

He shouts in panic:

“My cow! My cow!”

The woman inside the car urgently tells the person filming:

“Film it! Film it!”

The view zooms in toward the farmer and cow with a slightly uneven smartphone digital zoom. Fine detail becomes a little softer during the zoom. Keep their entire bodies visible.

The farmer is now hanging beneath the cow, both hands still gripping the SAME rear leg. His own legs dangle and swing freely. The cow continues slowly rotating, carrying him around with her; his weight makes him sway beneath the attachment point.

He does not climb onto her back or begin flying independently.

The view tilts upward as they ascend together toward the open hatch. The rain, wiper movement, and slight camera shake continue throughout.

The pull becomes stronger. The cow rises into the broad underside opening, followed by the farmer still hanging from her leg. Their movement remains continuous and visible until the cow and then the farmer disappear inside.

Complete the abduction by approximately twelve seconds, leaving the final moments for the witnesses’ reactions.

The man filming says, breathless:

“Oh my God!”

The woman immediately asks:

“Did you get that? Did you get that?”

Hold on the hovering spacecraft through the rain-streaked windshield. The empty shaft of light remains over the patch of grass where the cow was standing.

End abruptly at 15 seconds.

REALISM AND AUDIO

The cow has believable weight, fur, anatomy, and joint movement. The farmer visibly strains to maintain his grip. Rain darkens his clothes, wind moves loose fabric, and his body hangs downward throughout the ascent.

The unexplained lifting force comes from the spacecraft. Everything else reacts with ordinary weight and inertia.

Natural recorded sound only: rain striking the car, windshield wipers, wind through a slightly open side window, a cow’s distressed lowing, the farmer’s distant shouts, a subdued mechanical rumble from the craft, and the nearby voices inside the car.

All dialogue is English. The farmer sounds farther away than the two people inside. Their reactions are startled and spontaneous.

One continuous shot at normal speed. No cuts, external views, slow motion, or separate reaction shots. The recording device remains unseen.

No music, cinematic sound effects, subtitles, captions, watermark, or recording interface.

entries.title: Paper Plane Anime Chase Prompt
entries.description: A complex prompt for generating a 30-second anime video of a boy chasing a paper plane over a flower field, transitioning to a classroom scene, using Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
[Image 1] is the first frame. It defines the opening composition: a boy flying horizontally just above a flower field, facing screen left, with a strongly tilted horizon and large white cosmos flowers in the low foreground.
<Boy> corresponds to [Image 1]. Use his face, messy dark brown hair, white short-sleeve shirt, body proportions, and the hand-painted 2D anime art style.
<Flower Field> references [Image 1]. Use its rolling hills with bands of white cosmos, pink and yellow flowers, the distant green valley, and the bright blue summer sky with towering cumulus clouds.
<Paper Plane> is a single small white folded paper airplane. There is only one paper plane in the entire video.

[Generation Goal]
Generate a 30-second cinematic anime short with a story. <Boy> flies low over <Flower Field> at more than 100 km/h, chasing <Paper Plane>. The world flips upside down during the chase. When he finally catches the plane, time freezes, and the camera pulls back to reveal the whole flight was a crayon drawing in a sketchbook on the desk of a boy napping in a 1990s Korean classroom on a summer afternoon.

[Stage 1 | 0-4 seconds | The chase begins]
Initial state: exactly the composition of [Image 1].
Primary event: far ahead of <Boy>, <Paper Plane> glides toward screen left, catching the sunlight. <Boy> sees it, laughs, and accelerates. A burst of petals tears loose beneath him and streams past the camera.
End state: <Boy> is racing toward screen left just above the flowers, <Paper Plane> ahead of him.

[Stage 2 | 4-11 seconds | Skimming the flowers]
Primary event: the camera swings in front of <Boy> and races backward just above the flower heads like an FPV drone. <Paper Plane> dips and loops playfully just out of reach. <Boy> stretches out his hand, his fingertips brushing the tops of the cosmos.
Speed cues: in his wake the flowers bend flat in a rippling wave line and spring back up; foreground flowers streak into motion blur while the distant hills drift slowly; his hair and shirt are pressed flat by the wind.
End state: <Paper Plane> climbs away upward. <Boy> follows it.

[Stage 3 | 11-17 seconds | The world flips]
Primary event: <Boy> performs a slow barrel roll while chasing <Paper Plane>. In one continuous take, the camera rolls 180 degrees with him. The world turns upside down: <Flower Field> now hangs overhead like a ceiling of blossoms, and the sea of cumulus clouds spreads below. Petals fall upward toward the flowers. <Boy> flies inverted, reaching for the plane, his hair floating.
End state: the camera completes the roll back to upright. <Boy> is right behind <Paper Plane>, just above the flowers again.

[Stage 4 | 17-21 seconds | The catch]
Primary event: <Boy> lunges forward and his fingers close around <Paper Plane>. At the moment of contact, time slows to a near stop: petals freeze in midair, the flowers stop swaying, and his wide eyes reflect the sunlight. Bounce speed ramp into extreme slow motion.
End state: <Boy> holds <Paper Plane> in his hand, suspended above the frozen flower field.

[Stage 5 | 21-30 seconds | Waking up]
Primary event: the camera pulls back rapidly in one continuous move. The entire frozen scene flattens and becomes a crayon and colored-pencil drawing on a sketchbook page, the same flower field, sky, and flying boy now drawn in a child's hand. The camera keeps pulling back to reveal the sketchbook lying on a worn wooden school desk in a sunlit 1990s Korean classroom: green chalkboard, white curtains billowing in the breeze through an open window, a slowly turning ceiling fan. <Boy>, wearing the same white short-sleeve shirt, is asleep with his cheek resting on his folded arms beside the sketchbook, smiling slightly.
End state: in <Boy>'s loosely open hand on the desk rests the same white <Paper Plane>. A single real white cosmos petal drifts in through the window and lands softly on the drawing. The curtain settles.

[Visual Style]
Hand-painted 2D anime art with painterly cumulus clouds, crisp character linework, saturated summer blues and greens, strong warm sunlight. The classroom has soft golden afternoon light and dust motes floating in the air. Nostalgic, euphoric summer mood.

[Audio]
Stage 1-3: (Uplifting orchestral strings and piano building steadily, swelling during the world flip) <Roaring wind rushing past, rising with speed> <Soft whoosh of brushed flowers>. <Boy> laughs breathlessly once. No spoken dialogue.
Stage 4: all music and wind cut out instantly. Only a single soft heartbeat and a thin high whistle of air.
Stage 5: <Cicadas singing outside the window> <Curtains fluttering> <Ceiling fan humming> <A distant school bell> (A single gentle piano melody returns softly at the very end).

[Maintain Consistency]
Keep exactly one boy throughout, with the same face, hair, and white short-sleeve shirt, both flying and asleep. Keep exactly one <Paper Plane>. Keep his hands anatomically stable with five fingers. Keep the direction of flight mostly toward screen left. Do not add other characters in the field or in the classroom.

entries.prompt:

A naturally pretty Korean woman in her early 20s, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, long black hair tied in a loose low ponytail. Keep the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and appearance throughout.

SETTING:
A small traditional Korean countryside farm on a warm summer afternoon. Old wooden barn, cows, hay, buckets, farming tools, green fields and simple farmhouse surroundings. Everything should feel authentic, ordinary and lived-in.

CAMERA:
The camera is ALWAYS IN FRONT OF THE GIRL, never behind her. A friend films her while standing or walking backward in front of her using a handheld smartphone/early-2000s consumer DV camcorder. Her face stays clearly visible. Strong natural handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure changes, slight motion blur, soft digital detail and mild image noise.

NO cinematic camera movements, NO gimbal, NO drone, NO rear shots, NO polished commercial look, NO beauty filter.

The girl walks toward the camera with her friend filming from directly in front. She looks excitedly at the cows and smiles. She says in Korean:
“오늘 소 젖 짜는 걸 배워볼 거예요.”

Hard cut. The farmer calmly shows her the correct hand movement. She tries again while the friend films from the front. This time milk starts flowing into the bucket. Her face immediately lights up.

0:21–0:26 — She Gets It
She continues successfully, looking proudly toward the camera. She laughs and says:
“됐다! 진짜 된다!”

0:26–0:30 — Happy Ending
She stands beside the cow holding the small bucket and smiles at the camera. She gently pats the cow and gives a little wave.
“오늘 진짜 재밌었어요. 안녕!”
Natural cut to black.

AUDIO:
Only real farm sounds: cow mooing, bucket sounds, footsteps, birds, insects, distant farm activity and natural conversation. No music and no narration.

It must look like a genuine friend-recorded memory from an ordinary farm visit—not a movie or advertisement. Front-facing coverage throughout, with natural reactions and imperfect handheld footage.

entries.prompt:
Main Subject: Young Korean woman, 24, naturally attractive, realistic skin, minimal makeup, long dark hair loosely down, wearing a maroon oversized hoodie, loose casual pants, simple sneakers and a small canvas shoulder bag. Preserve her exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, body proportions and appearance throughout.
Location & Atmosphere: Quiet old Seoul residential neighborhood on a rainy early morning. Narrow wet sidewalks, old apartments, small shops, convenience stores, parked scooters/cars, puddles and wet pavement reflecting a dark blue-gray sky. Steady light rain, muted colors, weak warm shop lights and sleepy neighborhood ambience.
Style: Ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video filmed by another person casually walking behind or beside her. Candid, unstaged family-video feeling. Natural handheld shake, imperfect framing, gentle reframing, occasional autofocus hunting and exposure shifts, faded colors, soft contrast, authentic MiniDV compression and subtle low-light digital noise. No cinematic tracking, gimbal movement or modern stabilization.

entries.title: Japanese High-School Horror Sequence
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating an ultra-realistic Japanese high-school horror-action sequence with a teacher and infected students using Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic Japanese high-school horror-action sequence following a female teacher during an ordinary afternoon class. The classroom is calm when the lights suddenly flicker and every student's phone receives the same emergency alert at exactly the same moment. The teacher looks outside and notices the school courtyard completely empty.

A loud crash comes from the science laboratory next door. The teacher tells everyone to stay inside and carefully opens the classroom door. The hallway appears empty, but a trail of spilled chemical liquid leads toward the staircase. Suddenly, a student who had been quietly sitting at the back of the classroom collapses and begins behaving strangely, revealing that something has already happened inside the school.

The emergency alarm starts ringing. Several infected students suddenly rush from the staircase toward the classroom. The teacher quickly pushes the desks against the doorway while students work together to block the entrance with chairs and cabinets. One student notices an emergency exit sign and leads the group toward a second corridor.

They move through the dark school hallway while hearing footsteps approaching from behind. The teacher turns off the hallway lights, and everyone hides silently inside an empty classroom as the infected pass by outside.

They finally reach the rooftop and push the door open, expecting to find help. Instead, they see dozens of infected figures standing motionless across the school courtyard below.

The teacher slowly closes the rooftop door and turns toward her students.

Then a quiet voice whispers from behind them:

“Sensei... someone is already here.”

She slowly turns around.

Cut to black.

entries.title: K-Pop Music Video Choreography Prompt
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a 30-second K-pop music video with specific choreography, camera movements, and character consistency constraints.
entries.prompt:
Using the supplied first frame as the exact opening image, generate a 30-second horizontal 4:3 photorealistic summer K-pop music video.

CONCEPT

The five-member fictional K-pop girl group LUMINA performs with twelve international supporting dancers across three connected public locations in the same European neighborhood:

1. Sunny city plaza
2. Bright covered food market
3. Outdoor community basketball court

The visual tone is joyful, energetic and communal. Camera transitions must make the three locations feel physically connected rather than unrelated scenes.

CHARACTER COUNT LOCK

Use exactly:
- Five LUMINA members
- Twelve supporting dancers

No additional dancers may appear.

Background pedestrians, market vendors and customers are civilians only. They remain clearly separated from the choreography and never copy the dance.

Keep every LUMINA member consistent:
- Same face
- Same hairstyle
- Same outfit
- Same body proportions
- Same accessories
- Same role in the group

Do not duplicate, merge, replace or transform any performer.

CAMERA STYLE

Horizontal 4:3.
Polished live-action K-pop cinematography.
Use a stabilized gimbal, short dolly movements and one gentle crane reveal.

Camera movement should be energetic but readable:
- Smooth forward pushes
- Short lateral tracks
- Motivated close-ups
- Whip-pan transitions hidden by foreground objects
- Continuous screen direction

Do not use random camera teleportation, spinning camera, extreme shake or excessive cutting.

0.0–4.0 SECONDS — OPENING GROUP CHOREOGRAPHY

Continue directly from the first frame.

Nari drops her raised arm across her chest and initiates the first synchronized sequence.

All seventeen dancers perform:
- Two grounded side steps
- Alternating shoulder hits
- One upward diagonal arm sweep
- A clean hip-level hand cross
- One synchronized head turn toward camera-right

The camera slowly pushes forward while preserving all five main members in frame.

The yellow bus remains parked behind them. Background pedestrians continue normal movement.

4.0–7.0 SECONDS — NARI CENTER MOMENT

The other members step outward by half a meter, opening a clear center lane.

Nari advances two short steps toward the camera and performs:
- Right-hand face frame
- Quick wrist rotation
- Chest accent
- Half-turn
- Immediate return to face the camera

Her pleated skirt, hair and socks move naturally.

Transition into a chest-up shot without cutting off her hands. She smiles directly into the lens for one beat.

No slow motion.

7.0–10.0 SECONDS — FORMATION EXPANSION

The camera pulls back smoothly.

Mina and Jiyu move to Nari’s sides while Hana and Seoa close the rear line. The twelve supporting dancers expand outward into a wide semicircle.

The full group performs:
- Two bouncing steps
- Right-arm wave
- Left-arm wave
- Fast double hand point
- One small synchronized jump
- Clean wide-stance landing

Feet maintain accurate contact with the stone pavement.

The city bus begins moving slowly out of the background in the correct traffic direction.

10.0–12.0 SECONDS — MARKET TRANSITION

A supporting dancer in a cobalt overshirt crosses close to the camera from left to right.

His shirt briefly fills the frame and creates a natural wipe transition.

As the blue fabric clears, reveal the same forward camera movement continuing inside a bright covered municipal food market.

The transition must preserve movement direction and rhythm.

12.0–16.0 SECONDS — MOVING THROUGH THE MARKET

The five LUMINA members dance forward through a wide central market aisle.

Formation:
- Jiyu leads at center
- Nari and Mina follow behind
- Hana and Seoa occupy the outer positions
- Supporting dancers trail in two organized lines

Environment:
- White and pale-blue market counters
- Fresh fruit and vegetable stalls
- Flower buckets
- Closed glass seafood displays
- Hanging international festival flags
- Elderly vendors and ordinary shoppers standing safely outside the aisle
- Bright skylight illumination
- Clean, dry floor

The group performs walking choreography:
- Rhythmic forward steps
- Alternating elbow pulls
- Shoulder rolls
- Overhead hand waves
- One synchronized direction change around a market column

The camera tracks backward at matching speed.

16.0–19.0 SECONDS — MINA CLOSE-UP

Mina moves toward the front-left side of the formation.

The camera transitions into a smooth waist-up close-up as she performs:
- Hand sweep beside her cheek
- Elbow raised above shoulder level
- Playful head tilt
- Quick body roll
- Direct smile into the lens

Nari and Jiyu remain visible behind her in softer focus, continuing simpler choreography.

A row of colorful market flags passes above the frame.

19.0–21.0 SECONDS — SECOND MATCH TRANSITION

Mina spins once to her left.

Her pale blue-grey skirt creates a brief circular foreground blur.

Match the end of the spin with Seoa completing the same turn at an outdoor basketball court.

The rotation direction, body scale and camera height must remain consistent across the cut.

21.0–25.0 SECONDS — BASKETBALL COURT CHORUS

Reveal a sunny outdoor community basketball court approximately one block from the market.

Environment:
- Blue and coral painted court
- White boundary lines
- Blue basketball backboard
- Chain-link perimeter fence
- Colorful city buildings in the distance
- Green trees
- Clear afternoon sky
- No active basketball players inside the dance zone

All five LUMINA members return to the front row.
The twelve supporting dancers form two staggered rows behind them.

They perform a high-energy chorus:
- Wide side step
- Double forearm hit
- Alternating knee lifts
- Cross-body point
- Fast shoulder bounce
- Quarter-turn
- Return to front

The camera tracks laterally from left to right while maintaining a stable horizon.

25.0–28.0 SECONDS — ROTATING CENTER POSITIONS

Each member receives a brief movement highlight without stopping the group choreography:

- Hana performs a grounded two-count footwork accent
- Seoa performs a bright arm circle
- Jiyu performs a strong chest-and-shoulder hit
- Mina performs a face-framing gesture
- Nari returns to center with one clean pivot

The other performers stay in their assigned positions and use simplified supporting movements.

No member passes directly through another dancer’s path.

28.0–30.0 SECONDS — FINAL GROUP POSE

The camera rises gently by approximately one meter while moving slightly backward, revealing the full court formation.

All seventeen dancers complete:
- One synchronized upward arm throw
- Small controlled jump
- Stable landing
- Final asymmetrical pose

Final positions:
- Nari center front
- Mina and Jiyu one step behind her
- Hana and Seoa on the outer front diagonals
- Twelve supporting dancers in a broad semicircle

Nari looks directly into the camera and gives a bright confident smile.

Hold the final pose for the last half-second.

CHOREOGRAPHY QUALITY

- Professional K-pop synchronization
- Energetic but anatomically realistic movement
- Clear preparation before every turn and jump
- Accurate foot placement
- Natural knee compression on landings
- Realistic hair and fabric movement
- No repeated movement loops
- No performer colliding with another
- No bodies passing through one another
- No floating feet
- No excessive motion blur

SCENE CONTINUITY

All three locations exist in the same neighborhood and share the same afternoon weather.

Maintain:
- Consistent sunlight direction
- Consistent performer identities
- Consistent clothing
- Consistent hair
- Continuous movement direction during transitions
- Realistic travel logic between scenes

AUDIO

Create an original upbeat summer K-pop track:
- Bright percussion
- Clean bass line
- Rhythmic handclaps
- Light synth melody
- Energetic chorus
- Original non-lyrical vocal ad-libs

Mix in subtle location ambience:
- Distant city traffic
- Footsteps
- Market room tone
- Shoe contact on the basketball court
- Light

entries.title: Horror Bus Attack Short Film Prompt
entries.description: A detailed timestamped prompt for a cinematic horror-action short film set on a Japanese bus, featuring infected passengers and a heroic defense by the crew.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic horror-action short film set aboard a Japanese highway bus during the day, opens with an immediate strong hook, maximum dynamic camera work, grounded practical-effects style. Bus interior filled with passengers in every seat, a conductor in a gray uniform with a money pouch at his waist, a driver focused on the road ahead. Muted authentic color grading, natural diegetic sound throughout, tension score entering immediately.
>
> **[0-1s]** Hard cut: a woman mid-row suddenly jolts violently in her seat, gasping sharply.
>
> **[1-2s]** Close-up: her veins turn a deep red, spreading rapidly up her neck and across her face.
>
> **[2-3s]** Her eyes snap open, now fully red — she lunges instantly, biting into her seatmate's shoulder.
>
> **[3-4s]** He cries out, nearby passengers recoiling in shock, seats creaking as people scramble back.
>
> **[4-5s]** The bitten man convulses hard, veins spreading fast across his own neck and arms.
>
> **[5-6s]** He rises seconds later, eyes red, joining her, both turning toward the passengers around them.
>
> **[6-7s]** Panic spreads through the bus, passengers screaming, climbing over seats to get away.
>
> **[7-8s]** The conductor spots the chaos from the front, shouting urgently in Japanese: "バスを止めて!" ("Stop the bus!")
>
> **[8-9s]** The driver slams the brakes hard, the bus lurching to a stop on the highway shoulder.
>
> **[9-10s]** The conductor grabs a metal tire iron from beneath his seat, moving fast down the aisle.
>
> **[10-11s]** The driver grabs a heavy steel wheel wrench, following close behind him.
>
> **[11-12s]** They reach the folding door, wrenching it open, ushering panicked passengers out fast.
>
> **[12-13s]** Passengers pour out onto the highway shoulder, some stumbling, others sprinting clear.
>
> **[13-14s]** The two infected push through the fleeing crowd, lunging toward the nearest passenger outside.
>
> **[14-15s]** The conductor swings the tire iron hard, striking the first infected across the shoulder, sending it stumbling.
>
> **[15-16s]** The driver swings the wrench into the second infected, knocking it back against the bus.
>
> **[16-17s]** SLOW MOTION insert: the first infected lunges again, conductor sidestepping and striking it down with a solid blow.
>
> **[17-18s]** It collapses onto the gravel shoulder, motionless.
>
> **[18-19s]** The second infected recovers, charging the driver; he braces and swings the wrench in a wide arc.
>
> **[19-20s]** The impact connects hard, sending it sprawling against the guardrail.
>
> **[20-21s]** It tries to rise again; the conductor rushes over, delivering one final strike alongside the driver.
>
> **[21-22s]** It goes still, both men breathing hard, weapons still raised.
>
> **[22-24s]** Wide shot: passengers huddled together on the highway shoulder, shaken but safe, cars slowing on the opposite lane.
>
> **[24-26s]** The conductor lowers the tire

entries.description: A prompt for a 30-second photorealistic video featuring a Korean woman's day in Seoul, including comedic moments, bus catching, convenience store visits, subway rides, street food, Han River biking, and rooftop snacks.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second photorealistic, highly entertaining Korean Seoul lifestyle video featuring the SAME adult Korean woman throughout. Keep her face, hairstyle, outfit, accessories and overall appearance perfectly consistent in every shot.

Character: Adult woman with long soft dark hair, natural realistic skin, fresh minimal makeup, expressive eyes and genuinely playful facial expressions.

0–3 sec: She opens her Seoul apartment door confidently, takes one step outside, suddenly realizes she forgot something, freezes with a funny expression, turns around and runs back inside. Fast comedic camera push-in + whip transition.

3–7 sec: She comes running back outside and catches the Seoul bus at the last second. She looks at the camera with a tiny proud smile. Dynamic tracking shot.

7–11 sec: Seoul convenience store  she grabs iced coffee, a cute dessert and snacks. The dessert nearly slips from her hand, but she catches it perfectly and smiles.

11–15 sec: Subway ride through Seoul. She enjoys her dessert by the window, watches the city passing by and makes a playful expression at her reflection.

15–20 sec: Lively Korean street-food market. She tries spicy tteokbokki, reacts dramatically to the heat, laughs and grabs water while her friends tease her.

20–25 sec: Golden-hour Han River. She and her friends ride bicycles together, playfully racing and laughing. Smooth side-tracking camera.

25–30 sec: Nighttime rooftop convenience-store seating. They share snacks and dessert while Seoul glows behind them. Camera smoothly pulls backward and upward, revealing the beautiful Seoul skyline.

Style: Premium Korean lifestyle commercial × cinematic vlog, cute, playful, energetic, natural expressions, smooth camera movement, realistic Seoul locations, beautiful lighting, cinematic daylight-to-night transition, photorealistic 16:9 landscape.

entries.title: Subway Romance Comedy Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a cinematic subway comedy scene with specific character descriptions and story beats using Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
A confident young woman accidentally ends up on the wrong subway train, while a playful stranger who tried to warn her gets pulled into an increasingly ridiculous situation.

MAIN CHARACTER — WOMAN

Use the uploaded image as the exact visual reference for the woman. Preserve her face, identity, skin tone, hair, body proportions and overall appearance throughout the entire video.

OUTFIT: cropped cream-colored bomber jacket over a fitted black ribbed tank top, high-waisted wide-leg charcoal trousers, black leather ankle boots, small silver hoop earrings and a delicate silver necklace. Modern, stylish streetwear. Keep the outfit identical in every shot.

MAIN CHARACTER — MAN

Young man with short black hair, oversized forest-green sweatshirt, relaxed black cargo trousers and clean white sneakers. Playful and confident at first, gradually becoming confused and embarrassed.

STORY

A crowded subway platform during evening rush hour.

The woman suddenly notices her train is about to leave and rushes toward it. She reaches the doors at the last second and jumps inside.

Through the closing glass doors, the man notices something immediately.

She is on the wrong train.

He frantically points toward the platform sign, trying to warn her.

She misunderstands him and gives him an irritated look.

The doors close.

The train begins moving.

She looks around the unfamiliar carriage.

Then she notices the station displayed on the electronic screen.

Her expression slowly changes.

She looks directly at the man.

He gives her an awkward little wave.

She points at the station display.

He points toward the opposite direction.

She crosses her arms.

He shrugs.

Suddenly, the train brakes hard.

She loses her balance and grabs the man's sweatshirt to steady herself.

The force pulls him forward, and he awkwardly drops onto a subway seat.

Silence.

Everyone looks at him.

She remains standing perfectly calmly.

He slowly looks up at her, completely embarrassed.

A passenger nearby starts laughing.

Another passenger joins in.

The man tries to stand up with dignity—but his backpack gets caught on the seat handle and yanks him backward again.

The entire carriage bursts into laughter.

Even the woman can't hold back anymore.

When the train reaches the next station, the doors open.

She steps out, turns around and gives him a tiny mischievous smile.

He points at her in disbelief.

She simply waves goodbye and walks away.

The doors close between them as he sits there, still trying to understand what just happened.

VISUAL STYLE

Ultra-realistic subway environment, cinematic live-action photography, authentic carriage details, realistic fluorescent lighting, reflections on glass, subtle handheld camera movement, natural motion blur, realistic crowd reactions, believable body movement and physics, expressive facial acting, perfectly timed physical comedy, gritty documentary-inspired texture combined with polis

entries.title: Rain Chase Time Stop Combat
entries.description: A complex prompt for a fantasy action scene involving a knight named Seraine in a rainy gothic alley, featuring time-stop mechanics and high-speed combat choreography.
entries.prompt:
Rain chase→blind spot ambush→time stop counter→collapse burst.

Character reference, Seraine from @[image 1]: silver white tousled short hair, a side fringe covering half of one eye, grey blue eyes, a pale and severe face. She wears silver black plate armor, the breastplate and pauldrons covered in gilded scrollwork relief, a white quilted underlayer with a long skirt, a holy sword at her hip and a cross kite shield slung on her back. Keep her face, hair, armor patterning and sword design consistent for the whole shot.

The camera starts as a shoulder rig riding tight on Seraine and moves with her. A wet gothic stone alley on a rainy night, magic rune lamp signs hanging along both walls refracting through the rain into mottled patches of deep blue and dark gold, standing water on the ground reflecting broken light. Seraine, in her silver black gilded holy armor, is being run down from behind by several mechanical puppet knights, her stride fast and hard like a cheetah, the gilded runes in her armor joints flickering cold white light with every step. The shoulder rig bumps and shakes slightly with her pace, and raindrops hit the front of the lens and leave hazy water trails.

Several mechanical puppet knights, iron cast faceplates with glowing dark red mana cores set into their chests, ambush at the same moment out of the visual blind spots thrown by the rune signs and from behind the thick stone pillars on both sides of the alley. The camera snaps back fast and runs a 360 degree orbit, sweeping across the silhouettes closing in from every side, and lands on a close up of Seraine's face. Rainwater runs off the tips of her silver white hair, her eyes cold and sharp, and she throws up a hand and releases a deep blue time field. Time stops dead in that instant and holds for only about 1 second. Raindrops hang and freeze into ice crystals, and a knight's arm raising a halberd locks rigid halfway up.

The camera then dives into that almost frozen space. Seraine draws the holy sword at her hip with a reverse grip, and the moment the blade clears the scabbard the gilded runes along its spine light up one by one from hilt to tip, the whole sword wrapped in a layer of flowing gold white holy light, fine cold blue arcs burning along the edge. She triggers the blink rune array in her armor and her body bursts apart into a blinding stream of cold white light, flickering at high frequency between the knights. Every blink pulls a strong directional motion blur trail behind her and leaves several silver grey translucent afterimages fading out, and each reappearance lands with a harsh white flash and scattering shards of light. The suspended ice crystal raindrops are smashed by the light stream i

entries.title: Office Outbreak Horror Sequence
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 30-second outbreak-horror video set in a Korean corporate office, utilizing a reference image for the protagonist.
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic outbreak-horror sequence taking place entirely inside a modern Korean corporate office, using the uploaded image as the highest-priority reference for the female lead and preserving her exact face, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions and outfit. The young Korean woman works alone at her desk late at night when a strange coworker suddenly appears between the cubicles, breathing heavily and moving unnaturally. He collapses beside a workstation, convulses violently, then suddenly rises with bloodshot eyes and charges at another employee. The office erupts into panic as employees sprint between desks, knocking over chairs, monitors and papers. The woman runs toward the main entrance but sees infected coworkers flooding the hallway, forcing her to turn back. She and several survivors push desks, chairs and filing cabinets against the glass entrance doors as infected employees violently pound against them. Cracks spread across the glass before one panel suddenly shatters and infected hands reach through the opening. The survivors retreat deeper into the office and rush into a glass conference room, slamming the door behind them. They drag a large conference table against the entrance while the infected swarm surrounds the room. The woman notices a trapped coworker outside, briefly opens the door, pulls him inside and immediately barricades it again. Everyone falls silent, breathing heavily as infected silhouettes pound against the cracked glass. The office lights suddenly shut off, leaving only red emergency lighting as the glass begins to fracture under the pressure. entries.description: A very long, detailed Chinese prompt for generating an Attack on Titan style video that looks like a high-quality AAA game cinematic, specifying lighting, character details, and shot-by-shot actions.
entries.prompt: entries.title: Regency Era Period Montage
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 25-second cinematic montage set in 1811 England featuring a woman in Regency attire riding horses and walking through gardens, mimicking British period cinema.
entries.prompt:
Create a 25-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic period montage set in England around 1811–1812, late Georgian / early Regency era. Make it feel like prestigious British period cinema: natural 35mm film texture, subtle grain and halation, realistic skin, fabric, water, foliage and horse physics, soft atmospheric depth, restrained camera movement, elegant compositions, muted warm color grading and genuine historical realism.

CHARACTER LOCK — SAME WOMAN THROUGHOUT: exceptionally beautiful English woman in her mid-20s, delicate oval face, refined straight nose, subtle high cheekbones, softly defined jaw, naturally rosy lips, luminous fair warm skin with realistic texture, expressive almond-shaped dark hazel-brown eyes, softly arched dark eyebrows, rich dark chestnut-brown softly wavy hair in a low Regency chignon with loose tendrils. Calm, intelligent, slightly wistful expression. She wears exactly the same ivory-white flowing Regency Empire-waist gown in every shot: lightweight muslin/cotton-silk, modest neckline, long fitted sleeves, delicate botanical embroidery, fine lace edging, subtle ivory ribbons and natural fabric folds; identical lace-trimmed bonnet outdoors. Never change her face, hair, gown, accessories or proportions.

SHOT SEQUENCE

0–2s — HOOK:

A huge weeping willow frames a mist-covered ornamental lake at golden dawn. The woman stands beside the water in her white gown; a distant stone bridge disappears into haze, ducks glide across the lake. Slow dolly through hanging willow branches reveals her as she turns slightly toward the glowing landscape.

2–4s:

She walks across the old stone bridge, gown moving naturally in the breeze. Smooth backward tracking shot reveals water, willows and distant estate gardens.

4–6s:

She approaches a weathered arched stone doorway covered in pale pink climbing roses, gently opens the aged green wooden door and enters a formal Georgian garden. Rose leaves naturally obscure the lens during the transition.

6–8s:

Beside a lily-pad pond, she kneels and touches the water with two fingers. Realistic concentric ripples distort her reflection. Low waterline camera, intimate shallow focus.

8–10s:

A chestnut horse waits beneath an ancient oak. She gently touches its neck, mounts naturally and settles sidesaddle. Slow elegant camera arc around horse and rider.

10–12s:

Wide lateral tracking shot as she rides slowly across enormous English parkland: rolling green hills, ancient trees, ornamental lake and grand honey-colored Georgian country house in the distance. Her white gown and bonnet ribbons respond naturally to the wind.

12–14s:

She walks through a dense wildflower meadow, fingers brushing tall grasses. She picks a single flower and smiles subtly. Gentle circular camera movement.

14–16s:

The circular movement reveals the magnificent symmetrical Georgian estate across a vast lawn, framed by mature trees. She pauses and looks toward it.

16–18s:

Quiet visual pause: the Georgian manor reflected in the lake while ducks glide across the foreground, gently breaking the reflection. Willow branches move at the edges. Almost imperceptible push-in.

18–21s:

Match the lake reflection into the polished wood of a historically plausible Georgian grand piano inside the estate. The woman, still wearing the identical gown, plays softly beside tall sash windows overlooking the same lake and willows. Slow diagonal dolly from behind her shoulder toward her profile.

21–23s:

Close-up of her hands naturally playing the ivory piano keys; sleeve movement, polished wood reflections and subtle candle flame movement. Rack focus from keys → fingers → softly blurred face.

23–25s:

Slow dolly backward through the drawing room toward the tall windows, revealing the woman at the piano and the same lake, willow trees and stone bridge outside. Her final piano note fades as the image gently cuts to black.

ENVIRONMENT

Build one geographically coherent, beautiful English Georgian estate: large reflective ornamental lake, enormous weeping willows, lily pads, reeds, old stone bridge, rose-covered stone garden entrance, clipped hedges, gravel paths, pale pink roses, foxgloves, lavender, ferns, wildflower meadows, ancient oaks, rolling parkland and a grand symmetrical honey-colored Georgian country house with sash windows and classical detailing. Interior: cream plaster, dark walnut, tall sash windows, marble fireplace, botanical paintings, porcelain, candles and polished Georgian grand piano.

LIGHT / COLOR / PHYSICS

Natural English sunlight only: soft golden dawn, gentle afternoon daylight, warm late-afternoon highlights and realistic window light indoors with subtle candlelight. Creamy whites, muted sage, moss green, aged stone, dusty rose, warm gold and soft blue-gray shadows. Slightly desaturated greens, no teal-orange grade. Physically accurate reflections, shadows, water ripples, horse movement, cloth movement, foliage, mist and candle flames.

CAMERA / EDITING

Use motivated cinematic movement only: slow dolly, lateral tracking, gentle arcs, restrained push-ins, waterline perspective and foreground-obscured transitions. Cut on movement and use reflections and foreground-obscured transitions.

Cut on movement and use reflections and foreground-obscured transitions.

entries.title: Korean Action Romance Car Stop
entries.description: A cinematic 30-second video prompt depicting a Korean action-romance scene where a man stops a falling car with one hand to save a woman.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic live-action Korean action-romance scene using the reference storyboard. Keep the SAME two Korean characters, exact faces, hairstyles, outfits, body proportions, and the SAME black car throughout. No identity, wardrobe, hairstyle, or vehicle changes.

0–4s: Woman walks through a modern Korean street wearing earphones. A black car suddenly loses control and flies toward her.

4–8s: Close-up as she notices the car in shock. Cut to the hooded man seeing the danger and reacting instantly.

8–12s: He runs toward her at extreme speed and pulls her away just before impact.

12–16s: They fall safely. She looks up and sees the damaged car falling directly above them.

16–20s: He raises one hand and stops the falling car overhead. She moves closer to him in fear while he holds it.

20–24s: Close-up of his calm, focused face. He pushes the car away and it lands heavily several meters away.

24–28s: They stand up and quietly look at each other with shock, relief, and gratitude as warm sunset light fills the street.

28–30s: Wide rear shot of both against the glowing city skyline. Slow crane backward/upward, then fade to black.

STYLE: Premium Korean live-action cinema, photorealistic skin, natural expressions, realistic hair/clothing movement, believable gravity and car physics, cinematic depth of field, realistic motion blur, HDR lighting, subtle handheld action shots, smooth emotional shots.

STRICT LOCK: No AI-looking faces, face changes, body morphing, duplicated people, wardrobe changes, broken hands, unnatural movement, teleporting, or changing car model. Keep all motion realistic and professionally acted.

entries.title: Sentinel vs Mech Army Standoff
entries.description: A prompt for a cinematic sequence where a lone female sentinel uses violet kinetic energy to defeat an army of robotic quadrupeds in a post-apocalyptic desert.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic 16:9. Keep the EXACT same lone female sentinel, identical face, sharp focused expression, short dark braided hair, rugged dark grey tactical survival gear with armored plating, weathered cloak, boots, and gloves. Same desolate post-apocalyptic desert landscape, crumbling highway overpasses, distant ruin city skyline, harsh midday lighting with dust haze, and dry visual style. Every scene must directly continue from the previous scene using the exact previous last frame as the next Start/Reference Frame. No changes in identity, clothing, environment, direction, scale or lighting.
SCENE 1 — 0:00–0:02.5 Sentinel stands exactly in the center of a wide, cracked desert highway, facing a distance cluster of dormant, colossal robotic quadrupeds. Wide cinematic shot, overpasses and desert cliffs behind them.
SCENE 2 — 0:02.5–0:04.5 The same quadruped robots suddenly activate, glowing red optic sensors flashing, and unleash synchronized energy pulses toward the sentinel. Massive electrical blue flashes, dust kicking up. Camera moves slightly alongside the robotic forces.
SCENE 3 — 0:04.5–0:07 Cut to the exact same sentinel, standing calmly and facing the camera with unwavering focus. Slow cinematic push-in toward her face.
SCENE 4 — 0:07–0:09.5 Multiple energy bolts rapidly fly toward and around the sentinel, narrowly missing her. She remains completely still. Projectiles must keep their forward direction and physical integrity.
SCENE 5 — 0:09.5–0:11.5 The sentinel's eyes glow intense electric violet. She raises both hands and generates powerful violet kinetic energy around her arms and body.
SCENE 6 — 0:11.5–0:14 A massive shockwave erupts on the highway around the sentinel, deflecting the incoming bolts and shattering the cracked asphalt. Huge dust cloud and heat distortion.
SCENE 7 — 0:14–0:16.5 Low tracking shot of the same colossal robotic quadrupeds aggressively moving forward, heavy metallic legs grinding on the rock, dust and debris trailing.
SCENE 8 — 0:16.5–0:19 Multiple robots are suddenly caught and lifted high above the highway by a powerful supernatural force, floating helplessly. Same environment and harsh daylight.
SCENE 9 — 0:19–0:21.5 The floating robots violently compress and implode in mid-air. Large sparks, collapsing metallic frames, and debris fall downward.
SCENE 10 — 0:21.5–0:24 A gigantic localized explosion of energy completely fills the center of the highway with brilliant violet light and a cloud of metal dust. Wide cinematic shot.
SCENE 11 — 0:24–0:26 Cut back to the EXACT same sentinel, unchanged and unharmed, standing calmly in the center of the now-empty highway. Slow push-in.
SCENE 12 — 0:26–0:27.5 Camera moves behind the sentinel as she calmly walks forward down the cracked highway. End with a wide cinematic shot of her walking toward the distant city ruins.
NEGATIVE: No character change,

entries.title: Warrior Steps Out of Movie
entries.description: A prompt for a continuous shot where a black-armored warrior tears through a cinema projection curtain and steps into the real theater, interacting with the audience.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic video, one continuous shot.

Image 1 = main woman. Keep her exact face, hair, body and outfit.

Image 2 = intact cinema scene and black-armored warrior.

Start exactly like  Image 1. The woman casually films herself in selfie mode and naturally says: “This is definitely a movie theater.”

She smoothly turns the phone toward the cinema. The camera follows in one continuous movement. No cut.

The cinema shows a dark medieval fantasy movie with the black-armored warrior from  Image 2.

The warrior runs forward and suddenly tears through the cinema projection curtain, naturally pushing through the fabric with his body. The curtain splits and tears around him as he passes through. He does not collide with or bounce off the curtain.

He continues moving straight forward at the same horizontal level and smoothly emerges into the real cinema. No falling, dropping or stumbling.

The audience reacts with natural gasps and surprised exclamations. A few people lean back or turn toward him, but remain seated.

Keep the warrior's identity, armor, body proportions and scale consistent throughout the transition.

End with the warrior standing inside the cinema, the torn curtain behind him and the fantasy movie visible through the opening.

Realistic fabric physics, natural reactions, cinematic depth.

No wall impact, no glass, no solid screen, no explosion, no shockwave, no falling, no flying audience, no destroyed seats, no duplicated warrior, no extra characters, no cuts.

entries.title: Seoul Neighborhood Home Video Walk
entries.description: A prompt for a realistic home-video style clip of a Korean woman taking a walk in Seoul, interacting with friends and fixing her shoelaces, using early 2000s DV camera aesthetics.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic personal home-video of a young Korean woman enjoying a relaxed Sunday afternoon in an older Seoul residential neighborhood. Use the attached image as the character reference and keep her face, long black messy side ponytail, fitted pastel-blue top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers, silver necklace and overall appearance perfectly consistent throughout.

She leaves her home with her phone in one hand and earphones in her ears, starts playing music and casually walks down the quiet residential street while listening, gently moving her head to the rhythm and enjoying the peaceful afternoon.

She reaches a tiny neighborhood convenience store, removes one earphone, walks inside and buys a cold bottle of water. She steps outside, puts her phone and earphones safely into the pocket of her pajama pants, then walks toward a nearby neighborhood bench.

She sits comfortably on the bench, opens the water bottle and takes several refreshing sips while looking around at the peaceful street. She wipes a small drop of water from her lips and relaxes for a moment.

Her female friend suddenly appears from the opposite side of the street. They recognize each other, smile brightly and walk toward each other before sharing a warm, natural hug. They briefly chat and laugh together like close friends.

The friend says goodbye and walks away. She picks up her water bottle, gives a small wave and continues walking toward her home while casually carrying the bottle.

A few minutes later, she suddenly notices that one of her shoelaces has come undone. She stops on the sidewalk, bends down naturally, ties the shoelace securely, stands back up and brushes her hands against her pajama pants.

She continues walking toward her house, glances back toward the camera with a relaxed smile and casually says, “Bye!” before turning around and walking away down the quiet residential lane.

Use raw early-2000s consumer DV-camera footage: handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, soft digital detail, mild digital noise, natural motion blur, occasional awkward zooms, slightly faded colors and authentic home-video imperfections.

Natural Seoul neighborhood ambience only — footsteps, distant conversations, convenience-store door chime, traffic, birds, bicycle bells, leaves moving in the breeze, water bottle sounds and quiet street ambience. The music from her earphones should be faintly audible only when appropriate, never as background music for the video.

Maintain realistic continuity throughout: phone and earphones are placed into the pajama pocket before she drinks water, water bottle remains in her possession afterward, shoelace is visibly untied before she fixes it and properly tied afterward.

No music added to the soundtrack, no narration, no subtitles, no captions, no dramatic events, no polished commercial cinematography, no beauty-filter skin, no C

entries.title: Nostalgic Schoolyard Golden Hour Video

entries.title: Korean Horror Pharmacy Sequence
entries.description: A prompt for a 30-second ultra-realistic horror sequence set in a pharmacy where a customer transforms into a monster, featuring practical effects and suspenseful atmosphere.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Korean horror sequence, set inside a cramped neighborhood pharmacy late at night. Cinematic live-action quality, unsettling atmosphere, practical horror effects, realistic human movement, and a continuous sequence that feels like a scene from a Korean supernatural horror film.

A young Korean woman enters the dimly lit pharmacy, clutching a folded prescription. She looks exhausted, occasionally glancing toward the darkened aisles. Only the pharmacist is present. She places the prescription on the counter and quietly asks for her medication.

The pharmacist turns toward the shelves to locate the medicine. A barcode scanner beeps repeatedly. The sound becomes strangely prolonged as the overhead fluorescent tubes flicker. The woman suddenly stops breathing normally. Her hand tightens around the prescription, and her fingertips begin jerking in tiny, involuntary movements.

The pharmacist turns back. Her shoulders are trembling. Her fingers slowly curl inward, joints locking into unnatural positions. Without warning, her body snaps into violent spasms, slamming against the counter. Bottles tumble from nearby shelves. The pharmacist stumbles backward, visibly terrified.

She drops behind the counter. For a moment, everything goes quiet.

Then her body rises in slow, mechanical movements. Her eyes remain wide and unfocused, her face expressionless. One shoulder hangs at an unnatural angle, while her arms appear stiff and distorted. She tilts her head sharply to one side and fixes her gaze on the pharmacist.

He retreats toward the store entrance.

Her elbows suddenly fold backward with a disturbing, unnatural motion. Her jaw stretches open far beyond normal anatomy as a harsh, inhuman shriek fills the narrow pharmacy. She launches herself over the counter with sudden, explosive speed.

The pharmacist runs through the tight aisles. She follows with jerky, impossible movements, knocking medicine cartons and glass bottles onto the floor. A late-night customer pushes open the entrance door and freezes at the sight of her standing motionless between the shelves.

She slowly turns her head toward the newcomer.

A sudden burst of movement. The customer flees, slips on a fallen basket, and scrambles toward the exit. The pharmacist grabs a fire extinguisher from the wall, pulls the safety pin with trembling hands, and sprays a thick cloud of white powder directly at her.

She staggers backward into a glass cabinet. The glass rattles violently. Through the powder, her silhouette gradually straightens. Her face is coated white, her eyes locked on the pharmacist.

She opens her mouth into another impossible scream and charges.

The pharmacist keeps spraying while retreating toward the entrance. She crashes through the glass storefront door, sending shards across the deserted street. Her twisted limbs jerk violently as she disappears int

entries.prompt:
A30-second, 16:9 photorealistic Unreal Engine 5 third-person fantasy action-adventure gameplay sequence. Make it feel like real playable AAA gameplay with seamless movement, realistic physics, dynamic camera work, and minimal HUD.

A young explorer in weathered winter gear, fur-lined cloak, climbing equipment, curved sword, and a glowing silver-blue wind device explores a gigantic frozen temple suspended above the clouds. Maintain strict character and equipment consistency.

0–5s — Frozen Summit
The explorer climbs an icy wall, jumps onto a collapsing platform, then sprints across a narrow frozen bridge as massive ice chunks fall into the clouds. The camera pulls wide to reveal the enormous temple.

5–10s — Wind Traversal
The bridge collapses. The explorer activates the wind device, launches across the gap, grabs a hanging chain, swings around an ancient turbine, and lands on another platform.

10–15s — Temple Awakens
Inside a massive crystal-filled chamber, the explorer activates three ancient wind mechanisms. A frozen gate explodes open, revealing a gigantic winged creature awakening above the chamber.

15–21s — Escape
The temple begins collapsing. The explorer runs across rotating platforms, dodges falling stone, and uses the wind ability to glide toward the exit while the creature destroys platforms behind them.

21–26s — Boss Arena
The explorer bursts onto a huge circular platform above the clouds. The creature crashes through the temple roof. Snow and ice explode across the arena as the player draws their sword.

26–30s — Epic Combat
The creature unleashes a massive wing attack. The explorer dodges underneath, uses the wind device to expose a glowing chest crystal, then strikes it with the sword. Blue energy fractures spread across the creature as its health bar drops. End with the player charging forward as the creature prepares its next attack.

Photorealistic AAA gameplay, realistic snow and ice physics, cinematic lighting, volumetric clouds, detailed ancient architecture, natural cloth and hair movement, believable creature weight, smooth 60fps motion, continuous player-controlled camera.

No montage cuts, no gore, no blood, no modern weapons, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no black bars, no fade-out.

Modern cozy living room with a large light-colored fabric sofa, two fluffy cushions, and a low wooden coffee table holding a snack bag and remote. Visible entrance door, cabinet, wall art, floor lamp, and curtains. Soft daytime sunlight mixed with warm indoor lighting.

0:00–0:05 — The Warning
Medium-wide shot of the man preparing to leave. He points toward the sofa and tells the dog naturally: “No getting on the couch, okay? Be good.”

Cut to the man's suspicious expression.

Cut back to the dog.

The dog gives him an innocent smile and slowly tilts its head.

End.

entries.prompt:
Photorealistic Korean underground parking garage at night. Real actors, real environment, practical-looking impacts, premium cinematic VFX. So-Yeon is always the same person: 160cm, small build, messy black hair over her eyes, black hoodie, sweatpants, black Converse. Natural skin, pores, hair, expressions and realistic movement. No CGI human or digital double.

The Agent is a calm Korean man in a perfect black suit, white shirt, black tie and dark sunglasses. Short slicked hair, emotionless, precise and unarmed.

Style: classic bullet-time / wire-fu action. Real Wing Chun, Taekwondo and Judo. Fast combat with brief extreme slow-motion moments and smooth 180°/360° camera orbits. No visible wires, floating, glowing energy, auras or colored effects. All impacts obey real physics.

Sound: No music or subtitles. Korean dialogue only. Echoing footsteps, breathing, fabric movement, punches, impacts, fluorescent buzz and garage ambience.

TIMELINE

00:00–00:03
So-Yeon stands still in the empty garage. The Agent watches from 20 feet away.
Agent: “너를 계속 지켜봤다.”
(“I've been watching you.”)
She slowly raises her eyes through her bangs.

00:03–00:06
The Agent suddenly rushes forward and punches her face. She instinctively tilts her head; the fist barely misses.

00:06–00:10 — BULLET TIME #1
Extreme slow motion. Camera orbits 180° around the missed punch. Her hair and hoodie react to the passing fist; dust hangs in the air.
TIME SNAP: She counters with an elbow. He blocks effortlessly.

00:10–00:14
Rapid Wing Chun exchange: traps, parries and redirects. Neither lands a clean hit.
Agent: “너무 늦게 깨어났어.”
(“You woke up too late.”)

00:14–00:18
He strikes her shoulder, sending her into a concrete pillar. Dust bursts from the impact. She rebounds into a spinning back kick.

00:18–00:22 — BULLET TIME #2
360° orbit around the connecting kick. His suit and sunglasses move in slow motion; broken fluorescent glass hangs in the air.
TIME SNAP: He crashes onto a parked car, visibly denting the hood.

00:22–00:26
He immediately gets up, fixes his tie and attacks again. Fast parries, redirects and a low sweep. Both move with extreme precision.

00:26–00:29
Brief micro slow-motion. So-Yeon narrowly dodges, redirects his arm and lands one powerful palm strike to his chest. No energy effect—only physical impact.

00:29–00:30
TIME SNAP. The Agent skids across the floor. His sunglasses fly off. So-Yeon stares at her hand, shocked and breathing hard. He lies still. She walks away into the flickering light without looking back.

Camera: Kinetic low-angle tracking during normal speed; smooth orbital bullet-time during key moments; whip-pans and impact shake only on contact.

Core rule: The spectacle comes entirely from realistic martial arts, extreme reflexes, physical impacts and bullet-time cinematography—not supernatural energy.

entries.title: Miniature Mountain Village Construction Time-lapse
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt for Seedance 2.5 creating a photorealistic miniature diorama of a village being built from scratch by tiny workers, emphasizing physical construction over CGI magic.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second vertical 9:16 ultra-photorealistic miniature mountain village construction time-lapse.
CORE:
An empty miniature spring valley is physically transformed into a beautiful countryside village by hundreds of tiny realistic workers. Real handcrafted miniature diorama look — macro photography, natural sunlight, realistic soil, stones, wood, grass, flowers, water, shadows and shallow depth of field.

NOT CGI, NOT cartoon, NOT fantasy. No magical appearances, teleportation, instant buildings, instant trees or instant landscape changes. Every object must be physically constructed.

0–2s — FOUNDATION

Empty mountain valley. Hundreds of workers arrive, mark plots with ropes/stakes, dig foundations and mark the future road.

2–4s — ROAD

Workers excavate, level and compact a winding dirt-and-stone road while others carry gravel and place roadside stones.

4–6s — HOUSE FOUNDATIONS

Multiple teams simultaneously build house foundations using individual stones and wooden beams.

6–8s — WALLS

Stone masons stack walls layer-by-layer while carpenters assemble wooden frames. Houses visibly rise but remain unfinished.

8–10s — ROOFS

Workers lift roof beams, install roof tiles, doors and windows using ladders and tiny carts. Several cottages become recognizable.

10–12s — MORE HOUSES

Additional cottages are rapidly constructed farther up the slope: foundations → walls → frames. Workers also build retaining walls.

12–14s — GRASS & GARDENS

Workers spread soil, add grass, plant flowers and assemble small wooden garden fences around the cottages.

14–16s — CHERRY BLOSSOMS

Workers transport young trees, dig holes, plant and secure them. Through natural time-lapse, branches develop and pink-white blossoms appear. No popping into existence.

16–18s — FARMING

Farmers prepare soil, plant vegetable rows and construct tiny irrigation channels. Baskets and farming tools remain visible.

18–20s — STREAM & BRIDGE

Workers excavate a streambed, place stones and create flowing clear water. Carpenters build a wooden bridge: supports → beams → planks.

20–22s — PATHS & FENCES

Stone paths connect the houses. Workers install fences, stone walls and pathways throughout the village.

22–24s — VILLAGE LIFE

Tiny realistic goats, sheep, cows and chickens appear through natural movement into the completed environment. Farmers carry baskets, push carts and work between homes and fields.

24–26s — FLOWERS & DETAILS

Hundreds of gardeners finish the landscape with spring flowers, grass, flower pots, benches and farming tools.

26–28s — COMPLETE LIFE

Busy village: farmers working, villagers walking, animals moving, water flowing, cherry blossoms swaying and subtle chimney smoke. All construction remains physically consistent.

28–30s — GRAND REVEAL

Start close to one tiny farmer. Rapidly pull backward and upward to reveal the entire handcrafted village: dozens of stone-and-wood cottages, winding roads, green hills, blooming gardens, and the full scale of the miniature world under soft daylight.

entries.prompt:
Create an extremely photorealistic live-action tactical thriller scene, visually indistinguishable from high-budget cinema. Real human anatomy, authentic skin pores, natural sweat, realistic fabric and tactical gear, physically accurate weapon handling, natural facial expressions, realistic environmental lighting, subtle imperfections, cinematic depth of field, high-shutter-speed action, 24fps, immersive production sound, perfectly synchronized English dialogue. Maintain strict character, wardrobe, weapon and environment continuity across every shot.

0–5 SEC — FRONTAL SWAT CONFRONTATION

Ultra-realistic medium shot of a SWAT officer wearing authentic tactical armor, ballistic helmet and gas mask. He aims his rifle directly toward the camera lens, creating an intense fourth-wall perspective. Natural breathing, subtle body movement and realistic weapon handling.

He aggressively shouts:

“LET THE HOSTAGE GO! DROP THE WEAPON NOW!”

5–10 SEC — THE THREAT

Hard cut to an ultra-realistic medium shot of a sweaty, frantic man in a dirty tank top holding a terrified woman in a chokehold, with a pistol pressed against her head. Realistic skin texture, sweat, trembling hands and distressed facial expressions.

He screams toward the off-screen SWAT officer:

“STAY BACK! I’LL KILL HER!”

10–15 SEC — FINAL STANDOFF

Cut to an over-the-right-shoulder shot from directly behind the SWAT officer. His helmet, shoulder and rifle are sharply detailed in the foreground. The killer and hostage remain clearly visible in the mid-ground.

The killer screams:

“I’M GONNA DO IT!”

A brief moment of tense silence.

15–18 SEC — SINGLE SHOT

The SWAT officer fires one single round. Realistic muzzle flash, authentic recoil, brief smoke and sharp handheld camera reaction. The killer is struck and immediately drops, releasing the hostage.

Keep the impact non-graphic and cinematic, with no excessive blood or gore.

18–22 SEC — AFTERMATH

The hostage steps backward in shock, breathing heavily but unharmed. The SWAT officer remains alert with his rifle raised, then cautiously lowers it.

Hold on the woman's stunned expression for the final beat. Natural room ambience, breathing, subtle tactical gear sounds and realistic cinematic audio.

ULTRA-REALISM REQUIREMENTS:
Photorealistic human faces and anatomy, genuine skin pores and micro-textures, physically accurate lighting, realistic shadows, authentic tactical equipment, believable weapon mechanics, natural body weight and momentum, realistic recoil, subtle handheld camera shake, natural motion blur, cinematic lens behavior, accurate depth of field, realistic reflections, high dynamic range, detailed environmental textures, consistent identities throughout, no CGI appearance, no plastic skin, no distorted hands, no warped weapons, no unnatural movement, no subtitles, no text overlays.

entries.title: Hyperrealistic Supernatural Night Market Video Prompt
entries.description: A complex prompt for generating a hyperrealistic cinematic short video featuring a woman with supernatural powers in a neon-lit Asian night market facing an alien insectoid monster.
entries.prompt:
Create a hyperrealistic cinematic short video, 15 seconds long at 24fps, 1280x720 widescreen, in the visual style of a high-end supernatural-powers commercial/ad — grounded photoreal live-action look with heavy VFX, night-time neon lighting, and a deliberately understated, unbothered performance from the main character throughout.

CHARACTER: A young woman in her mid-twenties with sleek jet-black hair pulled into a high ponytail with a few loose strands framing her face, sharp defined features, and warm olive skin. She wears a fitted crimson-red silk bomber jacket with gold embroidered dragon detailing over a black fitted turtleneck, slim black trousers, and delicate gold hoop earrings with a thin gold chain necklace. Her expression is calm, composed, and faintly amused even amid chaos. Render her with photoreal skin detail, natural proportions, and keep her exact face, hairstyle, and outfit fully consistent across every single shot and camera angle for the entire 15 seconds — no identity drift, no design changes between cuts.

LOCATION: A rain-slicked night market street in a dense, towering Asian megacity — narrow lane packed with glowing neon signage in red, pink, and cyan, hanging paper lanterns, steam rising from food stalls, puddles reflecting the neon glow underfoot, and tightly packed multi-story buildings with illuminated windows rising into a hazy, overcast night sky. Keep this lighting, architecture, and atmosphere fully consistent across every shot.

CREATURE: A massive bioluminescent alien insectoid monster with an iridescent green-teal-purple segmented carapace, multiple armored clawed legs, and wing-like appendages, crashing through a large market structure/scaffolding in the background and causing the surrounding crowd to flee in panic. Keep its design, color, and proportions consistent in every shot it appears in.

ACTION SEQUENCE (chronological, 0:00-0:15, render the complete sequence in this order without skipping or shortening any beat):
0:00-0:04 — Opens with the main character seen from behind and then in side profile, standing calmly amid a moving, bustling night-market crowd, casually sipping from a beverage can, while neon signage flickers and reflects in the wet street around her and the crowd moves past, establishing a normal, lively night-market atmosphere.
0:04-0:07 — The giant creature crashes into the background market structure, sending sparks, steam, and debris flying; the surrounding crowd screams and flees in both foreground and background, but the main character remains still and unfazed, continuing to drink calmly even as the creature's massive leg looms close behind her.
0:07-0:09 — Glowing electric-blue lightning veins begin spreading across her exposed skin (neck, hands, and jacket seams), her ponytail whips upward as if caught in a rising magical energy field, her eyes ignite into glowing electric blue-white with twin light-trails streaming down like glowing tears, and a faint translucent blue force-dome begins forming around her silhouette, reflecting in the wet pavement below.
0:09-0:11 — She raises one arm and extends her open hand toward the creature, fingers illuminated with crackling light; a searing horizontal beam of white-blue energy erupts from her palm in an extreme close-up, then a wide shot shows the beam connecting directly down the narrow street into the creature in a blinding flash of white light that briefly washes out the neon signage, striking it down amid rising steam and smoke.
0:11-0:13 — Aftermath beat: she lowers her arm and the lightning fades from her skin as the camera holds on her calm profile, neon reflections flickering back across the wet street; smoke and small ground fires smolder in the background where the creature was struck down, with radial scorch and burn marks fanning out across the wet pavement.
0:13-0:15 (ending) — She turns and walks calmly away from the destruction with a neutral, unbothered expression, checking her phone casually mid-stride, and approaches a nearby night-market food stall in the foreground (steam rising, hanging lanterns, bottles on display) as smoke continues to rise behind her — the sequence ends on this casual walk-away shot, power fully deactivated, as if nothing happened.

CAMERA WORK: A mix of close medium shots from behind and in profile during the calm opening beats, a wider reactive shot as the creature crashes in, tight close-ups on the skin/eye transformation during the power-activation beat, an extreme close-up on the glowing hand during the beam release, a wide shot for the beam impact, and a following medium shot for the final calm walk-away. Camera movement is subtle and handheld-cinematic, never rushed, contrasting calm framing on the character against chaotic framing of the crowd and creature.

LIGHTING AND COLOR: Cool night ambient lighting throughout, with vivid red, pink, and cyan neon signage reflecting off wet pavement and glass, warm lantern light and food-stall steam in the background, contrasted against the electric blue-white glow of the character's powers and lightning veins, and warm orange fire/ember tones during the aftermath smoke and scorch marks. High dynamic range with strong rim lighting separating the character from the busy neon-lit background in every shot.

STYLE AND QUALITY: Photoreal hyperrealistic rendering with cinematic film grain, physically-based materials, detailed skin and fabric texture, realistic hair and cloth physics, wet-street reflections, atmospheric steam and smoke particle simulation, sharp foreground focus with natural depth-of-field falloff on the crowd and background chaos, color-graded like a premium commercial, fine 4K-equivalent detail, a tonal contrast between calm character performance and chaotic surrounding energy sustained across the full 15 seconds.

CONSISTENCY AND NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS: Maintain strong frame-to-frame and shot-to-shot consistency in the main character's facial identity, hairstyle, outfit, and proportions, and in the creature's design, across every camera angle described above. Avoid identity drift, face morphing, warping, flickering, duplicated limbs, extra fingers, distorted anatomy, inconsistent clothing or color between cuts, mismatched lighting direction, unwanted text, logos, watermarks, subtitles, low-resolution artifacts, plastic or waxy skin texture, and unnatural or robotic motion. Preserve natural physics for hair, cloth, smoke, lightning, and light-beam effects throughout. Render the complete 15-second sequence exactly as timed above, from the opening calm shot through the final walk-away shot, without skipping, shortening, or rushing any beat.

entries.title: Retro MiniDV Flea Market Comedy Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 15-second realistic home video style clip featuring three friends at a Berlin flea market in 2001, with specific comedic actions and camera behaviors.
entries.prompt:
Main Subjects: Three young adult German women, close friends, wearing authentic early-2000s casual fashion: denim jackets, fitted tops, bootcut jeans, chunky sneakers, colorful scarves, and small shoulder bags.

Location: An ordinary Sunday flea market in Berlin, Germany, around 2001. Folding tables, old vinyl records, secondhand clothes, porcelain dishes, vintage cameras, books, bicycles, cardboard boxes, and local shoppers. No modern smartphones or contemporary displays.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic early-2000s consumer MiniDV home video. Faded colors, soft contrast, realistic skin texture, mild digital noise, visible DV compression, autofocus hunting, slight motion blur, imperfect white balance, and occasional exposure pumping.

Camera Style: One friend casually films with a bulky MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, fast pans, accidental zooms, awkward close-ups, autofocus breathing, and imperfect framing. No stabilization.

Timeline — 15 Seconds

00:00–00:03
The recording begins with the camera pointed at a table covered in random objects. One woman picks up an enormous old hat, puts it on, and confidently says, “This is definitely coming home with me.” Her friends immediately start laughing.

00:03–00:06
They continue browsing. Another woman discovers an old pair of roller skates and insists she can still use them. She puts one on while standing beside the table and immediately struggles to balance.

00:06–00:09
She cautiously rolls forward a tiny distance, grabs her friend's shoulder for support, and nearly takes both of them down. The camera operator laughs so hard that the frame points toward the ground.

00:09–00:12
They find a stack of ridiculous vintage sunglasses. All three try different pairs and pose seriously for the camcorder. One woman sees herself in a small mirror and immediately starts laughing.

00:12–00:15
At the end of the market, the woman proudly carries her giant hat and roller skates. Her friend asks, “You're actually buying those?” She answers, “Absolutely.” The camera zooms toward her ridiculous outfit as everyone laughs and the tape cuts.

Audio: Market chatter, footsteps, cardboard boxes moving, objects clinking, bicycle bells, German conversation, laughter, distant traffic, and vendors talking. No added music, no narration.

Comedic Direction: Let the comedy grow from ordinary flea-market discoveries: ridiculous hat → roller-skate confidence → near fall → terrible sunglasses → actually buying everything. Keep reactions spontaneous and realistic.

Goal: Recreate an authentic 2001 German MiniDV memory where a normal flea-market visit turns into an embarrassing treasure hunt among friends.
