entries.title: Japanese Cinema Horror AI Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a 30-second ultra-realistic horror sequence in a Japanese cinema hall using Seedance 2.5, featuring zombie outbreaks and survival action.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Japanese horror-action sequence set inside a modern cinema hall during a late-night screening.

Photorealistic live-action, Japanese setting, practical-effects horror, authentic human reactions, natural handheld cinematography, realistic physics, cinematic lighting, and continuous scene progression. The footage should feel like a real horror movie captured by a professional camera crew, not AI-generated.

SCENE 1 — SOMETHING IS WRONG (0–7s)

A nearly full Japanese cinema hall. Movie light flickers across the audience. A female employee in her late 20s, wearing a dark cinema staff uniform, notices a man sitting several rows ahead behaving strangely. He suddenly stops moving. A drop of blood falls onto the armrest beside him. The audience slowly turns toward him. A faint, unnatural breathing sound emerges.

SCENE 2 — THE OUTBREAK (7–15s)

Without warning, a violent crash comes from the cinema's rear emergency exit. The door buckles open as a zombie-like infected person stumbles inside. People scream and rush between the seats. Before anyone can escape, the previously motionless man suddenly convulses and transforms, revealing that the infection was already spreading inside the audience. The camera moves with the panicking crowd in a chaotic but believable handheld shot.

SCENE 3 — FIGHT FOR SURVIVAL (15–25s)

The female employee grabs a heavy metal stanchion barrier and defends herself against an approaching infected person. Two audience members join her, using cinema seats and a fallen metal sign as improvised shields. They struggle desperately, pushing the attackers backward. No superhero movements—every hit has weight, imperfect timing, exhaustion, and genuine fear. They eventually knock down the attackers. The cinema falls completely silent except for heavy breathing and the faint hum of the projector.

SCENE 4 — FINAL TWIST (25–30s)

Everyone freezes. From behind the closed projection-room door, a low, distant zombie groan echoes through the empty cinema. The female employee slowly turns toward the sound. The projector light flickers across her terrified face. The camera moves closer as something scratches against the door from the other side.

CUT TO BLACK.

Ultra-realistic live-action, practical makeup and physical effects, natural skin textures, believable Japanese cinema architecture, realistic emergency lighting, subtle film grain, imperfect handheld camera movement, physically accurate collisions, and authentic crowd panic. Diegetic sound only: screams, footsteps, furniture impacts, breathing, projector hum, and distant groans. No music, narration, subtitles, watermark, random text, excessive gore, graphic injuries, animation, anime, cartoon aesthetics, CGI appearance, distorted anatomy, or unrealistic action choreography. entries.title: Moses Sea Splits Historical Epic
entries.description: A detailed prompt for reconstructing the biblical moment of Moses parting the sea, formatted as a 30-second historical epic video with specific camera directions.
entries.prompt: MOSES — “THE SEA SPLITS” 30 SECONDS | 16:9 | HISTORICAL EPIC RECONSTRUCTION | SEEDANCE 2.5 | MULTISHOT SETTING Ancient Egypt, thousands of years ago. A vast desert shoreline beside an enormous sea. Moses and a large group of Israelites are trapped at the water’s edge. Families, elderly people, children, animals and belongings crowd the shoreline. Far behind them, Pharaoh and a massive Egyptian army approach rapidly through the desert. The atmosphere is tense, dusty and chaotic. CHARACTERS MOSES: An elderly man with a long weathered beard, simple rough ancient robes and a wooden staff. Keep Moses visually consistent throughout. Never show a clear frontal close-up of his face. Primarily use rear, side and silhouette compositions. ISRAELITES: Men, women, children and elderly people in simple ancient clothing, carrying belongings and guiding animals. PHARAOH: An imposing ancient Egyptian ruler surrounded by soldiers and mounted forces. Large Egyptian army with horses, chariots, shields and ancient weapons. STORY 00:00–00:02.5 The Israelites reach the edge of the sea and suddenly stop. People look forward at the enormous water. Several turn around. A huge cloud of dust rises behind them. Pharaoh’s army is approaching. Handheld 35mm documentary perspective. Natural wind, shouting and distant horses. ⸻ 00:02.5–00:05 Moses steps forward toward the water. The frightened crowd remains behind him. He raises his wooden staff. The approaching Egyptian army becomes visible through the dust in the background. Camera moves slowly toward Moses from behind. Natural wind intensifies. ⸻ 00:05–00:07.5 Moses strikes the surface of the sea with his staff. The water suddenly begins pulling apart. A powerful current moves away from the center. Mist and spray fill the air. People react in disbelief. Camera shakes slightly from the enormous movement. ⸻ 00:07.5–00:10 The sea completely separates. A gigantic dry passage appears through the middle of the water. Massive walls of water rise on both sides. The scale is overwhelming. The ground inside the passage is dry and passable. Ultra-wide 24mm environmental shot. Extremely realistic water physics. ⸻ 00:10–00:12.5 The Israelites begin running through the dry passage. Families hold children’s hands. People carry belongings. Animals move alongside them. Moses leads them forward with his staff. The enormous walls of water remain on both sides. Handheld 35mm tracking shot. ⸻ 00:12.5–00:15 Pharaoh’s army reaches the shoreline. They see the Israelites disappearing into the passage. Pharaoh commands his forces forward. Egyptian chariots and soldiers enter the dry path. Low-angle handheld camera beside the moving horses. Dust and water spray fill the air. ⸻ 00:15–00:17.5 Inside the sea passage. The Israelites are far ahead. Pharaoh’s army follows behind them. The camera moves between the two groups. Towering water surrounds the passage on both sides. The environment feels enormous and dangerous. ⸻ 00:17.5–00:20 The Israelites reach the opposite shore. Moses stops and turns back toward the sea. In the distance, Pharaoh’s army is still inside the passage. The water begins moving violently. Moses remains completely still. ⸻ 00:20–00:22.5 The walls of water begin collapsing inward. Pharaoh’s horses panic. Chariots lose control. Soldiers desperately attempt to escape. Water rushes through the passage. Keep the action intense but non-graphic. ⸻ 00:22.5–00:25 Pharaoh is surrounded by rapidly returning water. He struggles to remain above the surface. His army disappears into the enormous surge around him. Camera remains distant and respectful. The water dominates the frame. ⸻ 00:25–00:27.5 The sea closes completely. A gigantic wave rolls across the area where the army had been. Then everything becomes still. Only the natural sea remains. ⸻ 00:27.5–00:30 Wide shot from the opposite shore. The Israelites stand together in silence. Moses is seen from behind, holding his staff. The sea stretches endlessly before them. Wind moves through their clothing. The camera slowly pulls back. CUT TO BLACK. CAMERA Large-format historical cinematography with realistic documentary behavior. 24mm for massive environmental shots. 35mm for crowds and action. 50mm for character moments. Handheld physical camera movement. Natural micro-shake. Occasional imperfect framing. Realistic autofocus. Natural motion blur. No floating camera. No impossible drone movements. No excessive slow motion. No music-video cinematography. LIGHTING Natural ancient-world daylight. Dust-filtered sunlight. Atmospheric haze. Realistic shadows. Natural reflections on the water. Subtle warm sunlight breaking through dusty air. No artificial fantasy glow. No neon effects. PHYSICS Extremely realistic water simulation. Huge water masses must have believable weight, turbulence and momentum. Realistic wind interaction. Natural spray and mist. Accurate horse movement. Realistic chariot weight. Wet ground and dry ground behave differently. Crowds move independently. No synchronized extras. No floating objects. HUMAN PERFORMANCE Fear before the sea opens. Disbelief when the water separates. Urgency during the crossing. Determination from Moses. Aggressive pursuit from Pharaoh’s army. Panic when the water returns. Natural facial expressions and body language. No exaggerated theatrical acting. AUDIO Natural environmental sound only. Strong desert wind. Footsteps. Animals. Horses. Chariot wheels. Distant shouting. Water movement. Roaring waves. Crowd reactions. Sudden silence after the sea closes. No modern music. No cinematic music-video soundtrack. VISUAL CHARACTER Photorealistic historical reconstruction. Authentic ancient-world atmosphere. Natural skin texture. Weathered clothing. Dust-covered surfaces. Realistic water. Realistic atmospheric depth. Subtle film grain. 24fps. 180-degree shutter. Natural motion blur. NO CGI LOOK. NO PLASTIC SKIN. NO BEAUTY FILTER. NO MODERN OBJECTS. NO MODERN CLOTHING. NO EXTRA FINGERS. NO DISTORTED FACES. NO WARPED HORSES. NO FANTASY ARMOR. CONTINUITY Same Moses throughout. Same staff throughout. Same clothing throughout. Same Israelites throughout. Same Pharaoh and army throughout. The sea transformation must happen progressively. The dry path remains in the same location. The Israelites cross first. Pharaoh’s army enters afterward. The water returns only after the Israelites reach the opposite shore. Every shot must feel like part of the same continuous historical event. NO RANDOM SHOT CHANGES. NO CHARACTER REDESIGN. NO AI-SLOP VISUALS.

entries.title: AAA Gameplay Action Adventure
entries.description: A complex prompt for generating a 30-second photorealistic AAA gameplay video featuring a Korean explorer solving puzzles and fighting bosses in Unreal Engine 5 style.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second photorealistic AAA third-person action-adventure gameplay video, 16:9, resembling real playable Unreal Engine 5 footage, not a cinematic trailer.

PROTAGONIST — STRICT CONSISTENCY:
Young Korean female explorer, mid-20s, natural oval Korean face, dark almond eyes, long dark hair in a low ponytail, athletic realistic build. Same face and body throughout. She wears a burgundy-red sleeveless utility jacket, charcoal long-sleeve shirt, olive cargo pants, rugged boots, climbing gloves, tactical backpack, rope/carbiners, silver magnetic bracelet on right wrist, and curved blade at right hip. Realistic dirt, cloth, hair, and physics.

CAMERA & STYLE:
Normal third-person player-controlled camera behind/slightly above her. Natural movement, realistic animation, shadows, materials, physics, lighting, and environmental interaction. No cinematic camera sweeps, slow motion, excessive DOF, lens flare, title cards, logos, subtitles, or watermark.

GAMEPLAY SEQUENCE

1. Abandoned Settlement
She enters a ruined island settlement with overgrown stone buildings, broken walkways, boats, cliffs, and a distant watchtower. HUD: “Investigate the Abandoned Settlement.”

2. Traversal
She climbs platforms and ledges, runs across a beam, jumps a gap, and reaches the watchtower route. Show stamina usage. HUD: “Reach the Abandoned Watchtower.”

3. Hidden Mechanism
She discovers a cracked stone wall, activates an ancient mechanism, and opens a hidden underground entrance. Interaction prompt: “Investigate.”

4. Ancient Lift Puzzle
In a huge underground chamber, she uses her magnetic bracelet to move metal counterweights onto the correct tracks. Ancient conduits activate and the stone lift starts moving. HUD: “Restore the Ancient Lift.”

5. Boss Fight
The lift reaches a temple chamber where a massive stone-and-bronze guardian awakens. She draws her curved blade and fights. HUD: “Defeat the Ruin Sentinel.” Enemy health bar and lock-on indicator appear.

6. Weak Point Mechanic
Guardian attacks → she dodges → uses the magnetic bracelet to pull off damaged armor → glowing weak point exposed → she strikes it with her blade → boss health decreases. Clearly show DODGE → MAGNET → WEAK POINT → ATTACK gameplay.

7. Flood Escape
Ancient pipes rupture and water floods the chamber. HUD: “Escape the Flooded Chamber.” She runs, jumps broken floors, avoids falling debris, climbs a wall, and reaches the surface.

8. New Mission
She reaches a rocky overlook above the ruined island. A mysterious ancient sky temple is visible beyond the mountains. HUD: “Mission Complete: Reach the Surface.” Then: “Investigate the Sky Temple.” She walks toward the new objective, clearly transitioning into the next playable mission.

FINAL REQUIREMENTS:
Same woman, outfit, face, hairstyle, equipment, environment, and visual quality throughout. Prioritize playable gameplay readability over cinematic beauty.

entries.title: Zombie Lab Horror Sequence
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a photorealistic zombie-horror sequence in a laboratory involving a scientist turning into a zombie.
entries.prompt:
Create a photorealistic zombie-horror sequence inside a high-security research laboratory. The central character is a young adult Korean female scientist dressed in a clean white lab coat over a simple light-colored shirt, blue straight-leg jeans, and practical white sneakers. She has natural dark hair, minimal makeup, realistic skin texture, and believable proportions. Her face, hairstyle, lab coat, jeans, shoes, and body proportions must remain consistent throughout the entire sequence. Build the environment with steel machinery, specimen tables, glass containment chambers, computer monitors, harsh fluorescent lighting, and realistic laboratory details. Use grounded practical effects and physically believable movement with tense handheld camerawork.

While she works at a containment station, a glass specimen chamber suddenly develops fractures and explodes, scattering glass across the floor as a small dark parasite escapes and attaches itself around her shoulder and neck. She stumbles backward, frightened, while dark veins gradually appear beneath her skin and spread upward across her neck and face. Her skin becomes noticeably pale and clammy, her fingers twitch, and violent tremors run through her body. Her terrified expression gradually disappears into a blank, emotionless stare as her eyes transform into an unnaturally deep obsidian black. She abruptly turns toward a nearby colleague and charges, forcing him behind a glass partition.

She repeatedly strikes the glass while staring directly at him, her completely black eyes and pulsing dark veins clearly visible. Two more scientists enter and freeze when she suddenly becomes perfectly still, then slowly rotates her head toward them. Around the laboratory, additional containment chambers begin cracking as warning lights activate. Another infected creature breaks free, sending the scientists scrambling for emergency equipment. They use a powerful emergency strobe and fire extinguisher to disorient the creatures before pushing a heavy steel cart across the corridor and retreating behind a security door.

The surviving scientists reach an emergency corridor and catch their breath as red warning lights wash over their exhausted faces. The sealed laboratory door violently shakes behind them. The camera gradually approaches its small observation window, revealing the infected woman standing motionless in the darkness, still wearing her white lab coat and blue jeans. Her pale face, prominent dark veins, and completely black eyes are visible through the glass. She slowly tilts her head toward the camera as the emergency lights flicker across her face. Cut to black.

entries.prompt:
JOSEON ZOMBIE DISASTER HORROR — NOWHERE SAFE. Total duration 30 seconds, 16:9, live-action cinema. Text-to-video with zero reference images.

[CHARACTERS AND SPACE]
Night in a Joseon-era Korean town. Zombies attack residents in homes and in the market. The protagonist is one Korean woman in her early twenties: small oval face, black ribbon-tied braid, faded ivory jeogori, dark navy chima skirt and straw shoes. Keep the same face, hair and clothing throughout. A pre-existing bite on her left wrist is concealed by her sleeve; she has not noticed it while fleeing. She begins with normal dark eyes. Zombies are distinct adult men and women in grey and brown hanbok, with pale skin and cloudy eyes that distinguish them from living residents.
The male victim and escaping woman in the first house are different residents, not the protagonist. The market merchant wears a brown vest; his attacker wears a grey jeogori. A wooden tray rests on the merchant's stall. The protagonist passes their struggle and takes shelter in the kitchen of an empty hanok at the end of the market. The kitchen is an enclosed interior with walls, a roof, a masonry hearth and storage jars. A thick, single-leaf wooden door and raised threshold separate it from the alley. Its hinges allow an inward swing; it is initially open. A wooden crossbar leans beside it indoors; once the door is closed, the bar spans two brackets on the door leaf and jamb.

[SEQUENCE]
(0:00–0:02) — Medium Wide, 28mm, Short Track Back. In the opening frame, a zombie outside the hanok crashes through a hanji-paper lattice door, tearing the paper and thin wooden slats as it lunges into the room. From an oblique interior angle, the camera retreats briefly, keeping the torn opening and the man beside the dining table together. Startled, he raises both arms to block the zombie's shoulders. He has not yet been bitten.

(0:02–0:04) — Tight Medium, 50mm, Short Push In. Cut closer to his blocking arm from the same side. The zombie bites his upper arm, compressing the fabric. At that instant, the man squeezes his eyes shut, screams in pain and arches backward. His body knocks the table, sending bowls down. The woman behind them flees through an open room doorway opposite the breached lattice door.

(0:04–0:06.5) — Wide, 24mm, Lateral Tracking. Hard cut to market chaos. The ivory-clad protagonist moves left to right. In front, the grey-clad zombie lunges at the brown-vested merchant, who raises a wooden tray from his stall to block it. Behind them, one resident drops a bundle and runs, another helps a fallen person up, and a zombie forces its way between stalls.

(0:06.5–0:09) — Medium, 35mm, Low Lateral Move. Cut to the merchant fighting the zombie. Holding the tray in both hands, he drives it hard into the zombie's chest. The chest and clothing compress; the zombie recoils backward, striking the stall with its back. The camera follows this displacement briefly, showing contact and recoil together.

(0:09–0:11) — Tight Medium, 50mm, Fast Push In. Stay with the same pair. The zombie yanks the tray's edge down and lunges onto the merchant's shoulder. The merchant pushes against its jaw with his forearm as he is forced toward a post. Move close on the braced arms, gaping mouth and straining face. Behind them, the same protagonist slips past the struggle into the alley.

(0:11–0:14) — Wide, 24mm, Interior Three-quarter. The camera is already inside the refuge kitchen, looking obliquely toward the open doorway. Include the nearby hearth, interior floor and alley beyond the raised threshold in one frame. The same woman runs in from the alley, crosses the threshold and plants both feet on the kitchen floor. Two pursuing zombies are still running outside in the alley. She catches the inward-open door leaf and turns.

(0:14–0:17) — Medium Wide, 28mm, Short Track Back. Retreat within the kitchen, keeping her and the door in view. She pulls the door shut, leaving the alley and zombies outside. The wooden leaf hits the frame closed. She lifts the crossbar from beside the interior wall with both hands.

(0:17–0:20) — Medium, 40mm, Handheld Settling. Remain inside at the same door. She seats the bar across the two brackets on the door leaf and jamb. After it is seated, a zombie slams into the door from outside. Door and bar shudder but hold closed. She leans her back against the door, gasping.

(0:20–0:24) — Close-up, Tilt Up. Feeling a sting, she looks down at her left wrist and pulls back its sleeve with her right hand. Dark blue-black veins spread up the arm from a small bite mark. Move from the wrist up to the same woman's face. Between 22 and 24 seconds, she says once in a tearful voice, “아니야…” Dull pounding continues outside.

(0:24–0:30) — Close-up, Slow Dolly In. Still against the door, the same woman's normal dark eyes turn cloudy grey-white as dark veins spread across her temples and cheeks. Her jaw trembles, her mouth opens, and gasping turns into a low, ragged zombie moan. From 28 seconds, her infected eyes and face are clearly visible. She slowly raises her head to face forward, still moaning, and the film ends at 30 seconds. The door and crossbar remain locked throughout.

[IMAGE TEXTURE AND LIVE-ACTION LOOK]
A location-shot historical disaster horror film. Distinct textures of sweaty, dusty skin, coarse cotton, worn timber and dirt floors. Muted navy and grey-brown, fine film grain and restrained edge sharpness. Preserve pores and small wrinkles, with gentle tonal transitions from bright lamps through skin midtones into deep shadow. Avoid broad oily sheen across faces or a hazy blur over the entire image.

[CINEMATIC CAMERA, LIGHTING AND COMPOSITION]
Oil lamps in the first house, lanterns and braziers in the market, and a small lamp on the kitchen shelf illuminate the night. Only surfaces near a light are warm; opposite facial planes and the alley stay deeply shaded. Keep mouth-to-arm contact, recoil, the threshold and the crossbar readable in the darkness. In the infection close-up, focus on her eyes and cheeks, with the wooden door darker and softly blurred behind her. Do not suddenly increase facial exposure in close-up.
Market wides establish the disaster; close fighting shots reveal resistance and pressure. Hard cut on continuing movement without swapping the merchant's and zombie's positions. Do not let shake obscure contact. Use short moves motivated by attack and counterattack rather than constant zooms or prolonged slow motion. Show the entire threshold crossing in a wide shot; finish on a stable close view of the transformation.

[BGM]
Urgent, frightening disaster-horror music from the opening. Low repeating strings, abrasive high strings and fast, heavy drums drive the attacks and market struggle. Build through flight and barricading at 11–20 seconds. At 20 seconds, as she leans against the door, reduce percussion but retain low strings beneath breath and dialogue. Dissonant strings build again at 24–30 seconds; a low impact at the cloudy-eye reveal at 28 seconds leaves resonance beneath her moan. No comic, festive or heroic victory music.

[SOUND EFFECTS AND DIALOGUE]
The impact, tearing paper and snapping thin wooden slats sound in sync with the intrusion. The first man's pain scream erupts when his upper arm is bitten. Tray impacts, the rattling stall, residents' screams and zombie moans come from their visible contacts and distances. Market noise continues behind close fighting shots. Her nearby footfalls cross the threshold into the kitchen; when the door shuts, pursuit sounds become muffled through the timber. Distinguish bar placement, the subsequent door impact, sleeve friction and human gasping changing into a zombie moan. The only spoken line is her single Korean “아니야…”, synchronized with her mouth. Other residents react with screams and breath.

JOSEON ZOMBIE DISASTER HORROR — NOWHERE SAFE. Total duration 30 seconds, 16:9, live-action cinema. Text-to-video with zero reference images.

[CHARACTERS AND SPACE]
Night in a Joseon-era Korean town. Zombies attack residents in homes and in the market. The protagonist is one Korean woman in her early twenties: small oval face, black ribbon-tied braid, faded ivory jeogori, dark navy chima skirt and straw shoes. Keep the same face, hair and clothing throughout. A pre-existing bite on her left wrist is concealed by her sleeve; she has not noticed it while fleeing. She begins with normal dark eyes. Zombies are distinct adult men and women in grey and brown hanbok, with pale skin and cloudy eyes that distinguish them from living residents.
The male victim and escaping woman in the first house are different residents, not the protagonist. The market merchant wears a brown vest; his attacker wears a grey jeogori. A wooden tray rests on the merchant's stall. The protagonist passes their struggle and takes shelter in the kitchen of an empty hanok at the end of the market. The kitchen is an enclosed interior with walls, a roof, a masonry hearth and storage jars. A thick, single-leaf wooden door and raised threshold separate it from the alley. Its hinges allow an inward swing; it is initially open. A wooden crossbar leans beside it indoors; once the door is closed, the bar spans two brackets on the door leaf and jamb.

[SEQUENCE]
(0:00–0:02) — Medium Wide, 28mm, Short Track Back. In the opening frame, a zombie outside the hanok crashes through a hanji-paper lattice door, tearing the paper and thin wooden slats as it lunges into the room. From an oblique interior angle, the camera retreats briefly, keeping the torn opening and the man beside the dining table together. Startled, he raises both arms to block the zombie's shoulders. He has not yet been bitten.

(0:02–0:04) — Tight Medium, 50mm, Short Push In. Cut closer to his blocking arm from the same side. The zombie bites his upper arm, compressing the fabric. At that instant, the man squeezes his eyes shut, screams in pain and arches backward. His body knocks the table, sending bowls down. The woman behind them flees through an open room doorway opposite the breached lattice door.

(0:04–0:06.5) — Wide, 24mm, Lateral Tracking. Hard cut to market chaos. The ivory-clad protagonist moves left to right. In front, the grey-clad zombie lunges at the brown-vested merchant, who raises a wooden tray from his stall to block it. Behind them, one resident drops a bundle and runs, another helps a fallen person up, and a zombie forces its way between stalls.

(0:06.5–0:09) — Medium, 35mm, Low Lateral Move. Cut to the merchant fighting the zombie. Holding the tray in both hands, he drives it hard into the zombie's chest. The chest and clothing compress; the zombie recoils backward, striking the stall with its back. The camera follows this displacement briefly, showing contact and recoil together.

(0:09–0:11) — Tight Medium, 50mm, Fast Push In. Stay with the same pair. The zombie yanks the tray's edge down and lunges onto the merchant's shoulder. The merchant pushes against its jaw with his forearm as he is forced toward a post. Move close on the braced arms, gaping mouth and straining face. Behind them, the same protagonist slips past the struggle into the alley.

(0:11–0:14) — Wide, 24mm, Interior Three-quarter. The camera is already inside the refuge kitchen, looking obliquely toward the open doorway. Include the nearby hearth, interior floor and alley beyond the raised threshold in one frame. The same woman runs in from the alley, crosses the threshold and plants both feet on the kitchen floor. Two pursuing zombies are still running outside in the alley. She catches the inward-open door leaf and turns.

(0:14–0:17) — Medium Wide, 28mm, Short Track Back. Retreat within the kitchen, keeping her and the door in view. She pulls the door shut, leaving the alley and zombies outside. The wooden leaf hits the frame closed. She lifts the crossbar from beside the interior wall with both hands.

(0:17–0:20) — Medium, 40mm, Handheld Settling. Remain inside at the same door. She seats the bar across the two brackets on the door leaf and jamb. After it is seated, a zombie slams into the door from outside. Door and bar shudder but hold closed. She leans her back against the door, gasping.

(0:20–0:24) — Close-up, Tilt Up. Feeling a sting, she looks down at her left wrist and pulls back its sleeve with her right hand. Dark blue-black veins spread up the arm from a small bite mark. Move from the wrist up to the same woman's face. Between 22 and 24 seconds, she says once in a tearful voice, “No...” Dull pounding continues outside.

(0:24–0:30) — Close-up, Slow Dolly In. Still against the door, the same woman's normal dark eyes turn cloudy grey-white as dark veins spread across her temples and cheeks. Her jaw trembles, her mouth opens, and gasping turns into a low, ragged zombie moan. From 28 seconds, her infected eyes and face are clearly visible. She slowly raises her head to face forward, still moaning, and the film ends at 30 seconds. The door and crossbar remain locked throughout.

[IMAGE TEXTURE AND LIVE-ACTION LOOK]
A location-shot historical disaster horror film. Distinct textures of sweaty, dusty skin, coarse cotton, worn timber and dirt floors. Muted navy and grey-brown, fine film grain and restrained edge sharpness. Preserve pores and small wrinkles, with gentle tonal transitions from bright lamps through skin midtones into deep shadow. Avoid broad oily sheen across faces or a hazy blur over the entire image.

[CINEMATIC CAMERA, LIGHTING AND COMPOSITION]
Oil lamps in the first house, lanterns and braziers in the market, and a small lamp on the kitchen shelf illuminate the night. Only surfaces near a light are warm; opposite facial planes and the alley stay deeply shaded. Keep mouth-to-arm contact, recoil, the threshold and the crossbar readable in the darkness. In the infection close-up, focus on her eyes and cheeks, with the wooden door darker and softly blurred behind her. Do not suddenly increase facial exposure in close-up.
Market wides establish the disaster; close fighting shots reveal resistance and pressure. Hard cut on continuing movement without swapping the merchant's and zombie's positions. Do not let shake obscure contact. Use short moves motivated by attack and counterattack rather than constant zooms or prolonged slow motion. Show the entire threshold crossing in a wide shot; finish on a stable close view of the transformation.

[BGM]
Urgent, frightening disaster-horror music from the opening. Low repeating strings, abrasive high strings and fast, heavy drums drive the attacks and market struggle. Build through flight and barricading at 11–20 seconds. At 20 seconds, as she leans against the door, reduce percussion but retain low strings beneath breath and dialogue. Dissonant strings build again at 24–30 seconds; a low impact at the cloudy-eye reveal at 28 seconds leaves resonance beneath her moan. No comic, festive or heroic victory music.

[SOUND EFFECTS AND DIALOGUE]
The impact, tearing paper and snapping thin wooden slats sound in sync with the intrusion. The first man's pain scream erupts when his upper arm is bitten. Tray impacts, the rattling stall, residents' screams and zombie moans come from their visible contacts and distances. Market noise continues behind close fighting shots. Her nearby footfalls cross the threshold into the kitchen; when the door shuts, pursuit sounds become muffled through the timber. Distinguish bar placement, the subsequent door impact, sleeve friction and human gasping changing into a zombie moan. The only spoken line is her single Korean “No...”, synchronized with her mouth. Other residents react with screams and breath.

[CAUTIONS]
Zero attachments, no su

entries.title: Microscopic Civilization Arrow Prompt for Seedance 2.5
entries.description: A complex prompt for a continuous shot transitioning from an ancient battlefield to a microscopic civilization living inside an arrow, requiring high detail and smooth scale transitions.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic video in one continuous shot, with medium-paced storytelling and smooth natural transitions. No cuts, no sudden jumps, no rushed movements.

0–6 seconds: Begin with an epic wide-angle view of a vast ancient battlefield at golden hour. Thousands of warriors clash with swords and shields beneath a hazy amber sky filled with smoke, dust and floating embers. The camera smoothly pushes through the chaos toward a lone archer in weathered bronze armor, his face covered with realistic dirt and sweat.

6–10 seconds: Move closer as the archer slowly draws his longbow. Show the tension in his hands, muscles and bowstring. He releases the arrow with a sharp, powerful snap. The camera immediately begins following the arrow in the same continuous movement.

10–17 seconds: Track directly behind the flying arrow in cinematic slow motion. The battlefield becomes progressively blurred behind it while the arrow remains extremely sharp. Smoke, ash and glowing embers drift around the camera. Show realistic wood grain, feather movement and subtle arrow vibration as it cuts through the air.

17–21 seconds: Gradually push closer until the wooden shaft fills the entire frame. Reveal intricate carved runes, tiny scratches, dust and natural imperfections in the aged wood. Continue moving toward one rune without cutting.

21–26 seconds: Seamlessly transition into an extreme macro view as the carved wood grain becomes a vast landscape. The grooves transform naturally into enormous canyon walls and the feather fibers become towering structures. Reveal a microscopic ancient civilization living across the arrow.

26–30 seconds: Show tiny warriors wearing detailed bronze armor fighting across the giant wood grain, climbing the carved runes with ropes, operating miniature catapults and carrying tiny shields and swords. Small torches flicker, smoke rises, dust moves naturally and miniature banners wave in the wind. Slowly reveal the incredible scale of the microscopic battlefield while maintaining visual continuity with the original arrow and distant battlefield.

Visual style: ultra-super-realistic live-action cinematography, physically accurate materials, realistic human movement, detailed skin and armor, natural golden-hour lighting, volumetric smoke, realistic particles, shallow depth of field, cinematic motion blur, macro photography, high dynamic range, realistic lens behavior, natural imperfections, believable scale transition, extremely detailed textures.

Camera: smooth continuous movement, medium pacing, no cuts, no teleportation, no abrupt transitions, no excessive speed ramps.

Avoid: cartoon CGI, plastic textures, game-engine appearance, oversaturated colors, distorted anatomy, duplicate characters, character morphing, inconsistent armor, artificial-looking miniature figures, unrealistic physics, visual

entries.title: 2005 MiniDV Mall Photo Booth Fail
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a comedic 15-second video mimicking authentic 2005 MiniDV footage of three friends failing to take good photos in a mall photo booth.
entries.prompt:
Main Subjects: Three young adult women, best friends, wearing authentic mid-2000s casual fashion: cropped hoodies, fitted graphic tops, low-rise bootcut jeans, colorful sneakers, small shoulder bags, chunky bracelets, and playful hair accessories.

Location: Ordinary suburban shopping mall in the United States, around 2005. CRT televisions in electronics stores, CD shops, food court, arcade, clothing stores, vending machines, tiled floors, and a small photo booth. No smartphones or modern LED displays.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic 2005 consumer MiniDV footage. Faded colors, soft contrast, realistic skin texture, mild digital noise, compression artifacts, blown highlights, autofocus hunting, occasional motion blur, imperfect white balance, and slight exposure pumping.

Camera Style: One friend casually filming with a bulky MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, accidental zooms, sudden pans, awkward close-ups, autofocus breathing, imperfect framing, and no stabilization.

Timeline — 15 Seconds

00:00–00:03
The footage starts outside a photo booth. One woman announces, “We need a perfect picture!” She dramatically fixes her hair while another friend secretly messes it up from behind. She turns around in confusion.

00:03–00:06
All three squeeze into the tiny photo booth. The curtain gets stuck halfway open, leaving them awkwardly visible to the mall walkway. They try pulling it closed while laughing.

00:06–00:09
The countdown begins. They pose seriously for the first shot—then one woman sneezes exactly as the flash fires. Everyone looks at her in shock before bursting out laughing.

00:09–00:12
They attempt another photo. One friend changes poses too early, another closes her eyes, and the third accidentally bumps the booth wall. The camera outside captures their muffled screaming and laughter.

00:12–00:15
They emerge holding the photo strip. All three inspect it silently. Their faces slowly turn disappointed. One finally says, “We paid for THAT?” Everyone collapses laughing as the camcorder zooms aggressively into the terrible photo strip, loses focus, and cuts to black.

Audio: Mall ambience, footsteps, distant arcade sounds, photo-booth countdown beeps, camera flashes, muffled voices behind the curtain, laughter, shopping bags, and natural conversation. No added music, no narration.

Comedic Direction: Build the humor through increasingly bad luck: hair prank → stuck curtain → perfectly timed sneeze → ruined poses → terrible final photos. Keep reactions spontaneous and physically realistic.

Goal: Make it feel like a genuinely forgotten 2005 MiniDV mall recording – the kind of embarrassing footage friends would rediscover years later and immediately start laughing at.

- MANAGER: man in his late 40s, 178 cm, heavyset, completely bald with a neat grey goatee, light-blue dress shirt with a lanyard, holding a white coffee mug. Appears only around the desk pods.
- CHATTY COWORKER: woman in her 30s, 175 cm, long curly red hair, green cardigan, hugging an open laptop covered in stickers, looking for someone to pull into a call. Appears only in the cubicle aisle.
- INTERN: man in his early 20s, 183 cm, skinny, a mop of curly blond hair, grey hoodie under a lanyard, carrying a cardboard tray of four coffees. Appears only at the kitchenette.
- FACILITIES GUY: man in his 60s, 165 cm, wiry, silver hair under a navy ball cap, navy coveralls, pushing a wheeled mail cart stacked with packages. Appears only in the lobby crossing.
MAYA is the only person in the entire video who wears glasses. The MANAGER is the only bald man; the INTERN is the only blond; the COWORKER is the only redhead; the FACILITIES GUY is the only person in a cap and coveralls.

LOCATION MAP
One unbroken spatial route the camera travels with her: her desk pod by the window → cubicle-partition aisle → print alcove → kitchenette corner → open lobby past a glass conference room → elevator bank → inside the elevator car. Foreground: grey carpet tiles, white standing desks with monitor arms, low felt partitions. Background: floor-to-ceiling window wall on camera-right with a downtown skyline in low golden 5 PM light, dust suspended in the sunbeams. Light enters from camera-right through the window wall along the entire route.

OFFICE GEOMETRY
The floor is a standard American open-plan office: desk pods in the center, the window wall along one side, the print alcove and kitchenette against the inner wall, a glass-walled conference room near the far end, and the elevator lobby beyond it. MAYA's pod sits at the window end, diagonally opposite the elevators, so her route crosses the entire floor. The elevator doors are brushed steel and reflect the warm light. Posters on the inner wall stay blurred — none of their text is legible.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
First frame is already in motion: MAYA's laptop lid clicks shut as she slides off her chair into a crouch below partition height, tote already on her shoulder. Camera behind her right shoulder. Game HUD fully visible from frame one.

FORMAT MODE
One continuous unbroken take from 0.0s to 27.0s with no cuts of any kind, then a single HARD CUT at 27.0s to one final locked framing that runs to 30.0s. Exactly one cut exists in the whole video, at 27.0s. The camera does not cut anywhere else.

OPTICS
One lens for the continuous section: 47° third-person over-the-shoulder framing as the baseline, breathing in to 29° on reaction beats and out to 63° for the kitchenette evasion and the cart crossing. All FOV changes in that section happen as smooth continuous zoom breathing, never as a jump. The final framing after the cut is a fixed 29° frontal view of MAYA, no drift.

CAMERA
For the continuous section the camera is a physical object flying with her. At 1.3 meters height, 1.5 meters behind MAYA, slightly camera-right of her back, swinging with a soft spring delay half a beat behind her turns like an analog-stick gameplay camera. It sinks to knee height when she crouches below partition level, rises when she stands, slides sideways along the partition line with her, swings wide across the kitchenette to open up the coffee-pot moment, drifts in lockstep beside the mail cart, and slips through the closing elevator doors with her. After the cut, the camera is repositioned INSIDE the elevator at the back-mirror position, eye level, facing the doors — locked off, completely static, no movement.

ACTION

[Beat 1 — 0.0s to 6.0s] Crouched inside her desk pod, MAYA swaps her black heels for white sneakers in two seconds flat, then thumbs a status toggle on her phone — the screen stays unreadable, but the HUD prints 【DECOY STATUS: "IN A MEETING"】. She rises 20 cm to peek over the partition: the MANAGER hovers two pods away, mug in hand, scanning the floor for one last quick question. She sinks down and whispers: "Five o'clock means five o'clock." HUD flashes 【FRIDAY — 4:59 PM】 and the mission banner 【OBJECTIVE: CLOCK OUT AT 5:00 — UNDETECTED】. She slips out of the pod away from his sight line, and the camera follows her without stopping.

[Beat 2 — 6.0s to 12.0s] Sneakers silent on the carpet, she presses her back to the low partition line and shuffles sideways at 2 km/h; the camera tracks sideways with her at the same speed. The CHATTY COWORKER turns into the aisle hugging her sticker-covered laptop, scanning the aisle for help with one last task. MAYA slides into the print alcove and freezes as the printer hums close beside her, eyes tracking without moving her head; her glasses slip down her nose and she pushes them back up with one finger. She whispers: "Don't see me. Don't see me." The minimap vision cone sweeps past MAYA's marker and turns away. HUD shows 【SNEAKING MODE】. The coworker exits frame-left; MAYA exhales and moves on.

[Beat 3 — 12.0s to 18.0s] The INTERN rounds the kitchenette corner two meters ahead with his tray of coffees, mouth already opening for a loud hello. A red exclamation marker pops up above his head with a quick alert chime, the HUD edge pulses red, 【ALERT】. The camera swings wide as MAYA reacts in one motion: two silent steps to the counter, grabs the coffee pot, turns her back and mimes topping up a mug, shoulders loose, perfectly casual. He reaches past her for the milk, hums, and wanders off without registering her. The alert bar drains amber to green. HUD prints 【HIDDEN IN PLAIN SIGHT】. She sets the pot down and whispers: "...that was close." The camera falls in behind her again.

[Beat 4 — 18.0s to 24.0s] The last stretch: the open lobby, overlooked by a glass conference room where a late meeting is still running. The FACILITIES GUY pushes his mail cart across the lobby toward the elevators. MAYA ducks behind the cart's far side and crouch-walks in perfect lockstep, matching its 2 km/h pace; the camera drifts with them. A man in the conference room glances up at a wheel squeak, sees only a cart, and returns to the whiteboard. From behind the cart MAYA whispers: "Bless this man." HUD prints 【MOBILE COVER】 then 【ALL CLEAR】, alert bar fully green.

[Beat 5 — 24.0s to 27.0s] She peels off at the elevator bank and presses the down button three times quickly, bouncing on her toes as the floor indicator crawls. She whispers: "Come on, come on—". Far behind her

场景背景
一段30秒的AAA级第三人称潜行喜剧游戏序列，设定在现代美国开放式办公室，周五下午4:59。玩家角色玛雅（MAYA）已完成任务清单，必须在5:00整穿过整个楼层并进入电梯，且不被任何可能让她迟到的人拦住。基调轻松、俏皮且温馨的职场喜剧。

参考素材
@Image1 = 玛雅（MAYA）的电影感角色设计板，展示其主肖像、全身三视图、头部研究和服装分解。仅使用@Image1来定义玛雅的外貌——发型、眼镜、服装和比例——并在整个视频中保持与她一致。不要在视频的任何地方显示设计板本身、其布局、注释或灰色背景。玛雅：美国上班族，27岁，浅色雀斑，蜂蜜金发梳成低发髻并有几缕散落在脸侧，黑色圆角矩形眼镜，象牙色衬衫外搭超大号驼色西装外套，修身黑色长裤，白色运动鞋，肩上挎着帆布托特包。声音：柔和低沉的女性声音，用英语低声耳语。

角色区分
出现四位不同的成年人，每人拥有不同的轮廓、年龄和发型，以便观众能识别为四个独立个体：
- 经理：近50岁的男性，身高178厘米，体型粗壮，完全秃顶留着整洁的灰色山羊胡，身穿浅蓝色正装衬衫佩戴挂绳，手持白色咖啡杯。仅出现在办公桌区域附近。
- 健谈同事：30多岁的女性，身高175厘米，长卷红发，绿色开衫，怀抱贴满贴纸的笔记本电脑，寻找有人加入通话。仅出现在隔间过道。
- 实习生：20出头的男性，身高183厘米，瘦削，一头金色卷发，灰色连帽衫下佩戴挂绳，手捧装有四杯咖啡的纸板托盘。仅出现在茶水间角落。
- 设施维护员：60多岁的男性，身高165厘米，精瘦，海军蓝棒球帽下露出银发，身穿海军蓝工作服，推着堆满包裹的轮式邮件车。仅出现在大堂通道。
在整个视频中，只有玛雅戴眼镜。经理是唯一的光头男子；实习生是唯一的金发者；同事是唯一的红发者；设施维护员是唯一戴帽子穿工作服的人。

地点地图
摄像机跟随她的一条不间断空间路线：靠窗的办公位 → 隔板过道 → 打印区 → 茶水间角落 → 经过玻璃会议室的大堂 → 电梯厅 → 电梯内部。前景：灰色地毯砖，带显示器支架的白色站立办公桌，低矮毛毡隔板。背景：摄像机右侧落地窗墙，沐浴在下午5点低角度金色阳光下的市中心天际线，光束中悬浮着灰尘。光线从摄像机右侧透过窗墙沿整条路线射入。

办公室几何结构
地板为标准美式开放式办公室：中心为办公位，一侧为窗墙，内侧墙壁设有打印区和茶水间，远端附近有玻璃墙会议室，其后是电梯厅。玛雅的办公位位于窗户一端，与电梯呈对角线相对，因此她的路线横跨整个楼层。电梯门为拉丝钢材质，反射暖光。内墙上的海报保持模糊——上面的文字均不可辨认。

首帧/站位
首帧已处于运动中：玛雅的笔记本电脑盖子咔哒一声合上，她从椅子上滑下蹲至隔板高度以下，托特包已挂在肩上。摄像机位于她右肩后方。游戏HUD从第一帧起完全可见。

格式模式
从0.0秒到27.0秒为一个连续不间断的长镜头，没有任何剪辑，然后在27.0秒处进行一次硬切（HARD CUT），切换到最终锁定的构图直至30.0秒。整个视频中恰好存在一次剪辑，即在27.0秒处。摄像机在其他任何地方都不进行剪辑。

光学设置
连续部分使用单一镜头：以47°第三人称过肩视角作为基准，在反应时刻呼吸式推近至29°，在茶水间躲避和推车穿越时拉远至63°。该部分的所有视场角（FOV）变化均以平滑连续的变焦呼吸发生，绝不跳跃。剪辑后的最终构图为固定的29°正面视角拍摄玛雅，无漂移。

摄像机
在连续部分，摄像机是一个随她飞行的物理物体。高度1.3米，位于玛雅身后1.5米处，略微偏右于她的背部，像模拟摇杆游戏摄像机一样，带有轻微的弹簧延迟，在她转向时半拍后摆动。当她蹲下到隔板水平以下时下沉至膝盖高度，站起时上升，沿着隔板线与她在同一速度下滑动，在茶水间大幅摆动以展现咖啡壶时刻，在邮件车旁同步漂移，并随着她滑入正在关闭的电梯门。剪辑后，摄像机重新定位在电梯内部的后镜位置，视线高度，面向门——锁定静止，完全静态，无移动。

动作

[节拍1 — 0.0秒至6.0秒] 玛雅蹲在她的办公位内，两秒钟内将黑色高跟鞋换成白色运动鞋，然后拇指在手机屏幕上滑动状态切换——屏幕内容不可读，但HUD打印出【诱饵状态：“正在开会”】。她升高20厘米越过隔板窥视：经理悬停在两个办公位外，手拿杯子，扫描地板准备问最后一个快速问题。她沉下身低声说：“五点钟就是五点钟。” HUD闪烁【星期五 — 4:59 PM】以及任务横幅【目标：5:00下班 — 未被发现】。她避开他的视线溜出办公位，摄像机紧随其后不停顿。

[节拍2 — 6.0秒至12.0秒] 运动鞋在地毯上无声，她背靠低隔板线以2公里/小时的速度横向挪步；摄像机以相同速度随她横向追踪。健谈同事抱着贴满贴纸的笔记本走进过道，扫描过道寻找帮助处理最后一项任务。玛雅滑进打印区并冻结，打印机在她身旁嗡嗡作响，眼睛在不转头情况下追踪；她的眼镜滑落鼻梁，她用一根手指将其推回。她低声说：“别看见我。别看见我。” 小地图视野锥扫过玛雅的标记然后移开。HUD显示【潜行模式】。同事退出画面左侧；玛雅呼出一口气继续前进。

[节拍3 — 12.0秒至18.0秒] 实习生端着咖啡托盘在两米前绕过茶水间角落，嘴巴已经张开准备大声打招呼。他头顶上方弹出一个红色感叹号标记伴随快速警报声，HUD边缘脉冲红光，【警报】。摄像机大幅摆动，玛雅在一个动作中做出反应：两步无声走到柜台，抓起咖啡壶，转过身模仿倒茶动作，肩膀放松，完美随意。他伸手越过她拿牛奶，哼着小调走开，没有注意到她。警报条从琥珀色降至绿色。HUD打印【大隐隐于市】。她放下咖啡壶低声说：“……好险。” 摄像机再次落回她身后。

[节拍4 — 18.0秒至24.0秒] 最后一段路程：开阔的大堂，旁边是一间仍在进行晚些时候会议的玻璃会议室。设施维护员推着他的邮件车穿过大堂朝向电梯。玛雅躲到车的远侧后面，以完美的同步节奏蹲行，匹配其2公里/小时的速度；摄像机随之漂移。会议室里的一名男子因轮子吱嘎声抬头瞥了一眼，只看到一辆车，便回到白板前。玛雅躲在车后低声说：“祝福这个男人。” HUD先打印【移动掩护】随后【一切安全】，警报条全绿。

[节拍5 — 24.0秒至27.0秒] 她在电梯厅分开，快速按下下行按钮三次，随着楼层指示器缓慢爬行而踮脚跳动。她低声说：“快点，快点——”。在她身后远处

entries.title: Bunny Grand Prix Cinematic Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a photorealistic 30-second cinematic video of rabbits racing miniature karts at golden hour, featuring specific camera settings, lighting, and character descriptions.
entries.prompt:
IDENTITY — CINEMATIC, CUT, ARRI Alexa 35 paired with a high-speed Phantom for the slow-motion inserts, 35mm anamorphic 2.39:1, motorsport broadcast meets prestige sports documentary. Golden-hour sun low on the horizon at 5200K raking across the track from frame right, long dramatic shadows, heat shimmer rising off the asphalt, rich saturated color, fine organic film grain, gentle halation on chrome and headlights, anamorphic oval bokeh and thin horizontal blue streaks on every hot highlight. Photorealistic live-action rabbits in miniature racing karts — real fur, real whisker physics, real ear weight whipping in the wind, real paw contact with tiny steering wheels. No cartoon stylization. No anthropomorphic faces. No talking mouths. The drama comes from real rabbit behavior at speed, real kart physics, and epic cinematography.

CAST — Driver 1 (Hops): adult white rabbit, medium build, long floppy ears streaming straight back in the wind, pink nose, dark glossy eyes, leaning hard into every corner. WARDROBE: tiny red satin bow tie flattened against his chest by the wind, no other clothing. KART: miniature open-wheel go-kart, glossy candy-apple red with a white racing stripe and the number 1 on the nose, chrome side pipes. Personality: the hotshot who overdrives every corner. CAST — Driver 2 (Thumper): adult chocolate-brown Holland lop rabbit, heavy droopy ears pinned back by speed, wide flat face, half-lidded eyes, sitting perfectly upright and motionless behind the wheel, jaw slowly chewing. WARDROBE: miniature black felt top hat with a thin grey ribbon band, somehow not blowing off, no other clothing. KART: matte black go-kart with a gold pinstripe and the number 2, no wasted movement, no drama. Personality: the deadpan veteran who never lifts and never flinches. CAST — Driver 3 (Nibbles): small young grey dwarf rabbit, dense soft coat, enormous ears for his body vibrating in the airflow, nose twitching at double speed, tiny paws gripping the wheel too tightly. WARDROBE: oversized black plastic novelty glasses with no lenses, slipping down his nose at every bump, no other clothing. KART: undersized sky-blue go-kart with a wobbling rear wheel and the number 3 painted slightly crooked. Personality: the terrified rookie who somehow ends up in the fight for the lead.

SYNOPSIS — Three rabbits contest the final lap of a miniature grand prix on a sprawling scale-model race circuit at golden hour. What begins as a clean three-wide sprint down the main straight escalates into an epic duel through a sweeping banked curve, a hairpin under a footbridge, a chicane lined with hay bales and tiny grandstands, and a long hill climb into a blinding sunset — with a mid-race spin, a slow-motion carrot-on-track hazard, a photo finish, and a final champagne-free podium where the deadpan lop accepts victory by simply chewing. Tone is genuinely epic: massive scale despite the miniature subjects, thunderous sound design, sweeping camera moves, and the absurdist comedy of three actual rabbits treating a kart race like the most important event in history.
LOCATION — A sprawling 20x20-foot scale-model racing circuit built outdoors on a rooftop or open field at golden hour. Real asphalt-textured track surface about 14 inches wide with painted white edge lines and red-and-white kerbing at the corners. Sections: a long main straight with a start-finish gantry, a wide banked sweeper with a tiny Armco barrier, a tight hairpin passing beneath a small wooden footbridge, a chicane lined with real miniature hay bales and small painted tire stacks in red and white, and a rising hill climb section that crests directly into the setting sun. Miniature grandstands with rows of tiny empty plastic seats catch the light. Miniature pit garages with rolled-up doors and dangling flags line the straight. A tiny race-control tower with a checkered flag mounted on top. Scattered real carrots and lettuce leaves as track debris. Real dust and small pebbles on the track edges. Beyond the circuit: hazy distant treeline and a vast sky graded from deep orange at the horizon to violet overhead, wisps of cloud catching gold. Long shadows from every object stretching across the track.
SHOT LIST — six beats, roughly 5 seconds each, hard cuts between shots, camera movement exactly as specified.

[0:00–0:05] SHOT 1 — THE FINAL LAP. Low tracking shot, camera mounted at track level about 6 inches above the asphalt, 35mm anamorphic, racing alongside the three karts down the main straight at full speed, the start-finish gantry whipping overhead as they cross the line for the final lap. Three-wide: Hops on the left in red, Thumper center in black, Nibbles on the right in sky blue. Ears streaming straight back on all three. Motion blur on the track surface and the grandstands, the karts sharp. Heat shimmer distorts the far end of the straight. Golden sun rakes across the karts from frame right, blowing out the chrome pipes into anamorphic streaks. A tiny race marshal's checkered flag waves in the foreground blur — final lap. Hops edges forward, leaning over his wheel. Thumper doesn't move a whisker. Nibbles' glasses slide down and he tilts his head back to catch them at 40 miles an hour.

[0:05–0:10] SHOT 2 — THE BANKED SWEEPER. Cut to a soaring drone shot, 24mm wide, camera sweeping in a high orbiting arc from directly behind the karts as they enter the wide banked curve, the whole circuit revealed below like a cathedral of asphalt and gold light — the hairpin, the chicane, the hill climb, the grandstands all laid out in miniature glory, shadows of the karts stretching long across the banking. The three karts lean into the curve, Hops taking the high line on the banking, Thumper the middle, Nibbles hugging the bottom. Hops carries too much speed — his rear wheels step out, a puff of dust, a slide caught with a flick of his paws on the wheel. The camera continues its arc, sun sweeping behind the trio and flaring across the lens in a wide horizontal blue streak. The scale of the circuit against the vast sunset sky makes three rabbits in go-karts look like the most important race ever run.

[0:10–0:15] SHOT 3 — THE HAIRPIN UNDER THE BRIDGE. Cut to a locked-off frame on the exit of the hairpin, 85mm long lens, camera positioned ahead of the corner looking back so the karts approach head-on through the shadow beneath the small wooden footbridge and burst into golden light as they exit. Deep compression of the long lens stacks all three karts in frame. Thumper leads now, perfectly calm, top hat level. Hops dives inside, karts almost touching, sparks of gravel kicking off the kerb. Nibbles brakes far too early behind them, his little kart's rear wheel wobbling violently. In the middle of the corner, a real carrot lies on the racing line. Rack focus snaps to it. Hops runs straight over it — the carrot bursts, orange fragments flying in slow motion at 120 frames per second, catching the sun like sparks. Snap back to real time. Hops' kart lurches, his ears flip forward over his face, he is momentarily driving blind.

[0:15–0:20] SHOT 4 — THE SPIN. Cut to a handheld chase cam, gimbal-stabilized but alive, 35mm, tracking close behind Hops as he charges into the hay-bale chicane still with his ears over his eyes. He flips them back just in time to see the first hay bale. He yanks the wheel. The red kart snaps into a full 360-degree spin — the camera whips with it, the world rotating: grandstands, hay bales, sky, sun, hay bales, grandstands — a plume of golden dust erupting around him, a hay bale clipped and exploding into drifting straw that catches the light. Through the dust, Thumper's black kart threads the chicane untouched, not deviating an inch, top hat level, chewing. Nibbles enters the chicane behind them, sees the chaos, pani

entries.title: Multi-Scene Transition Video Prompt
entries.description: A prompt for a fast-paced cinematic transition video using six images as keyframes, describing specific actions and match cuts to create a seamless continuous shot effect.
entries.prompt:
Create a fast-paced cinematic transition video using Image 1 to Image 6.

In Image 1, the woman swings a badminton racket from left to right while background characters quickly walk past, leaving motion silhouettes. After the complete swing, transition to Image 2 by matching the cane position with the final racket position.

In Image 2, the woman turns around. Push the camera toward her neck as her moving hair covers the lens. Use the hair as a natural transition into Image 3.

In Image 3, pull the camera back. A manservant in a suit and white gloves enters from the right and hands the woman a wine glass filled halfway with red wine. She takes the glass and moves it toward the camera until it completely covers the lens.

Use the wine glass occlusion to transition into Image 4. The woman pulls the glass toward herself, then quickly extends it toward the front-right. Match the glass with the prop in Image 5 for another rapid transition.

In Image 5, the woman lowers the gun and turns backward onto the rooftop, looking toward the camera. Push rapidly into an extreme close-up of her eyes. She gives a subtle wink.

Then pull the camera back and transition into Image 6, ending with a cinematic close-up of the woman.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Autumn City Vlog Sequence
entries.description: A complex multi-shot prompt for generating a 30-second autumn city vlog featuring a young woman, with specific camera angles, lighting, and narrative beats.
entries.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A 20-year-old East Asian woman spends an autumn day moving through a big city — leaving her apartment, riding the subway, grabbing coffee from a cart, cutting through a park in falling leaves, browsing a bookstore, catching golden hour on a rooftop, and riding home at night — filmed as a candid, mixed-format day-in-the-city vlog, 30 seconds total.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@image1: 20-year-old East Asian woman, soft round face, warm ivory skin, dark brown hair in a loose high bun with face-framing strands, natural dewy makeup, gentle expressive eyes, wearing a wine-burgundy ribbed knit off-shoulder sweater and a small silver flower pendant necklace. 100% matches the reference throughout every shot.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot. HARD CUTs only at the stated seconds; camera does not cut on its own between them. Mixed scene styles — not every shot has dialogue; some are silent candid b-roll.

0.0s–4.0s — HARD CUT
4.0s–8.0s — HARD CUT
8.0s–12.0s — HARD CUT
12.0s–17.0s — HARD CUT
17.0s–21.0s — HARD CUT
21.0s–26.0s — HARD CUT
26.0s–30.0s — end

OPTICS
Shot 1: 63° wide, POV-adjacent handheld. Shot 2: 47° neutral, static-ish lean. Shot 3: 29° portrait-compression, quick transactional. Shot 4: 18° natural-portrait, slow-mo detail. Shot 5: 29° portrait-compression, candid unaware angle. Shot 6: 47° neutral, two-shot-adjacent solo toast. Shot 7: 18° natural-portrait, close reflective. No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
Handheld throughout with natural 1–2cm tremor. Shot 1: phone-height POV-style, walking at 4 km/h. Shot 2: camera rests low against a pole, minimal movement, observational. Shot 3: quick whip from hand to face and back. Shot 4: slowed to half real-time, camera drifts sideways at 1 km/h following falling leaves. Shot 5: camera appears to catch her off-guard, slight delay before she notices it. Shot 6: static-ish, propped, she moves into frame. Shot 7: static through car window glass, reflections passing over her face.

ACTION
0.0s–4.0s: She steps out of an apartment building onto a leaf-scattered sidewalk, adjusting her bag strap, glancing at her phone, morning light low and warm through bare branches. She looks up at the camera briefly, half-smiles: "Okay — let's do this."

4.0s–8.0s: Inside a subway car, she leans against a pole, earbuds in, watching the platform lights blur past the window, city sounds muffled and rhythmic. No dialogue — just her quiet, unbothered expression, occasional sway with the train's motion.

8.0s–12.0s: At a small street coffee cart, steam rising from the machine, she hands over cash, receives a paper cup, wraps both hands around it immediately for warmth. Brief exchange, she says only: "Thanks, you're the best."

12.0s–17.0s: Slow-motion through a park path thick with falling amber leaves, she tips her head back mid-step and turns once, leaves catching in her hair and sweater, genuine unguarded laugh, no spoken line — just breath and laughter audible.

17.0s–21.0s: Inside a small bookstore, she runs a finger along a shelf, pulls a book halfway out, flips a few pages, unaware of the camera, soft window light across her face, ambient store quiet. No dialogue.

21.0s–26.0s: On a rooftop at golden hour, city skyline hazy behind her, she raises a takeaway coffee cup slightly toward the lens like a small toast, warm low sun rim-lighting her hair, says only: "To days like this."

26.0s–30.0s: Inside a taxi at night, warm amber streetlights sliding across the window glass and over her face in soft passing bands, she rests her head against the seat, tired contented smile, looks toward the lens and says: "Best day, hands down."

PERFORMANCE
Restrained, natural reactions — no performed excitement. Shots 2 and 5 specifically read as candid/unaware of the camera. Living eyes with catch-light in every close shot, visible breath in shot 1, natural skin and fabric texture throughout.

PHYSICS
Leaves fall and scatter with real weight and drift, catching briefly in hair and sweater fibers before falling away. Coffee steam rises and dissipates naturally. Streetlight bands move across her face and the window glass with correct parallax as the car moves. Train sway shifts her weight subtly and believably.

LIGHTING
Shot 1: low warm morning sun through bare branches, soft shadow lines. Shot 2: cool fluorescent subway light with warm practicals flickering past outside. Shot 3: overcast daylight, soft even key. Shot 4: dappled warm sun through park canopy, backlit leaf edges. Shot 5: soft window-diffused daylight, low contrast. Shot 6: warm low-angle golden hour key, strong rim light, soft haze. Shot 7: warm amber sodium streetlight passing bands only, otherwise dark interior.

COLOR GRADE
Warm autumn palette — amber, rust, and soft gold tones with muted city grays. Warm amber streetlight at night, never neon or saturated colored signage anywhere in frame. No cool-cyan or magenta tint.

WARDROBE
Wine-burgundy ribbed knit off-shoulder sweater and silver flower pendant necklace, unchanged and clearly visible in every shot. A loosely draped scarf or open coat may sit over it in the subway and taxi shots without covering it.

AUDIO
Shot 1: quiet street ambience, rustling leaves. Shot 2: muffled train rumble, distant announcement, no dialogue. Shot 3: espresso machine hiss, brief exchange. Shot 4: crunch of leaves, natural laughter, no line. Shot 5: quiet store ambience, page-turning, no dialogue. Shot 6: distant city hum, wind. Shot 7: engine hum, soft radio murmur under her line.

STYLE
Authentic day-in-the-life vlog cinematography, dreamy 35mm film aesthetic, fine natural grain, realistic autofocus hunting, mix of talking and silent candid shots for a lived-in, unscripted feel.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
4K, 24fps, 35mm grain, real-time except shot 4 (half real-time slow motion), realistic handheld motion, no neon or saturated signage in the color palette anywhere.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Same woman's face and build in every shot, matching @image1 exactly. Wine-burgundy sweater and silver necklace stay visible in every shot. Hair stays in the same loose high bun throughout. Cuts only at stated seconds, camera does not cut on its own. Shots 2 and 5 stay dialogue-free and candid. Warm amber tones hold throughout — no neon, no cool-cyan tint anywhere.

entries.title: Zombie King Battle Narrative Prompt
entries.description: A complex narrative action prompt involving specific characters and references to create a 20-second cinematic battle scene.
entries.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A 20-second cinematic realistic 3D narrative action scene inside a war-damaged ground floor connected to a ruined street. Battle-worn Alin fights the feral zombie king Ston in fast close-quarters combat. Her counter briefly works, then Ston re-catches her, throws her into a weak brick wall, and advances for the finishing blow. Hia races in from an upper side passage and, only after Ston has fully committed to the kill, flashes in through a side-above opening and kills him with one solid straight sword slash carrying a tight blue laser edge. She immediately catches and supports Alin, then helps her leave while fire and war continue behind them. Only one brief slow-motion beat: after Hia suddenly enters frame and before the blade touches Ston. Impact and aftermath return to normal speed.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
Image 1: Alin, adult woman, blonde long hair with straight bangs, white sleeveless top, blue jeans, brown tall boots. Exact face, body, hair base, and outfit style. Start already heavily battle-worn, not clean.
Image 2: Hia, adult swordswoman, black updo, gold hair ornaments, dark red ribbons, dark blue-black and dark red embroidered warrior outfit, shoulder armor, bracers, boots. Exact identity and costume. No weapon from this image.
Image 3: Ston, zombie king, grey cracked skin, gaunt but sinewy body, long black hair, cloudy eyes, torn black clothing, round pendant, exact humanoid structure. No wings, no extra bone armor. Blood is thick opaque near-black liquid.
Image 4: Hia’s only sword, rigid silver double-edged straight blade with engraved details, gold-bronze guard, black wrapped grip, metal pommel. Unsheathed only. Hia always holds it in her right hand. No scabbard, no weapon swap, no duplication, no stretching. Blue laser edge clings to the real metal blade, which always stays visible.

LOCATION MAP
The first frame already contains Alin and Ston mid-struggle. Alin is screen-left in front of a concrete pillar, Ston is to her right. About 2.5 meters behind Alin’s left is a damaged brick wall with cracked plaster, loose rubble at the base, and a gap opening to the street. Ston later throws Alin sideways into that exact weak wall section; she slides down to the rubble at its base. Ston advances along the ground in the same direction. Hia runs along an upper adjacent broken passage and reaches a natural floor gap above the near side of the battlefield. She kicks off the edge and drops forward-down through that opening. Debris, beams, and Ston’s body hide her final approach. When she clears the occlusion, the slash is already in motion. During the kill Alin is low against the wall, her head below Ston’s chest. Hia’s neck-height slash passes above Alin’s head. Hia lands beside Ston, within one step of Alin, never hovering. Ston collapses near his standing spot and does not block the rescue path. Final rescue position: Hia stands on Alin’s right, bearing her with left shoulder and left arm, sword low in Hia’s right hand pointing outward to empty ground.

FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame already contains the fight. No empty environment shot, no character intro shot. Main combat coverage stays on the same side of the action axis, shooting from the open street side toward the building interior. Hia’s rescue inserts show only fast fragments of eyes, partial side face, sword hand, and steps until after the kill. Her full stable reveal happens only during the rescue.

FORMAT MODE
Controlled multi-shot sequence. HARD CUTS only. Fast attack-defense rhythm, wall impact, exhaustion and pursuit, accelerating rescue inserts, sudden side-above entry, one brief pre-contact slow beat, immediate fast kill, normal-speed collapse, weighted rescue. Total finished runtime 20 seconds.

OPTICS
Main fight: 47° diagonal field of view, grounded natural combat coverage with full bodies, support feet, and landmarks readable.
Rescue inserts: 29° diagonal field of view, tighter kinetic fragments without distortion.
Kill shot: same natural-wide family, no lens drift.
No bent architecture, no extreme wide distortion, no telephoto flattening.

CAMERA
Opening combat stays mostly in one lateral two-person medium shot with a short follow-in. Cut only when power balance or position changes clearly. Wall throw uses a fast lateral follow over the 2.5 meter displacement. Hia inserts are continuous motion fragments: eye pass, sword-hand pass, step pass, all entering and exiting frame in one direction. The kill happens in one short follow-then-stabilize shot, not a rapid multi-angle montage. The only slow-motion moment is the 0.3 second pre-contact approach after Hia enters frame. After blade contact everything immediately resumes normal speed.

ACTION TIMING
0:00-0:01.2
Ston slams battle-worn Alin shoulder-back first into the pillar. Dust shakes loose at the contact point. He controls her upper body with one arm. Alin instantly braces with her arms, pushes back, and kicks at his knee. The kick bends his support leg, shifts his weight, loosens his grip, and lets her slip half a step sideways from the pillar. Camera stays close in a side two-shot and absorbs one impact jolt, then keeps following the escape attempt.
