Capture realistic water-gun pressure, fluid dynamics, gravity, air resistance, droplets, splashes, wet clothing, wet hair, running biomechanics, friction, momentum and natural environmental reactions. Water should behave like real pressurized liquid rather than artificial beams.

Use modern 2026 handheld cinematic-vlog cinematography with dynamic tracking shots, close-ups, over-the-shoulder angles, realistic autofocus, natural camera inertia and occasional wide village views.

Natural diegetic audio only: children's laughter, footsteps, water-gun sounds, water impacts, leaves, birds, insects and authentic Korean reactions. No music, narration or subtitles.

End with everyone completely soaked and laughing together as sunlight catches the falling water droplets in the peaceful village street.

No CGI, animation, fantasy water, impossible physics, dangerous behavior, distorted faces or hands, duplicated children, changing clothing, excessive camera movement, logos or watermark.

entries.title: Pixar Style Car Ad Prompt
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot prompt for generating a Pixar-style car advertisement video using Seedance 2.5, including character references and scene descriptions.
entries.prompt:
[素材]
@画像1 = 主人公の青年（花屋）の顔・くせ毛・体格・衣装・表情
@画像2 = 悪役（高級花店の男性オーナー）の顔・大柄な体格・プラム色のエプロン・腰の花ばさみ
@画像3 = 式場スタッフ（中年女性）の顔・まとめ髪・紺色の制服
@画像4 = 新婦の顔・髪・花の髪飾り・ドレス
@画像5 = 花飾り、壊れた花飾り、花の運搬ケース、台車、花のないアーチ
@画像6 = 白い結婚式場の搬入口・廊下・ホール
@画像7 = 青年の茶色い木造の花屋・看板・積み込みスペース
@画像8 = LUMIO（明るいリーフグリーンのステーションワゴン）の外観・荷室・後席を倒した状態

@画像1〜@画像4 の各シートに並ぶ人物は、同一人物の別角度・別表情。別人として登場させない。
シートの枠・ラベル・英字・番号は映像に出さない。

[ひとことで]
15秒 | 横16:9 | 24fps。
心優しい青年の花屋が、結婚式場の搬入口で大柄な男に花飾りを壊され、うつむく新婦を見て決意し、
自分の花屋でLUMIOの広い荷室に予備の花を積み込むまで。表情豊かな3Dアニメーション長編映画のルック、セリフなし。

[全体設定]
基本の環境と質感: 晴れた日の午前中。柔らかな自然光。花びらと葉、布地、車の塗装とガラスに繊細な質感。
ビジュアル: 表情豊かなスタイライズド3Dアニメーション長編映画のルック。オリジナルの人間キャラクター。やや浅い被写界深度。柔らかな午前の自然光。
カメラ言語: 1カットにつきカメラの動きは1つだけ。基本は固定カメラ。
人物:
  @画像1 青年 = 栗色の短いくせ毛、優しい茶色の瞳、アイボリーの袖まくりシャツ、セージグリーンのエプロン、濃紺のパンツ、白いスニーカー。
  @画像2 悪役 = 白髪まじりのグレーのなでつけ髪、太い眉、大きく四角いあご、太い首、広い肩、大柄な体。アイボリーの袖まくりシャツ、花の刺繍がある深いプラム色の胸当てエプロン、右腰の革ホルダーに赤い花ばさみ、茶色の革の腕時計、濃いグレーのパンツ、茶色の革靴。見下す目つきと片側だけの薄笑い。
  @画像3 スタッフ = こげ茶に白髪がまじるまとめ髪、紺色のジャケットとパンツ、胸に名札、小さな真珠のピアス。
  @画像4 新婦 = 茶色のまとめ髪、右側に白い花の髪飾り、七分袖レースの白いドレス。
  肌は3Dアニメらしい柔らかな質感。プラスチックのようなテカりを出さない。
LUMIO: @画像8 の明るいリーフグリーンの5人乗りステーションワゴン。低く長い車体、長いルーフ、アイボリーの内装、右ハンドル。前後のVエンブレム、ライト、ホイール、窓の形を固定。
花: 白いバラを中心に、淡いピンクとアプリコット色のバラ、小さな白い花、ユーカリの葉。@画像5 の配色とケースの形を固定。
演技の核: 眉・目線・口元・姿勢だけで感情を伝える。青年の「悲しみ → 決意」の切り替えがいちばん大事。
カット数: この動画は全部で5カット。これ以外のカットや場面を足さない。
禁止: 字幕なし。BGMなし。セリフ・声・ハミングなし。物が何もないところから湧く表現なし。背景や物体のモーフィングでつながない。走行シーンを追加しない。

[タイムスタンプ]

0-6s【紹介 → 妨害】カット1（途中で切らない）
場面: @画像6 の白い式場の搬入口。やや引いた中景の固定カメラ。人物の足元の床まで画面に入れる。台車に載った @画像5 の大きな花飾りと @画像1 の青年が画面中央。
  @画像3 のスタッフは、青年から3メートル以上離れた画面奥の扉の横に立つ。青年の隣には立たない。
動作:
  0-2s: 青年は台車の横に立ち止まり、白いバラを1本、指先でそっと整えて小さく微笑む。台車は押さず、止まったまま。
  2-3.5s: 画面右から @画像2 の悪役が歩いてくる。すれ違いざま、悪役の大きな右の手のひらが、台車の上の花飾りを横から強く突き飛ばす。悪役の手と花飾りが触れる瞬間を、画面の手前ではっきり見せる。青年の両手はこのとき台車から離れている。
  3.5-5s: 花飾りが画面の左奥へ横倒しに落ち、床の上で土台が割れ、白いバラの茎が数本折れる（@画像5 の壊れた花飾りの状態）。床に散らばった花が見える。青年が両手を伸ばすが間に合わない。
  5-6s: 悪役は片側の口角だけを上げ、振り返らずに画面左の外へ出ていく。画面奥のスタッフが立ち止まり、眉をひそめて悪役を見ている。
意図: 花が落ちたのは悪役のせいだと、ひと目でわかるようにする。青年が台車を押している最中に落ちると、青年の不注意に見えるので、青年は必ず止まっている。スタッフの目撃は後の伏線なので、小さくても奥に必ず入れる。
音: 台車の車輪の音 → 手が台車に当たる鈍い音 → 花飾りが落ちる音、茎が折れる乾いた音。
負: 悪役が青年を殴らない。花飾りが空中で止まらない。BGMなし。

6-8s【扉の向こうの新婦】カット2（間を置く）
場面: しゃがんだ青年の肩越し、低い位置の固定カメラ。手前に折れた白いバラ。開いた扉の奥の廊下の先に、@画像5 の花のないアーチと @画像4 の新婦。
  アーチはアイボリーの金属の骨組みだけ。花も葉も1本もついていない。
動作: 青年が折れたバラを両手で拾い、顔を上げて扉の奥を見る。新婦はアーチの前でうつむき、小さく肩を落としている。
意図: 青年が自分の花ではなく、新婦の式を心配していることを見せる。急がない。
音: 遠い屋内の気配だけ。ほぼ無音。
負: 新婦を泣き崩れさせない。BGMなし。

8-10s【決意】カット3（間を置く）
場面: 青年の顔の近景。固定カメラ。
動作: 眉が下がった悲しい顔 → 視線が画面右、屋外のLUMIOへ動く → 目を少し見開き、眉を上げ、口元をきゅっと結ぶ。やさしい顔のまま小さくうなずき、立ち上がって画面右へ駆け出す。
意図: 悲しみから決意へ、表情だけで切り替える。この動画でいちばん大事な芝居。これは怒りではなく「新婦のために、なんとかする」という前向きな覚悟。悪役への仕返しに見せない。
音: 立ち上がる衣擦れ、駆け出す足音。
負: 眉間にしわを寄せない。にらまない。口をへの字にしない。口を開いて叫ばない。BGMなし。

10-11s【花屋へ】カット4
場面: 式場前の屋外。カメラは車の右斜め後ろ。@画像8 のLUMIOの右側面（右ハンドルの運転席側）が見える。
動作: 青年が車の右前のドア（運転席）を開けて乗り込み、ドアを閉める。左側のドアは使わない。
意図: 走行は見せない。ドアの閉まる音で、次の瞬間には花屋に着いている。
音: ドアが閉まる重い音。次のカットの頭まで響かせる。
負: 走行シーンを入れない。BGMなし。

11-15s【積み込み】カット5
場面: @画像7 の茶色い木造の花屋の前。LUMIOの真後ろ、少し高い目線の固定カメラ。車から少し離れて、車の後ろ半分と、その奥の花屋を同時に画面に入れる。
  画面の上半分に、花屋の木の外壁、キャメル色のオーニング、白い花を描いた赤茶色の看板がはっきり見える。式場と違う場所だと、ひと目でわかる。
  リアハッチは開き、後席はカットの最初から倒れている。広い荷室の奥に前席2席が見える（@画像8 の後席を倒した荷室）。
動作:
  11-12.5s: 青年が画面右から花の入ったケースを両手で抱えて入り、荷室の奥の左へ置く。
  12.5-14s: 同じ構図のジャンプカット。荷室にはケースが3個並び、青年が4個目を両手で抱えて荷室の手前の右へ置く。横2個×前後2列、一段の4個がそろう。
  14-15s: 青年が一歩下がってリアハッチに手をかけ、閉める。
  青年は11sから15sまで、ずっと画面の中にいる。
意図: 荷室の広さが物語を解決する鍵。花が潰れず、ケースの上と左右に余裕があることを見せる。ケースは必ず青年の手で運び、手とケースの接触をはっきり見せる。人がいない荷室にケースだけが増えると、魔法に見えるので避ける。
音: ケースを置く音を2回。最後にリアハッチが閉まる音。
負: 青年がいない画を作らない。ケースが勝手に現れない。後席が画面の中で動かない。ケースを重ねない。ケースが荷室の床や壁を貫通しない。BGMなし。

[締め]
全編で: 午前の柔らかな自然光。式場は白、花屋は茶色。両者を混同しない。
全編で: 表情豊かなスタイライズド3Dアニメーションのルックを保つ。
全編で: 青年・悪役・スタッフ・新婦の顔、髪、服、体格を途中で変えない。悪役の髪は白髪まじりのグレー。
全編で: LUMIOをSUVやバンに変えない。右ハンドル、ドア、リアハッチ、荷室の形を変えない。
全編で: 花とケースのデザインと配色を統一する。手に持ったケースを浮かせない、貫通させない。
全編で: 5カット・15秒で終える。場面を足さない。長いスローモーションを入れない。
全編で: 字幕を出さない。BGMを出さない。セリフ・声・ハミングを出さない。シートの枠やラベルの文字を出さない。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Assets]
@Image1 = Face, curly hair, physique, costume, and expressions of the protagonist young man (florist)
@Image2 = Face, large build, plum-colored apron, and waist shears of the villain (male owner of a high-end flower shop)
@Image3 = Face, tied-up hair, and navy uniform of the wedding venue staff (middle-aged woman)
@Image4 = Face, hair, flower hair accessory, and dress of the bride
@Image5 = Flower arrangement, broken flower arrangement, flower transport cases, cart, and arch without flowers
@Image6 = Loading entrance, hallway, and hall of a white wedding venue
@Image7 = Brown wooden florist's shop, signboard, and loading space
@Image8 = Exterior, cargo area, and rear seats folded down of the LUMIO (light leaf-green station wagon)

The characters arranged on each sheet from @Image1 to @Image4 are different angles and expressions of the same person. Do not introduce them as different people.
Do not show sheet borders, labels, English letters, or numbers in the video.

[In a nutshell]
15 seconds | Landscape 16:9 | 24fps.
A kind-hearted young florist has his flower arrangement destroyed by a large man at the wedding venue's loading entrance. Seeing the bride looking downcast, he resolves to load spare flowers into the spacious cargo area of his LUMIO at his own florist's shop. Look of an expressive 3D animated feature film, no dialogue.

[Global Settings]
Basic environment and texture: Sunny morning. Soft natural light. Delicate textures on petals, leaves, fabric, car paint, and glass.
Visuals: Look of an expressive stylized 3D animated feature film. Original human characters. Slightly shallow depth of field. Soft morning natural light.
Camera language: Only one camera movement per cut. Basic is fixed camera.
Characters:
  @Image1 Young Man = Short chestnut curly hair, gentle brown eyes, ivory rolled-up sleeves shirt, sage green apron, dark navy pants, white sneakers.
  @Image2 Villain = Graying slicked-back hair, thick eyebrows, large square jaw, thick neck, broad shoulders, large body. Ivory rolled-up sleeves shirt, deep plum-colored bib apron with floral embroidery, red shears in a leather holder on the right hip, brown leather wristwatch, dark gray pants, brown leather shoes. Condescending gaze and a smirk on one side only.
  @Image3 Staff = Dark brown hair mixed with gray tied up, navy jacket and pants, name tag on chest, small pearl earrings.
  @Image4 Bride = Brown hair tied up, white flower hair accessory on the right side, three-quarter sleeve lace white dress.
  Skin has the soft texture typical of 3D animation. Do not create plastic-like gloss.
LUMIO: Light leaf-green 5-seater station wagon from @Image8. Low and long body, long roof, ivory interior, right-hand drive. Fix the front and rear V emblems, lights, wheels, and window shapes.
Flowers: Centered around white roses, with pale pink and apricot roses, small white flowers, and eucalyptus leaves. Fix the color scheme and case shape from @Image5.
Core of acting: Convey emotions only through eyebrows, gaze, mouth, and posture. The young man's switch from "sadness" to "determination" is the most important.
Number of cuts: This video consists of exactly 5 cuts. Do not add any other cuts or scenes.
Prohibited: No subtitles. No BGM. No dialogue, voices, or humming. No objects popping out of nowhere. No morphing backgrounds or objects to connect scenes. Do not add driving scenes.

[Timestamps]

0-6s [Introduction → Interference] Cut 1 (do not cut mid-way)
Scene: White wedding venue loading entrance from @Image6. Fixed camera at a slightly pulled-back medium shot. Include the floor below the characters' feet in the frame. The large flower arrangement from @Image5 on the cart and the young man from @Image1 are in the center of the screen.
  The staff from @Image3 stands next to the door in the background, more than 3 meters away from the young man. Do not stand next to the young man.
Action:
  0-2s: The young man stops beside the cart, gently adjusts a single white rose with his fingertips, and smiles slightly. He does not push the cart; it remains stopped.
  2-3.5s: The villain from @Image2 walks in from the right of the screen. As they pass, the villain's large right palm strongly shoves the flower arrangement on the cart from the side. Clearly show the moment the villain's hand touches the flower arrangement in the foreground. The young man's hands are off the cart at this time.
  3.5-5s: The flower arrangement falls sideways to the back left of the screen, the base cracks on the floor, and several white rose stems break (state of the broken flower arrangement from @Image5). Flowers scattered on the floor are visible. The young man reaches out with both hands but is too late.
  5-6s: The villain raises only one corner of his mouth, does not look back, and exits to the left of the screen. The staff in the background stop, frowning as they watch the villain.
Intent: Make it clear at a glance that the villain caused the flowers to fall. If the flowers fall while the young man is pushing the cart, it looks like the young man's negligence, so the young man must be stationary. The staff witnessing this is foreshadowing for later, so include them clearly in the background even if small.
Sound: Cart wheel sound → dull thud of hand hitting the cart → sound of flower arrangement falling, dry snap of stems breaking.
Negative: Villain does not punch the young man. Flower arrangement does not freeze in mid-air. No BGM.

6-8s [Bride Beyond the Door] Cut 2 (pause for effect)
Scene: Low-angle fixed camera over the shoulder of the crouching young man. A broken white rose in the foreground. In the distance down the hallway beyond the open door, the arch without flowers from @Image5 and the bride from @Image4.
  The arch is only an ivory metal frame. No flowers or leaves attached.
Action: The young man picks up the broken rose with both hands, lifts his face, and looks into the doorway. The bride stands before the arch, head down, shoulders slumped slightly.
Intent: Show that the young man is worried about the bride's ceremony, not just his own flowers. Do not rush.
Sound: Only faint indoor atmosphere. Almost silent.
Negative: Do not make the bride collapse crying. No BGM.

8-10s [Determination] Cut 3 (pause for effect)
Scene: Close-up of the young man's face. Fixed camera.
Action: Sad face with lowered eyebrows → gaze moves to the right of the screen, towards the LUMIO outside → eyes widen slightly, eyebrows raise, lips press together firmly. Nods slightly with a gentle expression, stands up, and runs off to the right of the screen.
Intent: Switch from sadness to determination using only facial expressions. This is the most important acting in the video. This is not anger, but a positive resolve to "do something for the bride." Do not make it look like revenge against the villain.
Sound: Rustle of clothes as he stands up, footsteps as he runs off.
Negative: Do not furrow brows. Do not glare. Do not make mouth a 'no' shape. Do not open mouth to shout. No BGM.

10-11s [To the Florist] Cut 4
Scene: Outdoors in front of the venue. Camera is behind and to the right of the car. The right side of the LUMIO from @Image8 (driver's side for right-hand drive) is visible.
Action: The young man opens the front right door (driver's seat), gets in, and closes the door. Do not use the left door.
Intent: Do not show driving. The sound of the door closing implies he arrives at the florist instantly.
Sound: Heavy sound of the door closing. Let it resonate until the start of the next cut.
Negative: Do not include driving scenes. No BGM.

11-15s [Loading] Cut 5
Scene: In front of the brown wooden florist's shop from @Image7. Fixed camera from directly behind the LUMIO, slightly high angle. Position the camera slightly away from the car to include the rear half of the car and the florist behind it simultaneously.
  The upper half of the screen clearly shows the florist's wooden exterior wall, camel-colored awning, and reddish-brown sign depicting white flowers. It is immediately obvious this is a different location from the venue.
  The rear hatch is open, and the rear seats are already folded down from the start of the cut. The two front seats are visible deep inside the spacious cargo area (cargo area with rear seats folded from @Image8).
Action:
  11-12.5s: The young man enters from the right carrying a flower-filled case with both hands and places it in the back left of the cargo area.
  12.5-14s: Jump cut with the same composition. Three cases are lined up in the cargo area, and the young man carries the fourth case with both hands and places it in the front right of the cargo area. Two rows across × two columns deep, completing four cases in one tier.
  14-15s: The young man steps back, places his hand on the rear hatch, and closes it.
  The young man remains in the frame continuously from 11s to 15s.
Intent: The width of the cargo area is the key to resolving the story. Show that the flowers are not crushed and there is ample space above and to the sides of the cases. Cases must always be carried by the young man's hands, and the contact between hands and cases must be clearly shown. Avoid having cases appear magically in an empty cargo area.
Sound: Sound of placing cases twice. Finally, the sound of the rear hatch closing.
Negative: Do not create shots where the young man is absent. Cases do not appear on their own. Rear seats do not move within the frame. Do not stack cases. Cases do not penetrate the cargo floor or walls. No BGM.

[Closing]
Throughout: Soft morning natural light. Venue is white, florist is brown. Do not confuse the two.
Throughout: Maintain the look of expressive stylized 3D animation.
Throughout: Do not change the faces, hair, clothes, or physiques of the young man, villain, staff, or bride midway. The villain's hair is graying.
Throughout: Do not change the LUMIO into an SUV or van. Do not change the right-hand drive, doors, rear hatch, or cargo area shape.
Throughout: Unify the design and color scheme of flowers and cases. Do not float held cases, do not let them penetrate objects.
Throughout: End with 5 cuts / 15 seconds. Do not add scenes. Do not include long slow motion.
Throughout: No subtitles. No BGM. No dialogue, voices, or humming. No text from sheet borders or labels.

entries.title: AAA Gameplay School Mission Video
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a 30-second photorealistic AAA gameplay video set in a Japanese high school.
entries.prompt:
Create exactly 30 seconds of photorealistic 4K AAA third-person gameplay inside a realistic Japanese high school on a bright weekday morning. The sequence should feel like a spontaneous story mission with believable movement, natural NPC behavior, realistic physics, and uninterrupted environmental continuity.

CHARACTER:
20-year-old Japanese schoolgirl with medium-length straight black hair, subtle side bangs, natural youthful facial features, white short-sleeve school blouse, navy ribbon, dark grey pleated skirt, black knee-high socks, white indoor sneakers, and a dark blue shoulder school bag. Maintain identical face, hair, body proportions, clothing, footwear, and accessories from beginning to end.

OBJECT:
A small red classroom key attached to a simple wooden key tag. The key is fully physical, metallic, reflective, and consistently sized throughout the sequence.

0–5s — THE MISSING KEY

Inside an emptying classroom, she searches through a desk drawer and realizes the classroom key is missing. She notices the red key tag underneath a stack of worksheets near the window. She reaches for it, but a sudden gust from the open window pushes the worksheets across the desk and the key drops onto the floor.

HUD: FIND THE CLASSROOM KEY

5–10s — DOWN THE CORRIDOR

She picks up the key and leaves the classroom. A school announcement begins playing through the hallway speakers. She walks toward the main office while checking the key tag against a handwritten classroom number.

Students move naturally around her, some entering classrooms, others carrying books and sports bags.

10–15s — WRONG TURN

She reaches an intersection and realizes she has taken the wrong corridor. She stops beside a wall map of the school and studies it briefly.

A group of younger students rushes past carrying basketballs, causing her to step back against the wall. Once the corridor clears, she turns into a smaller connecting hallway.

15–20s — LOCKED DOOR

She reaches a shortcut door but finds it locked. She tries the handle once, then notices a stairwell beside it.

She takes the stairs down one level. Her shoes make realistic sounds against each step while sunlight flickers across the stairwell through the tall windows.

HUD: TAKE THE SHORTCUT

20–26s — LAST SECOND

She exits the stairwell and reaches the classroom wing just as a staff member begins closing a large sliding partition at the end of the corridor.

She quickly walks through the remaining opening before it closes, then reaches the classroom door.

She inserts the key into the lock, turns it naturally, opens the door, and steps inside.

HUD: ROOM UNLOCKED

26–30s — HARD CUT

Hard cut to a fixed frontal classroom shot.

She places the key on the teacher's desk, removes her school bag, and sits down at her usual seat.

The teacher enters a moment later, notices the unlocked room, and gives her a brief approving look.

She quietly opens her notebook as the morning lesson begins.

HUD: MISSION COMPLETE

CAMERA:
Use one grounded third-person camera from 0–26s positioned behind and slightly beside the girl. Maintain natural gameplay-style tracking with realistic camera inertia and subtle operator movement.

The camera must physically follow the character through classrooms, corridors, stairwell, and doorway. No floating camera, no orbiting shots, no sudden perspective changes, no impossible tracking, and no cuts during the first 26 seconds.

entries.prompt:
CONCEPT:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic slice-of-life video about a young woman spending a quiet evening on an apartment rooftop, trying to get an old battery-powered radio working before sunset.

The entire story happens in one location. No shopping, no café, no market, no journey, and no walking-home sequence.

The charm comes from tiny realistic actions, environmental sounds, and her reaction when the radio suddenly works.

FORMAT:
30 seconds • 16:9 • 1080p • photorealistic live-action • authentic handheld consumer-camera footage

MAIN CHARACTER

A young Moroccan woman in her early 20s with naturally curly dark hair tied loosely with a fabric band.

She wears a faded mustard sweatshirt, relaxed dark jeans, white canvas sneakers, and a thin silver necklace.

Keep her face, hair, clothing, necklace, age, body proportions, and identity completely consistent.

LOCATION

An ordinary apartment rooftop in Casablanca, Morocco, shortly before sunset.

The rooftop contains:

- Concrete walls
- Old plastic chairs
- Several potted plants
- Water tanks
- Laundry lines
- A small wooden table
- A dusty portable radio
- Neighboring apartment buildings
- Satellite dishes
- Laundry moving gently in the breeze

Warm late-afternoon sunlight gradually changes as the scene progresses.

No famous landmarks or recognizable brands.

CAMERA STYLE

Recorded by a friend using an older consumer camcorder.

The camera should feel physically present on the rooftop.

- Handheld movement
- Slight natural shake
- Imperfect framing
- Occasional autofocus hunting
- Exposure shifts when pointed toward the sunset
- Mild digital noise
- Slight compression
- Natural motion blur
- Ordinary color reproduction
- No stabilization
- No artificial bokeh
- No commercial cinematography

SHOT BREAKDOWN

0–5 SECONDS — THE RADIO

Start with a close shot of an old dusty portable radio sitting on a small wooden table.

The woman enters the frame and picks it up.

She turns the power knob.

Nothing happens.

She taps the side of the radio.

She looks at the camera.

“Come on…”

---

5–10 SECONDS — TRYING AGAIN

She opens the battery compartment.

The camera moves closer over her shoulder.

She removes the batteries and checks them.

One battery is slightly loose.

She adjusts it and puts everything back together.

A small click.

Still nothing.

She gives the radio an annoyed look.

---

10–15 SECONDS — THE ANTENNA

She pulls the antenna upward.

The antenna makes a tiny metallic clicking sound.

She rotates the radio toward different directions.

The camera follows her movement.

Suddenly, a burst of static comes through the speaker.

She immediately stops moving.

---

15–21 SECONDS — FOUND IT

She slowly turns the tuning dial.

Static.

More static.

Then a faint, completely original radio melody comes through.

Her expression changes into a genuine smile.

She looks toward the camera.

“There.”

---

21–26 SECONDS — SUNSET

She places the radio on the table.

She pulls a plastic chair closer and sits down.

The camera slowly shifts away from her toward the rooftop horizon.

The radio continues playing softly.

Wind moves the laundry behind her.

She quietly listens.

---

26–30 SECONDS — LITTLE ENDING

She suddenly reaches over and lowers the radio volume.

She looks at the sunset.

The camera moves slightly closer from behind.

She doesn't say anything.

The shot ends naturally on her sitting beside the radio as the sunlight fades.

AUDIO

Authentic rooftop ambience only:

- Wind
- Distant traffic
- Birds
- Laundry fabric moving
- Radio static
- Dial clicks
- Battery compartment clicks
- Plastic chair scraping concrete
- Quiet original radio melody
- Natural breathing

NO ADDED BACKGROUND MUSIC.

The radio melody must be original and not imitate a recognizable copyrighted song.

REALISM / PHYSICS

The radio must behave like a real old battery-powered device.

The tuning dial should physically rotate.

The antenna should extend realistically.

The static should change naturally as the radio is rotated.

The laundry should respond subtly to the wind.

The chair should scrape slightly when moved.

Sunlight and shadows should remain physically consistent throughout.

Hands must interact naturally with the radio and battery compartment.

NEGATIVE PROMPT

CGI, 3D render, animation, plastic skin, beauty filter, artificial face, face morphing, identity drift, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicated people, floating objects, impossible radio mechanics, fake static, unrealistic antenna movement, teleportation, object duplication, excessive HDR, oversaturated colors, heavy cinematic grading, artificial bokeh, fake film grain, studio lighting, perfect stabilization, drone footage, commercial advertisement aesthetic, exaggerated acting, subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, recognizable brands, copyrighted music, wardrobe changes, hairstyle changes, continuity errors.

FINAL LOOK

The final footage should feel like someone casually filmed a quiet evening on a rooftop and happened to capture a small moment that felt worth remembering.

Don't force emotion.

Don't make the sunset overly dramatic.

Keep the imperfect camera movement, ordinary rooftop clutter, realistic wind, slight autofocus mistakes, and natural pauses.

Simple moment. Real environment. Genuine reaction.

entries.title: Robot Child Toy Assembly
entries.description: Ultra-realistic cinematic short film prompt depicting a robot helping a child assemble a toy in a dimly lit living room, focusing on emotional storytelling and lighting.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic short film, vertical 9:16.

Inside a dark, cozy living room late at night, a young child sits on the wooden floor, carefully assembling a small toy project. Beside the child, a humanoid robot kneels down at the child's eye level, gently assisting with the tiny toy parts.

The robot has a realistic white-and-black mechanical body, intricate joints, subtle brushed-metal textures, soft reflections, and expressive mechanical eyes. Its movements are slow, precise, and gentle. The robot carefully picks up a small toy component, examines it, and hands it to the child. The camera begins with a medium-wide shot of the robot and child sitting together on the floor, then slowly moves closer in a gentle cinematic dolly-in. Cut to a close-up of the robot's articulated fingers carefully placing a toy part. Cut to the child's face, showing genuine curiosity and a subtle smile. Natural handheld shake, imperfect framing, gentle reframing, occasional autofocus hunting, mild exposure shifts, faded colors, soft contrast, authentic DV compression, subtle low-light digital noise and microphone noise. ANIMATION:
Natural, smooth character movement with believable walking, tiny head movements, blinking, subtle feather motion, expressive eyes, wing gestures, and adorable comedic timing. Emphasize the emotional progression from annoyance to reconciliation.

CAMERA:
Vertical 9:16 composition. Cinematic medium shots and gentle close-ups. Slow, subtle camera movement with a shallow depth of field. Keep both chicks clearly visible and centered throughout the scene.

VISUAL STYLE:
High-end cinematic 3D animation, photorealistic fluffy feathers, detailed eyes, realistic soft lighting, beautiful depth of field, natural environmental textures, warm color grading, soft bokeh, polished movie-quality rendering.

MOOD:
Cute, funny, emotional, wholesome, playful, and heartwarming.

QUALITY:
Ultra-detailed, cinematic, smooth motion, physically believable animation, realistic feather physics, expressive facial animation, 4K quality, clean composition, no text, no watermark.

entries.title: Office Stealth Game Sequence
entries.description: A prompt for a 30-second AAA stealth-action game sequence set in a Japanese office, featuring a character named NAGI avoiding her boss to reach the elevator, with detailed character descriptions and spatial routing.
entries.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT

A 30-second realistic AAA third-person stealth-action game sequence set in a Japanese corporate office at exactly 5:00 PM on a bright weekday afternoon. The player character, NAGI, has finished her work and must reach the elevator without being stopped by her boss and given another assignment.

ACTIVE REFERENCES

[@Image1] = NAGI’s facial identity, if a character reference is supplied. Use only her facial appearance as the identity reference; replace any school clothing and background with the adult office character and environment specified below.

NAGI: Japanese woman, 25, long straight black hair with blunt bangs, white short-sleeve office blouse, charcoal tailored trousers, black leather belt, white minimalist sneakers, employee ID clipped to her waistband, small black work tote held close to her body.

Voice: light, breathy adult female voice, speaking Japanese in a hushed whisper. Keep her face, hairstyle, outfit, proportions, and accessories identical throughout.

CAST SEPARATION

Four distinct adult office characters appear, each with a different silhouette, age, and hairstyle so they read as separate people:

TEAM LEADER: man in his 40s, 170 cm, average build, full head of short black hair parted at the side, thin metal-framed glasses, white dress shirt with a loosened navy tie. Appears only beside the first desk cluster, checking his watch.
PAPERWORK COWORKER: woman in her 20s, 160 cm, slim, brown hair in a high ponytail, beige cardigan over a white blouse, carrying a thick stack of printouts. Appears only in the printer aisle.
BOSS: man in his 60s, 160 cm, stout and round-shouldered, completely bald with a shiny scalp and a fringe of white hair above the ears, round gold-rimmed glasses, charcoal three-piece suit with a company lapel badge, carrying a blue assignment folder. Appears at the corridor T-junction and remains in that connected corridor during the whiteboard sequence.
OFFICE ASSISTANT: man in his early 30s, 182 cm, lean and broad-shouldered, thick full black hair swept back, short beard, navy shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers, no glasses. Pushes the mobile whiteboard from the meeting-room alcove toward the elevator lobby.

The BOSS is the only bald character in the entire video. The OFFICE ASSISTANT keeps a full head of thick black hair and a beard, stands more than 20 cm taller than the BOSS, and is clearly a different, much younger man.

LOCATION MAP

One unbroken spatial route the camera travels with her:

Her workstation → low desk partition → printer aisle → corridor T-junction → meeting-room alcove with mobile whiteboard → elevator lobby → elevator interior.

Keep the route compact and physically traversable within the 27-second continuous section.

Foreground: polished linoleum floor, office desks, steel filing cabinets, rolling chairs, and reflective glass meeting-room partitions.

Background: window wall on camera-right overlooking neighboring office buildings, dust suspended in the sunbeams. Light enters from camera-right along the office route.

ELEVATOR GEOMETRY

The elevator entrance is at the end of the office corridor. The call button is on the wall beside the entrance. The elevator is empty when NAGI enters.

Inside the elevator: brushed-metal rear wall, side handrails, softly illuminated ceiling, control panel beside the doorway. No rear exit and no mirror creating a second NAGI.

NAGI enters facing the rear wall, then turns to face the open elevator doors.

For the final reverse shot, the camera is positioned INSIDE the elevator, immediately beside the doorway, looking inward at NAGI. The brushed-metal rear wall is behind her. The elevator doors close behind the camera, allowing her face to remain visible throughout the final shot.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING

First frame is already in motion: NAGI darts in from lower-left toward camera-right, work tote clutched to her chest, and drops into a crouch-slide behind a low desk partition beside her workstation.

Camera behind her right shoulder. Game HUD fully visible from frame one.

A small desk clock reads 17:00.

FORMAT MODE

One continuous unbroken take from 0.0s to 27.0s with no cuts of any kind, then a single HARD CUT at 27.0s to one final locked reverse shot that runs to 30.0s.

Exactly one cut exists in the whole video, at 27.0s. The camera does not cut anywhere else.

OPTICS

One lens for the continuous section: 47° third-person over-the-shoulder framing as the baseline, breathing in to 29° on reaction beats and out to 63° for the boss encounter and moving-whiteboard concealment.

All FOV changes in that section happen as smooth continuous zoom breathing, never as a jump.

The final shot after the cut is a fixed 29° frontal framing of NAGI, no drift.

CAMERA

For the continuous section, the camera is a physical object flying with her.

Chest-height, 1.5 meters behind NAGI, slightly camera-right of her spine, swinging with a soft spring delay half a beat behind her turns like an analog-stick gameplay camera.

It dips to knee height when she crouches, rises when she stands, slides sideways along the filing cabinets with her, swings wide to corridor-left to reveal the boss encounter, drifts behind her for the moving whiteboard, and follows her through the open elevator doorway.

The camera travels through open space around desks and partitions. It never clips through furniture, walls, the whiteboard, or elevator doors.

After the cut, the camera is repositioned inside the elevator beside the doorway, looking inward at NAGI — locked off, eye level, completely static, no movement.

ACTION

[Beat 1 — 0.0s to 6.0s]

NAGI crouch-slides behind the low desk partition, back flat against it, chest heaving. She leans out 20 cm to peek at the TEAM LEADER checking his watch beside the adjacent desk cluster, then pulls back.

She whispers in Japanese:

{定時だ…捕まったら終わり。}

HUD flashes 【5:00 PM — SHIFT OVER】 and the mission banner 【OBJECTIVE: REACH THE ELEVATOR UNDETECTED】.

The TEAM LEADER turns toward a ringing desk phone. NAGI slips behind his back, staying below the desk-partition line, and moves into the printer aisle.

The camera follows without stopping.

[Beat 2 — 6.0s to 12.0s]

The camera stays with her beside the steel filing cabinets.

NAGI presses her spine flat against the cabinets and shuffles sideways at 2 km/h, sneakers rolling heel-to-toe in silence. The camera tracks sideways with her at the same speed.

The PAPERWORK COWORKER walks past the end of the row carrying a thick stack of printouts, scanning the office for someone available to help.

NAGI holds her breath, pupils tracking the coworker without moving her head, and whispers:

{来ないで…こっち見ないで。}

The minimap vision cone sweeps past NAGI’s marker and turns away.

HUD shows 【SNEAKING MODE】.

The PAPERWORK COWORKER exits frame-left. NAGI exhales, crouches beneath the edge of the last desk, and slips into the corridor with the camera still on her shoulder.

[Beat 3 — 12.0s to 18.0s]

The BOSS steps around the T-junction two meters in front of her, blue assignment folder in hand.

He catches a brief glimpse of movement. A red exclamation marker snaps above his bald head with a sharp alert sting. The HUD edge pulses red: 【ALERT】.

He starts saying in Japanese:

{なぎさん、追加の仕事が…}

The camera swings wide to corridor-left as NAGI reacts in one motion: hugs her tote tightly against her ribs, drops below his eye line, pivots around the corner of a tall filing cabinet, and slips into the adjacent meeting-room alcove.

The cabinet fully blocks his view before he can finish approaching her.

She whispers:

{今だけは無理…！}

HUD prints 【EVASIVE MANEUVER】 and 【BREAK LINE OF SIGHT】.

The BOSS takes a step toward the place where he last saw her, looking around the cabinet. NAGI has already moved to the far side of a mobile whiteboard in the alcove.

The camera falls in behind her again.

entries.title: Kyoto Travel Vlog Prompt
entries.description: Prompt for creating a photorealistic personal travel vlog in Kyoto, focusing on slow pacing, natural handheld camera movement, and consistent character appearance from a reference image.
entries.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 30-second personal travel vlog featuring the exact same woman from the reference image. Keep her face, hairstyle, physical appearance, makeup, outfit and necklace consistent throughout the entire video.

Make it feel like a real young woman casually documenting her autumn trip to Kyoto with a friend behind the camera. No commercial travel-ad look, no fast montage and no overly cinematic movements.

Keep the pacing slow and natural. Each scene should focus on one simple action. Let shots breathe and allow natural pauses. She should walk, look around and react at normal human speed. Never speed up her movement or speech to fit more into the scene.

Show quiet everyday moments around Kyoto: riding a local train in the morning, walking through a residential street, discovering a small bakery, sitting by the river, browsing a tiny stationery shop, getting caught in light rain and grabbing a warm drink from a vending machine at night.

Keep the dialogue extremely short and casual, with natural pauses. Things like “Cute…”, “So pretty”, “Mmm… good”, “Look…”, “This one?”, “Oh… rain”, “Nice…” and “One more stop.” She should never sound like she's reading a script or rushing through lines.

Use realistic handheld camera movement, subtle autofocus, natural exposure changes, real ambient sounds, natural skin texture, realistic lighting and subtle 35mm film grain. Some moments should have no dialogue at all.

The goal is simple: make it feel like an actual travel vlog someone happened to capture during a real day in Kyoto, not an AI-generated commercial.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second vertical 9:16 video that looks like authentic gameplay from a modern ultra-realistic AAA open-world game — NOT a cinematic movie.

CHARACTER LOCK: One realistic 70-year-old Japanese man with grey hair, aged face, slightly bent posture, faded blue railway/work jacket, dark trousers and black shoes. Keep identical face, body, clothing and age throughout.

ENVIRONMENT: Beautiful rural Japanese mountain village with a narrow asphalt road, traditional houses, rice fields, dense greenery, utility poles, mountains and a distant railway. Late-afternoon natural lighting. One continuous environment.

CAMERA/HUD: Third-person gameplay camera behind the character, consistent distance, responsive to player movement. Original realistic game HUD with minimap, health/stamina and contextual controller prompts. No GTA branding/UI.

0–3s: Man rides a bicycle toward a yellow waypoint. HUD: “REACH THE VILLAGE” + L3 STEER.

3–6s: Fallen tree blocks the road. Player brakes. L2 BRAKE. Objective changes: “CLEAR THE ROAD”.

6–9s: △ DISMOUNT. He gets off and looks toward the obstacle. R3 LOOK.

9–12s: L3 MOVE + R2 SPRINT. He approaches the fallen tree with believable elderly movement.

12–15s: □ INTERACT → ← → PUSH. He physically pushes the heavy tree aside. Realistic friction and weight; no disappearing objects.

15–18s: A metal road barrier is revealed. □ INTERACT. Message: “PATH STILL BLOCKED”.

18–21s: Player opens the barrier. It swings naturally and a waiting vehicle becomes visible.

21–24s: R3 LOOK. He returns to the bicycle. △ MOUNT.

24–27s: R2 PEDAL. He cycles through the cleared road. Waypoint turns green. Objective: “ROAD CLEARED”.

27–30s: Continue riding toward the village. HUD notification: “MISSION COMPLETE — ROAD CLEARED”. End during active gameplay, no cinematic ending.

GAMEPLAY FEEL: Every action must feel player-controlled. Fast pacing with an interactive moment every 2–3 seconds. Prompts appear only when usable. Realistic bicycle physics, braking, wheel rotation, elderly movement, tree weight, barrier movement, shadows and ground contact.

STRICT CONSISTENCY: One man, one bicycle, one tree, one barrier. No duplicates, morphing, teleportation, object popping, floating/sliding, face deformation, outfit changes, environment changes, lighting/weather changes or camera teleportation.

Ultra-realistic game-engine rendering, 24fps, high detail, realistic NPC/environment behavior, no anime, no cartoon, no fantasy, no movie cinematography.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic early-2000s DV home video of a young Korean woman doing quiet Sunday chores around her home in an older Seoul neighborhood. Purely observational, no dialogue, no narrative arc  just rhythmic, textural everyday realism.
MAIN SUBJECT
Young Korean woman same as , early 20s, natural beauty, realistic skin texture, no makeup, black hair tied up messily in a claw clip, oversized faded T-shirt, rolled-up sweatpants, bare feet or house slippers. Keep her identity, outfit, hairstyle and proportions perfectly consistent throughout.
SETTING
The front step and small yard/alley outside an older Seoul home. Concrete step, a low gate, potted plants, a garden hose, a trash bin, scattered leaves. Ordinary, lived-in, no landmarks or brand names.
SEQUENCE (rhythmic, no dialogue)
She sweeps the front step with a short broom, dust and leaves scattering in the light.
She crouches down and pours a small amount of dry food into a bowl for a neighborhood cat waiting nearby; the cat eats while she watches briefly.
She stands and waters potted plants along the wall with a small watering can, water visibly darkening the soil.
She picks up a bagged trash bundle and carries it a few steps to place it by the curb/bin.
She wipes her hands on her shirt, looks around the now-tidy step and yard for a moment, then exhales/stretches.
She glances toward the camera briefly with a small, tired smile — no words — then turns and walks back inside.
Camera holds on the empty, swept step for a beat before cutting to black.
CAMERA
Raw handheld early-2000s DV camcorder, shaky footage, autofocus hunting, faded colors, exposure shifts, motion blur, soft digital detail, occasional accidental zooms. Observational, documentary-like framing — lingering shots, no cuts within actions. No polished cinematography.
AUDIO
Natural ambience only — broom bristles on concrete, water pouring, cat eating, distant birds, wind, a far-off scooter or dog bark, plastic bag rustling, faint footsteps. No dialogue, no music.
CONTINUITY
Broom, watering can and trash bag each remain consistent through their respective actions. Cat stays in frame while eating, doesn't disappear or duplicate. No teleporting or vanishing objects. Smooth, realistic, unhurried movement throughout.
NEGATIVE
CGI look, plastic skin, identity drift, outfit changes, distorted hands, extra fingers, subtitles, watermark.

entries.title: Late for Work Korean Baddie Vlog Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a fast-paced lifestyle video of a stylish Korean woman rushing to get ready and commute to work.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second cinematic, ultra-realistic lifestyle video featuring a stylish Korean baddie girl in her early 20s living in a modern Seoul apartment. The entire video should feel like a fast-paced, fashionable “late for work” morning vlog, with realistic movements, natural expressions, cinematic lighting, and smooth camera transitions.

Scene 1 — Waking Up (0–4 sec):
Early morning. Her alarm suddenly rings loudly. She wakes up, looks at her phone, and realizes she is late for work. Her eyes widen in panic. She quickly throws off the blanket and jumps out of bed. Close-up of the phone showing the late time, followed by a quick handheld camera movement.

Scene 2 — Rushing to Shower (4–8 sec):
She hurriedly grabs her towel and rushes into the bathroom. Fast cinematic cuts of her turning on the shower, stepping under the water, washing her hair, and quickly drying herself. Keep everything tasteful and non-explicit, focusing only on the rushed routine.

Scene 3 — Emergency Makeup (8–14 sec):
She runs back to her bedroom wearing a stylish casual robe. She sits in front of her vanity and rapidly does her makeup — concealer, foundation, blush, eyeliner, mascara, and glossy lip tint. She checks the mirror, fixes her hair quickly, sprays perfume, grabs her handbag, and runs out. Use energetic close-ups and quick cuts.

Scene 4 — Getting Dressed (14–18 sec):
Quick fashion montage: she throws on a sophisticated office outfit — fitted blazer, elegant top, tailored trousers, heels, and a structured handbag. She looks at the clock, gasps, grabs her phone and keys, and rushes out of the apartment.

Scene 5 — Breakfast in the Cab (18–25 sec):
She jumps into a modern Seoul taxi. While the city moves quickly outside the window, she eats a small breakfast on the go — taking quick bites of a sandwich and drinking iced coffee. She checks her phone, fixes her hair using the front camera, and looks slightly stressed but still effortlessly stylish. Show Seoul streets, morning traffic, pedestrians, and sunlight through the taxi window.

Scene 6 — Arriving at Office (25–30 sec):
The taxi stops in front of a sleek modern Seoul office building. She quickly pays, steps out, adjusts her blazer, takes a deep breath, and confidently walks toward the entrance as if nothing happened. Final cinematic shot from behind and then a close-up of her confident baddie expression as she enters the office.

Visual Style: ultra-realistic Korean fashion influencer aesthetic, cinematic Seoul morning, natural skin texture, realistic facial expressions, realistic physics, subtle handheld camera movement, dynamic tracking shots, quick match cuts, shallow depth of field, premium commercial cinematography, realistic city atmosphere, fashionable office styling, energetic pacing, seamless transitions, 4K detail, natural lighting, photorealistic.

entries.title: Laundry Chase Home Video
entries.description: A prompt for a natural 30-second home video of a young Turkish woman chasing a sock blown away by the wind while hanging laundry on a rooftop in Izmir, captured with amateur camcorder aesthetics.
entries.prompt:
VIDEO CONCEPT:
A completely natural 30-second personal home-video recording of a young woman doing something ordinary on a quiet apartment rooftop during a breezy afternoon. She hangs freshly washed clothes, discovers that one sock has blown away, and casually runs after it. The moment feels spontaneous, funny, and completely unplanned.
FORMAT:
30 seconds • 16:9 • 1080p • photorealistic live-action • raw consumer camcorder footage
MAIN SUBJECT
A young Turkish woman in her early 20s with long dark-brown hair tied loosely in a low ponytail.
She wears a faded white T-shirt, loose olive-green trousers, simple house slippers, and a thin silver bracelet.
Keep her face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and accessories completely consistent throughout the entire video.
SETTING
A modest apartment rooftop in Izmir, Turkey, on a warm breezy afternoon.
The rooftop has concrete flooring, metal railings, water tanks, plastic buckets, a simple clothesline, neighboring apartment buildings, satellite dishes, potted plants, and laundry moving in the wind.
The environment should feel lived-in and ordinary.
No famous landmarks, recognizable brands, advertisements, or tourist imagery.
CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC
Shot on an inexpensive early-2000s consumer digital camcorder.
Handheld and slightly shaky
Occasional uneven framing
Natural autofocus hunting
Slight exposure changes when pointing toward the bright sky
Mild digital compression
Subtle image noise
Natural motion blur
Slightly faded colors
No stabilization
No cinematic lens effects
No artificial bokeh
No polished commercial look
The camera operator should behave like a friend casually filming from a few feet away.
TIMELINE
0–5 SECONDS — ROOFTOP
The camera steps onto the rooftop.
The woman is already standing beside the clothesline with a small plastic basket full of freshly washed clothes.
Wind moves several shirts hanging nearby.
She looks toward the camera and says casually:
“It’s really windy today.”

5–12 SECONDS — HANGING CLOTHES
She takes a white shirt from the basket and clips it onto the clothesline.
The fabric immediately catches the wind and flutters strongly.
She laughs quietly and uses both hands to secure it with another clothespin.
The camera moves slightly closer.
Natural sunlight reflects off the metal clips.

12–18 SECONDS — THE SOCK
She pulls out a small sock from the basket.
Before she can attach it, a sudden gust catches it from her hand.
The sock flies across the rooftop.
She freezes for half a second.
Then says:
“Oh, come on!”
She quickly starts walking after it.

18–24 SECONDS — CHASING IT
The camera operator follows her with slightly shaky movement.
The sock slides across the concrete floor, pushed by the wind.
She reaches down but misses it.
The sock moves toward a rooftop corner.
She laughs while chasing it.
Her ponytail and loose shirt move naturally in the wind.

24–30 SECONDS — CAUGHT
She finally catches the sock near the railing.
She holds it up toward the camera with an amused expression.
She shakes her head and says:
“Got you.”
She walks back toward the clothesline.
The camera remains handheld and slightly imperfect as the recording ends mid-action.
AUDIO
Only natural location sound:
Strong but realistic wind
Clothes flapping
Plastic basket movement
Clothespins clicking
Distant city traffic
Birds
Footsteps on concrete
Her natural laughter
Quiet neighborhood ambience
NO MUSIC.
Dialogue should sound spontaneous, slightly imperfect, and naturally recorded from several feet away.
REALISM / PHYSICS
Wind must affect the environment consistently.
Clothes should flutter according to their size and weight. The lightweight sock should move more easily than the heavier clothing. Hair and loose fabric should respond naturally to gusts.
The plastic basket should remain grounded unless physically moved.
Hands must interact correctly with clothespins and clothing.
No impossible wind direction changes, floating objects, duplicated clothes, or objects appearing/disappearing.
Maintain perfect continuity of the woman’s face, hairstyle, outfit, bracelet, and slippers.
NEGATIVE PROMPT
CGI, 3D render, animation, game graphics, plastic skin, beauty filter, AI face, face morphing, identity drift, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicated people, floating objects, impossible physics, fake wind, excessive slow motion, HDR, oversaturation, cinematic color grading, artificial bokeh, dramatic lighting, studio lighting, perfect stabilization, drone footage, commercial advertisement aesthetic, staged acting, exaggerated expressions, subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, recognizable brands, background music, wardrobe changes, hairstyle changes, continuity errors.
FINAL LOOK
The footage should feel like a random afternoon memory captured by a friend on an old family camcorder.
The camera should not behave like a professional filmmaker. Small shakes, missed framing, autofocus adjustments, imperfect exposure, ordinary rooftop clutter, and spontaneous reactions should remain visible.
Make it feel like a real moment that happened once—not a scene created for a camera.

entries.prompt:
Photorealistic fictional open-world coastal crime-action gameplay livestream, 16:9, one continuous 45-second take split into a 30-second opening plus a seamless 15-second continuation. Fixed full-screen game HUD throughout: bottom-right square pink-blue neon facecam of HANEUL only, matching the supplied reference image exactly; fixed HUD, English-only scrolling live chat on the left, Korean streamer speech only with no subtitles, third-person chase camera, no cuts, no transitions, no scene changes, no duplicate characters.

0–8s: Player drives a dark muscle car through a neon coastal city at dusk toward a GPS destination; HANEUL is calm and focused in facecam, with engine, city ambience, faint radio, and keyboard/mouse sounds.

8–15s: At a warehouse, exactly two dark-red-jacket gang enemies emerge from cover, draw pistols, and ambush the player. The player dives behind a car, is visibly grazed, health drops, and wanted level rises to two stars. HANEUL reacts in shocked Korean.

15–24s: Intense reckless firefight. Player uses one compact SMG; enemies use pistols only. A flanking enemy shatters a nearby car window, bullets dent the car and pop a tire, ammo falls from 38/120 toward 24/120, wanted level reaches three stars, and distant police cruisers appear only in the background.

24–30s: Player fires five deliberate SMG shots with visible sequential hit reactions; both enemies fall only after being hit. Ammo drops exactly from 24/120 to 14/120. HANEUL remains wide-eyed and tense; police sirens close in.

30–38s: With both enemies down, the player limps into the damaged muscle car with a shredded tire. Two police cruisers pursue in the background as the car lurches forward on its rim. Health remains critically low and flashing red; wanted level stays at three stars.

38–45s: Player scrapes through a narrow alley, knocks off both mirrors, and reaches a side street where traffic briefly blocks the police. The wanted level remains flashing at three stars, police lights remain visible in the rearview, and the ending stays unresolved.

Strict rules: HANEUL appears only in the bottom-right fixed facecam; exactly one player and two gang enemies; no extra armed characters; no full-screen facecam; no subtitles; English-only HUD/chat text; no weapon swaps; no gore; no victory, clean escape, black screen, or end card.

entries.title: Synchronized Crowd Fashion Video

entries.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the exact visual reference for the characters, wardrobe, composition, lighting, and overall cinematic look. Create a photorealistic live-action video, 

A young woman wearing a long, fully closed ivory-white tailored coat, black sunglasses, and black pointed heels walks slowly and confidently straight toward the large crowd. Her posture is elegant and controlled, her arms relaxed naturally at her sides, and her expression remains serious and calm.

Start with a medium-wide frontal shot. The woman walks directly toward the camera and toward the center of the crowd. The camera smoothly tracks backward at the same pace, keeping her perfectly centered. The crowd remains completely still, watching forward.

She reaches the front-center position of the crowd and comes to a complete stop. Her feet settle naturally, arms remain at her sides, shoulders relaxed. She looks directly into the camera through her black sunglasses.

The woman remains 100% completely still.

Then, precisely behind her, the entire crowd suddenly begins moving in perfect synchronized rhythm.

Their movement should be sharp and unsettling:

heads jerk quickly to one side

shoulders snap upward

upper bodies briefly lean forward

they suddenly snap upright again

repeat the movement together like a perfectly synchronized group

The movement happens across the entire crowd, from the closest people to the deepest background rows.

The woman does absolutely nothing.
No head movement.
No body movement.
No hand movement.
No walking.
No reaction.

She simply stands motionless while everyone behind her moves aggressively in synchronization.

The camera slowly pushes closer toward the woman while the crowd continues its synchronized movements behind her. Keep her face and white coat sharply focused while the moving crowd has subtle cinematic depth-of-field blur.

End with a powerful centered close/medium shot. The woman is completely motionless in the foreground while the crowd performs one final synchronized head-and-shoulder snap behind her.

Hold on her still expression for the final moment.

Visual Direction

Dark, cold, high-end cinematic fashion aesthetic. Raw concrete environment, deep shadows, soft overhead lighting, realistic skin and fabric, natural hair physics, realistic human movement.

The central visual contrast is extremely important:
ONE perfectly still woman in white + a large crowd in black moving violently in perfect synchronization behind her.

No duplicate lead.
No additional white outfits.
No men.
No cartoon or animation.

No exaggerated camera shake.
No text.

entries.title: Seoul Summer Afternoon Home Video
entries.description: Prompt for a raw, early-2000s style home video of a young Korean woman's afternoon in Seoul, including badminton and water tap scenes.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary summer afternoon in the life of a young Korean woman.
MAIN SUBJECT
Young Korean woman, early 20s, naturally beautiful, realistic skin, minimal makeup, black wavy hair in a messy side ponytail, fitted pastel-blue short top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers and simple silver necklace. Keep her identity, outfit, hairstyle and proportions perfectly consistent throughout.
SETTING
A quiet older Seoul residential neighborhood on a warm summer afternoon. Narrow concrete lanes, small houses, old walls, potted plants, parked bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires and a few neighbors outside. Natural, ordinary and lived-in.
CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC
Raw early-2000s consumer DV camcorder footage filmed by a friend. Strong handheld movement, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild noise, motion blur and occasional accidental zooms. No stabilization, drone shots or polished cinematic look.
— LEAVING HOME
She steps outside her house and walks slowly through the neighborhood. She passes a few neighbors outside their homes, smiling and exchanging friendly gestures. She continues down the street with the camera following casually behind her. No dialogue.
— WATER TAP
She reaches a small public water tap beside the street. She turns it on, cups water in both hands and splashes it onto her face. She closes her eyes and smiles as the water runs naturally down her cheeks. She wipes her face, fixes her hair and turns the tap off. No dialogue.
— BADMINTON
On her way back, she notices a few children playing badminton in the street. She stops and watches them for a moment, then smiles and asks:
“Can I try?”
One child happily gives her the racket. She takes her position and waits for the shuttlecock.
— THE MISS + WALK HOME
A child hits the shuttlecock toward her. She swings and completely misses. The shuttlecock falls onto the ground.
She laughs naturally, shakes her head and hands the racket back to the child. The children laugh with her.
She then walks toward home as the camera follows her from behind. Near the end, she turns toward the camera with a small smile and says:
“See you!”
She continues walking home as the footage naturally ends.
AUDIO
Natural location sound only: footsteps, birds, summer insects, distant scooters, neighborhood sounds, running water, badminton hits and children laughing. Only two spoken lines in the entire video: “Can I try?” and “See you!” No other dialogue, no narration, no music, no subtitles.
Maintain realistic physics, natural human movement, consistent identity and authentic early-2000s home-video imperfections. No morphing, duplicated people, distorted hands, outfit changes, background swaps or CGI-looking motion.

entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic urban sequence set in a busy Manhattan-style city intersection during a bright late afternoon. Begin with a smooth low-angle forward tracking shot through a crowded pedestrian street surrounded by tall urban buildings, cinema signs, storefronts, traffic, street poles, and hundreds of naturally moving pedestrians. A rugged middle-aged bearded man wearing a dark charcoal jacket and dark shirt walks steadily toward the camera through the crowd, maintaining a serious, thoughtful expression. The camera smoothly tracks backward as he approaches, keeping him sharply in focus while pedestrians naturally pass in the foreground and background.

A woman in an elegant flowing red dress suddenly crosses into the scene from the side, walking past the man as they briefly notice each other. Continue with cinematic medium shots showing believable eye contact and natural human movement. Pigeons suddenly take flight around them, creating dynamic foreground motion and subtle visual tension. Cut between the man's face, the woman moving through the crowd, and wide environmental shots showing the scale and energy of the city. Gradually transition from smooth stabilized camera movement into a subtle handheld cinematic feel.

In the final seconds, the camera slowly pulls backward and rises slightly, revealing the entire crowded avenue stretching between tall buildings, with the man becoming smaller within the moving crowd. Warm natural sunlight, realistic shadows, atmospheric depth, subtle lens flare, shallow depth of field during close-ups, natural skin texture, realistic hair and clothing movement, physically accurate lighting, authentic pedestrian behavior, realistic pigeons and motion blur, cinematic color grading, premium feature-film cinematography, grounded photorealism, highly detailed urban environment.

No animation, no cartoon appearance, no exaggerated CGI, no distorted faces, no duplicated people, no unnatural body movement, no floating objects, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark. Maintain consistent character appearance, clothing, environment, and facial features throughout the entire sequence.

Shot timing

0–3 sec: Wide/low-angle tracking shot through crowded city street.
3–6 sec: Bearded man approaches camera, camera smoothly tracks backward.
6–9 sec: Woman in red dress crosses his path; brief eye contact.
9–12 sec: Close/medium shots + pigeons suddenly flying through foreground.

entries.title: Wuxia Epic Action Style Prompt
entries.description: A general style prompt for fusing Eastern wuxia aesthetics with Hollywood epic action cinema textures, intended for use with reference images.
entries.prompt:
[Overall Style]
A short film that fuses Eastern wuxia aesthetics with the texture of Hollywood epic action cinema. The tone is not abstract "speed for its own sake," but rather authentic life-or-death close-quarters combat measured in inches — every dodge grazes past the opponent's blade, every counterattack carries the desperation of an all-or-nothing gamble. The camera language draws on the tight, close-combat choreography of the John Wick series and the epic scale of Game of Thrones' climactic battle episodes: high-speed exchanges interwoven with a handheld, subtly shaky live-action feel, avoiding the weightless sensation of pure CG. The pacing follows a curve of "fast — faster — a frozen instant — an explosive burst even faster — an exhausted finish," rather than sustaining a single intensity throughout. The visual tone is dark fantasy wuxia, with cold-toned lightning and warm-toned candlelight interwoven, the ring of clashing steel and the tearing of cloth running throughout — the goal is to make the audience instinctively hold their breath in the moment, not merely pile up a high volume of action information.

entries.title: Travel Vlog Pronunciation Fix
entries.description: A prompt for a realistic travel vlog featuring a female influencer at a ryokan, focusing on correct Japanese pronunciation and eating sounds for Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
[素材]
@画像1 = 主人公の顔・髪型・体格・私服・浴衣の基準
@画像2 = 旅館の外観・玄関・暖簾・植栽
@画像3 = 客室（テーブル・窓・家具の配置）
@画像5 = 金目鯛の煮付け・器・盛り付け（背景は使わず@画像3のテーブルに配膳）

[ひとことで]
7秒 | 縦9:16 | 24fps。
34歳の女性旅行インフルエンサーが、熱海の温泉旅館「汐凪庵」に到着して自撮りで話しかけ、
時間を飛ばして客室での夕食で金目鯛をひと口食べて味わう、実写旅行Vlog。

[全体設定]
基本の環境と質感: 9月。前半は玄関先の午後の柔らかな自然光、後半は客室の夕食どきの暖かな室内灯。極限まで現実的な物理的質感を強調。
ビジュアル: 実写、浅い被写界深度、自然光→室内灯へ自然に推移。
カメラ言語: 各カットでカメラの動きは1つだけ。前半は本人がカメラを持つ自然な小さい揺れの自撮り。後半は顔と肩を中心にした固定カメラ。
人物: @画像1 の顔立ち・髪型・体格を全編で厳密に固定。前半は私服、後半は浴衣。本物の微細な毛穴と肌の質感を残す。
演技の核: 率直で気さくな旅行インフルエンサー。声を張らず、柔らかく自然な日本語。友達1人に話しかける距離感。広告の読み上げ口調にしない。
禁止: 字幕なし、BGMなし、撮影機器を画面に映さない、歩行やドアを開ける動作を追加しない、料理を箸で持ったままポーズしない。

[タイムスタンプ]
0-3s【到着・挨拶】
場面: @画像2 の旅館の玄関前。
動作: 私服の主人公が立ち止まり、片手で自撮り。胸から上の画角、顔は中央より少し上、背後に玄関と暖簾。自然な笑顔でレンズを見ながら話す。
セリフ: 「きょうの　おやどは、しおなぎあん。みて、いいかんじ」
（漢字ではなくひらがなのまま発話させる）
読み方: 「きょうの」は普通の速さで軽く。
「おやどは、」の後に小さな間を置く。ここで一度息継ぎする。
「しおなぎあん」は分割せず一息でなめらかに言う固有名詞。
「みて、いいかんじ」は明るく弾むトーンに切り替える。
「みて」で玄関へ軽く視線を向け、背景を共有する。

Pronunciation / Pitch:
KYOU[H]->NO[L] / きょ↑う→の→ （今日・実在語・頭高型）
O[L]->YA[H]->DO[H] / お→や↑ど→ （お宿・実在語・平板型。助詞「は」も高いまま続く）
SHI[H]->O[L]->NA[L]->GI[L]->AN[L] / し↑お↓な→ぎ→あん→ （汐凪庵・造語のため標準アクセントなし。
  演出上のリズムとして頭高型に指定。「しお」で上がって「なぎあん」は下げたまま平らに続け、句切れを作らない）
MI[H]->TE[L] / み↑て→ （見て・実在語・頭高型）
I[L]->I[H]->KAN[H]->JI[H] / い→い↑かん→じ→ （いい感じ・実在語・平板型）
意図: 到着の嬉しさが自然に出た表情。頬と目元も口元に合わせて柔らかく動く。呼吸・まばたき・小さな視線の動きを残す。
カメラ: 自撮り固定、自然な遠近感。顔や腕を広角で歪ませない。

【カット間】
客室・温泉・湯上がり・夕食配膳までの数時間は省略する。硬い切り替えを禁止し、自然なカット切替でつなぐ。
時間は昼から夕暮れへ進み、逆戻りしない。

3-7s【ひと口・感想】
場面: @画像3 の客室のテーブル。浴衣姿の主人公が席についている。@画像5 の金目鯛の煮付けが配膳済み。
動作: 小さくほぐした金目鯛の身を右手の箸で口元へ運んだところから開始。口に入れ、箸を下げる。
とろけるようにやわらかい魚をひと口食べる仕草。噛む力を強く入れず、口の中で自然にほどけていくのに任せる。
料理の質感: 白身魚の煮付け。箸を入れるとほろりとほどけるほど繊細に煮えた身。水分をたっぷり含み、とろけるようにやわらかい。
音: 口の中で身がふわりとほどけ、湿った脂と煮汁を含んだ、こもった小さな咀嚼音。かすかな「もぐ、もぐ」という湿り気のある音だけが聞こえる。
意図: ゆっくりと自然に噛み、急がず飲み込む。飲み込み終えたら料理からレンズへ視線を戻し、口元が自然にほころんで話す。
セリフ: 「うん、おいしい」
意図: 満足感がにじむ、力の抜けた笑み。
カメラ: 固定、動きなし。

[締め]
全編で: 声質・話す距離感・音量を統一。セリフは指定どおり。口の動きと同期させる。
環境音: 前半は屋外の風のみ。後半は静かな室内音・小さな食器音・柔らかい咀嚼音のみ。BGMなし。
純粋な映像。字幕なし。本物の微細な毛穴と肌の質感を残す。人物の顔・衣服を変えない。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Assets]
@Image1 = Reference for protagonist's face, hairstyle, physique, casual clothes, yukata
@Image2 = Ryokan exterior, entrance, noren curtain, plants
@Image3 = Guest room (table, window, furniture layout)
@Image5 = Simmered golden eye snapper, dishware, plating (serve on table from @Image3, do not use background)

[Summary]
7 seconds | Vertical 9:16 | 24fps.
A 34-year-old female travel influencer arrives at 'Shionagian' hot spring ryokan in Atami, talks to selfie camera, then time jumps to dinner in guest room where she tastes a bite of golden eye snapper. Live-action travel vlog.

[Global Settings]
Basic Environment & Texture: September. First half: soft afternoon natural light at entrance. Second half: warm indoor lighting at dinner time. Emphasize extreme realistic physical textures.
Visuals: Live-action, shallow depth of field, natural transition from daylight to indoor light.
Camera Language: One camera movement per cut. First half: natural slight shake of selfie held by subject. Second half: fixed camera centered on face and shoulders.
Character: Strictly fix facial features, hairstyle, physique from @Image1 throughout. Casual clothes in first half, yukata in second. Retain real fine pores and skin texture.
Core Acting: Straightforward, friendly travel influencer. No shouting, soft natural Japanese. Distance feeling like talking to one friend. Do not use ad-read tone.
Prohibitions: No subtitles, no BGM, do not show filming equipment, do not add walking or opening doors actions, do not pose holding food with chopsticks.

[Timestamps]
0-3s [Arrival & Greeting]
Scene: In front of ryokan entrance from @Image2.
Action: Protagonist in casual clothes stops, takes selfie with one hand. Framing above chest, face slightly above center, entrance and noren behind. Smiles naturally while looking at lens and speaking.
Dialogue: "kyouno oyado wa, shionagian. mite, ii kanji"
(Speak in hiragana, not kanji)
Pronunciation Guide: "kyouno" normal speed, light.
Small pause after "oyado wa,". Take breath here.
"shionagian" proper noun, smooth in one breath, no splitting.
"mite, ii kanji" switch to bright bouncing tone.
Look lightly towards entrance at "mite", sharing background.

Pronunciation / Pitch:
KYOU[H]->NO[L] / kyoo->no-> (Today - existing word - kammuri type)
O[L]->YA[H]->DO[H] / o->ya->do-> (Ryokan/Oyado - existing word - heiban type. Particle 'wa' continues high)
SHI[H]->O[L]->NA[L]->GI[L]->AN[L] / shi->o->na->gi->an-> (Shionagian - coined word, no standard accent.
Specified as kammuri type for rhythmic direction. Rise at 'shio', keep 'nagian' flat and low, no phrase break)
MI[H]->TE[L] / mi->te-> (Look/Mite - existing word - kammuri type)
I[L]->I[H]->KAN[H]->JI[H] / i->i->kan->ji-> (Good Feeling/Ii Kanji - existing word - heiban type)
Intent: Expression showing natural joy of arrival. Cheeks and eyes move softly with mouth. Retain breathing, blinking, small eye movements.
Camera: Fixed selfie, natural perspective. Do not distort face/arms with wide angle.

[Between Cuts]
Skip hours until guest room, hot spring, post-bath, dinner service. Prohibit hard transitions, connect with natural cut changes.
Time progresses from noon to dusk, no reversal.

3-7s [First Bite & Reaction]
Scene: Table in guest room from @Image3. Protagonist in yukata seated. Simmered fish from @Image5 served.
Action: Start with bringing small flaked piece of fish to mouth with chopsticks in right hand. Put in mouth, lower chopsticks.
Gesture of eating fish that melts like butter. Do not chew hard, let it dissolve naturally in mouth.
Food Texture: Simmered white fish. Delicately cooked flesh that crumbles easily with chopsticks. Contains plenty of moisture, melts like butter.
Sound: Flesh dissolves softly in mouth, muffled small chewing sound containing moist fat and broth. Only faint wet 'mogu, mogu' sounds heard.
Intent: Chew slowly and naturally, swallow unhurried. After swallowing, return gaze from food to lens, mouth corners relax into speech.
Dialogue: "un, oishii"
Intent: Relaxed smile showing satisfaction.
Camera: Fixed, no movement.

[Conclusion]
Throughout: Unify voice quality, speaking distance, volume. Dialogue exactly as specified. Sync mouth movements.
Ambient Sound: First half: only outdoor wind. Second half: only quiet indoor sounds, small dish sounds, soft chewing sounds. No BGM.
Pure video. No subtitles. Retain real fine pores and skin texture. Do not change character's face/clothes.
