entries.title: Wuxia Heroine Water Gliding
entries.description: A comparative test of Seedance 2.5 against other models using a detailed Wuxia cinematic prompt featuring a heroine gliding over water.
entries.prompt:
Wuxia Cinematic Epic Prompt:
[Core Style] Epic cinematic wuxia film (Wuxia Cinematic Epic), Oriental Xianxia Fantasy Aesthetic, 8K ultra-high resolution, ultra-photorealistic details.
[Setting & Environment] A majestic karst canyon landscape, surrounded by mountains, with cascading waterfalls faintly visible through distant mist. A crystal-clear river surface mirrors the sky like a mirror. Volumetric lighting: dreamlike sunlight piercing through heavy clouds, casting dappled, shifting light and shadow onto the river's surface. Pink petals drift through the air.
[Character Description] A beautiful Wuxia heroine, dressed in a flowing red-and-white traditional robe, with an exquisite silk sash tied at her waist. Her long black hair dances wildly in the wind. Her gaze is resolute, her body light and graceful as a swallow.
[Key Action & Effects] The heroine is performing supreme lightness skill (Qinggong/water-gliding), skimming across the river's surface at extremely high speed. Her toes lightly tap the water's surface, and each step precisely stirs up slow-motion, gentle water splashes. The splashes scatter like pearls in the sunlight, forming an extended trail behind her as she moves. Dynamic motion blur perfectly conveys the sense of high-speed movement.
[Camera & Audiovisual Control – Total Duration: 10 Seconds]
•0–2s (High Angle Dive & Glide): The camera dives from a high angle above the canyon (drone-style dive), rapidly pushing in to track the heroine's silhouette as she speeds across the water from a distance. This showcases the grandeur of the canyon and the character's speed.
•2–4s (Low Angle Hero Shot): Cut to a shoulder-cam medium shot, with the camera positioned close to the water's surface for a low-angle lookup shot. Focus stays tightly on the heroine's feet and face. Close-up of the moment the splash bursts, revealing the flowing texture of her robe and her resolute expression.
•4–7s (Orbit & Pan): Multi-camera bullet-time orbit combined with horizontal parallax panning. The camera orbits 180 degrees around the heroine, capturing her profile and front view as she moves at high speed. Petals and water splashes swirl around her in slow motion, with shallow depth of field separating the background from the subject.
•8–10s (Pull-back, Spin & Freeze-frame): High frame rate/ultra slow-motion capture. The camera rapidly pulls back and zooms out. The heroine performs one final beautiful 360-degree aerial spin as a finishing move. At the moment the spin completes and her body is fully extended, the protagonist turns her head

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Travel Vlog Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for Seedance 2.5 to create a realistic 30-second vertical travel vlog of a woman staying at a hot spring inn, including camera directions, dialogue, and lighting changes.
entries.prompt:
【形式・物語】
30秒、縦9:16、音声付きの実写旅行Vlog。
以下の7カットを時間順につなぎ、1本の完成した動画として生成する。

9月、34歳の女性旅行インフルエンサーが、熱海の高台にある架空の温泉旅館「汐凪庵（しおなぎあん）」へ1人で泊まる。
午後の到着、客室、温泉、湯上がり、夕食、食後までの数時間を、自然なカット編集で30秒にまとめる。
親しい視聴者へ旅の様子を共有する、気取らないVlog。

【5枚の参照画像】
画像1＝主人公の顔、髪型、体格、私服、浴衣の基準。
シート内の正面顔を人物の主基準にする。複数の人物として扱わず、全カットを同じ女性で統一する。
画像2＝旅館の外観、玄関、建材、暖簾、植栽。
画像3＝客室の間取り、家具、窓、眺望。湯上がり、食事、締めもこの同じ客室で撮影する。
画像4＝露天風呂の浴槽、素材、周囲の構造、植栽、眺望。
画像5＝料理、器、盛り付け、配膳。画像5の背景は使わず、画像3の客室のテーブルに料理を置く。

参照画像の内容を縦画角に自然に収める。人物、建物、家具を縦長に引き伸ばさない。
キャラクターシートの分割線や文字を映像に出さない。

【主人公・演技】
画像1の34歳の女性。美しく、親しみやすい顔立ち。ミディアムヘア。
率直で気さくな性格。友達1人に話しかけるくらいの距離感。
声を張らず、柔らかく自然な日本語で話す。広告の読み上げ口調にしない。

到着と客室では画像1の旅行服。湯上がり以降は画像1の浴衣。
全編で顔、髪の分け目・長さ・色、体格を固定。浴衣と帯の柄、着付けも維持する。

到着時は、嬉しさが自然に出た笑顔。頬と目元も口元に合わせて柔らかく動く。
その後は景色や料理に視線を向け、感想を共有するときにレンズを見る。
毎回同じ笑顔で静止せず、呼吸、まばたき、小さな視線の動きを残す。

【撮影・光】
自撮りと主観撮影は、本人がカメラを持つ自然な小さい揺れ。
湯上がり、食事、締めは、本人が置いたカメラによる固定撮影。
自撮りは自然な遠近感で、顔や腕を広角で歪ませない。
1カットにつきカメラの動きは1つ。過剰なズームや映画的な旋回は使わない。

自然な肌、髪、布、木材、石の質感。
午後の柔らかな自然光から、夕食の暖かな室内灯、食後の青い夕暮れへ進む。
顔の露出と肌色は安定させる。

【0〜4秒：到着】
画像2の旅館の玄関前。
私服の主人公が立ち止まり、片手で自撮りしている。
胸から上の画角。顔は中央より少し上、背後に玄関と暖簾が見える。
撮影機器は映さない。

自然な笑顔でレンズを見ながら話す。
「今日のお宿は、しおなぎあん。見て、いい感じ」

「見て」で玄関へ軽く視線を向け、背景を共有する。
歩行やドアを開ける動作は追加しない。

【4〜8秒：客室】
入室後の主観映像へカット。
画像3の部屋をそのまま再現し、家具と窓の配置を維持する。
部屋全体から海の見える窓へゆっくりカメラを向け、最後は眺めで一度止める。
主人公は画面外から話す。

「しかも、部屋から海見えるの」

到着時とつながる午後の光。
指差す手は追加しない。

【8〜11秒：露天風呂】
画像4の露天風呂へカット。
浴槽とその向こうの眺望が分かる、ほぼ固定した主観映像。
水面の小さな揺れと、湯の流れる音。
主人公は画面外から話す。

「じゃ、入ってくるね」

語尾のあとに少し湯音を残す。
入浴中の人物は映さない。

【11〜15秒：湯上がり】
入浴と着替えの時間を省略し、画像3の客室へカット。
浴衣姿の主人公が窓辺の椅子に座っている。
固定カメラ。座った目線の高さ、腕を伸ばせばレンズへ届く距離の上半身画角。
この椅子と撮影位置を、最後のカットでも使う。

水を飲み終え、透明なグラスを膝元に下げた状態から開始。
肩を緩めて息を吐き、窓からレンズへ視線を戻して話す。

「はぁ、気持ちよかった」

飲む動作は追加しない。飲みながら話さない。
窓の外はまだ日中の明るさを残す。

【15〜18秒：夕食】
時間を省略し、同じ客室のテーブルに配膳された夕食へカット。
画像5の1人分の料理と器を再現する。
金目鯛を主役にした斜め上からの主観映像。料理へわずかに寄る。
料理とテーブルを中心に写し、背景はほとんど入れない。
主人公は画面外から話す。

「見て、きんめだい」

元の卓上の茶器などは配膳前に移動済み。
室内灯を主体とする夕食時の光。

【18〜24秒：ひと口】
同じ食卓に座る主人公へカット。
浴衣姿のまま。顔と肩を中心にした固定カメラ。
小さくほぐした魚の一口を右手の箸で口元へ運んだところから開始。

口に入れ、箸を下げる。
口を閉じて自然にかみ、飲み込む。
料理からレンズへ視線を戻し、口元が自然にほころんで話す。

「うん、おいしい」

食べている間は話さない。咀嚼を急がせない。
料理を箸で持ったままポーズしない。
食器が映る場合は前のカットと同じ配置で、食べた部分が元に戻らない。
夕食の照明を維持する。

【24〜30秒：締め】
食事の残り時間を省略し、窓辺でくつろぐ主人公へカット。
湯上がりと同じ椅子、同じ撮影位置、高さ、距離、画角。
同じ浴衣と髪型。窓や家具の形を変えない。
窓の外は青い夕暮れ、顔は室内灯で柔らかく照らされる。
グラスはサイドテーブルに置き、両手は空。

レンズを見てリラックスして話す。
「今日はもう、のんびりします。またね〜」

24〜27秒頃：
「今日はもう、のんびりします」と自然に話す。

27〜28秒頃：
「またね〜」と笑い、右手を顔の横で小さく一振りする。

28〜29.7秒頃：
その右手を戻さず、開いた手のひらをレンズへゆっくり近づける。
手のひらが徐々に画面を覆い、最後は画面全体を覆う。

最後の約0.3秒：
手に遮られた暗い画面のまま終了する。
手を振ってからレンズを覆うまでワンカット。
編集のフェードではなく、手による遮光で暗くする。
手を引いて顔を再表示しない。

【編集・音声・固定条件】
指定した7
entries.translated_prompt:
[Format & Story]
30 seconds, vertical 9:16, live-action travel vlog with audio.
Connect the following 7 cuts in chronological order to generate one completed video.

In September, a 34-year-old female travel influencer stays alone at a fictional hot spring inn called "Shionagian" located on a hill in Atami.
Summarize the few hours from afternoon arrival, room, hot spring, post-bath relaxation, dinner, and after-dinner into 30 seconds with natural cut editing.
A casual vlog sharing the journey's atmosphere with close viewers.

[5 Reference Images]
Image 1 = Standard for protagonist's face, hairstyle, physique, casual clothes, and yukata.
Use the front-facing face in the sheet as the primary standard for the person. Do not treat as multiple people; unify all cuts with the same woman.
Image 2 = Inn exterior, entrance, building materials, noren curtains, plants.
Image 3 = Room layout, furniture, window, view. Post-bath, meal, and closing scenes are also filmed in this same room.
Image 4 = Open-air bath tub, materials, surrounding structure, plants, view.
Image 5 = Food, dishes, plating, serving. Do not use Image 5's background; place food on the table in the room from Image 3.

Fit the content of reference images naturally into the vertical frame. Do not stretch people, buildings, or furniture vertically.
Do not show split lines or text from character sheets in the video.

[Protagonist & Acting]
Image 1's 34-year-old woman. Beautiful, approachable features. Medium hair.
Straightforward and friendly personality. Distance like talking to one friend.
Speak in soft, natural Japanese without raising voice. Do not use an advertising read-aloud tone.

Wear Image 1's travel clothes during arrival and room scenes. Wear Image 1's yukata after post-bath.
Fix face, hair parting/length/color, and physique throughout. Maintain yukata and obi patterns and dressing.

At arrival, a smile where happiness naturally shows. Cheeks and eyes move softly matching the mouth.
Afterward, look towards scenery or food, looking at the lens when sharing impressions.
Do not remain static with the same smile every time; leave breathing, blinking, and small eye movements.

[Cinematography & Light]
Selfies and subjective shots have natural small shakes from holding the camera.
Post-bath, meal, and closing are fixed shots from a camera placed by the subject.
Selfies have natural perspective; do not distort face or arms with wide angle.
One camera movement per cut. No excessive zooms or cinematic spins.

Natural textures of skin, hair, cloth, wood, stone.
Progress from soft afternoon natural light, to warm indoor light at dinner, to blue dusk after eating.
Stabilize facial exposure and skin tone.

[0-4s: Arrival]
In front of Image 2's inn entrance.
Protagonist in casual clothes stops and takes a selfie with one hand.
Framing from chest up. Face slightly above center, entrance and noren visible behind.
Do not show filming equipment.

Talk while looking at lens with natural smile.
"Today's stay is Shionagian. Look, nice feeling."

Turn gaze lightly toward entrance at "Look," sharing background.
Do not add walking or opening door actions.

[4-8s: Room]
Cut to subjective footage after entering.
Reproduce Image 3's room exactly, maintaining furniture and window placement.
Slowly pan camera from whole room to sea-view window, stopping once at the view.
Protagonist speaks off-screen.

"Plus, you can see the sea from the room."

Afternoon light connecting with arrival.
Do not add pointing hands.

[8-11s: Open-air Bath]
Cut to Image 4's open-air bath.
Almost fixed subjective shot showing tub and view beyond.
Small ripples on water surface and sound of flowing water.
Protagonist speaks off-screen.

"Well, I'm going in."

Leave slight bath sounds after end of phrase.
Do not show person bathing.

[11-15s: Post-Bath]
Omit bathing/changing time, cut to Image 3's room.
Protagonist in yukata sitting on chair by window.
Fixed camera. Upper body framing at seated eye level, distance reachable by extending arm to lens.
Use this chair and shooting position in final cut too.

Start from state after finishing water, lowering transparent glass to lap.
Relax shoulders, exhale, return gaze from window to lens and speak.
"Haa, felt good."

Do not add drinking actions. Do not talk while drinking.
Outside window still retains daytime brightness.

[15-18s: Dinner]
Omit time, cut to dinner served on same room's table.
Reproduce Image 5's single portion of food and dishes.
Subjective shot diagonally from above focusing on Kinmedai (golden eye snapper). Slight push-in to food.
Center on food and table, barely include background.
Protagonist speaks off-screen.

"Look, kinmedai."

Original tea utensils etc. moved before serving.
Dinner-time light primarily from indoor lamps.

[18-24s: One Bite]
Cut to protagonist sitting at same table.
Still in yukata. Fixed camera centered on face and shoulders.
Start from bringing a small piece of loosened fish to mouth with right chopsticks.

Put in mouth, lower chopsticks.
Close mouth, chew naturally, swallow.
Return gaze from food to lens, mouth corners relax naturally and speak.
"Mm, delicious."

Do not talk while eating. Do not rush chewing.
Do not pose holding food with chopsticks.
If dishes appear, maintain same arrangement as previous cut; eaten parts do not revert.
Maintain dinner lighting.

[24-30s: Closing]
Omit remaining meal time, cut to protagonist relaxing by window.
Same chair, shooting position, height, distance, framing as post-bath.
Same yukata and hairstyle. Do not change window or furniture shapes.
Outside window is blue dusk, face softly lit by indoor lamp.
Glass placed on side table, both hands empty.

Look at lens and speak relaxedly.
"I'll just take it easy today. Bye~"

Around 24-27s:
Naturally say "I'll just take it easy today."

Around 27-28s:
Say "Bye~" with a laugh, wave right hand small near face.

Around 28-29.7s:
Without returning right hand, slowly bring open palm toward lens.
Palm gradually covers screen, finally covering entire screen.

Last ~0.3s:
End with dark screen obscured by hand.
One cut from waving to covering lens.
Darken via hand obscuring, not editing fade.
Do not pull hand away to re-show face.

[Editing/Audio/Fixed Conditions]
Specified 7

entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a cinematic travel vlog of a man hiking in Zhangjiajie, including specific timestamps, dialogues, and visual descriptions.
entries.prompt:
Subject: A young man with messy brown hair, wearing a light beige short-sleeve button-down shirt, a gold chain necklace, small hoop earrings, and carrying a backpack, vlogging a scenic mountain hike in Zhangjiajie, China.

Style: Cinematic travel vlog aesthetic featuring natural overcast lighting, earthy green and grey color grading, and organic handheld camera movement.

Camera & Framing: Soft ambient overcast daylight with atmospheric mist. Dynamic first-person selfie-cam angles and wide panning shots revealing dramatic mountain pillar landscapes.

Audio & Scene Dialogues Breakdown:

00:00 - 00:03
Dialogue: "Okay... This is way cooler than I expected."
Visual: Medium selfie tracking shot of the man walking along a stone path by a wooden fence, looking directly at the camera.

00:04 - 00:08
Dialogue: "Whoa... Look at that!"
Visual: Panning left to reveal massive, mist-shrouded vertical sandstone pillars towering over a dense green forest.

00:09 - 00:14
Dialogue: "Yeah... I could stay here all day."
Visual: He turns the camera back toward himself, smiling and looking up in awe while continuing his walk along the trail.

00:15 - 00:19
Dialogue: "Okay, so... we came to another part..."

00:20 - 00:26

00:27 - 00:29

entries.title: Jungle Waterfall Discovery Adventure Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a cinematic nature adventure video featuring a young woman discovering a hidden waterfall in a jungle canyon.
entries.prompt:
Genre: Epic nature adventure / cinematic discovery
Style: Ultra-realistic feature-film cinematography, photorealistic landscapes, realistic water physics, lush untouched wilderness, atmospheric depth, controlled camera movement, subtle film grain, premium adventure-film look.
CHARACTER — STRICT CONSISTENCY

Use the exact young woman as the main character.

Preserve her exact face, facial features, skin tone, dark loosely tied hair, body proportions and identity.

Wardrobe: light cream linen shirt with rolled sleeves, olive-green shorts, simple sandals, small dark crossbody bag.

Keep her appearance, hairstyle and wardrobe completely consistent throughout the entire sequence.

00:00–00:03 — THE MYSTERIOUS SOUND

Open on an extreme wide shot of a quiet jungle river at early morning.

The young woman stands alone at the front of a narrow wooden boat, drifting through dense emerald vegetation.

Everything is unusually still.

Suddenly, she hears a deep, distant rumble.

She turns toward a narrow opening between enormous moss-covered cliffs.

A faint mist is visible in the distance.

The boat begins moving toward it.

00:03–00:07 — INTO THE UNKNOWN

Low cinematic tracking shot beside the boat.

The river becomes narrower as the cliffs close in.

The woman leans forward, curious, watching the mist ahead.

Her hand lightly touches the damp canyon wall as the boat passes close enough to brush hanging vines.

Sunlight disappears behind the cliffs.

The sound of rushing water slowly becomes louder.

Tiny droplets float through the air.

00:07–00:11 — THE REVEAL

Camera moves in front of the boat and slowly pulls backward.

The narrow passage suddenly opens.

A gigantic hidden waterfall appears beyond the canyon — cascading from hundreds of feet above into a crystal-clear turquoise pool.

Mist fills the valley.

The woman freezes for a moment, completely stunned.

Birds burst from the surrounding trees as sunlight breaks through the clouds.

The waterfall dominates the entire background.

00:11–00:15 — THE DISCOVERY

Epic aerial rise and pullback.

The camera lifts rapidly but naturally above the canyon.

Reveal the full secret landscape:

tiny wooden boat → turquoise pool → enormous waterfall → dense jungle → towering cliffs → distant mountains disappearing into morning mist.

The woman remains standing at the bow, looking toward the waterfall.

The boat slowly glides toward the edge of the pool.

A warm beam of sunlight cuts through the mist and illuminates the boat for a brief moment.

Hold on the breathtaking landscape.

End exactly at 15 seconds.

🎨 COLOR & CINEMATIC LOOK — HIGH PRIORITY

Natural emerald jungle greens
Deep turquoise-blue water
Warm golden sunlight
Cool blue-green canyon shadows
Natural skin tones
Rich cinematic contrast
Soft highlight roll-off
Subtle atmospheric mist
Realistic blacks
Gentle film grain
Natural cinematic depth

Keep colors rich but believable.
No oversaturation, no artificial HDR, no e

entries.description: A detailed prompt for Seedance 2.5 via OpenArt to create a realistic home-video style farm day scene.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary summer afternoon in the life of a young Korean woman visiting a small traditional farm and helping with the animals. No reference image.

A naturally pretty beautiful Korean woman in her early 20s, realistic natural skin texture, minimal makeup, relaxed and cheerful personality. Long black hair tied in a loose low ponytail. She wears a loose white cotton T-shirt, light olive-green cargo pants, brown ankle boots, and a beige canvas crossbody bag. Preserve the continuous shot, low viewpoint, single-hand potion action, room layout, and timing. Enrich the scene with weathered stone, carved wood, worn leather, iron fittings, and realistic glass. Combine cool window light and drifting dust with warm fireplace illumination and softly glowing magical liquids. Create natural wood fire with thin, irregular flames curling between charred logs, glowing embers, occasional sparks, and subtle smoke. Keep the hand anatomy, bottle shape, fire movement, and focus transitions consistent throughout. Review the full generated video, especially the hand action and fireplace. Deliver the white-model MP4, the PixVerse-rendered MP4, and the editable Blender project. After acceptance, retain the latest approved versions and move older versions to recoverable storage.

entries.title: High school classroom action sequence
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a highly dynamic, one-take fight scene inside a Japanese high school classroom, featuring complex choreography and realistic lighting.
entries.prompt:
@image1 fights three opponents inside a Japanese high school classroom in an intense, highly dynamic one-take action sequence. The classroom is filled with wooden desks, chairs, school bags, a chalkboard, sliding windows, curtains, fluorescent ceiling lights, posters, books, and scattered papers. The camera is extremely dynamic and close to the action, never static — fast-moving, constantly following, circling, ducking, whipping, and pushing through the fight, immersive and physically present. Natural classroom lighting mixed with warm afternoon sunlight through the windows, realistic shadows, practical motion blur, grounded textures, raw cinematic look, no glossy AI finish.

[0-2s] Camera whips into the room low and fast — she's already mid-motion, ducking under the first opponent's swing near the chalkboard.
[2-4s] She sweeps a chair into his legs, camera circling tight around the impact as he stumbles into a row of desks.
[4-6s] Second opponent charges from the side aisle; she vaults over a desk, camera rising suddenly to follow her over the top.
[6-8s] Mid-air, she kicks off the desk toward him, papers exploding upward around the impact, camera pushing in close.
[8-10s] She slides across a tabletop to close distance, camera tracking low alongside the desk surface, dust catching sunlight.
[10-12s] Third opponent grabs a backpack, swings it — she blocks with a raised forearm, camera whipping around to catch the block from behind her shoulder.
[12-14s] She grabs the same backpack, deflecting his next strike and shoving him into a toppling desk, camera dropping low as it crashes.
[14-16s] First opponent recovers, rushes her from behind; camera spins 180° rapidly to reveal him closing in.
[16-18s] She pivots, uses the narrow aisle to redirect his momentum, throwing him into a row of chairs, camera circling the throw.
[18-20s] Second and third opponents converge — camera rushes backward ahead of her as she retreats between desks, curtains whipping from the motion.
[20-22s] She grabs a fallen chair, sweeping it low — camera drops near floor level to catch the leg-sweep connecting.
[22-24s] She rises fast, camera surging upward with her as she catches an incoming strike and redirects it into a desk.
[24-26s] Final opponent lunges; she sidesteps using the aisle space, slams him against the sliding window frame, glass rattling, curtain billowing.
[26-28s] Camera whips around her as she scans the room, all three opponents down or staggering among overturned desks and scattered papers.
[28-30s] She exhales, standing still amid the wreckage, sunlight cutting through dust in the air, camera slowly pushing in on her face for the final beat.

Strong choreography, realistic body movement, believable impact, fast reaction timing, close-range combat, continuous motion, handheld urgency throughout, one uninterrupted take feel.

entries.title: 1989 Berlin archival street video
entries.description: A prompt for generating an ultra-photorealistic archival recording of everyday street life in West Berlin during 1989, featuring period-correct vehicles and handheld camera motion.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 16:9, 1080p ultra-photorealistic archival video of everyday Berlin street life in 1989.

The entire video must look like genuine footage recorded in 1989 with an unusually good professional video camera. It should feel like a real archival recording that has been digitized in HD, not a modern recreation, not a movie, and not an AI-generated vintage filter.

**MAIN FOCUS:**
The video is primarily about ordinary daily life on the streets of West Berlin in 1989. Crowded sidewalks, people walking in different directions, period-correct taxis (Mercedes W123s), Trabants and Wartburgs passing through traffic, buses, storefronts, street vendors, newspaper kiosks, and the constant movement of the city. The camera should feel like someone documenting the everyday routine of Berlin, not showcasing its architecture or politics.

**SCENE SEQUENCE:**
- **0–5s:** Street-level view from a busy West Berlin sidewalk (e.g. near Kurfürstendamm). A crowd of pedestrians walks past the camera in both directions. Mercedes taxis, Trabants, and older European cars move through the street. Natural handheld camera movement.
- **5–10s:** A crowded avenue intersection. People wait at the crosswalk, then begin crossing. Buses, taxis, and traffic move through the frame. The camera slowly pans with the street activity.
- **10–15s:** A closer street-level view of everyday pedestrians, storefronts with German signage, newspaper kiosks, and passing cars. People carry shopping bags, talk to each other, and go about their normal routines. Natural, unscripted-looking movement.
- **15–20s:** A slightly wider street view showing a busy Berlin avenue filled with pedestrians and traffic. Buildings are visible only as part of the background. A section of the Berlin Wall or period signage may appear naturally in the distance, but the street activity remains the focus.
- **20–25s:** Another crowded sidewalk and intersection. Trabants, taxis, buses, pedestrians, and storefronts create a constantly moving urban scene. The camera gently follows the flow of people.
- **25–30s:** Final street-level view of a busy avenue, with pedestrians crossing, cars passing, and traffic continuing naturally. End like a real archival recording, without a dramatic cinematic conclusion.

**CAMERA & CINEMATOGRAPHY:**
Real 1989 professional video-camera footage. Mostly street-level, eye-level, and slightly elevated sidewalk viewpoints. Natural handheld and vehicle-mounted camera movement, slow pans, gentle zooms, slight camera vibration, occasional imperfect framing, and realistic motion blur. The camera should feel operated by a real person filming the city, with small imperfections and natural timing. No modern drone footage, no gimbal-smooth movement, no impossible camera angles, and no dramatic cinematic camera moves.

**IMAGE QUALITY:**
Surprisingly sharp

entries.title: Osaka Grandma GTA Style 30s Video Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed Japanese prompt for creating a 30-second continuous video in the style of a AAA open-world crime action game like GTA, featuring an elderly woman in Osaka escaping the police on a bicycle after a 'double-dipping' incident at a food stall.
entries.prompt:
30秒の連続映像。大阪を舞台にしたAAA級オープンワールド犯罪アクションゲーム風のプレイ映像。実写映画ではなく、最新AAAゲームの高精細なリアルタイム3DCGとして描く。人物の肌、髪、衣服、道路、車両、建物、照明、影、反射、物理挙動まで、リアルだが明確にゲームCGらしい質感で統一する。主人公の背後から追従する三人称ゲームカメラを基本とし、実際にプレイヤーが操作しているように空間と動きを連続させる。左下に小さな円形ミニマップと体力ゲージ、右上に手配度の星を表示。

舞台は雨上がりの夕方、大阪ミナミを思わせる繁華街。串カツ店、狭い商店街、派手な立体看板、雑居ビル、自動販売機、路上駐輪、電線、濡れたアスファルトが並ぶ。主人公は60歳前後の大阪のおばちゃん。短い紫がかったパーマ、金色のイヤリング、オレンジと黒のトラ柄シャツ、黒いパンツ、赤いスニーカー、斜め掛けバッグ。がっしりした体格で眼光が鋭い。乗り物は銀色の普通のママチャリ。前カゴにはスーパーの買い物袋と長ネギ。顔、衣装、自転車、小物は全編で統一する。

0〜6秒。三人称視点でおばちゃんが串カツ店の屋外カウンターに立つ。串カツを共用ソースに一度浸し、一口食べた直後、その食べかけの串をもう一度ソースへゆっくり浸す。周囲の空気が止まり、店主が絶句。近くの警察官が「二度漬けやないか！」と叫ぶ。右上の手配度が★2へ上昇。警察官がおばちゃんの腕をつかむが、おばちゃんは強く振りほどき、警察官を突き飛ばす。警察官は金属テーブルにぶつかり地面へ倒れる。重量感のある衝撃。手配度が★3になる。

6〜10秒。おばちゃんは買い物袋を拾い、店先のママチャリへ向かう。追ってくる警察官を無視し、袋を前カゴへ放り込み、自転車にまたがって全力で発進。カメラが自然に自転車後方のゲーム視点へ移行。遠くからパトカーのサイレン。

10〜17秒。おばちゃんが大阪の狭い商店街を猛スピードで逃走。現実的なペダリングで必死に加速し、服やバッグが揺れ、前カゴの長ネギが激しく振動する。後方からパトカーと警察バイクが追跡。おばちゃんは路地を急旋回し、追跡車両は急ブレーキ。濡れた路面でタイヤが鳴き、車体がカラーコーンや壁を擦る。逃走中、おばちゃんは歩行者1人にママチャリで接触して転倒させ、別の歩行者の肩をかすめる。周囲から「危ないやろ！」「何さらしてんねん！」と罵声が飛ぶ。おばちゃんも前方を見たまま「どいてや！」と怒鳴る。短くベルを鳴らし、さらに狭い路地へ突入。手配度は★4。

17〜23秒。前方を警察官2人が塞ぐ。おばちゃんは強くブレーキをかけ、濡れた路面で後輪を少し滑らせて停止。すぐにママチャリを降り、前カゴから長ネギを引き抜く。進路を塞ぐ1人目の警察官の腕を長ネギで強く叩き、そのまま顔面へ一撃。警察官はよろめいて倒れる。2人目が接近すると、おばちゃんは長ネギを横薙ぎに振り、肩から首元を打ってひるませ、さらに体当たりして地面へ倒す。ネギは大きくしなり、一部が潰れる。人体には重さがあり、大げさには吹き飛ばない。おばちゃんは乱れた長ネギを持ったまま進もうとするが、路地の出口をさらに別の警察官が塞ぎ、後方にはパトカー。完全に包囲される。

23〜30秒。BGMが静まり、サイレン、警察無線、おばちゃんの荒い呼吸が響く。警察官が慎重に近づき「もう逃げられへんで」と言う。おばちゃんは無言で斜め掛けバッグに手を入れる。警察官が緊張する。おばちゃんが取り出したのは赤い透明包装の小さな飴。肩越しのゲームカメラで、おばちゃんが低い声で「兄ちゃん、飴ちゃん食べる？」と言う。短い沈黙。警察官が飴とおばちゃんを交互に見る。おばちゃんが警察官の手のひらに飴を1個置く。警察官は少し迷い、静かに受け取る。その瞬間、右上の手配度が★★★★から★★★、★★、★、0へ順番に消えていく。サイレンも止まる。警察官は無言で身体を横へずらして道を空ける。おばちゃんは小さくうなずき、ママチャリに戻って乗り込む。警察官の横を通り過ぎながら「ほな」と一言。最後は標準的な三人称ゲーム視点に戻り、折れかけた長ネギを前カゴから突き出したまま、おばちゃんが大阪の街へ走り去る。

全編を通して、人物、街、車、自転車、衝突、衣服、表情、路面反射を最新AAAゲームのリアルCGとして描写する。犯罪ゲームらしい緊張感と重量感を保ちつつ、「串カツ二度漬け→ママチャリ逃走→ネギで警察を突破→飴ちゃんで手配解除」という異常な展開だけがシュールな笑いになる構成。
entries.translated_prompt:
A 30-second continuous sequence of gameplay footage in the style of a AAA open-world crime action game set in Osaka. Not a live-action film, but rendered as high-definition real-time 3DCG typical of modern AAA titles. Human skin, hair, clothing, roads, vehicles, buildings, lighting, shadows, reflections, and physics are all realistic yet unified with a distinct game-CG texture. The primary perspective is a third-person game camera following from behind the protagonist, with space and movement continuous as if actually controlled by a player. A small circular minimap and health gauge are displayed at the bottom left, and 'Wanted' level stars at the top right.

Set in a bustling shopping district reminiscent of Osaka's Minami on a rainy evening. The scene features Kushikatsu stalls, narrow arcades, flashy 3D signs, multi-tenant buildings, vending machines, street bike parking, power lines, and wet asphalt. The protagonist is an 'Osaka Obachan' (middle-aged/elderly woman) around 60. She has short purple-tinted permed hair, gold earrings, an orange and black tiger-print shirt, black pants, red sneakers, and a crossbody bag. She has a sturdy build and a sharp gaze. Her vehicle is a standard silver 'mamachari' bicycle. In the front basket are supermarket shopping bags and a long green onion (leek). Face, costume, bicycle, and props remain consistent throughout.

0-6 seconds: In third-person view, the Obachan stands at the outdoor counter of a Kushikatsu shop. She dips a skewer into the shared sauce once, takes a bite, and immediately dips the half-eaten skewer back into the sauce slowly. The surroundings freeze, and the shopkeeper is speechless. A nearby police officer shouts, 'You double-dipped!' The Wanted level at the top right rises to ★2. The officer grabs her arm, but she forcibly shakes him off and shoves him. The officer hits a metal table and falls to the ground. A heavy, impactful shock. Wanted level rises to ★3.

6-10 seconds: Obachan picks up her shopping bag and heads to her bicycle in front of the shop. Ignoring the pursuing officer, she throws the bag into the front basket, mounts the bike, and starts pedaling at full speed. The camera naturally transitions to a game-style perspective behind the bike. Police sirens wail in the distance.

10-17 seconds: Obachan escapes through a narrow Osaka shopping arcade at high speed. She accelerates desperately with realistic pedaling; her clothes and bag sway, and the leek in the basket vibrates violently. Police cars and motorcycles chase from behind. She makes sharp turns into alleys, causing chase vehicles to slam on their brakes. Tires screech on the wet road, and car bodies scrape against traffic cones and walls. During the escape, she collides with one pedestrian with her bike, knocking them over, and brushes the shoulder of another. Shouts of 'That's dangerous!' and 'What are you doing?!' come from the crowd. She yells 'Move it!' while looking straight ahead. She rings the bell briefly and plunges into a narrower alley. Wanted level reaches ★4.

17-23 seconds: Two police officers block the path ahead. She brakes hard, sliding the rear wheel slightly on the wet road to stop. She immediately gets off the bike and pulls the leek out of the basket. She strikes the first officer blocking her path hard on the arm with the leek, then delivers a blow to the face. The officer staggers and falls. As the second one approaches, she swings the leek horizontally, hitting him between the shoulder and neck to make him flinch, then tackles him to the ground. The leek bends significantly, and part of it gets crushed. The bodies have weight and don't fly off exaggeratedly. She tries to proceed with the mangled leek, but more officers block the exit of the alley, with police cars behind. She is completely surrounded.

23-30 seconds: The BGM fades, and sirens, police radio, and her heavy breathing echo. An officer approaches cautiously and says, 'You can't escape anymore.' She silently puts her hand into her crossbody bag. The officers tense up. She pulls out a small candy in red transparent wrapping. Through a game camera over the shoulder, she says in a low voice, 'Hey kid, want a candy?' A brief silence. The officer looks back and forth between the candy and her. entries.prompt: Create a 30-second, 1080p, 16:9 ultra-realistic early-2000s DV home video of a young Korean woman having a spontaneous summer evening around a quiet neighborhood market in Seoul. SUBJECT Young Korean woman, early 20s, naturally pretty, realistic skin, minimal makeup, relaxed expressions. Strong handheld shake, imperfect framing, occasional focus hunting, exposure shifts when moving between sunlight and shadow, soft digital detail, slightly faded colors, mild tape noise, subtle compression artifacts, motion blur, accidental zooms, awkward reframing, and natural camera movement. The camera should feel like a friend casually recording the moment rather than a professional filming a scene. No stabilization, gimbal movement, drone shots, cinematic camera choreography, cinematic lighting, shallow-depth-of-field commercial shots, or polished color grading. TIMELINE 00:00–00:06 — LEAVING THE BUILDING She steps out through an old residential entrance carrying her cream canvas shoulder bag. She pauses beside a parked bicycle and checks the time on a small wristwatch. She notices the camera pointing at her and gives the camera operator an amused look. She says: “Are you filming me again?” The camera moves closer slightly. She shakes her head with a small laugh and starts walking toward the neighborhood market. 00:06–00:12 — SMALL MARKET She walks past a tiny neighborhood fruit stand and notices a colorful pile of peaches. She stops, picks up one peach, looks at it, then looks directly at the camera. She says: “Should I get this?” The camera operator responds naturally from behind the camera: “Definitely.” She laughs quietly, buys one, and takes a bite while continuing down the street. 00:12–00:18 — SUMMER MOMENT She reaches a small side street lined with old apartment walls and potted plants. A sudden warm breeze moves the leaves and pushes loose strands of her hair across her face. She tries to fix her hair while still holding the peach. A bicycle passes behind her. She looks toward the bicycle, then back at the camera and says jokingly: “Okay, that was almost dangerous.” She laughs naturally. 00:18–00:24 — STREET CORNER She reaches a small neighborhood corner with a public bench beside an old concrete wall. In the background, an older resident slowly sweeps the pavement while another person carries groceries toward an apartment entrance. She watches the street quietly for a few seconds. The camera operator asks: “Tired?” She looks toward the camera with a relaxed smile and replies: “A little.” She takes another sip of water and smiles. 00:24–00:30 — HEADING BACK She stands up, brushes a small piece of dust from her jeans, adjusts the cream canvas shoulder bag across her shoulder, and starts walking back toward the residential buildings. The camera follows from behind with imperfect handheld movement. After a few steps, she turns around while walking backward and looks directly into the camera. She smiles and says: “Hurry up.” She turns forward and continues walking. The camera follows her for another moment before the footage abruptly cuts to black. AUDIO Natural location sound only. Footsteps on concrete, distant traffic, bicycle wheels, birds, summer insects, leaves moving in the breeze, neighborhood market ambience, faint conversations, a distant scooter, plastic bags rustling, street sweeping, water bottle sounds, natural laughter, and subtle camcorder handling noise. Dialogue should sound spontaneous and conversational, with natural pauses and imperfect timing. No music, narration, subtitles, captions, translations, logos, watermarks, or on-screen text. REALISM & CONTINUITY Maintain strict character continuity throughout all shots. Her face, hairstyle, black headband, dusty-rose T-shirt, dark-indigo jeans, white canvas sneakers, cream canvas shoulder bag, silver necklace, body proportions, and overall appearance must remain identical from beginning to end. Natural human reactions and imperfect timing. Background pedestrians should move naturally and remain physically consistent. Objects must not disappear, duplicate, teleport, or change position unnaturally. No duplicated people, disappearing objects, distorted faces, warped bodies, broken hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, CGI appearance, identity drift, hairstyle changes, outfit changes, accessory changes, exaggerated acting, unrealistic facial expressions, or overly cinematic footage. The final result should feel like a genuine forgotten home-video recording from the early 2000s rather than a modern cinematic recreation. 16:9 aspect ratio, 1080p, 30 seconds.

entries.title: Ostrich Egg Fried Rice Volcano Stunt
entries.description: A humorous and surreal high-altitude stunt where explorers throw a giant ostrich egg and a bag of rice into a volcano, resulting in an eruption of perfectly cooked egg fried rice.
entries.prompt:
【风格】
真人写实的高空奇观搞笑短视频，手机广角手持摄影质感。真实人物、直升机机舱、火山岩与橙红色熔岩，结合电影级超现实食物特效。自然光、真实材质、轻微飞行振动与运动模糊，突出巨大道具、高空落差、短暂等待后突然爆发的反差。

蛋炒饭具有真实食物质感：饱满分明的金黄米粒、松软不规则的黄色炒蛋块、零星绿色葱花，表面带少量油润反光和热气。喷出时既有成团的炒饭，也有散开的米粒，落下后会弹跳、散落和堆积，不像泡沫、液体或黄色烟雾。

【时长】
15秒，9:16竖屏。全程一个连续手持长镜头，正常速度，不切镜、不慢放、不定格。节奏：双人展示食材 → 先扔巨蛋、紧接着倒米 → 俯拍落入熔岩 → 短暂蓄势 → 火山喷出海量蛋炒饭 → 两人被炒饭撒满 → 男子拿起身上的炒饭尝一口，用中文说“真香”。

【场景】
一架具有宽大侧舱门的直升机悬停在火山口上方，舱门完全打开。摄影机位于机舱内部，与门口保持一定距离，能够同时拍到两名人物及其手中的食材。

机舱内有深灰色防滑地板、金属门槛、深色座椅、安全带和内壁面板。下方是一处巨大的近圆形熔岩池，橙红色熔融物不断翻滚，周围是黑色火山岩壳与发光裂缝。远处山脊笼罩在灰色薄雾中。开场机舱、人物和镜头均干净，没有食物。

【人物】
人物A：成年女性探险者，棕色马尾，荧光黄色短袖、灰绿色工装长裤、深色靴子，佩戴黑色安全背带与航空耳机，负责抱住并投下巨型鸵鸟蛋。

人物B：成年男性探险者，短发，橙色短袖、深灰色工装长裤、深色靴子，佩戴黑色安全背带与航空耳机，负责抱住并倾倒一大袋大米。

两人分处宽大舱门左右两侧，投掷时依次前倾，不互相挤压。安全系绳分别连接舱内固定点，两人始终留在机舱内。开场相视坏笑，动作时有真实负重感；结尾男子尝身上的炒饭，女子在旁观察并笑出声。

【道具】
巨型鸵鸟蛋：高约80厘米、最宽处约55厘米，完整椭圆蛋形，一端稍窄，一端较宽，乳白色厚蛋壳，表面具有细腻颗粒 and 轻微天然斑点。女子必须双臂环抱，蛋体从胸口延伸到大腿，不能单手托住。全片只有这一枚巨蛋，离手后保持完整，直到碰到熔岩表面才破开。

大米袋：一只接近男子半身高的透明厚塑料大袋，装满白色生米，袋体鼓胀，重量使底部下坠，内部能清晰辨认密集米粒。袋口已经打开，男子一只手抓紧袋口侧边，另一只手托住袋底。倾倒时大米从袋口连续流出，袋体逐渐变瘪，空袋由男子收回舱内，不扔进火山。

【镜头】
开场广角中景，同时看清两个人的表情、双臂、巨蛋和米袋。摄影机随食材向下俯转，追踪巨蛋和大米落向同一个熔岩区域，始终留在机舱门口，不跟着下坠。

食材落下后保持俯拍等待。蛋炒饭喷起时，摄影机后撤并转向两人，完整交代炒饭从舱外飞入、撒在人物与地板上的过程。结尾由双人中景轻轻靠近男子，清楚拍到捻起米粒、送入口中、咀嚼和说话的动作。

[00:00–00:01.40] 动作段1：双人展示，一枚巨蛋配一大袋米
女子站在画面左侧，双膝微屈，双臂紧抱巨型鸵鸟蛋，蛋体上缘接近胸口，下缘接近大腿。男子位于右侧，将沉甸甸的透明米袋抱在腰腹前，双手分别控制袋口与袋底。

两人先看向摄影机，展示夸张尺寸的食材，再互相看一眼，露出心照不宣的坏笑。女子把巨蛋向怀里提稳，男子调整托袋底的手，米粒随动作在袋内滑动，塑料袋出现明显受力褶皱。

音效：直升机旋翼、高空风声、塑料袋摩擦和袋内米粒沙沙声。

[00:01.40–00:02.80] 动作段2：女子推蛋，男子准备倒米
女子先转身朝向舱外下方，双膝下沉，将巨蛋下缘送到门槛附近。她双臂向前伸展，蛋体由竖直逐渐向舱外倾斜，重心越过门槛后，双手松开，让整枚巨蛋向下坠落。松手后她立即收回双臂，身体退回半步。

男子紧接着前倾，一只手控制袋口，另一只手抬高袋底，将敞开的米袋口朝向舱外下方。先有少量白米滑到袋口，随后开始形成连续米流。

摄影机向右下方俯转，保持巨蛋下坠和米袋倾斜同时可见，两人的动作前后衔接。

音效：用力呼气声、鞋底摩擦地板声、米袋挤压声。

[00:02.80–00:04.60] 动作段3：巨蛋在前，大米瀑布紧随其后
摄影机俯拍舱外。巨型鸵鸟蛋沿下坠轨迹迅速远离，缓慢转动，椭圆轮廓和乳白蛋壳始终清楚，随着距离增加而连续变小。

画面上方紧接着落下一道浓密的白色大米瀑布。米流从袋口倾泻而出，先集中成束，随后被气流吹成略微张开的弧形，追随巨蛋落向同一处熔岩池。近处能辨认独立米粒，远处呈细密的白色颗粒流。

男子抬高袋底，将剩余大米倒出，袋体逐渐塌瘪。最后一小股米粒滑落后，他把空袋收回，退出画面上缘。左下角保留倾斜的金属门槛，明确摄影机仍在高空机舱内。

巨蛋先接触熔岩表面，蛋壳沿接触处裂开，半透明蛋清与浓黄蛋黄短暂摊开，随即被翻涌熔岩卷入；紧随的大米像密集白雨一样落进同一区域。蛋壳碎片沉入落点，不向高空喷射。

音效：持续倒米沙沙声、风声，一声遥远低沉的破壳与落入声。

[00:04.60–00:07.20] 动作段4：熔岩吞没食材，短暂停顿后开始翻炒
摄影机保持俯视，落点位于画面中央。巨蛋和白米已经被熔岩吞没，表面先恢复短暂的橙红翻涌，制造“好像没发生什么”的等待。

随后落点冒出细小气泡和少量白色热气，周围熔融表面逐渐向中心卷动，形成一个宽阔、缓慢旋转的凹陷。凹陷内闪过少量金黄颗粒，接着米粒和松软的炒蛋块越来越清楚，在旋转中不断翻起、落回，像火山内部正在完成一次巨大翻炒。

落点由橙红色逐渐变成金黄色的颗粒区域，中央开始鼓起。周围黑色火山岩和外围熔岩仍然稳定可见，不能突然把整座火山变成锅。

音效：低沉熔岩翻滚声逐渐叠加密集滋滋声，声音持续增强，旋翼声保留。

[00:07.20–00:09.20] 动作段5：火山猛然喷出海量蛋炒饭
中央金黄色区域突然向上拱起，紧接着海量蛋炒饭从同一落点猛然喷出，形成粗大的金黄色食物喷泉。

喷出的主体必须清楚可辨为米饭：大量饱满金黄米粒、大小不一的黄色炒蛋块和零星葱花混合，裹着少量白色热气。底部连续上涌，上方大团炒饭冲散成无数颗粒，形成向外张开的伞状抛物线。

随着炒饭逼近高空，近处颗粒越来越大、越来越清晰。摄影机先稍稍抬起追踪，随后惊讶地抖动并向舱内后撤。最先到达的几粒米和小蛋块越过门槛，在金属地板上弹跳。

音效：短促喷发闷响、密集食物颗粒碰撞声，两人从画面外发出惊讶呼声。

[00:09.20–00:11.50] 动作段6：炒饭雨灌入，两个人被撒得满头满身
摄影机连续后撤并转向舱内，两人重新进入画面。女子缩头耸肩，双手抬到脸前；男子已经放下空袋，一只手抓住舱内把手，另一条前臂挡在额头前。两人同时向后退，让出门口。

大量蛋炒饭像密集颗粒雨一样从舱门外飞入。米粒与炒蛋块先拍在两人的前臂、肩膀和头顶，再沿胸口、裤腿滚落。部分米粒黏在头发、耳机、衣服褶皱和安全背带上，肩头堆出一小层炒饭，几块松软炒蛋挂
entries.translated_prompt:
[Style]
Real-life high-altitude comedy spectacle short video, mobile wide-angle handheld photography texture. Realistic characters, helicopter cabin, volcanic rocks, and orange-red lava, combined with movie-level surreal food effects. Natural light, real materials, slight flight vibration, and motion blur, highlighting giant props, high-altitude drops, and the contrast of sudden eruption after a brief wait.

The egg fried rice has a realistic food texture: plump, distinct golden rice grains, soft irregular yellow scrambled egg pieces, scattered green onion, surface with a little oily reflection and steam. When ejected, there are both clusters of fried rice and scattered rice grains, which bounce, scatter, and accumulate after falling, unlike foam, liquid, or yellow smoke.

[Duration]
15 seconds, 9:16 vertical screen. One continuous handheld long take, normal speed, no cuts, no slow motion, no freeze frames. Rhythm: Two people show ingredients -> Throw giant egg first, followed immediately by pouring rice -> Top view drop into lava -> Brief buildup -> Volcano erupts massive egg fried rice -> Two people covered in fried rice -> Man tastes a grain of rice from himself, saying 'It's delicious' in Chinese.

[Scene]
A helicopter with a large side cargo door hovers over a volcanic crater, the door fully open. The camera is inside the cabin, at a distance from the door, capturing both figures and their ingredients.

The cabin has dark gray non-slip flooring, metal threshold, dark seats, seat belts, and interior panels. Below is a huge near-circular lava pool, orange-red molten material continuously churning, surrounded by black volcanic rock crust and glowing fissures. Distant ridges are shrouded in gray mist. At the start, the cabin, characters, and camera are clean, with no food.

[Characters]
Character A: Adult female explorer, brown ponytail, fluorescent yellow short sleeves, gray-green cargo pants, dark boots, wearing black safety harness and aviation headset, responsible for holding and dropping the giant ostrich egg.

Character B: Adult male explorer, short hair, orange short sleeves, dark gray cargo pants, dark boots, wearing black safety harness and aviation headset, responsible for holding and pouring a large bag of rice.

The two are on either side of the wide door, leaning forward in turn during throwing without squeezing each other. Safety tethers connect to cabin fixed points; both remain inside. Start with knowing smirks; movements have a real sense of weight; ends with the man tasting rice while the woman laughs beside him.

[Props]
Giant Ostrich Egg: About 80cm high, 55cm wide, full oval shape, creamy white thick shell with fine texture and light natural spots. The woman must embrace it with both arms; the egg extends from chest to thighs. Only this one giant egg; it stays intact after leaving hands until it hits the lava surface.

Rice Bag: A transparent thick plastic bag nearly half the man's height, filled with white raw rice, bag bulging, weight causing the bottom to sag, dense rice grains clearly visible inside. The bag mouth is open; the man grips the side of the mouth with one hand and supports the bottom with the other. Rice flows continuously from the bag, which gradually deflates; the empty bag is pulled back into the cabin, not thrown into the volcano.

[Camera]
Wide-angle medium shot at the start, showing both expressions, arms, egg, and bag. The camera tilts down with ingredients, tracking the egg and rice falling to the same lava area, always remaining at the door. 

Maintain top view wait after falling. When rice erupts, the camera retreats and turns to the two, showing rice flying in and covering people and floor. Ends with a medium shot closing in on the man, clearly capturing the action of picking up rice, eating, chewing, and speaking.

[00:00–00:01.40] Segment 1: Dual Display, one giant egg and one large bag of rice
The woman stands on the left, knees slightly bent, arms hugging the giant egg. The man is on the right, holding the heavy transparent rice bag at his waist.

[00:01.40–00:02.80] Segment 2: Woman Pushes Egg, Man Prepares Rice
The woman leans toward the exit and drops the egg. The man leans forward, holding the bag mouth over the exit.

[00:02.80–00:04.60] Segment 3: Egg First, Rice Waterfall Follows
Camera top view outside. The egg falls and shrinks in distance. A dense white rice waterfall follows, falling into the same lava pool. The man pulls back the empty bag.

[00:04.60–00:07.20] Segment 4: Lava Swallows Ingredients, Stir-frying Begins
Wait after ingredients disappear. The fall point bubbles and steam rises, forming a wide rotating depression where golden grains and egg pieces churn, as if being stir-fried inside the volcano.

[00:07.20–00:09.20] Segment 5: Volcano Erupts Massive Egg Fried Rice
The golden center arches and erupts a huge food fountain. Grains and egg pieces spray outward. The camera retreats into the cabin in shock.

[00:09.20–00:11.50] Segment 6: Rice Rain, Two People Covered
Camera turns to the cabin. Rice rains in from outside, covering the explorers' heads and shoulders. Scrambled eggs hang on their clothes.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic music video featuring three young adult singers performing an emotional modern song in a neon-lit city at night. The video should look like a high-budget professional music video with realistic humans, precise lip-sync, expressive performances, atmospheric lighting, and sophisticated cinematography.

CHARACTERS

Character 1 — Female Lead:
Young adult woman, early 20s, long black hair, expressive eyes, elegant black-and-silver outfit, confident yet emotional personality.

Character 2 — Male Lead:
Young adult man, early 20s, dark textured hair, stylish black jacket and white shirt, charismatic and emotionally expressive.

Character 3 — Female Vocalist:
Young adult woman, early 20s, shoulder-length dark hair, fashionable deep-red outfit, energetic but natural stage presence.

Keep their faces, clothing, hairstyles, body proportions, and identities perfectly consistent throughout the video.

ENVIRONMENT

A futuristic downtown street at night after light rain. Wet pavement reflecting colorful neon signs, glowing storefronts, subtle fog, distant traffic, cinematic bokeh, atmospheric city lights and realistic reflections.

SHOT-BY-SHOT

0–4 sec — Opening
Extreme close-up of Character 1's eyes. Neon reflections visible in her eyes. Camera slowly pulls back as she begins singing. Rain droplets sparkle in the background.

4–8 sec — Lead Performance
Character 1 walks slowly down the wet street while singing directly toward the camera. Smooth backward tracking shot. Her hair moves naturally in the night breeze.

8–12 sec — Male Verse
Cut to Character 2 leaning against a neon-lit building. He begins singing his section. Slow cinematic camera orbit around him, with colorful city lights blurred behind him.

12–16 sec — Female Vocalist
Character 3 appears walking through the neon street. She sings while looking toward the camera. Smooth side-tracking shot transitions into a close-up.

16–22 sec — Trio Performance
All three characters meet in a wide city intersection and perform together. Camera slowly circles around them while they sing. Natural interaction, subtle gestures, believable chemistry.

22–27 sec — Emotional Chorus
Rapid but elegant sequence of close-ups: Character 1 singing, Character 2 joining, Character 3 harmonizing. Every mouth movement precisely follows the provided audio.

27–30 sec — Final Shot
The three singers stand together in the middle of the wet street. Camera rises slowly upward and pulls away, revealing the glowing city around them. They finish the final lyric together exactly on the beat. End on a dramatic cinematic wide shot.

CINEMATOGRAPHY

High-end music-video cinematography, anamorphic lens look, shallow depth of field, smooth gimbal tracking, slow-motion accents, cinematic close-ups, controlled camera movement, realistic lens flares, natural motion blur, beautiful bokeh and dynamic composition.

Early morning just after sunrise. Fresh green leaves and extremely fine natural strands of spider silk covered with dew. Warm low sunlight catches the water and creates tiny natural highlights and soft sparkling bokeh. Extremely shallow depth of field. Realistic macro-lens focus breathing. Tiny cars travel along the street. Pedestrians move along sidewalks. Traffic lights change. Subtle atmospheric movement exists between buildings. The curved droplet naturally refracts and bends the city near its edges. The center becomes beautifully sharp while the outer edges remain optically distorted by the water. [00:07–00:10] Without a hard cut, the camera slowly tracks sideways along the dew-covered strand. Tokyo slips naturally out of focus. Rack focus onto another large droplet. Inside is an AFRICAN SAVANNA AT SUNRISE. Golden grass gently moves in the wind. A tiny distant herd slowly crosses the landscape. Soft morning sunlight stretches across the miniature horizon. Continue gliding. Focus transfers to another droplet containing a SNOW-COVERED ALPINE VILLAGE. Tiny chimney smoke rises and drifts. Clouds move subtly around distant mountains. A dramatic modern city skyline with clouds slowly moving behind the buildings. Every droplet contains its OWN UNIQUE living world. Movement continues independently inside every visible droplet. NO duplicated locations. [00:13–00:15] The camera gradually begins pulling backward. More of the leaf and delicate dew-covered strands come into view. What seemed like only a few droplets becomes DOZENS of sparkling morning dew drops. Several droplets remain large enough to glimpse different tiny living worlds moving inside them. Sunlight passes through the droplets, creating beautiful realistic refraction and sparkling highlights. CAMERA: Continuous elegant cinematic macro movement. Slow controlled dolly/push. Gentle lateral tracking. Natural rack-focus transitions between droplets. Extreme macro depth of field. Locations must conform visually to the curved optical properties of the water. Correct refraction. Correct highlights. Correct reflections. Correct depth. The worlds must feel genuinely THREE-DIMENSIONAL inside the droplets. DO NOT make the droplets look like glass marbles. DO NOT make them crystal balls. DO NOT place flat photographs inside them. DO NOT make them video screens. DO NOT transform the droplets into full-size locations. DO NOT transition the entire scene into Tokyo, Africa, mountains or cities. entries.title: Japanese Supernatural Railway Mystery
entries.description: An intricate 30-second prompt for a supernatural sequence at a Japanese rural train crossing, featuring surreal unraveling steel rails and volumetric fog effects.
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Japanese supernatural mystery sequence at a remote rural train crossing during a dense midnight fog. The entire sequence must be one continuous unbroken camera shot with no cuts, no montage, no CCTV inserts, and no teleporting camera. Photorealistic live-action cinematography, thick volumetric fog, wet gravel reflections, practical halogen signal lighting, natural human reactions, believable physics, subtle supernatural surrealism, no violence, no injury, no gore, no blood, no disturbing body transformation, no explicit threat, no subtitles, no watermark, no artificial CGI aesthetic. OPEN WITH AN EPIC IMAGE. The camera begins high above a vast, mist-shrouded Japanese valley at midnight. A full moon occasionally pierces through heavy, moving fog, illuminating miles of dark bamboo forest and winding mountain ridges. Far below, barely visible, a single red signal light blinks at an isolated railroad crossing on a forgotten countryside lane. The camera descends continuously through thick fog and swaying bamboo toward it. The rusted crossing gates, wooden ties, and single set of steel tracks emerge from the gloom. No houses. No traffic. Only the warm, rhythmic amber glow of the crossing signal cutting through the darkness. The camera drops toward track level and glides alongside the weathered wooden fence. Beside the track stands a lone high school student holding a transparent umbrella, waiting for the train. A quiet dinging sound begins. The red signal lights flash in sequence. The mechanical wooden crossing gates lower with a heavy clatter. Everything feels ordinary, routine, grounded. Then the student notices something along the tracks. The steel rails are changing. Not melting. Unraveling. The solid steel splits into thousands of fine, thread-like silver strands that gently lift into the air like weightless spider silk. The effect spreads along the railway line. The heavy wooden cross-ties beneath the rails break apart into fine, glowing wooden fibers that float upward. The coarse gravel ballast beneath the tracks detaches from the earth, stone by stone, suspending itself in midair like liquid droplets. The student steps back in quiet awe. The camera follows seamless and low. Rain begins to drizzle through the fog, but wherever the unraveling wave passes, moisture freezes in midair, forming a dense lattice of suspended, glowing ice crystals. The transformation accelerates. The mechanical signal post fragments into floating metallic dust. The red warning lamps separate from their housings, their light continuing to shine without any physical bulb, suspended in the mist. A bright headlight appears far down the tracks in the fog. A classic electric train approaches slowly. But as it passes through the unraveling zone, the metal train car begins to dissolve into the same silver threads—not destructively, but gently deconstructing into a swirling vortex of glowing geometry. Within seconds, the entire train dissolves, leaving behind no wreckage, only its passengers standing quietly on the air where the carriages used to be, suspended safely above the ground. Then the very ground beneath the crossing dissolves. The topsoil and modern asphalt disintegrate into fine, dark sand that spirals upward into the sky. The camera slowly pulls upward. The modern crossing vanishes completely. But beneath the vanished modern soil, something ancient is revealed. Carved overgrown stone stepways. A massive, moss-covered Torii gate buried for centuries. The original Edo-period pilgrimage path, flanked by hundreds of ancient stone lanterns whose hollow centers suddenly ignite with soft, supernatural blue flame. The camera rises faster now, maintaining its single unbroken shot. The dissolved modern railway stretches for miles through the valley, now transformed into a massive, shimmering river of floating silver threads overhead. And beneath it, completely uncovered across the valley floor, lies the sprawling stone ruins of an ancient sacred highway leading toward a hidden mountain shrine. Then comes the final impossible reveal. The cloud of floating silver threads and suspended gravel overhead begins organizing itself in the night sky. The particles align into a massive, vertical spiral staircase made of solid light and liquid stone, stretching up into the storm clouds toward the moon. Moving along this vertical highway of light are dozens of ancient phantom travelers carrying glowing paper lanterns, quietly descending from the sky toward the newly revealed stone ruins. The student and the suspended passengers look up together in silent wonder from the ancient path below. One floating traveler carrying a massive bronze bell steps off the sky-road onto the top stone archway of the ancient ruin. The camera continues rising into a breathtaking high-altitude aerial view. Ancient stone path illuminated below. Modern railway turned into an ascending highway of stars above. Mountains submerged in ocean-like fog. And an impossible procession of light descending from the clouds. End on the vast aerial image. Atmosphere: hauntingly peaceful supernatural mystery, contemplative and serene, monumental scale, volumetric fog and mist used for depth, authentic rural Japanese infrastructure, slow visual escalation, surreal environmental transformation, strong visual cause and effect, spectacular final reveal.

entries.title: Nostalgic Seoul Street Walk
entries.description: A highly detailed video prompt designed to mimic a nostalgic early-2000s MiniDV home video style, following a woman on a walk through a Seoul residential lane with a specific umbrella-related narrative.
entries.prompt:
GIRL / MAIN CHARACTER: Young Korean woman in her mid-20s, black hair in a loose braid, fitted pastel-lilac blouse, wide-leg beige trousers, white flat sandals, thin silver bracelet, small crossbody bag. Natural skin texture, realistic features, consistent identity throughout.
LOCATION: Peaceful old Seoul residential lane on a warm evening—narrow concrete street, small houses, potted plants, parked bicycles, a convenience store on the corner, overhead wires, a few trees.
STYLE: Photorealistic Seedance 2.5, nostalgic early-2000s MiniDV home video. Handheld shaky camera, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, faded colors, soft digital image, exposure shifts, motion blur and compression noise. No modern cinematic look.
ACTION (timed):
00:00–00:02 — She steps out of her house with an empty cloth bag, locks the door.
00:02–00:04 — She walks down the lane toward the corner convenience store.
00:04–00:07 — She buys eggs and bread at the store, puts them in the bag.
00:07–00:09 — She starts walking back home through the lane, umbrella still hooked over her shoulder.
00:09–00:11 — Suddenly one rib of the umbrella bends outward and it becomes lopsided. She stops and notices it.
00:11–00:13 — She tries pushing the bent rib back into place with her fingers, but it keeps popping back out. Friend filming zooms in awkwardly.
00:13–00:15 — She spots a rubber band near a parked bicycle, picks it up, wraps it tightly around the bent section.
00:15–00:17 — She opens the umbrella slightly to test it—the rib snaps loose again and the umbrella flops sideways.
00:17–00:19 — She stares at the camera, stunned, then bursts out laughing.
00:19–00:21 — She collapses the umbrella completely and holds it firmly under her left arm. The cloth bag with groceries stays in her right hand.
00:21–00:23 — She continues walking home, passes a neighbor watering plants who notices the crooked umbrella and chuckles. She shrugs and grins.
00:23–00:26 — She turns to the camera and says, "Bi-do an oneunde, deurama-네!" ("It's not even raining, and there's drama!"). She laughs.
00:26–00:28 — She reaches her house and unlocks the door.
00:28–00:30 — She walks inside. Friend remains outside filming the closed door.
CONTINUITY RULE: From 00:19 onward, the umbrella stays tucked under her left arm and never touches the ground, disappears, duplicates, or reopens on its own. Groceries never disappear from the bag.
FINAL FRAME: Closed door, empty lane, no umbrella left on the street.
AUDIO: Natural birds, footsteps, distant traffic, bicycles, neighborhood ambience, store chime, dogs barking faintly, evening sounds. No music or narration.
NEGATIVE: No disappearing/duplicating umbrella, no umbrella on the ground, no object teleportation, no missing groceries or bag, no identity drift, outfit changes, distorted hands, extra fingers, unnatural movement, CGI look, subtitles or watermark.

entries.title: 3D Chinese Animation CG Battle Scene
entries.description: A highly detailed structured prompt for a 3D Chinese animation style battle scene featuring complex character movements, asset locking, and cinematic lighting.
entries.prompt:
【全局设定】
30秒，16:9，顶级3D国漫CG，电影级立体光影、精细角色建模、真实布料动力学与金属质感。不是真人摄影，不是二维动画。整体凌厉、高速、招招见力，近战斩击与群体技能递进，最终全灭收剑。
【资产引用与锁定】
@女主资产：使用「3D女主.png」，锁定同一成年女性的脸型、五官、棕金眼睛、黑发高束与额间蓝色三道印记，保持参考图的深蓝黑战袍、旧金属护肩与装饰；参考图三个视角属于同一个人，视频不出现三联画。右手仅持一把参考长剑，左腰从开场起固定配套剑鞘，直至结尾不消失。

@魔兽群资产：仅对应普通四足魔兽群，锁定体型、黑色甲壳、暗红裂纹、角与四肢结构；数量有限，死亡后不刷新、不复活，不变成巨型魔兽。
@巨型魔兽资产：对应全文所有“重兽／重型魔兽”，全片仅一只，严格参考资产图的巨大体型、厚重肩甲、双角、粗壮前肢与胸甲下暗红核心；体型明显大于普通魔兽，比例始终一致。从t=1s起就在兽群后排可见，t=14s开始冲撞，t=25—26s被大招击杀，此后不复活、不再新增。

@草原场景资产：锁定起伏草原、低矮石脊、中央孤岩和浅沟的位置关系；草高至小腿，交战脚步清晰，远方双峰作为方向参照；破坏痕迹持续保留，不自动恢复。

以上资产仅在本区引用，逐秒分镜使用“女主、普通魔兽、重兽”等简称，不重复添加@。所有资产统一为3D国漫CG风格。

【战场与战斗逻辑】
阴云透出斜向日光，狂风压低草浪。开场全景交代前、中、后三层魔兽，数量有限，不刷新、不复活、不从画面外无限补充。普通魔兽低身扑咬、侧向包抄；重型魔兽沉肩冲撞、前肢砸地，攻击先有发力动作再接触。

前段0—9秒：快速小技能接光速感位移，反复穿过兽群。
中段9—21秒：移动释放群体技能，清除中心兽群，外围残敌和重型魔兽仍可见。
后段21—28秒：压缩残敌位置，移动中完成大招，杀尽所有魔兽。
最后28—30秒：明确战场无活兽，再完整收剑入鞘，结束战斗。

【位移、技能与特效】
女主位移必须表现为“整个人与手中剑收束成一道细长金色光线，外缘带青色流光”，不是人物慢跑拖着光带；光线实际穿越草原、绕过孤岩、掠过浅沟，到达攻击位置立即恢复清晰人形完成斩击。起点、路径、落点连贯，不生成分身。
小技能【掠光斩】：蹬地化光穿阵，落点挥剑，释放贴着剑路的短促青金刃弧。
群体技能【回澜剑潮】：移动挥剑连续带出三层贴地弧形剑潮，逐层推过中心兽群，敌人先被命中，再失衡、崩解。
终极技能【一剑平川】：高速折返过程中将流光压入剑锋，落脚转髋横斩，低矮而宽阔的青金剑潮覆盖剩余敌阵；不站桩结印，不召唤新武器。

特效配比：能量体50%＋水墨25%＋流体25%，红、青、金三色为主；青金属于女主，暗红属于魔兽. 能量紧贴剑路，水墨沿受力方向迸裂，流体表现为附着剑锋的黏稠能量与翻卷浪沿。零血液、零断肢，魔兽死亡化作水墨粒子与失去光泽的甲壳碎屑，碎屑受重力落地。
【运镜与节奏铁律】
连续高速跟拍、一镜到底，十组三秒镜头仅表示连续调度段落，不代表硬切。每秒写明运镜、景别、动作与结果；组间借人物追击、草叶和碎屑掠镜连续换位，不跳轴、不突然瞬移机位。
低机位急推、侧向追踪、交错点环绕、快速升降和攻击方向甩镜交替；命中后短促定向震动，随即追踪敌人飞退. 主体接触时清楚，背景沿运动方向拉伸，禁止全屏模糊掩盖动作。
清怪期间持续冲刺、侧蹬、滑步与折返，短蓄力融入移动；正常时间下的极高速动作，无慢动作、子弹时间、冻结帧。敌人全部死亡后才允许自然减速收剑。
无台词、无字幕；声音为剑鸣、密集破空、兽吼、冲撞、甲壳崩裂与草浪声，最后以清晰入鞘声收束。
【镜头1（0—3秒）】
t=1s运镜贴草向前急推，FS全景低机位侧视女主从左侧石脊蹬地化成细长金光穿入前排兽群，落点恢复人形横斩扑来的魔兽，青金刃弧命中后炸开黑墨碎粒，后排重型魔兽清楚可见。
t=2s运镜沿横斩方向高速侧移，MS中景斜侧视女主顺势压身滑过第二只魔兽的扑击，反手斜挑击中其侧甲，魔兽翻向外侧压倒草丛，剑锋流体沿斩线甩成细弧。
t=3s运镜绕交错点快速弧移并拉宽，FS全景俯斜视女主侧蹬地面化光折返，从两兽夹击的空隙贯过并在末端回身一斩，两侧魔兽接触刃弧后崩解，草原留下清楚折线压痕。
【镜头2（3—6秒）】
t=4s运镜沿金光贴地追进，FS全景低角度侧视女主以【掠光斩】穿过横扑兽腹下方的空隙，现身后旋腰扫中侧甲，魔兽受力横飞，墨粒与草屑沿同一方向喷开。
t=5s运镜快速横甩至反击方向，MS中景侧视一只魔兽从孤岩旁扑向女主持剑侧，女主短促架开前爪并借接触旋身绕后，碰撞处先出金属火星，再带动其前肢偏转。
t=6s运镜贴孤岩外缘疾掠，FS全景侧视女主脚掌蹬岩化作一道金线绕过岩背，在魔兽后侧恢复人形落剑，其甲壳沿命中处炸裂，孤岩留下蹬踏裂痕与飞散石粉。

【镜头3（6—9秒）】
t=7s运镜降至浅沟上方高速跟拍，FS全景斜俯视女主贴沟化光穿过追扑间隙，在沟沿落脚转身劈出短刃弧，前兽被斩灭，后兽踩入沟底失衡，泥块沿沟壁滚落。
t=8s运镜沿沟沿侧移并收近，MS中景侧视女主向前压步连续斜斩两次，分别击碎两只扑近魔兽的肩甲与能量核心，兽体先折退再散成黑墨，镜头在第二次重击后短震。
t=9s运镜随女主跃过沟沿迅速抬高，FS全景俯视她化光绕向中心兽群外侧，落地拖剑划出第一道青金弧线，魔兽转向追咬，远处外围残敌仍在向战区奔来。
【镜头4（9—12秒）】
t=10s运镜贴女主身侧高速平移，MS中景斜视她在连续侧滑中转腕收剑，剑锋流体迅速增厚并接一记低位横斩，【回澜剑潮】第一层浪沿从剑路推出，撞翻中心前排魔兽。
t=11s运镜沿第一层剑潮斜向急推，FS全景腰高侧视女主紧随浪沿蹬地折向，再斩出第二层更宽刃浪，刚跃起避浪的魔兽被第二层截住，黑墨与甲片沿后退方向炸开。
t=12s运镜升至孤岩侧上方拉宽，FS全景俯视女主绕中心兽群奔行完成第三次斩击，三层剑潮依次推过夹击区域，中心魔兽接连崩解，外围兽群与重型魔兽仍留在远端。

【镜头5（12—15秒）】
t=13s运镜沿女主冲出剑潮的路线急降，FS全景低机位侧视她化光穿过正在落下的墨粒，落点挑斩一只冲出浪沿的魔兽，兽体向后折翻，草浪被切出狭长通道。
t=14s运镜迅速转向重型魔兽并后拉，FS全景斜侧视重型魔兽低头沉肩猛冲，女主侧蹬化光让开正面撞击，其肩甲撞碎低矮石脊，碎石先接触崩裂再沿冲势滚飞。
t=15s运镜贴撞碎的石脊高速侧跟，MS中景侧视女主在重兽外侧现身斩中前肩甲，重兽踉跄侧摆却未倒下并抬爪反扑，青金刃弧与暗红护甲光短促对撞，镜头随接触震动。
【镜头6（15—18秒）】
t=16s运镜压低跟随横扫前爪，FS全景低角度侧视女主低身滑过爪下并划开其侧甲，爪尖扫中身后碎岩而非空气，石屑向外扇开，女主出滑步立即继续前冲。
t=17s运镜贴草追踪女主折返路线，FS全景俯斜视她化作金线绕重兽外侧切入外围兽群，落点连续两记短斩逼开左右扑兽，青金弧线与翻飞黑墨标出清楚攻击落点。
t=18s运镜随斩击横向快移并拉宽，FS全景侧视女主顺势推出一道低位扇形剑潮扫过聚集的普通魔兽，前排被命中后层层倒向后排，重兽从浪沿后方重新踏稳追来。
【镜头7（18—21秒）】
t=19s运镜沿追击
entries.translated_prompt:
[Global Settings]
30 seconds, 16:9, top-tier 3D Chinese animation CG, cinematic stereoscopic lighting, fine character modeling, realistic cloth dynamics and metallic textures. Not live photography, not 2D animation. Sharp, high-speed, powerful moves, close-range slashes progressing into area-of-effect skills, ending with all enemies destroyed and sword sheathed.
[Asset Reference and Locking]
@Female Heroine: Use '3D_Heroine.png', locking the face shape, features, brown-gold eyes, high-ponytail black hair, and three blue forehead marks of the same adult female. Maintain the dark blue/black battle robes and old metal pauldrons from the reference image. The three perspectives in the reference belong to one person; do not show a triptych. Only one long sword in the right hand, with a matching scabbard fixed on the left waist from the start until the end.

@Demon Beast Pack: Refers only to ordinary four-legged beasts. Lock the body shape, black carapace, dark red cracks, horns, and limb structure. Limited quantity; no refreshing or reviving after death, and they do not turn into giant beasts.
@Giant Demon Beast: Refers to all 'heavy beasts/heavy demon beasts'. Only one in the whole film. Strictly reference the asset image for the huge body, heavy pauldrons, double horns, thick forelimbs, and the dark red core under the chest armor. Size is significantly larger than ordinary beasts, with consistent proportions. Visible behind the pack from t=1s, starts charging at t=14s, killed by the ultimate at t=25-26s, and does not revive.

@Grassland Scene: Lock the spatial relationship between undulating grassland, low stone ridges, central lone rock, and shallow ditches. Grass height to calves, clear footsteps during battle, and distant twin peaks as directional references. Destruction marks persist and do not automatically restore.

[Battle Logic]
Slanting sunlight through dark clouds, gale-force winds pressing down the grass. Wide shot opening shows front, middle, and rear beast layers. Beasts use low lunges and flank maneuvers; the giant beast uses shoulder slams and forelimb smashes, with clear wind-up actions before impact.

0-9s: Fast small skills with light-speed displacement, weaving through the pack.
9-21s: Moving area-of-effect skills to clear the center; outer enemies and the giant beast remain visible.
21-28s: Compress remaining enemy positions, complete the ultimate move while moving, killing all beasts.
28-30s: Clear the battlefield, sheathe the sword completely, ending the battle.

[Movement, Skills, and FX]
Heroine's displacement must be shown as 'person and sword converging into a thin golden ray with cyan flow', not a person running with a light trail. The ray traverses the grassland, lone rock, and ditches, restoring to a clear human form for slashes upon reaching targets. Continuous path, no clones.
Skill [Flicker Slash]: Dash through the formation as light, strike upon landing, releasing a short cyan-gold blade arc along the sword path.
Area Skill [Billowing Tide]: Continuous sword swings while moving, generating three layers of ground-level arc-shaped blade tides, pushing through the center pack.
Ultimate [One Blade Leveling the Plains]: Compress light into the blade during high-speed zigzagging, land with a hip-rotation horizontal slash; a wide cyan-gold tide covers the remaining enemies. No stationary casting or summoning new weapons.

FX Ratio: 50% Energy + 25% Ink + 25% Fluid; primarily Red, Cyan, and Gold. Cyan-Gold belongs to the heroine, dark red to beasts. Ink splatters along force directions. Demon beasts dissolve into ink particles and dull carapace debris upon death.
[Cinematography Rules]
Continuous high-speed tracking, one-shot feel. Use low-angle pushes, side tracking, and rapid focal point rotations. Motion blur only on the background along movement directions, keeping the subject clear. No slow motion or frozen frames allowed until the enemies are dead and the sword is sheathed.
[Shot 1 (0-3s)]
t=1s low-angle push along grass, FS wide shot of heroine dashing from the left stone ridge as a golden line into the front pack, horizontal slash on landing, beasts explode into ink particles.

entries.title: One-Take Water Park Challenge
entries.description: An extensive script for generating a 30-second hyper-realistic video of a water-park obstacle course. It uses a single continuous take and two face references to maintain character consistency through a series of physical mishaps.
entries.prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | photorealistic live-action | ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE | 2 FACE REFERENCES

FICTIONAL RECREATION — Hyper-realistic unscripted water-park obstacle challenge filmed as if captured by a real production camera. Two provided face references are used strictly for identity consistency. Preserve facial identity, facial proportions, hairstyle, skin texture, age, and recognizable features throughout the entire shot. No face swapping, no identity drift.

CORE CONCEPT
A seemingly normal water-park obstacle challenge progressively turns into a spectacular chain reaction of physical mistakes. The entire sequence happens in ONE UNBROKEN TAKE with no cuts, no transitions, no time jumps, and no impossible camera teleportation. The humor comes entirely from believable physics, bad timing, momentum, slipping, water impact, and genuine human reactions.

CHARACTERS
SUBJECT A — Adult contestant based on FACE REFERENCE 1. Athletic casual appearance, realistic swimwear, wet hair and skin, natural body proportions.

SUBJECT B — Adult contestant based on FACE REFERENCE 2. Standing nearby and reacting naturally throughout the sequence.

Both identities remain locked. Clothing, body proportions, hairstyle, wetness, accessories, and facial characteristics remain continuous from beginning to end.

SETTING
Large modern outdoor water park on a bright summer afternoon. Giant inflatable obstacle course floating in a large pool, climbing platforms, floating balance beams, slippery ramps, overhead water jets, inflatable barriers, spectators behind safety rails, lifeguards, wet concrete, colorful umbrellas, realistic resort architecture. Hundreds of subtle background actions create authentic environmental life without distracting from the main action.

CAMERA / ONE-TAKE CHOREOGRAPHY
00:00–05:00 — Camera begins approximately three meters behind Subject A at pool level, handheld but professionally operated. Subject A runs toward the first floating obstacle while Subject B watches from the side. Camera follows naturally, matching walking and running speed. Small realistic handheld movements, natural autofocus, water droplets occasionally crossing the lens.

05:00–10:00 — Subject A jumps onto a wet inflatable platform. Their landing is slightly unstable. One foot slides forward unexpectedly. They recover for a moment, laugh nervously, then continue. Camera moves closer while maintaining continuous spatial relationship and realistic human-scale perspective.

10:00–15:00 — Subject A attempts to cross a narrow floating balance beam. Their foot slips. They grab a flexible overhead rope, swinging sideways with real momentum. The rope stretches and pulls their body back toward the obstacle. Subject B reacts from the adjacent platform, stepping backward to avoid the swinging contestant.

15:00–20:00 — Subject A regains balance but accidentally kicks a large inflatable obstacle. It shifts dramatically. A nearby water jet activates directly into the obstacle, creating a sudden burst of spray. Camera operator instinctively steps backward while continuing to film, briefly losing perfect framing before quickly reacquiring Subject A.

20:00–25:00 — Subject A tries to escape across a slippery ramp but loses traction completely. Their body slides uncontrollably downhill. Subject B reaches toward them but misses. Subject A collides softly with a large inflatable barrier, rebounds, spins naturally, and falls backward into the pool.

25:00–30:00 — Huge realistic splash completely covers the camera lens for a moment. Camera operator wipes the lens while remaining in the same physical location. Through droplets and distorted reflections, Subject A resurfaces laughing and trying to regain composure. Subject B is laughing in the background. Camera settles into a final medium-wide composition showing both contestants, the obstacle course, lifeguards, and surrounding spectators.

PHYSICAL REALISM
Every movement follows believable human biomechanics and real-world water physics. Correct body weight, inertia, friction, momentum, buoyancy, splash displacement, wet-surface slipperiness, inflatable deformation, rope tension, water spray and gravity. No floating bodies, rubbery limbs, impossible recoveries, teleportation, or exaggerated cartoon physics.

CAMERA REALISM
Authentic handheld operator behavior. Natural micro-jitter, slight bobbing while walking, imperfect framing during sudden action, realistic autofocus hunting, exposure adaptation between bright sunlight and shaded obstacles, lens water droplets, temporary obstruction, realistic motion blur. The camera physically moves through the environment rather than cutting between viewpoints.

LIGHTING
Strong natural afternoon sunlight, realistic reflections on wet skin and inflatable surfaces, physically accurate water highlights, soft shadows, subtle atmospheric haze. Sunlight remains consistent throughout the continuous take.

AUDIO
Pure location sound. Running footsteps, splashing water, inflatable material flexing, distant conversations, excited spectators, water jets, lifeguard whistles, Subject A laughing and reacting naturally, Subject B shouting a spontaneous reaction, heavy splash impact, water dripping directly onto the camera microphone. No music. No cinematic sound effects.

VISUAL CHARACTER
Extremely photorealistic live-action footage. Premium high-end sports-documentary realism combined with authentic spontaneous UGC imperfections. Natural skin pores, wet hair strands, realistic fabric saturation, detailed water droplets, physically accurate reflections, realistic crowd behavior, subtle lens imperfections, natural exposure, realistic depth of field. Absolutely no CGI appearance, no plastic skin, no artificial cinematic overgrading.

CONTINUITY LOCK
ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE from 00:00 to 30:00. No cuts. No hidden cuts. No camera teleportation. Subject A and Subject B remain identical to their respective face references throughout. Preserve wardrobe, hairstyle, accessories, body proportions, wetness progression, environment, obstacle positions, sunlight direction and physical geography. Every action must logically cause the next action.

FINAL QUALITY TARGET
The footage must be indistinguishable from an expensive real-world water-park challenge filmed by a skilled human camera operator. The spectacle comes from authentic physical interaction and unpredictable human behavior—not CGI, fantasy, exaggerated destruction, or artificial visual effects.

entries.prompt:
【风格】 真人写实的高空奇观搞笑短视频，手持手机广角摄影质感。真实人物、直升机内饰、火山岩和橙红色熔岩，结合电影级超现实泡沫效果。自然光、真实材质、轻微飞行振动和运动模糊，突出高空落差、喷发逼近的压迫感，以及结尾人物狼狈大笑的喜剧反差。 白色泡沫具有细密气泡、湿润反光、黏附感和重量。喷涌时成团翻卷，撞击后飞溅、堆积，附着在人物和机舱表面后缓慢滑落。不是烟雾、棉花、雪或纯白光效。 【时长】 15秒，9:16竖屏。全程一个连续手持长镜头，正常速度，不切镜、不慢放、不定格。前半段展示和投掷动作清楚，中间留出等待，后半段泡沫突然爆发，结尾留足人物大笑的时间。 【场景】 一架直升机悬停在火山口上方，侧面舱门完全敞开。摄影机位于机舱内，靠近舱门。暗色门框、灰黑色防滑地板、金属门槛、深色座椅与安全带真实可见。 下方是一个巨大的近圆形熔岩池，橙红色熔融物缓慢翻滚，金黄色亮斑不断变化，四周覆盖黑色火山岩壳，分布细密发光裂缝。远处山脊笼罩在灰色薄雾中。开场人物、机舱与镜头均干净，没有泡沫。 【角色】 一名成年黑人女性探险者，棕色马尾，荧光黄色短袖上衣、灰绿色工装长裤、深色靴子，佩戴黑色安全背带与带麦克风的航空耳机。安全系绳连接机舱固定点，人物始终留在舱内。 开场兴奋地向摄影机展示道具；推动巨物时有真实负重感；泡沫冲来时本能缩头后退；最后满身泡沫，看向摄影机哈哈大笑，笑声与嘴型、呼吸和肩膀颤动同步。 【道具】 一颗巨型白色曼妥思薄荷糖，直径约80厘米、厚约30厘米，圆润厚实的扁圆造型，正反面略微鼓起，边缘圆滑，表面是哑光白色糖衣，完全不透明。 糖果竖立在人物胸腹前，上缘接近胸口，下缘接近膝盖，宽度超过躯干。必须双臂环抱，双手扣住左右两侧，前臂夹紧，屈膝承重。不能单手拿起，不能变成小糖粒、薄纸片、球体或透明冰块。全片只出现这一颗糖。 
【镜头】 开场近距离手持中景，人物位于左侧，巨型白色糖果占据中央，敞开的舱门位于右侧。摄影机同时拍到人物表情、双臂、糖果完整形状与门槛。 糖果离手后，摄影机向右下方俯转，追踪下坠，但始终留在机舱内。随后持续俯瞰熔岩落点，等待反应。泡沫冲来后，摄影机迅速后撤并转回人物，最后稳定在满身泡沫的人物中近景。 [00:00–00:01.30] 动作段1：抱着巨型曼妥思，兴奋展示 人物侧身站在敞开的舱门旁，双脚前后错开，膝盖微屈。双臂抱紧巨型白色曼妥思，糖果竖在胸腹前，占据画面中央大部分空间，头部和肩膀露在上方，裤腿露在下方，明确建立巨大尺寸。 她看向摄影机，露出兴奋的笑容，双手重新扣紧糖果两侧，将它向怀里提稳一下。前臂绷紧，肩膀略微耸起，表现糖果的分量。马尾被舱门外的风吹向侧后方。 音效：直升机旋翼声、机舱振动声、高空风声。 [00:01.30–00:02.30] 动作段2：转向舱外，屈膝送到门口 人物将目光转向舱外下方，肩膀和躯干一起向门口转动。双膝进一步弯曲，身体重心降低，把糖果下缘移到金属门槛附近。 她双臂逐渐伸出，糖果从贴近胸腹的位置向外移动，保持明确厚度和重量。朝向熔岩的白色表面出现轻微暖色反光，其余部分仍是哑光白色。 摄影机轻微向右下方倾斜，重点转向双手、巨型糖果与门槛。 音效：衣物和背带摩擦声，人物短促用力呼气。 [00:02.30–00:03.10] 动作段3：推出门槛，双手松开 人物双腿逐渐伸展，双臂合力把糖果推过门槛。糖果顶部先向舱外倾斜，重心越过边缘后，左右手先后松开，糖体完全离手。 巨型糖果沿向外下方的轨迹坠落，缓慢开始翻转。人物双掌短暂停在空中，随后迅速收回，身体重心退回机舱。 摄影机立即沿糖果运动方向向下俯拍，人物脸部退出画面，左上角短暂保留前臂，门槛与防滑地板留在下方前景。 音效：风声增强，鞋底摩擦地板声，旋翼低频持续。 [00:03.10–00:04.60] 动作段4：糖果翻转下坠，落入熔岩 巨型曼妥思从近处清晰的厚扁圆形，逐渐变成远处的非常小的白色圆片。下坠时正面倾斜、侧面转向摄影机，再继续缓慢翻转。糖果实际尺寸与形状不变，只因距离增加而在画面中连续缩小。 摄影机持续向下俯拍，将圆形熔岩池移到中央。左下角留着一条斜向金属门槛，保持高空舱门视角。 糖果以倾斜姿态落入熔岩亮区，局部表面短暂凹下，周围熔融物向外翻开。白色糖体被翻涌的熔岩逐渐遮没，没有立即出现大喷发。 音效：旋翼声、风声，一声遥远低沉的落入声。 [00:04.60–00:07.00] 动作段5：等待反应，白色小泡逐渐聚集 摄影机保持俯视同一处落点，只有轻微手持振动。熔岩继续缓慢翻卷，金黄色纹理改变形状，周围黑色岩壳与裂缝保持固定位置。 先保留一小段没有明显变化的等待。随后落点出现零星白泡，细小气泡接连鼓起、破裂，逐渐聚成一小片浓密泡沫。 白色泡沫缓缓扩大，中央开始隆起，但大部分熔岩池仍然可见。画面形成“好像只是冒一点泡”的错觉。 音效：持续旋翼声，细微嘶嘶声和起泡声逐渐变密。 [00:07.00–00:09.00] 动作段6：泡沫骤然爆发，巨大白柱直冲镜头 落点中央突然隆起，白色泡沫由小团迅速变成粗大的喷涌柱。新的泡沫不断从底部向上推挤，顶部成团翻卷膨胀，整体以惊人的速度升向高空。 泡沫从中心向外覆盖熔岩池，橙红色熔岩逐渐只剩外围一圈。巨大的白色浪头向两侧展开，直接朝舱门逼近，气泡纹理随接近而越来越清楚。 摄影机先抬起一点视线追踪泡沫，随后明显抖动并开始后撤。几团先到的泡沫越过门槛，拍在地板和镜头边缘，留下黏附的白色湿点。 音效：起泡声骤然增强为浑厚喷涌声、湿润扑打声，人物从画面外短促惊呼。 [00:09.00–00:11.50] 动作段7：泡沫灌满舱门，人物从头到脚被覆盖 摄影机后撤并转向舱内，人物、座椅和内壁重新进入画面。人物抓紧把手，屈膝缩头，另一只前臂抬到脸前，向后退一步。 紧接着，白色泡沫浪越过门槛涌入机舱，先撞上她的前臂和肩膀，再铺向胸腹、双腿和靴子。另一团泡沫盖住头顶与耳机，形成歪斜的厚厚泡沫帽，马尾只露出几缕。 座椅靠背、坐垫、门框和地板同时被泡沫覆盖。泡沫碰到表面后黏住、堆积，再缓慢滑落；地面泡沫向舱内推进，包住靴面。黄色上衣逐渐只剩零星色块，黑色背带大部分被埋住。 镜头被一团泡沫短暂擦过，局部泛白，随后泡沫滑向边缘，重新看清人物。舱外喷涌开始减弱，人物稳稳留在舱内，满身泡沫，没有被冲走。 音效：连续“噗、哗、啪”的泡沫撞击声，人物惊呼开始转为忍不住的笑声。
 [00:11.50–00:15.00] 动作段8：发现满身泡沫，擦开脸后哈哈大笑 摄影机稳定在人物中近景。整个机舱和门框覆盖大片白色泡沫，脚边地板堆着厚厚泡沫。她从头到脚都被裹住，肩头和手臂还不断有泡沫缓慢滑下。 她先低头看自己的胸口，再抬起挂满泡沫的手，短暂愣住。随后用手掌抹开眼睛和嘴边的泡沫，让五官露出来；头顶、耳机、脸颊边缘和衣服仍保留大量泡沫。 她抬眼看向摄影机，先咧嘴，随即仰头发出自然畅快的“哈哈哈哈”大笑。眼睛眯起，嘴巴张开，肩膀和胸口随着笑声连续起伏。低头再看一眼自己狼狈的模样，又笑得更厉害。 她举起满是泡沫的手，向摄影机展示。镜头轻轻靠近，让笑脸清晰可见

entries.description: A high-end CGI commercial prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring mercury-like liquid metal transforming into a sleek futuristic electric sports car in a minimalist studio.
entries.prompt:
A hyper-realistic, photorealistic 8K CGI advertisement sequence for a futuristic luxury electric concept sports car, styled like a high-end commercial with a sleek, powerful, and sophisticated mood.

Setting & EnvironmentSet in an infinite, minimalist virtual studio with a deep black void background and a perfectly polished, highly reflective black obsidian floor that crystal-clearly mirrors the scene. The atmosphere is crystal clear with subtle light bloom.
Lighting

Key Light: A cool-white (6000K) softbox panel light descends from above, growing larger to cast clean defining highlights over the final car.

Emissive Accent Light: Silvery-white and vibrant electric-blue light glows directly from the fluid liquid metal, projecting dynamic reflections onto the floor.

Subject Transformation

Initial Form: A single, pristine sphere of mercury-like liquid metal hovering above the floor, rippling with high reflectivity and surface tension.

Final Form: A low-profile, aerodynamic futuristic sports car with smooth, single-piece molded body panels in deep gloss black pearlescent paint that subtly shifts to dark blue, featuring razor-sharp LED light bars.

Camera ChoreographyAn uninterrupted, dynamic camera move starting as an extreme close-up macro (85mm, f/1.8 shallow depth of field) focused on the hovering liquid drop. The camera smoothly pulls back and accelerates into a sweeping clockwise orbit, transitioning to a wide shot (35mm, f/5.6 deep focus) to reveal the complete vehicle sharp and in full view.

Action & Animation Sequence
0–2s: The liquid metal sphere slowly pulses and ripples to a low-frequency bass hum.

2–5s: The sphere explodes outward in zero-gravity as liquid tendrils stretch to form the car's wireframe, traced by glowing electric-blue energy lines, accompanied by high-tech chimes and metallic crackles.

5–7s: Liquid metal flows over the energy frame, solidifying into smooth body panels and forming wheels to a heavy bass thrum.

7–8s: The car gently settles onto the reflective obsidian floor, its razor-sharp LED headlights and taillights flash on with a powerful pulse, fading into the subtle hum of a high-tech electric motor.
