entries.title: French Father-Daughter Bicycle Repair
entries.description: A prompt for an ultra-realistic 2004-style MiniDV home video showing a father and daughter repairing a bike in Lyon.
entries.prompt:
Main Subjects: Young French woman, 23, natural everyday appearance, shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair tied loosely with a faded blue scrunchie, wispy bangs, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup. Her father, early 50s, ordinary appearance, short greying brown hair, light stubble, wearing a faded navy work shirt, worn beige trousers, and old sneakers. Their relationship feels casual and familiar, with natural teasing and comfortable silence. Maintain consistent identities, clothing, hairstyles, and appearances throughout.

Location: Quiet residential neighborhood in Lyon on a sunny Saturday afternoon. Modest row houses and apartment buildings, narrow pavement, parked bicycles, small gardens, garage doors, old concrete walls, potted plants, and mature trees casting moving shadows. An old dark-green bicycle rests beside a garage. No tourist landmarks, cafés, advertisements, or commercial activity.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine family interaction, spontaneous laughter, natural body language, believable physical movement, authentic lived-in French neighborhood atmosphere.

Camera Style: Early-2000s consumer MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, occasional accidental zoom, autofocus hunting between faces and bicycle parts, exposure pumping when moving between sunlight and shade, faded colors, soft contrast, slight motion blur, subtle rolling shutter, mild digital compression artifacts, visible sensor noise, no stabilization, no cinematic camera movement.

00:00–00:03
Her father kneels beside the old bicycle, turning the wheel by hand and inspecting the loose chain. She stands nearby holding a small box of tools while the camera approaches shakily.

00:03–00:06
He tries to reconnect the chain, but it slips off again. She laughs quietly. He looks at her with an exaggerated annoyed expression before both start laughing.

00:06–00:09
She crouches beside him and holds the bicycle steady while he works with a wrench. Grease gets onto his fingers, and he casually wipes them on an old cloth.

00:09–00:12
They finally get the chain working. Her father spins the pedal and the wheel turns smoothly. He gives a satisfied nod while she claps jokingly.

00:12–00:15
She gets onto the repaired bicycle and slowly rides down the residential street. Her father calls something encouraging from behind. She turns around, smiles toward the camcorder, and keeps riding as the operator struggles to follow before abruptly cutting to black.

Audio: Natural ambience only–bicycle chain clicking, tools tapping metal, footsteps, birds, distant cars, leaves rustling, occasional neighborhood conversation, bicycle tires rolling over pavement, father and daughter laughing. No music. No narration.

Goal: A forgotten MiniDV home video from 2004, capturing a completely ordinary Saturday afternoon with a father and daughter repairing an old bicycle outside their home in Lyon

entries.prompt:

六只较小成年翼魔围绕对峙，它们有瘦骨感躯干、反关节腿、长爪臂、短后弯角、窄颅、尖牙和两片真实连接的皮膜翼。它们只作为前景与边缘二级剪影存在，角形、姿态、翼膜破损各有轻微差异，绝不变成克隆。所有角色完全独立，身份、脸部、外形轮廓和肢体数量必须始终清晰，绝不融合，绝不共享肢体，绝不出现手指粘连、翅膀脱离、额外头部或额外肢体。

镜头规则：原生横屏16:9，无永久黑边，30fps，精确20.00秒。使用虚拟ARRI Alexa 35与Cooke anamorphic镜头语言，28-35mm用于地狱宽景，连续推近中自然过渡到约50mm人像压缩感，但整个片段仍是一个连续镜头，无剪切、无跳切、无转场、无隐藏剪辑、无闪切。允许在同一镜头内形成约五个主要构图段落，但不是实际切镜。构图保持史诗横向间距，镜头低位、贴近地面、危险而克制，不做英雄摆拍、正面炫耀或胜利定格。前18秒移动缓慢、 deliberate、自然时间；最后火攻时镜头随压力波快速真实晃动一次，无全局慢动作、无速度坡变、无过度乱抖。

0.00-4.00秒：镜头从破裂玄武岩地面极低处开始，左、右前景各有一只翼魔蹲伏成黑色剪影，面对画面中心；后方断岩上其他翼魔轻微移动，翼膜抽动，爪子收紧，狭窄头颅追踪烟中逼近的东西。摄影机非常缓慢向前，从两只剪影之间滑入。中央烟雾里先出现一个微弱深红菱形光点，随后浓烟被沉重步伐推开，依次露出巨像额晶、红眼、披甲头骨、巨大肩部和两条长而 planted 的前肢。每一步都压缩关节，震动地面，让小石子跳动，烟尘被向外挤开，但不要一次性露完整身体。

4.00-7.50秒：同一镜头自然推进并升到低位中广角构图，巨像把两只巨大前爪压进地面，抬头并缓慢滚动肩膀，灰白鬃毛被热流托起。额心深红晶体脉冲一次，照亮头骨脊线、湿润獠牙 and 黑金属甲片。驯兽师从它右前肢旁平静走入画面，两步后停住；她的全高只到巨像肩部很小一段。她站姿挺直，肩放松，下巴略抬。巨像在她身后张开下颚发出低沉非语言 growl，烟从两者腿部滚过，翼魔仍在画面边缘作为紧张剪影。

7.50-10.50秒：镜头继续无剪切地滑成克制50mm感上胸至头部肖像，女人占据前景，巨像巨大而发光的脸在她左肩后方柔焦可读。她先看向画外翼魔，表情中性、评估、冷静。她缓慢抬起右手到脸侧，手腕向外旋转，只竖起食指与中指，其余手指自然折回。一道狭窄深红微光沿两根手指边缘流动。她眼神轻微上移，嘴角形成小而自信的笑。巨像额晶回应更强深红脉冲，红光扫过她的脸颊、眼睛与肩甲，但不改变她的面孔；她绝不开口，嘴唇不动。

10.50-13.50秒：镜头横移到一只近处翼魔张开的爪与颚之间作为前景框，驯兽师在中距离缓缓把手降向腰侧，双指保持伸展直到手势完成。巨像巨大头部贴近她身旁向前俯下，颚略开，几条唾液丝在獠牙间自然拉伸，鼻孔吐出炽热蒸汽。女人只把眼睛转向巨像，身体不转，表情仍稳。最近的翼魔后退半步，翼膜防御性张开；另一只低头，收回伸出的爪手。所有动作分离、真实、有重量。

13.50-15.50秒：同一镜头继续推进到三只翼魔的小群近景。中央翼魔先露牙，随后深红光洗过它的窄脸，它突然停住，眼睛睁大；两侧翼魔快速互看并把翼膜收得更贴近身体。三只各自用不同节奏后撤，脚趾和爪尖刮过玄武岩，石屑被拖开，绝不瞬移、绝不互相融合。画外开始传来巨像更深、更长的吸气，火光在烟后逐渐增强。

15.50-18.00秒：镜头退入最终低位宽景构图，巨像占据中央，驯兽师冷静站在它右前肢旁，翼魔剪影框住左右前景。巨像迈出一次巨大前步，领先爪撞入地面，几道小裂缝张开，灰尘与火星向外喷散。它把头压低到肩间开始吸气，橙色光从肋下、喉底和牙缝之间逐级增强；额晶仍保持独立深红色，不与橙火混为一体。驯兽师完全不动，只有热压把她头发、战裙片和链条向后推，前景翼魔在火焰释放前就开始从中心线慌乱撤开。

18.00-20.00秒：自然高速中，巨像猛地前送头颅，张开重颚，释放一道连续橙白火焰锥直冲前景。必须清楚看到火焰从喉内形成，穿过牙齿之间，仍然附着在口腔并沿明确方向扩展，不能从身体、晶体或地面冒出。最近翼魔用腿和翅膀向两侧扑离，仍可见它们逃出火线，不在火中凭空消失。低机位被压力波震动一次，火舌卷过下方前景，透过火焰仍短暂读到巨像脸、深红额晶和驯兽师不动的黑色轮廓。精确在20.00秒结束于持续喷射中，无淡出、无冻结、无标题、无片尾卡。

声音：只有真实现场音效与环境声，绝无音乐、无配乐、无歌声、无对白、无旁白、无咒语、无可辨识语言，驯兽师嘴唇绝不移动。声音包括沉重怪物脚步、玄武岩震颤、盔甲皮革与链条轻响、翼膜拍动、爪子刮石、深沉非语言低吼、远处洞穴回声、岩浆 crackle、

entries.title: Ultra-Realistic Infinite Zoom Sequence
entries.description: An epic cinematic infinite zoom prompt starting from a human eye and traveling through the city, space, and the microscopic world.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic infinite zoom cinematic sequence, mind-bending visual transformation, premium VFX realism. One seamless continuous shot with a constant forward zoom, smooth acceleration, perfect match-cuts and impossible scale transitions. Sharp detail, cinematic depth, subtle motion blur, premium lighting evolution, surreal but photorealistic, no cartoon look.

One adult human figure appears only at the beginning as the starting visual anchor. After that, the sequence becomes a visual journey through environments, structures and worlds. No dialogue.

The sequence begins in a modern city apartment, then transforms through multiple scales and environments: human eye, room, city, clouds, Earth, space, galaxy, nebula, microscopic world, cell-like structures, abstract geometric tunnel, then a final new city reveal.
Perfect seamless infinite zoom illusion, coherent scale transitions, photorealistic environments, macro-to-cosmic continuity, elegant match transformations, stable geometry, premium VFX detail, smooth camera flow, visually viral, no cuts, no text.

0-5s: Extreme macro push-in Start on an ultra close-up of a human eye. The camera zooms into the pupil. The reflections inside the eye reveal a window, then the entire apartment room appears inside the iris as the camera keeps pushing forward.

5-10s: Continuous infinite zoom The apartment becomes a city block seen from above, then the entire city, then clouds, then the curvature of Earth. The zoom continues smoothly into outer space, with the planet shrinking into a starfield.

10-15s: Acceleration through cosmic scale The camera passes through a spiral galaxy, then a glowing nebula, then dives into a bright star that transforms seamlessly into a microscopic cell-like structure. The cell membrane becomes a huge circular landscape.

15-20s: Final impossible reveal The camera continues forward through abstract crystalline patterns and geometric light tunnels, then emerges into a completely new futuristic city at sunrise, revealing that the entire cosmic journey has resolved into another world. End on a breathtaking wide reveal.

entries.title: Premium UGC Perfume Advertisement

She has a naturally captivating appearance, expressive eyes, polished makeup, luminous realistic skin texture, and beautifully styled hair. Her look is sophisticated and confident rather than overly glamorous. Scene: A luxurious modern interior with warm ambient lighting, subtle shadows, and an upscale editorial atmosphere. Keep the background clean and slightly out of focus so the woman and perfume remain the visual focus. Outfit: She wears an elegant, bold evening outfit with a sophisticated silhouette—fashion-forward, refined, and alluring while remaining tasteful. The outfit should complement the luxury positioning of the perfume. UGC performance: She holds the perfume bottle naturally and speaks directly to the camera as if recommending a fragrance she genuinely loves. Start with a casual attention-grabbing moment, then show the bottle close to the camera, spray the perfume on her wrist/neck, smell it, and react with a subtle confident smile. Include natural hand gestures, slight movements, authentic facial expressions, and relaxed body language. Camera: Handheld smartphone-style UGC footage mixed with a few polished close-up shots. Natural micro-movements, realistic autofocus, shallow depth of field, occasional subtle push-in. Avoid the overly perfect look of a traditional commercial. Product focus: Give the perfume bottle several hero moments with crisp focus, realistic reflections, premium glass and liquid details, while keeping the brand label clearly visible and undistorted. Lighting & aesthetic: Warm luxury lighting, soft highlights on her face and hair, realistic skin pores and fine details, cinematic but believable exposure, sophisticated neutral tones, premium beauty-ad aesthetic. Video style: Authentic high-end UGC × luxury fragrance campaign, natural and aspirational, confident feminine energy, photorealistic, cinematic realism, 4K, realistic motion, natural expressions, no CGI appearance, no beauty-filter effect. Ending: She looks directly into the camera, holds the perfume beside her face, gives a subtle confident smile, and finishes with a natural recommendation-style expression. Avoid exaggerated acting, unnatural body movements, plastic skin, excessive retouching, distorted hands, warped perfume bottles, fake-looking reflections, or artificial facial expressions.

entries.title: Korean Martial Arts Training Vlog
entries.description: A vlog-style prompt capturing a Korean woman's martial arts training and victory, emphasizing natural movement, selfie footage, and consistent character identity.
entries.prompt: Sports vlog continuing the story of the same young Korean woman in her early 20s after completing traditional Chinese kung fu training. She wears the same training uniform and maintains perfect identity consistency throughout. The video takes place in the same authentic outdoor martial arts courtyard in China and is filmed mostly by a friend using a real handheld smartphone, with occasional selfie footage. Use natural hand shake, imperfect framing, autofocus shifts, exposure changes, motion blur, realistic courtyard ambience, student reactions, footsteps and breathing—never cinematic, professional, or action-movie style. She starts in selfie mode, excited but nervous, saying in Korean, “이제 배운 걸 한번 해볼게요!” before showing the training area. She respectfully begins a friendly supervised sparring match with another student, using safe, controlled footwork, blocks and training movements. As she gains confidence, she avoids a controlled attack and successfully scores points. After the final exchange, the instructor signals that she has won. Surprised and excited, she says, “제가 이겼어요? 진짜요?” She and her opponent respectfully smile and acknowledge each other while nearby students clap. Finally, she takes the phone back in selfie mode, slightly out of breath and proudly says, “처음엔 아무것도 몰랐는데 결국 이겼어요! 정말 재밌었어요!” She laughs, waves naturally and lowers the phone to end the vlog.

entries.title: Hand-drawn pencil sketch time-lapse
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a 10-second time-lapse video of a digital pencil sketch being drawn. It simulates the entire process from a blank canvas to the final signature, following the structure and composition of a reference image.
entries.prompt:
【10秒手工鉛筆速寫繪畫延時】

在專業數位繪圖軟體中，從完全空白的米白色紙張畫布開始，使用全程可見的滑鼠游標，逐步重建提供的參考圖。保持參考圖的人物、姿勢、構圖、長髮、服裝，以及湖面、拱橋、遠山、柳樹、遊船等場景關係。

0:00-0:02
空白畫布開始，游標快速建立人物比例與整體構圖，勾勒人物、湖面、拱橋、遠山與主要環境輪廓。

0:02-0:04
快速細化人物與背景線稿，繪製臉部、五官、長髮、服裝，同步增加橋梁、山體、柳樹、遊船與背景人物。

0:04-0:06
使用石墨鉛筆快速排線，建立頭髮、臉部、服裝與環境明暗。保留自然交叉線、重複線、斷續線與手工修改痕跡。

0:06-0:08.5
持續精修五官、髮絲、服裝褶皺與環境細節，逐漸形成完整的手工鉛筆速寫。

0:08.5-0:09.5
完成最後細節，擦除少量多餘構造線，穩定展示完整作品。

0:09.5-0:10
游標移至畫面左下角，以自然手寫筆觸完成最後署名「● DeepBlue」。署名只能在最後出現，完成後游標停留。

風格：
高速手工鉛筆速寫延時攝影；米白色紙張、石墨線條、自然排線、交叉線、紙張紋理、真實手繪痕跡。畫布為視覺主體，UI 簡潔可信。

核心要求：
空白畫布 → 構圖 → 草圖 → 細節線稿 → 排線明暗 → 精修 → 完成 → 最後署名。所有畫面變化都由可見游標實際繪畫逐步產生，後續畫面必須建立在前一階段之上。禁止角色或背景突然出現、禁止直接切換成完成圖、禁止彩色上色、水彩、3D、動漫風與電影式轉場。
entries.translated_prompt:
[10-second manual pencil sketch drawing time-lapse]

In professional digital drawing software, starting from a completely blank cream-white paper canvas, use a mouse cursor visible throughout the process to gradually reconstruct the provided reference image. Maintain the characters, poses, composition, long hair, and clothing of the reference image, as well as the scene relationships like the lake surface, arched bridge, distant mountains, willows, and pleasure boats.

0:00-0:02
Start with a blank canvas; the cursor quickly establishes character proportions and overall composition, outlining characters, lake surface, arched bridge, distant mountains, and main environmental contours.

0:02-0:04
Quickly refine the line art of characters and background, drawing faces, features, long hair, and clothing; simultaneously add bridges, mountains, willows, pleasure boats, and background figures.

0:04-0:06
Use a graphite pencil for quick cross-hatching to establish light and shadow on hair, face, clothing, and environment. Retain natural cross-hatching, repeated lines, broken lines, and manual correction marks.

0:06-0:08.5
Continuously refine facial features, hair strands, clothing folds, and environmental details to gradually form a complete manual pencil sketch.

0:08.5-0:09.5
Complete final details, erase a small amount of extra construction lines, and stably display the finished work.

0:09.5-0:10
The cursor moves to the bottom left corner of the screen to complete the final signature '● DeepBlue' with natural handwritten strokes. The signature can only appear at the end, and the cursor stays after completion.

Style:
High-speed manual pencil sketch time-lapse photography; cream-white paper, graphite lines, natural hatching, cross-hatching, paper texture, realistic hand-drawn marks. The canvas is the visual subject, with a simple and credible UI.

Core Requirements:
Blank canvas → Composition → Sketch → Detailed line art → Hatching light and shadow → Refinement → Completion → Final signature. All screen changes must be gradually produced by the visible cursor's actual drawing, and subsequent frames must be built on the previous stage. Prohibit characters or backgrounds from suddenly appearing, prohibit direct switching to the finished image, prohibit color painting, watercolor, 3D, anime style, and cinematic transitions.

entries.title: Cinematic Black Sphere Sci-Fi Scene
entries.description: A surreal cinematic sci-fi prompt featuring a massive pulsing black sphere, time reversal in a futuristic city, and a character encounter with a reflection.
entries.prompt:
10 seconds, cinematic, ultra-realistic, photorealistic, colossal scale, no text, no logos. The black sphere pulses. The frozen city suddenly moves again. On a rooftop far below, a young woman in a dark futuristic raincoat stands completely still, drenched by the rain. She looks upward as the sphere begins opening like a gigantic black eye. Her hair and coat whip violently in the gravitational wind. She slowly raises one hand toward the sphere. Inside it, the tiny city begins moving backward through time—cars reverse, rain rises, broken buildings reconstruct themselves. The woman watches in disbelief as her own reflection appears inside the sphere. The reflection moves independently. The real woman lowers her hand. The reflection doesn't. It suddenly turns toward her and points behind her. She turns around. Every skyscraper in the city is now facing her, windows illuminating one by one in a massive wave.  The gravitational force suddenly intensifies. She is pulled across the rooftop toward the sphere, sliding through the rain. She grabs a massive steel structure, barely holding on as buildings around her stretch toward the black sphere.  Extreme close-up of her eyes. Inside her pupil, the entire futuristic city is reflected. Then the reflection reveals something impossible: another version of the woman standing directly behind her. A deep pulse. 

HARD CUT TO BLACK. Sound: violent rain → deep gravitational rumble → metallic tearing → sudden silence → one sharp breath → enormous sub-bass pulse. Character: realistic young woman, dark futuristic raincoat, wet hair, natural facial features, cinematic lighting, determined but frightened expression. Keep her visually consistent throughout the sequence

entries.title: Eastern Fantasy Hanfu Action Sequence
entries.description: A stylized 15-second vertical action video featuring an East Asian woman in a jade-green hanfu engaging in an improvised dance-like battle.
entries.prompt:
Use Image 1 as the character reference for Alin, and Image 2 as the handgun reference. Create a 15-second vertical video, 9:16 canvas, with a horizontal cinematic frame centered inside it and black bars above and below.

Scene: an eerie Eastern fantasy ruined town, burned wooden gate, dead branches, sparse peach blossoms, smoke, embers, fallen zombies on the ground.

Alin: young East Asian woman, pale skin, delicate oval face, cold clear eyes, black hair in an ornate updo. She wears a pale jade-green hanfu with translucent wide sleeves, white and soft pink inner layers, gold peony embroidery, gold waist ornaments, pearl chains, and an ornate gold floral hair crown with jade, pearls, white flowers, and dangling tassels. She holds two black heavy semi-automatic handguns matching Image 2: square black metal slide, long barrel, textured black grip.

Motion core: Alin does not perform fixed dance steps. Her movement is one continuous unstable improvised body flow, like a possessed dance. Tiny shoulder twitches travel through elbows, wrists, waist, hips, knees, and feet. She tilts her head, drops a shoulder, twists her waist, missteps, leans back, spins, sinks, and rebounds. Every motion flows from the previous momentum, no hard cuts, no frozen poses. She barely aims; her arms are carried by body inertia, and each casual wrist flick or turning motion fires a shot. Zombies fall back, collapse, or slide out of frame. No gore.

Facial emotion progression: 0-3s blank and trance-like; 3-6s strange faint smile, unfocused eyes; 6-9s excited and dangerous; 9-12s suddenly cold and precise; 12-15s quiet, tired, with a disturbing slight smile toward camera.

Timeline:
0-3s: Alin stands under the burned gate, head lowered, pistols hanging down. Subtle shoulder twitches begin, sleeves and tassels sway. Zombies approach from both sides; without looking up, she leans sideways and casually shoots one down.
3-6s: Her body becomes more erratic, hips shift off-balance, feet slide, torso collapses the opposite way. A strange smile appears. Her pistols draw loose arcs; short shots drop zombies on both sides.
6-9s: She half-spins, abruptly pauses, sleeves circle around her. Her head snaps with the rhythm. Zombies leap from behind or above; she flicks both pistols upward without looking, and they fall out of the air.
9-12s: She sinks low, rebounds upward, face turns cold. Arms cross, pistols sweep from low to high. Each passing muzzle triggers a short shot; zombies collapse one by one.
12-15s: The movement resolves. She slowly straightens, still faintly twitching. One final wrist turn drops the last zombie at the edge of frame. Pistols lower, sleeves settle, Alin looks into camera with a tired eerie smile.

Music: dark Eastern ritual dance track, unstable low drums like broken heartbeat, guzheng plucks, pipa scrapes, low war drum, reversed breath-like vocals, tiny bell

entries.title: Cinematic Rainy Bus Stop Dialogue
entries.description: A cinematic slice-of-life video prompt featuring a rainy-day encounter at a bus stop, emphasizing natural dialogue, soft lighting, and professional subtitles.
entries.prompt: Cinematic slice-of-life video, 30 seconds, single continuous narrative, photorealistic, natural realistic visuals, soft overcast daylight color grade, light rain throughout, smooth steady handheld-style camera, professional small clean subtitles burned in at the bottom of the frame, precisely synced to spoken dialogue, natural understated performances — no over-acting, calm normal conversation. 00–07s: A woman in her late 20s stands at a bus stop under a small umbrella, light rain falling, quiet street ambience. A man around the same age walks up, no umbrella, hood up, slightly damp. He stands a little apart, glancing at the rain. Dialogue (subtitled): Him: "Of course it rains right when I forget my umbrella かのんくん" Her: (small smile, shifting the umbrella slightly toward him) "Come here, there's room ." 07–14s: He steps under the umbrella beside her, natural slightly awkward-but-warm moment, both looking out at the rain. Him: "Thanks. Didn't expect that." Her: "I'd want someone to do the same for me." 14–21s: Easy natural conversation continues, small genuine laughs, comfortable silence in between. Him: "So do you take this bus every day?" Her: "Most days. You?" Him: "First time, actually. New job starts today." Her: "Good luck. You'll be fine." 21–27s: The bus approaches in the distance, headlights visible through the rain. Both glance toward it, a small shared look, like neither really wants the moment to end. Him: "This is us, huh." Her: (smiling) "Guess so." 27–30s: The bus doors open, they step forward together, she closes the umbrella, quiet warm nod between them as they board. Camera holds on the empty bus stop for a beat as the bus pulls away, rain continuing softly. Fade out. Camera: Smooth handheld-style realism, natural eye-level framing, subtle steady movement, gentle push-in during dialogue, documentary-like pacing, no dramatic angles モイネロ #SideM特別生配信 . Lighting: Soft overcast daylight, muted natural tones, light rain reflections on pavement, realistic wet-weather atmosphere. Subtitles: Small, clean, professional white sans-serif font, centered bottom third, subtle semi-transparent dark background box, precisely synced, simple fade in/out only. Audio: Natural rain sound throughout, distant traffic, umbrella rain patter, footsteps on wet pavement, bus engine approaching and doors opening, calm natural dialogue delivery, very light ambient acoustic music underneath at low volume, no dramatic score. Style: Realistic, warm, natural color grading, authentic candid feel, mature grounded tone, no exaggerated expressions.

entries.title: Late-90s Radio Station Vlog
entries.description: A nostalgic 15-second vlog-style sequence of a radio host in the late 90s, capturing the urgency of a live broadcast with a consumer camcorder aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-photorealistic late-night workplace vlog inside a tiny local radio station. Use six fast handheld shots recorded on a consumer camcorder from the late 1990s.

CHARACTER LOCK: One adult female radio host in her late 30s, short auburn hair, black rectangular glasses, burgundy cardigan, charcoal T-shirt, dark jeans and silver over-ear headphones around her neck. She carries one paper coffee cup. Preserve her identity, clothes, glasses, headphones and cup throughout.

0–2s — IMMEDIATE HOOK: The red ON AIR lamp suddenly illuminates while she is still rushing through the studio door with coffee in one hand and a stack of records slipping from the other. Her alarmed face and the glowing lamp fill the same frame.

2–4.5s: She catches the records against her chest, sets the coffee down and slides into the broadcast chair. The camcorder pans late and briefly crops her head.

4.5–7s: Close shot of her hands rapidly checking three record sleeves. One sleeve is empty. She looks under the console as the turntable continues spinning silently.

7–9.5s: She finds the missing record beneath a notebook, places it on the turntable and lowers the needle with one second to spare. Her movements are urgent but precise.

9.5–12s: She pulls on the headphones, opens the microphone channel and leans toward it. Her panic disappears into a calm professional smile; no audible scripted speech is required.

12–15s: The camera pulls back through the booth glass. She points at the saved record and silently celebrates with one small fist pump while the clock advances and the coffee cup trembles beside the speaker.

VISUAL STYLE: 4:3 late-1990s consumer camcorder, fluorescent studio light, analog equipment LEDs, soft tape noise, low dynamic range, minor color bleed, imperfect white balance and clumsy zoom. No modern cinematic lighting or polished commercial composition.

AUDIO: Door, record sleeves, chair wheels, turntable motor, needle contact, console switches, headphone movement, room tone and faint record crackle. No background score, narration or intelligible copyrighted music.

CONSTRAINTS: One host only. Equipment, records, coffee, glasses and headphones remain consistent. No spilled coffee, broken equipment, duplicated props, readable station branding, subtitles, logos or watermark.

entries.title: Fantasy Inferno Hunter Action Cinematics
entries.description: A complex 30-second action sequence prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring a furnace-wielding hunter battling ice creatures in a one-take cinematic style.
entries.prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | 4K UHD | 24fps
Ultra-realistic AAA cinematic fantasy action
Pure visual storytelling
No dialogue
Continuous one-take.

REFERENCE LOCK:
@image1 controls the hunter's identity, outfit, face, hair and furnace weapon.
@image2 controls the frozen environment and ice creatures.
Do not redesign either reference.

VFX RULE:
All creature destruction happens only after physical weapon contact. No spontaneous burning or unexplained explosions. No blood or biological gore.

0.0s–5.0s:
Camera races low across cracked black ice toward the hunter. Thousands of ice beasts charge toward her. She grips the massive furnace weapon with both hands and performs one heavy downward strike. Contact creates a circular orange-white thermal shockwave that instantly cracks the ice armor of nearby creatures.

5.0s–10.0s:
She slides across the frozen ground while dragging the weapon behind her, carving a glowing molten line through the ice. She pivots and swings upward. A fan-shaped wave of compressed heat travels through the creature formation. Impacted armor glows from within, fractures, turns black and collapses into steam, ash and glowing fragments.

10.0s–15.0s:
A gigantic armored ice beast leaps from the background. Hunter blocks its claws with the furnace weapon. The collision creates a violent burst of steam and shattered ice. Camera circles around both figures while maintaining one continuous shot.

15.0s–20.0s:
Hunter pushes the creature backward, then runs along a collapsing frozen wall. She jumps from the wall and lands directly on the creature's shoulder armor. The weapon reaches maximum temperature, mechanical pistons extending and molten channels turning white-hot.

20.0s–26.0s:
She raises the weapon above her head and delivers one enormous vertical strike from shoulder to torso. The exact contact point becomes a glowing thermal mark. Cracks of white-orange heat spread across the creature's armor. The entire body transforms into black volcanic ash, white steam and burning armor fragments without showing flesh.

26.0s–30.0s:
The frozen battlefield becomes covered in drifting steam and falling ash. Hunter lands on one knee, slowly rises, rests the giant weapon over her shoulder and walks toward a gigantic ancient frozen gate. Camera smoothly pulls backward, revealing the enormous ruined landscape.

Negative Prompt: blood, gore, flesh, organs, wounds, red liquid, severed bodies, dismemberment, spontaneous fire, blue magic, ocean, city, green grass, desert, duplicate character, duplicate weapon, sword morphing, weightless weapon, katana, dual weapons, outfit change, hair change, face distortion, extra limbs, extra fingers, fused hands, weapon clipping, text, subtitles, watermark, logo, UI, hard cuts, freeze frames, slow motion, black screen, camera teleportation.

entries.title: Cinematic Spring Portrait Video
entries.description: A cinematic portrait prompt for a spring-themed scene, focusing on subtle emotional transitions, realistic hair physics, and a soft pastel aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic spring portrait video, 10–15 seconds, featuring a beautiful young adult Asian woman (18–22), slender and graceful, with long dark hair, fair luminous skin, soft innocent eyes, delicate natural features, and light Korean-style makeup. She wears a simple cream or pale-blue spring outfit, clean, modest, elegant, and youthful. Her look is based on Image1.

The scene takes place outdoors in early spring, in a quiet campus-like garden or tree-lined path with fresh green leaves, soft blossoms, warm sunlight, and a gentle pastel atmosphere. A light spring breeze continuously moves through her long hair and the fabric of her clothes.

Opening shot: medium half-body shot from slightly behind and to the side. The girl stands sideways to the camera, body turned about 70–90 degrees away, quietly gazing into the distance. Her hair gently flows in the breeze. She looks peaceful, slightly dreamy, and lost in thought.

The unseen person holding the camera softly calls out to her from behind the camera in a young boy's / gentle teenage-boy voice — a warm, soft male voice off-screen. The camera operator must never appear in frame.

Hearing the boy's voice, she pauses for a brief moment, then suddenly turns around to face the camera directly — rotating her head and upper body from the sideways profile all the way to a full head-on, face-toward-camera position. Her long hair naturally swings with the movement and catches the spring breeze.

The moment she recognizes the person behind the camera, her expression changes from distant and calm to surprised, warm, and shy. Her eyes soften, she gives a tiny restrained smile, then slightly lowers her gaze and shyly dips her head, as if suddenly embarrassed to make eye contact.

Keep the acting subtle and natural: no exaggerated smile, no theatrical movement. The emotional focus is the tiny transition from quiet distance → surprise → recognition → shy affection.

Camera language: intimate handheld or gently stabilized photography, slight natural camera breathing, shallow depth of field, 50mm–85mm portrait lens look, soft background bokeh, natural skin texture, realistic hair movement, soft spring backlight, warm highlights, clean Korean / Xiaohongshu cinematic portrait aesthetic, dreamy but lifelike, romantic youthful atmosphere, high-end fashion short film, photorealistic, high detail, realistic motion, no slow-motion exaggeration.

Do not show: camera operator, extra people, text, subtitles, watermark, exaggerated beauty filter, plastic skin, anime styling, overly dramatic wind, unnatural hair physics, exaggerated facial expressions.

entries.title: Pet Owner's Cinematic Daily Routine
entries.description: A documentary-style prompt for a 15-second cinematic sequence showing a pet owner's daily routine with a golden-brown dog, focusing on realistic physics and biomechanics.
entries.prompt:
A Pet Owner’s Daily Routine

A pet owner starts the morning by waking up and greeting their golden-brown dog with gentle affection. The routine continues with feeding the dog, taking it for a morning walk, working together from home, and ending the day with a fun game of fetch in the backyard during golden hour.

Every scene follows realistic human and animal behavior with accurate physics, including gravity, inertia, momentum, friction, collisions, leash tension, realistic object weight, natural fur movement, cloth dynamics, and anatomically correct human and canine biomechanics.

Ultra-realistic visuals, cinematic documentary style, natural lighting, realistic skin and fur, smooth camera movement, subtle handheld motion, realistic depth of field, natural focus pulls, physically accurate shadows, consistent character identity, detailed environments, natural colors, subtle film grain, and 4K cinematic quality.

entries.title: Miniature Tokyo Drink Can Reflection
entries.description: A unique cinematic prompt that transitions from a rainy Tokyo street into a miniature city hidden within the reflection of a drink can.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic miniature-world video, 9:16 vertical, 4K HDR, photorealistic macro cinematography.

0–4s:
Rainy Tokyo-inspired street at night. A futuristic vending machine glows under neon lights. Wet pavement reflects cyan and magenta colors. A young man approaches, presses a button, and a cold drink can drops naturally.

4–8s:
He picks up the can. Extreme macro shot of water droplets and neon reflections on the aluminum surface. The camera slowly moves into the reflection. Tiny moving lights appear inside it.

8–13s:
The camera seamlessly enters the reflection and reveals a miniature futuristic Tokyo inside the can: tiny skyscrapers, streets, pedestrians, cars, vending machines and an elevated train. Everything has realistic scale and movement.

13–19s:
The camera flies through the miniature city at street level. Tiny cars pass through wet intersections, pedestrians walk naturally, a train crosses overhead, and neon lights reflect on miniature roads. Realistic atmospheric steam and rain.

19–24s:
The camera rises above the city, revealing the entire miniature metropolis contained inside the cylindrical drink can. Flying delivery drones move between skyscrapers. The metallic walls of the can surround the city.

24–27s:
The camera smoothly pulls backward through the reflection. The miniature city becomes smaller and disappears into the can.

27–30s:
Return to the real Tokyo street. The man holds the can and looks at it with genuine surprise. The camera pushes toward the can one final time, briefly revealing the glowing miniature city inside its reflection.

Create a 15-second extremely funny cinematic 3D animated action comedy, 16:9 widescreen. Modern corporate conference room, polished feature-film-quality animation, expressive facial acting, dynamic camera movement, escalating physical comedy, strong visual storytelling.

An overly confident professional presenter who becomes increasingly desperate to retrieve the remote while pretending everything is under control.

A presentation is going perfectly in a modern conference room.
The presenter confidently advances slides using a small remote.
The remote slips from his hand.

The presenter freezes for one moment.
Then immediately resumes smiling professionally.

3–6 seconds:

The remote rolls farther underneath the table.

Misses.

Under the table he performs an action-comedy obstacle course around chair legs, briefcases, power cables, and rolling office chairs.
The remote continues narrowly escaping him.
The presentation screen behind him automatically advances through multiple slides.

He finally catches the remote.
He emerges dramatically from beneath the table like a victorious action hero.
He raises the remote triumphantly.

14–15 seconds:
He looks toward the presentation screen.
The presentation has already reached the final slide:

THANK YOU.

The audience is applauding.

The presenter stands there holding the remote, realizing he missed the entire presentation.

CUT TO BLACK.

entries.title: Authentic Airplane Window Anomaly POV
entries.description: A detailed prompt for an authentic-looking smartphone video recorded from an airplane window that captures a mysterious geometric structure beneath the ocean.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-photorealistic smartphone video recorded by a passenger looking out of an airplane window during a normal daytime flight.

The footage must look completely authentic and accidental: handheld phone camera, imperfect framing, slight window reflections, subtle autofocus changes, realistic airplane vibration, natural exposure, compression, ordinary clouds and realistic atmospheric haze.

STRUCTURE:

0–9 SECONDS — ORDINARY
The passenger casually films the view outside the airplane window. Blue sky, layers of clouds and ocean far below. The airplane wing is partially visible. Everything looks completely normal and boring.

9–14 SECONDS — SLIGHTLY STRANGE
Something unusual becomes visible far below through a gap in the clouds.

At first it looks like an unusual circular patch in the ocean.

The person filming slowly tilts and zooms the phone toward it.

14–21 SECONDS — WTF
As the camera zooms in, the circular area becomes clearer.

Something enormous appears to be moving beneath the surface.

Do NOT clearly reveal what it is.

For a brief moment, the water reveals the outline of an enormous perfectly geometric structure beneath the ocean, far too large to be a normal ship or island.

The passenger becomes increasingly confused and instinctively adjusts the phone framing.

21–27 SECONDS — IMPOSSIBLE
The clouds begin moving across the view.

Just before the object disappears behind the clouds, a huge section of the underwater structure subtly moves.

The movement must make the viewer realize this isn't an island or geological formation.

It is something enormous beneath the ocean.

The passenger quietly says, naturally and uncertainly:

“What the hell is that?”

No dramatic acting.

27–30 SECONDS — CUT
The clouds completely obscure the view.

The passenger tries to reposition the camera, but the video abruptly ends.

Make the anomaly extremely difficult to identify at first. The viewer should initially think they are watching ordinary airplane footage.

CRITICAL REALISM:
No cinematic color grading, no fantasy lighting, no giant obvious monster, no science-fiction aesthetic, no exaggerated VFX. Everything should look like authentic phone footage someone accidentally captured from an airplane.

The viewer's progression should feel like:
‑Nice clouds.‑
→ ‑Wait, what's that?‑
→ ‑Is that something underwater?‑
→ ‑That can't be real.‑

entries.title: Spicy Food Challenge Personal Vlog
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot prompt for a realistic personal home-video depicting a woman's reaction to a spicy food challenge.
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video of a young Korean woman confidently accepting a spicy food challenge from her friend, only to completely unravel as the heat kicks in. No reference image. MAIN SUBJECT Young Korean woman in her early 20s, casual and playful energy, natural makeup, expressive face that shifts from smug confidence to genuine distress. Hair tied back in a high ponytail to "keep it out of the way," a few loose strands already escaping, small stud earrings. Wearing an oversized gray hoodie with sleeves pushed up, loose sweatpants, sitting cross-legged on the floor like she's settling in for battle. Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and appearance throughout the entire video. SETTING A cozy, lived-in living room floor setup, late afternoon light coming through the window. A low coffee table covered with a spread of increasingly spicy tteokbokki/ramen bowls lined up in a row, a stack of napkins, a carton of milk and a glass of water nearby "just in case," a phone propped against a water bottle timing things, a half-eaten snack bag pushed aside, and a blanket tossed on the couch behind her. Ordinary, slightly messy, very real. CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC Raw personal footage filmed by her friend on a phone, strong handheld vlog shake throughout. Camera bounces slightly with the friend shifting position to get better angles of her face. Autofocus hunts between the steaming bowls and her face. Mild motion blur when she reaches for water in a panic. Exposure shifts slightly as the afternoon light changes. Visible digital noise, slightly warm color cast from the window light. No stabilization, no cinematic polish — it should feel like a real video shot for a group chat dare. 00:00–00:05 — THE CONFIDENT SETUP She rolls up her sleeves theatrically, cracking her knuckles over the bowls like she's about to do something serious. She looks into the camera, completely unbothered, smug smile. "This is nothing. I grew up eating spicy." 00:05–00:10 — FIRST BITE She picks up the first, mildest bowl and takes a confident bite, chewing casually, nodding like it's easy. "See? Nothing." The camera stays steady, her friend clearly unimpressed off-camera: "That one's basically ketchup, keep going." 00:10–00:15 — THE SHIFT She moves to the second, spicier bowl. A few bites in, her nodding slows. Her eyes start to water slightly, and she reaches for the water glass "just to wash it down," still trying to act casual. Her voice comes out slightly strained: "It's — it's fine, it's just warm." The camera pushes in slightly, catching the sweat starting to form on her forehead. 00:15–00:20 — LOSING COMPOSURE She hits the hottest bowl. One bite in, her whole face changes — eyes wide, fanning her open mouth with her hand, grabbing for the milk carton and drinking straight from it. She sets it down hard, breathing fast, pointing at the bowl accusingly. "Okay — okay that one's not normal, that's not — " The camera shakes as her friend bursts out laughing off-camera. 00:20–00:25 — FULL MELTDOWN She grabs a napkin, fanning her tongue with her hand while making a pained noise, rocking slightly where she sits. She reaches for the water again, chugs it, immediately regrets that too and grabs the milk back. Her friend, off-camera, barely able to film straight from laughing: "You said you grew up eating spicy?!" She shoots a watery-eyed glare at the camera without being able to respond, still fanning her mouth. 00:25–00:30 — FINAL MOMENT She slumps back against the couch, defeated, milk carton clutched to her chest, face flushed and eyes still watering. She looks at the camera, voice hoarse and pathetic. "...I don't grow up eating spicy. I lied." She weakly gives a thumbs down as the frame shakes with her friend's laughter, and the footage cuts abruptly to black. AUDIO Natural location sound only: Chewing, sniffling, exaggerated exhales and gasps, milk carton opening and gulping sounds, napkin rustling, her friend's genuine off-camera laughter throughout, glass clinking against the table, and handheld camera noise. No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects. Spoken lines: "This is nothing. I grew up eating spicy." / "See? Nothing." / "That one's basically ketchup, keep going." (friend) / "It's — it's fine, it's just warm." / "Okay — okay that one's not normal, that's not —" / "You said you grew up eating spicy?!" (friend) / "...I don't grow up eating spicy. I lied." FINAL FEEL Genuine, escalating physical comedy built entirely on real reactions to real heat — confident denial collapsing into full surrender. Funny, relatable, unscripted-feeling, the kind of video that gets sent straight to a group chat with "lmaooo." No exaggerated acting beyond real spice reactions. No fake toughing-it-out — the comedy comes from how fast and how completely her composure breaks.

•Lighting: Physically accurate natural and practical lighting

Open with a cinematic view of Seoul at dusk. Show N Seoul Tower in the distance, glowing city lights, modern skyscrapers, Korean signs, busy streets, cars, pedestrians, and authentic Seoul atmosphere.

Maintain completely natural facial expressions and realistic walking movement.

She stops at a Korean street-food stall and looks excitedly at freshly prepared tteokbokki or hotteok.

Transition seamlessly to Gyeongbokgung Palace. Show beautiful traditional Korean architecture, palace gates, tiled roofs, detailed wooden structures, and the surrounding evening atmosphere.
Use a smooth cinematic camera movement passing beside her as she looks around in wonder.
15–18 SECONDS — TRADITIONAL MARKET
Continue seamlessly from the palace into a lively traditional Korean market in Seoul during the evening.

entries.title: 90s Sitcom Cat Book Club Scene
entries.description: A humorous 1990s multi-camera sitcom style prompt for Seedance 2.5, featuring a group of cats hosting a book club in a cozy apartment.
entries.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 30-second 1990s multi-camera sitcom scene, 9:16 vertical, shot like genuine 35mm television footage. Bright cosy apartment, warm tungsten lighting, soft even fill, subtle film grain, evening blue dusk outside, authentic sitcom staging and natural audience laughter.

A young man enters his apartment carrying groceries and freezes when he discovers 12 real cats having a “book club.” Cats are naturally scattered across the red sofa, armchair, rug and coffee-table area with open books nearby. His chubby white cat, wearing a backwards burgundy cap, rectangular glasses and red-black plaid flannel, sits proudly in the middle of the sofa. All cats must remain completely realistic four-legged domestic cats; only the white cat speaks, with a posh British accent.

0:00–0:05
Man stares around in disbelief.
MAN: “No. Nope. What is THIS?”
CAT: “Book club.”
MAN: “Book club?!”
CAT: “Every Thursday.”

0:05–0:11
MAN: “There are ELEVEN cats in my living room!”
CAT: “Twelve.”
MAN: “Where’s twelve—?”
Another cat suddenly pokes its head naturally from his grocery bag.
MAN: “OH, COME ON!”

0:11–0:17
Man points at the books.
MAN: “None of you can even READ!”
Dead silence. All cats gradually turn and stare at him naturally.
MAN, suddenly unsure: “…Right?”

0:17–0:22
White cat looks over its glasses.
CAT: “And yet, somehow… you’re still the dumbest one here.”
Huge audience laughter. Man gives the camera an exhausted stare.

0:22–0:27
MAN: “That’s it! Everybody OUT! Book club is OVER!”
CAT: “We took a vote.”
MAN: “And?!”
CAT: “You’re leaving.”

0:27–0:30
Doorbell rings. Man opens the door and finds another real cat sitting outside with a paperback gently held in its mouth.
CAT, from sofa: “Oh good. That’s Margaret.”
Man closes his eyes in defeat. Freeze frame with huge laughter, applause and a short upbeat 90s sitcom ending sting.

Ultra-realistic physical set, natural human acting, genuine cat fur and anatomy, believable physics and imperfect feline movements. No CGI/AI look, anthropomorphic cats, human-like cat gestures, extra limbs, cartoon styling, futuristic elements, dark cinematic grading, subtitles, logos or watermark.

entries.title: 3D-Printed Dragon Transformation Prompt
entries.description: A cinematic sequence prompt where a 3D-printed miniature dragon comes to life and escapes a dark industrial workshop in a single continuous take.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic fantasy sequence in one continuous unbroken take inside a dark professional 3D-printing workshop.

A large industrial resin 3D printer rapidly prints a fierce miniature dragon on its build platform. The dragon has a coherent anatomical design throughout: four muscular legs, two large folded wings, a long armored tail, sharp horns, layered black scales with subtle crimson highlights, amber eyes and a powerful reptilian head. Preserve exactly the same dragon identity, anatomy, scale pattern, horns, wings and proportions from printing to animation.

0–4s: Begin with an extreme macro close-up inside the printer. Show the dragon being formed rapidly from the feet upward in a visually clear accelerated printing process. Thin resin layers build the legs, torso, tail, folded wings, neck, horns and head in the correct physical order. The printer mechanism moves at high speed while remaining mechanically believable. The camera slowly orbits the build platform as the complete solid dragon emerges. At exactly 4 seconds, the printer stops and the finished dragon remains motionless on the platform for a brief beat.

4–7s: The camera pushes close to the dragon's face. Its solid printed surface gradually transforms into living black scales without changing its silhouette or anatomy. Warm amber light ignites inside its eyes. Its chest expands with its first breath, its claws flex against the platform, its tail moves naturally and faint smoke escapes from its nostrils. The transformation spreads smoothly from head to tail with realistic material detail.

7–11s: The dragon raises its head, unfolds both wings to their full span and releases a fierce roar. The force of the wings blows loose resin dust and small workshop papers outward. It crouches, pushes firmly from the build platform and launches into the air with believable weight, muscle movement and aerodynamic wing beats. The printer remains intact behind it.

11–15s: The camera follows the dragon in a fast, smooth tracking move as it flies between workshop equipment toward a large open industrial window. It beats its wings powerfully, exits into the night and climbs above the rooftops. End with a wide cinematic reveal of the living dragon flying toward a moonlit city skyline while the glowing 3D-printing workshop remains visible below. Hold the final composition briefly.

CAMERA AND STYLE: Photorealistic live-action cinematography, dark industrial workshop, dramatic practical lighting, cool blue ambient light mixed with warm red printer lights, extreme macro detail, shallow depth of field, realistic resin translucency, detailed scales, natural motion blur and volumetric dust. Use one continuous camera path: macro orbit, facial push-in, launch tracking and exterior aerial reveal.

Small local grocery shop, apartment buildings with balconies, parked compact cars, scooters, plane trees, tiled sidewalks, recycling bins, and residents returning home from work. No famous landmarks, tourist streets, or staged activity.

She walks down the residential sidewalk carrying an empty canvas tote. She checks a handwritten grocery list while approaching a small neighborhood shop.

entries.title: Laptop Portal to Tropical Garden AR
entries.description: A complex first-person mixed-reality prompt for a video showing a laptop screen opening a portal into a lush tropical garden.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic first-person mixed-reality video, natural window daylight mixed with warm indoor lamp, hanging pothos vines, wooden desk with brown ceramic mug, smartphone, white binders, Lenovo laptop with red-backlit keyboard showing 3D software viewport. Smooth, slightly handheld camera that later becomes more immersive.

0–4s: Over-the-shoulder view of the desk and large window with trees and white building outside. Right hand reaches toward the laptop screen; the display and surrounding space begin to warp. A small dark geometric fragment with blue edges lifts off the screen into real air.

4–10s: Hands pull and stretch a growing irregular black mesh filled with glowing cyan triangular wireframe. The sculpture expands, folds, and floats above the laptop while the camera tilts and orbits. Real room edges start tearing; plants and window frames distort around the digital form. Both hands sculpt and rotate the mesh.

10–16s: The wireframe rapidly enlarges and engulfs the frame. Bright neon-green wireframe hands overlay the real hands. Camera plunges into a dense abstract universe of intersecting blue lines on black. Green skeletal hands reach, grab, and push through the geometry. A tan sneaker briefly materializes inside the mesh.

entries.title: Spooky Hallway CCTV Security Footage
entries.description: A suspenseful CCTV recording prompt where a man's shadow behaves independently, designed for ultra-realistic horror storytelling.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic fixed CCTV security-camera recording inside an ordinary apartment building hallway at night.

The entire video must be ONE CONTINUOUS STATIC SHOT from a ceiling-mounted security camera.

The camera NEVER moves.
No cuts.
No camera shake.
No zoom.
No change of perspective.

The hallway is completely ordinary: beige walls, apartment doors, tiled floor, fluorescent ceiling lights.

A single adult man wearing ordinary casual clothes walks slowly through the hallway.

His shadow is clearly visible on the floor.

IMPORTANT: Keep the man's body, clothing, face, shadow, hallway geometry, lighting and camera position CONSISTENT throughout the entire video.

TIMELINE:

0–10 seconds:
The hallway is empty.

The man enters the frame and casually walks down the hallway.

Everything looks completely normal.

10–15 seconds:
The man stops underneath one of the ceiling lights.

He stands still for a moment.

His shadow is directly beneath and behind him, behaving normally.

15–19 seconds:
The man begins walking forward again.

His body moves normally.

BUT HIS SHADOW DOES NOT MOVE.

The man's shadow remains exactly where it was when he stopped.

The man continues walking several steps away from it.

The shadow stays completely stationary on the floor.

19–23 seconds:
The man suddenly notices something is wrong.

He stops walking.

He slowly turns his head and looks back toward his shadow.

The shadow remains in the exact location where he originally stopped.

23–27 seconds:
The man remains completely still.

His shadow slowly turns its head toward him.

IMPORTANT:
Only the SHADOW moves.
The man's actual body does NOT move.

The shadow's movement must be subtle, slow and physically impossible.

27–30 seconds:
The man takes one small step backward.

The shadow takes one small step FORWARD toward him.

The man freezes.

Abruptly CUT TO BLACK.

REALISM IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN DRAMA.

The footage must initially look like completely authentic boring apartment CCTV.

Use realistic low-quality surveillance footage:
16:9 aspect ratio, fixed wide-angle security camera, mild compression, low-light digital noise, subtle fluorescent lighting, realistic shadows and ordinary colors.

DO NOT use:
glowing shadows,
black smoke,
ghost effects,
distorted humans,
monsters,
floating objects,
melting,
morphing,
extra people,
changing architecture,
camera movement,
cinematic lighting,
dramatic effects,
or exaggerated horror imagery.

The supernatural effect must come ONLY from the shadow behaving independently of the person.

entries.title: Gothic Woman Cat Transformation
entries.description: A dark fantasy cinematic prompt involving a mysterious Gothic woman who transforms into a black cat in a moonlit alley while being recorded.
entries.prompt:
A strikingly beautiful woman wearing casual black Gothic-inspired clothing, layered silver jewelry, ornate rings, a crescent moon pendant, and polished high heels black boots walks confidently down a bustling modern city street at night. entries.title: Slice-of-Life Fantasy Laundry Magic

entries.prompt:
Duration: 15s | 16:9 Landscape | Native 4K UHD | 24fps
Genre: Cinematic Slice-of-Life Fantasy Comedy
Target: Ultra-realistic premium live-action fantasy cinema

REFERENCE LOCK — @image1

Use @image1 as the sole identity reference. Preserve Character A exactly as shown. Exactly one Character A. No redesign, duplication, morphing, identity drift, outfit change, or hairstyle change.

CORE CONCEPT

In an old witch's stone laundry room, Character A notices a black magical cloak hanging from a high wooden beam. Character A tries to pull it down with a wand. The cloak suddenly flies toward Character A, wraps around the entire body, then immediately unwraps itself and lands perfectly over Character A's shoulders as if nothing happened.

SHOT 1 — 0s–4s | HIGH AND ANNOYING

Wide vertical-depth composition inside a rustic stone laundry room.

Character A stands beneath a dark magical cloak hanging from a wooden beam nearly 2 meters above.

Character A reaches upward.

Clearly impossible to reach.

Character A tries stretching once.

Fails.

Character A pauses and stares at the cloak.

Slow camera push-in.

Old washing basin, hanging fabrics and dusty sunlight create realistic environmental detail.

SHOT 2 — 4s–7s | SUMMONING

Character A raises one wand.

Macro close-up of wand grip.

A subtle blue-white glow builds around the tip.

Cut to aligned OTS shot:

WAND TIP → OPEN AIR → CENTER OF CLOAK.

At 6s, a thin magical ray travels directly into the cloak.

Visible contact spark.

Cloak fabric reacts naturally.

For 0.3s it remains completely still.

Then suddenly pulls free.

SHOT 3 — 7s–11s | CLOAK CHAOS

The cloak shoots downward with realistic fabric inertia.

It passes directly over Character A's head.

Character A disappears underneath the fabric for one second.

The cloak twists naturally around the shoulders.

Character A stands completely still.

The fabric settles.

Character A slowly pulls the cloak away from the face.

Deadpan expression.

SHOT 4 — 11s–15s | AT LEAST IT WORKED

Tight three-quarter close-up.

Character A adjusts the cloak collar.

Looks down at it.

Brief exhausted pause.

The cloak suddenly tightens itself perfectly around the shoulders.

Character A gives one tiny annoyed blink.

Then walks out of the laundry room wearing it.

End during movement.

No smile, no camera look, no freeze frame.

AUDIO + MUSIC

Stone-room ambience, cloth movement, wooden creaks, wand ignition, magical hum, fabric rush, soft impact, footsteps.

Music: acoustic guitar, muted piano, pizzicato strings, playful clarinet and brushed percussion.

Music builds during the spell, drops briefly during the cloak rush, then returns softly after the cloak settles.

No dialogue, vocals, boing, circus music, laugh track or meme sounds.

CAUSALITY

CLOAK TOO HIGH → HAND FAILS → WAND RAISES → RAY CONNECTS → CONTACT SPARK → CLOAK RELEASES → CLOAK RUSHES DOWN → WRAPS CHARACTER A → SETTLES → CHARACTER A WEARS IT → EXIT.

entries.title: Cinematic Outdoor Laundry Scene
entries.description: An ultra-realistic video following a woman as she naturally hangs laundry and handles wet fabric in a peaceful residential setting.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic 30-second video featuring a fictional adult woman doing laundry outdoors in a peaceful residential setting.

0–7s: Start with a smooth cinematic medium-wide shot. She stands beside a clothesline and naturally hangs a freshly washed garment, gently stretching and straightening the fabric before securing it. Her movements are graceful, relaxed, and realistic.

7–14s: The camera slowly tracks beside her as she finishes adjusting the garment. She turns toward a nearby bucket containing freshly washed clothes and walks over naturally. A light breeze moves her hair and the hanging laundry.

14–21s: She bends slightly, reaches into the bucket, and takes out another wet garment. Holding it with both hands, she shakes it several times with energetic, natural movements to unfold and straighten it. The wet fabric responds realistically with believable weight, folds, wrinkles, and subtle water droplets.

21–27s: She returns to the clothesline, lifts the garment, spreads it evenly, and hangs it carefully. She smooths the edges with her hands while the fabric settles naturally in the breeze.

27–30s: Finish with a gentle cinematic camera push-in as she steps back and looks at the neatly hanging clothes. The garments sway softly in the wind, creating a calm and realistic ending.

Ultra-realistic fictional character, natural anatomy, realistic skin and hair texture, authentic hand and finger movements, physically accurate cloth simulation, wet fabric detail, subtle water droplets, natural daylight, realistic shadows, cinematic depth of field, smooth tracking camera, gentle handheld realism, natural motion blur, detailed residential environment, immersive ambient sound, photorealistic cinematic quality. No resemblance to any real person or public figure, no exaggerated movements, no unnatural anatomy, no jump cuts.

entries.title: Seoul Autumn Memory MiniDV
entries.description: A nostalgic prompt for a MiniDV camcorder-style video of a young woman walking through a Seoul neighborhood and eating a roasted sweet potato.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic 30-second, 1080p personal home-video, an ordinary autumn afternoon in the life of a young Korean woman, no reference image.

MAIN SUBJECT: early 20s, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, relaxed genuine personality. Dark-brown hair loosely tied back. Oversized cream knit sweater, blue jeans, white sneakers, small canvas shoulder bag. Same face, hair, and outfit held throughout.

SETTING: quiet older Seoul residential neighborhood, cool autumn afternoon. Narrow concrete streets, aging brick houses, fallen leaves, parked bicycles, faded walls, small neighborhood shops. Lived-in and unplanned - no tourist spots, no visible brands.

CAMERA: raw handheld footage from an early-2000s MiniDV camcorder, held by a friend. Autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, awkward zooms, mild tape noise, natural camera-handling imperfections. No stabilization, no gimbal, no cinematic choreography.

BEATS: she leaves home, buys a roasted sweet potato from a street stall, burns her mouth and laughs about it. Keeps walking, notices a bike passing, waves at a dog. A leaf lands on her shoulder - she says Why me? and laughs it off. She sits on a low wall, finishes eating, watches the street in silence for a few seconds -camera just keeps rolling. She stands, walks off, turns back once -Are you coming? - then disappears around the corner as the tape cuts to black.

AUDIO: wind, leaves on pavement, footsteps, bicycle bells, distant scooters, doors closing, subtle camera-handling noise. No music, no narration. Only the two lines above.

STYLE: nothing dramatic happens on purpose. No posing, no exaggerated acting, no cinematic hero shots -realism comes from awkward laughter, imperfect framing, and dead air nobody bothered to cut.

The moment she starts performing for the lens instead of her friend, the whole "found tape" illusion breaks. This one never does.

entries.title: Christian Drama Hill Climb
entries.description: An emotional 30-second sequence of a man struggling to crawl toward a cross at the summit of a rocky hill under storm clouds.
entries.prompt:
30-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic Christian drama, 16:9. A disabled adult man lies on the rough ground at the bottom of a long rocky hill. At the summit stands a large wooden Cross silhouetted against brilliant golden light breaking through storm clouds.

[0–7s] The man looks toward the Cross with tears in his eyes. Unable to stand, he begins struggling to crawl uphill using only his arms and every ounce of strength. His hands grip dirt and stones as he pulls his body forward. AUDIO: strained breathing, quiet groans from physical effort, hands scraping over gravel, clothing dragging across the earth, distant wind.

[7–15s] He keeps dragging himself toward the Cross, exhausted but refusing to stop. His arms tremble, he slips backward slightly, then desperately reaches forward and pulls himself onward. Camera moves low beside him, emphasizing the steep climb and distant Cross. AUDIO: heavier breathing, strained groans from physical effort, gravel shifting beneath him, fabric scraping, wind growing stronger.

[15–24s] Now close to the summit, he is extremely fatigued but determined. Tears run down his face as he reaches toward the Cross and drags himself the final few feet with everything he has. Warm golden sunlight begins breaking through the clouds around him. AUDIO: labored breathing, strained groans from physical effort, scraping earth and stones, swelling emotional orchestral music.

[24–30s] He finally reaches the foot of the Cross. Overcome with emotion, he places one trembling hand against the wood, bows his head and begins to pray silently. Tears fall as brilliant warm sunlight surrounds the Cross and the exhausted man. Camera slowly pulls back, revealing the Cross towering above him against the radiant sky. AUDIO: his breathing gradually calms, soft crying, wind, powerful uplifting orchestral music. No dialogue, no text, no captions.

entries.title: Realistic High-Intensity Urban Chase Scene
entries.description: A prompt for a 30-second cinematic chase sequence with realistic physics, focusing on environmental interactions like crashing into a fruit stand.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic 30-second high-intensity chase scene with natural human motion, realistic physics, dramatic but believable camera work, and detailed environmental interaction.

0–6s: The camera starts in a fast handheld tracking shot from behind, following a man dressed entirely in black as he sprints desperately along a crowded roadside. His breathing is heavy, his posture tense, and his movements show clear panic. A group of people chase him from behind, shouting and running at different speeds. Footsteps, hurried breathing, distant traffic, and crowd reactions create an immersive atmosphere.

6–12s: The camera accelerates and smoothly transitions into a dynamic side-tracking shot, keeping the fleeing man in sharp focus while the background and nearby pedestrians create natural motion blur. His black clothing moves realistically with each stride, his arms pump naturally, and he repeatedly glances back at the approaching crowd with a frightened expression.

12–19s: As he runs past a roadside fruit stand, he suddenly loses control and crashes into it. The wooden stand shakes and collapses realistically as baskets, loose fruit, and small objects fall onto the pavement. Apples, oranges, and other fruit scatter and roll in different directions with accurate weight and momentum. The impact feels spontaneous and physically believable.

19–24s: The man stumbles forward and falls onto the roadside, briefly losing his balance. He immediately pushes himself up with his hands, quickly regains his footing, looks back in panic, and continues sprinting away. His movements remain grounded and physically realistic rather than exaggerated.

24–30s: The camera returns to a fast rear three-quarter tracking angle as he disappears farther down the street. The crowd rushes past the overturned fruit stand, some people stepping around the scattered fruit while others continue the pursuit. Panicked voices, startled reactions, running footsteps, traffic ambience, and realistic street noise fill the scene.

Cinematic visual style, ultra-realistic human anatomy and facial expressions, physically accurate running and collision dynamics, detailed skin and clothing textures, realistic cloth movement, natural daylight with dramatic contrast, shallow depth of field where appropriate, authentic motion blur, subtle handheld camera shake, dynamic tracking shots, realistic lens behavior, detailed roadside environment, immersive cinematic sound design, continuous fluid action, photorealistic quality. No slow motion, no teleportation, no jump cuts, no unnatural body deformation, no cartoonish physics.

entries.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルック。

【敵】黒鉄の軽装剣士一人。橙色の片刃剣一本を扱う。二人の特徴・顔・衣装・武器を混同、交換、複製しない。両者の剣は刀身・鍔・柄がつながった完成品で、持ち手が柄を握って剣全体を動かす。
構造は EVASION → COUNTER → DECISIVE_FINISHER。敵が先に攻撃し、主人公は回避後に反撃し、その後に独立した決定打を放つ。二人の攻防は互いへ向かう。
カメラは攻防と命中を最も格好よく見せる位置へ自由に動き、寄り引き、パン、ドリー、オービット、高低差と構図変化をアクションに合わせて選ぶ。
Cut 1：0.0–3.9秒｜Enemy-first EVASION
黒鉄の敵が先に橙色の片刃剣で主人公へ斬り込む。主人公はその攻撃を見て、レイピアを振るわず、敵刃に触れず体ごと線外へ抜ける。敵剣を空振りさせ、その勢いのまま反撃へ向く。
Cut 2：3.9–4.9秒｜COUNTER

entries.title: Aesthetic Pinterest Fail Vlog
entries.description: Generates a realistic home-video style vlog of a young woman attempting to recreate aesthetic photos, resulting in humorous real-life failures like wind blowing away props or bees interrupting poses.
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video of a young Korean woman trying to recreate a dreamy Pinterest photo, with reality ruining every single attempt. No reference image. **MAIN SUBJECT** Young Korean woman in her early 20s, effortlessly trendy look, soft dewy makeup, expression that shifts between aspirational-serene and increasingly done-with-it. Long black hair styled in soft waves, a flower clip pinning one side back, delicate gold necklace. Wearing a flowy white sundress, a cream cardigan draped over her shoulders, strappy sandals, carrying a small woven picnic basket as a prop. Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and appearance throughout the entire video. **SETTING** A grassy riverside park on a windy, bright afternoon — the kind of spot that looks perfect in a photo and chaotic in person. A picnic blanket laid out unevenly on slightly bumpy grass, a thermos and a plate of fruit balanced precariously, wildflowers scattered nearby, ducks on the water in the background, other picnicking families and joggers occasionally passing through frame, a tree with low branches, and intermittent gusts of wind rolling across the open field. **CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC** Raw personal footage filmed by her friend on a phone, oscillating between attempted "aesthetic" cinematic framing (slow pans, soft golden-hour-style angles) and sudden handheld chaos when things go wrong. Autofocus hunts between her and the fluttering blanket. Camera overcorrects and wobbles when she moves suddenly. Mild motion blur during wind gusts and quick recoveries. Slightly warm, oversaturated "Pinterest filter" color grade that keeps slipping back to flat reality mid-shot. Visible digital noise, natural sun flare that occasionally blows out the frame. No stabilization, no real cinematic polish — the aspiration is aesthetic, the execution is not. --- **00:00–00:05 — THE SETUP SHOT (ATTEMPT)** She kneels gracefully by the picnic blanket, arranging the fruit plate just so, trying to look candidly absorbed in it. The camera does a slow artful pan across the "perfect" spread — then a gust of wind flips the paper plate clean off the blanket. She freezes, hand still hovering mid-air, watching it tumble away. **00:05–00:10 — REACTION** She stares after the plate, deadpan, not even chasing it. "...Okay, we'll pretend that didn't happen." Her friend behind the camera laughs, frame jolting as they try to film both her and the runaway plate at once. **00:10–00:15 — THE FLOWER CROWN MOMENT** She sits back down and tries to casually place a small wildflower behind her ear for a "candid nature" shot, tilting her head serenely toward the light. A bee, clearly interested in the flower, buzzes directly at her face. She yelps, swatting wildly, completely abandoning the serene pose. The camera whip-pans trying to follow the chaos, briefly blurring. **00:15–00:20 — THE WINDBLOWN HAIR SHOT** She stands up to attempt a slow-motion "hair flowing in the wind" walk toward the water, cardigan billowing dramatically behind her. The wind gusts too hard — her hair whips completely across her face, and the cardigan blows up over her head, blinding her mid-step. She stumbles slightly, laughing from underneath the fabric, arms flailing to find the opening. **00:20–00:25 — THE THERMOS DISASTER** She sits back down and tries a "pouring tea thoughtfully" shot, tilting the thermos elegantly — the lid isn't fully on, and it spills straight down the front of her white dress. She looks down at the spreading stain in silence for a beat, completely unbothered by this point. Her friend, off-camera, losing it: "That's — that's going to stain—" **00:25–00:30 — FINAL MOMENT** She gives up entirely, flops backward onto the picnic blanket, stained dress, wind-wrecked hair, flower crooked, staring straight up into the camera as her friend leans over her. "This is the photo. This is the one we're posting." She gives a flat, exhausted thumbs up from the ground as the frame shakes with her friend's laughter, and the footage cuts abruptly to black. --- **AUDIO** Natural location sound only: Wind gusting, fabric flapping, birds and distant duck sounds, grass rustling, thermos lid clattering, tea splashing, her friend's genuine off-camera laughter throughout, footsteps on grass, and handheld camera noise. No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects. Spoken lines: "...Okay, we'll pretend that didn't happen." / "That's — that's going to stain—" (friend) / "This is the photo. This is the one we're posting." **FINAL FEEL** Bright, breezy, self-aware comedy built on the universal gap between a curated Pinterest fantasy and messy outdoor reality — golden light, real wind, real mishaps, real laughter. No posed perfection sustained for more than a few seconds before nature ruins it. No exaggerated slapstick — the comedy comes from genuine reactions to genuinely uncooperative wind, bees, and gravity.

entries.title: Balcony Collapse Home Video
entries.description: A chaotic prompt for a handheld phone video showing a man in a kiddie pool on a balcony that eventually cracks and collapses.
entries.prompt:
RAW HOME PHONE VIDEO. One continuous 30-second clip recorded on a current smartphone from a facing balcony. Amateur handheld, natural micro-shake, occasional clumsy pinch-zooms in and out. No film look, no cinematic grade, no grain recipe. Overcast gray daylight, peeling block facade, rust, smoke, wet concrete, cheap plastic. Trash metal blasting from the black speaker. Feels like a neighbor filmed it.

Characters
A big bald man with beard and mullet, balcony, grill, Jack Daniel's tap, blue inflatable pool, rubber ducks, speaker, railing and building. Man with receding hair with long sides, gold chain, black SLAYER tank, belly and seated posture.

TIMELINE
0-10s: [Handheld phone wide] The man sits dead-calm in the tiny blue kiddie pool, cigarette in his right hand, living like a king. Serious, unhurried, enjoying. Trash metal pounds. With his free left hand he reaches to the smoking grill, picks up a sausage, smells it, then puts it back exactly where it was. Steam rolls. The phone slowly zooms toward his face, then clumsily zooms back out. He never stands.

10-20s: [Handheld, lazy zoom] His large wife in a floral dress steps out the open door with an empty glass. She fills it from the Jack Daniel's tap with apple juice the same amber color as whiskey, and hands it to him. He takes a long swallow without getting up. She hikes the dress and climbs into the cramped pool with him. They splash. Ducks bob. He stays seated, still smoking, still unbothered. Camera wobbles in on the pour, then out to both of them.

20-30s: [Handheld widening, more shake as it gets worse] A black cat walks out the door and crosses the rusty railing. Only after the cat passes along the railing does the terrace start to crack: hairline fractures spread through the slab. The balcony slowly sags. The inflatable pool tilts; water sloshes over the rim. The couple slide with the tipping pool. The cat jumps out of frame. Concrete splits, railing twists, grill and speaker shift. The terrace gives way and they fall with the water as the clip ends.

AUDIO
Loud trash metal from the speaker the entire time. Grill sizzle, tap pour, splash, groaning metal, cracking concrete, rushing water. Distant courtyard noise. No dialogue. No extra score. No cinematic sound design.

STYLE & QUALITY
Looks like a real phone video from today: auto exposure, slightly crushed highlights, ordinary digital noise, real weight and water physics, wet skin and fabric, collapsing structure with coherent debris.

[16–22s] Cinematic slow-motion crossover. Sharp weight shift and direction change with believable ball inertia. Defender reacts slightly late. Detailed footwork and natural movement.

[22–30s] Player drives into a layup. Camera rises with the jump. Ball leaves fingertips with realistic backspin, banks off the glass, drops through the hoop, and the net sways naturally.

STYLE: ULTRA-REALISTIC, photorealistic sports cinematography, premium commercial quality, authentic physics, natural biomechanics, cinematic lighting, realistic textures, smooth camera transitions, high temporal consistency, 4K detail.

NO warped anatomy, floating ball, sliding feet, unnatural motion, inconsistent player, excessive camera shake.
