entries.prompt: AFTER THE LAST SHOW Duration: Exactly 20.0 seconds Aspect ratio: 21:9 Photorealistic live action, restrained auteur drama, premium production design, intimate, nocturnal and melancholic. REFERENCE [Image 1] is the uploaded character sheet and the exact male lead reference. Preserve the identical face, age, messy dark wavy hair, light stubble, lean proportions, skin tone and wardrobe in every shot: faded bottle-green rolled-sleeve shirt, charcoal trousers and black leather shoes. No identity or costume drift. PERFORMANCE Quiet, emotionally tired, introspective and slightly restless. Extremely naturalistic acting. No model posing, exaggerated sadness, hero gestures or direct looks into the camera. Show the performance through tiny eye movements, breathing, unconscious hand gestures and pauses. ENVIRONMENT An old single-screen cinema after midnight. Empty muted-red seats, dark aged wood, worn walls, visible dust in the projector beam, a narrow side corridor and a glass fire-exit door. Outside, the rain has just stopped. The pavement is wet and black, with sparse distant city lights and cold humid air. The entire film takes place during one continuous night. Keep the geography logical: auditorium to aisle to corridor to exit to exterior to glass door to corridor to auditorium to screen. Never teleport the character. Motivate every cut through movement, gaze, sound or light. CAMERA ARRI Alexa 65 cinematic feel with premium anamorphic glass. Use 100mm for intimate face shots, 65 to 85mm for profile shots, 40mm for movement and 24mm for architectural wides. Organic highlight roll-off, rich shadow detail, subtle film grain, realistic skin and dimensional depth. Use subtle handheld breathing, controlled drift and gentle tracking. No robotic gimbal movement, random orbit, drone shots or flashy camera movement. COLOR AND LIGHT Deep inky blacks, petroleum-teal and cyan shadows, natural skin, muted dark-red seats, pale projector highlights and a tiny amber lighter flame. Projector light is the recurring visual motif. No neon, heavy bloom, aggressive teal and orange grading or oversaturation. AUDIO Generate an original auteur-film score, not a conventional song. Late-night melancholic art-pop with subtle vintage Indian lounge jazz and restrained downtempo trip-hop at approximately 74 BPM. Use sparse detuned piano, warm analog bass, faint tremolo guitar, extremely restrained brushed percussion, subtle tape texture and a distant wordless vocal atmosphere. No lyrics, chorus, pop hook, EDM, trap, trailer music or obvious Bollywood melody. Native sound effects: projector mechanism, room tone, footsteps, seat creak, ticket paper, door hinge, wet-road ambience, raindrops, lighter wheel and ignition, inhale and soft exhale. Keep physical sounds realistic and audible beneath the music. SHOT 01, 0.0 TO 2.3 SECONDS Extreme close-up, 100mm. The lead's eyes and upper face. Pale projector flicker crosses his skin. He looks slightly downward, lost in thought. Tiny handheld breathing. Sparse piano and projector hum. His eyes shift toward the auditorium, motivating the cut. SHOT 02, 2.3 TO 5.0 SECONDS 24mm wide backward tracking shot through the vast empty auditorium. He walks slowly down the center aisle while his fingertips casually graze one red seat. The projector beam and floating dust remain behind him. The bass enters subtly. His gaze drops toward the floor. SHOT 03, 5.0 TO 7.4 SECONDS 40mm flowing low-to-medium shot, not rapid inserts. The camera lowers as he notices an old ticket near his shoe. He bends, picks it up and rises with the camera. He studies it for one quiet beat, folds it, pockets it and continues toward the corridor. The paper rustle is audible. SHOT 04, 7.4 TO 9.3 SECONDS 40mm rear follow through the narrow corridor toward the glass exit door. The auditorium remains briefly visible behind him. The light becomes colder. He pushes the door open. Wet-street ambience begins before the exterior as an audio bridge. SHOT 05, 9.3 TO 12.2 SECONDS 65mm exterior profile in one continuous smoking observation. Under the covered exit, with wet pavement behind him, he naturally places a cigarette, shields the lighter, ignites it and briefly warms his face, then takes one restrained drag. The camera makes an almost imperceptible lateral move. Keep the smoke small and natural. The music strips back while the lighter, inhale, exhale and distant traffic move to the foreground. His eyes shift toward the glass door. SHOT 06, 12.2 TO 14.7 SECONDS 50mm through rain-speckled glass. His reflection overlaps the empty auditorium. Faint smoke crosses the reflection. The projector quietly restarts behind the glass: mechanical movement, pale flicker, then a beam through dust. No dramatic flash. His eyes react first, then his head slowly turns. Match the turn into the next shot. SHOT 07, 14.7 TO 17.7 SECONDS 35 to 40mm subtle handheld follow as he calmly re-enters and walks through the corridor toward the auditorium. No running. The projector grows louder and brighter ahead. A tiny bass pulse returns. Maintain continuous directional movement. SHOT 08, 17.7 TO 20.0 SECONDS 24mm static extreme wide. The enormous blank screen dominates the frame while the lead stands tiny at the lower center. A luminous projector beam cuts through the dust behind him. He does nothing except take one natural breath. Remove percussion. End on an unresolved piano and tremolo-guitar chord with the projector mechanism. Hard cut to black at exactly 20.0 seconds. No title or text. GLOBAL Maintain continuous visual, spatial and editorial logic throughout. Preserve the exact lead, wardrobe, cinema geography, projector position, lighting logic and screen direction. No extra people, face morphing, random props, dialogue, subtitles, title cards, speed ramps, excessive slow motion, glamour posing, huge smoke, lens-flare gimmicks or cheap rapid cuts. Prioritize restraint, continuity, atmosphere and emotionally motivated filmmaking. Note: Replace [Image 1] with your own character reference.

entries.prompt:
真实手机第一视角恶作剧短视频。

现代写字楼电梯＋长走廊实拍质感。

全程自然手机手持拍摄，保留轻微手持晃动、正常行走产生的小幅起伏、手机自动对焦、数码变焦和快速甩镜产生的真实运动模糊。

纯真人实拍。

无电影广告质感。

【时长与画幅】

约 14 秒。

9:16 竖屏。

【场景】

深夜现代写字楼公共区域。

一部电梯停在当前楼层，电梯门已经完全打开。

电梯外连接一条笔直、纵深很长的写字楼走廊。

环境包括：

浅灰色光滑石材地面、银灰色金属电梯门、平整窄金属门槛、浅灰墙面、冷白色顶灯、方形立柱、远处长走廊。

电梯内部地面与外部走廊地面基本齐平。

整个区域保持无人状态。

除女主和第一视角摄影者外，不出现其他可辨识人物。

【女主】

严格保持同一个女主。

全程保持相同：

脸型、五官、发型、服装、肤色、身材比例和人物身份。

女主右脚始终穿着一只黑色皮鞋。

女主左脚没有穿鞋，只穿黑色及膝袜。

另一只属于左脚的黑色皮鞋最开始放在电梯内部靠近门口的地面。

女主右手拿着手机。

【开场】

手机第一视角拍摄女主完整身体。

女主站在已经打开的电梯入口一侧。

身体自然轻靠在电梯门口旁边。

女主低头看右手里的手机。

右脚穿黑色皮鞋并踩在地面。

左脚没有穿鞋，只穿黑色及膝袜。

脱下的左脚黑色皮鞋放在电梯内部靠近门口的地面。

【第一次踢鞋】

手机镜头自然向下移动，对准脱下的左脚黑色皮鞋。

摄影者穿白色运动鞋的一只脚从画面下方进入。

白色运动鞋轻轻踢中黑色皮鞋。

必须清楚看到两只鞋发生真实接触。

黑色皮鞋受到推动后贴着地面向前滑动。

黑色皮鞋滑过平整的电梯门槛，进入电梯外的走廊地面。

【第二次踢鞋】

摄影者保持正常步行速度向前走。

不奔跑。

不追赶鞋子。

手机保持自然向下拍摄。

脱下的左脚黑色皮鞋沿光滑石材地面继续滑动，并自然减速。

摄影者走到鞋子附近。

白色运动鞋第二次轻轻踢中黑色皮鞋。

必须再次清楚看到真实接触。

黑色皮鞋再次贴着地面向前滑动。

全片只有两次踢鞋。

第二次踢完以后，镜头立即离开鞋子。

之后不再拍摄脱下的左脚黑色皮鞋。

【第一次隐藏剪辑】

第二次踢鞋结束后，手机立即从地面向前上方快速甩起。

快速甩镜产生强烈整屏运动模糊。

在画面完全模糊的瞬间完成第一次隐藏剪辑。

甩镜结束后：

女主已经站在长走廊远处中央。

摄影者没有看到女主移动的过程。

【远处女主树式姿势｜核心重点】

女主位于长走廊远处中央。

正面面对摄影者。

女主保持非常清楚的单腿树式姿势。

右腿竖直承重。

右脚穿黑色皮鞋，并稳稳踩在地面。

左腿抬起。

左膝向身体左侧明显打开并弯曲。

左脚没有穿鞋，只穿黑色及膝袜。

左脚向身体内侧收起。

左脚贴在右膝内侧附近。

左脚始终悬空，不接触地面。

上半身保持直立。

右手拿着手机自然垂在身体右侧。

左臂自然垂下。

头部正对摄影者。

女主保持这个树式姿势不变。

不换腿。

不落下左脚。

不双脚站立。

不跳动。

不向摄影者走动。

从女主第一次出现在远处开始，直到第二次隐藏剪辑之前：

女主始终保持完全相同的树式姿势。

【手机数码变焦】

摄影者站在原地。

女主站在远处保持树式姿势。

手机快速数码变焦拉近女主。

拉近后清楚看到：

女主完整身体、右脚黑色皮鞋、左脚黑色及膝袜和完整树式姿势。

短暂停留。

随后手机快速数码变焦拉远。

女主重新恢复到走廊远处的完整全身构图。

整个过程中：

摄影者位置不变。

女主位置不变。

女主树式姿势不变。

只有手机焦距发生变化。

【第二次隐藏剪辑】

数码变焦恢复远景后：

镜头快速甩向右侧。

女主暂时离开画面。

镜头立即甩回。

再次短暂看到远处仍然保持树式姿势的女主。

随后镜头再次快速甩向右下方。

走廊地面和强烈运动模糊占满整个画面。

在整屏完全模糊的瞬间完成第二次隐藏剪辑。

镜头重新抬起时：

女主已经站在摄影者旁边。

不能展示女主从远处移动过来的过程。

【结尾】

女主近距离站在摄影者旁边。

女主直视镜头。

随后主动快速靠近手机镜头。

人物从近景进入面部极近特写。

女主自然轻轻嘟嘴。

脸部靠近镜头后闭上眼睛。

形成即将亲吻镜头的视觉效果。

随后女主自然向后退回正常近景。

重新睁开眼睛。

轻微侧头看向镜头。

视频结束。

这一段人物大小变化只能来自：

女主主动靠近镜头，再主动退回。

不能使用数码变焦代替。

【隐藏剪辑规则】

全片只有两次隐藏剪辑。

第一次隐藏剪辑：

第二次踢鞋后甩镜 → 整屏运动模糊 → 女主出现在长走廊远处。

第二次隐藏剪辑：

远处女主 → 甩向右下方 → 整屏运动模糊 → 女主出现在摄影者旁边。

两次剪辑只能发生在整屏完全模糊的瞬间。

剪辑前后的手机运动方向、速度和晃动保持连续。

禁止：

闪白、黑场、溶解、淡入淡出、特效转场、清晰画面中的明显硬切。

【环境声音】

全程无音乐。

无背景配乐。

无旁白。

只保留真实同步声音：

写字楼环境底噪、电梯设备轻微运行声、摄影者正常行走脚步声、白色运动鞋踢中黑色皮鞋的碰撞声、黑色皮鞋滑过石材地面的摩擦声、衣物摩擦声、轻微呼吸声、快速甩镜产生的自然风噪。

不要卡通音效。

不要人工转场音效。

不要亲吻音效。
entries.translated_prompt:
Real mobile phone POV prank short video.

Modern office elevator + long corridor handheld footage texture.

Natural handheld shooting throughout, retaining slight shake, walking gait, autofocus, digital zoom, and motion blur from fast whip pans.

Pure real-person live action. No commercial cinematic feel.

[Duration & Aspect Ratio]
Approx 14 seconds, 9:16 vertical.

[Scene]
Late night modern office building. Elevator door open, connecting to a long hallway. Grey stone floor, metal doors, cold white lights. No other people.

[Female Protagonist]
Maintain character consistency. Wearing black pumps on right foot, only black knee-high sock on left foot. The other black pump is on the elevator floor. Holding a phone in right hand.

[Opening]
POV shot of the girl leaning by the elevator door, looking at her phone.

[First Shoe Kick]
Camera tilts down. Shooter's white sneaker enters from bottom and kicks the black pump on the floor, sliding it into the hallway.

[Second Shoe Kick]
Shooter walks forward, kicks the shoe again as it slows down. Only two kicks total.

[First Hidden Cut]
After second kick, camera whips up quickly creating full-screen blur. During blur, perform a hidden cut. After blur, girl is now standing far down the corridor.

[Tree Pose]
Girl is far away, facing the camera in a single-leg tree pose (right leg weight-bearing, left knee out, left foot against right knee, suspended). Maintains this pose without moving.

[Digital Zoom]
Shooter stays put. Phone zooms in on girl in tree pose, then zooms back out to full-body far shot.

[Second Hidden Cut]
Whip pan right then back, then whip pan right-down to floor blur. Hidden cut performed. Camera raises to show girl now standing next to shooter.

[Ending]
Girl looks at camera, leans in for a close-up pouting/kissing motion, closes eyes, then pulls back, opens eyes, and smiles/looks away. Video ends.

[Rules]
No black frames or dissolves. Cuts must be during whip-pan blur. Sync handheld motion. Natural ambient sound only (walking, shoe sliding, breathing, wind noise).

entries.title: Dark Fantasy Wuxia Action Trailer
entries.description: A 30-second cinematic fantasy action trailer featuring a warrior battling a colossal demon in an ancient Chinese village at night.
entries.prompt:
A cinematic fantasy action trailer, 30 seconds, night setting, ancient Chinese village.

Open on a symmetrical wide shot down a stone-paved village path at night, thatched-roof walls lined with moss on either side. A colossal demon materializes from billowing black smoke at the end of the path — massive curved horns, a skeletal snarling face, hollow eyes, jagged teeth, two clawed hands reaching forward. (0:00–0:05)

Cut to a low dynamic tracking shot: a cloaked warrior launches a flying slash attack, his glowing blade trailing a long streak of fire through the air, sparks and embers scattering, motion-blurred cape whipping behind him. (0:05–0:10)

Cut to a wide static shot of a stone courtyard as fire and smoke erupt where the warrior lands, his silhouette visible inside the blast. A glowing golden ritual circle burns into the ground beneath him, radiating concentric light outward as smoke billows into the black sky. (0:10–0:15)

Cut to a fast tracking shot following the warrior from behind as he sprints past a thatched wall, a trail of yellow-gold sparks streaking off his cloak, camera shaking with the velocity, dusk-blue tones mixed with warm ember light. (0:15–0:20)

Cut to a low-angle symmetrical shot: the warrior stands with his back to camera in the center of the path, both hands raised overhead gripping a glowing golden blade pointed skyward. A massive circular glyph ignites above the blade tip like a solar seal, wind whipping his robe outward. (0:20–0:25)

Close on his back as he throws both arms open, splitting the frame in two: one side erupts into a churning wall of orange fire, the other blooms into a swirling purple-blue-green cosmic nebula, the golden blade-beam still firing straight up between them. (0:25–0:28)

End on the empty, misty stone path as dust and light settle into silence. (0:28–0:30)

Style: dark cinematic fantasy, high contrast lighting, volumetric smoke and particles, dramatic color grading (deep blacks, fire-orange, cosmic purple), motion blur on fast action, epic scale, wuxia trailer aesthetic.

entries.title: Behind the Door Horror Creature
entries.description: A chilling cinematic horror prompt for a late-night bedroom scene where a woman encounters a tall, elongated monster behind a door.
entries.prompt:
Behind the Door Monster Cinematic Horror ultra-photorealistic cinematic horror scene inside a quiet house late at night. A young woman is alone in her bedroom, wearing simple realistic sleepwear. The room is dimly illuminated by a single warm bedside lamp, while the hallway outside is almost completely dark.
She suddenly hears slow, heavy footsteps coming from the corridor outside her bedroom. She freezes and listens carefully. The footsteps stop directly outside her door.
She slowly walks toward the bedroom door and cautiously opens it.
The corridor is completely empty.
She looks left, then right. Nothing is there. The house is silent.
She slowly steps into the hallway, confused and frightened. After a moment, she turns around toward her bedroom.
Standing directly behind the partially open door is a tall, terrifying humanoid monster, almost completely hidden in the darkness. Its body is unnaturally thin and elongated, with extremely long arms hanging almost to the floor. Its skin looks pale and slightly wet, its face partially obscured by shadow, with deep dark eyes staring silently at her.
The woman freezes.
The monster suddenly leans its head around the doorframe, revealing its distorted face. It remains completely still for one tense moment.
Then it suddenly lunges toward her.
She screams and runs down the corridor as the bedroom door violently swings open behind her. The monster follows with fast, unnatural movements, its long limbs striking the walls as it crawls and runs toward her.
The camera shakes with realistic handheld movement as she desperately tries to escape.
Final shot: the hallway is empty again. The bedroom door slowly closes by itself. From behind the closed door, two faint eyes appear in the darkness.
Cut to black
Ultra-photorealistic live-action horror, realistic human proportions, believable monster anatomy, practical low-light lighting, deep shadows, cinematic suspense, realistic handheld camera movement, natural skin and fabric textures, atmospheric darkness, disturbing creature design, fast unnatural movement, non-gory horror, no blood, no cartoon style, no fantasy environment, no subtitles, no text overlays.

entries.title: Emotional Female Monologue Performance
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for a 20-second cinematic monologue focusing on subtle facial micro-expressions and complex emotional transitions.
entries.prompt:
参考上传人物图片生成一段约20秒的电影感人物独白视频。人物必须严格以参考图中的成年女性为唯一人物参考，完整保持她的五官、脸型、肤色、黑色长卷发、红唇妆容、黑色单肩礼服、珍珠项链以及整体复古贵气造型，不改变人物身份，不更换发型和服装，不生成其他女性，不要AI网红脸，不要五官漂移。

场景也尽量延续参考图的复古室内氛围：人物坐在复古沙发上，右侧保留暖黄色复古台灯，背景昏暗、安静、低饱和，暖棕色与暗金色调。整体像老电影中的深夜独白，画面高级、克制、安静。镜头以人物脸部和上半身为核心，浅景深，轻微胶片颗粒，柔和侧光打在脸上。

人物的核心状态不是悲伤痛哭，也不是愤怒控诉，而是经历过很多事情以后真正“看淡了”的感觉：疲惫、清醒、从容、略带自嘲，但内心仍然坚定。表情尤其重要，要通过眼神、呼吸、慢眨眼、嘴角细微变化表现情绪。像一个曾经认真爱过、失望过，现在已经不想解释，也不再争辩的人。

人物使用自然普通话，缓慢、有感情地念出以下内容：

“我过去，现在，未来，都不会为钱出卖我的爱情，更不会出卖我的灵魂。

我依然相信爱情，我依然眼光不行，我依然智慧欠奉。

但我相信法律，相信善良，相信终究会有的正义和公平。

时间会证明一切。”

0-3秒：
保持参考图中的坐姿和人物造型。开场先安静约0.5秒，没有马上讲话。人物视线没有直视镜头，而是轻轻看向前方偏下的位置，像是在想起过去的事情。轻轻吸气，然后缓慢抬眼。
开始说：“我过去，现在，未来，都不会为钱出卖我的爱情……”

“过去、现在、未来”之间稍微留一点停顿。

表情非常平静，眼神里有疲惫，但没有委屈，没有控诉。说到“爱情”时，目光短暂移开，像是不愿再回忆太多。

3-6秒：
继续缓慢说：

“更不会出卖我的灵魂。”
说到“更不会”时重新抬眼直视镜头。

“灵魂”两个字明显放慢一点，说完停顿约0.5秒。

人物嘴角轻轻抿一下，眼神稳定而坚定。不要皱眉，不要咬牙，不要激动，而是一种“这件事情我早就想清楚了”的状态。

说完后视线轻轻移向旁边，缓慢眨一次眼。

6-10秒：
说：

“我依然相信爱情，我依然眼光不行，我依然智慧欠奉。”

这是整段最重要的微表情段落。
说“我依然相信爱情”时，眼神短暂变柔，嘴角非常轻微上扬，像是心里依旧保留着一点温柔。

说“我依然眼光不行”时，人物轻轻低头，嘴角出现非常淡的苦笑，像是在笑自己。

说“我依然智慧欠奉”时，轻轻呼出一口气，眼神微微向下，带着一点自嘲和无奈。

这里不要哭。

不要表现成受害者。

更像是在坦然承认：“可能我确实看错过人。”

10-15秒：
人物慢慢重新抬头看向镜头，说：

“但我相信法律，相信善良，相信终究会有的正义和公平。”

从“但我相信”开始，人物情绪从无奈慢慢转为平静而坚定。

说“法律”时，眼神稳定。
说“善良”时，表情稍微柔和。

说到“正义和公平”时持续直视镜头，声音不需要变大，但语气比前面更加确定。

不要演成宣言。

不要激昂。

而是一种经历很多之后依然选择相信这些东西的坚定。

眼神传递的是：

“我已经不想争了。”

“结果交给时间。”

15-20秒：
说最后一句：

“时间会证明一切。”

说“时间”之前停顿约0.8秒。

人物先看着镜头，然后非常缓慢地说：

“时间……会证明一切。”
每个字都比前面稍慢。

说完之后不要马上切镜。

保持沉默约1.5秒。

人物继续看着镜头几秒，随后缓慢眨一次眼，眼神逐渐从锐利变得柔和。

嘴角出现一丝几乎看不出来的释然浅笑。

最后视线缓慢移向远处，不再看镜头。

非常轻地呼出一口气。

镜头极缓慢后退。

人物安静坐在沙发上，暖黄色台灯依旧亮着。

最后自然淡出。

声音要求：
成年女性普通话，自然、真实、偏低声线，语速偏慢，声音轻柔但清晰。不要播音腔，不要朗诵，不要电视剧式哭腔。声音可以略带一点疲惫 and 轻微沙哑感，像深夜一个人平静地说出心里话。

情绪曲线：
开始：平静、疲惫
中间：温柔 → 自嘲 → 无奈
后段：清醒、坚定
结尾：释然、看淡

表情要求：
表情必须极其细腻自然。大量使用眼神变化而不是大幅面部动作。偶尔缓慢眨眼、轻轻抿嘴、短暂移开视线、极浅的苦笑、轻微呼气。不要流泪，不要红眼，不要歇斯底里，不要皱眉控诉，不要明显悲伤。

最重要的感觉是：

她不是原谅了谁，也不是还在等待谁。

只是经历过以后，已经不再执着于解释。
有一种“该说的我已经说完，剩下的交给时间”的平静。

画面要求：
严格保持参考人物的一致性，五官稳定，脸型稳定，发型稳定，珍珠项链稳定，黑色单肩礼服稳定。保留复古沙发和右侧暖黄色台灯。电影级写实质感，浅景深，暖棕暗金色调，低饱和，柔和侧光，真实皮肤纹理，轻微胶片颗粒。
镜头运动极慢，以固定镜头、非常轻微推近和最后缓慢拉远为主。不要频繁切镜，不要夸张运镜，不要大幅肢体动作。
避免：五官漂移、换脸、发型改变、服装改变、项链消失、手指畸形、嘴型与台词不同步、表情抽搐、过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、AI网红脸、夸张哭戏、舞台朗诵感。

Like someone who has loved and been disappointed, and now no longer wishes to explain or argue.

Natural Mandarin monologue: 'In the past, now, and the future, I will not sell my love for money, let alone my soul. I still believe in love, I still have poor judgment, I still lack wisdom. But I believe in the law, in kindness, and in the justice and fairness that will eventually come. Time will prove everything.'

0-3s: Quiet for 0.5s. Looking down and forward, remembering. Inhale slightly, raise eyes slowly. Start: 'In the past, now, and the future...' Pauses between timeframes. Calm expression, tired eyes.

3-6s: Continue: 'let alone my soul.' Look directly at camera on 'let alone'. Slow down on 'soul', pause 0.5s. Slight lip purse, steady gaze. No frowning or excitement.

6-10s: 'I still believe in love, I still have poor judgment, I still lack wisdom.' Soften eyes on 'love', slight smile. Lower head and bitter smile on 'poor judgment'. Exhale and look down on 'lack wisdom'. No crying. Acknowledging mistakes.

10-15s: Raise head to camera: 'But I believe in the law, in kindness...' Transition to firm state. Steady gaze on 'law', soften on 'kindness'. Direct gaze on 'justice and fairness'. Not a declaration, but a choice after hardship.

15-20s: Final sentence: 'Time... will prove everything.' Pause 0.8s before 'Time'. Speak slowly. Keep frame for 1.5s silence. Slow blink, eyes soften. Tiny smile of relief. Look away. Exhale. Slow zoom out to fade out.

Audio: Adult female, natural, low pitch, slow pace. No broadcasting style or exaggerated drama. Slightly tired/raspy voice.

Visuals: Strict consistency of features, clothing, and accessories. Cinematic realistic texture. Slow camera movement. Avoid: feature drifting, face swapping, inconsistent necklace, desynced mouth movements.

entries.title: Autumn Afternoon Asian Woman Vlog
entries.description: A 30-second vlog-style prompt capturing an ordinary autumn afternoon in a southern city, using a consumer DV camcorder aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary autumn afternoon in the life of a young Asian woman. No reference image.

MAIN SUBJECT

Young Asian woman in her mid-20s, naturally pretty, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, warm and gentle personality.

Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions and overall appearance throughout the entire video.

SETTING

A quiet old residential neighborhood in a southern city during a cool autumn afternoon. Tree-lined streets, mossy stone steps, old brick walls, bamboo drying poles, potted orchids, a small neighborhood convenience store with a striped awning, rusty bicycles parked against walls, fallen yellow leaves scattered on the pavement, and golden afternoon sunlight filtering through ginkgo trees.

Everything should feel lived-in, ordinary and peaceful. No tourist attractions, advertisements, recognizable brands or commercial activity.

CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC

Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder.

Strong handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, occasional motion blur, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild noise, accidental zooms and natural camera imperfections.

No stabilization, drone footage, gimbal movement, dramatic lighting or polished commercial cinematography.

LEAVING THE APARTMENT

She steps out of an old walk-up apartment building, carrying a small canvas tote bag. She pulls the iron gate shut, adjusts her sweater sleeves, and looks toward the camera with a gentle smile.

A cool autumn breeze lifts a few strands of her hair as she starts walking down the leafy street.

CONVENIENCE STORE STOP

She reaches a tiny neighborhood convenience store and buys a warm bottle of roasted oolong tea.

She steps outside, takes her first sip, and immediately closes her eyes with a satisfied expression because it warms her up.

She notices her friend filming and holds the bottle toward the camera with a playful toast gesture before taking another sip.

WALKING THROUGH THE NEIGHBORHOOD

She continues down the tree-lined street while holding her tea.

An elderly neighbor passes by on an old bicycle, ringing his bell. She steps aside, waves politely, and chuckles softly.

She pauses to look at a stray orange cat sleeping on a stone wall, but doesn't wake it.

SMALL ACCIDENT

She walks beneath a large ginkgo tree when a few yellow leaves drift down onto her head.

She stops, looks up confused, then realizes what happened and lets out a light laugh.

She shakes the leaves from her hair while her friend zooms awkwardly toward her face.

She looks directly into the camera with an amused expression and says:

"Are you filming this?"

QUIET MOMENT

She reaches a low stone bench beside an old banyan tree and sits down for a moment.

He enters a small neighborhood shop and looks through the shelves. He picks up a bottled drink and a simple snack, pays, and steps outside. The bright indoor light briefly causes the camera exposure to adjust.
TURN — 0:12–0:18
He sits on a low wall outside the shop and opens his snack. A stray cat appears nearby. He notices it, breaks off a tiny piece of food, and places it on the ground. The cat approaches cautiously. He smiles quietly.
SUSTAIN — 0:18–0:25
He continues walking home. The street is almost empty. He passes parked bicycles and apartment entrances. He stops beneath a streetlight, takes a drink, looks up at the night sky for a moment, then continues walking.
CLOSE — 0:25–0:30
He reaches his apartment entrance. Before going inside, he turns toward the camera and says, “I’m going to sleep.”
He gives a small tired smile, opens the door, and disappears inside. The camera remains outside for a few seconds before the recording cuts to black.
NEGATIVE:
No modern smartphones, recognizable brands, advertisements, logos, famous people, copyrighted characters,

entries.title: Cyberpunk Found-Footage Street Scene
entries.description: A found-footage style video prompt featuring a young woman walking through a rainy, lived-in cyberpunk megacity residential street.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal found-footage video showing an ordinary rainy evening in the life of a young woman in a dense cyberpunk megacity. No reference image.

MAIN SUBJECT

Young woman in her mid-20s, mixed heritage, naturally pretty, realistic skin texture, tired-but-content expression, minimal makeup. A thin faded scar through one eyebrow and a small dermal port behind her left ear with a dim amber standby light — old tech, scuffed, nothing flashy.

Short choppy black hair with grown-out teal ends, damp from the rain, tucked behind one ear. Wearing a cropped charcoal thermal top, an oversized translucent rain poncho with a peeling logo, loose cargo pants with taped-up cuffs, worn high-top sneakers, and a cheap braided cable worn as a necklace.

Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, dermal port and overall appearance throughout the entire video.

SETTING

A cramped lower-level residential street in a vertical megacity at night, light rain falling. Narrow wet walkways, stacked micro-apartments with mismatched retrofit doors, tangled power conduits and coolant pipes running overhead, laundry hanging between fire escapes, potted plants under grow-strips, parked delivery mopeds, a humming transformer box, and a tiny family-run noodle stall with a flickering hand-painted sign and steam pouring into the rain.

Neon and holo-signage exists but stays in the background — reflected in puddles, glowing through steam, partially broken, in an invented script. Everything feels lived-in, worn, ordinary and peaceful. Street-level poverty-adjacent but safe and homey. No recognizable brands, no readable real-world text, no violence, no crowds of extras posing.

CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC

Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend walking behind her on a cheap consumer handheld recorder. Over-the-shoulder following distance of two to three meters for most of the video.

Strong handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting on the neon reflections, exposure blowing out when signs pass through frame, occasional motion blur, mild sensor noise in the shadows, rain drops occasionally hitting the lens, accidental zooms and natural camera imperfections.

No stabilization, drone footage, gimbal movement, dramatic lighting cues or polished commercial cinematography. The city lights ARE the lighting.

— LEAVING THE BLOCK

She steps out of a narrow retrofit apartment door onto the wet walkway, pulls her poncho hood half-up, and palms the door lock, which chirps and glows green. She glances back at the camera with a relaxed smile and a small eye-roll at being filmed, then starts walking. Steam from a vent drifts across the lane as she passes through it.

— NOODLE STALL STOP

She reaches the tiny noodle stall and taps her wrist against the counter's payment pad. An elderly vendor hands her a steaming paper cup of noodles with chopsticks balanced on top. She takes the first slurp right there under the stall's awning and immediately smiles because it's good. She notices her friend filming and holds the cup toward the camera playfully, steam curling up past her face, before taking another bite.

— WALKING THE LANE

She continues down the narrow walkway eating as she goes, weaving past a parked moped and ducking under low-hanging laundry. A small battered cleaning drone trundles along the gutter beside her for a few steps like a stray cat. She notices it, crouches down and taps its dented shell twice. Its status light blinks from red to a friendly blue. The drone beeps and rolls away and she laughs before continuing.

— SMALL ACCIDENT

She walks beneath a leaking overhead coolant pipe and a fat drip of condensation lands on her forehead. She stops, looks confused, looks up, realizes what happened and laughs. She wipes it away with her sleeve while her friend zooms awkwardly into her face. She looks directly into the camera and says:

"Seriously?"

— QUIET MOMENT

She reaches a low concrete barrier at the edge of the walkway overlooking a drop to the level below and sits down for a moment. She finishes the noodles while watching the level beneath — mopeds hissing past on wet ground, a tram's light sweeping by, a distant maintenance mech slowly walking a far walkway, neighbors' windows glowing in the stacked apartments across the gap.

Rain drips off her hood. She casually pushes the hood back, fixes her hair behind her ear, and looks around peacefully. The amber light behind her ear blinks once.

— FINAL MOMENT

She stands up, crushes the empty cup into a recycler slot in the wall, and continues walking home. After a few steps, she turns back toward the camera with a small playful smile and says:

"Come on."

She keeps walking down the wet neon-reflected lane while the camera follows behind. She disappears around a steam-shrouded corner and the recording abruptly cuts to black.

AUDIO

Natural location sound only: steady light rain, footsteps on wet metal grating and concrete, the hum of transformers and vent fans, distant tram chimes, sizzling and ladle clanks from the noodle stall, muffled music from an apartment above, the cleaning drone's small servo whir and beep, indistinct neighbor conversation in the background, and subtle camera-handling noise with rain hitting the recorder.

No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects. Only the two spoken lines specified above.

FINAL FEEL

The entire video should feel like a forgotten clip pulled off a friend's old drive — someone's completely ordinary evening that just happens to take place in a towering neon city. Warm, casual, slightly playful, intimate and nostalgic.

The cyberpunk world is background texture, never spectacle. No action, no danger, no dramatic events, no exaggerated acting, no model poses and no polished cinematic shots. The realism comes from the worn, lived-in surroundings, natural expressions, small accidents, rain physics, steam movement, reflections in puddles and imperfect handheld camera operation.

entries.title: Cinematic Tokyo Office Romance Montage
entries.description: A romantic cinematic montage prompt set in Tokyo, following two characters from an office meeting to their traditional wedding in a shrine.
entries.prompt:
Hyperrealistic, photorealistic, cinematic 30-second 
romance montage.

TOKYO. HARUTO, 27, slim, black side-part, charcoal 
suit, navy tie. MEI, 26, brown shoulder bob, cream 
blouse, thin gold chain. Glass-walled office, warm 
afternoon light, seasons shifting beyond the windows.

[0.0–5s] Slow dolly, glass corridor. Her folders SLIP 
— papers FAN across tile. He kneels, hands back the 
last page. Startled blink, shy half-smile, both look 
away. Office hum, printer click, first piano note. 
Dust motes in the light.

[5–10s] Handheld two-shot, gentle drift. Late desks, 
shared noodles; he SLIDES coffee across, she laughs 
mid-bite. Easy grins, elbows touching, unaware. Rain 
streaks on glass, monitor glow. Cello joins piano.

[10–15s] Push-in, rack focus city → her face. Rooftop 
dusk, wind LIFTS her hair, he drapes his jacket. 
Hands HOLD one beat too long. Breath catches, eyes 
lock. Strings SWELL. Golden flare, drifting petals.

[15–20s] 360 orbit, shallow depth. Winter street, 
lanterns. She TUGS his scarf — he pulls her close. 
First kiss. Eyes close, smile into smile. Crowd fades 
to silence, then strings return. Falling snow, bokeh.

[20–25s] Low-angle crane rise. Shrine courtyard, white 
kimono, black montsuki. He LIFTS her hands, family 
CLAPS. Her tears, his steady smile. Taiko BEAT, 
cheers, score SURGES full orchestra. Petals SHOWER 
through the torii light.

[25–30s] Slow pull-back to locked wide. Sunlit 
apartment, years later. Two cups. She rests her head 
on his shoulder. Quiet contentment. Kettle whistle, 
birds, solo piano fades out. Warm haze, soft bloom.

Shot on ARRI Alexa 35, 1080p, 35mm + 85mm primes, 
shallow DOF, warm filmic grade, natural skin tones, 
24fps motion blur, stereo score + ambient SFX.

entries.title: Obese Martial Arts Master Action Sequence

entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic martial-arts action with absurd elegance and premium slow-motion choreography. Shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with anamorphic lenses, combining dramatic close-ups, low-angle tracking, smooth orbit moves, whip pans and intense speed ramps into suspended slow motion. Bright daylight, subtle dust in the air, cinematic depth, rich fabric motion, grounded realism with a slightly surreal heroic tone.
Central figure: elderly obese martial-arts master, round body, heavy build, bald crown with grey side hair, expressive face, calm eyes, loose traditional training clothes, soft slippers, unexpectedly graceful movement. Opponents: three adult men in modern street clothing, all clearly different in height and build, overconfident and aggressive.
Open training courtyard between old stone walls and a modest dojo entrance, clean ground, a few leaves blowing, no crowd, no distractions.

Photorealistic action, hyper-choreographed movement, premium slow motion, readable combat geography, clearly differentiated opponents, stable anatomy, stylish absurd contrast between body type and agility, realistic impact reactions, no gore, normal proportions without stretch.

0-5s: Low-angle medium-wide tracking shot - The elderly obese master stands relaxed at center frame, hands behind his back, breathing calmly. The three men spread around him and begin closing in. Close-up on his soft belly and loose sleeves moving in the breeze, then close-up on his serene eyes.
5-9s: Slow push-in - The first attacker lunges. Time stretches. The old master shifts his weight by inches, narrowly avoiding the strike with absurd ease, his movement impossibly smooth for his size.
9-15s: Elegant orbit with speed ramps - In one seamless flow, he redirects the first man with a soft palm turn, pivots into the second with a spinning body check, ducks under the third, then unleashes a series of fluid counters: sleeve deflection, hip turn, sweeping step, rotating elbow redirection, and one surprisingly graceful half-spin that sends two attackers off balance at once.
15-20s: Hero close-up into wide reveal - Extreme slow motion: his cheeks and robe ripple as he performs one final absurdly elegant finishing combination, leaving all three men downed around him. He calmly exhales, adjusts his robe, pats his stomach once, and resumes a peaceful stance.

entries.title: Claymation Robot Startup Story
entries.description: A comprehensive multi-shot stop-motion claymation prompt for Seedance 2.5, detailing a creative workspace where tiny robots help a young entrepreneur build and launch an app.
entries.prompt:
一句话总结：橡皮泥定格动画短片。深夜的小阁楼里，一个年轻的黏土创业者有了一个做app的点子，书桌上那个小小的银色黏土方盒（一台迷你电脑主机）的盖子像玩具箱一样打开，一群小机器人帮手爬出来，自动完成设计、写代码、画图标、测试和上线，让他只专注于最有趣的创意部分。app上线的那一刻，窗外整座黏土城市亮起来。30秒，多机位剪辑，无对白无旁白，全程拟音音效驱动，结尾出现黏土字幕。

核心概念（像给10岁孩子解释）：这个小方盒里住着一群小帮手。你有了一个点子，按一下按钮，它们就爬出来把所有麻烦的活儿自动干完。你只负责想出最酷的东西。

风格：真实手工定格动画质感，每秒12帧的分步运动，非平滑插值，角色表情靠眉毛和肩膀的微小变化传达。黏土表面可见指纹与接缝。微缩布景：毛毡、瓦楞纸、火柴棍家具、棉花云。浅景深移轴感，每个镜头一个明确的机位行为，机位变化时用硬切。禁止：真实照片质感、光滑3D CG、任何品牌标志、水印、除结尾指定字幕以外的任何文字。

角色与道具：创业者是一个瘦高的黏土青年，蓬乱的棕色头发、圆圆的大眼镜、灰色连帽衫、浓密会动的眉毛。主机是一个巴掌大的银色哑光黏土方盒，圆角，正面有一个小圆按钮，底部有一圈细缝。方盒旁边立着一台小小的黏土显示器。机器人帮手是拇指大小的白色黏土小机器人，圆脑袋、一只天线、两条细腿，每个手里拿着不同的小工具（画笔、迷你键盘、放大镜、小印章、小喇叭）。app的吉祥物是一颗带笑脸的橙色小彗星。

镜头1（0s-4s）设定。大远景，正面对称构图，深夜的微缩阁楼：斜屋顶、一扇小窗、窗外是黑蓝色的纸板城市轮廓。创业者坐在小书桌前，桌上堆着歪歪扭扭的黏土便利贴塔，银色方盒安静地立在显示器旁边。他盯着一张空白的黏土纸，眉毛拧成一团。<远处城市的轻微嗡鸣> <纸张摩擦声> 忽然，他头顶一步一步鼓出一颗黄色黏土灯泡，眉毛猛地扬起。<清脆的"叮"> 末状态：他看向银色方盒。

镜头2（4s-8s）触发。切到桌面高度的低角度镜头，银色方盒在前景占据画面下方，创业者在后景虚化。他的手指伸进画面，按下方盒正面的小圆按钮。<机械的"咔哒"> 方盒底部的细缝亮起一圈薄荷绿光，焦点从他的脸拉到方盒。方盒的顶盖像玩具箱一样一步一步掀开，<盖子弹开的"啪"> 一架火柴棍小梯子从里面伸出来搭在桌上，小机器人一个接一个顺着梯子爬出来，落在桌面上排成一排，齐刷刷举起工具。<梯子伸出的木头咯吱声> <细碎的爬梯脚步声> <小工具碰撞的叮当声> 末状态：六个机器人面向镜头站好，顶盖敞开着，创业者在后景眼镜反光。

镜头3（8s-12s）自动搭建。切到正上方的垂直俯拍镜头，桌面像一张棋盘。机器人以极快的分步节奏把一块块彩色黏土薄片拼成一排排整齐的app界面：按钮、列表、一个大大的空白圆圈留给图标。另一个机器人坐在方盒顶上用迷你键盘敲字，一条卷曲的黏土代码彩带从方盒的细缝里不断长出来，绕着桌面盘旋。<密集的键盘哒哒声> <薄片拼合的啪嗒声> 末状态：界面整齐铺满桌面，代码彩带绕了一圈。

镜头4（12s-16s）他做最有趣的部分。切到微距特写，浅景深。创业者的手拿着一小根黏土，慢慢捏出一颗橙色小彗星，再用指尖点出两只眼睛和一个笑脸。<黏土揉捏的柔软声> <两下轻点声> 一个拿画笔的机器人踮脚趴在他手边看，天线激动地颤抖。焦点从彗星拉到机器人的脸，再拉回来。末状态：彗星完成，创业者把它放进界面上那个空白圆圈里。<恰好嵌入的"咔"声>

镜头5（16s-20s）自动测试。切到侧面横移镜头，镜头缓慢分步向右平移，一次扫过三个工位：第一个机器人用放大镜检查显示器上的界面，发现一个歪掉的按钮，用手指推正；第二个机器人在一部迷你黏土手机上滑动，彗星在屏幕上跳来跳去；第三个机器人举起小印章，重重盖在一张黏土纸上。<放大镜的玻璃摩擦声> <推正按钮的"咔"> <滑动的轻微沙沙声> <印章落下的"咚"> 末状态：三个机器人同时向创业者竖起大拇指。

镜头6（20s-25s）上线。切回正面构图，创业者深吸一口气，肩膀抬起，然后用手掌拍下桌上一个大大的红色黏土按钮。<按钮按下的沉闷"咚"> 方盒底部的绿光猛地变亮，显示器闪一下白光。<一声上扬的"叮"> 镜头开始缓慢后拉，穿过小窗飞到阁楼外面：黑蓝色的纸板城市里，一扇接一扇的小窗户亮起橙色光，每扇窗里都有一块微型黏土屏幕上跳着那颗笑脸彗星，光点像涟漪一样从阁楼向外扩散到整座城市。<窗户逐个亮起的连续"啵"声，越来越密> <温暖的合唱般的嗡鸣渐强> 末状态：大远景，整座城市点亮，阁楼的小窗在正中央。

镜头7（25s-30s）结尾。切回阁楼桌面，机器人们向创业者挥手，一个接一个爬回梯子钻进方盒，梯子缩回去，顶盖一步一步合上。<倒放的爬梯脚步声> <盖子合上的轻柔"咔哒"> 创业者在后景虚化，双手抱头靠在椅背上，眉毛放松。镜头缓慢分步推近至银色方盒的英雄特写，暖色背光勾勒轮廓，底部绿光轻柔呼吸。方盒顶部的黏土字母像积木一样一个个从盖子上凸起成形，先是【meet the new Mac mini】，停顿一下，再在前方凸起一行较小的【made for builders】。<字母逐个凸起的软"啵"声> <一声温暖的余韵音，然后归于安静> 末状态：方盒居中，两行字幕清晰可读，定格保持1秒。

灯光：主光是书桌上一盏黏土台灯的暖黄光，从左上方打下，硬边阴影，在银色方盒的圆角上留下柔和高光。窗外冷蓝色月光作为逆光 and 补光。方盒亮起后，底部的薄荷绿光成为第三个光源，映在创业者的眼镜上。镜头6城市亮起时，橙色窗光逐渐盖过蓝色月光。轻微的定格式亮度闪烁。三层色彩：基底为深蓝夜色与炭灰纸板，主体为灰色连帽衫的创业者和银色哑光方盒，点缀色为薄荷绿底光和橙色彗星与窗光。

全程保持：每个镜头只有一种机位行为，镜头之间硬切。所有运动分步、无平滑过渡。创业者、银色方盒、机器人和彗星的外形、颜色、大小全程一致。音频全程只有拟音音效和轻微的环境底噪。无对白、无旁白、无人声、无背景音乐。除结尾两行黏土字幕外，无任何文字、无品牌标志、无水印。
entries.translated_prompt:
One-sentence summary: A claymation stop-motion short film. In a late-night small attic, a young clay entrepreneur has an idea for an app. A small silver clay box (a mini computer host) on the desk opens like a toy box, and a group of small robot helpers climb out to automatically complete design, coding, drawing icons, testing, and launching, allowing him to focus only on the most interesting creative part. The moment the app goes live, the entire clay city outside the window lights up. 30 seconds, multi-camera editing, no dialogue, no narration, driven by foley sound effects throughout, with clay subtitles appearing at the end.

Core concept (like explaining to a 10-year-old): This little box is home to a team of little helpers. You have an idea, press a button, and they crawl out to do all the hard work automatically. You're just responsible for coming up with the coolest stuff.

Style: Hand-crafted stop-motion animation texture, 12 frames per second step-motion, non-smooth interpolation, character expressions conveyed through subtle movements of eyebrows and shoulders. Fingerprints and seams visible on the clay surface. Miniature set: felt, corrugated cardboard, matchstick furniture, cotton clouds. Shallow depth-of-field tilt-shift feel, each shot has a clear camera behavior, with hard cuts between camera changes. Forbidden: Realistic photo texture, smooth 3D CG, any brand logos, watermarks, any text other than the specified end titles.

Characters and Props: The entrepreneur is a tall, thin clay young man with messy brown hair, big round glasses, a gray hoodie, and thick, expressive eyebrows. The host is a palm-sized silver matte clay square box with rounded corners, a small round button on the front, and a ring of thin slits at the bottom. A small clay monitor stands next to the box. The robot helpers are thumb-sized white clay robots with round heads, one antenna, and two thin legs, each holding different small tools (brush, mini keyboard, magnifying glass, small stamp, small horn). The app's mascot is a small orange comet with a smiley face.

Shot 1 (0s-4s) Setting. Extreme wide shot, symmetrical composition, miniature attic at night: slanted roof, a small window, with a dark blue cardboard city silhouette outside. The entrepreneur's hand holds a small piece of clay, slowly molding a small orange comet, then dotting two eyes and a smiley face with his fingertip. <Soft sound of clay kneading> <Two light dotting sounds> A robot with a paintbrush stands on its toes by his hand, its antenna vibrating with excitement. Cut back to the attic desk, the robots wave to the entrepreneur and crawl back into the box one by one, the ladder retracts, and the lid closes step-by-step. <Reversed crawling footsteps> <Soft 'click' of the lid closing> The entrepreneur is blurred in the background, leaning back in his chair with his hands behind his head, eyebrows relaxed. Huge atrium. Glass ceiling. Strong natural light. Glass-fronted stores. Escalators. Marble floors. Metal railings. Advertising screens. Brand shops. Food court. Product displays.
It starts very peaceful, with many general customers enjoying shopping normally.
After the battle begins, the mall is destroyed in stages.

SCENE 1 | 0.00–6.00 seconds
PEACE BEFORE CHAOS
Do not start the fight from the beginning. Bright daytime. Huge shopping mall atrium. Many shoppers are walking normally. Families. Couples. People with shopping bags. Customers using escalators. DIM’S is also walking normally among the general public. Not in a combat stance yet. Natural walk. Arms are also down naturally. Expression is calm. The camera is initially a HIGH-ANGLE WIDE SHOT from the upper floor of the atrium. Descend slowly. Approach DIM’S while passing through the crowd. Transition naturally to LOW FRONT TRACKING. The camera moves to the side of DIM’S for SIDE TRACKING. Do not use intense camera work here. A brief CINEMATIC CLOSE-UP on DIM’S face. Behind her. One man in a black suit + sunglasses in the crowd. Another one in a different direction. Two more from the escalator. DIM’S still doesn't look back. The agents close the distance with DIM’S while blending into the crowd. Tension rises quietly.

SCENE 2 | 6.00–12.00 seconds
SUDDEN AMBUSH
Suddenly, the front agent throws a high-speed punch at DIM’S. DIM’S is walking normally until just before. A few centimeters before the fist reaches her face. DIM’S instantaneously shifts her body sideways. MISS. Simultaneously, three people attack from the rear and sides. Video speed and camera work accelerate all at once from here. DIM’S does not retreat. Step into the center of the encirclement. LOW DUCK. Fist passes overhead. High-speed PIVOT. ROUNDHOUSE KICK. Direct hit to one's torso. Body flies sideways and crashes into a product display. Products scatter. Immediately after, another agent from behind. DIM’S turns around while performing a SPINNING BACK KICK. IMPACT. Agent crashes into a glass showcase. Glass shatters. From that moment, general customers understand the situation. Screams. Shopping bags fall to the floor. People start to flee all at once. CAMERA: Whip-pan. Low tracking. Rapid lateral tracking. 180° combat orbit. Crash push. Micro slow-motion for only a few frames at peak impact. Immediately return to full speed.

SCENE 3 | 12.00–19.00 seconds
MULTI-DIRECTIONAL ASSAULT
Five more agents rush in from different directions. Everyone moves simultaneously. Two in front. One on the left. One on the right. One behind. DIM’S also advances at high speed. SIDESTEP the first punch. Continue to LOW SPINNING SWEEP. Sweep the enemy's legs. Enemy falls to the marble floor. DIM’S doesn't wait to see them fall. Immediately to the next enemy. Attack from the right. DUCK. KNEE STRIKE. Immediate ELBOW COUNTER. Another enemy approaches from behind. DIM’S BACK KICKS without looking back. IMPACT. Enemy crashes into a food court table. Chairs and tables scatter. Two others attack from left and right simultaneously. DIM’S slips through the gap between the two at the last second. The enemies' attacks miss each other. DIM’S stops suddenly. High-speed reversal. Continuous kick COMBO. LEFT ROUNDHOUSE. RIGHT SPINNING KICK. Two enemies are blown away in different directions. One to the metal railing. One to a glass store. Railing deforms. Glass collapses. Destruction of the mall progresses rapidly. CAMERA: The camera itself passes between two enemies. Extreme low tracking. High-angle vertical drop. Short 180° orbit following DIM’S rotation. Fleeing general customers cross the foreground. Glass shards pass the lens at high speed. Maintain spatial continuity.

SCENE 4 | 19.00–25.00 seconds
SIGNATURE MOVE
SMASH’IN JUMP DUAL SPINNING 360° KICK
Remaining agents immediately reorganize. No one flinches. Multiple people rush DIM’S simultaneously. Two jump in from left and right almost at the same time. DIM’S advances at full speed. LOW ANGLE CAMERA tracks her feet. DIM’S kicks the floor hard. JUMP. Camera also rises at once. 360° high-speed rotation of the whole body in the air. SMASH’IN JUMP DUAL SPINNING 360° KICK. Within one jump rotation, the first leg hits the left agent's upper body directly. IMPACT 1. Body flies toward the glass display. DIM’S continues the aerial rotation. Opposite leg hits the right agent directly. IMPACT 2. Second person is blown away in the opposite direction. Almost simultaneously, CRASH!! Glass shatters explosively. Products scatter. Metal frame deforms. Very short MICRO SLOW MOTION only for this moment. Hair. Oversized shirt. Wide cargo pants. Necklace. Everything reacts naturally to the centrifugal force of the rotation. Immediately return to FULL SPEED. DIM’S lands. At the same time as landing, the next enemy attacks. Do not rest. Evade immediately.

SCENE 5 | 25.00–30.00 seconds
THE FIGHT IS NOT OVER
The last few seconds are not a "victory." Remaining agents attack again from beyond the rubble. One in front. One behind. DIM’S evades the front punch by a few centimeters. PIVOT. ELBOW STRIKE. SPINNING BACK KICK to the enemy behind. Enemy is blown into the food court. Tables and chairs scatter violently. Another agent immediately jumps in. DIM’S ROUNDHOUSE KICKS while advancing. Enemy crashes into a large glass panel. Huge glass surface collapses. With that impact, a large advertising sign, part of the ceiling panel, and store displays fall in a chain reaction. Dust and glass shards fill the atrium. General customers have mostly evacuated. CAMERA passes through the fragments at high speed. PULL BACK all at once. Full view of the destroyed huge atrium. However, DIM’S does not strike a victory pose. Beyond the rubble, multiple black-suited agents stand up again. Other agents appear from the top of the escalator. DIM’S looks at them immediately. Do not stop to pose. Run full speed toward the enemy. Camera follows from a low position. Just before DIM’S jumps into the next enemy— CUT. The fight is not over yet.

PHYSICAL IMPACT
All attacks should have clear weight, inertia, and reaction. Enemy bodies react naturally according to the direction and force of the attack. Unnatural ragdoll is prohibited. Hair, clothes, and accessories follow the body's acceleration, rotation, and landing. Give DIM’S herself center of gravity movement, stepping in, and landing impact. Glass, metal, product shelves, tables, chairs, railings, and marble floors also react physically according to the impact direction. Destruction should not be maximum from the start, but escalate in stages: Peaceful mall -> small-scale destruction -> glass destruction -> furniture scattering -> large-scale destruction. Excessive bleeding, open wounds, amputation, and gore are prohibited.

CAMERA DNA
The first 6 seconds are relatively calm cinematic camera. Change to Aggressive cinematic camera simultaneously with the start of combat. Low-angle tracking. Extreme low tracking. Rapid lateral tracking. Dynamic 180° orbit. Short 360° combat orbit. High-angle vertical drop. Aerial follow. Whip-pan reacquisition. Crash push. Snap push. Reverse tracking. Foreground wipe. Environmental parallax. Impact recoil. Boldly switch between High -> Eye Level -> Low -> Extreme Low -> Overhead. 360° orbit only for important scenes like SIGNATURE MOVE. Prohibit repeated use. Micro slow-motion only for maximum impact. No long slow motion. No static camera. No random camera shake. Even if the camera momentarily loses DIM’S, reacquire immediately from the next movement direction. Maintain the positional relationship between the person and the enemy even with intense camera work.

COLOR GRADING
Premium cinematic daylight grade. Natural warm skin tones. Cool deep shadows. High dynamic range. Rich blacks. Controlled highlights. Subtle teal-green background separation. Warm natural sunlight on DIM’S. Slightly desaturated urban environment. Filmic contrast. Subtle cinematic grain. Natural highlight roll-off.

AUDIO
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE. Diegetic sound only. Shopping mall ambient sounds. People's conversations. Footsteps. Escalator sounds. After combat starts: Sudden footsteps. Breathing. Movement of clothes. Punch sounds. Heavy kick impact. Sound of leather shoes kicking marble. Glass shattering. Metal deformation. Furniture collision. Products falling. Crowd screams. Footsteps of people fleeing. Distant shouting. Mall interior reverberation. Synchronize all major impacts with the exact frame of physical contact.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
(As in original English negative prompt section)

PRIORITY — ABSOLUTE
Fast continuous martial-arts choreography. DIM’S remains completely unarmed. Kick-dominant combo combat. SMASH’IN JUMP DUAL SPINNING 360° KICK is the signature movement and the largest visual highlight. All enemies actively attack DIM’S. Enemies NEVER wait their turn. Every attack creates a realistic reaction to the body. Every major impact creates visible physical consequences in both the enemy and surrounding environment. Crowd reacts naturally and immediately after combat begins. Mall progressively gets destroyed as the fight escalates. Camera aggressively orbits, tracks and changes perspective while maintaining spatial continuity. DIM’S identity, face, hairstyle, proportions and outfit remain identical to the reference image throughout all 30 seconds. No weapons. No superhero powers. No hero pose. The fight remains unfinished.

FINAL FRAME:
DIM’S is still moving forward toward the next wave of black-suited agents. CUT DURING MOTION. DO NOT END THE ACTION.

SEEDANCE 2.5 — MALL AGENT BATTLE: UPPER FLOOR FINAL ASSAULT

MODEL: Seedance 2.5
DURATION: 15 seconds
FPS: 24
ASPECT RATIO: 16:9
RESOLUTION: 4K
REFERENCE:
@image1 = Complete fixed character reference for protagonist DIM'S
@image2 = Last frame of the previous video / Start frame for this one
CONTINUITY — MOST IMPORTANT
The video must start directly from the last frame of @image2. Maintain the location, shopping mall destruction state, rubble, smoke, dust, lighting, escalators, 2nd-floor corridor, glass railings, and positional relationships of agents on the upper floor. Do not make it look like a switch to a different scene from the previous video. In @image2, the protagonist is running from the center of the 1st floor toward the agents on the 2nd floor. Do not stop that running; connect directly to the action this time.

STYLE
Ultra-realistic live-action action movie.

entries.title: Cinematic Muddy Motocross Race
entries.description: A high-stakes, realistic 30-second motocross racing prompt featuring heavy rain, mud explosions, and immersive camera work.
entries.prompt:
Style: Premium cinematic motocross racing, gritty realism, extreme weather, heavy rain, deep mud, dramatic natural lighting, high energy. Duration: 30 seconds.

[0–5s] — The Veteran
Extreme close-up of the veteran rider’s mud-covered full-face helmet and tinted goggles, face completely hidden. Slow camera push-in as rain streams across the visor and mud sticks to the helmet. Subtle breathing and engine vibration. Shallow depth of field, realistic rain droplets and lens moisture.

[5–10s] — The Challenger
Cut to the second rider from a low side angle. Aggressive helmet design, covered in fresh mud. He leans forward and blips the throttle as the rear tire spins slightly, throwing wet dirt. Camera tracks smoothly beside the bike.

[10–15s] — Tension Before Launch
Wide establishing shot of the muddy starting gate under a dark stormy sky. Deep ruts, puddles, rain mist and reflective wet surfaces. Both riders hold position as engines grow louder. Brief close-ups of gripping gloves, throttle movement and spinning wheels.

[15–20s] — Explosive Launch
The gate slams down. Both riders launch violently forward. Low camera near the ground captures tires digging into mud and blasting water toward the lens. One rider lifts into a controlled wheelie. Brief slow motion as mud explodes through the air, then return to full speed.

[20–25s] — First Corner
Dynamic tracking shot alongside the riders as they attack the first muddy turn. Bikes slide naturally through deep ruts, suspension compresses, and thick mud sprays from the rear tires. Camera movement feels fast, physical and immersive.

[25–30s] — Into the Storm
Low rear tracking shot as the riders accelerate away, battling for position. Headlights glow through heavy rain and atmospheric mist. One rider edges ahead toward the next jump. Finish with a dramatic wide shot and brief slow-motion mud spray.

Cinematic Direction: Consistent riders, helmets, motorcycles and environment throughout. Realistic physics, natural motion blur, shallow depth of field, volumetric rain, subtle lens splashes, dramatic contrast, immersive camera choreography, authentic motocross movement. No unnecessary cuts, no exaggerated CGI effects.

Audio: Thunder, heavy rainfall, engine idle, throttle blips, rising RPM, gate slam, tire spin, mud impacts and powerful engine roar, synchronized naturally with the action.

entries.title: Korean Summer Evening Home Video
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a nostalgic 2000s-style home video of a young woman in Seoul.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary summer evening in the life of a young Korean woman. No reference image.

MAIN SUBJECT

Young Korean woman in her early 20s, naturally pretty, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, relaxed and approachable personality.

Long black hair loosely tied into a messy side ponytail with a few loose strands around her face. Wearing a fitted pastel-blue short top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers and a simple silver necklace.

Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions and overall appearance throughout the entire video.

SETTING

A quiet older Seoul residential neighborhood during a warm summer evening. Narrow concrete lanes, small houses, potted plants, bicycles, old walls, utility poles, overhead wires, a tiny neighborhood bakery, a public water tap and large leafy trees casting shadows across the street.

Everything should feel lived-in, ordinary and peaceful. No tourist attractions, advertisements, recognizable brands or commercial activity.

CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC

Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder.

Strong handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, occasional motion blur, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild noise, accidental zooms and natural camera imperfections.

No stabilization, drone footage, gimbal movement, dramatic lighting or polished commercial cinematography.

 — OUTSIDE THE HOUSE

She steps outside carrying a small reusable shopping bag. She locks the door, adjusts her messy ponytail and looks toward the camera with a relaxed smile.

A light summer breeze moves her hair as she starts walking down the lane.

 — BAKERY STOP

She reaches a tiny neighborhood bakery and buys a warm pastry.

She steps outside, takes her first bite and immediately smiles because it tastes good.

She notices her friend filming and holds the pastry toward the camera playfully before taking another bite.

— WALKING HOME

She continues down the narrow street while eating.

A neighborhood cat follows her for a few steps. She notices it, crouches down and gently pets it.

The cat walks away and she laughs before continuing.

 — SMALL ACCIDENT

She walks beneath a large tree when a few leaves fall onto her hair.

She stops, looks confused, then realizes what happened and laughs.

She brushes the leaves away while her friend zooms awkwardly toward her face.

She looks directly into the camera and says:

"Seriously?"

 — QUIET MOMENT

She reaches a low concrete wall beside the street and sits down for a moment.

She finishes the pastry while watching bicycles and neighbors passing through the lane.

A gentle breeze moves her hair. She casually fixes her ponytail and looks around peacefully.

 — FINAL MOMENT

She stands up and continues walking home.

After a few steps, she turns back toward the camera

entries.title: Primeval Forest Monster Chase Trap
entries.description: A high-action 15-second chase sequence prompt for Seedance 2.5 where a woman flees a beast through a primeval forest and traps it on a rotten cliff log.
entries.prompt: Focus on the female lead, Alin: a young white woman with very light golden-blonde straight hair and a straight fringe, wearing a white form-fitting tank top, blue jeans, and brown knee-high boots. <<<image_2>>> Lock on to the pursuing monster: A lanky, decaying four-legged beast with extremely long forelimbs, spines along its spine, a massive gaping wound, yellowish-white eyes, and damp, cold, rough, keratinous skin. 15 seconds, single take, third-person ultra-wide-angle high-speed close-up side shot—the camera stays tightly on Alin’s side as she sprints, never losing sight of the subject. Alin flees at top speed down a steep slope in a deep, primeval forest, weaving in an S-shape, sidestepping tree trunks, and ducking to avoid overhanging branches, while a horde of the monsters from Figure 2 closes in rapidly behind her. She stumbles on a tree root, braces herself with one hand, slides, and rolls halfway around before pushing off a thick tree trunk to instantly get back up and continue her sprint. At the edge of the forest ahead lies a cliff, spanned by a massive, rotten fallen log: parched and dehydrated, grayish-white and cracked, with peeling bark, rot in the middle, and a few remaining dead branches. One end is wedged between the rocks and roots in the forest floor, while the other hangs over the cliff’s edge. The moment Alin burst out of the forest, a blinding light erupted. He stepped directly onto the rotten log and sprinted at full speed, sending wood shavings flying and snapping off broken branches beneath his feet. At the log’s end, he made a daring leap onto the rock face on the opposite side. The very next second, the lead monster and the front-row creatures lunged onto the log; its middle section snapped instantly, and the monsters plummeted into the mist-shrouded abyss along with the broken timber. The last leader monster clung to the broken stump and nearly lunged at Alin’s feet. Alin immediately spun around and kicked away the remaining support, sending it plummeting into the abyss. The camera briefly follows the falling log and debris downward before returning to Alin at the cliff’s edge—his chest heaving, hair disheveled, and clouds and mist swirling behind him. Cool-toned Tyndall volumetric light in the woods gives way to a sudden burst of harsh sunlight as she bursts out of the forest, creating a stark contrast of light and shadow at the cliff’s edge. High-speed motion blur, dust and decaying leaves, snapping branches, wood chips and碎石, air turbulence, and swaying vegetation—all must be rendered realistically. No robots, no cutaways, and no monsters mindlessly falling off the cliff on their own—it must clearly show Alin actively luring the monsters onto the fallen log and executing the final counterattack.

entries.title: Independent Coffee Shop Barista Vlog
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a realistic 'day in the life' barista vlog, featuring handheld digital camcorder aesthetics, natural lighting, and detailed coffee preparation shots.
entries.prompt: Handheld digital camcorder aesthetic, landscape framing. A gorgeous young barista films herself by hand in selfie-cam and first-person style during a quiet early-morning shift at a small independent coffee shop. Keep realistic hand shake, slightly crooked framing, autofocus briefly hunting between her face and the coffee equipment, occasional motion blur, small framing mistakes where the espresso machine or her hands briefly slip out of frame, and natural exposure changes when she moves between the warm café interior and the bright front window. Mix handheld selfie footage with a few fixed external shots. Important: never show her placing, adjusting, or setting up a camera. When switching from handheld footage to a fixed external angle, use a clean jump cut as if the camera had already been positioned before the shot began. The camera itself must never appear on screen, in mirrors, in polished metal reflections, or in the espresso machine surfaces. - LOOK: Warm early-morning café light. Soft golden sunlight enters through the front window, mixing with warm pendant lights above the counter and a subtle cool blue tone from the street outside. Slight camcorder softness, faint digital noise in darker corners, mild bloom around the pendant lights, realistic reflections on the espresso machine, ceramic cups, glass pastry case, and wet countertop. Coffee realism is the core of the look: freshly ground coffee falling into the portafilter, realistic espresso extraction, crema forming naturally, milk swirling and stretching under steam, condensation on the milk pitcher, tiny coffee splashes, realistic steam, glossy latte foam, crumbs on the pastry counter, and small droplets from wiping the work surface. The café should feel tactile and lived-in: wood grain, fingerprints on the counter, worn metal edges, chalk dust, paper napkins, scattered coffee grounds, and slightly imperfect organization. Realistic skin texture, natural skin tones, slightly tired but cheerful morning expression, subtle under-eye detail, and believable movement throughout the shift. - STYLE: A realistic “day in my life working at a coffee shop” vlog. The tone is warm, casual, funny, quietly energetic, and natural. She talks to the lens like she is speaking to a close friend while continuing to work. She is attractive and charismatic, but the video must feel like a believable self-recorded shift at a real neighborhood café, not a commercial, music video, or polished barista advertisement. Fast clean jump cuts, strong continuity, natural body language, realistic café ambience, grinder noise, espresso machine sounds, milk steaming, ceramic cups touching the counter, paper bag sounds, soft street noise, and no awkward dead moments. - CHARACTER: The woman in the reference image. Her face, facial features, skin tone, body shape, hairstyle, and overall appearance must match the reference image exactly in every shot. She wears exactly what she is wearing in the reference image. Do not restyle, beautify, slim, age, or alter her appearance. The only addition is a simple dark café apron worn naturally over her reference outfit. The apron remains the same color and fit in every shot. Her hair and makeup remain consistent with the reference image. She looks naturally polished but not overly styled, like someone who has arrived for an early shift. A small black barista towel is tucked over one shoulder for most of the video. SETTING: A small independent neighborhood coffee shop in the early morning. Warm wooden service counter, commercial espresso machine, two coffee grinders, stacks of ceramic cups, paper takeaway cups, pastry display case, handwritten menu board, jars of coffee beans, milk pitchers, syrup bottles, napkins, receipt printer, sink, dish rack, small plants, and a front window showing a quiet morning street. The café feels real, slightly worn, warm, and lived-in. The espresso machine, grinder, register, cups, pastry case, and milk refrigerator stay in consistent positions throughout the video. No visible coworkers. No identifiable customers. No pets. - IMPORTANT CONTINUITY RULES: The same woman from the reference image must remain fully consistent in every shot. No face changes, no body changes, no hairstyle changes, no makeup changes, and no outfit changes. The dark apron remains the same throughout the video. The work progression moves in one direction only: opening the station, preparing coffee beans, grinding coffee, pulling espresso, steaming milk, making a latte, preparing a pastry order, serving the completed drink, wiping the counter, and ending the shift moment. The coffee process must never reverse or regenerate. Coffee grounds never turn back into whole beans. Extracted espresso never becomes unextracted coffee. Steamed milk never becomes cold or unsteamed. A finished latte remains finished. Hands and coffee tools are the top priority: five fingers always, correct grip on the portafilter, correct use of the tamper, realistic positioning of fingers around the milk pitcher, no duplicated hands, no fused fingers, no floating utensils, and no tools passing through her hands. Coffee physics must be realistic: espresso flows downward, crema forms naturally, milk creates believable swirling patterns, steam moves upward, liquid stays inside the cup, and foam behaves like real microfoam. The espresso machine, grinder, cups, milk pitcher, coffee beans, towel, and pastry bags remain stable and consistent. No camera visible in the espresso machine reflection, window reflection, glass display case, or chrome surfaces. No camera setup shown. No impossible customer interactions. No duplicated limbs. No warped cups. No illegible or constantly changing text on the menu board. - STORYBOARD: 30 seconds total, 10 cuts. entries.title: Nostalgic Early-2000s Korean MiniDV Footage
entries.description: An authentic camcorder aesthetic prompt for a spontaneous 30-second family-style video featuring a Korean woman in an everyday setting.
entries.prompt:
Create a highly realistic 30-second Seedance 2.5 video that looks like genuine early-2000s Korean MiniDV family footage accidentally preserved on an old camcorder. Use 4:3 aspect ratio. The footage should feel spontaneous, imperfect, nostalgic and completely authentic rather than cinematic or AI-generated.
MAIN SUBJECT:
A Korean woman in her mid-20s with a consistent natural identity throughout the entire video. She has loosely tied black hair, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup and relaxed everyday expressions. She wears simple early-2000s casual clothing: a loose sleeveless top, comfortable full-length trousers, worn sneakers and a small necklace. She never poses or acknowledges the camera.
0–6s — Rooftop:
She carries a small laundry basket onto a modest rooftop and hangs a large bedsheet. A sudden breeze makes the sheet billow toward her. She casually pulls it back and continues hanging laundry while the camcorder operator reacts slightly late.
6–12s — Everyday interruption:
A lightweight plastic container rolls across the rooftop. She quickly catches it before it reaches the edge, places it beside some household items and glances toward a nearby house after hearing someone call.
12–18s — Stairway:
She carries the basket down a narrow concrete staircase. The camera follows from behind, briefly loses focus, then refocuses as sunlight enters the frame.
18–24s — Residential lane:
She walks through a quiet Korean neighborhood with bicycles, laundry, utility poles, older vehicles, small gardens and neighbors doing ordinary chores. A bicycle passes near the camera and the operator instinctively shifts the framing.
24–30s — Natural ending:
She reaches a small outdoor utility area, places the basket down, picks up a household item and begins walking back. The camera attempts a small zoom but reacts too late. End abruptly with a natural cut.
CAMCORDER LOOK:
Authentic early-2000s MiniDV: 4:3 framing, handheld shake, imperfect composition, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, mild blown highlights, soft digital detail, subtle motion blur, low dynamic range, slightly warm faded colors, digital noise, compression artifacts, imperfect white balance and occasional accidental zoom. Keep the image clear enough to recognize faces and surroundings.
REALISM:
Maintain identical facial identity, hairstyle, clothing and body proportions throughout. Natural anatomy and movement, realistic hands, physically accurate fabric, hair and environmental motion. No warped faces, duplicated objects, disappearing props, floating objects, changing clothing, artificial bokeh, glossy skin or modern cinematic grading.
AUDIO:
Raw consumer-camcorder microphone only: footsteps, birds, wind, distant conversations, bicycles, household sounds and neighborhood ambience. No music, narration or cinematic sound effects.

entries.title: Ghost Girl Horror to Wholesome Romance
entries.description: A 30-second prompt for Seedance 2.5 that transitions from a scary paranormal television incident into a wholesome romantic makeover montage with a ghost girl.
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic handheld home-video style clip that begins like a frightening paranormal incident and gradually turns into a bizarre wholesome romantic montage. OVERALL STYLE The footage must look like real consumer-camera video, not polished cinema. Use a realistic handheld recording aesthetic: natural hand shake, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus delay, slight exposure shifts, soft digital detail, mild motion blur, faint noise, realistic indoor lighting, and believable human reactions. The first part should feel like spontaneous scary footage captured in a living room at night. The later part should become a quick but clear montage of sweet everyday moments, still grounded in realism. MAIN CHARACTERS A group of ordinary young adults watching TV in a living room at night. One young man stays central after the scare. He is calm, slightly confused, but kind. A creepy ghost-like young woman emerges from the TV. She has very pale skin, long wet black hair, a tired eerie expression, and a simple white dress or nightgown. She should look unsettling at first, but still human and realistic — not monstrous, not gory, not decomposed. As the video continues, she should remain the exact same woman, only gradually becoming cleaner, fresher, and more presentable. Do not transform her into a completely different person. IMPORTANT TONE Start tense and scary. Then switch into absurd kindness and sweet humor. The humor should come from the contrast between: a terrifying ghost entering the room, and a guy reacting like she just badly needs help and self-care. TIMELINE 00:00–00:05 — LIVING ROOM / HORROR START A few friends are sitting in a dim living room at night watching a scary movie on an old television. The TV is flickering. The room is lit mostly by the TV glow and a weak lamp. Suddenly, a creepy pale ghost girl with long wet black hair starts crawling out of the television into the room. The people panic, scream, and run away in fear. The handheld camera shakes hard and struggles to keep the action framed. 00:05–00:07 — THE GUY STAYS One young man remains in the room, staring at her in shock. Instead of screaming, he looks concerned and says something like: “Oh no… we need to fix this.” The ghost girl pauses and looks confused. 00:07–00:11 — QUICK CLEANUP / MAKEOVER START Fast but readable montage. He gestures for her to go clean up. Show short realistic clips of: her standing awkwardly in a bathroom doorway, brushing her teeth, washing up / shower steam / rinsing her hair, him handing her a towel, her hair looking cleaner and less messy. Keep this simple and visually clear. Do not overcomplicate the bathroom actions. 00:11–00:15 — GETTING READY More quick makeover moments: he helps dry or gently brush her hair, she now looks neater, still pale, still clearly the same ghost girl, very light makeup or a tidier appearance, a cleaner casual outfit or a more presentable version of her original look. She should still feel slightly strange and deadpan, just less terrifying. 00:15–00:23 — WHOLESOME MONTAGE A sweet, funny montage of them spending time together in public: walking through a park, sitting on a bench, eating ice cream or sharing a snack, taking a selfie, feeding birds or ducks, laughing awkwardly, one small cute moment where she tries to imitate normal human behavior. Everything should feel warm, a little absurd, but still realistic and grounded. 00:23–00:27 — PROPOSAL In a simple, heartfelt outdoor moment, the guy proposes to her. He shows a ring. She looks surprised, then gives a small quiet smile and accepts. Keep it sweet, not exaggerated. 00:27–00:30 — WEDDING ENDING Cut to a small wedding ceremony. They are dressed for a wedding, standing together while guests smile and clap. The ghost girl looks calm and beautiful but still slightly eerie in a charming way. For the final beat, add one subtle joke: a nearby TV screen flickers in the background, and she glances at it for a second. End there. VISUAL / PHYSICAL REALISM Maintain believable anatomy and motion throughout. No broken limbs, no extra fingers, no floating objects, no teleporting, no disappearing clothing, no sudden identity changes. Keep the ghost girl’s face and identity consistent from scene to scene. Keep the man’s identity consistent as well. All interactions must look physically plausible. CAMERA / EDITING The clip should feel like a real recorded video with cuts, not a polished movie trailer. The opening living room scare should feel especially raw and chaotic. The montage can be faster, but each shot must still be readable and visually clean. Do not use slow motion. Do not use cinematic crane shots, drone shots, or glossy commercial lighting. AUDIO Use only natural scene audio: TV flicker / room ambience, frightened reactions, bathroom ambience, outdoor park ambience, wedding ambience. No dramatic score is necessary. No narration. IMPORTANT RESTRICTIONS No gore No blood No body horror No graphic violence No grotesque facial distortions No copyrighted logos or recognizable movie footage on-screen Do not make the ghost girl cartoonish Do not make the romance mocking or cruel Keep the humor warm, weird, and unexpectedly wholesome FINAL FEEL The final result should feel like: a terrifying found-footage setup that turns into a strangely sweet love story. It should be funny, memorable, realistic-looking, and emotionally warm in the second half.

entries.title: Cinematic Mechanical Bus Transformation
entries.description: A multi-stage video prompt for a photorealistic sequence where an abandoned American bus transforms into a giant mechanical caterpillar creature.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic transformation sequence set in a remote, abandoned parking area surrounded by dense forest. Use photorealistic visuals, realistic human anatomy, detailed mechanical textures, natural lighting, physically accurate transformations, cinematic camera movement, realistic shadows, atmospheric fog, subtle film grain, and Hollywood-level VFX.

0–5 sec — The Bus
An old, oversized, extra-long American-style green bus sits abandoned in a dilapidated parking lot surrounded by trees. A young Asian male driver sits inside, nervously gripping the steering wheel. The bus suddenly shakes violently. The driver looks around in fear as strange mechanical sounds begin from inside the vehicle.

5–12 sec — Transformation Begins
The interior starts aggressively transforming from the inside out. Seats split apart and reorganize into complex mechanical components. Metal panels twist, fold and slide into place. The driver's cabin reshapes into a massive mechanical head, while the windshield becomes glowing eyes and the front bumper forms a menacing mouth.

The transformation should feel heavy, mechanical and physically believable, with pistons, gears, hydraulic systems, cables and metal plates moving with realistic weight.

12–18 sec — Mechanical Giant Emerges
The entire bus transforms into a gigantic mechanical creature resembling a monstrous caterpillar. The wheels remain visible and functional as part of its body. The sides of the mouth open hydraulically, revealing sharp teeth made from broken orange bus handrails and metal components.

The creature violently shakes and roars as smoke, dust and debris fill the air.

18–24 sec — Attack
The mechanical creature lunges toward the terrified driver. Its enormous jaws snap around him in a dramatic but non-graphic attack, lifting and throwing him onto its back. He grabs onto the exposed metal handrails to avoid falling as the creature moves violently.

Use fast cinematic camera movement, realistic motion blur, flying dust and sparks.

24–30 sec — Final Reveal
The mechanical creature crawls rapidly through the parking lot and forest, crushing small obstacles beneath its massive body. Its metallic legs and wheels move with convincing mechanical weight.

The camera pulls far back into a dramatic wide shot, revealing the creature's enormous scale against the forest.

End on a powerful close-up of its glowing mechanical eyes and roaring mouth.

Visual Direction: Ultra-realistic, photorealistic 4K/8K detail, realistic metal, rust, dirt, hydraulic pistons, gears, cables and mechanical joints, physically accurate transformation, realistic reflections, cinematic depth of field, atmospheric night lighting, volumetric fog, dynamic camera movement, intense sci-fi thriller atmosphere.

Important: Keep the same bus, driver, environment and mechanical creature consistent throughout. The transformation must look like a real physical machine transforming, not magical or cartoon

entries.title: Cinematic Morning Routine Vlog
entries.description: A long-form cinematic vlog prompt for Seedance 2.5 that follows a character's morning routine from waking up to walking the dog.
entries.prompt:
30-SECOND CINEMATIC MORNING VLOG — “FROM BED TO OUTSIDE”

Use the user-provided character reference as a strict identity lock and the user-provided outfit reference exactly. Keep the same face, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, shoes, and accessories throughout the entire video. Use the same dog consistently in every shot.

FORMAT: 16:9 widescreen, photorealistic, premium lifestyle vlog, cinematic natural lighting, realistic motion, subtle film grain, warm morning color grading.

0–5 SEC — WAKE UP
Soft morning sunlight enters the bedroom. The character slowly wakes up, sits on the edge of the bed, runs a hand through his hair, and takes a quiet moment before getting up. Slow cinematic push-in, natural bedroom ambience.
5–10 SEC — COFFEE
Cut to the kitchen. He prepares a simple morning coffee. Close-up of coffee beans, water pouring, coffee filling the cup, then him taking the first sip beside the kitchen window. Warm sunlight, shallow depth of field, gentle handheld camera movement.

10–15 SEC — GETTING READY
He puts on his shoes, grabs his keys and leash, and looks toward his dog waiting excitedly near the door. Quick but smooth cinematic cuts. The dog happily follows him toward the entrance.
15–25 SEC — MORNING WALK
He steps outside with his dog into a peaceful morning street. They walk casually together through a quiet neighborhood. Capture wide establishing shots, low-angle walking shots, close-ups of their feet, the dog walking beside him, and natural sunlight filtering through trees.

25–30 SEC — FINAL SHOT
Wide cinematic shot from behind as the character and dog continue walking down the street. He briefly looks toward the morning sky while the dog walks beside him. Slow camera pull-back, peaceful ending.
CAMERA STYLE: Smooth handheld movement, slow push-ins, gentle tracking shots, occasional low angles, natural transitions, realistic depth of field, cinematic framing.

AUDIO: Natural morning ambience, birds, subtle footsteps, coffee machine sounds, leash movement, soft city atmosphere. Minimal calm background music.
NEGATIVE PROMPT: identity changes, outfit changes, inconsistent dog, different dog breed, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, unnatural walking, floating objects, unrealistic motion, excessive camera shake, oversaturated colors, artificial skin, cartoon, anime, CGI look, text, subtitles, watermark, logo.
