entries.title: Industrial Factory Spy Action Sequence
entries.description: An aggressive handheld cinematic spy-action sequence prompt set in an oil-soaked industrial factory with complex stunt choreography.
entries.prompt:
REFERENCE / IDENTITY LOCK
Use Reference Image 1 as the exact identity lock for the adult male spy. Preserve identical face, facial proportions, black hairstyle, skin tone, physique, outfit and accessories throughout. No identity or wardrobe changes.

15-SECOND CINEMATIC ACTION — 24FPS, REAL-TIME
Photorealistic Hollywood spy-action, ARRI Alexa Mini, 27mm spherical lens, 4K, 24fps, realistic physics, sharp cinematic film grain, aggressive handheld camera, dynamic tracking, whip-pans, low-angle combat shots and realistic motion blur. 9:16 vertical.

ENVIRONMENT
Continue inside the same oil-soaked industrial factory. Thick smoke, flickering cyan-white fluorescent lights, sparks, steam bursts, broken glass, damaged machinery, oil-covered concrete, fallen enemies, barrels, conveyor belts, steel columns, overhead crane and elevated platforms. Maintain perfect continuity.

0–4 SEC: Immediately after the final gunshot, two armed reinforcements burst through a steel security door while another enemy rappels from an overhead crane. The spy instantly sprints forward, steps onto a fallen crate and launches into a flying side kick, crushing Enemy 6 into the steel door. He seamlessly follows with a spinning tornado kick, knocking Enemy 7 from the rappel line into stacked barrels.

4–7 SEC: Enemy 8 opens automatic fire. The spy rolls underneath the gunfire, draws a combat knife with his left hand, slashes the weapon arm and disarms him. He traps the wrist, pivots with precise Kung Fu footwork, throws Enemy 8 over his shoulder and finishes with a powerful downward axe kick.

7–10 SEC: Warning alarms activate as a heavily armored operative with a ballistic shield charges. The spy sprints toward him, rebounds from a steel column, performs a short wall-run and launches an aerial bicycle kick, knocking the shield upward. He lands behind the operative, executes a rapid arm lock, elbows, knees and spinning back kick, sending him through a steel railing onto the lower floor.

10–13 SEC: Enemies on elevated platforms open fire. The spy dives behind a moving conveyor, slides underneath it and fires four rapid tactical shots through narrow openings, eliminating two attackers. He emerges, grabs a hanging industrial chain, swings across a machinery gap and launches a flying double-foot kick into the final attacker, smashing him through reinforced safety glass.

13–15 SEC: The spy lands in a controlled three-point stance. Red emergency lights replace the fluorescent lighting. A massive fuel pipeline ruptures behind him, creating a realistic towering wall of fire. Without looking back, he calmly turns toward a dark industrial corridor. Brief cinematic push-in, then hard cut to black at 15 seconds.

CAMERA / LIGHTING: Aggressive handheld shaky-cam, fast dolly tracking, rapid whip-pans, dynamic low angles, close over

entries.title: Okinawa Romance Travel Cinematic Scene
entries.description: A 30-second cinematic romance prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring a couple in Okinawa, including Japanese dialogue, subtitles, and detailed emotional storytelling.
entries.prompt:
Hyperrealistic, photorealistic, cinematic 30-second 
romance travel scene. Spoken Japanese, English 
subtitles.

OKINAWA COAST. HARUTO, 27, tousled black hair, open 
white linen shirt, sun-tanned. MEI, 26, brown bob, 
yellow sundress, straw hat, bare feet. Turquoise 
shallows, white sand, high summer sun, salt haze.

[0.0–5s] Low tracking shot along wet sand. She RUNS 
ahead, hat flying off, he chases. Wide open laugh, 
head thrown back.
MEI (calling back, breathless): "はやく！おそいよ！"
SUB: "Hurry up, slowpoke!"
Gulls, surf hiss, ukulele and light percussion kick 
in. Spray glitters in sunlight.

[5–10s] Handheld waist-level, drifting. Knee-deep 
water — she KICKS a sheet of spray at him. He gasps, 
mock-outraged, grabs her waist.
HARUTO (laughing, disbelieving): "うそだろ、やったな！"
SUB: "You did NOT just do that."
SPLASH, shrieked laughter. Score bounces brighter. 
Rainbow refracts in the droplets.

[10–15s] Slow orbit, golden hour. Beach shack table, 
shaved ice between them. He wipes syrup from her chin 
with his thumb. She goes still — soft, caught look.
MEI (quiet, teasing): "見すぎ。"  SUB: "Stop staring."
HARUTO (softer): "むり。"  SUB: "Can't."
Wind chimes, distant surf. Strings under ukulele. 
Warm lens flare.

[15–20s] Crane rise from two-shot to wide. Scooter 
along a cliff road, her arms LOCKED around his waist, 
chin on his shoulder. Eyes closed, blissful. Engine 
hum, wind roar, score OPENS wide. Sea glitter to 
horizon.

[20–25s] Push-in, shallow focus. Sunset pier, 
foreheads touching, swaying, no music but the waves.
MEI (whisper): "毎年、こんな夏がいいな。"
SUB: "I want every summer to be like this one."
Breath, small laugh. Solo guitar returns. Silhouettes 
rimmed in orange fire.

[25–30s] Locked wide, slow pull-back. Fireworks BLOOM 
overhead — she points up, he watches her instead. 
Both grinning. BOOM and crackle, crowd cheer, score 
SWELLS then softens out. Sparks mirrored in water.

Native Japanese delivery, casual couple register, 
natural lip-sync. Shot on ARRI Alexa 35, 1080p, 35mm 
+ 85mm primes, shallow DOF, warm summer grade, 24fps 
motion blur, stereo score + natural ambience.

entries.title: Korean Schoolgirl Lightning Awakening Fight
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a high-school confrontation scene where a student awakens electric powers, featuring specific timestamps for action sequences, camera direction, and VFX instructions.
entries.prompt:
Characters: Korean teenage schoolgirl with straight black hair in a high ponytail, oversized white school shirt, navy pleated skirt, black backpack, white sneakers. Four Korean students surround her: a female delinquent in an oversized jacket and two male students in gym tracksuits, plus one female bystander.

00:00–00:07-Confrontation
In a Korean high-school corridor with wooden/green lockers, the bully girl shoves the ponytail girl's head and taunts her: “야, 이제 뭐라도 해보시게?” The girl looks down nervously and whispers: “…죄송합니다.” Static eye-level medium shots, tense atmosphere.

00:07–00:13-Power Awakens
The bully slaps her. Her eyes instantly glow neon-magenta as pink electricity races across her arms and shoulders. She thrusts an open palm forward, releasing a powerful pink shockwave that sends the bully backward into the lockers. Students scream and scatter.

00:13–00:22- Super-Speed Fight
A male student attacks. She effortlessly ducks, lightning wrapping around her body, then counters with a lightning-charged roundhouse kick. Papers and school notices fly through the hallway. She turns toward another attacker and suddenly sprints at super-speed, leaving magenta lightning trails and wind distortion behind her.

00:22–00:28- Final Strike
She launches into a dramatic flying kick surrounded by intense pink energy. The impact creates a spherical air-shockwave that throws the attacker far down the corridor. Use dramatic slow motion at the moment of impact, followed by a fast landing shot.

00:28–00:30- Aftermath
She lands as the electricity fades. Her glowing magenta eyes return to natural dark brown. In the suddenly silent, debris-filled hallway, she slowly raises her trembling hands and stares at them in shock and fear.

Camera: Static confrontation shots → rapid pans → low-angle tracking → lateral super-speed tracking → slow-motion impact → locked frontal ending.

VFX & Audio: Neon-magenta eyes, pink electric arcs, motion trails, shockwave rings, sparks, realistic debris, subtle smoke and volumetric light. Tense electronic drone building into an intense beat, then fading into an airy synth pad. Realistic slap, power surge, whooshes, sonic boom and electric-static SFX.

Aspect Ratio: 16:9
Duration: Approximately 30 seconds

entries.title: Cinematic Mountain Biking Film Sequence
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a multi-scene, 30-second extreme sports film with precise shot sequencing and cinematic lighting.
entries.prompt:
A hyper-realistic, ultra-cinematic 30-second mountain biking film shot on high-end cinema cameras with anamorphic lenses. Epic golden-hour light, dramatic god rays piercing through low fog and sea of clouds below jagged peaks. Photorealistic detail, rich color grading, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, intense motion blur on fast sections, smooth camera tracking.

Sequence:

0–3s: Wide establishing shot of a lone mountain biker silhouetted on a sharp rocky peak high above a thick layer of rolling clouds and distant mountain ranges at sunrise/sunset. Rider stands still with bike, looking out over the vast landscape. Slow, majestic aerial push-in.

3–6s: Extreme close-up of the rider’s face inside a black full-face downhill helmet and goggles. Intense focused eyes, slight breath, determined expression, warm sidelight catching sweat and facial hair. Shallow depth of field.

6–13s: Dynamic third-person and low-angle tracking shots following the rider bombing a steep forest dirt trail at high speed. Heavy motion blur on trees and ground, bike kicking up dust, body language aggressive and fluid, sun flaring through the canopy. Mix of side tracking, rear following, and low ground-level shots as the rider carves tight turns and drops.

13–17s: Rider approaches and crosses a narrow wooden suspension bridge clinging to a sheer cliff face next to a powerful waterfall. Mist and spray in the air, dramatic height, camera following closely from behind then swinging to the side as water crashes far below.

17–25s: Massive drop and big air off a rocky cliff edge. Rider launches into a long, floating jump high above a deep valley filled with forests, rivers, and distant towns. Slow-motion mid-air shots from multiple angles — side profile, rear, slightly below — showing full extension, bike suspended against the sun and sea of clouds, god rays exploding behind.

25–30s: Smooth landing on a rocky summit ridge. Rider rolls to a stop on the peak, silhouetted against the blazing sun rising/setting over endless mountains and cloud inversion. Final wide aerial pull-back as the sun creates powerful starburst rays across the entire frame. Fade on the epic, solitary figure on the edge of the world.

Style: ultra-photorealistic, cinematic color grade (warm golds, deep shadows, cool blues in the distance), high production value adventure sports film look, seamless continuous energy, no text, no logos.

entries.title: Recreating Viral Stunts UGC Comedy
entries.description: A 24-second vertical video prompt depicting a humorous attempt by a creator to recreate a viral skateboard stunt.
entries.prompt: Create a 24-second vertical 9:16 hyper-realistic UGC comedy video titled “I Tried to Recreate a Viral Video in Real Life.” CORE CHARACTER: A confident, attractive adult woman in her mid-20s with a thick, curvy body type, fuller hips and thighs, realistic natural proportions, long dark hair, expressive face and natural makeup. She wears casual streetwear: fitted black oversized T-shirt, loose blue jeans and white sneakers. She looks like a real social-media creator, not a professional model. Maintain the exact same face, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, accessories and physical appearance throughout every shot. CONCEPT: The creator discovers an absurdly viral video showing a woman performing an impossibly clean skateboard stunt beside a city fountain. She decides to recreate it in real life. The original viral footage looks effortless and perfectly produced; her real-life attempts are chaotic, awkward and genuinely funny. After several failed attempts, she finally succeeds and recreates the viral shot almost perfectly. SCENE 1 — 0:00–0:02 — VIRAL HOOK Open with a fictional viral-video clip: the same thick, curvy female creator runs toward a large urban fountain, jumps, spins naturally in midair and lands perfectly on a moving skateboard. The shot is exceptionally clean and impressive, with perfect timing and composition. Add large social-media-style text: “47 MILLION VIEWS.” Immediately smash cut to raw smartphone selfie footage of the creator. She looks directly into the lens and says: “Okay… I’m recreating this in real life.” SCENE 2 — 0:02–0:05 — REFERENCE BREAKDOWN Rapidly replay the fictional viral stunt as three extremely short visual beats: RUN → JUMP → PERFECT LANDING. Freeze briefly on the landing. The creator appears beside the footage in selfie mode and says: “How hard can this be?” Fast punch-in toward her skeptical expression. SCENE 3 — 0:05–0:08 — ATTEMPT ONE Real urban plaza, same fountain, same skateboard. Handheld smartphone footage. She runs toward the fountain, attempts the stunt, completely mistimes the jump and lands awkwardly on the grass. The camera jolts from the surprise. She gets back up, embarrassed, looks into the camera and says: “That was terrible.” SCENE 4 — 0:08–0:11 — ATTEMPT TWO Same exact location, wardrobe and props. She prepares again. This attempt is much closer: she jumps correctly, but the skateboard rolls away before her feet reach it. She misses the landing and looks at the skateboard in disbelief. The person filming laughs naturally. Keep the moment spontaneous and unscripted. SCENE 5 — 0:11–0:14 — ATTEMPT THREE Fast preparation montage: she tightens her sneakers, positions the skateboard, takes a breath and looks nervously at the camera. She runs and jumps. She almost lands perfectly but misses by a fraction. She bends over exhausted and says: “One more.” SCENE 6 — 0:14–0:18 — SUCCESS Fourth attempt. Begin with the same framing and movement as the fictional viral reference. She runs toward the fountain, jumps, rotates naturally, the skateboard rolls underneath at exactly the correct moment and she lands successfully. Keep the physics realistic. There is a brief moment of silence after landing. She looks at the camera completely shocked and says: “WAIT—WE GOT IT!” SCENE 7 — 0:18–0:22 — PERFECT RECREATION Hard match cut from the real successful attempt to the finished recreation. Reproduce the fictional viral video's composition, timing, camera movement, framing and stunt almost perfectly, but with the real creator and real environment. The viewer should immediately recognize that she has successfully recreated the original viral clip. SCENE 8 — 0:22–0:24 — COMEDIC PAYOFF Abruptly return to raw smartphone footage. The creator is lying exhausted on the grass, breathing heavily, hair slightly messy. She looks directly into the camera and says: “That took 37 takes.” Freeze frame for a fraction of a second with small text: “Never doing this again.” End abruptly with natural fountain ambience. VISUAL STYLE: Authentic smartphone UGC throughout the recreation attempts. Natural daylight, realistic skin texture, imperfect framing, subtle autofocus shifts, slight exposure changes, handheld micro-shake, occasional motion blur, realistic smartphone dynamic range and natural environmental colors. The opening fictional viral video may look cleaner and more polished, but the real-life recreation must feel genuinely captured by a friend on a phone. CAMERA: Smartphone camera, approximately 24–28mm equivalent. Selfie camera for dialogue, rear camera for stunt attempts. Handheld tracking, imperfect operator movement, occasional reframing, realistic autofocus and exposure behavior. No anamorphic cinematography, no commercial crane shots, no impossible camera movement. AUDIO: Natural creator dialogue, footsteps, skateboard wheels, fountain water, distant pedestrians and subtle environmental noise. Energetic social-media music underneath but keep dialogue clearly audible. Failed attempts should contain genuine reactions and natural laughter. EDITING: Extremely strong first two seconds. Rapid visual progression. Most beats last 2–3 seconds. Use punch-ins, abrupt cuts and match cuts rather than cinematic dissolves. The successful recreation must provide the strongest visual payoff. CONTINUITY: Same woman, same thick/curvy physique, same face, same hair, same clothing, same shoes, same skateboard, same fountain, same plaza and consistent daylight throughout all attempts. Do not change her body shape, face, wardrobe or proportions between shots. No duplicate people, duplicate skateboards or disappearing objects. REALISM: Believable human movement, realistic weight distribution, natural hair physics, realistic skateboard motion and contact with the ground, physically plausible jumping and landing. No superhero movement, floating, rubber limbs, distorted anatomy or impossible physics. AVOID: Glossy commercial advertising, excessive beauty retouching, artificial skin, perfect studio lighting, cinematic slow motion, excessive lens flares, fake-looking UGC, overacting, robotic dialogue, random wardrobe changes, location changes, distorted hands, extra fingers, duplicated objects, warped faces, inconsistent body proportions, text artifacts, watermarks and AI-looking motion. PRIMARY CREATIVE GOAL: The audience must first become curious about the viral stunt, then enjoy watching the creator fail repeatedly, and finally experience the satisfaction of seeing her successful recreation match the original viral video. The contrast between the impossibly perfect original and the messy real-life attempts is the central comedy.

entries.title: Korean Night Market Street Food Experience
entries.description: A detailed narrative prompt for a photorealistic video of a woman exploring a Korean night market, watching food being grilled, and enjoying a meal.
entries.prompt:
A Korean woman in her mid-20s walks naturally through a lively evening market filled with glowing food stalls, colorful signs, conversations, footsteps, sizzling grills, drifting steam, and a gentle summer breeze.

She notices a Korean BBQ-style stall and slows down to watch the vendor grill fresh meat and vegetables.  Realistic sizzling, smoke, steam, subtle flames, metal tongs, and natural food physics make the cooking feel completely real.

She smiles and says, “That smells so good.”

She chooses her food, receives the tray naturally, carefully carries it through the crowd, and finds an outdoor communal table. She pulls out a chair, sits down, places the tray on the table, and prepares for her first bite.

Using chopsticks, she picks up the freshly grilled food, pauses for the steam, takes a bite, and reacts with a genuine smile. 😋

“Perfect for a summer night.” 🌙

The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the glowing stalls, busy pedestrians, outdoor seating, drifting smoke, warm lights, and atmospheric Korean summer night.

🎥 Ultra-photorealistic | Cinematic documentary style | Natural handheld/gimbal movement | Realistic human biomechanics | Authentic Korean market atmosphere | Physically accurate objects, food, smoke, heat & crowd behavior | Natural dialogue & lip sync | Immersive ambient audio | 16:9

🚫 No AI look, robotic movement, teleportation, floating objects, distorted hands, extra fingers, foot sliding, duplicated people, unrealistic crowds, giant flames, excessive smoke, instant transitions, changing faces/outfits, impossible camera movement, text overlays, logos, or watermarks.

🎯 Sequence: Enter → notice grill → watch cooking → choose food → receive tray → walk → sit → first bite → genuine reaction → cinematic market reveal.

Priority: Every action must follow naturally from the previous one, with realistic gravity, weight, friction, momentum, balance, heat, airflow, and material interaction throughout.

entries.title: Anime-Inspired School Hallway Martial Arts Fight
entries.description: A prompt for a cinematic, photorealistic live-action scene of a lavender-haired schoolgirl involved in a high-tension hallway fight with martial arts movements and dynamic camera tracking.
entries.prompt:
Create a cinematic, photorealistic live-action anime-inspired school hallway fight scene.

A beautiful young Japanese/Korean schoolgirl with short pastel lavender-purple hair, wearing a small blue-and-white flower hair clip, stands in a bright but moody Japanese high-school corridor. She wears a traditional school uniform: light gray fitted blazer with dark piping, white shirt, large pale blue ribbon bow, dark navy pleated skirt, white knee-high socks and dark brown/black low-heeled school shoes. Several other female students in matching gray school uniforms are present in the background.

The scene begins with a close-up of the lavender-haired girl looking seriously and emotionally toward another female student standing in front of her. Natural daylight enters through large corridor windows, creating soft diffused cinematic lighting. The camera has a shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, natural facial expressions and subtle handheld movement.

The tension increases as the girls confront each other. Cut between medium shots, close-ups and dynamic over-the-shoulder shots. The lavender-haired girl reacts defensively and begins fighting another schoolgirl. Show realistic martial-arts-style movements, punches, blocks and kicks, with believable body mechanics and natural momentum.

At one point, show a low-angle close-up of several students' shoes rapidly moving across a slightly wet reflective school hallway floor. Water reflections and subtle splashes are visible as the characters move.

Continue with dynamic handheld tracking shots as the lavender-haired girl exchanges blows with the other student. Include a dramatic side kick and defensive movements. Background students watch the confrontation from a distance with surprised and concerned expressions.

The camera should move naturally with the action: close-up → medium shot → tracking shot → low-angle foot shot → wide hallway shot → close-up. Use realistic motion blur during fast movements while keeping faces and important details sharp.

The hallway should look authentic and lived-in: large windows, pale walls, wooden classroom doors, polished reflective floor, cool overcast daylight and a slightly dramatic atmosphere.

Near the end, the lavender-haired girl walks toward the camera after the confrontation. She looks directly into the lens with a serious, determined expression while the other schoolgirls remain blurred in the background.

Ultra-realistic live-action cinematography, photorealistic faces, realistic Japanese school environment, cinematic composition, natural skin pores, realistic fabric and hair movement, physically accurate shadows, soft overcast daylight, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, handheld camera, realistic motion blur, dramatic pacing, high-detail textures, 4K cinematic quality.

Aspect ratio: 16:9.
Duration: approximately 30 seconds.
Style: photorealistic cinematic live-action, realistic human movement, anime-inspired ch

entries.title: Ultra-Realistic Korean Morning Vlog
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a realistic 30-second handheld phone vlog featuring a young Korean woman in a rural market setting.
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary Sunday morning in the life of a young Korean woman. No reference image. MAIN SUBJECT Young Korean woman in her early 20s, natural and approachable look, realistic skin texture with visible pores, bare-faced or barely-there makeup, warm and slightly playful expression. Shoulder-length wavy black hair left down, side-swept bangs, small mole near her left eye. Wearing an oversized pastel-yellow hoodie, loose gray jogger pants, fuzzy slide sandals, and a small crossbody pouch bag. Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and appearance throughout the entire video. SETTING A small countryside town on a bright, breezy Sunday morning. A traditional outdoor market with striped awnings, crates of vegetables, a fishmonger's stall, an old bus stop with a rusted bench, a narrow road running alongside rice paddies, a local bakery with a hand-painted sign, a grandmother's front yard with drying red peppers on a mat, chickens wandering nearby, and mountains faintly visible in the background. Everything sun-bleached, dusty, and authentically rural. CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend, strong handheld vlog feel throughout. Constant natural hand shake and micro-jitters, footsteps visibly bouncing the frame, imperfect and often off-center framing, occasional partial crops of her face or shoulder, autofocus visibly hunting between her and the background, exposure flaring when the camera swings toward the sun, mild motion blur on quick turns, soft image detail, subtle digital noise, slightly warm and faded color grading like an old phone camera. The camera operator walks and jogs to keep up with her, breathing audible at times, camera dipping and swaying with each step. No stabilization, no gimbal smoothness, no cinematic camera movements, no dramatic lighting, no slow motion, no polished commercial appearance. The footage should feel like a real, unplanned phone recording — accidentally beautiful rather than deliberately cinematic. --- 00:00–00:05 — MARKET ENTRANCE She weaves through the outdoor market stalls, the camera bouncing behind her as it struggles to keep pace. She stops briefly to pick up a small bag of cherry tomatoes, holding them up toward the camera with a grin. The frame jolts as the operator steps over a crate in the path. **00:05–00:10 — FISH STALL DETOUR** She wanders to the fishmonger's stall, wrinkling her nose playfully at the smell and laughing. The camera whip-pans slightly too fast trying to follow her hand gesture, briefly blurring before catching focus again. She waves the camera away, still laughing: "Ugh, don't film that, film me!" **00:10–00:15 — BUS STOP WAIT** She jogs to catch the local bus stop bench just as an old bus pulls away without her, the camera shaking hard from the sudden running motion. She throws her hands up in mock frustration, plops down on the rusted bench, and sighs dramatically, laughing at herself. The frame settles slightly off-center as she rests her chin on her palm. **00:15–00:20 — RICE PADDY ROAD She walks along the narrow road beside the rice paddies, wind blowing loose strands across her face. The camera drifts low near her feet as she kicks a small pebble, then swings back up to her face, slightly overexposed from the open sky. She spins around once with her arms out, the frame swaying and overshooting past her before correcting. **00:20–00:25 — GRANDMOTHER'S YARD** She ducks into a yard where red peppers dry on a mat, crouching to gently shoo away a curious chicken pecking near her sandals. The camera jerks back suddenly as the chicken flaps its wings, both of them startled and laughing. She picks up a dried pepper, sniffs it, makes a face, and tosses it back down. **00:25–00:30 — FINAL MOMENT** She grabs a warm bag of fresh bread from the nearby bakery counter, takes a big bite, and turns straight to the camera mid-chew. The frame shakes as she leans in too close, filling half the screen with her grinning face. She says, muffled and amused: "Okay, stop filming me eating!" She swats the camera lens with her hand, and the footage cuts abruptly to black, mid-laugh. --- AUDIO Natural location sound only: Market chatter, footsteps crunching on gravel, a bus engine pulling away, wind, chickens clucking, rustling plastic bags, distant rooster crow, bread bag crinkling, the operator's breathing and quiet laughter, and audible handheld camera noise. No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects. Only the spoken lines: "Ugh, don't film that, film me!" and "Okay, stop filming me eating!" FINAL FEEL The entire video should feel like a chaotic, cheerful, completely unplanned Sunday morning caught on a friend's phone — bright, breezy, playful, and warmly nostalgic. No dramatic events. No exaggerated acting. No model poses. No cinematic hero shots. The realism should come from constant handheld imperfection, sun glare, dust, uneven pacing, real laughter, and moments that feel genuinely caught rather than staged.

entries.title: Rainy Night Collision Slow Motion
entries.description: A cinematic prompt featuring a rainy night scene where a collision leads to a dramatic slow-motion sequence of objects flying through the air.
entries.prompt:
Young Korean woman in her early 20s, natural appearance, black wavy hair loosely tied back, wearing the exact outfit, sunglasses and accessories from the reference images. Photorealistic skin, realistic anatomy, natural expressions and consistent identity throughout.

A rainy city street at night with wet asphalt, glowing street signs, puddle reflections, pedestrians in the distance and a stopped car with headlights. Authentic early-2000s handheld DV camcorder look: strong natural shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, soft digital texture, faded colors, exposure shifts and occasional accidental zooms.

She walks toward the camera holding a drink in one hand and an open flip phone against her ear, wearing the sunglasses. A man walking beside her accidentally clips her shoulder, causing the sunglasses, phone and drink to fly from her hands simultaneously.

The collision transitions naturally into dramatic slow motion. The sunglasses, phone and cup fly directly past the camera at different distances with realistic weight, momentum and wide-angle distortion. The drink visibly sloshes inside the cup as it spins. The camera struggles to follow each object, continuously shifting focus as they pass close to the lens.

The action returns to normal speed as the objects land on the wet street. She looks down at the mess, then toward the camera with a stunned expression.

Realistic physics, believable human movement, natural object trajectories, authentic liquid behavior, cinematic night lighting and photorealistic Seedance 2.5 quality. No teleportation, morphing, duplicated objects, floating objects or CGI-looking motion.

entries.title: Continuous Sci-Fi Fight Sequence
entries.description: A continuous shot cinematic sci-fi action prompt featuring a Korean hero with a gravity blade in a neon alley, emphasizing physics and visual consistency.
entries.prompt:
One continuous shot. The young Korean man, same matte-black combat suit, same blue-glowing gravity blade, same three black armored robots, and the same rain-soaked neon alley remain unchanged throughout. No teleporting, no position resets, no sudden costume/weapon changes, no jump cuts.

0–3 sec: The man walks slowly forward through the neon alley while the three robots approach him from ahead. Camera: smooth backward tracking at chest height, keeping him centered. Rain falls naturally and blue blade light reflects on the wet ground.

3–6 sec: Without cutting, the robots charge. He stops, plants his left foot, and swings the blade horizontally. A blue gravity wave expands directly from the blade toward the closest robot. Camera: smoothly circles from his front-left to his side, following the same movement.

6–9 sec: The gravity wave hits the first robot and throws it sideways into the wall; the other two lose balance and become partially weightless. The man remains exactly where he finished the swing. Camera: continues the same orbit and reveals the robots floating around him.

9–12 sec: One robot recovers and jumps toward him. He raises the same blade upward and reverses its gravity, pulling the attacker sharply toward the ceiling while the other robot remains suspended behind him. Camera: smoothly tilts upward with the robot, then follows the blade back down to the hero.

12–15 sec: The man lowers the blade and releases the gravity field. The floating robots and loose debris fall naturally to the ground around him. He remains standing in the same position as rain continues falling. Camera: slowly pushes toward his face as the blue glow of the blade fades slightly.

Visual style: continuous cinematic sci-fi action, anime-inspired but original, realistic physics, detailed mechanical robots, rain, neon reflections, volumetric fog, natural motion blur and smooth camera choreography. No cuts, no scene changes, no teleportation, no sudden jumps in character position.

entries.title: Nostalgic Winter Snow Home Video
entries.description: A 15-second nostalgic home-video prompt using MiniDV aesthetics to capture a spontaneous moment of a woman discovering snow.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic home-video captured on an old consumer DV camcorder. The scene should feel spontaneous, intimate, nostalgic, and genuinely recorded rather than professionally filmed.

### CAMERA

Old DV camcorder aesthetic, handheld POV. The woman occasionally holds the camera herself, with natural hand shake, imperfect framing, slight motion blur, delayed autofocus, exposure pumping, awkward zooms, occasional framing mistakes, and subtle tape artifacts. The camcorder itself is never visible.

### VISUAL LOOK

Soft slightly blurry MiniDV/16mm-tape-like image quality, faint analog noise, subtle grain, muted contrast, realistic skin texture, naturally bloomed highlights, imperfect white balance, and low-light DV characteristics.

Late-morning winter light inside the apartment transitions to cool overcast daylight outside. Keep the lighting natural and slightly imperfect.

### CHARACTER

A Korean woman in her 20s with long straight black hair, naturally slightly messy, realistic dewy skin, minimal makeup, large expressive eyes, and a relaxed natural appearance.

She wears a comfortable oversized cream-colored sweater, loose pants, and simple socks indoors. Before going outside, she quickly puts on a dark winter coat and scarf.

Maintain identical facial features, hairstyle, body proportions, and clothing continuity throughout.

### STORY — 15 SECONDS

**0–3 SECONDS — BEDROOM**

Handheld POV.

She is sitting lazily on her bed in the late morning, looking at her phone.

Something catches her attention.

She suddenly looks toward the window.

A few tiny white snowflakes are visible outside.

Her expression changes from bored to surprised.

She immediately gets up.

**VOICEOVER:**
*"Wait... is it actually snowing?"*

---

**3–6 SECONDS — WINDOW**

She quickly walks toward the window.

The camera follows shakily behind her.

She pulls the curtain open.

Outside, snow is now clearly falling over the quiet city.

She leans closer to the glass, smiling in disbelief.

The autofocus briefly struggles between her face and the snowy background.

**NO VOICEOVER.**

Only soft room ambience and faint distant city sounds.

---

**6–9 SECONDS — GETTING READY**

Fast but natural handheld sequence.

She grabs her coat from a chair, quickly puts it on, wraps a scarf around her neck, and slips on her shoes.

She briefly looks toward the camera with an excited smile before rushing toward the door.

Do not make this montage overly polished — preserve the awkward, spontaneous DV-camera movement.

---

**9–12 SECONDS — OUTSIDE**

The apartment door opens.

She steps outside into the cold afternoon.

The camera follows her onto the sidewalk.

Snow is falling more heavily now.

She stops walking and looks upward.

Her hair and coat move slightly in the cold wind.

She reaches one hand out and catches a few snowflakes.

---

**12–15 SECONDS — SNOW**

Close handheld shot from slightly below.

She looks directly upward as snow

entries.title: Anime Webtoon Sandwich Cooking Video
entries.description: A detailed 15-second anime-style cooking prompt featuring a young woman preparing a sourdough sandwich in a sunlit rustic kitchen.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second cinematic anime/webtoon cooking video featuring a cheerful young woman with short dark hair, wearing a cream apron over a sage-green shirt, cooking in a bright rustic kitchen with wooden counters, hanging plants, and warm morning sunlight.

Scene 1 — 0–3s: Close-up of her spreading garlic butter and pesto onto two slices of crispy toasted sourdough, with smooth, satisfying hand movements.

Scene 2 — 3–6s: Medium shot as she happily layers lettuce, juicy tomato, melted cheese, crispy chicken, and avocado onto the toast using wooden tongs.

Scene 3 — 6–9s: Close-up of a sunny-side-up egg sliding from a small skillet onto the towering sandwich, followed by her placing the second toast slice on top.

Scene 4 — 9–12s: Dynamic close-up as she cuts the sandwich diagonally with a chef’s knife; cheese stretches slightly as she lifts both halves toward the camera, revealing the colorful layers.

Scene 5 — 12–15s: Cozy medium close-up as she takes a huge bite, closes her eyes, and smiles with a delighted expression while warm sunlight fills the kitchen.

Style: High-quality 2D anime/webtoon aesthetic, expressive character animation, clean line art, soft pastel colors, warm cinematic lighting, cozy atmosphere, detailed food textures, smooth camera movements, appetizing close-ups, natural motion, consistent character design.

entries.title: Cheek Squish Selfie Micro-Expression Video
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a vertical close-up video of a girl reacting to her cheek being poked, focusing on subtle facial expressions, character consistency, and realistic interaction.
entries.prompt: Generate a 12-second, 9:16 vertical, live-action extreme close-up selfie micro-expression video. 【Character Lock｜Highest Priority】 Strictly use the girl in the reference image as the only person throughout the entire video. Maintain exactly the same face shape, facial feature proportions, gray-blue eyes, long straight black hair, bangs, makeup, skin tone and perceived age throughout. Keep the white fluffy cat-ear hair accessories, white bow decoration and white collar from the reference image, with a silver heart-shaped metal ring in the center of the collar. Do not change the face shape. Do not swap faces. Do not change the hairstyle. Do not change the cat-ear color. Do not change the collar color. Do not suddenly add or remove accessories. 【Overall Visuals】 9:16 vertical, extreme close-up selfie framing with a phone's front-facing camera. The person always faces the camera directly, with the face occupying most of the frame, fully visible from the cat ears to around the collarbones. The camera remains fixed, with no cuts, no zooming, no rotation. Keep the background as a simple blurred dark gray-black background. Soft frontal lighting, with the face bright and clear, and natural catchlights in the gray-blue eyes. Skin should be delicate but retain slight realistic texture, no plastic-looking skin. There is no speaking and no voiceover throughout the entire video, with all the charm conveyed entirely through micro-expressions of the eyes, eyebrows, lips and cheeks. 【0–1.5 seconds｜Quietly Looking at the Camera】 The girl quietly looks directly at the camera. Her expression is slightly adorably blank. Her lips are naturally relaxed. She gently blinks once. Then her eyes shift slightly to the right, before looking back at the camera. As if waiting for something to happen. 【1.5–3 seconds｜Finger Pokes Cheek for the First Time】 One finger naturally enters from the lower right of the frame. Note that only one hand, and only one index finger, participates in the interaction. The index finger slowly approaches the girl's right cheek, then gently pokes into it. At the moment of contact, the soft cheek forms a small, realistic indentation. At first, the girl does not move her head. Her eyes immediately glance sideways, looking at the finger poking her. Pause for about 0.3 seconds. Then her brows furrow very slightly. Her lips gently press together. With an expression like: “Hm?” 【3–4.5 seconds｜Starting to Look Annoyed】 The finger releases. After a very short interval, it gently pokes the cheek again. This time the girl reacts immediately. Her brows furrow slightly. Her nose wrinkles gently once. Her eyes narrow slightly. One corner of her mouth turns very slightly to one side. Then she slowly shifts her gaze from the finger back to the camera. Staring at the camera for about 0.5 seconds. Creating a restrained, helpless feeling of: “Are you really that bored?” Do not make her exaggeratedly angry. 【4.5–6.5 seconds｜Puffing Cheeks】 The girl suddenly takes a gentle breath in. Her lips close tightly. Both cheeks slowly and naturally puff up. The entire process must visibly show the cheeks gradually expanding, rather than the face shape suddenly becoming larger. After puffing up her cheeks, she maintains direct eye contact with the camera. Her brows remain slightly furrowed. Her eyes open just a little wider. Creating a cute sulking expression. At this point, the index finger gently presses one of the puffed-up cheeks again. The pressed area forms a soft, realistic indentation. The other cheek remains puffed up. 【6.5–8 seconds｜Completely Helpless】 The girl is still trying hard to hold her breath. Her eyes first look toward the finger pressing her cheek. Then her eyes slowly move upward. She gives a very slight, restrained little eye roll. Do not show a large amount of the whites of her eyes. Then she closes her eyes for about 0.3 seconds. Her brows remain slightly furrowed. After reopening her eyes, one eyebrow is raised while the other is lowered. The corners of her mouth turn gently downward. As if saying: “Fine……” Her head barely moves throughout the entire process. Everything is conveyed through the eyes, eyebrows and mouth. 【8–9.5 seconds｜Deflating】 The index finger gently pokes the puffed-up cheek once again. The girl finally cannot hold it anymore. Her puffed-up cheeks slowly deflate and return to normal. Her lips part slightly. She naturally exhales a breath. Then she tilts her head very slightly. One corner of her mouth turns to the side. She looks at the camera with half-narrowed eyes. Showing an obvious but very cute sense of speechlessness. 【9.5–10.8 seconds｜Thinking It's Over】 The finger completely exits the frame. The girl's face returns to its normal shape. She looks directly at the camera again. Her brows slowly relax. She gently blinks once. The corners of her mouth are just about to form the slightest smile. Her whole demeanor looks as if she has finally relaxed. 【10.8–12 seconds｜Here It Comes Again】 Just as the girl has returned to normal, that index finger suddenly approaches slowly again from the right side of the frame. The girl notices the finger in her peripheral vision. Her eyes instantly glance sideways at it. Pause for about 0.2 seconds. Then she immediately furrows her brows. Her lips press tightly together. Her eyes slowly return to the camera. Finally revealing an extremely helpless “why are you back again” expression. Hold this expression for the final 0.5 seconds as the ending. 【Micro-Expression Focus】 The entire video must form a continuous emotional progression: Adorably blank waiting → noticing the finger → cheek gently poked → confusion → slight brow furrow → poked again → mild annoyance → puffing cheeks in a sulk → finger continues poking the puffed-up cheek → looking at the finger → restrained little eye roll → closing eyes helplessly → deflating → tilting head and pursing mouth to the side → returning to normal → thinking it's finally over → finger appears again → instantly speechless. 【Action Realism｜Very Important】 All expression changes must be subtle, continuous, natural. No cartoon expressions. No exaggerated funny faces. Do not suddenly widen the eyes. Do not exaggerate the eye roll. Do not shake the head dramatically. Do not open the mouth widely. Focus on realistic human micro-expressions: Slight eyebrow movements, natural eye movements, gentle narrowing of the eyelids, subtle changes in the nostrils, tiny changes at the corners of the mouth, realistic cheek puffing and deflating. The finger must make realistic contact with the skin. When poking the cheek, the skin must naturally indent with the pressure, and immediately rebound naturally after the finger leaves. Only one hand may appear throughout. The hand must always enter from the right side or lower right of the frame. NO extra hands. NO extra fingers. NO deformed fingers. NO finger penetrating skin. NO face morphing. NO identity change. NO hairstyle change. NO accessory change. NO camera cuts. NO subtitles. NO text. NO watermark.

entries.title: Japanese Summer Slice-of-Life
entries.description: A nostalgic and peaceful prompt for an ultra-realistic video of a young woman enjoying a popsicle in a quiet Japanese neighborhood at dusk.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic slice-of-life video set in a peaceful Japanese residential neighborhood during a warm summer evening.
Main subject: A young Japanese woman in her early 20s, natural appearance, shoulder-length dark hair with soft bangs, wearing an oversized off-white T-shirt, relaxed light-wash jeans, and clean white sneakers. She sits casually on a low concrete wall beside a leafy garden, holding a bright blue popsicle.

Action & movement:
She slowly enjoys the popsicle while looking down the quiet residential street. A gentle summer breeze moves her hair and the surrounding leaves. In the background, a few neighborhood children casually walk and play together, adding subtle life to the scene. She briefly looks toward them with a small, natural smile, then takes another bite of the popsicle.

Environment: Authentic Japanese suburban street, traditional houses, concrete block walls, utility poles, narrow asphalt road, lush greenery, small colorful flowers, drainage gutters, bicycles and subtle everyday details. Everything should feel lived-in and naturally imperfect.

Camera: Slow, cinematic handheld push-in from a medium-wide shot toward the woman. Very subtle natural handheld movement, shallow depth of field, realistic focus breathing, occasional background blur, no dramatic camera movement.

Lighting: Warm golden-hour sunlight filtering through the trees, soft highlights on her face and hair, gentle shadows, realistic atmospheric haze, natural summer warmth.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic Japanese slice-of-life cinematography, nostalgic summer atmosphere, natural skin texture, realistic fabric and foliage movement, subtle film grain, soft cinematic contrast, authentic colors, 4K detail.

Mood: Peaceful, nostalgic, innocent, cozy — like a fleeting childhood summer memory.

Audio: Natural neighborhood ambience — distant children talking, birds, soft wind through leaves, faint cicadas, occasional footsteps and subtle street sounds. No music.

Important: Keep character appearance, clothing, environment and lighting consistent throughout. Natural human movement only. No exaggerated expressions, no artificial motion, no warped hands, no extra fingers, no flickering, no text, no subtitles, no logos.

Keep the same Paris street, lighting, film grain and color grade from the reference image in every shot. Multi-shot sequence, slow elegant camera, no text, no logos, no modern cars, no phones. Shot 1: Vincent van Gogh, red hair and beard, pale blue 1880s three-piece suit, walks toward camera on the cobblestone street. Medium full shot, then a quick closer pass as he walks by. Shot 2: A young 19th-century Parisian woman in an off-shoulder teal silk ballgown with a rose on her shoulder walks toward camera down the same street. Shot 3: On a Paris stone bridge, a balding man in a black overcoat, white shirt, red tie and black bowler hat holds a green apple. Slow side tracking shot. Shot 4: The American Gothic couple standing in the same Paris street: thin balding farmer with round glasses holding a pitchfork, woman in a brown 1930s dress with white collar, both looking at camera, serious faces. Shot 5: Close profile of the Girl with a Pearl Earring as a real young woman: blue and yellow turban, large pearl earring, mustard jacket, looking over her shoulder on the Paris bridge. Shot 6: A pale young woman with long curly red hair in a simple long white dress walks toward camera on the cobblestone street, wind in her hair. End on a tight close-up of her face looking into the lens. Cinematic film look, natural walking, realistic cloth and hair, subtle background pedestrians in period clothing. Soft orchestral period atmosphere. 20 to 25 seconds. Use the reference image as the look and location. Photorealistic vertical 9:16 video. Vincent van Gogh with red beard and pale blue 1880s suit walks toward camera on a cobblestone Paris street. Cinematic slow push-in, overcast light, film look, realistic walking, no text.

entries.title: Aria Vale Summer K-Pop Vlog
entries.description: A fresh summer morning vlog prompt for a K-pop idol character, showing a cozy bedroom scene with realistic lighting and a natural off-duty aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
Create the first frame for a 30-second horizontal 16:9 realistic summer K-pop member daily vlog.

Scene:
A bright cozy bedroom in summer morning. Printed silk bedsheets slightly messy, pale wood floor, sheer curtains glowing with sunlight, small bedside table with a phone, lip balm, wireless earbuds, a folded towel, and a cream tote bag on a chair. A soft blue sky is visible through the window. The room feels lived-in, clean, warm, and personal.

Main subject:
Aria Vale sits on the edge of the bed, holding her phone in one hand like she is starting a vlog. Her shoulder-length dark brown hair is slightly messy from sleep but cute and natural. She wears a soft white cropped cardigan over a pale blue fitted tank top, light washed high-waist denim shorts, white crew socks, and clean white sneakers placed nearby on the floor.

Opening action:
She looks into the phone camera with a sleepy small smile, one hand lightly smoothing her hair. The tote bag and dance towel are visible nearby, hinting that she is about to go to dance practice.

Composition:
Horizontal 16:9, casual selfie-vlog feeling mixed with a stable bedroom shot. Medium-wide framing, natural morning light, soft shadows, realistic depth of field. The frame should feel like a real K-pop member’s off-duty summer vlog.

Lighting:
Warm summer morning sunlight through sheer curtains, soft highlights on skin and hair, gentle shadows, airy bright room.

Mood:
Fresh summer morning, casual personal vlog, quiet and intimate, the start of a day that leads to coffee and dance practice. No text, no subtitles, no watermark

entries.title: Cinematic Cat Chase Tracking Shot
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for a 20-second continuous tracking shot of a cat navigating urban obstacles with realistic lighting and motion physics.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic animal chase scene. One seamless 20-second continuous tracking shot. Camera stays low and fast, following closely behind and beside the cat with smooth gimbal energy, subtle handheld vibration, fast lateral adjustments and brief speed ramps. Bright late-afternoon city light, warm reflections, realistic motion blur, premium live-action realism, stylish but grounded.

Main subject: one sleek agile city cat, short fur, highly expressive body language, explosive speed, realistic feline movement, sharp reflexes, natural anatomy.
Dense urban street environment with narrow sidewalks, parked bicycles, café chairs, delivery crates, street bollards, puddles, stair steps, alley entrances and passing pedestrians in the background.

0-5s: Low tracking shot behind the cat
The cat bursts forward at full speed along the sidewalk. The camera races just behind it, inches above the ground. It darts past shoes, table legs and a bicycle wheel, tail steady, paws hitting pavement with rapid precision.
5-10s: Side tracking with slight orbit
The cat cuts sharply left into a narrow alley, rebounds off a low ledge, leaps over stacked crates, squeezes between two bollards and lands cleanly without losing speed. The camera glides beside it, matching every move.
10-15s: Aggressive follow shot
It explodes back into the main street, slides under a bench, jumps across a puddle, runs along a low wall for two steps, then drops down and slaloms between café chairs and pedestrians with elegant near-miss precision.
15-20s: Hero tracking finish
The cat accelerates into one final sprint, vaults onto a parked scooter seat, springs from it to a windowsill, then lands on a high ledge and stops for one beat, looking back toward the camera as the city rush settles behind it.

Photorealistic cat anatomy, realistic sprinting and jumping physics, strong sense of speed, clean tracking continuity, precise obstacle navigation, premium urban detail, stylish near-miss choreography, natural feline balance, no cuts, no cartoon motion.

entries.title: Nostalgic 2000s Seoul Pool Vlog
entries.description: A detailed prompt designed to recreate the look of early-2000s MiniDV camcorder footage of friends hanging out at a public pool in Seoul.
entries.prompt:
Main Subjects: Three Korean university friends, early 20s, natural everyday appearances, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup. Friend 1: long black hair in a messy ponytail, wearing a yellow sleeveless athletic top, navy swim shorts, and white sandals. Friend 2: short dark hair, wearing a faded blue T-shirt, black swim shorts, and rubber sandals. Friend 3: shoulder-length brown-black hair, wearing a loose white T-shirt over a simple one-piece swimsuit and black sandals. Maintain consistent identities, clothing, hairstyles, and appearance throughout.

Location: Small public outdoor swimming pool in Seoul during a hot summer afternoon. Old concrete pool deck, blue tiled pool, metal railings, plastic chairs, faded Korean safety signs, changing-room building, umbrellas, trees, and a few local families. Authentic early-2000s atmosphere.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Candid friendship, spontaneous laughter, natural body language, realistic water movement and sunlight.

Camera Style: Early-2000s Sony MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting between faces and bright water, exposure pumping in direct sunlight, faded colors, soft contrast, slight motion blur, DV compression artifacts, mild sensor noise, no stabilization.

00:00–00:03
The three friends walk onto the pool deck carrying towels and plastic bags. One friend immediately shields her eyes from the bright sun.

00:03–00:06
They sit at the pool edge with their feet in the water, chatting and laughing. Friend 1 suddenly splashes water toward the others.

00:06–00:09
Everyone reacts with laughter as the friends splash each other. The camera shakes heavily while trying to follow the action.

00:09–00:12
They climb out and sit beneath a large umbrella, drinking cold canned beverages and drying their hair with towels.

00:12–00:15
Friend 2 notices the camcorder and playfully points at it. All three wave and laugh as the operator backs away, accidentally tilting toward the bright sky before abruptly cutting to black.

Audio: Natural ambience only–water splashing, children laughing, pool echoes, footsteps, distant conversations, birds, vending-machine hum, towels rustling, and summer wind. No music. No narration.

Goal: A forgotten MiniDV home video from 2004, capturing a carefree summer afternoon with university friends at an ordinary Seoul public pool–messy, youthful, warm, nostalgic, and completely believable.

entries.title: Cinematic Commercial Aircraft Cockpit Experience
entries.description: A multi-stage prompt for Seedance 2.5 using a reference image to create a professional 20-second cinematic sequence inside a commercial aircraft cockpit.
entries.prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE: Use the uploaded cockpit photo as the exact visual reference. Preserve the woman’s appearance, hairstyle, sunglasses, clothing, cockpit layout, controls, seats, lighting, and overall realism. Create a believable cinematic moment inside a real commercial aircraft cockpit.

🎬 MASTER PROMPT — 20 SECONDS

Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic 20-second image-to-video sequence using the reference image. The woman is seated in the cockpit of a modern commercial passenger aircraft, surrounded by authentic flight controls, instrument panels, overhead switches, navigation displays, cockpit windows, and pilot seating.

The video should feel like real footage captured by a professional aviation videographer, NOT an AI animation.

0–3 SEC — STOP-SCROLL HOOK

Begin exactly from the reference composition. The camera makes a slow, realistic push-in toward the woman as bright sunlight pours through the cockpit windshield. She calmly reaches toward the instrument panel while looking forward.

Add subtle natural movement: blinking, breathing, tiny hand movements, realistic hair movement, reflections on her sunglasses, and gentle vibration of the aircraft.

3–7 SEC — COCKPIT REVEAL

The camera smoothly moves from her side toward the instrument panel, revealing the incredible density of authentic cockpit controls.

Focus briefly on:

- illuminated flight displays
- switches and knobs
- throttle/control area
- navigation instruments
- overhead control panel
- realistic warning and indicator lights

Use shallow depth of field and cinematic rack focus between her hand and the instruments.

7–11 SEC — THE WOW MOMENT

Cut to a dramatic over-the-shoulder angle looking toward the windshield.

Outside, reveal an incredible high-altitude sky above a sea of soft white clouds, with golden sunlight illuminating the cockpit.

The woman turns slightly toward the camera and gives a subtle confident smile/thumbs-up, creating the feeling of an unforgettable aviation experience.

Keep everything physically realistic and grounded.

11–15 SEC — CINEMATIC FLIGHT SHOT

The camera gently arcs around her seat, revealing the full cockpit environment from a wider perspective.

Sunlight creates realistic reflections across the windshield and instrument panels. Tiny vibrations, realistic shadows, fabric movement, and natural lens reflections make the scene feel genuinely filmed inside a moving aircraft.

No exaggerated turbulence.

15–18 SEC — HERO SHOT

Return to a beautiful cinematic profile of the woman.

She looks toward the windshield, then briefly toward the camera.

The aircraft cruises smoothly above the clouds while warm sunlight creates a spectacular golden-hour aviation atmosphere.

The moment should feel inspiring, luxurious, adventurous, and authentic.

18–20 SEC — VIRAL ENDING / LOOP

Camera slowly pushes toward the cockpit windshield.

The bright sky and clouds fill the frame.

Just before the video ends, smooth

entries.prompt: CHARACTER A 是“余烬守望者”：原创明确成年男性型人形战士，精瘦运动体格，charcoal-black／黑曜石质感面部，狭长 amber-orange 发光眼，短而向后扫的黑色尖刺形成 crown-like 轮廓；穿贴身不对称炭黑装甲、深色分层织物、加固战靴、撕裂肩缘，一件鲜明 crimson mantle 稳固连接在上背。双手、前臂与胸骨只在攻击前后出现受控 red-orange ember glow；嘴部结构稳定，可做无台词的发力怒吼。身体比例、脸部、装甲、披风长度和发光位置全程不变。 CHARACTER B 是“沙丘亡魂”：原创明确成年超自然巨人，约 CHARACTER A 两倍高度，宽厚沉重体型，原创侵蚀骨石面具与深空眼窝，大型 weathered hood，gray-black 分层长袍、绳索状破布、细长爪手，躯体部分由压实黑沙组成。始终携带同一把长暗色 polearm，前端为原创宽阔 crescent blade；长度、刀刃方向、双手抓握关系必须稳定。它可以崩解和由黑沙重组，但全程只有一个，绝不复制。 两名角色完全独立，身份、轮廓、肢体、武器关系始终清晰，绝不融合、换脸、共享肢体、多手、多头或武器漂浮。 风格：原生16:9，精确30.00秒，30fps，stylized-photoreal 3D CGI dark-fantasy，premium AAA game-cinematic 渲染，anime-influenced 超人动作节奏但绝不是 anime line art、cel shading、2.5D 或真人 环境为空旷 pale-gold 沙丘，cream-amber 雾霾天空，无建筑、植物、观众。暖低角度逆光勾边，阴影保持暖棕。持续横风推动布料与沙尘。深体积尘雾、局部余烬、黑沙颗粒、克制 anamorphic bloom、暖 halation 和细电影颗粒。大多数战斗极快自然时间，冲刺、披风、武器和 whip 有强方向运动模糊；接触姿态必须瞬间清晰。仅在高空跃起、巨人重击反冲、终结踢接触和大规模黑沙爆发处做极短局部时间延展，绝不全片慢动作。 镜头规则：一个连续镜头，无剪切，无跳切，精确30秒。摄影机以低位侧面、背侧、近距离反应式跟拍为主，利用沙尘遮镜、crimson mantle 横扫镜头、武器擦框和 whip-pan 制造“七段镜头感”，但摄影机轨迹必须真实连续。禁止英雄角度、胜利摆拍、正面戏剧脸部特写和干净稳定宣传构图；只有23秒后短暂稳定正面宽景用于动作可读性。 0.00-3.70秒：低位 Dutch-angle 贴沙追拍，巨人在中右横扫 crescent polearm。A 从左侧压低身体冲向右侧，武器与脚步同时切开沙丘；0.70-1.10秒浓沙完全吞没镜头，但摄影机继续穿过。A 从尘墙中几乎水平爆出，肩先行、双臂收紧、crimson mantle 被拉到后上方，胸口与手边点亮余烬。他高速弧线绕过巨人，镜头拼命侧后跟随，末端披风扫满镜头形成红橙运动遮挡。 3.70-7.90秒：遮挡退开后自然进入低侧中宽景。巨人水平持 polearm，A 双手抵住杆身，屈膝向后抗住巨大重量；随后一脚踩杆，另一腿发力上跃，沿杆身翻越，披风延迟扬起。他落入武器内圈并钻过杆下，从宽稳站姿完成三次分离攻击：短右拳打下肋、左拳打胸骨、强右 cross 打上躯干。每拳严格“接近→实体接触→局部橙火花→收回”，巨人逐次后摇并掉下少量黑砂碎片。 7.90-12.80秒：A 顺势压低蹲上水平 polearm，crescent blade 留在左侧，巨人在右端支撑。双膝压缩后垂直弹起，摄影机仰跟；约8.30-9.55秒极短局部时间延展，双膝收向躯干，披风像沉重布翼铺开，布料仍持续运动。恢复自然速度后，A 落在巨人左侧深蹲，双靴把沙推开，立即冲回。巨人抬杆完成重型上斜 counter-swing 并同时砸地产生砂石爆压，A 被动量打成向后空翻。摄影机侧跟旋转与飞砂；他双手和一膝落地，拖腿划沙，滚过惯性，站起再次冲锋。 12.80-16.85秒：摄影机贴入胸高侧面中近景，A 连续完成右直拳胸口、左拳肋下、短右 hook 上胸、左击肩下、强右 cross 胸骨，再补两次紧凑交替打击。每只拳头独立起手、接触、收回；只有接触帧产生余烬爆点。肩髋旋转正确，巨人躯干逐次后摇，hood 与robes 有重量滞后，小黑碎屑持续脱落，骨石面具稳定不融化。最后发光一击借披风和沙雾遮镜进入下一阶段。 16.85-23.05秒：巨人被最后一拳扭身后，用巨大爪臂横扫 A 上胸与头侧。接触瞬间只出现用户指定的少量 non-graphic dark-red ember mist，从颈后被风带散；无开放伤口。短暂减速突出 recoil：A 头部后甩、胸口打开、双臂散开、双靴仍压地滑出两道槽；巨人手臂完成完整 follow-through。立刻恢复自然速度。A 降低重心切入内圈，短 forearm 撞躯干，右膝顶腹，落膝后以支撑脚为轴卷髋，跃起旋转；约21.10秒一记 spinning side kick 清楚命中上躯干，接触点只短暂强调。巨人从受击侧开始裂解成黑沙与撕裂布料，崩解跨过胸腹直至全身，侧倒成颗粒云。A 弯膝落地，手臂张开只为平衡，不做英雄停姿，随后谨慎向低矮黑沙堆迈步。 23.05-27.40秒：摄影机随A移动到较稳定正面宽景。A 在残骸前双脚分开，两手发光举过头顶，仅作为攻击预备，不作胜利摆拍；约24.75秒髋膝突然折叠，双掌砸入残骸 and 周围沙面。黑沙从背后径向爆开成多层不规则 particle sheets，视觉像暗色翼状扩散但绝不是实体翅膀；重颗粒先起，细沙形成圆形地面 shockwave。仅对此扩张做轻微局部时间延展。A 保持低蹲，随后边观察边缓慢起身，黑粒持续落在靴边；此时看不到完整巨人。 27.40-30.00秒：摄影机从A右侧肩后贴近，但不做正面脸部特写；画面右侧主要是下半张脸、张开的嘴与右肩，他面向前方做一次无语言发力胜吼，仍有黑沙漂浮。其左肩后

entries.title: Sci-Fi Time Pause Parking Lot
entries.description: A cinematic sci-fi prompt featuring a time-freeze effect in a parking lot triggered by a smartphone interface.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic sci-fi sequence set in an open-air parking lot at night. Use photorealistic humans, natural skin texture, realistic facial expressions, physically accurate lighting, realistic shadows, cinematic depth of field, subtle film grain, and Hollywood-level visual quality. Maintain perfect character and environment consistency throughout.

0–5 sec — Intro:
A young man stands alone in a quiet parking lot at night, holding a smartphone. A woman walks naturally across the parking lot in the background. The camera slowly pushes toward the man as he notices her. His phone suddenly displays a mysterious “TIME PAUSE” interface.

5–10 sec — Activation:
Extreme close-up of the smartphone. The man presses the pause button. A subtle energy wave moves through the environment. Instantly, the woman, cars, pedestrians, dust, and everything around him freeze completely. Hair and small particles remain suspended naturally in mid-air.

10–16 sec — Time Freeze:
The camera smoothly performs a 180° cinematic orbit around the man. The entire parking lot is frozen while he remains the only moving person. Frozen cars, headlights, dust particles and pedestrians create an eerie, believable suspended-time effect.

16–22 sec — Interaction:
The man walks toward the frozen woman. Use a smooth tracking shot followed by a medium close-up. He slowly raises his hand and gently touches her nose/cheek while she remains completely frozen. Capture realistic skin texture, reflections and subtle cinematic lighting.

22–26 sec — Time Resumes:
He quickly steps back and presses the phone again. Time instantly resumes. Hair moves, dust falls, cars continue driving and background sounds return naturally with a powerful cinematic impact.

26–30 sec — Twist Ending:
The woman suddenly looks at him, confused. She blinks and naturally says, “What happened?” The man looks shocked. End with a dramatic close-up of the phone showing the TIME PAUSE interface.

Visual direction: Ultra-realistic, photorealistic, cinematic 4K/8K detail, realistic human anatomy, natural movement, realistic nighttime lighting, volumetric atmosphere, accurate reflections, subtle motion blur, shallow depth of field, seamless camera transitions, consistent characters, realistic physics, premium Hollywood sci-fi thriller aesthetic. No cartoon appearance, no CGI-looking faces, no distorted anatomy, no extra fingers, no character morphing, no flickering, no subtitles or unwanted text.

entries.title: Korean Neighborhood Summer Camcorder Footage
entries.description: A prompt designed to evoke a nostalgic, intimate home video feel of a summer afternoon in an ordinary Korean residential neighborhood.
entries.prompt:
MAIN SUBJECT
Young Korean woman in her early 20s, naturally attractive, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, relaxed and approachable personality. Long dark hair loosely tied into a messy side ponytail, natural facial expressions. Wearing a fitted pastel-blue short top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers, and a simple silver necklace. Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and overall appearance throughout.

LOCATION
A quiet older Korean residential neighborhood during a warm summer afternoon. Narrow concrete lanes, low-rise homes, small gardens, bicycles, potted plants, utility poles, overhead wires, old staircases and a small neighborhood fruit stand. No tourist attractions, advertisements, recognizable brands, crowds, or commercial activity.

CAMERA / VISUAL STYLE
Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend on an early-2000s consumer camcorder. Natural handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, slight motion blur, faded colors, soft image detail, mild digital noise and occasional accidental zooms. No stabilization, gimbal movement, drone shots or polished commercial cinematography.

— BALCONY
She steps onto a small balcony carrying a watering can. She waters several potted plants, notices a tiny cat near the doorway and smiles. She crouches down and gently pets it before heading downstairs.

— NEIGHBORHOOD WALK
She walks through the narrow lane carrying a small reusable bag. A neighbor sitting outside calls her name. She stops, chats casually for a moment and laughs before continuing.

— FRUIT STAND
She stops at a tiny roadside fruit stand and chooses a peach. She takes a bite immediately and smiles at the camera. She wipes her hand and continues walking.

— UNEXPECTED MOMENT
A little neighborhood dog runs past and bumps into her shopping bag. She catches it before anything falls, laughs and watches the dog run away. She looks toward the camcorder with an amused expression.

00:20–00:25 — QUIET STREET
She continues walking beneath large trees. A gentle breeze moves her hair and clothes. She stops beside a low concrete wall, finishes the peach and quietly watches the street.

00:25–00:30 — FINAL MOMENT
She gets up and starts walking home. After a few steps she turns toward the camera, smiles and says, “See you tomorrow.” She turns back and continues down the lane while the camera follows shakily. The recording suddenly cuts to black.

AUDIO: Natural environmental audio only — birds, insects, footsteps, distant scooters, bicycle bells, wind through trees, neighborhood conversations, dog sounds, fruit stand sounds and subtle camera-handling noise. No music, narration or soundtrack.

FINAL FEEL: A forgotten recording of an ordinary summer afternoon — warm, intimate, nostalgic, slightly imperfect and spontaneous. No posing, exaggerated reactions o

entries.title: Cinematic Couple Micro-Expression Interaction
entries.description: A detailed 8-second video prompt for a romantic interaction, focusing on micro-expressions, character consistency, and natural physical reactions.
entries.prompt:
9:16竖版，8秒，电影级真人情侣近景微表情视频，极慢推近，镜头整体稳定，人物面部始终为视觉中心。​
严格保持上传参考图中女友的同一人物身份、同一张脸、同一年龄、同一脸型、同一五官比例、同一眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、眉毛、发型、肤色和妆容，不允许换脸，不允许年龄漂移，不重新设计人物五官。女友为22–25岁年轻成年东方女性，气质温柔、亲密、自然甜感。​
女友参考图 {{Mixed 1}} 。若参考图人物为自然放松状态，则从自然放松继续，不允许第一秒自动微笑或提前害羞。​
全程只有一个明确情侣互动动作：男友从画面侧方自然靠近，只轻轻亲一下女友侧面脸颊，亲吻短促、柔和、克制，只发生一次。禁止男友追加捏脸、摸头、抬下巴、拥抱、第二次亲吻或其他互动动作。男友可以只出现侧脸局部或身体局部，画面主体始终是女友的面部反应。​
0.0–1.2秒，女友自然放松，眼神柔和稳定，正常眨眼，嘴唇自然放松，肩颈松弛，鼻腔轻柔呼吸，镜头极慢向前推进。​
1.2–2.1秒，男友从侧方靠近私人距离，女友先通过余光注意到变化，眼球先轻微向男友方向移动，约0.2秒后头部仍基本不动，注意力轻微集中，但不要提前微笑。​
2.1–2.8秒，男友轻轻亲一下女友侧面脸颊，只亲一次，动作自然短促。接触位置产生非常轻微真实的脸颊软组织和皮肤挤压变化，不要夸张变形。​
2.8–3.7秒，亲吻结束后女友首先短暂停止眨眼，上眼睑轻轻抬高，眼睛只比正常状态稍微睁大一点，嘴唇自然微微分开，呼吸停半拍，表现短暂没有反应过来的轻微惊讶。头部不要突然后退，不要瞪眼。​
3.7–4.6秒，女友意识到刚才发生的是男友亲吻，惊讶迅速软化，上眼睑恢复自然，嘴唇慢慢靠拢，眼神变柔，鼻腔轻轻呼气，此时嘴角才开始出现非常细小的向上变化。​
4.6–5.5秒，害羞和开心开始自然泄露，嘴角逐渐上扬，脸颊真实轻微上提，下眼睑和眼轮匝肌参与笑容，形成真实笑意。女友眼神先向侧下方偏开，约0.2秒后头部才极轻微跟随一点，不要让眼睛和头同步移动。​
5.5–6.5秒，女友试图压住笑意，嘴唇轻轻抿住，但嘴角仍压不住地继续轻微上扬，两侧表情保持轻微自然不对称，形成真实的害羞偷笑，呼吸逐渐放松。​
6.5–7.3秒，女友眼睛先偷偷重新看向男友方向，短暂接触后又略微偏开，头部尽量保持稳定，表现想看男友又有点不好意思持续看他的亲密感。​
7.3–8.0秒，结尾保持带羞意的自然浅笑，眼神柔软，眼轮匝肌和脸颊共同参与真实笑容，嘴角自然上扬但不大笑。最后0.4到0.5秒接近静止，只保留轻柔呼吸、眼神笑意、嘴角余韵和真实皮肤细微变化。​
整体表演必须遵循真人反应顺序：自然放松 → 注意到靠近 → 亲吻发生 → 短暂轻微惊讶 → 惊讶软化 → 害羞泄露 → 压不住偷笑 → 情绪残留。​
动作必须存在自然时间差，禁止所有五官同时变化。眼睛优先于头部移动。笑容必须由嘴角、脸颊和眼轮匝肌共同形成，不能只有嘴角机械上扬。强调真实皮肤质感、真实脸部软组织变化、细腻眼神和克制情侣亲密感。
