entries.title: Cinematic Urban Lifestyle Video
entries.description: A high-end cinematic prompt focused on Detroit's Eastern Market, using rapid cuts and professional camera movements to build urban momentum.
entries.prompt: Build engagement through contrast. Change framing, depth and scale frequently enough that every new shot reveals another piece of his day. Never stay at one visual distance for too long. Alternate close, medium and long shots so the edit feels like it’s continually breathing in and out. Cinematic street photography, food-detail inserts, candid medium character shots, expansive urban establishing frames and quick transitions that preserve a relaxed lifestyle feel. 15-second cinematic urban lifestyle video, vertical 9:16. Use the attached image only as the character reference. Preserve the man’s exact face, hair, beard, body proportions, and identity in every scene. He wears a washed black vintage indie-rock T-shirt with a small cream abstract graphic, narrow-cut denim jeans, and black leather boots. He is ruggedly handsome, relaxed, observant, and naturally charismatic. Hyper-realistic live action, natural skin texture, no fake skin, no plastic skin, no animated look, no morphing, no outfit changes, no dialogue, no text overlays, no logos except the fictional record-shop logo. Use a premium cinematic camera package with motivated camera choices: - ARRI ALEXA 65 for expansive establishing shots and the final hero image. - ARRI ALEXA Mini LF on a stabilized gimbal for walking shots, tracking, interiors, and moving coverage. - ARRI ALEXA 35 with a 75mm or 85mm prime for intimate facial close-ups and natural skin detail. - Sony VENICE 2 with macro and portrait lenses for food, hands, vinyl, album-cover, and transaction details. Maintain realistic lens behavior, natural depth of field, believable motion blur, subtle film grain, rich but natural color, and accurate skin tones. The camera should never feel like a smartphone or an animation. Story: “Detroit: The Record.” Follow him through Detroit’s Eastern Market, into a small independent record shop, and back through the market. Use very fast, engaging cuts with full-body, waist-up, medium, close-up, and detail shots. Use front gimbal tracking, side tracking, rear-follow shots, short push-ins, handheld micro-movement, quick whip transitions, and changing camera angles. Keep him in motion. The tone is stylish, warm, urban, and musically intelligent. Critical object continuity: Before entering the record shop, he has no record. After purchasing it, the same 12-inch black vinyl record remains inside the same brown paper sleeve in every later scene. The sleeve is medium brown kraft paper with one centered, medium-sized, cool minimalist indie record-store logo printed in black. The logo is a simple geometric emblem with no readable text. Never change the sleeve color, logo, size, placement, or design. Scene 1, 0:00–0:01.2: Wide establishing shot of Detroit’s Eastern Market district, captured on an ARRI ALEXA 65 with a wide 28mm lens. He walks through busy food stalls, brick buildings, murals, vendors, shoppers, and colorful market activity. A stabilized camera tracks backward as he approaches. Use strong architectural depth and active background movement. He is empty-handed. Scene 2, 0:01.2–0:02.1: Waist-up tracking shot on an ARRI ALEXA Mini LF with a 35mm prime. He approaches a street-food vendor and casually orders with a small, natural hand gesture while the vendor prepares the food. Keep his face and upper body prominent. Scene 3, 0:02.1–0:03.3: Use the Sony VENICE 2 with a macro lens for a crisp close detail of the vendor handing him the food. Cut quickly to a 75mm portrait shot of his face as he gives the vendor a warm, appreciative nod. Keep his emotion subtle and genuine. Scene 4, 0:03.3–0:04.3: Side-tracking shot on the ARRI ALEXA Mini LF with a 50mm lens as he eats while walking through the market. Show his face, hands, food, and relaxed enjoyment. Use natural handheld micro-movement and foreground pedestrians for depth. He looks confident and unposed. Scene 5, 0:04.3–0:05.3: Full-body shot on the ARRI ALEXA Mini LF with a 28mm lens as he leaves the market and notices a small independent record store across the street. His pace slows slightly and his attention shifts toward the storefront. Use a brief lateral camera move that reveals the shop. Scene 6, 0:05.3–0:06.8: A quick 1.5-second beauty close-up captured on the ARRI ALEXA 35 with a 75mm prime. The camera pans smoothly across the front of his face as he looks toward the record shop. He appears mildly thoughtful and curious, deciding whether to go inside. Ruggedly handsome, restrained emotion, realistic eyes, no exaggeration. Scene 7, 0:06.8–0:07.8: Dynamic follow shot on the Sony VENICE 2 with a 35mm lens as he enters the record shop. Warm wood, posters, record racks, and people quietly thumbing through vinyl bins fill the interior. Low-key indie rock plays inside. Use a smooth forward push with slight handheld texture. Scene 8, 0:07.8–0:09.1: Waist-up side tracking on the ARRI ALEXA Mini LF with a 50mm prime as he moves through two aisles, scanning album spines and browsing with focused interest. Alternate with quick Sony VENICE 2 close details of his hand moving across the records. Keep the cuts sharp and rhythmically connected. Scene 9, 0:09.1–0:10.1: Use the ARRI ALEXA 35 with a 65mm lens. He turns toward one section of record bins and gives a restrained amused grin without showing teeth. The camera makes a short, subtle push-in as he recognizes the record he wants. Scene 10, 0:10.1–0:11.3: Use the Sony VENICE 2 with a 90mm macro lens for an over-the-shoulder shot and close hand detail as he pulls the front record from the bin. He studies the album cover briefly, then gives another quiet, satisfied grin. Keep the record artwork stable and consistent. Scene 11, 0:11.3–0:12.8: Short counter arc captured on the ARRI ALEXA Mini LF with a 35mm lens. He pays the cashier. The cashier hands him the 12-inch record inside the same medium-brown kraft sleeve with the same centered black geometric logo clearly visible. Use a quick insert of the sleeve before cutting away. Scene 12, 0:12.8–0:13.8: Front and side tracking on the ARRI ALEXA 35 with a 35mm prime as he exits the shop holding the sleeve naturally at his side. He turns back toward the Eastern Market district. Keep the sleeve visible but do not make him pose with it. Scene 13, 0:13.8–0:14.6: Rear-follow shot on the ARRI ALEXA Mini LF with a 50mm lens as he passes the same food vendor from earlier. The vendor recognizes him and gives a small friendly nod. He answers with a faint smile without stopping. The moment should feel natural and connected. Scene 14, 0:14.6–0:15: Final hero image captured on the ARRI ALEXA 65 with a 40mm lens in warm late-afternoon light. He walks away through the active Detroit market with the brown record sleeve visible in his hand. The camera slowly pulls back as he disappears into the moving street scene. End with motion, atmosphere, and cinematic realism, not a static pose. Keep the pacing tight, the record and sleeve perfectly consistent, the camera choices purposeful, the cuts visually varied, and every movement physically believable.

entries.title: Indonesian Comedy Dog Chase Vlog
entries.description: A multi-shot script for a funny, amateur iPhone-style video of a girl being playfully chased by a dog in Indonesia.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second realistic smartphone video in 16:9 aspect ratio.

Style: authentic Gen-Z Indonesian comedy, spontaneous iPhone home-video footage, natural daylight.

SHOT 1- 0:00–0:02
A girl casually walks along a small Indonesian residential street. She suddenly notices a medium-sized pet dog ahead and stops. Her relaxed expression instantly turns nervous.

SHOT 2-0:02–0:04
Quick handheld pan from the girl to the dog and back. She slowly steps backward and says: “Uh... don't come closer, okay...” The dog looks curious and harmless.

SHOT 3-0:04–0:06
The dog playfully runs a few steps toward her. She panics: “AAAAA RUN!” The camera operator reacts and moves backward.

SHOT 4-0:06–0:08
She suddenly runs away, looking back over her shoulder. The iPhone camera follows while running, creating natural shaky footage. Her white fitted T-shirt, light-blue short denim shorts, and white low-profile slippers move naturally.

SHOT 5-0:08–0:10
Side close-up while she runs. She looks back and screams: “BRO, IT'S FOLLOWING ME!” The camera shakes as the friend behind the camera laughs.

SHOT 6-0:10–0:13
The camera widens as she runs toward her friend, waving her hands: “DON'T LAUGH! HELP ME, BRO!” The dog follows playfully without attacking, biting, or touching her.

SHOT 7- 0:13–0:15
She reaches a safe spot, bends over briefly to catch her breath, then looks at the camera with an annoyed and embarrassed expression: “I was literally just passing by, why did that turn into cardio?!” The friend bursts out laughing. Abrupt cut.

CAMERA & REALISM

Amateur one-handed iPhone recording. Natural handheld shake, imperfect framing, slight tilt, occasional autofocus shifts, automatic exposure changes, realistic motion blur, natural smartphone colors, subtle digital sharpening and compression. Environmental details remain visible. No cinematic look.

entries.title: Professional Female Teacher Lifestyle Vlog
entries.description: A detailed 30-second cinematic vlog prompt following a female teacher's day from home to the classroom, emphasizing character consistency.
entries.prompt:
DURATION: 30 seconds
ASPECT RATIO: 16:9

DURATION: 30 SECONDS

Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic professional female teacher lifestyle vlog.

REFERENCE PRIORITY:

@IMG1 = MAIN FEMALE TEACHER
@IMG2 = SCHOOL EXTERIOR
@IMG3 = CLASSROOM
@IMG4 = TEACHING ACTION
@IMG5 = NOTEBOOK CHECKING
@IMG6 = SCHOOL EXIT

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:

The EXACT SAME woman from @IMG1 must appear throughout the entire video.

Preserve her exact face, facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, age appearance and overall identity.

She remains the SAME teacher throughout every scene.

Keep her professional teacher outfit consistent after she gets dressed.

--------------------------------------------------

0–4 SECONDS — LEAVING HOME

The teacher prepares for her school day at home.

She picks up her professional tote bag containing notebooks and teaching materials.

She checks her phone briefly.

She puts on her shoes, picks up her bag and leaves home.

CAMERA:
Quick cinematic morning lifestyle shots.

Close-up of the bag and notebooks.

Medium shot as she walks out the door.

Natural morning light.

--------------------------------------------------

4–8 SECONDS — SCHOOL ARRIVAL

Use @IMG2.

The teacher arrives at the school.

She walks through the main entrance carrying her tote bag.

She walks across the school courtyard toward the building.

She enters the school.

CAMERA:
Wide establishing shot of the school exterior.

Smooth tracking shot following her toward the entrance.

--------------------------------------------------

8–12 SECONDS — CLASSROOM PREPARATION

Use @IMG3.

The teacher enters her classroom.

She places her tote bag on the teacher's desk.

She organizes her notebooks and teaching materials.

She picks up a marker.

She briefly checks the whiteboard and prepares the lesson.

Students gradually settle into their desks.

CAMERA:
Medium classroom shot.

Brief close-ups of notebooks, marker and teaching materials.

--------------------------------------------------

12–20 SECONDS — TEACHING

Use @IMG4.

The teacher stands at the front of the classroom.

She writes a simple lesson heading or diagram on the whiteboard.

She turns toward the students.

She explains the lesson using natural hand gestures.

She points toward the board.

One student raises a hand.

The teacher acknowledges the student and responds with a natural smile.

Students remain attentive.

CAMERA:
Wide classroom shot.

Medium shot of teacher.

Brief close-up of her writing.

Over-the-shoulder shot from the students' perspective.

Natural classroom interaction.

--------------------------------------------------

20–25 SECONDS — NOTEBOOK CHECKING

Use @IMG5.

The lesson has finished.

The teacher sits at her desk.

She picks up a student's notebook.

She reads the work.

She turns a page.

She makes a few simple corrections with a pen.

She sees a well-completed answer and gives a small approving smile.

She places the notebook on a neat stack of checked work.

CAMERA:
Medium shot.

Brief close-up of notebook and hand.

Close-up of her satisfied expression.

--------------------------------------------------

25–30 SECONDS — SCHOOL EXIT

Use @IMG6.

The school day is finished.

The teacher organizes her papers into her tote bag.

She leaves the classroom.

She walks through the school corridor toward the main entrance.

She exits the school building.

The camera follows her from behind as she walks away.

Finish with a wide cinematic shot of the school exterior and the teacher walking toward the exit.

She gives a subtle relaxed smile.

CUT TO BLACK.

--------------------------------------------------

CAMERA STYLE:

Premium cinematic educational lifestyle vlog.

Smooth professional tracking.

Natural handheld feel.

Wide establishing shots.

Medium lifestyle shots.

Close-ups for important details.

Over-the-shoulder classroom shots.

Gentle cinematic pull-back at the ending.

No excessive camera shake.

No unnecessary fast camera movement.

--------------------------------------------------

REALISM:

Natural walking.

Natural classroom interaction.

Realistic writing.

Realistic notebook handling.

Realistic teacher gestures.

Natural student reactions.

Realistic school environment.

Natural facial expressions.

Realistic hands and fingers.

No exaggerated acting.

No distorted hands.

No extra fingers.

No face morphing.

No identity changes.

--------------------------------------------------

CONTINUITY:

Same female teacher throughout.

Same face.

Same hairstyle.

Same professional outfit.

Same school environment.

Same classroom.

Same teaching materials.

No different teacher.

No random outfit changes.

No cartoon.

No anime.

No futuristic school.

No text overlays.

No logos.

No watermark.

FINAL FEELING:

A realistic cinematic glimpse into a professional teacher's normal school day.

HOME → SCHOOL → CLASSROOM PREPARATION → TEACHING → NOTEBOOK CHECKING → SCHOOL EXIT.

entries.title: Affectionate Couple Nose-Touch Interaction
entries.description: A romantic 8-second video prompt featuring a delicate nose-touch interaction between a couple, emphasizing realistic facial muscle changes and emotional progression.
entries.prompt:
8秒，9:16竖版，电影级真人情侣近景微表情视频，固定近景，一镜到底。主体是一位22–24岁年轻成年东方女性，气质可爱、亲近、带一点自然撒娇感。严格保持人物全程同一张脸、同一年龄、同一五官比例、同一发型、同一肤色、同一妆容和同一人物身份，不重新设计人物。​

第一帧严格承接参考图 {{Mixed 1}} 。女友最初处于轻松自然状态，身体和肩膀放松，头部稳定，眼神明亮亲近地看向男友，正常眨眼，嘴唇自然放松，呼吸平稳。

全片男友只有一个主动互动动作：用指腹非常轻、非常短地轻点一下女友鼻尖，接触后立即自然撤开。禁止出现第二个亲密互动动作。​

0.0–1.0秒，女友自然放松地看着男友，眼神亲近，正常眨眼一次，嘴角只有浅浅的自然松弛感。​
1.0–1.8秒，男友一根手指自然进入画面，用指腹轻轻点一下女友鼻尖，力度很轻，短暂接触后撤开。女友鼻尖被碰到的一瞬间出现两次快速短促本能眨眼，鼻翼和鼻尖附近肌肉微微收紧，呼吸停顿半拍，头部不立刻后躲。​
1.8–2.8秒，女友重新睁眼后先看向男友，下眼睑轻轻收紧，出现一次很轻、很短的皱鼻反应，嘴角原本的放松感停止，眼神像是在判断‘你干嘛？’。​
2.8–3.8秒，嘴唇轻轻抿住，嘴角非常轻微向下压一点，形成短暂的小委屈和小嗔怪，眼神仍看着男友。眉毛变化非常克制，不夸张皱眉。​
3.8–4.6秒，女友像故意维持一点埋怨，嘴唇仍轻抿，眼球先轻微偏向侧面，约0.2秒后头部才极轻跟随，鼻腔轻轻呼气一次。​
4.6–5.5秒，情绪开始松动，一侧嘴角先极轻往上提一点后停住，下眼睑逐渐放松，眼神中的埋怨感慢慢变软。她仍然抿嘴，像努力忍住笑，但已经开始压不住。​
5.5–6.5秒，嘴唇慢慢放松，两侧嘴角自然上扬，脸颊轻微上提，眼轮匝肌参与，眼睛真正出现笑意。女友重新看向男友，形成‘还有一点埋怨，但已经被你逗笑了’的真实表情。​
6.5–7.3秒，微笑保持但不扩大，她轻轻重新抿一下嘴，保留一点撒娇式嗔怪残留，呼吸恢复轻松。​
7.3–8.0秒，最终停留在埋怨残留中的轻松微笑，嘴角带笑，眼神亲昵，仍保留一点‘你真烦’的轻微嗔怪。最后约0.5秒几乎静止，只保留轻柔呼吸、稳定眼神和真实皮肤细微动态。​

整体表演强调真人情侣之间熟悉、自然、亲密的互动感。表情不能同时启动，要保持鼻部本能反应 → 眼神判断 → 嘴部小嗔怪 → 笑意泄露 → 真实微笑的时间差。动作不匀速，存在启动、停顿、控制和残留。真实皮肤纹理、自然脸颊物理变化、真实眼轮匝肌与嘴角联动，不要AI假笑。

entries.title: Seoul Evening Personal Home Video Vlog
entries.description: A prompt for a raw, ultra-realistic personal home-video following a young Korean woman through a quiet Seoul neighborhood, emphasizing handheld camera imperfections and natural atmosphere.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary evening in the life of a young Korean woman. No reference image.

MAIN SUBJECT

Young Korean woman same face as <<<image_1>>> in her early 20s, naturally pretty, realistic skin texture with visible pores and texture, minimal makeup, soft and slightly tired expression after a long day.

Long straight black hair tied in a loose low bun, a few flyaway strands near her ears, small silver hoop earrings.

Wearing an oversized beige knit cardigan over a plain black turtleneck, straight-leg dark jeans, white canvas sneakers, and carrying a small worn tote bag.

Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and appearance throughout the entire video.

SETTING

A quiet riverside neighborhood in Seoul on a cool early-autumn evening, right after a light rain has just stopped.

Wet pavement reflecting streetlights, a small laundromat with fogged windows, a street-side flower stand closing up, a covered bus shelter, a narrow pedestrian bridge over a stream, scattered puddles, string lights above a closed market alley, a convenience store with a lit sign, and a few pigeons picking at the ground. Everything damp, quiet, and softly lit as dusk settles in.

**CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC**

Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend.

Handheld camera with natural shake, imperfect framing, occasional partial crops, autofocus hunting on reflections and wet surfaces, exposure shifts between streetlight glow and shadow, mild motion blur, soft image detail, subtle digital noise, slightly desaturated evening colors, and natural camera imperfections.

The camera operator walks with her and reacts naturally.

No stabilization, no cinematic camera movements, no dramatic lighting, no slow motion, no polished commercial appearance.

The footage should feel accidentally beautiful rather than deliberately cinematic.

---

**00:00–00:05 — LEAVING THE LAUNDROMAT**

She pushes open the laundromat door, stepping out with a small basket of folded laundry against her hip.

She glances up at the sky, checking if it's really stopped raining, and exhales a small relieved breath.

The camera follows her out, slightly unsteady on the wet step.

She glances back at the camera with a tired little smile.

**00:05–00:10 — THE FLOWER STAND**

She walks past a street-side flower stand that's closing up for the night.

She pauses, picks up a small bundle of daisies on impulse, pays the vendor, and tucks them into her tote bag.

The camera briefly focuses on the flowers before drifting back up to her face.

**00:10–00:15 — THE PEDESTRIAN BRIDGE**

She crosses a narrow footbridge over the stream, puddles reflecting the streetlights beneath her feet.

She stops halfway, resting her forearms on the railing, looking down at the water without saying anything.

The camera stays slightly shaky and imperfectly framed, as if her friend is just leaning on the railing beside her.

**00:15–00:20 — CONVENIENCE STORE STOP**

She ducks into a small convenience store, the automatic door chiming behind her.

She grabs a warm canned coffee from the heated shelf, pays, and steps back outside, cracking it open right away.

A passing scooter splashes through a puddle in the background.

The camera operator accidentally clips the doorframe while following her out, then quickly reframes.

**00:20–00:25 — BUS SHELTER**

She sits under a covered bus shelter, sipping her coffee, laundry basket beside her feet.

A few pigeons wander near the curb; she watches them idly, unbothered.

Steam rises faintly from the coffee can in the cool evening air.

The camera drifts slightly out of focus on the streetlight behind her, then refocuses.

**00:25–00:30 — FINAL MOMENT**

She notices the camera still recording and turns toward it, laundry basket now tucked under one arm.

She gives a small amused, slightly embarrassed smile and says:

*"Why are you still filming me?"*

She laughs quietly and starts walking toward the camera, waving it off with her free hand.

The camera moves backward as she approaches, and the recording abruptly cuts to black before she reaches it.

---

**AUDIO**

Natural location sound only:

Footsteps on wet pavement, distant traffic, dripping water, a scooter passing, the convenience store door chime, coins and paper bag rustling, pigeons cooing, fabric movement, a bus passing in the distance, and subtle handheld camera noise.

No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects.

Only the single spoken line: *"Why are you still filming me?"*

**FINAL FEEL**

The entire video should feel like a completely ordinary rainy evening that somehow became a quiet, beautiful memory.

Soft, feminine, tired-but-content, intimate, gently nostalgic, and unplanned.

No dramatic events. No exaggerated acting. No model poses. No cinematic hero shots.

The realism should come from tiny imperfections, damp reflections, casual body language, natural expressions, ordinary surroundings, imperfect camera operation, and moments that feel completely unposed.

entries.prompt:
Main subject: Young Korean woman, early 20s, wearing a loose faded lavender T-shirt, cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers and a delicate necklace. Messy black side ponytail, natural makeup, realistic skin and completely consistent appearance.

Location: Older Korean residential neighborhood on a hot summer afternoon. Narrow alleys, concrete homes, tiny gardens, bicycles, utility poles and leafy trees creating patches of shade.

Shot entirely like an early-2000s home video filmed by her friend. Strong handheld shake, accidental framing, autofocus hunting, blown-out highlights, faded colors, digital noise, occasional zoom mistakes and realistic motion blur.

She leaves her house carrying a small paper bag and walks toward a tiny neighborhood snack stall. She buys a warm fish-shaped pastry, takes a bite immediately and smiles at the camera.

She continues down the lane eating it when a friend sitting outside a small house calls her over. They chat casually and laugh while she offers her pastry to the friend for a bite.

She continues walking and passes a group of children playing football in the street. The ball rolls toward her feet. She stops it, kicks it gently back to the children and waves as they cheer.

She reaches a large tree, sits briefly on a low concrete wall and finishes her snack while watching the quiet street. A little breeze moves her hair, and she casually adjusts it with her hand.

She gets up, gives the camcorder a small smile and walks down the lane. The camera follows shakily from behind as she gradually disappears around the corner.

Audio: Summer insects, birds, footsteps, bicycle bells, distant scooters, children playing football, wind through leaves, casual conversation and natural neighborhood ambience. No music.

Warm summer sunlight, spontaneous everyday moments, nostalgic early-2000s DV colors, authentic handheld imperfections, realistic food and object physics, natural expressions and photorealistic Seedance 2.5 quality.

entries.title: 2000s Korean Home Video Style
entries.description: A nostalgic Korean home video prompt using MiniDV aesthetics, following a young woman through a neighborhood as she experiences a funny mishap with a grocery bag.
entries.prompt:
GIRL = MAIN CHARACTER: Young Korean woman in her early 20s, natural makeup, realistic skin, long black hair in a messy side ponytail, oversized faded-blue T-shirt, loose white pajama pants, black sneakers and simple silver necklace. Completely consistent identity.

LOCATION: Older Korean residential neighborhood during a bright summer afternoon. Narrow lanes, small grocery shop, concrete houses, potted plants, bicycles and leafy trees.

CAMERA / LOOK: Early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video. Strong handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, faded colors, digital noise, exposure changes, motion blur and accidental zooms.

SEQUENCE:
She leaves a tiny grocery shop carrying a paper bag filled with fruit and snacks. She walks down the lane while eating a grape and casually chatting with her friend behind the camera.

Suddenly, the bottom of the paper bag tears and several pieces of fruit fall onto the pavement and roll in different directions. She freezes for a moment, looks down in disbelief, then starts laughing.

She quickly crouches down to collect everything while her friend moves closer with the shaky camera. A neighborhood child notices and comes over to help her pick up the fruit. She thanks the child, puts everything into a stronger reusable bag and gives them a small snack.

She stands up, looks directly into the camcorder, laughs and says, “Well… that didn’t go as planned.”

She continues walking home down the sunny lane while eating another grape. The camera follows behind her and slowly loses focus before the recording cuts.

AUDIO: Fruit rolling on concrete, footsteps, birds, distant scooters, children talking, bicycle bells, laughter and natural neighborhood ambience. No music.

Warm summer sunlight, spontaneous everyday humor, realistic object physics, nostalgic early-2000s DV aesthetic and photorealistic Seedance 2.5 quality.

entries.title: High School Superhero Action Sequence
entries.description: A cinematic action prompt for a superhero-style scene set in a high school hallway, featuring energy-powered combat and dynamic camera work.
entries.prompt:
Create a cinematic, photorealistic 30-second live-action video set inside a modern American high school hallway lined with dark green lockers and classroom doors. A beautiful young female student with wavy black hair, wearing a beige oversized sweater, black cargo pants, white sneakers and a gray backpack, walks through the crowded hallway while students around her glance at her and continue their conversations.

Start with a natural medium shot from behind that slowly moves around to reveal her face as she walks. Use realistic handheld camera movement, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic lighting, natural skin texture, realistic facial expressions and authentic high-school atmosphere.

A sudden commotion breaks out ahead. A male student runs toward her and tries to push past her. She stops instantly. A mysterious electric-blue energy begins flickering around her hands. Thin arcs of light travel across her arms while tiny particles float around her body, gradually forming a powerful supernatural aura.

Transition smoothly into an intense superhero-style action sequence in the same school corridor. The girl suddenly moves at impossible speed, disappearing from one side of the hallway and reappearing beside the attacker. She delivers a precise energy-powered strike followed by a fast sequence of kicks and punches. Blue electrical trails follow every movement.

Use cinematic slow motion for the moment of impact, showing the energy wrapping around her fist before the strike connects, then switch back to rapid cuts. Students retreat behind classroom doors as the fight moves through the hallway. Reflections from the blue energy ripple across the lockers and polished floor, with realistic sparks, smoke, dust and motion blur.

Include a dramatic low-angle moment where the girl leaps over the opponent, spins in midair and lands behind him, releasing a concentrated burst of electric-blue energy that sends him stumbling backward.

Near the end, the energy gradually fades into tiny sparks. The girl straightens her clothes, adjusts her backpack and walks calmly toward the end of the hallway. End with a close-up of her face as the last blue spark disappears from her eyes.

Visual style: photorealistic Hollywood superhero movie, cinematic color grading, realistic teenage/high-school environment, detailed faces, natural skin, realistic clothing and hair physics, realistic lighting, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field, professional cinematography, dynamic camera movement, high-detail VFX, realistic particle effects, 4K cinematic quality.

Camera: handheld tracking shots, medium shots, close-ups, low-angle action shots, smooth whip-pans, controlled motion blur, occasional slow motion during attacks.

Aspect ratio: 16:9
Duration: approximately 30 seconds. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no distorted faces, no extra fingers, no unnatural anatomy.

entries.title: Cinematic Bus Time Freeze Comedy
entries.description: A comedic Hollywood-style action scene set on a New York City bus where two characters fight over a seat while time is frozen for everyone else.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 30 seconds | 16:9 | 24fps cinematic | ultra photorealistic live action | Hollywood studio comedy action | realistic human anatomy | premium VFX time freeze | daytime natural light

IDENTITY LOCK: Maintain exactly the same two leads in every shot. Never change faces, hair, age, body proportions, wardrobe or props. No character morphing. No extra active fighters. All background passengers remain frozen statues after 0:03 and never move, never blink, never react.

CHARACTERS
DANI: late twenties Latina woman, 5 foot 3, athletic, black curly hair in a high messy bun, small gold hoop earrings, cafe uniform of black tee, dark green canvas apron, rolled sleeves, black jeans, worn white sneakers. Sharp, fast talking, unbothered.
WALTER: mid fifties white man, 6 foot 1, tall and heavy shouldered, thinning gray hair, wire rim glasses, rumpled charcoal suit, loosened maroon tie, brown leather briefcase. Exhausted, dignified, quietly petty.

ENVIRONMENT: Interior of a modern New York City public bus, midday. Blue and gray molded seats, chrome grab poles, rubber floor, overhead ad panels left blank. Bright hard sunlight cuts through large side windows in hot rectangles across the aisle. Outside the glass, a frozen Manhattan avenue with yellow cabs, pedestrians caught mid stride, pigeons suspended in air. Nine ordinary commuters frozen mid motion inside the bus. Exactly one empty aisle seat, midway back, sunlit, the object of the entire fight.

0:00 to 0:03 THE FREEZE HOOK
Handheld medium shot down the aisle. The bus lurches. A commuter paper coffee cup launches from a hand, lid popping, liquid arcing. Dani and Walter both lunge toward the empty seat from opposite ends. Hard sound drop to silence. Everything stops. Coffee suspended as a glittering brown ribbon, dust motes still, pigeons pinned outside the window. Only Dani and Walter continue moving.

0:03 to 0:07 REALIZATION
Both freeze mid lunge, straighten slowly, look at the suspended coffee, then at each other. Slow 30 degree camera orbit around the frozen splash between them.
DANI: "Okay. Either we are both hallucinating, or that seat is cursed."
WALTER: "It is my seat. I have been standing for eleven blocks."
DANI: "Eleven blocks? Try eleven years, buddy."

0:07 to 0:11 FIRST EXCHANGE
They rush each other. Comedic but real physicality. Walter throws a broad open hand shove, Dani ducks under his arm, plants a palm on his chest and slides past on the rubber floor. Whip pan follows her. She grabs a chrome pole and swings her legs at his shoulder. He blocks with a forearm. Both land clean, no cartoon physics.

0:11 to 0:15 THE BRIEFCASE
Low angle. Walter reaches back for his briefcase. It hangs motionless in the air three feet behind him, frozen mid swing.
DANI: "Your briefcase is stuck in the sky."
WALTER: "Then I will improvise."
He tugs a frozen commuter umbrella free with visible effort. The commuter stays rigid, hand still curled around nothing.

0:15 to 0:19 FROZEN OBSTACLE COURSE
Fast tracking shot along the aisle. Dani vaults over a frozen seated man, uses a suspended shopping bag as a step, and pushes off an immobile standing passenger shoulder. Walter swings the umbrella. She parries with a rolled newspaper pulled from another frozen hand. Three crisp exchanges, readable, no slow motion.

0:19 to 0:23 POLE FIGHT
Both grab the same chrome pole and spin around it in opposite directions, colliding shoulder to shoulder. Camera arcs with them. Walter glasses slide down his nose. Dani bun collapses. He hooks her apron strap. She twists free, leaving him holding a limp green apron.
WALTER: "I have your apron."
DANI: "I have your dignity."

0:23 to 0:27 TRUCE
Both stop, breathing hard, three feet apart, hands on knees. Medium two shot, sunlight bars across their faces. The frozen coffee ribbon still hangs between them.
DANI: "Truce?"
WALTER: "Truce."
They shake hands. Micro pause. Both eyes flick to the empty seat.

0:27 to 0:30 TIME RESUMES
Both explode toward the seat simultaneously. The instant they move, the world unfreezes. Coffee splashes down, passengers jolt, pigeons scatter outside, engine noise slams back in.

LAST FRAME: Locked medium wide composition down the bus aisle. Dani and Walter are wedged half onto the single seat side by side, both mid shove, both grinning, coffee spraying across the sunlit air between them. Nine confused passengers turn to stare. No text appears anywhere in frame. No subtitles, no captions, no signage lettering, no ad panel text, no logos, no watermarks.

CAMERA LANGUAGE: Studio comedy action photography. Controlled handheld during physical exchanges, smooth dolly and orbit during freeze reveals, low angle hero framing for Walter, fast whip pans between leads. Anamorphic character, shallow depth on dialogue, natural motion blur, consistent screen direction and spatial geography inside the bus.

VFX: Photoreal suspension physics. Frozen liquid holds surface tension and internal highlights. Dust and fabric hold perfect stillness. The resume moment restores full gravity and momentum in a single continuous frame with no morphing and no dissolve.

AUDIO, DIEGETIC ONLY: No music score. Bus engine rumble and road noise before the freeze. During the freeze, near total silence with a faint high pitched air tone, breathing, sneaker squeak on rubber, apron fabric, umbrella whoosh, pole clang. English dialogue only, natural American accents, clean lip sync with proper bilabial closure. At resume, coffee splash, passenger gasps, engine and traffic return abruptly.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS: No text, subtitles, logos, watermark or UI. No background passenger movement during the freeze. No blood, no gore. No duplicated people. No extra limbs or fingers. No floating props except the deliberately frozen ones. No wardrobe changes. No face changes. No slapstick cartoon physics. No random slow motion. No excessive camera shake. Keep the comedy dry, the fight readable, the physics coherent.

entries.title: Cinematic Kindness Chain Narrative
entries.description: A cinematic narrative prompt depicting a chain of kind acts through city streets at golden hour, utilizing match cuts and intimate handheld camera work.
entries.prompt: "Photorealistic, cinematic, high production value, 4K, warm golden-hour light, film grain, teal-and-amber color grade, gentle handheld motion. A wordless story of a kindness passed along a city street. 0–3s: She buys a warm pastry from a street cart, then hands it to a shivering old man on a bench; she smiles and walks on. 3–6s: Tracking shot — the old man gives his scarf to a young busker with cold hands; the busker nods gratefully. 6–9s: The busker helps a lost tourist with directions and a coin; match-cut on a passed object between hands. 9–12s: The tourist steadies a mother's stroller wheel on a curb; soft slow motion on the grateful glance. 12–15s: The mother offers her umbrella to a woman caught in sudden light rain — and it is her, from the first shot; she looks up, surprised and moved, as the camera pushes into her warm smile. Camera: intimate handheld → lateral tracking → match cuts on hands → slow push-in on final reveal. Ambient city sound, soft piano score rising to the loop-back moment. Maintain narrative continuity; keep her facial features and wardrobe fully consistent. Detailed hands, natural human motion."

entries.title: Convenience Store Multishot Interaction
entries.description: A highly detailed multishot video prompt for a convenience store interaction, specifying facial identities, scene context, camera angles, and digital-cinema textures.
entries.prompt: SCENE CONTEXT Night, a small convenience store, one continuous situation in four shots. @Image 1 has eleven items on the counter. @Image 2 asks whether he wants a bag. He declines — politely, immediately, without thinking about it. Then he has to carry eleven items out with two hands, and he commits to it completely rather than change his answer. She watches the whole thing without helping and without commenting. He gets them stacked to his chin and reaches the door. One item falls. Neither of them reacts. He comes back to the counter. Japanese dialogue. Played completely straight by both people. ACTIVE REFERENCES @Image 1 — the man: facial identity, glasses, hair, build and the navy sack suit ONLY. Do not copy its white background, its framing or its lighting. @Image 2 — the store clerk: facial identity, ponytail, and the striped shirt and navy apron ONLY. Same exclusions. Her name badge stays blank. @Image 3 — the store: counter geometry, bag rack, hot-food case, shelving, the glass storefront and the flat fluorescent light level ONLY. It is empty of people and stays that way apart from these two. FORMAT MODE Four-beat multishot, real-time, VARIED ANGLES each cut. Total 16s. HARD CUTS at 4.0s, 8.0s, 12.0s. 9:16 vertical, 720P. Dialogue. No subtitles. FILM STOCK / TEXTURE Clean modern digital-cinema look, low contrast, faintly cool fluorescent white balance, very fine grain, deep enough focus that both people and the goods stay readable. Real skin texture with visible pores. No digital sharpening, no beauty smoothing. LOCATION MAP A small convenience store at night. The register counter runs across the frame with a bag rack on the clerk's side; eleven boxed and bagged items are already stacked on the customer's side in the first frame — instant noodles, two rice balls, a carton of milk, a bento, four cans, a bag of ice, a magazine. The glass storefront and the automatic door are on screen left, black street beyond. Flat fluorescent ceiling light everywhere, no shadow direction, no light change of any kind. Exactly two people exist in this store and nobody else enters. The counter is the action axis; the camera stays on the customer's side for all four beats. FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING Frame one is already in motion: the clerk's hands are placing the last of the eleven items down on the customer's side of the counter; he stands square to the counter with both arms at his sides; the door is on screen left behind his shoulder. SPATIAL BLOCKING / ANGLES (a different angle each cut) SEG1: WAIST-HEIGHT two-shot across the counter, both of them and the whole pile in frame. SEG2: LOW at counter level from the goods' side, the pile huge in the foreground, his chin above it. SEG3: WIDE from beside the door, his back to camera, the clerk small and still behind the counter. SEG4: FLAT FRONT-ON medium from behind the counter beside her shoulder, holding him in the doorway. BLOCKING & TIMING 0.0–4.0s: Two-shot. She sets the last item down, squares it with one finger, and asks. He answers immediately, before the question has finished landing. She nods once and does not ask again. Her hands go to the counter edge and stay there. 4.0s CUT. 4.0–8.0s: Low at counter level. He begins loading. Forearms first, then the crook of one elbow, then his chin comes down onto the top of the stack to hold it. He works with total concentration — small corrections, a re-stack, a cardboard corner sliding and being caught by his jaw. His expression does not change once. 8.0s CUT. 8.0–12.0s: Wide from the door. He turns and walks, slowly, absolutely upright, the pile from his hips to his chin. He is three steps from the door. Nobody speaks and nothing else moves in the shot for two full seconds — she does not step out, does not offer, does not smile. 12.0s CUT. 12.0–16.0s: Flat front-on. He reaches the door. One rice ball leaves the stack and lands on the floor. Neither of them looks at it. He stands perfectly still for one beat, then turns, walks back to the counter, and stops in front of her. He speaks. Hard end on the two of them and the fallen rice ball on the floor between them. DIALOGUE @Image 2 (flat, service register, at 2.8s): 「袋、ご利用になりますか。」 ("Would you like a bag?") @Image 1 (immediate, polite, at 3.4s): 「大丈夫です。」 ("I'm fine.") @Image 1 (identical tone, no shift whatsoever, at 15.0s): 「…袋、お願いします。」 ("…A bag, please.") ACTING TASK (the work happens in the eyes; nobody plays the joke) SCENE EVENT (read backward from the last line): a man declines something reflexively and then pays for that reflex in full, in public, rather than revise it — and revises it only when physics ends the argument for him. ESSENTIAL AXIS: will he change his answer. CONTRAST PAIR: @Image 1 — a man with two hands (minus) / a man who will not be a burden (plus). @Image 2 — a clerk who could obviously solve this (minus) / a professional who does not intervene in a customer's decision (plus). — @Image 1 — MOTIVE: saying "actually yes" would mean he was wrong three seconds ago. GOAL: get eleven items to the door. TACTIC: he solves it as an engineering problem, seriously, with real re-stacking and real chin pressure. He never looks at her for help and never checks whether she is watching. The last line is delivered at exactly the same politeness level as the first — no defeat, no irony. — @Image 2 — MOTIVE: it is not her place to overrule a customer. GOAL: complete the transaction. TACTIC: she asks once, accepts the answer, and then simply watches — hands on the counter edge, no lean, no smile, no second offer. Her stillness is the whole performance; she is not enjoying this, she is waiting. (Safety: gazes always engaged in the task — never a frozen glassy stare; natural, uneven, unsynchronised blink cadence. Neither person smiles or laughs at any point.) PHYSICS Boxed goods slide against each other and need constant correction; a carton takes weight, a bag of ice does not. His chin actually compresses the top item. The stack leans and is caught twice before it is stable. The rice ball falls with real weight, bounces once low and stops. Nothing in frame is ever completely motionless — the hot-food case steams, the fluorescent light has a faint flicker cycle, both blink at uneven intervals — and the action begins on the first frame, no opening freeze. LIGHTING Flat fluorescent ceiling light, even, no shadow direction, no change of any kind across the 16 seconds. Black street beyond the glass with no passing light. AUDIO Convenience-store room tone at one unchanging level — a refrigerator hum, a low ventilation note, the oden pot simmering. Plastic and cardboard shifting from 4.4s onward, continuously. A single register beep at 1.2s. The rice ball landing on vinyl at 13.4s. His footsteps returning at 14.2s. Japanese only. No narration. No music at any point. POSITIVE CONSTRAINTS Exactly two people. Eleven items are on the counter in the first frame and all eleven are accounted for at the end. The clerk stays behind the counter for the whole video. Nobody smiles, laughs or raises their voice. End on the fallen item still on the floor.

entries.title: Ballerina on Arctic Ice Cinematic
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot video prompt for a ballerina performing on a vast Arctic ice sheet, focusing on cinematography and movement.
entries.prompt:
IDENTITY — CINEMATIC, CUT, ARRI Alexa 35, anamorphic 2.39:1, 35mm and 85mm lenses, desaturated palette with ice-blue dominance and pale skin tones, fine grain, volumetric fog, hard polar sunlight with long shadows, high contrast.
CAST — ballerina: mid-20s, lean athletic build, pale skin, dark hair pulled tight in classical bun, focused expression. WARDROBE: white tutu with layered tulle, pale pink tights, white pointe shoes, bare arms.

SYNOPSIS — A ballerina performs a classical variation alone on a vast ice sheet at the Arctic pole, her movements precise and defiant against the frozen expanse, tone ethereal and isolating, building from wide establishing shots to intimate close-ups of her technique.
LOCATION — endless white ice field stretching to horizon, jagged pressure ridges in mid-distance, pale blue sky with diffuse sun low on horizon, wind-sculpted snow drifts, surface glare, sub-zero clarity, no vegetation or structures.

Start on a wide aerial establishing shot, drone descending from 60 feet, the ballerina a small white figure centered on the ice, her shadow stretching long across the snow, anamorphic flare catching the low sun. Cut to a ground-level wide, locked-off 35mm, the ballerina in arabesque, pointe shoe planted on ice, arms extended, wind pulling at her tutu, ice field vast behind her. Cut to a medium tracking shot, 85mm shallow depth, camera circling her as she executes a series of pirouettes, her face concentrated, breath visible in cold air, ice crystals catching light. Cut to a close-up of her feet, 85mm macro-tight, pointe shoes on ice, toes flexing and gripping the slick surface, micro-adjustments visible, ice cracking faintly under pressure. Cut to a low-angle medium, 35mm, the ballerina leaping in grand jeté, body suspended mid-air against pale sky, tutu floating, arms reaching, landing clean on ice with controlled impact.

SFX: wind howling steady across ice, pointe shoes scraping and tapping on hard surface, fabric rustling, sharp exhales, ice cracking faintly under weight, landing thud.

entries.title: Paper Plane Seasonal Journey Video
entries.description: A cinematic one-take prompt featuring a paper plane navigating through changing seasons in an old city street, emphasizing smooth transitions and environmental consistency.
entries.prompt:
生成一支15秒、16:9、720p的写实电影质感奇幻短片。全片以同一架米白色手折纸飞机为唯一主角，纸张纹理、折痕、尺寸和飞行方向始终一致。采用一镜到底的低空跟随镜头，镜头位于纸飞机后侧约半米，平稳向前移动，不突然切镜，不穿模。

0至3.5秒，清晨的老城区春日街道，樱花花瓣随微风掠过，纸飞机从一扇打开的教室窗户飞出，镜头立即跟上。柔和晨光，空气清透，只听见风声、远处鸟鸣和很轻的钢琴前奏。

3.5至7秒，纸飞机从一棵近景树冠后掠过，遮挡完成自然转场。街道进入盛夏午后，绿荫浓密，短暂阵雨落下，纸面沾上少量水珠但不破损、不变形。镜头保持相同距离和运动方向，雨声与钢琴节奏略微增强。

7至10.5秒，纸飞机贴近一辆驶过的旧公交车，利用车身遮挡转入深秋黄昏。金黄色落叶沿同一风向卷起，夕阳从画面右侧照亮纸飞机折痕。它短暂下坠后重新被气流托起，动作符合空气阻力，不瞬移。

10.5至15秒，纸飞机穿过一团近景白雾，街道进入安静冬夜，屋檐和路面覆有薄雪。镜头逐渐绕到纸飞机侧前方，露出巷口一名约八岁、穿深蓝棉衣的男孩。他抬手接住纸飞机，低头看见机翼内侧有一行稚嫩铅笔字「给长大后的我」。男孩停顿一秒，抬头望向纸飞机飞来的方向，钢琴只留下一个尾音，画面自然停住。

四季必须发生在同一条街道和同一飞行路径上，建筑空间、屏幕方向和镜头轴线连续。纸飞机全程只有一架，不改变颜色、材质、折法和大小。季节变化只通过遮挡转场、光线、植被、天气与环境声完成。禁止额外纸飞机、人物突然出现或消失、文字乱码、纸张融化、镜头跳切、画面闪烁、平台水印、字幕、旁白和多余对白。
entries.translated_prompt:
Generate a 15-second, 16:9, 720p realistic cinematic fantasy short film. The entire film features a single off-white hand-folded paper plane as the sole protagonist, with consistent paper texture, fold lines, size, and flight direction throughout. Use a one-take low-altitude following shot, with the camera positioned about half a meter behind the paper plane, moving steadily forward without sudden cuts or clipping.

0 to 3.5 seconds: A spring morning street in an old town, cherry blossoms drifting in the breeze. The paper plane flies out of an open classroom window, and the camera immediately follows. Soft morning light, clear air, with sounds of wind, distant birds, and a very light piano intro.

3.5 to 7 seconds: The paper plane glides behind a foreground tree canopy, completing a natural transition through occlusion. The street enters a midsummer afternoon with thick shade and a brief rain shower; small water droplets appear on the paper surface without damaging or deforming it. The camera maintains the same distance and direction of movement, with rain sounds and piano rhythm slightly intensifying.

7 to 10.5 seconds: The paper plane flies close to a passing old bus, using the vehicle body for a transition into a late autumn twilight. Golden fallen leaves swirl in the same wind direction, and the setting sun illuminates the paper plane's folds from the right. It briefly dips before being lifted by an air current again, moving according to air resistance without teleporting.

10.5 to 15 seconds: The paper plane passes through a patch of foreground white mist, and the street enters a quiet winter night with thin snow covering the eaves and road. The camera gradually moves to the front side of the paper plane, revealing an eight-year-old boy in a navy cotton coat at an alley entrance. He raises his hand to catch the paper plane and looks down to see a line of childish pencil handwriting on the inside of the wing: 'To my future self'. The boy pauses for a second, looking up in the direction the paper plane came from. The piano leaves only a final note, and the scene stops naturally.

The four seasons must occur on the same street and flight path, with continuous architectural space, screen orientation, and camera axes. There is only one paper plane throughout, with no changes in color, material, folding method, or size. Seasonal changes are achieved only through occlusion transitions, lighting, vegetation, weather, and ambient sounds. No additional paper planes, sudden appearances or disappearances of characters, garbled text, melting paper, jump cuts, flickering frames, platform watermarks, subtitles, narration, or extra dialogue.

entries.title: FPV Construction Site Transformation
entries.description: A complex FPV drone prompt illustrating a synchronized mechanical construction transformation of a modern building.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-dynamic continuous FPV construction transformation. Keep one identical modern building, one identical construction site, exact same architecture and final design throughout. The entire construction site behaves like one enormous synchronized MEGA MACHINE, where every movement mechanically activates the next.

Photorealistic Hollywood construction action, IMAX scale, 14mm extreme wide-angle, aggressive speed ramps, steel-blue shadows, warm construction-orange highlights, realistic dust, sparks, debris, motion blur and metallic reflections. One uninterrupted FPV shot, no cuts.

00:00–00:02- CORE ACTIVATION
Camera flies through the unfinished building toward a massive rotating mechanical construction core. Hydraulic arms suddenly extend and lock into the central structure. A powerful metal impact sends sparks across the lens, triggering the entire site.

Multiple tower cranes begin rotating in perfect synchronization. Their cables release enormous steel frames that swing through the air and lock precisely onto the building. Camera races between the moving structures with extreme near-misses.

00:04–00:06-STRUCTURE RISE
Hydraulic construction platforms activate simultaneously. Columns extend upward while horizontal beams automatically slide into their connection points. Each lock triggers the next structural section, creating a rapid upward mechanical wave.

Camera dives through the building. Massive floor platforms travel along industrial rails from both sides, rapidly locking into place floor by floor. Mechanical clamps snap shut immediately behind the camera as the structure rises around it.

00:08–00:10- ROTATING FRAME
Camera bursts outside and performs a fast vertical orbit. Entire structural frames rotate upward from the ground like giant mechanical arms and lock into the building. The unfinished skeleton rapidly becomes the exact final silhouette.

00:10–00:12- FACADE STORM
Hundreds of white curved façade sections and blue reflective glass panels launch from automated installation platforms. They fly toward the building in synchronized waves and snap perfectly into position around the curved exterior.

00:12–00:13.5- GLASS LOCK
Camera races along the façade as one enormous glass panel moves directly beside the lens. Speed suddenly drops into brief bullet time. Sparks and dust float almost motionless. The panel rotates and locks into its frame with a powerful mechanical impact.

00:13.5–00:15- FINAL MACHINE RELEASE
The final impact activates every remaining construction mechanism at once. Rooftop elements, final glazing and architectural details rapidly lock into place. Camera shoots above the roof, performs a fast 180° rotation and pulls far backward into a monumental aerial reveal of the fully completed building above the city

entries.title: Fox Vlogger in Golden Meadow
entries.description: A detailed 30-second continuous vlog prompt featuring an anthropomorphic fox exploring a flower meadow, specifying camera shake, focus pulls, and dialogue.
entries.prompt:
Create a single continuous self-filmed vlog recorded on a handheld action camera in 16:9 aspect ratio. The camera is always held by the anthropomorphic fox, creating a natural first-person selfie perspective with light wind-induced shake, occasional soft lens flares from sunlight, realistic focus pulls, and dynamic walking/leaning motion. No cuts, transitions, or cinematic effects. Include a subtle realistic digital timestamp in the bottom-right corner that progresses naturally throughout the video.
Visual Style: Bright modern 4K digital look with vibrant yet soft natural colors, warm mid-afternoon golden sunlight mixed with gentle shadows, soft bokeh on distant flowers, subtle pollen or floating seeds in the air, crisp details on fur and petals. Slight handheld energy but smooth enough for casual vlogging. Widescreen 16:9 framing.
Character: Ember, a 24-year-old anthropomorphic red fox (bipedal, human-like proportions) with soft fluffy reddish-orange fur, white chest and muzzle, bright amber eyes, pointed ears, and a long bushy tail that sways naturally. He wears a simple light denim jacket with rolled sleeves over a soft cream t-shirt and comfortable cargo shorts. Personality: curious, warm, slightly playful and soft-spoken.
Location: Starts in a wide open golden meadow filled with tall wildflowers (yellow buttercups, purple lupines, white daisies) surrounded by distant soft green hills and a few scattered oak trees under a clear blue sky with a few wispy clouds. Gentle breeze moving the grass and flowers.
Sequence (exactly 30 seconds, continuous take with timestamps):
0:00 – 0:05
Ember lifts the camera, smiles softly at the lens with his ears perking up, and says in a warm, slightly raspy voice:
“Hey friends… look at this meadow I just wandered into.”
0:05 – 0:13
He walks slowly through the tall flowers, lowering the camera slightly to show the colorful blooms and butterflies fluttering past while continuing:
“The whole field is glowing… and there are so many little butterflies.”
0:13 – 0:20
He crouches carefully among the flowers, gently reaches one paw toward a yellow bloom without picking it, and watches a butterfly land nearby, laughing lightly:
“Hi little one… you’re so delicate.”
0:20 – 0:26
He turns the camera to capture both his face and the meadow, then sits cross-legged in a soft patch of grass, letting his tail curl beside him. He gazes around for a few seconds and says quietly:
“Places like this make the world feel endless and calm.”
0:26 – 0:30
He stands up, waves one paw at the camera with a gentle smile, and says:
“Thanks for coming along today. See you next time.”
The camera naturally lowers a little as he continues walking deeper into the meadow.

entries.title: Pixar Style Gym Animation

- JAKE (to himself, confident): "Watch this."
- ZARA (surprised, to Theo): "Wait— you can do THAT?"
- THEO (modest shrug): "...it's just grip strength."
- JAKE (muttering, deflated): "...grip strength."

Style: stylized 3D Pixar-animated rendering, soft rounded shapes, warm golden-hour lighting, glossy cartoon textures, expressive exaggerated key poses, natural comedic timing on the reveal beat.
NEGATIVE: face drift, deformed hands, extra fingers, unrealistic gym equipment physics, morphing outfits, inconsistent character design between characters, flat lighting, blurry.

Next to the dog, immediately beside him at the same depth in the frame, a realistic ginger cat sits upright like a calm storyteller, holding an open yellow book with its paws. The dog is on the left and the cat is on the right, sitting close together in bed. The cat and dog must look like real animals with realistic fur, anatomy, lighting, and texture — NOT cartoonish, NOT animated in a toy-like way. Keep the environment natural and believable.

Soft digital tape camcorder look with subtle vintage DV character. A locked or very gently drifting medium-wide shot from the foot-side of the bed, framing both animals clearly. Slight natural camera imperfection is okay, but keep it subtle. entries.title: Korean Woman Cat Interaction DV Vlog
entries.description: A detailed story-based prompt for Seedance 2.5 following a young Korean woman interacting with a cat in a quiet Seoul neighborhood, using a MiniDV camcorder style.
entries.prompt:
Main Subject: Young Korean woman, early 20s, wearing a loose faded green T-shirt, white lounge pants, white socks and a thin silver necklace. Long dark hair tied into a messy ponytail. Keep her appearance identical.
Location: Quiet old Seoul residential neighborhood during a warm late afternoon.
Story: She notices a small cat sitting outside her apartment and leaves some food for it. The cat suddenly walks away down the alley, and she playfully follows it. The camcorder follows behind her as she passes gardens, bicycles and small houses. The cat disappears beneath a staircase. She crouches down and calls for it, laughing when it suddenly appears behind her. She picks up the cat gently, carries it back toward her apartment and sits outside while it rests beside her.
Style: Ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV footage, candid home-video feeling, heavy handheld movement, autofocus hunting, imperfect framing, faded colors, soft contrast, slight sensor noise and natural exposure shifts.
Audio: Cat sounds, footsteps, birds, distant motorcycles, wind, neighborhood chatter and natural apartment ambience. No music or narration.
Goal for all stories: They should feel like ordinary moments accidentally captured on an old family camcorder—not staged, not cinematic, slightly messy, warm, spontaneous and genuinely believable.

entries.title: China Travel Vlog Storyboard
entries.description: A comprehensive storyboard-driven travel vlog prompt set in China, maintaining character consistency across iconic locations like the Great Wall and Forbidden City using smartphone-style footage.
entries.prompt:
[Reference Role]
@Image 1 is a 13-panel storyboard grid (Row 1: 4 panels | Row 2: 5 panels | Row 3: 4 panels), read left to right, top row first. It defines three things: (a) the woman's facial identity, hair, and skin; (b) her wardrobe; (c) each shot's location, framing, and lighting. Do NOT reproduce the grid layout, panel borders, split-screen, or collage seams — the output is one continuous edited video showing a single full-frame image at any moment. Do not use any background person from the grid as a recurring character.

[Subject Profile: the Vlogger]
Same woman as @Image 1 throughout. Korean idol-like woman in her early 20s, long straight black hair with soft natural volume, fair skin, large bright expressive eyes, delicate V-line face, small nose, natural glossy lips, fresh minimal makeup, warm and approachable expression.
Default outfit (all shots except Shot 5): ivory mandarin-collar long-sleeve top with frog-button closures, charcoal wide-leg trousers, small black crossbody bag on a thin strap.
Shot 5 outfit only: short-sleeve red silk qipao with gold-and-pink floral embroidery, mandarin collar, thin bracelet on right wrist.
She is one single continuous person — never duplicate or split her.

[Visual Style]
Authentic smartphone travel footage. 26mm phone lens, deep focus, realistic skin texture with visible pores, mild HDR, neutral iPhone color science, handheld with small natural sway. Unedited candid look: no cinematic grading, no studio lighting, no light trails, no artificial bloom or glow effects, no added motion-blur effects. Imperfect framing, occasional slight tilt, real night grain in low light.

[Shots — timestamps are time budgets per event, not frame-accurate cuts]

Shot 1 (0:00–0:01.8) Great Wall. Low-angle selfie on the stone steps, watchtowers and ridgeline behind her, sky overexposed to near white. Wind lifts her hair, she breaks into a natural open smile mid-frame-adjust. She says in Korean: {드디어 중국에 왔어요...!} Hard cut.

Shot 2 (0:01.8–0:02.8) Forbidden City. Mid-stride through the vermilion gate, golden roof tiles above, wide stone courtyard behind. She turns her head back toward camera without stopping. Overcast daylight. Snap cut.

Shot 3 (0:02.8–0:03.8) Hutong food stall. She pushes a freshly steamed baozi close to the lens, eyebrows raised, mouth open in an exaggerated delighted reaction. Steam drifts across frame, harsh bare-bulb interior light, whites slightly clipped. Snap cut.

Shot 4 (0:03.8–0:04.6) Temple of Heaven park. Seated on a wooden bench under old cypress trees, chin lifted, looking away from camera. Dappled daylight, small lens smudge in the corner, ambient sound opens up for a beat. Cut on natural movement.

Shot 5 (0:04.6–0:06.1) Chinese restaurant, red qipao. Seated at a round table with dim sum baskets and small dishes, chopsticks lifting food to her mouth, eyes squeezing shut as she laughs mid-bite. Red lanterns glowing behind her, warm amber practical light, realistic skin in amber. She says in Korean: {진짜 맛있어!} Cut on the end of the laugh.

Shot 6 (0:06.1–0:07.1) Xi'an night market. Standing in the crowded lane holding a lamb skewer, red lanterns and neon signage overhead, uneven warm and pink light on her face, crowd blurred around her. Small closed-mouth smile toward camera. High ISO grain. Snap cut.

Shot 7 (0:07.1–0:08.1) High-speed train at night. She sits by the window, her face doubled in the glass reflection, city lights streaking past outside. She looks out, not at camera. Slight ghosting on the glass. Snap cut.

Shot 8 (0:08.1–0:09.1) Terracotta Army pit, Xi'an. Shot from behind at the railing, rows of clay warriors receding below, she leans forward slowly to look down. Dim museum hall light. Snap cut.

Shot 9 (0:09.1–0:10.1) ★ SIGNATURE — Sichuan opera teahouse, Chengdu. Profile close-up. A bianlian performer in a painted mask stands on the lit stage behind her. Her eyes widen and her mouth opens slightly as the mask changes; red, violet and blue stage light lands directly on her skin. Rack focus — her face sharp, the stage diffused. Projection on skin only, no bloom. Speed: roughly 60% slow motion. Soft cut.

Shot 10 (0:10.1–0:10.9) Leshan Giant Buddha. Wide low angle, she stands very small at the viewing railing while the enormous carved stone Buddha fills the frame above her. Slight barrel distortion, sky slightly blown out. Sharp cut.

Shot 11 (0:10.9–0:11.9) Jinli lantern alley, Chengdu. Following her from behind down the narrow lane, rows of red lanterns overhead, warm highlights against deep dark shadows. She glances back over her shoulder once, then keeps walking. Cut on forward movement.

Shot 12 (0:11.9–0:13.5) Shanghai skyline. Close selfie, then her arm extends and the Lujiazui skyline and river open up behind her. Wind blows strands of hair across the lens. Her eyes drift off camera toward the towers and her smile softens. Natural night phone exposure. She says in Korean: {이런 야경은 차음 봐요...} Hard cut on the last word.

Shot 13 (0:13.5–0:15) Chengdu panda base. She crouches and holds out a bamboo shoot toward a panda cub. The cub grabs it and leans into her; a second cub pushes against her back and she rocks off balance, bursting into genuine laughter. Handheld, off-centre, slightly unsteady. Soft daylight, green bamboo behind. She says in Korean: {잠깐! 넘어질 육했어!} Fade to black.

[Audio]
No background music at any point. Diegetic ambience only, changing with each location: <wind over open stone steps>, <footsteps and distant crowd chatter>, <sizzling and stall noise>, <birdsong and rustling leaves>, <clinking chopsticks and restaurant murmur>, <dense night-market crowd and vendor calls>, <muffled high-speed train hum>, <hushed indoor echo>, <opera gongs and audience gasps>, <open-air wind>, <quiet footsteps on stone>, <river wind and distant traffic>, <bamboo rustle and panda chewing>. Her voice is a natural young Korean woman's speaking voice, unprocessed, at real handheld-phone recording distance.

[Maintain Consistency]
Same face, same hair length and parting, same body proportions in every shot. Default outfit unchanged across all shots except Shot 5. The black crossbody bag stays on the same shoulder whenever visible. Only one woman appears in the entire video. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermarks, no split-screen or grid at any point.

entries.title: Office Body Horror Transformation Film
entries.description: A multi-shot Seedance 2.5 prompt for a 30-second corporate horror film, featuring a woman at a cubicle transforming into a jointed creature.
entries.prompt:
Shot 1 (0.0–1.2s): (ref image), matching reference face/outfit, alone at her late-night cubicle, exhausted, screen glow, empty office, realistic corporate horror.

Shot 2 (1.2–2.4s): She types mechanically; her monitor reflection moves half a second out of sync, dim lighting, subtle unease.

Shot 3 (2.4–3.6s): Coworker passes, notices the delayed reflection, stops uneasily.

Shot 4 (3.6–4.8s): Her hands tremble, breathing rapid, panic building, cold monitor light, close-up.

Shot 5 (4.8–6.0s): Fingers bend backward on keyboard with a crack, knuckles distorting, terrified eyes, extreme close-up, body horror.

Shot 6 (6.0–7.2s): Coworkers stand, alarmed; phones and papers fall as they back away, handheld camera.

Shot 7 (7.2–8.5s): Her spine arches backward, joints pop, limbs elongate unnaturally, dim cubicle lighting.

Shot 8 (8.5–10.0s): Spindly many-jointed creature emerges from her collapsing form, limbs folding wrong, pale glistening skin, full reveal.

Shot 9 (10.0–11.5s): Creature skitters across cubicle wall, joints clicking; coworkers scramble below in terror.

Shot 10 (11.5–13.0s): Terrified coworker's face, frozen scream, chaos reflected in wide eyes, cinematic shallow focus.

Shot 11 (13.0–14.5s): Creature leaps desk-to-desk, smashing monitors/keyboards, long limbs, motion blur, frantic handheld camera.

Shot 12 (14.5–16.0s): Coworkers flee through cubicle maze, papers flying, fluorescent lights flickering, chaos.

Shot 13 (16.0–17.3s): Creature silently drops before fleeing coworker, joints bending inward, crouched low, extreme close-up.

Shot 14 (17.3–18.7s): Coworkers sprint toward break room, looking back in terror, motion blur, corporate horror chase.

Shot 15 (18.7–20.0s): Group slams break-room door and barricades it with table/chairs, shaking hands, frantic teamwork.

Shot 16 (20.0–21.4s): Long jointed limb slides under door, claws floor; coworkers back against far wall.

Shot 17 (21.4–22.8s): Coworker grabs fire extinguisher, pulls safety pin as door buckles.

Shot 18 (22.8–24.2s): Creature bursts through door, limbs unfolding to full height, flickering fluorescent light, dramatic reveal.

Shot 19 (24.2–25.6s): Coworker blasts creature with extinguisher; thick white cloud, creature recoils and flails.

Shot 20 (25.6–27.0s): Another coworker throws a stapler at its head; hard impact, shriek, creature staggers.

Shot 21 (27.0–28.5s): Powder-covered creature scrambles backward through broken doorway and retreats down dark hallway.

Shot 22 (28.5–30.0s): Coworkers huddle in break-room doorway, covered in residue, silently staring down the empty hallway, cinematic horror ending.

entries.title: Realistic Female Facial Expression Control
entries.description: Detailed temporal control prompt for generating realistic facial expressions and physical interactions like cheek pinching on an East Asian female.
entries.prompt: 9:16竖版，8秒，电影级超写实年轻成年东方女性面部近景，一镜到底，全程无切镜、无跳切、无转场。 严格保持参考人物身份 {{Mixed 1}} 、五官比例、脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、眉毛、发型、肤色与年龄完全一致，不重新设计人物，不发生换脸或五官漂移。 摄影机固定在人物正前方，与双眼基本同高，人物脸部位于画面中央，头顶保留极少空间，下方只露出少量颈部。近距离人像镜头，接近70–85mm中长焦视觉效果，避免广角脸部变形。 全程摄影机基本固定，不推近、不拉远、不环绕。人物头部也基本保持静止，主要依靠眼球、眼睑、眉毛、嘴唇、下颌和脸颊肌肉完成表演。 柔和均匀的正面散射光，明亮冷白高调人像，背景简洁浅冷灰蓝。人物皮肤白净通透但真实，保留极细微皮肤纹理，眼睛清澈湿润有明显高光，嘴唇具有自然水润反光，淡粉腮红，整体像高质量美容近景摄影，不要塑料皮，不要CG感。 ## 0.0–0.8秒 固定镜头。 人物正面直视镜头，头部完全保持稳定。 双眼自然睁开，上下眼睑放松，目光稳定落在镜头中央。 嘴唇自然微张，上下唇之间留有很窄的缝隙，下颌放松，能够看到少量上排牙齿。 保持约半秒后，嘴唇开始自然合拢，不要突然闭嘴。 整个过程只有轻微自然呼吸，鼻翼几乎不动。 ## 0.8–1.6秒 嘴唇完全闭合。 随后双唇轻轻向内压紧，下唇稍微向前顶，颏肌开始轻微收缩，下巴中央出现很浅的细小凹凸。 双眼仍然先看镜头。 约1.4秒后，眼球开始先于头部向画面左侧移动。 头部不要跟随转动。 ## 1.6–2.8秒 人物保持头部完全朝向正前方。 只有双眼明显看向画面左侧，形成“头不动、眼睛先偷看旁边”的状态。 视线在侧方停留，不快速来回扫动。 双唇继续轻轻压紧，下唇保持轻微前伸，嘴角基本水平。 颏肌保持轻度收缩，下巴下方出现自然的肌肉纹理。 不要微笑。 不要皱眉。 这一段主要依靠侧向眼神和压住的嘴唇形成表情。 ## 2.8–3.3秒 视线开始从画面左侧返回镜头中央。 在返回过程中完成一次自然偏慢的眨眼： 上眼睑先向下落，双眼短暂闭合，再重新睁开。 不要连续眨眼。 睁眼之后视线重新稳定落在镜头。 嘴唇的压力稍微松开，但仍保持闭合。 ## 3.3–4.4秒 人物开始出现明显的面部变化。 两侧内眉逐渐向上提，同时眉心轻微向中央收拢。 眉间形成很浅的竖向皱褶，但不要深度皱眉。 下眼睑稍微绷紧，双眼继续直视镜头。 嘴角开始轻微向下压。 颏肌再次收缩，下唇明显向前推出一点，形成自然的下唇前顶。 上下唇仍然闭合。 下巴稍微收紧。 这一变化必须逐渐形成： 先动眉毛， 再收紧下眼睑， 最后才让下唇向前推出。 不要同时完成所有动作。 ## 4.4–5.0秒 人物保持当前面部状态。 一只手从画面右侧边缘进入。 手部动作速度自然，不要突然出现。 拇指与食指逐渐靠近人物画面右侧的脸颊。 人物眼睛仍然看着镜头，不需要明显转头看手。 眉心继续轻微收紧。 下唇保持前顶。 ## 5.0–6.8秒 拇指和食指轻轻夹住人物画面右侧脸颊的软组织。 手指首先接触皮肤，然后才逐渐施加压力。 脸颊皮肤在接触点出现真实压陷。 随后手指将脸颊轻轻向画面右侧并略微向外拉动。 皮肤、嘴角和下颌受到物理牵引产生局部形变。 只有被捏住的一侧脸颊发生明显变化，另一侧脸保持自然。 人物眉心进一步轻微收拢。 内眉仍然保持上提。 下眼睑稍微收紧。 眼睛保持较大程度睁开并直视镜头。 下唇因为脸颊受到牵拉而进一步向前突出。 不要张嘴。 不要尖叫。 不要摇头。 不要做夸张疼痛表情。 重点表现： 手指真实压入柔软脸颊， 皮肤受到挤压， 脸颊局部产生弹性形变， 眉眼只有轻度反应。 手指施力不是匀速的。 接触后停顿一下， 再稍微增加一点压力， 然后保持。 ## 6.8–7.2秒 手指逐渐减小压力。 被夹住的脸颊开始自然回弹。 手指松开后缓慢离开皮肤，但仍短暂停留在画面右侧附近。 脸颊恢复原本轮廓。 眉心的紧绷开始略微减弱。 下唇也逐渐减少前顶幅度。 不要瞬间恢复成完全中性脸。 必须保留约0.2秒的表情残留。 ## 7.2–7.55秒 人物完成一次明显但自然的闭眼。 上眼睑快速落下。 双眼短暂闭合。 眉毛开始放松。 嘴唇也稍微松开。 下颌不再绷紧。 这是整个镜头中一个很短的“重置停顿”。 ## 7.55–8.0秒 重新睁开双眼后，不再看镜头中央。 眼球立即向画面左上方移动。 头部仍然基本保持正面，不跟随眼球明显转动。 形成明显的“只动眼睛、不动头”的侧上方视线。 眉心基本舒展开。 嘴唇重新轻微分开一条小缝。 下颌放松。 保持这个眼神约最后0.2秒结束画面。 不要笑。 不要再次皱眉。 不要再加入新的动作。 --- ## 表演节奏控制 整段表演遵循： 前2秒以嘴唇和眼神为主； 2–3秒用一次眨眼完成状态转换； 3–4.4秒才逐渐加入眉毛和下唇； 4.4秒以后手部才出现； 5–6.8秒为整个镜头唯一明显的物理动作高潮； 7秒以后迅速降低动作强度； 最后只用一次闭眼和斜上方眼神完成收尾。 人物不能一直活动。 每一个明显动作之间必须存在极短暂停顿。 面部动作不要全部同步启动。 眼球、眼睑、眉毛、嘴唇之间应有约0.1–0.3秒的自然时间差。 --- ## 面部动作重点 侧看时： 眼球先移动，头保持静止。 委屈表情形成时： 内眉上抬 + 眉心轻微收拢 + 下眼睑轻微绷紧 + 颏肌收缩 + 下唇前顶。 不要用“瞪大眼睛+撅嘴+皱眉”同时出现的夸张卡通表达。 捏脸时： 主要变化来自真实物理挤压，而不是人物主动做更大的表情。 被捏一侧皮肤明显变形，另一侧基本保持原状态。 松开后： 皮肤需要有自然弹性回弹过程，不允许一帧瞬间恢复。 --- ## 声音与呼吸 无人物台词。 全程只保留非常轻微的自然呼吸。 0–3秒呼吸平稳。 3–5秒眉心收紧以后，可以出现一次很轻的鼻腔吸气。 捏脸过程中不要发出夸张叫声。 如果生成环境声音，只保留极轻微衣物、手指与皮肤接触产生的细小摩擦声。 不要配夸张卡通音效。

entries.title: Elevator Doppelganger Horror Sequence
entries.description: A chilling cinematic horror sequence prompt where a woman encounters her identical doppelganger in a flickering elevator corridor at night.
entries.prompt:
Create a highly realistic cinematic horror sequence set inside a quiet apartment building late at night. A young woman enters an empty elevator alone, wearing simple casual clothes, with natural realistic facial features and subtle nervous expressions. The elevator moves strangely, stopping at several floors. Every time the doors open, the exact same long, empty apartment corridor appears outside, dimly lit by flickering ceiling lights. She becomes increasingly confused and frightened, repeatedly pressing the elevator buttons and looking down the corridor.
On the final stop, the elevator doors slowly slide open. At the far end of the corridor stands another young woman who looks exactly identical to her, motionless and staring directly at her. The atmosphere becomes completely silent. The woman inside the elevator slowly steps forward, unable to understand what she is seeing. The identical woman suddenly tilts her head at an unnatural angle and takes one slow step toward her.
Without warning, the corridor woman violently charges toward her with extremely fast, unnatural movement. The original woman screams and tries to retreat into the elevator, but the other woman tackles her and both fall to the floor. The corridor woman grabs her and aggressively drags her backward across the floor while the original woman desperately tries to hold onto the elevator doorway. The elevator lights flicker rapidly, casting harsh moving shadows across both faces.
The original woman manages to reach one hand toward the elevator control panel, desperately trying to press the door-close button. The corridor woman suddenly grabs her wrist and pulls her away. The elevator doors begin closing by themselves, slowly separating the two women. The original woman reaches toward the narrowing gap in panic while the identical woman stares at her with an eerie, emotionless expression.

The doors finally slam shut.

Cut to a completely empty corridor. No one is visible. A smartphone lies on the floor where the struggle happened, its screen still glowing and displaying 2:13 AM. The hallway lights flicker once, then everything goes completely dark.

Ultra-photorealistic live-action horror, realistic human movement, believable apartment building textures, natural skin detail, subtle handheld camera movement, cinematic low-light exposure, practical fluorescent lighting, deep shadows, atmospheric tension, realistic motion blur, disturbing but non-gory horror, no supernatural visual effects, no text overlays, no subtitles, no cartoon appearance.

entries.title: Snail Express 3D Animation Script
entries.description: A highly detailed 3D Pixar-style animation script for an action-comedy scene featuring a racing snail named Shelldon, complete with macro shots and slow-motion sequences.
entries.prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | 3D Pixar family animation. Lush garden macro world, golden hour lighting, action-comedy with slow-motion heroics against real-time chaos, vibrant and dynamic colors, highly detailed textures, cinematic camera work.

00–03s  
Extreme close-up: Snail Shelldon ties a bright green leaf-cape to his shell and blows a tiny party whistle. A nervous ladybug passenger buckles into a leaf-harness on his back. Macro lens, shallow depth of field.  
Shelldon: “All aboard the Express!”  
Ladybug: “This is a terrible idea!”

03–05s  
Wide shot: Shelldon launches onto a green garden hose like a roller-coaster track. An ant pushing a pebble freezes in pure terror. Static camera then rapid pan.  
Ant: “WRONG TRACK!”

05–08s  
Tracking shot: Shelldon glides in glorious slow-motion. Dewdrops hang frozen in the air. Ladybug screams with a mix of terror and joy. 360-degree bullet-time rotation around the snail.  
Ladybug: “WE ARE GONNA DIE!”  
Shelldon: “Keep all limbs inside the ride!”

08–11s  
Wide shot: Sprinkler activates ahead. Real-time water jets blast upward. Shelldon enters the water-arc tunnel in slow-motion. Low angle, dramatic water silhouettes.  
Ladybug: “TUNNEL!”

11–14s  
Close-up: Shelldon’s determined face. Water droplets hit his shell and refract rainbows. Macro face close-up.  
Shelldon: “Choo… choo…”

14–17s  
Wide shot: Lawnmower roars to life in the distance. Ants scatter in panic. Shelldon is still mid-crossing the hose. Rapid zoom out.  
Ant Guard: “CODE GREEN! CODE GREEN!”

17–22s  
Tracking shot: Lawnmower blades spin dangerously fast toward Shelldon. He inches forward heroically. Ladybug covers her eyes. Low tracking shot with grass blurring past.  
Ladybug: “I want my mommy!”  
Shelldon: “Next stop: Destiny!”

22–26s  
Wide slow-motion: The lawnmower passes directly over Shelldon. Grass blades bend and part around him like a Moses moment. He emerges unharmed with a single grass blade stuck on his head like a trophy. Under-slug angle through the grass. Triumphant orchestral hit.

26–28s  
Close-up: Shelldon reaches the end of the hose. Ladybug kisses the dirt in relief. Shelldon tips an imaginary hat. Gentle push-in.  
Shelldon: “Thank you for riding Snail Express.”

28–30s  
Title card: Black screen. Bold colorful letters “THE SNAIL EXPRESS” appear with a tiny leaf-cape fluttering beside them. Soft party-whistle toot.

entries.title: Indonesian Market Vlog Camcorder
entries.description: An ultra-realistic live-action vlog prompt following an Indonesian woman through a busy neighborhood market, captured with the raw look of a late-2000s personal camcorder.
entries.prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | Ultra-realistic live-action

Use image1 only for exact face, hairstyle, skin tone, and body proportions.

Adult Indonesian woman in a busy neighborhood food market, searching for ingredients to make traditional spicy chili sauce.

Outfit: dusty-blue loose cotton shirt, dark brown ankle-length skirt, woven shoulder bag, brown sandals, wooden-bead bracelet, tiny silver studs. Hair loosely tied with natural flyaways. Outfit stays identical.

Style: raw late-2000s personal camcorder footage. Handheld, shaky walking camera, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, mild lens smudging, faded warm colors, digital noise, compression artifacts, no stabilization, no beauty filter, no cinematic look.

00–04s

Walking toward the market. She looks at camera:
“Okay, let's see what we can find today.”
Motorbikes, vendors, natural market activity.

04–08s

She enters the market and examines red/green chilies, tomatoes, shallots, garlic, limes and herbs. Elderly vendor recommends the hotter chilies.
“That one? Seriously?”
Both laugh naturally.

08–12s

She selects ingredients and puts them into her woven bag. Vendor weighs them on an old mechanical scale. Camera briefly loses focus.

12–16s

She notices a traditional food stall where a cook grinds chili mixture in a heavy stone mortar. She crouches and asks:
“Do you always make it this way?”

16–20s

She tries grinding the mixture herself. Uses too much force, ingredients splash slightly. Everyone laughs. She tries again and gets smoother.

20–24s

She tastes the chili. A moment later, her eyes widen from the heat. She fans her mouth and says:
“Okay… that's definitely spicy.”

24–27s

She walks out carrying her bag, waves to a vendor, scooter passes nearby. Camera follows naturally.

27–30s

Under a shaded awning, she checks her ingredients, smiles at camera:
“Alright, I think we have everything. Let's go make something good.”
She reaches toward the camera, fingers cover the lens, exposure shifts, recording ends naturally.

AUDIO: Native market sounds only—voices, vendors, footsteps, motorbikes, plastic bags, scale clicks, grinding, sizzling food, birds, laughter, breathing. No music or narration.

REALISM: Natural physics, realistic hands and food interaction, spontaneous expressions, independent background people, delayed camera reactions.

NEGATIVE: No copied sequence, wardrobe, dialogue or character design; no logos, subtitles, watermarks, commercial look, CGI, plastic skin, HDR, stabilization, perfect framing, fake props, duplicated people, distorted hands, extra fingers, face drift, outfit/hairstyle changes, floating objects, unrealistic food physics, artificial blur, fantasy environment, background music.
