A thin natural stream of cigarette smoke rises and bends with the morning air. Lia briefly takes a small sip of coffee, lowers the glass, casually looks toward the cameraman behind the lens and gives a tiny amused smile. Camera is not perfectly centered and slowly drifts a few centimeters while the operator settles his grip. Tropical morning sunlight illuminates the yard while Lia remains partially under terrace shade. Moving leaves create soft shifting dappled shadows. Exposure reacts slightly to the bright yard behind her. 00:02.8–00:04.5 CAMERAMAN speaks from behind the camera, playful and casually surprised: "widiihh lia santai amat" The cameraman remains completely off-screen. While listening, Lia keeps her lips closed except for a tiny amused smile. She glances toward the lens/operator, lightly raises her eyebrows and relaxes the cigarette hand near her knee. 00:04.5–00:09.7 LIA answers, conversational and excited with a natural light Javanese-Indonesian accent: "iya mas pagi hari itu wajib ngopi dan udud kalau ga bisa pusing loh" Accurate Indonesian lip sync ONLY for Lia. She speaks while sitting naturally rather than performing for camera. Small head movement, lively eyebrows, natural blinking, relaxed shoulders. After finishing the spoken line, she takes a tiny relaxed breath; do not make her drink while her mouth is actively speaking. The camera operator makes a very small late correction to keep her face centered. Autofocus briefly breathes, then settles back on Lia. 00:09.7–00:11.5 CAMERAMAN asks from behind the camera: "habis udud mau kemana lia?" Lia remains silent while he speaks. No Lia lip-sync. She tilts her head slightly, looks amused and shifts her weight forward as if preparing to get up. 00:11.5–00:14.5 LIA answers with growing excitement and a playful inviting expression: "ayo ikut aku mancing mas mauu?" Accurate lip sync. On "mauu?" she lifts her eyebrows, smiles toward the cameraman and leans forward slightly, inviting him to follow. Keep the delivery spontaneous, like talking to a real friend, not presenting to an audience. 00:14.5–00:17.5 Dialogue pauses. Lia naturally completes the current activity before leaving. First she places the coffee glass down with her LEFT hand on the nearby terrace surface. Then she taps the cigarette once and extinguishes the cigarette completely in a small simple ashtray using her RIGHT hand. The cigarette state changes from LIT to EXTINGUISHED only after visible contact with the ashtray. After this moment there is no new cigarette smoke. She plants both sandal-covered feet firmly, shifts her weight forward, stands with believable human balance, straightens her skirt naturally and takes her first step away. Realistic cloth movement and hair secondary motion. Foley: soft glass contact, small ashtray tap, woven skirt rustle, sandal movement. entries.title: Wuxia Martial Arts Bamboo Forest Chase
entries.description: A dynamic film-style prompt for a martial arts sequence in a bamboo forest, featuring complex character interactions, movement timing, and cinematic camera work.
entries.prompt:
生成一段25秒、16:9横屏、4K、24fps的真人武侠电影短片。竹林中，青衣持剑女子不断追击黑衣男子；黑衣男子全程不拔剑、不还手、不出拳、不出脚，只用身法避剑，并在她每次攻势落空、短暂停顿时用嘴轻吻她脸颊后迅速退开。是俏皮武侠追逐，不猥琐、不粗暴。
【风格】
真人古装武侠电影实拍质感，35mm胶片颗粒，清晨竹林的青绿色、金色侧逆光、薄雾、风吹竹叶与真实衣袂破风。人物皮肤、发丝、布料、剑身与竹叶都必须真实；无仙侠法术、无游戏CG、无夸张剑气。
【场景】
幽深竹林石径，地面有湿润落叶和散落竹叶，竹竿高耸。。
【角色】
女主：成年青衣剑客，一手拿着细长银色长剑。另一手什么东西都没拿
男主：成年黑衣男子：短黑发、神情痞帅、松弛、带一点调侃的浅笑，眼神有分寸；不要猥琐坏笑、不要油腻表情。
【严格动作限制】
男主全程不拔剑，不摸剑柄，不挥拳，不攻击女主。只允许侧身、低头、后撤、旋身、绕步闪避。
女主持剑进攻，但剑锋始终在安全距离，不砍中人。
男主共4次用嘴轻吻女主右侧脸颊：每次仅约0.3秒，都是女主剑势落空、剑尖已经安全落下的停顿瞬间；男主不按住她、不拉扯她，亲完马上后撤。
【女主表情】
第一次被亲：先怔住，眼睛微睁、呼吸停半拍，随后立刻侧目怒瞪。
第二次：提前察觉男主靠近，嫌弃地抿嘴、想躲却慢半拍；主退开后更气。
第三次：眼睛短暂闭上、脸颊微红，但马上咬住下唇，用凶狠眼神继续追。
第四次：气到无语，翻一下眼神、嘴角压紧，随后转身继续挥剑，带有“你又来”的羞恼感。 女主不能傻笑，不能轻易原谅，整体保持又气又乱的克制表情。
【摄影机与运镜】
全片一个连续长镜头，电影摄影机搭配35mm镜头，稳定器手持跟拍，有轻微真实呼吸感。
开头为两人全身中景，女主在左、男主在右。镜头随着两人沿石径移动，一边后退一边微绕圈，始终同时拍清剑锋、女主攻击和男主闪避。每次亲脸前，镜头自然推进到肩部以上双人近景面部特写；亲完立刻后撤回中景，接着女主下一轮挥剑。不要切镜头，不要无人机，不要慢动作。
【声音】
竹叶风声、脚踩落叶、衣袖破风、剑刃划过空气的轻啸、近距离呼吸与布料摩擦声，亲吻声。无台词、无字幕、无背景音乐；
【时长】
25秒。
[00:00-00:04.2]
画面起始，两人均为侧面视角，女主先以一记旋身横斩起手：青色衣摆旋开，长剑画出干净弧线；男主向后撤半步、转肩闪开。
[00:04.2-00:05.0]
第一次亲脸：女主前刺落空、剑尖向下刚刚收势时，男主马上轻松贴近女主，轻吻她脸颊后马上退开。
[00:05.0-00:08.2]
女主羞恼回身，踏竹根借力轻功跃起，人在半空中一记斜向下劈；男主不拔剑，只低头后撤，剑锋从他肩前安全掠过。她落地时衣摆和竹叶同时扬起。
[00:08.2-00:09.2]
第二次亲脸：女主落地后刚转身，男主从她避剑后的侧后方靠近，轻吻脸颊一下便退开。女主眼睛微睁、随后咬住下唇瞪他。
[00:09.2-00:12.5]
女主连续两招：先旋身反手横斩，再向前飞起一记凌空飞踢。男主只侧步避开剑锋，随后微微后仰让开飞踢，双手始终不攻击、不接触她。
[00:12.5-00:15.0]
第三次亲脸：女主飞踢落地时重心短暂停住，男主绕步到她侧面，快速轻吻脸颊后退回。女主先闭眼一瞬，再怒气冲冲提剑。
[00:15.0-00:18.5]
女主施展更明显的中式武侠步法：踏步、转身、轻功跃起，长剑从上方直刺而下；男主旋身绕过竹竿，衣袍擦过竹叶，始终只闪避。
[00:18.5-00:21.5]
第四次亲脸：女主腾空落地、剑势偏向一侧时，男主趁她转头的半拍靠近，再次轻吻脸颊，立刻退开。女主翻一下眼神，气得脸颊微红。
[00:21.5-00:25.0]
女主最后一轮追击：旋身出剑后接一记凌空飞踢，男主后撤闪开，仍不拔剑、不反击。女主落在石径中央，剑尖斜指地面，回头怒瞪镜头外的男主。
entries.translated_prompt:

In a bamboo forest, a woman in green robes with a sword chases a man in black; the man never draws his sword, fights back, or strikes, only using movements to evade. Every time her attack misses, he quickly kisses her cheek and retreats during the brief pause. Playful wuxia chase, not crude.
[Style]
Live-action period martial arts film texture, 35mm film grain, morning bamboo forest green and gold backlight, mist, blowing bamboo leaves. Realistic skin, hair, fabric, sword, and leaves. No magic or CG.
[Characters]
Female: Adult swordsman in green, holding a long silver sword. Male: Adult in black, short hair, handsome and relaxed, playful but respectful smile.
[Action Constraints]
Male never draws sword or attacks. Only dodging. Female attacks but keeps safe distance. Male kisses her cheek 4 times during pauses after missed attacks.
[Expressions]
Female: Shocked and angry at first, then annoyed and alert, eventually flushed and exasperated.
[Cinematography]
One continuous long take, 35mm lens, handheld stabilizer with realistic breathing. Starts as a medium shot of both. Zooms in for kisses, zooms out for chases. No cuts.
[Time Breakdown]
0-4.2s: Initial attack and evasion.
4.2-5s: First kiss after a missed thrust.
5-8.2s: Leap and downward strike; male dodges.
8.2-9.2s: Second kiss after landing.
9.2-12.5s: Continuous attacks; male avoids all contact.
12.5-15s: Third kiss after a flying kick pause.
15-18.5s: Complex footwork and overhead strike.
18.5-21.5s: Fourth kiss as she lands.
21.5-25s: Final chase sequence ending with a glare.

entries.title: Southeast Asian Night Market Documentary
entries.description: A photorealistic documentary-style prompt for a continuous shot of a bustling night market, capturing the movement, steam, and atmosphere of Southeast Asia.
entries.prompt:
A crowded Southeast Asian night market during a busy evening, filmed as one continuous handheld street-level shot. Hundreds of people move naturally through narrow walkways while food vendors prepare dishes at crowded stalls. One vendor rapidly tosses noodles in a flaming wok, another pours a steaming soup into bowls, and customers point at food, exchange cash, carry drinks, and weave through the crowd.

Motorcycles carefully pass through the edges of the market while vendors call out to customers. Steam from cooking stalls mixes with light smoke in the humid night air. Colorful signs, hanging lights, umbrellas, plastic stools, food trays, and electrical wires fill the environment. The pavement is slightly wet and reflects the market lights.

The camera slowly moves forward through the crowd, naturally avoiding people and objects while constantly changing focus between foreground interactions and the busy background. People occasionally walk directly in front of the lens, partially blocking the view. Hands, food, utensils, vehicles, and background characters all move naturally and independently.

Photorealistic documentary-style footage, extremely detailed environment, realistic human behavior, natural crowd movement, accurate hand interactions, believable food preparation, realistic steam and smoke, wet-surface reflections, authentic atmospheric lighting, continuous camera movement, no cuts, no slow motion, no staged poses, no cinematic perfection.

entries.title: Korean Neighborhood Summer Afternoon
entries.description: A nostalgic 2000s home-video style prompt describing a young woman's summer afternoon activities in an older Korean residential neighborhood, from cycling to chatting with friends.
entries.prompt:
Main subject: Young Korean woman, early 20s, wearing a soft pink short top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers and a delicate necklace. Messy black side ponytail, natural makeup, realistic skin and completely consistent appearance.
Location: Older Korean residential neighborhood on a hot summer afternoon. Narrow alleys, concrete walls, tiny gardens, bicycles leaning against houses, colorful laundry, utility poles and leafy trees creating patches of shade.
Shot entirely like an early-2000s home video filmed by her friend. Strong handheld shake, accidental framing, autofocus hunting, blown-out highlights, faded colors, digital noise, occasional zoom mistakes and realistic motion blur.
She leaves her house carrying a small basket and walks barefoot toward a bicycle. She slips on her sneakers, hops onto the bicycle and starts riding through the lane.
She passes a friend sitting outside a small house. The friend calls her name and she immediately stops.
They chat casually for a moment, laughing about something. She steals a sip from her friend's iced drink, laughs and continues cycling.
She stops beneath a giant tree and parks the bicycle. She looks upward as the leaves move in the warm breeze.
A basketball rolls into the lane from nearby children. She kicks it gently back toward them and waves.
She gets back on the bicycle and rides away while the camera remains behind, slowly losing sight of her around the corner.
Audio: Summer insects, birds, bicycle chain, distant children, wind through leaves, casual conversation and neighborhood ambience. No music.

entries.title: House Party Smartphone Found-Footage
entries.description: Authentic, shaky smartphone footage capturing the energy and chaos of a massive suburban house party.
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second ultra-realistic smartphone found-footage video of a massive suburban house party at night. It should feel like chaotic footage captured on different partygoers’ phones, with realistic handheld movement rather than polished cinematography. All visible people are clearly 21+ adults. Use the provided reference image as the strict visual reference for the main woman. Keep her face, facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, body proportions, outfit, makeup and accessories consistent and recognizable throughout. TIMELINE 0–5s — Arrival: Start directly inside a crowded house. A shaky phone follows the woman through dancing guests. Show friends greeting her, packed hallways, phones recording, warm lights, flashes, laughter and raised cups with soft drinks. 5–10s — Interior Party: The crowd becomes denser. Show the woman dancing with friends, spontaneous dance circles, confetti, group selfies, food-covered counters and flashing phones. Use quick reframing, autofocus shifts, motion blur and people briefly blocking the lens. 10–15s — Pool Reveal: Hard cut to a huge backyard packed with adults around a swimming pool, lawn, patio and balcony. Show dancing, safe pool jumps, splashing water, colorful inflatables, string lights and sprinklers. Briefly let water or a person obstruct the phone. 15–20s — Giant Celebration: Everyone joins one enormous group moment. Keep the woman clearly recognizable at the center while the camera is pulled through the crowd. 20–25s — Party Everywhere: Rapid cuts between the porch, lawn, garden, living room and backyard. Show dancing, snacks, glowing wristbands, playful videos, countdowns, cheering and confetti. The scale and energy should continue increasing. 25–30s — Finale: Reach maximum intensity. The woman dances with friends, looks directly into the phone and smiles before reaching toward the camera. entries.title: Steampunk Sky-Market Action Script
entries.description: A complex, multi-beat action sequence script featuring a young inventor, a massive sky-guardian robot, and a high-stakes airship chase.
entries.prompt:
[0:00–0:03]
VISUAL: PIP, a small scrappy inventor-kid (10, goggles, patchwork jacket, mechanical glove on one hand), weaves through the crowded sky-market carrying a glowing energy core wrapped in cloth, glancing over her shoulder.
PIP (muttering to herself): "Just get to the turbine. Don't look back. Don't look—"
SFX: bustling market chatter, wind chimes, distant airship engines.

[0:03–0:06]
VISUAL: A massive armored SKY-GUARDIAN robot (18ft tall, clunky but powerful, glowing red visor) smashes through a market stall behind her, scanning the crowd.
GUARDIAN (booming, robotic): "RETURN THE CORE. THIS IS YOUR ONLY WARNING."
SFX: stall wood splintering, heavy mechanical footsteps, crowd gasping.

[0:06–0:10]
VISUAL: Pip sprints onto a rope bridge, glances back — the Guardian rips the bridge's support post clean out of the platform, sending the whole bridge swinging wildly.
PIP (yelping, gripping the rope): "Okay THAT one I didn't plan for!"
SFX: rope creaking, wood cracking, wind howling.

[0:10–0:15]
VISUAL: ULTRA-FAST ACTION SEQUENCE. Pip swings across on the collapsing bridge, activates her mechanical glove — it fires a grappling hook onto a passing airship, yanking her clear just as the Guardian's fist smashes the empty bridge to splinters.
SFX: grapple-hook fire, metal clank, whoosh of swinging, massive fist impact.

[0:15–0:19]
VISUAL: Airship pilot (an old grizzled sky-trader, unbothered) glances at Pip now hanging off his ship's railing.
PILOT (deadpan, sipping tea): "You're the kid they're after."
PIP (still dangling): "Depends who's asking!"
SFX: airship engine hum, tea cup clink, Pip's boots scrambling for grip.

[0:19–0:23]
VISUAL: The Guardian leaps from platform to platform, closing the gap, and grabs the airship's tail fin. HEAVY VFX: the ship lurches violently, energy-balloon ropes snapping, sparks and steam bursting from the engine.
SFX: metal groaning, snapping ropes, steam hiss, alarmed pilot shout.

[0:23–0:26]
VISUAL: Pip climbs to the ship's engine core, yanks a lever, redirecting the storm turbine's built-up energy straight into the Guardian's grip. MASSIVE VFX ENERGY BURST — blue lightning arcs wrap the Guardian, throwing it off the ship in a shower of sparks, tumbling down through the clouds below.
PIP (shouting, triumphant): "Static shock — my favorite trick!"
SFX: massive electric surge, thunder-crack, Guardian's distant metallic crash fading into clouds.

[0:26–0:30]
VISUAL: Pip slumps back against the railing, soot-streaked, grinning, hugging the core to her chest as the airship steadies and the sunset glows gold across the sky-city behind her. The old pilot glances over, impressed despite himself.
PILOT (small smile): "...Not bad, kid."
PIP (catching her breath, grinning): "Told you it depends who's asking."

entries.title: Indonesian Village Vacation Vlog
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 30-second authentic vacation vlog in an Indonesian village, featuring a market visit and a local breakfast.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 30 seconds | 16:9 | Ultra-photorealistic live-action | Continuous handheld vacation vlog

Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, identity, skin tone, facial features, and body proportions from @image1 throughout the entire video. The same adult Indonesian woman must appear consistently in every shot.

WARDROBE: oversized terracotta linen shirt, dusty burgundy wide-leg trousers, brown leather sandals, small gold hoop earrings, loose natural wavy hair.

VISUAL STYLE: Authentic late-2000s personal vacation vlog recorded on a cheap handheld flip camera. Extremely raw and imperfect footage. Heavy natural camera shake, awkward handheld framing, occasional partial face crops, sudden reframing, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, blown highlights, slightly soft image quality, warm faded colors, mild digital noise, compression artifacts, and subtle motion blur. No cinematic camera movements, no gimbal stabilization, no polished composition, no modern color grading, no beauty filter, no artificial sharpness.

The entire video must feel like one genuine recording captured by a friend while traveling through a real Indonesian village, not a staged commercial or cinematic recreation.

00:00–00:04 — MORNING ARRIVAL

The woman walks along a narrow village path early in the morning, surrounded by small homes, tropical plants, bicycles, chickens, and locals beginning their daily routines.

The camera follows her from slightly behind, then quickly moves around to her face as she smiles naturally.

She looks into the camera and says:

"Okay, let's find some real Indonesian breakfast!"

A little camera shake and accidental framing should make the moment feel completely spontaneous.

00:04–00:08 — LOCAL MORNING MARKET

She arrives at a tiny roadside morning market filled with colorful baskets, bananas, herbs, vegetables, steamed snacks, and traditional food.

She stops at a small food stall where a friendly local woman is preparing a traditional Indonesian breakfast.

The camera gets very close to the food as steam rises from a bamboo steamer. The focus briefly locks onto the food before hunting back to the woman's face.

She reacts with genuine curiosity and says:

"Everything smells amazing."

entries.prompt:
Story / Location.
A man rides alone as a passenger in the middle of a half-empty city bus traveling at speed across a long bridge — landscape sweeping past the windows, the cabin vibrating, light bands sliding across him — seated by the window with a paperback and reading glasses, calm, never near the wheel. Something enormous strikes the bus from outside and the vehicle rolls one and a half times only — his book flies open, windows spider and burst, a backpack and seat cushions cartwheel past him, dust and shattered glass fill the cabin as the roof becomes the floor and he tumbles between the seat frames, his glasses torn off his face. The bus grinds to a stop upside down on its roof, the same interior now inverted and destroyed, seats torn loose, glass everywhere; he lies still on the ceiling, then feels through the debris, finds his glasses and puts them back on before hauling himself out through a shattered window opening. He drops onto the cracked bridge deck and crawls a few meters, turns to see the overturned bus — and far behind it a dark colossal long-armed figure seen from behind, its back to camera, striding away from him down the bridge, never turning, never approaching, survivors scattering in the distance.

Character Acting
Calm and absorbed in his book → head snaps up, face turning to raw fear as the impact lands → thrown limp and helpless through the roll, arms grabbing at nothing → dazed on the ceiling, hands searching the glass for his glasses, pushing them back onto his face → exhausted and panicking, breath ragged, hands shaking as he crawls, then frozen staring up at what is walking away.

Cinematic [camera, sounds, sfx] — Single continuous shot, 30s, no cuts, one unbroken handheld take
0–7s: inside the bus — medium on him reading in a passenger seat mid-cabin, slow drift in from the aisle, bridge sweeping past the windows behind him.
7–10s: the impact slams the bus at full normal speed, camera jolting hard as the first roll begins.
10–13s: speed ramps into hard slow motion mid-flip, floating with him as the cabin inverts, glass, pages and his glasses suspended in the air around his body.
13–17s: real time snaps back, the camera goes untethered through the final half-roll and the bus grinds to a stop upside down.
17–21s: settles low with him on the ceiling of the wrecked inverted cabin, breathes into the stillness, follows his hand searching the glass, finding his glasses and lifting them to his face.
21–25s: rises with him and follows through the shattered window opening, glass crunching past the lens, out into daylight.
25–30s: outside the bus — cranes back and arcs with him as he crawls and turns, revealing the overturned bus and, far behind it, the colossal walking away from camera, back turned, receding down the bridge.

Lights & Theme: AAA Hollywood realistic cinema, 8K, anamorphic. Interior

Use a realistic wide angle action camera around 18mm equivalent with subtle optical distortion, natural handheld walking motion, tiny wrist corrections, realistic autofocus breathing and physically accurate motion blur.

Second 0 to 2. Begin extremely close to the front quarter of a modern white luxury SUV completely buried under thick dried brown road mud. The contamination has irregular texture, cracked areas, wet streaks and heavy buildup around the grille, wheel arches and lower doors. Black nitrile gloved hands enter naturally from the bottom of frame holding professional detailing equipment. Slowly step backward to reveal how dirty the vehicle is.

Second 2 to 5. The operator raises a professional foam cannon and sprays intensely saturated pink cleaning foam across the muddy hood, grille and front wheel. Show the liquid leaving the nozzle as real atomized spray. Foam gradually accumulates instead of appearing instantly. Pink cleaner mixes with brown dirt, becomes darker in contaminated areas, drips downward under gravity and splashes onto the tiled floor.

Second 5 to 7. Move quickly but naturally toward the front wheel. Capture an intimate close view as a detailing brush scrubs between alloy wheel spokes. Thick pink foam moves around the brush fibers, dirty liquid runs down the tire and small droplets hit the camera lens. Preserve realistic hand pressure, brush deformation and imperfect human movement.

Second 7 to 11. Pick up a pressure washer and begin rinsing the front of the SUV from close range. The water jet physically cuts a clean path through the brown and pink foam, revealing glossy untouched white paint underneath. Follow the cleaning line across the hood, headlight, grille and driver side door. Water sheets over the paint, beads along edges and explodes into fine mist when hitting the body. Dirty runoff spreads naturally across the floor drain.

Second 11 to 13. Smooth handheld orbit around the front quarter as the last foam is rinsed away. Bright rectangular ceiling lights stretch as realistic reflections across the newly clean wet paint. Water droplets remain on the windows and body. Daylight from the open garage door softly mixes with the neutral white indoor lighting.

Second 13 to 15. Finish with a clean wide hero view of the pristine white SUV from a low front three quarter angle. The operator lowers the pressure washer into the foreground while water continues dripping from the vehicle. Hold briefly on the transformation with no artificial camera flourish.

entries.prompt:
Authentic home-video footage recorded on a consumer handheld camcorder in 1997 during a family birthday party inside a modest suburban home. The footage feels completely unplanned and genuinely captured by a family member, not like a polished film.

The camera is handheld and slightly shaky, with imperfect framing and occasional autofocus hunting. A large group of family members gathers around a birthday table while a child blows out the candles. Someone briefly walks directly in front of the camera, partially blocking the shot. Another family member laughs and tells the person holding the camera to move closer. The camera awkwardly zooms in too far, briefly loses focus, then corrects itself.

Warm household lighting mixes with a harsh ceiling light, creating slightly blown-out highlights and uneven exposure. People move naturally and casually, talking over one another, laughing, eating, and looking toward the camera at different moments. A child runs through the background while someone carries a tray of food past the lens.

Visible 1997-style camcorder timestamp in the corner, authentic analog video noise, subtle VHS-era softness, interlacing artifacts, slight color bleeding, low-resolution consumer-camera image quality, realistic motion blur, imperfect white balance, occasional exposure fluctuations, natural handheld shake, spontaneous framing, genuine human behavior.

The footage should feel like a forgotten family recording discovered decades later — intimate, imperfect, nostalgic, and completely believable. Avoid cinematic composition, dramatic lighting, modern digital sharpness, artificial camera movement, or polished commercial aesthetics.

entries.title: Cinematic Airport Farewell Video Script
entries.description: A highly detailed narrative script for Seedance 2.5 featuring four key shots of an emotional breakup at an airport, focusing on complex character emotions and environmental atmosphere.
entries.prompt:
时长：精确30秒  
画幅：16:9，720p  
镜头数量：4个主要镜头  
声音：无BGM，只有雨声、机场环境声、人物呼吸和行李箱滚轮声

## 角色与空间锁定

- 女主 {{Mixed 1}} 严格保持参考图中的脸。
- 男主 {{Mixed 2}} 严格保持参考图中的脸。

- 场景保持参考图 {{Mixed 3}} 中的雨夜机场出发层、玻璃自动门、冷白顶灯、湿地反光和道路暖色车灯。
- 女主的黑色小型行李箱始终由右手控制，位于她身体右侧，不瞬移、不交换归属。
- 女主靠近画面左侧机场入口，面向右侧车道；男主从画面右侧进入。正反打保持女主看向画面右侧、男主看向画面左侧。

## 表演核心

女主 来机场 以前已经决定离开，但内心仍然给男主 保留了最后一次机会。她真正想听到的不是解释，而是一个足以让她相信“这次会不一样”的理由。

她的表情不能从期待突然切换成愤怒，也不能从心软突然切换成冷漠。前一种情绪要残留在后一种情绪中：

- 她受伤时，嘴角还残留着见到男主的笑意；
- 她质问时，眼睛仍然在等待他的答案；
- 她说狠话时，声音比眼神更坚定；
- 她离开时，身体已经做出决定，情感却还停在男主身边。

## 0–4秒｜她假装自己已经不在乎

35mm中远景，缓慢推近。

女主 站在机场 入口外，右手握着行李箱。她看似准备随时离开，注意力却一直停留在右侧车道。

男主 从雨夜车灯中出现。

女主看见他的瞬间，原本克制的脸不受控制地松了一下。那不是完整的笑，而是某种“他终于还是来了”的安心。她几乎要朝他走过去，却在发现男主没有加快脚步时停住。

她努力把刚才的反应藏起来，轻声说：

女主：“So… you came.”

说完后，她仍看着他。嘴角的微小笑意没有马上消失，眼睛却已经开始观察他的神情，害怕他接下来要说的话。

## 4–9秒｜她差一点替他找好借口

切50mm女主近景，此后保持镜头，不切男主。

男主在画外说：

男主：“It was a mistake.”

女主最先出现的不是愤怒，而是一声几乎没有发出来的短促气息，像是想笑，也像是松了一口气——她差一点把这句话理解为道歉。

她的嘴唇已经准备说出“Okay”，但声音没有出来。

半秒之后，她才意识到：男主说的是“一个错误”，不是他怎样伤害了她。

刚才残留在嘴角的笑意没有立刻消失，而是停留得稍微久了一点，逐渐变成难以维持的苦涩。她低下眼睛，像是在替自己感到难堪。

握着行李箱的手先松开一点，又重新收紧。

## 9–15秒｜她在质问，也在给他最后一次机会

镜头继续停留在女主脸上。

她抬头时，眼睛已经眼周泛红，但神情没有变得强硬。她仍然希望男主能说出一个不同的答案。

女主：“Which part?”

她原本想用讽刺保护自己，但声音比预想中更轻。说完后，她短暂避开男主的目光，重新吸气：

女主：“Lying to me… or thinking I’d stay?”

前半句带着受伤后的锋利；说到“stay”时，声音却不明显地软了一下。

台词结束后，她没有立刻摆出决绝表情，而是安静看着男主。她的眼神仍在等他回答，像是在无声地给他最后一次机会。

这段停顿里，愤怒和期待必须同时存在。

## 15–21秒｜熟悉的温柔差点让她放弃决定

切50mm侧面双人中景，保持两人的距离和手部位置清楚。

男主向她靠近半步，抬手想碰她的脸：

男主：“I still love you.”

女主保持站着不动，听见这句话，女主的防备不是立刻变强，而是先松开。

她看着男主，眼神迅速恢复了过去面对他时的柔软。她差一点闭上眼睛接受男主的触碰。

就在男主的手即将碰到她之前，女主看见他脸上熟悉的请求原谅的神情。她意识到，这一幕以前发生过。

她没有猛然后退，只是停在那里。眼里的温柔没有消失，却慢慢蒙上一层失望。

她轻微低下头用近乎请求的气声说：

女主：“Don’t.”

这句“Don’t”既是在阻止男主，也是在阻止自己再次心软。

男主的手停在半空，没有触碰她。

## 21–26秒｜她必须在自己再次原谅他之前结束

切85mm女主近景。

女主没有马上退开。她抬头看着男主，眼神里保留着刚才的温柔。正因为还爱他，接下来的话才显得困难。

她的嘴唇动了一下，像想说另一句话，最后却低下眼睛：

女主：“You love being forgiven.”

这句话说得很轻，不像指控，更像她终于承认了一个早已知道的事实。

她停顿。呼吸开始不稳，眼眶中的泪光（眼眶含泪不落）继续增加。她抬眼重新看向男主，想把最后一句完整说出来：

女主：“We…”

声音在这里短暂卡住。

她没有立刻接下去，而是看了男主一秒，像是在确认自己是否真的舍得结束。

随后，她吸入一小口气：

女主：“…are done.”

“done”说得清楚，却没有愤怒。尾音落下时，她的眼神仍然舍不得离开男主。

## 26–30秒｜身体先离开，感情晚一步跟上

切35mm侧面中景，固定机位。

女主转身拉动行李箱。转身动作没有干脆利落，而是略微迟缓，仿佛身体在等待男主再次叫住她。

她向机场入口迈出两步。

在自动门前，她的步伐停顿很短的一瞬。头部没有回转，但目光不自觉地向男主所在方向偏移，像是最后一次确认他是否会追上来。

男主没有动作。

女主眼里的泪水终于从眼角滑落一滴。她没有擦，也没有再等待，重新迈步进入机场。

自动门开始打开，她穿过入口。画面结束在她跨过门槛的背影上，不表现关门，不使用倒影。

## 表演连续性

- 女主看见男主时产生的安心不能完全消失，要逐渐变成受伤和自嘲。
- 质问时不能只有愤怒；台词结束后的眼神必须仍在等待答案。
- 听见“I still love you”后，必须先出现真实的心软，再出现自我阻止，不能提前后退。
- “Don’t”不是冷酷命令，而是带着请求感的自我保护。
- “We are done”不要一字一顿地强硬宣布；“We”短暂卡住，表现她并不情愿结束。
- 女主离开时不能瞬间恢复坚定。她可以迟疑，但不能回头。
- 全程避免挑眉、抿嘴、握拳、落泪等动作逐项轮换；所有变化都从上一种情绪中自然生长出来。
- 不使用表情归零、突然冷脸、戏剧化瞪眼、夸张哭腔或胜利式转身。

entries.title: Pixel Art to Mall Transformation

Behind the gate is not a burial chamber, but a glowing portal to another dimension filled with swirling blue and purple energy, floating runes, magical particles, and spatial distortion. She hesitates, then steps inside. As she enters the portal, her pixelated body dissolves into luminous fragments and smoothly transforms into a realistic modern young woman. She is now fully human, wearing a stylish modern outfit inspired by her original adventurer look. She looks around in awe, confused but fascinated. Final extreme close-up of her eyes reflecting the bright mall lights, giant screens, and the unfamiliar real world. Strong contrast between retro pixel-art fantasy and realistic modern cinematic visuals, emotional, magical, visually stunning, dynamic camera, dramatic lighting, high detail, smooth transformation, epic short film. entries.title: Emotional Kitten Rescue Storyboard
entries.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for a 15-second emotional narrative about a woman rescuing a kitten during a rainy morning.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic emotional video set on a rainy morning. Maintain the same young woman and the same small kitten consistently throughout every scene. Natural acting, realistic physics, detailed rain, cinematic lighting, smooth camera movement, shallow depth of field, realistic facial expressions, and seamless scene transitions.

Scene 1 — Breakfast on a Rainy Morning (0–3s)

Inside a cozy modern home during early morning. A young woman with long straight dark hair is sitting at a dining table, peacefully eating breakfast. Warm natural morning light enters through the large window. Her breakfast, a cup of tea/coffee, and simple tableware are visible. Outside the window, the sky is dark and rain is beginning to fall. The atmosphere feels calm and cozy.

Camera: Medium cinematic shot, slowly pushing toward the woman.

Scene 2 — She Notices the Rain (3–5s)

The woman suddenly hears the sound of heavy rain. She pauses while eating and looks toward the window. The camera moves closer to her face as she notices the rain falling heavily outside. Raindrops cover the glass, with a realistic rainy neighborhood visible in the background.

Camera: Close-up on her face, then rack focus from her face to the rain-covered window.

Scene 3 — The Kitten Is Trapped (5–7s)

Cut to outside. A tiny fluffy kitten is stranded in a corner beside a wall and some plants. The kitten is completely soaked by the rain, shivering and looking frightened. Water is flowing across the ground and rain is falling heavily around it. The kitten tries to move but is trapped in the narrow sheltered corner.

Camera: Low-angle close-up of the wet kitten, with cinematic rain droplets and realistic fur detail.

Scene 4 — The Rescue (7–10s)

The woman quickly grabs an umbrella and runs outside. She kneels beside the frightened kitten, carefully reaches toward it, and gently picks it up. She protects the kitten from the rain with the umbrella and wraps it in a soft cloth or her jacket.

Camera: Dynamic handheld cinematic movement following her outside, then a close-up as she gently lifts the kitten.

Scene 5 — Bringing the Kitten Home (10–13s)

She carries the kitten back inside her warm home. The scene transitions from the cold blue rainy exterior to a warm, cozy interior. She places the kitten gently on a soft towel and carefully dries its wet fur. The kitten begins to relax and feel safe.

Camera: Smooth tracking shot following her through the doorway, followed by a warm close-up of the woman drying the kitten.

[Stage 2 - approx 6-13s] Close-quarters exchange mid-corridor. She slips a punch, drives an elbow into the mask, ducks a hook, shoulders him into the paneling. A table lamp topples. He stays on his feet. Camera whip pans with the strikes. 
[Stage 3 - approx 13-20s] He draws a straight black knife and lunges at her chest. She turns her hips out of the line, traps his wrist in both hands, twists it outward, and the knife drops point-first into the carpet. She stands over it empty-handed. Low medium two-shot. 
[Stage 4 - approx 20-26s] She drives him backward through tall open glass doors onto a stone balcony. Sky opens behind him, dense city skyline in orange and deep blue dusk. She plants and kicks him in the chest. He goes over the balustrade and out of frame. Camera tracks with them, then stops at the rail.

One knife, and it stays in the carpet after Stage 3. The fight travels one direction, away from camera, and never reverses. Corridor light warm and low, balcony light cool dusk. No dialogue. entries.title: Mountain Pass Blizzard Ambush Script
entries.description: A highly technical and descriptive prompt for a cinematic sequence featuring a column of soldiers in a high-altitude blizzard being stalked by a colossal entity.
entries.prompt: SCENE CONTEXT A narrow mountain pass at high altitude, heavy wind and blowing snow, visibility near zero past 40 meters. A column of soldiers advances through the pass on foot. Something colossal moves parallel to them in the fog, felt before it is seen. ACTIVE REFERENCES None supplied — no character or creature reference image locked. Design freely within the direction below. LOCATION MAP Foreground: rock and ice-crusted ground, drifting snow blowing left to right at ankle height, a low wall of ice-crusted boulders occluding roughly 20% of the left frame edge. Midground: the soldier column, a dozen figures in single file, heads down against the wind, dark wool and canvas gear dusted white, moving along a diagonal trail from upper-right to lower-left. Background: the pass narrows between two rock walls dissolving upward into dense fog, fog density 70% past the column. Along the right-side ridge, something vast moves — no clean silhouette, only a slow displacement of fog and a periodic deep tremor in the ground. FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING Frame opens empty for a beat: fog drifting across bare rock, wind sound only, nothing human in frame yet. The column then enters from the upper-right edge, already mid-stride, filling the lower third as they advance. Nothing giant is visible in the first frame — only the empty, waiting pass. FORMAT MODE One continuous shot, the camera does not cut on its own. OPTICS Opens at 63° FOV, observational distance, holding the empty pass and the column's entrance. No drift for the first two-thirds of the shot; a slow optical narrowing to 47° arrives only in the final third as tension resolves toward the ridge. CAMERA Static tripod height at 1.6 meters at the mouth of the pass, camera on the shadow side of the trail, foreground boulder providing partial occlusion over the left third of frame — a hidden-camera, observation-pattern vantage. Extremely slow push-in at 1 km/h across the full duration, barely perceptible, motivating dread rather than action. Focus holds on the column; anything beyond the ridge line stays soft and unresolved. ACTION The column marches at a steady 4 km/h, leaning into the wind, rifles swaying with each stride, boots punching through crusted snow. Midway through the shot, a soldier near the rear stumbles half a step — not from wind, but from a deep tremor underfoot. He stops, turns his head toward the ridge. Nothing is confirmed there yet, only a shifting density in the fog, as if something enormous just repositioned. A second tremor follows, heavier, and loose snow sheds off a distant rock ledge in response, arriving a beat late. Only in the final two seconds does one massive leg partially resolve through a thinning gap in the fog on the ridge — human-scale as tall as four humans stacked head to toe, gone again as the fog closes before it is ever fully seen. The soldier turns back to the column and keeps walking, faster now. PERFORMANCE The stumbling soldier's face shows a controlled swallow of fear rather than an open reaction — jaw sets, eyes stay wide a beat too long, breath visible and quickened in the cold air before he forces himself back into march rhythm. PHYSICS Wind-driven snow crosses frame at roughly 50 km/h, catching on fabric edges and rifle straps. Each ground tremor arrives with a half-second delay before visible snow-shedding on distant ledges, giving the unseen mass a felt weight before any visual confirmation. The one glimpsed leg displaces snow on contact, fog curling back into the gap immediately after. LIGHTING Flat, overcast high-altitude light, source diffused through fog from directly above, near-zero shadow contrast on the soldiers. In the brief moment the leg resolves, the ambient light behind it dims fractionally a negative-shape presence rather than a lit reveal, keeping the form a suggestion, not a display. COLOR GRADE Desaturated cold palette steel-blue snow, ash-grey rock, olive-drab wool with a grey-blue cast. The only warm note is wind-chapped pink-red skin on the soldiers' faces, a small human fragility against the cold vastness of the pass. WARDROBE Heavy wool greatcoats and canvas webbing, crusted with dry snow on the windward shoulder, rifle slings frozen slightly rigid. AUDIO Constant low wind roar, boots crunching unevenly through crusted snow, fabric snapping in gusts. Each ground tremor carries a low sub-bass rumble felt more than heard, arriving a half-second before its visible snow-shed. No score tension carried entirely by wind and the tremor's silence-then-weight rhythm. STYLE Photoreal, restrained war-film naturalism reading as a cold open to a feature film — patient, observational, withholding. Fine visible grain, muted cold contrast, no stylization beyond the desaturated grade. OUTPUT SETTINGS 21:9, real-time speed throughout, no slow-motion segments. Rendered at 1080p "8K" language above sets detail intent only. POSITIVE LOCKS The giant stays unresolved for the full shot except the final two-second partial leg reveal through fog — never a clean silhouette, never fully lit. Column stays in single file, advancing diagonally toward camera throughout. Wind and snow direction stay constant left to right. Camera holds its near-imperceptible push-in with no cuts. Tremors always precede their visible effect by a half-second delay.

entries.title: Korean Apartment Horror Short
entries.description: A detailed horror screenplay prompt for a 30-second video featuring a woman followed by a mysterious silhouette in a Korean apartment hallway.
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic Korean apartment horror short in 16:9 widescreen, specifically designed to grab attention within the first few seconds and maintain escalating tension until the final frame. CORE CONCEPT: A young woman returns home late at night and notices that the automatic hallway lights are switching off one by one behind her. At first she thinks it is a faulty lighting system. Then she realizes something is using the darkness to get closer. SEQUENCE 0–1.5s Immediate hook: Wide cinematic shot of a quiet Korean apartment corridor late at night. A young Korean woman walks toward her apartment carrying a small grocery bag. The fluorescent light directly behind her suddenly switches off. She stops and looks back. 1.5–3s — First anomaly: She continues walking. Another ceiling light farther behind her flickers twice and turns off. For a single instant, a tall human-like silhouette is visible underneath the next remaining light. It does not move. 3–4.5s — Impossible movement: She cautiously looks back again. The corridor appears empty. She takes one step backward. Another light shuts off. When the light goes dark, the silhouette is suddenly several meters closer when the next light comes on. 4.5–6s — Fear reaction: Close-up of her face as she realizes something is wrong. Her breathing becomes tense. She slowly raises her phone and activates the flashlight. 6–7.5s — Empty corridor: Her flashlight sweeps across the hallway. Nothing is there. The camera follows the beam naturally. She starts to relax—then notices a single wet footprint directly in front of her. 7.5–9s — Invisible approach: More wet footprints slowly appear on the floor one after another, moving toward her from the darkness. No creature is visible. She freezes. 9–10.5s — Escape: She suddenly runs toward her apartment. Controlled handheld camera follows behind her. Corridor lights extinguish sequentially in her direction, creating the impression that darkness is chasing her. 10.5–12s — Door struggle: She reaches her apartment, hurriedly searches for her keys and unlocks the door. Her hands tremble naturally. She enters and immediately turns around. 12–13.5s — False safety: She looks down the hallway. It is completely empty. She slowly closes and locks her apartment door. 13.5–15s — Something is inside: The apartment is quiet. She takes several steps away from the door. The hallway light inside her apartment flickers. In the glass of a nearby cabinet, a dark human silhouette can be seen standing behind her. 15–17s — Reflection horror: She notices the reflection and slowly turns around. Nothing is there. She looks back at the glass. The silhouette is now much closer to her reflection. 17–19s — Reality breaks: She spins around again. The apartment remains empty. Her phone suddenly begins ringing. 19–21s — Unsettling call: Extreme close-up of the phone screen. The incoming call appears to be coming from her own phone number. She hesitates before answering. 21–23s — Sound reveal: She answers. No voice comes through. Instead, she hears the unmistakable sound of footsteps coming from her apartment hallway—matching the exact rhythm of the footsteps she made earlier. 23–25s — Final reveal begins: Her front door slowly opens by itself. Beyond it is the dark apartment corridor. At the far end stands a figure that looks almost identical to her, facing away from the camera. 25–27s — Unnatural turn: The woman remains frozen inside her apartment. The distant figure slowly rotates its head toward the camera while its body remains completely motionless. The movement is subtly unnatural and unsettling, but no gore or extreme deformation. 27–28.5s — Darkness: Every light in the corridor suddenly switches off simultaneously. Complete darkness for a brief moment. Hold the silence. 28.5–30s — Replay-worthy ending: The lights suddenly return. The corridor is empty. The woman is no longer visible. The camera remains inside the apartment, staring toward the open doorway. After a brief pause, the door slowly closes by itself. CUT TO BLACK immediately. VISUAL STYLE Ultra-realistic Korean apartment complex at night, authentic modern residential architecture, narrow corridor, realistic fluorescent lighting, subtle reflections, natural skin texture, believable clothing and hair movement, realistic phone illumination, cinematic shadows, atmospheric darkness, restrained psychological horror, sophisticated body-horror influence without gore, realistic environmental physics, cinematic film grain, natural motion blur, high dynamic range, premium horror-film cinematography. CAMERA & COMPOSITION 16:9 widescreen cinematic composition. Use the wide frame intentionally: leave negative space in corridors so subtle silhouettes and background movement can be noticed by viewers. Combine wide establishing shots, controlled handheld tracking shots, medium shots and occasional close-ups. Keep camera movement tense but controlled and physically believable. Avoid excessive shaking, random zooms, unnecessary cuts, or disorienting camera movement. Maintain clear geography of the apartment and hallway throughout the entire video. CONTINUITY & QUALITY CONTROL Maintain the exact same woman, face, hairstyle, clothing, grocery bag, phone, apartment door, corridor architecture and lighting environment throughout every shot. Ensure: - Consistent facial identity - Correct human anatomy and proportions - Natural hands and fingers - Realistic walking and running physics - Realistic reflections - Correct shadows and lighting direction - Consistent object placement - No duplicated characters - No disappearing or changing clothing - No warped faces - No extra limbs or fingers - No floating objects - No changing apartment architecture - No inconsistent doors or hallways - No random camera transitions - No accidental text or subtitles - No gore - No blood - No cartoonish monster design The horror should come primarily from anticipation, darkness, reflections, impossible positioning and subtle movement, keeping the entity mysterious rather than showing it constantly. SOCIAL-MEDIA RETENTION Make the first 1–2 seconds visually intriguing, introduce a new unsettling event approximately every 1–2 seconds, and progressively increase the tension. Avoid slow filler shots. The final reveal should be subtle enough that viewers may want to rewatch the video to find the exact moment the entity appeared, making the ending highly suitable for social-media sharing. entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 15-second observational lifestyle video that mimics authentic smartphone footage of a friend's day trip to the countryside.
entries.prompt:
"A Surprise Day Trip"

Create a hyper-realistic 15-second observational lifestyle video following a young Korean woman during an unexpected day trip. This is not a vlog and she never talks directly to the camera. The footage is recorded by a friend on a modern flagship smartphone, with the phone itself never visible.
Use natural handheld movement, subtle smartphone stabilization, realistic autofocus, authentic exposure changes, slight framing imperfections, and genuine environmental audio. The footage should feel like a real spontaneous memory rather than a professionally produced video.
Character & Outfit
A stylish Korean woman in her early 20s with long softly wavy black hair, natural glowing skin, minimal makeup, and an expressive, cheerful personality.
She wears a cream oversized knit sweater, high-waisted straight-leg blue jeans, white sneakers, a small brown crossbody bag, and delicate gold earrings. Casual, attractive, and appropriate for a relaxed day outdoors.
Location
A beautiful countryside destination outside the city with a small scenic train station, green hills, wildflowers, a quiet walking trail, and a charming riverside café.
Sequence
The video begins as she steps off a small local train with a surprised smile, looking around at the peaceful scenery.
She walks along the platform while her friend films from several steps away.
She notices a beautiful view beyond the station and excitedly gestures for the camera to follow her.
Cut-free, she walks along a flower-lined trail, occasionally looking back and smiling at the person filming.
She reaches a small riverside café, picks up two takeaway coffees, and hands one to the camera operator with a playful smile.
They continue walking beside the river.
She suddenly spots a small wooden footbridge, laughs, and quickly walks across it while turning back to wave.
The final moment shows her standing beside the river, holding her coffee, enjoying the scenery as the breeze moves her hair. She looks toward the unseen camera, smiles naturally, and gestures for the camera operator to come closer.
Realism Requirements
One continuous 15-second recording with consistent identity, outfit, environment, and lighting. Natural walking physics, realistic hair movement, accurate hands and facial expressions, believable object interactions, authentic smartphone exposure, and natural environmental audio. Avoid AI artifacts, duplicated people, warped anatomy, floating objects, unnatural facial expressions, impossible physics, excessive stabilization, cinematic camera movements, or sudden scene changes. The finished footage should look like an authentic spontaneous day-trip memory captured by a friend on a smartphone.

entries.title: Nostalgic 2000s Korean University Basketball Video
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt for Seedance 2.5 that recreates a candid early-2000s MiniDV home video aesthetic featuring a young woman playing basketball.
entries.prompt:
Main Subject: Young Korean university woman, 21, natural everyday appearance, medium-length dark brown hair tied in a messy high ponytail with loose wispy bangs, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, energetic and playful personality.

Wearing an oversized white athletic T-shirt, navy basketball shorts, white crew socks, worn black-and-white basketball sneakers, and a thin black wristband. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout.

Location: Outdoor university basketball court in Seoul on a warm late-spring afternoon. Faded painted court lines, old metal hoops, chain-link fencing, mature trees, benches, bicycles, backpacks, and several students casually playing nearby. Apartment buildings visible beyond the fence.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine candid behavior, spontaneous friendship, natural athletic movement, authentic early-2000s campus atmosphere.

Camera Style: Early-2000s Sony MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting between players and her face, exposure pumping under bright sunlight and tree shade, faded colors, soft contrast, slight motion blur, DV compression artifacts, mild sensor noise, no stabilization.

00:00–00:03
She dribbles a basketball casually across the court while talking to a friend off-camera. The camera struggles to follow her fast movement.

00:03–00:06
She attempts a jump shot and misses completely. She laughs and immediately looks toward the camera with an embarrassed expression.

00:06–00:09
A friend passes the ball back to her. She tries again and makes the basket, throwing both hands up in celebration.

00:09–00:12
She sits on the court edge, drinks water, and wipes sweat from her forehead while chatting with her friends.

00:12–00:15
She suddenly notices the camcorder, grabs the basketball, smiles, and lightly tosses it toward the camera. The operator jerks backward as the ball approaches, causing the image to shake violently before abruptly cutting to black.

Audio: Natural ambience only–basketball bouncing, sneakers squeaking, students laughing, distant conversations, birds, wind through trees, bicycle bells, and city traffic. No music. No narration.

Goal: A forgotten MiniDV home video from 2004, capturing an ordinary afternoon of friends playing basketball at university–messy, spontaneous, youthful, nostalgic, and completely believable.

entries.title: Supernatural Time Freeze Thriller
entries.description: A highly specific prompt for a supernatural thriller where a woman freezes time on a busy city street to escape a thief, including detailed rules for the frozen environment.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second cinematic, ultra-realistic supernatural thriller set on a busy modern city street in the late afternoon. Crowded sidewalks, cars, cyclists, pedestrians, pigeons and drifting leaves. Realistic warm lighting, authentic textures, subtle film grain and grounded physics. No glowing magic or exaggerated VFX.

Characters: A young woman in casual streetwear, jacket, jeans, sneakers and shoulder bag. A male thief in dark clothing approaches from behind.

Camera & Style: Natural handheld tracking, transitioning to smooth cinematic tracking after the freeze. Follow the woman continuously with occasional close-ups and wide shots. Avoid excessive cuts and maintain continuity.

[00–04s | THE APPROACH]
The woman walks through the crowded sidewalk as the camera tracks backward. The thief approaches from behind and reaches for her shoulder bag.

[04–07s | THE FREEZE]
The thief grabs the bag strap. She spins around and screams. At the peak of her scream, time instantly freezes. Absolute silence. The thief freezes gripping the strap. Pedestrians, cyclist, pigeon, leaves and cars all become completely motionless.

[07–11s | ESCAPE]
She realizes time has stopped, removes the thief's hands from her bag, secures it and walks away without looking back.

[11–15s | CHANGE ONE]
She passes a frozen businessman holding coffee with a crooked tie. She straightens his tie and continues walking.

[15–19s | CHANGE TWO]
She passes a frozen woman with sunglasses on her head. She lowers them onto her eyes and keeps walking.

[19–23s | CHANGE THREE]
She passes a frozen man holding an open umbrella. She closes it and places it under his arm.

[23–27s | FROZEN WORLD]
Wide tracking shot as she confidently walks through the frozen city. Show suspended pigeons, leaves, cyclist and fountain water. Her expression changes from confusion to playful confidence.

[27–30s | TIME RETURNS]
She snaps her fingers. Time instantly resumes. Cars move, the cyclist continues, the pigeon flies away, leaves fall and the fountain flows. The three people react with confusion. The thief realizes she has disappeared. She keeps walking without looking back.

TIME-FREEZE RULES: The scream freezes time; the snap restores it. Only the woman, camera and objects she touches can move. Frozen people must not blink, breathe or react. Vehicles, animals, liquids and airborne objects remain motionless. No slow-motion effect.

Audio: Natural city sounds → silence during freeze → sounds instantly return after snap. No music.

Negative: No text, logos, subtitles, slow motion, magic effects, excessive VFX, distortions, duplicates or unrealistic physics.

entries.title: Joseon Era Zombie Mother Daughter Tragedy
entries.description: A long, emotional video screenplay prompt set in the Joseon era, depicting a mother's tragic birthday gesture for her infected zombie daughter.
entries.prompt:
生成一段30秒、16:9横屏、原生4K、24fps、超写实真人电影质感的朝鲜时代母女僵尸悲剧短片。整体像高预算韩国历史僵尸电视剧实拍，真实皮肤、头发、韩服、木屋与布料质感。核心不是恐怖，而是“母亲仍然记得女儿的生日”。现实始终冷灰、压抑、危险；回忆温暖、柔和、幸福。无BGM，只有场景内真实声音。

【素材绑定】
只使用2张人物参考图。image1 = 母亲唯一且最高优先级人物参考。严格保持可辨识脸部身份、五官比例、真实发色、发型、发饰、白色韩服、鞋子、体型与整体气质。现实与回忆都是同一个母亲；现实中脸色疲惫苍白、眼睛哭红、衣服有轻微灰土，回忆中同样的脸、发型和白色韩服保持干净，脸部有健康血色。
image2 = 6岁女儿唯一且最高优先级人物参考。严格保持同一张脸、圆脸、幼童比例、双辫、现有发饰、彩色条纹韩服上衣、红色裙子、白色袜鞋。回忆 = 健康状态的image2；现实 = 同一个孩子感染后的状态，只改变皮肤状态、眼睛、头发凌乱与服装污损程度，绝不改变身份、年龄、脸型或服装设计。

【现实女儿】
必须第一眼清楚看出已经感染。皮肤明显失去血色并呈冷青灰色，嘴唇苍白发干，脸颊与颈侧出现少量青黑色细血管，眼球浑浊发白、难以正常聚焦、眨眼极少，表情空洞，下颌略松。双辫已经部分松散，一侧明显凌乱，碎发贴在脸颊。彩色韩服与红裙有灰土、水渍和轻微磨损，但仍清楚保持image2原本设计。不要血腥、腐烂或怪物化。

【现实束缚】
女儿从现实开始到结束都坐在靠墙位置，腰部与上臂由宽厚旧布带固定在低矮木柱或木框上，只用于限制行动，不表现任何身体损伤。她不能站起、爬行、行走或挣脱，只能让头、肩膀和上半身向前约20-30厘米。每当母亲的手、脸或身体靠近时，女儿都会立即产生强烈感染本能：身体突然前冲、颈部前伸、张口扑近母亲，但始终因为距离与束缚无法真正接触。现实中这种反应必须持续存在，绝不能突然变温顺或认出妈妈。

【故事与核心道具】
今天是女儿的生日。母亲没有准备食物，也没有生日饭桌。她只带来一个小小的旧布包，里面装着一条全新的鲜红色传统댕기。这个红色댕기是全片唯一核心道具，也是现实与过去的视觉锚点。
现实：母亲冒着女儿不断向她扑近的危险，亲手整理女儿凌乱的双辫并绑上生日礼物。
回忆：同样的红色댕기曾是健康女儿生日当天最开心的礼物。
全片必须出现2次清楚的现实回忆交叉，而且都通过红色댕기和相似动作完成，不允许只是普通闪回cut。

【环境】
现实是朝鲜时代偏僻、狭小、昏暗的木屋内室。粗糙木墙、旧土墙、草席、薄被、少量生活用品。没有饭桌、食物、蛋糕、蜡烛或现代生日装饰。窗纸透入阴冷灰蓝色自然光。
回忆是完全相同的房间，但过去更整洁，午后金黄色自然光透过窗纸，空间温暖而有生活气息。背景始终简单，不抢人物。

【0-5秒】
静止中景。木门慢慢打开。母亲走进来，双手捧着一个很小的旧布包。她看向角落里的女儿，眼睛已经发红。女儿发现母亲后立即突然向前猛冲击，布带瞬间绷紧，颈部前伸、张口扑近母亲方向。母亲受到惊吓，本能停下并后缩半步，但没有离开。<布带骤然绷紧声> <女儿干涩低沉的喉音> <母亲短促吸气>

【5-9秒】
母亲在安全距离跪坐，将布包放在膝上，非常小心地慢慢打开。里面露出一条崭新的鲜红色传统댕기。冷灰房间里，这一点红色必须非常醒目。母亲用手指轻轻抚平댕기，眼神瞬间变得柔软。女儿不理解礼物，只盯着母亲的手；母亲稍微靠近，女儿马上再次突然前冲。母亲猛地缩手，停顿几秒，再重新伸出去。

【9-13秒 — 第1次交叉】
母亲把红色댕기举到女儿眼前。女儿突然随着母亲的手向前猛冲。就在她身体达到最大前倾位置时进行无切镜match dissolve：女儿的身体位置、大小、前倾方向尽量锁定，冷灰现实逐渐变成温暖金黄色的过去，浑浊眼睛恢复清澈，青灰皮肤恢复健康血色，凌乱双辫恢复整齐。

【13-16秒 — 第1次回忆】
健康的image2女儿看到母亲手里的新红色댕기，眼睛一下亮起来。她以与现实相似的前倾姿势开心地凑向母亲，但动作柔软、自然、充满期待。她惊喜地问：“엄마, 내 거야?” 母亲笑着点头，温柔地回答：“응, 생일 선물이야.” 女儿立刻开心地笑起来。<孩子清亮的声音> <自然笑声> <布料轻轻摩擦声>

【16-20秒】
通过母亲手中的同一条红色댕기match dissolve回现实。眼前重新是被固定着、青灰色、眼神浑浊的女儿。母亲慢慢移动到女儿侧后方，准备整理她已经松散的双辫。她刚碰到头发，女儿立即猛地转头并向母亲手部张口扑近。母亲瞬间抽手，身体明显一颤。女儿无法够到她。母亲喘息几下，看着手中的红댕기，又看看女儿，最后主动再次靠近。

【20-23秒】
母亲利用女儿动作受到束缚限制的间隙，小心地将她凌乱的一侧辫子重新整理。不是一下完成：女儿持续扭头、前倾、发出低沉喉音，母亲每次都会真实地缩手避开，然后再继续。母亲眼泪逐渐掉下来，但没有停止。最终她把新的红色댕기绕到辫尾，开始打最后一个结。

【23-25秒 — 第2次交叉】
红色댕기最后一个结被拉紧的瞬间进行第二次memory overlap。现实中母亲打结的手，与过去母亲给健康女儿绑댕기的手完全重叠。红色댕기的位置、手指姿势和辫尾构图尽可能一致。

【25-27秒 — 第2次回忆】
温暖的生日记忆碎片。健康女儿头上已经绑好漂亮的新红色댕기。她开心地站起来，小小地转一圈，让红댕기随辫子轻轻摆动，然后回头期待地看着母亲，笑着问：“예뻐?” 母亲看着她笑得很幸福。这个回忆只有短短2秒，像母亲突然想起的一块最珍贵记忆。

【27-30秒】
回忆消失，瞬间回到冷灰现实。同样的红色댕기现在绑在感染女儿凌乱的辫尾上，鲜红色在灰暗环境中格外清楚。女儿仍然眼神浑浊、没有任何喜悦，也完全不理解发生了什么。
母亲蹲在她侧前方，看到完成的红댕기，眼泪不断掉下来。她努力露出一个非常微弱、几乎维持不住的笑，轻声说：“응… 예쁘다.” 停顿半秒，再用更轻的哭腔说：“생일 축하解… 우리 딸.”
女儿没有回应。突然再次向母亲方向猛然前冲，布带骤然绷紧。母亲被吓得身体后缩，但没有逃。她只是留在原地看着女儿。
Very slow push-in。最后画面聚焦在女儿凌乱黑发上新绑好的鲜红色댕기，再rack focus到后方母亲湿润发红的眼睛。<布带轻响> <女儿微弱干涩的喘息> <母亲压抑的抽泣> <旧木屋轻微吱嘎声> 直接结束。

【表演要求】
母亲全程韩国电视剧式克制演技。她知道女儿已经危险，所以女儿每次突然靠近时必须出现真实的惊吓、缩手、呼吸停顿与身体后缩；但每次之后，她都会主动再次接近，最终坚持把生日礼物绑好。不要提前嚎哭，主要通过眼神、吞咽、发抖的手、停顿与无声掉泪表现。
现实女儿绝不能说话、微笑、哭泣、认出母亲、配合母亲、主动展示댕기或突然恢复人性。她从头到尾保持明确感染状态。所有可爱表情、语言与正常儿童动作只能存在于回忆。

【交叉与一致性】
第1次交叉9-16秒：现实中女儿向红댕기与母亲的手突然前倾 → 过去女儿看到生日礼物开心凑近。
第2次交叉23-27秒：现实中母亲完成红댕기结 → 过去母亲完成同一个结，
entries.translated_prompt:
Generate a 30-second, 16:9 widescreen, native 4K, 24fps, ultra-realistic cinematic tragedy short set in the Joseon era featuring a mother and daughter. The overall quality should resemble high-budget South Korean historical zombie dramas, with realistic skin, hair, hanbok, wooden houses, and fabric textures. The core focus is not horror, but the fact that the 'mother still remembers her daughter's birthday.' The reality is always cold grey, oppressive, and dangerous; memories are warm, soft, and happy. No background music, only diegetic environmental sounds.

[Asset Binding]
Only use 2 character reference images. image1 = mother's sole and highest priority character reference. Strictly maintain recognizable facial identity, features, hair color, style, accessories, white hanbok, shoes, and overall temperament. The mother is the same in both reality and memory; in reality, her face is pale and exhausted with eyes red from crying, and her clothes are slightly dusty. In memories, the same face, hair, and white hanbok are clean with a healthy flush.
image2 = 6-year-old daughter's sole and highest priority character reference. Strictly maintain the same face, round face, child proportions, twin braids, existing hair accessories, colorful striped hanbok top, red skirt, and white socks/shoes. Memory = healthy state of image2; reality = infected state of the same child, only changing skin condition, eyes, hair messiness, and clothing wear—never changing identity, age, face shape, or clothing design.

[Reality Daughter]
It must be clear upon first sight that she is infected. Skin has lost color and is cold blue-grey, lips are pale and dry, small dark veins appear on cheeks and neck, eyes are cloudy and white, unable to focus normally with minimal blinking, expression is hollow, jaw slightly slack. Twin braids are partially loose and messy on one side. The colorful hanbok and red skirt are dusty and water-stained but clearly follow image2's design. No gore or rotting transformations.

[Reality Constraint]
From beginning to end, the daughter sits against a wall, her waist and upper arms bound to low wooden pillars with wide old fabric strips to limit movement, without showing physical damage. She cannot stand, crawl, or escape—only leaning her head and shoulders forward about 20-30 cm. Whenever the mother approaches, the daughter immediately displays a strong infection instinct: lunging forward, neck stretching out, snapping at the mother, but never making contact due to the distance and bindings. This reaction must be constant in reality; she must never suddenly become docile or recognize her mother.

[Story & Core Prop]
Today is the daughter's birthday. The mother has no food or birthday table. She only brings a small old bundle containing a brand-new bright red traditional daenggi ribbon. This red ribbon is the sole core prop and the visual anchor between reality and the past.
Reality: The mother risks being bitten to personally tidy her daughter's messy braids and tie the birthday gift.
Memory: The same red daenggi was the favorite gift on her healthy birthday.
The film must feature 2 clear reality-to-memory cross-dissolves, both triggered by the red ribbon and similar movements.

[Environment]
Reality: A remote, small, dim Joseon-era wooden interior. Rough wooden walls, old earth walls, straw mats, thin blankets. No tables, food, or modern decorations. Cold blue-grey natural light filters through window paper.
Memory: The same room, but cleaner. Golden afternoon sunlight filters through window paper, creating a warm atmosphere. Simple background.

[0-5s]
Still medium shot. Wooden door slowly opens. Mother enters holding a small bundle. She looks at her daughter in the corner, her eyes red. The daughter immediately lunges forward, the fabric bindings tightening. Mother is startled, flinching back half a step but staying. <Sound of bindings tightening> <Daughter's dry guttural sound> <Mother's sharp intake of breath>

[5-9s]
Mother kneels at a safe distance, places the bundle on her lap, and opens it carefully. A new bright red daenggi is revealed. In the cold room, this bit of red is striking. Mother gently smooths it, her eyes softening. Daughter doesn't understand, staring only at mother's hand; as mother moves closer, daughter lunges again. Mother pulls back, pauses, then tries again.

[9-13s — 1st Cross]
Mother holds the red ribbon up to the daughter's eyes. Daughter lunges at the hand. At the peak of the lean, a match dissolve occurs: daughter's position and size stay locked as the cold reality shifts to a warm golden past. Cloudy eyes clear, skin regains color, braids become neat.

[13-16s — 1st Memory]
Healthy daughter sees the ribbon, her eyes lighting up. She leans in with a similar posture to reality but with soft, natural excitement. She asks, 'Mom, is it mine?' Mother nods with a smile, answering, 'Yes, it's your birthday gift.' Daughter smiles happily. <Clear child's voice> <Natural laughter> <Soft fabric rustling>

[16-20s]
Match dissolve back to reality via the ribbon. The infected, grey, cloudy-eyed daughter is back. Mother slowly moves behind her to fix the loose braids. As she touches the hair, daughter snaps at the hand. Mother flinches, trembling, but continues.

[20-23s]
Using the restraint gap, mother tidies one side of the braids. It's not one smooth motion: daughter keeps turning and growling, and mother flinches each time but persists. Tears fall silently. Finally, she ties the last knot of the red ribbon.

[23-25s — 2nd Cross]
As the knot is pulled tight, the second memory overlap occurs. Reality hands merging with past hands tying the ribbon on the healthy daughter. Composition and finger positions match exactly.

[25-27s — 2nd Memory]
Warm memory fragment. Healthy daughter wears the beautiful ribbon. She stands, spins once, letting the ribbon sway, then asks with a smile, 'Is it pretty?' Mother looks on happily. A 2-second precious memory.

[27-30s]
Memory fades instantly to cold reality. The same red ribbon is now tied on the infected daughter's messy hair, stark red against the gloom. Daughter remains empty-eyed, not understanding. Mother squats in front, crying. She forces a faint, broken smile and whispers, 'Yes... it's pretty.' Then, with a sob, 'Happy birthday... my daughter.' Daughter lunges again. Mother flinches but stays. Slow push-in on the red ribbon, racking focus to mother's red eyes. <Sound of bindings> <Daughter's dry breathing> <Mother's muffled sobbing> <Creak of old wood> Fade to black.

[Acting Requirements]
Mother: Restrained Korean drama-style acting. She knows the danger, so her flinching and trembling must be real, yet she persists. Reality Daughter: Must never speak, smile, or recognize mother. She remains entirely infected. All cute expressions and speech are reserved for memories.

[Consistency]
1st cross: Lunging at the ribbon -> leaning in for the gift.
2nd cross: Pulling the knot tight in reality -> pulling the knot tight in the past.

entries.title: Cinematic Wuxia Sword Duel Long Take
entries.description: A highly detailed long-take cinematic prompt for a martial arts duel between two swordswomen, focusing on realistic movements and traditional Chinese wuxia style.
entries.prompt:
基础设定：一段青衣女侠与白衣女侠对剑的画面。两人均一只手持剑，另一只手没有拿任何东西。中式写实武侠动作电影质感，一镜到底完成整段双人对剑，场景在古街 对峙，画面仅有两个女侠。全程保持中景到全景，人物始终完整可见，画面中必须同时清楚保留两名剑客的身体姿态、持剑手、步法与两剑之间的距离关系；绝不切换特写，绝不拍脸部特写、手部特写、剑刃特写或火花特写，不使用慢镜头，不使用跳切，不使用定格。镜头以高速跟拍、侧向滑轨、环绕运镜、前冲后拉和轻微升降为主，始终跟随招式推进。动作深度参考中式武侠的剑术设计：剑走身随、腰胯发力、步法抢位、贴剑卸力、虚实变招、进退连贯；强调轻盈、凌厉与真实冲击，形成中式武侠电影中“人随剑走、剑带身转、进退皆有章法”的视觉冲击。完全真人写实质感，中式真人武侠风格，电影感，仅生成音效，不要生成背景音乐。

画面一：青衣女侠从画面左前方疾步切入，前脚点地、后脚发力，身体压低后骤然向上挑起，以轻功般轻盈但有明确起跳力量的斜跃穿过石板地面。她在半空中收膝转胯，剑锋由低至高斜刺白衣女侠肩侧空隙；白衣女侠不与之硬碰，先以极短的侧滑步离开剑线，身体向后微仰，衣摆随避让动作掠开，剑身贴着青衣女侠的剑脊向外一拨，利用贴剑引力令来剑擦身而过。青衣女侠以落地脚为轴继续旋开，剑锋顺势横扫；白衣女侠立即低身，膝盖深屈、上身后倾，从横扫剑线下轻盈避过，同时后手沉腕，将剑尖从低位斜挑向青衣女侠的落脚方向。摄影机从二人斜侧前方高速跟进，保持完整中景，在青衣女侠起跳时略微向上升，在白衣女侠低身闪避时同步下沉，完整保留两人从空中出剑、贴剑卸力、落地转身到低身回击的连续动作。

画面二：白衣女侠借低位挑剑逼迫青衣女侠横移，连续发动三条不同方向的剑线：先是一记由下向上的挑刺，再迅速收剑变为横向削切，最后以前送步贴近，剑尖直取中线。三次进攻必须像一组紧凑连招，方向清楚、节奏递进，不是重复地两剑相撞。青衣女侠先以侧身让过挑刺，随后脚尖轻点地面，身体横向掠开半步，剑锋仅以极小幅度拨开横削；面对最后的直刺，她不后退，而是突然借前脚踏地腾起，做一个短促、轻灵的斜向跃步。她在空中将身体侧卷，白衣女侠的剑锋从青衣女侠腰侧下方穿过，青衣女侠同时翻腕出剑，自上向下压向白衣女侠剑背。白衣女侠迅速向外转肩，将剑抽离而非硬抗，二人剑刃只短暂擦过，迸出极少量细碎火星。镜头沿着白衣女侠连续变招的方向侧向滑动，再围绕二人向内环绕约四分之一圈。

画面三：青衣女侠落地后立即借旋转余势发动反攻。她先做一次低位虚晃，剑尖贴近地面向白衣女侠前脚掠去，引得白衣女侠抬步避让；青衣女侠随即突然收剑、沉肩、转腰，身体完成干净利落的旋身出剑。旋身不是原地展示，而是带着向前切入的步法：前半圈将剑收于身侧蓄力，后半圈借腰胯和肩线将剑锋横斩而出。白衣女侠快速后撤半步，身体后仰，剑锋从其胸前极近处掠过；她在后仰未尽时，以脚尖为支点轻轻旋回，白衣长袖与衣摆形成流畅惯性，剑尖从外侧绕出，反刺青衣女侠转身后的背侧空隙。青衣女侠凭借腰部扭转及时察觉，以背身状态将剑反手横在身后完成盲位格挡。两剑在身侧发生第一次明确重碰，金属撞击短促有力，火花沿剑刃接触点向外飞散，青衣女侠向前滑步卸力，白衣女侠借后撤转身重新回正。

画面四：双方同时抓住彼此剑路回收的瞬间，发动最后一轮连招。青衣女侠向前抢位，先刺上路，白衣女侠侧身避开；青衣女侠立刻变为低位削切，白衣女侠轻跃收腿避让；青衣女侠再以旋身出剑横斩，白衣女侠在落地同时以身体后仰、剑身斜封化开。白衣女侠顺势以一记短促飞踢踢向青衣女侠腰侧，青衣女侠向外撤胯、抬肘护身，以剑格和步法共同让开踢击，随后借退步回弹，重新送出一记直线快剑。白衣女侠此时不再闪避，而是迎上前去，以沉肩、坠肘、转腕完成最后一次坚实格挡。两把剑在双方之间正面猛烈对碰，爆出火星呈短线状向两侧飞散，双剑受力后迅速分开。碰撞必须有冲击感：两人的剑臂被震开，前脚同时滑退半步，衣摆与剑穗因反震而甩动，但没有任何一人倒地、脱手或明显落败。

动作风格要求：深度参考传统中式武侠动作设计，所有攻防都遵循“试探、抢位、格挡、卸力、变招、反击、再平衡”的逻辑；动作凌厉、短促、有爆发力，出剑与收剑都干净利落，强调腰胯驱动、沉肩坠肘、步法换位、剑身引导和真实受力，不要西式击剑姿态，不要杂乱挥砍，不要魔法剑气，不要夸张腾空，不要无意义翻滚。每次格挡都要有剑刃接触、力量转移和后续变招；每次飞踢都要有起跳、闪避、落地 and 重心恢复；每次旋身出剑都要先蓄势再发力；每次双剑碰撞的火花都要短促、真实、具有金属摩擦质感。画面整体保持紧凑、冷峻、强冲击力的中式武侠电影节奏。
禁止剑气特效，禁止人物变形，禁止多余手臂，禁止武器穿模，禁止动作断裂，禁止杂乱群演，禁止字幕、水印、文字。
entries.translated_prompt:
Basic Setup: A scene of a swordswoman in green and a swordswoman in white dueling. Both hold a sword in one hand, with the other hand free. Chinese realistic wuxia action film texture, completed in a single long take. The setting is a standoff in an ancient street with only the two swordswomen in the frame. Maintain a medium to wide shot throughout, with both figures fully visible. Clearly capture their physical postures, sword hands, footwork, and the distance between their blades. No close-ups, no facial details, no hand shots, no blade or spark close-ups. No slow motion, jump cuts, or freeze frames. The camera uses high-speed tracking, lateral sliding, orbital movement, forward thrusts, and slight vertical shifts, always following the flow of the moves. Deeply reference traditional Chinese swordplay design: body follows the sword, power from hips and waist, strategic footwork, parrying force, fluid transitions, and consistent advance and retreat. Emphasize lightness, sharpness, and real impact to create the visual impact of 'person follows sword, sword drives body.' Full live-action realistic texture, Chinese martial arts style, cinematic feel, generate sound effects only, no background music.

Scene 1: The green swordswoman enters rapidly from the front left, pushing off with her back foot and leaping diagonally across the stone floor with clear power. She tucks her knees and twists in mid-air, thrusting her blade from low to high toward the side of the white swordswoman's shoulder. The white swordswoman avoids a direct clash, using a short side-slide to leave the line of attack, leaning back slightly as her clothes flutter. She deflects the incoming blade by sliding her own along the spine of the green swordswoman's sword, using the friction to guide it past her. The green swordswoman pivots on her landing foot and swings horizontally; the white swordswoman immediately crouches, bending her knees deeply and leaning back to evade, while flicking her sword tip from a low position toward the green swordswoman's landing spot. The camera tracks at high speed from a diagonal front angle, maintaining a medium shot, rising slightly during the leap and sinking with the crouch to capture the continuous sequence of mid-air thrust, parry, landing pivot, and low counterattack.

Scene 2: The white swordswoman uses the low thrust to force the green swordswoman to move sideways, launching a three-hit combo: an upward prick, a quick horizontal slice, and a forward step thrust toward the center. The attacks must be a tight sequence with clear direction and progressive rhythm, not repetitive clashing. The green swordswoman evades the first prick, slides half a step, and parries the slice with a minimal flick. Facing the final thrust, she leaps diagonally forward instead of retreating, rolling her body in the air so the blade passes beneath her waist while she strikes down onto the white swordswoman's blade back. The white swordswoman quickly rotates her shoulder to pull the sword away rather than resisting. The blades graze briefly, creating a few sparks. The camera slides laterally following the combo and orbits about 90 degrees.

Scene 3: Upon landing, the green swordswoman counterattacks using her momentum. She feints low toward the white swordswoman's front foot, drawing a dodge. She then suddenly pulls back, drops her shoulder, and executes a clean spinning strike. The spin involves a forward step: charging power in the first half-turn and swinging out from the hips and shoulders in the second. The white swordswoman retreats half a step and leans back, the blade passing inches from her chest. Before finishing her lean, she pivots on her toes, her white sleeves forming a fluid motion as she stabs back at the green swordswoman's exposed side. The green swordswoman senses it through her waist rotation and performs a blind parry behind her back. The blades collide for the first clear heavy hit, a short powerful metal sound with sparks flying. The green swordswoman slides forward to dissipate the force while the white swordswoman resets after her retreat.

Scene 4: Both seize the moment of blade recovery for a final combo. The green swordswoman advances, thrusting high, then slicing low, and finally spinning for a horizontal slash. The white swordswoman evades the high thrust, leaps to avoid the low slice, and leans back while parrying the slash. The white swordswoman then delivers a short flying kick toward the green swordswoman's waist, who retreats her hip and raises her elbow to block while sliding out of range, then lunges back with a straight thrust. The white swordswoman stands her ground, rotating her wrist and shoulder for a solid final block. The swords collide head-on with a violent burst of sparks flying sideways. Both are jolted back by the impact, their arms pushed open and feet sliding back half a step, clothes and sword tassels fluttering from the vibration, but neither falls or loses their grip.

Action Style Requirements: Deeply reference traditional Chinese martial arts logic: probe, position, parry, dissipate, transition, counter, rebalance. Actions are sharp, short, and explosive. Emphasize waist-driven power, dropped shoulders and elbows, footwork, and realistic force. No Western fencing, messy hacking, magic sword energy, exaggerated floating, or meaningless rolling. Every parry needs blade contact and force transfer. Every kick requires a jump, dodge, landing, and recovery. Every spin requires a wind-up. Sparks should be short and realistic. The overall pace is tight, cold, and high-impact wuxia cinema.
Prohibit: sword energy effects, character deformation, extra limbs, weapon clipping, broken movements, messy extras, subtitles, watermarks, text.

entries.title: Countryside Garden Vlog Montage

entries.prompt:
Montage, multi-shot handheld home-video vlog — 7 shots. One-handed phone filming, snapshot-like realism, slightly tilted framing, visible handheld shake, warm late-afternoon light, fine film grain, photorealistic.

A woman (Image) spends a quiet afternoon reading and writing at a small table in the lush garden of a cozy countryside cottage. (Image) provides only her face and hairstyle. She wears a soft heather-grey cotton short-sleeve shirt and cream-colored loungewear pants. She is the only person throughout.

The garden is naturally grown and slightly imperfect, with wildflowers, herbs, vines, mature trees, grass, a weathered wooden fence, and a stone path leading to the cottage. Warm sunlight filters through the trees as leaves and curtains move gently in the breeze.

Shot 1 (0–2s): She writes in her notebook at the garden table. Close side angle, cottage and greenery behind her.

Shot 2 (2–4s): A sudden gust scatters loose papers. She looks up and quickly reaches for them as the camera jolts with the movement.

Shot 3 (4–6s): One paper blows across the grass. She stands, holds the notebook against herself, follows it, laughs softly, and says: "어, 잠깐!" The camera follows from behind.

Shot 4 (6–8s): Another paper blows past in the opposite direction. She turns and hurries after it; the camera swings and briefly loses her.

Shot 5 (8–10s): She catches the paper near the wooden fence, holds it to her chest, and gives a breathless little laugh.

Shot 6 (10–13s): She returns, gathers the papers, and places a small stone on them. Looking at it, she quietly says: "이제 됐지." Camera moves close to her hands.

Shot 7 (13–15s): She sits down, secures the papers under the stone, smiles toward the garden, and resumes writing as the camera slowly drifts backward.

Sound: Live ambient sound only — wind, fluttering paper, leaves, birds, distant countryside ambience, footsteps, chair movement, notebook sounds, breathing, and natural Korean murmurs. Wind strengthens in the middle and settles toward the end.

No music, subtitles, text, logos, or watermarks. Do not depict or duplicate the reference image itself.

entries.title: Physics Dynamics Demonstration
entries.description: A highly technical prompt designed to test Seedance 2.5's understanding of Newton's laws, gravity, and fluid dynamics in a continuous sequence.
entries.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic 15-second vertical 9:16 video demonstrating real-world physics through one continuous, believable sequence. Scene: a young woman walks along a riverside carrying a small ball and approaches a wooden boat floating near the shore during golden hour. From 0–3 seconds, she walks naturally toward the boat; her footsteps demonstrate gravity, weight, friction, balance, inertia, and realistic acceleration and deceleration. Loose hair and clothing react naturally to wind and air resistance. From 3–6 seconds, she gently pushes the boat into the water and steps inside. The boat moves backward as a realistic reaction to her push, demonstrating Newton’s third law and conservation of momentum. Her body shifts slightly because of inertia as the boat accelerates, while friction and water drag gradually reduce the boat’s motion. From 6–9 seconds, she drops the ball inside the boat; gravity causes it to fall with realistic acceleration, bounce once according to its elasticity and collision physics, and settle because of friction. From 9–12 seconds, she throws the ball forward; the ball follows a realistic curved trajectory under gravity and air resistance while the moving boat continues forward because of momentum. The ball lands on the water, creating a realistic splash, ripples, displacement, surface tension, buoyancy, and fluid-dynamic interaction. From 12–15 seconds, the boat continues gliding naturally, creating a realistic wake behind it as water resistance and drag gradually reduce its speed. Throughout the entire video, accurately simulate Newton’s three laws, gravity, inertia, momentum, conservation of momentum, conservation of energy, friction, acceleration, deceleration, collision forces, elasticity, mass, weight, air resistance, drag, buoyancy, pressure, surface tension, fluid dynamics, displacement, and realistic cause-and-effect interactions. Every movement must have believable physical consequences and correct timing. Objects must maintain consistent mass, scale, position, texture, and physical properties from frame to frame. Use realistic water reflections, shadows, wind movement, natural motion blur, physically accurate lighting, photorealistic materials, cinematic depth of field, smooth camera movement, and professional film quality. No impossible movement, no floating objects, no teleportation, no sudden unexplained acceleration, no object clipping, no distorted anatomy, no duplicated objects, and no violation of realistic physics. Total duration exactly 15 seconds.

entries.title: Magical Bird Jar Transformation
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a 10-second video of a realistic bird emerging from magical mud inside a glass jar, focusing on macro textures and photorealistic physics.
entries.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the exact visual reference. Create a highly detailed, cinematic 10-second magical transformation video. Keep the overall composition, character appearance, lighting, camera quality, and environment consistent with the reference.

⏱️ 0–2 seconds — Jar & Mud
The subject is holding a small transparent glass jar/container carefully in both hands. Inside the jar is thick, dark, moist magical mud/soil with realistic texture. The camera slowly pushes toward the jar, focusing on the mud. Tiny particles of soil begin to move naturally.

🌱 2–5 seconds — Mud Comes Alive
The mud inside the jar starts gently swirling and rising as if something is forming underneath it. Small cracks appear across the surface of the mud. Tiny pieces of soil lift into the air and fall naturally. A subtle magical glow begins to emerge from inside the mud, while keeping the scene photorealistic rather than cartoonish.

🐣 5–8 seconds — Bird Emerges
A small realistic bird slowly emerges from the mud inside the jar. First, its tiny head appears, followed by its neck, wings, and body. Wet mud naturally falls away from its feathers as it comes out. The bird gradually becomes fully formed, with extremely detailed feathers, realistic eyes, tiny beak, and natural movements. The emergence should feel magical but physically believable.

🐦 8–10 seconds — Final Moment
The bird completely emerges from the mud and gently spreads its wings. A few tiny pieces of mud fall back into the jar. The bird looks around naturally and gives a subtle wing movement. The camera finishes with a beautiful close-up of the bird sitting on/above the mud inside the jar, creating a mysterious and magical final shot.

🎥 CAMERA & VISUAL STYLE

Duration: 10 seconds
Format: 9:16 vertical
Ultra-photorealistic
Cinematic fantasy realism
Smooth slow camera movement
Macro-style detail on mud and feathers
Realistic depth of field
Natural lighting and shadows
Detailed glass reflections
Realistic mud physics
Smooth motion with strong temporal consistency
No sudden camera movements
No cuts
No stitching
No camera shake

🪶 BIRD DETAILS

The bird should look completely realistic:

Extremely detailed individual feathers
Natural feather movement
Realistic eyes and beak
Correct bird anatomy
Natural wing structure
Realistic proportions
Wet mud sticking temporarily to feathers
Mud naturally falling away as the bird emerges
Subtle breathing and head movement
Natural wing movement

🚫 NEGATIVE PROMPT

cartoon, anime, CGI-looking bird, fake feathers, deformed bird, malformed wings, extra wings, extra legs, extra eyes, multiple birds, duplicate bird, bird suddenly appearing, bird teleportation, unnatural bird anatomy, giant bird, oversized bird, disappearing bird, distorted mud, floating mud, unrealistic mud physics, excessive magic effects, cartoon magic, excessive glowing particles, explosions, smoke, fire, distorted jar, broken glass, melting jar

entries.title: Santorini Sunset Cinematic Reveal

The camera suddenly glides backward and upward, revealing the glamorous Japanese couple sitting beside the pool with the entire Santorini cliffside appearing behind them.

Reveal the entire infinity pool merging visually with the Mediterranean Sea.

Bougainvillea flowers sway dramatically in the breeze. Candle flames dance. Pool water sparkles. Tiny boats move naturally across the sea. Warm lights begin appearing throughout the cliffside villas as dusk arrives.
