The camera rises above and behind the couple into a spectacular cinematic aerial reveal.

The couple becomes an elegant silhouette in the foreground while the glowing Santorini village, turquoise infinity pool, deep-blue sea, yachts, and enormous orange-pink-purple sky fill the frame.

entries.prompt:
Main Subject: Young Korean woman, 24, natural everyday appearance, shoulder-length dark hair tied into a loose high ponytail with wispy bangs, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, relaxed and cheerful personality.

Wearing a faded mustard-yellow windbreaker over a white T-shirt, loose navy track pants, grey running shoes, a small red waist bag, and simple silver stud earrings. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout.
Location: Small riverside farmers' market in Daegu on a cool Sunday morning. Folding tables covered with fresh vegetables, fruit crates, homemade snacks, bicycles parked along the path, elderly vendors, concrete river embankment, mature trees, and a quiet walking trail beside the water. No modern shopping malls or tourist crowds.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine candid behavior, natural body language, imperfect everyday interactions, authentic early-2000s atmosphere.

Camera Style: Early-2000s Sony MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting between produce and her face, exposure pumping between shaded stalls and bright sunlight, faded colors, soft contrast, slight motion blur, DV compression artifacts, mild sensor noise, no stabilization.

00:00–00:03
She walks slowly between small market stalls, carrying a reusable cloth bag. The camera briefly focuses on a pile of bright red apples before finding her.

00:03–00:06
She picks up several tangerines, smells one playfully, then laughs when an elderly vendor jokes with her.

00:06–00:09
She buys a small bag of fruit and places it carefully into her cloth bag. Coins clink as she pays.

00:09–00:12

00:12–00:15
She notices the camcorder, holds up the peeled tangerine with a playful smile, then continues walking beside the river. The operator pans toward the water and the recording abruptly cuts to black.

Audio: Natural ambience only–vendors talking, plastic bags rustling, bicycle bells, footsteps, birds, river water, distant traffic, light wind, coins, and quiet laughter. No music. No narration.

entries.title: Storybook Ink-Brush Transformation
entries.description: A magical video prompt that transforms live-action environments into watercolor storybook art via a first-person POV ink-brush stroke, featuring seamless urban transitions.
entries.prompt:
Style: Cinematic live-action seamlessly blended with richly textured 2D storybook illustration, using a magical ink-brush transformation effect.
Visual Direction:
First-person POV throughout. A hand holding a thin black ink brush appears at the bottom of the frame. Wherever the brush moves through the environment, realistic objects gradually transform into beautifully illustrated storybook artwork. The transformation spreads naturally from the brushstroke, with ink textures, paper grain, watercolor washes, and hand-drawn outlines appearing over the live-action footage.
Scene Transitions & Subjects:
Coffee Shop: A barista places a steaming cup of coffee on a wooden counter. The ink brush sweeps across the cup, counter, and surrounding café, transforming everything into warm watercolor storybook art while steam becomes delicate illustrated swirls.
Bicycle: A cyclist rides through a sunlit city street. The brush follows the spinning wheels, causing the bicycle to transform into expressive ink-and-watercolor line art while the rider and background gradually follow.
Flower Stall: A woman walks past a colorful flower stall carrying a small bouquet. The brush traces across the flowers, turning each one into vibrant hand-painted illustrations, with petals appearing as flowing watercolor strokes.
Dog: A golden retriever runs through a small park. The brush follows behind it, transforming the dog, grass, trees, and path into a charming illustrated storybook scene while preserving the dog's natural movement.
Girl: A woman stands beneath a large tree, looking around curiously. The brush circles around her and sweeps upward, transforming her clothing, hair, tree branches, and sky into detailed hand-drawn artwork.
Transition:
The final brushstroke sweeps across the entire frame. The last remaining live-action elements dissolve into paper texture, leaving a fully illustrated storybook world. The camera continues moving forward through the artwork as if entering the drawing itself.
Tone & Atmosphere:
Warm afternoon sunlight, charming city environment, whimsical storytelling, gentle camera movement, subtle handheld POV, rich watercolor textures, expressive ink lines, organic animation, and magical visual transitions.
Overall Effect:
The video should feel like a real world being painted into existence by the viewer's hand. Every transformation should begin exactly where the brush touches, spreading organically through objects and environments. Avoid sudden cuts or artificial morphing; the live-action footage should physically evolve into hand-drawn artwork while maintaining realistic motion, perspective, and continuity.

entries.title: Cinematic Sci-Fi Space Exploration

entries.prompt:

12-18s: Smooth over-the-shoulder tracking shot as the astronaut walks toward the light. Fine dust moves naturally around the boots. The camera gradually arcs sideways, revealing a luminous biological form partially visible beyond the rocks.

18 -24s: Wide reveal. An original peaceful extraterrestrial life-form emerges into the open landscape, elegant proportions, translucent organic surfaces and subtle blue bioluminescence. It remains several meters from the astronaut and slowly extends one open hand.

24–28s: Medium profile shot. The astronaut calmly mirrors the gesture. The creature’s bioluminescent patterns brighten and tiny particles of light drift gently through the surrounding air.

28–30s: Camera rapidly pulls back into an enormous aerial wide shot. Hundreds of matching blue lights gradually illuminate across the distant valley, revealing an immense hidden ecosystem. The astronaut and life-form remain tiny figures at the center of the landscape.

Photorealistic cinematic exploration, original creature design, realistic spacesuit movement, natural gravity, atmospheric planetary landscape, volumetric twilight, controlled anamorphic framing, seamless shot transitions, stable character continuity and realistic proportions.

entries.title: Detailed NYC Superhero Parkour Drone Shot
entries.description: An exceptionally detailed cinematic prompt for a 15-second continuous drone sequence following a female character performing parkour through New York City streets and rooftops.
entries.prompt:
角色参考—必须：脸—参考图3。服装—齐肩黑短发、黑色贴身短夹克、破洞深色工装短裤、系在腰间的灰色连帽衫、青绿色缎面芭蕾尖脚鞋、粉色裤袜、黑色耳机贴耳、白手套。

关键—角色解剖。不可协商：165厘米、47公斤。运动型、纤瘦、受控。永远不要布娃娃式。永远不要软弱。永远不要松散。核心始终收紧。每个动作都有肌肉意图。她像一个恰好拥有超能力的训练有素的体操运动员/舞者一样移动—精准、随意、毫不费力。最少旋转。身体遵循每个动作的物理逻辑。

关键—与环境的物理接触。不可协商：她不仅仅是在空中飞行。她与城市有物理互动—脚从墙上推开、手抓住壁架、身体与建筑表面接触。每个接触点：膝盖吸收冲击、肌肉收紧、身体对表面做出反应。这是跑酷+秋千飞行，不是悬浮。

关键—每个动作类型的身体位置：
网络秋千：双臂向前伸展握住网、腿并拢拖在后面、核心紧绷、后背笔直、下巴向上—干净的绳秋千运动员位置
墙面推开：双脚平放在墙上、膝盖深弯吸收、然后腿在发射时完全伸展、手臂向前挥动获得动量
在墙上奔跑：身体向墙倾斜45度、脚以跑步步态击中表面、手臂摆动、头发和连帽衫被动量向侧拉
自由飞行峰值：手臂自然打开至两侧、身体微微向后拱、放松—不是摆姿势、只是身体释放
街道级跑步：全力冲刺、手臂驱动、头向前、青绿色尖脚鞋击中人行道、身体向行进方向倾斜

关键—现实主义。不可协商：真实好莱坞电影。RED Monstro 8K、变形镜头。真实动感模糊、真实织物物理、真实纽约霾。真实。

关键—摄像机。不可协商：一个连续无人机跟踪。零切割。零传送。倾斜、俯冲、翻滚物理上合理。足够宽以始终显示她和环境。

15秒连续无人机跟踪镜头。直接继续—从黑色开始。
0–1秒：黑色。然后—特写—白色手套的手。手指打开。手腕一转。网发射。摄像机立即拉回。
1–4秒：广角—纽约住宅街。褐色砂岩、防火梯、杂货店。她低挥动—距街道3米。身体：手臂向前伸展握住网、腿并拢拖在后面、核心紧绷、后背笔直。在摆动弧的底部，她的脚掠过停放汽车的屋顶—短暂物理接触、脚轻轻弹开、她用它重定向。摄像机倾斜40度。
4–7秒：她在峰值释放网—身体打开、手臂向外、腿伸展。然后不立即发射新网—她沿着褐色砂岩墙的一侧奔跑。脚以真实跑步步态击中砖面—身体向墙倾斜45度、手臂摆动、4–5步沿着竖直表面—然后她用双脚用力推开、膝盖完全伸展、空中发射向宽交叉口对面建筑的新网。摆动将她猛烈拉向一侧—摄像机滚动60度。
7–10秒：她低飞下狭窄街道挤满黄色出租车。距地面2米、身体流线型—手臂向前、腿像箭一样拖在后面。网释放。她的脚击中地面—全力冲刺、身体向前倾斜、手臂驱动—她在出租车间跑3–4步、利用动量、脚击中湿漉漉的人行道。出租车鸣笛。她笑了。然后单脚踏上出租车侧面、用一步爆炸性推开车顶、向高楼发射网向上、火速上升。
"呜呼！"
10–15秒：广角—屋顶水平、不要太高。她在峰值悬挂—手臂略微打开、身体自然拱起、完全静止一个屏息时刻。金色时刻天空—温暖的橙色和粉红色光照亮地平线。巨大戏剧性的云从下方用金色照亮。她是一个小身影死中心对着巨大发光的天空。城市屋顶、水塔、下方街道。画面保持。她开始向下坠落。
[结束]

关键—情感和声音。不可协商：她在每一帧都生机勃勃。不是空白。不是中立。不是离线。
她的脸和身体始终表达真实的实时情感：
在第一次摆动期间—睁大眼睛、轻微微笑、纯粹专注
当脚掠过汽车—快速惊讶的笑、本能的
在墙上奔跑—下颌紧绷、坚定、强烈专注
低飞出租车间—牙齿显露、肾上腺素微笑、倾身向前
出租车鸣笛—她大声笑、头轻微向后仰
"呜呼！"—完全不可控制、嘴张开、真实喜悦尖叫
最后在峰值的广角—手臂打开、头向后、眼睛闭合、纯自由的脸—不是空白、不是摆姿势、只是一个人生命中最美好时刻的样子
音频：仅音效。无音乐。风呼啸。网快速和弦声。脚击中车顶。脚击中人行道—真实撞击声。出租车喇叭。她真实的笑声。"呜呼！"在建筑间回响。风切割当她上升。然后—峰值的寂静。

RED Monstro 8K、变形、165厘米47公斤受控运动型身体始终、与墙/汽车/表面的物理接触在每个机会、每个动作类型的详细身体力学—摆动/跑步/推开/冲刺、无布娃娃无悬浮、摆动期间严重荷兰角、金色时刻日落天空温暖橙色粉红色、戏剧性体积云、对象屋顶水平非高空、对象微小在宽广最后画面中心、纽约住宅褐色砂岩、连续单一无人机跟踪、无切割、照片写实
entries.translated_prompt:
Character Reference—Required: Face—Reference Image 3. Outfit—shoulder-length black short hair, black fitted short jacket, ripped dark cargo shorts, grey hoodie tied around the waist, turquoise satin ballet point shoes, pink tights, black headphones, white gloves.

Key—Character Anatomy. Non-negotiable: 165cm, 47kg. Athletic, lean, controlled. Never ragdoll. Never weak. Never loose. Core always tight. Every movement has muscular intent. She moves like a highly trained gymnast/dancer who happens to have superpowers—precise, casual, effortless. Minimum spin. Body follows the physics logic of each movement.

Key—Physical Contact with Environment. Non-negotiable: She is not just flying in the air. She has physical interaction with the city—feet pushing off walls, hands grabbing ledges, body in contact with building surfaces. Every contact point: knees absorb impact, muscles tighten, body reacts to the surface. This is parkour + swing flight, not levitation.

Key—Body Position for Each Movement Type:
Web Swing: Both arms extended forward holding the web, legs together trailing behind, core tight, back straight, chin up—clean rope swing athlete position.
Wall Push-off: Both feet flat on the wall, knees deep bend for absorption, then legs fully extended on launch, arms swinging forward for momentum.
Wall Running: Body leaning 45 degrees towards the wall, feet hitting the surface in a running gait, arms swinging, hair and hoodie pulled sideways by momentum.
Free Flight Peak: Arms naturally open to the sides, body slightly arched back, relaxed—not posing, just body release.
Street Level Running: Full sprint, arms driving, head forward, turquoise point shoes hitting the sidewalk, body leaning in direction of travel.

Key—Realism. Non-negotiable: True Hollywood movie. RED Monstro 8K, Anamorphic lens. Real motion blur, real fabric physics, real NYC haze. Real.

Key—Camera. Non-negotiable: One continuous drone track. Zero cuts. Zero teleports. Tilt, dive, roll physically plausible. Wide enough to always show her and the environment.

15-second continuous drone tracking shot. Starts directly from black.
0–1s: Black. Then—Close-up—white gloved hand. Fingers open. Wrist flick. Web fires. Camera immediately pulls back.
1–4s: Wide angle—NYC residential street. Brownstones, fire escapes, grocery stores. She swings low—3m from the street. Body: arms forward holding web, legs trailing, core tight. At the bottom of the swing arc, her foot skims the roof of a parked car—brief physical contact, foot light bounce, she uses it to redirect. Camera tilts 40 degrees.
4–7s: She releases web at peak—body opens, arms out, legs extended. Then doesn't fire new web immediately—she runs along the side of a brownstone wall. Feet hit brick in real running gait—body leans 45 degrees, arms swing, 4–5 steps along vertical surface—then she pushes off hard with both feet, knees fully extended, fires new web in mid-air toward the building across the wide intersection. The swing pulls her violently to one side—camera rolls 60 degrees.
7–10s: She flies low down a narrow street crowded with yellow taxis. 2m above ground, body streamlined—arms forward, legs trailing like an arrow. Web released. Her feet hit the ground—full sprint, body leaning forward, arms driving—she runs 3–4 steps between taxis, using momentum, feet hitting wet sidewalk. Taxis honk. She smiles. Then one foot on taxi side, explosive one-step push off the roof, fires web upward toward a high-rise, soaring up fast.
"Woo-hoo!"
10–15s: Wide angle—rooftop level, not too high. She hangs at peak—arms slightly open, body naturally arched, perfectly still for a breath-holding moment. Golden hour sky—warm orange and pink light illuminates the horizon. Huge dramatic clouds lit from below with gold. She is a small figure dead center against the massive glowing sky. City rooftops, water towers, streets below. Shot holds. She begins to fall downward.
[End]

Key—Emotion and Sound. Non-negotiable: She is alive in every frame. Not blank. Not neutral. Not offline.
Her face and body always express real real-time emotion:
During first swing—eyes wide, slight smile, pure focus.
When foot skims car—quick surprised laugh, instinctive.
Wall running—jaw set, determined, intense focus.
Low fly between taxis—teeth showing, adrenaline smile, leaning in.
Taxi honk—she laughs out loud, head back slightly.
"Woo-hoo!"—completely uncontrollable, mouth open, scream of real joy.
Final wide shot at peak—arms open, head back, eyes closed, face of pure freedom—not blank, not posing, just what a person looks like in the best moment of their life.
Audio: SFX only. No music. Wind whistling. Web zip-chord sounds. Feet hit car roof. Feet hit sidewalk—real impact sound. Taxi horns. Her real laughter. "Woo-hoo!" echoing between buildings. Wind cutting as she rises. Then—silence at the peak.

RED Monstro 8K, Anamorphic, 165cm 47kg controlled athletic body throughout, physical contact with walls/cars/surfaces at every opportunity, detailed body mechanics for every move type—swing/run/push-off/sprint, no ragdoll no levitation, heavy Dutch angle during swings, golden hour sunset sky warm orange pink, dramatic volumetric clouds, subject at rooftop level not high altitude, subject tiny in center of wide final frame, NYC residential brownstones, continuous single drone track, no cuts, photo-realistic.

entries.title: Anthropomorphic Fox Nature Vlog
entries.description: A highly detailed, 30-second continuous vlog prompt featuring an anthropomorphic fox named Ember exploring a mountain stream in a first-person selfie style.
entries.prompt:
Create a single continuous self-filmed vlog recorded on a handheld action camera in 16:9 aspect ratio. The camera is always held by the anthropomorphic fox, creating a natural first-person selfie perspective with light wind-induced shake, occasional soft lens flares from sunlight filtering through trees, realistic focus pulls, and dynamic walking/leaning motion. No cuts, transitions, or cinematic effects. Include a subtle realistic digital timestamp in the bottom-right corner that progresses naturally throughout the video.
Visual Style: Bright modern 4K digital look with vibrant yet soft natural colors, warm late-afternoon golden sunlight mixed with dappled shade, gentle water reflections and soft mist rising from the stream, subtle water droplets or mist on the lens near the water, and crisp details on fur and leaves. Slight handheld energy but smooth enough for casual vlogging. Widescreen 16:9 framing.
Character: Ember, a 24-year-old anthropomorphic red fox (bipedal, human-like proportions) with soft fluffy reddish-orange fur, white chest and muzzle, bright amber eyes, pointed ears, and a long bushy tail that sways naturally. He wears a simple light denim jacket with rolled sleeves over a soft cream t-shirt and comfortable cargo shorts. Personality: curious, warm, slightly playful and soft-spoken.
Location: Starts on a wooden footbridge over a clear mountain stream in a lush temperate forest, surrounded by mossy rocks, ferns, wildflowers, and overhanging maple and pine branches. Soft green and golden foliage, clear water with gentle ripples and small fish darting below.
Sequence (exactly 30 seconds, continuous take with timestamps):
0:00 – 0:05
Ember lifts the camera, smiles softly at the lens with his ears perking up, and says in a warm, slightly raspy voice:
“Hey friends… you won’t believe this spot I found.”
0:05 – 0:13
He walks slowly along the wooden bridge, lowering the camera slightly to show the clear stream and small fish swimming just below the surface while continuing:
“The water is so clear… I can see every little fish moving around.”
0:13 – 0:20
He crouches carefully at the edge, reaches one paw toward the water without touching it, and watches the fish dart past, laughing lightly:
“They’re swimming right up to me. Hi little guys.”
0:20 – 0:26
He turns the camera to capture both his face and the stream, then sits on a flat mossy rock at the water’s edge, letting his tail curl beside him. He gazes at the water for a few seconds and says quietly:
“Moments like this make everything feel peaceful.”
0:26 – 0:30
He stands up, waves one paw at the camera with a gentle smile, and says:
“Thanks for exploring with me. See you next time.”
The camera naturally lowers a little as he walks further along the path beside the stream.

entries.title: Cinematic One-Shot Dance Transformation
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 15-second cinematic video featuring a dancer whose style and environment transform through various traditions.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-cinematic continuous one-shot. A single dancer performs in the center of frame and never stops moving. The camera orbits her at one constant speed, in the opposite direction to her turns. Her dance style transforms through eight traditions while her face and body stay exactly the same, always fully visible and in focus.

Style chain: folk, ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, breaking, krump, motion capture.

She spins in a folk dance, a heavy embroidered skirt flaring around her, boots striking a wooden floor.

Mid-spin the skirt's fabric lightens and its hem lifts as layers of tulle push out from the waistband into a tutu. Her boots shrink around the foot and their toes harden into pointe shoes while she is already rising onto them. The floorboards polish themselves into a stage surface. Her movement lengthens into ballet.

Metal plates push through the soles of the pointe shoes at toe and heel and her steps start to strike sound out of the floor. The stage narrows and footlights rise along its front edge.

The tutu's layers unravel downward and reweave into a loose satin dress falling to the knee. Her rhythm loosens and swings. The footlights lower and the walls draw inward into a smoky jazz club.

The dress widens at the shoulders and its fabric thickens into an oversized jacket and loose trousers. The club floor hardens into concrete and a sodium streetlight grows overhead. Her movement drops toward the ground and sharpens.

She goes down to the floor entirely, the jacket tightening around her body as she moves into breaking, the camera dropping to floor level and continuing its orbit.

She rises into krump, her movement turning explosive and percussive, the concrete walls darkening around her."

Final moment: her clothing tightens into a plain black suit and glowing markers push through the fabric at every joint, the room going dark behind them so only the markers read. They hold the exact same movement for one full beat. The suit lightens back into rehearsal clothes and the lights come up on her standing still in a plain studio, breathing hard, looking straight at the camera.

entries.title: Gen Z Character Glow-Up Animation
entries.description: A stylish 3D animation prompt featuring a Gen Z character's makeup and styling routine, utilizing fast cuts, whip-pans, and snap zooms for a dynamic pacing.
entries.prompt:
3D high-fidelity stylized animation , featuring a girly Gen Z character wearing oversized baggy pants, chunky sneakers, and a cropped distressed leather jacket. Cartoon-leaning style with hyper-expressive features, NOT photorealistic. Clean vanity setup with soft pink warm lighting, glossy makeup textures, fast, snappy pacing, and no logos. Aggressive dynamic camera movement with macro punches, snap-zooms, whip-pans, handheld bounce, micro-orbits, speed ramps, and freeze beats.

Start with a HARD SNAP ZOOM into her eye in the mirror as she is already mid-blink, creating an instant hook with a sharp reflection.

Show a MACRO SLOW-MOTION shot of the mascara wand approaching her lashes, capturing tiny details and freezing just before contact.

Quickly SPEED RAMP as the mascara touches the lashes and they extend dramatically, followed by a SNAP ZOOM revealing both eyes with a clean, symmetrical finish.

WHIP-PAN to her lips as she applies glossy lip gloss in smooth slow motion. The light catches the shine as she gently presses her lips together for a polished finish.

Move into a TRACKING close-up as she taps blush onto her cheeks and blends it quickly. Her cheeks instantly become warmer and more radiant as the glow builds.

Cut to a MACRO highlight shot as her finger sweeps across the cheekbone. FREEZE briefly at the shimmer impact while the light creates a soft flare.

WHIP UP toward her hair as she flips her head forward and then snaps it back up. Individual strands bounce naturally into place, enhanced by a dramatic speed ramp.

Use FAST CUTS for hair styling as she loosens and adjusts her hair tie, keeping the motion continuous while creating a perfectly messy, effortless shape.

Create a MICRO ORBIT around her as she leans closer to the mirror and checks different angles, ending with a subtle, confident change in expression.

SNAP ZOOM into the outfit details as she pulls her jacket perfectly into place. The chain catches the light, creating a satisfying final styling moment.

Use a SLOW PUSH-IN as she slightly lifts her chin, revealing the complete finished look with a polished glow-up effect.

End with a FINAL FREEZE BEAT followed by subtle motion as she turns toward the camera, gives a confident smirk, tilts her head softly, and finishes in a clean, stylish pose.

Audio: upbeat pop beat with detailed mascara brush sounds, smooth gloss swipe sounds, energetic whoosh transitions, a soft shimmer chime during the highlight moment, natural hair swish, and a final sparkle hit.

entries.title: Rooftop Pool Party Vlog
entries.description: A handheld UGC-style video of a group of friends celebrating at a luxury rooftop pool terrace at night, featuring dynamic camera movements and a splash finale.
entries.prompt: Raw vertical phone video (UGC), handheld throughout, filmed by a friend who walks with the group, casual sway, natural night lighting, wide-angle lens, deep focus. Characters: The hero is a young woman with long copper-red hair in an emerald-green satin slip mini dress, barefoot after kicking off her heels, small gold hoop earrings. Her three friends: a brunette in a silver sequin mini dress, a blonde in a black satin slip dress, a dark-haired girl in a short red dress — party dresses and heels. Laughing, shrieking, spontaneous girls-night energy. Setting: A luxury rooftop pool terrace at night — a long infinity pool glowing bright turquoise from underwater LED lights, faint steam curling off the warm water, string lights overhead, wooden loungers with white towels, potted palms, a glass balustrade at the far infinity edge, and a wide glittering city skyline of bokeh lights beyond. Wet stone deck around the pool catching reflections, a soft neon glow from the rooftop bar sign behind them. [0.0s–4.0s] — Wide tracking shot, eye level, camera moving backward. The camera walks backward ahead of the four women as they stroll toward it along the pool deck, framed head-to-toe, laughing and talking over each other, string lights and the glowing pool on their left, skyline behind, slight handheld bob. [4.0s–6.0s] — Medium shot, eye level, backward track + quick right pan. The woman in the emerald dress suddenly hands her clutch to the brunette, kicks off her heels one after the other, and surges ahead of the group toward the pool, hair flying; the camera keeps tracking back and pans right to hold her. [6.0s–8.0s] — Medium-wide, camera whips right and tilts to follow. She sprints three steps along the wet stone deck and launches off the pool edge into a leap, arms out, dress fluttering; the handheld camera whips to chase her off the edge, friends screaming behind. [8.0s–10.0s] — High-angle wide, looking down at the pool, slight jolt. From the deck the camera looks down as she crashes into the glowing turquoise water — a huge white splash bursting over the underwater LEDs, ripples slamming the pool edges, droplets flicking onto the lens; the handheld frame jolts with the impact. [10.0s–13.0s] — High-angle medium, looking down, small handheld drift. She surfaces in the bright teal water, gasping and laughing up at the camera, copper hair slicked back dark and wet, treading water, the emerald satin floating around her, her friends' shadows falling across the water. [13.0s–16.0s] — Handheld tilt up and back down, slight zoom. The camera tilts up to the three friends doubled over laughing at the pool edge, the sequin dress sparkling under the string lights, one of them filming with her phone, then tilts back down and zooms slightly in on the hero still treading and laughing in the glow. [16.0s–20.0s] — High-angle medium, tilting to follow her up. She swims two strokes to the pool's stone lip, plants both palms flat, and hauls herself out in one motion; the camera tilts upward with her as she rises, water sheeting off the soaked satin, the dress clinging, pool water pouring back off her legs onto the deck. [20.0s–23.0s] — Low/close medium at the pool edge, static handheld. She stands on the wet stone, soaked emerald dress clinging, wrings out the hem with both hands so water streams onto the deck, then flips her long wet hair forward and wrings that too, laughing the whole time; the camera holds close, catching every drip. [23.0s–27.0s] — Medium shot, eye level, loose handheld reframe. Back among the loungers she walks toward her friends dripping a wet trail, one friend throws a white towel at her face, she catches it laughing without breaking stride, skyline and glowing pool behind her. [27.0s–30.0s] — Medium shot, eye level, camera settles. Still soaked, towel over one shoulder, she strikes a confident playful pose for the camera — hand on hip, tossing her wet hair back with a big smile — her friends cracking up around her; the camera holds on the pose to end. Audio: Live sync sound — friends laughing and shrieking excitedly in Spanish, a scream at the leap, one huge water splash, water sloshing against the pool edges, wet bare feet slapping stone, the towel thump, distant city hum and faint rooftop-bar chatter. No music. Consistency: The same four women throughout — same faces, same hair, same dresses, no changes. The hero's dress is emerald green satin in every shot and stays soaked and clinging from the splash onward, never dry again. Water only moves where she moves it: one splash, real ripples, real dripping. Five fingers on every hand, no extra people on the rooftop, the phone camera itself never visible in any reflection or shot. Style: Raw amateur vertical phone footage, natural night lighting, warm string lights mixing with the turquoise underwater pool glow against the dark skyline, authentic handheld motion.

entries.title: Japanese Summer Vlog with Cat
entries.description: A cinematic vlog prompt featuring a Japanese woman exploring a hidden town and interacting with a stray cat, ending in a sunset scene.
entries.prompt:
Create a 20-second cinematic vlog featuring a cheerful young Japanese woman exploring a hidden little town in Japan.

Character & Outfit: A cheerful young Japanese woman wearing a cute pastel short summer dress with a delicate floral pattern, white ankle socks, and adorable sneakers. Soft hairstyle, natural makeup, bright expressive eyes, warm smile, youthful and wholesome summer-vlog aesthetic.

0–5s — Discovering Japan: She walks through a beautiful hidden Japanese alley decorated with colorful lanterns, flowers, traditional wooden houses, and tiny cafés. She turns the camera toward herself, smiles excitedly and says: “Hi guys! I found the cutest little place in Japan!”

5–9s — The Cat Appears: She sits outside a cozy flower-filled café, holding a cute drink. Suddenly, a tiny fluffy cat slowly walks toward her and stops in front of her. She looks surprised and smiles: “Oh… hello, little one. Did you come to see me?” The cat gently rubs against her leg. She giggles and kneels down.

9–13s — First Bonding Moment: She offers her hand. The cat curiously sniffs it, then gently places one tiny paw on her hand. She smiles warmly and says: “Aww… I think we’re friends now.” She gently pets its head while the cat happily stays beside her.

13–17s — Cute Friendship: The cat curls up next to her on the bench. She gently strokes its fluffy fur and laughs softly: “You’re way too cute!” The cat looks up at her and gives a tiny playful meow. She looks at the camera and whispers: “Okay… you’re coming with me.”

17–20s — Sweet Ending: Golden sunset beside a peaceful Japanese river. She sits with the cat beside her, gently pets its head, looks into the camera with a warm smile and says: “Best day ever. See you tomorrow!” She giggles and waves goodbye while the cat looks toward the camera.

Visual & Audio Style: Ultra-realistic cinematic vlog, natural English dialogue, realistic Japanese female voice, accurate lip-sync, adorable facial expressions, playful reactions, realistic fluffy cat fur and movements, authentic Japanese scenery, lanterns, flowers, cozy café, peaceful river, warm golden-hour lighting, cinematic depth of field, smooth handheld vlog camera, gentle close-ups, natural transitions, soft ambient café and street sounds, wholesome kawaii atmosphere, photorealistic 4K.

entries.title: Night Rooftop Martial Arts Duel
entries.description: A high-action cinematic prompt for a night-time rooftop duel between two martial artists under a full moon, featuring detailed choreography and camera work.
entries.prompt:
A cinematic night-time rooftop duel between two original young martial artists under a huge glowing full moon.

Fighter A is a lean young man with messy black hair, a loose white shirt, dark fitted pants and a long wooden staff. Fighter B is an agile young swordsman with dark hair, a dark green jacket, black pants and a short curved blade. Keep both characters visually consistent throughout the entire sequence.

The scene begins with a wide establishing shot of the moonlit rooftop, wind blowing their clothes and hair. They stare at each other silently. Suddenly Fighter B bursts forward at incredible speed and swings his blade toward Fighter A. Fighter A blocks with his staff, creating a sharp metallic impact. They exchange a rapid combination of staff strikes, sword slashes, punches, elbows and spinning kicks.

The camera dynamically tracks around them at ground level, then rapidly pushes into close-ups of their eyes, weapons and feet. Fighter A ducks beneath a sword slash and sweeps Fighter B's legs. Fighter B flips backward, lands on one hand and immediately launches a powerful flying kick. Fighter A blocks the kick with his staff and is pushed backward across the rooftop.

Fighter A suddenly charges forward, vaults over a rooftop ventilation unit and attacks from above. Fighter B jumps into the air to meet him. Both fighters perform several acrobatic exchanges in mid-air–spinning kicks, weapon blocks and evasive movements–while the camera performs a dramatic 360-degree aerial rotation around them.

They land on opposite sides of the rooftop. A brief silence. Fighter B suddenly dashes forward for the final strike. Fighter A waits until the last instant, pivots aside and strikes the sword from his hand with one precise staff movement. The sword spins through the moonlight and lands on the rooftop.

Both freeze. Fighter B looks at his empty hand. Fighter A lowers his staff.
Final shot: slow cinematic push-in as the full moon fills the background, wind blowing through their clothes, dramatic anime-film atmosphere, highly detailed environment, fluid choreography, realistic physics, dynamic camera movement, cinematic lighting, subtle motion blur, crisp character animation, no gore, no text, no subtitles.

entries.title: Korean University Friends MiniDV Style
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a nostalgic 2004-style MiniDV video of Korean university friends on an autumn campus, featuring consistent character designs and realistic camcorder effects.
entries.prompt:
Main Subjects: Three Korean university friends in their early 20s, natural everyday appearances, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, distinct facial features and hairstyles. 

Friend 1: young woman with long black hair in a loose ponytail, wearing a burgundy cardigan, white T-shirt, relaxed blue jeans, and canvas sneakers. 

Friend 2: young woman with short dark-brown hair, wearing an oversized navy university sweatshirt, beige trousers, and white sneakers. 

Friend 3: young man with slightly messy black hair, wearing a faded grey hoodie, dark jeans, and worn sneakers. 

Maintain consistent identities, clothing, hairstyles, and appearances throughout.

Location: Authentic Seoul university campus on a mild autumn afternoon. 

Older lecture buildings, concrete walkways, bicycles, campus noticeboards covered with paper flyers, vending machines, benches, trees with yellow leaves, students carrying backpacks, and a small grassy courtyard. Casual and lived-in, not a polished modern campus.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine friendship, spontaneous laughter, natural body language, imperfect everyday behavior.

Camera Style: Early-2000s consumer MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting between faces, exposure pumping under trees, faded colors, soft contrast, slight motion blur, DV compression artifacts, mild digital noise, no stabilization.

00:00–00:03
The three friends walk out of an old lecture building together, talking and laughing. The camera follows from behind, slightly shaky and poorly centered.

00:03–00:06
They stop beside a campus vending machine. Friend 1 buys three canned drinks while Friend 3 jokingly reaches for one before she hands them out.

00:06–00:09
They sit on a grassy courtyard wall, sharing snacks and laughing at something off-camera. Autofocus jumps between their faces.

00:09–00:12
Friend 2 suddenly notices the camcorder and points at it, causing everyone to look toward the camera. They laugh and wave casually.

entries.title: Sketchbook Pencil Animation

entries.prompt:
A 15-second hand-drawn pencil sketch animation set entirely inside a living sketchbook world. Every element is rendered in graphite pencil linework on textured cream paper — loose crosshatching, soft smudged shading, visible construction lines and rough sketch energy throughout. Strictly monochrome pencil illustration: no color, no ink, no 3D rendering, no digital polish. The camera glides through an underwater-meets-sky dreamscape drawn in sketchy strokes, where whimsical fruit-animal hybrids come alive.

Sequence breakdown:
1. 0-2s: Open on a blank sketchbook page as pencil lines rapidly draw themselves into rippling water, hatched shading blooming across the paper.
2. 2-4s: A banana-squid drifts into frame, its peeled banana body trailing long curling tentacle-peels, propelling itself with a gentle sketchy ripple.
3. 4-6s: An orange-octopus scuttles past, plump dimpled orange body with a tiny leaf stem, its segmented citrus-wedge tentacles curling and uncurling, eyes peeking from beneath the peel.
4. 6-8s: Eggplant snakes slither through crosshatched seagrass, their glossy elongated bodies coiling, stems flicking like tongues.
5. 8-10s: Star fruit starfish tumble slowly across the sandy paper floor, their ridged five-pointed silhouettes rotating, while a spiky durian pufferfish inflates suddenly, thorns bristling in quick scratchy pencil strokes.
6. 10-12s: The camera tilts upward as a flock of round kiwi-birds flutters by, fuzzy speckled bodies with stubby sketched wings and tiny beaks.
7. 12-15s: A majestic dragon fruit dragon sweeps across the page, its layered pink-scale petals drawn as overlapping flame-like fins, wings unfurling in bold graphite strokes — it exhales a swirl of pencil-smudge mist that dissolves the scene back into loose sketch lines and a blank page.

Style notes: 2D hand-drawn animation with a wobbling boiling-line effect frame to frame, visible paper grain, eraser smudges and stray guide marks left intact, soft vignette of the sketchbook edges. Gentle whimsical pacing, naturalistic creature movement, warm storybook charm. Aspect and mood: intimate, tactile, entirely graphite — as if the artist's sketchbook came to life.

entries.title: High Altitude Anime Sakuga Aerial Duel
entries.description: A complex anime action prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting an aerial duel between two warriors during a solar eclipse, featuring mid-air vaults and time-dilation effects.
entries.prompt:
Generate a 15-second horizontal 16:9 original aerial fantasy action anime video from the provided first frame.

CRITICAL ENTITY LOCK:
There must be exactly 2 main characters in the entire video: SORA (female sky sentinel in white/gold light armor) and THORNE (male storm warrior in dark steel armor).
Do not add secondary knights, dragons, flying creatures, or background onlookers.
Maintain strict visual consistency for Sora's cyan braided hair, golden wind rapier, white armor, and Thorne's dark steel armor, navy cape, and purple lightning greatsword throughout all cuts.

Character identity:
SORA: Female sky sentinel, white and gold light armor, wing-like stabilizers, cyan braided hair, golden wind rapier, agile aerial combat style.
THORNE: Male storm warden, dark steel plate armor, tattered navy cape, messy dark hair, purple lightning greatsword, heavy kinetic strikes.

Video style:
High-budget Japanese anime feature film quality, high-altitude fantasy aesthetic, high-contrast stratosphere lighting during a solar eclipse, fluid aerial movement, dynamic time-dilation effects.

Camera and pacing:
High-flying aerial action transitioning into an ultra-detailed slow-motion impact freeze:
0.0s - 8.5s: Rapid kinetic tracking as warriors leap between floating stone monoliths, trading high-speed blade deflections and lightning arcs above clouds.
12.0s - 15.0s: Explosive snap back to full velocity with a shockwave clearing the sky, ending on a grounded standoff pose on separate floating ruins.

Action timing:
0.0s - 2.5s:
SORA and THORNE launch off floating stone monoliths into open air. SORA uses wing stabilizers for a mid-air dash, trailing golden wind through dark thunderclouds.

2.5s - 5.5s:
THORNE swings his greatsword, releasing a purple electrical arc. SORA deflects the arc with a dual-blade spin, creating an atmospheric energy shockwave.

5.5s - 8.5s:
THORNE launches a heavy upward thrust. SORA vaults off the blade surface mid-air, spinning into a golden wind counter-strike that THORNE blocks with his steel gauntlet.

8.5s - 12.0s:
Both warriors collide in mid-air cross-strike. Time dilates to an absolute crawl. Camera zooms close on the point of contact. Purple lightning arcs, golden wind spirals, floating mossy stone fragments, and solar eclipse rays hover motionless in mid-air.

12.0s - 15.0s:
REAL-TIME SNAP BACK: Shockwave detonates with a sonic blast, clearing surrounding clouds in a massive ring. Both land on separate floating stone islands as energy dissipates into the stratosphere. Final freeze frame.

Motion quality:
Fluid 2D animation, realistic cloud and wind particle dispersion, flawless 120fps slow-mo

entries.title: Ultra-Realistic Sushi Chef Macro
entries.description: A documentary-style macro sequence capturing an experienced sushi chef preparing salmon nigiri in a single continuous take, emphasizing realistic physics and food textures.
entries.prompt:
One continuous 15-second take. No cuts. No scene changes. No transitions.

PREMISE: An experienced sushi chef prepares a single piece of salmon nigiri from start to finish. The purpose of this scene is to demonstrate extremely realistic hand movement, knife physics, food texture, reflections, cloth simulation, and shallow depth of field.

The entire clip happens in one take.

SUBJECT:

Professional sushi chef.

Late 40s.

Ordinary appearance.

White chef jacket.

Dark blue apron.

Natural hands with wrinkles, veins, fingernails, tiny scars from years of cooking.

Nothing should feel stylized.

Everything should feel documentary.

CAMERA:

ARRI Alexa 35.

100mm macro lens.

Locked handheld.

Tiny natural breathing movement only.

No zoom.

No reframing.

No focus hunting.

Focus stays perfectly on the hands.

BACKGROUND:

Minimal Japanese sushi bar.

Warm wood counter.

Everything behind the chef dissolves into creamy bokeh.

No distractions.

ACTION:

0–3s

The chef picks up a fresh piece of salmon.

The fish bends naturally under gravity.

Its surface catches the light with realistic moisture.

The knife is already in his other hand.

3–6s

He slices the salmon in one continuous motion.

The blade glides effortlessly.

The salmon compresses slightly before separating.

Tiny fibers stretch realistically before releasing.

The knife reflects the environment accurately.

6–9s

He shapes a piece of sushi rice using both hands.

Individual rice grains compress together.

A few grains shift naturally under finger pressure.

Nothing sticks unnaturally.

9–12s

The salmon is placed over the rice.

His thumb gently presses the top.

The fish conforms around the rice naturally.

Tiny surface reflections move as it bends.

12–15s

He brushes a thin layer of soy glaze across the salmon.

The glaze catches highlights.

The brush leaves tiny streaks before leveling naturally.

The finished nigiri is placed onto a black ceramic plate.

The plate rotates slightly.

Steam from fresh rice remains subtly visible.

AUDIO:

Only real restaurant ambience.

Knife on cutting board.

Soft cloth movement.

Tiny brush sounds.

Hands touching rice.

No music.

No narration.

No dialogue.

RENDER:

Photorealistic.

Natural color science.

Fine film grain.

Realistic food texture.

Physically accurate reflections.

Natural hand anatomy.

Correct knife reflections.

Perfect temporal consistency.

NEGATIVE:

No extra fingers.

No morphing.

No floating rice.

No unrealistic knife motion.

No CGI look.

No oversaturated colors.

No text.

No logos.

No overlays.

Everything should look indistinguishable from a high-end food documentary.

entries.title: Seoul City Life Smartphone Vlog
entries.description: A realistic smartphone-style vlog prompt showing a young woman navigating daily life in Seoul, including a subway exit, a cafe, and a riverside sunset.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second photorealistic live-action video of a clearly adult Korean woman in her early 20s spending an ordinary afternoon in modern Seoul.

SUBJECT:
Young Korean woman with natural facial features, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, black wavy hair with wispy bangs. She wears a dark navy fitted knit top, relaxed beige wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, and a small black shoulder bag. Keep her face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions and accessories completely consistent from beginning to end.

CAMERA:
Modern high-end smartphone footage recorded casually by a friend. Vertical handheld video, natural walking movement, slight hand shake, realistic smartphone autofocus, subtle exposure adjustment, authentic motion blur and realistic HDR. No cinematic camera moves, no slow motion, no artificial film effects.

STORY — ONE CONTINUOUS AFTERNOON:

00:00–00:05
The video begins with the woman walking out of a Seoul subway station into bright daylight. She looks at her phone while walking, then notices the camera and gives a quick natural smile. The camera follows behind and slightly to her side.

00:05–00:10
She walks across a real Seoul intersection while the pedestrian signal is green. Cars and buses move naturally in the background. She waits briefly at the opposite curb, adjusts her shoulder bag and looks toward her friend.

00:10–00:15
She enters a small modern café. The camera follows her through the glass door. She approaches the counter, orders an iced drink, pays with her smartphone, receives the drink and immediately takes a sip.

00:15–00:20
She leaves the café and continues walking along a modern Seoul street. She laughs at something her friend says off-camera. While walking, she briefly fixes her bangs with one hand and keeps the drink in her other hand.

00:20–00:25
She reaches a riverside pedestrian path. The city skyline and river are visible behind her. She stops beside the railing, places her drink down, and looks across the water while wind naturally moves her hair.

00:25–00:30
She suddenly looks toward the skyline and points at something in the distance. She turns toward the camera and says naturally, “Look at that.” The camera follows her pointing gesture and ends on the real sunset skyline over the river.

VISUAL REALISM:
Make this look like genuine footage recorded by a real person, not an AI video or commercial. Natural imperfect human movement, realistic walking physics, believable background pedestrians, accurate reflections, realistic shadows, natural hair and clothing movement, physically correct object interaction and consistent anatomy.

Absolutely no extra fingers, duplicated hands, malformed hands, warped faces, duplicated people, floating objects, disappearing objects, changing clothes, changing hairstyle, facial identity drift, unnatural body movement, impossible reflections or physically impossible interactions.

The woman must always have anatomically correct features.

entries.title: Early-2000s MTV Pool Party
entries.description: An energetic video montage prompt replicating the handheld broadcast camcorder aesthetic of early-2000s MTV or teen reality TV at an outdoor pool party.
entries.prompt:
Create a fast, energetic montage set at a daytime outdoor pool party, designed to feel like authentic early-2000s teen drama, reality TV, or MTV-style footage from around 2001–2006.

CAMERA & VISUAL STYLE:
Use a true early-2000s handheld DV/broadcast camcorder aesthetic. The camera should feel physically operated by a person walking through the party: shaky handheld movement, imperfect framing, quick pans, snap zooms, loose reframing, occasional autofocus hunting, slight exposure shifts, rolling movement, and occasional overexposed sunlight. Avoid modern gimbal smoothness, robotic camera movement, or polished commercial cinematography.

IMAGE QUALITY:
Early digital-video character with slightly soft detail, baked-in camcorder sharpness, mild video noise, subtle DV/interlacing texture, saturated summer colors, warm skin tones, bright pool blues, glossy sunscreen highlights, and slightly blown-out sunlight. The final footage should resemble archived early-2000s television coverage rather than modern 4K video.

SETTING:
A large suburban or resort-style house with an outdoor pool, bright summer sunlight, clear blue sky, palm trees or lush greenery, lounge chairs, towels, coolers, plastic cups, floats, and people gathered around the pool and patio.

MONTAGE:
Create many short, energetic, easily cuttable shots from different distances and angles: wide shots of the entire party, handheld walk-bys, groups talking and laughing, drinks clinking, friends hyping each other up, people dancing, feet splashing in the pool, people jumping into the water, cannonballs, floating pool toys, sunglasses being adjusted, friends cheering, spontaneous reactions, playful flirting, and splashes hitting the camera lens. Include quick zooms onto funny or unexpected moments.

SHOT LANGUAGE:
Mix wide establishing shots, medium handheld coverage, close-up reactions, water-level inserts, and candid moments. Use snap zooms, whip pans, quick push-ins, brief rack-focus imperfections, and occasional operator reactions. The camera can sometimes arrive slightly late or reframe imperfectly to make the footage feel genuinely captured rather than staged.

TONE:
Fun, carefree, youthful, slightly chaotic, summery, nostalgic, and energetic — like a last-day-of-school, spring-break, or pool-party episode from an early-2000s TV show.

IMPORTANT:
Keep the entire sequence outdoors. No indoor scenes, no modern influencer aesthetic, and no ultra-clean commercial polish. Prioritize authentic handheld camcorder energy, natural party behavior, spontaneous reactions, splashing water, and the unmistakable nostalgic look of early-2000s television.

No dialogue is required; use only indistinct background chatter if necessary. Focus primarily on visuals, atmosphere, reactions, movement, and nostalgic early-2000s montage energy.

entries.title: Candid MiniDV Korean Woman

15-sec Seedance prompt — 5 shots

Character/style: Young Korean woman, 24, naturally attractive, realistic skin, long dark hair loosely tied back, minimal makeup. Loose cream cardigan, white T-shirt, blue jeans, and silver necklace. Cut closer. She poses deliberately for a photo, tilting her head and smiling sweetly. After a moment, she struggles to keep a straight face and looks away.

entries.title: Motorsport FPV Drone Sequence
entries.description: A high-octane racing sequence featuring aerial drone and trackside handheld shots of open-cockpit cars, including audio commentary and realistic stadium effects.
entries.prompt:
Style & Mood: High-octane motorsport realism, overcast daylight with even soft light, packed grandstands and tall PA speaker towers ringing the circuit, raw open-air speed and scale, no logos or real team branding anywhere in frame. 

Narrative Summary: A driver in an original matte-black-and-electric-blue open-cockpit car takes the lead off the start, a silver-liveried rival close on his tail, before the camera dives in to catch him grinning as he shouts over the noise. 

Dynamic Description: Aerial drone opens high above the full circuit, grandstands packed and roaring, red-and-white kerbs curving into the distance. Hard cut to a low handheld trackside angle as the matte black and electric-blue car rips past at speed, the silver rival car trailing tight behind through the same frame. Cut to a static extreme close-up insert: the leading car's front-left tire spinning hard, dust and rubber kicking off the surface. Cut to a stabilized tracking medium shot alongside the car through a fast corner, the rival still glued to its tail, both cars leaning hard into the apex. The camera then launches into a fast, weaving FPV drone dive, banking low over the tarmac, cutting between the cars and the packed stands in rapid sweeps before rocketing straight toward the leading cockpit and settling into a tight close-up on the driver's face. His head turns toward camera, the corners of his mouth pulling into a wide grin, eyes bright and locked forward, jaw moving as he speaks. 

Static Description: A full-scale racing circuit, red-and-white curbing, dense grandstands on both sides, tall PA speaker towers spaced along the straight. The leading car in matte black with electric-blue accent stripes and chrome trim, the rival car in plain silver, neither carrying any logos or sponsor marks. Driver in a racing helmet with the visor raised, face visible, gloved hands on the wheel, harness straps across the shoulders. 

Audio: A commentator's voice runs under the scene throughout, saying, "It's lights out and away we go, with Vishwas taking the lead, the Mercedes following behind his tail...", the voice carrying a big open-air stadium reverb as if blasting from speaker towers around the whole track, each phrase trailing into a faint echo. Crowd cheering swells across the shot, engine roar cutting through underneath. As the camera lands on the driver's face, the commentary and crowd dip down and his voice comes through clear: "This feels so fun. Everyone in their life should try it for once." Crowd noise and commentary swell back up the instant he finishes. Make sure the audio at the end of the video is exactly taken from @Audio 1 it and it syncs with the lips of the person speaking that. It should have the following sound effects and music and ambient sounds of the air, along with the audio that I've given you.

entries.title: Manga Cyborg Battle Arena
entries.description: A 30-second action sequence prompt for a battle between a humanoid cyborg and a massive mechanical bear in a futuristic manga-style industrial arena.
entries.prompt:
[PROJECT TYPE] Text-to-video. 30-second action sequence. Manga-style cyborg battle.

[Global Setting] Industrial futuristic arena. Metal platforms, neon lights, dark 
atmospheric background. Rain falling. High-energy manga battle aesthetic.

[Character 1  Humanoid Cyborg] Sleek android with human-like proportions. Metallic 
silver and black armor plating. Glowing blue energy lines running through body. 
Sharp geometric design. Tall and agile. Fighting stance: balanced, precise, fast.

[Character 2  Bear Cyborg] Massive mechanical bear. Bulky armored body with 
heavy metal plating. Red glowing eyes. Enormous claws and teeth (mechanical). 
Low center of gravity. Brutal, powerful stance.

[Opening, 0–3s] Wide shot of arena. Both cyborgs face each other. Humanoid cyborg 
in sleek fighting stance, energy lines glowing brighter. Bear cyborg pounds ground, 
creating shockwave. Neon lights flashing. Tension building. NO DIALOGUE.

[First Exchange, 3–9s] Humanoid cyborg LAUNCHES first with superhuman speed 
blur of motion across frame. Humanoid delivers series of rapid strikes (punches, 
kicks), speed lines trailing motion manga-style. Bear cyborg ROARS (mechanical 
sound) and swings massive arm to block. Impact creates EXPLOSIVE visual effect. 
Sparks fly. Both move with incredible speed. Humanoid's blue energy lines pulse 
brighter. Bear's red eyes glow more intense.

[Mid Battle, 9–18s] Dynamic rapid exchanges. Humanoid cyborg executes acrobatic 
flip-kick, Bear cyborg swats at air missing by inches. Humanoid bounces off wall 
(superhuman) and comes back for second assault. Bear charges forward with raw 
power  ground shakes. Humanoid dives under incoming strike. Both fighting at 
extreme speed. Multiple fast-cut angles showing intensity. Manga-style motion 
lines following every movement. Speed effects and blur. Mechanical sounds 
(servos, hydraulics, metal clanging). Energy bursts where they collide.

[SLOW-MOTION MOMENT, 18–24s] Time slows to 40% speed. One final powerful exchange 
in slow-motion. Humanoid executes a devastating uppercut aimed at Bear's torso. 
Bear's massive paw comes down to counter. Slow-motion impact between them 
MASSIVE explosion of energy, sparks, and mechanical parts flying. The collision 
creates a shockwave that ripples outward. Both cyborgs suspended in moment of 
peak clash. Humanoid's energy lines at maximum glow, Bear's red eyes blazing. 
Return to normal speed.

[Final Moment, 24–30s] Both cyborgs are pushed back by the impact. Humanoid 
slides backward on metal platform, energy crackling. Bear cyborg stumbles back, 
roars (mechanical roar). Both breathing heavily (mechanical servos hissing). They 
face each other again, both clearly damaged but still ready. Energy building for 
next round. Final frame: both in standoff position, ready to continue. Neither 
defeated. Pure intensity.

[Audio] Heavy rain sound at start. Mechanical servo sounds

16:9横屏。摄影机固定在主摩托车后方、略高于后座的位置，，全程单镜头到底，不切人物正反打、不切侧面全景、不切无人机视角。
构图固定如下：
画面左侧前景：粉发女生的肩、部分后背、飞扬的粉发、部分手臂。
画面中央偏右：西部牛仔猫一开始紧紧靠在女生的后背，能看清它回头、拔枪、开火与说话。
画面中央远处：高速公路消失点、带闪电的沙尘暴、巨型车辆和后方追兵。
镜头随摩托真实颠簸、震动和加速轻晃；爆炸时短暂猛烈震颤，但始终保持构图，不漂浮。
【场景】
末世沙漠高速公路：龟裂柏油路被黄沙吞没，画面背后有一阵带闪电的沙尘暴即将袭来。
【人物】
前座骑手：参考图中的真人粉发女生e4788cde-6c9d-45a0-94d5-070c82f2f146，短粉发被风吹乱，黑色背心
后座角色：参考图中的西部牛仔猫fd8787f2-b04d-4370-8cb0-9334280320f1。不要头盔，牛仔帽全程不掉。
追兵：多个参考图中的锈蚀骷髅型丧尸机器人骑手 29212976-41d7-4481-a03d-9aacbee68eb6，黑褐色厚重装甲、金属颅骨、外露电缆、链条和液压结构，骑黑色废土摩托从后方追来。

【武器设定】
猫背后固定一支短火箭筒；车侧挂载一把重型废土加特林机枪；腰间皮套内是一把参考图风格的黑铜色等离子手炮，机械复古枪身、雕花握把、圆柱能量腔。
等离子手炮只有在最后近战时亮起冷蓝色核心，发射短促强烈的蓝色等离子脉冲；蓝色光只存在于拔枪、蓄能和开火的几秒，不要把全片调成蓝色科幻霓虹风。
【声音】
持续音效：摩托引擎、强风、超高速行驶产生的风声、砂石、轮胎摩擦、武器后坐力、火箭尾焰、机枪扫射、爆炸、金属碎裂和车辆翻滚声。
粉发女生的声音是真人年轻女性音色，兴奋、带一点挑衅；她的脸不入镜，声音从画面左前方的前座传来。
西部牛仔猫的声音是港式喜剧电影青年男主的嗓音：带一点幽默感；猫说话时口型必须同步自然，不要人类嘴型夸张变形。
不要生成背景音乐，仅生成音效
【时长】
27秒，单镜头连续拍摄。
[00:00-00:02] 开场台词
后向固定机位。粉发女生高速驾驶，左侧前景露出她的粉发、肩背和握把动作；西部牛仔猫坐在后座中央偏右。女生兴奋地问：“准备好燥起来了吗？”
[00:02-00:04] 猫回应
猫抬头朝镜头偏一下脸，牛仔帽帽檐压低，嘴型自然同步，用低沉又神气的港式青年喜剧男主角音色回答：“必须的。” 远处已有两名骷髅机器人骑摩托逼近。

猫回头，单爪抓住后座扶手稳住身体，另一爪抽出背后短火箭筒，对准画面正后方最近的一名机器人骑手发射。火箭命中机器人骑手，机器人骑手被炸飞，远处爆开真实橙色火球、黑烟和飞散金属碎片。
[00:08-00:11] 切换加特林
镜头不断。猫将火箭筒固定回背部，取下车侧重型加特林机枪；弹链垂在后座侧面，随着摩托震动猛烈晃动。两名机器人摩托穿过烟尘继续逼近。
[00:11-00:14] 机枪与战斗台词
猫向后方连续扫射，枪口橙色火焰闪烁，追兵被击中后失控侧滑、翻滚、火花四溅。猫在一段枪声间隙略偏头，带着不耐烦又得意的语气喊：“喵了个咪的！”
[00:14-00:20] 巨型战车爆燃
烟尘后方，巨型废土装甲沙漠战车占满车道高速压来。猫持续多次扫射战车的外露油罐与机械连接处；油罐爆燃，巨型车辆失控侧翻，火焰、黑烟、碎片和冲击波从右后方掠过。粉发女生压低身体加速避开，镜头剧烈震动但不切换。

[00:24-00:27]
猫扣下扳机，一束短促、强烈的蓝色等离子脉冲射出，击中机器人。蓝白色高能火花与金属碎片爆开，机器人和摩托被冲击力甩向后方半空翻滚。

entries.title: Winter Lake Ice Rescue Short Film
entries.description: A gripping survival sequence set on a frozen Canadian lake, focusing on realistic physics and natural character reactions during an ice rescue.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 30-second photorealistic survival short film, 4K UHD, 24fps, realistic Canadian winter environment, fast-paced live-action, natural physics, intense but believable

TIME: 3:18 PM–3:48 PM, late winter afternoon, rapidly fading daylight

LOCATION: Frozen lake near a small Canadian town, snow-covered forest, ice-fishing shelters, parked pickup trucks

CHARACTERS: Father, 39, heavy winter jacket; son, 10, red winter coat; nearby fisherman, 55

STORY: A child falls through thin ice, and his father must reach him before the broken ice spreads farther.

00:00–00:03 → Father and son walk across the frozen lake carrying a small sled. The boy runs several steps ahead.

00:03–00:06 → A sharp crack travels beneath the snow. The boy stops. The surface suddenly collapses and he drops waist-deep into freezing water.

00:06–00:09 → Father throws himself flat onto the ice instead of running toward him. A nearby fisherman immediately grabs a rope from his truck.

00:09–00:12 → Father crawls forward, spreading his weight across the ice. The boy grabs the edge while water splashes around his jacket.

00:12–00:16 → The fisherman anchors the rope around the truck and throws the other end toward the father. The ice cracks farther behind them.

00:16–00:20 → Father reaches the boy, wraps one arm around his chest and pushes the rope beneath his arms.

00:20–00:24 → Fisherman and father pull together. The boy slides onto solid ice while chunks break away behind him.

00:24–00:27 → Father immediately removes his own jacket and wraps it around the boy. The fisherman drags the sled closer.

00:27–00:30 → They place the boy on the sled and pull him toward shore. He reaches out and grabs his father's hand as the camera cuts wide to the dangerous cracked ice behind them.

CAMERA: Handheld rescue-documentary style. Fast ground-level tracking, close shots during physical interaction, low angle near the ice, quick camera repositioning with the rescuers, no slow motion.

PHYSICS: Ice cracks propagate irregularly. Human weight is distributed by crawling flat. Water splashes naturally around the submerged body. Rope becomes taut before pulling. Sled slides with realistic friction over packed snow.

ENVIRONMENT MOTION: Snow blowing across the lake, bare branches moving in wind, ice fragments floating, visible breath condensation, clothing reacting to movement.

LIGHTING: Cold natural winter daylight with long shadows. Reflective snow creates realistic ambient fill.

AUDIO: Ice cracking, water splashing, shouting, rope tension, boots scraping snow, wind, heavy breathing, sled runners.

REALISM: No impossible rescue strength, no exaggerated ice explosions, no instant recovery. Characters show cold, fear and physical exhaustion through natural behavior.

entries.title: Cinematic Emotional Anime Memory Sequence
entries.description: An emotional anime-style video prompt that follows a man reflecting on his past, transitioning through childhood, school, and teenage memories using rainy window reflections.
entries.prompt:
STYLE:
Cinematic emotional anime, hand-drawn anime aesthetics blended with detailed modern anime cinematography, subtle film grain, soft painterly backgrounds, realistic lighting, deep shadows, emotional facial expressions. Maintain the same character design, hairstyle, outfit and room throughout.

CHARACTER:
A young man sits alone in a vintage black leather armchair late at night, wearing a slightly loose white shirt, loosened black tie and dark trousers. He looks calm but emotionally distant, slowly staring toward the rainy window as memories from his childhood begin to surface.

CAMERA:
Start with a slow cinematic push-in from behind the character, revealing the rainy city outside the window. Cut to a close-up of his eyes as they become slightly emotional. Slowly orbit around him while smoke from the cigarette drifts through the warm light. Use shallow depth of field, gentle handheld movement and slow, smooth camera transitions.

STORY / MEMORY SEQUENCE:
As he looks into the rain, the room gradually fades into memories.

1. CHILDHOOD — A small version of him running through his old neighborhood, laughing with childhood friends, sunlight glowing through the trees.

2. SCHOOL YEARS — Sitting at a classroom desk, writing in a notebook, exchanging smiles with friends, walking home with a school bag under the evening sky.

3. TEENAGE YEARS — Riding a bicycle through familiar streets, watching sunsets, dreaming about his future, moments of friendship and youthful freedom.

4. GROWING UP — First serious responsibilities, long nights studying and working, failures, loneliness, silently wiping away tears and continuing forward.

5. PRESENT DAY — The memories dissolve back into the same dark room. He is sitting exactly where he started. He looks toward the window, gives a very subtle nostalgic smile, takes a slow breath and lowers his cigarette.

LIGHTING:
Present-day room: warm amber lamp light against cool blue moonlight coming through the rainy window.
Memories: progressively warmer and brighter lighting, golden sunlight and soft nostalgic glow.
Transition back to present: colors slowly desaturate and become darker.

VISUAL TRANSITIONS:

entries.title: Continuous Aging Woman Morphing Sequence
entries.description: A sophisticated morphing video prompt showing a woman's entire life cycle and environment transformation in a single continuous one-shot.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-cinematic continuous one-shot. The same woman walks from left to right, aging continuously from a small child into an old woman. She is recognizably the same person at every age. The aging never happens in steps: her limbs lengthen, her face matures, and her hair changes color progressively across the entire shot, at every single frame.

Age chain: 5 years old, 10, 16, 22, 30, 45, 65, 85.

She starts as a five-year-old running forward, holding a stuffed rabbit against her chest. As she walks, her legs lengthen and her stride opens. The rabbit's soft body compacts and its fabric tightens and squares off, its ears folding down into shoulder straps until it sits on her back as a school satchel. The nursery floor under her feet stretches forward into a school corridor, walls sliding up on both sides.

The satchel's flap lifts and its body flattens into a laptop she carries against her chest. Her school uniform loosens thread by thread into casual clothes, sleeves rolling themselves up her forearms. The corridor walls fill with posters that unroll downward, then push outward into a city street at dusk, buildings growing upward from the wall line.

The laptop's lid closes and its edges round and soften, its surface growing fabric until it is a blanket wrapped around a sleeping infant in her arms. Her jacket thickens and its collar folds into a soft cardigan. The street facades slide inward and become the walls of a small apartment, morning light arriving from the right.

The blanket folds itself along her forearm and its corners harden into leather, a handle rising from the top until she is carrying a work bag. The cardigan tightens across her shoulders and its edges sharpen into a tailored blazer. The apartment walls retract sideways and the ceiling lifts, opening into a wide office floor. Her walk lengthens and gains confidence.

The bag's leather rounds and splits into woven strands until it is a garden basket. The blazer softens back into a knitted sweater, its weave loosening. Grey travels through her hair strand by strand from the roots outward. The office floor grows grass at the edges and becomes a garden path in late summer.

Her steps shorten. The basket handle narrows, straightens and hardens downward into a wooden cane that meets the ground exactly in rhythm with her step. The garden path becomes a warm living room floor, walls growing inward around her.

Final moment: she stops beside a window. On the sill, already there, sit the stuffed rabbit, the satchel, the laptop, the folded blanket, the leather bag and the woven basket, in the order she carried them. She touches the rabbit and smiles.

entries.title: Tokyo Street Supernatural Thriller
entries.description: A 15-second cinematic thriller set in Tokyo where a woman's scream freezes time, allowing her to escape a thief and make minor changes to the frozen world.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second cinematic, photorealistic supernatural thriller in 16:9 landscape.

Setting: A crowded modern Japanese city street in Tokyo during late afternoon. Busy pedestrian crossing, Japanese traffic lights, compact cars, bicycles, convenience stores, restaurants, vending machines, salarymen and young pedestrians. Realistic contemporary Japan, natural warm sunlight, cinematic realism, subtle film grain. No anime, no cyberpunk.

Main character: A young Japanese woman in her early 20s, casual jacket, jeans, sneakers and shoulder bag. She is walking while looking at her smartphone. A male thief in ordinary dark clothing approaches from behind.

Core rule: Her scream instantly freezes time. Everything except her and objects she directly touches becomes completely motionless. No magical effects. No glowing energy. Frozen people do not blink, breathe or react. Cars, bicycles, birds, leaves and airborne objects remain absolutely still. During frozen time, only her footsteps and breathing are audible. A finger snap instantly restores time.

[00–03] THE DANGER

Medium tracking shot. The woman walks toward a busy Japanese intersection while looking at her phone. The thief suddenly grabs her shoulder-bag strap. She spins around, terrified, and screams.

At the exact peak of the scream, TIME STOPS.

The thief freezes with both hands on the bag. Pedestrians freeze mid-step. Cars stop. A cyclist freezes mid-pedal. A pigeon and leaves hang motionless in the air. Complete silence.

[03–06] ESCAPE

She slowly realizes everyone is frozen. She looks at the thief’s frozen hands, calmly removes them from her bag, pulls the bag securely over her shoulder and immediately walks away. She never looks back.

[06–12] THREE SMALL CHANGES

Smooth tracking shot follows her continuously through the frozen crowd.

Change 1: She passes a businessman frozen with a takeaway coffee. His tie is crooked. She quickly straightens it and keeps walking.

Change 2: She passes a young woman frozen mid-step with sunglasses on top of her head. She gently lowers the sunglasses onto her eyes and keeps walking.

Change 3: She passes a man frozen holding an open umbrella despite the sunny sky. She closes the umbrella and places it under his arm.

All three people remain completely frozen in their new positions.

[12–15] TIME RETURNS

She keeps walking forward. She raises one hand and snaps her fingers.

TIME INSTANTLY RESUMES.

City sounds return. Cars move. The cyclist continues pedaling. The pigeon flies away. Leaves fall.

The businessman notices his perfectly straight tie. The woman suddenly realizes her sunglasses are covering her eyes. The man looks confused at his closed umbrella.

Far behind them, the thief realizes the woman is already gone.

entries.prompt: A young woman with long, pastel rainbow-colored hair—blended with shades of pink, purple, and blue—emerges through grand wooden double doors of a chandelier-lit mansion, wearing an intricately embellished burgundy gown with a dramatic skirt. She gazes intently forward with a somber expression as she walks onto a stone terrace, holding up her voluminous dress before stepping down and running across a sprawling green lawn toward the glowing golden-hour sunset, her train trailing behind as she heads toward the horizon.

entries.title: One-Armed Swordsman Action Battle
entries.description: A high-action Hollywood-style sequence featuring a one-armed warrior in a medieval battle.
entries.prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | No music

Ultra-photorealistic live-action, AAA Hollywood action style with premium VFX. One continuous dynamic shot, permanent 40° Dutch angle, low tracking, fast pursuit, whip-pans and quick orbiting. Real human performance, not CGI.

IMAGE 1: Preserve exact identity, face, hair, clothing and proportions. Image1 has ONLY ONE ARM — RIGHT ARM ONLY. No left arm, hand, elbow, prosthetic or phantom limb. Sword is always controlled one-handed with the right hand.

SETTING: Massive medieval royal plaza, castle walls, stormy sky, damaged market structures and dozens of armored soldiers surrounding Image1.

00–06s: Soldiers attack. Image1 narrowly dodges a sword, parries one-handed, vaults over an attacker and kicks another into a shield wall, then bursts forward with a black afterimage and blue-white lightning trail.

06–12s: Image1 runs across fallen shields, bends a spear with his foot and cuts it with a lightning-charged slash. He rolls, rises and immediately fights three soldiers using fast parries, kicks and a reverse sword strike.

12–18s: A dense spear formation attacks. Image1 slides underneath, cuts several spear shafts and spins into a powerful heel kick. Lightning jumps between broken weapons as soldiers are thrown backward.

18–24s: Surrounded by enemies, Image1 throws the sword upward, then uses rapid Taijutsu—low sweep, shoulder strike, high kick and jumping knee. Brief black afterimages emphasize his physical burst speed. No teleportation.

24–30s: Image1 catches the falling sword perfectly with his right hand. Electricity surges across the blade. A powerful one-handed slash and spinning kick create a compressed-air shockwave, blasting soldiers outward through dust and debris. Camera pulls back as Image1 keeps advancing and another wave of soldiers enters at 30 seconds. No ending pose.

VFX: Restrained blue-white lightning, sparks, afterimages, shockwaves, dust and debris. Keep everything physically integrated with realistic lighting, shadows and reflections while Image1 remains fully authentic live-action.

AUDIO: Wind, armor, sword impacts, electrical crackling, debris and battle cries. No dialogue or music.

NEGATIVE: Left arm, two-handed grip, teleportation, clones, CGI human, digital double, cartoon look, gameplay camera, broken anatomy, face drift, costume drift, subtitles, logos, watermark.

entries.title: Spider-Man Style Rooftop Drop
entries.description: A 15-second action sequence of a blonde woman performing a Spider-Man style drop and web-swinging through a city.
entries.prompt:
Subject: @Image1 A young white woman with long, straight, silky light-blonde hair and neat, airy bangs; she has light gray, clear eyes and delicate, cool-toned features; Overall Outfit: A white, fitted, short-sleeved V-neck ruched tank top; blue, fitted jeans; a vintage brown leather belt with an ornate silver buckle; dark brown leather knee-high boots. Realistic skin texture; wears the same outfit throughout. Maintain consistency in her facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, demeanor, and overall proportions; her appearance must remain consistent throughout the entire sequence without any deviations.

> Timeline Actions (0–15s):
•  > 0–2.5s: She sits on an open windowsill gazing at the city’s skyscrapers. Suddenly, she leans back and falls out the window—head and shoulders drop first, followed by her legs swinging over the window frame—without performing a somersault. Stable, symmetrical wide-angle shot → As she falls backward, she quickly thrusts forward in a dive through the window.
•  > 2.5–4.2s: A brief freefall, with close-ups of the wet street and vehicles; she tilts her body forward, raises her hand to shoot a spider thread, and as the thread tightens, she swings forward. Close-up of the dive → brief cut to a close-up of her wrist → accelerated tracking shot skimming close to the street along the direction of the thread.
•  > 4.2–6.5s: Pendulum-like swing over vehicles; skirt and straw hat billow in the airflow. After reaching the lowest point, accelerates and releases the web to glide, remaining upright throughout. Low-altitude pursuit from the rear side, following an arc that descends then ascends, with vehicles and streetlights streaking across the foreground.
•  > 6.5–8.3s Glides close to the building’s exterior wall, stepping sequentially on the wall and a metal fire escape ladder; after two quick pushes off the wall, leaps toward the street with a distinct rebound. Sideways tracking shot along the wall, moving downward to follow as the camera approaches the landing point of the soles.
•  > 8.3–10.5s: Low-angle shot from the wet sidewalk; a shadow sweeps into the frame; brown boots drop from above, splashing water; after cushioning the impact with her knees, she immediately gets up and runs. Fixed shot close to the ground → slight tremor upon landing → pan up → low-angle tracking shot from the rear side.
•  > 10.3–11.3s: A yellow taxi drives by and blocks the view while she is running; by the time the car moves out of the way, she has already reached the other side of the street. She steps on the guardrail, leaps up, and shoots a second strand of spider silk, which pulls her toward the rooftop. Low-angle tracking shot utilizing the taxi as a screen → sideways tracking shot as she leaps, followed by an upward-facing shot.
•  > 11.3–13s She lands next to a puddle on the rooftop, crouching to break her fall; one hand touches the water’s surface

entries.title: Realistic Woman Yelling At Cat Meme
entries.description: A cinematic re-staging of the famous 'Woman Yelling at a Cat' meme, broken down into 15 specific stage directions for character consistency and comedic timing.
entries.prompt:
meme_reference corresponds to [UPLOADED MEME REFERENCE IMAGE]. Use it as visual and semantic evidence for the characters, appearance, poses, expressions, composition, and comedic meaning. Re-stage the meme as a realistic cinematic scene. Do not show the original image, split-screen layout, captions, borders, UI, typography, or watermark.

[Stage 1] (0–1s) Establish a high-end Beverly Hills restaurant patio at dusk. Wide shot showing the blonde woman and her brunette friend at one table, with the small white cat sitting calmly at another table beside a green salad.

[Stage 2] (1–2s) Close-up of the blonde woman suddenly screaming and pointing toward the cat, with realistic facial tension and an exaggerated expression.

[Stage 3] (2–3s) Medium shot pans from the woman's pointing finger across the space toward the cat, clearly connecting the two subjects.

[Stage 4] (3–4s) Close-up of the brunette friend holding the woman back. She looks worried and confused as the woman continues pointing.

[Stage 5] (4–5s) Reverse close-up of the white cat. Its ears are slightly flattened and its eyes narrowed, creating the same unimpressed expression as the reference.

[Stage 6] (5–6s) Low-angle macro shot of the green salad sitting untouched on the plate, creating a humorous contrast with the dramatic situation.

[Stage 7] (6–7s) Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the cat, looking toward the woman screaming in the distance.

[Stage 8] (7–8s) Reverse over-the-shoulder shot from behind the woman, revealing the tiny white cat sitting completely indifferent.

[Stage 9] (8–9s) Wider lateral camera move reveals other restaurant guests noticing the strange confrontation and looking confused.

[Stage 10] (9–10s) Extreme close-up of the cat's nose, whiskers, and white fur. The cat remains perfectly still.

[Stage 11] (10–11s) Slow push-in toward the woman's pointing finger, emphasizing her accusation, gold jewelry, and expression.

[Stage 12] (11–12s) High-angle overhead shot showing the complete geometric relationship between the woman, friend, cat, and two tables.

[Stage 13] (12–13s) Quick cinematic pan across the table, showing the salad and a half-empty wine glass, emphasizing the absurdly serious dinner atmosphere.

[Stage 14] (13–14s) Smooth 360-degree orbit around the scene, keeping the woman and cat as the central focus while preserving their positions.

[Stage 15] (14–15s) Slow pull-out to a final master wide shot. The woman is still pointing and screaming, her friend is holding her back, while the tiny white cat remains completely unfazed.

[MAINTAIN CONSISTENCY]
Keep the blonde woman's black top and blonde hair, the friend's dark hair and gold earrings, the small white cat with white fur and flattened ears, the green salad, restaurant patio, lighting, and spatial relationships consistent throughout.

[TECHNICAL STYLE]
Hyper-realis
