entries.title: 2D Animation Hybrid POV
entries.description: A unique hybrid prompt for Seedance 2.5 that combines live-action POV footage with hand-drawn 2D animation chaos in an urban setting.
entries.prompt:
POV sequence in an original live-action and hand-drawn 2D animation hybrid world. The entire scene is filmed from first-person perspective with smooth handheld movement, quick pans and playful reframing. Real environments use natural lighting and realistic shadows; animated characters use bold ink outlines, flat colors, elastic motion and expressive cartoon timing. Retro urban comedy, fully original design, no recognizable characters, no studio references.

A fictional old-fashioned city street leading into a colorful entertainment hall, then a narrow backstage corridor and exterior alley.

0-5s: POV moves through a lively street. Real pedestrians walk normally while small abstract cartoon creatures bounce between signs, stretch across doorways and leave hand-drawn motion trails.

5-10s: POV enters the hall. A tiny animated server slides across a real counter carrying wobbling drinks, spins once, waves at camera and disappears behind a curtain.

10-16s: POV turns toward a live performer on stage while animated musicians play around them. One cartoon instrument stretches toward the lens, curls into a spiral, then snaps gently back into place.

16-22s: POV backs away as playful animated chaos spreads through the room: drawn paper shapes float, a cartoon character flattens under a door, another leaves a cloud of sketched stars. Real people remain completely serious.

22-27s: POV moves quickly down the corridor while a small animated guide runs beside camera and says in English: “Keep moving. The drawings are improvising again.”

27-30s: POV exits into the alley. A huge inflatable cartoon prop swings past the lens, bounces harmlessly off a trash bin and launches colorful drawn stars into the air. End on a playful freeze-frame.

entries.title: Luxury Product Video Tutorial
entries.description: A minimalist instructional video prompt for creating luxury product ads, featuring clean UI and a high-end perfume bottle.
entries.prompt:
Create a polished 12-second educational tutorial video in sleek modern minimalist style that clearly demonstrates exactly two steps for making a luxury product advertisement video on LartAI.

Step 1: Slow push-in camera on a bright clean interface; a glowing cyan prompt box lights up as elegant text types itself letter by letter reading “Describe your luxury product in detail”, soft light particles float around the box.

Step 2: A luminous circular Generate button pulses once and is activated; a thin progress ring fills smoothly, then a high-end crystal perfume bottle appears and slowly rotates under warm golden studio lights with sparkling reflections and gentle light flares.

Smooth cross-dissolve transitions between the two steps, large bold centered text overlays “STEP 1” and “STEP 2”, soft ambient electronic background music, crisp white-and-cyan digital interface, professional instructional look, ultra-sharp 720p or higher, no real people or faces, rich surface details, cinematic depth of field and lighting.

entries.title: Authentic Morning Phone Vlog
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 9:16 vertical phone-shot vlog featuring authentic handheld movement, autofocus hunting, and natural morning light with a dog.
entries.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 phone-shot morning vlog, filmed by the subject on her own phone. Authentic personal camera-roll footage, not a commercial.

CAMERA: Handheld throughout except where noted. Opens in selfie mode at arm's length. Keep natural handheld shake, drifting composition, autofocus hunting and re-locking, small rushed reframes, uneven zoom, exposure breathing as she moves between shade and sun, occasional imperfect framing that crops the top of her head. The phone itself is never visible.

LOOK: Modern phone capture with a warm, slightly soft grade. Gentle grain, mild halation around morning sunlight, realistic skin tones, low contrast, natural motion blur. Golden early light, long soft shadows.

CHARACTER: NADIA, mid-20s, dark wavy hair in a claw clip with loose strands, brown eyes, minimal makeup, oversized cream hoodie, black shorts, white sneakers. Genuinely energized and cheerful, not performing. She speaks in short natural sentences with comfortable pauses, laughs easily, brushes hair from her face. Her voice is warm, conversational, unpolished, slightly breathy from walking.

DOG: An excited, healthy golden retriever with a glossy coat, pulling happily on the leash.

SETTING: Quiet tree-lined suburban neighborhood on a sunny morning, then a small green park with benches, then her bright modest kitchen. Birdsong, distant traffic, leaves. Very few people around.

SCENES IN ORDER:

(0-5s) Selfie mode. Nadia steps out of her apartment building into the morning sun, dog already pulling ahead on the leash. She squints, grins into the lens. "Morning." Small beat, glancing down at the dog. "We are both very awake today."

(5-11s) Still selfie, walking down the sidewalk. Dappled light through trees. The dog stops to sniff a tree trunk and she reframes to catch him, autofocus hunting. She looks up at the light and smiles. "God, it's nice out. This is the good part of the day."

(11-17s) WIDE SHOT — the phone is now propped on a park bench, static frame, slightly crooked. Nadia walks into frame in the green park and throws a tennis ball; the retriever sprints joyfully after it and comes bounding back. She is laughing, pleasantly out of breath, hands on knees. "Okay, one more. One more and then coffee."

(17-22s) Back to handheld selfie, walking home along the sidewalk, sun flaring through the branches behind her. Relaxed and content. "Best hour of the day, honestly. Nobody's texting me yet."

(22-26s) Kitchen interior, phone propped against something on the counter, static and slightly off-level. Morning light through the window. Coffee brewing, steam rising, her hands moving through frame. Off-frame the dog's nails click on the floor and he huffs impatiently. She glances down toward him and smiles. "Okay — you first, then me."

(26-30s) FINAL SHOT, SILENT — no dialogue at all. The phone is set down on the kitchen

entries.title: Suited Camel Penthouse Combat
entries.description: An absurd comedy-action prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring a martial arts fight between a woman and a camel in a business suit inside a luxury penthouse.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second cinematic live-action comedy/action video set inside a luxurious modern high-rise penthouse at night. Large floor-to-ceiling glass windows reveal a beautiful city skyline filled with glowing lights. The interior has elegant sofas, warm ambient lighting, polished wooden flooring, modern furniture, and a sophisticated upscale atmosphere.

MAIN CHARACTERS:

1. A young adult woman with realistic natural facial features, shoulder-length dark brown hair with bangs, wearing a fitted black long-sleeve crop top and black pants. She is confident, expressive, energetic, and moves like a trained martial artist.

2. A bizarre but highly realistic anthropomorphic camel-like character. The character has a large orange-brown camel head, expressive eyes, small ears, a prominent muzzle, and wears thin black rectangular glasses. Its body is human-sized and dressed in a perfectly tailored dark business suit, white shirt, and dark tie. The character behaves like a serious businessman despite looking absurd.

VISUAL STYLE:
Ultra-realistic live-action cinematography, cinematic lighting, realistic skin and fabric textures, physically believable movement, detailed facial expressions, natural motion blur, shallow depth of field, high-end movie production quality, dramatic nighttime atmosphere mixed with absurd comedy.

CAMERA & ACTION:

0–4 seconds:
Begin with a medium two-shot of the woman and the suited camel facing each other inside the penthouse. They appear to be having a serious confrontation. The woman gestures aggressively while the camel responds with exaggerated but believable body language. Slowly push the camera forward to increase tension.

4–8 seconds:
Cut to a closer shot of the camel. Its glasses sit naturally on its face and its eyes move expressively. Cut back to the woman's suspicious expression. Keep the dialogue serious, as if this is an intense argument between two people.

8–12 seconds:
The woman suddenly becomes aggressive and throws the first martial-arts strike. The camel quickly reacts and dodges. Use a handheld cinematic camera with subtle shake to make the action feel energetic and spontaneous.

12–17 seconds:
Wide shot showing both characters moving across the luxurious room. The woman performs fast punches, blocks, kicks and evasive movements. The camel awkwardly but surprisingly skillfully defends itself. Keep the choreography playful and slightly exaggerated without becoming cartoonish.

17–21 seconds:
Move the fight toward the floor-to-ceiling windows. Use a tracking shot following them as they exchange several quick attacks. The city lights remain visible behind them, creating a dramatic cinematic background.

21–25 seconds:
The woman delivers a powerful kick. The camel stumbles backward and nearly falls onto a sofa but quickly recovers. Add realistic physical reactions, clothing movement, foot impacts, and natural motio

entries.title: Japanese Summer Festival Cinematic Shot
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for a 15-second continuous cinematic shot of a Japanese summer festival at night, including food stalls and fireworks.
entries.prompt: Create one continuous 15-second video in 16:9. Use the provided storyboard and festival reference images as visual guidance. The entire video must feel like ONE continuous real-life smartphone recording captured by a person attending a Japanese summer festival at night. Ultra-high-definition 4K photorealistic live-action footage with premium cinematic image quality, crisp natural details, high dynamic range, rich color depth, clean professional nighttime exposure, and realistic fine textures. The video should feel immersive, spontaneous, emotional, and believable, like an unexpectedly beautiful viral moment captured during a real local Japanese summer festival. Do not treat the storyboard panels as separate unrelated shots. Maintain strong spatial continuity, camera continuity, lighting continuity, and environmental consistency throughout the full 15-second sequence. The same festival location, same riverside, same crowd atmosphere, same night, same lighting, and same visual world must remain consistent. 0:00–0:02 — Walking through the summer festival Begin in first-person POV, naturally walking forward through a lively Japanese summer festival street. Use the provided festival reference image for the overall composition and atmosphere. On the left is a realistic yakisoba stall with a large hot metal griddle, noodles, cooking tools, rising steam, warm lighting, and vendors preparing food. On the right is a traditional Japanese goldfish scooping stall with a shallow blue water tank, many small orange goldfish, paper scoops, subtle water reflections, and festival visitors enjoying the game. Warm paper lanterns hang above the street. Many Japanese festival visitors naturally walk through the center of the frame, some wearing yukata and others wearing casual summer clothes. The camera moves gently up and down with realistic human footsteps. Natural handheld smartphone motion. No visible hands or arms in front of the camera. The image should be extremely clean and detailed. Clearly preserve: lantern paper texture, stall fabric texture, food surface detail, steam, goldfish, water reflections, yukata fabric, hair, skin, pavement texture, and background lights. The atmosphere is warm, busy, nostalgic, immersive, and realistic. 0:02–0:03 — The firework launch sound begins Continue walking through EXACTLY the same festival street. Do not cut. Do not change the stall arrangement. A distant firework launch sound begins: “whoooooosh…” The camera movement naturally slows slightly as the person notices the sound. The person has not yet fully turned toward the river. The yakisoba stall remains on the left. The goldfish scooping stall remains on the right. The crowd continues moving naturally. Build curiosity and anticipation. The sound indicates that a firework has already been launched somewhere behind or beside the viewer. 0:03–0:04 — Smoothly turn toward the firework Without cutting, smoothly turn the camera toward the direction of the firework sound. The movement must be one continuous and physically believable human reaction. Use a quick but controlled handheld pan. Avoid excessive motion blur. As the camera turns away from the stalls, gradually reveal: the edge of the festival crowd, the riverside, the distant city skyline, and the open dark night sky. The SAME firework is already visible in mid-flight, rising upward. Do not begin a new firework. Do not reset the firework. Do not make it suddenly appear at the bottom of the frame. The glowing shell should already be clearly above the launch point when the camera finishes turning. Crowd silhouettes remain naturally visible near the bottom of the frame. 0:04–0:07 — Follow the same firework upward Continue following the exact SAME firework. The camera naturally tilts upward while tracking it. The firework rises steadily higher into the night sky. It leaves one continuous golden-orange glowing trail with realistic fine sparks and a thin smoke trail. The trajectory must remain completely consistent. The same light source must remain visible throughout. Do not create another firework. Do not restart the launch animation. Do not suddenly change its direction. The camera keeps the firework close to the center of the frame. The upward tracking motion should remain smooth and realistic. The night sky should remain deep and clean, with detailed shadows and minimal image noise. Do not crush the blacks. Preserve subtle city lights and crowd silhouettes near the bottom of the frame. Build suspense. The viewer should feel: “What is this firework going to become?” 0:07–0:08 — The firework starts to burst The same firework reaches its highest point. Create a very short pause before the explosion. Then: BANG! The shell begins exploding outward. It initially opens into a realistic golden chrysanthemum-style firework. The explosion grows naturally from the center outward. Use physically realistic luminous particles, fine glowing trails, smoke, and sparks. The brightness should be powerful but well controlled. Do not completely blow out the highlights. Preserve detailed spark structure even in the brightest parts. The camera reacts with only a subtle natural handheld shake. Do not cut. 0:08–0:10 — Giant rainbow chrysanthemum firework The SAME golden firework naturally transforms into a huge rainbow-colored chrysanthemum firework. It continues expanding outward into a nearly perfect large circular bloom. Use vivid but believable colors: red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple. The colors should remain richly separated and clearly visible without looking artificial. The firework fills a large portion of the night sky. This is the visual and emotional climax of the video. Make the firework feel massive, breathtaking, elegant, and realistic. Render extremely fine individual firework particles. Each glowing trail should have delicate sparkling detail. Preserve: particle separation, small glowing fragments, smoke texture, subtle color gradients, and realistic fading brightness. Do NOT form words. Do NOT form Japanese characters. Do NOT form symbols. Do NOT form logos. This must remain a pure, giant, realistic rainbow chrysanthemum firework. Hold the camera almost still for a brief moment so the viewer can fully appreciate the firework. 0:10–0:12 — Enjoy the afterglow The rainbow firework gradually fades. The colored trails break into hundreds of small glowing embers. Individual sparks slowly fall downward under gravity. Realistic smoke gently spreads across the dark sky. The city skyline and crowd silhouettes remain subtly visible near the bottom of the frame. The camera stays mostly still. Create a quiet emotional pause after the visual climax. Preserve fine detail in the fading sparks and smoke. Avoid muddy black areas. Avoid excessive noise. Avoid oversharpening. Do not immediately cut back to the festival. The audience should have time to enjoy the余韻. 0:12–0:15 — Smoothly return to the festival street While the last firework sparks are still fading, slowly tilt the camera downward. This must be a continuous physical camera movement. No hard cut. No teleportation. As the camera tilts down: first reveal the tops of the crowd, then more people, then warm lantern light, then the festival stalls. Gradually return to the exact SAME festival street from the beginning. The yakisoba stall is again on the left. The goldfish scooping stall is again on the right. Maintain the same general crowd density, stall arrangement, warm lighting, and festival atmosphere. The person naturally begins walking forward again. The lanterns glow warmly without clipping. entries.title: Emotional Crying Shoreline Scene
entries.description: An extremely detailed 15-second one-take prompt focusing on pure facial emotion and realistic skin textures, depicting a woman crying on a cool shoreline.
entries.prompt: One unbroken 15-second take. No cuts, no scene changes, no re-framing. PREMISE: she has already been crying for ten minutes before this shot begins. Every sign of prolonged crying is ALREADY PRESENT IN THE FIRST FRAME and stays constant — it does not develop, appear, spread or intensify during the clip. SUBJECT (fixed state from frame one): extreme close-up of a fictional young East Asian woman, late twenties, face filling the frame, outdoors on a cold shoreline. Ordinary face cast from the street, not a fashion model — slightly asymmetric features, one eyelid marginally lower, natural brows with visible individual hairs. Long dark brown hair, loose and windblown. Grey sleeveless cotton top. Large thin silver hoop earrings. Already established at frame one and held constant: eyelids puffy and swollen, inner eyelid rims and waterline red, nostril rims raw and pink, a settled uneven flush across the nose bridge and upper cheeks, blotchy mottled patches on the neck, faint dried salt tracks on the cheeks from earlier crying. This is her baseline appearance for the entire clip. Skin at full texture: visible pores across nose and cheeks, vellus hair along the jaw and upper lip, uneven undertone, a couple of dormant blemishes, dry cracked lower lip. No makeup, no smoothing, no beautification. CRITICAL: no progressive reddening. No skin colour change of any kind across the 15 seconds. No swelling developing. No blotches appearing or spreading. No flush blooming, creeping or intensifying. Pigmentation and puffiness are locked at the frame-one state. Within these 15 seconds, ONLY these things are permitted to change: facial muscle position, tear fluid, breathing movement, hair position, cloth position, and wet gloss on skin. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND: soft flat overcast daylight, cool 6500K, no direct sun, no shadow direction, no exposure shift, no white balance drift. Behind her a completely blurred pale grey coastal background — sea and horizon dissolved into unreadable bokeh, no detail resolving. CAMERA: handheld operator on a long lens. Continuous micro-drift, small weight shifts, faint breathing sway. No zoom, no push-in, no pull-out, no orbit, no rack focus. Focus locked on the near eye, far eye slightly soft. Face scale identical first frame to last. CONTINUOUS: fine loose hair strands blow across her cheek, lips and eyeline in irregular gusts, sometimes sticking to wet skin. Involuntary blinks at uneven intervals. Real chest and shoulder breathing. 0.0–3.0s — Suppressing it. Lips compress to a thin flat line, the lip border blanching white under mechanical pressure. Chin muscle bunches and dimples in fast small tremors. One sharp shuddering inhale lifts the chest and catches in the throat; a visible swallow moves the neck. Nostrils flare open and relax. Tears build along the lower lash line and hold by surface tension without spilling; eye surface glassy and reflective. 3.0–6.0s — It breaks. Eyes squeeze shut, lower-lid creases compressing. Inner brows pull up and together, wrinkles forming between them. Mouth opens into a sob, lower lip pulled down and out, corners dragging toward the jaw, tendons standing in the neck. The held tears break and run in two uneven tracks down both cheeks, catching light, thinning over the cheekbone. Wet lashes clump into points. Wet skin gains gloss where the tears pass — moisture only, no colour shift. 6.0–7.5s — Head tilts downward, chin toward the chest, shoulders sinking. Eyes reopen a fraction, unfocused and streaming. 7.5–11.0s — She wipes her face with her own shirt. Her right hand enters from the bottom of the frame, fingers bunching the front hem of the grey top, and pulls the fabric up. She presses the balled cloth against her right cheekbone, holds a beat, and drags it upward and inward across the wet skin — fabric bunching in her fist, dragging the cheek flesh slightly, catching under the eye, pulling the lower lid down a fraction as it passes. Where the cloth presses hard the skin blanches pale for a moment and refills within a second, as real compressed skin does. The cotton darkens where it absorbs the tears. She switches to the left cheek with the same fistful of cloth, wipes across roughly, then presses it flat over her nose and mouth and breathes into it, the fabric denting inward on the inhale and puffing on the exhale. The knit stretches and thins under tension, hem curling, tension wrinkles radiating from her grip. A rough, functional, unglamorous wipe — not delicate, not choreographed. 11.0–12.5s — She lets go. The fabric drops with real cloth weight — a fast fall, a small overshoot, then settles onto her collarbones with residual creases and visible damp patches. Her hand exits back down out of frame. Her face is uncovered in the same position, nothing snapping or teleporting. The tears are physically gone from the cheeks, leaving only faint moisture gloss and a few hair strands pulled loose and stuck across the skin. Her underlying redness and puffiness are exactly as they were at frame one — unchanged by the wiping. 12.5–15.0s — Eyes open only partway, cast downward and slightly off-lens, lashes stuck in wet spikes. Mouth stays open, taking heavy uneven exhausted breaths, top lip trembling on each exhale. Nostrils flaring. Chest rising and falling out of rhythm. One fresh tear starts again at the corner of the left eye and begins to travel. No recovery, no smile, no resolution. AUDIO: diegetic and sparse only. Steady offshore wind across the microphone, low distant surf, faint fabric rustle when the shirt moves and when it drops. Her breathing carries the scene: the sharp catching inhale near 2s, a broken wet sob on the break near 4s, muffled breath through the cloth around 9–10s, then slow ragged uneven breathing to the end. Small involuntary throat sounds and sniffs. No words, no dialogue, no speech of any kind. No music, no score, no sound design, no reverb, no interior room tone. RENDER: photoreal cinema, ARRI Alexa 35, 85mm at T2.0, shallow depth of field, filmic contrast with lifted blacks and gentle highlight rolloff, muted desaturated cool palette, fine organic grain, faint chromatic fringing. NEGATIVE: no progressive reddening, no flush blooming or spreading, no skin tone change, no swelling developing, no colour grading shift, no cuts or transitions, no zoom, no camera move beyond handheld drift, no face morphing or identity drift, no changing hairstyle, no extra or malformed fingers, no second hand entering, no background detail resolving, no lighting change, no text, no captions, no overlays, no logos, no slow motion, no speed ramp, no additional people, no spoken words, no music.

entries.title: NYC Parkour and Web-Swinging Action
entries.description: A highly technical 15-second continuous drone-follow prompt for a character performing superhuman parkour and web-swinging across NYC brownstones.
entries.prompt:
CHARACTER REFERENCE — MANDATORY: Face — Reference Image 3. Outfit — short dark bob, black fitted crop jacket, distressed dark cargo denim shorts, gray hoodie tied at waist, teal satin ballet pointe shoes, pink tights, black headphones ON EARS, white gloves.
 CRITICAL — CHARACTER ANATOMY. NON-NEGOTIABLE: 165cm, 47kg. Athletic, lean, controlled. NEVER ragdoll. NEVER limp. NEVER floppy. Core always engaged. Every movement has muscle intention. She moves like a trained gymnast/dancer who happens to have superpowers — precise, casual, effortless. Minimal spinning. Body follows physics of each movement logically.
 CRITICAL — PHYSICAL CONTACT WITH ENVIRONMENT. NON-NEGOTIABLE: She does NOT just fly through the air. She interacts with the city physically — feet push off walls, hands grab ledges, body grazes building surfaces. Every contact point: knees absorb impact, muscles engage, body reacts to the surface. This is parkour + web-swinging, not floating.
 CRITICAL — BODY POSITIONS PER MOVEMENT TYPE:
Web swing: arms extended forward gripping web, legs together trailing, core tight, back straight, chin up — clean rope-swing athlete position
Wall push-off: both feet plant flat on wall, knees bend deep to absorb, then legs explode into full extension at launch, arms punch forward for momentum
Running on wall: body leans 45 degrees toward wall, feet striking surface in running gait, arms pumping, hair and hoodie pulled sideways by momentum
Free flight peak: arms naturally open to sides, body slightly arched back, relaxed — not posed, just physically released
Street level run: full sprint, arms driving, head forward, teal pointe shoes striking pavement, body leaning into direction of travel
 CRITICAL — REALISM. NON-NEGOTIABLE: Real Hollywood film. RED Monstro 8K, anamorphic lens. Real motion blur, real fabric physics, real atmospheric NYC haze. REAL.
 CRITICAL — CAMERA. NON-NEGOTIABLE: ONE continuous drone-follow. ZERO cuts. ZERO teleporting. Tilts, banks, rolls physically. Wide enough to always show her AND environment. 

15-second continuous drone-follow shot. DIRECT CONTINUATION — starts from black.
0–1 sec: Black. Then — CLOSE-UP — white-gloved hand. Fingers open. Wrist snaps. Web shoots. Camera pulls back immediately.
1–4 sec: Wide — residential NYC street. Brownstones, fire escapes, bodegas. She swings LOW — 3 meters above street. Body: arms extended gripping web, legs together trailing, core tight, back straight. At the bottom of the swing arc her feet skim the roof of a parked car — brief physical contact, feet bounce off lightly, she uses it to redirect. Camera banks 40 degrees.
4–7 sec: She releases the web at peak — body opens, arms out, legs extend. Then instead of firing a new web immediately — she runs along the side of a brownstone wall. Feet strike the brick surface in a real running gait — body angled 45 degrees toward the wall, arms pumping, 4–5 quick steps along the vertical surface — then she pushes off hard with both feet, knees fully extending, and fires a new web mid-air toward a building across a wide intersection. Swing pulls her hard sideways — camera rolls 60 degrees.
7–10 sec: She comes in LOW down a narrow street packed with yellow taxis. 2 meters off the ground, body streamlined — arms forward, legs trailing like an arrow. Web releases. Her feet hit the ground — full sprint, body leaning forward, arms driving — she runs 3–4 steps between taxis, using the momentum, feet striking the wet pavement. A taxi honks. She laughs. Then plants one foot on the side of a taxi cab, pushes off the car roof with a single explosive step, fires a web upward at a tall building, and rockets HIGH.
"WOOHOO!"
10–15 sec: WIDE SHOT — rooftop level, not too high. She hangs at the peak — arms slightly open, body naturally arched, completely still for one breathless moment. Golden hour sky — warm orange and pink light across the horizon. Massive dramatic clouds lit from below with gold. She is a small figure dead center against the enormous glowing sky. City rooftops, water towers, streets below. The frame holds. She begins to fall back down.
[END]

 CRITICAL — EMOTION AND SOUND. NON-NEGOTIABLE: She is fully alive in every frame. Not blank. Not neutral. Not AFK.
Her face and body express genuine real-time emotion throughout:
During the first swing — wide eyes, slight grin, pure focus
When feet skim the car — quick surprised laugh, instinctive
Running on the wall — jaw set, determined, intense concentration
Low between taxis — teeth showing, adrenaline grin, leaning into it
The taxi honk — she laughs out loud, head tips back slightly
"WOOHOO!" — completely uncontrolled, mouth open, genuine scream of joy
Final wide shot at peak — arms open, head back, eyes closed, face of pure freedom — not blank, not posed, just a person at the best moment of their life
AUDIO: SFX ONLY. NO MUSIC. Wind rushing. Web snap and twang. Feet hitting car roof. Feet hitting pavement — real impact sounds. Taxi horn. Her genuine laugh. "WOOHOO!" echoing between buildings. Wind cutting as she rises. Then — silence at the peak.

RED Monstro 8K, anamorphic, 165cm 47kg controlled athletic body throughout, physical contact with walls/cars/surfaces at every opportunity, detailed body mechanics per movement type — swing/run/push-off/sprint, NO ragdoll NO float, severe Dutch angle during swings, golden hour sunset sky warm orange pink, dramatic volumetric clouds, subject at rooftop level NOT high altitude, subject tiny in center of wide final frame, residential NYC brownstones, continuous single drone follow, no cuts, photorealistic

Use realistic lip-sync, natural facial expressions and subtle background tavern sounds.

Scene 2 — Confrontation | 5–10 seconds

The warrior approaches the table and places one hand on her sword.

Warrior:
“I came here to collect a debt.”

The woman casually takes another bite of food.

Woman:
“Then you came to the wrong table.”

The warrior becomes irritated.

Warrior:
“I don't think you understand who you're dealing with.”

The woman slowly smiles.

Woman:
“Oh, I understand perfectly.”

Scene 3 — Fight Begins | 10–17 seconds

Suddenly the warrior swings her enormous sword.

Use dynamic handheld cinematography and fast martial-arts choreography. The woman quickly moves aside, surprisingly agile despite her size.

The sword crashes into the wooden table, sending pieces of wood and food flying.

The woman grabs the warrior and throws her backward.

Warrior, shocked:
“Wait… you're actually strong?!”

Woman:
“You should have asked before starting a fight.”

Scene 4 — Fire Attack | 17–23 seconds

The warrior gets back up and charges again.

The woman takes a deep breath.

A mysterious orange glow begins building inside her mouth.

The warrior stops suddenly.

Warrior:
“What the hell are you doing?”

The woman exhales a powerful burst of magical fire toward her.

Create a dramatic, realistic fire effect illuminating the entire tavern. The warrior narrowly avoids the flames but gets thrown backward by the force of the blast.

Scene 5 — Defeat | 23–27 seconds

The warrior crashes onto the wooden floor.

The woman walks toward her calmly.

The warrior tries to crawl away and looks completely stunned.

Warrior: “Okay… I admit it”

entries.title: 3D Anthropomorphic Kittens Gift Scene
entries.description: A cute 3D animation prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring two ginger kittens in a heartwarming interaction involving a bouquet and a surprise gift of cash.
entries.prompt:
Style & overall look

Photorealistic 3D anthropomorphic kittens, soft cinematic lighting, warm golden sunlight streaming through a large window, light wooden floor with long soft shadows, bright modern room with cream walls. Ultra-cute, high detail fur, expressive faces. Vertical 9:16 format.

Characters

Girl cat: Ginger tabby, black bangs + two high pigtails with pink ties, wearing a beige ruffled dress and matching beige Mary Jane shoes. Starts grumpy/pouty.

Boy cat: Ginger tabby, big blue eyes, small brown leather backpack.

Storyboard (10 seconds)

0:00 – 1:00
Girl cat stands center-left, arms crossed tightly, angry pout, looking away. Boy cat enters from the right, holding a colorful bouquet (yellow sunflower, purple/pink flowers, white daisies), smiling excitedly, offering the flowers.

1:00 – 2:00
Boy cat steps closer, still smiling brightly, holding the bouquet out. Girl cat uncrosses one arm and reaches toward the flowers with a skeptical look.

2:00 – 3:00
Girl cat takes the bouquet… then immediately drops it on the floor with a dismissive flick. She crosses her arms again, looking annoyed. Boy cat’s smile vanishes, ears slightly down, looking shocked and sad.

3:00 – 4:00
Girl cat remains arms-crossed and grumpy. Boy cat stands next to the fallen bouquet, looking thoughtful. A glowing yellow lightbulb appears above his head.

4:00 – 5:00
Boy cat’s eyes light up with an idea. He quickly takes off his small brown backpack and holds it in front of him.

5:00 – 6:00
Boy cat opens the backpack zipper, looks inside, then pulls out a thick stack of cash (US dollar bills).

6:00 – 7:00
Boy cat happily holds out the stack of money toward the girl cat. Girl cat’s eyes go wide in surprise, arms still crossed but expression changing.

7:00 – 8:00
Girl cat grabs the money with both paws, eyes sparkling with joy, big excited smile. Boy cat keeps smiling and holding the open backpack.

8:00 – 9:00
Girl cat and boy cat jump into a tight, happy hug. Both laughing with eyes closed in pure joy. Girl cat still clutching the money. The bouquet remains on the floor.

9:00 – 10:00
They continue hugging tightly, both laughing happily. Soft warm light continues to fill the room. Fade out or hold on the cute hug.

entries.title: Shanghai Morning Vlog and Subway Commute
entries.description: A two-part realism test prompt for Seedance 2.5 generating a high-quality, handheld phone-style vlog of a morning routine in Shanghai and a subway commute.
entries.prompt: 【生成目标】真实的上海上班早晨 Vlog。女主在公寓内穿衣、梳妆、整理头发，拿上手机、钥匙和背包，离开公寓，穿过上海老弄堂，最后到达地铁站入口。镜头数量较多，节奏快速，每个镜头只表现一个短动作，镜头之间使用普通硬切。【参考素材职责】@Image1 只用于女主的脸部特征、五官比例、深棕色高发髻、自然碎发、身材比例、肤色、银色耳饰和人物身份。不采用参考图的棚拍背景和静态姿势。女主穿白色上衣、浅色长裤、米色薄外套和深色小双肩包。【共性锁定】女主在所有镜头中保持同一张脸、同一发型、同一身材比例、同一套服装、同一副银色耳饰和同一个背包。她动作自然，不对镜头摆姿势，不夸张表演。这是女主朋友用普通手机随手拍摄的生活记录，不是自拍，不是专业摄影师拍摄。拍摄者始终在女主附近跟拍，但经常慢半拍；走路时有自然的上下浮动、轻微手抖、运动模糊、构图偏心和短暂失焦。自动对焦会在女主、镜子、衣物、钥匙和背景之间搜索；室内外切换时自动曝光短暂变亮或变暗。上述手持缺陷必须贯穿每个镜头。自然光和室内现有灯光，没有专业布光、没有稳定器、没有轨道运镜、没有电影化构图、没有现代商业调色。每个镜头之间只使用普通硬切，不使用遮挡物、溶解、淡入淡出或花哨转场。现场声音为主，没有旁白，画面不出现字幕、Logo 或水印。【本卡个性镜头说明】镜头 1：清晨卧室。女主从椅子上拿起白色上衣穿好，窗帘缝隙透进晨光，床边有手机、耳饰和半开的背包。镜头从侧后方短暂跟拍，拍摄者起步稍晚，只捕捉到她穿衣动作的后半段。个性说明：突出刚开始一天的生活感，画面不完整但真实。镜头 2：浴室镜前。女主整理高发髻，把碎发别到耳后，快速确认妆容和银色耳饰。镜头靠近镜面，自动对焦先落在镜框，再回到她的脸。个性说明：突出室内近距离手持拍摄和镜面反光的不稳定感。镜头 3：公寓玄关。女主拿起手机、钥匙和小双肩包，把钥匙放进口袋。镜头从桌面小物快速抬起跟随她，室内画面略暗。个性说明：突出朋友随手记录小物和动作，而不是精心安排的特写。镜头 4：门口低机位。女主坐下穿好浅色运动鞋，起身背上包。镜头跟随时短暂拍到地板和鞋尖，人物偏离画面中心。个性说明：突出拍摄者边走边拍时的低头失误和真实构图。镜头 5：上海老弄堂。女主关上公寓门，经过灰砖墙、石库门门框、晾衣绳、旧自行车、电线和梧桐树影，边走边查看一次手机。一辆自行车从镜头近处经过，画面轻微晃动。个性说明：突出上海弄堂的生活环境，让人物自然融入街道。镜头 6：地铁站入口外。女主快步走到入口前，晨光切换到入口阴影，自动曝光短暂过亮后恢复。她确认一次手机路线，背包在肩上，第一段在这个状态结束。个性说明：明确建立第一段结尾状态，为第二段的地铁站内部硬切做准备。【现场声音】衣物摩擦声、窗外鸟声、浴室水声、钥匙碰撞声、鞋底落地声、弄堂脚步声、自行车铃、远处居民交谈声和城市早晨环境声。【生成目标】真实的上海地铁通勤 Vlog。直接从地铁站内部开始，女主进站、刷卡、走向站台、等待地铁、列车进站、上车并坐下。镜头数量较多，节奏快速，每个镜头只表现一个短动作，镜头之间使用普通硬切。【参考素材职责】@Image1 只用于女主的脸部特征、五官比例、深棕色高发髻、自然碎发、身材比例、肤色、银色耳饰和人物身份。不采用参考图的棚拍背景和静态姿势。女主保持与上一段完全相同的白色上衣、浅色长裤、米色薄外套、深色小双肩包和银色耳饰。【共性锁定】女主在所有镜头中保持同一张脸、同一发型、同一身材比例、同一套服装、同一副银色耳饰和同一个背包。她动作自然，不对镜头摆姿势，偶尔自然看镜头一眼后移开视线。这是同一位朋友继续用同一部普通手机记录女主，不是自拍，不是专业摄影师拍摄。镜头始终是近距离手持跟拍：拍摄者走路时有上下浮动，转身时有横向晃动，跟不上女主时会慢半拍；自动对焦会在女主、闸机、扶手、车窗反光和背景乘客之间短暂搜索；站厅、站台和车厢之间的亮度变化会引起自动曝光波动；快速移动的列车保留轻微运动模糊和手机滚动快门感。上述手持缺陷必须贯穿每个镜头。自然地铁灯光和手机现场收音，没有专业布光、没有稳定器、没有轨道运镜、没有电影化构图、没有商业宣传片效果。镜头之间只使用普通硬切，不使用遮挡物、溶解、淡入淡出或花哨转场。背景乘客只做自然活动，不抢占女主画面。没有字幕、Logo 或水印。【本卡个性镜头说明】镜头 1：直接硬切到上海地铁站内部。女主从入口台阶走入灰白色站厅，背景有黄色盲道、玻璃栏杆、自动闸机和早高峰乘客。摄像机从侧后方快速跟拍，随着下楼脚步产生上下晃动。个性说明：直接承接第一段故事，但空间从住宅街道突然切换为地铁站内部。镜头 2：闸机近景。女主用手机或交通卡刷卡通过，手和卡片短暂失焦，闸机提示音响起，镜头快速抬起重新找到她。个性说明：突出真实通勤中的小动作和手机对近距离物体的对焦失误。镜头 3：站台中景。女主站在安全线后等待列车，低头看一次手机，再抬头看向隧道。拍摄者一开始拍偏了空站台，随后快速调整到她身上。个性说明：突出等待过程中的短暂停顿，让快速剪辑中仍然保留生活节奏。镜头 4：列车进站。车灯从隧道出现，列车风吹动女主的碎发和外套，画面因车灯短暂过曝，玻璃屏蔽门和列车车身快速掠过。个性说明：突出地铁进站带来的速度、风和曝光变化，但保持普通手机记录感。镜头 5：车门打开。女主快步上车，背包自然贴在肩后，一名乘客从前景经过，镜头短暂被打断但女主保持清晰。个性说明：突出拥挤但不戏剧化的通勤瞬间，背景人物只作为自然环境存在。镜头 6：车厢座位。女主坐在靠窗位置，把背包放在腿上，抬头看向车窗外。自动对焦先落在车窗反光和扶手，再回到她的侧脸。地铁开始启动，窗外光影移动，第二段在她安静看向窗外的状态结束。个性说明：用安静的坐下和窗外移动光影收束前面的快速节奏。【现场声音】地铁站环境声、闸机提示声、乘客脚步声、模糊的站内广播、列车进站风声、车门提示音、车厢运行声、背包和座椅摩擦声。没有旁白，画面不出现字幕、Logo 或清晰可读的广告文字。
entries.translated_prompt: [Generation Goal] A realistic morning commute Vlog in Shanghai. The female protagonist gets dressed, grooms herself, and fixes her hair inside her apartment. She grabs her phone, keys, and backpack, leaves the apartment, walks through an old Shanghai alleyway (longtang), and finally arrives at a subway station entrance. The video features many shots with a fast pace, where each shot depicts a single short action with standard hard cuts between them. [Reference Material Duties] @Image1 is used only for the protagonist's facial features, proportions, deep brown high bun, natural stray hairs, body proportions, skin tone, silver earrings, and character identity. Do not use the studio background or static pose from the reference. The protagonist wears a white top, light-colored trousers, a beige light jacket, and a dark small backpack. [Commonality Locking] The protagonist must maintain the same face, hairstyle, body proportions, outfit, silver earrings, and backpack across all shots. Her movements are natural; she does not pose for the camera or perform exaggeratedly. This is a lifestyle record casually shot by a friend using an ordinary smartphone, not a selfie or a professional shoot. The camera follows her closely but often lags slightly behind; there is natural vertical swaying while walking, slight hand tremors, motion blur, off-center composition, and brief moments of defocusing. Autofocus will search between the protagonist, mirrors, clothing, keys, and the background. Automatic exposure will briefly brighten or darken during indoor-to-outdoor transitions. These handheld imperfections must persist throughout every shot. Use natural and existing indoor lighting; no professional lighting, stabilizers, dolly tracks, cinematic composition, or modern commercial color grading. Use only hard cuts between shots; no wipes, dissolves, fades, or fancy transitions. Focus on ambient sound; no narration, subtitles, logos, or watermarks. [Individual Shot Descriptions] Shot 1: Early morning bedroom. The protagonist picks up a white top from a chair and puts it on. Morning light peeks through the curtains. A phone, earrings, and a half-open backpack are by the bed. A brief follow shot from behind; the camera starts late, capturing only the latter half of the dressing action. Detail: Emphasize the sense of life just beginning the day; the frame is incomplete but realistic. Shot 2: In front of the bathroom mirror. The protagonist fixes her high bun, tucks stray hair behind her ear, and quickly checks her makeup and silver earrings. The camera is close to the mirror; autofocus first hits the frame before returning to her face. Detail: Highlights the instability of close-up indoor handheld shooting and mirror reflections. Shot 3: Apartment entryway. She picks up her phone, keys, and small backpack, putting the keys in her pocket. The camera lifts quickly from small items on a table to follow her; the interior is slightly dark. Detail: Emphasize a friend casually recording small items and actions rather than meticulously arranged close-ups. Shot 4: Low angle at the doorway. She sits to put on light-colored sneakers, then stands and puts on her bag. The camera briefly captures the floor and the tips of her shoes while following, with the character drifting off-center. Detail: Highlights the downward-looking mistakes and raw composition of walking while filming. Shot 5: Old Shanghai alley. She closes the apartment door and walks past gray brick walls, Shikumen frames, clotheslines, old bicycles, wires, and shadows of plane trees, checking her phone once. A bicycle passes close to the camera, causing a slight shake. Detail: Emphasize the living environment of Shanghai alleys, letting the character blend naturally into the street. Shot 6: Outside the subway entrance. She walks briskly to the entrance. The morning light shifts to the entrance shadow; auto-exposure briefly over-brightens then recovers. She confirms a route on her phone with her backpack on her shoulder. The first segment ends in this state. Detail: Clearly establishes the ending state of the first segment to prepare for the hard cut into the subway interior in the second segment. [Live Sound] Rustling of clothes, birds outside, water in the bathroom, keys clinking, soles hitting the ground, footsteps in the alley, bicycle bells, distant chatter from residents, and the ambient sounds of a city morning. [Generation Goal] A realistic Shanghai subway commute Vlog. Starts directly inside the subway station. The protagonist enters, swipes her card, walks toward the platform, waits for the train, the train arrives, she boards and sits down. Many shots, fast pace, each shot shows one short action with hard cuts. [Reference Material Duties] @Image1 is used only for character identity and features. Protagonist maintains the exact same white top, light trousers, beige jacket, dark backpack, and silver earrings as the previous segment. [Commonality Locking] Same face, hair, body, outfit, earrings, and bag. Natural movements; she occasionally glances at the camera naturally before looking away. The same friend continues recording with the same ordinary phone. The camera is always close-up handheld following: vertical swaying when walking, horizontal shaking when turning, lagging behind the lead. Autofocus hunting between lead, gates, rails, reflections, and passengers. Brightness changes between hall, platform, and carriage cause exposure fluctuations. Moving train shots retain motion blur and rolling shutter feel. No professional gear or cinematic effects. Hard cuts only. Background passengers behave naturally. No subtitles or logos. [Individual Shot Descriptions] Shot 1: Hard cut to subway interior. She enters the gray-white station hall from the stairs. Yellow tactile tiles, glass railings, automatic gates, and morning rush passengers in the background. Camera follows quickly from behind, shaking with the steps. Detail: Continues the story but switches space abruptly from street to station interior. Shot 2: Close-up of the gate. She swipes her phone or card to pass. The hand and card are briefly out of focus. The gate beep sounds; the camera lifts to find her again. Detail: Highlights small actions in a real commute and focus errors on close objects. Shot 3: Mid-shot on the platform. She stands behind the safety line waiting, looks down at her phone, then up toward the tunnel. The cameraman initially frames the empty platform incorrectly then quickly adjusts to her. Detail: Highlights short pauses in the commute to maintain a life rhythm within fast editing. Shot 4: Train arrival. Headlights appear from the tunnel; the wind blows her hair and jacket. The frame briefly overexposes due to the lights. Glass screen doors and the train body rush past. Detail: Highlights the speed, wind, and exposure changes of a train entering, maintaining a phone recording feel. Shot 5: Doors open. She boards quickly, backpack naturally against her shoulder. A passenger passes in the foreground, briefly interrupting the shot but she stays clear. Detail: Highlights the crowded but non-dramatic commute moment. Shot 6: Carriage seat. She sits by the window, places her bag on her lap, and looks out. Autofocus first lands on window reflections and handrails before returning to her profile. The train starts moving; lights and shadows shift outside. The segment ends with her quietly looking out the window. Detail: Uses a quiet sitting moment and shifting light to resolve the previous fast pace. [Live Sound] Subway ambience, gate beeps, footsteps, vague announcements, wind from the train, door chimes, train running sounds, and the friction of the bag and seat. No narration, no subtitles, logos, or legible ads.

entries.title: Cinematic Fantasy Action Sequence
entries.description: A continuous handheld cinematic take of a fantasy action scene featuring a character named Iris landing on a windswept fjord ledge during a storm.
entries.prompt:
Thirty second cinematic realism fantasy action clip, one continuous handheld take, storm lit and grounded, shot like anamorphic 35mm.

SUBJECT: Iris - mid-thirties, dark auburn hair wind torn loose to the jaw, skin damp with sea spray. Wardrobe: charcoal long sleeve thermal, dark grey leggings, mud stained trainers. She carries Bram, a heavy silver grey Maine Coon cat with tufted ears and green eyes.
SETTING: a slate escarpment above a grey fjord, late dusk, low cloud, wet moss and black shale, sea breaking far below, constant hard wind.
STYLE: desaturated blue-grey grade, one ember-warm accent, wet stone specular, fine 35mm grain, shallow depth, natural overcast key.
CAMERA: one unbroken handheld take, operator on the ledge, reactive whip-pans, no cuts.

0-3s Empty windswept ledge, low wide. Cloud drags across the fjord. A dark shape tears out of the cloud deck. Camera tilts up to follow it. <wind roar, distant surf>
3-5s Iris slams onto the shale, curled tight around Bram. Camera flinches down with the impact. <body impact on wet rock, stone crack>
5-8s She skids through moss and gravel, one arm caging the cat, stops in a crouch, chest heaving. Camera recovers and pushes in. <gravel skitter, ragged breath>
8-12s Profile two-shot. Iris lifts Bram to eye level, hair lashing her face, and studies him. Slow push to a tight profile. Iris says, low and breathless: {We are not done. Stay with me.} <wind, cat chirrup>
12-16s She sets him down and opens her palm. A thread of dark smoke coils into a small ember above her hand. Camera pushes past her shoulder onto the closing fist. <low sub-bass hum, cloth snap>
16-19s Snap-wide. Iris drops to one knee, Bram pressed to her side. Charcoal smoke bursts outward at ground level, orange embers scattering across the moss. Camera pulls back. <concussive whump, fire crackle>
19-23s The smoke tears away in the wind. Iris now wears an oxidised bronze and slate plated flight harness, and enormous storm-grey wings with pale primaries unfurl and lock open behind her. Bram is gone; a snow-grey lynx stands where he was. Camera holds centred. <feather snap, deep exhale>
23-27s Iris walks straight at the lens, wings spread past the frame edges, the lynx padding at her hip, shards of slate lifting off the ground around them. Slow track back. <stone grinding, rising wind>
27-30s She crouches and launches. A wingtip sweeps across the lens, the camera whips up into cloud, debris streaking past, then settles back on the ledge. <wingbeat boom, wind blast>

AUDIO: diegetic only - hard coastal wind, breaking sea, gravel, cloth, fire, wingbeats. Dialogue language: English. No music. No subtitles.

Last frame: the empty slate ledge in low wide, ash and grit still falling through frame, cloud closing over the fjord. No on-screen text, no captions, no logo, no watermark.

Negative Prompt: cuts, jump cuts, slow-motion ramping, plastic CGI wings, extra animals, a s

entries.title: Cyberpunk Rooftop Heist Thriller
entries.description: A cinematic heist thriller prompt for Seedance 2.5 involving a skilled infiltrator on a neon-lit rooftop.
entries.prompt:
Reference Character: Use the first image as the protagonist — a skilled infiltrator. Maintain identical face, hairstyle, tactical outfit, and identity throughout all shots.
Reference Location: Use the second image as the city skyline/rooftop complex. Maintain identical architecture, neon signage, and lighting throughout every scene.
Style: Ultra realistic cinematic heist thriller, night city lighting, handheld and drone-style blend, photorealistic, neon-blue and amber contrast, rain-slicked reflective surfaces, shallow depth of field, 35mm anamorphic, physically accurate motion blur, HDR, sharp cinematic color grading.
Audio: No music. Only wind, rain, distant traffic hum, footsteps on metal/concrete, fabric movement, radio static burst, breathing, heartbeat under tension.
0–3s
Wide drone-style shot. City skyline at night, rain falling in sheets, neon signs reflecting off wet rooftops. Protagonist crouches at the edge of one building, scanning the target tower.
3–6s
Close-up. Gloved hand pulls a grappling device from a harness, checking the tension with a practiced motion. Rain drips off the visor.
6–9s
Wide tracking shot. Protagonist sprints across the rooftop and leaps the gap between buildings, body suspended mid-air for a beat, rain streaking past.
9–12s
Handheld shot, landing roll absorbed smoothly. Protagonist moves low and fast toward a maintenance hatch, checking over one shoulder.
12–15s
Close-up on hands working quickly at a control panel — wires, a small device blinking red then green. A soft click as the hatch unlocks.
15–18s
Medium shot, descending through the hatch into a dim service corridor. Flashlight beam cuts through steam venting from overhead pipes.
18–21s
Wide shot. A security beam sweeps across the corridor. Protagonist flattens against the wall, perfectly still, timing the gap between sweeps.
21–24s
Handheld shot, fast movement. Protagonist slips past the beam at the exact moment, rolling underneath and continuing forward without breaking stride.
24–27s
Close-up. Reaching the target vault door, hand pressing a device against the lock. A tense beat as lights blink rapidly, then turn solid green.
27–30s

entries.title: First Person Dragon Flight POV
entries.description: A complex, two-shot prompt for a photorealistic dragon flight, transitioning from a nervous character close-up to a high-speed first-person rider perspective.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, full-realism fantasy dragon flight in 2 shots, vertical 9:16, using the references strictly: 100% face/character, armor, dragon, world and scale consistency. Only ONE dragon exists.

SHOT A — 0:00–0:06: Frontal handheld close-up of SHARON, nervous first-time rider in white-silver armor, seated on a colossal 60m white-grey opalescent dragon at a cliff edge. Slow zoom out reveals her and the dragon’s horned head facing camera, valley behind. She nervously says: “Okay, buddy… ready? Just—no games, alright? It’s my first flight aaand—” Frequent blinks, wandering gaze, shaky breathing. Dragon snorts a tiny flame, crests flare, then suddenly charges toward the cliff. HARD CUT at launch.

SHOT B — 0:06–0:30: Strict first-person rider POV from Sharon’s eyes, never third-person. Her armored hands and reins remain visible throughout, constantly clenching during fear and relaxing during calm moments. Exact route: plunge off cliff → skim through village → full flock of sheep rushes into view and splits left/right in panic → brush outer willow leaves with wingtip → hard 45° waterfall bank through spray → climb past floating islands → 360° barrel roll → dragon glances back → reveal colossal Gothic castle → spiral upward → dragon’s own claws seize the tallest empty spire and coil around it → final panoramic valley vista. No other dragons or creatures on the spire.

Dragon must look like a living animal: thousands of individually layered opalescent scales with keratin texture, micro-wear and dirt seams; moving aqua/lilac/rose-gold/pearl reflections; neck scales rippling in wind; crests folding according to speed; translucent veined wings flexing naturally; realistic muscle, inertia, tail ruddering and wingbeats. No plastic, chrome or CG sheen.

Maintain believable collisions: never pass through buildings, trees, rocks or water; only outer leaves are brushed. Sheep escape unharmed. Realistic reins, saddle movement, wind, G-forces and camera shake.

Warm natural daylight, deep focus, cinematic anamorphic optics, realistic spray droplets, subtle edge distortion and chromatic aberration. No music, subtitles, text, logos, watermarks, lens flares or stylization. Full photorealism.

entries.title: Living Room Girl Interaction Vlog
entries.description: A realistic lifestyle video prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring a girl in a dimly lit living room, focusing on subtle expressions, micro-movements, and natural interactions with the camera.
entries.prompt: 【场景】 阴天白天的普通客厅，整体非常暗。女孩盘腿坐在粗织布艺沙发上，背景不要过度整洁、不要现代样板间质感。 【构图】 侧面拍摄人物，竖屏中景，人物坐在画面中下部偏左，开场能看到上半身、盘起的双腿。无字幕、无文字、无水印。 【时长】 15 秒，9:16 竖屏，一镜到底，无转场。 [00:00-00:01.80] 安静低头 女孩盘腿坐在沙发上，低头用手指慢慢捏着针织毯边缘。她神情平静甚至有点出神，不看镜头；窗边冷光让她的脸处于柔暗阴影里。 [00:01.80-00:03.30] 迟疑地发现镜头 她慢慢抬眼，先用余光看镜头，再停顿一下才正眼望过来。表情不要马上笑，只是略微困惑、带一点不自在；一缕头发垂在脸侧。 [00:03.30-00:04.55] 很小的笑意，带有不情愿被偷拍的表情 ，像终于忍不住被逗笑，而不是摆拍。 [00:04.55-00:05.85] 第一次手掌盖镜头 她带着假装抗拒的表情，轻笑着前倾，一只手掌慢慢向镜头靠近。手掌先占住前景并失焦，再遮住镜头大部分；手指缝里短暂可见她眯眼笑的脸 and 亮窗。停留不足半秒后撤开，曝光缓慢恢复，不要突然变亮。 [00:05.85-00:07.30] 拿靠枕、假装攻击 她低头笑着转向身侧，拿起米咖色方形靠枕。先把靠枕举到胸前，再突然从画面左侧朝镜头挥过去；靠枕近距离掠过前景，带来一大片软糊的布料运动模糊。动作是幼稚玩闹，不是用力砸人。 [00:07.30-00:09.25] 笑着扑近镜头 靠枕掠过后，她笑到肩膀抖动，突然朝镜头扑近猛撞，带有撒娇的感觉。白 T 恤、肩膀 and 头发依次扫过镜头，手机被碰到，画面明显倾斜、失焦、变暗；人物身体短暂遮住绝大部分画面，只留窗边模糊亮光。 [00:09.25-00:10.80] 近距离笑到停不下 她退开一点但仍离镜头很近。超广角让脸部自然轻微放大；她先大笑两三下，然后笑声自然减弱，不能持续固定露齿笑。眼角褶皱、呼吸、凌乱碎发都要真实。 [00:10.80-00:13.15] 安静下来后的对视 她慢慢坐回一点，笑意收成闭嘴的小笑。她安静望着镜头，约 12.5 秒时轻轻歪头；神情温柔但克制，不要再大笑。 [00:13.15-00:14.35] 靠枕遮脸偷看 她把同一个米咖色靠枕举到鼻子下方，双手捏住靠枕两角，只露出眼睛。她从靠枕上缘偷看镜头，眼睛有一点害羞的笑。 [00:14.35-00:15.00] 第二次盖镜头 她仍抱着靠枕，用另一只手缓慢靠近镜头。掌心从前景虚焦到完全遮挡画面，最后只在手指缝间留下一小点眼睛 and 窗光；画面因镜头被遮住自然变暗至黑色，不能硬切。

entries.title: 3D Animated Street Racing Sequence
entries.description: A high-energy, video-game style 3D animation sequence following a young woman racing her red sports car through a city for a date.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second cinematic 3D animated street-racing sequence with a stylized high-end video-game aesthetic, expressive cartoon characters, realistic vehicle physics, dynamic camera work, polished feature-film animation, and energetic comedic pacing.
Scene 1 — The forgotten date:
A stylish young woman with long black hair, expressive eyes, oversized sunglasses, silver hoop earrings, a cropped black leather jacket, fitted white top, high-waisted jeans, and chunky sneakers relaxes on her apartment sofa while scrolling through her phone. She suddenly checks the time, realizes she completely forgot about an important date, freezes in shock, drops her phone onto the sofa, and dramatically screams while jumping to her feet.
Scene 2 — Instant transformation:
She races toward her bedroom. Fast comedic cuts show her throwing on a red leather jacket, adjusting her earrings, grabbing her handbag, putting on sunglasses, and quickly fixing her hair. She grabs her keys and rushes out of the apartment.
Scene 3 — The getaway car:
She bursts into an underground parking garage and jumps into a sleek modified red sports car. The engine roars as she grips the steering wheel with determination. She looks at the clock, widens her eyes, and slams the accelerator.
Scene 4 — Downtown launch:
The car launches onto a busy city street. Low-angle shots capture the wheels spinning, tire smoke, reflections across the glossy bodywork, and the car accelerating between traffic. Buildings streak past as the camera rapidly switches between front, side, overhead, and interior shots.
Scene 5 — The chaotic chase:
She races through downtown, weaving around taxis, buses, delivery vans, and intersections. She takes a sharp corner in a controlled drift, narrowly passes through a closing traffic barrier, and cuts through a narrow alley as the camera follows with aggressive tracking movement.
Scene 6 — Impossible shortcut:
She spots a steep parking-ramp entrance and takes it at full speed. The car launches briefly over the ramp, lands smoothly, spins into a controlled drift, and exits onto another street. Use dramatic slow-motion impact, tire smoke, realistic suspension movement, and exaggerated but believable physics.
Scene 7 — Finally there:
She reaches a stylish rooftop café overlooking the city at golden hour and slides the car to a stop. She jumps out, quickly fixes her hair, checks herself in the car window, and runs toward the entrance.
Scene 8 — The date:
A stylish young man is waiting outside the café, looking at his watch. She arrives breathless and gives him an embarrassed smile. He looks at her for a moment, then laughs. She points toward the city and jokingly gestures that the traffic was not her fault.
Final shot:
They walk into the rooftop café together as the camera pulls backward. Through the glass windows, the red sports car remains parked below while the golden city skyline glows behind them.

entries.prompt: FORMAT: 30-second photorealistic adventure mystery short film, 4K UHD, 24fps, realistic Chinese countryside, natural sunlight, physically accurate movement TIME: 3:40 PM–4:10 PM, clear autumn afternoon LOCATION: Rural mountain village in southern China, old stone house, bamboo forest, abandoned hillside temple, narrow underground passage CHARACTERS: Chinese boy, 16, faded blue jacket, small backpack, curious and energetic; grandfather, 70s, traditional countryside clothing STORY: A teenager discovers that an old stone wall near his grandfather's house hides a forgotten passage leading toward an abandoned hillside temple. ACTION FLOW: 00:00–00:04 → Boy helps his grandfather move old wooden boxes inside a stone storage room. One box falls, exposing an unusual stone pattern behind it. 00:04–00:08 → He pushes the stones and discovers a narrow opening. Dust falls from the ceiling. Grandfather immediately tells him to stop. 00:08–00:12 → Boy secretly returns with a flashlight and crawls through the passage beneath the house. 00:12–00:16 → Passage opens into a bamboo-covered hillside. He climbs out and discovers old stone steps disappearing into vegetation. 00:16–00:20 → He follows the steps, pushing bamboo branches aside. A weathered temple roof suddenly appears through the trees. 00:20–00:24 → He enters the abandoned courtyard and discovers an old bell covered in moss. Wind moves the rope. 00:24–00:27 → He touches the bell. It swings naturally and produces one deep sound across the valley. 00:27–00:30 → Cut back to grandfather standing at the tunnel entrance, silently watching him. He says, “I thought that place was gone forever.” CAMERA: Fast handheld exploration footage, 24mm wide lens inside the tunnel, quick focus pulls, natural camera shake while crawling and climbing, occasional branches crossing lens, rapid reveal of the temple. PHYSICS: Loose stones shift under pressure, dust falls from disturbed masonry, bamboo bends when pushed, footsteps displace dry leaves, bell swings from applied force and gradually loses momentum. LIGHTING: Warm afternoon sunlight outside, dark flashlight-lit tunnel, scattered sunbeams through bamboo, realistic exposure transition when exiting the passage. AUDIO: Wooden boxes scraping, stone movement, falling dust, footsteps, bamboo rustling, insects, distant birds, bell resonance, natural dialogue. REALISM: Historically plausible rural architecture, weathered stone, natural vegetation, realistic underground geometry and human movement. No magical tunnel, glowing objects or fantasy temple effects.

entries.title: Cinematic Frozen Time Hero Shot
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt featuring a man freezing time in a park to stabilize a falling jogger, utilizing smooth Steadicam tracking and image reference consistency.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic frozen-time drama in bright daylight. One seamless 30-second continuous shot. Smooth Steadicam tracking, subtle push-ins, one elegant orbit and a final hero close-up. Warm summer light, soft breeze, lush green park, premium live-action realism, tasteful blockbuster emotion, no cartoon look.

Main character: use (image_1) as the strict identity of the adult man, preserving his face, hair, beard, black jacket and body proportions. He wears fitted blue jeans and red, white and black high-top sneakers. Secondary character: one attractive adult woman jogging in stylish athletic wear. Background: a few park visitors, one dog, and birds in flight.
Large city park in daytime with tree-lined paths, benches, grass, soft sunlight, joggers, a dog crossing the path and birds flying overhead.

Photorealistic frozen-time illusion, stable identity, elegant body movement, coherent suspended birds and dog, realistic park atmosphere, seamless camera continuity, emotional heroic payoff, natural anatomy, no readable text, normal proportions without stretch

0-8s: Medium tracking shot moving backward - The man walks calmly toward camera through the park. Sunlight filters through the trees. A woman jogs into frame behind him from the side, moving fast along the path. Birds cross overhead and a dog runs nearby.
8-12s: Push-in to close-up - The jogging woman catches her foot and begins to lose balance, starting to fall forward. At the exact same moment, the man turns, raises one hand and snaps his fingers. Instantly everything stops. The woman freezes mid-fall, birds hang motionless in the air, the dog freezes mid-run, nearby people stop in place.
12-22s: Slow orbit around the man - He remains the only moving person. He walks calmly through the frozen park, steps between the motionless birds and people, reaches the woman, gently supports her and places her into a safe upright balanced posture as if stabilizing the moment itself.
22-30s: Low-angle dolly backward into hero close-up - He returns to his path and snaps again. Time resumes naturally. The woman regains her footing smoothly and continues without crashing, briefly confused but unharmed. Birds fly again, the dog keeps running, and the man walks forward with a subtle satisfied smile.

entries.title: Realistic Lion Interaction Selfie Video
entries.description: Creates a realistic social media style selfie video of a woman interacting with a large lion inside a luxury mansion.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic selfie video using the reference image for the woman’s identity. Keep her face, skin tone, hair, features, and overall appearance consistent throughout, with zero identity drift or facial distortion.

Setting: Luxury mansion living room with marble columns, ornate white ceiling, crystal chandelier, soft grey walls, and an elegant grey sofa behind her. Keep the background and lighting consistent with no scene changes.

Camera: Natural smartphone selfie camera, held close to her face with a slight 24–28mm wide-angle look. Subtle handheld micro-sway only. Soft natural indoor daylight, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, and documentary-style realism.

0–5s:
She looks into the camera, smiles warmly, and says naturally:
“Simbaaa... Simba, come here. I’m making a video for Instagram. They wanna see you... good boy.”

5–10s:
A large, fully realistic adult male lion slowly walks out from behind the sofa and approaches her right shoulder. He moves calmly with realistic weight, paw placement, fur movement, breathing, and a gently swaying tail. She notices him, turns slightly, and laughs nervously while keeping the phone steady.

10–17s:
The lion gently rubs his massive head against her cheek and neck like an affectionate giant house cat. He gives a soft low growl/snort. The contact between his fur and her skin should look physically realistic.

17–23s:
The lion affectionately licks her cheek with a realistic tongue. She laughs genuinely and says:
“Aww, good boy...”

23–30s:
She continues smiling and laughing while the lion stays close, gently nuzzling her. She looks between him and the camera, enjoying the moment. End naturally on the close interaction.

Realism: Photorealistic 4K/8K-quality appearance, detailed skin pores, fine facial hairs, realistic eyes and blinking, natural lip-sync, individual lion fur strands, whiskers, detailed eyes, moist nose, realistic tongue and saliva sheen, accurate body weight and contact physics.

No cuts, scene changes, flickering, face morphing, identity drift, warped hands, extra limbs, unnatural movement, or camera movement. Keep the woman, lion, environment, lighting, and appearance consistent for the entire 30 seconds. The final video should feel like an authentic spontaneous Instagram selfie.

entries.title: Botanical Tomato Plant Growth Time-lapse
entries.description: A highly detailed time-lapse prompt for Seedance 2.5 that visualizes a tomato plant's journey from a tiny seedling to a mature plant with ripe fruit. It features cinematic macro photography, smooth organic growth, and consistent lighting across a 10-second sequence.
entries.prompt:
Create a 10-second ultra-realistic cinematic macro time-lapse video 🌱🎥, using the provided reference image as the exact visual starting point. Begin with the same tiny green seedling 🌱 emerging from dark, rich, slightly moist soil. Keep the camera completely locked and stationary 📷, preserving the same composition, camera angle, depth of field, warm natural sunlight ☀️, soft background bokeh, and realistic soil texture throughout the entire video.

0–2 seconds 🌱: The tiny seedling slowly pushes upward from beneath the soil. Small cracks and subtle soil movement appear naturally around its base as the plant emerges. The thin green stem gradually becomes taller while the two young leaves slowly unfold and expand 🍃.

2–4 seconds 🌿: The seedling continues growing into a young tomato plant. The stem becomes thicker and taller, while additional green leaves and small branches gradually emerge. Each leaf unfolds naturally with visible veins and realistic botanical detail 🍃✨. Gentle sunlight passes through the leaves ☀️, creating beautiful natural highlights.

4–6 seconds 🌼: The plant grows fuller and stronger. Small yellow tomato flowers 🌼 begin appearing on the branches. The flowers gradually develop and bloom one by one, with delicate petals opening naturally. The plant continues extending upward and outward in a smooth time-lapse 🌿.

6–8 seconds 🍅: After flowering 🌼, tiny green tomatoes 🍅 begin forming beneath the flowers. The fruits slowly enlarge from tiny green buds into recognizable round tomatoes. More tomatoes develop across the branches while fresh leaves continue growing around them 🌿🍃.

8–10 seconds 🍅❤️: The green tomatoes gradually mature and transform into large, ripe, vibrant red tomatoes 🍅❤️. End with a healthy, fully grown tomato plant 🌿 surrounded by several beautiful ripe tomatoes hanging naturally from its branches.

Make the entire transformation smooth, continuous, organic, and biologically believable 🌱➡️🌿➡️🌼➡️🍅. Use photorealistic textures, realistic plant anatomy, detailed leaves and veins, natural soil particles, subtle wind movement 🍃, warm golden-hour sunlight ☀️, cinematic depth of field 🎥, soft background bokeh ✨, realistic shadows, macro photography quality, and highly detailed 4K visuals.

Important: No cuts ❌, no transitions ❌, no camera movement ❌, no zoom ❌, no camera shake ❌, no text ❌, no people ❌, no hands ❌, and no artificial-looking morphing ❌. The plant must grow progressively from the exact location of the original seedling, with every stage naturally connected to the previous stage. The final result should look like a real professional botanical time-lapse 🌱🎥🍅, showing the complete journey from a tiny seedling to a mature tomato plant full of ripe red tomatoes. 🍅✨

entries.title: Realistic Couple Breakup Emotional Scene
entries.description: A sophisticated script-style prompt for Seedance 2.5 that generates a realistic emotional scene of a couple breaking up at dusk. It specifies character consistency, staging, cinematography rules (180-degree rule), and precise time-coded shots with dialogue and emotional nuances.
entries.prompt:
时长：20秒
形式：第三人称写实感情戏，多镜头剪辑
场景：傍晚公寓楼下
核心冲突：男生以为女生因为自己某一次缺席而分手；女生真正离开的原因，是她已经不再本能地依赖他。男生最后追问“是谁”，再次证明他没有理解她。

### 角色与表演基调

女生 {{Mixed 2}} 与男生 {{Mixed 3}} 分别严格参考情侣图片中的对应人物，保持各自的五官、脸型、发型、体型、身高、服装和气质，不能混脸或交换服装。

女生已经反复考虑过分手。她不是来吵架，也没有期待男生挽留。表面平静，真正的情绪藏在停顿、呼吸、吞咽和移开的视线里。

男生开始时认为这只是一次普通争吵。他急于找到一件具体的错事进行解释，却没有意识到问题是长期积累的情感疏离。

### 场景设定

傍晚的公寓楼下 {{Mixed 1}} 。

室外是偏冷的自然暮色，楼道玻璃门内透出暖黄色灯光。女生站在台阶下，身旁放着一个小行李箱，一只手始终搭在拉杆上。

背景只有轻微树叶风声、远处车辆声、楼道门开合声和行李箱轮子声。无字幕、无煽情配乐、无慢动作。

### 摄影规则

采用正常电视剧感情戏的单人正反打叙事。

- 女生始终面向画面左侧。
- 男生始终面向画面右侧。
- 两人的视线高度和方向正确衔接。
- 摄影机始终停留在同一条180度轴线的一侧。
- 开场使用全景交代环境和行李箱。
- 普通对话使用胸口以上中近景。
- 冲突加深后逐渐进入肩部以上近景。
- 最关键的台词后保留短暂反应，不要台词一结束就立即切镜。
- 不使用夸张推镜、旋转运镜、手持自拍或偶像剧式柔光。

---

### 【00:00–00:02.2｜镜头一：环境全景】

景别：固定全景
人物：只有女生入画

公寓楼、台阶、玻璃门和女生的完整身体同时进入画面。

女生独自站在台阶下，行李箱放在右手边。她低头检查拉杆是否扣好，动作安静而明确。

她没有来回走动，也没有焦躁地看手机，说明她不是临时赌气，而是已经决定要离开。

身后的玻璃门传来打开的声音。

男生尚未进入画面，声音先从女生背后传来：

“你真要走？”

女生整理拉杆的动作停了一下，但没有立即回头。

---

### 【00:02.2–00:05｜镜头二：男生中近景】

景别：胸口以上中近景
机位：男生四分之三侧面，面向画面右侧

切到男生单人镜头。

他刚从楼道里追出来，呼吸略微急促。第一反应先看画外的行李箱，再看向女生所在的方向。

他眉头轻轻收紧，语速比正常稍快：

“就因为那天我没去医院？”

说这句话时，他已经提前进入解释状态。

最后一个字说完后，他嘴唇仍然微微张着，像是准备马上补充理由。

镜头不要立刻切走，短暂保留他等待女生回答的表情。

---

### 【00:05–00:08｜镜头三：女生中近景】

景别：腰部以上中近景，随后非常缓慢地靠近
机位：女生四分之三正面，面向画面左侧

女生已经转过身面对男生。

她先看着他，没有马上说话。脸上没有愤怒，只有一瞬间“原来你是这样理解的”的疲惫。

她轻声回答：

“不是。”

停顿约半秒。

“你妈那天手术，我知道你走不开。”

这句话不能带讽刺，也不能咬重“知道”两个字。

她说的是真话。她理解男生当时为什么没有出现，也从未准备拿这件事逼他道歉。

说完以后，她的视线从男生脸上移开，落到两人之间的地面。

搭在行李箱拉杆上的手指轻轻收紧。

---

### 【00:08–00:10.2｜镜头四：男生近景】

景别：肩部以上近景
机位：保持男生面向画面右侧

男生听到“不是”以后，眉头没有松开，反而更加困惑。

他原本准备好的解释突然失去作用。

短暂停顿后，他向女生方向靠近半步，声音里出现压不住的焦躁：

“那你到底在怪我什么？”

“怪”字略微加重。

他说完以后直直看着女生，像是在等她列出一件可以解决的错误。

不要表现成吼叫，也不要瞪眼。重点是他迫切需要一个具体答案。

---

### 【00:10.2–00:15.5｜镜头五：女生情绪近景】

景别：肩部以上近景
机位：接近正面，但女生视线仍看向画面左侧的男生

这是整段视频最重要的镜头。

切过来时，女生没有立刻说话。

她先吸进一小口气，随后轻轻呼出。眼神在男生脸上停留片刻，像是在判断说出真相还有没有意义。

她说：

“我没怪你。”

停顿。

男生似乎想在画外接话，但女生继续说下去：

“只是那天我最难受的时候……”

说到这里，她短暂低下视线。

不是低头哭，而是需要一点时间把后半句话说完整。

她轻轻吞咽一下，重新抬眼看向男生：

“第一个想到的人，已经不是你了。”

最后几个字明显放轻，但保持清楚。

她说完后不躲开视线，继续看着男生，等待他真正理解这句话。

眼眶可以出现非常轻微的湿润感，但不能立刻流泪。嘴角不能颤抖成哭相，脸颊不能突然泛红。

镜头在台词结束后继续停留约半秒。

她脸上没有解脱，也没有报复成功的快感，只有承认事实后的安静和疲惫。

---

### 【00:15.5–00:16.8｜镜头六：男生反应特写】

景别：面部近景，但保留完整头顶、下巴和部分肩膀
机位：男生面向画面右侧

切到男生。

他没有马上理解。

原本紧绷的眉头稍微松开，眼睛却停住。嘴唇动了一下，像是脑中先闪过一个具体的人。

他下意识问：

“……是谁？”

语气降低，不是愤怒质问，而是害怕答案。

问完后， his视线牢牢停在女生身上，完全没有意识到自己问错了问题。

---

### 【00:16.8–00:19.3｜镜头七：女生最终近景】

景别：肩部以上近景
机位：与镜头五保持相同位置和光线

女生听见“是谁”以后，眼神出现非常轻微的变化。

不是震惊，也不是生气。

她原本还残留的一点期待，在这一刻彻底消失。

她短促地从鼻腔呼出一口气，视线偏开一下，随后重新看向男生：

“你看……”

停顿半秒。

“你还是没听懂。”

语气平静，没有讽刺。

说完后，她不再等待回答。

她的视线先从男生脸上移开，随后身体转向画面右侧，离开当前构图。

镜头不追随她。

---

### 【00:19.3–00:20｜镜头八：男生结尾特写】

景别：男生肩部以上近景
人物：只有男生入画

切回男生。

画外传来行李箱轮子开始滚动的声音。

男生下意识抬起一只手，像是准备叫住她。

手只抬到胸口附近便停住。

他张开嘴，却没有发出声音。

视线随着画外女生离开的方向缓慢移动。

最后停在他终于开始意识到问题并不是“另一个人”的表情上。

行李箱轮子的声音逐渐远去，画面自然结束。

### 真实性约束

- 正反打必须保持视线方向、环境光线 and 空间轴线一致。
- 女生不能从开场就满脸悲伤，也不能在关键台词后突然落泪。
- 男生不能夸张震惊、暴怒、抓头或冲上去拉扯女生。
- 不使用“每句台词对应一个表情”的机械表演。
- 先让角色听懂台词，再通过停顿、呼吸和视线变化产生反应。
- 允许说话时轻微吞字、换气和停顿，不使用播音腔。
- 最后不拍女生远去的背影
