entries.title: Epic Sci-Fi Cinematic Flight Odyssey
entries.description: An epic sci-fi cinematic video prompt detailing a continuous flight sequence from Earth's wasteland through a thunderstorm, stratosphere, orbit, moon, and finally reaching the sun.
entries.prompt:
【风格】科幻史诗真人电影（Sci-fi Epic Live-Action），ARRI Alexa 35 机身 + Panavision Ultra Vintage 变形宽银幕镜头（Anamorphic），2.39:1 宽银幕画幅，Tiffen Black Pro-Mist 1/4 柔光镜，Kodak 250D 胶片质感、可见但细腻的颗粒，高光边缘带红橙渗色光晕（Halation），180°快门角自然运动模糊，暗部保留细节不死黑，8K超清，真实摄影（Photorealistic），无动漫感、无CG塑料感

【时长】30秒

【场景】从地球荒原一路上升，穿雷暴云 → 平流层 → 近地轨道 → 月球 → 小行星带 → 太阳表面

【角色】主角（全片同一人，服装与外形完全以参考图为准）

[00:00-00:02] 镜头1：负手而立（85mm 长焦 / Slow Dolly In）

广角远景：主角@图片1背对镜头站在枯黄草原上，双手背在身后，一动不动。天顶被一整片巨大的乳状积云压满，远处地平线只有一条明亮的逆光带。

画面：风吹得草浪成片倒伏，逆光把草叶边缘描出一圈毛茸茸的金边。

机位：85mm 长焦压缩空间，镜头缓慢向前推进。

[00:02-00:04] 镜头2：起飞冲击（40mm / Speed Ramp + Whip Tilt Up）

0.3秒慢动作：主角@图片1脚下一圈环形冲击波贴地扩散出去，方圆几十米的草被压平成一个同心圆，碎草和沙尘垂直腾起。

随即切全速：他猛然垂直升空，画面只剩他的腿从上方出画。镜头急速上摇跟随，被气浪震了一下（Camera Shake），穿过尘土冲进云层。

[00:04-00:07] 镜头3：雷暴云中心（40mm）

主角@图片1缩成一个小黑点在云柱中垂直上升，负手姿态没有改变。四周云里的蓝白色闪电一道道炸开，每次闪把周围的云照亮一瞬，他的剪影在亮起的云幕上被压成一个黑点。

机位：跟随上升，云层向画面下方飞速倒退，变形镜头把画面边缘轻微拉长。

[00:07-00:09] 镜头4：冲出云顶（50mm / Backlit Emergence）

主角@图片1逆光穿出金色云层，身后的云被撞出一个漏斗形的空洞，暖金色光晕从他背后爆开。

画面：强逆光在他轮廓外缘烧出一圈红橙色渗色光晕（Halation），高光被柔光镜化开但不过曝。

[00:09-00:13] 镜头5：平流层360°环绕（50mm / Full 360° Orbit）

画面：主角@图片1在云海上方静止悬停，双手垂在身侧一动不动，全程不转身。天空上半部已是深棕黑的临近太空，下方是被夕阳染成金色的积云海。

机位（00:09-00:12）：50mm 镜头从他背后起，绕着他匀速环绕一整圈——依次经过他的侧面、正面、另一侧，最后转回他的背后。环绕全程机位与他的距离保持不变，他在画面里的大小也不变。

机位（00:12-00:13）：镜头停在他背后不动，他从这个背面视角猛然加速垂直上升，瞬间缩成一个小点飞离画面，只剩空荡荡的金色云海。

节奏：这一段要慢，是全片的呼吸点。

[00:13-00:15] 镜头6：地球轨道冲刺（40mm / Side Tracking + Vapor Cone）

硬切超近景：主角@图片1俯冲飞行姿态，身体水平前倾、手臂前伸，衣物被气流抽打得剧烈变形，布料褶皱清晰。背景是地球弧面和一整个台风漩涡云系。

特效：他身体周围炸开一圈白色音爆云环。

机位：侧后方跟拍，广角镜头把地球弧线拉得更弯，他向前飞离，两秒内缩成一个小黑点。

[00:15-00:17] 镜头7：奔月（40mm / Speed Trails + Star Streaks）

地球表面高速掠过化成放射状拉丝，切进黑色太空：主角@图片1拖出放射状速度线冲向远处的月球，背景的星星被拉成一道道细线。月球在画面中快速变大，冷白的月光在镜头里横向拉出一条蓝色变形光条。

[00:17-00:19] 镜头8：月面掠地（40mm / Low Skim）

主角@图片1从画面左侧入画，右侧是月球大特写，环形坑的边缘被侧光切出硬边。他俯冲向月面贴地极速掠行，月面从下方飞速倒退成放射状运动模糊，身后拉出一条长长的尘迹。

[00:19-00:21] 镜头9：落月（50mm / Impact + Dust Settle）

主角@图片1砸向月面，接触瞬间画面白闪一帧，一圈环形冲击波把月尘推出去铺成一张圆盘，镜头被震了一下。

尘埃在低重力下缓慢沉降后，他站在环形坑正中，双手垂在身侧一动不动，天上挂着一颗巨大的星球。

光：无大气散射的硬光，只有一个光源，影子内部纯黑没有任何补光。

机位：缓慢拉远并下摇。

[00:21-00:23] 镜头10：蹬地起飞（100mm 特写 → 广角 / Low-gravity Launch）

100mm 特写：主角@图片1的脚踩在布满裂缝的月壤上，投出一道又长又硬的黑影，浅景深把远处的坑壁化开。月壤颗粒质感清晰。

0.3秒慢动作后切全速：他猛然蹬地起飞，月尘炸成一根冲天的垂直喷射柱，柱体在低重力下缓慢向外扩散、久久不落。随后切太空：他的背影剪影在月球弧线上方，快速缩成一个光点。

[00:23-00:24] 镜头11：掠过橙色行星（85mm / Wide Pass）

切一颗橙黄色行星的弧面，厚大气层边缘泛出一圈辉光。主角@图片1化成一个小黑点从行星上方高速掠过，长焦压缩让行星显得巨大而人几乎看不见。

[00:24-00:27] 镜头12：撞穿小行星带（40mm / Behind-the-back Tracking）

画面：主角@图片1的背影锁在画面正中，身体前倾、双臂后掠，在密集的小行星之间高速穿梭、贴身擦过。几块小行星被撞碎，碎屑向四周甩出去。

机位：第三人称背后跟拍，镜头始终锁在他背后不动。小行星向画面两侧飞掠形成强烈的放射状运动模糊，变形镜头把边缘的岩块拉成长条，每次撞击镜头轻微震一下。

[00:27-00:29] 镜头13：太阳出现（40mm / Anamorphic Flare + Crash Zoom）

冲出小行星带，前方黑暗中出现一个带光晕的火点，横向的宽银幕镜头光晕贯穿整个画面。

机位：镜头急速推进，太阳在两秒内从一个点长到充满画面，边缘的日珥翻卷着甩出去。

[00:29-00:30] 镜头14：抵达（85mm / Continuous Push In）

主角@图片1的小剪影背对镜头，悬停在充满整个画面的太阳圆盘正中，只剩一个纯黑的轮廓。

光：过曝的橙白高光从他身体边缘溢出来，在轮廓外烧出一圈红橙渗色光晕，胶片颗粒在高光区变得明显。

机位：镜头持续推进直至定格。

音效：风吹草声 → 一记闷雷般的起跳冲击 → 雷暴轰鸣 → 破空声 → 真空静默（只剩低频轰鸣）→ 小行星碎裂的闷响 → 太阳表面的低频翻滚。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Style] Sci-fi Epic Live-Action, ARRI Alexa 35 body + Panavision Ultra Vintage Anamorphic lens, 2.39:1 widescreen aspect ratio, Tiffen Black Pro-Mist 1/4 filter, Kodak 250D film texture with fine visible grain, red-orange halation on highlight edges, natural motion blur with 180° shutter angle, shadow detail preserved, 8K ultra-clear, photorealistic, no anime or CG plastic feel.

[Duration] 30 seconds

[Scene] Continuous ascent from Earth's wasteland through thunderstorm clouds → stratosphere → low Earth orbit → moon → asteroid belt → sun's surface.

[Character] Protagonist (same person throughout, clothing and appearance strictly following reference image).

[00:00-00:02] Shot 1: Standing with hands behind back (85mm Telephoto / Slow Dolly In)
Wide vista: Protagonist @Image1 standing with back to camera on yellowed grassland, hands behind back, motionless. A massive mammatus cloud fills the zenith; only a bright backlit band remains on the far horizon.
Visual: Wind makes waves in the grass; backlighting creates a golden rim around grass edges.
Camera: 85mm compression, slow forward push.

[00:02-00:04] Shot 2: Takeoff Impact (40mm / Speed Ramp + Whip Tilt Up)
0.3s slow-motion: A circular shockwave spreads across the ground at protagonist's feet, flattening grass within tens of meters into a concentric circle; dust and debris rise vertically.
Full speed: He suddenly ascends vertically, frame only showing legs exiting above. Camera whips upward to follow, shaken by the air blast (Camera Shake), piercing through dust into the clouds.

[00:04-00:07] Shot 3: Thunderstorm Core (40mm)
Protagonist @Image1 shrinks to a black speck ascending vertically within a cloud pillar, posture unchanged. Blue-white lightning bursts around him, illuminating clouds momentarily; his silhouette is pressed against the bright cloud screen.
Camera: Follow ascent, clouds receding rapidly downward; anamorphic lens slightly stretches frame edges.

[00:07-00:09] Shot 4: Breaking Cloud Top (50mm / Backlit Emergence)
Protagonist @Image1 breaks out of golden clouds backlit, creating a funnel-like hole in the clouds; warm golden flare bursts from behind him.
Visual: Strong backlighting burns a red-orange halation around his silhouette; highlights softened by the filter but not overexposed.

[00:09-00:13] Shot 5: Stratospheric 360° Orbit (50mm / Full 360° Orbit)
Visual: Protagonist @Image1 hovers motionless above the cloud sea, hands at sides, no turning. Top of sky is dark brown near-space; below is a sunset-dyed golden cloud sea.
Camera (00:09-00:12): 50mm lens starts behind, orbiting him uniformly — side, front, other side, returning to back. Distance and subject size remain constant.
Camera (00:12-00:13): Camera stops behind; he suddenly accelerates vertically, shrinking to a point and flying out of frame, leaving the empty golden cloud sea.
Rhythm: Slow segment, the film's breather.

[00:13-00:15] Shot 6: Earth Orbit Sprint (40mm / Side Tracking + Vapor Cone)
Hard cut to extreme close-up: Protagonist @Image1 in dive-flight posture, body horizontal, arms forward, clothing violently deformed by airflow. Background shows Earth's curve and a typhoon vortex system.
FX: A white sonic boom vapor cone bursts around him.
Camera: Side-back track, wide angle curves Earth more; he flies off, shrinking in two seconds.

[00:15-00:17] Shot 7: Moon Bound (40mm / Speed Trails + Star Streaks)
Earth surface streaks past; cut to black space: Protagonist @Image1 trails speed lines towards the moon; stars stretch into lines. Moon grows rapidly; cold white moonlight creates a horizontal blue anamorphic streak.

[00:17-00:19] Shot 8: Moon Surface Skimming (40mm / Low Skim)
Protagonist @Image1 enters from left; right side is moon extreme close-up with sharp crater edges. He dives to skim the moon surface; ground recedes into radial motion blur, trailing a long dust track.

[00:19-00:21] Shot 9: Moon Landing (50mm / Impact + Dust Settle)
Protagonist @Image1 hits the moon surface, one-frame white flash; circular shockwave pushes moon dust into a disc; camera shakes.
Dust settles slowly in low gravity; he stands in the crater center, motionless; a giant planet hangs in the sky.
Light: Hard light without atmospheric scattering, single source, pure black shadows without fill.
Camera: Slow zoom out and tilt down.

[00:21-00:23] Shot 10: Lunar Takeoff (100mm Close-up → Wide / Low-gravity Launch)
100mm close-up: Protagonist @Image1's feet on cracked lunar soil, casting long hard shadows; shallow depth of field blurs distant crater walls. Soil texture clear.
0.3s slow-motion to full speed: Sudden takeoff, moon dust explodes into a vertical plume spreading slowly. Cut to space: silhouette against moon curve, shrinking to a point.

[00:23-00:24] Shot 11: Passing Orange Planet (85mm / Wide Pass)
Curve of an orange-yellow planet with a glowing atmospheric rim. Protagonist @Image1 streaks past as a tiny speck; telephoto compression makes planet look vast and the human barely visible.

[00:24-00:27] Shot 12: Piercing Asteroid Belt (40mm / Behind-the-back Tracking)
Visual: Protagonist @Image1's back locked in center, body leaning, arms back, weaving through dense asteroids. Some rocks shatter, debris flying.
Camera: 3rd person back track, locked behind him. Asteroids fly past creating radial blur; anamorphic lens stretches edges; camera shakes with each impact.

[00:27-00:29] Shot 13: Sun Appears (40mm / Anamorphic Flare + Crash Zoom)
Breaks asteroid belt; a fire point appears in darkness; horizontal anamorphic flare spans frame.
Camera: Rapid zoom; sun grows to fill frame in 2s; solar prominences curl out.

[00:29-00:30] Shot 14: Arrival (85mm / Continuous Push In)
Protagonist @Image1's small silhouette center against the solar disc, just a black outline.
Light: Overexposed orange-white highlights bleed from edges, burning a red-orange halation; grain prominent in highlights.
Camera: Continuous push until freeze.
Audio: Wind in grass → muffled takeoff impact → thunderstorm roar → sonic boom → vacuum silence (low freq hum) → asteroid shattering → sun surface low freq rolling.

entries.title: Cinematic Sci-Fi Time Machine Thriller
entries.description: A 10-second sci-fi sequence depicting a scientist witnessing a catastrophic future through a time-viewing device.
entries.prompt:
"Create a 10-second photorealistic cinematic sci-fi thriller.

A young scientist stands inside a dark futuristic laboratory beside a glowing experimental time machine. He activates it and sees exactly 10 seconds into the future.

At first, he smiles in amazement as the machine shows the laboratory still intact.

Suddenly, the future image changes.

The same laboratory is now completely destroyed—glass shattered, machines burning, sparks flying, smoke everywhere.

The scientist looks around in panic.

A countdown appears on the machine: 10... 9... 8... 7...

He notices the machine's glowing energy core rapidly overheating.

3... 2... 1...

He realizes the machine is about to explode.

The screen instantly cuts to black as a massive white flash fills the laboratory.

Ultra-photorealistic, cinematic sci-fi thriller, realistic futuristic laboratory, dramatic lighting, realistic fire and sparks, intense suspense, fast pacing, believable technology, realistic physics, cinematic camera movement, premium Hollywood VFX, subtle film grain, highly detailed, 4K.

No subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no cartoon style."

entries.title: Tokyo Shopping Vlog Smartphone Style
entries.description: A realistic UGC-style vlog prompt of a Japanese woman shopping in Tokyo, designed for a authentic handheld look.
entries.prompt: Ultra-realistic UGC smartphone vlog in Japan. A young Japanese woman with long dark hair and a casual stylish outfit explores a lively Tokyo shopping street, filmed entirely on her phone with natural handheld movement, slight camera shake, realistic autofocus, imperfect framing and authentic street ambience. 0–3s: selfie mode while walking, smiling: “Come shopping with me in Japan!” 3–6s: quick camera turn showing colorful Japanese shops and busy street, then she enters a cute accessories store. 6–10s: she browses cute bags and hair accessories, picks up one item, tries it in a mirror and excitedly says, “Wait, this is so cute!” 10–13s: quick shot of her paying and receiving a small shopping bag, then walking outside. 13–15s: she holds the bag toward the camera, smiles and says, “Definitely worth it!” Natural Japanese environment, realistic skin texture, authentic expressions, real smartphone exposure, subtle motion blur, natural lighting, no beauty filter, no commercial look, no exaggerated acting, seamless fast-paced storytelling, consistent character throughout, highly photorealistic, 1080p, Seedance 2.5.

entries.title: Retro Future Mega Arcade Adventure
entries.description: A complex, cinematic one-shot video prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring an anime character and a fluffy companion in a retro-future arcade chaos.
entries.prompt: 【参照画像】を唯一のキャラクター参照として使用する。Seedance entries.title: Steampunk City First-Person POV Walkthrough
entries.description: A highly detailed first-person perspective video prompt for Seedance 2.5 that captures a journey through a steampunk city, including interactions with characters and rich environmental sounds.
entries.prompt:
提供された画像を最初のフレームとして使用し、自然な環境音を伴う、一人称視点（POV）の途切れのない動画を作成してください。動画全体を通して、元の画像が持つ世界観、雰囲気、照明、建築物の密度、スチームパンク特有のリアリズム、そして緻密な映像品質を忠実に維持してください。カメラは視聴者の視点であり、撮影者は一切言葉を発しません。

動画の長さ：約30秒。

重要な継続性：
冒頭で既に道を歩いている男性は、撮影者や老婦人とは無関係です。彼は振り返ったり、立ち止まったり、カメラに近づいたり、誰かと関わったりすることなく、ただ自然に道に沿って前進し続けるようにしてください。

0～3秒
一人称視点で開始し、前方の巨大なスチームパンク都市に向かって道をゆっくりと歩いています。手持ちカメラによる自然な動きで、没入感とリアリティのある映像にします。
開始から約1秒後、左手前の地面にあるキャベツに気づき、カメラをゆっくりと下に向けてそれらを捉えます。

3～7秒
キャベツやその他の収穫したての野菜に少し近づきます。それらの新鮮さと美味しさを視聴者に伝えるような、感心し興味を惹かれた様子が伝わるカメラワークで捉えます。野菜の質感、大きさ、新鮮さを少し長めに映し出します。

7～10秒
ゆっくりとカメラを上げ、近くにある畑や農耕エリアを映し出します。これらの新鮮な野菜がどこで育てられたかを発見したような感覚を、カメラの動きで表現します。

10～16秒
畑で作業をしていた老婦人が視聴者に気づき、自然に歩み寄ってきます。彼女は終始、温かく、快活で、穏やかかつ親しみやすい様子です。
彼女は撮影者の方を見て、何気ない様子でこう言います。
老婦人：「一つ、持っていかない？」
彼女の口調は温かく自然で、歓迎するような響きがあり、芝居がかったところは一切ありません。

16～20秒
老婦人が自然に身をかがめ、キャベツを一つ手に取って、撮影者に向かって差し出します。
撮影者は無言でそれを受け取ります。

20～24秒
一人称視点のフレーム内で、キャベツが撮影者の手に自然に持たれています。カメラはそれを見下ろし、新鮮で美味しそうな様子を愛でるように、視聴者に向けてそっと差し出します。

24～27秒
カメラが再び老婦人の方を向きます。カメラマンは、さりげなく小さく頷いたり、身振りで感謝の意を示したりします。
老婦人は穏やかに微笑み、こう答えます。
老婦人：「ああ、気にしないで。楽しんでね。」
口調は柔らかく、気さくで、誠実なものにします。

27～30代
やり取りは自然に終わります。カメラマンは小さく別れの挨拶をして元の道の方を向き、キャベツを抱えたまま街の奥へと歩き続けます。
老婦人は自然に作業場所へと戻っていきます。
前方を歩く無関係な男性は、そのまま自然に歩き続け、この一連のやり取りには一切関与しません。

キャラクター演出：
老婦人は常に親切で、快活、穏やか、そして親しみやすい人物です。
その動作、表情、話し方は、控えめでリアルなものにします。
カメラマンは一切言葉を発しません。
前方を歩く男性は、カメラマンや老婦人と関わることなく、ただ自分の道を進み続けます。

カメラ演出：
一人称視点（人間の目の高さ）のみ。自然な歩行の動きと、リアルな手持ちカメラの揺れを表現します。カメラの動きは、大げさな動作を避けつつ、好奇心、感心、感謝、発見といった感情を伝えるものにします。三人称視点のショットやカット割りは行いません。

音声演出：
全編を通して自然な環境音を生成します。ぬかるんだ道の足音、遠くの街の喧騒、蒸気機関の音、鶏の鳴き声、かすかな風の音、穏やかな農作業の音、衣擦れの音、そして老婦人の自然な英語の声を入れます。カメラマンのナレーションやBGMは入れません。

映像演出：
元の画像の視覚的アイデンティティ、構図の質、豊かな環境のディテール、フォトリアルなスチームパンクの美学、建築、照明、質感、雰囲気、そして背景の緻密な複雑さを忠実に維持します。全編を通して一貫して高い画質を保ちます。スタイルの変化、街の簡略化、現代的なオブジェクトの混入、大げさな演技、急激なカメラの動きは避けます。
entries.translated_prompt:
Use the provided image as the first frame to create a seamless, first-person (POV) video with natural ambient sounds. Throughout the video, faithfully maintain the worldview, atmosphere, lighting, architectural density, steampunk-specific realism, and detailed visual quality of the original image. The camera represents the viewer's perspective, and the narrator remains silent.

Video duration: Approx. 30 seconds.

Key Continuity:
The man already walking down the path at the start is unrelated to the narrator or the old woman. Ensure he continues walking naturally along the path without turning back, stopping, or interacting with anyone.

0-3s
Start in POV, walking slowly along a road toward a massive steampunk city. Use natural handheld camera motion for realism.
At about 1 second, notice cabbages on the ground to the left and slowly tilt the camera down to capture them.

3-7s
Move closer to the cabbages and other fresh vegetables. Capture them with camera work expressing admiration and interest, highlighting their texture and freshness.

7-10s
Slowly lift the camera to reveal the nearby fields, conveying a sense of discovery about where the vegetables were grown.

10-16s
An old woman working in the field notices the viewer and walks over naturally. She is warm, cheerful, and friendly throughout.
She looks at the narrator and says naturally: "Would you like to take one?"
Her tone is welcoming and authentic, without being theatrical.

16-20s
The old woman leans down, picks up a cabbage, and offers it to the narrator, who accepts it silently.

20-24s
The cabbage is held naturally in the narrator's hand within the frame. The camera looks down at it, gently presenting its fresh appearance to the viewer.

24-27s
The camera turns back to the woman. The narrator gives a subtle nod or gesture of thanks.
The old woman smiles gently and replies: "Oh, don't worry. Enjoy it."
Her tone is soft, casual, and sincere.

27-30s
The interaction ends naturally. The narrator gives a small parting gesture, turns back to the road, and continues walking toward the city while holding the cabbage. The woman returns to her work. The unrelated man ahead continues his journey, uninvolved in the interaction.

Character Direction:
The old woman is consistently kind and friendly. Her movements and speech are realistic and understated. The narrator does not speak. The unrelated man moves independently.

Camera Direction:
Human-eye-level POV only. Natural walking motion and realistic handheld shake. Camera movements convey emotions like curiosity and gratitude without exaggeration. No cuts or third-person shots.

Audio Direction:
Generate natural ambient sounds: footsteps on a muddy path, city bustle, steam engines, chickens, wind, farming sounds, and the woman's natural English voice. No narration or BGM.

Visual Direction:
Faithfully maintain the visual identity, lighting, and complex photorealistic steampunk aesthetic of the original image. Maintain high quality throughout without modern objects or sudden style shifts.

entries.title: Realistic Woman and Lion Selfie
entries.description: An ultra-realistic 15-second selfie video prompt involving a woman in a luxury mansion being nuzzled by a lion. It focuses on zero identity drift and extreme anatomical realism for both the human and the animal.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic 15-second selfie video of the exact woman from the reference image (precise facial structure, skin tone, hair, features, expression locked 1:1 — zero identity drift).
Setting: inside a luxury mansion living room. Marble columns, ornate white ceiling with detailed molding, large crystal chandelier, soft grey walls, elegant grey couch visible behind her. Background remains completely identical and static the entire time — no scene change, no camera movement beyond natural handheld micro-sway.
Camera: selfie mode, held close to her face, slightly wide lens (≈24-28mm equivalent). Natural indoor daylight coming from the front/side, soft and flattering. Extremely crisp focus on her face with shallow depth of field; background gently falls off. Handheld natural motion only.

Action sequence (strict timeline):
0.0–3.5s
She looks into the lens, warm genuine smile, and speaks clearly:
“Simbaaaa... simba come here... I'm making a video for Instagram, they wanna see you... good boy...”
3.5–7.0s
From behind the couch, a large fully realistic adult male lion slowly walks into frame. Soft, deliberate paw steps on the floor. Tail swaying gently. He sniffs the air as he approaches. He moves toward her right shoulder.
7.0–9.5s
She notices the lion over her shoulder, turns her head slightly, and laughs nervously while still holding the phone steady.
9.5–13.5s
The lion rubs his massive head against her cheek and neck exactly like a giant affectionate cat. Soft low growl/snort. Then he gently licks her face with a large realistic tongue.
She laughs genuinely and says:
“Aww good boy...”
13.5–15.0s
She continues smiling and laughing lightly as the lion stays close, nuzzling. Hold on the intimate interaction.
Extreme realism requirements:
Visible skin pores, fine facial hairs, natural micro-texture, subtle stubble if present in reference, realistic subsurface scattering and soft shadows on skin.
Lion: dense individual fur strands, accurate mane and body spots, realistic whiskers, wet black nose, detailed eyes, authentic tongue texture and saliva sheen when licking.
Natural physics on fur movement, weight, and contact.
Perfect facial consistency of the woman throughout - no morphing, no warping, no age/skin change.

Technical & style:
Ultra-sharp 8K detail, 64K micro-detail rendering, clean natural color grading, cinematic yet documentary realism, zero flicker, zero temporal warping, zero face distortion. Soft natural indoor light only.
Reference image locked for character identity.

entries.title: Cinematic Minimalist Studio Dance Film
entries.description: An extensive cinematic prompt for a high-budget music film sequence, featuring a single dancer in a minimalist studio with dramatic orange lighting and specific camera choreography.
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second cinematic dance sequence as if directed for a high-budget international music film. DIRECTOR'S VISION The film takes place inside a massive minimalist studio at night. The space is almost completely dark, with carefully controlled #FF4900 orange practical lighting creating a striking visual identity. The atmosphere should feel sophisticated, dramatic, and expensive. There is one adult female dancer. She remains the exact same person throughout the entire sequence. Her face, hairstyle, wardrobe, proportions, and styling never change. OPENING — 0:00–0:05 Start on an extreme close-up of the dancer's face. She stands completely still. Only a thin orange light crosses her face. Hold the shot for a moment before slowly pulling the camera backward on a dolly. The music begins quietly. She makes the first controlled movement. BUILD — 0:05–0:12 Cut to a 50mm medium shot. The dancer begins a precise contemporary choreography. The camera moves sideways with her rather than simply pointing at her. Let the movement of the camera and performer feel connected. Orange practical lights gradually illuminate behind her. Use shallow depth of field and a subtle focus pull from the background to her eyes. MOMENTUM — 0:12–0:20 The music becomes more energetic. Transition into a 35mm tracking shot. The camera slowly circles around the dancer while she performs a sequence of turns, controlled footwork, coordinated arm movements, and a brief jump. Do not over-edit. Let the choreography breathe. Use natural motion blur and realistic physical movement. HERO MOMENT — 0:20–0:26 Move into a wide 24mm shot. The dancer moves toward the center of the enormous studio. As she reaches the beat, hundreds of small orange lights activate across the architecture behind her. The camera performs a slow crane movement upward, revealing the scale of the environment. The dancer remains the visual focus. ENDING — 0:26–0:30 Everything suddenly becomes quiet. Return to a 50mm shot. The dancer stops and looks directly toward the camera. Hold the composition for two seconds. The orange lights behind her slowly fade except for one strong backlight. Camera gently pushes in. Cut to black. CINEMATOGRAPHY High-end feature-film cinematography, motivated camera movement, deliberate framing, realistic lens characteristics, controlled depth of field, natural motion blur, subtle film grain, realistic exposure, sophisticated contrast, volumetric atmosphere, practical lighting, physically accurate reflections. PERFORMANCE DIRECTION The dancer should perform like a professionally trained performer. Movements are precise, confident, rhythmic, and natural. No exaggerated body motion. No unnatural poses. CONTINUITY One performer throughout. Perfect facial consistency. Identical hairstyle, wardrobe, accessories, proportions, and appearance in every shot. Stable anatomy and hands.

entries.title: Documentary Style Lava Crater Transformation
entries.description: A comprehensive multi-stage video generation prompt for Seedance 2.5 that depicts a man running through a lava crater that reveals itself to be a coffee mug.
entries.prompt:
【生成の目的】
実写のドキュメンタリー風の短編動画を生成する。中心になる被写体は〈七三の男〉。主な出来事は、火口の岩場を無言で逃げていた〈七三の男〉が、より広い画に切り替わることで、世界の正体が分かる。

【人物】
〈七三の男〉は @画像1 と @画像2 の両方に対応する、同一の男性1人である。
@画像1 は髪型、体型、紺色のスーツ、白いシャツ、えんじ色のネクタイ、黒い革靴を決める。画像の白い背景と、画像内の文字は使わない。
@画像2 は顔立ち、黒い丸眼鏡、前歯を決める。画像の灰色の背景は使わない。
2枚はどちらも同じ1人の男性を表す。出力には常に男性が1人だけ含まれること。

【場面】
〈火口〉は @画像3 を参照する。赤い溶岩の湖の形、中央の黒い岩の位置、白い蒸気の出かた、真上から見た円い輪郭だけを使う。
〈朝の食卓〉は @画像4 を参照する。木のテーブルの木目、白い陶器のマグカップの形・厚み・縁の丸み・内側の質感だけを使う。画像のカップの中身と、画像の画角の広さは使わない。
@画像3 の円い輪郭と、@画像4 のマグカップの内側の輪郭は、同じ大きさ・同じ形として扱うこと。

【被写体プロフィール：七三の男】
身長は168センチで、体は細い。
口は最初から最後まで閉じたままで、会話をしない。
使わないもの：参照画像の背景、参照画像の白い床。

【本文】
〈七三の男〉が、赤く溶けた岩の湖に囲まれた黒い岩場を走って逃げる。熱で空気が揺れ、白い蒸気が立ちのぼり、赤い飛沫が跳ねる。
映像は実写のドキュメンタリー映像として作る。肌の毛穴と汗、スーツの布の織り目、眼鏡のレンズの反射、岩の細かい凹凸が見える質感にする。光は溶岩の赤い照り返しが下から顔に当たる。
4つのシーンで構成し、シーンとシーンの間はカットで切り替えます。各シーンのカメラは固定で、シーンの途中でカメラを移動させません。
セリフは無い。

【段階1】0〜6秒
最初の状態：顔のアップ。丸眼鏡のレンズに赤い光が映り、額と鼻に汗が浮いている。口は閉じている。背後の暗がりで赤い飛沫が跳ねる。
主な出来事：正面から画面の奥へ向き直り、走り出す。
終了時の状態：画面の右奥に背を向けて立っている。口は閉じたまま。

【段階2】6〜14秒
前の段階から続く：同一の男性1人、同じ服装、同じ丸眼鏡のまま。口は閉じたまま。
主な出来事：黒い岩場を走り、足元の岩が崩れ、赤く光る割れ目を跳び越える。
終了時の状態：黒い岩の上で両手を岩について低くしゃがみ、顔だけを後ろへ向けている。上着の裾は右へ流れている。口は閉じたまま。

【段階3】14〜21秒
前の段階から続く：同一の男性1人、同じ服装のまま。口は閉じたまま。
主な出来事：真上からの俯瞰の画に切り替わり、赤い湖の中央にある黒い岩の上に、小さく立っている。白い蒸気が湖面から一斉に上がる。
終了時の状態：黒い岩の中央に立ち、両腕を体の横に下ろし、真上を見上げている。口は閉じたまま。画面の外周には白いもやが薄くかかっている。

【段階4】21〜27秒
前の段階から続く：同一の男性1人、同じ服装のまま。黒い岩の上に立ったまま。口は閉じたまま。
主な出来事：さらに広い画に切り替わり、朝の光が差す木のテーブルの上に置かれた白い陶器のマグカップが映る。段階3の火口はそのマグカップの中身である。上から銀色のスプーンが下りてくる。
終了時の状態：銀色のスプーンの先はマグカップの縁より上の空中にあり、まだ触れていない。男はマグカップの中の黒い岩の上に、輪郭と紺色のスーツが判別できる大きさで立ったまま映っている。口は閉じたまま。

【動きと音声】
（低く持続する弦の音が最初から最後まで流れる）
＜溶けた岩が重く泡立つ音＞＜岩が崩れて転がる音＞＜蒸気が吹き上がる音＞＜走る足が岩を蹴る音＞
段階4に入った瞬間、溶岩の音がやみ、＜陶器に銀のスプーンが軽く触れる音＞と＜台所の小さな環境音＞に変わる。
セリフと歌は入れない。

【一貫性を保つ】
顔立ち、丸眼鏡、七三分けの髪型、紺色のスーツ、白いシャツ、えんじ色のネクタイ、黒い革靴を、最初から最後まで一貫させること。
男性は常に1人だけであること。
段階1から段階3までは、白い陶器の面、マグカップの持ち手、木のテーブル、台所の物を一切映さないこと。
段階4のマグカップの中身は、段階3で見せた火口とまったく同じ形であること。

【禁止】
1. 口を開けること
2. 話すこと、叫ぶこと、歌うこと
3. 画面に文字、字幕、ロゴを出すこと
4. 男性を2人以上出すこと
5. 段階1から段階3で、白い陶器の面と持ち手を映すこと
6. 段階1から段階3で、木のテーブルと台所の道具を映すこと
7. シーンの途中でカメラを動かすこと、ズームすること
8. 服を着替えること、眼鏡を外すこと
9. 段階4で男が画面から消えること
10. スプーンがコーヒーに触れること、かき混ぜること
entries.translated_prompt:
[Generation Purpose] 
Generate a live-action documentary-style short video. The central subject is a "man with a 7:3 part." The main event is that the man, who was silently escaping a volcanic rocky area, reveals the true nature of his world when the shot switches to a wider view.

[Character] 
 The "man with a 7:3 part" is one and the same male corresponding to both @Image1 and @Image2. 
@Image1 determines hairstyle, physique, navy blue suit, white shirt, dark red tie, and black leather shoes. Do not use the white background or text in the image. 
@Image2 determines facial features, black round glasses, and front teeth. Do not use the gray background in the image. 
Both images represent the same single man. The output must always contain only one man.

[Scene] 
"Crater" refers to @Image3. Use only the shape of the red lava lake, the position of the black rock in the center, the way white steam rises, and the circular outline seen from directly above. 
"Morning Dining Table" refers to @Image4. Use only the grain of the wooden table, and the shape, thickness, edge roundness, and inner texture of the white ceramic mug. Do not use the contents of the cup or the wide angle of the image. 
The circular outline of @Image3 and the inner outline of the mug in @Image4 must be treated as the same size and shape.

[Subject Profile: Man with a 7:3 part] 
Height is 168 cm, slim build. 
Mouth remains closed from start to finish; no conversation. 
Do not use: backgrounds from reference images, white floors from reference images.

[Main Text] 
A man with a 7:3 part runs away across a black rocky area surrounded by a lake of red molten rock. The air trembles with heat, white steam rises, and red droplets splash. 
The footage should be created as a live-action documentary. The texture should show skin pores and sweat, the weave of the suit fabric, reflections in the glasses lenses, and fine irregularities of the rocks. Light from the red reflection of the lava hits the face from below. 
Consists of 4 scenes, switching with cuts between scenes. The camera for each scene is fixed and does not move during the scene. 
No dialogue.

[Stage 1] 0–6 seconds 
Initial state: Face close-up. Red light is reflected in the lenses of the round glasses, and sweat is on the forehead and nose. Mouth is closed. Red splashes in the darkness behind. 
Main event: Turns from the front toward the back of the screen and starts running. 
Ending state: Standing with back to the right rear of the screen. Mouth remains closed.

[Stage 2] 6–14 seconds 
Continuing from the previous stage: Same single man, same clothes, same round glasses. Mouth remains closed. 
Main event: Runs across black rocky ground, rocks crumble underfoot, jumps over a glowing red fissure. 
Ending state: Squatting low on a black rock with both hands on the rock, head turned back. The hem of the jacket flows to the right. Mouth remains closed.

[Stage 3] 14–21 seconds 
Continuing from the previous stage: Same single man, same clothes. Mouth remains closed. 
Main event: Switch to a top-down bird's-eye view, standing small on a black rock in the center of the red lake. White steam rises simultaneously from the lake surface. 
Ending state: Standing in the center of the black rock, arms down at sides, looking straight up. Mouth remains closed. A thin white haze hangs on the periphery of the screen.

[Stage 4] 21–27 seconds 
Continuing from the previous stage: Same single man, same clothes. Standing on the black rock. Mouth remains closed. 
Main event: Switch to an even wider shot, showing a white ceramic mug placed on a wooden table in the morning light. The crater from Stage 3 is the contents of that mug. A silver spoon descends from above. 
Ending state: The tip of the silver spoon is in the air above the rim of the mug and has not touched it yet. The man is shown standing on the black rock inside the mug at a size where his outline and navy suit are recognizable. Mouth remains closed.

[Movement and Sound] 
(A low, sustained string sound plays from beginning to end) 
<Sound of molten rock bubbling heavily> <Sound of rocks crumbling and rolling> <Sound of steam blowing up> <Sound of running feet kicking rocks> 
The moment Stage 4 begins, the lava sounds stop and change to <the sound of a silver spoon lightly touching ceramic> and <small ambient kitchen sounds>. 
Do not include dialogue or singing.

[Maintain Consistency] 
Facial features, round glasses, 7:3 parted hair, navy suit, white shirt, dark red tie, and black leather shoes must be consistent from beginning to end. 
There must always be only one man. 
From Stage 1 to Stage 3, do not show the white ceramic surface, the mug handle, the wooden table, or any kitchen items. 
The contents of the mug in Stage 4 must be exactly the same shape as the crater shown in Stage 3.

[Prohibitions] 
1. Opening the mouth 
2. Speaking, shouting, or singing 
3. Showing text, subtitles, or logos on screen 
4. Showing two or more men 
5. Showing the white ceramic surface and handle from Stage 1 to Stage 3 
6. Showing the wooden table and kitchen tools from Stage 1 to Stage 3 
7. Moving the camera or zooming during a scene 
8. Changing clothes or removing glasses 
9. The man disappearing from the screen in Stage 4 
10. The spoon touching the coffee or stirring it

entries.title: Cinematic Anime Silver Train Action
entries.description: A high-quality anime video generation prompt for Seedance 2.5 involving a silver train, a canyon, and intense character action.
entries.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。夕暮れの赤い峡谷を高速走行する銀色列車。0.0秒から主人公は屋根を全速疾走しており、導入の静止画や構えは置かない。全動作は実時間。速い足運び、重心移動、武器接触、反力、次の移動が切れずにつながる。

【参照・人物固定】
material:129768はface/identity referenceであり、顔と人物同一性の基準。全Cutで同一人物、同じ細い顎、青い瞳の形と虹彩色、長い月光銀の髪、前髪、青い薔薇と蝶の髪飾り、その配置を固定する。
material:129769はoutfit/full-body reference。黒いハイネック、黒レース袖、深紺のショートケープ、青い宝石ブローチ、金銀の細装飾、紺のプリーツミディスカート、黒い編み上げブーツ、月模様バッグ、細身のシルエットを固定する。バッグは右腰へ密着。
参照が衝突した場合のpriority：顔・目・髪はmaterial:129768を優先し、首から下の衣装・装飾・体型はmaterial:129769を優先する。最終の表情変化はeyes soften → brows lower slightly → eyelids narrow once → mouth stays closed → gaze returns forwardの順。許可する変化は表情、視線、呼吸、戦闘姿勢、自然な髪と布の揺れだけ。別人化、顔の平均化、衣装交換、左右反転、分身、主人公追加なし。

【装備固定】
owner / ownership count：主人公だけが持つ青銀の細身片刃刀は一本（one sword）、スケルトンキングだけが持つ黒鉄大剣は一本（one greatsword）。映像内の剣類は合計二本で固定する。主人公の左腰にはベルト固定した濃紺の鞘が一本。冒頭は右手に抜刀済み、鞘は空、左手は自由。
片刃刀は刀身・鍔・柄、大剣は刀身・鍔・柄がそれぞれ連結した同じ長さの単一構造を保つ。主人公は右手で柄を握り、キングは両手で柄を握る。回転と受け流しでは切先だけでなく武器全体を一体として動かす。武器、柄、鍔、鞘の増殖や持ち主交換なし。

【敵固定】
一般スケルトンは三体だけ。skeleton / undeadとして、頭骨、露出した肋骨、脊椎、骨盤、長い指骨、青い眼窩光、破れた黒布を持つ。武器はなく、三体同時に異なる高さから掴みかかる。
スケルトンキングは一体だけ。skeleton / undeadとして、二回り大きな頭骨と肋骨、頭骨に固定した黒鉄冠、厚い黒鉄鎧、裂けた濃紺マント（armor, cloak）、強い青い眼窩炎、黒鉄大剣を持つ。盾なし。一般兵三体が倒れた後にだけ登場する。
全敵は決着まで骨・布・鉄の固体素材を維持し、結晶体や光の人型へ置換しない。一般兵とキングの特徴混合、敵の複製なし。

【レンダリング固定】
3D toon/cel-lookだけを使用。material:129768とmaterial:129769を核に、細い青灰色の輪郭線、二〜三層のトゥーン陰影と柔らかな勾配、澄んだ月光銀・深紺・ロイヤルブルー、銀髪の鋭い細ハイライト、ベルベット・レース・金属・宝石・ガラスを区別できる高密度素材表現。
Character-first palette / character-specific palette：主人公のロイヤルブルーをcharacter-specific key light、深紺をcharacter-specific shadowとして優先する。背景はlow-saturation background、シアンはcyan only as auxiliaryとして接触光にだけ使う。外装リブ、窓枠、座席、吊り革、手すり、連結扉、床反射まで高密度。
太い輪郭線にしない。単層の平板セル塗りにしない。汎用的な3Dアニメ顔にしない。滑らかなプラスチックCG素材にしない。低密度背景にしない。実写にしない。半実写にしない。くすんだ色にしない。画風を混在させない。

【運動と撮影の共通軸】
戦闘はone continuous trajectory。屋根の前進、窓への落下、三方向の骨腕を潜る低い回避、包囲中央の通過、一続きの刀円弧、キングの大剣で外へ曲げられる軌道、内側への旋回、前後位置の交換、水平の返し、斜め上の決着、納刀まで同じ運動線を受け渡す。接触によって軌道が変形し、静止して構え直さない。
撮影系統はlow rear-three-quarter attacker tracking、車体外側の斜め、front retreat、over-the-shoulder counter、short orbit / axis change、diagonal impact push-in、side medium close-upを目的に合わせて切り替える。low angleの高さは屋根と床の動作で0.4m、肩越しで1.2m、納刀で1.35m。
座席、窓枠、骨腕、刀身のforeground occlusionを一瞬許し、速度時には身体の一部が画面外へ抜けてもよい。背景の消失軸は常に列車前方へ流れ、カット切替は足の接地、骨腕の通過、刀の横切り、武器接触、身体の通過方向でつなぐ。

【速度・動作締切・音】
全身動作は実時間。接触時のヒットストップは最大1フレーム。各Cutの先頭から支持足、腰、胸郭、武器を動かし、記載した中間時刻を順番に通過して終了時刻までに指定状態へ到達する。時間区間を接触前の単一姿勢や同じ剣交差の補間に使わない。火花、髪、布だけで速度を代用せず、それらが残る間も人物、敵、二本の武器が床基準で次の位置へ移る。
金属屋根の足音、風圧、ガラス破砕、骨腕の風切り、骨が床へ落ちる乾音、刀と大剣の短い金属衝突、鎧の亀裂、最後の納刀音を可視イベントへ同期する。台詞、字幕、ロゴ、UI、透かしなし。

Cut 1：0.0–2.0秒｜屋根を全速疾走
低い背後3/4。主人公は屋根リブを前方へ四歩駆け、ブーツの接地ごとに支持脚、骨盤、肩、刀身が同じ推進軸で移動する。屋根リブと峡谷は高速で後退し、髪とケープは後方へ鋭く流れる。四歩目の反力をそのまま使って屋根右縁から車体側面へ飛び降りる。
2.0秒、主人公の頭、肩、腰、両脚はすべて無傷の窓ガラスより車外側にあり、身体のどこもまだ窓枠の内側へ入っていない。

Cut 2：2.0–5.0秒｜外側から窓を破り、全身を車内へ通す
2.0–3.15秒は列車外側の斜め前方カメラ。レンズと主人公を窓の外に置き、銀色の車体外板、窓枠の外縁、ガラス越しの無人車内を同時に見せる。主人公は車外から窓面へ接近し、身体の進行ベクトルを車外 → ガラス面 → 車内の一方向へ保つ。
2.0秒、主人公の全身は完全に車外、窓は無傷。2.7秒、右手の片刃刀全体を短い水平円弧で運び、切先寄りの刃がガラスの外向き面中央へ命中する。命中後の2.8秒にだけ放射亀裂が開き、ガラス片は外側カメラから遠ざかって車内方向へ飛ぶ。3.1秒、頭と右肩が車外から窓枠を越えて車内へ入り、腰と両脚はまだ車外に残る。
飛び込むガラス片を一瞬の前景遮蔽として3.15秒に車内斜め前方へ切り替える。壊れた窓を主人公の背後に残し、3.7秒までに腰、両膝、両ブーツの順で外から内へ窓枠を通過する。4.2秒、両ブーツを含む全身が完全に車内へ入り、通路床へ低く着地する。5.0秒までに腰と胸郭が床の継ぎ目を二本越え、前方へ二歩走って次の包囲へ接続する。

Cut 3：5.0–6.2秒｜骨腕を瞬間偏向し、三方向の攻撃線へ入る
カメラは主人公の左斜め前、胸の高さ1.2mから後退し、主人公を膝上の大きさで画面右寄せに置く。列車前方の連結扉を消失軸にし、左から頭上へ伸びる骨腕、右から膝下へ伸びる骨腕、正面から胸の高さへ迫る骨腕と、それらの中央に残る斜め前方の隙間を同じ画面で見せる。
5.4秒、主人公の右足が次の床パネルへ接地する。膝を短く圧縮し、腰と胸郭を前へ運ぶ。5.6秒、左から来る高い骨腕の前腕と片刃刀の鍔寄りには約10cmの空隙がある。5.7秒、鍔寄りが骨の前腕へ一瞬接触し、接触後にだけ骨腕が頭上外側へ弾かれる。その反力で主人公は刀全体を右腰沿いへ畳み、頭と左肩を高い骨腕の下へ沈めて次の回避へ入る。6.0秒、左肩が高い骨腕を通過し、右膝は低い骨腕より上を越える。6.2秒、弾かれた長い指骨がレンズ前を横切る瞬間を遮蔽として次の視点へ渡す。

Cut 4：6.2–7.5秒｜上下の骨腕を潜り、包囲中央へ抜ける
遮蔽が明けると、カメラは主人公の右肩後方、高さ0.75mへ移り、全身、支持脚、一本の片刃刀、三体の肋骨を近い奥行きで捉える。背景の消失軸を正面扉から左奥の窓列へ斜めに変える。
6.2秒、主人公は片刃刀を右腰沿いへ引き付けたまま、右足裏で床を捉える。6.6秒、右足の蹴りで骨盤を支持脚の前へ通し、後ろの左足を低い骨腕の上へ素早く抜く。7.0秒、上体を左へ傾けて正面の指骨を右肩の外へ滑らせる。三体の骨腕は主人公の背後で交差し始める。7.5秒、主人公の頭、両肩、腰が三体の形成する三角形の中央を完全に通過し、左足が次の床パネルへ接地する。

Cut 5：7.5–8.8秒｜支持足を替え、一続きの刀円弧へ入る
主人公の左足接地を起点に、カメラは右肩後方から低い左斜め前へ短く回り込み、高さを0.75mから0.45mへ下げる。人物サイズを膝上から全身へ引き、左奥の窓列から列車前方の連結扉へ背景の消失軸を戻す。
7.5秒、左膝が短く圧縮される。7.8秒、骨盤が左足の上を越え、時計回り旋回を開始する。8.1秒、右手の片刃刀全体が右腰から腰高の一つの円弧へ入り、刀身、鍔、柄が同じ回転軸で動く。8.5秒、同じ一本の刃筋が密集した三体の肋骨の前面を連続して通過する。主人公は敵ごとに構え直さず、その円弧と同じ方向へ身体を通す。8.8秒、主人公の腰が三体の包囲線を完全に越え、右足が前方の床へ向かう。

Cut 6：8.8–10.3秒｜三体の崩壊を背後へ残して走り抜ける
低い左斜め前から後退し、主人公の全身を中央より右へ置く。壊れた窓列と連結扉を奥行き軸にし、主人公と背後の三体を同じ画面へ残す。
8.8秒、主人公の右足が接地し、その反力で左足を前へ運ぶ。刀の通過後にだけ三体の肋骨と骨盤が同時にほどけ始める。9.2秒、主人公は三体の指先が届く範囲を完全に抜ける。三体は順番に倒れず、主人公の通過線の後方で同時に骨の山へ崩れる。9.7秒、主人公の腰と胸郭が床の継ぎ目を二本越え、片刃刀は右後方のフォロースルーから前方へ戻り始める。10.3秒、次の右足が連結扉手前へ接地し、背後の三体分の骨が床へ落ち切る乾音と同時にキング登場へつなぐ。

Cut 7：10.3–11.0秒｜キング登場を下降円弧へ即接続
主人公の右足接地と同時に連結扉が内側へ押し開かれ、スケルトンキングが一歩で通路へ入る。低い斜め前方から、主人公の支持脚、キングの全身、黒鉄大剣全体を同じ画面へ収める。
10.3秒、キングの前足が扉の敷居を越える。10.6秒、両手で握った大剣全体を頭上で止めず、踏み込みから縦の下降円弧へ移す。主人公は前進を残したまま右手の刀を身体前へ立てる。11.0秒、下降中の大剣と片刃刀の間に約10cmの空隙を残し、双方の腰と支持足が動いている状態で次の接触へ渡す。

Cut 8：11.0–11.5秒｜初接触を一瞬で解除
主人公の左肩後方、高さ1.15mから、二本の武器全体、接触前の空隙、主人公の右足を同じ画面に収める。
11.0秒、二本の刃には空隙がある。11.2秒、大剣の刃元と片刃刀の鍔寄りが一点で初めて命中する。接触瞬間だけ最大1フレームのヒットストップを置き、短い金属音と青白い火花を命中位置へ同期する。次フレームから反力が主人公の手首、肘、肩、胸郭、腰、右足へ通り、右足が床を蹴る。11.35秒、二本の刃が離れ始める。11.5秒、刃の間が刀身一本分まで開き、交差した姿勢を保持せず、主人公の右肩が大剣の内側へ入り始める。

Cut 9：11.5–12.6秒｜内側を抜け、前後位置を交換
接触点を横切る短い軸回り込みで、カメラは主人公の右側、高さ0.7mへ移り、双方の全身、二本の武器、床の継ぎ目を見せる。
11.5秒から落下する火花の背後で、主人公の腰と胸郭が時計回りに前進し、片刃刀全体は大剣から離れ続ける。11.8秒、主人公の右肩が大剣の内側を通過する。12.1秒、腰と骨盤がキングの脇を越え、左足が次の床パネルへ接地する。12.4秒、主人公とキングの前後位置が完全に入れ替わる。12.6秒、キングは主人公を追って肩、腰、両足を回し始め、下降円弧で残った全身の回転を次の返しへ渡す。

Cut 10：12.6–14.0秒｜追尾回転を水平の返しへ変える
カメラは主人公の右斜め前、高さ0.95mから攻撃線に沿って後退し、キングの全身、大剣全体、主人公の支持脚を同時に捉える。
12.6秒、キングは前足を別の床パネルへ踏み替え、両足裏から床へ返る反力で肩と腰を追尾回転させる。13.2秒、大剣全体がその回転を引き継いで水平の返し円弧を開始する。主人公は後退せず、左足を通路外側へ半歩置き、片刃刀の中腹を大剣の進路へ運ぶ。13.6秒、二本の刃の間には約10cmの空隙がある。13.8秒、大剣の刃中腹と片刃刀の中腹が一点で命中する。ヒットストップは最大1フレーム。13.9秒、二本の刃は既に離れる。14.0秒、主人公の左足が横圧を前進速度へ変え、その反力を次の攻撃へ渡して通過へつなぐ。

Cut 11：14.0–18.5秒｜返しの反力で反対側を抜け、決着軌道へ入る
座席を一瞬の前景にした低い斜め視点。14.0秒、二本の刃は離れながら別方向へ移動し、火花だけをその場へ残す。14.5秒、主人公の左足が通路外側の床を捉え、膝を短く圧縮する。15.2秒、横圧を受けた骨盤が支持足を越えて前へ進み、主人公の胸郭と腰がキングの剣腕側を通過する。
15.8秒、主人公とキングの前後関係が再び更新され、主人公はキングの斜め後方へ出る。キングは置き去りにならず、大剣全体と胴体を主人公へ向けて追う。16.4秒、主人公の右足がキング後方の床へ接地する。17.2秒、その接地反力で時計回りの身体回転を斜め上へ返る一本の刀軌道へ変える。18.0秒、片刃刀全体が無傷の黒鉄鎧前面へ接近し、まだ約10cmの空隙を保つ。18.5秒、空隙を残したまま刃と身体が前進中の瞬間を決着へ渡す。

Cut 12：18.5–22.8秒｜斜め上の一刀で決着し、崩壊を開始
主人公の斜め後方、高さ0.8mから短く押し込み、片刃刀全体、黒鉄鎧前面、双方の支持脚を同じ画面に収める。
18.5秒、鎧は無傷で刀との間に空隙がある。18.7秒、片刃刀の中腹が黒鉄鎧前面を斜め上へ通過する。接触瞬間だけ最大1フレームのヒットストップを置く。18.8秒、刀の通過後にだけ細い青い亀裂が鎧へ走る。19.2秒、キングの青い眼窩炎が消える。
主人公は接触位置へ留まらず、19.6秒までに刀のフォロースルーと腰をキングの外側へ運ぶ。20.0秒、キングの両膝が支持力を失う。20.8秒、鎧の胴が前方へ傾き、大剣の切先が床へ近づく。21.6秒、片膝と大剣の切先が床へ触れ、金属音を同期する。22.8秒、キングの胴と大剣が床へ向かって倒れ続ける未完了の落下を次のCutへ渡す。

Cut 13：22.8–26.8秒｜崩壊を背後へ残し、納刀準備へ接続
カメラは主人公の左斜め前、高さ1.1mから後退し、主人公を膝上、倒れるキングを全身で背景へ収める。
22.8秒、主人公は右足を前方の床へ置き、倒れるキングを背後へ残す。23.4秒、キングの両膝と鎧の胴が床へ落ちる。24.0秒、黒鉄大剣が横倒しになって床で停止し、乾いた重い金属音を同期する。24.2秒、主人公は一歩目を進める。24.8秒、二歩目で床の継ぎ目を越える。
25.4秒、主人公は歩行の反力を使って倒れたキングへ半回転し、右手の片刃刀を身体横へ戻す。26.2秒、左手が左腰の鞘を支え、右手が刀全体を鞘口方向へ回し始める。26.8秒、切先が実在する鞘口の直前へ合い、まだ挿入していない状態で次のCutへ渡す。

Cut 14：26.8–30.0秒｜納刀で確定終了
顔、両手、左腰の鞘口を収める横斜めの近景。26.8秒、左手が鞘を支え、右手が片刃刀全体を回して切先を鞘口へ正確に合わせる。27.2秒、切先が鞘口へ入り、その後は刀身が途切れず実時間で収まる。
29.7秒、鍔が鞘口へ密着し、乾いた金属音「カチン」と同期して納刀完了。床の三体分の骨、倒れたキング、横倒しの大剣は背景で停止する。29.7秒の納刀完了と同時に、上記の短い表情変化を行う。30.0秒、右手が柄から離れる直前の確定状態でカットする。
entries.translated_prompt:
High-quality anime footage. A silver train traveling at high speed through a red canyon at dusk. From 0.0 seconds, the protagonist is sprinting across the roof at full speed; no introductory still images or poses. All movements are in real-time. Fast footwork, shifts in center of gravity, weapon contact, reaction force, and the next movement connect seamlessly without interruption.

【Reference/Character Consistency】
material:129768 is the face/identity reference, serving as the standard for facial and character identity. Maintain the same person across all cuts, with the same slender jawline, blue eye shape and iris color, long moonlight-silver hair, bangs, blue rose and butterfly hair ornaments, and their placement. 
material:129769 is the outfit/full-body reference. Fix the following: black high-neck top, black lace sleeves, dark navy short cape, blue gemstone brooch, fine gold and silver decorations, navy pleated midi skirt, black lace-up boots, moon-patterned bag, and slender silhouette. The bag is held tightly to the right hip. 
Priority for conflicting references: face/eyes/hair favor material:129768; clothing/decorations/body type from the neck down favor material:129769. Final facial expression change sequence: eyes soften → brows lower slightly → eyelids narrow once → mouth stays closed → gaze returns forward. Permissible changes are limited to expressions, gaze, breathing, combat stances, and natural hair/fabric sway. No character changes, facial averaging, outfit swaps, horizontal flipping, clones, or additional protagonists.

【Equipment Consistency】
Owner / ownership count: The protagonist alone holds one slender blue-silver single-edged katana (one sword), and the Skeleton King alone holds one black iron greatsword (one greatsword). The total number of swords in the footage is fixed at two. The protagonist has one dark navy scabbard secured to the left hip by a belt. At the start, the sword is already drawn in the right hand, the scabbard is empty, and the left hand is free. 
The single-edged katana and the greatsword each maintain a single structural unit (blade, guard, hilt connected) of the same length throughout. The protagonist grips the hilt with the right hand; the King grips the hilt with both hands. During rotations and parries, the entire weapon moves as a single unit, not just the tip. No duplication or swapping of weapons, hilts, guards, or scabbards.

【Enemy Consistency】
General Skeletons: Three only. As skeleton/undead, they possess skulls, exposed ribs, spines, pelvises, long phalanges, blue orbital glows, and tattered black cloth. No weapons; three attack simultaneously from different heights. 
Skeleton King: One only. As skeleton/undead, he has a skull and ribcage two sizes larger, a black iron crown fixed to the skull, thick black iron armor, a torn dark navy cloak, intense blue orbital flames, and a black iron greatsword. No shield. He appears only after the three general soldiers have fallen. 
All enemies maintain solid material properties (bone, cloth, iron) until defeat; no replacement with crystalline or light humanoid forms. No mixing of general soldier and King traits, no duplication of enemies.

【Rendering Consistency】
Use only 3D toon/cel-look. Centered on material:129768 and material:129769, express high-density materials: thin blue-gray outlines, two-to-three layer toon shading with soft gradients, clear moonlight-silver, dark navy, and royal blue, sharp thin highlights on silver hair, and distinguishable velvet, lace, metal, gemstones, and glass. 
Character-first palette / character-specific palette: Prioritize the protagonist's royal blue as the character-specific key light and dark navy as the character-specific shadow. The background is a low-saturation background; cyan is used only as auxiliary for contact lighting. High density down to exterior ribs, window frames, seats, straps, handrails, connecting doors, and floor reflections. 
No thick outlines. No single-layer flat cel shading. No generic 3D anime faces. No smooth plastic CG textures. No low-density backgrounds. Not live-action. Not semi-realistic. No dull colors. No mixed art styles.

【Common Axis of Motion and Cinematography】
Combat is one continuous trajectory. The same line of movement is passed through roof advancement, falling to the window, low evasions diving under bone arms from three directions, passing through the center of a siege, a continuous sword arc, a trajectory bent outward by the King's greatsword, inward turns, swapping front-and-back positions, horizontal returns, a diagonal upward finish, and sheathing. Trajectories are deformed by contact rather than stopping to re-pose. 
Cinematography systems switch purposefully: low rear-three-quarter attacker tracking, diagonal exterior view, front retreat, over-the-shoulder counter, short orbit / axis change, diagonal impact push-in, and side medium close-up. Low angle heights: 0.4m for roof and floor actions, 1.2m for over-the-shoulder, 1.35m for sheathing. 
Brief foreground occlusion by seats, window frames, bone arms, and blades is permitted; parts of the body may exit the frame during high speed. The background vanishing axis always flows toward the front of the train. Cut transitions are linked by foot placement, bone arms passing, sword swipes, weapon contact, and the direction of body passage.

【Speed, Motion Deadlines, and Sound】
Full-body motion is in real-time. Hit stops upon contact are a maximum of 1 frame. Move support feet, hips, ribcage, and weapons from the start of each Cut, passing through listed intermediate timestamps in order to reach the specified state by the end time. Do not use time intervals to interpolate a single pre-contact pose or the same sword clash. Do not substitute speed with sparks, hair, or cloth alone; while they remain, the character, enemies, and two weapons must move to their next positions relative to the floor. 
Synchronize metallic roof footsteps, wind pressure, glass shattering, bone arm wind-cutting, dry sounds of bones hitting the floor, short metallic clashes between the katana and greatsword, armor cracking, and the final sheathing sound to visual events. No dialogue, subtitles, logos, UI, or watermarks.

Cut 1: 0.0–2.0s | Sprinting on the Roof
Low rear 3/4 view. The protagonist sprints four steps forward across the roof ribs; with each boot strike, the supporting leg, pelvis, shoulders, and blade move along the same propulsion axis. The roof ribs and canyon recede at high speed; hair and cape stream sharply backward. Using the reaction force of the fourth step, she jumps from the right edge of the roof to the side of the train.
At 2.0s, the protagonist's head, shoulders, hips, and both legs are all outside the undamaged window glass; no part of the body has entered inside the window frame yet.

Cut 2: 2.0–5.0s | Breaking the Window from Outside and Passing the Whole Body Into the Car
2.0–3.15s: Diagonal front camera outside the train. Place the lens and protagonist outside the window, showing the silver car exterior, outer window frame edges, and the empty interior through the glass. The protagonist approaches the window from outside, maintaining a single vector of movement: outside → glass surface → inside. 
At 2.0s, the body is completely outside, window intact. At 2.7s, she swings the katana in a short horizontal arc; the blade near the tip hits the center of the outer glass surface. Radial cracks open only after impact at 2.8s; glass shards fly away from the outer camera toward the interior. At 3.1s, the head and right shoulder cross the window frame into the car; hips and legs remain outside. 
Use flying glass shards as a brief foreground occlusion to switch to a diagonal front interior view at 3.15s. Leaving the broken window behind the protagonist, the hips, both knees, and both boots pass through the window frame from outside to inside by 3.7s. At 4.2s, the entire body including both boots is completely inside, landing low on the aisle floor. By 5.0s, the hips and ribcage cross two floor seams, running two steps forward to connect to the next siege.

Cut 3: 5.0–6.2s | Instant Deflection of Bone Arms and Entering the Triple Attack Lines
Camera retreats from the protagonist's left diagonal front at chest height (1.2m), placing the protagonist on the right side of the screen at knee-up size. Using the connecting door at the front of the train as the vanishing axis, show a bone arm extending from the left overhead, one from the right below the knees, and one approaching chest height from the front, all in the same shot with a diagonal front gap in the center. 
At 5.4s, the protagonist's right foot strikes the next floor panel. Compress the knee briefly to drive the hips and ribcage forward. At 5.6s, there is a roughly 10cm gap between the forearm of the high bone arm from the left and the guard-side of the katana. At 5.7s, the guard-side makes momentary contact with the bone forearm; only after contact is the bone arm parried toward the upper outside. Using that reaction, the protagonist folds the katana along the right hip, ducks the head and left shoulder under the high bone arm, and enters the next evasion. At 6.0s, the left shoulder passes the high bone arm, and the right knee clears the low bone arm. At 6.2s, the parried long phalanges crossing the lens act as a transition occlusion to the next viewpoint.

Cut 4: 6.2–7.5s | Diving under Upper and Lower Bone Arms and Passing through the Center of the Siege
As the occlusion clears, the camera moves behind the protagonist's right shoulder at 0.75m height, capturing the full body, support leg, one katana, and three sets of ribs in close depth. Change the background vanishing axis diagonally from the front door to the row of windows on the back left. 
At 6.2s, the protagonist grips the floor with the right sole while keeping the katana tucked against the right hip. At 6.6s, the right foot kick drives the pelvis past the support leg, and the trailing left foot is quickly pulled over the low bone arm. At 7.0s, she leans the torso left to slide the frontal phalanges past the outside of the right shoulder. The three bone arms begin to cross behind her. At 7.5s, the head, shoulders, and hips completely pass through the center of the triangle formed by the three enemies, and the left foot strikes the next floor panel.

Cut 5: 7.5–8.8s | Switching Support Feet and Entering a Continuous Sword Arc
Starting from the left foot strike, the camera orbits briefly from behind the right shoulder to the low left diagonal front, lowering height from 0.75m to 0.45m. Pull the character size from knee-up to full body, returning the vanishing axis from the left window row to the front connecting door. 
At 7.5s, the left knee compresses. At 7.8s, the pelvis passes over the left foot, beginning a clockwise rotation. At 8.1s, the entire katana enters a single waist-high arc from the right hip; the blade, guard, and hilt move on the same rotational axis. At 8.5s, the same single blade path passes consecutively across the fronts of the three crowded ribcages. The protagonist does not re-pose for each enemy, passing the body in the same direction as the arc. At 8.8s, the waist completely crosses the siege line of the three enemies, and the right foot heads toward the floor ahead.

Cut 6: 8.8–10.3s | Running Through while Leaving the Three Collapsing Enemies Behind
Retreating from the low left diagonal front, placing the protagonist's full body to the right of center. Using the broken window row and connecting door as the depth axis, keep the protagonist and the three enemies behind her in the same shot. 
At 8.8s, the right foot strikes, and the reaction force drives the left foot forward. Only after the sword passes do the three sets of ribs and pelvises begin to unravel simultaneously. At 9.2s, the protagonist completely exits the reach of the three enemies' fingertips. The three do not fall in sequence; they collapse into a pile of bones simultaneously behind the passage line. At 9.7s, the hips and ribcage cross two floor seams, and the katana begins to return forward from the rear-right follow-through. At 10.3s, the next right foot strikes in front of the connecting door, synchronizing the dry sound of three sets of bones hitting the floor with the King's entrance.

Cut 7: 10.3–11.0s | Connecting the King's Entrance Immediately to a Descending Arc
Simultaneous with the right foot strike, the connecting door is pushed inward, and the Skeleton King enters the aisle in one step. From a low diagonal front view, capture the protagonist's support leg, the King's full body, and the entire black iron greatsword in the same shot. 
At 10.3s, the King's lead foot crosses the door threshold. At 10.6s, without stopping the greatsword overhead, he transitions from the step into a vertical descending arc. The protagonist maintains forward momentum while raising the katana in front of her body. At 11.0s, a roughly 10cm gap remains between the descending greatsword and the katana, with both parties' hips and support feet in motion as the scene passes to the next contact.

Cut 8: 11.0–11.5s | Instantly Releasing the First Contact
From behind the protagonist's left shoulder at 1.15m height, capture both weapons in full, the pre-contact gap, and the protagonist's right foot. 
At 11.0s, there is a gap between the two blades. At 11.2s, the base of the greatsword and the guard-side of the katana hit at a single point for the first time. Place a hit stop of maximum 1 frame at the moment of contact, synchronizing a short metallic sound and blue-white sparks to the impact location. From the next frame, the reaction force passes through the protagonist's wrist, elbow, shoulder, ribcage, waist, and right foot, which kicks the floor. At 11.35s, the two blades begin to separate. At 11.5s, the space between the blades opens to the width of one blade; the crossed pose is not maintained, and the protagonist's right shoulder begins to enter the inside of the greatsword.

Cut 9: 11.5–12.6s | Passing Through the Inside and Swapping Front-Back Positions
With a short axial orbit across the contact point, the camera moves to the protagonist's right side at 0.7m, showing both full bodies, both weapons, and floor seams. 
Behind the sparks falling from 11.5s, the protagonist's hips and ribcage advance clockwise, while the katana continues to distance itself from the greatsword. At 11.8s, the right shoulder passes inside the greatsword. At 12.1s, the waist and pelvis clear the King's side, and the left foot strikes the next floor panel. At 12.4s, the front-back positions of the protagonist and King are completely swapped. At 12.6s, the King begins to rotate his shoulders, hips, and feet to follow the protagonist, passing the remaining body rotation from the descending arc into the next return swipe.

Cut 10: 12.6–14.0s | Transforming the Tracking Rotation into a Horizontal Return Swipe
Camera retreats from the protagonist's right diagonal front at 0.95m along the attack line, capturing the King's full body, the entire greatsword, and the protagonist's support leg. 
At 12.6s, the King steps to another floor panel, using the reaction force from the floor to rotate his shoulders and hips in pursuit. At 13.2s, the greatsword takes over that rotation to begin a horizontal return arc. The protagonist does not retreat, placing her left foot half a step toward the outside of the aisle and bringing the middle of the katana into the path of the greatsword. At 13.6s, there is a 10cm gap between the two blades. At 13.8s, the middle of the greatsword and the middle of the katana hit at a single point. Hit stop is max 1 frame. By 13.9s, the blades have already separated. At 14.0s, the protagonist's left foot converts lateral pressure into forward speed, passing that reaction to the next attack to connect to the passage.

Cut 11: 14.0–18.5s | Passing through the Opposite Side via Return Reaction and Entering the Finishing Trajectory
Low diagonal view with a seat as a brief foreground. At 14.0s, the two blades move in different directions while separating, leaving only sparks behind. At 14.5s, the left foot catches the floor on the outside of the aisle, compressing the knee. At 15.2s, the pelvis, having received lateral pressure, advances past the support foot, and the protagonist's ribcage and waist pass the King's sword-arm side. 
At 15.8s, the front-back relationship is updated again, with the protagonist emerging diagonally behind the King. The King is not left behind, turning the greatsword and torso to follow her. At 16.4s, the right foot strikes the floor behind the King. At 17.2s, that grounding reaction transforms the clockwise body rotation into a single sword trajectory returning diagonally upward. At 18.0s, the entire katana approaches the front of the undamaged black iron armor, maintaining a roughly 10cm gap. At 18.5s, the moment with the gap remaining between the blade and the advancing body is passed to the finish.

Cut 12: 18.5–22.8s | Finishing with a Diagonal Upward Slash and Beginning Collapse
Short push-in from behind the protagonist's diagonal rear at 0.8m, capturing the entire katana, the front of the black iron armor, and both parties' support legs. 
At 18.5s, the armor is intact with a gap between it and the sword. At 18.7s, the middle of the katana passes diagonally upward across the front of the black iron armor. Place a hit stop of max 1 frame at the moment of contact. At 18.8s, a thin blue crack runs through the armor only after the sword passes. At 19.2s, the King's blue orbital flames extinguish. 
The protagonist does not linger at the contact point, moving the sword's follow-through and her hips past the King's exterior by 19.6s. At 20.0s, the King's knees lose their support. At 20.8s, the armor torso leans forward, and the greatsword tip nears the floor. At 21.6s, one knee and the greatsword tip touch the floor, synchronized with metallic sound. At 22.8s, the incomplete fall of the King's torso and greatsword toward the floor is passed to the next Cut.

Cut 13: 22.8–26.8s | Leaving the Collapse Behind and Connecting to Sheathing Preparation
Camera retreats from the protagonist's left diagonal front at 1.1m, capturing the protagonist at knee-up and the falling King in full in the background. 
At 22.8s, the protagonist places her right foot on the floor ahead, leaving the falling King behind. At 23.4s, both knees and the armor torso hit the floor. At 24.0s, the black iron greatsword falls sideways and stops on the floor, synchronized with a dry, heavy metallic sound. At 24.2s, she takes her first step. At 24.8s, she crosses a floor seam on the second step. 
At 25.4s, using the walking reaction, she half-turns toward the fallen King and brings the katana back to her side. At 26.2s, the left hand supports the scabbard on the left hip, and the right hand begins to rotate the sword toward the scabbard opening. At 26.8s, the tip aligns just in front of the actual scabbard opening, not yet inserted, as it passes to the next Cut.

Cut 14: 26.8–30.0s | Concluding with Sheathing
Lateral diagonal close-up capturing the face, both hands, and the scabbard opening on the left hip. At 26.8s, the left hand supports the scabbard, and the right hand rotates the entire katana to align the tip accurately with the scabbard opening. At 27.2s, the tip enters the opening, and the blade thereafter slides in continuously in real-time. 
At 29.7s, the guard meets the scabbard opening, synchronizing with a dry metallic 'clink' sound as sheathing is completed. The background bones of the three, the fallen King, and the sideways greatsword remain static. Simultaneously with the completion of sheathing at 29.7s, perform the brief facial expression change mentioned above. At 30.0s, cut the scene in a finalized state just before the right hand lets go of the hilt.

entries.title: Italian Woman Documentary Acting Scene
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a documentary-style close-up of an Italian woman. It specifies subtle emotional beats, precise dialogue timing, and atmospheric sound design for a realistic acting performance.
entries.prompt: Restrained Documentary footage, single continuous take, no cuts. Real, natural steady footage, intimate close-up framing.nuanced understated, An Italian woman, twenty-eight years old, dark hair loosely framing her face, sharp blue suit, open collar, close-up dead center, matches the confirmed opening frame exactly: soft window light from one side, muted neutral grade, shallow depth of field, She speaks in a near-whisper with a noticeable Italian-English accent, voice flat, controlled, unhurried, every word calculated and released with total economy, nothing given away.  She holds the frame from the opening image, composed and still, the smallest flicker of restraint beneath an otherwise unreadable calm. Soft room tone, quiet breath, distant ambient hum. No music or soundtrack, diegetic sound only.    The camera holds the opening frame's exact composition for the first four seconds (0–4s), an all but invisible push-in beneath complete stillness. She holds, unmoving but for a single natural blink (4–6.5s), then speaks, barely audible, flat and even, accent faint in the vowels: "Who told you my name is Jill?" (6.5–8s), a long still pause, breath suspended, before "Tell me. Please." (8–9.5s), the words dissolving to near silence. Final beat: she remains motionless, eyes steady, lips closed, expression unreadable, stillness unbroken (9.5–10s). Face identity stable throughout, one natural blink only, performance held to the barest minimum of visible effort.

entries.title: Surreal Giant Woman Pool Comedy
entries.description: Prompt for a photorealistic absurd comedy scene in an indoor hotel pool featuring a giant woman and a tiny man.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic absurd surreal comedy scene in a small indoor hotel pool. Low-budget real-world environment: tiled pool, metal ladders, fluorescent lighting, depth markers on the wall, white plastic chairs, a vending machine in the background, and a few casually dressed people in swimwear watching.

A giant beautiful young woman is submerged in the pool up to her neck and upper chest, as if her body is enormous and fills most of the pool. She has wet slicked-back dark hair, expressive eyes, realistic wet skin, and a slightly amused then surprised expression. Her face and shoulders are huge compared to the rest of the environment.

A normal-sized adult man in swim trunks carefully walks down the pool ladder as if he is just entering the water. He holds a white cup in one hand. As he steps down, it becomes clear that because of the bizarre scale mismatch, he is stepping directly onto the giant woman’s face. He awkwardly steps on her nose and cheek while trying to keep balance.

The woman looks confused and cross-eyed toward him. The man slips, grabs at her nose for balance, and then slides toward her open mouth. By the end of the shot, he accidentally tumbles into her mouth in a ridiculous surreal way. She looks shocked. The people in the background react with surprise and laughter.

Camera style:
Recorded like a viral smartphone clip. Slight handheld movement, but mostly stable from the poolside. Realistic phone-video look, mild compression, indoor echo, natural pool reflections, believable lighting, not cinematic. The scene should feel like a bizarre real video someone captured by accident.

Tone:
Absurd, funny, surreal, and visually shocking — not gory, not violent, not horror. The humor comes from the impossible scale and the dead-serious realism.

Action timing:
0–3s: Show the indoor pool and the giant woman occupying most of it. The man starts climbing down the ladder.
3–7s: He continues stepping down and accidentally plants a foot on her face/nose.
7–11s: He loses balance, grabs at her nose, and slips toward her mouth.
11–15s: Her mouth opens in surprise, he tumbles into it, and the bystanders react.

Important details:
Keep the scale relationship very clear: giant woman, tiny man, normal-size background people. Keep the environment realistic and grounded. Preserve believable water interaction and reflections. No gore, no body horror, no extra limbs, no broken anatomy, no glitchy transitions.

Young American woman, early 20s, natural everyday appearance, cropped puffer vest over a long-sleeve tee, biker shorts, white sneakers, hair in a high ponytail, minimal makeup, realistic skin texture, energetic morning-person personality.

Small neighborhood street with a corner coffee shop, early morning. Brick sidewalks, parked bicycles, a bench outside, soft morning fog lifting. No large crowds, no chain branding.

Ultra-realistic documentary realism, candid unscripted feeling, cool soft morning light.

entries.title: 1980s Japanese Game Show Sequence
entries.description: A prompt for an authentic 1980s Japanese game-show obstacle course with realistic stunt physics and broadcast aesthetics.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second authentic 1980s Japanese game-show broadcast sequence inspired by classic Japanese obstacle-course television. Realistic live-action footage, broadcast-camera aesthetics, natural handheld movement, analog film grain, slightly washed colors, chaotic energy, practical stunt physics, and no modern visual artifacts. No reference images provided; generate everything from this description.

0–5s — Wide Establishing Shot:
A young Japanese man in his late 20s, wearing a red tracksuit and white safety helmet, sprints onto a massive horizontal rotating log above a deep muddy pit. The log spins continuously beneath him while several giant padded wrecking balls swing across the path. The camera tracks him with imperfect handheld broadcast movement.

5–10s — Medium Action Shot:
The first wrecking ball swings toward him. He ducks desperately, rapidly shuffling his feet to maintain balance as the rotating log accelerates. His arms flail naturally, and muddy water splashes below where other contestants have fallen.

10–15s — Close Action Shot:
A second padded wrecking ball strikes his shoulder, sending him spinning off balance. He drops onto his knees and desperately hugs the rotating log as his body slides around its wet wooden surface. Strong motion blur and realistic momentum.

15–20s — Dynamic Tracking Shot:
He ends up hanging underneath the rotating log, gripping it with both hands while his legs kick through the air. He struggles to crawl toward the opposite platform as the log continuously rotates. His grip gradually weakens and his fingers slip.

20–25s — Major Impact:
He finally loses his grip and falls into the deep muddy pit. He hits the water with a huge, physically realistic explosion of brown mud and water. The camera reacts with chaotic handheld movement as the splash briefly fills the frame.

25–30s — Comedic Ending Shot:
He resurfaces completely covered in mud, helmet crooked and face stunned. He slowly raises one defeated fist toward the camera while the rotating log continues spinning behind him and a wrecking ball swings overhead. Maintain the authentic chaotic game-show atmosphere.

Visual requirements: High-fidelity realistic live action, accurate rotating-log physics, believable human movement and impacts, realistic mud and water simulation, practical-stunt appearance, coherent character identity throughout, 1980s Japanese television broadcast grain, subtle analog noise, imperfect exposure, natural motion blur, period-accurate camera movement, no CGI-looking surfaces, no modern cameras, no futuristic elements, no text overlays, no subtitles.

entries.title: Summer Café Frozen Time
entries.description: A photorealistic video prompt of a summer café terrace where a man snaps his fingers to freeze time and save a falling beer.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic summer café scene with subtle frozen-time VFX. One continuous 20-second shot. Natural handheld camera with a smooth backward track and one gentle side move. Bright daylight, warm terrace atmosphere, realistic shadows, soft film grain, no dramatic action styling.

One adult man seated at an outdoor café table, wearing casual summer clothes. One adult waitress carrying a glass of beer on a tray. A few adult customers remain in the background.
Sunny café terrace with small tables, umbrellas, chairs and a quiet city street.

Photorealistic pause-time effect, simple body motion, stable anatomy, realistic glass handling, coherent background extras, natural summer atmosphere, seamless camera continuity, no fall, no injury, no direct body repositioning.

0-5s: Medium-wide tracking shot - The man waits calmly at his table. The waitress approaches with a cold beer on a tray.

5-8s: Gentle push-in - Her foot catches slightly on the edge of a chair. She loses balance for a moment. The beer glass begins sliding off the tray.

8-11s: Close-up - The man snaps his fingers. Time pauses instantly. The waitress becomes motionless in a tilted but stable pose. The beer glass and a few droplets remain suspended close to the tray.

11-16s: Slow side move - The man stands, calmly takes the suspended beer glass, places it on his table, then moves the chair slightly out of the waitress’s path. He does not touch her.

16-20s: Push-in to medium close-up - He sits back down and snaps again. Time resumes. The waitress regains her footing naturally and looks confused when she sees the beer already on the table. The man smiles and says in English: “Perfect timing.”

entries.title: Realistic China Travel Vlog

entries.prompt: Preserve the exact face, identity, skin tone, body proportions, facial features, hairstyle, and outfit of the character throughout the entire video. No appearance changes or identity drift. Duration: 30 seconds Aspect Ratio: 16:9 Create an authentic 2026 smartphone travel vlog showing a surprising side of everyday China. The concept is: “The future is normal here.” Avoid typical tourist landmarks. Focus on ordinary streets, technology, local food, and spontaneous reactions. 00:00–00:05 Selfie footage while walking through a modern Chinese neighborhood. She notices an autonomous delivery robot moving along the sidewalk and turns the camera toward it. She says naturally: “Wait… is that actually delivering food?” She laughs as the robot continues past her. People around her barely react. 00:05–00:10 She enters a modern convenience store. She picks up an unfamiliar local snack and looks at the camera: “I have no idea what this is.” She pays using her phone and reacts: “That was way too easy.” 00:10–00:16 Outside, she notices electric vehicles and scooters moving quietly through the street. She films them briefly, then looks back at the camera. She says: “I expected futuristic buildings…” Brief pause. “…but it's the normal streets that surprise me.” 00:16–00:23 She enters a lively local food street. Show steaming food stalls, cooks preparing noodles and skewers, pedestrians eating, bicycles, scooters and authentic evening street ambience. She orders a local snack, takes a bite and genuinely reacts: “Okay… that's really good.” 00:23–00:30 Golden-hour-to-evening selfie shot while walking through the busy street. Warm storefront lights, local people and everyday city life fill the background. She looks into the camera and says: “Everyone shows you the famous China…” She turns the camera toward the street. “But this is the part I didn't expect.” She smiles and keeps walking as the phone lowers naturally. entries.title: Macro Butterfly Nature Documentary Shot
entries.description: A highly detailed macro cinematography prompt for generating a cinematic sequence of a Blue Morpho butterfly in a tropical setting, focusing on rack focus transitions and realistic insect movements.
entries.prompt:
【视频规格】
16:9，1920×1080，24fps，超写实野生动物微距电影摄影。明亮的热带清晨，自然阳光从画面左上方穿过植物，形成清晰但柔和的金色sunray。空气中存在少量真实的悬浮微尘与花粉颗粒，仅在阳光中可见。ARRI Alexa 35电影质感，专业超微距探针镜头，真实浅景深、自然焦外、细腻动态模糊与轻微电影颗粒。全片为一条连续镜头，无剪辑、无重置、无morph。无背景音乐。
【参考图与一致性】
上传的蝴蝶特写图必须作为完全一致的第一帧，并作为全片唯一的角色与环境参考。不要添加第二张结束图。全程保持同一只蓝色闪蝶：相同的头部、复眼、黑色身体绒毛、钴蓝与青绿色虹彩翅膀、深色翅缘和粉紫色细微纹理。始终保持四片正确连接的翅膀、六条细长黑腿、两根触角以及一根卷曲口器。禁止改变物种、头部尺寸、翅膀图案或身体比例。
摄影机焦点必须有意识地依次转移，而不是全画面一直清晰：
复眼 → 花蕊与花粉 → 翅膀鳞片 → 完整蝴蝶。
每一次焦点转换都通过真实镜头的rack focus完成，持续约0.4–0.7秒。禁止突然模糊、随机失焦或AI式focus pumping。
【0–4秒｜复眼与自然生命感】
从参考图的超近距离复眼特写直接开始。复眼保持最清晰焦点，可看到细密复眼结构、热带花园与阳光的微小倒影。摄影机不是静止的，而是以极缓慢的弧形轨迹绕头部移动约25度，同时轻微向前滑动。
蝴蝶保持真实的微动作：一根触角缓慢扫过前景，另一根触角产生轻微独立摆动；头部细小调整角度；口器轻微收缩；胸腹随着呼吸出现极细微起伏。附近花瓣被微风轻轻推动。禁止蝴蝶像静态模型一样完全不动。
焦点始终锁定复眼，前景花蕊自然虚化。最后摄影机沿着蝴蝶视线缓慢滑向前方的洋红色花蕊，复眼开始柔和离焦。
【4–8秒｜焦点转移到花朵与花粉】
完成第一次自然rack focus：复眼逐渐虚化，洋红色花蕊、露珠和金黄色花粉进入锐利焦点。摄影机贴近花蕊横向滑行，掠过湿润花瓣表面和透明露珠。露珠必须真实反射蓝色翅膀和周围绿色植物。
蝴蝶的一只前足向前移动并轻轻触碰花蕊。必须先发生真实接触，花蕊产生弯曲与回弹，随后才释放少量细小花粉。花粉不是爆炸，而是几十颗不同大小的微粒缓慢进入阳光，部分靠近镜头，产生自然前后景视差。
卷曲口器缓慢向花心伸展，动作连续、柔软且符合昆虫生理。摄影机继续沿花蕊向蝴蝶身体移动，焦点短暂锁定在附着于前足细毛上的几颗金色花粉。背景中的蝴蝶仍然可辨识，但保持柔和虚化。
【8–12秒｜焦点转移到翅膀微观纹理】
摄影机沿前足向上滑至胸部 and 翅膀根部，完成第二次rack focus：花蕊逐渐虚化，翅膀根部与微小鳞片进入锐利焦点。
蝴蝶开始缓慢打开翅膀。摄影机以距离翅面数厘米的平行轨迹沿翅膀表面移动，清楚展示数百万片重叠排列的真实微型鳞片、细小翅脉与深色翅缘。随着摄影机角度变化，结构色自然从深蓝转变为钴蓝、青绿和蓝紫色；颜色变化来自光线角度，不是发光或魔法效果。
翅膀只完成一次完整而自然的打开动作，不机械重复拍动。展开产生的微弱气流推动花瓣、露珠和先前释放的花粉。少量花粉从下方向上旋转经过阳光，形成细腻的airborne micro-pollen效果。部分极小露珠被气流抬起，但运动必须遵循重量、惯性和重力。
摄影机始终位于翅膀外侧，绝不穿过翅膀、身体或花朵。翅膀可以从镜头附近掠过，但绝不能完全遮住画面或造成形体变形。
【12–15秒｜完整展示与短距离起飞】
摄影机快速但平稳地后拉并略微上升，完成第三次焦点转换，从翅膀微观纹理过渡到整只蝴蝶。蝴蝶完整身体进入清晰焦点，四片翅膀结构正确，六条腿仍自然抓住花瓣。
蝴蝶身体先微微下沉，翅膀向上蓄力；随后通过一次强有力的向下拍翼离开花朵。必须清楚表现因果关系：腿先释放花瓣，花瓣因反作用力向下弯曲，身体获得向上与向前的加速度，随后花瓣回弹。禁止直接漂浮、瞬移或无力缩小。
蝴蝶只进行一次短距离自然起飞，沿阳光方向向前上方飞行。翅膀保持快速但略微不规则的真实拍动。摄影机同步后拉并做轻微侧向追踪，在空中保持蝴蝶清晰，同时让洋红色花朵、漂浮花粉和金色sunray形成明显空间层次。
最后一秒，蝴蝶从画面近处飞向中景，仍保持同一外观与翅膀图案。摄影机停留在动态跟拍状态，不落到第二朵花，不突然定格，不切换场景。
【摄影机与焦点原则】
摄影机全程持续进行细微的弧形移动、横向滑动、沿物体表面追踪和最后的平稳后拉，绝不使用僵硬固定镜头。移动必须细腻、稳定、具有真实微距摄影的空间视差。
焦点变化必须明确且具有叙事目的：
复眼最清晰，花朵虚化。
花蕊、露珠和花粉最清晰，蝴蝶柔和虚化。
翅膀鳞片最清晰，花朵虚化。
最后拉远时完整蝴蝶进入清晰焦点。
禁止整段画面全部锐利，也禁止主体毫无理由突然模糊。浅景深必须来自真实光学距离，焦点平面平滑移动。
【物理与环境细节】
花粉与微尘只能因为前足触碰、花蕊回弹或翅膀气流而移动，禁止无原因随机出现。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Video Specifications]
16:9, 1920×1080, 24fps, ultra-realistic wildlife macro cinematography. Bright tropical morning, natural sunlight passing through plants from the upper left, forming clear but soft golden sunrays. Small amount of real suspended dust and pollen particles in the air, visible only in sunlight. ARRI Alexa 35 film texture, professional ultra-macro probe lens, real shallow depth of field, natural bokeh, delicate motion blur, and slight film grain. The entire film is one continuous shot, no cuts, no resets, no morphing. No background music.
[Reference Image and Consistency]
The uploaded butterfly close-up must serve as the perfectly consistent first frame and the only reference for character and environment throughout the film. Do not add a second ending image. Maintain the same Blue Morpho throughout: identical head, compound eyes, black body fuzz, cobalt and cyan iridescent wings, dark wing edges, and subtle pink-purple textures. Always maintain four correctly connected wings, six long black legs, two antennae, and one curled proboscis. Do not change species, head size, wing patterns, or body proportions.
The camera focus must consciously shift in sequence rather than the entire frame being clear throughout:
Compound eyes → Stamens and pollen → Wing scales → Complete butterfly.
Each focus transition is completed through a real lens rack focus, lasting approximately 0.4–0.7 seconds. Prohibit sudden blurring, random defocusing, or AI-style focus pumping.
[0–4s | Compound Eyes and Natural Vitality]
Start directly from the ultra-close-up compound eye in the reference image. The compound eye maintains sharpest focus, showing fine compound eye structures and tiny reflections of the tropical garden and sunlight. The camera is not static but moves in a very slow arc around the head by about 25 degrees, while sliding slightly forward.
The butterfly maintains real micro-movements: one antenna slowly sweeps the foreground, the other oscillates slightly independently; head makes tiny adjustments; proboscis contracts slightly; the thorax and abdomen show very subtle fluctuations with breathing. Nearby petals are gently pushed by a breeze. Prohibit the butterfly from remaining completely motionless like a static model.
Focus remains locked on the compound eye, foreground stamens naturally blurred. Finally, the camera slides slowly along the butterfly's line of sight toward the magenta stamens ahead, the compound eye beginning to softly defocus.
[4–8s | Focus Shift to Flower and Pollen]
Complete the first natural rack focus: compound eyes gradually blur, magenta stamens, dewdrops, and golden-yellow pollen enter sharp focus. The camera slides laterally close to the stamens, passing over the wet petal surface and transparent dewdrops. Dewdrops must realistically reflect the blue wings and surrounding greenery.
One of the butterfly's forelegs moves forward and gently touches a stamen. Real contact must occur first, with the stamen bending and rebounding, then releasing a small amount of fine pollen. Pollen is not an explosion but dozens of different-sized particles slowly entering the sunlight, some close to the lens, creating natural foreground/background parallax.
The curled proboscis slowly extends toward the flower center, motion continuous, soft, and physiologically accurate. The camera continues moving along the stamen toward the butterfly's body, focus briefly locking on a few golden pollen grains attached to the fine hairs of the foreleg. The butterfly in the background remains recognizable but softly blurred.
[8–12s | Focus Shift to Wing Micro-texture]
The camera slides up the foreleg to the thorax and wing base, completing the second rack focus: stamens gradually blur, wing base and tiny scales enter sharp focus.
The butterfly begins to slowly open its wings. The camera moves in a parallel track a few centimeters from the wing surface, clearly showing millions of overlapping real micro-scales, fine wing veins, and dark wing edges. As the camera angle changes, structural color naturally shifts from deep blue to cobalt, cyan, and blue-violet; color changes come from light angles, not glowing or magic effects.
Wings complete only one full and natural opening motion, not mechanical repetitive flapping. The weak airflow generated by the expansion pushes petals, dewdrops, and previously released pollen. A small amount of pollen spirals upward through the sunlight, forming a delicate airborne micro-pollen effect. Some tiny dewdrops are lifted by the airflow, but movement must follow weight, inertia, and gravity.
The camera always stays on the outside of the wings, never passing through wings, body, or flowers. Wings can pass near the lens but must never completely cover the frame or cause shape distortion.
[12–15s | Full Display and Short Takeoff]
The camera pulls back quickly but smoothly and rises slightly, completing the third focus transition, transitioning from wing micro-texture to the whole butterfly. The butterfly's full body enters sharp focus, four wings correctly structured, six legs still naturally gripping the petals.
The butterfly's body first dips slightly, wings powering upward; then leaves the flower with one strong downward wing beat. Causality must be clear: legs release petals first, petals bend downward due to reaction force, body gains upward and forward acceleration, then petals rebound. Prohibit direct floating, teleporting, or powerless shrinking.
The butterfly performs only one short-distance natural takeoff, flying forward and upward in the direction of sunlight. Wings maintain fast but slightly irregular real flapping. Camera tracks and pulls back synchronously with a slight lateral tracking, keeping the butterfly clear in the air while allowing magenta flowers, floating pollen, and golden sunrays to form clear spatial layers.
In the final second, the butterfly flies from the foreground to the midground, maintaining the same appearance and wing pattern. The camera stays in a dynamic tracking state, not landing on a second flower, not suddenly freezing, and not switching scenes.
[Camera and Focus Principles]
The camera continuously performs subtle arc movements, lateral slides, tracking along object surfaces, and a final steady pull-back throughout the entire sequence, never using stiff fixed shots. Movement must be delicate, stable, and have the spatial parallax of real macro photography.
Focus changes must be clear and serve narrative purposes:
Compound eyes sharpest, flowers blurred.
Stamens, dewdrops, and pollen sharpest, butterfly softly blurred.
Wing scales sharpest, flower blurred.
Complete butterfly enters sharp focus upon final pull-back.
Prohibit the entire sequence from being all sharp, and prohibit the subject from suddenly blurring without reason. Shallow depth of field must come from real optical distance, focus plane moving smoothly.
[Physical and Environmental Details]
Pollen and dust can only move due to foreleg contact, stamen rebound, or wing airflow; prohibit random appearance without cause.
