entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic time-journey as ONE completely seamless, continuous, unbroken camera shot. No cuts, fades, dissolves, montage, teleportation, or resets.

A woman enters an ordinary old house and moves continuously through it while the same rooms transform through centuries.
Begin at dusk.
A modest old house stands alone in a quiet field.
The woman enters through the front door.
The camera follows directly behind her into a simple kitchen.
As she passes through a doorway, the room transforms seamlessly into a Victorian interior: dark wood, brass, gaslight and period furniture.
She continues through the hallway.
The walls and staircase transform around her as she climbs.
The Victorian house becomes a medieval stone hall with tapestries, candles and rough wooden furniture.
She opens another door.
The camera follows.
The interior becomes an ancient stone dwelling surrounded by an ancient city visible through the windows.
She keeps moving.
The architecture rapidly evolves around her as she passes through connected rooms: ancient stone becomes medieval timber, timber becomes industrial brick and iron, industrial becomes twentieth-century modern, then contemporary glass and concrete.
The woman changes naturally with each era: clothing, hairstyle, accessories and posture adapting while she remains the same continuous person.
She reaches the final door.
She opens it.
The camera follows her into the future.
The house has become an extraordinary futuristic residence integrated into a vast green city. Glass walls reveal vertical gardens, elevated transit and luminous architecture.
She walks into one final room.
It is completely empty except for a simple wooden chair.
The camera slowly moves backward through the doorway.
As it retreats, the futuristic room remains behind her while earlier versions of the house appear through successive doorways: modern, industrial, medieval, ancient.
The camera reaches the original entrance.
For the first time, we see the entire house from outside.
It is no longer old.
It is enormous and ancient-looking, surrounded by a completely transformed future landscape.
The woman is still visible through the distant window.
The house has remained through every age.
End on the quiet realization that while civilizations changed completely, this one place remembered them all.
Photorealistic cinematic realism, emotional, mysterious, elegant, awe-inspiring, family-friendly. The transformations must occur physically during camera movement, never as abrupt scene changes. Keep the woman continuously moving until the final moment.

entries.title: Ukiyo-e Tokyo City Scroll
entries.description: A highly detailed video prompt for Seedance 2.5 that creates an animated Japanese picture scroll of an Edo-period cityscape transitioning into modern Mount Fuji.
entries.prompt: [SUMMARY] 15 seconds, 16:9, 24fps. A Japanese emakimono picture scroll unrolls from right to left, the ukiyo-e woodblock city painted on it comes alive, and the film lands on Mount Fuji with a title on the blank paper. Animated woodblock-print style. One single slow leftward drift carries the entire film. [GLOBAL SETUP] Look and texture: 2D animated Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print. Flat hand-printed color, visible woodgrain, washi paper fibre showing through every surface, thin sumi-ink outlines, gold-leaf cloud bands, Rinpa-school decorative flatness. Keep the ink lines slightly uneven, the way a hand-cut block prints. Palette: washi ivory, indigo ai-iro, vermilion shu-iro, gold kin-iro, golden-yellow yamabuki-iro, pine-green matsu-midori, sumi black. No other colors. The scroll as an object: the ivory washi paper of the scroll, with its dark wooden roller, stays visible at the top and bottom of the frame from 0 to 2.5s and again from 11.5 to 15.0s. Between 2.5 and 11.5s the camera is inside the painting and the paper edges are out of frame. Camera language: exactly one camera move per time slice, always small amplitude at slow speed. The overall direction of travel is leftward for the whole film. Never combine two camera moves in one slice. No handheld shake. Transitions: use zoom-in transition at 2.5s, ink-wash transition at 5.0s, matching-shape transition at 7.5s, and zoom-out transition at 12.5s. No hard cuts anywhere. Nothing appears out of empty space. Keep the camera's breathing in harmony with the length of each slice and leave enough time for each transition to complete. Forbidden throughout: no subtitles, no background music, no photorealism, no 3D rendering, no CG lighting, no video-game look, no modern buildings, no trains, no cars, no power lines, no neon, no Japanese kanji or kana characters anywhere in the frame, no watermark, no logo, no on-screen text at all before 12.5s, no mosaic, no tiling, no puzzle-piece assembly, no rapid cutting. [TIMELINE] 0-2.5s — The scroll opens Scene: A closed emakimono scroll with a dark wooden roller sits at the right edge of an ivory frame. Action: The scroll unrolls leftward and reveals a painted Nihonbashi Bridge. The painted crowd on the bridge starts to move and walks across it. A painted boat slides out from under the bridge and its flat ink outlines ripple into moving water. Camera: slow leftward drift, small amplitude, following the unrolling paper. Sound: paper rustling, a wooden roller turning, then a low market crowd fading in. Not in this slice: no text, no music, no camera shake. 2.5-5.0s — Into the painting: the food street Transition: zoom-in transition. The camera pushes into the painted surface until the paper edges leave the frame and the painting fills the whole screen. Scene: An open-air Edo food street under fluttering vermilion nobori banners. Action: A chef presses a piece of nigiri sushi between his hands and sets it down on a bare wooden board. Steam lifts from a soba pot as a cook draws noodles out of the water. A customer pulls a noren curtain aside and steps in under it. Camera: slow push in, small amplitude, stopping on the sushi board. Sound: a knife tapping wood, oil sizzling, a pot bubbling, cloth brushing. Not in this slice: no text, no music, no modern kitchen equipment. 5.0-7.5s — The river Transition: ink-wash transition. Sumi ink bleeds across the frame like ink dropped in water, and the river scene emerges out of the bleed. Scene: The Sumida River, an arched wooden bridge, rows of low wooden townhouses on the far bank under gold cloud bands. Action: A boatman pushes his pole and the boat glides forward past the bridge. Cherry blossom petals blow across the water from the right. A woman in a patterned kimono standing on the bridge turns her head and looks toward the camera. Camera: slow leftward tracking shot, small amplitude, keeping pace with the boat. Sound: an oar dipping, wood creaking, water lapping, wind through cherry branches. Not in this slice: no text, no music, no motorboats. 7.5-9.5s — Night, lanterns, kabuki Transition: matching-shape transition. A round pink cherry petal drifting in the previous slice matches into a round red paper lantern in this one. Scene: A night street of two-story wooden machiya townhouses under a deep indigo sky. Action: Red paper lanterns light up one after another down both sides of the street. A kabuki theater curtain sways open at the far end and an actor in bold red kumadori face paint strikes a still mie pose. Camera: slow tilt up, small amplitude, from the lanterns to the sky above the rooftops. Sound: wooden kabuki clappers striking twice, geta sandals on plank streets, a low crowd. Not in this slice: no text, no music, no electric light. 9.5-12.5s — Fireworks and the whole city Continuous from the previous slice, the tilt up carries straight into this one. Scene: Golden fireworks open in the indigo sky above the river. Action: Two fireworks bloom and fall in gold and vermilion. The view widens into one grand bird's-eye folding-screen painting of the whole city of Edo across the full width of the frame: dense wooden rooftops, winding canals, arched bridges, boat traffic, a vermilion torii gate, a temple complex, and the tiered white keep of Edo Castle, with gold-leaf cloud bands drifting between the districts. At 11.5s the ivory washi paper edges of the scroll slide back in at the top and bottom, revealing the whole city to be one continuous painting on one scroll. Camera: slow pull out, large amplitude, one single continuous move. Sound: fireworks booming and crackling far away, the crowd noise widening and thinning into open air. Not in this slice: no text, no music, no shattering or reassembling of the image. 12.5-15.0s — Mount Fuji and the title Transition: zoom-out transition completing into the far end of the scroll. Scene: Snow-capped Mount Fuji stands alone on the right against a gold sky. Wide empty ivory washi paper fills the left half of the frame. Action: Cherry blossom petals drift down across the empty paper. The single large word "EDO" fades in on that empty paper in clean pale sumi-black geometric sans-serif capitals. One beat later the smaller line "NOW CALLED TOKYO" fades in directly beneath it. Both lines are English Latin capitals, spelled exactly as written here, centered on the empty paper, sharp and perfectly legible, with no Japanese characters, no extra words and no misspellings. The two lines are static once they appear and are not re-rendered. Camera: the drift comes to rest and holds perfectly still for the last 1.5 seconds. Sound: a single distant temple bell ringing once, then quiet wind. Not in this slice: no music, no additional text, no camera movement after the title appears. [CLOSING CONSTRAINTS] Throughout the whole film: keep the flat ukiyo-e woodblock look, the washi paper fibre, the seven-color palette and the uneven hand-cut ink lines identical from the first frame to the last. Keep every camera move small in amplitude and slow in speed, and keep the overall direction of travel leftward. Keep all transitions soft, with no hard cuts and nothing appearing out of empty space. Throughout the whole film: no subtitles, no background music, no photorealism, no 3D rendering, no modern objects of any kind, no Japanese kanji or kana characters, no watermark and no logo. On-screen text appears only after 12.5s, only the two English lines specified above.

entries.title: Ancient Egyptian Scribe Comedy
entries.description: A cinematic and humorous opening shot of an ancient Egyptian scribe facing a deadline while his cat sleeps on his papyrus.
entries.prompt: REFERENCE-FIRST SHOT CONTRACT. A 6-second clip in multimodal reference mode. A scribal chamber at dawn inside the Giza construction complex. First frame snaps to an extreme close-up of a limestone deadline shelf: one long freshly painted red vertical line drops like an alarm bar, and beneath it a shallow stone shelf holds exactly six pale bones in a clean countdown row, each casting a hard charcoal shadow. The framing widens to reveal Henu at his low stone desk, hunched over a single clean papyrus with exhausted dread, glancing from the shelf to his empty page. A spotted Egyptian mau is curled asleep across the papyrus, blocking the work surface. Through the far colonnade an unfinished pyramid wrapped in wooden scaffolds fills the horizon. Dawn light from the right, cool in the shade, pale gold on the floor. Limestone beige, dusty ocher, faded linen, charcoal shadow, and the isolated red deadline line dominate.

entries.title: Cinematic Rainy Warehouse Fight Scene
entries.description: A detailed 30-second action prompt for a choreographed fight scene between two men in a rain-soaked warehouse, featuring precise timestamps for motion and audio cues.
entries.prompt:
30-second ultra-realistic cinematic fight scene, 16:9. Two adult male fighters face off inside a rain-soaked abandoned warehouse at night. Keep the SAME two men, clothing, and appearances throughout. Intense choreographed action with realistic physics. No injuries, blood, wounds, or graphic violence.

[0–5s] Wide shot. Fighters circle cautiously beneath flickering lights. Heavy rain pounds the roof, distant thunder rumbles, shoes scrape the concrete. Both breathe heavily.

[5–10s] Fighter one throws a controlled punch. Fighter two ducks and counters with a blocked strike. Realistic whooshes, impacts, sharp grunts, footsteps, and clothing movement.

[10–15s] Rapid punches and defensive blocks. Each fighter makes natural effort sounds—short grunts, forceful exhales, heavy breathing. Punches create crisp impact sounds without exaggerated bone-cracking.

[15–20s] Fighter two attempts a sweeping kick. Fighter one jumps backward. Loud shoe scrape, kick whoosh, landing thud, rain and thunder continue.

[20–25s] Fast dodges, blocks, spins, and controlled martial-arts combinations. Dynamic camera circles them. Realistic impacts, grunts, breathing, footsteps, and environmental echoes.

[25–30s] Both attempt a final strike but stop inches apart. Silence briefly cuts through the action except for their heavy breathing and rain. They lower their fists and step backward as thunder rolls.

Photorealistic humans, realistic anatomy, natural physics, cinematic lighting and synchronized audio. No music. No dialogue. No injuries, blood, bruises, weapons, gore, death, broken limbs, distorted anatomy, duplicated characters, or morphing.

entries.title: Futuristic Humanoid Robot Workshop Cinematic
entries.description: A comprehensive cinematic sci-fi prompt for a 30-second sequence detailing an engineer assembling a humanoid robot in a high-tech workshop.
entries.prompt:
30-second cinematic sci-fi video, 16:9. Inside a highly detailed futuristic workshop, one skilled adult male engineer builds one humanoid robot. Keep the SAME man, SAME clothing, SAME workshop, and SAME robot perfectly consistent throughout. The robot never duplicates or changes design.

[0–5s] Wide establishing shot. The engineer stands beside an unfinished humanoid robot secured upright on a mechanical platform. Its metallic frame, exposed wiring, joints, and dark inactive eyes are clearly visible. Slow camera push forward.

[5–10s] Close tracking shot. The man carefully installs a glowing blue power core into the robot’s open chest compartment. Tiny sparks flicker as he connects several cables with precise hand movements.

[10–15s] Side view. He uses a handheld electric tool to attach polished armor plates to the robot’s shoulders and chest. Mechanical clamps hold each component firmly in place. Realistic tool motion and metal reflections.

[15–20s] Close-up. The engineer gently installs the robot’s final facial panel, creating a sleek but unmistakably mechanical humanoid face. He steps back and studies his work.

[20–25s] The man activates a control panel. Electrical energy flows through illuminated circuits across the robot’s body. Its eyes gradually glow blue, fingers move naturally, and its head slowly turns toward its creator.

[25–30s] The robot carefully steps down from the platform and stands face-to-face with the engineer. The man smiles proudly and extends his hand. The robot looks at it, then gently shakes his hand. Camera slowly circles them for a powerful final shot.

Ultra-realistic cinematic lighting, intricate mechanical detail, natural human movement, believable robotics, smooth camera motion, realistic physics, dramatic reflections, consistent scale and anatomy. No morphing, duplication, extra people, extra robots, text, subtitles, logos, or watermark.

entries.title: Aztec Sun Temple Drone Escape Sequence
entries.description: A highly detailed action sequence prompt for a 30-second single-take shot. It depicts a young woman escaping an Aztec sun temple through a jungle city, captured with high-speed FPV drone-style camera movements and cinematic transitions.
entries.prompt: A precise 30-second single-take shot with no editing or cuts. Focus on @Image1: a young white woman with long, straight, silky light-platinum hair and neat, airy bangs; she has light gray, clear eyes and delicate, cool-toned features; Overall outfit: white, fitted, pleated, cropped V-neck spaghetti-strap tank top; blue, fitted denim pants; vintage brown leather belt with carved design and large silver buckle; dark brown leather knee-high boots. Realistic skin tones; same outfit throughout. Background: A mythical Aztec sun temple complex deep in the jungle—stepped pyramids, rainforest, vine-covered stone channels, jade-and-gold color scheme, and golden morning mist; do not copy the composition of the reference image. Pursued by fanatics, she escapes from the altar chamber through the jungle pyramid city to the summit of the Great Sun Pyramid. The camera follows closely like a high-speed FPV drone, tracking/diving/ skimming the ground/circling/barrel rolling/pulling up in rapid cuts; transitions are naturally driven by foreground obstructions (stone gates/vine curtains/waterfalls/flags/leaves/pollen). 00:00–04 Altar: Close-up of her holding a golden-jade sun disk as golden dust sweeps across the lens; she dashes past the camera, crouches on a snake-adorned platform, leaps into a narrow cave, and the vine curtain sweeps across the lens to fade out. -08 Cliff: Emerges from the wall in a wide shot, circling the pyramid, the massive city, and the waterfall as it vanishes into the mist; sprints down a drainage channel, runs along the wall, makes a long leap over the wall to cross the valley, with the camera diving close to her feet and rising sharply to her side. -12 Marketplace: Plunges onto a wooden platform in the marketplace, half-rolls along the ground, skims past a fruit stall, and darts through the bamboo floor; jump over a cart, flip over a jar, slide under a beam, spin open a curtain; feathered flags and pottery wheels pass by. -16 Rock Alley: Pushed into the scene through a yellow cloth-covered lens; she kicks off the wall, climbs high, grabs a vine, swings across the rapids, spins, and lands on a wooden sled; the FPV camera snakes through the scene, rolls through barrels, and water droplets splash against the lens. -20 Stone Axle: The wooden sled crashes into the stone machinery room, somersaulting and kicking off rotating gears; she supports herself with her hands, flips sideways, slides low to dodge falling rocks; the camera passes through the wheel hub, skims along the water’s surface, and glides under a low arch. -24 Hollow Banyan: She leaps from a slanted channel over three consecutive walls into the hollow of an ancient banyan tree; the camera spirals upward underwater around her; she grabs a vine to use its lift to control her spin and swing toward the canopy window; golden dust sweeps by. -27 Collapsed Bridge: She exits the tree, lands on the shattered bridge, dashes past the falling rocks, and leaps away; two leopard-faced pursuers in the distance do not抢焦; with lightness skills, she leaps across the chasm as the camera flies backward, loops forward, and rises. -30 Tower Top: She leaps over fluttering banners to the golden summit, lands on one knee, touches the sun motif, and rises; the camera pulls sharply over her shoulder and rises to reveal the entire city shrouded in green mist under the morning sun. Camera: A single traceable continuous path, maintaining high-speed FPV centering; includes one each of skimming the ground, diving and rapid ascent, serpentine flight through narrow passages, spiral ascent, and a wide pull-back; High-speed motion blur but sharp focus on face and body; no teleportation; speed changes driven by her acrobatics and the structure. Action: Ancient martial arts parkour; lightness skills rely on pushing off the ground, springy steps, and momentum—not levitation; seamless transitions from wall-running, leaping, side flips, low slides, swinging on vines, kicking off gears, and long leaps; landing with impact and fluttering robes; focused and panting, never looking at the camera. Foreground: Altar / vine curtain / waterfall / jar / yellow cloth / vines / gears / counterweights / water / banyan roots / gold dust / flag / leaves—appear in sequence at the very foreground, temporarily obscuring the view before reappearing instantly; the pyramid and jungle are interconnected. Visuals: Realistic, mythical ancient Mesoamerica, where massive stone pyramids merge with the jungle; limestone yellow / jade green / moss gray / obsidian / warm sun gold, with dark clothing setting off the gold; beams of light piercing through damp mist and foliage create a high-contrast cinematic feel; ancient, fiery, and awe-inspiring.

entries.title: Swiss Mountain Station Winter Mystery
entries.description: A narrative mystery prompt set in a snowy Swiss mountain railway station, focusing on atmospheric physics, audio details, and emotional performance.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 30-second realistic emotional mystery film, 4K UHD, 24fps, photorealistic European live action

TIME: 6:40 AM–7:10 AM, winter morning, light snowfall

LOCATION: Small Swiss mountain railway station, snow-covered platform, pine forest, distant mountains, old station building

CHARACTER: Woman, 30, dark winter coat, small suitcase, traveling alone

STORY: She arrives at an almost empty station and realizes the old man waiting beside her knows exactly why she came.

SEQUENCE:

00:00–00:05 → Woman steps onto the snowy platform carrying a suitcase. A small local train departs behind her.

00:05–00:09 → She checks the station sign and realizes there are no other passengers.

00:09–00:13 → An elderly man sitting on a bench looks at her suitcase and says, “Your father carried the same one.”

00:13–00:17 → She stops and looks at him. He points toward an old station locker.

00:17–00:21 → She opens the locker using a small key from her pocket. Inside is an old envelope addressed to her.

00:21–00:25 → She opens it and reads silently while snow collects on her coat.

00:25–00:28 → She looks toward the bench again. The old man is gone.

00:28–00:30 → A train approaches through the snowy valley. She holds the letter tightly and steps toward the platform edge.

CAMERA: Natural handheld European travel-documentary style, 35mm lens, controlled tracking, realistic depth, snow occasionally hitting lens, no slow motion.

PHYSICS: Snow accumulates on surfaces, suitcase wheels struggle slightly through snow, train produces displaced air and loose snow movement as it approaches.

AUDIO: Train brakes, snow crunching, wind, station announcement, paper unfolding, distant train horn.

REALISM: Authentic Swiss railway environment, realistic mountain scale, natural snowfall, believable train movement and restrained emotional performance.

entries.title: WWII Battlefield FPV Cinematic Shot
entries.description: An immersive first-person cinematic flight through a WWII battlefield featuring trenches, armored vehicles, and aerial combat maneuvers.
entries.prompt: 30-second ultra-cinematic immersive first-person battlefield flight through a fictional WWII-era battlefield. The viewer experiences the movement directly through an invisible camera viewpoint. The camera itself is completely unseen and physically nonexistent in the image: only the environment and action are visible. Photorealistic, extreme velocity, realistic inertia, wide-angle perspective, seamless continuous movement. 0–4s: Begin high inside smoke above the battlefield. Instantly plunge into a steep vertical dive, rotating 180° as the ground rapidly approaches. Trenches, armored vehicles and ruined buildings rush toward the viewer. 4–8s: Pull out just above muddy terrain at extreme speed. A WWII-era fighter aircraft tears across the sky overhead. Immediately bank hard around wreckage, perform a complete 360° aerial roll, then dive into a narrow trench. 8–12s: Race through the trench at incredible speed, weaving between wooden supports, sandbags and moving soldiers. Burst upward, skim directly over an armored vehicle, then dive underneath its raised chassis and emerge at full speed. 12–17s: Accelerate across cratered terrain. Hard left around wreckage, hard right around a military truck, then climb rapidly toward ruined buildings as another aircraft crosses overhead. 17–22s: Target a shattered second-floor window. Rapidly climb and pass directly through it at full speed, thread through ruined rooms, rotate 90° through a doorway, descend through a stairwell opening and burst through another window into daylight. 22–26s: Dive toward a massive crater, spiral tightly around its interior wall, recover at the last moment and race between two armored vehicles while dust, smoke and debris rush past. 26–30s: Maximum acceleration toward a ruined church tower. Spiral vertically around the tower, complete a fast 360° roll through dense smoke, then burst above the smoke into a gigantic aerial battlefield reveal and continue toward the horizon. The entire sequence is seen exclusively from an invisible first-person cinematic viewpoint. No physical camera equipment is ever visible. No object occupies the foreground as a filming device. The viewer simply experiences impossible aerial movement. Continuous momentum, realistic motion blur, strong environmental parallax, volumetric smoke, dust turbulence, mud particles, sparks, rapid exposure changes and physically coherent transitions. No conventional cuts.

Shot 2 (0:01–0:03): Top-down overhead view of a metal wire whisk actively stirring velvety, glossy chocolate batter into silky concentric swirl patterns. Shot 4 (0:05–0:07): Straight-on medium shot inside a modern oven, warm amber interior glow, showing the chocolate lava cake fully risen and domed on the wire rack. Shot 5 (0:07–0:10): Hero macro shot of the baked lava cake on a matte dark plate; a silver spoon breaks into the crust, releasing a flowing cascade of warm molten chocolate lava with delicate rising steam. Style: High-end commercial cinematography, natural studio lighting, ultra-realistic textures, shallow depth of field, 8k resolution, smooth transitions. A professional 5-panel commercial storyboard layout on a clean, light-grey textured background with crisp black frame borders and typography: Top Row (Left to Right): Panel 1: 00:00 - 00:01 | CU, Angle 45-degree angle — Raw egg yolk cracking into cocoa powder and flour in a glass bowl. Text: "Combine your rich ingredients." Panel 2: 00:01 - 00:03 | Angle: High-Angle / Top-Down (CU) — Whisk swirling glossy chocolate batter into concentric rings. Text: "Whisk until perfectly smooth." Panel 3: 00:03 - 00:05 | MCU, Eye-Level — Thick ribbon of chocolate batter pouring vertically into a grey ramekin. Text: "Bake until the edges are set." Bottom Row (Centered): Panel 4: 00:05 - 00:07 | MS, Straight-On Centered — Puffed cake resting on the wire rack inside a warm illuminated oven. entries.title: Complex Multi-Shot Cinematic Scene Workflow
entries.description: A highly detailed multi-shot production prompt incorporating character sheets, location mapping, and specific facial geometry references for a professional narrative sequence.
entries.prompt: NEUROPROSTIR — ENTRANCE → THE WEIGHING → THE CASE → ONE CHORD → THE TWENTIETH → LOGO SHOT STRUCTURE: 11 shots, 30 seconds, 4:3, exactly as listed, no added shots REFS: @[Image 1](image_1) = location reference sheet. Controls the room itself only — architecture, layout, materials, window positions, bar position, fixtures, colour of the space. Every shot is staged inside this room. @[Video 1](video_1) = video reference of Vova's face. Controls facial geometry, features, skin and expression range INSIDE the hairline only: forehead, eyes, nose, mouth, jaw, complexion. It does not control hair, hairline, head shape above the hairline, or anything below the neck. @[Image 2](image_2) = character sheet. Controls Vova's hair length, parting, volume and fall, plus his build, height, wardrobe and silhouette. @[Image 3](image_3) = prop turnaround. Controls the guitar's shape, colour, wear and the logo on the lower bout only. @[Image 4](image_4) = character sheet. Controls El Patrón's face, hair, build and wardrobe. @[Image 5](image_5) = photo reference. Controls Anya's face, hair, glasses, earrings and jacket. @[Image 6](image_6) = brand reference. Controls the logo shape, its orange-to-violet gradient, the wordmark, the subscribe button and the server-room environment, for the final shot only. ACTIVE REFERENCES: @[Image 1](image_1) 95% · @[Video 1](video_1) 90% (face only) · @[Image 2](image_2) 95% (hair, build, wardrobe) · @[Image 3](image_3) 95% · @[Image 4](image_4) 90% · @[Image 5](image_5) 90% · @[Image 6](image_6) 100% (final shot only) LOCATION MAP — fixed for the entire piece, every shot is staged against these anchors: - The room runs roughly 12 metres east to west and 9 metres north to south. Terracotta tile floor, adobe plaster walls, exposed dark timber ceiling. - NORTH WALL: the bar, 6.2 metres long, brass rail, a spotted mirror and a full wall of bottles behind it. A single 2400K bulb hangs over the bar. - SOUTH WALL: the batwing doors, 1.4 metres wide, the only entrance. - WEST WALL: three shuttered windows. This is the only daylight source in the room. - EAST WALL: a jukebox, and one table beside it. - CENTRE: a slow ceiling fan, and scattered tables between the doors and the bar. FIXED POSITIONS — each character occupies exactly one position for the whole piece and never appears in two places: - <Bartender> behind the bar, centre, facing south into the room. - <Vova> enters through the south doors, walks north-west across the floor, and stops at the WEST END of the bar. He stands there from shot 3 onward and does not move again. - <El Patrón> is seated on a stool at the bar, about 2.5 metres EAST of where Vova stops, from the first frame to the last. He never stands and never leaves the stool. - <Anya> is seated alone at the EAST TABLE beside the jukebox, whisky and tablet in front of her, from the first frame to the last. She never moves to another table. - Six men at the scattered centre and south tables, seated, none of them at the bar. BAR AXIS: Vova and El Patrón stand and sit side by side along the bar, both facing north toward the bottles. They speak to each other through the spotted mirror, not face to face. The camera stays SOUTH of the bar for the entire piece and never goes behind it. GLOBAL STYLE NOTES: - look: late afternoon sun through the three west shutters as the single daylight source, hard-edged at 3000K, throwing long slatted bars across the tile and up the north wall, dust and cigarette smoke standing visible in the shafts; the 2400K bulb over the bar adds a small warm pool exactly where Vova stops, while El Patrón's stool sits in the gap between two shutter bars and reads darker without any separate lighting; the room falls to deep amber shadow away from the windows; 35mm film still, Kodak Vision3 500T pushed one stop, heavy grain, halation on the shutter slats, warm ochre grade with the shadows lifted to brown - setting: dry air at 34°C, thick with dust; a mariachi guitar playing low from the jukebox on the east wall, the fan motor, glass on wood, boots on tile, the doors knocking twice as they settle; room tone stays present under every quiet beat, never digital silence; ambience ducks under every spoken line and returns in the gap - characters: <Vova> face from @[Video 1](video_1), hair and everything else from @[Image 2](image_2). 190 cm, dark brown wavy hair falling to the shoulders, centre-parted, thick and slightly unruly, covering the tops of the ears — the hair is taken from @[Image 2](image_2) and is never redrawn from the video reference. Black cropped jacket with silver conchos down both fronts, black shirt open at the throat, silver chain, black jeans with silver buttons down the outer seam, worn black boots. He stands about 7 cm taller than El Patrón. Keep identical in every shot. <El Patrón> corresponds to @[Image 4](image_4). 183 cm, moustache, hair slicked back, white linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, gold chain, dark trousers, brown belt, brown boots, gold watch, rings. Keep identical in every shot. <Anya> corresponds to @[Image 5](image_5). Short blonde-grey hair, round glasses, silver hoop earrings, black blazer with white stitching. Keep identical in every shot. <Bartender> a thin older man, apron, towel over the shoulder. Keep identical in every shot. - acting — Vova: scene direction: keep it ordinary, let the room do the work, never sell anything fuel: he knows exactly what is in the case and quietly enjoys that they do not goal: make them ask instead of making them listen obstacle: the pull to explain himself; one sentence of pitch and the room owns him tactic: says nothing until asked twice, then answers a half-beat late and one word shorter than expected, checking the mirror after each answer to see whether the man is waiting for more, and giving him less each time channel: walking, then setting the case flat on the bar and working the latches without hurry gaze always engaged in the task, natural blink cadence - acting — El Patrón: scene direction: same, keep it ordinary, nothing here is worth standing up for fuel: three men came through those doors this year with a case and he is still the one sitting goal: get him out through the same doors without leaving the stool obstacle: curiosity, which he refuses to show and which leaks through every repeated question tactic: asks, then lets the pause run past comfortable to see whether the man fills it; the man never does, so he has to ask again, and each repeat costs him a little ground channel: turning a glass slowly on the bar top, never lifting it gaze always engaged in the task, natural blink cadence - acting — Anya: listener_task: she is checking whether the number on her tablet is final or still moving, and the bar is not part of that until it is CONTRAST AXIS: risk. Vova courts it, El Patrón holds ground against it. Both speak sparsely, both flat, both dry — the comedy lives in how alike they sound while wanting opposite things. Neither is a villain: two quiet men at a bar trading short sentences, and the older one loses ground only by having to ask twice. EYELINE GEOMETRY, anchored to the room and to each body, never to screen sides: (A) Vova and El Patrón face north at the bar — each looks at the other's REFLECTION in the spotted mirror, and their real heads stay turned toward the bottles; (B) Anya's table sits past El Patrón's OWN RIGHT shoulder — to reach her he rotates his head toward that shoulder and looks back over it; (C) the doors sit directly behind both of them to the south — glancing

entries.title: Shanghai Courier Mystery Delivery Film
entries.description: A 30-second high-detail short film prompt following a Shanghai courier during a sunrise delivery involving a mysterious photograph.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 30-second high-detail photorealistic live-action short film, 4K UHD, 24fps, realistic Chinese urban environment

TIME: 5:50 AM–6:20 AM, humid summer morning, city transitioning from darkness to sunrise

LOCATION: Shanghai residential tower, underground delivery area, crowded morning street, elevated metro line

CHARACTER: Chinese male courier, 26, delivery uniform, electric scooter, insulated food bag

STORY: A courier makes one final delivery before ending his shift, only to discover the recipient is someone who cannot possibly have ordered it.

ACTION:

00:00–00:04 → Courier rides an electric scooter through nearly empty Shanghai streets, checking the delivery address at a red light.

00:04–00:08 → He enters a residential tower, rushes through the lobby and checks the apartment number.

00:08–00:12 → He knocks. An elderly woman opens the door and immediately recognizes the name on the package.

00:12–00:16 → She looks confused and says the person listed has been dead for ten years.

00:16–00:20 → Courier checks the delivery app. The order suddenly disappears from his screen.

00:20–00:24 → The woman opens the package herself. Inside is an old photograph of her and the deceased man.

00:24–00:27 → She turns the photograph over and finds today's date handwritten on the back.

00:27–00:30 → Courier looks down the hallway. His scooter alarm suddenly sounds from the street below. He runs toward the elevator.

CAMERA: Fast handheld urban storytelling, practical building lights, elevator reflections, moving tracking shots, natural autofocus transitions, no slow motion.

PHYSICS: Scooter suspension reacts to road imperfections, elevator doors and floor indicators operate normally, package weight affects courier's movement, paper bends naturally, morning humidity creates realistic atmospheric haze.

AUDIO: Electric scooter motor, traffic signals, elevator chime, footsteps, door knock, distant metro, phone notification, scooter alarm.

REALISM: Authentic Shanghai residential architecture, Chinese signage, realistic courier behavior, natural Chinese dialogue, believable crowd density and traffic. Mystery remains unexplained without visible supernatural effects.

entries.title: Y2K Skater Style Car Destruction
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a Y2K-style underground video featuring a character destroying a vehicle, complete with image references and a second-by-second timeline.
entries.prompt:
[CINEMATIC SETUP]
Early-2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic / gritty Y2K underground skater video style / aggressive handheld camera / distinct hard cuts. Faded colors, harsh fluorescent parking garage lighting, thick white tire smoke, shattered glass on concrete. Natural ambient sound only (spatial sound design, heavy metallic impacts, glass shattering, echoing footsteps, no narration).

[IMAGE REFERENCES / LEGEND]
@ image1 = [main character: 30-year-old man, 1.93m tall. CRITICAL OVERRIDE 1: completely clean-shaven face with absolutely no beard or stubble. CRITICAL OVERRIDE 2: 100% bare hands, exposed natural skin only. Movie-level realistic facial features, stable throughout]
@ image2 = [cap reference. NO logos on sides or visor. Back features a bare cutout revealing hair/skin, and a plain plastic snapback strap]
@ image3 = [hooded sweatshirt reference, actively worn by the main character. CRITICAL DETAIL 1: small "JFB" embroidery strictly confined to the LEFT wrist cuff only. CRITICAL DETAIL 2: back of the hoodie features a specific typographical design and letters]
@  image4 = [pants reference. CRITICAL OVERRIDE: oversized fit. The pant hem NEVER drops below the high-top collar of the sneakers]
@ image5 = [high-top sneakers reference. CRITICAL OVERRIDE: 100% exposed from the sole to the top of the ankle collar, completely unobstructed by the pants]
@ image6 = [car reference, functioning as the vehicle being destroyed]

[TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND]
0-2s: [Low-angle trunk shot] The camera is positioned inside the dark trunk of the vehicle (@ image6). The trunk lid violently rips open upward, flooding the lens with harsh garage light. @ image1 reaches in with his bare hands (strictly no rings) and grabs a heavy wooden baseball bat. [Sudden upward motion] + [Trunk opening and heavy wood grab SFX]
2-3s: [HARD CUT TO: Extreme close-up] A violent downward swing. The wooden bat obliterates the front headlight. Glass explodes outward. The LEFT wrist cuff (@ image3) with the "JFB" embroidery flashes through the frame. [Violent whip pan] + [Loud glass shattering SFX]
3-4s: [HARD CUT TO: Medium shot] @ image1 repeatedly slams the bat into the metal hood of the vehicle (@ image6), leaving massive dents. [Aggressive camera recoil] + [Heavy metallic crunch SFX]
4-5s: [HARD CUT TO: High-angle Dutch shot] The bat crashes directly into the windshield, instantly creating dense spiderweb cracks across the glass. [Violent downward shake] + [Loud glass cracking SFX]
5-6s: [HARD CUT TO: Close-up] A fast lateral swing completely snaps the side mirror off the vehicle (@ image6), sending it flying off-screen. [Fast lateral pan] + [Plastic snapping SFX]
6-7s: [HARD CUT TO: Over-the-shoulder] @ image1 smashes the driver's side window. The glass shatters instantly. The oversized pants (@ image4) drape naturally above the exposed sneakers (@ image5). [Handheld shake] + [Glass breaking SFX]
7-8s: [HARD CUT TO: Macro shot] The bat obliterates the rear taillight, scattering red plastic shards across the wet concrete. [Fast zoom out] + [Crisp plastic shatter SFX]
8-9s: [HARD CUT TO: Wide profile] @ image1 delivers one final, massive overhead strike to the vehicle's roof, severely caving the metal inward. [Aggressive vertical shake] + [Deep metallic boom SFX]
9-10s: [HARD CUT TO: Low-angle tracking] @ image1 drops the bat on the concrete and walks away into the thick garage smoke. The camera focuses on the typography on the back of his hoodie (@ image3) and the fully exposed high-top sneakers (@ image5). The recording cuts abruptly to black. [Smooth drift back] + [Wood dropping and echoing footsteps SFX]

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Heavy 2000s digital camcorder texture, gritty lo-fi urban aesthetic, raw Y2K underground video vibe. Photorealistic 8K, ultra-detailed textures, cinematic lighting, perfect motion blur. Ultra-realistic documentary realism, accurate real-world physics, high-quality embroidery and typography textures, natural body language, realistic metal denting physics, realistic glass fracturing. Exact character and clothing consistency with the reference images.

[NEGATIVES]
melting metal, morphing objects, continuous morphing, rubber weapons, bending bat, floating glass, embroidery on right sleeve, logo on right wrist, symmetrical logos, text on right arm, rings, jewelry, watches, bands on fingers, metallic accessories on hands, wedding band, ring on finger, deformed faces, blurry motion, low resolution, text artifacts, inconsistent lighting, watermark, extra limbs, clean pristine resolution, cinematic color grading, mannequin, stiff posture, frozen face, pants covering shoes, pants overlapping sneakers, hidden footwear, hidden sneakers, dragging pant hem, covered ankles, beard, mustache, stubble, facial hair, body hair, professional lighting, slow motion.

entries.title: Shopping Mall Commercial Dance MV
entries.description: A complex multi-character video prompt for Seedance 2.5 that creates a 30-second shopping mall commercial featuring three distinct dancers performing Capoeira, Idol Dance, and Breaking as part of a coordinated flash mob.
entries.prompt:
@Image1=I1
@Image2=I2
@Image3=I3

将I1中的角色设定资料定义为<A>。即使I1内部包含同一人物的多个视角、表情、局部细节或服装展示，也全部理解为同一个角色的设计资料，绝不能拆成多个不同人物。<A>的脸、发型、体型、服装主结构、配色与角色身份只参考I1。

将I2中的角色设定资料定义为<B>。即使I2内部包含同一人物的多个视角、表情、局部细节或服装展示，也全部理解为同一个角色的设计资料，绝不能拆成多个不同人物。<B>的脸、发型、体型、服装主结构、配色与角色身份只参考I2。

将I3中的角色设定资料定义为<C>。即使I3内部包含同一人物的多个视角、表情、局部细节或服装展示，也全部理解为同一个角色的设计资料，绝不能拆成多个不同人物。<C>的脸、发型、体型、服装主结构、配色与角色身份只参考I3。

<A>、<B>、<C>从第一帧到最后一帧始终是三个不同的人，不能换脸，不能换衣，不能互相复制，不能把背景群众变成三位主角的复制体。整个30秒始终发生在同一个大型现代购物中心中央中庭，不切换到舞台、街头、摄影棚或其他建筑。

【生成目标】
生成一支30秒高密度购物中心品牌形象CM。前27秒几乎完全表现成高规格Dance MV与公共Flash Mob事件，27秒时舞蹈本篇明确结束，27-30秒突然进入极其正规、明亮、白々しい商业广告收尾。核心不是三个彼此隔绝的solo，而是三位主角共同完成一支角色分工明确、彼此呼应、但几乎不做整齐同步的群体编舞。

A负责Flow / Orbit：Capoeira，负责流动、环绕、回避、圆周运动与空间连接。
B负责Center / Hook：轻盈现代Idol Dance为主体，加入Waacking大臂线与极少量Popping强拍点缀，负责可读hook、群众模仿与中心引导。
C负责Power / Punctuation：Breaking，负责地板层、rotation、power move与乐句强拍收束。

三人通过call and response、canon时间差接力、layered choreography合作。观众必须看出他们是在一起完成一支舞，但不是整齐同步团舞。

0-9秒建立三位主角与角色差异。
9秒开始第一波Flash Mob。
15秒以后群众规模继续扩大。
18秒以后扶梯与二层人群明显加入。
24-27秒达到最大高潮。
27秒之后所有舞蹈停止，进入购物中心CM结尾。

【空间与构图】
使用宽阔横向空间与建筑纵深，不要长期把三人挤在画面中央。

第一帧布局明确：
A位于左前区域。
B位于中央稍后区域。
C位于右前区域。

A主要使用左侧与左中区域，允许斜向穿行和圆弧路线。
B保持中央视觉锚点，拥有完整双臂展开空间。
C主要使用右侧与右中宽阔地板区域，保证windmill、flare、swipe、backspin等power move有完整旋转半径。

背景是现代大型购物中心中央中庭：挑高玻璃天窗、开放式二层与三层回廊、玻璃栏杆、多组自动扶梯、浅色石材地面、咖啡休息区、长椅、室内植物、无明确品牌的商铺外立面。环境明亮、通透、具有真实大型商业设施尺度，玻璃、金属与石材具有自然反射。背景始终有普通购物顾客、情侣、朋友、家庭、独行者、咖啡区顾客、扶梯乘客和二层围观者。

镜头移动时尽量保持至少两位主角同框，并多次实现三人同框。后半群众大幅增加时，也不能让A、B、C消失在Flash Mob中。

【A｜Flow / Orbit｜Capoeira】
A只跳Capoeira，明显偏向Capoeira Regional表演感。A的全部动作必须建立在持续可见的ginga基础上。A不是做几个Capoeira招式的杂技舞者，而是从头到尾维持Capoeira独有的身体节奏：身体略微前倾，左右非对称交换重心，膝部保持弹性，一只手经常自然保护脸部与上身，另一只手辅助平衡，身体持续摇摆。每次大型动作后都重新回到ginga，不站直等待下一招。

A始终面向斜前方的虚拟对手方向，通过feint、esquiva、ginga与圆形腿部轨迹形成问答感，但不与B或C真实对抗。

主要动作语言：
ginga
feint
esquiva
queixada
armada
negativa
rolê
meia lua de compasso
au
低位重心转换
圆形腿部轨迹
横向与斜向连续移动

推荐连接逻辑：
ginga → feint → esquiva → ginga → queixada / armada → ginga → negativa → rolê → ginga → meia lua de compasso → 恢复ginga

au只用于短暂方向转换，不连续堆叠，不把A变成体操或tricking。A的视觉核心是流动、躲闪、欺骗性、圆周、重心交换与身体弹性。

A的beat sync方式不是机械打点。拍间由ginga与rolê持续流动，弱拍用于feint或esquiva，强拍由圆形腿法顶点、au落地、重心着地或ginga方向切换完成。

【B｜Center / Hook｜Idol Dance + Waacking accents + light Popping accents】
B是整支群舞的中央核心与群众引导者。

B以现代、轻盈、明亮、柔和、松弛而富有亲和力的Idol Dance为主体。整体具有轻微甜美感与自然可爱感，但不过度卖萌、不幼稚。重点是容易读、容易记、容易被普通人模仿。Waacking负责扩大视觉轮廓，Popping只保留为极少量强拍点缀。

主体动作：
轻快step-touch
柔和但明确的上身律动
开肩
双臂向外展开
简洁转身
可记忆的hook手势
单手上举或指向
左右对称arm sweep
轻量idol dance footwork
轻快bounce
半圈或一圈转体

Waacking accents：
大幅arm circle
绕头轨迹
翻腕
肩部驱动臂线
短pose变化

Popping accents只允许少量：
hit
tick
dime stop
短body accent

不要让B重新变成Popping solo。Popping只用于强拍钉住节奏。

B必须建立一套可传播的hook motif：
step-touch → 双臂展开 → 开肩 → 单手上举或指向 → 半圈转体 → arm sweep → 拍手或短hit

0-9秒由B反复变形展示这个hook。
9秒以后Flash Mob主要复制其简化版。
B不是动作最困难的人，而是整座商场最容易被观众记住、最容易带起集体舞的人。

B的beat sync最直接：
step-touch对应主拍。
arm sweep穿过拍间。
短hit / dime stop对应kick或snare强拍。

【C｜Power / Punctuation｜Breaking】
C只跳Breaking，并明显强化rotation与power move。

toprock、drop、six-step、CC、kick-out和普通footwork存在，但主要用于连接与进入power move。

核心动作：
windmill
flare
swipe
backspin
短促可控的headspin
低位高速footwork
one-arm freeze
baby freeze
power transition
旋转进入freeze

每一段power move遵循：
进入旋转 → 形成一种清楚的主要power move → 保持足够时间让动作可读 → 平稳退出 → freeze或稳定支撑

不要同一瞬间塞入所有power move。
前段以backspin / windmill建立。
中段增加flare。
后段增加swipe、windmill、flare与短controlled headspin组合。
终盘做最强power combo并以freeze结束。

C不是一直抢中心，而是在音乐乐句末尾从地板层打出巨大标点。B给出hook，A让空间流动，C负责把段落砸在地板上。

C的beat sync方式：
power move在2-4拍中持续。
强拍进入或退出。
重要乐句终点用freeze锁住。
不要一拍换一个大技。

【三人编舞关系】
1. Call and Response
B先给出清楚hook，A用Capoeira圆形运动回应，C再用地板power move收束。

2. Canon
相同音乐意图按照B → A → C形成时间差接力，不复制同一动作，而是依次用三种身体语言回答同一个节拍。

3. Layered Choreography
同一时刻A横向流动，B中央展示hook，C地板旋转，三人动作不同但音乐关系一致。

4. Shared Final Accent
只在少数巨大重拍上三人同时收束：
A = ginga落点或圆周动作落地
B = hook pose / dime stop
C = freeze

少量同步终点比全程同步更重要。

【音乐与声音】
整体音乐明确为：
idol-friendly Brazilian breakbeat funk / dance-pop hybrid

必须同时满足：
B可以成立为明亮易懂的center / hook dancer。
C有足够强的breakbeat和低频支撑power move。
A通过Brazilian percussion和轻微Capoeira音乐纹理获得风格支撑。
Flash Mob容易在后半加入。
整体仍具有大型商业广告可接受的明亮、爽朗与上口感。

音色结构：
明亮上口的dance-pop主框架
清楚有力的kick与snare
funk bass groove
breakbeat骨架
轻微berimbau-like metallic pulse
轻微pandeiro-like syncopation
clap层
女性日语主唱

女性主唱明确为日语歌唱，不指定固定歌词文本，只要求现代、明亮、节奏感强、hook清楚、略带偶像感但不过分甜腻。不是旁白，不是朗读。

0-9秒：
舞曲 + 女性日语主唱为主。

9秒以后逐步加入：
<Beatbox低鼓>
<Beatbox军鼓>
<Beatbox hi-hat>
<多人拍手>
<A Cappella低声部>
<A Cappella中声部>
<A Cappella高声部>
<群众短促呼应>
<现场欢呼>
<鞋底与石材地面的节奏声>
<商场自然混响>

这些声音像群众自己现场制造，不是纯电子音效。

15秒以后Beatbox与A Cappella增强。
18秒以后更多群众参与和声与拍手。
24-27秒达到最大高潮。
At 27 seconds，主舞曲、Beatbox、A Cappella与群众拍手快速而干净地收束，为CM ending腾出空间。

【镜头总原则】
镜头持续主动工作，但不狂乱摇晃。每个镜头只承担一种主要运镜。动作可读性优先于炫技摄影。

拍A时完整显示腿部圆弧、ginga与低位重心变化。
拍B时完整显示双臂、hook手势和中央存在感。
拍C时完整显示地板、支撑手、腿部圆周、旋转轴与freeze。

前半以三人关系为核心。
后半通过crane、pull-back、orbit与宽景逐步扩大群众规模。
不要用长时间单人特写破坏群舞结构。

【镜头1｜0.0-3.0秒｜空间建立】
运镜：中庭外围中高机位稳定前推。

第一帧已经显示完整中庭、回廊、扶梯、自然顾客流动与三位主角。

A左侧以ginga进入，接feint、esquiva，再回到ginga，随后出现第一条圆形腿部轨迹。
B中央展示第一版hook motif：
step-touch → 双臂展开 → 开肩 → 单手上举 → 半圈转体 → 短hit
C右侧以toprock进入，快速drop，短footwork后进入backspin或短rotation。

三人从第一秒就拥有完全不同身体语言，但明显共享同一首音乐。
背景顾客继续购物、聊天、经过、休息，只有少数人开始注意。

【镜头2｜3.0-6.0秒｜横向Tracking】
运镜：沿三人前方平滑横向tracking，从A移动到C。

A：
ginga → queixada → 重心切换 → rolê → ginga
B：
step-touch → arm sweep → 开肩 → 转身 → Waacking arm circle → 短dime stop
C：
footwork → windmill → 低位稳定支撑

横移时尽量让其他两人仍存在于中远景。三人不是轮流solo，而是同时在同一空间运行。

【镜头3｜6.0-9.0秒｜Call and Response】
运镜：围绕三角区域进行单方向半圆orbit。

B先给出更明确hook phrase：
双臂展开 → 单手指向 → 转身 → 短pose
A随后回应：
ginga → esquiva → meia lua de compasso → ginga
C最后回应：
低位进入flare → 维持清楚圆周 → 退出freeze

背景开始积聚围观者。有人停下，有人笑，有人零散拍手，二层也有人向下看。正式Flash Mob尚未开始。

【镜头4｜9.0-12.0秒｜第一波Flash Mob】
At 9 seconds, on a strong musical downbeat, the first background group joins B’s hook motif.

运镜：摄影机缓慢升高并向后拉开。

中央后方和左右通道第一批顾客开始复制B的简化hook：
step-touch
双臂展开
肩部bounce
简单转向
拍手
单手上举
左右重心交换

A继续Capoeira，从群舞前方与侧翼形成横向流线。
B中央继续明确带队，用清楚hook加少量Waacking arm circle。
C右侧从footwork进入windmill，并连接短backspin。

声音第一次加入Beatbox低鼓、军鼓、多人拍手与A Cappella低声部。

【镜头5｜12.0-15.0秒｜第一段群舞高潮】
运镜：沿中庭进行单方向弧形移动。

A：
ginga连续换边 → esquiva → 圆弧腿法 → au → rolê → ginga
B：
step-touch → arm sweep → 开肩 → 转身 → 大臂线 → 拍手 → 短hit
群众主要跟随B的简化动作。
C：
flare → 短controlled headspin或backspin → freeze

Flash Mob向咖啡区、扶梯口与后方走道扩散。二层开始更整齐拍手。Beatbox hi-hat与A Cappella中高声部加入。

【镜头6｜15.0-18.0秒｜Breakdown与B带队】
At 15 seconds, the music briefly strips back to percussion, bass groove, vocal hook and human rhythm layers.

运镜：从三人宽景稳定push-in到B附近，但仍保留A与C在两侧。

B把hook motif做得最大、最简单、最像现场教学：
step-touch → 胸前拍节拍 → 单手指向外侧 → 双臂展开 → 开肩 → 柔和转体

更多普通顾客学会这套动作。

A在B左侧外围以ginga、esquiva、negativa、rolê持续绕行，像围绕中心hook画出运动轨道。
C暂时降低power move强度，以低位footwork、CC和短freeze为下一段蓄力。
此段群众与B的关系最清楚。

【镜头7｜18.0-21.0秒｜第二波Flash Mob扩张】
运镜：摄影机crane up，展示地面层、扶梯层与二层。

第二波群众正式加入。原本只围观的二层人物开始拍手、bounce与简化挥臂。扶梯上的人以上半身动作参与。地面群众明显增加。

A：
ginga → queixada → armada → ginga，在左侧与左中横向穿行
B：
center hook → 双臂外展 → Waacking arm circle点缀 → 半圈转体 → 单手高举 → 短hit
C：
swipe → windmill → freeze

A Cappella三层和声更完整。现场欢呼明显增强。

【镜头8｜21.0-24.0秒｜Canon大接力】
运镜：围绕中庭中心进行较大的单方向orbit。

B先给出一组完整 hook phrase。
A随后以ginga加速、esquiva和大圆弧腿法回应。
C最后以power rotation和freeze收束。

下一小节，背景群众整体复制B的简化hook phrase，形成：
B → A → C → Flash Mob
的连锁反应。

地面、扶梯、二层、远处走道同时活跃。保留少数只围观的人，让场景仍像真实公共空间。

【镜头9｜24.0-27.0秒｜最大规模与Dance MV最终高潮】
运镜：从较远的大宽景开始缓慢向前推进，逐步收紧到三位主角和大规模Flash Mob同时清楚可读的高潮构图。

Flash Mob达到最大规模。

地面层形成多个小群体共同跟随B的hook。
扶梯和二层以拍手、bounce与简化arm sweep参与。
远处走道的人也开始加入。

A在左侧前景完成最流畅的一组Capoeira组合：
ginga加速 → esquiva → 巨大圆弧腿法 → au或rolê → 回到ginga落点

B位于中央，完成最大center hook：
step-touch → 最大幅度双臂展开 → hook手势 → 半圈转体 → Waacking臂线放大 → 短dime stop

C在右侧执行最强power combo：
短footwork → windmill → flare → 短backspin或controlled headspin → 最终freeze

声音达到全片最大热量：
女性日语主唱

At 27 seconds, on the final strong musical downbeat：

整个Flash Mob同时完成一次巨大拍手与身体重拍。

这里就是舞蹈本篇的正式结束点。27秒以后不再继续任何复杂舞蹈。

entries.translated_prompt:
Define the character setting data in I1 as <A>. Even if I1 contains multiple perspectives, expressions, or clothing details of the same person, understand them all as design data for the same character. <A>'s face, hairstyle, body type, clothing structure, color scheme, and identity refer only to I1.

Define the character setting data in I2 as <B>. (Same character consistency rule as above) <B>'s features refer only to I2.

Define the character setting data in I3 as <C>. (Same character consistency rule as above) <C>'s features refer only to I3.

<A>, <B>, and <C> must be three different people from start to finish. No face-swapping, no clothing changes, no mutual copying, and background crowds must not become copies of the three protagonists. The entire 30 seconds takes place in the central atrium of a large modern shopping mall; do not switch to a stage, street, studio, or other buildings.

[Generation Goal]
Generate a 30-second high-density shopping mall brand image commercial. The first 27 seconds play out as a high-spec Dance MV and public Flash Mob. At 27 seconds, the dance officially ends, and from 27-30 seconds, it abruptly transitions into a formal, bright, and overtly clean commercial outro. The core is not three isolated solos, but three protagonists completing a group choreography with clear roles that respond to each other, though rarely in unison.

A: Flow / Orbit: Capoeira. Responsible for flow, circling, evasion, circular movement, and spatial connection.
B: Center / Hook: Light modern Idol Dance as the base, adding Waacking arm lines and minimal Popping accents. Responsible for the readable hook, leading the crowd, and center guidance.
C: Power / Punctuation: Breaking. Responsible for floor work, rotations, power moves, and punctuating musical phrases.

The three collaborate via call and response, canon timing, and layered choreography. The audience must see they are dancing together, but not in a synchronized idol group style.

Timeline:
0-9s: Establish character differences.
9s: First wave of Flash Mob starts.
15s+: Crowd size expands.
18s+: Escalators and 2nd-floor crowds join in.
24-27s: Peak climax.
27s+: All dancing stops; enter mall CM ending.

[Space and Composition]
Use wide horizontal space and architectural depth; don't crowd the three in the center for long.

Initial Layout:
A: Front-left area.
B: Center-rear area.
C: Front-right area.

A uses left/mid-left zones with diagonal and circular paths. B stays as the visual anchor with full arm span space. C uses the right/mid-right floor area, ensuring enough radius for windmills, flares, and power moves.

Background: Modern mall atrium with glass skylights, open galleries, escalators, stone floors, cafe areas, and plants. Bright, transparent, and realistic scale with natural reflections. Populate with shoppers, couples, families, and bystanders.

[Detailed Movement Styles]
- A (Capoeira): Movements must be based on a visible 'ginga' step. Not just acrobatic tricks, but a continuous rhythmic sway. Uses feints and circular kicks to create a 'dialogue' with the environment.
- B (Idol/Waacking): Soft, approachable Idol dance for easy crowd imitation. Waacking expands the visual silhouette. Popping is used sparingly for beat hits. B provides the 'hook motif' that the flash mob eventually copies.
- C (Breaking): Rotation-focused. Toprock and footwork serve as transitions into power moves (windmill, flare, backspin). Ends phrases with clear freezes.

[Music and Sound]
Style: Idol-friendly Brazilian breakbeat funk / dance-pop hybrid. Features bright dance-pop frame, funk bass, and Japanese female vocals. From 9s onwards, add human rhythmic layers like beatboxing, clapping, and a cappella harmonies as if generated by the crowd.

[Camera Principles]
Active but stable. Prioritize readability over flashy camera tricks. Show A's full leg arcs, B's arm gestures, and C's floor rotations clearly. Use cranes and orbits to capture the expanding crowd scale in the second half.

[Shot Breakdown (1-10)]
(Detailed descriptions of 10 shots covering the progression from intro to the 27-second climax, including specific dance moves for each character and the synchronized final accent at 27 seconds where the music stops for the commercial outro.)

entries.prompt:
A cinematic slow-motion sequence inside a busy professional restaurant kitchen at night. A young female @[Image 1](image_1) chef in her early 20s with freckles, light blonde hair pulled back in a neat bun, wearing a pristine white double-breasted chef’s coat, walks forward through the chaotic kitchen holding a large white ceramic plate with both hands. The plate holds a perfectly plated dish: two slices of medium-rare steak with pink centers, golden roasted potatoes, colorful root vegetables, microgreens, and a vibrant orange sauce.
Steam rises, blue gas flames flare under copper pots, other chefs in white coats move busily in the background under industrial stainless-steel hoods and hanging copper pans. As she walks, the food suddenly lifts off the plate in elegant zero-gravity slow motion. Impact is sudden and physical.
[Dynamic Tracking into Super Slow-Motion] Collision detonates. steak slices, potatoes, sauce droplets, and greens float explode upward. Camera orbits smoothly around the impact. Time locks completely at the peak of the spill. Every face freezes in pure shock. Only the girl remains free to move. She freezes for one beat with a clear "I fucked up" expression, — above the empty plate while she looks up in wide-eyed shock.
The food then gracefully settles back into perfect arrangement on the plate. She continues walking and presents the restored dish across a stainless-steel pass to a stern older male head chef (bald, white chef’s coat) standing under copper pendant lights. He inspects it closely, then points at the plate and says in a firm voice: “It’s a go.”
The young chef’s face softens with relief and quiet pride as she looks at the finished plate.
Highly detailed, photorealistic, dramatic kitchen lighting with warm copper highlights and cool stainless tones, shallow depth of field, cinematic camera tracking and slow-motion, 24fps film look, anamorphic lens.

entries.title: VFX K-Pop Dance Performance
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for a 30-second K-pop dance video with customized VFX trails (ink, paint, pixel) and precise lip-sync for Japanese dialogue.
entries.prompt:
spoken_language: Japanese
motion: 通常速度、高密度、60fps相当の滑らかな時間解像感

【参照素材】
R1@image1＝人物＋全身衣装の唯一参照。顔、肌、瞳、髪、髪飾り、身体比率、性別表現、年齢印象、衣装、装飾、アクセサリー、靴、素材、色、丈を取得し、30秒間同一人物・同一衣装を維持。R1が男性なら男性、女性なら女性として扱い、外見・骨格・体格・表情・所所作・声質をR1へ自動適応する。性別を固定指定せず、R1から自然に判定する。背景、照明、構図、静止ポーズは継承しない。
R2@image2＝舞台、建築、床、壁、天井、遠景、家具、装飾、小道具、環境光、時間帯、色温度、空間配置を参照。存在しない構造や人物を追加しない。

【完成映像】
R1の成人人物がR2の実写空間で行う高密度K-POP performance。振付、速度、footwork、waacking、body isolation、shoulder hit、chest accent、pivot、turn、travelingを維持。VFXはR1の主要色、髪色、衣装色を解析し、各動作ごとにINK、PAINTERLY、PIXELからランダムに1種だけ出現。黒固定にせず、腕、手首、指先、足、pivot、turn、travelingを0.15～0.7秒遅れて追う。胸部・胴体前面を発生源にしない。

【音楽・歌・声】
128 BPM、bright rhythmic K-POP × hip-hop。tight kick、punchy bass、crisp snare、closed hi-hat、funky synth、plucked synth、short brass、keyboard。shoulder hit＝snare、heel-toe/cross＝kick＋hat、wrist snap＝dry click、waacking＝synth sweep、pivot＝bass pickup、turn＝高速hat roll＋reverse synth、着地＝kick＋bass。00～03秒bass pulse＋percussion motif、03秒full beat、15.5秒hat＋bass増加、24秒final build。EDM drop、長いbreak、テンポ変更なし。
主人公の歌声と通常声はR1の人物像へ自動適応。R1が男性的なら自然な成人男性域、女性的なら自然な成人女性域、それ以外もR1の外見・年齢印象・キャラクター性に最も自然な声域、音色、話し方へ合わせる。別人の声にしない。
00.0～30.0秒、音楽の歌唱パートは主人公が最初から最後まで継続して正確にLip Syncする。歌詞の各音節、母音、子音、口・唇・顎の動きを歌唱音声へ同期し、ダンス中も歌の口パクを止めない。ただし三台詞の指定区間だけ歌唱Lip Syncを完全停止し、その区間では歌詞を発音せず、主人公の台詞だけを一度発話する。台詞終了直後から次の歌詞位置へ自然に復帰し、歌唱Lip Syncを再開。台詞中の音楽はinstrumentalのみで、歌声を重ねない。三台詞の復唱、追加台詞、英訳、字幕なし。

【VFX】
R1から目立つ2～4色を抽出。INK＝半透明liquid ink、wet pigment、calligraphy streak。PAINTERLY＝dry-brush、paint ribbon。PIXEL＝小色ブロック、pixel trail、dither cluster。3種類を重ねず動作ごとにランダム切替。肩hit＝肩外側、waacking/arm sweep＝腕後方、heel-toe＝床接地点、cross＝足元間、pivot＝支点足周囲、turn＝身体外周、finger wave＝指先後方。body wave、chest hit、contract、releaseにはVFXなし。顔、胸、胴体前面へ重ねない。

【30秒タイムライン】

00.0–03.0｜50mm medium close、左寄り。00.8瞳だけカメラへ。01.1片手を顎下、手首を返す。01.35–02.70だけ歌唱Lip Syncを止め「ねえ……月が隠れるまで、遊ばない？」を一度だけ発話し日本語音素へ完全同期。02.70で口を閉じ、復唱せず直後から歌唱Lip Syncへ復帰。最後の「い？」で右踵を上げ02.8 kick着地、足元へ極小ランダムVFX。

03.0–06.0｜35mm全身。03.0右踵着地＋右肩hit、03.3左肩hit、03.6胸郭left→front→right isolation。04.0右足cross、左手を顔横、右腕低い対角線。04.4両手首反転→waacking circle。04.9半回転、顔を先にカメラへ。05.3左足横、右足引寄せ、05.7chest hit。肩、waacking、turnへランダムVFX。胴体動作には出さない。歌唱Lip Sync継続。

06.0–09.0｜06.0 right step＋left wrist snap、06.4 left step＋right shoulder、06.8腕cross→解放。07.1 heel→toe→cross。0.4秒だけ膝高斜め正面で脚・靴・衣装下部と顔を同一構図。07.7 body wave、08.1右45度pivot、08.5肩right→left→both、08.8顎を2cm上げ瞳だけカメラへ。footwork、pivot、肩へランダムVFX。歌唱Lip Sync継続。

09.0–12.5｜左へtraveling、カメラ右後方。09.0 cross、09.4胸郭右、09.8非対称vogue geometry、10.1解放。10.4 right-left高速前進、10.9左手頭上、右人差し指をレンズへ。11.2指先を約3cm前で停止、顔と瞳は明瞭。11.4口角を僅かに上げ、11.6指を横へ引き右腕→左腕→両腕waacking。12.2chest hit、12.5後退step。腕、前進、指先、waackingへランダムVFX。歌唱Lip Sync継続。

12.5–15.5｜カメラ左側を横切りstep→cross→肩前後hit。13.35–14.65だけ歌唱Lip Syncを止め、顔をカメラへ向け「その目、まだ私だけにして。」を一度だけ発話し完全同期。14.65で終了し復唱せず歌唱Lip Syncへ即復帰。足とgrooveは止めない。14.7首を約7度傾け、15.0両腕内cross→外、15.2正面。台詞中VFXは足元のみ、15.0腕軌道へ1種。

15.5–19.0｜15.5右足前＋left shoulder、15.8左足横＋right shoulder、16.1 back tap＋chest contract、16.4release。

一支由朋友拍摄、跟随主角一整天的写实手持旅行Vlog。以参考图中的女性作为主要拍摄对象。在整个视频中保持她完全一致的面部特征、发型、五官和身体比例。

镜头感要像真实的个人Vlog相机，而非商业大片制作。自然的手持运镜、随意的构图、不完美的人为镜头晃动、真实的日常氛围。没有剧本式的表演。该女性表现自然，像真实的旅行Vlog一样与环境互动。

0-5秒：清晨出发
这位女性背着小背包离开温馨的公寓。她看了看手机，对着镜头微笑，整理了一下头发，然后开始向外走。镜头从背后跟拍，像朋友拍摄一样有轻微晃动。清晨的阳光，安静的街区，人们开始新的一天。

5-12秒：探索城市
镜头跟随她穿梭在当地街道上。她走进一家小咖啡馆，买了一杯饮料，对着镜头简单说了几句话，自然地笑了起来。她穿过街头市场，看着小商店，随意地拍照。镜头保持近距离，捕捉自然发生的瞬间。

12-20秒：抵达海滩
她乘坐公共交通或步行前往海岸。环境逐渐从城市街道过渡到海滨小镇。海风吹动着她的头发。当她看到大海时，显得很兴奋。镜头跟随她沿着海滩漫步。她捡起一枚贝壳，看着海浪，并与附近的人自然互动。

20-27秒：夏日海滩的午后
她在海滩上与朋友汇合。大家在水边聊天、大笑、玩耍。镜头在人群中自然穿梭，捕捉真实的抓拍瞬间。她回头看向镜头并微笑着。

27-30秒：结尾时刻
黄金时刻的日落。她坐在海边，拿着一杯饮料，看着夕阳。镜头缓慢后退，展现出海滩、海浪和宁静的傍晚。营造出一种真实的个人旅行记忆感。

视觉风格：
真实的旅行Vlog素材感。
逼真的智能手机或微单相机画质。
自然日光。
随性的手持运镜。
轻微的镜头晃动。
真实的人物反应。
纪录片般的写实主义。
无电影级的商业大片感。
无戏剧化的刻意摆拍。
无生硬的人工转场。
无文字叠加。
无Logo水印。
不改变面部。
不改变人物身份。

A tiny, adorable brown ant walks through a beautiful forest floor carrying a tiny red berry. Suddenly, a huge raindrop crashes beside him. He looks up in shock as heavy rain begins falling.

The ant notices a small green caterpillar curled up beneath a broken leaf, trembling as rainwater slowly floods around him. The ant drops his berry and rushes toward him.

entries.title: Hi8 Analogue Home Video Errand
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a nostalgic 15-second Hi8/VHS-C style video of a young woman on a rainy afternoon errand, focusing on realistic analogue artifacts and casual atmosphere.
entries.prompt:

Create an authentic 15-second analogue home-video recording filmed with a handheld Hi8/VHS-C camcorder. The camcorder is never visible. The audience only sees the recorded footage, as if watching a digitized family videotape. This is not a vlog, commercial, or cinematic production—just a friend casually filming another friend during an ordinary day.
Use authentic analogue camcorder aesthetics: soft SD resolution, subtle VHS tape grain, faint interlacing, analogue colour bleed, mild tracking imperfections, slight autofocus hunting, natural handheld shake, tiny framing errors, realistic motion blur, washed-out colours, and faint tape hiss. A young Korean woman in her early twenties wears a fitted pastel crop top, mid-rise vintage blue denim shorts, white ankle socks, classic white sneakers, and a lightweight oversized windbreaker tied around her waist. She carries a small canvas shoulder bag, and her appearance reflects a nostalgic late-90s/early-2000s Korean street style without referencing any specific year.
The scene takes place on a quiet residential street after a light summer rain. The pavement is still damp, small puddles reflect nearby buildings, bicycles are parked outside shops, neighbours walk by with umbrellas, and local cafés and convenience stores create a peaceful everyday atmosphere.
The footage begins as she exits a small neighbourhood convenience store carrying a drink and a paper shopping bag. She pauses under the awning, looks up at the cloudy sky, and smiles as a light drizzle begins again. She playfully extends her hand to feel a few raindrops before noticing the unseen camera operator. She laughs, gives a friendly wave, briefly twirls once in the drizzle, then continues walking down the wet street. The camera follows naturally behind as reflections shimmer on the pavement and a city bus quietly passes in the background. The recording ends naturally as she disappears farther down the street.
Generation Requirements
Produce one continuous 15-second recording with no cuts or transitions. Maintain consistent identity, realistic anatomy, natural walking, authentic human expressions, believable interactions, and physically accurate rain effects. Include realistic ambient sounds such as soft rain, distant traffic, birds, footsteps on wet pavement, and neighbourhood ambience. Avoid AI artifacts, duplicated pedestrians, warped anatomy, floating objects, modern cinematic effects, or anything that reveals the footage as AI-generated. The final result should feel indistinguishable from a genuine nostalgic analogue home video recorded by a friend.

entries.title: One-Take Kaiju Monster Movie
entries.description: A complex 30-second continuous one-take prompt featuring a mecha kaiju summon and a battle against a biological monster at sunset, designed for a photorealistic monster movie aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
A 30-second continuous one-take shot, no cuts. Photorealistic kaiju movie, sunset light, 16:9. No on-screen text.

STARTING FRAME (given as first-frame image): a small human pilot stands frozen in a throwing stance, holding a small metal capsule, beside a fallen 70m wolf-type kaiju in a ruined street at sunset. The video continues seamlessly from this exact frame.

CHARACTERS:
[PILOT] a small human in a plain matte-black flight suit. The suit does NOT glow.
[MECHA KAIJU] a 100m mechanical war-machine kaiju: matte gunmetal armor with riveted plates, hydraulic joints, two legs, massive fists, a heavy metal tail, a violet reactor core in its chest, eyes dark until ignition. Clearly a machine, but an original design.
[ENEMY] a 120m kaiju of flesh and blood — a horned, black-scaled reptilian titan with glowing orange eyes. A living animal: NO metal, NO armor plates, NO robot parts. The same individual as in the reference image.

0–4s: The PILOT hurls the capsule high into the sky. The camera follows its glowing arc up against the sunset clouds. At its peak the capsule bursts into a sphere of violet light.

4–10s: Out of the light the MECHA KAIJU drops and lands in the street with a massive shockwave, kneeling, dormant, eyes dark — a colossal silent machine towering over the tiny pilot.

10–14s: Its chest plate opens with white light. The PILOT's body dissolves into streams of violet energy that flow up into the open chest; the plate seals; the reactor core and both eyes ignite violet, and the machine rises to its feet.

14–22s: Drawn by the light and the shockwave, the ENEMY comes storming back through the smoke, furious. The MECHA KAIJU meets the charge: it catches the titan and hurls it through a row of buildings — spectacular, beautiful destruction, glass and debris glittering in the sunset. The ENEMY rises from the rubble, cracked but unbroken, angrier than before.

22–30s: Both titans charge and LOCK together in a grappling deadlock — claws clasped against metal fists, foreheads almost touching, feet plowing trenches through the asphalt, surrounding buildings crumbling from the strain, a ring of dust expanding around them. The camera pulls back wide and HOLDS on the two locked silhouettes against the blazing sunset until the very end. Final frame: the two titans still locked, straining, no winner. The video ends on this deadlock.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic fitness video featuring my AI female model, preserving her exact facial identity, body proportions, hairstyle, and overall appearance throughout the entire video. She is wearing stylish, realistic black fitted gym leggings, a flattering fitted sports top, and clean training shoes.

0–7 seconds — Treadmill: She walks into a modern premium gym and begins running at a moderate pace on a treadmill. Use dynamic cinematic tracking shots from the side and front, showing realistic movement, natural breathing, focused facial expression, and subtle sweat. Include a brief close-up of her shoes moving on the treadmill.

7–14 seconds — Dumbbell workout: Transition smoothly to her performing controlled dumbbell exercises, such as dumbbell squats and shoulder presses. Show proper gym form, realistic muscle engagement, natural movement, and confident concentration. Use a mixture of medium shots and close-ups of the dumbbells and her movements.

14–23 seconds — Glute/hip workout: Show her performing a glute-focused lower-body workout, including controlled hip thrusts/glute bridges and cable or resistance-band kickbacks. Emphasize proper form, controlled repetitions, realistic muscle movement, and athletic training rather than exaggerated body proportions. Use cinematic side and three-quarter camera angles.

23–30 seconds — Final sequence: She finishes with a few controlled walking lunges or Romanian dumbbell deadlifts, then stands upright, catches her breath, takes a sip of water, and looks confidently toward the camera. End with a cinematic wide shot of her in the modern gym.

Visual style: ultra-photorealistic, premium fitness commercial, realistic human motion, natural anatomy, authentic gym environment, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movement, realistic sweat and fabric physics, detailed skin texture, high-end professional fitness photography, seamless transitions, 4K, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no glitches, no duplicated limbs, no identity changes.

entries.title: Late Night Kitchen Phone Recording
entries.description: A realistic 30-second smartphone vlog prompt featuring an everyday late-night cooking scene with natural lighting and audio.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 30-second horizontal 16:9 realistic smartphone video.

Create an authentic, imperfect everyday late-night kitchen phone recording, as if a friend casually left a phone recording on the counter. Use a standard smartphone camera with mild autofocus hunting, subtle exposure shifts, natural motion blur, compression artifacts, and slightly uneven handheld framing. No polished commercial look.

00–05s — WALKING IN

The character walks into a quiet home kitchen carrying a small grocery bag. They set it on the counter, sigh quietly, and pull out a few simple ingredients.

They glance at the phone for a second before turning back toward the counter.

Camera remains several feet away at counter height, as if casually recording from a nearby surface.

05–10s — GETTING STARTED

They wash their hands, turn on the kitchen light, and begin preparing the ingredients.

A cutting board shifts slightly against the counter. They pause to move it into a better position.

The character looks tired but relaxed, occasionally brushing their hair away from their forehead.

10–15s — COOKING

They place a pan on the stove and begin cooking.

Steam gradually becomes visible. The phone autofocus briefly shifts between the character and the foreground pan before settling again.

They stir the food, taste a tiny amount, think for a moment, then add a little more seasoning.

No readable labels or packaging should be visible.

15–20s — SMALL MISTAKE

The character gets distracted for a moment and notices the food starting to cook more quickly than expected.

They immediately lower the heat and give a small amused shake of their head.

They quietly mutter something like:

“Yeah… almost forgot about that.”

The delivery should feel spontaneous and understated.

20–25s — FINISHING

They finish preparing the food, turn off the stove, and carefully transfer the meal onto a plate.

They wipe a small splash from the counter with a paper towel.

Natural movements only—nothing overly choreographed.

25–30s — QUIET ENDING

They sit at the kitchen table with the finished meal.

They take one bite, pause, and give a small satisfied smile.

They look toward the phone and quietly say:

“Honestly… not bad.”

They pick up the fork again and continue eating as the camera keeps recording for another moment before the clip naturally ends.

AUDIO

Natural kitchen ambience only: refrigerator hum, ventilation, running water, utensil sounds, pan sizzling, footsteps, clothing movement, cupboard and drawer sounds, plate and fork noises, and subtle room ambience.

No music.

Dialogue should sound spontaneous and conversational, with natural pauses and imperfect delivery.

VISUAL REALISM

Authentic smartphone footage, ordinary warm household lighting, realistic skin texture, natural shadows, mild phone-camera sharpening, subtle compression noise, imperfect exposure, slight autofocus changes, believable reflections, natural steam, realistic food textures

entries.title: 1950s Diner Time Freeze Rewind
entries.description: A cinematic 1950s diner sequence where time freezes during a coffee spill and then elegantly rewinds, while one character remains unaffected.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic 1950s American diner, chrome stools, red vinyl, neon glow and checkerboard floor, shot with modern lived-in realism and soft natural window light. Subtle handheld texture, warm practicals, rich period detail, heavy film grain.

0-4s: [Medium Wide] A striking young woman in her early 20s sits alone at the counter, calm and slightly amused, slowly sipping a tall thick milkshake through a straw. Behind her a young waitress in classic uniform approaches with a tray of eggs and bacon in one hand and a full glass coffee pot in the other. An older lady starts rising from a nearby booth.

4-8s: [Dynamic Tracking] The older lady collides hard into the waitress. Tray, plate, eggs, bacon and coffee pot explode upward in chaotic slow motion. Coffee erupts into long liquid ribbons and perfect suspended droplets. Camera immediately begins a smooth continuous orbit around the impact. Time locks completely at the peak of the spill. Every face freezes in pure shock. Only the girl at the counter keeps moving, completely unfazed.

8-17s: [Slow 360° Orbital] Camera glides in a full elegant orbit through the frozen diner. Coffee hangs in mid-air as glassy ribbons and spheres with perfect volume and surface tension. Bacon strips, eggs and the spinning tray float weightlessly. Patrons and waitress remain locked in startled expressions. The girl at the counter takes one slow, deliberate sip, eyes half-lidded, almost bored, while the entire frozen world (except her) begins an elegant reverse: every droplet, every piece of food and every person rewinds smoothly back to the exact starting positions.

17-24s: [Medium Shot] Rewind lands perfectly. Waitress stands balanced again with tray and coffee pot. The girl lifts her eyes, raises two fingers in a small casual gesture and softly calls the waitress by name. The waitress turns toward her just before the older lady begins to stand, completely avoiding the collision. A tiny private smile crosses the girl's face.

24-30s: [Extreme Close-Up] Hard cut to her face as she takes one last slow sip. Soft knowing smile, eyes almost closed in quiet satisfaction, like she has done this a hundred times. Shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh of the neon diner behind her.

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed fluid physics, perfect motion blur only on moving elements, stable characters, cinematic lighting, heavy natural film grain, no artifacts, movie-level temporal coherence, high rewatch value.
