entries.title: K-Pop Rehearsal Smartphone Vlog
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for a realistic K-pop dance rehearsal vlog filmed on a smartphone, focusing on physical accuracy and consistent character identity.
entries.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic 15-second behind-the-scenes vlog filmed by a young Korean woman on a modern flagship smartphone using the front-facing camera. She records herself throughout the rehearsal in a natural, spontaneous way. The phone itself should never be visible. Use realistic handheld movement, subtle smartphone stabilization, natural autofocus, exposure adaptation, authentic indoor audio, and occasional imperfect framing. It should look like genuine creator footage, not an AI-generated video or polished music video.
Character & Outfit
A Korean woman in her early 20s with long dark hair tied in a high ponytail, expressive eyes, natural glowing skin, and light stage makeup.
She wears a stylish fitted black athletic crop jacket over a white performance tank, relaxed charcoal cargo joggers, clean white dance sneakers, small hoop earrings, and a smartwatch. The outfit is fashionable but practical for intense choreography and remains consistent throughout.
Location
A professional K-pop dance studio with a large mirrored wall, polished wooden floor, ceiling speakers, bright neutral studio lighting, water bottles, towels, backpacks, and a few dancers preparing in the background.
Sequence
The video opens with her entering the studio while holding the phone toward herself.
"You guys asked what rehearsal actually looks like, so come with me."
She turns the camera toward the studio, briefly showing the dancers warming up and the mirrored room.
She returns to selfie view:
"We've been working on this part all morning."
Music starts. She places the phone on a stable studio shelf facing the mirror and performs a short, energetic choreography section with the other dancers. The choreography should have realistic footwork, synchronized movements, natural hair motion, and believable body mechanics.
She quickly picks up the phone afterward, slightly out of breath and smiling.
"Okay... that looked easier in my head."
She laughs, takes a sip of water, then turns the camera toward the dancers as they practice the same section once more.
She finishes with a quick smile toward the camera:
"Back to practice!"
She runs back into formation as the music starts again, and the recording ends naturally.
Realism Requirements
Maintain one consistent identity and outfit throughout. Make hands, faces, hair, reflections, shadows, feet, and dance movements physically accurate. The mirror must show correct synchronized reflections. Keep the studio layout and props consistent. No duplicated dancers, warped limbs, floating objects, sudden outfit changes, unnatural choreography, jump cuts, excessive camera movement, plastic skin, beauty filters, or impossible physics. Natural sweat and slightly heavier breathing after dancing are encouraged. The final result should look like a real Korean dance-rehearsal vlog captured casually on a smartphone.

entries.title: Realistic UGC Cleanser Review
entries.description: A detailed multi-sequence prompt for a 30-second continuous shot of a young woman unboxing and testing a facial cleanser in her apartment.
entries.prompt: 30s | 16:9 | Realistic UGC cleanser recommendation | strict one-take | natural smartphone footage Use the same young woman from the reference image throughout the entire video. She has a short black bob haircut, light natural makeup, real skin texture, a slim body, and natural proportions. Keep her face, hairstyle, outfit, and body proportions fully consistent in every second of the video. She must wear the same blue short-sleeve collared pajama top and matching blue pajama shorts from the reference image. The product is one facial cleanser. The key product behavior is: when mixed with water in her hands, it should create rich, fine, realistic white foam. The foam must be formed naturally through rubbing with wet hands, then applied onto the face. It must not appear as a visual effect or pop into existence. Scene A cozy, ordinary apartment with natural daylight. The video starts in the living room. Background includes a beige sofa, coffee table, floor lamp, green plants, and a few real everyday items. The girl sits cross-legged on a rug. In front of her is a plain kraft shipping box, and beside it is a small household pair of scissors. The bathroom is connected nearby and can be naturally walked into. Spatial continuity must feel real and uninterrupted. Camera style This must be one continuous take from start to finish. No cuts, no transitions, no hidden edits, no jump frames, no teleportation. It should feel like a friend is filming her on a phone. Use a natural smartphone wide-angle lens, with slight handheld shake, realistic autofocus and exposure changes. Do not make it feel like a polished commercial. No cinematic camera moves, no subtitles, no over-retouching, no plastic skin. The overall vibe: she just received a cleanser her friend recommended and casually filmed a real unboxing + first try. Sequence 0–3s | Opening Camera starts in the living room. She sits on the rug with the package in front of her, looks at camera, smiles naturally and says: “Okay, this finally came.” Then she looks down at the package. 3–8s | Unboxing She picks up the scissors, holds the box steady with one hand, and cuts through the top tape naturally while saying: “My friend has been telling me to try this cleanser.” She puts the scissors back down and opens the box with both hands. 8–12s | Product out She takes the cleanser out, looks at it briefly, then lifts it naturally toward the camera. No cutaway product close-up, only a slight camera lean-in. She says: “She literally swears by it.” Then smiles and says: “Let’s try it.” She prepares to stand up with the cleanser. 12–17s | Walk to bathroom She stands up naturally while holding the cleanser. The camera backs up and follows her continuously as she walks from the living room into the bathroom. She says while walking: “I haven’t even washed my face yet, so perfect timing.” 17–20s | Wet face At the sink, she places the cleanser beside the sink, turns on the tap, gathers water in her hands, and wets her face. Water must physically touch the skin. Natural droplets appear on hands and face. 20–23s | Foam up She picks up the cleanser, squeezes a small amount into her wet palm, puts the cleanser back down, adds a little water, and rubs both hands together. The foam must build gradually from a small amount into rich, fine white foam. 23–26s | Wash face She applies the foam to her face and massages her cheeks, nose, forehead, and chin naturally. Foam follows her hand movement realistically. Do not cover her eyes. Do not make the foam excessive or like shaving cream. She reacts with mild pleasant surprise and says: “Oh... this feels really nice.” 26–28s | Rinse off She leans toward the sink, uses clean water to rinse off the foam. The foam gradually disappears with water. Her face is revealed clean and naturally wet, with a few droplets still visible. 28–30s | Final reaction She lifts her head, gently touches her cheek, turns to the camera, smiles with a pleasantly surprised expression and says: “Okay... I get the hype.” Then she picks up the cleanser and shows it naturally, saying: “She was right.” End naturally. Critical continuity rules The whole action must happen in one real continuous shot: sitting in living room → pick up scissors → cut tape → put scissors down → open box → take out cleanser → show cleanser → stand up → walk to bathroom → place cleanser down → turn on water → wet face → squeeze cleanser into palm → add water → rub hands → foam forms → apply foam to face → massage → rinse off → touch face → pick up cleanser → share reaction. Must avoid No second cleanser. No product teleportation. No hairstyle change. No outfit change. No face change. No hand/finger deformities. No environment changes. No sudden dry/wet face continuity errors. No foam appearing from nowhere. No hidden cuts. Key story: friend strongly recommends it → package just arrived → she opens it immediately → walks straight to the bathroom → tries it right away → real foaming wash → genuinely likes how her skin feels. Natural, casual, relaxed, everyday American UGC tone.

entries.title: Viking in Modern America Comedy
entries.description: A hilarious buddy-comedy prompt about a corporate woman guiding a time-traveling Viking through a fast-food run, featuring precise timestamped actions.
entries.prompt:
A stressed young corporate woman leaving work late encounters a confused Viking warrior who has somehow appeared in modern-day America, then becomes his reluctant guide to fast food, shot as a cinematic fish-out-of-water buddy comedy with realistic nighttime photography and energetic multi-angle camera work.

0-4 seconds: Smooth backward tracking shot on a rainy downtown sidewalk. A 26-year-old woman in a beige trench coat, office clothes and white sneakers walks toward camera carrying a laptop bag and coffee.
Woman: "I swear, if one more thing happens tonight..."

4-7 seconds: Sudden whip-pan toward an alley as a violent blue-white flash erupts. Trash bags flutter outward from the shockwave. A huge Viking warrior with braided blond hair, fur cloak, leather armor and round wooden shield stumbles into the street coughing through smoke.
Viking: "MIDGARD?!"

7-11 seconds: Medium handheld reaction shot. The woman freezes. The Viking raises his axe suspiciously, then spots her coffee cup.
Woman: "Please tell me you're filming a commercial."
Viking: "What potion is that?"

11-15 seconds: Tight insert shot. She cautiously hands him the coffee. He takes one heroic gulp, immediately recoils from the heat, spraying coffee sideways.
Viking: "THE CUP ATTACKS!"
Woman bursts out laughing.

15-19 seconds: Side-mounted tracking shot from outside her small car as the enormous Viking squeezes awkwardly into the passenger seat, shield wedged against the roof.
Woman: "I'm taking you somewhere civilized."
Viking: "To your king?"
Woman: "Wendy's."

19-23 seconds: Drive-thru POV from inside the car. Viking leans toward the speaker box.
Speaker: "Welcome, what can I get started for you?"
Viking, terrified: "THE WALL SPEAKS!"

23-27 seconds: Fast dolly-in inside the restaurant. Viking stares reverently at an enormous cheeseburger, slowly lifts it with both hands, takes a bite and becomes emotional.
Viking: "Your people possess great wisdom."

27-30 seconds: Exterior crane pull-back. They sit on the hood of the parked car beneath glowing restaurant signage, Viking drinking a giant soda through a straw while holding his axe.
Woman: "So... where exactly are you staying?"
Viking: "Your couch."

Additional Notes: Keep the woman’s trench coat, office clothes and appearance identical throughout. Viking always retains braided blond hair, fur cloak, armor, shield and axe. Treat the Viking and props with realistic physical weight. Modern people react naturally in the background without turning the scene into chaos. Rain remains visible throughout exterior shots. Comedy comes from sincere performances rather than exaggerated cartoon acting. Photorealistic cinematic realism, believable skin, natural motion blur, realistic reflections and fabric physics. No subtitles.

电影级光影，强逆光，体积光，大气透视，高对比度，土黄与暗金主色调，金属皮革极致材质，尘土粒子，烟雾，人群虚化背景。史诗、压迫、英雄主义氛围，8K，超真实，电影质感，动态模糊，慢动作与快速剪辑结合，导演级构图。，21:9，10s

entries.title: Magical Room Transformation
entries.description: A cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.5 showing a static bedroom transforming into a magical sanctuary through a glowing energy burst from a spherical device.
entries.prompt: Hyperrealistic, photorealistic cinematic video. Static symmetrical wide-angle shot of a starkly empty bedroom with soft daylight. In the center sits a polished, red-and-white spherical capture device that wiggles once. Suddenly, it bursts open in a dazzling eruption of golden energy and sparkling particles with cinematic lens flares. From this central pulse, magical streams of light solidify into a bed with yellow creature-themed bedding, a wooden desk, shelves, and various colorful monster plush toys. Framed posters and a glowing lightning-bolt neon sign appear on the walls. The room is instantly transformed into a complete magical sanctuary. Sound effects: soft magical hum, energy burst, and the sound of furniture solidifying.

entries.title: Cinematic Istanbul Night Fight
entries.description: An extensive cinematic action prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring a realistic handheld sequence of a street fight in rainy Istanbul.
entries.prompt:
生成一段15秒超写实电影感近身格斗视频，严格16:9横屏，原生4K，24fps。整体风格为雨夜伊斯坦布尔街头的粗粝新黑色电影动作场面。画面必须像真实真人实拍，不像AI美颜、不像数字人、不像游戏CG。

【素材绑定】
image1 = 第一位人物 / 主角参考。
image2 = 第二位人物 / 攻击者参考。

使用image1作为主角的脸部、五官比例、发型、发色、皮肤质感、体型比例、年龄感、服装逻辑、鞋子、配饰和整体气质参考。
使用image2作为攻击者的脸部、五官比例、发型、发色、皮肤质感、体型比例、年龄感、服装逻辑、鞋子、配饰 and 整体气质参考。

两人都是明确成年的女性格斗者。
保持两人的可识别身份，但允许自然真人表情、湿发摆动、呼吸起伏、肌肉紧张、疼痛反应和真实动作变形。
不要把脸固定成僵硬照片。不要做角色设定图、拼贴图、分镜图、标签、文字、边框或面板。

【真人质感要求】
必须避免AI美颜感。
保留自然人类皮肤质感、轻微不对称、真实毛孔、细微眼下纹理、湿发碎发、雨水打湿后的皮肤反光、自然眨眼、下颌紧张、呼吸不稳、肌肉用力和真实疼痛反应。
脸不能像塑料娃娃、不能像数字头像、不能过度磨皮、不能有玻璃眼或过度完美五官。

【场景】
雨后的伊斯坦布尔夜街。整场格斗只发生在这条街上。
街道狭窄而真实，地面湿滑发亮，有水坑、碎石、散落垃圾、停靠车辆、旧建筑墙面、路边栏杆、昏黄街灯、远处霓虹光晕、潮湿雾气和湿润反射。
画面氛围粗粝、危险、冷色雨夜、带有新黑色电影质感。

一辆深色停靠轿车从开头就固定出现在街道右侧或后方可见位置。它必须在整个镜头中保持同一空间位置，最后成为主角被踢飞后撞上的目标。不要让汽车突然出现。

【核心动作原则】
真实近身格斗，不是舞蹈，不是武侠，不是超能力。
每一次攻击都必须有明确因果链：
蓄力 → 出手路径 → 接触或擦过 → 身体反应 → 重心变化。
禁止假打、隔空反应、身体穿模、无原因摔倒、无重量飞行。

动作要快、狠、清楚，但不能混乱。
两人都必须像真实训练过的格斗演员。攻击者更主动、更凶狠；主角一开始冷静、轻蔑、精准，但最后被攻击者重击打飞，处于失败状态。

【摄影】
一个连续手持长镜头，无剪切，无黑屏转场，无瞬移。
摄影机路径必须清楚：
主角肩后OTS开场 → 自然移动到侧面轮廓近景 → 近身格斗环绕跟拍 → 跟随主角被踢飞的方向 → 推近破损汽车上的主角脸部。
手持摄影要贴近、流动、沉浸，但不能晃到看不清动作。
只在关键近身擦拳和最后重击瞬间使用短暂速度变化，不要整段慢动作。

【时间轴】

0.0–2.5秒
从主角肩后的OTS镜头开始。主角站在湿滑街道前景，背部和肩膀占据部分画面。远处的攻击者从雨夜街道另一端快速冲来，脚步踩过水坑，水花溅起。
摄影机贴着主角肩膀移动，能看到停靠的深色轿车在街道右侧或后方位置。雨声、脚步声、远处车声和低沉环境音存在。
主角没有慌张，只微微侧头，眼神冷静。

2.5–5.5秒
摄影机自然绕到两人的侧面轮廓角度。
攻击者冲到近距离，对主角脸部打出一记快速直拳或右拳。
只在拳头擦过脸侧的瞬间使用极短速度变化。
主角不大幅闪避，不后仰，不后退。她只在最后一刻做极小幅度的头部后撤和下巴转动。
拳头必须清楚从她脸颊前方几厘米处擦过，能看见拳头、脸颊和中间间隙。拳风轻微带动她的发丝和衣领。
主角嘴角露出很淡的轻蔑笑，像是觉得对方太慢。表情要自然，不要夸张。

5.5–8.5秒
速度回到正常。
攻击者立刻继续压迫，打出第二击和近身组合。
动作顺序清楚：
攻击者左拳横扫 → 主角用前臂挡开 → 攻击者低位膝击或短踢 → 主角后脚小幅滑步化解 → 主角用短肘或短拳反击攻击者胸口或肩线。
每个动作都要有接触感。挡格必须真的改变攻击路线。被打到的一方肩膀、头部、胸口和脚步都要根据力的方向反应。
湿地上的脚步会打滑，但不能失控。

8.5–11.5秒
近身格斗升级。
攻击者更凶狠，连续逼近。主角尝试控制攻击者手臂，并打出一次快速反击。
包含：
低角度看到攻击者一次旋转踢或强力侧踢的准备动作；
主角先闪过一次危险近身攻击；
然后两人短暂贴身，出现手腕控制、肩膀碰撞、肘击格挡。
摄影机绕着两人半圈，保持脸、手、脚和地面反应清楚。
主角仍然看起来有优势，但攻击者没有被压制，她正在等待重击机会。

11.5–13.0秒
攻击者突然爆发，打出一记强力旋转后踢，目标是主角胸口或上半身中央。
这一瞬间使用短暂慢动作和拉长低频冲击声。
攻击者脚跟或脚底清楚击中主角上半身，不能打空。
主角身体从胸口开始被冲击带动，肩膀后仰，双脚离开湿地，水花和灰尘从地面弹起。
冲击必须真实有重量，不要像轻飘飘飞走。

13.0–15.0秒
主角被踢飞向开头就出现的深色停靠轿车。
摄影机快速跟随她后退方向。
她的背部和肩膀撞上车身与前挡风玻璃区域，挡风玻璃碎裂，玻璃碎片四散，但不要血腥。
她重重落在车身或破碎挡风玻璃上，身体失去力量般塌下。
攻击者站在湿街道上，保持强势战斗姿态，像胜者一样冷冷看着她。

最后一秒，摄影机不再强调攻击者，而是从攻击者方向缓慢推近到倒在破损汽车上的主角脸部。
主角脸上有雨水、疲惫、疼痛和不甘，仍保持image1身份特征。攻击者留在背景里轻微虚化。
结尾不要切黑，停在主角破碎但清醒的表情上。
entries.translated_prompt:
Generate a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic close-quarters combat video, strictly 16:9 landscape, native 4K, 24fps. The overall style is a gritty neo-noir action scene on the streets of Istanbul on a rainy night. The image must look like a real live-action shoot, not AI beauty, not a digital human, not game CG.

[Material Binding]
image1 = First person / Protagonist reference.
image2 = Second person / Attacker reference.

Use image1 for facial features, proportions, hairstyle, color, skin texture, body proportions, age, clothing logic, shoes, accessories, and overall temperament reference.
Use image2 for the attacker's facial features, proportions, hairstyle, color, skin texture, body proportions, age, clothing logic, shoes, accessories, and overall temperament reference.

Both are clearly adult female fighters.
Maintain recognizable identities, but allow for natural live expressions, wet hair swaying, breathing rise and fall, muscle tension, pain reactions, and realistic movement deformation.
Do not fix faces into stiff photos. Do not make character concept art, collages, storyboards, labels, text, borders, or panels.

[Real Texture Requirements]
Must avoid AI beauty look.
Retain natural human skin texture, slight asymmetry, real pores, fine under-eye texture, wet stray hair, skin reflections after being wet by rain, natural blinking, jaw tension, unsteady breathing, muscle exertion, and real pain reactions.
The face cannot look like a plastic doll, a digital avatar, overly airbrushed, or have glass eyes or overly perfect features.

[Scene]
Istanbul night street after rain. The entire fight takes place only on this street.
The street is narrow and real, the ground slippery and shiny, with puddles, rubble, scattered trash, parked vehicles, old building walls, roadside railings, dim streetlights, distant neon glows, damp mist, and wet reflections.
The atmosphere is gritty, dangerous, cold rainy night, with a neo-noir quality.

A dark parked sedan appears fixed at the right side or back of the street from the start. It must maintain the same spatial position throughout the shot, eventually becoming the target the protagonist hits after being kicked flying. Do not let the car suddenly appear.

[Core Action Principles]
Real close-quarters combat, not dance, not martial arts, not superpowers.
Every attack must have a clear causal chain:
Charging -> Striking path -> Contact or grazing -> Body reaction -> Center of gravity change.
Prohibit fake hitting, reacting across space, body clipping, falling without reason, or weightless flying.

Actions must be fast, fierce, and clear, but not chaotic.
Both must look like real trained combat actors. The attacker is more active and fierce; the protagonist starts calm, contemptuous, and precise, but is finally hit by a heavy blow and knocked back, in a losing state.

[Photography]
A continuous handheld long take, no cuts, no black screen transitions, no teleportation.
The camera path must be clear:
Protagonist's shoulder OTS opening -> Natural move to side profile close-up -> Close-quarters combat orbiting tracking -> Following the direction the protagonist is kicked -> Pushing into the protagonist's face on the damaged car.
Handheld photography should be close, fluid, and immersive, but not so shaky that actions cannot be seen clearly.
Use brief speed changes only at key close contact and final heavy impact moments; do not use slow motion for the entire segment.

[Timeline]

0.0–2.5s
Starts with an OTS shot behind the protagonist's shoulder. The protagonist stands in the foreground of the slippery street, back and shoulders occupying part of the frame. The distant attacker rushes quickly from the other end of the rainy night street, feet stepping through puddles, splashing water.
The camera moves past the protagonist's shoulder, seeing the parked dark car at the right or back of the street. Sound of rain, footsteps, distant car sounds, and low ambient noise are present.
The protagonist is not flustered, only slightly turning her head, eyes calm.

2.5–5.5s
The camera naturally orbits to a side profile angle of the two.
The attacker rushes to close range, throwing a fast jab or right punch at the protagonist's face.
Use a very short speed change only at the moment the punch grazes the side of the face.
The protagonist does not dodge significantly, does not lean back, does not retreat. She only does a minimal head retreat and jaw turn at the last moment.
The fist must clearly graze a few centimeters in front of her cheek; the fist, cheek, and gap between them can be seen. The wind of the punch slightly moves her hair and collar.
The protagonist's mouth shows a very slight contemptuous smile, as if thinking the opponent is too slow. The expression should be natural, not exaggerated.

5.5–8.5s
Speed returns to normal.
The attacker immediately continues to press, throwing a second blow and close-range combination.
Sequence of actions clear:
Attacker left hook -> Protagonist parries with forearm -> Attacker low knee or short kick -> Protagonist resolves with a small step back with the rear foot -> Protagonist counters with a short elbow or punch to the attacker's chest or shoulder line.
Every movement must have a sense of contact. Blocking must actually change the attack path. The side hit must react according to the direction of force in shoulders, head, chest, and footsteps.
Footsteps on wet ground will slip, but not lose control.

8.5–11.5s
Close-quarters combat escalates.
The attacker is more fierce, pressing continuously. The protagonist attempts to control the attacker's arm and throws a quick counter.
Includes:
Low angle seeing the attacker's preparation for a spin kick or strong side kick;
Protagonist first dodges a dangerous close attack;
Then the two briefly clash, with wrist control, shoulder bumps, and elbow parries.
The camera orbits half a circle around them, keeping faces, hands, feet, and ground reactions clear.
The protagonist still seems to have the advantage, but the attacker is not suppressed; she is waiting for a heavy blow opportunity.

11.5–13.0s
The attacker suddenly explodes, throwing a powerful spinning back kick targeting the protagonist's chest or upper center.
Use brief slow motion and an elongated low-frequency impact sound at this moment.
The attacker's heel or sole clearly hits the protagonist's upper body, not a miss.
The protagonist's body is driven by the impact starting from the chest, shoulders leaning back, feet leaving the wet ground, water and dust splashing from the floor.
The impact must be realistically weighted, not like flying away weightlessly.

13.0–15.0s
The protagonist is kicked flying toward the dark parked sedan that appeared at the start.
The camera quickly follows her backward direction.
Her back and shoulders hit the car body and front windshield area; the windshield shatters, glass fragments scatter, but not bloody.
She falls heavily onto the car body or broken windshield, her body collapsing as if losing power.
The attacker stands on the wet street, maintaining a strong fighting stance, looking at her coldly like a victor.

In the last second, the camera no longer emphasizes the attacker but slowly pushes from the attacker's direction to the protagonist's face lying on the damaged car.
The protagonist's face has rain, fatigue, pain, and resentment, still maintaining image1 identity features. The attacker remains slightly blurred in the background.
The end should not cut to black, stopping on the protagonist's broken but conscious expression.

entries.title: Luxury Perfume Commercial Advertisement
entries.description: A high-end, master-level cinematic commercial prompt for an original luxury perfume brand, focusing on materials, lighting, and sensory details.
entries.prompt:
生成视频：生成一支 10 秒高端奢侈香水广告片，产品为原创虚构奢侈香水品牌「MAISON LUMÉA」，产品名「Obsidian Elixir 黑曜鎏金香水」。整体必须呈现顶级国际香水大片质感，像由大师级导演、奢侈品创意总监、顶级摄影指导、巴黎高定美术团队、珠宝级产品摄影团队和电影级后期公司共同制作。画面必须像花费上百万经费完成的品牌主广告，极度高级、神秘、感性、昂贵、克制，有 “黑夜、金液、丝绒、火光、稀有香气” 的气质。不要出现任何真实品牌标志，不要模仿现有香水品牌，不要出现廉价电商图，不要像直播间产品展示，不要出现杂乱字幕。
视频比例 16:9，时长 10 秒，电影级写实风格，超高端商业广告摄影。主色调为深黑、黑曜石、暗金、琥珀金、微弱酒红和象牙白高光。画面整体偏暗，光线极其精准，用少量高光雕刻香水瓶身。质感参考顶级香水广告、珠宝广告、红毯高定大片、博物馆级静物摄影：大面积黑色负空间，低调奢华，丝绒般的阴影，金色液体像被封存在黑曜石中的火焰。整体不能喧闹，不能花哨，不能霓虹赛博，不能过度紫蓝，不能塑料感。
产品设定：一瓶原创高端香水「MAISON LUMÉA Obsidian Elixir」。瓶身为厚重黑曜石质感玻璃，近乎黑色但边缘有半透明烟灰折射，瓶体轮廓简洁、雕塑感强，像一件建筑艺术品。瓶身内部有深琥珀金色香水液体，液体在光线照射下呈现浓郁蜂蜜、陈年干邑和熔金般的层次。瓶盖为暗金金属，造型克制，有细密拉丝纹理，顶部嵌入一小块黑色水晶。瓶身正面可以有极简品牌字样「MAISON LUMÉA」和小号产品名「Obsidian Elixir」，文字必须精致、居中、低调，像真实高级香水瓶丝印，不能出现乱码，不能太大，不能像贴纸。
场景设定：香水瓶置于黑色丝绒与黑曜石镜面石材交界的展台上，背景为极暗的巴黎夜色室内空间，像私人沙龙、古老宫殿中的烛光房间或高级定制香氛实验室。远处有模糊烛火、暗金镜框、黑色帷幕、少量烟雾和微弱花瓣轮廓，但背景必须虚化，不能抢产品。空气中漂浮极细微金色香氛粒子，像香气被可视化，但要非常克制、真实、优雅。画面不能出现人物正脸，可以有一瞬间模糊的黑色丝绸或高定裙摆掠过作为氛围，但产品始终是绝对主角。
镜头设计：
0-2 秒：从全黑开始，画面中只有一束极窄、温暖的金色光线从左上方缓慢扫入，先照亮黑色丝绒表面的一道柔软褶皱。镜头极近距离微距，景深非常浅，能看到丝绒绒毛与空气中极细香氛粒子。随后瓶身底部的黑曜石玻璃边缘被光线勾出一条锋利高光，观众还看不清完整瓶子，只感到一种昂贵、神秘、仪式感极强的开场。
2-4 秒：镜头缓慢上移并轻微推近，黑曜石玻璃瓶身逐渐显现。瓶体边缘呈现深烟灰透明折射，中间几乎黑到看不透，内部琥珀金液体在光线穿过时像一团低温燃烧的金色火焰。瓶身表面有非常干净的镜面反射，远处烛火在玻璃中形成细小、柔和、昂贵的光点。镜头运动必须稳定、缓慢、像电影机械臂拍摄，不能摇晃。
4-6 秒：切到香水液体超近特写。画面看到瓶内金色液体轻微流动，像蜂蜜、琥珀和熔金混合，浓稠但优雅。光线穿过液体形成复杂折射，液体边缘有微小金色波纹。几缕极淡烟雾从瓶口附近缓缓升起，烟雾中隐约有黑玫瑰花瓣、香草荚、琥珀树脂的抽象轮廓，但不能变成明显道具堆砌，只能像香调意象。此段需要极致感官化，观众几乎能 “闻到” 香味。
6-8 秒：镜头拉开到完整产品英雄镜头。香水瓶以 3/4 角度立在黑曜石展台上，瓶盖暗金金属被一束窄光精准照亮，瓶身内部金液发出深沉光泽。黑色丝绒从瓶身后方自然垂落，远处烛火虚化成极小金色光斑。画面中有几片黑玫瑰花瓣缓慢落下，但数量极少，轨迹优雅，不要像婚礼花瓣雨。镜头从低角度缓慢环绕 15 度，形成雕塑般的产品登场。
8-10 秒：最终定格式收束。香水瓶居中偏右，左侧保留高级黑色负空间。瓶身正面品牌字样「MAISON LUMÉA」清晰但低调，产品名「Obsidian Elixir」小号呈现。最后一秒，一道温暖金色高光从瓶盖滑到瓶身，再穿过金色液体，形成短暂、克制、昂贵的鎏金闪耀。香氛粒子在瓶身周围缓慢漂浮，画面停在极静、极贵、极具收藏感的瞬间。
摄影要求：使用电影级商业广告摄影语言，ARRI Alexa 35 或同等级电影机质感，85mm 与 100mm 微距镜头结合，浅景深，真实镜头呼吸，精密控光，黑旗遮光，窄束金色主光，柔和烛光反射，丝绒阴影。画面锐度集中在瓶身边缘、金属瓶盖、液体折射、品牌字样和黑曜石玻璃质感。背景必须柔和虚化，不能分散注意力。
灯光要求：低调暗场布光，黑色空间中用极少光线塑造香水瓶。主光为温暖金色窄束光，辅光极弱，轮廓光带一点冷白，让黑曜石玻璃边缘更立体。烛火只作为远景氛围光，不要照亮整个房间。高光要细腻、柔滑、昂贵，不能过曝，不能闪烁廉价，不能出现彩虹杂光。阴影浓郁但保留瓶体轮廓。
材质要求：黑曜石玻璃必须厚重、真实、半透明，有折射和镜面反射；金属瓶盖必须是暗金拉丝质感，不是亮黄塑料；香水液体必须像高浓度琥珀金液体，有深度和流动性；丝绒必须柔软、有暗部层次；石材展台必须是黑色镜面，有克制倒影。所有材质都要像真实高端实拍，不能像 3D 素材库，不能廉价渲染。
动态要求：整体动作极慢、极稳、极克制。允许的动态包括：光线缓慢扫过、镜头轻微推近与环绕、金色液体轻微流动、烟雾缓缓升起、少量花瓣慢速落下、香氛粒子轻微漂浮。不要快速剪辑，不要瓶子旋转过猛，不要液体飞溅，不要夸张爆炸，不要出现魔法特效，不要产品漂浮，不要镜头抖动。
后期质感：电影级调色，高对比暗调，黑位干净，金色浓郁但不过饱和，肤色元素几乎不出现，整体像高定香水主广告。加入非常轻微胶片颗粒、柔和高光晕染、真实镜头暗角，但不能脏，不能模糊，不能复古过度。最终成片必须可作为奢侈香水发布会主视觉广告，具有艺术品般的精致度。
声音想象可作为视觉节奏参考：低沉弦乐、微弱玻璃共鸣、轻柔呼吸感、火焰细声、最后一个极轻的金属音符。虽然只生成视频，也要让画面节奏像有高级配乐支撑：前 4 秒神秘铺垫，4-6 秒感官爆发，6-8 秒产品登场，8-10 秒品牌定格。
负面要求：不要出现真实品牌 Logo，不要出现 Chanel、Dior、Guerlain、Tom Ford、YSL 等真实品牌元素；不要出现乱码文字、错误拼写、大段字幕、促销语、价格、购买按钮、电商背景、直播间灯光、廉价玻璃瓶、塑料瓶盖、过亮黄金色、脏乱桌面、普通浴室或商场柜台；不要出现人物抢戏、手部畸形、瓶身变形、液体穿模、烟雾过厚、花瓣太多、画面低清、过曝、抖动、AI 扭曲。整体必须是黑曜石般神秘、鎏金般奢华、巴黎高定般克制、百万级广告制作感。，16:9，10s
entries.translated_prompt:
Generate Video: Create a 10-second high-end luxury perfume commercial for the original fictional luxury brand "MAISON LUMÉA" and the product "Obsidian Elixir." The overall production must present a top-tier international perfume film quality, as if co-created by a master director, luxury creative director, top director of photography, Paris haute couture art team, jewelry-grade product photography team, and a cinematic post-production house. The visuals must look like a flagship brand commercial made with a multi-million budget: extremely high-end, mysterious, sensual, expensive, and restrained, with an aura of "night, golden liquid, velvet, firelight, and rare fragrance." Do not include any real brand logos, do not imitate existing perfume brands, avoid cheap e-commerce imagery, do not look like a livestream product display, and avoid messy subtitles.
Aspect ratio 16:9, duration 10 seconds, cinematic realistic style, ultra-high-end commercial photography. Main color palette: deep black, obsidian, dark gold, amber gold, faint burgundy, and ivory white highlights. The overall scene is dark with extremely precise lighting, using a small amount of highlights to sculpt the perfume bottle. Texture references: top perfume ads, jewelry ads, red carpet haute couture films, museum-grade still-life photography: large areas of black negative space, understated luxury, velvet-like shadows, golden liquid appearing like fire sealed in obsidian. The overall vibe must not be noisy, flashy, neon-cyber, excessively purple-blue, or plastic-like.
Product Setting: A bottle of original high-end perfume "MAISON LUMÉA Obsidian Elixir." The bottle is heavy obsidian-textured glass, nearly black but with translucent smoky gray refraction at the edges. The bottle silhouette is simple and sculptural, like an architectural work of art. Inside the bottle is deep amber-gold perfume liquid, showing rich layers of honey, aged cognac, and molten gold under light. The cap is dark gold metal, restrained in design with fine brushed texture, and a small black crystal embedded at the top. The front of the bottle can feature minimalist branding "MAISON LUMÉA" and the product name "Obsidian Elixir" in a small font; the text must be exquisite, centered, and understated, like real high-end silk-screen printing, no garbled code, not too large, not like a sticker.
Scene Setting: The perfume bottle is placed on a display stand at the junction of black velvet and obsidian mirror-finished stone. The background is an extremely dark Parisian night interior, like a private salon, a candlelit room in an ancient palace, or a haute couture fragrance lab. In the distance are blurred candlelight, dark gold frames, black curtains, light smoke, and faint petal silhouettes, but the background must be blurred to not distract from the product. Extremely fine golden fragrance particles float in the air, visualizing the scent in a very restrained, realistic, and elegant way. No clear faces of people; a fleeting blur of black silk or a haute couture skirt can pass by for atmosphere, but the product is always the absolute protagonist.
Shot Design:
0-2s: Start from total black. A very narrow, warm golden light beam slowly enters from the top left, first illuminating a soft fold on the black velvet surface. Macro close-up, very shallow depth of field, showing velvet fuzz and tiny fragrance particles. Then, a sharp highlight traces the edge of the obsidian glass at the base of the bottle. The audience cannot yet see the full bottle, only feeling an expensive, mysterious, and highly ceremonial opening.
2-4s: The camera slowly moves up and pushes in slightly, revealing the obsidian glass bottle. The edges show smoky translucent refraction, while the center is almost opaque black. The amber-gold liquid inside looks like a low-temperature burning golden flame as light passes through. The bottle surface has clean mirror reflections, with distant candlelight forming tiny, soft, expensive light points in the glass. Movement must be stable, slow, like a robotic arm, no shaking.
4-6s: Cut to an extreme close-up of the perfume liquid. The golden liquid inside flows slightly, like a mix of honey, amber, and molten gold, thick but elegant. Light creates complex refractions with small golden ripples at the edges. Faint wisps of smoke rise from near the bottle neck, with abstract silhouettes of black rose petals, vanilla pods, and amber resin visible within the smoke, but these shouldn't look like props—only olfactory imagery. This section needs to be extremely sensory; the audience should almost "smell" the fragrance.
6-8s: Pull back to a full product hero shot. The bottle stands at a 3/4 angle on the obsidian platform. The dark gold metal cap is precisely lit by a narrow beam, and the golden liquid inside glows deeply. Black velvet drapes naturally behind the bottle, with distant candlelight blurred into tiny golden bokeh. A few black rose petals fall slowly—very few, with elegant trajectories, not like a wedding petal shower. The camera slowly orbits 15 degrees from a low angle, creating a sculptural product introduction.
8-10s: Final freeze-frame resolution. The bottle is centered-right, with high-end black negative space on the left. The brand name "MAISON LUMÉA" is clear but understated, with the product name "Obsidian Elixir" presented in a small size. In the last second, a warm golden highlight slides from the cap to the bottle, passing through the golden liquid for a brief, restrained, expensive gilded shimmer. Fragrance particles float slowly around the bottle, ending on a static, expensive, collectible moment.
Photography Requirements: Cinematic commercial photography language, ARRI Alexa 35 or equivalent texture, combining 85mm and 100mm macro lenses, shallow depth of field, realistic lens breathing, precise light control, black flag shading, narrow golden key light, soft candlelight reflections, velvet shadows. Sharpness focused on bottle edges, metal cap, liquid refraction, branding, and obsidian glass texture. Background must be softly blurred.
Lighting Requirements: Low-key lighting, shaping the bottle with minimal light in a black space. Key light is a warm golden narrow beam, fill light is very weak, rim light slightly cool white to make obsidian edges three-dimensional. Candlelight is for background atmosphere only. Highlights must be delicate, smooth, and expensive, not overexposed or flickering cheaply, no rainbow artifacts. Shadows are rich but preserve the bottle's silhouette.
Material Requirements: Obsidian glass must be heavy, realistic, semi-transparent with refractions and mirror reflections; metal cap must be dark gold brushed texture, not bright yellow plastic; perfume liquid must look like high-concentration amber gold with depth and fluidity; velvet must be soft with dark layers; stone platform must be black mirror with restrained reflections. All materials must look like real high-end photography, not 3D asset libraries or cheap rendering.
Dynamic Requirements: Movements are extremely slow, steady, and restrained. Allowed dynamics: slow light sweeps, slight camera push and orbit, slight liquid flow, slow rising smoke, a few slow-falling petals, light floating particles. No fast cuts, no excessive bottle spinning, no liquid splashing, no exaggerated explosions, no magic effects, no floating products, no camera shake.
Post-production Texture: Cinematic color grading, high-contrast dark tones, clean blacks, rich gold but not oversaturated, skin elements almost non-existent. Like a haute couture perfume ad. Add very slight film grain, soft highlight bloom, realistic lens vignetting, but not dirty or overly blurry. The final result must be suitable as a visual for a luxury perfume launch with artistic sophistication.
Sound Imagination (Visual Reference): Deep strings, faint glass resonance, soft breathing, crackling fire, a final light metallic note. Although generating video, the visual rhythm should feel supported by high-end scoring: 0-4s mysterious buildup, 4-6s sensory burst, 6-8s product reveal, 8-10s brand lockup.
Negative Requirements: No real brand logos (Chanel, Dior, Guerlain, Tom Ford, YSL, etc.); no garbled text, spelling errors, long subtitles, promotional slogans, prices, buy buttons, e-commerce backgrounds, livestream lighting, cheap glass, plastic caps, overly bright gold, messy desks, ordinary bathrooms or mall counters; no distracting figures, hand deformities, bottle warping, liquid clipping, thick smoke, too many petals, low resolution, overexposure, jitter, or AI distortion. The overall feel must be obsidian-mysterious, gilded-luxurious, haute-couture-restrained, with million-dollar-budget production value. 16:9, 10s

entries.title: Mediterranean Coffee Run Vlog
entries.description: A highly realistic, handheld DV style vlog capturing a woman's morning walk in a sun-washed coastal town.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm daily vlog footage. The video MUST begin with her holding the camera at arm's length in selfie mode while stepping out of an old stone doorway into a narrow street. The first 20–30 seconds are entirely handheld. Later she occasionally sets the camera on a windowsill, café ledge, or low seawall for wider shots. Keep subtle handheld shake, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, exposure breathing, brief accidental face cropping, and imperfect framing throughout. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK: Warm analog tape texture with gentle film grain, softened sharpness, subtle halation where sunlight cuts between buildings, faint salt-air haze, realistic skin tones, low contrast, tiny exposure shifts, natural motion blur. Authentic everyday footage, not a polished commercial.

STYLE: A quiet Mediterranean morning coffee-run vlog. Unhurried, warm, spontaneous. She talks to the camera in short sentences with comfortable pauses, reacts to the street around her, laughs easily.

CHARACTER: ELENA — a Mediterranean woman in her mid-20s. Dark wavy hair in a loose bun, olive skin, minimal makeup, small gold hoops, oversized white linen shirt, denim shorts, leather sandals, canvas tote on one shoulder.

SETTING: A sun-washed coastal old town just after sunrise. Narrow limestone alleys, pastel shutters, bougainvillea spilling over walls, glimpses of the sea between buildings, distant church bells and scooters, almost no people. A sleepy stray cat on a warm step.

SCENES:

The vlog opens in selfie mode as Elena steps out of the doorway into the bright alley, squinting.
"Morning."
She walks, sunlight strobing between buildings across her face.
"Okay it's already hot. Of course it is."
She reaches a tiny corner kiosk and orders an iced coffee, camera still handheld, framing half-wrong.
She sets the camera on the counter ledge for a wide shot while she waits, drumming her fingers.
A stray cat appears at her feet and stares up.
She crouches down to it.
"Hi. You again."
The cat rubs against her leg. She laughs.
"I have a bodyguard now."
She picks the camera back up, coffee in the other hand, and walks toward the water, the cat trotting behind for a few steps.
She sits on the low seawall, sea behind her, and takes the first sip.
"Worth it. Every time."
She looks off at the water for a moment, hair moving in the breeze, then back to the lens.
"Okay. Work now."
A small wave.
"See you later."

entries.description: A high-budget sci-fi epic prompt featuring a solitary figure in a frozen, submerged city standing before a massive ice-swallowed statue.
entries.prompt: 逼真真人电影风格，使用大画幅变形镜头拍摄，浓重的体积雾气和缓缓飘落的雪花，近乎单色调的冰冻色调，以淡冰蓝色、骨白色和湿板岩灰为主，几乎处处无饱和度，仅有一个单一的熔金色强调色，其他皆无，平坦的阴天光线，无太阳无硬阴影，人物与结构间极端尺度对比，近景浅景深，深远的空中透视效果，远景层级渐隐入白色，细腻的自然胶片颗粒，高预算科幻史诗，克制的色彩分级，无冲击力。完全原创的角色与生物设计，不得类似于任何现有电影、游戏或动画作品。16:9。20秒，SEVEN个镜头，缓慢而审慎。动作从第1帧开始，无开场静止。无人说话，无唇部动作，无对白。角色锁定 — 每场镜头完全相同：一个孤独的身影，年龄不明，体型瘦削而静止，裹着一件及地长重的厚骨白色毛毡大衣，深毛衬里兜帽拉起。霜冻结在肩部和下摆上。灰白色头发，湿润并从脸部向后推开。苍白皮肤，眼睫毛上结霜，神情平静而难以解读。大衣下是朴素的深色层叠衣物和磨损的皮革手套。无盔甲，无武器，无徽章，无额头标记，无珠宝，无面部穿刺。这个角色身上唯一的颜色是眼中熔金色的光芒，眼眸直到第四场镜头才睁开。巨像锁定 — 每场镜头完全相同：一个巨大的跪姿石像，被冰层半吞没，体型庞大，仅低垂的头部、一侧肩膀和一只向上翻转的张开手掌从霜线中升起。风化的花岗岩，深邃的侵蚀沟槽，苔藓 and 冰块塞满每一道缝隙。其面容被数世纪磨损得几乎平滑 — 无表情，无牙齿，无角，无恶魔特征，只是一张宁静的残破面孔，眼眸闭合。暗金色的细脉络贯穿石头的裂缝，处于休眠状态。世界锁定：一座被淹没的城市彻底冰封 — 残破的塔楼、断裂的桥梁、工业管道和粗重电缆在结构间拉伸，全被冰层包裹，并在百米内渐隐入白色雾气。无任何人影。无文字，无标牌。镜头1 — 0.0秒至3.0秒 — 极端广角，长焦镜头，摄像机极缓慢漂移：冰封的残破城市笼罩在雾中，其中心从冰中升起的巨像低垂头部和一只巨大的张开石掌。雪花稳步飘落。尺度压倒性，画面几乎全为灰白。CUT。镜头2 — 3.0秒至6.0秒 — 广角，极缓慢推进：一个身着骨白色大衣的渺小身影一动不动地站在巨像张开石掌的中心，不比其一个指甲盖更大。雾气在他们之间翻滚。CUT。镜头3 — 6.0秒至9.0秒 — 近景肖像，静态，浅景深：身影的面容在毛兜帽内，眼眸闭合，眼睫毛上积霜，呼吸雾化并飘散而去。绝对静止。他们身后的一切是柔和的白色虚无。CUT。镜头4 — 9.0秒至12.0秒 — 极端近景，静态：眼眸睁开。它们燃烧着深沉的熔金色光芒，这是整部影片中第一个也是唯一的颜色，向皮肤上的霜层投下微弱的温暖辉光。在此停留。CUT。镜头5 — 12.0秒至15.0秒 — 广角低角度，摄像机缓慢上升：身影现立于一块粗糙的暗色石板上，悄无声息地悬浮在冰封城市高空，大衣在风中侧向飘扬，巨像的低垂头部在雾中隐现于身后。CUT。镜头6 — 15.0秒至17.5秒 — 中景，静态：身影缓慢而审慎地举起一只张开的戴手套的手，向下方遥远城市伸去。无戏剧性。只是这个手势。CUT。镜头7 — 17.5秒至20.0秒 — 极端广角，摄像机锁定不动：熔金色的细脉络在冰层中向外疾驰，并向上穿越巨像的裂缝，整个城市中冰封的塔楼、桥梁和电缆从地面脱离，悄无声息地升入空中，悬浮在雾中。画面停留在漂浮的城市上，雪仍飘落。七次剪切分别在3.0秒、6.0秒、9.0秒、12.0秒、15.0秒和17.5秒。无溶解，无淡入淡出，无速度渐变。摄像机运动始终缓慢而受控。每场镜头内持续微妙动作 — 飘落雪花、漂移雾气、呼吸、飘扬布料 — 无物完全静止。音效：低沉持续的风声掠过开阔冰面，深层压力下冰块的呻吟，雪花敲击织物的滴答声，眼眸睁开时一段长久的低频重低音膨胀，金色扩散时渐起的低沉共鸣嗡鸣，以及结尾时巨大质量脱离地面的深沉研磨声。无声，无对白，无旁白，无音乐。负面提示：动漫，日漫，卡通渲染或风格化动画，忍者，头带，额头护具，带有印花图案或云朵的斗篷，环状或图案虹膜，橙色或尖刺头发，面部穿刺，与现有电影、游戏、漫画或动画角色的任何相似，武器，血腥，内脏，伤口，可见人群或旁观者，温暖阳光，蓝天，除金色外的任何饱和色，渐变，镜头光晕，画面文字，字幕，字母，单词，数字，可读标牌，标志，水印，卡通，3D渲染，视频游戏电影风格，慢动作，速度渐变，开场静止，首帧静态。
entries.translated_prompt: Photorealistic live-action cinematic style, shot on large format anamorphic lenses, heavy volumetric fog and slowly falling snowflakes, near-monochromatic frozen color palette dominated by pale ice blue, bone white, and wet slate grey, almost zero saturation everywhere except for a single molten gold accent color, flat overcast lighting, no sun, no hard shadows, extreme scale contrast between figures and structures, shallow depth of field for close-ups, deep aerial perspective, background layers fading into white, fine natural film grain, high-budget sci-fi epic, restrained color grading, non-impactful. Completely original character and creature design, must not resemble any existing film, game, or animation work. 16:9. 20 seconds, SEVEN shots, slow and deliberate. Action starts from frame 1, no opening static. No one speaking, no lip movement, no dialogue. Character Lock — Exact same in every shot: a solitary figure, indeterminate age, thin and still, wrapped in a floor-length heavy bone-white felt coat with a deep fur-lined hood pulled up. Frost frozen on shoulders and hem. Ash-white hair, damp and pushed back from face. Pale skin, frost on eyelashes, calm and unreadable expression. Under the coat are simple dark layered garments and worn leather gloves. No armor, no weapons, no insignias, no forehead marks, no jewelry, no facial piercings. The only color on this character is the molten gold glow in the eyes, which do not open until Shot 4. Colossus Lock — Exact same in every shot: a massive kneeling stone statue, half-swallowed by ice, enormous in scale, only the bowed head, one shoulder, and a single upturned open palm rising above the frost line. Weathered granite, deep erosion grooves, moss and ice choking every crevice. Its face worn almost smooth by centuries — expressionless, no teeth, no horns, no demonic features, just a serene broken face, eyes closed. Thin veins of dark gold run through the cracks in the stone, dormant. World Lock: A submerged city completely frozen — broken towers, fractured bridges, industrial pipes, and heavy cables stretching between structures, all encased in ice, fading into white fog within a hundred meters. No human figures. No text, no signage. Shot 1 — 0.0s to 3.0s — Extreme wide angle, telephoto lens, camera drifting very slowly: The frozen broken city shrouded in fog, with the Colossus's bowed head and one giant open stone hand rising from the ice at its center. Snow falls steadily. Scale is overwhelming, the image almost entirely grayscale. CUT. Shot 2 — 3.0s to 6.0s — Wide angle, very slow push-in: A tiny figure in a bone-white coat stands motionless in the center of the Colossus's open stone palm, no larger than one of its fingernails. Fog rolls between them. CUT. Shot 3 — 6.0s to 9.0s — Close-up portrait, static, shallow depth of field: The figure's face within the fur hood, eyes closed, frost on eyelashes, breath misting and drifting away. Absolute stillness. Everything behind them is soft white void. CUT. Shot 4 — 9.0s to 12.0s — Extreme close-up, static: The eyes open. They burn with a deep molten gold glow, the first and only color in the film, casting a faint warm light onto the frost on the skin. Lingers here. CUT. Shot 5 — 12.0s to 15.0s — Wide low angle, camera rising slowly: The figure now stands on a jagged dark stone slab, silently hovering high above the frozen city, coat blowing sideways in the wind, the Colossus's bowed head looming in the fog behind them. CUT. Shot 6 — 15.0s to 17.5s — Medium shot, static: The figure slowly and deliberately raises one open gloved hand toward the distant city below. No drama. Just the gesture. CUT. Shot 7 — 17.5s to 20.0s — Extreme wide angle, camera locked: Thin veins of molten gold race outward through the ice and upward through the cracks of the Colossus, as frozen towers, bridges, and cables throughout the city detach from the ground and silently rise into the air, suspended in the fog. Frame holds on the floating city, snow still falling. Seven cuts at 3.0s, 6.0s, 9.0s, 12.0s, 15.0s, and 17.5s. No dissolves, no fades, no speed ramps. Camera movement always slow and controlled. Subtle movement within every shot — falling snow, drifting fog, breath, blowing fabric — nothing is completely static. Sound: A low, constant wind over open ice, the groan of ice under deep pressure, the tick of snowflakes hitting fabric, a long low-frequency sub-bass swell when the eyes open, a rising low resonant hum as the gold spreads, and the deep grinding sound of massive weight detaching from the ground at the end. No voices, no dialogue, no narration, no music. Negative Prompt: Anime, manga, cel-shaded or stylized animation, ninja, headband, forehead protector, cloak with printed patterns or clouds, ringed or patterned irises, orange or spiky hair, facial piercings, any resemblance to existing movie, game, manga or anime characters, weapons, gore, viscera, wounds, visible crowds or bystanders, warm sunlight, blue sky, any saturated color except gold, gradients, lens flare, on-screen text, subtitles, letters, words, numbers, readable signage, logos, watermarks, cartoons, 3D renders, video game cinematic style, slow motion, speed ramps, opening static, first frame static.

entries.title: AI Knowledge Sharing Talking Head
entries.description: A video prompt for a realistic talking head video of a knowledge blogger explaining AI in a study setting.
entries.prompt:
使用参考图中的女性人物作为唯一人物参考，保持人物五官、发型、肤色、服装和整体气质高度一致。

9:16竖屏，10秒，超写实真人知识科普口播。

人物坐在真实居家书房中，胸口以上中近景，固定机位，镜头基本不运动。自然窗光从侧前方照射，背景书架轻微虚化，整体像真实知识博主用相机拍摄。

人物面对镜头自然口播：

“很多人以为，AI回答问题是在数据库里找答案。其实不是，它更像是在根据前面的内容，不断预测接下来最可能出现的词。”

表演要求：
0-2秒：自然直视镜头开场，语气像在聊天，轻微眨眼。
2-5秒：说到“其实不是”时，轻轻摇头一次，眉毛有自然变化。
5-8秒：解释“根据前面的内容”时，一只手自然进入画面做很小的解释手势。
8-10秒：说完“最可能出现的词”，轻微点头收尾。

整个过程不要背稿感，不要主持人播音腔。
嘴型严格匹配中文语音。
保留自然眨眼、呼吸、微表情、轻微头部运动和真实皮肤纹理。
眼神可以偶尔短暂偏离镜头，再自然看回。
手势克制，不要频繁挥手。

真实手机/微单拍摄质感，轻微传感器噪点，真实肤质，不磨皮，不网红滤镜，不塑料皮肤，不夸张电影光影，不运镜，不字幕，不水印，不画面文字。
entries.translated_prompt:
Use the female character in the reference image as the sole character reference, maintaining high consistency in facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, clothing, and overall temperament.

9:16 vertical screen, 10 seconds, ultra-realistic live-action knowledge science broadcast.

The character is sitting in a real home study, medium-close up from the chest up, fixed camera, essentially no movement. Natural window light shines from the side front, background bookshelves are slightly blurred, looking like a real knowledge blogger filmed with a camera.

Character naturally broadcasts to the camera: 'Many people think that AI answering questions is finding answers in a database. Actually it's not; it's more like continuously predicting the most likely next word based on the previous content.'

Performance requirements: 0-2s: Naturally look directly at the camera to start, conversational tone, slight blinking. 2-5s: When saying 'Actually it's not,' gently shake head once, eyebrows have natural changes. 5-8s: When explaining 'based on previous content,' one hand naturally enters the frame to make a very small explanatory gesture. 8-10s: After saying 'most likely next word,' finish with a slight nod. The whole process should not feel like reading a script or have a host's broadcasting tone. Mouth movements strictly match Chinese speech. Retain natural blinking, breathing, micro-expressions, slight head movements, and real skin texture. Eyes can occasionally briefly deviate from the camera and then naturally look back. Restrained gestures, do not wave hands frequently. Real mobile phone/mirrorless camera shooting texture, slight sensor noise, real skin quality, no airbrushing, no internet celebrity filters, no plastic skin, no exaggerated movie lighting, no camera movement, no subtitles, no watermarks, no screen text.

entries.title: Choreographed Dance with Anime Style Overlays
entries.description: A creative video prompt for generating a dancing sequence where hand gestures create animated frames featuring anime and Spider-Verse inspired visuals.
entries.prompt:
Setting: A cozy indoor room with warm, ambient lighting, featuring posters on the wall, a hanging lamp, and modern furniture.

Subject: A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a gray hooded jacket, performing a rhythmic, choreographed hand and body motion dance in front of the camera.

Key Visual Effects:

Animated Framing & Transitions: As she moves her hands to form frames and geometric shapes (triangles, rectangles) in front of her face and upper body, colorful animated overlays appear inside the framed spaces.

Anime & Superhero Styles:

The initial overlays display an anime-style digital avatar matching her expressions.

Midway through, the overlay switches to a Spider-Gwen / Spider-Verse comic style, complete with a hooded mask and neon cityscape backgrounds.

The animation dynamically shifts and transforms along with her hand movements, smoothly blending back into real life by the end of the clip.

entries.title: Cinematic FPV Drone Sequence
entries.description: A highly detailed, technical prompt for generating a continuous FPV drone shot around a cliffside house with precise timing and movement controls.
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic, highly detailed FPV drone sequence in one continuous, seamless take, strictly maintaining architectural fidelity and avoiding morphing. The drone moves with dynamic, cinematic precision.

Sequence Breakdown (0:00 - 0:17):
0:00 - 0:04 (Path Approach): The sequence begins from a low, fast, dynamic angle along the lit stone path. For these 4 seconds, the drone accelerates toward the whimsical cliffside house, capturing the texture of the stone pavers.

0:04 - 0:10 (Wide Orbit): As the drone reaches near the front door (the point of closest approach), it seamlessly transitions into a wide, sweeping, dynamic orbit around the entire complex. This wide orbit encompasses both the unique house structure and the leaning tree, framed against the vast ocean and cloudy sky, taking 6 seconds.

0:10 - 0:17 (Close, Focused Orbit): The drone then executes a tight, closer-in, and more focused inspection orbit around the house itself. For the final 7 seconds, the camera dynamically focuses on and locks onto the specific architectural features: the round window, the slanted side windows, the curved white overhang, the fin-like structural elements, the stone chimney, and the antenna.

Technical Specifications: Ultra-realistic FPV movement, cinematic speed ramps, realistic inertia, grounded aerial realism, fluid camera transitions, dynamic focus, no cuts, no duplicated buildings.Negative Constraints: No architectural morphing, structural shifting, hallucination, changing window shapes, disappearing details, shape distortion, duplicated buildings, text, watermark.

entries.title: Wholesome Puppy and Kitten Story
entries.description: A charming 30-second animated prompt for a continuous shot story of a puppy and kitten exploring a magical garden at sunset.
entries.prompt: Create a charming 30-second animated cinematic story told as one continuous uninterrupted shot, with no cuts or transitions. A tiny fluffy golden puppy discovers a small orange-and-white kitten sitting alone beside a flower-covered garden fence. The puppy gently approaches and offers the kitten a tiny red flower. The kitten becomes curious, smiles, and follows the puppy into a magical backyard filled with oversized flowers, glowing fireflies, colorful butterflies, and floating soap bubbles. They playfully chase the bubbles together, jumping and tumbling through soft grass. The puppy suddenly notices a small wooden bridge over a sparkling stream and runs across it, with the kitten happily chasing behind. Halfway across, the kitten pauses nervously, so the puppy turns back and gently encourages the kitten forward. They cross together and reach a beautiful hill overlooking the glowing garden at sunset. The puppy and kitten sit side by side as dozens of fireflies illuminate the scene around them. The kitten rests its head against the puppy while the puppy gently leans toward it. End with the camera slowly rising above them, revealing the entire magical garden glowing beneath the warm evening sky. Adorable stylized 3D animation, expressive faces, soft fur, playful body language, whimsical environments, smooth character animation, cinematic depth of field, warm lighting, consistent character design, detailed environment, emotional storytelling, seamless camera movement, no dialogue, no text, no cuts.

entries.title: Hip-Hop Music Video Performance
entries.description: A high-end rap music video sequence following a character from a backstage mirror to center stage, involving dancing and drumming.
entries.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the exact character reference. Preserve her facial identity, eye color, skin tone, hairstyle, makeup, body proportions, and overall appearance consistently throughout every shot. She wears a fitted white crop top, relaxed black denim shorts, white sneakers, white crew socks, silver jewelry, and a cropped red bomber jacket. Maintain perfect character and outfit consistency.
Create a premium American hip-hop performance video inside a backstage concert environment with black curtains, glowing red LED panels, stage equipment, speakers, cables, mirrors, metal cases, and atmospheric haze.
The video opens with her sitting in front of a backstage mirror, putting on her earrings while looking confidently at her reflection. She stands, adjusts her crop top and bomber jacket, then walks through the backstage corridor toward the stage.
She enters the performance area and starts moving to the beat with relaxed hip-hop choreography, combining quick steps, shoulder movements, spins, hand gestures, and confident poses. The camera follows her from behind before swinging around into a front-facing tracking shot.
She grabs a microphone stand, performs expressive lip-sync, then transitions into a powerful dance sequence. The camera rapidly cuts between close-ups of her face, sneakers hitting the floor, moving hands, and wide stage compositions.
She moves toward a drum kit positioned beside the stage, sits down, and plays a short energetic rhythm. Overhead and low-angle shots capture the drumsticks, cymbals, foot movements, and her focused expression.
She steps back onto center stage, throws her bomber jacket over one shoulder, walks directly toward the camera, and finishes with a strong fashion pose beneath dramatic red lights.
Style: High-end rap music video, concert backstage aesthetic, cinematic handheld movement, dynamic tracking shots, realistic lip-sync, expressive body language, realistic fabric and hair movement, dramatic stage lighting, shallow depth of field, premium editorial cinematography, photorealistic, 4K HDR, 24fps, 16:9.
Negative Prompt: No text, no subtitles, no watermarks, no duplicate characters, no distorted hands, no facial inconsistency, no outfit changes, no flickering, no unrealistic physics, no cartoon rendering.

entries.title: Webrunner Superhero Comic Edit
entries.description: A fast-paced hybrid of live-action and comic-book animation featuring a city run and web-slinging hero action.
entries.prompt:
Create a fast-paced cinematic 15-second vertical 9:16 superhero edit blending photorealistic live action with an original comic-book animation aesthetic.

0–4 SEC — CITY RUN
A young woman with long brown hair, oversized light-pink shirt, white tank top, light-blue jeans, and white sneakers runs through a modern European-inspired city. She films herself with a pink smartphone, smiling at the camera. Smooth tracking shot suddenly transitions into bold comic-book linework, halftone textures, vibrant colors, and speed lines.

4–8 SEC — HERO ACTION
She jumps between rooftops as two completely original masked web-slinging heroes appear. One wears a white, charcoal, and teal suit; the other wears crimson and midnight blue. No recognizable existing superhero designs. Energy webs shoot from their gloves as they swing between skyscrapers.

8–12 SEC — COMIC CHAOS
First-person web-swinging POV through a futuristic city at golden hour. Neon signs, floating debris, graphic panels, motion blur, and an original “WHOOSH!” graphic create explosive comic energy. She lands dramatically on a rooftop.

12–15 SEC — FINAL HERO SHOT
She crouches on a rooftop with her hair blowing in the wind as the camera pulls back to reveal a vast fictional city skyline glowing pink and orange.

Final text:

WEBRUNNER
RISE. SWING. RUN.

STYLE: Premium cinematic live action, original graphic-novel animation, bold outlines, halftone textures, vibrant colors, realistic hair and fabric physics, dynamic camera movement, dramatic lighting, seamless transitions, photorealistic detail, 4K, vertical 9:16.

AVOID: Existing superhero characters, recognizable costumes, logos, franchise imagery, real-world landmarks, copied animation styles, distorted faces, warped hands, inconsistent characters, random text, cheap CGI.

entries.title: First-Person POV Dragon Rider Cinematic
entries.description: An epic, photorealistic 8K sequence of riding a crimson-obsidian dragon over emerald cliffs and diving into the ocean with cinematic sound design.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second vertical 9:16, 24fps, 8K-quality photorealistic live-action fantasy sequence from a first-person rider POV. A massive original obsidian-crimson dragon with individually detailed scales, subtle dark mottling, molten-gold eyes, volcanic-black swept-back horns, blade-like dorsal fins, burgundy-red translucent wings and faint ember-like fissures across its body. Rider wears black leather gloves, dark-green sleeves and weathered leather bracers, holding heavy chain reins from a worn brown studded saddle.

Begin with the dragon calmly breathing on a wet emerald coastal cliff; it slowly turns toward camera and the rider gently pets its neck. Suddenly it lowers its body, launches across the grass and leaps from the cliff. Dive steeply toward the grey-green ocean, deploy huge wings with realistic membrane movement, then skim just above the water with spray hitting the lens. Perform a dramatic high-speed bank around a sea stack, then plunge directly underwater. Brief dark-teal underwater silence with bubbles and faint crimson glow, followed by a powerful eruption through the ocean. Finish with a calm glide above foggy water as the dragon slowly turns and looks toward the rider.

Use physically accurate anatomy, weight, gravity, wing aerodynamics, water physics, scale deformation, wind and environmental interaction. Natural rider-mounted camera movement, realistic motion blur, lens droplets, focus breathing, subtle handheld vibration, cinematic depth of field, soft overcast lighting, HDR, restrained film grain and natural cinematic color grading.

Audio: atmospheric drone → intimate cello → rising orchestral tension → massive launch/flight score → intense percussion during the bank → muffled underwater audio → epic orchestral return during emergence → soft cello/piano ending. Layer detailed ASMR/SFX: dragon breathing, scales, leather, reins, claws scraping soil, wind, wingbeats, water spray, bubbles, ocean impact and a deep natural dragon roar.

Make it indistinguishable from expensive real live-action cinema. No AI look, cartoon, anime, game CGI, plastic textures, fake physics, neon glow, oversaturation, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, text or watermark.

entries.title: Consistent Character Lifestyle Film
entries.description: A long-form lifestyle commercial prompt designed for near-perfect character consistency throughout a full daily routine, from morning to night.
entries.prompt: Use the attached reference image as the identity reference. Preserve the girl's face, hairstyle, body proportions, age, and overall appearance with near-perfect consistency across every shot. She wears realistic outfits appropriate for each scene while remaining clearly the same person throughout. Cinematic, photorealistic, premium lifestyle commercial, 4K, natural color grading, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movement, authentic facial expressions. Every scene flows logically through seamless match cuts and continuous time progression. Scene 1 (0–3s): Soft golden sunrise enters a cozy bedroom. A smartphone alarm rings on the bedside table. She slowly opens her eyes, stretches naturally under the blanket, smiles sleepily, and turns off the alarm. Scene 2 (3–6s): She gets out of bed, opens the curtains, morning sunlight fills the room. Match cut to brushing her teeth, washing her face, then applying light skincare while looking into the mirror. Scene 3 (6–9s): She changes into a smart office outfit. Quick elegant cuts of buttoning her blouse, fastening a watch, putting on earrings, grabbing her handbag, and checking herself in the mirror. Scene 4 (9–12s): Bright modern kitchen. She prepares a healthy breakfast, pours coffee, takes a few bites while checking her phone, then picks up her bag and leaves. Scene 5 (12–16s): Urban commute. Walking confidently through city streets toward a modern office building. Match cut to entering the office, greeting coworkers, typing on a laptop, participating in a meeting, smiling during productive work. Scene 6 (16–19s): Lunch break at a stylish café with colleagues. Everyone laughs naturally while eating and chatting. Warm candid atmosphere, genuine interactions. Scene 7 (19–22s): Late afternoon. She packs her laptop, says goodbye to coworkers, exits the office building into warm golden-hour light. Scene 8 (22–26s): Evening rooftop café with close friends. They enjoy drinks, laugh together, take a quick selfie, city lights gradually illuminate behind them as blue hour begins. Scene 9 (26–30s): Night. She returns home, gently places her keys on the table, changes into comfortable loungewear, sits by the bedroom window with a warm cup of tea while soft ambient lights glow. She exhales with a relaxed smile, curls up on the bed with a book, then turns off the bedside lamp. Fade to black. Style & Camera: Ultra-photorealistic cinematic lifestyle film. Natural, believable acting with subtle expressions. Smooth gimbal movement, gentle push-ins, tracking shots, and seamless match cuts. Soft morning light → bright daytime → golden hour → blue hour → warm cozy night, creating a natural day-to-night progression. Consistent facial identity and outfit continuity within each scene. Realistic environments, premium production quality, no jump cuts, no teleportation, no duplicated people, no distorted hands, no warped objects, no identity drift, no text, no logos, no watermarks. entries.title: Photorealistic CCTV Accident Simulation
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for simulating a realistic surveillance camera view of a narrow-escape traffic accident.
entries.prompt:
フォトリアルな固定監視カメラ（CCTV）映像。高いポールに設置された交通監視カメラが、2車線道路とその脇の歩道をやや見下ろすワイドアングルで捉えている。昼間の自然光、実際の防犯カメラらしい淡いコントラスト、わずかなセンサーノイズと軽い広角の歪み、画面隅に日時のタイムスタンプ表示。カメラは終始完全に固定で動かない。

[0s-9s] ごく平穏な日常。歩道を父親が幼い子供と手をつないでゆっくり歩いている。道路では車が数台、通常の速度で行き交う。異変の気配はまったくない。

[9s-12s] 走ってきた1台の乗用車が突然コントロールを失い、タイヤを鳴らして車線を横切り、歩道の親子めがけて真っ直ぐ突進してくる。速度はほとんど落ちず、車体はぐんぐん親子との距離を詰めていく。父親はまだ気づいていない。

[12s-15s] 車が目前数メートルまで迫った最後の瞬間、父親がタイヤの悲鳴にハッと振り向き、反射的に子供を抱きかかえて横へ全力で飛び退く。その直後、車は一瞬前まで親子が立っていたまさにその場所を突き抜け、二人のわずか数十センチ脇を掠めて歩道側に乗り上げ、砂埃を上げて停止する。接触は一切なく、親子は無傷のまま息を切らして立ち尽くす。ギリギリ間一髪の回避。

スタイル: 実際の監視カメラ録画そのもののフォトリアル品質。固定ワイドショット、演出的なカメラワークなし。音は遠くの走行音、タイヤのスキール音など控えめな環境音のみ。
entries.translated_prompt: Photorealistic fixed surveillance camera (CCTV) footage. A traffic surveillance camera mounted on a high pole captures a wide-angle view looking down slightly at a two-lane road and the sidewalk beside it. Natural daylight, faint contrast characteristic of real security cameras, slight sensor noise and light wide-angle distortion, with a date and time timestamp in the corner of the screen. The camera remains completely fixed and stationary throughout. [0s-9s] A peaceful daily scene. A father is walking slowly on the sidewalk holding hands with a young child. Several cars pass by on the road at normal speeds. [9s-12s] A passenger car suddenly loses control, tires screeching as it crosses the lanes and charges straight toward the parent and child on the sidewalk. [12s-15s] At the final moment, the father snaps around and reflexively scoops up the child, jumping aside. The car plows through the exact spot where they stood, stopping in a cloud of dust. Style: Photorealistic quality of actual surveillance recordings. Fixed wide shot, no cinematic camerawork. Ambient sounds only.

entries.title: Ancient Temple Perfume Thief Action Scene
entries.description: A detailed 30-second one-take action prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring a character in a white lace outfit navigating an ancient temple filled with traps to retrieve a modern perfume bottle.
entries.prompt: 生成一段30秒、实时速度、无剪辑的一镜到底冒险动作影片。中心主体是参考角色@1，她全程严格穿着参考服装@2，连续突破地下古代神殿的四个机关区域，最终从祭坛取得一瓶现代瓶装香水。真实古代遗迹环境，无观众、无主持人、无演播室。 [全局设定] 参考图职责锁定\n仅作为人物参考：锁定同一名成年女性的脸部轮廓、五官比例、深棕色长卷发、红色唇妆、自然成熟气质、古铜色圆盘垂坠耳环和精致金色项链。禁止引用@1的白色背景、九宫格排版、拍摄角度和静态证件照姿势。\n仅作为服装参考：严格锁定白色缎面蕾丝连体服、立体蕾丝高领、胸前结构化蕾丝拼接、白色缎面腰带及正面蝴蝶结、半透明白色长袖披纱、拖曳式蕾丝纱摆、白色缎面长手套、白色蕾丝长筒袜与白色尖头高跟鞋。 禁止引用@2的大理石室内、暖色灯带、跪姿、无头人体展示方式。角色必须拥有@1的完整头部和身体，穿着@2的完整服装。 服装必须适合连续动作表现但不可擅自改款：披纱、腰结、长袜、高跟鞋始终存在。白色布料会逐渐沾染尘土和少量水渍，不能在不同阶段突然恢复洁白。 环境与质感 地下古代神殿内部：长满青苔的巨大石壁、龟裂石板、积水沟渠、半坍塌拱门、深渊石桥和雕刻祭坛。天顶缝隙漏下细窄的冷色光柱，壁面火把产生橙色暖光。空气中漂浮尘埃。石材磨损、青苔湿度、玻璃反光、缎面褶皱、蕾丝纤维、皮革划痕、汗水与灰尘均呈现极致写实的物理质感。 视觉风格 经典考古冒险电影实拍质感，电影级浅景深，暖橙火光与冷色天光混合照明，克制的胶片颗粒和自然运动模糊。不得呈现电子游戏、舞台表演、时装棚拍或香水广告片质感。 镜头语言 一个完整、不中断、实时速度的30秒斯坦尼康长镜头。摄影机必须通过实际移动完成所有角度变化：从3/4后方跟拍，降低至水面高度侧拍，沿回廊侧壁平移，再绕至低角度追逐，最后减速绕至3/4正面中近景。 禁止利用石柱遮挡、摆锤遮挡、黑暗、尘土、快速甩镜或披纱掠过镜头制造隐藏剪辑。角色绝不固定在画面中央，始终位于左右三分之一，行进方向前方保留空间。人物全程从画面左侧向右侧前进，不跳轴、不反向。 角色与道具 @1为唯一角色，穿完整@2服装。她右手持同一支燃烧火把，身体斜挎一只小型磨损棕色皮质探险包。火把、探险包、耳环、项链、腰结、高跟鞋和披纱全程保持一致。探险包用于最终收纳香水。 表演核心 机关触发时必须出现即时反射动作；通过复杂区域前先以眼神计算距离或节奏；急促呼吸和短暂回望表现真实压力。最终表情不是炫耀胜利，而是危险暂时解除后的安心、惊讶与兴奋各占一部分。 现代香水锁定 祭坛宝物是一瓶明确的现代香水：透明厚底切割玻璃方瓶，内部装有淡琥珀粉色液体，银色拉丝金属圆柱瓶盖，现代极简轮廓，无可读品牌文字。瓶体大小、形状、液体颜色和瓶盖必须稳定一致；禁止变成黄金神像、古代圣杯、宝石、魔法药水或其他器物。 [时间戳分镜] 0—5秒｜石门飞镖机关 @1穿着完整@2服装，右手举着火把穿过狭窄石门。摄影机从她的3/4后方贴身跟随，将她置于画面右侧三分之一；深棕色长卷发和白色半透明披纱在行走气流中自然摆动。 第二步落下时，白色尖头高跟鞋踩中一块松动石板。石板在鞋跟重量下发出清晰的“咔哒”声并突然下沉。她的视线瞬间向侧面移动，双肩收紧；左右墙壁孔洞紧接着连续射出飞镖，“嗖、嗖、嗖”交叉掠过。 她立即压低重心，左手撑地、下巴内收，将持火把的右臂向外上方伸开，完成一次沿肩背滚动的贴地前滚。高跟鞋短暂离地，腰间蝴蝶结、长发和蕾丝披纱顺着惯性翻卷，但没有脱落或缠住四肢。飞镖擦过披纱边缘，钉进身后的石壁。 **终态：**她单膝落地，左手撑住龟裂石板，右手火把仍在燃烧；白色手套和膝侧第一次沾上灰尘。她急促呼吸并短暂回头，身后数支飞镖仍在石壁上震动。 5—12秒｜地下水道踏石 承接单膝落地状态。她站起并继续向右，摄影机从后方沿连续弧线降低至水面高度，自然转为侧面轮廊平行跟拍。相机沿地下水道旁的狭窄石沿滑行，不穿墙、不跨越空间。 大厅地面在前方中断，一条黑色地下水道横亘其中，六块方形踏石以之字形排列。她位于画面左侧三分之一，前方留出完整的跳跃空间。 她的视线始终先锁定下一块踏石，然后才转移身体重心。每次起跳都控制在较低高度，以适应高跟鞋和拖曳披纱：前脚掌先落在石块干燥中心，膝盖弯曲吸收冲击，确认稳定后鞋跟才短暂落下。她随即蹬向下一块。 每块踏石承受重量后都会缓慢下沉，缝隙冒出气泡，水面发出低沉“咕噜”声。最后两次跳跃中，披纱末端扫过水面，留下少量湿痕；耳环、项链、腰结和探险包随动作产生真实惯性。 **终态：**她双脚落上对岸石台，前脚掌先接触、膝盖深度弯曲，左手短暂触地恢复平衡。最后一块踏石在她身后完全沉入黑水，披纱下缘沾有水迹，但服装结构完整。 12—18秒｜摆锤石刃回廊 她从落地姿势起身，直接进入与石台相连的狭窄回廊。摄影机绕过入口石柱后贴近同一侧墙壁，以侧面平移继续跟拍，保持一个连续镜头。 回廊天顶垂下三座巨大的半月形石制摆锤，交错摆动，发出沉重轴承摩擦和“嗖、嗖”的破风声。摆锤周期性横穿镜头前景，将她短暂遮挡后再次显露，但遮挡期间仍保持连续环境声和真实摄影机运动，绝不是隐藏转场。 她停一拍观察第一座摆锤的周期，目光在三座石刃之间迅速移动。第一道间隙出现，她提起前脚、身体前倾冲过；第二座摆锤返回时，她紧贴石墙停住，披纱和头发被气流吹向一侧；下一道间隙打开，她再次冲刺。 面对最后一座摆锤，她的后脚前掌牢牢压住石面，前膝弯曲，腰腹收紧，上半身迅速后仰。巨大石刃贴着她胸前和蕾丝领口上方掠过，风压掀起长发、耳环和半透明披纱。石刃没有接触身体，服装没有破裂。 **终态：**她恢复直立并踏出回廊，站在出口右侧三分之一，急促吸气；身后三座摆锤仍按原有节奏交错摆动。 18—24秒｜崩塌石桥冲刺 回廊出口直接连通一座横跨深渊的古老石桥。摄影机不中断地绕至她的3/4后方，并降低到接近膝盖高度；她位于画面右侧三分之一，左侧留给正在崩塌的桥体。 她的第一只高跟鞋踏上桥面，桥梁后端立即发出沉闷断裂声。石板从后方向前依次“轰隆、轰隆”塌落，碎石坠入黑暗。 她开始全力向右冲刺，但步幅保持短促而快速，主要以前脚掌触地，避免鞋跟卡进石缝。探险包撞击腰侧，披纱在身后形成连续拖曳轨迹。一次落脚时鞋跟擦过松动石块，她的身体向外偏斜；左臂立刻展开配重，右手抬高火把，重新找回轴线，继续冲刺。崩塌线始终紧追脚跟。 桥端最后一块石板开始倾斜，她用前脚掌奋力蹬出，向对岸完成一次低而远的跃出。双脚接触地面后膝盖压缩，她顺势侧肩翻滚卸力，避免高跟鞋承受垂直冲击。白色披纱和缎面服装卷起一层灰尘。 **终态：**她伏身停在对岸地面，火把仍握在右手；身后的石桥完全崩塌，只剩碎石落入深渊的回声。她的白色服装已经积尘，披纱下缘带有水渍，状态不重置。 24—30秒｜香水祭坛 她从伏身状态起身，继续向右进入与桥端直接相连的宝物室。摄影机随她升高并自然减速。正前方古老祭坛上，一道天顶冷色光柱照亮一瓶现代香水：透明厚底切割玻璃方瓶、淡琥珀粉色液体和银色拉丝圆柱瓶盖，在周围破败遗迹中形成明确但真实的时代反差。 香水仅受火把暖光与天顶冷光照亮，没有突然出现的摄影棚产品灯光。

entries.title: Authentic Tokyo Travel Vlog
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for a continuous handheld vlog in Tokyo, focusing on maintaining character identity across morning, food, and evening scenes.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic boyfriend-vlog video filmed as one continuous, unbroken handheld take. Use the woman from the reference image as the main character and preserve her exact facial identity, hairstyle, facial features, body proportions, and overall appearance throughout the entire video. She must remain clearly the same person in every moment.

The footage should feel like her boyfriend casually filming her during an ordinary day in Tokyo with a small mirrorless camera or smartphone. Natural handheld movement, slight camera shake, imperfect framing, realistic autofocus, subtle exposure changes, occasional motion blur, and spontaneous reactions. She never poses or performs for the camera; she behaves naturally and sometimes forgets she is being filmed.

0–6s — Morning apartment. Soft daylight enters a small Tokyo apartment. She sits near the bed fixing her hair and getting ready. She notices the camera, smiles, laughs, and playfully gestures for her boyfriend to stop filming. Keep the moment intimate and spontaneous.

6–12s — Tokyo neighborhood. She walks ahead carrying a small bag while the camera follows behind. Quiet residential streets, bicycles, pedestrians, small shops opening, natural morning activity. She occasionally looks back at the camera and casually interacts with the person filming.

12–18s — Local food stop. They enter a cozy neighborhood restaurant. She sits down and tries ramen or another local Japanese dish. Capture close handheld moments of her picking up chopsticks, tasting the food, reacting naturally, and laughing when it is hotter than expected. The boyfriend reacts naturally from behind the camera.

18–24s — Afternoon exploration. She walks through a lively Tokyo neighborhood, browses small shops, looks at interesting objects, takes photos, and occasionally glances back at the camera. The camera naturally shifts between her face, hands, surroundings, pedestrians, storefronts, and small details of everyday life.

24–30s — Evening ending. Tokyo streets are illuminated as night falls. She walks slightly ahead, then turns back and smiles at the camera. Cut naturally to them riding a train home; she sits beside the window watching Tokyo lights pass outside. The camera gently moves closer as she rests quietly, ending like an authentic personal memory.

VISUAL STYLE: Ultra-realistic candid boyfriend travel vlog, documentary realism, natural lighting, authentic human expressions, imperfect handheld camera behavior, realistic skin texture, natural body movement, subtle motion blur, believable Tokyo atmosphere. No commercial/ad aesthetic, no dramatic posing, no cinematic perfection, no artificial transitions, no CGI appearance, no text, no logos, no face changes, no identity drift, no wardrobe changes, and no character inconsistency.

entries.title: Mediterranean Dirt Bike Action
entries.description: A high-intensity, multi-shot cinematic action sequence prompt for a female adventurer riding a dirt bike through a coastal canyon.
entries.prompt: 15-second hyper-realistic live-action cinematic action sequence, 16:9 widescreen. Tomb Raider-inspired adventure atmosphere. A fearless athletic brunette adventurer with one long dark braid, olive-green fitted tank top, weathered brown shorts, rugged utility belt, fingerless gloves and worn leather combat boots rides a powerful realistic dirt bike at extreme speed through a sun-baked coastal canyon. Preserve exactly the same woman, face, hairstyle, clothes, body proportions, motorcycle and environment throughout every shot. Absolute photographic live-action realism. Real human skin, pores, sweat, dust, fabric fibers, worn leather, scratched metal, real suspension movement, tire deformation, realistic weight, inertia, gravity and momentum. Natural Mediterranean sunlight, hard highlights, deep canyon shadows, airborne dust, wind violently moving her braid and clothes, strong sunlight glittering across the ocean. A large elegant white yacht is clearly visible offshore below the cliff, anchored on calm deep-blue water. 0.0–1.3s — SHOT 1 — EXTREME LOW FRONT THREE-QUARTER TRACKING SHOT. Start immediately inside the action, camera only centimeters above the rocky trail, very wide 18mm perspective. The front tire violently enters frame and blasts past loose stones toward camera position, suspension compressing over uneven terrain. The rider attacks the canyon at full speed. Huge dust trail fills the background. Strong parallax from rocks whipping past the lens. Visceral natural camera vibration, believable motion blur, intense sense of speed. 1.3–2.8s — SHOT 2 — TIGHT SIDE PROFILE TELEPHOTO. Hard cut to a compressed 100mm side tracking view framed tightly on the rider from waist to head. Canyon walls streak behind her. Her focused face remains razor sharp while her braid lashes horizontally in the wind. Dust particles catch direct sunlight. Her gloved hand twists the throttle and the bike surges forward. Extremely shallow depth of field with natural focus breathing. 2.8–4.2s — SHOT 3 — REAR WHEEL ACTION CLOSE-UP. Ground-level 35mm shot positioned behind and beside the rear tire. ショット1（0-3秒）：雨に濡れたネオンの夜の街。濡れたアスファルトに反射が揺れ、換気口から蒸気が立ち上る。青チェックスーツのヘルメット男が誰もいない歩道を静かに歩いていて、ヘルメットを雨が流れ落ちる。前方で第1波の覆面2人が暗い路地から出てきて道を塞ぎ、彼は立ち止まる。背後からのゆっくりした追従ショット。〈激しい雨、遠くの雷鳴〉
ショット2（3-6秒）：第1波の2人が襲いかかる。彼は1人目を金属シャッターに叩きつけ、雨の中に火花が散り、1人目は崩れ落ちてそのまま倒れている。ハンドヘルド追従。〈重い打撃音、金属音、雨〉
ショット3（6-10秒）：スローモーション。2人目が振る警棒の下へ上体を反らし、雨粒がネオンの光の中に静止する。通常速度へ速度ランプで復帰し、その同じ襲撃者を濡れたアスファルトへ激しく投げ落とし、水しぶきが上がり、2人目はそのまま倒れている。これで第1波の2人は動かない。ローアングル。〈深い風切り音、重い打撃、水しぶき〉
ショット4（10-12秒）：停車中のバンのスライドドアが勢いよく開き、3人目が飛び出す。直後、4人目がヘッドライトの逆光の中、車のボンネットを飛び越えてくる。光の帯を雨が吹き抜ける。ミディアムワイド、わずかなハンドヘルドの揺れ。〈バンのドア音、濡れた地面の足音〉
ショット5（12-15秒）：4人目が殴りかかる. 彼は横にかわし、鋭い蹴りで4人目を濡れたアスファルトに沈め、4人目はそのまま倒れている。ハンドヘルド追従。〈鋭い打撃音、雨〉
ショット6（15-17秒）：バンからの3人目がタックル。彼は体を回してかわし、縁石脇に積まれた木箱ごと叩き潰す。砕けた木片が雨の中に飛び散り、3人目もそのまま倒れている。これで4人全員が濡れた路上に倒れて動かない。ハンドヘルドの近接追従。〈木の砕ける音、重い落下音〉
ショット7（17-20秒）：降りしきる雨の中のミディアムクローズアップ。水たまりにネオンの反射が震え、背景に倒れた4人が動かないまま映る。赤いネクタイを直すと、黒いスクリーンに明るい黄色の8ビット風ドット絵スマイルが点灯し、雨越しに温かく光る。ゆっくりドリーイン、ローアングル。〈雨音、柔らかいレトロなビープ音〉
全ショットでヘルメット、青チェックスーツ、赤ネクタイ、オリーブのバックパック、黒い革靴を同一に維持。シャープでピント固定、映像安定、変形なし。音楽なし、ヘルメット画面のドット絵スマイル以外の画面テキストなし。

她抓住蛛丝沿弧线向街道方向摆荡下落。重力、惯性和速度变化真实：身体先加速下降，再随着蛛丝绷紧沿圆弧前摆；头发和衣服受到风力向后飘动。摄影机从她的侧后方下降跟随，逐渐形成轻微荷兰角。她松开蛛丝，屈膝落在一辆正在缓慢行驶的黑色汽车车顶上。鞋底与金属车顶发生清晰、扎实的接触，车顶轻微下沉，她通过屈膝和摆臂吸收冲击，绝不漂浮。

8–12秒：
她立刻沿纽约居民区街道上的汽车车顶向前全力冲刺。摄影机低空贴近，以侧后方航拍跟随。她完成三次清晰可读的连续跑酷动作：在第一辆车顶快速奔跑；脚掌蹬住车顶边缘，跨越真实距离跳向第二辆车；落地时脚底准确接触车顶并屈膝缓冲；随后再次蹬地跳向第三辆车。每一步都有明确的起跑、蹬地、腾空、落地和冲击反馈。汽车保持沿街道行驶，车辆大小和透视稳定，人物不能踩空，不能滑行，不能出现布娃娃式肢体或超长滞空。镜头随奔跑节奏产生富有控制感的强烈荷兰角倾斜，但人物始终清晰可见。

12–15秒：
接近街道尽头时，她在最后一辆汽车车顶上用力蹬地跃起，同时再次从手腕向前上方射出白色蜘蛛丝。蛛丝牢固黏在前方红砖公寓楼高处的固定点。绳索先略微松弛，随后随着身体重量自然拉直、拉伸并产生轻微弹性回弹。她被惯性带起，沿真实钟摆弧线从一栋带黑色消防梯的红砖楼荡向另一栋红砖楼。

15–20秒：
摄影机继续无缝追随她进行第二次低空摆荡，始终保持在街道与屋顶之间的中低高度，不进入摩天大楼上空。镜头逐渐从近距离跟拍平滑后退并拉成超广角，露出完整的纽约红砖联排公寓、黑色消防梯、街道车辆和层叠屋顶。人物继续向夕阳方向摆荡，最终在巨大城市画面中变得渺小，准确位于画面中央。镜头以明显但稳定的荷兰角结束。

【物理与摄影要求】
真实重力、惯性、离心力、落地冲击和人体跑酷力学。蛛丝始终连接手腕与明确的建筑锚点，长度稳定，受力后自然绷紧、轻微拉伸和回弹；禁止蛛丝凭空断裂、穿过建筑或改变固定点。人物摆荡必须呈圆弧轨迹，不能直线飞行。摄影机像高机动性FPV无人机一样连续穿窗、俯冲、贴街追逐、抬升和后撤，运动快速但顺滑，主体跟踪稳定，适度自然运动模糊，无抖动眩晕。

纽约低层居民街区，红砖联排公寓、外墙消防梯、狭长街道和真实车流。金色黄昏，暖橙色与粉红色天空，戏剧性的层云、体积光、夕阳轮廓光和玻璃反射。超写实电影质感，真实皮肤与发丝，真实布料和材质，宽动态范围，电影级调色，细腻胶片颗粒，高细节，8K观感。

【严格避免】
任何剪辑、转场、跳切、时间跳跃、场景突变、瞬移、镜头穿帮；人物换脸、换装、复制、突然出现面具或超级英雄制服；多余人物抢镜；多余手指、肢体扭曲、关节反折、腿部穿模；布娃娃动作、漂浮、滑行、太空失重、慢动作滞空；脚没有踩到车顶、车顶与脚底分离、车辆突然消失或变形；蛛丝从手掌以外的位置出现、蛛丝没有锚点、蛛丝变成粗绳；高空摩天楼飞行；卡通感、游戏CG感、过度锐化、塑料皮肤、画面闪烁。
entries.translated_prompt: Generate a 15–20 second, 9:16 vertical, strictly one-take ultra-realistic cinematic video. The entire shot features only one continuous aerial follow-cam, with no cuts, transitions, jump cuts, or resets. [Reference Image Mapping] Image 1: Action and close-up composition for landing on a car roof. Image 2: Action reference for parkour across moving car roofs. Image 3: Sunset sky, NYC brick neighborhood, web-swinging, and final wide-angle atmosphere. Image 4: First frame, character identity, face, hairstyle, clothing, and bedroom environment. [Character Consistency] The character is always the young Asian woman from Image 4: same features, medium-length straight black hair with bangs, off-white short-sleeved knit top, off-white high-waisted shorts, and white sneakers. No face swapping, no costume changes, no superhero suits, and no masks. Body proportions remain stable and natural throughout. [Action Timeline] 0–3s: Camera starts inside a warm, cluttered NYC bedroom. The girl sits cross-legged on a wide windowsill. Golden sunset fills the room. She looks at the camera, then turns toward the city. The camera moves past her side smoothly toward the window. 3–5s: She stands up, shoots a thin white web from her wrist to a nearby building, and jumps out the window. The camera follows her through the window without a cut. 5–8s: She swings down toward the street with realistic gravity and wind effect. She releases the web and lands in a crouch on a moving black car roof. The roof slightly compresses under the impact; she absorbs the shock with her arms and legs—no floating. 8–12s: She sprints forward across car roofs. The camera follows closely at a low angle with a slight Dutch tilt. She performs three distinct parkour jumps between roofs with clear landing feedback. 12–15s: Near the end of the block, she jumps and shoots a new web at a red brick building. The rope stretches and rebounds naturally as she swings between buildings. 15–20s: The camera follows the second swing, pulling back into a super wide-angle shot showing the NYC skyline and brick apartments under the sunset. The character swings toward the sun, becoming a small figure in the center. Ends with a stable Dutch angle. [Physics and Camera Requirements] Realistic gravity, inertia, and impact mechanics. Webs must connect wrist to fixed anchors. Camera moves like a high-agility FPV drone—smooth, fast, and stabilized with natural motion blur. Super-realistic film texture, detailed skin and hair, cinematic color grading, 8K quality. [Strict Avoidance] No cuts, no costume changes, no superhero uniforms, no floating or ragdoll physics, and no sudden scene changes.
