entries.title: Airplane Engine Fire Found Footage POV
entries.description: An immersive found-footage style video prompt depicting a terrifying in-flight emergency with an engine fire seen from a passenger's perspective.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA
Locked first person POV from a passenger seated at the window. Natural handheld head movement only. Realistic breathing, involuntary reactions, turbulence induced shake. Camera never leaves the passenger's perspective.

LOOK
Ultra realistic aviation footage, documentary style, natural cabin lighting mixed with bright daylight outside, authentic aircraft interior, physically accurate engine fire and smoke.

STYLE
Immersive found footage, grounded realism, suspenseful, no cinematic hero shots, every movement feels accidental and human.

CHARACTER
A window seat passenger experiencing an in flight emergency. Only the passenger's natural movements are visible through the camera.

VEHICLE
Modern twin engine commercial airliner cruising above the clouds.

SETTING
Bright afternoon at cruising altitude. Calm conditions suddenly interrupted by an engine fire.

STORYBOARD (15s, 6 cuts)

(~0 to 2.5s, Passenger Window POV)
@Image1The passenger casually looks out of the window. He see bright orange flames erupt from the right engine as thick black smoke streams behind the wing. The passenger leans closer in disbelief while the aircraft begins slight vibration.

(~2.5 to 5s, Passenger Cabin POV)
The passenger quickly turns away from the window into the cabin. Nearby passengers notice the panic, some stand halfway before flight attendants urgently tell everyone to remain seated. Confused faces, nervous whispers, increasing cabin tension.

(~5 to 7.5s, Passenger Cabin POV)
The aircraft shakes harder. Overhead bins rattle. People grip their armrests, someone begins crying, another passenger records on their phone. The cabin lighting flickers slightly.

(~7.5 to 10s, Passenger Cabin POV)
A flight attendant braces while shouting, "Heads down! Stay seated!" The captain announces an engine emergency over the intercom. More passengers begin praying, others panic as turbulence intensifies.

(~10 to 12.5s, Passenger Cabin POV)
Oxygen masks suddenly deploy from the ceiling throughout the cabin. Several passengers scream while others immediately pull masks over their faces. The shaking becomes much more violent.

(~12.5 to 15s, Passenger Cabin POV)
The aircraft banks sharply. Loose items slide across tray tables. The passenger looks toward the front where flight attendants remain strapped into their jump seats as the emergency descent continues. The video ends abruptly during heavy shaking.

CONSISTENCY RULES
Remain entirely in first person passenger POV.
Only the first scene shows the burning engine through the window.
All remaining shots stay inside the cabin.
Maintain the same aircraft interior, seat position, lighting, passenger clothing, and camera height.
Natural human reactions only.
No impossible camera movements.

NEGATIVE PROMPTS
Third person shots, exterior aircraft shots after the first scene, drone footage, Hollywood explosions, detached wings, unrealistic fireballs, CGI look, AI artifacts, duplicated p

entries.title: Game Ad Style Anime Video
entries.description: A sophisticated prompt for creating 2D hand-drawn anime advertisements, focusing on character consistency, facial expression transitions, and cinematic scene transitions.
entries.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。高級品質アニメ、2D手描き（2D hand-drawn）。表情の変化は、目→眉→まぶた→口元→視線の順に進める。

【キャラクター固定】
Image1のキャラクターを全編で同一人物として維持する。Image1は画面に現れる唯一の人物。小さく繊細な丸い顔立ち、大きな紫〜ライラック色の宝石のような瞳、複数の白いキャッチライト、濃い上まつ毛、淡い頬の赤み、長いパステルピンクの髪を左右で結んだ二束、額のゆるいカール、紫の花飾りと濃紺のリボンを保持する。白い半袖セーラーカラーのトップス、濃紺と金の縁取り、ラベンダーのプリーツスカート、濃紺のフリル裾、紫の宝石ベルトも変えない。変化してよいのは表情、視線、自然な口の動き、姿勢、呼吸、髪とスカートの風による揺れだけ。別人化、顔の平均化、髪型変更、衣装交換、分身、鏡像、反射像、別の人物、手、影、シルエットを出さない。会話相手は画面外にも姿を見せず、彼女の斜め左前への視線だけでデートの気配を表す。カメラは終始、客観的な第三者視点。
【画風固定】
Image1の繊細な手描き線画と淡い紫がかった線色、透明な多層影、やわらかなグラデーション、ミルキーピンクとラベンダー、濃紺と金のアクセント、髪の細かな束感、瞳の宝石のような輝き、上品なハイライト、衣装のプリーツと花飾りの情報量を保つ。夏の街、カフェ、川沿い、花火、空もすべて同じ高密度の2D手描き背景美術として描く。太線、厚輪郭、簡略TVアニメ、平坦なセル塗り、低密度背景、滑らかなCG・3D化、写真寄りの質感、くすんだ色、能面のような顔、画風混合にしない。参照画像はImage1の外見と絵柄だけの参照であり、元画像の石造りの回廊、城、ポーズ、構図、カメラ距離を再現しない。全Cutを新規の夏の都市デート場面にする。

【小物・音響固定】
透明なアイスティーのカップは1個だけで、所有者はImage1のみ。Cut 1の冒頭ではImage1が胸の前で両手に持ち、ひと口飲んだ後、Cut 1の終わりにImage1自身が右手でカフェのテーブルへ静かに置く。カップはそのテーブルに残り、Cut 2以降は画面に出さない。
歌なしの爽やかな恋愛ゲーム風インストBGM。柔らかなエレクトリックピアノ、クリーンギター、控えめなシェイカー、淡いシンセパッドを使い、夕方から夜へ自然に高揚させる。氷がカップ内で触れる小さな音、街の遠い空気音、衣擦れ、足音、花火の打ち上げ音を可視の動作へ同期させる。台詞の直前と発話中はBGMを少し下げ、Image1本人の日本語の声を明瞭に聞かせる。歌、ナレーション、相手の返事、ほかの声は入れない。
Cut 1：0.0–3.6秒｜夕暮れの街角カフェ。カメラの位置はImage1の左斜め前の三分の四、目線と同じ高さ、人物サイズは胸上、背景の消失軸はテーブルの奥から夕陽の当たる通り右奥へ伸びる。目的は、アイスティーの一口と、Image1の瞳の最初のときめきを同時に読むこと。Image1が透明カップのアイスティーを両手で持ち、笑顔のまま一口飲む。氷が一度だけ澄んだ音を立て、夕陽がカップの縁と髪の外周を淡く照らす。Image1は右手でカップをテーブルの上へ確実に置き、斜め左前へふっと視線を上げ、瞳と口角が少し明るくなる。カメラは同じ高さで短く横へスライドし、カフェのオーニングの影がレンズ前を一瞬横切って次の街路へつなぐ。

Cut 2：3.6–7.2秒｜夕焼けの商店街。カメラの位置はImage1の左斜め前の三分の四、腰より少し高い位置、人物サイズは中景、背景の消失軸は彼女の進行方向にある商店街の左奥へ続く。目的は、歩みと一言に宿るときめきを顔から読み取ること。Image1は自然に一歩進む。発声前の短い予備動作として、目が少し明るくなる、眉がほんの少し上がる、まぶたがやわらかく細まる、口元の口角がほどける、最後に斜め左前を見る。Image1本人が「今日、すごく楽しいね。」と一度だけ自然に発声する。唇の動き、息、表情、声を完全に同期させる。発声中はBGMを控えめにして声を前へ出し、言い終わりの短い余韻でクリーンギターとシェイカーが戻る。街路樹の葉の前景ぼけが短くレンズを横切り、夜の川沿いへ切り替わる。
Cut 3：7.2–11.0秒｜青紫の夜に変わった川沿いの散歩道。カメラの位置はImage1の右側面、目線と同じ高さ、人物サイズは横顔が読める中景、背景の消失軸は川沿いの遊歩道から遠い花火の空へ伸びる。目的は、夜空の変化がImage1の驚きとときめきへ届く瞬間を見せること。Image1が一度だけ空を見上げる。髪束とスカートの裾が夜風に遅れて揺れた瞬間、遠い夜空で紫、桃、金の花火が一発大きく弾ける。花火の光は顔に点や線として重ねず、髪の外周と衣装の縁にだけ柔らかな面光として返す。花火が弾ける瞬間に、BGMへあたたかいシンセパッドと細いストリングスを加えて一段だけ広げる。カメラは右側からわずかに寄り、驚きからときめきへ変わる瞳と微笑みを読み取れる距離を保つ。
Cut 4：11.0–15.0秒｜花火の余韻とタイトル。カメラの位置はImage1の左斜め前の三分の四、目線と同じ高さ、人物サイズは胸上、背景の消失軸は右側の夜空の奥へ開く。目的は、Image1の顔とタイトルを互いに邪魔せず一枚の余韻として読ませること。Image1を画面左三分の一の胸上サイズに保ち、右側の夜空だけをタイトル用の余白として開ける。Image1は花火を見たまま一度ゆっくり瞬き、横顔からわずかに斜め前へ表情を戻し、澄んだ笑顔で止まらず自然に呼吸を続ける。夜空の右側に、顔・瞳・口元・髪飾りから十分離して二行の清潔なタイトル処理を表示する。小さな乳白色の文字で「この夏、君との出会いがときめきにかわる」、その下に大きな深い藍色と淡いラベンダーの縁光で「真夏の夜」。字幕ではなく作品タイトルとして表示し、ほかの読める文字、ロゴ、透かしは出さない。カメラはImage1を小さくしない範囲でほんの少し引く。15.0秒ちょうどで、Image1の顔とタイトルの両方が完全に読め、最後の花火の尾が夜空で消える直前に、ピアノの短い余韻でカットする。
entries.translated_prompt:
High-quality anime footage. High-quality anime, 2D hand-drawn. Facial expression changes proceed in the order of eyes -> eyebrows -> eyelids -> mouth -> gaze.

[Character Fixation]
Maintain the character from Image1 as the same person throughout. Image1 is the only person appearing on screen. Small and delicate round facial features, large purple to lilac jewel-like eyes, multiple white catchlights, thick upper eyelashes, faint cheek redness, long pastel pink hair tied in two bunches on the sides, loose curls on the forehead, purple flower ornaments and dark blue ribbons. White short-sleeved sailor collar top, dark blue and gold trim, lavender pleated skirt, dark blue frill hem, and purple jewel belt do not change. Only expressions, gaze, natural mouth movements, posture, breathing, and the swaying of hair and skirt in the wind may change. Do not produce different people, facial averaging, hairstyle changes, outfit swaps, doubles, mirror images, reflections, other people, hands, shadows, or silhouettes. The conversation partner does not appear even off-screen; the presence of a date is expressed only by her gaze toward the diagonal left front. The camera is objectively third-person throughout.
[Art Style Fixation]
Maintain the delicate hand-drawn line art and pale purple-tinged line colors, transparent multi-layered shadows, soft gradients, milky pink and lavender, dark blue and gold accents, fine hair textures, jewel-like eye sparkle, elegant highlights, and detail in the skirt pleats and flower ornaments of Image1. The summer town, cafe, riverside, fireworks, and sky are all drawn as the same high-density 2D hand-drawn background art. Do not use thick lines, heavy outlines, simplified TV anime, flat cell shading, low-density backgrounds, smooth CG/3D conversion, photo-like textures, dull colors, expressionless faces, or mixed styles. The reference image is only for appearance and style; it does not reproduce the stone corridor, castle, pose, composition, or camera distance of the original image. Every cut is a new summer urban date scene.

[Prop and Audio Fixation]
There is only one transparent iced tea cup, owned only by Image1. At the beginning of Cut 1, Image1 holds it in both hands in front of her chest, and after taking a sip, Image1 herself quietly places it on the cafe table with her right hand at the end of Cut 1. The cup remains on that table and is not shown from Cut 2 onwards.
A refreshing romance game-style instrumental BGM without vocals. Use soft electric piano, clean guitar, modest shakers, and pale synth pads, naturally building excitement from evening to night. Synchronize small sounds like ice clinking in the cup, distant city ambient sounds, rustling clothes, footsteps, and the sound of fireworks launching with visible actions. Lower the BGM slightly just before and during dialogue to make Image1's Japanese voice clearly audible. Do not include singing, narration, the other person's response, or other voices.
Cut 1: 0.0–3.6s | Street corner cafe at dusk. Camera position is three-quarters to the left front of Image1, at eye level, character size is chest-up, background vanishing axis extends from the back of the table to the back right of the street illuminated by the sunset. The goal is to simultaneously read the sip of iced tea and the first flicker of excitement in Image1's eyes. Image1 holds the transparent cup of iced tea in both hands and takes a sip while smiling. The ice makes a clear sound once, and the sunset softly illuminates the rim of the cup and the outer edge of her hair. Image1 firmly places the cup on the table with her right hand, shifts her gaze slightly to the diagonal left front, and her eyes and the corners of her mouth brighten slightly. The camera slides sideways for a short distance at the same height, and the shadow of the cafe awning momentarily crosses in front of the lens to connect to the next street.

Cut 2: 3.6–7.2s | Shopping street at sunset. Camera position is three-quarters to the left front of Image1, slightly higher than the waist, character size is medium shot, background vanishing axis continues to the far left of the shopping street in her direction of travel. The goal is to read the excitement in her steps and words from her face. Image1 naturally takes a step forward. As a short preliminary action before speaking, her eyes brighten slightly, eyebrows lift just a bit, eyelids soften and narrow, the corners of her mouth relax, and finally she looks toward the diagonal left front. Image1 herself naturally speaks once: "Today is really fun." Completely synchronize lip movements, breath, expression, and voice. During the speech, lower the BGM to bring the voice forward, and in the short lingering sound at the end, the clean guitar and shaker return. A foreground blur of street tree leaves briefly crosses the lens, switching to the night riverside.
Cut 3: 7.2–11.0s | Riverside promenade changed to blue-purple night. Camera position is the right side of Image1, at eye level, character size is a medium shot where the profile can be read, background vanishing axis extends from the riverside promenade to the sky of distant fireworks. The goal is to show the moment the change in the night sky reaches Image1's surprise and excitement. Image1 looks up at the sky once. The moment her hair bunches and skirt hem sway slightly late in the night breeze, a large purple, peach, and gold firework bursts in the distant night sky. Do not overlay firework light as dots or lines on the face; return it only as soft surface light to the outer edge of the hair and the edges of the outfit. At the moment the firework bursts, add warm synth pads and thin strings to the BGM to expand it by one stage. The camera leans in slightly from the right, maintaining a distance where the eyes and smile changing from surprise to excitement can be read.
Cut 4: 11.0–15.0s | Afterglow of fireworks and title. Camera position is three-quarters to the left front of Image1, at eye level, character size is chest-up, background vanishing axis opens to the back of the night sky on the right. The goal is to let Image1's face and the title be read together as a single afterglow without interfering with each other. Keep Image1 in a chest-up size on the left third of the screen, leaving only the right night sky open as white space for the title. Image1 continues to breathe naturally without stopping with a clear smile, blinking slowly once while looking at the fireworks, shifting her expression slightly from the profile to the diagonal front. On the right side of the night sky, display a clean two-line title treatment well away from the face, eyes, mouth, and hair ornaments. In small milky white characters: "This summer, my encounter with you turns into excitement," and below it in large deep indigo with pale lavender edge light: "Midsummer Night." Display it as a work title rather than a subtitle, and do not show other readable text, logos, or watermarks. The camera pulls back slightly without making Image1 too small. At exactly 15.0 seconds, both Image1's face and the title are completely readable, and cut with a short piano afterglow just before the last firework tail disappears in the night sky.

entries.title: Anime Popcorn Timestop Sequence
entries.description: A mixed-media prompt for a 3D bar scene where an anime character freezes time, walks through suspended objects, and restarts motion, including detailed sound cues.
entries.prompt:
Use @dargo as the main character, keeping facial features, hairstyle, and body proportions consistent throughout. He is a 25-year-old man. Cinematic time-freeze anime short film, 18 seconds, ultra-realistic 2D anime character composited into a realistic 3D setting, 35mm lens, moody sports bar interior lighting with neon accents, volumetric haze, dynamic hard shadows, shallow depth of field.
[0:00–0:04] A packed, dimly lit sports bar, time flowing normally. Steadicam frontal medium shot tracking him as he walks confidently through total chaos with a smug smirk. He is clearly a 2D anime-styled man inside a realistic 3D bar environment, creating a striking mixed-media contrast. On the blurred TVs in the background, the Yankees have just clinched the World Series. The crowd erupts in euphoric celebration. As he walks, he slowly raises his right hand, snaps, and shouts, “ZA WARUDO.”
[0:04–0:07] At the snap, a subtle spherical shockwave bursts from his fingertips with air distortion and light refraction, expanding outward through the bar. Everything freezes mid-eruption. Thick golden arcs of beer suspend in the air with sharply visible droplets. Popcorn kernels float motionless. Fans are frozen mid-cheer, mid-jump, and mid-embrace. Neon highlights catch the suspended liquid, dust, and haze. The entire room falls into absolute silence.
[0:07–0:10] Only he moves. His footsteps echo faintly in the frozen bar. The camera glides backward as he walks through the suspended celebration, calm and amused. He casually ducks under a frozen splash of beer, then notices a cluster of floating popcorn. He reaches out and plucks a single kernel from the air with total ease.
[0:10–0:13] He stops in front of a frozen woman in a Yankees jersey, her face locked in an ecstatic, tearful scream, arms raised for a high-five. He tilts his head with quiet amusement, gently adjusts the brim of her frozen Yankees cap, then gives a small approving nod.
[0:13–0:18] He flicks the popcorn kernel into her open mouth, turns toward camera, and smirks. He snaps again. A stronger reverse shockwave bursts outward and restores motion instantly. The beer completes its splash, the crowd’s deafening roar slams back in, and fans land from their jumps. He continues walking away through the wildly celebrating crowd as the camera pushes forward through the bar. Fade to black.
Sound: deafening sports bar celebration and TV crowd noise → finger snap → deep shockwave bass drop → absolute silence → faint footsteps and room tone → small popcorn flick and crunch → second snap → reverse shockwave → full crowd roar returns instantly.

entries.title: Realistic Bedroom Candid Observation
entries.description: A multi-shot video prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring a young woman relaxing in her bedroom, interacting with her phone and a cat, with detailed shot descriptions and dialogue.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic multi-shot candid observational video of a young Korean woman relaxing naturally in her bedroom. Use multiple distinct shots and camera angles, not a single continuous take. The footage should feel like an accidentally captured real-life moment.

STYLE:
Handheld documentary realism, imperfect framing, subtle camera shake, gentle exposure breathing, autofocus settling slightly late, realistic skin texture, soft natural indoor light and shallow depth of field. Natural blinking, breathing, body movement and restrained authentic expressions. No posing, glossy commercial look or cinematic perfection.

SUBJECT:
A naturally beautiful young Korean woman in her early 20s with long dark hair. She wears a matching cotton pajama set: scoop-neck sleeveless top and loose shorts. Barefoot, minimal makeup, realistic skin texture.

SETTING:
A lived-in, slightly messy bedroom with an unmade bed, soft bedding and everyday personal belongings. She relaxes on her stomach across the bed while browsing a shopping page on a black smartphone. A house cat interacts naturally with her.

SHOT 1 — 0–4s:
She lies on her stomach, casually scrolling through a shopping page. She frowns slightly, then mutters in Korean: "아, 뭐 살랬더라..." ("Ah... what was I going to buy again?"). Natural Korean lip sync. Her bare feet gently sway behind her. A low handheld camera glides beside the mattress.

SHOT 2 — 4–8s:
A house cat jumps onto the bed, compressing the blanket and walking toward her arm. It gives one natural meow. The camera reacts with a tiny jolt, then reframes toward her face, hands and cat.

SHOT 3 — 8–12s:
She turns toward the cat and gently strokes it from forehead to shoulders. She affectionately says: "우리 애기 왔어?" ("Did my baby come?"). Accurate lip sync. The camera pushes closer through the cat's softly blurred foreground.

SHOT 4 — 12–16s:
Her friend's ringtone sounds. She looks down, checks the caller, swipes to answer and brings the phone to her ear. The camera makes a loose semicircular movement from a slightly tilted overhead angle.

SHOT 5 — 16–21s:
Her friend talks. She listens with a confused expression, then reacts: "어, 왜? 진짜 거짓말!" ("Huh? Why? No way, you're kidding."). She immediately bursts into genuine laughter. The cat kneads the blanket beside her. A close handheld side angle captures her profile and phone.

SHOT 6 — 21–25s:
A clear doorbell interrupts her laughter. She and the cat turn toward the bedroom door. She pauses, realizing her food has arrived, braces one hand on the mattress and begins getting up. The camera reacts slightly late before correcting back to her movement.

SHOT 7 — 25–30s:
Still holding the phone, she says in Korean: "어, 나 밥 왔다. 끊어." ("Oh, my food's here. I'll hang up."). She ends the call, gets off the bed and walks toward the door. The cat follows across the blankets. The camera tilts upward as she stands, ending with a natural handheld follow toward the doorway.

AUDIO:
No musi

entries.title: Seamless Multi-Style Character Transformation
entries.description: A complex video prompt that transforms a single character through three distinct visual styles—live-action, anime, and Hollywood cinematic—in one continuous shot.
entries.prompt:
Create a premium cinematic 15-second transformation story following the SAME young female protagonist continuously through three visual styles: realistic live-action → high-end anime/3D animation → Hollywood blockbuster.

0–5s — REALISTIC WORLD
A stylish young woman walks alone through a modern city at night.

Rain falls lightly. Neon signs reflect across the wet street. She wears a sophisticated black streetwear outfit with subtle red accents.

She hears a powerful hip-hop beat.

She stops.

Close-up of her eyes.

She looks toward camera and begins a confident dance-inspired movement.

Typography appears:
“WHO ARE YOU?”

Camera rapidly pushes toward her hand as she raises it toward the lens.

5–10s — ANIMATED WORLD
The exact hand movement triggers the transformation.

The live-action city smoothly becomes a breathtaking high-end animated world.

The SAME girl, SAME outfit, SAME pose and SAME movement continue without interruption.

Stylized energy particles surround her. Buildings stretch upward. Neon colors pulse with the beat.

She performs a powerful choreographed movement through the animated city.

Typography dynamically forms around her:

“WHO YOU CHOOSE TO BE.”

Use fluid premium animation, detailed facial expressions, realistic cloth movement and cinematic camera choreography.

10–15s — HOLLYWOOD BLOCKBUSTER
During her final animated movement, the environment suddenly transforms into an epic Hollywood-style cinematic cityscape.

The SAME girl lands on a rooftop overlooking a massive glowing metropolis.

Realistic wind moves her hair and clothes. Dramatic clouds, atmospheric haze, anamorphic lens flare and powerful backlighting create blockbuster scale.

Camera circles her as she turns toward the lens.

Final beat.

She confidently smiles.

Huge cinematic typography appears:

“BECOME UNSTOPPABLE.”

Final hero frame with dramatic music impact and premium movie-trailer finish.

VISUAL RULE: The transformation should feel like ONE continuous shot/story—not three separate clips. Preserve the girl's identity, clothing, movement, camera direction and emotional expression through every style transition.

entries.title: Comical Fridge J-POP Music Video
entries.description: A creative prompt for a 30-second comedic music video featuring a woman who forgets why she opened the fridge and starts singing a catchy J-POP song, designed for testing lip-sync in Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt: 30秒のコミカルな実写ミュージックビデオ。日本の普通の家庭のキッチン。一人の女性が冷蔵庫の前に立っている。女性は冷蔵庫を勢いよく開けた瞬間、完全に目的を忘れてしまう。冷蔵庫の中を真剣な顔で見つめながら、突然、明るくキャッチーなJ-POP風の歌を日本語で歌い始める。歌声は自然な日本人女性の声。明るくコミカルだが、歌唱自体は本格的で上手い。歌詞を明瞭な日本語で発音し、口の動きを歌声に正確に同期させる。【歌詞】「何しに来たんだ　冷蔵庫 開けた瞬間　わからない 麦茶じゃない プリンじゃない 昨日のカレーでもない いったん閉めれば思い出す？ 閉めた！ 思い出した！ ……何だっけ？」最後の「何だっけ？」で音楽が突然止まる。女性は無言で冷蔵庫をもう一度開け、真顔で中を見つめる。冷蔵庫の冷気だけが静かに流れる。映像演出：最初は普通の日常ドラマのような自然な映像。歌が始まった瞬間から急に本格的なミュージックビデオになる。冷蔵庫内部からのPOVショット、顔への高速ドリーイン、牛乳やプリンへの劇的なクローズアップ、サビでは大げさな映画的ライティング。無駄に壮大で高品質な映像演出。音楽：キャッチーで明るいJ-POP。軽快なドラム、ベース、ピアノ、ブラス。歌声を最前面に配置。日本語の歌詞が聞き取りやすいミックス。途中で音楽を途切れさせない。最後の「何だっけ？」の直後だけ完全に音楽を停止。字幕、テロップ、画面上の文字は一切表示しない。
entries.translated_prompt: A 30-second comical live-action music video. A typical Japanese family kitchen. A woman is standing in front of a refrigerator. The moment she flings the fridge open, she completely forgets her purpose. While staring seriously into the fridge, she suddenly begins to sing a bright, catchy J-POP style song in Japanese. The singing voice is a natural Japanese female voice. It is bright and comical, but the singing itself is professional and skillful. Pronounce the lyrics in clear Japanese and synchronize lip movements exactly with the singing voice. [Lyrics] 'Why did I come to the fridge? The moment I opened it, I don't know. It's not barley tea. It's not pudding. It's not yesterday's curry... Will I remember if I close it once? Closed it! I remembered! ...What was it?' At the final 'What was it?', the music stops suddenly. The woman silently opens the fridge again and stares inside with a deadpan face. Cold air flows quietly from the fridge. Visual Direction: Starts as a natural daily life scene. The moment the song starts, it suddenly becomes a professional music video. POV shots from inside the fridge, high-speed dolly-ins on the face, dramatic close-ups of milk and pudding, and exaggerated cinematic lighting during the chorus. Purposefully grand and high-quality visual direction. Music: Catchy and bright J-POP with light drums, bass, piano, and brass. Singing voice placed at the forefront. Mix ensures Japanese lyrics are easy to hear. Do not interrupt the music mid-song. Stop music completely only after the final 'What was it?'. Do not display any subtitles, captions, or text on screen.

entries.title: Luxury Car Delivery Vlog Video Prompt
entries.description: A professional-grade, multi-shot cinematic prompt for generating a realistic 30-second vlog showing a luxury car delivery ceremony, featuring specific camera movements and vehicle details.
entries.prompt:
【风格】高端交车仪式 vlog（Luxury Car Delivery Vlog），专业机位 + 手持自拍视角混剪，4K 真实摄影（Photorealistic），自然肤质毛孔可见，无滤镜塑料感，竖屏 9:16
【时长】30秒
【场景】超跑交付展厅（水泥灰地面、黑色墙面、顶部条形射灯）→ 展厅门口坡道 → 傍晚城市高架
【角色】车主@ 图片1（长发女性，黑发发尾酒红渐层大波浪，细金属框透明镜片眼镜，灰色针织吊带连衣裙）；两名穿黑西装的工作人员（背景功能性人物，不给正脸）
【车辆】明黄色兰博基尼 Urus（Lamborghini Urus，超级SUV），四门高底盘车身，车头六边形大灯与Y字形日行灯，侧面锐利折线，宽轮眉，23寸黑色轮毂，双边四出排气，车尾贯穿式扰流板
【全局约束】黑布只在镜头1出现，滑落后堆在车尾地面，之后所有镜头不再出现；鲜花、彩带、丝带只存在于镜头1至镜头7的地面与场地布置中，镜头8车身表面必须干净，无任何花束、丝带、彩带或装饰物

[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：黑布自动后拉揭幕（Crane Up / Reveal）
低机位，画面中央是一台被整块哑光黑绒布完全罩住的高大车形，布料垂坠贴着车身轮廓，能看出高底盘和方正的车顶线条。
动作：她从画面右侧走入，停在车头前，抬手示意。黑绒布被车尾方向的牵引绳拉动，整块布从车头开始向车尾方向匀速滑走——先露出明黄色车头和六边形大灯，再是引擎盖和前风挡，接着是车顶、侧窗、宽轮眉，最后布料从车尾滑脱，堆在车尾后方的地面上。
镜头同步从地面缓缓上升，黄色车漆随着布的后撤一段段亮起来。
音效：厚重布料在车漆上摩擦滑动的沙沙声，现场轻微惊呼，低频背景音渐起。

[00:05-00:09] 镜头2：360°环绕（Orbit 360）
镜头贴地绕车身完整转一圈，依次扫过Y字形日行灯、前保险杠进气口、宽轮眉与23寸黑轮毂、侧面锐利折线、车尾贯穿式扰流板和双边四出排气。
动作：她站在车身左侧，一只手搭在车门把手上，身体随镜头转动始终看向车，头发被空调风轻轻吹动。
顶部条形射灯在黄色折线车身上扫出一道不断流动的高光。

[00:09-00:13] 镜头3：交车仪式铺花（Slow Dolly Right）
中景，镜头缓慢向右横移。两名穿黑西装的工作人员从画面两侧走入，把一捧捧白玫瑰和粉色绣球铺在车头前方地面 and 车身两侧，围成一个半圆花带，车头盖上摆一束系着红丝带的花束。
画面右侧推入一辆金色小推车，上面放着冰桶和几只高脚杯，冰块表面有细密水珠。
她站在花带中央，低头看了看脚边的花，抬头笑。

[00:13-00:16] 镜头4：碰杯（Handheld Close-up）
近景，她端起一只高脚杯，杯中金色气泡不停往上冒，她冲镜头笑着说了句什么，然后把杯沿轻轻磕在镜头前，"叮"的一声，镜头随之轻微晃了一下。
她眯眼笑，抬起的手臂短暂遮住半边眼镜又移开，指尖在杯壁上留下一点雾痕。
手持真实轻微抖动，背景的黄色车身虚化成一片暖黄。

[00:16-00:19] 镜头5：礼炮打响（Slow-mo Confetti Burst）
全景略微升格。她站在车头旁的花带中间，画面左右两侧的礼炮同时"嘣"地打响，大量金色和白色彩带、纸屑向上喷出，在空中缓慢翻卷飘落。
动作：她被声响吓得肩膀猛地一缩，随即张嘴大笑，双手举高，头发被气流掀起。彩带落在她的肩膀和黄色车漆上。

[00:19-00:22] 镜头6：坐车比耶（Handheld Selfie POV）
车门向外打开，她踩着侧踏板抬腿坐上高位驾驶座。切到手持自拍视角，她左手对着镜头比耶，右手搭在方向盘上，脸凑近镜头笑，一根彩带还挂在她头发上。
车内红黑撞色皮革、双联屏中控、六边形出风口、碳纤维饰板清晰可见。画面在逆光下短暂过曝后自动恢复。

[00:22-00:25] 镜头7：准备出发（Rear Seat Fixed Cam）
后排固定机位，越过驾驶座椅背拍摄，她的后脑勺和酒红色发尾垂在椅背上，前挡风外是展厅门口的亮光。
动作：她掀开中控台上的红色启动键保护盖，拇指按下去，双联屏和仪表盘瞬间亮起，发动机爆出一声轰鸣，车身轻微抖了一下。她向右后方回头，笑着看向镜头两秒，然后转回去握住方向盘。

[00:25-00:30] 镜头8：上路·航拍收尾（Launch + Drone Pull-back）
车门"砰"地关合。车全力起步冲出展厅门口坡道，车尾轻微下压，地面的花瓣和彩带被排气气流吹得翻卷起来。车身表面干净，无任何鲜花、丝带或彩带残留。
镜头切到航拍：无人机高空俯拍，明黄色车身在灰色高架上快速穿行，落日金光从车顶和侧面一路掠过。无人机随车向后上方拉升，城市天际线露出，黄色车身缩成画面里一个明亮的黄点。
音效：排气轰鸣、轮胎摩擦、风噪，背景音乐在最后两秒推到最高点后骤停。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Style] High-end car delivery vlog, professional camera mixed with handheld selfie POV, 4K photorealistic, natural skin texture with visible pores, no plastic filter look, vertical 9:16
[Duration] 30 seconds
[Scene] Supercar delivery showroom (cement grey floor, black walls, top strip lights) → Showroom ramp → Urban highway at sunset
[Characters] Owner @Image 1 (long black hair with wine red ombre waves, thin metal frame transparent lenses, grey knit slip dress); two staff members in black suits (background figures, no front faces shown)
[Vehicle] Bright yellow Lamborghini Urus (Super SUV), four-door high-chassis, hexagonal headlights with Y-shaped DRLs, sharp side creases, wide arches, 23-inch black rims, quad exhausts, rear integrated spoiler
[Global Constraints] Black cloth only in Shot 1, drops behind the car, then disappears; flowers and ribbons only in Shots 1-7, vehicle surface must be clean in Shot 8

[00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Black cloth automatic reveal (Crane Up / Reveal). Low angle, centered on a high car shape covered in matte black velvet. The owner enters from the right, signals, and the cloth is pulled back smoothly, revealing the yellow car from front to back. Audio: Thick fabric sliding on paint, slight gasps, low-frequency background music starts.
[00:05-00:09] Shot 2: Orbit 360. Ground-level circular shot sweeping over headlights, wheels, side creases, and exhausts. The owner stands by the left door, hand on handle, body turning with the camera. Audio: Atmospheric indoor hum.
[00:09-00:13] Shot 3: Flower arrangement (Slow Dolly Right). Staff members place white roses and pink hydrangeas in a semi-circle around the car. A golden cart with ice and glasses is pushed in. The owner stands in the flowers and smiles. 
[00:13-00:16] Shot 4: Toasting (Handheld Close-up). She holds a glass with golden bubbles, smiles to the camera, and clinks it against the lens. A slight finger mist mark is left on the glass. Handheld shake, car background blurred.
[00:16-00:19] Shot 5: Confetti Burst (Slow-mo). Full shot. Confetti cannons fire white and gold streamers. She shrugs playfully at the sound then laughs with hands up. Streamers land on her and the car.
[00:19-00:22] Shot 6: Sitting in car (Handheld Selfie POV). She gets into the driver's seat, gives a peace sign to the camera, a streamer still in her hair. Interior leather and dual-screen dash clearly visible.
[00:22-00:25] Shot 7: Departure prep (Rear Seat Fixed Cam). View from behind the driver's seat showing her burgundy hair. She opens the red start button cover, presses it, engine roars, car shakes slightly. She smiles back at the camera then turns to the wheel.
[00:25-00:30] Shot 8: On road (Launch + Drone Pull-back). Car pulls out of the showroom ramp, tail dipping slightly, blowing petals away. Aerial drone shot follows the yellow car on the grey highway as the sunset hits. Drone pulls back to reveal the skyline. Audio: Exhaust roar, wind noise, music peaks then stops.

entries.title: Ink-Wash Wuxia Combat Scene
entries.description: A comprehensive storyboard prompt for a 2D ink-wash style martial arts battle between a water mage and a swordsman.
entries.prompt: Left side woman: Cold Tide barrier master, blue-white long robe, water-element mage. Uses cold water, barriers, water walls, water rings, water-flow traction, and ink-wash tidal waves in combat. She must maintain distance and must never allow the man to stably close in. Right side man: Crimson-black long robe red-blade swordsman, solid red large blade, black cloak, crimson fire-ink, black ink waves, golden shattered ink. Fighting style is strong assault, breaking formations, charging in, horizontal slashes, aerial heavy chops. He must constantly attempt to close the distance and break through the water walls. Generate a 15-second 16:9 landscape 720P high-definition 2D ink-wash wuxia combat video. Overall high-energy 2D ink-wash combat aesthetic: fierce, fast, explosive actions, strong ink-follow, large-area splash-ink explosions, characters high-definition and clear. No 3D, no live-action, no CG feel, no sketch style, no static illustration. Combat arena: rainy aftermath of shattered water-courtyard ruins, large areas of shallow water covering a green-stone plaza, surrounded by broken bridges, residual pillars, collapsed water pavilions, broken tiles, stone steps, distant ink clouds. The ground must have large water surfaces; character movement produces water splashes, ripples, reflections, and ink-wash ripples. During combat the water surface is split by blade energy, water walls are shattered, residual pillars are broken by water waves, green stone is cleaved by the red blade, broken tiles are swept up by water flow and shockwaves. Core combat relationship: The woman is a mid-to-long-range water mage who actively controls the field and suppresses. The man is a close-range red-blade fighter who must constantly charge to break distance. The woman always uses the water surface, barriers, water walls, and spatial displacement to keep 3–8 meters distance. The man constantly uses ground-hugging dashes, diagonal charges, aerial downward chops, and spinning horizontal slashes to forcibly close the gap. Every time the man is about to get close, the woman must use water walls, water rings, surging waves, mirror-position swaps, sliding-water retreats, or barrier rebounds to interrupt. She cannot stand still to cast; she must cast while sliding, spinning, retreating, or leaping on water. Absolute real-time high-speed combat. No slow motion, no variable frame rates, no speed ramps, no static charging, no one-move-one-stop, no idle time after collision. From the first frame to the last frame continuously. At least 3 effective offense-defense exchanges per second: water-wall blocking, red-blade breaking walls, water-wave counter-push, charge dodging, barrier rebound, pursuit avoidance happening continuously. Ink-wash special effects must be extremely strong. All of the woman’s actions carry cyan-blue ink, water splashes, cold white flying white, water-ripple barriers, transparent water walls, vortex water rings. All of the man’s actions carry crimson fire-ink, large red blade arcs, black cloak ink waves, golden shattered ink. Water and fire-ink must contrast sharply: cyan-blue tides suppress red-black blade waves; when the red blade splits a water wall, red-blue colliding splash-ink explodes. Ordinary exchanges occupy one-third of the frame with ink effects, heavy strikes occupy half the frame, final explosion is full-screen ink-wash detonation. 0–3 s: Low camera close to the water surface rapid tracking. Woman slides backward on water, sleeves roll out three cyan-blue water rings, semi-transparent water wall rises from the surface. Man charges violently from the distance hugging the ground, red blade dragging and splitting the water surface, crimson fire-ink and water splashes exploding simultaneously. Man horizontal-slashes the first water wall; woman sideways slides on water to change position; second water wall rolls up from his side and deflects his slash momentum. Camera stays low on the water surface chasing, water splashes hitting the lens. 3–6 s: Medium-close rapid cuts. Man consecutive three-stage strong assault: diagonal charge horizontal slash, spinning upward lift, aerial downward chop. Woman retreats while casting without pause: water sleeves flick to form an arc water shield, foot vortex shifts her body sideways three meters, both hands form seals to raise two water walls for pincer attack. Red blade shatters the water shield, shattered water turns into cyan-blue splash-ink rain; woman uses the water wave to push herself sliding to the side of the broken bridge, maintaining distance. 6–9 s: Large-scale spatial displacement. Man stomps and shatters green stone, leaps across the water channel, black cloak trailing red-black ink waves, red blade chopping down from above. Woman does not hard-block; she leaps on water, water column underfoot lifts her into a side flip, circular water-ripple barrier appears behind her. Blade energy chops into the barrier, water surface explodes into a ring-shaped giant wave, man is forced half a step back by water pressure. Woman lands on top of a residual pillar on the opposite side and immediately flings three water blades from different angles to seal the man’s pursuit path. 9–12 s: Pursuit and counter-suppression. Man forcibly breaks through the water blades, ground-hugging rapid charge, red blade continuously splitting the water surface forming three crimson blade scars. Woman high-speed retreats along the water surface, both sleeves trailing long cyan-blue ink tails, spins and summons a row of water walls pushing forward like a tidal wave. Man uses the large blade to continuously break the walls; his body is repeatedly shocked back, slides, then forcibly charges forward again; water surface underfoot is stomped and explodes, red-blue splash-ink continuously detonating. Camera rapidly switches between weapon close-ups, water-wall shattering close-ups, and full-body chase shots; cuts never interrupt the action. 12–15 s: Final high-intensity explosion. Man finally charges into close range, aerial heavy chop, red blade carrying a crimson fire-ink giant wave pressing down. Woman instantly slides back on water and spins; large area of water underfoot rises into a ring-shaped water tornado, three layers of transparent water walls stack continuously. Man shatters the first layer with one chop, spins horizontal slash to tear open the second layer, lands dragging the blade upward to crash into the third layer. Woman pushes both hands forward; the water tornado contracts into a huge cyan-blue ink-wash shockwave. Man’s red blade hard-blocks; red-black blade wave and cyan-blue tide collide head-on, full-screen splash-ink, water flowers, flying white, shattered ink, golden shattered ink explode. After the explosion the man is blasted sliding backward several meters, blade tip plowing the water surface; woman slides back on water to a distance, water rings still rotating behind her; both remain in residual combat momentum, not a static pose. Camera requirements: Tsui Hark-style rapid camera work combined with high-energy 2D ink-wash combat. 70% medium-close and water-surface tracking shots, 20% full-body medium shots showing large displacements, a small amount of long shots showing the water-courtyard ruins and large water surface. Cuts must continue the same movement direction—no breaking of moves, no stuttering. Character force feedback must be strong. entries.title: Cinematic Sci-Fi Time Loop Sequence
entries.description: A complex multi-shot video prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting a surreal time loop sequence with reality glitches, sudden perspective shifts, and a suspenseful sci-fi narrative arc.
entries.prompt:
SHOT 1: ECU, 85mm macro push-in / Phone screen reads 7:59:59 as her finger hovers over the alarm; the second flips to 8:00 and the screen glitches for a split second / SFX: alarm pulse, digital tick, subtle glitch.
SHOT 2: WS, 24mm handheld whip / She jolts upright in bed, instantly alert, as morning light flickers unnaturally across the room / SFX: mattress bounce, sharp breath, low electrical hum.

SHOT 5: Interior fridge POV, 24mm wide / Door bursts open; she reaches for milk, but the carton is suddenly replaced by a small glowing object she doesn't recognize / SFX: fridge hum, bottle clink, mysterious electronic tone.
SHOT 6: Insert, 50mm handheld / Smash cut: the glowing object lands on the kitchen counter; she touches it and the entire room freezes mid-motion / SFX: touch ping, room-tone drop, deep whoosh.
SHOT 7: MCU, centered 50mm push-in / Everything snaps back; she checks the clock — 8:00 exactly — and realizes she's back at the beginning / SFX: clock beep, heartbeat, sudden silence.

entries.title: Vintage 16mm Italian Documentary Film
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt for a photorealistic 1980s documentary-style film set in rural Italy, featuring a woman in a floral dress walking through a medieval village.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second photorealistic vintage 16mm documentary set in rural Umbria, Italy, summer 1982. Make it feel like a beautiful forgotten family film shot on Kodak 16mm: warm sun-faded colors, fine analog grain, subtle film flicker, dust, tiny scratches, gentle light leaks, soft halation, slight gate weave, organic focus breathing and imperfect handheld camera movement. 4:3 aspect ratio, no modern cinematic polish.

Main character: A naturally beautiful Italian woman, early 20s, slender, warm olive-fair skin, hazel-brown eyes and long dark honey-brown hair loosely tied with a cream ribbon, soft flyaway strands. She wears an elegant ivory linen midi dress with tiny muted terracotta and dusty-blue floral prints, fitted waist, soft puff sleeves, square neckline and fabric-covered buttons, a thin vintage leather belt, tan ankle-strap sandals, tiny pearl earrings and a delicate gold necklace. Natural makeup, no modern accessories. She carries a woven wicker basket with bread, peaches, figs, basil and white wildflowers.

0–6s: She walks through a picturesque medieval Umbrian village lane, touching ivy-covered stone walls. Terracotta roofs, green shutters, red geraniums, ceramic pots and an old Fiat 126 surround her. Her floral dress and hair move gently in the afternoon breeze.

6–12s: She enters a small village piazza. An elderly baker carries fresh bread, women sit outside a bakery, a boy rides an old bicycle and a cream Vespa rests beside a stone wall. The baker smiles and gives her a small loaf. She laughs softly. The handheld camera briefly loses focus before finding her again.

12–17s: A little girl drops wildflowers. The woman kneels gracefully, gathers them and returns the bouquet with a warm smile. The child smiles shyly. Nobody acknowledges the camera.

17–23s: She leaves the village along a path bordered by olive trees, golden grass, poppies and ancient stone walls. The camera moves beside her as her ivory floral dress flows naturally. Birds suddenly rise from a nearby field.

23–28s: She reaches an overlook above beautiful Umbrian hills: vineyards, olive groves, golden fields, stone farmhouses and distant medieval hill towns in warm summer haze. She rests against an old wooden railing, watches the valley and gently tucks windblown hair behind her ear.

28–30s: She picks up her basket and walks away through the olive trees. The camera stops naturally and holds on the empty golden landscape. A subtle film flicker ends the footage.

Overall aesthetic: romantic Italian summer, elegant vintage fashion, authentic 1982 village life, beautiful natural woman, warm golden sunlight, realistic skin and fabric texture, documentary realism, imperfect human camera movement, genuine Kodak 16mm archival texture. No modern objects, no digital look, no AI-smooth skin, no posing.

entries.title: Anthropomorphic Cat Garden Vlog
entries.description: A charming first-person vlog prompt featuring an anthropomorphic orange tabby cat exploring a Japanese-style garden and koi pond.
entries.prompt:
Create a single continuous self-filmed vlog recorded on a handheld action camera in 16:9 aspect ratio. The camera is always held by the anthropomorphic cat, creating a natural first-person selfie perspective with light wind-induced shake, occasional soft lens flares from sunlight filtering through trees, realistic focus pulls, and dynamic walking/leaning motion. No cuts, transitions, or cinematic effects. Include a subtle realistic digital timestamp in the bottom-right corner that progresses naturally throughout the video.
Visual Style: Bright modern 4K digital look with vibrant yet soft natural colors, warm midday sunlight mixed with dappled shade, gentle water reflections, subtle water droplets or mist on the lens near the pond, and crisp details on fur and scales. Slight handheld energy but smooth enough for casual vlogging. Widescreen 16:9 framing.
Character: Mochi, a 22-year-old anthropomorphic orange tabby cat (bipedal, human-like proportions) with soft fluffy orange-and-white fur, big expressive green eyes, pink nose, upright pointed ears, and a long striped tail that sways naturally. He wears a simple light linen shirt with rolled sleeves and comfortable shorts. Personality: curious, gentle, slightly playful and soft-spoken.
Location: Starts on a wooden walkway beside a traditional Japanese-style garden pond filled with colorful koi fish (orange, white, black, and golden), surrounded by smooth stones, mossy rocks, small lanterns, and overhanging maple or willow branches. Soft green foliage and clear water with gentle ripples.
Sequence (exactly 30 seconds, continuous take with timestamps):
0:00 – 0:05
Mochi lifts the camera, smiles softly at the lens with his whiskers twitching, and says in a warm, slightly deep voice:
“Hey friends… look what I found today.”
0:05 – 0:13
He walks slowly along the wooden edge of the pond, lowering the camera slightly to show the swimming koi just below the surface while continuing:
“These koi are so peaceful… I’ve never seen colors like this up close.”
0:13 – 0:20
He crouches carefully, reaches one paw toward the water without touching it, and watches the fish swim past, laughing lightly:
“They keep swimming right up to me. Hi little guys.”
0:20 – 0:26
He turns the camera to capture both his face and the pond, then sits on a flat rock at the water’s edge, letting his tail curl beside him. He gazes at the fish for a few seconds and says quietly:
“Moments like this make everything feel calm.”
0:26 – 0:30
He stands up, waves one paw at the camera with a gentle smile, and says:
“Thanks for exploring with me. See you next time.”
The camera naturally lowers a little as he walks along the pond path.

Epic 2000s historical war-drama film look, shot on 35mm with dusty golden desaturated tones, gritty arena texture, visible film grain. Sweeping crane shots combined with intense handheld close-ups, roaring crowd atmosphere implied through visual scale and dust.

6-12s: [Slow rotating tracking shot around him] He turns slowly, scanning the roaring crowd above, blood and sweat streaking his face, weapon still gripped tightly in one hand.

24-30s: [Extreme wide aerial-style shot] The entire arena is visible, warrior standing small but commanding at the center, dust swirling upward into the harsh sunlight, crowd noise implied through raised arms and open mouths throughout the tiers.

Authentic early-2000s epic historical color grading, coherent dust and sand physics, stable character continuity, harsh natural sunlight, no modern digital cleanliness, visceral triumphant scale throughout.

entries.title: Cinematic Korean Thriller Mini-Mart
entries.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for a photorealistic Korean thriller scene at a rainy gas station, including multi-shot sequences, dialogue rules, and character consistency instructions for Seedance 2.5.
entries.prompt:
Use <<image>>only for the WOMAN’s face, identity, hair, skin texture, and body proportions. Do not copy its background, clothing, lighting, or composition.

30s cinematic thriller, photorealistic. Rainy gas-station mini-mart after a car crash. Controlled handheld camera, fluorescent practicals, intermittent red/blue police lights, wet asphalt, haze, realistic sweat/grime, shallow DOF, film grain. No music.

CAST: WOMAN throughout: torn dark jacket, jeans, scraped forearm, messy half-loose hair, sweaty, aggressive and adrenaline-fueled. CLERK: tired 40s man, green vest/flannel, cautious. STRANGER appears only in S9, dark silhouette, face never visible. No other people.

DIALOGUE RULE: Korean, natural quiet speech, perfect lip-sync. Action must completely stop before speaking; speaker faces camera/front 3/4 with unobstructed mouth and remains still during the line. No VO/off-screen speech. S9 silent.

S1 0–2.5: Woman bursts in, grabs unlabeled water from cooler, rushes to counter.

S2 2.5–5: Slams bottle down, stops, faces camera: “붕대 있어요? 빨리요.”

S3 5–7.5: Clerk cautiously gets bandage kit, stops, faces camera: “저기… 괜찮으신 거예요?” Places kit down.

S4 7.5–9.5: Woman grabs kit, stops: “신경 꺼요.” Clerk backs away.

S5 9.5–12: She sits by window, opens kit and wraps forearm. Police lights/wreck briefly visible outside. No dialogue.

S6 12–14.5: Finishes bandage, stops, faces camera: “…살아있네.” Then drinks water.

S7 14.5–16.5: Watches police lights through rainy glass, sets bottle down. No dialogue.

S8 16.5–18.5: Hears something, clenches fist, rises and faces door. No dialogue.

S9 18.5–22: Stranger bursts in and grabs her. Brief raw struggle—she twists free, elbows/shoves him, shelf rattles, bottle rolls, she forces him outside. His face never visible. No dialogue.

S10 22–25: She reaches door, stops, looks back at clerk: “문 잠가요. 아무도 안 들여보내고.” Then exits.

S11 25–30: She sprints through rain, jumps into dark sedan, starts instantly, reverses and speeds away from the police and crash. Police car passes the now-empty station too late. Door remains open/swinging.

CONTINUITY: Same woman/face, store layout, door, red OPEN sign, water bottle and bandage progression throughout. No duplicated props/people, no weapons/blood/gore, no subtitles/text/logos/watermarks, no beauty retouching, no slow motion/speed ramps.

entries.prompt:
Duration 15 seconds, 2.39:1, 24fps, photorealistic live action, theatrical 4K.

Above a fortified coastal city, a towering elderly warrior with short silver hair, a rugged beard, an indigo martial tunic, dark combat trousers and a long ivory mantle leaps from a military airship. Real human anatomy, weathered skin, practical clothing and grounded destruction.

0:00–0:04: He plunges toward the city as the camera dives beside him. His mantle snaps violently in the wind. Black-crimson lightning coils around his body while frightened raiders scatter below. He bellows in Japanese:

「無法者ども、よく聞け！」
(Outlaws, listen well!)
0:04–0:09: Extreme close-up as he pulls one fist back. A blinding gold-white energy core forms around his knuckles. Red lightning tears across the sky; cross-shaped lens flares, prismatic energy streaks and brief galaxy-like particles fill the frame. He declares:

「奪われた若者は、この国の未来だ！」
(The young one you took is this nation’s future!)

「そして……俺の誇りだ！」
(And… my pride!)
0:09–0:15: He roars 「天壊震拳！」 and punches the air without touching the ground. A colossal spherical pressure wave crashes downward. Crimson lightning forms a violent lattice over the city as a gold-white explosion expands into concentric rings. Streets buckle, stone towers split, debris levitates, and a vast crater opens beneath him. End on the warrior suspended above the glowing devastation as dust rises toward the camera.

Cinematic color shifts from bright cyan daylight into deep crimson-black shadows, molten gold highlights and cobalt undertones. One has long straight black hair with blunt bangs, narrow dark futuristic sunglasses, a distressed silver and black sleeveless graphic top, layered metallic necklaces, stacked bracelets, fingerless black gloves, loose dark trousers, chunky black footwear and a large worn black shoulder bag. The second has long pale blonde hair under a fitted black beanie, oversized rectangular black sunglasses, a fitted white top, oversized black jacket slipping casually from her shoulders, a short dark skirt, black thigh high socks, chunky shoes, silver jewelry and a large textured handbag. The camera should feel like a real person holding a small early digital camcorder at arm length. Never make movement perfectly stabilized or mechanically smooth. Open extremely close to both women crouching beside a black motorcycle, staring calmly into the lens while a fluorescent fixture blooms above them. One unseen camera operator only, frightened adult hiker breathing heavily behind the camera. One massive Bigfoot-like forest creature: tall, broad, covered in dark matted hair, humanlike posture, heavy natural movement, never cartoonish.

entries.prompt: You are a Seedance 2.5 cinematic short-video generator. Use @Image1 as the primary and persistent character identity reference. Create one finished short video only. Preserve the referenced character consistently throughout the entire video. Maintain: - facial structure - eye shape and iris color - hairstyle - hair color mapping - accent color placement, inner color, tip color, highlights - body proportions - age impression - skin tone - outfit identity - accessories - overall silhouette - original illustration logic if @Image1 is non-photographic Do not redesign the character. Do not switch to another person. Do not alter the face, outfit, hairstyle, or body proportions mid-video. [Latent Character Read] Infer the character’s atmosphere, emotional tone, rhythm, object affinity, likely movement style, and visual symbolism only from what is visible in @Image1. Do not invent an excessive biography. Do not rely on generic clichés. Design one short film that feels specific to this character. [Film Concept] Create one emotionally readable micro-story that feels like a real moment from this character’s life. The story should be simple, visually clear, and memorable. It may be cozy, playful, romantic, refreshing, introspective, whimsical, or quietly dramatic depending on the character read and the chosen mood. Avoid random posing or disconnected shots. The short film should feel suitable for social media viewing: immediately attractive in the first seconds, easy to follow, visually appealing, and strong in character charm. [Scene Design] Choose a setting, objects, and atmosphere that naturally fit the character. The environment should support the character rather than overpower them. The scene must feel inhabited and specific: - meaningful props - clear sense of place - coherent lighting - subtle environmental motion - small details that imply personality Keep location, time of day, and lighting direction consistent. [Camera Language] Use clear cinematic camera grammar. Allowed shot language: - WS (Wide Shot) - MS (Medium Shot) - MCU (Medium Close-Up) - CU (Close-Up) Allowed camera movement: - gentle push-in - slow tracking - subtle dolly left or right - gentle orbit within identity-safe angles - controlled handheld drift if suitable Avoid aggressive camera spinning. Avoid dramatic angle changes that increase identity drift. Keep the face readable during key emotional moments. [Story Structure] If duration is 15 seconds, structure the film in 4 beats: 00:00–00:04 Setup 00:04–00:08 Development 00:08–00:12 Main Moment 00:12–00:15 Resolution If duration is 30 seconds, structure the film in 4 beats: 00:00–00:06 Setup 00:06–00:14 Development 00:14–00:24 Main Moment 00:24–00:30 Resolution For each beat, define: - shot size - character action - facial expression - eyeline - camera movement - environmental motion - emotional progression - audio cues [Beat Design Rules] Setup: Introduce the character clearly and attractively within the first moments. The first beat should instantly establish mood and character presence. Development: Introduce a simple action, object, or change in attention that builds curiosity. Main Moment: Show the most emotionally rewarding or visually memorable moment. This should be the highlight of the short film. Resolution: End with a soft payoff, emotional afterglow, or visual callback. The final frame should feel complete and memorable. [Motion Quality] Use natural and believable movement. Include: - subtle breathing - blinking - small eye shifts - natural weight transfer - coherent hand and finger movement - secondary hair motion - cloth motion - small posture changes - believable inertia The motion should feel like a real animated performance, not a still image being warped. [Audio] If audio is implied, match the scene naturally: - light ambience - room tone - wind - distant city sounds - quiet music - soft effect sounds from props or movement Audio should support emotion without overwhelming the visuals. [Optional Text] If on-screen text is enabled, keep it minimal. Use only one short line or one small readable text element. Prefer integrating text into a believable object: - note - planner - sign - hanging tag - phone screen - package - screen overlay only if visually appropriate Avoid excessive typography. Avoid subtitle-like clutter. [Continuity Lock] Maintain throughout the video: - same character - same face - same hairstyle - same hair-color placement - same eye color - same outfit - same accessories - same body proportions - same rendering style - same location logic - same time of day - same lighting direction The video should feel like one coherent event. [Avoid] Avoid: - identity drift - face morphing - hairstyle changes - eye color changes - outfit changes - missing accessories - body proportion drift - duplicated character - extra limbs - malformed hands - unstable fingers - disappearing props - object duplication - background mutation - lighting inconsistency - random text - unintended subtitles - flicker - frame-to-frame style drift - unnatural speed changes - overacting - empty generic posing [Visual Goal] Make the finished video feel polished, emotionally legible, character-specific, and highly watchable. Prioritize: - strong first impression - stable character identity - charming performance - clean visual storytelling - elegant camera use - smooth continuity - social-media-friendly clarity

Create a 5-second original cyberpunk action sequence inspired by the sleek, philosophical sci-fi action aesthetic of early-2000s simulation movies, without copying specific characters, costumes, shots, or scenes.

entries.title: Spectral Dragon Portal
entries.description: A multi-shot narrative prompt featuring a warrior and a dragon emerging from a portal in a storm.
entries.prompt:
Continuing exactly from the previous frame — warrior's face lit by the fully-open portal behind her, rain still falling, lightning flickering.
[0-6s] Camera holds steady, then slowly pulls back as a massive clawed hand emerges from the portal's liquid-light surface, talons gripping the air like tearing fabric.
[6-14s] Camera whip-pans to follow a spectral dragon fully emerging from the portal — wings unfurling with dynamic motion blur, translucent scales catching rim light from the twin moons, ribs of pale energy visible beneath ghostly skin.
[14-20s] Dragon lets out a silent roar (visual shockwave ripple distorts the air around its jaw), wind gusts intensify, warrior's cloak snaps violently in the backdraft. Camera low-angle, looking up at the creature's full wingspan against the storm.
[20-26s] Camera settles into a wide low-angle hero shot — warrior standing small in frame, dragon towering protectively above her, both bathed in the portal's fading glow. Embers and light particles drift upward in slow motion.
[26-30s] Final shot: subtle handheld breathing camera movement, slow fade of portal light behind them as thunder rolls one last time. Scene settles into stillness — warrior and dragon, framed together, storm calming.
Camera: Cinema Studio — pull-back + whip-pan + low-angle hero shot, matching 35mm anamorphic lens from Clip 1
Color grade: Same teal/gold grade for continuity

6.0–7.0s — CHECK DASHBOARD

7.0–8.2s — PRESS CONTROLS
Right hand leaves the steering wheel and presses several physical center-console buttons sequentially. Each button reacts immediately with subtle illumination. Left hand remains on the wheel. Show tactile realistic finger contact.

8.2–10.0s — START ENGINE
Right hand presses the engine START button once. Engine starts with a deep luxury V12-style rumble. Dashboard fully illuminates, gauge needles rise and stabilize. Subtle vibration passes through steering wheel and hands. Exterior lights

entries.title: Cinematic Coffee Machine Commercial
entries.description: A professional-grade video prompt for a 30-second UGC-style product commercial showcasing a coffee machine with macro detail.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second vertical AI UGC product commercial (9:16) for a premium coffee machine.

Style: Ultra-realistic, cinematic, social-media UGC, premium lifestyle, 4K HDR, natural lighting, smooth handheld camera, realistic human motion, luxury color grading.

Scene 1 (0–5s)
A creator walks into a modern kitchen holding a coffee mug and says, "I finally tried this coffee machine."

Scene 2 (5–10s)
Close-up shots of opening the coffee bean container, adding beans, filling water, and pressing the power button. Natural hand movements and satisfying button clicks.

Scene 3 (10–17s)
Macro shots of coffee grinding, rich crema forming, steam rising, and coffee slowly pouring into a glass cup. Beautiful golden morning sunlight.

Scene 4 (17–23s)
The creator takes the first sip, smiles naturally, and says, "This honestly tastes amazing."

Scene 5 (23–27s)
Premium product showcase with smooth orbit shots, close-ups of the controls, metallic finish, and elegant kitchen background.

Scene 6 (27–30s)
Hero shot of the coffee machine beside a fresh cup of coffee with soft cinematic lighting. End with the creator holding the cup and smiling at the camera.

Requirements:
Vertical 9:16, 30 seconds, AI UGC style, realistic creator vibe, premium product advertising, natural expressions, realistic hands, smooth camera movement, clean transitions, cinematic quality, no logos or watermarks.

entries.title: Cinematic Morning Routine Multi-Shot
entries.description: A complex, multi-shot cinematic prompt for a morning routine, detailing camera angles, sound effects, and realistic movements.
entries.prompt:
SHOT 1: ECU, 85mm push-in / on the phone screen as it shakes on rumpled sheets / SFX: alarm, sheet rustle.

SHOT 2: WS, 35mm handheld jolt / Rhythmic cut into her jolting upright through side light, throwing the blanket aside, and planting her feet on the floor in one rushed motion, still in a sleep tee and lounge shorts / SFX: mattress bounce, blanket whip, sharp breath.

SHOT 3: MCU, 50mm slide / Cut on action into face wash at the sink, droplets catching the top light / SFX: faucet rush, water slap.

SHOT 4: Insert shot, 85mm lens focus / Match cut into the toothbrush held at a natural forward brushing angle against the front teeth; hand relaxed and upright, mint foam and mirror eye / SFX: bristle scrape, sink drip.

SHOT 5: Interior fridge view, 24mm wide / Object pass into the camera inside the fridge looking out as the door snaps open and her hand darts in, blue light framing a hurried grab for breakfast ingredients / SFX: fridge hum, bottle clink, shelf scrape.

SHOT 6: Insert shot, 50mm handheld / Rhythmic cut into egg and toast hitting the pan under warm practical light / SFX: butter sizzle, chop tap.

SHOT 7: MCU, centered 50mm push-in / Match cut into one rushed bite, a quick clock glance, and an immediate rise from the chair / SFX: crunch, ceramic clink, chair scrape.

SHOT 8: Bird’s-eye, 35mm overhead / Match cut on action as the sleep tee disappears under a fitted top and tailored jacket; then her keys, transit card, and bag get scooped up in one messy grab / SFX: fabric whip, key jingle, zipper pull, bag rustle.

SHOT 9: MS, 35mm pan / Camera slips into a rushed outfit change as the sleep tee disappears under a fitted top and tailored jacket; then her keys, transit card, and bag get scooped up in one messy grab / SFX: fabric whip, key jingle, zipper pull, bag rustle.

SHOT 10: Insert shot, 50mm overhead / Match cut into lace-up shoes slamming on as the laces yank tight in one impatient pull / SFX: sole thump, lace tug, short breath.

SHOT 11: WS, 24mm parallel / Whip pan transition into her, now in the tailored outside outfit, rushing through the apartment corridor into bright light without breaking stride / SFX: latch click, rapid footsteps, hallway air.

SHOT 12: MS to CU, 35mm glide, 85mm push-in / Sound bridge into the metro interior as she grips the pole and slips through just before the closing doors, reflected chrome streaking around her and the city blurring outside / SFX: train rattle, carriage screech, door warning chime, light breath.

SHOT 13: Insert to MCU, 50mm snap zoom / Smash cut to the office entrance as her access card hits the reader, the glass door unlocks, and she slips through before dropping into her chair and opening her laptop / SFX: badge beep, door click, laptop chime.

SHOT 14: OTS, 35mm handheld / Rhythmic cut into her fingers racing across the keyboard with blue monitor light illuminating her face / SFX: keyboard clicks, notification sounds, mouse click.

entries.title: Japanese Seaside Travel Vlog
entries.description: A multi-scene sequential prompt for creating a realistic smartphone-style travel vlog featuring a Japanese woman exploring a coastal town.
entries.prompt:
Scene 1 (0–3 sec)
A beautiful young Japanese woman begins a morning adventure in a quiet coastal town. She walks beside the ocean with her smartphone in selfie mode, smiling naturally as gentle waves move behind her.

Scene 2 (3–6 sec)
She explores a small seaside fishing harbor, watches local fishermen preparing their boats, and casually records the colorful boats and peaceful morning atmosphere.

Scene 3 (6–9 sec)
She discovers a small local seafood market. She looks around curiously, interacts naturally with a friendly vendor, and receives a freshly prepared local snack.

Scene 4 (9–12 sec)
She walks through a narrow traditional Japanese street lined with small wooden houses and shops. She stops at a tiny souvenir store and picks up a handmade ceramic item.

Scene 5 (12–15 sec)
She continues toward a rocky coastline and carefully walks along a scenic ocean path. The camera captures waves crashing against the rocks while she films the view.

Scene 6 (15–18 sec)
She reaches a quiet hidden beach. She removes her shoes, walks along the wet sand, and lets the ocean water touch her feet while laughing naturally toward the camera.

Scene 7 (18–21 sec)
She sits at a small outdoor seaside café, enjoys an iced matcha drink and a light dessert, and casually talks to the smartphone camera.

Scene 8 (21–24 sec)
Golden-hour sunlight begins to cover the coastline. She walks toward a small lighthouse on a hill, filming the glowing ocean and surrounding scenery.

Scene 9 (24–27 sec)
At sunset, she stands near the lighthouse overlooking the ocean. Her hair moves gently in the sea breeze as she watches the sun disappear below the horizon.

Scene 10 (27–30 sec)
Final selfie shot. She turns toward the camera, smiles brightly, waves goodbye and says: “What a beautiful day. See you on my next adventure. Bye!”

Overall style: Ultra-realistic Japanese smartphone travel vlog, same beautiful Japanese woman and consistent appearance throughout, natural handheld phone footage, realistic human movement, authentic facial expressions, real ocean ambience, waves, wind and distant harbor sounds, cinematic natural lighting, realistic colors, documentary-style travel footage, no artificial movements, no text, no subtitles, no watermark.

entries.title: Cinematic Drama Acting Masterclass Prompt
entries.description: An extremely detailed professional prompt for Seedance 2.5 to generate a 30-second dramatic acting scene with precise emotional arcs and camera control.
entries.prompt:
时长：30秒
画幅：16:9
语言：自然美式英语
声音：演员现场原声，精准口型同步；无旁白、无字幕、无背景音乐
影像：高端欧美现实主义爱情电影质感，克制、冷峻、浅景深，真实皮肤纹理，摄影机运动极轻微
人物均为原创虚构角色，不参考任何演员、名人或影视作品。
【人物设定】
男方 NOAH：28岁，英俊、身材挺拔，深棕色短发，白衬衫袖口卷起。他怀疑女友爱上了一个更富有的男人。表面愤怒，实际害怕自己不值得被爱。
女方 CLAIRE：26岁，漂亮、气质冷静，金棕色长发，黑色简约连衣裙。她确实曾被另一个男人吸引，但真正动摇她的不是金钱，而是长期被男友忽视。
全程保持两人脸部、发型、服装、声线和空间位置一致。
【核心情绪曲线】
怀疑压制 → 讽刺防御 → 直接逼问 → 短暂坦白 → 男方受伤 → 女方说出关系早已结束的真相。
两个人不是从第一秒就大吼。真正的情绪峰值出现在女方说出：
“No. But I wanted to.”
最终一刀则是：
“We just kept calling it love.”
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头一｜0.0—7.0秒】
双人中近景。NOAH站在前景，CLAIRE站在几步之外。摄影机缓慢向两人靠近。
0.0—2.4秒
NOAH的目的：逼她主动承认。
他先盯着她沉默半秒，嘴唇压紧，下颌轻微咬住。眉毛向内下压，眼睑收紧，但音量保持克制，不要立刻咆哮。
他缓慢说道：
“Tell me the truth. Is it him?”
“truth”略微加重；说到“him”时才抬起眼睛直视她。
看完后保持静止，不提前流泪，不移开视线。
2.4—4.4秒
CLAIRE的目的：用讽刺挡住羞耻。
她没有立即回答。鼻腔短促呼气，嘴角出现不足一秒的苦涩微笑，目光扫过他的衬衫，然后重新看回他的眼睛。
她轻声反问：
“You mean the man with the car?”
“car”没有炫耀意味，而是故意刺中他的自卑。
说完后笑意立刻消失。身体没有后退。
4.4—7.0秒
NOAH被刺中，眉间压力增强，向前走半步，但不触碰她。
声音第一次抬高：
“Don’t make this a joke. I saw you leave with him.”
“saw”短促加重；最后的“him”压低声音，像在努力控制失态。
CLAIRE听他说话时不翻白眼、不抢话。她的眼神短暂变软，随后重新封闭。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头二｜7.0—20.0秒】
切到CLAIRE肩后拍NOAH，再缓慢转为两人的交替近景。
7.0—9.3秒
CLAIRE的目的：让他明白“离开”和“背叛”不是同一件事。
她停顿半秒，平静说道：
“And I came home.”
语速慢，音量低。“home”说得很轻，像提醒他自己曾经选择回来。
她说完后等待他的反应，不继续解释。
9.3—12.0秒
NOAH的愤怒开始失去保护作用。
他的嘴唇张开，却有半秒没有声音。目光从她的眼睛移到嘴唇，又迅速回到眼睛。胸口出现一次明显但受控的吸气。
他问：
“Did you kiss him?”
不要吼叫。声音比前面更轻、更不稳定，像他真正害怕听见答案。
12.0—16.0秒
CLAIRE先保持眼神接触一秒。
她回答第一个词：
“No.”
停顿约0.8秒。她的目光第一次落下，嘴角轻微绷紧；再次抬眼时，攻击性完全消失。
随后坦白：
“But I wanted to.”
“wanted”说得很轻，不能喊。声音尾部出现轻微气息断裂，但不哭。
这是全片最重要的转折。NOAH听到“wanted”后才出现反应：眼睑轻微抬起，下颌松开，身体像失去支撑一样后移半步。反应不能提前。
16.0—20.0秒
NOAH试图用金钱解释这一切，重新保护自尊。
他短促吸气，眉毛向内收紧，声音突然抬高一次：
“Because he can give you everything?”
“everything”达到男方全片最高音量，随后立即降下来。
说完后他闭紧嘴唇，眼神已经不再愤怒，而是在等待一次能够拯救自己的否认。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头三｜20.0—30.0秒】
CLAIRE面部特写，随后轻微转焦到她身后的NOAH。摄影机保持克制，不环绕、不快速推进。
20.0—23.2秒
CLAIRE终于说出真正原因。
她的眉毛内侧轻微抬起，眼眶开始湿润，但眼泪不能落下。下巴轻微绷紧，呼吸变浅。
她直视他说：
“Because he listened when I spoke.”
“listened”轻微加重；“spoke”几乎成为耳语。
这句话不是报复，而是她已经疲惫到不想再争辩。
23.2—25.0秒
NOAH所有攻击性消失。
肩膀下降，目光短暂离开她。他想说更多，却只能低声问：
“So that’s it?”
“it”尾音轻微发虚。不要哭，不要做夸张痛苦表情。
25.0—30.0秒
CLAIRE轻轻摇头一次。
她先说：
“No.”
停顿0.6秒，像是在决定是否还要给这段关系留下体面。
随后平静说道：
“It ended months ago. We just kept calling it love.”
“ended”保持冷静；说到“love”时声音第一次轻微破裂。
最后一个词结束后，她仍然直视他约1秒。眼泪停留在下眼睑，不落下来。随后她缓慢移开目光。
NOAH站在失焦背景中，没有追上去，也没有说话。
结尾保持两人之间的静止和距离至少1秒，不恢复中性表情，不增加额外对白。
【表演限制】
- 不要从第一秒开始吼叫或哭泣。
- CLAIRE在20秒前眼眶不能明显湿润，全程不连续流泪。
- NOAH的核心不是暴怒，而是用愤怒掩盖自卑和恐惧。
- CLAIRE不是冷酷反派，她是在承认一段关系早已被忽视耗尽。
- 所有停顿都有心理行动，避免机械停顿。
- 手势克制，不摔东西、不推搡、不发生身体冲突。
- 保留准确英文对白、角色分配、自然呼吸和精准口型。
NEGATIVE:
subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, background music, theatrical overacting,
constant shouting, premature tears, instant emotional switch, random gestures,
physical violence, frozen listener, robotic delivery, lip-sync drift, double mouth,
warped face, extra fingers, identity drift, wardrobe drift, abrupt camera movement
entries.translated_prompt:
Duration: 30 seconds
Aspect Ratio: 16:9
Language: Natural American English
Sound: Original actor's voice on set, precise lip-sync; no narration, no subtitles, no background music
Image: High-end Western realistic romance film quality, restrained, cold, shallow depth of field, real skin texture, minimal camera movement
Characters are original fictional characters, do not refer to any actors, celebrities, or film/TV works.
[Character Settings]
Male NOAH: 28 years old, handsome, tall, short dark brown hair, white shirt sleeves rolled up. He suspects his girlfriend has fallen for a wealthier man. Angry on the surface, but actually afraid he isn't worthy of love.
Female CLAIRE: 26 years old, beautiful, calm temperament, long golden-brown hair, simple black dress. She was indeed attracted to another man once, but what truly shook her wasn't money, but being long ignored by her boyfriend.
Maintain consistency in faces, hairstyles, clothing, voices, and spatial positions throughout.
[Core Emotional Arc]
Suppressed suspicion → Sarcastic defense → Direct confrontation → Brief confession → Male hurt → Female reveals the relationship ended long ago.
The two don't shout from the first second. The true emotional peak occurs when the female says:
“No. But I wanted to.”
The final blow is:
“We just kept calling it love.”
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[Shot 1 | 0.0—7.0s]
Two-person medium-close shot. NOAH stands in the foreground, CLAIRE stands a few steps away. Camera slowly approaches them.
0.0—2.4s
NOAH's goal: Force her to admit it.
He stares at her in silence for half a second, lips pressed tight, jaw slightly clenched. Brows pressed inward/down, eyelids tightened, but volume kept restrained, do not shout immediately.
He says slowly:
“Tell me the truth. Is it him?”
Slightly emphasize “truth”; only look up at her when saying “him”.
Stay still after speaking, no premature tears, do not look away.
2.4—4.4s
CLAIRE's goal: Use sarcasm to block shame.
She doesn't answer immediately. Short breath from the nose, a bitter smile appears for less than a second, eyes sweep over his shirt, then look back into his eyes.
She asks softly:
“You mean the man with the car?”
“car” has no showing-off tone, but is meant to sting his insecurity.
Smile disappears immediately after speaking. Body does not retreat.
4.4—7.0s
NOAH is stung, pressure between brows increases, takes half a step forward but doesn't touch her.
Voice raises for the first time:
“Don’t make this a joke. I saw you leave with him.”
Short emphasis on “saw”; lower voice on the final “him”, as if trying to control losing composure.
CLAIRE doesn't roll eyes or interrupt while he speaks. Her eyes soften briefly, then close off again.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[Shot 2 | 7.0—20.0s]
Cut to over-the-shoulder shot of CLAIRE looking at NOAH, then slowly transition to alternating close-ups.
7.0—9.3s
CLAIRE's goal: Make him understand “leaving” and “betrayal” are not the same thing.
She pauses for half a second, says calmly:
“And I came home.”
Slow speed, low volume. “home” is said very softly, as if reminding him she once chose to return.
Wait for his reaction after speaking, no further explanation.
9.3—12.0s
NOAH's anger begins to lose its protective function.
His lips open, but no sound for half a second. Eyes move from her eyes to her lips, then quickly back to eyes. One obvious but controlled inhale in the chest.
He asks:
“Did you kiss him?”
Do not shout. Voice is softer and more unstable than before, as if he is truly afraid to hear the answer.
12.0—16.0s
CLAIRE maintains eye contact for a second first.
She answers the first word:
“No.”
Pause for about 0.8s. Her eyes drop for the first time, corners of mouth tighten slightly; when looking up again, aggression has completely vanished.
Then confession:
“But I wanted to.”
“wanted” is said very softly, cannot be shouted. Slight breath break at the end of the voice, but no crying.
This is the most important turning point. NOAH reacts only after hearing “wanted”: eyelids lift slightly, jaw relaxes, body moves back half a step as if losing support. Reaction must not be premature.
16.0—20.0s
NOAH tries to explain everything with money, re-protecting his self-esteem.
Short inhale, brows tighten inward, voice suddenly raises once:
“Because he can give you everything?”
“everything” reaches the male's highest volume in the film, then drops immediately.
Presses lips tight after speaking, eyes no longer angry but waiting for a denial that can save him.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[Shot 3 | 20.0—30.0s]
Close-up of CLAIRE's face, then slight focus shift to NOAH behind her. Camera remains restrained, no orbiting or rapid zooming.
20.0—23.2s
CLAIRE finally states the real reason.
Inner brows lift slightly, eyes begin to moisten but tears cannot fall. Jaw tightens slightly, breathing becomes shallow.
She looks straight at him and says:
“Because he listened when I spoke.”
Slight emphasis on “listened”; “spoke” is almost a whisper.
This sentence is not revenge, but she is too exhausted to argue anymore.
23.2—25.0s
All of NOAH's aggression disappears.
Shoulders drop, eyes briefly leave her. He wants to say more but can only ask in a low voice:
“So that’s it?”
The ending of “it” is slightly weak. Do not cry, no exaggerated painful expressions.
25.0—30.0s
CLAIRE shakes her head once gently.
She says first:
“No.”
Pause for 0.6s, as if deciding whether to leave some dignity for the relationship.
Then says calmly:
“It ended months ago. We just kept calling it love.”
Keep “ended” calm; voice breaks slightly for the first time when saying “love”.
After the last word, she still looks straight at him for about 1 second. Tears stay on the lower eyelid, do not fall. Then she slowly looks away.
NOAH stands in the out-of-focus background, doesn't chase after her, doesn't speak.
Keep stillness and distance between the two for at least 1 second at the end, do not return to neutral expression, no extra dialogue.
[Performance Restrictions]
- Do not shout or cry from the first second.
- CLAIRE's eyes cannot be noticeably moist before 20s, no continuous crying throughout.
- NOAH's core is not rage, but using anger to cover insecurity and fear.
- CLAIRE is not a cold villain; she is admitting a relationship has long been exhausted by neglect.
- All pauses have psychological actions, avoid mechanical pauses.
- Gestures restrained, no throwing things, no pushing, no physical conflict.
- Retain accurate English dialogue, character assignments, natural breathing, and precise lip-sync.
NEGATIVE:
subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, background music, theatrical overacting,
constant shouting, premature tears, instant emotional switch, random gestures,
physical violence, frozen listener, robotic delivery, lip-sync drift, double mouth,
warped face, extra fingers, identity drift, wardrobe drift, abrupt camera movement

entries.title: Time-Freeze Italian Town Sequence
entries.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for a 30-second sequence featuring a time-freeze effect in a sunlit Italian old-town street.
entries.prompt:
@ Image1 is the main character. Preserve her identity, face, hairstyle, body proportions and clothing consistently throughout. One character only. Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic time-freeze sequence.

A sunlit Italian old-town street with beautiful stone buildings, narrow cobblestone roads, cafés, pedestrians, pigeons and warm afternoon light. The woman walks confidently toward camera as a smooth Steadicam tracks backward.

0–5s:
Normal life. Pedestrians cross, bicycles pass, pigeons fly overhead, leaves move in the breeze. She walks calmly through the crowd, looking completely in control.

5–8s:
She suddenly stops, raises her hand and snaps her fingers.

A powerful but elegant invisible shockwave expands outward from her fingertips. Air bends, dust and leaves ripple outward, then EVERYTHING FREEZES.

8–15s:
Absolute stillness. Pedestrians are frozen mid-step, pigeons suspended in flight, a bicycle stopped mid-motion, leaves hanging in the air, a coffee splash frozen above a cup.

Only she can move.

The camera slowly circles her as she walks through the impossible frozen street. She examines a suspended raindrop-sized water droplet, gently touches it, then continues forward.

15–20s:
She notices a pigeon frozen inches above the pavement. She walks underneath it, looks up with an amused smile, then casually walks past a frozen man holding a coffee cup. She subtly moves the cup a few centimeters and walks away.

20–24s:
She reaches the center of the street and turns toward camera. Everything behind her remains perfectly frozen.

She gives a confident half-smile, raises her hand and snaps again.

24–28s:
A second shockwave explodes outward, stronger and more dramatic. Light bends through the air as the frozen world suddenly comes alive again.

Pigeons flap away, leaves fall, pedestrians continue their steps, coffee splashes naturally, bicycles move and city ambience instantly returns.

28–30s:
She remains completely calm while everyone around her continues as if nothing happened. She turns and walks deeper into the old-town street.

The camera rises into a beautiful overhead wide shot and reveals the entire bustling city street.

STYLE:
Premium cinematic filmmaking, photorealistic, natural sunlight, 50mm cinema lens, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and hair, physically accurate motion and physics, subtle film grain, HDR, sophisticated color grading, smooth Steadicam choreography, dramatic but realistic VFX, natural shadows and reflections.

SOUND:
Busy Italian street ambience → finger snap → deep cinematic shockwave → complete silence → footsteps and subtle breathing → second shockwave → full city ambience returns.

NO face morphing, identity drift, duplicate characters, extra limbs, distorted hands, frozen objects moving, inconsistent physics, cartoon CGI, excessive VFX, text, subtitles, logos or watermark.

entries.description: A massive, multi-scene prompt for a 30-second cinematic travel vlog featuring a consistent character across multiple locations and activities.
entries.prompt:

Maintain identical facial features, hairstyle, makeup, skin tone, body proportions, and outfit consistency unless naturally changed during the journey. Premium lifestyle cinematography, luxury airport aesthetic, authentic travel atmosphere, smooth handheld and gimbal camera movement, realistic body language, 4K HDR, 16:9.

She switches off the bedside lamp as the camera slowly pulls back.
