entries.title: Cinematic Dark Fantasy Battle
entries.description: A high-intensity cinematic fantasy prompt featuring a silver-armored warrior battling a multi-armed ghost in a witch chamber.
entries.prompt:
A young heroic warrior wearing beautifully crafted silver armor, a dark blue cape, and carrying an ancient enchanted longsword slowly enters an abandoned underground witch chamber. The room is filled with broken ritual circles, ancient books, shattered altars, skulls, scattered candles, and dozens of lifeless witch bodies lying across the cold stone floor. The atmosphere is eerily silent.

The camera slowly follows behind him as he carefully scans every corner, gripping his sword tightly and remaining fully alert.

Suddenly, the ancient stone walls begin to tremble.

A horrifying ghost emerges from the darkness. It has a grotesque deformed face, glowing crimson eyes, an unnaturally long body, and dozens of skeletal arms extending in every direction. Instead of wielding weapons, the ghost attacks using its razor-sharp claws and multiple arms, striking from impossible angles with incredible speed.

An intense close-quarters battle begins.

The warrior skillfully dodges the ghost's relentless claw attacks, parries with his enchanted sword, and cuts through several skeletal arms as they lunge toward him. The ghost continuously regenerates new arms, making the fight increasingly desperate.

The battle reaches its climax as the ghost charges forward with all of its arms at once. The warrior times the attack perfectly, leaps into the air, and delivers a single breathtaking spinning sword strike that cleanly severs the ghost's head.

The head falls to the stone floor as the ghost's body freezes in place, cracks with glowing purple energy, and disintegrates into countless glowing magical particles that fade into the air. The chamber becomes completely silent once again.

Style

entries.title: 16mm Analog Morning Vlog
entries.description: A highly detailed video prompt for Seedance 2.5 mimicking a handheld 16mm analog morning vlog of a woman walking her dog, focusing on realistic imperfections and film texture.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm daily vlog footage. The video MUST begin with her holding the camera at arm's length in selfie mode while stepping outside her apartment building with her dog. The first 20–30 seconds are entirely handheld. Later she occasionally places the camera on a park bench, low stone wall, picnic table, or the ground for wider shots. Keep subtle handheld shake, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, exposure breathing, brief accidental face cropping, and imperfect framing throughout. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK: Warm analog tape texture with gentle film grain, slightly softened sharpness, subtle halation around sunlight, realistic skin tones, low contrast, tiny exposure shifts, and natural motion blur. It should feel like authentic footage from someone's everyday life rather than a polished commercial.

STYLE: A relaxed morning lifestyle vlog. Quiet, cozy, and spontaneous. She occasionally laughs at her dog, pauses to look around, adjusts the leash, brushes hair away from her face, and speaks naturally in short sentences with comfortable pauses.

CHARACTER: EMMA — a beautiful white woman in her mid-20s. Long light brown hair in a messy ponytail, green eyes, minimal makeup, oversized gray hoodie, black biker shorts, white sneakers, and a small crossbody bag. She is walking a happy golden retriever.

SETTING: A peaceful suburban neighborhood on a sunny morning. Tree-lined sidewalks, quiet residential streets, birds singing, a small park with benches, green grass, and soft golden morning light. Very few people are around.

SCENES:

The vlog opens in selfie mode. Emma holds the camera while leaving her apartment building with the golden retriever excitedly pulling on the leash.
"Good morning."
She smiles.
"Someone couldn't wait."
The dog eagerly sniffs everything as they walk down the sidewalk.
She laughs quietly.
"He has to inspect every single tree."
Still holding the camera, she walks into a small neighborhood park.
The dog suddenly stops and stares at a squirrel.
"Oh... there we go."
She smiles and gently shakes her head.
She places the camera on a nearby bench for a wider angle while throwing a tennis ball.
The dog happily chases after it.
"Worth waking up early."
She picks the camera back up.
Walking slowly through the park, she looks up at the trees for a moment.
"It's actually really peaceful out here."
The dog returns with the ball but drops it halfway.
She laughs.
"Close enough."
She sits on the bench while the dog lies beside her.
She scratches behind his ears.
"I think he's happier than I am."
She stands up and continues walking.
The camera stays in selfie mode as they head toward home.
"Coffee is definitely next."
She smiles into the lens.
"See you later."
She gives a small wave and ends the recording.

entries.title: Found-Footage POV Forest Horror
entries.description: A terrifyingly immersive POV horror prompt set in a dark forest and an abandoned house, styled like amateur found footage.
entries.prompt:

Deep forest at night, wet ground, dead branches, distant wind, then inside a decaying abandoned wooden house hidden in the trees. Mood: extreme tension, suffocating dread, oppressive silence broken by panicked breathing and quiet sobbing.

0–5s: shaky POV moving through dense dark forest with flashlight beam trembling. Heavy breathing close to the microphone. The person whispers through tears: "I don’t know where I am… please… please..." Branches scrape the lens, footsteps crunch on wet leaves.

5–10s: the camera stumbles toward the old house. Fast unstable push through the doorway into a rotten interior. Floorboards creak. The breathing becomes more frantic. The person starts crying harder and says: "Someone is in here… I heard it…"

10–15s: slow pan across the dark room, filthy walls, broken furniture, hanging fabric moving slightly. The camera catches a childlike bundle of sticks hanging in a corner. A faint noise comes from upstairs. The person gasps, starts trembling, and whispers: "No… no… don’t do this..."

15–20s: the POV turns toward a doorway. In the far corner of the room, a motionless human figure stands facing the wall. The camera freezes, breathing turns into sobbing. The person whispers: "Why are you standing there?" The figure slowly tilts its head without turning around. Hard camera glitch, violent drop in the frame, instant blackout.

entries.description: A highly detailed, timestamped video generation prompt for a realistic fantasy scene featuring a woman with a transparent umbrella on a wet street, including magical transitions and precise camera control.
entries.prompt:
写实奇幻短片。女主的脸严格参考特写，身材、发型和服装严格参考 {{Mixed 1}} 全身。她全片只穿参考图中的灰蓝色风衣、白色圆领上衣、深蓝色牛仔裤和黑色短靴，右耳银色圆形耳钉始终存在。透明雨伞严格参考 {{Mixed 2}} 撑开，八根银色伞骨、5毫米黑色包边、银色中杆和黑色J形手柄不得改变。路口建筑位置、斑马线方向、红色交通灯、粉紫色橱窗光和湿地面反光严格参考 {{Mixed 3}} 。

女主全片左手持伞，左手始终握住黑色J形手柄，右手只负责打响指和触碰气球。镜头始终位于道路西侧并朝东拍摄，不越过斑马线中轴，不发生跳轴。场景中增加约20名普通行人和6辆汽车，行人服装为低饱和灰、蓝、棕色，不得出现与女主相同的灰蓝色风衣。红色气球只有一个，直径约35厘米，系着一根80厘米长的白线。

0至6秒，镜头高度1.6米，35mm镜头，稳定器跟拍。女主从画面底部中央进入，沿斑马线向东直走4米，速度约每秒0.7米。她左手撑伞，右臂自然摆动。背景行人和车辆正常通过，地面没有新的雨滴，环境声为轮胎压过湿路面、脚步声和远处交通声。

6至10秒，女主在斑马线中央停下，身体仍面向东方。镜头移动到她右前方约2米处，改用50mm中景。她抬起右手，用拇指和中指打一次响指。响声出现的同一帧，所有背景行人、车辆轮胎、衣角和水面波纹停止运动。一个红色气球停止在女主右前方约1米、离地1.6米的位置。女主和她的头发、风衣下摆仍可正常运动。

10至13秒，镜头以每秒0.5米的速度向右平移，保持女主腰部以上中景。女主朝气球走三步，左手继续持伞。13秒结束时，女主站在气球左侧，右手食指伸出，指尖距离气球表面约5厘米。

13至16秒，镜头继续向右平移，不切镜。女主右手食指向前移动5厘米并触碰气球一次。接触点先出现直径约3厘米的透明区域，随后透明区域在1.5秒内均匀扩展到整个气球。气球外形、直径和位置保持不变，只把红色橡胶材质变成无色透明玻璃材质。变化完成后，气球内部出现一尾约8厘米长的金色小鱼，小鱼面向画面右侧，摆尾一次。白色气球线保持原状。

16至21秒，女主收回右手，向后退半步，抬眼观察透明气球。镜头停止平移，保持50mm中景。透明气球、金色小鱼、女主和雨伞的位置连续，背景仍完全静止。

21至25秒，女主再次用右手打一次响指。响声出现的同一帧，背景行人和车辆恢复原来的运动方向与速度。透明气球垂直上升约1.5米，气球内部的金色小鱼化成一个直径2厘米的金色光点，从气球右侧穿出。

25至30秒，镜头以连续运动升高到离地6米，镜头向下倾斜约35度，仍保持斑马线中轴和女主位于画面中央。女主站在原地抬头，透明伞从高处看是完整圆形。金色光点沿画面右上方飞出，在29秒时熄灭。30秒停在女主与斑马线的高位全景，不黑场。

全片保持女主脸部、耳钉、发型、服装、身高、雨伞结构和左右手分工连续。禁止女主换脸、换装、换手持伞、雨伞伞骨增减、红色气球复制、透明气球尺寸变化、金鱼出现在气球外、人物穿模、汽车穿过人物、镜头跳轴、突然切镜、字幕、文字、logo和水印。
entries.translated_prompt:
Realistic fantasy short film. The female lead's face strictly follows the close-up, while her body, hairstyle, and clothing strictly follow {{Mixed 1}} full body. She wears only the grey-blue trench coat, white crew-neck top, dark blue jeans, and black ankle boots from the reference image, with silver round stud earrings in her right ear throughout. The transparent umbrella strictly follows {{Mixed 2}} opened, with eight silver ribs, 5mm black piping, a silver center pole, and a black J-shaped handle that must not change. The intersection building positions, crosswalk direction, red traffic light, pink-purple window light, and wet ground reflections strictly follow {{Mixed 3}}.

The lead holds the umbrella in her left hand throughout, always gripping the black J-shaped handle, while her right hand is only for snapping fingers and touching the balloon. The camera is always on the west side of the road shooting east, not crossing the center axis of the crosswalk or jumping the axis. The scene includes about 20 ordinary pedestrians and 6 cars; pedestrian clothing is low-saturation grey, blue, and brown, and must not include the same grey-blue trench coat as the lead. There is only one red balloon, about 35cm in diameter, tied with an 80cm white string.

0-6s: Camera height 1.6m, 35mm lens, stabilizer tracking. Lead enters from bottom center, walking east 4m along the crosswalk at ~0.7m/s. Left hand holds umbrella, right arm swings naturally. Pedestrians and cars pass normally, no new raindrops, ambient sound of tires on wet road, footsteps, and distant traffic.

6-10s: Lead stops at crosswalk center, still facing east. Camera moves to ~2m in front and to her right, 50mm medium shot. She raises her right hand and snaps her thumb and middle finger. At the same frame as the snap, all pedestrians, car tires, clothing edges, and water ripples stop moving. A red balloon stops ~1m in front of her right side, 1.6m above ground. Lead, her hair, and trench coat hem move normally.

10-13s: Camera pans right at 0.5m/s, keeping medium shot from waist up. Lead takes three steps toward the balloon, left hand still holding the umbrella. At 13s, she stands to the left of the balloon, right index finger extended, tip ~5cm from balloon surface.

13-16s: Camera continues panning right, no cuts. Lead's right index finger moves forward 5cm to touch the balloon once. A ~3cm diameter transparent area appears at contact, then expands uniformly to the whole balloon in 1.5s. Shape, diameter, and position remain unchanged, only the red rubber material becomes colorless transparent glass. After the change, an ~8cm golden fish appears inside, facing right, waving its tail once. White balloon string remains unchanged.

16-21s: Lead retracts right hand, steps back half a step, looking up at the transparent balloon. Camera stops panning, 50mm medium shot. Balloon, fish, lead, and umbrella positions are continuous; background remains static.

21-25s: Lead snaps fingers again with right hand. At the same frame, pedestrians and cars resume original motion. Transparent balloon rises ~1.5m, the fish inside turns into a 2cm golden light spot and exits from the right side of the balloon.

25-30s: Continuous movement raising camera to 6m, tilting down 35 degrees, keeping crosswalk axis and lead centered. Lead stands looking up, umbrella looks like a perfect circle from above. Golden spot flies out to top right, extinguishing at 29s. Ends on a high-angle panorama of the lead and crosswalk, no fade to black.

Maintain continuity of face, earrings, hair, clothing, height, umbrella structure, and hand roles. Prohibit face swapping, outfit changes, switching umbrella hands, rib changes, balloon duplication, balloon size changes, fish outside balloon, clipping, cars passing through characters, axis jumping, sudden cuts, subtitles, text, logos, or watermarks.

entries.title: Abandoned Amusement Park Storm Sequence
entries.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting an abandoned amusement park at dusk, focusing on a teenage boy and a mysterious girl in a yellow raincoat during a heavy storm.
entries.prompt: 00:00–00:03 — Wide cinematic shot of an abandoned amusement park at dusk. Dark storm clouds roll in fast. A teenage boy in a red jacket walks alone. 00:03–00:06 — Strong wind hits. A loose metal sign swings violently and crashes behind him. He starts running. 00:06–00:09 — He reaches the old carousel and climbs onto a faded wooden horse as heavy rain begins. 00:09–00:12 — Lightning flashes, illuminating the entire park in stark white. The carousel slowly starts turning from the wind. 00:12–00:15 — Rain hammers the metal roof. He holds on tightly as the carousel spins faster. 00:15–00:18 — Another lightning strike reveals a girl in a yellow raincoat standing at the entrance, watching him. 00:18–00:21 — She steps inside the spinning carousel as the storm intensifies. 00:21–00:24 — The boy looks at her. Both stay silent while rain pours and the ride turns. 00:24–00:27 — Camera slowly pushes in to a medium two-shot. Another lightning flash freezes the moment. 00:27–00:30 — Final close-up of their faces as rain streaks down. Atmosphere: eerie, melancholic, charged with quiet tension.

entries.title: Cinematic Running Shoe Ad Sequence
entries.description: A comprehensive 30-second professional ad script for running shoes, featuring multiple environmental transitions like neon nights and glaciers using multimodal references.
entries.prompt:
Generate a 30-second, 16:9, 4K, cinematic professional running shoe ad.

【Reference Material Mapping】
Materials 01–03 are product references for the same pair of silver-white professional running shoes.
Material 01 is used to determine the front-left appearance of the running shoe;
Material 02 is used to determine the rear-right appearance of the running shoe;
Material 03 is used to determine the sole tread, sole thickness, and translucent cushioning structure.
The full film must strictly maintain the following product features:
Silver-white streamlined shoe upper, thin black line Logo, white woven laces, translucent cushioning sole,
dark gray geometric anti-slip tread, fixed upper stitching structure.
Material 04 is only used to determine the environment, lighting and color of the early morning modern city and neon rainy night.
Material 05 is only used to determine the environment, lighting and color of the golden desert and blue glacier.
Material 06 is only used to determine the environment, lighting and color of the white space station and black future arena.
The scene images only control the environment and must not change the running shoe design.
The gray studio background in the product images must not appear in the final footage.

【Global Camera Rules】
The full film adopts a one-shot shot with no visible editing cuts.
The camera is always positioned about 20 cm above the ground,
continuously following mainly from the low angle at the left rear of the running shoe.
The runner always moves forward toward the depth of the frame.
Except for the weightless phase, the motion axis, step frequency and forward direction must not change.
The running movement must conform to the real human motion rules:
Left and right feet land alternately;
The sole produces real compression when contacting the ground;
The sole naturally recovers when the foot lifts off the ground;
Body weight, inertia, friction and landing impact must be credible.

【30-second Timeline】
0–4 seconds: Early Morning City
The camera starts close to the left foot sole.
An athlete wearing the silver-white running shoes shown in materials 01–03
keeps accelerating on the slightly wet asphalt road in the early morning modern city.
The camera moves smoothly backward from the left foot sole to the left rear of both feet,
clearly showing the shoe upper, laces, Logo and translucent sole during running.
The athlete does not show their face, only the legs below the knees and running shoes appear in the frame.
Near the 4th second, the right foot steps forward into a puddle.

4–8 seconds: Neon Rainy Night
When the right foot lands, transparent water splashes fly toward the camera and briefly cover the entire frame.
The camera keeps moving forward without stopping or cutting.
After the water splash dissipates, the same road has continuously transformed into a neon rainy night street.
Wet ground has reflections of red, cyan and yellow lights.
The running shoes continue to run forward, the appearance remains silver-white,
and must not be permanently dyed by neon lights.
Near the 8th second, the left foot lands heavily,
and water droplets fly upward from both sides of the sole.

8–12 seconds: Golden Desert
The flying water droplets gradually turn into golden sand grains in the air.
After the sand grains fall, the wet asphalt road naturally transforms into a golden desert track.
The entire change occurs continuously without hard cuts or dissolves.
The running shoes keep passing through low sand dunes.
A small amount of real dust is generated every time the sole lands,
but the upper structure and color remain unchanged.
Near the 12th second, a cloud of dust rolls from the right side of the frame to the left,
gradually covering the front of the camera.

12–16 seconds: Blue Glacier
The sand grains covering the camera gradually condense into blue-white ice crystals in the air.
After the ice crystals fall, they form a glacier track extending forward.
The running shoes continue to maintain the same moving direction and step frequency.
Slight sliding and ice chips are generated when the sole contacts the ice surface,
then stable grip is restored.
Near the 16th second, the right foot steps heavily on the ice surface.
Radial cracks are generated on the ice surface from the landing point forward.

16–22 seconds: Weightless Space Station
The ice cracks, the camera and the runner fall down together into the crack.
The interior of the ice layer gradually transforms into a bright white space station passage.
This process must show continuous change of spatial structure, no sudden background replacement.
After entering the space station, gravity disappears briefly.
The runner maintains forward body inertia and slowly rotates 180 degrees in the air.
The camera rotates at the same speed and direction as the runner,
the running shoes are always clearly visible.
No extra legs, shoes or body deformation shall appear during the rotation.
Near the 22nd second, gravity inside the space station is restored.
The runner's feet face the track below.

22–27 seconds: Future Arena
The running shoes land accurately on the black mirror arena track.
When landing, the sole compresses first, then naturally recovers,
then immediately enters the final high-speed sprint.
Lights on both sides of the arena light up sequentially as the running shoes move forward.
The ground reflection must correspond to the same pair of running shoes, no wrong mirror images or extra shoes are allowed.
The camera gradually moves from the left rear to the direct side of the running shoe,
but the movement direction remains continuous.

27–30 seconds: Product Freeze Frame
Near the 27th second, the running shoe stops abruptly on the black mirror track.
The sudden stop generates a small amount of water droplets, sand grains and ice crystals.
These particles are suspended briefly around the running shoes,
symbolizing the different worlds passed before.
The camera smoothly orbits around the running shoe for about 90 degrees,
finally stopping at the front-left 45-degree product perspective similar to material 01.
The last frame clearly shows the shoe shape, Logo, laces and translucent sole.

【Visual Style】
High-budget commercial ad;
Photorealistic cinematic photography;
Real product materials;
Controlled high-speed movement;
High contrast but not over-saturated;
Clear, stable, with real sense of weight.
No voiceover, no subtitles, no extra brand copy generated.

【Prohibited Items】
Prohibit shoe shape change;
Prohibit Logo deformation, disappearance or movement;
Prohibit lace quantity and structure change;
Prohibit the translucent sole from becoming a solid sole;
Prohibit left and right foot confusion;
Prohibit running shoe discoloration;
Prohibit extra shoes or legs from appearing;
Prohibit movement direction reversal;
Prohibit sudden hard cuts;
Prohibit environmental materials from permanently attaching to or altering the product design;
Prohibit wrong mirror images, body deformation and unreadable text.

### Storyboard Design

| Time Period | Scene | Core Action | Transition Trigger |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0–4 sec | Early Morning City | Low-angle follow and acceleration | Right foot steps into the puddle |
| 4–8 sec | Neon Rainy Night | Continuous running on wet ground | Water droplets turn into sand grains |
| 8–12 sec | Golden Desert | Pass through low sand dunes | Dust covers the camera |
| 12–16 sec | Blue Glacier | Grip running, ice cracks | Step on and crack the ice surface |
| 16–22 sec | White Space Station | Fall, weightless rotation | Gravity restoration |
| 22–27 sec | Future Arena | Land and do the final spr

entries.title: Elven Warrior Fantasy Action
entries.description: An elaborate cinematic action sequence featuring an elven warrior princess fighting orcs using magical blink abilities in a ruined battlefield.
entries.prompt: Create a 20-second cinematic fantasy action sequence in 16:9 with photorealistic live-action quality, bright natural daylight, sharp HDR detail, and one continuous handheld camera shot. A tall elven warrior princess with platinum-blonde hair, pale freckled skin, pointed ears, icy blue eyes, a delicate silver crown, and elegant silver battle armor fights her way through a ruined battlefield using a single longsword. Keep her appearance completely consistent from beginning to end. Around twenty-four individually designed green-skinned orc warriors attack her one after another from different parts of the environment, each carrying different weapons and wearing noticeably different armor so none of them feel duplicated. Instead of standing around waiting, every enemy should charge, defend, dodge, block, or attempt a counterattack. The princess moves between opponents through a magical blink ability: a brief silver-white burst surrounds her, she disappears completely, the camera keeps physically moving through the visible battlefield, and another small burst reveals her near the next attacker already positioned to strike. Never show her traveling between those points. Keep the camera close to the action, naturally following, circling, backing away, lowering, rising, and moving around rubble without cuts, sudden resets, whip pans, or impossible camera jumps. Her sword fighting should constantly change between powerful diagonal cuts, horizontal counters, rising slashes, overhead attacks, direct thrusts, reverse cuts, spinning finishes, parries, and quick evasive strikes, with no obvious repeated move back-to-back. Each exchange must involve only one opponent, with a clearly readable sword impact and that enemy falling before attention shifts to the next one; no single attack should defeat several enemies at once. Begin slightly wider as she enters the battlefield, gradually bring the camera closer as the pace increases, and make the final few seconds the fastest and most intense. The last opponent is a huge armored orc commander carrying a heavy cleaver. He swings aggressively, she narrowly avoids it and disappears in a bright silver flash, then reappears behind him and delivers one clean overhead finishing strike before he collapses. End with the princess standing among the defeated warriors as dust and loose fabric settle around her. Keep faces, armor, hair, sword edges, debris, particles, and environmental textures extremely crisp throughout with no motion blur. Use realistic sword sounds, armor impacts, footsteps, magical flash cracks, individual enemy reactions, battlefield ambience, and rising cinematic percussion, with no dialogue, captions, subtitles, duplicated characters, morphing anatomy, extra limbs, soft focus, hidden edits, camera teleportation, or night lighting.

entries.title: Olympic Table Tennis Kung Fu Duel
entries.description: A cinematic and highly technical prompt for Seedance 2.5 that blends an Olympic table tennis match with the high-speed choreography of a Hong Kong kung fu film.
entries.prompt: 卓球・オリンピック決勝 × カンフー映画の高速バトル 【SUMMARY】 10 seconds, 16:9. The final point of an Olympic table tennis final, shot like a Hong Kong kung fu duel. Two players, one ball, a dark arena, one column of light on the table. Real time on every impact, deep slow motion between, one burst of pure hyper-speed. 【SET】 A packed arena, the crowd sunk into near-blackness — silhouettes and tiny out-of-focus highlights. A hard column of white light falls onto a dark blue table with crisp white lines. Fine dust drifts inside the beams. Extremely realistic physical texture: paddle rubber, sweat-soaked fabric, the matte ball. High contrast, deep shadow, hard rim light from above and behind, shallow depth of field around f/2.0. A physical LED scoreboard hangs in the darkness behind the table, orange digits reading 10 - 10, sharp and correctly formed, never changing. It is the only lettering in the film. 【PLAYERS — two people, never more】 RED: a 24-year-old East Asian man, lean, heavy shoulders and forearms. Cropped black hair soaked to his forehead. Sharp narrow eyes, high cheekbones, hard jaw. Cool-toned skin with real pores, wet with sweat. Plain solid red sleeveless shirt, plain black shorts, no logo or number. The aggressor. BLUE: a 26-year-old East Asian man, taller and rangier. Longer black hair pushed back, dripping. Thick brows, square jaw, steady unblinking stare. Warm-toned skin with real pores. Plain solid blue sleeveless shirt, plain black shorts, no logo or number. The counter-puncher. Neither shows fear: two masters at the end of a long duel, calm and spent. The violence is in the ball, not their faces. 【TIMELINE】 0.0-2.5s SERVE — deep slow motion. RED tosses the ball straight up. It climbs through the light, turning slowly, dust around it. He exhales, drops his shoulder, loads his arm. At 2.2s he strikes: real time snaps in and the ball tears out of frame. Camera: low angle just above the table surface, looking up past the net. Locked off. Audio: near silence — his breath, shoes creaking, a low hush. Then one sharp crack. 2.5-4.3s HYPER-SPEED RALLY — no slow motion at all, the fastest passage in the film. Fourteen exchanges in under two seconds, faster than any real rally. The ball stops reading as an object and becomes a white streak cutting a line through the dust. Paddle arms blur into afterimages, shoulders whip, feet smear. Sweat is thrown off both men in sheets. The table shudders. Camera: side-on at net height, one smooth horizontal slide along the table — the camera stays calm while everything inside the frame is violent. Audio: the cracks run together into a hard stutter like a drum roll, over squealing shoes and a rising crowd. 4.3-5.5s THE BREATH — the speed drops out. One exchange stretched into deep slow motion. RED drives the ball low across the net, sweat lifting off his forearm and floating, dust turning around the ball. BLUE's eyes track it. At 5.4s his paddle meets it and real time cracks back in. Camera: the same side-on slide, now crawling. Audio: everything falls to a muffled rumble and one long breath, then the crack. 5.5-8.0s THE ANSWER — the deepest slow motion in the film. BLUE pushes off the floor and leaps sideways, body fully extended, back arched, paddle arm cocked behind his head. He hangs there. Sweat droplets float around him. Dust turns in the beam. His eyes lock on the ball. At 7.8s the paddle connects and real time slams back with the loudest crack yet. Camera: low angle, looking steeply up at him against the black arena roof. Locked off. Audio: sound drops muffled and distant while he hangs, then the crack at full volume. 8.0-10.0s THE POINT — real time. The ball skips off the far corner and away into the dark. RED is caught frozen mid-reach, unable to follow it. BLUE lands hard, skids on one foot, and roars, head back, fists clenched. Behind them the crowd erupts, thousands of silhouettes rising at once. Camera: wide on the table and both men, pushing in 5% at most. Hold to the last frame. Audio: the crowd explodes, his roar cutting through it, the ball still bouncing underneath. 【RECAP — all 10 seconds】 Dark arena, one hard column of light on the dark blue table, drifting dust, a near-black crowd of silhouettes. Only two people in frame. Their faces, hair and clothing stay identical in every shot, every garment a single solid colour with no logo, number or pattern. One camera movement per shot, never two. Hard clean cuts on impact. The ball stays inside the frame at all times. Real time on every impact, deep slow motion between, switching instantly, with one sustained hyper-speed burst where the ball is a streak. The scoreboard reads 10 - 10 and never changes, and it is the only lettering. The sound is the ball, the shoes, the breathing and the crowd — keep the mix free of music and commentary.

Camera: wide on the table and both men, pushing in 5% at most. Hold to the last frame. Audio: the crowd explodes, his roar cutting through it, the ball still bouncing underneath. 【RECAP — all 10 seconds】 Dark arena, one hard column of light on the dark blue table, drifting dust, a near-black crowd of silhouettes. Only two people in frame. Their faces, hair and clothing stay identical in every shot, every garment a single solid colour with no logo, number or pattern. One camera movement per shot, never two. Hard clean cuts on impact. The ball stays inside the frame at all times. Real time on every impact, deep slow motion between, switching instantly, with one sustained hyper-speed burst where the ball is a streak. The scoreboard reads 10 - 10 and never changes, and it is the only lettering. The sound is the ball, the shoes, the breathing and the crowd — keep the mix free of music and commentary.

entries.title: Frozen Time Diner Sequence
entries.description: A complex, multi-stage storyboard prompt for a frozen-time sequence in a 90s diner, detailing character consistency and complex object physics.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic 1990s American diner, red vinyl booths, neon signs, chrome details, checkerboard floor, soft natural window light mixed with warm practicals, subtle handheld texture, rich lived-in period detail, heavy film grain. Shot with modern realism and precise temporal control.

Use the provided reference image as the exact character lock for the bald bearded man in black sunglasses and dark hoodie. Maintain perfect facial structure, beard, head shape, skin texture and clothing consistency at all times.

0-5s: [Medium Wide] The bald man sits in a red vinyl booth. He stands up, turns, and collides hard into a waitress carrying a full breakfast tray (eggs, bacon, toast, coffee pot). Impact is sudden and physical.

5-12s: [Dynamic Tracking into Super Slow-Motion] Collision detonates. Tray, plate, eggs, bacon strips and coffee pot explode upward. Coffee erupts into long liquid ribbons and perfect suspended droplets. Camera orbits smoothly around the impact. Time locks completely at the peak of the spill. Every face freezes in pure shock. Only the bald man remains free to move. He freezes for one beat with a clear “I fucked up” expression, then quickly grabs two bacon strips and a fried egg from the floating debris.

12-22s: [Tracking Shot] Still inside the frozen diner, he walks toward the exit door while taking deliberate bites of bacon then egg. All patrons, waitress and flying food stay perfectly suspended in mid-air.

22-27s: [Medium Shot] Just as he reaches the door and is about to push it open, time snaps back to normal speed. Everything that was floating crashes down at once — plates, eggs, bacon, tray and coffee slam onto the floor with a loud chaotic impact. The waitress and patrons react in sudden real-time shock.

27-30s: [Medium Close-Up] He pauses, turns slightly, raises his eyebrows and gives a small casual “it is what it is” shrug with a quiet half-smile of acceptance, still holding the remaining food.

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed fluid and object physics, perfect volume and surface tension on liquids, sharp motion blur only on moving elements, stable character, cinematic lighting, heavy natural film grain, no artifacts, movie-level temporal coherence, high rewatch value.

entries.title: Action-Comedy Monster Wrestling Script
entries.description: A detailed, cinematic action-comedy script prompt featuring a man wrestling a creature while another character tests wardrobe outfits in the background.
entries.prompt:
Use the supplied image as the exact opening frame and primary visual reference. Preserve the man, the enormous creature, the blonde woman, the warehouse, the creature’s torn “2.5” clothing, facial identities, proportions, wardrobe details, and realistic natural lighting.

Create a polished live-action action-comedy scene. The man continues wrestling the huge creature at close range, desperately holding its throat and shoulders as it growls, twists, shoves, and tries to overpower him. Their struggle must feel heavy, physical, and dangerous, with believable weight and stable anatomy.

0–5 seconds: The creature forces the man backward while he strains to contain it. Without looking away from the monster, the man urgently shouts in a strained American male voice:

MAN: “Flamethrower girl, can you help me with 2.5 over here?”

5–14 seconds: In the background, the blonde woman remains surprisingly calm and distracted. She is testing reference outfits, briefly holding different jackets, accessories, and costume pieces against herself, comparing them and turning slightly as though deciding what looks best. Use clean, seamless wardrobe-reference transitions without changing her face, body, tattoos, or location. She answers in a natural 24-year-old American female voice, mildly annoyed:

WOMAN: “Tim, you said I could demo references for this video!”

Meanwhile, the foreground fight continues uninterrupted. The creature swings one huge arm, the man ducks and struggles to keep his grip.

14–20 seconds: The creature nearly throws the man aside. He braces himself, grimaces toward the woman for one instant, then screams with panicked frustration:

MAN: “I CHANGED MY MIND!”

The monster roars and surges forward as the man desperately wrestles it back. End during the active struggle.

CAMERA: One coherent cinematic shot with subtle professional handheld movement and restrained natural shake from the impact. Keep the woman clearly visible in the background while prioritizing the foreground fight. No cuts to unrelated angles.

SOUND: Natural warehouse ambience, boots scraping, fabric pulling, heavy impacts, strained breathing, creature growls and roars. Dialogue must be clean, correctly assigned, and fully completed. No music.

QUALITY: Photorealistic live action, natural performances, realistic physical contact, stable faces, consistent character identity, accurate lip synchronization, believable motion blur, professional action choreography. No duplicated people, extra limbs, warped hands, body morphing, disappearing characters, costume contamination, subtitles, captions, logos, or added text.

entries.title: Medieval Market Time Freeze Shot
entries.description: An ultra-realistic scene in a medieval market where a traveler gestures to freeze time for everyone and everything else in the environment.
entries.prompt:
ultra-realistic medieval market scene in daylight, filmed as one smooth continuous Steadicam shot.

A confident medieval traveler wearing a rough brown wool tunic, leather belt and worn boots walks slowly through a small village market. Around him are simple wooden stalls, baskets of apples, bread, cloth awnings, two chickens and one calm donkey beside a cart. A few villagers move naturally in the background.

After several seconds, the traveler makes a small hand gesture. The entire market suddenly becomes perfectly motionless, like a paused film. Villagers stop in place, the chickens become astill, the donkey stops moving, cloth awnings stop in the wind.

The traveler remains the only moving person. He calmly walks through the paused market, takes one apple from a wooden basket, bites it, places a crooked loaf of bread upright, lifts a coin from a merchant’s table, examines it, then returns it exactly where it was. He gently rotates a hanging wooden sign so it faces forward, walks past the motionless donkey, and smiles at the strange frozen scene.

The camera keeps moving backward in front of him, then slowly circles to his side and finishes with a close-up as he walks toward the lens, eating the apple.

Natural medieval textures, realistic stone, wood, mud and fabric, stable anatomy, realistic animals, coherent background figures, subtle film grain, no dialogue, no logos, no readable text, no floating objects, no cuts.

entries.title: Vintage Western Comedic Duel
entries.description: A highly structured 15-second script for Seedance 2.5 that uses spatial continuity and character traits to create a comedic Western duel between two cowboys.
entries.prompt:
15-second vintage Western duel with exactly TWO cowboys, in ONE continuous location and ONE continuous timeline.

CRITICAL SPATIAL AND CHARACTER CONTINUITY:

Cowboy A is the terrifying scar-faced cowboy. Cowboy B is the harmless, dim-witted cowboy. After they turn around, Cowboy A must remain on SCREEN LEFT, facing RIGHT. Cowboy B must remain on SCREEN RIGHT, facing LEFT. They stand approximately eight meters apart, directly facing each other from opposite sides of the street. They must NEVER stand side by side after the opening moment. They never cross positions. Maintain the same left-to-right duel axis and obey the 180-degree camera rule in every shot.

Each cowboy owns exactly ONE revolver and exactly ONE hip holster. Cowboy A has one revolver in his right-side holster. Cowboy B has one revolver in his right-side holster. Neither cowboy has a second weapon, a second holster, a backup gun or a rifle. Their left hands remain empty. After a revolver is drawn, its original holster is visibly empty.

0–4 SECONDS — ESTABLISH AND LOCK THE DUEL AXIS:

One symmetrical wide profile shot of an empty, dusty frontier street. The two cowboys begin back-to-back at the exact center of the street. Cowboy A walks three steps toward screen left. Cowboy B walks three steps toward screen right. They stop simultaneously and pivot inward to face each other.

End this beat with Cowboy A firmly positioned on screen left looking right, and Cowboy B firmly positioned on screen right looking left. They are separated by eight meters of empty street. Do not place them beside each other.

4–7 SECONDS — CONTROLLED TENSION INSERTS:

Use only three short cuts while preserving the established orientation:

1. Extreme close-up of Cowboy A’s scarred face on the left side of the composition, his eyes looking toward screen right.
2. Extreme close-up of Cowboy B’s nervous, foolish face on the right side of the composition, his eyes looking toward screen left.
3. Matching close-ups of their right hands hovering above their single holstered revolvers.

Then show a clean vertical split-screen containing ONLY their faces. Cowboy A occupies the left half and looks inward toward the right. Cowboy B occupies the right half and looks inward toward the left. Their gazes meet across the center dividing line. No full bodies and no weapons appear during the split-screen shot.

7–15 SECONDS — COMEDIC ENDING:

Cowboy B, still on screen right, panics and throws his ONE revolver from right to left toward Cowboy A. Cowboy B’s right hand becomes completely empty. The thrown revolver lands in the dirt one meter in front of Cowboy A; Cowboy A does NOT catch it and does NOT pick it up.

Cowboy B turns away and runs off toward the far right edge of the street, nearly losing his hat.

entries.title: Cinematic Cooking Survival Show Video Prompt
entries.description: A sophisticated multi-scene prompt for Seedance 2.5 that creates a dramatic cooking competition sequence, focusing on cinematic lighting, detailed food preparation close-ups, and judge reactions.
entries.prompt:
한국 요리 경연 프로그램 결승전, 무대 입장부터 심사와 판정까지. 방송 쇼 멀티캠, 어두운 무대에 빛기둥만 떨어지는 조명, 선명한 4K 방송 화질, 약간의 손떨림.

넓고 텅 빈 어두운 스튜디오. 검은 바닥과 검은 벽. 안쪽 끝에 사람 키의 몇 배나 되는 거대한 양문이 있고 그 뒤에서 흰빛이 새어 나온다. 문턱 없이 평평한 바닥이 문 앞에서 무대 앞쪽까지 그대로 이어지고, 무대 앞쪽 긴 심사대 위로만 빛이 쏟아진다. 뒤쪽은 어둠에 잠겨 있다. 옅은 안개가 깔려 빛줄기가 눈에 보인다.

요리: 큼직한 흰 도자기 접시를 가득 채운 간장 갈비찜. 심사위원 셋이 이 한 접시를 나눠 먹는다. 짧게 자른 갈비 대여섯 대가 뼈를 드러낸 채 수북이 쌓여 있고 두툼한 살이 뼈에 붙어 있다. 짙은 갈색 소스가 윤기 나게 덮이고 사이사이 통밤과 대추, 어슷 썬 당근이 박혀 있다. 김이 계속 피어오른다.

카트: 요리 경연 프로그램에서 요리를 실어 나르는 고급 스테인리스 서빙 카트. 허리 높이에 위아래 두 칸 선반이고 상판은 거울처럼 닦여 조명이 길게 미끄러진다. 한쪽 끝에 세로로 선 U자 손잡이가 달려 있고 셰프가 두 손으로 잡고 민다. 네 귀퉁이에 작은 검은 캐스터 바퀴. 위 칸 한가운데에 요리 접시가 은색 돔 뚜껑에 덮여 놓이고 뚜껑 틈으로 김이 새어 나온다. 아래 칸은 비어 있다.

인물: 첨부한 캐릭터 시트를 이 여성의 유일한 시각 기준으로 삼는다. 얼굴·머리·옷차림을 사진 그대로 유지하고 조금도 바꾸지 않는다. 이십 대 후반 여성 셰프, 표정이 굳어 있다. 셰프는 요리를 심사대에 올린 뒤 건너편에 선 채 지켜보기만 하고 요리에는 손대지 않는다. 먹는 사람은 심사위원 셋뿐이다. 심사대에 왼쪽부터 오십 대 남자, 사십 대 여자, 삼십 대 남자 순으로 나란히 앉아 있고 맛보는 순서도 왼쪽부터다. 셋 다 어두운 정장 차림이다. 처음에는 표정이 없다가 한 입 먹은 뒤부터 얼굴이 살아난다.

소리: 입장에서 웅장한 오케스트라가 터져 나왔다가 낮은 현악 지속음으로 가라앉아 긴장을 끌고 간다. 타임락마다 굵은 북 한 방. 판정 대사 직전 음악이 뚝 끊겼다가, 대사가 끝나는 순간 금관과 팀파니가 터진다. 저음이 두꺼운 오케스트라.

0~1.5초 [정면 로우앵글 와이드] 바닥 가까이에서 문을 올려다본다. 어둠 속에서 거대한 양문이 갈라지며 흰빛이 세로로 벌어져 바닥에 긴 빛줄기를 낸다. 그 한가운데에 카트를 잡은 셰프의 검은 실루엣이 서 있다.

1.5~4초 [측면 트래킹에서 정면으로 도는 로우앵글] 카메라가 옆에 붙어 걸음 속도에 맞춰 나란히 따라간다. 화면을 가로지르는 옆모습 — 두 팔이 카트 손잡이를 잡고 은색 뚜껑 가장자리가 번뜩이며 역광이 윤곽선을 하얗게 그린다. 카메라가 앞으로 돌아 들어가는 사이 카트가 무대 앞쪽 빛 속으로 들어서고, 빛이 얼굴에 닿아 이목구비가 드러난다. 카트를 세우고 정면을 본다.

4~8초 [미디엄 투샷] 셰프가 카트 위의 접시를 들어 심사대 가운데에 내려놓고 은색 뚜껑을 들어 올린다. 김이 조명 속으로 뭉텅 피어오른다. 뚜껑을 든 채 한 걸음 물러나 건너편에 선다. 심사위원 셋이 나란히 앉아 접시를 내려다본다. 왼쪽 끝의 오십 대 남자가 눈을 들어 셰프를 본다. "Are you ready for the final challenge?" 셰프가 짧게 "Yes." 그녀의 굳은 얼굴로 빠르게 컷.

8~13초 [로우앵글 + 급속 컷] 왼쪽의 오십 대 남자 심사위원이 젓가락을 넣어 살점을 결대로 찢는다. 살이 두 갈래로 벌어지는 순간 슬로모로 열린다 — 갈라진 결 사이에서 김이 뭉텅 뿜어져 나오고 안쪽 면이 소스에 젖어 번들거린다. 가장 크게 벌어진 지점에서 시간이 잠긴다. 카메라가 갈라진 자리 주위를 궤도로 돈다. 그가 그 조각을 자기 입에 넣고 씹기 시작하는 익스트림 클로즈업 인서트. 건너편에 선 셰프가 지켜본다. 남자는 아무 말도 하지 않는다.

13~17초 [다이내믹 사이드 트래킹] 시간이 다시 흐른다. 접시 한쪽은 이미 파여 살점이 뜯겨 나가 있다. 가운데의 사십 대 여자 심사위원이 숟가락으로 소스를 떠서 접시 위로 기울인다. 슬로모 — 짙은 갈색 소스가 숟가락 끝에서 굵고 느리게 흘러내리다 떨어지는 중간에서 정지. 여자 어깨너머로 급속 컷. 그녀가 소스를 머금은 살점을 젓가락으로 집어 자기 입에 넣고 씹는다. 씹다 말고 눈썹을 들어 올리며 왼쪽의 오십 대 남자를 쳐다본다.

17~21초 [핸드헬드 클로즈 액션] 접시는 이미 절반이 비었고 소스가 사방으로 번져 있다. 오른쪽의 삼십 대 남자 심사위원이 젓가락을 갈비뼈 옆에 대고 살을 옆으로 밀어낸다. 슬로모 — 살이 뼈에서 스르르 밀려나며 결이 층층이 갈라지고 김이 새어 나온다. 뼈가 하얗게 드러나는 순간 정지. 카메라가 밀고 들어가 드러난 뼈 주위를 돈다. 그가 그 조각을 집어 입에 넣고 씹으며 눈이 살짝 커진다.

21~26초 [미디엄 클로즈업] 접시 가장자리를 훑는 짧은 익스트림 클로즈업 — 소스가 검게 졸아붙어 테두리에 눌어 있다. 접시에서 사람으로 하드컷. 왼쪽의 오십 대 남자가 젓가락을 이미 접시 옆에 내려놓은 채 냅킨으로 입가를 닦고 셰프를 똑바로 본다. 그 오른쪽으로 사십 대 여자와 삼십 대 남자도 자리에 앉은 채 그를 본다. 접시는 여전히 반쯤 비고 살이 발린 갈비뼈와 번진 소스가 그대로다. 담담하고 전문가다운 말투. "The seasoning is a little heavy… but this dish, chef… it wins." 셰프의 얼굴로 하드컷 — 참으려다 새어 나오는 작고 절제된 미소.

26~30초 [마지막 익스트림 클로즈업 몽타주] 살점이 뜯겨 나가 파인 자리와 번진 소스 자국의 익스트림 클로즈업. 접
entries.translated_prompt:
Korean cooking competition final, from stage entry to judging and decision. Broadcast show multicam, lighting with only pillars of light falling on a dark stage, vivid 4K broadcast quality, slight camera shake.

A large, empty dark studio. Black floor and black walls. At the far end, there's a huge double door several times human height, and white light leaks from behind it. A flat floor without a threshold leads directly from the door to the front of the stage, and light pours only onto the long judging table at the front of the stage. The back is submerged in darkness. A light mist is present, making the light beams visible.

Cooking: Soy sauce braised short ribs (Galbi-jjim) filling a large white ceramic plate. Three judges share this one plate. Half a dozen short-cut ribs are piled up with bones exposed, and thick meat is attached to the bones. Shiny dark brown sauce covers it, with whole chestnuts, jujubes, and diagonally sliced carrots embedded here and there. Steam continues to rise.

Cart: A high-end stainless steel serving cart used to transport food in a cooking competition program. It has two shelves at waist height, and the top surface is polished like a mirror, with light sliding across it. A U-shaped handle is attached vertically at one end, and the chef holds and pushes it with both hands. Small black caster wheels at the four corners. A serving dish is placed in the center of the top shelf covered with a silver dome lid, and steam leaks through the gap in the lid. The bottom shelf is empty.

Person: Use the attached character sheet as the only visual criteria for this woman. Keep the face, hair, and clothing exactly as in the photo and do not change them at all. A female chef in her late twenties, her expression is stiff. After placing the dish on the judging table, the chef just stands on the opposite side and watches, and does not touch the food. Only the three judges eat. The judges sit in a row from the left: a man in his fifties, a woman in her forties, and a man in his thirties, and the tasting order is also from the left. All three are dressed in dark suits. Initially expressionless, their faces come alive after taking a bite.

Sound: A grand orchestra bursts forth at the entrance, then subsides into a low string drone to maintain tension. A single heavy drum beat at each time lock. The music stops abruptly just before the judging dialogue, then brass and timpani burst out the moment the dialogue ends. An orchestra with thick bass.

0-1.5s [Front Low Angle Wide] Look up at the door from near the floor. In the darkness, the huge double doors split open, and white light spreads vertically, creating a long beam of light on the floor. In the center stands the black silhouette of the chef holding the cart.

1.5-4s [Side Tracking to Front Low Angle] The camera follows closely at walking speed. A profile shot crossing the screen — two arms holding the cart handle, the edge of the silver lid gleaming, and the backlight tracing the outline in white. As the camera moves to the front, the cart enters the light at the front of the stage, and the light hits the face, revealing facial features. Stop the cart and look straight ahead.

4-8s [Medium Two-Shot] The chef picks up the dish from the cart, places it in the middle of the judging table, and lifts the silver lid. Steam billows into the light. Holding the lid, take a step back and stand on the opposite side. The three judges sit in a row and look down at the dish. The man in his fifties at the far left looks up at the chef. "Are you ready for the final challenge?" The chef briefly says "Yes." Quick cut to her stiff face.

8-13s [Low Angle + Rapid Cut] The male judge in his fifties on the left uses chopsticks to tear the meat along the grain. The moment the meat splits in two, it opens in slow motion — steam bursts out between the split grains, and the inner surface is shiny and soaked in sauce. Time locks at the widest point. The camera orbits around the split. Extreme close-up insert of him putting that piece in his mouth and starting to chew. The chef standing on the opposite side watches. The man says nothing.

13-17s [Dynamic Side Tracking] Time flows again. One side of the plate is already hollowed out where meat has been torn off. The female judge in her forties in the middle scoops up sauce with a spoon and tilts it over the plate. Slow motion — dark brown sauce flows thick and slow from the tip of the spoon and stops mid-drop. Rapid cut over the woman's shoulder. She uses chopsticks to pick up a piece of meat soaked in sauce, puts it in her mouth, and chews. While chewing, she raises her eyebrows and looks at the man in his fifties on the left.

17-21s [Handheld Close Action] The plate is already half empty and sauce is spread everywhere. The male judge in his thirties on the right places chopsticks next to a rib and pushes the meat aside. Slow motion — the meat slides smoothly off the bone, the grains splitting in layers and steam leaking out. Stop the moment the bone is revealed white. The camera pushes in and orbits the revealed bone. He picks up that piece, puts it in his mouth, and chews, his eyes slightly widening.

21-26s [Medium Close-up] Short extreme close-up scanning the edge of the plate — the sauce is boiled down black and stuck to the rim. Hard cut from the plate to the people. The man in his fifties on the left has already put his chopsticks down next to the plate, wipes his mouth with a napkin, and looks straight at the chef. To his right, the woman in her forties and the man in his thirties also look at her while sitting in their seats. The plate is still half empty, with the scraped rib bones and smeared sauce remaining. Tone is calm and professional. "The seasoning is a little heavy… but this dish, chef… it wins." Hard cut to the chef's face — a small, restrained smile leaking out as she tries to hold it back.

26-30s [Final Extreme Close-up Montage] Extreme close-up of the hollowed-out area where meat was torn off and the smeared sauce marks. Plate

entries.title: Dog and Cat Motorcycle Vlog
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a humorous video featuring a German Shepherd driving a motorcycle with a cat passenger, including specific camera movements and realistic animal behaviors.
entries.prompt: 15秒，16:9横屏，24fps，连续一镜到底，极度写实的手机纪实视频。镜头始终位于一辆正在行驶的汽车内部，隔着前挡风玻璃向前拍摄，画面底部露出少量仪表台。真实手机自动曝光、对焦呼吸、挡风玻璃反光、轻微灰尘、车辆震动和视频压缩感。  开场第一帧汽车就已经在林荫道路上向前行驶，道路与车道线持续向镜头下方移动，不能静止起步。汽车即将经过一个右侧支路路口。  0–2秒： 汽车正常向前行驶时，一辆蓝黑色宝马BMW G 310 R突然从画面右侧支路快速冲出来，由右向左斜着切过汽车正前方，距离车头很近。摩托车明显带着转弯倾角，然后迅速回正，抢在汽车前面拐入同一条车道继续向前行驶。汽车轻微减速，镜头因刹车产生自然前倾和抖动。  驾驶摩托车的是一只照片级真实的成年德国牧羊犬，直立跨坐驾驶，两只前爪握住车把；后座是一只橘色、黑色、白色毛发清晰稳定的成年三花猫，双只前爪紧紧抱住德牧腰背。德牧和三花猫从侧路冲出时，身体受到转弯离心力影响自然向一侧倾斜，猫因为突然加速而抱得更紧。  2–5.5秒： 宝马摩托车刚切到汽车前方，距离镜头仍然很近。德牧意识到自己突然抢道，立即回头看向挡风玻璃后的司机。  重点表现德牧“非常抱歉、点头哈腰”的讨好状态：德牧耳朵稍微向后转，肩膀缩起，脖子向内收，下巴快速收向胸口，然后重新抬起，连续做三次小幅度低头鞠躬。动作像做错事后不断向司机道歉。  德牧用左前爪暂时稳住车把，右前爪短暂抬到胸前，肉垫朝向汽车司机，做出“抱歉、借过一下”的示意动作；一边回头观察司机，一边缩着肩膀连续点头哈腰，随后赶紧把右前爪放回车把。  低头动作必须真实自然：肩膀先下沉，头部稍后跟随，耳朵和脸部皮毛产生轻微惯性，不要机械点头，不要卡通表演。三花猫被摩托车晃得左右摇摆，立刻收紧双爪抱住德牧，耳朵紧张地竖起。  5.5–11秒： 摩托车在汽车前方继续行驶，汽车保持距离跟拍。德牧重新用两只前爪控制车把，身体直立，偶尔回头看向镜头，再补上一次很轻的歉意低头。三花猫始终抱着德牧后背，身体和尾巴随着车身摆动。  摩托车逐渐出现真实的左右晃动，宝马车架、车轮、悬挂、刹车盘和轮胎运动结构准确；轮胎始终正确接触路面，动物毛发受到行驶气流自然吹动。  11–12.5秒： 摩托车慢慢偏向道路右侧，前轮碰到路沿并冲进草地。德牧慌忙左右修正车把，三花猫紧紧抱住它，但宝马摩托车仍然低速向草地一侧倾倒，侧滑倒在柔软草地旁。  12.5–13.5秒： 德牧和三花猫顺着惯性轻轻滚进草地，没有受伤。德牧迅速撑起身体，三花猫也立刻翻身坐好，动作符合真实动物的骨骼、重量与肌肉发力。  13.5–15秒： 汽车缓慢停到它们旁边。倒下的宝马摩托车位于后方，德牧与三花猫若无其事地并排坐在路沿草地上。德牧耳朵竖起，吐着舌头喘气，用做错事以后装乖的眼神看着镜头，肩膀缩起，最后再快速低头一下表示抱歉。三花猫淡定地舔一下前爪，然后抬头看向镜头。停留一秒，真实、荒诞、好笑地结束。  自然收音：汽车行驶声、轻微刹车声、摩托车发动机声、风声、轮胎摩擦声、车辆倒进草地的闷响、德牧喘气声。无对白、无旁白、无字幕、无背景音乐。
entries.translated_prompt: 15 seconds, 16:9 aspect ratio, 24fps, continuous one-shot, extremely realistic mobile phone documentary video. The camera is always located inside a moving car, shooting forward through the front windshield, with a small amount of the dashboard visible at the bottom of the frame. Real mobile phone auto-exposure, focus breathing, windshield reflections, slight dust, vehicle vibration, and video compression. In the opening frame, the car is already driving forward on a tree-lined road, with the road and lane lines continuously moving down the frame, no static start. The car is about to pass a side road intersection on the right. 0–2 seconds: While the car is driving forward normally, a blue-black BMW G 310 R suddenly rushes out from the side road on the right, cutting diagonally across the front of the car from right to left, very close to the front. The motorcycle clearly has a turning lean angle, then quickly rights itself, and takes the lead in front of the car to continue driving forward in the same lane. The car decelerates slightly, and the camera naturally tilts forward and jitters due to braking. Driving the motorcycle is a photorealistic adult German Shepherd, sitting upright and straddling the bike with both front paws on the handlebars; on the back seat is an adult calico cat with clear and stable orange, black, and white fur, with both front paws tightly hugging the German Shepherd's waist and back. When the German Shepherd and the calico cat rush out from the side road, their bodies naturally lean to one side due to the centrifugal force of the turn, and the cat hugs tighter due to the sudden acceleration. 2–5.5 seconds: The BMW motorcycle has just cut in front of the car and is still very close to the camera. The German Shepherd realizes it has suddenly cut in, and immediately looks back at the driver behind the windshield. Focus on showing the German Shepherd's 'very sorry, bowing and scraping' apologetic state: the ears are turned slightly back, shoulders are shrugged, neck is tucked in, chin is quickly tucked towards the chest, and then raised again, performing three small bows in quick succession. The action is like constantly apologizing to the driver after doing something wrong. The German Shepherd temporarily stabilizes the handlebars with its left front paw, briefly raises its right front paw to its chest, paw pad facing the driver, making a 'sorry, excuse me' gesture; while looking back to observe the driver, it keeps shrugging its shoulders and bowing, then quickly puts its right front paw back on the handlebars. The bowing motion must be natural and realistic: the shoulders sink first, the head follows slightly later, the ears and facial fur produce slight inertia, not a mechanical nod, and not a cartoonish performance. The calico cat sways left and right as the motorcycle wobbles, immediately tightening its paws to hold the German Shepherd, ears pricked up in tension. 5.5–11 seconds: The motorcycle continues to drive in front of the car, and the car keeps its distance to follow. The German Shepherd regains control of the handlebars with both front paws, sits upright, and occasionally looks back at the camera, adding one more slight apologetic nod. The calico cat is always hugging the German Shepherd's back, its body and tail swaying with the bike. The motorcycle gradually exhibits realistic left and right wobbling, with the BMW frame, wheels, suspension, brake discs, and tire movement structures being accurate; the tires always make correct contact with the road surface, and animal fur is naturally blown by the driving airflow. 11–12.5 seconds: The motorcycle slowly veers towards the right side of the road, the front wheel hitting the curb and rushing into the grass. The German Shepherd hurriedly corrects the handlebars left and right, the calico cat hugs it tightly, but the BMW motorcycle still tips over towards the grass at low speed, sliding onto the soft grass. 12.5–13.5 seconds: The German Shepherd and the calico cat roll gently into the grass following inertia, uninjured. The German Shepherd quickly props up its body, and the calico cat also immediately flips over and sits up, with movements following the skeletal, weight, and muscular force of real animals. 13.5–15 seconds: The car slowly stops beside them. The fallen BMW motorcycle is behind them, and the German Shepherd and calico cat are sitting casually side by side on the grass by the roadside. The German Shepherd's ears are pricked, it's panting with its tongue out, looking at the camera with an 'acting cute after doing something wrong' expression, shoulders shrugged, and finally gives one last quick nod to apologize. The calico cat calmly licks a front paw and then looks up at the camera. Hold for one second, ending realistically, absurdly, and hilariously. Natural sound recording: car driving sound, slight braking sound, motorcycle engine sound, wind sound, tire friction sound, the muffled thud of the vehicle falling into the grass, and the German Shepherd's panting. No dialogue, no narration, no subtitles, no background music.

entries.title: Tropical Village Travel Vlog
entries.description: A raw 2000s-style handheld flip-camera vlog following an Indonesian woman through a tropical village, featuring coconut hunting and local interaction.
entries.prompt:
Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, identity, skin tone, and body proportions from @ image1 throughout. Outfit: oversized terracotta linen shirt, dusty burgundy wide-leg trousers, brown leather sandals, small gold hoop earrings, loose natural wavy hair. Authentic Indonesian woman. Late-2000s personal vlog aesthetic. Extremely raw handheld flip-camera footage with heavy camera shake, natural reframing, partial face crops, focus hunting, exposure shifts, warm faded colors, mild digital noise, and authentic home-video imperfections. No posing, no cinematic glamour, no stabilization, no modern color grading.

00:00–00:04 Walking through a peaceful tropical village lined with coconut trees, smiling into the camera. "Today we're hunting for fresh coconuts!"

00:04–00:08 Stops at a small roadside coconut stall where a friendly local vendor expertly chops open a fresh green coconut. She watches with an excited reaction.

00:08–00:12 Takes her first sip of fresh coconut water, smiles brightly, and says, "This is so refreshing!"

00:12–00:16 Sits with local villagers on a wooden bench, chatting, laughing, and enjoying the relaxed atmosphere while holding the coconut.

00:16–00:20 Tries opening another coconut herself using simple tools, struggles playfully, laughs, and the locals cheer and laugh with her.

00:20–00:24 Scoops out the soft coconut flesh with a spoon, tastes it, and gives a happy thumbs-up to the camera.

00:24–00:27 Walks slowly through the village, waving to children and locals while carrying the empty coconut shell.

00:27–00:30 Stops beneath tall coconut trees, turns back toward the camera with a warm smile, waves, and says, "See you in my next adventure. Bye!" before naturally ending the recording.

Natural ambience only: birds, palm leaves rustling, village conversations, coconut chopping sounds, footsteps, breeze, insects, and distant laughter. No background music, subtitles, logos, or watermarks. The footage should feel exactly like a genuine late-2000s handheld flip-camera vacation vlog with authentic human movement and realistic interactions.

entries.title: Modern High-Speed Rail Station Lifestyle Short
entries.description: A detailed video prompt for a realistic lifestyle scene in a modern train station, featuring a woman with a turquoise suitcase, captured in a nostalgic early 2000s MiniDV style with natural handheld movement.
entries.prompt:
模式：T2V。15秒真实生活短片。

主角：成年东亚女性，黑色及肩直发扎成低马尾，额前有自然碎发；明黄色短袖针织Polo衫，衣摆完整塞进浅蓝色高腰直筒牛仔裤，白色低帮运动鞋、浅灰色短袜，小巧银色圆耳钉与银色腕表。无外套、无帽子、无背包、无手提袋、无手机。

唯一道具：20英寸青绿色硬壳拉杆行李箱，圆角长方体，无Logo、无贴纸，黑色双杆拉手始终完全拉出。开场由她右手拉着行李箱在右侧身后拖行；停下时箱体竖直在右腿旁；滑走与被制止时始终竖直，不翻倒、不打开、不变形；结尾由她双手抱住箱体，停在胸腹前。

场景：晴朗白天的现代高铁站候车厅，明亮整洁，不是旧车站。左侧高大玻璃幕墙透进日光，浅灰色石材地面，前方有成排浅蓝灰色候车座椅，顶部是简洁白色灯带和模糊不可读的现代导视。候车厅人流只作为远处模糊背景，不出现其他清晰人物。阳光在地面形成柔和亮区，整体是当代交通枢纽的清爽日常感。

摄影：2000年代初家用MiniDV，朋友在她右后侧边走边随手拍。自然手持晃动、构图不准、人物偶尔偏出画面；事件发生后镜头晚半拍跟上，自动对焦在鞋、行李箱轮子、座椅、地面和脸之间短暂抽动，玻璃幕墙日光造成轻微曝光跳动。低对比、轻微褪色、软细节、数字噪点、自然运动模糊。旧DV只影响拍摄质感，车站环境保持现代。不要稳定器、电影化运镜、精致vlog、广告光；摄影者和DV机不得清晰入镜。

00:00-00:03，她从候车厅通道走向一排空座位，右手拉着青绿色行李箱从右侧身后跟随。朋友边走边拍，镜头先偏低拍到白色运动鞋和行李箱轮子，再迟半拍抬起找到她。

00:03-00:06，她停在座椅前，把行李箱竖直放在右腿旁，右手松开拉杆，准备转身坐下。行李箱因地面轻微坡度自行向前缓慢滑走。她回头发现后眉毛抬起，左脚急忙伸出去想挡住，却没有踩准，箱子从脚尖前继续滑开。

00:06-00:09，她立刻向前快追两步，身体明显前倾、双臂伸开；右手终于抓住完全拉出的黑色拉杆。朋友第一次滑走时还拍偏在座椅，听到她急促脚步才慌忙后退取景。

00:09-00:12，行李箱仍有余势，竖直箱体被拉杆带得向左侧偏转，她的右臂被带直、身体向前一晃，右脚急退一大步，左脚再补一步，双膝弯曲，呈现差点失去平衡但没有倒下的状态。她立刻放开拉杆，双手抱住箱体上半部，把行李箱紧紧固定在胸腹前，终于站稳。朋友此时刚好拍到她抱着箱子、双脚分开的狼狈姿势，并晚开始地短促推近。

00:12-00:15，她慢慢直起身，仍双手抱着行李箱，低头确认箱子不会再跑；听到朋友压低的笑声后，她抬头瞪镜头一眼，随后自己也忍不住笑。镜头下摇到固定在他怀里的青绿色箱体、白色运动鞋和阳光地面，在手持晃动中像误触一样突然黑屏。

声音：候车厅空调低鸣、远处模糊广播、行李箱轮子滚过石材地面的轻响、她快追时的鞋步声、拉杆被抓住的塑料碰撞声、她短促吸气和朋友压低的笑声；远处商店传来极轻微且听不清歌词的来源音乐。无旁白、无字幕、无后期配乐、无夸张音效。

优先级：现代明亮候车厅、青绿色行李箱、主角“走向座位-松手滑走-脚挡失败-快追抓杆-箱体偏转带来失衡-双手抱住站稳”的两级冲突优先。拒绝行李箱翻倒、打开、失控远跑、人物真实摔倒、拥挤人群、人物换装、老旧车站风格和清晰文字。
entries.translated_prompt:
Mode: T2V. 15-second real-life short film.

Protagonist: Adult East Asian female, black shoulder-length straight hair tied in a low ponytail, natural stray hairs on forehead; bright yellow short-sleeved knit Polo shirt, hem fully tucked into light blue high-waisted straight jeans, white low-top sneakers, light gray socks, small silver round stud earrings and a silver wristwatch. No jacket, no hat, no backpack, no handbag, no cell phone.

Only prop: 20-inch turquoise hard-shell rolling suitcase, rounded rectangular prism, no logo, no stickers, black double-rod handle always fully extended. The opening shows her pulling the suitcase behind her to the right; when stopped, the case is vertical next to her right leg; when sliding away or being stopped, it remains vertical, not toppling, opening, or deforming; the end shows her holding the case with both hands in front of her chest and abdomen.

Scene: A modern high-speed railway station waiting hall on a sunny day, bright and tidy, not an old station. Large glass curtain walls on the left let in sunlight, light gray stone floor, rows of light blue-gray waiting seats ahead, simple white light strips and blurry unreadable modern signage at the top. The flow of people in the waiting hall is only a blurry background in the distance, no other clear characters appear. The sunlight forms a soft bright area on the ground, creating a refreshing daily feel of a contemporary transportation hub.

Cinematography: Early 2000s home MiniDV, a friend filming casually while walking behind her to the right. Natural handheld shaking, inaccurate composition, characters occasionally drifting out of frame; the camera follows half a beat late after events happen, autofocus twitches briefly between shoes, suitcase wheels, seats, ground, and face, and sunlight from the glass curtain wall causes slight exposure jumps. Low contrast, slight fading, soft details, digital noise, natural motion blur. The old DV only affects the filming texture, the station environment remains modern. No stabilizers, cinematic camera movements, polished vlogs, or commercial lighting; the photographer and DV camera must not be clearly in the frame.

00:00-00:03, she walks from the waiting hall aisle towards a row of empty seats, pulling the turquoise suitcase behind her on the right. The friend films while walking, the camera first low, catching the white sneakers and suitcase wheels, then raising half a beat late to find her.

00:03-00:06, she stops in front of the seat, places the suitcase vertically beside her right leg, lets go of the handle with her right hand, and prepares to turn and sit down. The suitcase slides forward slowly on its own due to a slight slope in the floor. She looks back and discovers it, eyebrows raised, quickly stretching out her left foot to block it, but misses, the suitcase continuing to slide past her toes.

00:06-00:09, she immediately chases two steps forward, body leaning forward significantly, arms extended; her right hand finally grabs the fully extended black handle. The friend was still filming the seats when it first slid away, hurriedly backing up to capture the scene upon hearing her urgent footsteps.

00:09-00:12, the suitcase still has momentum, the vertical case being pulled to the left by the handle, her right arm straightened, body jerking forward, right foot taking a large step back, left foot following, knees bent, appearing nearly losing balance but not falling. She immediately lets go of the handle, holds the upper part of the case with both hands, and tightly fixes the suitcase in front of her chest and abdomen, finally standing steady. The friend happens to capture her awkward posture holding the box with feet apart, and starts a short zoom-in late.

00:12-00:15, she slowly straightens up, still holding the suitcase with both hands, looking down to confirm it won't run again; hearing the friend's suppressed laughter, she looks up and glares at the camera, then can't help laughing herself. The camera pans down to the turquoise case held in her arms, white sneakers, and sunlit ground, suddenly going black like an accidental touch amidst the handheld shaking.

Sound: Low hum of the waiting hall air conditioning, blurry announcements in the distance, the light sound of suitcase wheels rolling over stone ground, footsteps when she chases, the plastic clatter when the handle is grabbed, her short inhalation and the friend's suppressed laughter; very faint source music with unidentifiable lyrics from a distant shop. No narration, no subtitles, no post-production music, no exaggerated sound effects.

Priority: Modern bright waiting hall, turquoise suitcase, and the two-stage conflict of the protagonist "walking to seat - letting go and sliding - failing to block with foot - chasing and grabbing handle - case turning causing imbalance - holding with both hands to stand steady" take priority. Reject suitcase toppling, opening, running out of control, characters actually falling, crowded people, character outfit changes, old station styles, and clear text.

entries.title: Anime Maid Awakening Comedy Scene
entries.description: A long-form 30-second anime prompt for Seedance 2.5 involving a cold maid, her master, and a comedic sequence ending with a balcony toss.
entries.prompt:
【Seedance 2.5／30秒／4:3／日本語音声/430p]
日本のテレビアニメ風、セルルック、平塗り中心。すっきりした主線、整理された色面、自然で控えめな朝の光。高密度な美麗イラスト調や厚塗りにしない。西洋風の大きな屋敷にある、格式高いご主人様の寝室。早朝。室内には大きな天蓋付きベッド、重厚なカーテン、背の高い両開き窓がある。
登場人物は二人だけ。
画像1は毒舌で冷静沈着な美しいメイド。クラシカルな黒いロング丈のメイド服、白いエプロン、白いメイドキャップ。姿勢がよく、動作は無駄がなく優雅。普段は感情の薄い無表情。声は落ち着いた若い女性の声で、丁寧だが冷淡。
寝起きの画像2のご主人様。画像2をパジャマ姿で。ベッドの中では無防備で、少し甘えた性格。声は眠そうな若い男性の声。
キャラクターの顔、髪型、衣装、体格、配色を全カットで完全に統一する。会話は自然な日本語。台詞に合わせて口を正確に動かす。画面内に字幕、文字、吹き出し、ロゴ、透かしを表示しない。
【0～3秒】
重厚なカーテンと、それをつかむ画像1のメイドの手を極端なクローズアップで映す。
朝の柔らかな日差しが隙間から広がり、画面が明るくなる。カーテンが滑る布の音。遠くから小鳥の声。
【3～6秒】
ベッドで眠っている画像2のご主人様の顔のクローズアップ。
開かれた床まである大きな窓から差し込んだ朝日が, ご主人様の閉じた目元に当たる。まぶしさに眉を寄せ、顔をしかめる。まだ目は開かない。枕に顔を少し埋めようとする。
【6～9秒】
ご主人様のPOV。まぶたがゆっくり開く主観映像。
最初はぼやけていた視界が徐々に鮮明になる。ベッドの横に立ち、こちらを見下ろしている画像1のメイドの全身が、寝床から見上げる低いアングルで見える。朝日がメイドの背後から差し込む。
ご主人様が眠そうに小さくうなる。
ご主人様「う、うーん……」
【9～14秒】
ベッドから画像1のメイドを見上げるローアングルのバストアップ。カメラに向かって話すメイド。
画像1のメイドは背筋を伸ばし、完全な無表情。瞬きも最小限。声は礼儀正しいが、温度の低い事務的な口調。
画像1のメイド「おはようございます、ご主人様」
カット切り替え。
画像1のメイドの斜め横、下からのアップ「朝です。起きてください」
【14～19秒】
ベッドを真上から見下ろす俯瞰ショット。
画像2のご主人様は目を閉じたまま、眠そうな笑顔で甘える。台詞の途中から毛布を引き上げ、最後には頭まで完全に潜り込む。
ご主人様「優しくしてくれたら起きる～」
毛布の中で身体を丸め、起きる気がまったくない。メイドの影がベッドの上に静かに伸びる。
【19～22秒】
画像1のメイドの顔のクローズアップ。
無表情だったメイドが、突然、慈愛に満ちた天使のような美しい微笑みを浮かべる。目を細め、わずかに首を傾ける。背景の朝日が神々しく輝き、ごく控えめなキラキラが現れる。
しかし、その微笑みにはどこか恐ろしい圧がある。声だけは非常に優しい。
画像1のメイド「仕方ありませんね」
台詞の直後、短い不穏な間。
【22～30秒】
テンポよくハードカットして、状況が一変したコミカルなワイドショット。
寝室の外のバルコニー。
画像2のご主人様は毛布で頭の下から足先まで、巨大な巻物のように何重にもグルグル巻きにされている。毛布は2箇所、紐で結ばれている。画像2のご主人様の顔だけが毛布の端から出ている。身体や手足は毛布の中に完全に包まれており、身動きできない。
画像1のメイドは寝室の前のバルコニーに立ち、その毛布巻きのご主人様を両手で頭上高く, 水平に軽々と持ち上げている。両手で毛布の塊を確実をつかみ、窓の外へ放り投げる直前の姿勢。画像1のメイドの姿勢は安定しており、表情は先ほどと同じ天使のような微笑み。動作には一切の迷いがない。
画像2のご主人様は目を大きく見開き, 顔だけを必死に動かして叫ぶ。
ご主人様「ウソです！　起きまーす！」
メイドは笑顔のまま無言。ご主人様を持ち上げた状態で静止し、実際には投げない。
軽快なコメディ調の音楽と、ご主人様の焦った声で締める。最後の一秒は、微笑むメイドと恐怖で青ざめたご主人様の対比がよく分かる構図で止める。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Seedance 2.5 / 30 seconds / 4:3 / Japanese Audio / 430p]
Japanese TV anime style, cel-look, primarily flat colors. Clean outlines, organized color fields, natural and modest morning light. Not high-density beautiful illustration style or thick painting. A prestigious master's bedroom in a large Western-style mansion. Early morning. The room has a large canopy bed, heavy curtains, and tall double-hung windows.
Only two characters.
Image 1 is a beautiful, cold-tempered, sharp-tongued maid. Classical black long maid uniform, white apron, white maid cap. Good posture, efficient and elegant movements. Usually expressionless with little emotion. Voice is a calm young woman's voice, polite but cold.
Image 2 is the master just waking up. Image 2 in pajamas. Vulnerable in bed, slightly spoiled personality. Voice is a sleepy young man's voice.
Face, hairstyle, costume, physique, and color scheme of the characters are completely unified across all cuts. Conversation is natural Japanese. Mouth moves accurately according to the lines. No subtitles, text, speech bubbles, logos, or watermarks in the frame.
[0-3s]
Extreme close-up of heavy curtains and the hand of the maid from Image 1 grabbing them.
Soft morning sunlight spreads through the gap, and the screen brightens. Sound of curtains sliding. Small birds in the distance.
[3-6s]
Close-up of Image 2's face sleeping in bed.
Morning sun shining from the large floor-to-ceiling window hits Image 2's closed eyes. Brows furrowed in glare, grimacing. Eyes don't open yet. Trying to bury face slightly in the pillow.
[6-9s]
Master's POV. Subjective footage of eyelids opening slowly.
The initially blurry vision gradually becomes clear. The full body of the Image 1 maid standing beside the bed looking down is seen from a low angle. Morning sun shines from behind the maid.
Master groans sleepily.
Master: "Ugh, hmmm..."
[9-14s]
Low-angle bust-up shot looking up at Image 1 maid from the bed. Maid talking to the camera.
Image 1 maid has her back straight and is completely expressionless. Minimal blinking. Voice is polite but low-temperature and business-like.
Image 1 maid: "Good morning, Master."
Cut change.
Diagonal side/upward close-up of Image 1 maid: "It is morning. Please wake up."
[14-19s]
Overhead shot looking straight down at the bed.
Image 2 master acts spoiled with a sleepy smile, eyes closed. Pulls up the blanket during the dialogue and eventually dives in completely over his head.
Master: "I'll wake up if you're kind to me~"
Curling up inside the blanket with no intention of waking. Maid's shadow extends quietly over the bed.
[19-22s]
Close-up of Image 1 maid's face.
The previously expressionless maid suddenly wears a beautiful, angelic smile full of affection. Narrows her eyes and tilts her head slightly. Background morning sun shines divinely with subtle sparkles.
However, there is a somehow terrifying pressure in that smile. The voice alone is extremely gentle.
Image 1 maid: "I suppose it can't be helped then."
A short, ominous pause immediately after the line.
[22-30s]
Quick hard cut to a comical wide shot with a completely changed situation.
Balcony outside the bedroom.
Image 2 master is wrapped multiple times in a blanket from head to toe like a giant scroll. The blanket is tied with string in two places. Only Image 2 master's face is poking out. Body and limbs are completely wrapped, unable to move.
Image 1 maid stands on the balcony, holding the blanket-wrapped master high above her head horizontally with ease. Holding the bundle firmly with both hands, in a posture just before throwing him out the window. Maid's posture is stable, with the same angelic smile. No hesitation in movement.
Image 2 master's eyes are wide open, moving only his face desperately as he screams.
Master: "It's a lie! I'm waking up!"
The maid remains silent with a smile. She stays still while holding the master up and does not actually throw him.
Ends with light comedy music and the master's panicked voice. The final second freezes on a composition showing the contrast between the smiling maid and the master pale with fear.

entries.title: First-Person Drifting Car Mountain Run
entries.description: An immersive first-person perspective prompt for a mountain road drifting sequence, focusing on aggressive handling, tire smoke, and realistic cockpit vibration.
entries.prompt: 第一人称视角，拍摄着一辆漂移车攻击山路的过程。需要快速进行转向调整，采取激进的反向操控，调节油门和离合器，后轮会不断打滑，同时实现持续的过度转向。浓重的轮胎烟雾在车后弥漫，悬架在转向过程中会压缩，车身倾斜效果非常真实，驾驶舱的震动也很强烈，头部动作与重力加速度同步，速度感十足，营造出极具沉浸感的赛车体验。
entries.translated_prompt: First-person perspective, filming a drift car attacking a mountain road. Requires rapid steering adjustments, aggressive counter-steering, throttle and clutch modulation, with rear wheels constantly slipping while achieving sustained oversteer. Thick tire smoke billows behind the car, the suspension compresses during turns, and the body lean effect is very realistic. The cockpit vibration is intense, head movements are synchronized with G-forces, providing a strong sense of speed and creating a highly immersive racing experience.

entries.title: Empress Palace Silk Dance
entries.description: A cinematic prompt for a Qing-dynasty palace drama scene, featuring a graceful traditional dance with specific camera movements and a timeline.
entries.prompt:
[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
Opulent Qing-dynasty palace drama television look, shot on ARRI Alexa with warm amber candlelit tones mixed with cool jade accents, refined ceremonial atmosphere. Slow circling crane shots combined with graceful tracking movements, elegant restrained pacing throughout.

[CHARACTERS]
A young elegant woman with an elaborate traditional updo adorned with pearl and jade ornaments, dressed in a flowing pale silk gown with wide draping sleeves, moving with graceful controlled fluidity. Seated nobility and officials in formal Qing-dynasty attire watching intently from surrounding cushioned seats.

[LOCATION]
Grand imperial palace hall with red lacquered pillars, intricate carved wooden screens, warm lantern light glowing against dark polished floors, silk banners hanging from high ceilings.

[TIMELINE]
0-6s: [Wide crane shot descending into the hall] The woman stands center stage in the flowing pale gown, arms raised gracefully as soft instrumental music implied through her poised stillness, seated guests watching with anticipation.

6-12s: [Slow circling tracking shot around her] She begins moving through a series of fluid controlled poses, wide sleeves trailing through the air like wings, jade ornaments catching the lantern light.

12-18s: [Low tracking shot following her sleeve movements] Her long sleeves sweep low and rise again in perfect synchronization with her turning steps, silk fabric rippling elegantly with each motion.

18-24s: [Medium shot capturing a dramatic spin] She executes a graceful spinning turn, sleeves flaring outward in a wide circular arc, expression serene yet intensely focused, seated guests leaning forward in admiration.

24-30s: [Wide pull-back crane shot] She settles into a final elegant pose, sleeves draping gently to the floor, the entire hall falling into a moment of hushed appreciation before quiet approving murmurs ripple through the seated guests.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
