A long straight rooftop service runway of wet, realistic black concrete runs to the vanishing point — aggregate visible, hairline cracks, patched seams, rust bleed from embedded rebar, chipped edge markings glowing faint green. The concrete is heavy, porous, and stained, never plastic. The world is living code: every bullet drags concentric ripple rings and glows pale green, and air grid-lines flash whenever something moves too fast. The protagonist moves faster than all of it, with the poise of a fashion show model. Implied code glow only, no legible characters. Natural skin texture at all times — pores, fine lines, slight asymmetry, no retouching. [SHOT FLOW] [Shot 1|0.00~2.00s] [START] Extreme wide to the horizon. Low camera on the runway. A tiny protagonist stands facing the camera on the wet runway under the green sky. [MAIN EVENT] Silence, only wind. The protagonist takes one step onto the runway. [END] The green sky, wet runway, and tiny protagonist standing. [Shot 2|2.00~4.00s] [START] HARD CUT. Low angle looking up at the protagonist. Green sky behind. [MAIN EVENT] Dozens of bullets appear in a ring around the protagonist, tips inward, dragging green ripple rings. Heavy kick starts. Protagonist lifts chin. [END] Protagonist with chin raised, framed by suspended bullets. [Shot 3|4.00~5.50s] [START] HARD CUT. Fixed wide shot across the runway. Protagonist surrounded by bullets. [MAIN EVENT] Protagonist dashes right and disappears. The bullets plunge into his spot, pulverizing concrete. A wall of shattered concrete and water spray stretches to the right edge. [END] Protagonist gone. Cratered impact, raw concrete, exposed rebar, and debris wall remain. [Shot 4|5.50~7.50s] [START] HARD CUT. Fixed wide shot from above. Swarm of bullets midair. [MAIN EVENT] Protagonist bursts in from the left, sliding in a large arc. Shoes scrape wet concrete, leaving a groove and water fan. He shatters the swarm with a spinning kick. Explosion of glass and concrete. [END] Protagonist frozen in kick follow-through, debris scattering, arc of spray behind. [Shot 5|7.50~9.30s] [START] HARD CUT. Medium shot from beside the protagonist. A single green bullet flies at his face. [MAIN EVENT] He arches his upper body far back. Beat cuts. Only he and the bullet move in slow motion as it grazes just above his face. Water and debris swirl at normal speed. [END] Protagonist arched far back, bullet passing above his face. [Shot 6|9.30~11.30s] [START] HARD CUT. Top-down view. Dozens of bullets close in. [MAIN EVENT] He spins sharply, knocking bullets outward. Deflected bullets shatter. Debris and water spread in a vortex. He drops to one knee. [END] Top-down of protagonist on one knee in a vortex of debris and spray. [Shot 7|11.30~13.50s] [START] HARD CUT. Front medium shot. Hundreds of green bullets fill the air, stopped just in front of him. [MAIN EVENT] Silence. He touches one bullet's tip, then flicks it. All stopped bullets shatter at once like an explosion. Music returns. [END] Protagonist in flick follow-through, storm of fragments. [Shot 8|13.50~15.00s] [START] HARD CUT. High angle wide shot. Runway diagonal. Protagonist in back right. [MAIN EVENT] He dashes diagonally toward the camera, growing larger, dashes past, and exits bottom left. Long diagonal spray trail remains. [END] Protagonist gone. Long diagonal spray trail along the runway. [Shot 9|15.00~15.80s] [START] HARD CUT. Fixed wide shot across the runway. Protagonist on the left. [MAIN EVENT] He dashes right, leaps onto the flooded plaza, and exits right. Wall of water spray remains. [END] Protagonist gone. Spray wall continuing onto the plaza. [Shot 10|15.80~16.80s] [START] HARD CUT. High angle wide shot. Flooded plaza. He slides in from bottom left. [MAIN EVENT] He leans like a skater, sliding fast, weaving in large curves. Camera pans right to follow. Shoes scrape water, plumes explode, a winding trail is left. [END] Protagonist sliding right, winding spray trail behind him. [Shot 11|16.80~17.60s] [START] HARD CUT. Low camera above water. He dashes in from the left. A slab of broken concrete and glass thrusts up diagonally right. [MAIN EVENT] He dashes up the slab like a ramp, leaps high into the sky, and exits top right. [END] Towering slab diagonally right. Protagonist gone. [Shot 12|17.60~18.80s] [START] HARD CUT. Midair side view. Green sky behind. He flies left to right. Slabs thrust up far below. [MAIN EVENT] He twists and backflips. At the peak, he turns slowly, then spins all at once rapidly after passing the peak. [END] Protagonist finishing backflip, descending toward the slab. [Shot 13|18.80~19.60s] [START] HARD CUT. Top-down high above. Slabs thrust up. He descends onto the center slab. [MAIN EVENT] He lands perfectly on the tip on one foot. [END] Top-down of him on one foot on the slab tip, forest of slabs around. [Shot 14|19.60~21.20s] [START] HARD CUT. Fixed wide side view of slabs. He is on the left slab tip. [MAIN EVENT] He leaps to a low slab, then to a tall slab. Concrete bursts on each landing. He leaps down to the plaza and slides far right. Shoes scrape water, spray fans up, he stops in a low stance. [END] Protagonist in low stance right, long groove and spray behind. [Shot 15|21.20~22.20s] [START] HARD CUT. Camera looking up from his feet. He is in a low stance. [MAIN EVENT] A massive raw concrete pillar thrusts up beneath him, carrying him into the green sky. [END] Giant pillar towering into the green sky, him at the tip. [Shot 16|22.20~23.20s] [START] HARD CUT. High above the pillar tip. Him at the tip. Slab forest far below. [MAIN EVENT] He leaps into the sky, straightens, and spins in place. [END] Him spinning high above the slab forest. [Shot 17|23.20~24.20s] [START] HARD CUT. Camera circling him midair. [MAIN EVENT] Spin accelerates, drawing rain and debris into a pale green tornado with him at the core, reaching the ground. [END] Pale green tornado swirling around him, reaching the ground. [Shot 18|24.20~26.00s] [START] HARD CUT. Extreme wide to horizon. Hundreds of pillars. Massive tornado in the middle. [MAIN EVENT] Tornado arcs across the plaza, shattering pillars and sucking fragments in. Ground left perfectly flat and bare. [END] Tornado consuming pillars, flat bare ground spreading behind. [Shot 19|26.00~27.20s] [START] HARD CUT. Wide shot from very far away. Flat bare plaza, only the tornado. [END] Green sky, flat bare ground to horizon. [Shot 20|27.20~30.00s] [START] HARD CUT. High in the sky, wide shot. Tiny protagonist floating in the green sky. Flat plaza far below.

entries.title: Zombie Apocalypse Katana Combat
entries.description: A complex prompt for a 30-second photorealistic action sequence featuring a protagonist with a flaming katana fighting zombies in a post-apocalyptic city, including strict character locking and timeline instructions.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 16:9, 4K photorealistic Hollywood action sequence at 60 FPS, featuring the exact protagonist from @image1 in the established post-apocalyptic environment of @image3.

CHARACTER LOCK: Preserve the protagonist's exact face, hairstyle, beard, skin tone, and body proportions from @image1. He wears the same black hoodie, backwards cap, tan cargo shorts, and sneakers, carrying a katana. No identity changes.

ENVIRONMENT: A devastated city highway with ruined skyscrapers, cracked asphalt, burning cars, a massive concrete overpass, drifting smoke, and golden dust haze.

ENEMIES: Only tattered zombies. No female antagonist, no human warriors, and no additional characters.

TIMELINE:

00:00–00:06 — The protagonist draws his katana as zombies emerge from the smoke. He kicks the first zombie backward and cuts down the next one.

00:06–00:12 — He performs a one-handed cartwheel, lands, and eliminates two approaching zombies with precise sword strikes. Each defeated zombie disintegrates into dark ash.

00:12–00:18 — Near a massive concrete pillar, he ducks beneath a zombie's grasp, strikes it with his sword hilt, and kicks another into the pillar. He ignites his katana with roaring orange flames.

00:18–00:24 — The protagonist charges through the remaining horde, defeating zombies one by one with controlled sword strikes. He leaps, lands on one knee, and unleashes a fiery X-shaped double slash that eliminates the final group.

00:24–00:30 — He calmly walks through the drifting ash, cuts down the last surviving zombies individually, and finishes alone in the center of the ruined highway, holding his flaming katana.

CAMERA & AUDIO: Cinematic wide shots, readable medium combat shots, controlled tracking, and dramatic close-ups. Maintain consistent screen direction and character identity. Heavy bass music synchronized with sword impacts, zombie growls, fire, and debris.

FINAL CONTROL: Exactly 30 seconds. Preserve the same protagonist throughout. Every zombie must be visibly defeated individually. No female antagonist, no additional enemies, no character transformations, and no unrelated events.

entries.title: Wuxia Sword Fight Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating a realistic wuxia sword fight scene between two female warriors in ancient China. It specifies camera movements, action choreography, and visual style for video generation.
entries.prompt:
基础设定:一段青衣女侠与白衣女侠对剑的画面。两人均一只手持剑,另一只手没有拿任何东西。中式写实武侠动作电影质感,一镜到底完成整段双人对剑,场景在古街对峙,画面仅有两个女侠。全程保持中景到全景,人物始终完整可见,画面中必须同时清楚保留两名剑客的身体姿态、持剑手、步法与两剑之间的距离关系;绝不切换特写,绝不拍脸部特写、手部特写、剑刃特写或火花特写,不使用慢镜头,不使用跳切,不使用定格。镜头以高速跟拍、侧向滑轨、环绕运镜、前冲后拉和轻微升降为主,始终跟随招式推进。动作深度参考中式武侠的剑术设计:剑走身随、腰胯发力、步法抢位、贴剑卸力、虚实变招、进退连贯;强调轻盈、凌厉与真实冲击,形成中式武侠电影中"人随剑走、剑带身转、进退皆有章法"的视觉冲击。完全真人写实质感,中式真人武侠风格,电影感,仅生成音效,不要生成背景音乐。
画面一:青衣女侠从画面左前方疾步切入,前脚点地、后脚发力,身体压低后骤然向上挑起,以轻功般轻盈但有明确起跳力量的斜跃穿过石板地面。她在半空中收膝转胯,剑锋由低至高斜刺白衣女侠肩侧空隙;白衣女侠不与之硬碰,先以极短的侧滑步离开剑线,身体向后微仰,衣摆随避让动作掠开,剑身贴着青衣女侠的剑脊向外一拨,利用贴剑引力令来剑擦身而过。青衣女侠以落地脚为轴继续旋开,剑锋顺势横扫;白衣女侠立即低身,膝盖深屈、上身后倾,从横扫剑线下轻盈避过,同时后手沉腕,将剑尖从低位斜挑向青衣女侠的落脚方向。摄影机从二人斜侧前方高速跟进,保持完整中景,在青衣女侠起跳时略微向上升,在白衣女侠低身闪避时同步下沉,完整保留两人从空中出剑、贴剑卸力、落地转身到低身回击的连续动作。
画面二:白衣女侠借低位挑剑逼迫青衣女侠横移,连续发动三条不同方向的剑线:先是一记由下向上的挑刺,再迅速收剑变为横向削切,最后以前送步贴近,剑尖直取中线。三次进攻必须像一组紧凑连招,方向清楚、节奏递进,不是重复地两剑相撞。青衣女侠先以侧身让过挑刺,随后脚尖轻点地面,身体横向掠开半步,剑锋仅以极小幅度拨开横削;面对最后的直刺,她不后退,而是突然借前脚踏地腾起,做一个短促、轻灵的斜向跃步。她在空中将身体侧卷,白衣女侠的剑锋从青衣女侠腰侧下方穿过,青衣女侠同时翻腕出剑,自上向下压向白衣女侠剑背。白衣女侠迅速向外转肩,将剑抽离而非硬抗,二人剑刃只短暂擦过,迸出极少量细碎火星。镜头沿着白衣女侠连续变招的方向侧向滑动,再围绕二人向内环绕约四分之一圈。
画面三:青衣女侠落地后立即借旋转余势发动反攻。她先做一次低位虚晃,剑尖贴近地面向白衣女侠前脚掠去,引得白衣女侠抬步避让;青衣女侠随即突然收剑、沉肩、转腰,身体完成干净利落的旋身出剑。旋身不是原地展示,而是带着向前切入的步法:前半圈将剑收于身侧蓄力,后半圈借腰胯和肩线将剑锋横斩而出。白衣女侠快速后撤半步,身体后仰,剑锋从其胸前极近处掠过;她在后仰未尽时,以脚尖为支点轻轻旋回,白衣长袖与衣摆形成流畅惯性,剑尖从外侧绕出,反刺青衣女侠转身后的背侧空隙。青衣女侠凭借腰部扭转及时察觉,以背身状态将剑反手横在身后完成盲位格挡。两剑在身侧发生第一次明确重碰,金属撞击短促有力,火花沿剑刃接触点向外飞散,青衣女侠向前滑步卸力,白衣女侠借后撤转身重新回正。
画面四:双方同时抓住彼此剑路回收的瞬间,发动最后一轮连招。青衣女侠向前抢位,先刺上路,白衣女侠侧身避开;青衣女侠立刻变为低位削切,白衣女侠轻跃收腿避让;青衣女侠再以旋身出剑横斩,白衣女侠在落地同时以身体后仰、剑身斜封化开。白衣女侠顺势以一记短促飞踢踢向青衣女侠腰侧,青衣女侠向外撤胯、抬肘护身,以剑格和步法共同让开踢击,随后借退步回弹,重新送出一记直线快剑。白衣女侠此时不再闪避,而是迎上前去,以沉肩、坠肘、转腕完成最后一次坚实格挡。两把剑在双方之间正面猛烈对碰,爆出火星呈短线状向两侧飞散,双剑受力后迅速分开。碰撞必须有冲击感:两人的剑臂被震开,前脚同时滑退半步,衣摆与剑穗因反震而甩动,但没有任何一人倒地、脱手或明显落败。
动作风格要求:深度参考传统中式武侠动作设计,所有攻防都遵循"试探、抢位、格挡、卸力、变招、反击、再平衡"的逻辑;动作凌厉、短促、有爆发力,出剑与收剑都干净利落,强调腰胯驱动、沉肩坠肘、步法换位、剑身引导和真实受力,不要西式击剑姿态,不要杂乱挥砍,不要魔法剑气,不要夸张腾空,不要无意义翻滚。每次格挡都要有剑刃接触、力量转移和后续变招;每次飞踢都要有起跳、闪避、落地和重心恢复;每次旋身出剑都要先蓄势再发力;每次双剑碰撞的火花都要短促、真实、具有金属摩擦质感。画面整体保持紧凑、冷峻、强冲击力的中式武侠电影节奏。
禁止剑气特效,禁止人物变形,禁止多余手臂,禁止武器穿模,禁止动作断裂,禁止杂乱群演,禁止字幕、水印、文字。
entries.translated_prompt:
Basic setting: A scene of a duel between a female warrior in blue robes and a female warrior in white robes. Both hold a sword in one hand, with the other hand empty. Realistic Chinese Wuxia action movie quality, single continuous shot completing the entire dual sword fight, set in an ancient street standoff, only two female warriors in the frame. Maintain medium to full shots throughout, characters always fully visible, clearly preserving both swordsmen's body postures, sword-holding hands, footwork, and the distance between the two swords; no close-ups, no facial/hand/blade/spark close-ups, no slow motion, no jump cuts, no freeze frames. Camera primarily uses high-speed tracking, lateral slider moves, orbiting shots, push-pull, and slight vertical movements, always following the progression of moves. Action depth references traditional Chinese Wuxia swordplay design: sword follows body, waist and hips generate force, footwork for positioning, deflecting by sticking to the blade, mixing feints and real attacks, coherent advance and retreat; emphasize lightness, sharpness, and realistic impact, creating the visual impact of "body follows sword, sword drives body turn, every move has structure" seen in Chinese Wuxia films. Fully photorealistic texture, Chinese live-action Wuxia style, cinematic feel, generate sound effects only, do not generate background music.
Scene 1: The blue-robed warrior enters swiftly from the front-left, stepping on toes, pushing off with back leg, lowering body then suddenly rising, performing a diagonal leap across stone pavement with light but distinct jumping power. Mid-air, she retracts knees and rotates hips, thrusting sword diagonally upward into the gap beside the white-robed warrior's shoulder; the white-robed warrior doesn't clash directly, first sidesteps briefly to exit the sword line, leaning back slightly, robe sweeping aside as she dodges, blade brushing along the incoming sword's spine outward, using stickiness to let the attack graze past. The blue warrior continues spinning on landing foot, sweeping sword horizontally; the white warrior immediately ducks low, deep knee bend, upper body leaning back, lightly avoiding under the horizontal sweep, while sinking wrist to flick sword tip diagonally upward toward the blue warrior's landing spot. Camera tracks fast from diagonal front-side, maintaining full medium shot, rising slightly during blue warrior's jump, sinking simultaneously during white warrior's dodge, preserving continuity from aerial strike, deflection, landing spin, to low counter-attack.
Scene 2: White warrior uses low flick to force blue warrior sideways, launching three consecutive sword lines in different directions: first an upward thrust, then quickly retracting to a horizontal slash, finally closing in with forward step, sword tip aiming at centerline. These three attacks must form a tight combo, clear directions, progressive rhythm, not just repeated clashes. Blue warrior dodges the thrust by turning side, taps toe lightly, slides half-step laterally, parries the slash with minimal amplitude; facing the final direct stab, she doesn't retreat but suddenly pushes off front foot, performing a short, agile diagonal leap. In air, she curls body, white warrior's sword passes under her waist, blue warrior flips wrist, pressing down from above onto white warrior's sword back. White warrior quickly turns shoulder outward, withdrawing sword rather than resisting, blades briefly scrape, emitting few sparks. Camera slides laterally along white warrior's changing attack direction, then orbits inward about a quarter circle around them.
Scene 3: Blue warrior lands and immediately counters using rotation momentum. First, a low feint, sword tip skimming ground towards white warrior's front foot, causing her to lift foot to avoid; blue warrior then suddenly retracts sword, drops shoulder, twists waist, executing a clean spinning strike. Spin isn't static display but carries forward cutting step: first half-circle gathers sword at side for charge, second half-circle uses waist/hips and shoulder line to swing sword horizontally out. White warrior retreats half-step, leans back, sword grazes extremely close to chest; before fully recovering from lean, pivots on toe, long sleeves and robe flowing with inertia, sword tip circles from outside, stabbing backward at blue warrior's exposed back after turn. Blue warrior senses this via waist twist, blocks blindly behind back with reversed grip. Swords collide heavily for first time, metallic clang sharp and powerful, sparks fly from contact point, blue warrior slides forward to absorb force, white warrior uses retreat-turn to reset.
Scene 4: Both seize moment of opponent's sword recovery for final combo. Blue warrior advances, stabs high, white warrior dodges side; blue shifts to low slash, white leaps to avoid; blue spins for horizontal cut, white lands, leans back, seals with angled blade. White warrior follows up with short flying kick to blue's waist, blue withdraws hip, raises elbow to guard, avoids kick with block and footwork, then rebounds from retreat, sending straight fast sword. White warrior now meets it, dropping shoulder, sinking elbow, twisting wrist for final solid block. Swords clash head-on violently, sparks scatter linearly, blades separate quickly due to force. Collision must have impact: arms shaken apart, front feet slide back half-step, robes and tassels whip from recoil, but neither falls, drops weapon, or clearly loses.
Action style requirements: Deep reference to traditional Chinese Wuxia action design, all offense/defense follow logic of "probe, position, block, deflect, change, counter, rebalance"; actions sharp, brief, explosive, draw/strike clean, emphasizing waist/hip drive, sunk shoulders/elbows, footwork swaps, blade guidance, realistic force, no western fencing stance, no messy swings, no magic qi, no exaggerated jumps, no meaningless rolls. Each block needs blade contact, force transfer, subsequent change; each kick needs launch, dodge, land, weight recovery; each spin-strike needs gather then release; each spark collision short, realistic, metallic friction texture. Overall frame maintains tight, cold, high-impact Chinese Wuxia film rhythm.
Prohibit qi effects, character deformation, extra arms, weapon clipping, broken actions, chaotic crowds, subtitles, watermarks, text.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 Flash Frozen Port Escape Prompt
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt for Seedance 2.5 Flash depicting a tense escape from a frozen port with crystalline pillars closing the gate, featuring combat and ship maneuvering.
entries.prompt:
冬の晴れた朝の小さな漁港。陸に上げた古い木の帆船の、固い結び目がほどけない。白いコートの男の手が勝手にほどく。「手が、知っている」。さくらの左肩のシオの殻が海へ灯った瞬間、防波堤の雪が割れて、結晶の柱が同じ間隔で立ち上がり、左右から港の口を閉じはじめる。凍った楔を木槌で叩き割り、船を船台から滑らせて飛び乗る。「乗って!」。男が帆を上げ、閉じていく門へまっすぐ。壁の継ぎ目が六角に開き、柱の先がこちらを向く。

走りながら殻から鎧が組み上がる。壁から槍のように飛び出す柱を、寸前でこぶしと蹴りで砕いて進む。門が船の幅より狭くなり、両腕で受けても押し負ける。振り向くと、舵を握る男。「使え」。両腕を開くと、門が止まり、左右へ押し戻される。船が抜けた直後、後ろで門が閉じきる。静かな外海で、男の手が綱を持ったまま止まる。「これは、どう、結ぶ」。綱が抜けて帆桁が振れ、頭の高さを払う。伏せてかわし、戻りを両手で受け、綱を腕に巻く。「わたしが、持つ」。シオが綱の端をはさむ。水平線の上に、小さな光と細い影。

一緒に旅をしている友達が手持ちで撮った記録。結び目の寄り、船台を滑る船の並走、背中ごしに見る閉じていく門、肩ごしに飛び出してくる柱、舳先の真正面のあおり、港の内側から見る閉じる門、帆桁の真横。曲は変身から門を抜けるまで。
entries.translated_prompt:
A small fishing port on a clear winter morning. The hard knot of an old wooden sailing ship lifted onto land won't come undone. The hand of a man in a white coat unties it automatically. "The hand knows." The moment the shell on Sakura's left shoulder lights up the sea, the snow on the breakwater cracks, and crystal pillars rise at equal intervals, beginning to close the port entrance from both sides. He smashes the frozen wedges with a mallet, slides the ship off the slipway, and leaps aboard. "Get on!" The man raises the sail and heads straight for the closing gate. The wall joints open into hexagons, and the tips of the pillars turn toward him.

Running, armor assembles from the shell. Pillars shoot out like spears from the walls; he advances by smashing them with fists and kicks just in time. The gate becomes narrower than the ship's width; even bracing with both arms, he loses the push. Turning around, he sees the man gripping the helm. "Use it." Opening both arms, the gate stops and is pushed back sideways. Immediately after the ship passes through, the gate closes completely behind it. In the quiet outer sea, the man's hand stops holding the rope. "How do I tie this?" The rope slips, the yardarm swings, sweeping past head height. He ducks to avoid it, catches the return with both hands, and wraps the rope around his arm. "I'll hold it." Shio clamps the end of the rope. On the horizon, a small light and a thin shadow.

Recorded handheld by a friend traveling together.
